And He was certainly good to me when He took me out of prison and brought you [here] from bedouin life after Satan had induced [estrangement] between me and my brothers. Indeed, my Lord is Subtle[619] in what He wills. Indeed, it is He who is the Knowing, the Wise.
en.footnotes:
[618] That of greeting and respect, which was lawful until the time of Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ). Prostration to any person or object other than Allāh was then prohibited conclusively.
[619] Perceptive of unapparent matters within which is benefit to His servants.

so.text: 100. Wuxuuna geeyey labadiisa waalid Carshigiisa, waxayna hortiisa kula dhaceen sujuud [32], wuxuuna yidhi: Aabbow! Kani waa fasirkii riyadaydii hore! Rabbigay wuxuu ka yeelay xaq. Waana i wanaajiyey markuu iga soo saaray xabbiska, idinkana keenay miyiga, kaddib markuu Shaydaan ku abuuray kala fogaansho dhexdeenna aniga iyo walaalahay. Hubaal, Rabbigay waa u Roonaan iyo daryeel Badan yahay cidduu doono. Hubaal waa Isaga wax kasta Ogsoonaha, Xakiimka ah.
so.footnotes: [32].Taasi waa salaan xurmo iyo ciseyn ah, ee bannaaneyd ka hor soo diristii Nabi Muxammad s.c.w. U sujuudidda ama u rukuuca qof ama shey ama cid aan ahayn Alle markaa kaddib waa la mamnuucay.

ayat.arabic: ۞ رَبِّ قَدۡ ءَاتَيۡتَنِي مِنَ ٱلۡمُلۡكِ وَعَلَّمۡتَنِي مِن تَأۡوِيلِ ٱلۡأَحَادِيثِۚ فَاطِرَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ أَنتَ وَلِيِّۦ فِي ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَٱلۡأٓخِرَةِۖ تَوَفَّنِي مُسۡلِمٗا وَأَلۡحِقۡنِي بِٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ

en.text: My Lord, You have given me [something] of sovereignty and taught me of the interpretation of dreams. Creator of the heavens and earth, You are my protector in this world and the Hereafter. Cause me to die a Muslim and join me with the righteous."

so.text: 101. Rabbiyow! Waxaad i siisay xukun, oo i bartay fasirka dhacdooyinka (iyo riyooyinka); Kan (Keliya) ee Aheysiiyow samooyinka iyo arlada! Adigaa ah Gargaaraheyga adduunkan iyo Aakhiradaba ee i oofso anigoo Muslim ah, ina haleeshii kuwa wanaagsan.

ayat.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ مِنۡ أَنۢبَآءِ ٱلۡغَيۡبِ نُوحِيهِ إِلَيۡكَۖ وَمَا كُنتَ لَدَيۡهِمۡ إِذۡ أَجۡمَعُوٓاْ أَمۡرَهُمۡ وَهُمۡ يَمۡكُرُونَ

en.text: That is from the news of the unseen which We reveal, [O Muḥammad], to you. And you were not with them when they put together their plan while they conspired.

so.text: 102. Kani waa wax ka mid ah wararka la xidhiidha waxa qarsoon aan muuqan oo aan kuu waxyoonno (Nabiyow). Ma aad aheyn mid la jooga iyaga markay go’aansadeen arrinkoodii iyagoo abaabulayey shirqoollo.

ayat.arabic: وَمَآ أَكۡثَرُ ٱلنَّاسِ وَلَوۡ حَرَصۡتَ بِمُؤۡمِنِينَ

en.text: And most of the people, although you strive [for it], are not believers.

so.text: 103. Dadka badankiisu ma rumeeyaan (Xaqa) si kastoo aad ugu dadaasho.

ayat.arabic: وَمَا تَسۡـَٔلُهُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرٍۚ إِنۡ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكۡرٞ لِّلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

en.text: And you do not ask of them for it any payment. It is not except a reminder to the worlds.

so.text: 104. Wax abaalgud ahna kuma weydiisatid  (Qur’aan)kani darti; (Qur’aankani) wax kale ma aha aan aheyn waanada Caalamka.

ayat.arabic: وَكَأَيِّن مِّنۡ ءَايَةٖ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ يَمُرُّونَ عَلَيۡهَا وَهُمۡ عَنۡهَا مُعۡرِضُونَ

en.text: And how many a sign within the heavens and earth do they pass over while they, therefrom, are turning away.

so.text: 105. Badanaa waxa calaamo ku sugan samooyinka iyo arlada ay soo maraan iyagoo ka jeedsan.

ayat.arabic: وَمَا يُؤۡمِنُ أَكۡثَرُهُم بِٱللَّهِ إِلَّا وَهُم مُّشۡرِكُونَ

en.text: And most of them believe not in Allāh except while they associate others with Him.

so.text:
106. Badankoodna ma rumeeyaan Alle 
 iyagoo wax la wadaajinaya (cibaadada) maahee oo u shariig yeelaya.

ayat.arabic: أَفَأَمِنُوٓاْ أَن تَأۡتِيَهُمۡ غَٰشِيَةٞ مِّنۡ عَذَابِ ٱللَّهِ أَوۡ تَأۡتِيَهُمُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ بَغۡتَةٗ وَهُمۡ لَا يَشۡعُرُونَ

en.text: Then do they feel secure that there will not come to them an overwhelming [aspect] of the punishment of Allāh or that the Hour will not come upon them suddenly while they do not perceive?

so.text: 107. Ee ma waxay (dadku) ka yihiin aamin inay u timaaddo daboosho Cadaabka Alle ah, ama ugu timaaddo Saacadda (Qiyaame) kedis iyagoon dareemeyn.

ayat.arabic: قُلۡ هَٰذِهِۦ سَبِيلِيٓ أَدۡعُوٓاْ إِلَى ٱللَّهِۚ عَلَىٰ بَصِيرَةٍ أَنَا۠ وَمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَنِيۖ وَسُبۡحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ

en.text: Say, "This is my way; I invite to Allāh with insight, I and those who follow me. And exalted is Allāh; and I am not of those who associate others with Him."

so.text: 108. Dheh: Kani (Islaamka) waa jidkayga; Waxaan ugu baaqaa dadka xagga Alle, Aniga iyo cid kastoo i raacdaba innagoo yaqiinsan oo ku sugan xujo cad. Xurmo oo dhanna waxaa iska leh oo (xumaan) ka Hufan Alle, aniguna ka mid ma ahi mushrikiinta.

ayat.arabic: وَمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مِن قَبۡلِكَ إِلَّا رِجَالٗا نُّوحِيٓ إِلَيۡهِم مِّنۡ أَهۡلِ ٱلۡقُرَىٰٓۗ أَفَلَمۡ يَسِيرُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَيَنظُرُواْ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡۗ وَلَدَارُ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ خَيۡرٞ لِّلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوۡاْۚ أَفَلَا تَعۡقِلُونَ

en.text: And We sent not before you [as messengers] except men to whom We revealed from among the people of cities. So have they[620] not traveled through the earth and observed how was the end of those before them? And the home of the Hereafter is best for those who fear Allāh; then will you not reason?
en.footnotes: [620] Those who deny Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ).

so.text: 109. Ma aanu soo dirin hortaa waxaan ahayn rag ka tirsan dadka magaalooyinka kuwaasoo aan u waxyoonnay. Ee miyeyna [33] marin dhulka oo fiirinin siday aheyd cidhibta kuwii ka horreeyey (ee Xaqa beeniyey)? Daarta Aakhiro baana u khayr badan kuwa ka dhowrsada (shirkiga iyo xumaha). Ee miyeydaan garowsaneyn?
so.footnotes: [33]. Kuwa beeniya Nabi Muxammad s.c.w.

ayat.arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا ٱسۡتَيۡـَٔسَ ٱلرُّسُلُ وَظَنُّوٓاْ أَنَّهُمۡ قَدۡ كُذِبُواْ جَآءَهُمۡ نَصۡرُنَا فَنُجِّيَ مَن نَّشَآءُۖ وَلَا يُرَدُّ بَأۡسُنَا عَنِ ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ

en.text: [They continued] until, when the messengers despaired and were certain that they had been denied, there came to them Our victory, and whoever We willed was saved. And Our punishment cannot be repelled from the people who are criminals.

so.text: 110. Jeer markay Rusushu quustaan oo ya- qiinsadaan in la beeniyey, markaas ayaa waxaa u yimaada gargaarkayaga, oo aan badbaadinnaa ciddaan doonno, lagamana celiyo Baaskayaga qoloda denbiilayaasha ah.

ayat.arabic: لَقَدۡ كَانَ فِي قَصَصِهِمۡ عِبۡرَةٞ لِّأُوْلِي ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِۗ مَا كَانَ حَدِيثٗا يُفۡتَرَىٰ وَلَٰكِن تَصۡدِيقَ ٱلَّذِي بَيۡنَ يَدَيۡهِ وَتَفۡصِيلَ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ وَهُدٗى وَرَحۡمَةٗ لِّقَوۡمٖ يُؤۡمِنُونَ

en.text: There was certainly in their stories a lesson for those of understanding. Never was it [i.e., the Qur’ān] a narration invented, but a confirmation of what was before it and a detailed explanation of all things and guidance and mercy for a people who believe.

so.text: 111. Waxaa dhab ahaan ugu sugan qisooyinkooda cashar ay ku cibrad qaataan wax garadka. Ma aha (Qur’aankani) hadal la been abuurtay, waase rumeyn wixii ka horreeyey (oo Kutub Alle ah), iyo caddeynta wax kasta [34], waana u hanuun iyo naxariis ciddii rumayn (Xaqa).
so.footnotes: [34]. Caqiidada, axkaanta, xalaasha xaaraanta, adaabta iyo debciga san.

ayat.arabic: الٓمٓرۚ تِلۡكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِۗ وَٱلَّذِيٓ أُنزِلَ إِلَيۡكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ ٱلۡحَقُّ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ

en.text: Alif, Lām, Meem, Rā.[622] These are the verses of the Book; and what has been revealed to you from your Lord is the truth, but most of the people do not believe.
en.footnotes: [622] See footnote to 2:1.

so.text:
1. Alif Laam Miim Raa [1].
Kuwakani waa Aayadaha Kitaabka (Qur’aanka), oo (Waxyiga) lagaaga soo dejiyey xagga Rabbigaa waa Xaq, dadka badankiisuse ma rumeeyaan.
so.footnotes: [1]. Eeg sharaxa SuuraddaAl-Baqarah: Aayadda 1.

ayat.arabic: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي رَفَعَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ بِغَيۡرِ عَمَدٖ تَرَوۡنَهَاۖ ثُمَّ ٱسۡتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلۡعَرۡشِۖ وَسَخَّرَ ٱلشَّمۡسَ وَٱلۡقَمَرَۖ كُلّٞ يَجۡرِي لِأَجَلٖ مُّسَمّٗىۚ يُدَبِّرُ ٱلۡأَمۡرَ يُفَصِّلُ ٱلۡأٓيَٰتِ لَعَلَّكُم بِلِقَآءِ رَبِّكُمۡ تُوقِنُونَ

en.text: It is Allāh who erected the heavens without pillars that you [can] see; then He established Himself above the Throne[623] and made subject[624] the sun and the moon, each running [its course] for a specified term. He arranges [each] matter; He details the signs that you may, of the meeting with your Lord, be certain.
en.footnotes:
[623] See footnotes to 2:19 and 7:54.
[624] For the benefit of mankind.

so.text: 2. Alle waa Kan kor yeelay samooyinka tiirar la’aan aad aragtaan, markaas dul ahaaday Carshiga, Wuxuu (idiin) sakhiray qorraxda iyo dayaxa; mid walbaa ku socdo (marriinkiisa) ilaa waqti magacaaban, Wuxuu isku dubbiradaa oo maamulaa arrin walba (ee uunka), ka yeelaa caddaan Aayadaha si aad u yaqiinsataan la kulanka Rabbigiin.

ayat.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي مَدَّ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَجَعَلَ فِيهَا رَوَٰسِيَ وَأَنۡهَٰرٗاۖ وَمِن كُلِّ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ جَعَلَ فِيهَا زَوۡجَيۡنِ ٱثۡنَيۡنِۖ يُغۡشِي ٱلَّيۡلَ ٱلنَّهَارَۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّقَوۡمٖ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ

en.text: And it is He who spread the earth and placed therein firmly set mountains and rivers; and from all of the fruits He made therein two mates; He causes the night to cover the day. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought.

so.text: 3. Alle Waa Kan fidiyey arlada yeelayna dhexdiisa buuro sugan iyo webiyo, midho kastaana ka yeelay dhexdiisa labo nooc, wuxuu ku daboolaa habeenka maaalinta. Hubaal waxaa arrinkani ugu sugan calaamooyin ciddii fekeri.

ayat.arabic: وَفِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ قِطَعٞ مُّتَجَٰوِرَٰتٞ وَجَنَّٰتٞ مِّنۡ أَعۡنَٰبٖ وَزَرۡعٞ وَنَخِيلٞ صِنۡوَانٞ وَغَيۡرُ صِنۡوَانٖ يُسۡقَىٰ بِمَآءٖ وَٰحِدٖ وَنُفَضِّلُ بَعۡضَهَا عَلَىٰ بَعۡضٖ فِي ٱلۡأُكُلِۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّقَوۡمٖ يَعۡقِلُونَ

en.text: And within the land are neighboring plots and gardens of grapevines and crops and palm trees, [growing] several from a root or otherwise,[625] watered with one water; but We make some of them exceed others in [quality of] fruit. Indeed in that are signs for a people who reason.
en.footnotes: [625] i.e., only one from a root.

so.text: 4. Waxaa dhulka ah goosinno isbar bar ah, iyo beero canab ah, haruur iyo geedo timir leh jirrid urursan ay dhowr geed ka soo baxaan iyo kuwo kala tagsan oo geed keliya ka soo baxo halkii jirridba [2], lagana waraabsho biyo isku mid ah, waxaana kaga sare marinnaa qaarkoodba qaar kale (qiimaha) cunnada. Waxaa hubaal arrinkani ugu sugan calaamooyin ciddii fahmi.
so.footnotes: [2]. Mid keliya uu ka soo baxo jirridkii, iyo kuwo halkii jirrid dhowr geed ka soo baxaan.

ayat.arabic: ۞ وَإِن تَعۡجَبۡ فَعَجَبٞ قَوۡلُهُمۡ أَءِذَا كُنَّا تُرَٰبًا أَءِنَّا لَفِي خَلۡقٖ جَدِيدٍۗ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِرَبِّهِمۡۖ وَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلۡأَغۡلَٰلُ فِيٓ أَعۡنَاقِهِمۡۖ وَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِۖ هُمۡ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ

en.text: And if you are astonished,[626] [O Muḥammad] - then astonishing is their saying, "When we are dust, will we indeed be [brought] into a new creation?" Those are the ones who have disbelieved in their Lord, and those will have shackles[627] upon their necks, and those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally.
en.footnotes:
[626] At those who deny resurrection.
[627] Iron collars to which their hands are chained.

so.text: 5. Haddaad yaabtana [3], waxaa yaab ah weedhooda: Ma markaan noqonno carro, miyaa markaas abuur cusub (nala abuuri)? Kuwan weeye kuwa ku gaaloobay Rabbigood, kuwan waxaa ahaan jeebbado luqmahooda korkood [4], waa kuwan ehlu Naarka, iyagoo ku dhex waari weligood.
so.footnotes:
[3]. Aad la yaabban tahay kuwaa beeniya Towxiidka islaamka ee caabuda cid kale aan Alle ahayn. 
[4]. Silsilado bir ah oo gacamahooda lagu xirxiro iyo luqumahooda.

ayat.arabic: وَيَسۡتَعۡجِلُونَكَ بِٱلسَّيِّئَةِ قَبۡلَ ٱلۡحَسَنَةِ وَقَدۡ خَلَتۡ مِن قَبۡلِهِمُ ٱلۡمَثُلَٰتُۗ وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَذُو مَغۡفِرَةٖ لِّلنَّاسِ عَلَىٰ ظُلۡمِهِمۡۖ وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَشَدِيدُ ٱلۡعِقَابِ

en.text: They impatiently urge you to bring about evil before good,[628] while there has already occurred before them similar punishments [to what they demand]. And indeed, your Lord is the possessor of forgiveness for the people despite their wrongdoing, and indeed, your Lord is severe in penalty.
en.footnotes: [628] They said, challenging the Prophet (ﷺ) in ridicule, "Bring on the punishment, if you are truthful," rather than asking for mercy and forgiveness from Allāh.

so.text: 6. Waxay (Nabiyow) ku weydiisan inaad u soo dedejiso xumaan 'Cadaab' [5] halkii wanaagga, waxaana tagay tusaalooyin (ciqaabeed) hortood. Rabbigaa waa u denbi dhaaf badan yahay dadka dulmigooda. Rabbigaana ciqaabkiisu aad buu u Daran yahay.
so.footnotes: [5]. Waxay yidhaahdeen iyagoo ka hor imaanaya Nabiga s.c.w. oo ku jeesjeesaya noo keen ciqaab haddaad run sheegeyso, halkay dalbi lahaayeen naxariista Alle iyo denbi dhaafkiisa.

ayat.arabic: وَيَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَوۡلَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيۡهِ ءَايَةٞ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦٓۗ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُنذِرٞۖ وَلِكُلِّ قَوۡمٍ هَادٍ

en.text: And those who disbelieved say, "Why has a sign not been sent down to him from his Lord?" You are only a warner, and for every people is a guide.

so.text: 7. Kuwa gaalooba waxay yidhaahdaan: Maxaa looga soo dejin waayey calaamo xagga Rabbigi ah? Adigu waxaad tahay oo keliya dige, qolo walbaana waxay leeyihiin hanuuniye.

ayat.arabic: ٱللَّهُ يَعۡلَمُ مَا تَحۡمِلُ كُلُّ أُنثَىٰ وَمَا تَغِيضُ ٱلۡأَرۡحَامُ وَمَا تَزۡدَادُۚ وَكُلُّ شَيۡءٍ عِندَهُۥ بِمِقۡدَارٍ

en.text: Allāh knows what every female carries[629] and what the wombs lose [prematurely] or exceed.[630] And everything with Him is by due measure.
en.footnotes:
[629] With absolute knowledge inclusive of every aspect of the fetus' existence.
[630] Beyond their normal period of pregnancy and/or the number of fetuses therein.

so.text: 8. Alle wuu Og yahay waxay dheddig walbaa uurka ku siddo [6], iyo waxa ilmo galeennadu nusqaamiyaan iyo waxay kororsadaanba [7]. Wax walbaana Alle Agtiisa qaddar (waqti) go’an yuu leeyahay.
so.footnotes:
[6]. Isagoo aqoon dhan u leh wax kastoo ku saabsan ilmahaas uurka ku jira. 
[7]. Dhaafsiisan waqtiga caadiga ee uurka oo ogsoon muddada ilmaha ku jira uurka.

ayat.arabic: عَٰلِمُ ٱلۡغَيۡبِ وَٱلشَّهَٰدَةِ ٱلۡكَبِيرُ ٱلۡمُتَعَالِ

en.text: [He is] Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Grand, the Exalted.

so.text: 9. Waa Ogsoonaha waxa aan muuqan iyo waxa muuqda, waa Weynaha, aad u Sarreeya.

ayat.arabic: سَوَآءٞ مِّنكُم مَّنۡ أَسَرَّ ٱلۡقَوۡلَ وَمَن جَهَرَ بِهِۦ وَمَنۡ هُوَ مُسۡتَخۡفِۭ بِٱلَّيۡلِ وَسَارِبُۢ بِٱلنَّهَارِ

en.text: It is the same [to Him] concerning you whether one conceals [his] speech or publicizes it and whether one is hidden by night or conspicuous [among others] by day.

so.text: 10. Waa isugu mid (Alle) kiinna idinka mid ah ee hadalkiisa qarsada iyo kan kor ugu dhawaaqa, iyo kan isku qariya habeenka iyo (kan) socda dharaar cad.

ayat.arabic: لَهُۥ مُعَقِّبَٰتٞ مِّنۢ بَيۡنِ يَدَيۡهِ وَمِنۡ خَلۡفِهِۦ يَحۡفَظُونَهُۥ مِنۡ أَمۡرِ ٱللَّهِۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُغَيِّرُ مَا بِقَوۡمٍ حَتَّىٰ يُغَيِّرُواْ مَا بِأَنفُسِهِمۡۗ وَإِذَآ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ بِقَوۡمٖ سُوٓءٗا فَلَا مَرَدَّ لَهُۥۚ وَمَا لَهُم مِّن دُونِهِۦ مِن وَالٍ

en.text: For him [i.e., each one] are successive [angels][631] before and behind him who protect him by the decree of Allāh.[632] Indeed, Allāh will not change the condition of a people until they change what is in themselves. And when Allāh intends for a people ill,[633] there is no repelling it. And there is not for them besides Him any patron.
en.footnotes:
[631] Replacing each other by turn.
[632] The phrase may also be rendered "...who guard him from [everything except] the decree of Allāh."
[633] i.e., punishment or destruction because of their sins.

so.text: 11. Wuxuu leeyahay (qof kasta) kuwo is beddela 'malaa’ig' [8], oo hortiisa iyo gadaashiisa ah, kuwaasoo ku ilaaaliya Amarka Alle [9]. Alle ma beddelo xaaladda qolo, jeeray iyagu naf ahaantoodu beddelaan xaaladdooda. Markuu Alle la doonona qolo xumaan, cidna ma baajin karto, mana leh Isaga sokadiis wax u soo gargaari kara.
so.footnotes:
[8]. Iyagoo isku beddela moogaaleysi.
[9]. Waxaa weedhan loo qaadan karaa sidoo kale : kuwaasoo ka ilaaliya wax kasta wixii Alle u qoray oo qaddaray maahee.

ayat.arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِي يُرِيكُمُ ٱلۡبَرۡقَ خَوۡفٗا وَطَمَعٗا وَيُنشِئُ ٱلسَّحَابَ ٱلثِّقَالَ

en.text: It is He who shows you lightning, [causing] fear and aspiration, and generates the heavy clouds.

so.text: 12. Alle Waa Kan idin tusa hillaaca cabsi iyo rajo gelin darteed, iyo (Kan) unka daruuro hogol ah oo biyo la culus.

ayat.arabic: وَيُسَبِّحُ ٱلرَّعۡدُ بِحَمۡدِهِۦ وَٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ مِنۡ خِيفَتِهِۦ وَيُرۡسِلُ ٱلصَّوَٰعِقَ فَيُصِيبُ بِهَا مَن يَشَآءُ وَهُمۡ يُجَٰدِلُونَ فِي ٱللَّهِ وَهُوَ شَدِيدُ ٱلۡمِحَالِ

en.text: And the thunder exalts [Allāh] with praise of Him - and the angels [as well] from fear of Him - and He sends thunderbolts and strikes therewith whom He wills while they dispute about Allāh; and He is severe in assault.

so.text: 13. Wuxuu ku tasbiixsadaa onkodku Xamdiga Alle, malaa’igtuna ka Heybeysigi darteed, Wuxuu soo diraa danabyada oo ku ridaa cidduu doono [10], iyaguna waxay ka doodaan arrinka Alle Isagoo Awood Badan oo Ciqaabkiisu Daran Yahay.
so.footnotes: [10]. Waa ciqaab ama halaagid denbiyadooda dartood.

ayat.arabic: لَهُۥ دَعۡوَةُ ٱلۡحَقِّۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ يَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِهِۦ لَا يَسۡتَجِيبُونَ لَهُم بِشَيۡءٍ إِلَّا كَبَٰسِطِ كَفَّيۡهِ إِلَى ٱلۡمَآءِ لِيَبۡلُغَ فَاهُ وَمَا هُوَ بِبَٰلِغِهِۦۚ وَمَا دُعَآءُ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ إِلَّا فِي ضَلَٰلٖ

en.text: To Him [alone] is the supplication of truth. And those they call upon besides Him do not respond to them with a thing, except as one who stretches his hands toward water [from afar, calling it] to reach his mouth, but it will not reach it [thus].[634] And the supplication of the disbelievers is not but in error [i.e., futility].
en.footnotes: [634] The analogy indicates that false deities will never respond to them at all.

so.text: 14. (Alle keliyaa) mudan Baryada (cibaadada) Xaqa ah. Kuwaana ay baryaan (caabudaan) sokadiisa waxba uma ajiibi karaan, waxayna ka dhigan yihiin mid hore u soo fidsha gacmahiisa xagga biyo ku jira (ceel salki) si ay u soo gaadhaan afkiisa, mana gaadhayaan, baryada (cibaadada) gaaladuna ma aha waxaan aheyn baadil [11].
so.footnotes: [11]. Macnaha waxaa weeye in ilaahyada beenta ah ayan marnaba ajiibin baryadooda.

ayat.arabic: وَلِلَّهِۤ يَسۡجُدُۤ مَن فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ طَوۡعٗا وَكَرۡهٗا وَظِلَٰلُهُم بِٱلۡغُدُوِّ وَٱلۡأٓصَالِ۩

en.text: And to Allāh prostrates whoever is within the heavens and the earth, willingly or by compulsion, and their shadows [as well] in the mornings and the afternoons.

so.text: 15. Waxaa Alle u sujuuda (oo u hoggaan- san) wax kasta oo jira samooyinka iyo arlada iyagoo oggol ama qasban, iyo hoosaskooda aroor kasta iyo galbihiiba.

ayat.arabic: قُلۡ مَن رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ قُلِ ٱللَّهُۚ قُلۡ أَفَٱتَّخَذۡتُم مِّن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوۡلِيَآءَ لَا يَمۡلِكُونَ لِأَنفُسِهِمۡ نَفۡعٗا وَلَا ضَرّٗاۚ قُلۡ هَلۡ يَسۡتَوِي ٱلۡأَعۡمَىٰ وَٱلۡبَصِيرُ أَمۡ هَلۡ تَسۡتَوِي ٱلظُّلُمَٰتُ وَٱلنُّورُۗ أَمۡ جَعَلُواْ لِلَّهِ شُرَكَآءَ خَلَقُواْ كَخَلۡقِهِۦ فَتَشَٰبَهَ ٱلۡخَلۡقُ عَلَيۡهِمۡۚ قُلِ ٱللَّهُ خَٰلِقُ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ وَهُوَ ٱلۡوَٰحِدُ ٱلۡقَهَّٰرُ

en.text: Say, "Who is Lord of the heavens and earth?" Say, "Allāh." Say, "Have you then taken besides Him allies not possessing [even] for themselves any benefit or any harm?" Say, "Is the blind equivalent to the seeing? Or is darkness equivalent to light? Or have they attributed to Allāh partners who created like His creation so that the creation [of each] seemed similar to them?"[635] Say, "Allāh is the Creator of all things, and He is the One, the Prevailing."[636]
en.footnotes:
[635] The obvious conclusion is that the claimed partners, having no ability to create, cannot be compared to Allāh in any way.
[636] Refer to footnotes in 12:39.

so.text:
16. Dheh: Waa kuma Rabbiga samooyinka iyo arlada? Dheh: Allaah. Dheh: Ma waxaad haddaba yeelaneysaan Alle ka sokow 
awliyo (gargaarayaal) kuwaasoo aan u hanan karin wax awood ah ay wax ugu taraan ama wax ku yeelaan nafahooda? Dheh: Miyey siman yihiin kan indhaha la’ iyo kan wax arka? Ama ma sinnaan karaan Mugdiyada iyo Nuurka? Mise waxay la barbar dhigaan Alle shariigyo abuuray wax la mid ah abuurkiisa [12], oo waxaa isaga ekaaday abuurkii? Dheh: Alle waa Abuuraha wax waliba. Waana Waaxidka, Sandulleeyaha (daalimiinta, isla weynayaasha iyo cadowyadiisa).
so.footnotes: [12]. Waxaa halkaas laga qaadanayaa in ilaahyadaa ay sheegeen, ayan awood u lahayn inay wax abuuraan, oo aan la barbar dhigi karin Alle sinnaba.

ayat.arabic: أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءٗ فَسَالَتۡ أَوۡدِيَةُۢ بِقَدَرِهَا فَٱحۡتَمَلَ ٱلسَّيۡلُ زَبَدٗا رَّابِيٗاۖ وَمِمَّا يُوقِدُونَ عَلَيۡهِ فِي ٱلنَّارِ ٱبۡتِغَآءَ حِلۡيَةٍ أَوۡ مَتَٰعٖ زَبَدٞ مِّثۡلُهُۥۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يَضۡرِبُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡحَقَّ وَٱلۡبَٰطِلَۚ فَأَمَّا ٱلزَّبَدُ فَيَذۡهَبُ جُفَآءٗۖ وَأَمَّا مَا يَنفَعُ ٱلنَّاسَ فَيَمۡكُثُ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يَضۡرِبُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡأَمۡثَالَ

en.text: He sends down from the sky, rain, and valleys flow according to their capacity, and the torrent carries a rising foam. And from that [ore] which they heat in the fire, desiring adornments and utensils, is a foam like it. Thus Allāh presents [the example of] truth and falsehood. As for the foam, it vanishes, [being] cast off; but as for that which benefits the people, it remains on the earth. Thus does Allāh present examples.

so.text: 17. Wuxuu (Alle) ka soo dejiyaa biyo daruuraha, markaas bay togaggu qiyaastood (biyo la) durduraan, oo daadku qaadaa xumbada kor sabbaysa, iyo (macdanta) ay dadku dabka gashaan si ay uga sameystaan waxyaalo ay isku qurxiyaan, wuxuu daadku qaadaa sidoo kale alaabo (qashin ahoo) xumbada la mid ah, sidaasuu Alle tusaale ugu kala dhigaa Xaqa iyo Baadilka. Marka ma xumbada iyadu way tagtaa sida waxa aan qiimaha lahayn, waxase u leh nafaca dadku wuxuu ku haraa dhulka. Sidaasuu Alle u yeelaa tusaalayooyinka.

ayat.arabic: لِلَّذِينَ ٱسۡتَجَابُواْ لِرَبِّهِمُ ٱلۡحُسۡنَىٰۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ لَمۡ يَسۡتَجِيبُواْ لَهُۥ لَوۡ أَنَّ لَهُم مَّا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ جَمِيعٗا وَمِثۡلَهُۥ مَعَهُۥ لَٱفۡتَدَوۡاْ بِهِۦٓۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمۡ سُوٓءُ ٱلۡحِسَابِ وَمَأۡوَىٰهُمۡ جَهَنَّمُۖ وَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡمِهَادُ

en.text: For those who have responded to their Lord is the best [reward], but those who did not respond to Him - if they had all that is in the earth entirely and the like of it with it, they would [attempt to] ransom themselves thereby. Those will have the worst account, and their refuge is Hell, and wretched is the resting place.

so.text: 18. Abaal gudka kuwa ajiiba Baaqa Rabbigood (ah inay Alle u Keli yeelaan cibaadada oo raacaan Rasuulka) waa Wanaag (Janno). Kuwase aan ajiibin hadday leeyihiin waxa yaal dhulka oo dhan oo ay wehliso wax la mid ah waxay u bixin lahaayeen madax furasho. Kuwaasi waxay leeyihiin xisaab daran oo xun, hoygooduna waa Jahannama; oo u xun gogol ahaan.

ayat.arabic: ۞ أَفَمَن يَعۡلَمُ أَنَّمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيۡكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ ٱلۡحَقُّ كَمَنۡ هُوَ أَعۡمَىٰٓۚ إِنَّمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ أُوْلُواْ ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ

en.text: Then is he who knows that what has been revealed to you from your Lord is the truth like one who is blind? They will only be reminded who are people of understanding -

so.text: 19. Ma mid og in waxa lagaaga soo dejiyey xagga Rabbigaa uu yahay Xaq baa la mid ah mid ka indha la'? Waase oo keliya dadka wax garadka ah kuwa waansami.

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يُوفُونَ بِعَهۡدِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَا يَنقُضُونَ ٱلۡمِيثَٰقَ

en.text: Those who fulfill the covenant of Allāh and do not break the contract,

so.text: 20. Ee ah kuwa oofiya axdiga Alle, oo aan ka bixin ballanka.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَصِلُونَ مَآ أَمَرَ ٱللَّهُ بِهِۦٓ أَن يُوصَلَ وَيَخۡشَوۡنَ رَبَّهُمۡ وَيَخَافُونَ سُوٓءَ ٱلۡحِسَابِ

en.text: And those who join that which Allāh has ordered to be joined[637] and fear their Lord and are afraid of the evil of [their] account,
en.footnotes: [637] i.e., they uphold the ties of relationship.

so.text: 21. Kuwa xidhiidhiya waxa uu Alle amray in la xidhiidhiyo [13], oo ka baqa Rabbigood, kana cabsada Xisaab Daran.
so.footnotes: [13]. Waa in aad loo ilaaliyo xiriirka qaraabada oo lagu dadaalo wanaajintooda. Nabigu s.c.w. wuxuu yidhi: “Ma galo Jannada qof qaraabo goys ah”.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ صَبَرُواْ ٱبۡتِغَآءَ وَجۡهِ رَبِّهِمۡ وَأَقَامُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَأَنفَقُواْ مِمَّا رَزَقۡنَٰهُمۡ سِرّٗا وَعَلَانِيَةٗ وَيَدۡرَءُونَ بِٱلۡحَسَنَةِ ٱلسَّيِّئَةَ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمۡ عُقۡبَى ٱلدَّارِ

en.text: And those who are patient, seeking the face [i.e., acceptance] of their Lord, and establish prayer and spend from what We have provided for them secretly and publicly and prevent evil with good - those will have the good consequence of [this] home[638] -
en.footnotes: [638] i.e., the world and its trials, its good consequence being Paradise.

so.text: 22. Ee ah kuwa samra (waqtiga shiddada ee ku sugnaada cibaadada) iyagoo doonaya Wajiga Rabbigood, oogana salaadda, oo bixiya wax ka mid ah waxaan ku irzaaqnay qarsoodi iyo caddaanba, kuna qaabila xumaanta samaan, kuwaasi waxay leeyihiin cidhib wanaagsan Daarta Dambe (Aakhirada).

ayat.arabic: جَنَّٰتُ عَدۡنٖ يَدۡخُلُونَهَا وَمَن صَلَحَ مِنۡ ءَابَآئِهِمۡ وَأَزۡوَٰجِهِمۡ وَذُرِّيَّٰتِهِمۡۖ وَٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ يَدۡخُلُونَ عَلَيۡهِم مِّن كُلِّ بَابٖ

en.text: Gardens of perpetual residence; they will enter them with whoever were righteous among their forefathers, their spouses and their descendants. And the angels will enter upon them from every gate, [saying],

so.text: 23. Jannooyinka cadni (negaadi) oo ay galayaan iyaga iyo kuwa wanaagsan ee ka mid ah aabbayaashood iyo xaasaskooda iyo ubadkooda: waxayna Malaa’igtu uga soo geli albaab walba (iyagoo leh):

ayat.arabic: سَلَٰمٌ عَلَيۡكُم بِمَا صَبَرۡتُمۡۚ فَنِعۡمَ عُقۡبَى ٱلدَّارِ

en.text: "Peace [i.e., security] be upon you for what you patiently endured." And excellent is the final home.

so.text: 24. Nabad korkiinna ha ahaato samirka aad yeelateen iyo sugnaashadiinna darteed. Wanaagsanaa Daartaa dambe (ee Jannada).

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَنقُضُونَ عَهۡدَ ٱللَّهِ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مِيثَٰقِهِۦ وَيَقۡطَعُونَ مَآ أَمَرَ ٱللَّهُ بِهِۦٓ أَن يُوصَلَ وَيُفۡسِدُونَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمُ ٱللَّعۡنَةُ وَلَهُمۡ سُوٓءُ ٱلدَّارِ

en.text: But those who break the covenant of Allāh after contracting it and sever that which Allāh has ordered to be joined and spread corruption on earth - for them is the curse, and they will have the worst home.[639]
en.footnotes: [639] i.e., Hell. Another meaning is (in contrast to verse 22), "...and they will have the bad consequence of [this] home," also referring to Hell.

so.text: 25. Kuwase jebiya axdiga Alle kaddib adkayntiisa, oo gooya wuxuu Alle amray in la xidhiidhiyo (oo wanaajiyo, sida qaraabada iyo deriska), oo fasaadiyana dhulka, kuwaas, waxaa u sugnaaday Nacalad, waxayna leeyihiin daarta xun (Naar).

ayat.arabic: ٱللَّهُ يَبۡسُطُ ٱلرِّزۡقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقۡدِرُۚ وَفَرِحُواْ بِٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَمَا ٱلۡحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنۡيَا فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ إِلَّا مَتَٰعٞ

en.text: Allāh extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it]. And they rejoice in the worldly life, while the worldly life is not, compared to the Hereafter, except [brief] enjoyment.

so.text: 26. Alle wuxuu u fidiyaa risiqa qofkuu doono oo ku cidhiidhiyaa (qofkuu doono), waxayna ku farxaan nolosha adduunkan, mana aha nolosha adduunka marka loo eego Aakhirada waxaan ahayn raaxo muddo yar ah oo dhammaaneysa.

ayat.arabic: وَيَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَوۡلَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيۡهِ ءَايَةٞ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦۚ قُلۡ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُضِلُّ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهۡدِيٓ إِلَيۡهِ مَنۡ أَنَابَ

en.text: And those who disbelieved say, "Why has a sign not been sent down to him from his Lord?" Say, [O Muḥammad], "Indeed, Allāh leaves astray whom He wills and guides to Himself whoever turns back [to Him] -

so.text: 27. Kuwa gaalooba waxay yidhaahdaan: Maxaa calaamo (mucjiso) looga soo dejin waayey xagga Rabbigii? (Nabiyow) Dheh: Alle wuxuu dhumiyaa kuu doono oo u soo hanuuniyaa Xaggiisa kuwa u soo laabta (tawbad keena).

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَتَطۡمَئِنُّ قُلُوبُهُم بِذِكۡرِ ٱللَّهِۗ أَلَا بِذِكۡرِ ٱللَّهِ تَطۡمَئِنُّ ٱلۡقُلُوبُ

en.text: Those who have believed and whose hearts are assured by the remembrance of Allāh. Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allāh hearts are assured."

so.text: 28. Ee ah kuwa (Towxiidka) rumeysan oo ay quluubtoodu ku xasisho xusidda Alle.  Ogaada xusidda Alle bay ku xasishaa quluubtu.

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ طُوبَىٰ لَهُمۡ وَحُسۡنُ مَـَٔابٖ

en.text: Those who have believed and done righteous deeds - a good state is theirs and a good return.

so.text: 29. Kuwa (Xaqa) rumeeyey oo fala samaha aayatiin wanaagsan [14] bay leeyihiin iyo rug u laabasho fiican (Janno).
so.footnotes: [14]. Nabigu s.c.w. wuxuu yidhi: Jannada waxaa ah geed uu u socdo hooskeeda kan gaadiid saaran boqol sano oo uusan goyneyn. W.w. Al-Bukhaari.

ayat.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ أَرۡسَلۡنَٰكَ فِيٓ أُمَّةٖ قَدۡ خَلَتۡ مِن قَبۡلِهَآ أُمَمٞ لِّتَتۡلُوَاْ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَيۡكَ وَهُمۡ يَكۡفُرُونَ بِٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِۚ قُلۡ هُوَ رَبِّي لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيۡهِ تَوَكَّلۡتُ وَإِلَيۡهِ مَتَابِ

en.text: Thus have We sent you to a community before which [other] communities have passed on so you might recite to them that which We revealed to you, while they disbelieve in the Most Merciful. Say, "He is my Lord; there is no deity except Him. Upon Him I rely, and to Him is my return."

so.text: 30. Sidaasaan kuugu soo dirnay ummad dhexdood ay horteed ummado kale tageen, si aad ugu akhrido waxaan kuu waxyoonnay, iyaguna waxay beeniyaan Raxmaanka (Allaah). Dheh: Waa Rabbigay! Ma jiro Ilaah (Xaq ah) aan ahayn Isaga, Isagaan isku halleeyaa oo tala saartaa, waana Xaggiisa noqodkeyga 'tawbadeyda'.

ayat.arabic: وَلَوۡ أَنَّ قُرۡءَانٗا سُيِّرَتۡ بِهِ ٱلۡجِبَالُ أَوۡ قُطِّعَتۡ بِهِ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ أَوۡ كُلِّمَ بِهِ ٱلۡمَوۡتَىٰۗ بَل لِّلَّهِ ٱلۡأَمۡرُ جَمِيعًاۗ أَفَلَمۡ يَاْيۡـَٔسِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ أَن لَّوۡ يَشَآءُ ٱللَّهُ لَهَدَى ٱلنَّاسَ جَمِيعٗاۗ وَلَا يَزَالُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ تُصِيبُهُم بِمَا صَنَعُواْ قَارِعَةٌ أَوۡ تَحُلُّ قَرِيبٗا مِّن دَارِهِمۡ حَتَّىٰ يَأۡتِيَ وَعۡدُ ٱللَّهِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُخۡلِفُ ٱلۡمِيعَادَ

en.text: And if there was any Qur’ān [i.e., recitation] by which the mountains would be removed or the earth would be broken apart or the dead would be made to speak,[640] [it would be this Qur’ān], but to Allāh belongs the affair entirely. Then have those who believed not accepted that had Allāh willed, He would have guided the people, all of them? And those who disbelieve do not cease to be struck, for what they have done, by calamity - or it will descend near their home - until there comes the promise of Allāh. Indeed, Allāh does not fail in [His] promise.
en.footnotes: [640] As suggested by the disbelievers.

so.text: 31. Haddii uu jiri lahaa Qur’aan ka yeeli buuraha inay socdaan, ama kala goyn dhulka, ama ka hadal siin meytida [15] (ma ahaadeyn waxaan aheyn Qur’aankan). Mayee! Alle baa iska leh Amarka oo idil. Ee miyaanay weli ogaan kuwa (xaqa) rumeeyey in haddii Alle doono uu  hanuunin lahaa dadkoo dhan? Oo kuwa gaalooba, ma deyn doonto inay ku dhacdo xumaha ay falaan darteed belaayo garaacda, amase degta meel ku dhow guryahooda, ilaa inta Ballanka Alle ka yimaado. Hubaal Alle ma ka baxo Ballankiisa.
so.footnotes: [15]. Sida ay soo jeediyeen oo dalbeen gaalada.

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدِ ٱسۡتُهۡزِئَ بِرُسُلٖ مِّن قَبۡلِكَ فَأَمۡلَيۡتُ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ ثُمَّ أَخَذۡتُهُمۡۖ فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عِقَابِ

en.text: And already were [other] messengers ridiculed before you, and I extended the time of those who disbelieved; then I seized them, and how [terrible] was My penalty.

so.text: 32. Waxaa lagu jeesjeesay Rusul (badan) adiga hortaa (Nabi Muxammadow), markaasaan siiyey fursad kuwii gaaloobay, kaddibna waan halaagay. Ee sidee mid daran u ahaa Ciqaabkeygii?.

ayat.arabic: أَفَمَنۡ هُوَ قَآئِمٌ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ نَفۡسِۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتۡۗ وَجَعَلُواْ لِلَّهِ شُرَكَآءَ قُلۡ سَمُّوهُمۡۚ أَمۡ تُنَبِّـُٔونَهُۥ بِمَا لَا يَعۡلَمُ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ أَم بِظَٰهِرٖ مِّنَ ٱلۡقَوۡلِۗ بَلۡ زُيِّنَ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مَكۡرُهُمۡ وَصُدُّواْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِۗ وَمَن يُضۡلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِنۡ هَادٖ

en.text: Then is He who is a maintainer of every soul, [knowing] what it has earned, [like any other]? But to Allāh they have attributed partners. Say, "Name them. Or do you inform Him of that[641] which He knows not upon the earth or of what is apparent [i.e., alleged] of speech?"[642] Rather, their [own] plan has been made attractive to those who disbelieve, and they have been averted from the way. And whomever Allāh sends astray - there will be for him no guide.
en.footnotes:
[641] i.e., other "deities."
[642] i.e., your attributing of divinity to other than Allāh.

so.text: 33. Ma mid Isagu dhowra naf walba oo ogsoon waxay kasbato (baa la mid ah kuwo aan waxba ogeyn)? Sidaa oy tahay, waxay u yeelaan shariigyo xagga Alle. Dheh: Magacaaba! Mise waxaad Alle u sheegeysaan wax (ilaahyo kale) uusan ku ogeyn dhulka, mise waa wax iska hadal afka baarki [16] ah. Mayee! Tabahooda xun baa loo qurxiyey gaalada, waxaana laga duway Jidka (Toosan ee Islaamka). Qofkii Alle uu lumiyo [17] ma laha wax hanuunin.
so.footnotes:
[16]. Inaad ku sifeysaan ilaahnimo cidaan ahayn Alle. 
[17]. Alle wuxuu lumiyaa qofka xun ee lunsan diiddiisa xaqa awgeed iyo inuusan doonin hanuunka.

ayat.arabic: لَّهُمۡ عَذَابٞ فِي ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَاۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ أَشَقُّۖ وَمَا لَهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَاقٖ

en.text: For them will be punishment in the life of [this] world, and the punishment of the Hereafter is more severe. And they will not have from Allāh any protector.

so.text: 34. Waxay leeyihiin cadaab nolosha adduunkan, Cadaabka Aakhirada baana ka sii daran, oo ma leh wax ka celin Alle.

ayat.arabic: ۞ مَّثَلُ ٱلۡجَنَّةِ ٱلَّتِي وُعِدَ ٱلۡمُتَّقُونَۖ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُۖ أُكُلُهَا دَآئِمٞ وَظِلُّهَاۚ تِلۡكَ عُقۡبَى ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَواْۚ وَّعُقۡبَى ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ ٱلنَّارُ

en.text: The example [i.e., description] of Paradise, which the righteous have been promised, is [that] beneath it rivers flow. Its fruit is lasting, and its shade. That is the consequence for the righteous, and the consequence for the disbelievers is the Fire.

so.text: 35. Tilmaanta Jannada kuwa Alle ka cabsada (ee ka dhowrsada xumaha) loo ballan qaaday, hoosteeda webiyaa qulqula, cunnadeedu waa joogto aan kala go'ayn iyo harkeeduba, tani waa cidhibta kuwa iska jira (shirkiga iyo xumaha kale), cidhibta gaaladuna waa Naar.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَاتَيۡنَٰهُمُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ يَفۡرَحُونَ بِمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيۡكَۖ وَمِنَ ٱلۡأَحۡزَابِ مَن يُنكِرُ بَعۡضَهُۥۚ قُلۡ إِنَّمَآ أُمِرۡتُ أَنۡ أَعۡبُدَ ٱللَّهَ وَلَآ أُشۡرِكَ بِهِۦٓۚ إِلَيۡهِ أَدۡعُواْ وَإِلَيۡهِ مَـَٔابِ

en.text: And [the believers among] those to whom We have given the [previous] Scripture rejoice at what has been revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], but among the [opposing] factions are those who deny part of it [i.e., the Qur’ān]. Say, "I have only been commanded to worship Allāh and not associate [anything] with Him. To Him I invite, and to Him is my return."

so.text: 36. Kuwa aan siinnay Kitaabka [18] waa ku farxaan waxa lagugu soo dejiyey, waxaase ka mid ah xisbiyada (Yuhuudda iyo mushrikiintaba) kuwa diida qaarki. (Nabiyow) dheh, "Waxaa sideedaba la i amray inaan caabudo Alle Keliya oo aan waxba la wadaajin (cibaadada). Isagaan (idiin) ku baaqaa, waana Xaggiisa noqodkeyku (aan u tawbad keeno)".
so.footnotes: [18]. Yuhuuddii iyo Nasaaradii soo galay islaamka.

ayat.arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَنزَلۡنَٰهُ حُكۡمًا عَرَبِيّٗاۚ وَلَئِنِ ٱتَّبَعۡتَ أَهۡوَآءَهُم بَعۡدَ مَا جَآءَكَ مِنَ ٱلۡعِلۡمِ مَا لَكَ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَلِيّٖ وَلَا وَاقٖ

en.text: And thus We have revealed it as an Arabic legislation.[643] And if you should follow their inclinations after what has come to you of knowledge, you would not have against Allāh any ally or any protector.
en.footnotes: [643] i.e., revealed in the Arabic language.

so.text: 37. Sidaasaana u soo dejinnay Xukun lagu kala baxo oo af Carabi ah. Haddaad raacdo hawadoodana kaddib waxa kuu yimid oo cilmi ah, kama heli doontid xagga Alle cid kuu gargaarta iyo ilaaliye ku dhowra midna.

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا رُسُلٗا مِّن قَبۡلِكَ وَجَعَلۡنَا لَهُمۡ أَزۡوَٰجٗا وَذُرِّيَّةٗۚ وَمَا كَانَ لِرَسُولٍ أَن يَأۡتِيَ بِـَٔايَةٍ إِلَّا بِإِذۡنِ ٱللَّهِۗ لِكُلِّ أَجَلٖ كِتَابٞ

en.text: And We have already sent messengers before you and assigned to them wives and descendants. And it was not for a messenger to come with a sign except by permission of Allāh. For every term is a decree.

so.text: 38. Waxaana soo dirnay Rusul hortaa oo waxaanu siinnay xaasas iyo ubadba [19]. Uma laha Rasuulna (awood) inuu iski ula yimaado Mucjiso, Alle oo idma ma ahee. Ajal walba wuxuu leeyahay muddo Alle u gooyo oo qoran.
so.footnotes: [19].Casri kasta wuxuu leeyahay axkaan uu Alle u jideeyo addoomahiisa oo ku saleysan Xikmaddiisa.

ayat.arabic: يَمۡحُواْ ٱللَّهُ مَا يَشَآءُ وَيُثۡبِتُۖ وَعِندَهُۥٓ أُمُّ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ

en.text: Allāh eliminates what He wills or confirms, and with Him is the Mother of the Book.[644]
en.footnotes: [644] The Preserved Slate (al-Lawḥ al-Maḥfūẓ), in which is inscribed the original of every scripture revealed by Allāh.

so.text: 39. Alle Wuxuu tiraa wuxuu doono (oo ka mid ah axkaanta iyo qeyrkoodba) oo uu sugaa (wuxuu doono oo ka mid ah), Agtiisana waxaa ah asalka Kitaabka [20].
so.footnotes: [20].Waa Looxa Maxfuudka oo ay ku qoran yihiin asalka Kitaab kasta uu Alle soo waxyooday iyo wax kasta oo Alle qaddaray.

ayat.arabic: وَإِن مَّا نُرِيَنَّكَ بَعۡضَ ٱلَّذِي نَعِدُهُمۡ أَوۡ نَتَوَفَّيَنَّكَ فَإِنَّمَا عَلَيۡكَ ٱلۡبَلَٰغُ وَعَلَيۡنَا ٱلۡحِسَابُ

en.text: And whether We show you part of what We promise them or take you in death, upon you is only the [duty of] notification, and upon Us is the account.

so.text: 40. Haddaan ku tusno qaar ka mid ah waxaan ugu goodinno (oo cadaab ah) ama aan ku oofsanno, waxaa uun adiga korkaaga ah Gaarsiinta (diinta), halka ay Annaga na saaran tahay xisaabintoodu.

ayat.arabic: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ أَنَّا نَأۡتِي ٱلۡأَرۡضَ نَنقُصُهَا مِنۡ أَطۡرَافِهَاۚ وَٱللَّهُ يَحۡكُمُ لَا مُعَقِّبَ لِحُكۡمِهِۦۚ وَهُوَ سَرِيعُ ٱلۡحِسَابِ

en.text: Have they not seen that We set upon the land, reducing it from its borders?[645] And Allāh decides; there is no adjuster of His decision. And He is swift in account.
en.footnotes: [645] Referring to the spread of Islām through Allāh's Prophet (ﷺ) and the diminishing of those areas controlled by the polytheists.

so.text: 41. Ma waysan arkayn inaan ku keenno baabba’ arlada innagoo ka dhimeyna darfaheeda 'furasho ama abaar' [21]? Alle baana xukun gooya, ma jiro wax burin kara Xukunkiisa, wuuna ku Dhaqso badan yahay Xisaabinta.
so.footnotes: [21].Waxay tilmaameysaa fiditaanka islaamka, iyo soo yaraanshaha dhulalka ay ka taliyaan mushrikiinta.

ayat.arabic: وَقَدۡ مَكَرَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡ فَلِلَّهِ ٱلۡمَكۡرُ جَمِيعٗاۖ يَعۡلَمُ مَا تَكۡسِبُ كُلُّ نَفۡسٖۗ وَسَيَعۡلَمُ ٱلۡكُفَّٰرُ لِمَنۡ عُقۡبَى ٱلدَّارِ

en.text: And those before them had plotted, but to Allāh belongs the plan entirely. He knows what every soul earns, and the disbelievers will know for whom is the final home.

so.text: 42. Kuwii ka horreeyey baa tabab degay, waxaase (tab) oo dhan iska leh Allaah. Wuxuu ogsoon yahay waxay naf waliba kasbato (khayr ama shar). Gaaladu way ogaan cidda yeelan Cidhibta Wanaagsan ee Daarta (Nabadda ah).

ayat.arabic: وَيَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَسۡتَ مُرۡسَلٗاۚ قُلۡ كَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ شَهِيدَۢا بَيۡنِي وَبَيۡنَكُمۡ وَمَنۡ عِندَهُۥ عِلۡمُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ

en.text: And those who have disbelieved say, "You are not a messenger." Say, [O Muḥammad], "Sufficient is Allāh as Witness between me and you, and [the witness of] whoever has knowledge of the Scripture."[646]
en.footnotes: [646] i.e., those who recognize the truth through their knowledge of previous scriptures.

so.text: 43. Waxay kuwa gaalooba odhan: Adigu (Muxammadow) ma tihid Rasuul la soo diray. Dheh: Alle baa ku filan marag uu ahaado dhexdeenna aniga iyo idinka, iyo ku kastoo u leh cilmi Kitaabka [22].
so.footnotes: [22]. Culimadii ehlu kitaabka ee soo galay islaamka. Waa kuwa garta xaqa iyagoo adeegsanaya cilmiga ay u lahaayeen kutubtii hore.

ayat.arabic: الٓرۚ كِتَٰبٌ أَنزَلۡنَٰهُ إِلَيۡكَ لِتُخۡرِجَ ٱلنَّاسَ مِنَ ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ إِلَى ٱلنُّورِ بِإِذۡنِ رَبِّهِمۡ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡحَمِيدِ

en.text: Alif, Lām, Rā.[648] [This is] a Book which We have revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], that you might bring mankind out of darknesses into the light by permission of their Lord - to the path of the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy -
en.footnotes: [648] See footnote to 2:1.

so.text:
1. Alif Laam Raa [1].
(Kani waa) kitaab (Qur’aan) aan kuugu soo dejinnay (Waxyi ahaan) si aad uga saarto dadka mugdiyada xagga Nuurka idanka Rabbigood – xagga Jidka Adkaadaha Sare, ee la ammaano.
so.footnotes: [1]. Eeg sharaxa Suuradda 2 Al-Baqarah: Aayadda1

ayat.arabic: ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِي لَهُۥ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۗ وَوَيۡلٞ لِّلۡكَٰفِرِينَ مِنۡ عَذَابٖ شَدِيدٍ

en.text: Allāh, to whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. And woe [i.e., destruction] to the disbelievers from a severe punishment -

so.text: 2. Allaah, ee iska leh waxa ku sugan samooyinka iyo waxa ku sugan arlada.  Hoog waxaa leh gaalada ka soo gaadhi Cadaab Daran xaggiis.

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَسۡتَحِبُّونَ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا عَلَى ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ وَيَصُدُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَيَبۡغُونَهَا عِوَجًاۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ فِي ضَلَٰلِۭ بَعِيدٖ

en.text: The ones who prefer the worldly life over the Hereafter and avert [people] from the way of Allāh, seeking to make it [seem] deviant. Those are in extreme error.

so.text: 3. Kuwa jecel nolosha adduunkan halkii Aakhirada, oo ka hor istaaga (dadka) Jidka Alle, lana dooni qallooc. Kuwaa waxay ku sugan yihiin habow fog.

ayat.arabic: وَمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مِن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا بِلِسَانِ قَوۡمِهِۦ لِيُبَيِّنَ لَهُمۡۖ فَيُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهۡدِي مَن يَشَآءُۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ

en.text: And We did not send any messenger except [speaking] in the language of his people to state clearly for them, and Allāh sends astray [thereby] whom He wills[649] and guides whom He wills. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
en.footnotes: [649] i.e., those who refuse His guidance.

so.text: 4. Rasuul kuma soo dirno waxaan aheyn afka qolodiisa si uu (Xaqa) ugu caddeeyo [2]; markaasuu Alle qofkuu doono lumiyaa, oo hanuuniyaa qofkuu doono, Waana Isaga Adkaadaha Sare, Xakiimka ah.[3]
so.footnotes:
[2]. Qur’aanka waxaa lagu soo waxyooday af Carabi faseex ah, taasina macnaheedu ma aha in Qur’aanku uu ku gaar yahay Carabta oo keliya, ee wuxuu Alle u soo dejiyey dadka oo dhan. 
[3]. Wuxuu lumiyaa kuwa diida hanuunkiisa oo ka dan la’aada oo doorta xumaha, oo wuu hanuuniyaa qof kastoo doonaya hanuunka oo jecel.

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مُوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ أَنۡ أَخۡرِجۡ قَوۡمَكَ مِنَ ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ إِلَى ٱلنُّورِ وَذَكِّرۡهُم بِأَيَّىٰمِ ٱللَّهِۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّكُلِّ صَبَّارٖ شَكُورٖ

en.text: And We certainly sent Moses with Our signs, [saying], "Bring out your people from darknesses into the light and remind them of the days[650] of Allāh." Indeed in that are signs for everyone patient and grateful.
en.footnotes: [650] Days of blessings bestowed upon the Children of Israel. Also interpreted as days of punishment and destruction of the former nations.

so.text: 5. Waxaanu la soo dirnay Muuse Aayadahayaga (Annagoo leh): Ka saar qolodaada Mugdiyada xagga Nuurka,  xusuusina Ayaamaha Alle [4]. Hubaal waxaa (arrin)kani ugu sugan calaamooyin wax lagu qaato mid walba oo samir badan, mahad naq badan.
so.footnotes: [4]. Maalmihii loogu nicmeeyey ilmahii Israa’iil. Sidoo kale waxaa lagu fasiray, wixii ku dhacay ummadihii hore hadday tahay nicmooyin ama cadaab.

ayat.arabic: وَإِذۡ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِقَوۡمِهِ ٱذۡكُرُواْ نِعۡمَةَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيۡكُمۡ إِذۡ أَنجَىٰكُم مِّنۡ ءَالِ فِرۡعَوۡنَ يَسُومُونَكُمۡ سُوٓءَ ٱلۡعَذَابِ وَيُذَبِّحُونَ أَبۡنَآءَكُمۡ وَيَسۡتَحۡيُونَ نِسَآءَكُمۡۚ وَفِي ذَٰلِكُم بَلَآءٞ مِّن رَّبِّكُمۡ عَظِيمٞ

en.text: And [recall, O Children of Israel], when Moses said to his people, "Remember the favor of Allāh upon you when He saved you from the people of Pharaoh, who were afflicting you with the worst torment and were slaughtering your [newborn] sons and keeping your females alive. And in that was a great trial from your Lord.

so.text:
6. Markuu Muuse ku yidhi qolodiisii: Xusuusta Nicmadda Alle idin siiyey, markuu idinka badbaadshay reer Fircoon iyagoo 
idin dhadhansiinayey Cadaab Daran, gawracayey wiilashiinna, oo deysanayey haweenkiinna (si ay ugu adeegaan),  (arrin)kaasina waxaa ku sugnaa imtixaan xagga Rabbigiin ah oo weyn.

ayat.arabic: وَإِذۡ تَأَذَّنَ رَبُّكُمۡ لَئِن شَكَرۡتُمۡ لَأَزِيدَنَّكُمۡۖ وَلَئِن كَفَرۡتُمۡ إِنَّ عَذَابِي لَشَدِيدٞ

en.text: And [remember] when your Lord proclaimed, 'If you are grateful, I will surely increase you [in favor]; but if you deny, indeed, My punishment is severe.'"

so.text: 7. Iyo markuu Rabbigiin idin ogeysiiyey: Haddaad mahad naqdaan, waan idiin kordhinayaa (nicmadda), haddaadse gaalowdaan, hubaal Cadaabkaygu waa mid Daran.

ayat.arabic: وَقَالَ مُوسَىٰٓ إِن تَكۡفُرُوٓاْ أَنتُمۡ وَمَن فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ جَمِيعٗا فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَغَنِيٌّ حَمِيدٌ

en.text: And Moses said, "If you should disbelieve, you and whoever is on the earth entirely - indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy."

so.text: 8. Wuxuuna Muuse yidhi: Haddaad gaalowdaan idinka iyo waxa ku sugan arlada oo dhan, hubaal Alle waa Hodan Deeqtoon, Ammaanan.

ayat.arabic: أَلَمۡ يَأۡتِكُمۡ نَبَؤُاْ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِكُمۡ قَوۡمِ نُوحٖ وَعَادٖ وَثَمُودَ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُهُمۡ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُۚ جَآءَتۡهُمۡ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِ فَرَدُّوٓاْ أَيۡدِيَهُمۡ فِيٓ أَفۡوَٰهِهِمۡ وَقَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا كَفَرۡنَا بِمَآ أُرۡسِلۡتُم بِهِۦ وَإِنَّا لَفِي شَكّٖ مِّمَّا تَدۡعُونَنَآ إِلَيۡهِ مُرِيبٖ

en.text: Has there not reached you the news of those before you - the people of Noah and ʿAad and Thamūd and those after them? No one knows them [i.e., their number] but Allāh. Their messengers brought them clear proofs, but they returned their hands to their mouths[651] and said, "Indeed, we disbelieve in that with which you have been sent, and indeed we are, about that to which you invite us, in disquieting doubt."
en.footnotes: [651] Several explanations have been given as to the meaning. Based upon the conclusion of the verse, Ibn Katheer preferred that this was a gesture of denial and rejection.

so.text: 9. Miyaanay idin soo gaadhin warka kuwii idinka horreeyay qolodii Nuux, Caad, Thamuud iyo kuwii ka dambeeyey, ma oga (tiradooda) waxaan ahayn Alle. Rusushoodii waxay ula yimaadeen xujooyin cad cad, Waxayse ku celiyeen gacmahooda afafkooda [5] oo yidhaahdeen: Ma aaminsanin waxa la idinla soo diray, waxaanuna ka qabnaa waxaad noogu yeedhaysaan shaki daran oo walaac leh.
so.footnotes: [5]. Waxay u celiyeen gacmahooda afafkooda waxaa laga bixiyey dhowr macnood. Iyadoo la tixgelinaya gunaanadka Aayadda, ibnu Kathiir wuxuu doortay inay tani ahayed tilmaan diiddo iyo gaaloobid.

ayat.arabic: ۞ قَالَتۡ رُسُلُهُمۡ أَفِي ٱللَّهِ شَكّٞ فَاطِرِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ يَدۡعُوكُمۡ لِيَغۡفِرَ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمۡ وَيُؤَخِّرَكُمۡ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٖ مُّسَمّٗىۚ قَالُوٓاْ إِنۡ أَنتُمۡ إِلَّا بَشَرٞ مِّثۡلُنَا تُرِيدُونَ أَن تَصُدُّونَا عَمَّا كَانَ يَعۡبُدُ ءَابَآؤُنَا فَأۡتُونَا بِسُلۡطَٰنٖ مُّبِينٖ

en.text: Their messengers said, "Can there be doubt about Allāh, Creator of the heavens and earth? He invites you that He may forgive you of your sins, and He delays you [i.e., your death] for a specified term." They said, "You are not but men like us who wish to avert us from what our fathers were worshipping. So bring us a clear authority [i.e., evidence]."

so.text: 10. Rusushoodii waxay yidhaahdeen: Ma waxaa jira shaki ku saabsan Alle, Askumaha samooyinka iyo aralda? Wuxuu idiinku yeedhi inuu idinka dhaafo denbiyadiinna, dibna idiinku dhigo ilaa muddo magacaaban. Waxay yidhaahdeen: Ma ahidin waxaan aheyn dad nala mid ah! Waxaad rabtaan inaad naga duwdaan waxay caabudi jireen aabbayaashayo, Ee noo keena xujo cad.

ayat.arabic: قَالَتۡ لَهُمۡ رُسُلُهُمۡ إِن نَّحۡنُ إِلَّا بَشَرٞ مِّثۡلُكُمۡ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَمُنُّ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنۡ عِبَادِهِۦۖ وَمَا كَانَ لَنَآ أَن نَّأۡتِيَكُم بِسُلۡطَٰنٍ إِلَّا بِإِذۡنِ ٱللَّهِۚ وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَلۡيَتَوَكَّلِ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ

en.text: Their messengers said to them, "We are only men like you, but Allāh confers favor upon whom He wills of His servants. It has never been for us to bring you evidence except by permission of Allāh. And upon Allāh let the believers rely.

so.text: 11. Rusushoodii waxay ku yidhaahdeen: Ma nihin waxaan aheyn dad idinla mid ah, wuxuuse Alle ku manneystaa (Deeqdiisa) cidduu doono ee ka mid ah addoomahiisa. Ma aha wax aan leennahay inaan idiin keenno xujo cad inuu Alle Idmo maahee. Alle uun waa inay mu’miniintu tala saartaan.

ayat.arabic: وَمَا لَنَآ أَلَّا نَتَوَكَّلَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ وَقَدۡ هَدَىٰنَا سُبُلَنَاۚ وَلَنَصۡبِرَنَّ عَلَىٰ مَآ ءَاذَيۡتُمُونَاۚ وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَلۡيَتَوَكَّلِ ٱلۡمُتَوَكِّلُونَ

en.text: And why should we not rely upon Allāh while He has guided us to our [good] ways. And we will surely be patient against whatever harm you should cause us. And upon Allāh let those who would rely [indeed] rely."

so.text: 12. Maxaanu u talo saaraneyn Alle? Isagoo nagu hanuuniyey jidadkayaga 'wanaagsan', waana ku samreynaa dhibka aad noo geysataan. Alle uun ha talo saarteen kuwaa wax talo saarta.

ayat.arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لِرُسُلِهِمۡ لَنُخۡرِجَنَّكُم مِّنۡ أَرۡضِنَآ أَوۡ لَتَعُودُنَّ فِي مِلَّتِنَاۖ فَأَوۡحَىٰٓ إِلَيۡهِمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ لَنُهۡلِكَنَّ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ

en.text: And those who disbelieved said to their messengers, "We will surely drive you out of our land, or you must return to our religion." So their Lord inspired to them, "We will surely destroy the wrongdoers.

so.text: 13. Kuwii gaaloobay waxay ku yidhaahdeen Rusushoodii: Waxaynu idinka saari dhulkayaga, ama haddii kale waxaad ku soo noqoneysaan diintayada. Markaasuu Rabbigood u waxyooday: Waanu halaagi daalimiinta (gar ma qaatayaasha).

ayat.arabic: وَلَنُسۡكِنَنَّكُمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِمۡۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَنۡ خَافَ مَقَامِي وَخَافَ وَعِيدِ

en.text: And We will surely cause you to dwell in the land after them. That is for he who fears My position[652] and fears My threat."
en.footnotes: [652] An alternative meaning is "the standing [for account] before Me."

so.text: 14. Waxaanuna idin dejin Dhulka iyaga kaddib. Kani waxaa leh kan ka cabsada in la i soo hor joojinayo oo ka cabsada Gooddigayga.

ayat.arabic: وَٱسۡتَفۡتَحُواْ وَخَابَ كُلُّ جَبَّارٍ عَنِيدٖ

en.text: And they requested decision [i.e., victory from Allāh], and disappointed, [therefore], was every obstinate tyrant.

so.text: 15. Wayna gargaar dalbeen, waxaana hoogay macangag kastoo madax adag.

ayat.arabic: مِّن وَرَآئِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ وَيُسۡقَىٰ مِن مَّآءٖ صَدِيدٖ

en.text: Before him[653] is Hell, and he will be given a drink of purulent water.[654]
en.footnotes:
[653] Literally, "after him [in time]," meaning ahead of him.
[654] That which oozes from the skins of Hell's inhabitants.

so.text: 16. Jahannama baa ka horreysa, waxaana laga waraabin  biyo carow ah [6].
so.footnotes: [6].Waa dhacaanka ka yimaada nabarrada dadka ehlu Naarka ah.

ayat.arabic: يَتَجَرَّعُهُۥ وَلَا يَكَادُ يُسِيغُهُۥ وَيَأۡتِيهِ ٱلۡمَوۡتُ مِن كُلِّ مَكَانٖ وَمَا هُوَ بِمَيِّتٖۖ وَمِن وَرَآئِهِۦ عَذَابٌ غَلِيظٞ

en.text: He will gulp it but will hardly [be able to] swallow it. And death will come to him from everywhere, but he is not to die. And before him is a massive punishment.

so.text: 17. Wuxuu u dhami aayar, mana ka degayo (qurunka, kulka, iyo kharaarkiisa darti),  dhimashaduna waxay uga iman meel walba, mase dhimanayo, waxaana horti ah Cadaab adag.

ayat.arabic: مَّثَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِرَبِّهِمۡۖ أَعۡمَٰلُهُمۡ كَرَمَادٍ ٱشۡتَدَّتۡ بِهِ ٱلرِّيحُ فِي يَوۡمٍ عَاصِفٖۖ لَّا يَقۡدِرُونَ مِمَّا كَسَبُواْ عَلَىٰ شَيۡءٖۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلضَّلَٰلُ ٱلۡبَعِيدُ

en.text: The example of those who disbelieve in their Lord is [that] their deeds are like ashes which the wind blows forcefully on a stormy day; they are unable [to keep] from what they earned a [single] thing. That is what is extreme error.

so.text: 18. Tusaalaha kuwa ku gaalooba Rabbigood camalladoodu waa sida dambas ay dabeyshu si daran u bitiso maalin dabeyl xumi dhaceyso, ma karaan inay ka helaan waxay kasbadeen sheyna. Kaasi waa lumitaanka fog.

ayat.arabic: أَلَمۡ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ بِٱلۡحَقِّۚ إِن يَشَأۡ يُذۡهِبۡكُمۡ وَيَأۡتِ بِخَلۡقٖ جَدِيدٖ

en.text: Have you not seen [i.e., considered] that Allāh created the heavens and the earth in truth? If He wills, He can do away with you and produce a new creation.

so.text: 19. Miyaadan arkayn inuu Alle u abuuray samooyinka iyo arlada Xaq? Hadduu doono wuu idin tegsiin oo la iman uun cusub.

ayat.arabic: وَمَا ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ بِعَزِيزٖ

en.text: And that is not difficult for Allāh.

so.text: 20. Waxnana kuma adka Alle.

ayat.arabic: وَبَرَزُواْ لِلَّهِ جَمِيعٗا فَقَالَ ٱلضُّعَفَٰٓؤُاْ لِلَّذِينَ ٱسۡتَكۡبَرُوٓاْ إِنَّا كُنَّا لَكُمۡ تَبَعٗا فَهَلۡ أَنتُم مُّغۡنُونَ عَنَّا مِنۡ عَذَابِ ٱللَّهِ مِن شَيۡءٖۚ قَالُواْ لَوۡ هَدَىٰنَا ٱللَّهُ لَهَدَيۡنَٰكُمۡۖ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيۡنَآ أَجَزِعۡنَآ أَمۡ صَبَرۡنَا مَا لَنَا مِن مَّحِيصٖ

en.text: And they will come out [for judgement] before Allāh all together, and the weak will say to those who were arrogant, "Indeed, we were your followers, so can you avail us anything against the punishment of Allāh?" They will say, "If Allāh had guided us, we would have guided you. It is all the same for us whether we show intolerance or are patient: there is for us no place of escape."

so.text: 21. Waxayna iyagoo dhammi iman Alle horti, markaasay kuwii ducafada (raciyadda) ahaa ku odhan kuwii isla weynaa (madaxda): Waxaanu ahayn raciyadiinna; ee wax ma nooga tareysaan Cadaabka Alle? Waxay odhan: Hadduu Alle na hanuunin lahaa, waan idin hanuunin lahayn. Waa isugu keen mid haddaan calaacalno (haatan) ama aan samirno, nooma sugnaan meel loo cararo.

ayat.arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ لَمَّا قُضِيَ ٱلۡأَمۡرُ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ وَعَدَكُمۡ وَعۡدَ ٱلۡحَقِّ وَوَعَدتُّكُمۡ فَأَخۡلَفۡتُكُمۡۖ وَمَا كَانَ لِيَ عَلَيۡكُم مِّن سُلۡطَٰنٍ إِلَّآ أَن دَعَوۡتُكُمۡ فَٱسۡتَجَبۡتُمۡ لِيۖ فَلَا تَلُومُونِي وَلُومُوٓاْ أَنفُسَكُمۖ مَّآ أَنَا۠ بِمُصۡرِخِكُمۡ وَمَآ أَنتُم بِمُصۡرِخِيَّ إِنِّي كَفَرۡتُ بِمَآ أَشۡرَكۡتُمُونِ مِن قَبۡلُۗ إِنَّ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٞ

en.text: And Satan will say when the matter has been concluded, "Indeed, Allāh had promised you the promise of truth. And I promised you, but I betrayed you. But I had no authority over you except that I invited you, and you responded to me. So do not blame me; but blame yourselves. I cannot be called to your aid, nor can you be called to my aid. Indeed, I deny your association of me [with Allāh] before.[655] Indeed, for the wrongdoers is a painful punishment."
en.footnotes: [655] By your obedience to me instead of Him during life on earth.

so.text: 22. Shaydaanna wuxuu odhan marka Arrinka la xukumo: Alle wuxuu idiin ballan qaaday ballan Xaq ah, aniguna idiin ballan qaaday ballamo (been ah), waana idiinka baxay. Kuma laheyn awood dushiinna, waan idiin baaqay uun oo aad i yeesheen. Marka ha i eedaynina ee eedeeya nafahiinna [7]. Anigu idiinma gargaari karo (haatan), idinkuna iima gargaari kartaan. Anigu diiday ila wadaajintiinna horey cibaadada Alle. Hubaal, Daalimiintu waxay leeyihiin Cadaab Xanuun Badan.
so.footnotes: [7]. Adeeciddii aad I adeecdeen aniga halkii Alle intaad dunida joogteen.

ayat.arabic: وَأُدۡخِلَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ جَنَّٰتٖ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا بِإِذۡنِ رَبِّهِمۡۖ تَحِيَّتُهُمۡ فِيهَا سَلَٰمٌ

en.text: And those who believed and did righteous deeds will be admitted to gardens beneath which rivers flow, abiding eternally therein by permission of their Lord; and their greeting therein will be, "Peace!"

so.text: 23. Waxaa la gelin  kuwa(Xaqa) rumeeyey oo  samaha fala Beero (Jannooyin) hostooda ay webiyo qulqulaan iyagoo dhexdeeda ku waaraya Idanka Rabbigood, soo dhoweyntoodu dhexdeeda waa Salaan.

ayat.arabic: أَلَمۡ تَرَ كَيۡفَ ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلٗا كَلِمَةٗ طَيِّبَةٗ كَشَجَرَةٖ طَيِّبَةٍ أَصۡلُهَا ثَابِتٞ وَفَرۡعُهَا فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ

en.text: Have you not considered how Allāh presents an example, [making] a good word like a good tree, whose root is firmly fixed and its branches [high] in the sky?

so.text: 24. Miyaanad ogaan sida Alle uga yeelay tusaale Kelmedda Wanaagsani [8] inay la mid tahay geed wanaagsan asalkiisu dhidban yahay, laamaheeduna cirka (kor) jiraan.
so.footnotes: [8]. Waxaa soo galaya kelmedda wanaagsan: Ikhlaaska, towxiidka, iyo erey kasta oo fiican oo lagu hadlo , iyo sama falka.

ayat.arabic: تُؤۡتِيٓ أُكُلَهَا كُلَّ حِينِۭ بِإِذۡنِ رَبِّهَاۗ وَيَضۡرِبُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡأَمۡثَالَ لِلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ

en.text: It produces its fruit all the time, by permission of its Lord. And Allāh presents examples for the people that perhaps they will be reminded.

so.text: 25. Ku soo bixisa midhaheeda goor walba Idanka Rabbigeed, Alle wuxuu u yeelaa tusaalooyin dadka si ay u waantoobaan.

ayat.arabic: وَمَثَلُ كَلِمَةٍ خَبِيثَةٖ كَشَجَرَةٍ خَبِيثَةٍ ٱجۡتُثَّتۡ مِن فَوۡقِ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مَا لَهَا مِن قَرَارٖ

en.text: And the example of a bad word is like a bad tree, uprooted from the surface of the earth, not having any stability.

so.text: 26. Tusaalaha Kelmedda xunna [9] waa sida geed xun laga rujiyey dhulka korkiisa oo aan laheyn sugnaan.
so.footnotes: [9]. Waxaa soo galaya kelmedda xun: Gaalnimada, shirkiga, iyo erey kasta oo xun oo lagu hadlo, iyo xumo falka.

ayat.arabic: يُثَبِّتُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ بِٱلۡقَوۡلِ ٱلثَّابِتِ فِي ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَفِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِۖ وَيُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَۚ وَيَفۡعَلُ ٱللَّهُ مَا يَشَآءُ

en.text: Allāh keeps firm those who believe, with the firm word,[656] in worldly life and in the Hereafter.[657] And Allāh sends astray the wrongdoers. And Allāh does what He wills.
en.footnotes:
[656] The testimony that there is no deity except Allāh and that Muḥammad (ﷺ) is the messenger of Allāh.
[657] When questioned in their graves by the angels after death.

so.text: 27. Alle Wuxuu  waafajiyaa oo ku sugaa kuwa rumeeyey kelmedda sugan [10] nolosha adduunkan iyo aakhirada [11]. Alle wuu lumiyaa daalimiinta. Alle wuxuu falaa wuxuu doono.
so.footnotes:
[10]. Qowlka sugan waa kelmedda wanaagsan ee ku soo arooray Aayadda 24 Waxaa soo galaya kelmedda wanaagsan kelmedda towxiidka inuusan jirin ilaah xaq lagu caabudo aan ahayn Allaah iyo in Muxammad s.c.w. yahay Rasuulkii Alle, iyo qowl kasta oo dadka ugu yeedhaya samaanta oo ka reebaya xumaanta, kelmedda towxiidkana waxaa weeye laa ilaaha illal Laah. 
[11]. Markay malaa’igta wax ku su’aalayaan dadka qubuurahooda dhimashada kaddib, iyagoo weydiinaya seddex su’aalood: Waa kuma Rabbigaa? Maxay tahay diintaadu? Waa kuma Nabiga la idiin soo diray?

ayat.arabic: ۞ أَلَمۡ تَرَ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ بَدَّلُواْ نِعۡمَتَ ٱللَّهِ كُفۡرٗا وَأَحَلُّواْ قَوۡمَهُمۡ دَارَ ٱلۡبَوَارِ

en.text: Have you not considered those who exchanged the favor of Allāh for disbelief[658] and settled their people [in] the home of ruin?
en.footnotes: [658] They met Allāh's blessing with denial instead of gratitude.

so.text: 28. Miyaanad ogaan kuwa ku beddelay Nicmadda Alle (Islaamka) abaal dhac 'gaalnimo' [12], oo ka yeelay dadkoodii inay degaan daarta halaagga.
so.footnotes: [12]. Waxay ku qaabileen nicmooyinkii Alle beenin halkii xamdi naqa iyo shukrinta.

ayat.arabic: جَهَنَّمَ يَصۡلَوۡنَهَاۖ وَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡقَرَارُ

en.text: [It is] Hell, which they will [enter to] burn, and wretched is the settlement.

so.text: 29. Jahannama bay gali (oo ku guban). Oo u xun meel lagu sal yeesho.

ayat.arabic: وَجَعَلُواْ لِلَّهِ أَندَادٗا لِّيُضِلُّواْ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦۗ قُلۡ تَمَتَّعُواْ فَإِنَّ مَصِيرَكُمۡ إِلَى ٱلنَّارِ

en.text: And they have attributed to Allāh equals to mislead [people] from His way. Say, "Enjoy yourselves, for indeed, your destination is the Fire."

so.text: 30. Waxay u yeelaan Alle shariigyo si ay uga lumiyaan (dadka) Jidkiisa. Dheh: iska Raaxaysta! Aayihiinnu waa xagga Naarta.

ayat.arabic: قُل لِّعِبَادِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ يُقِيمُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُنفِقُواْ مِمَّا رَزَقۡنَٰهُمۡ سِرّٗا وَعَلَانِيَةٗ مِّن قَبۡلِ أَن يَأۡتِيَ يَوۡمٞ لَّا بَيۡعٞ فِيهِ وَلَا خِلَٰلٌ

en.text: [O Muḥammad], tell My servants who have believed to establish prayer and spend from what We have provided them, secretly and publicly, before a Day comes in which there will be no exchange [i.e., ransom], nor any friendships.

so.text: 31. Ku dheh addoommahayga (Xaqa) rumeeyey ha oogeen salaadda, hana bixiyeen wax ka mid ah waxaan ku irsaaqnay sir iyo caddaanba ka hor inta aysan imaan Maalin aysan jirin ganacsi iyo saaxiibtinnimo midna.

ayat.arabic: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَأَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءٗ فَأَخۡرَجَ بِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ رِزۡقٗا لَّكُمۡۖ وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلۡفُلۡكَ لِتَجۡرِيَ فِي ٱلۡبَحۡرِ بِأَمۡرِهِۦۖ وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرَ

en.text: It is Allāh who created the heavens and the earth and sent down rain from the sky and produced thereby some fruits as provision for you and subjected for you[659] the ships to sail through the sea by His command and subjected for you the rivers.
en.footnotes: [659] i.e., made serviceable to you.

so.text: 32. Alle waa Kan abuuray samooyinka iyo arlada kana soo dejiya biyo (roob) daruuraha, oo ku soo bixiya midho risiq idiin ah, Wuxuuna idiin sakhiray doonyaha inay ku maaxaan badda Amarkiisa, idiinna sakhiray webiyada.

ayat.arabic: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلشَّمۡسَ وَٱلۡقَمَرَ دَآئِبَيۡنِۖ وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيۡلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ

en.text: And He subjected for you the sun and the moon, continuous [in orbit], and subjected for you the night and the day.

so.text: 33. Wuxuuna idiin sakhiray qorraxda iyo dayaxa, labaduba joogto ugu socdaan rugahooda; idiinna sakhiray habeenka iyo maalinta.

ayat.arabic: وَءَاتَىٰكُم مِّن كُلِّ مَا سَأَلۡتُمُوهُۚ وَإِن تَعُدُّواْ نِعۡمَتَ ٱللَّهِ لَا تُحۡصُوهَآۗ إِنَّ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ لَظَلُومٞ كَفَّارٞ

en.text: And He gave you from all you asked of Him.[660] And if you should count the favor [i.e., blessings] of Allāh, you could not enumerate them. Indeed, mankind is [generally] most unjust and ungrateful.[661]
en.footnotes:
[660] Something of what you asked and all of what you continually require, according to His wisdom.
[661] i.e., disbelieving and denying of Allāh's favor.

so.text: 34. Wuxuuna idin siiyaa wax ka mid ah wax kastoo aad weydiisataan [13], haddaad tirisaan Nicmooyinka Alle, ma koobi kartaan. Hubaal Aadmigu waa dulmin badan yahay (naftiisa), (ka) abaal dhac badan yahay (Nicmooyinka Rabbigi).
so.footnotes: [13]. Wax ka mid ah waxa aad weydiisateen iyo dhammaan wax ka mid ah waxa aad sida joogtada ah u dalabtaan si waafaqsan xikmaddiisa.

ayat.arabic: وَإِذۡ قَالَ إِبۡرَٰهِيمُ رَبِّ ٱجۡعَلۡ هَٰذَا ٱلۡبَلَدَ ءَامِنٗا وَٱجۡنُبۡنِي وَبَنِيَّ أَن نَّعۡبُدَ ٱلۡأَصۡنَامَ

en.text: And [mention, O Muḥammad], when Abraham said, "My Lord, make this city [i.e., Makkah] secure and keep me and my sons away from worshipping idols.

so.text: 35. (Xus, Nabiyow) markuu Ibraahiim yidhi: Rabbiyow! Ka yeel beledkan (Makkah) aamin, igana dheeree aniga iyo awlaaddeydaba inaan caabudno sanammo.

ayat.arabic: رَبِّ إِنَّهُنَّ أَضۡلَلۡنَ كَثِيرٗا مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِۖ فَمَن تَبِعَنِي فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّيۖ وَمَنۡ عَصَانِي فَإِنَّكَ غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٞ

en.text: My Lord, indeed they have led astray many among the people. So whoever follows me - then he is of me;[662] and whoever disobeys me - indeed, You are [yet] Forgiving and Merciful.
en.footnotes: [662] i.e., of my religion.

so.text: 36. Rabbiyow! Waxay (sanamyadu) lumiyeen in badan oo ka mid ah dadka. Ee qofkii i raaca, aniga buu iga mid yahay; qofkiise igu caasiya - hubaal Adigaa ah Denbi Dhaaf Badane, Naxariis Badan.

ayat.arabic: رَّبَّنَآ إِنِّيٓ أَسۡكَنتُ مِن ذُرِّيَّتِي بِوَادٍ غَيۡرِ ذِي زَرۡعٍ عِندَ بَيۡتِكَ ٱلۡمُحَرَّمِ رَبَّنَا لِيُقِيمُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ فَٱجۡعَلۡ أَفۡـِٔدَةٗ مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِ تَهۡوِيٓ إِلَيۡهِمۡ وَٱرۡزُقۡهُم مِّنَ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَشۡكُرُونَ

en.text: Our Lord, I have settled some of my descendants in an uncultivated valley near Your sacred House, our Lord, that they may establish prayer. So make hearts among the people incline toward them and provide for them from the fruits that they might be grateful.

so.text: 37. Rabbigayow! Waxaan dejiyey qaar ka mid ah durriyadeydii tog aan sarac lahayn (Makkah), oo Beytkaaga (Kacbada) Xurmadda leh agtiis ah; Rabbigayow si ay u oogaan salaadda ee ka yeel quluubta qaar dadka ka mid ah kuwo u soo iisha xaggooda oo ku irsaaq midho si ay u mahad naqaan.

ayat.arabic: رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ تَعۡلَمُ مَا نُخۡفِي وَمَا نُعۡلِنُۗ وَمَا يَخۡفَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ مِن شَيۡءٖ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَا فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ

en.text: Our Lord, indeed You know what we conceal and what we declare, and nothing is hidden from Allāh on the earth or in the heaven.

so.text: 38. Rabbigayow! Waxaad adigu ogtahay waxaan qarinno iyo waxaan muujinnaba. Kama qarsoomaan Alle wax dhulka jira ama cirka gudahiisa ah.

ayat.arabic: ٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي وَهَبَ لِي عَلَى ٱلۡكِبَرِ إِسۡمَٰعِيلَ وَإِسۡحَٰقَۚ إِنَّ رَبِّي لَسَمِيعُ ٱلدُّعَآءِ

en.text: Praise to Allāh, who has granted to me in old age Ishmael and Isaac. Indeed, my Lord is the Hearer of supplication.

so.text: 39. Ammaan idilkeed iyo mahad waxaa iska leh Allaah ee i siiyey anigoo weyn oo da’ ah Ismaaciil iyo Isxaaq. Hubaal, Rabbigay waa Maqlaha baryada.

ayat.arabic: رَبِّ ٱجۡعَلۡنِي مُقِيمَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِيۚ رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلۡ دُعَآءِ

en.text: My Lord, make me an establisher of prayer, and [many] from my descendants. Our Lord, and accept my supplication.

so.text: 40. Rabbiyow! Iga yeel mid ooga salaadda aniga iyo durriyadeydaba, Rabbigayow! Iga aqbal baryadayda (iyo cibaadeysigayga).

ayat.arabic: رَبَّنَا ٱغۡفِرۡ لِي وَلِوَٰلِدَيَّ وَلِلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ يَوۡمَ يَقُومُ ٱلۡحِسَابُ

en.text: Our Lord, forgive me and my parents and the believers the Day the account is established."

so.text: 41. Rabbigayow! Ii denbi dhaaf aniga iyo labadeyda waalid iyo mu’miniintaba Maalinta ay dhici Xisaabtu (Qiyaamadu).

ayat.arabic: وَلَا تَحۡسَبَنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَٰفِلًا عَمَّا يَعۡمَلُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَۚ إِنَّمَا يُؤَخِّرُهُمۡ لِيَوۡمٖ تَشۡخَصُ فِيهِ ٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرُ

en.text: And never think that Allāh is unaware of what the wrongdoers do. He only delays them [i.e., their account] for a Day when eyes will stare [in horror].

so.text: 42. Ha moodin in Alle moog yahay waxay falayaan daalimiintu, Wuxuu uun dib ugu dhigaa Maalin ay taagmi indhahu.

ayat.arabic: مُهۡطِعِينَ مُقۡنِعِي رُءُوسِهِمۡ لَا يَرۡتَدُّ إِلَيۡهِمۡ طَرۡفُهُمۡۖ وَأَفۡـِٔدَتُهُمۡ هَوَآءٞ

en.text: Racing ahead, their heads raised up, their glance does not come back to them,[663] and their hearts are void.
en.footnotes: [663] This is their state at the time of resurrection from the graves. Their heads are upraised in fixed stares of terror, unable even to glance back.

so.text: 43. Iyagoo horay u degdegaya (si ay u ajiibaan baaqaha), madaxyadoodu kor u taagan yihiin [14], uusan soo noqoneyn arragooda (taagmi indhahu), quluubtoodu- na maran tahay (cabsi darteed).
so.footnotes: [14]. Tani waa xaaladdooda marka laga soo saaro qubuurahooda. Madaxyadooda kor yihiin iyagoo aan meelna jalleeceyn argagax darteed, aan awoodin xitaa inay dib dhugtaan.

ayat.arabic: وَأَنذِرِ ٱلنَّاسَ يَوۡمَ يَأۡتِيهِمُ ٱلۡعَذَابُ فَيَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ رَبَّنَآ أَخِّرۡنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٖ قَرِيبٖ نُّجِبۡ دَعۡوَتَكَ وَنَتَّبِعِ ٱلرُّسُلَۗ أَوَلَمۡ تَكُونُوٓاْ أَقۡسَمۡتُم مِّن قَبۡلُ مَا لَكُم مِّن زَوَالٖ

en.text: And, [O Muḥammad], warn the people of a Day when the punishment will come to them and those who did wrong will say, "Our Lord, delay us for a short term; we will answer Your call and follow the messengers." [But it will be said], "Had you not sworn, before, that for you there would be no cessation?[664]
en.footnotes: [664] Of the blessings which Allāh had bestowed upon you during life on earth.

so.text: 44. Uga dig dadka Maalintuu u iman  cadaabka, markaas kuwii dulmiga (shirkiga iyo xumaha kale) falay waxay odhan: Rabbigayow! Dib noo dhig muddo dhow, waxaynu ajiibi baaqaaga oo raaci Rususha. Miyeydaan ka hor ku dhaaran inaydaan (adduunka ka) tegeyn [15].
so.footnotes: [15]. Inayan idinka guureyn nicmooyinka uu Alle idinku galladeystey dushiinna intii aad joogteen dhulka guudkiisa oo aysan jirin qubuur layska soo saari iyo xisaab.

ayat.arabic: وَسَكَنتُمۡ فِي مَسَٰكِنِ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓاْ أَنفُسَهُمۡ وَتَبَيَّنَ لَكُمۡ كَيۡفَ فَعَلۡنَا بِهِمۡ وَضَرَبۡنَا لَكُمُ ٱلۡأَمۡثَالَ

en.text: And you lived among the dwellings of those who wronged themselves, and it had become clear to you how We dealt with them. And We presented for you [many] examples."

so.text: 45. Waxaadna degteen guryihii kuwii dulmiyey nafahooda, waana idiin caddaatay sidaan u galnay. Waxaana idiin soo bandhignay tusaalooyin.

ayat.arabic: وَقَدۡ مَكَرُواْ مَكۡرَهُمۡ وَعِندَ ٱللَّهِ مَكۡرُهُمۡ وَإِن كَانَ مَكۡرُهُمۡ لِتَزُولَ مِنۡهُ ٱلۡجِبَالُ

en.text: And they had planned their plan, but with Allāh is [recorded] their plan, even if their plan had been [sufficient] to do away with the mountains.[665]
en.footnotes: [665] An alternative meaning is "...and their plan was not [sufficient] to do away with the mountains," i.e., it had no effect against Allāh's will.

so.text: 46. Waxay tabeeyeen tab xun, tabtooda xun se waxaa (ka war) hayay Alle, inkastoo tabtooda xun ahayd mid (daran) ay la baabba’aan buuruhu [16].
so.footnotes: [16]. Tafsiir kale waa tabtooda xun kuma filneyn inay ka qaadaan buuraha meelahooda, macna kale waa kuma lahayn wax saameys ah doonista Alle.

ayat.arabic: فَلَا تَحۡسَبَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُخۡلِفَ وَعۡدِهِۦ رُسُلَهُۥٓۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَزِيزٞ ذُو ٱنتِقَامٖ

en.text: So never think that Allāh will fail in His promise to His messengers. Indeed, Allāh is Exalted in Might and Owner of Retribution.[666]
en.footnotes: [666] Refer to footnote for 3:5.

so.text: 47. Ee marnaba ha moodin inuu Alle uga baxayo Ballankiisa Rusushiisa. hubaal Alle waa Adkaade Sare, Aar gudasho leh.

ayat.arabic: يَوۡمَ تُبَدَّلُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ غَيۡرَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُۖ وَبَرَزُواْ لِلَّهِ ٱلۡوَٰحِدِ ٱلۡقَهَّارِ

en.text: [It will be] on the Day the earth will be replaced by another earth, and the heavens [as well], and they [i.e., all creatures] will come out before Allāh, the One, the Prevailing,

so.text: 48. Maalinta marka arlada loo beddeli arlo kale iyo samooyinkaba, waxaana la hor keeni (uumanka oo idil) Alle horti, Waaxidka, Sandulleeyaha (isla weynayaasha).

ayat.arabic: وَتَرَى ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ يَوۡمَئِذٖ مُّقَرَّنِينَ فِي ٱلۡأَصۡفَادِ

en.text: And you will see the criminals that Day bound together in irons,

so.text: 49. Waxaad arki denbiilayaasha oo Maalintaas iskula xir-xiran silsilado bir ah .

ayat.arabic: سَرَابِيلُهُم مِّن قَطِرَانٖ وَتَغۡشَىٰ وُجُوهَهُمُ ٱلنَّارُ

en.text: Their garments of liquid pitch and their faces covered by the Fire

so.text: 50. Qamiisyadoodu ka sameysan yihiin daamur (Naar ah), waxaana dabooli wajiyadooda dab.

ayat.arabic: لِيَجۡزِيَ ٱللَّهُ كُلَّ نَفۡسٖ مَّا كَسَبَتۡۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَرِيعُ ٱلۡحِسَابِ

en.text: So that Allāh will recompense every soul for what it earned. Indeed, Allāh is swift in account.

so.text: 51. Si uu Alle uga abaal mariyo naf walbaa waxay kasbatay (khayr ama shar). Hubaal Alle waa ku Dhaqso Badan yahay Xisaabta.

ayat.arabic: هَٰذَا بَلَٰغٞ لِّلنَّاسِ وَلِيُنذَرُواْ بِهِۦ وَلِيَعۡلَمُوٓاْ أَنَّمَا هُوَ إِلَٰهٞ وَٰحِدٞ وَلِيَذَّكَّرَ أُوْلُواْ ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ

en.text: This [Qur’ān] is notification for the people that they may be warned thereby and that they may know that He is but one God and that those of understanding will be reminded.

so.text: 52. Kani (Qur’aanku) ugu filan gaarsiin cad dadka, iyo in loogu digo, iyo inay ogaadaan in Macbuudka Xaqa ahi Ilaah Keliya uun yahay ee Mid ah (Allaah), iyo inay ku waano qaataan (arrinkaa) waxgaradku.

ayat.arabic: الٓرۚ تِلۡكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ وَقُرۡءَانٖ مُّبِينٖ

en.text: Alif, Lām, Rā.[668] These are the verses of the Book and a clear Qur’ān [i.e., recitation].
en.footnotes: [668] See footnote to 2:1.

so.text:
1. Alif Laam Raa [1].
Kuwakani waa Aayadaha Kitaabka, oo Qur'aan ah ay cad yihiin (Aayadahiisu).
so.footnotes: [1]. Eeg sharaxa Suuradda 2 : Aayadda 1.

ayat.arabic: رُّبَمَا يَوَدُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَوۡ كَانُواْ مُسۡلِمِينَ

en.text: Perhaps those who disbelieve will wish[669] that they had been Muslims.
en.footnotes: [669] On the Day of Judgement or at the time of death.

so.text: 2. Wax badan bay kuwa gaalooba jecleysan doonaan (Aakhirada) inay ahaayeen Muslimiin [2].
so.footnotes: [2]. Waxay sidaas jecleysan Maalinta Qiyaamaha ama waqtiga dhimashadooda.

ayat.arabic: ذَرۡهُمۡ يَأۡكُلُواْ وَيَتَمَتَّعُواْ وَيُلۡهِهِمُ ٱلۡأَمَلُۖ فَسَوۡفَ يَعۡلَمُونَ

en.text: Let them eat and enjoy themselves and be diverted by [false] hope, for they are going to know.

so.text: 3. Iska daa wax ha iska cunaane hana iska raaxaystaan iyo (in) rajo maawiliso, wayse ogaan doonaan (waxa ku dhaca).

ayat.arabic: وَمَآ أَهۡلَكۡنَا مِن قَرۡيَةٍ إِلَّا وَلَهَا كِتَابٞ مَّعۡلُومٞ

en.text: And We did not destroy any city but that for it was a known decree.

so.text: 4. Ma jirto magaalo aan halaagnay oo aan lahayn waqti la yaqaan oo qoran.

ayat.arabic: مَّا تَسۡبِقُ مِنۡ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسۡتَـٔۡخِرُونَ

en.text: No nation will precede its term, nor will they remain thereafter.

so.text: 5. Kama hor mari karto ummadi muddadeeda, kamana dib marto.

ayat.arabic: وَقَالُواْ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِي نُزِّلَ عَلَيۡهِ ٱلذِّكۡرُ إِنَّكَ لَمَجۡنُونٞ

en.text: And they say, "O you upon whom the message has been sent down, indeed you are mad.[670]
en.footnotes: [670] Literally, "possessed by jinn."

so.text: 6. Waxay (ku) yidhaahdeen (Nabiga): Kan Waanada (Qur’aanka) lagu soo dejiyeyow [3]! Adigu waxaad tahay jinnoole.
so.footnotes: [3]. Waxay sidaas gaaladu ugu yidhaahdeen Nabi Muxammad s,c,w, ku digasho iyo jeesjees ahaan.

ayat.arabic: لَّوۡمَا تَأۡتِينَا بِٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ

en.text: Why do you not bring us the angels, if you should be among the truthful?"

so.text: 7. Maxaad noogu keeni weyday malaa’ig haddaad run sheegeyso?

ayat.arabic: مَا نُنَزِّلُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ إِلَّا بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَمَا كَانُوٓاْ إِذٗا مُّنظَرِينَ

en.text: We do not send down the angels except with truth;[671] and they [i.e., the disbelievers] would not then be reprieved.
en.footnotes: [671] i.e., with a message or, as the conclusion of the verse suggests, to carry out a promised punishment.

so.text: 8. Uma soo dirno malaa’igta waxaan xaq [4] aheyn, lamana sugo oo siiyo (gaalada) fursad markaas (ay ku tawbad keenaan) .
so.footnotes: [4]. Macnaha waxaan la soo dirnaa fartiin ama sida laga qaadanayo hal dhaca Aayadda cadaabka loogu goodiyey gaalada.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّا نَحۡنُ نَزَّلۡنَا ٱلذِّكۡرَ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ لَحَٰفِظُونَ

en.text: Indeed, it is We who sent down the message [i.e., the Qur’ān], and indeed, We will be its guardian.

so.text: 9. Xaqiiq, Annagaa soo dejinnay Waanada (Qur’aanka) Annagaana xaqiiq ilaalin [5].
so.footnotes: [5]. Aayaddan waxay muujineysa meeqaanka Qur’aanka iyo xifdintiisa.

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مِن قَبۡلِكَ فِي شِيَعِ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ

en.text: And We had certainly sent [messengers] before you, [O Muḥammad], among the sects of the former peoples.

so.text: 10. Waxaana dhab ahaan soo dirnay Rusul hortaa ummadahii hore dhexdood.

ayat.arabic: وَمَا يَأۡتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ

en.text: And no messenger would come to them except that they ridiculed him.

so.text: 11. Ma jirin Rasuul u yimaada oo aysan ku jees-jeesin.

ayat.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ نَسۡلُكُهُۥ فِي قُلُوبِ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ

en.text: Thus do We insert it [i.e., denial] into the hearts of the criminals.

so.text: 12. Sidaasaan u gelinnaa (diiddada Xaqa) quluubta denbiilayaasha.

ayat.arabic: لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِهِۦ وَقَدۡ خَلَتۡ سُنَّةُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ

en.text: They will not believe in it, while there has already occurred the precedent of the former peoples.

so.text: 13. Ma rumeeyaan waxa ku soo arooray (Qur’aanka), dhab ahaanna waxaa hore maray tusaalihii kuwii hore ee tegay [6].
so.footnotes: [6]. Hannaaka iyo hab raaca Alle waxaa halkan loola jeedaa halaagidda dadka beeniya Rususha Alle.

ayat.arabic: وَلَوۡ فَتَحۡنَا عَلَيۡهِم بَابٗا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَظَلُّواْ فِيهِ يَعۡرُجُونَ

en.text: And [even] if We opened to them a gate from the heaven and they continued therein to ascend,

so.text: 14. Haddaan uga furno albaab samada oo ay ahaadaan kuwo kor u kora;

ayat.arabic: لَقَالُوٓاْ إِنَّمَا سُكِّرَتۡ أَبۡصَٰرُنَا بَلۡ نَحۡنُ قَوۡمٞ مَّسۡحُورُونَ

en.text: They would say, "Our eyes have only been dazzled. Rather, we are a people affected by magic."

so.text: 15. Waxay (gaaladu) odhan lahaayeen: Waxaa uun la awday Indhahayaga. Mayee, waxaanu nahay qolo la sixray.

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ جَعَلۡنَا فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ بُرُوجٗا وَزَيَّنَّٰهَا لِلنَّٰظِرِينَ

en.text: And We have placed within the heaven great stars and have beautified it for the observers.

so.text: 16. Waxaan dhab ahaan yeelnay samada xiddigo waaweyn iyo rugo ay maraan, Waxaana u qurxinnay daawadayaasha.

ayat.arabic: وَحَفِظۡنَٰهَا مِن كُلِّ شَيۡطَٰنٖ رَّجِيمٍ

en.text: And We have protected it from every devil expelled [from the mercy of Allāh]

so.text: 17. Waxaana ka ilaalinnay Shaydaan kastoo laga ceyrshay (Naxariista Alle).

ayat.arabic: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱسۡتَرَقَ ٱلسَّمۡعَ فَأَتۡبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٞ مُّبِينٞ

en.text: Except one who steals a hearing and is pursued by a clear burning flame.

so.text: 18. Mid maahee xada mar wax uu maqlo, markaas la raaciyo danab muuqda.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ مَدَدۡنَٰهَا وَأَلۡقَيۡنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِيَ وَأَنۢبَتۡنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ مَّوۡزُونٖ

en.text: And the earth - We have spread it and cast therein firmly set mountains and caused to grow therein [something] of every well-balanced thing.

so.text: 19. Dhulka - waanu fidinnay, waxaanu ku sugnay buuro, waxaana ka soo bixinnay wax kastoo miisaaman.

ayat.arabic: وَجَعَلۡنَا لَكُمۡ فِيهَا مَعَٰيِشَ وَمَن لَّسۡتُمۡ لَهُۥ بِرَٰزِقِينَ

en.text: And We have made for you therein means of living and [for] those for whom you are not providers.[672]
en.footnotes: [672] Allāh has put at your service other men and animals for which He provides. An additional meaning is that Allāh provides means for your living and for all other creatures as well.

so.text: 20. Waxaana idiinka yeellay dhexdiisa asbaabta noolaanshaha idinka iyo midka kastoo aydaan idinku irsaaqin [7].
so.footnotes: [7]. Macnaha waxaa weeye Alle wuxuu idiin sakhiray dad iyo duunyo kale uu isagu wax siiyo oo irsaaqo. Macno kale waxaa weeye Alle wuxuu idin siiyaa waxyaalo aad ku noolataan oo sidoo kale siiyaa dhammaan uumanka kale.

ayat.arabic: وَإِن مِّن شَيۡءٍ إِلَّا عِندَنَا خَزَآئِنُهُۥ وَمَا نُنَزِّلُهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِقَدَرٖ مَّعۡلُومٖ

en.text: And there is not a thing but that with Us are its depositories, and We do not send it down except according to a known [i.e., specified] measure.

so.text: 21. Ma jiro wax aannu Annagu (Alle ah) hayn khasnadahiisa. Kumana aan soo dejinno waxaan aheyn qaddar la yaqaan.

ayat.arabic: وَأَرۡسَلۡنَا ٱلرِّيَٰحَ لَوَٰقِحَ فَأَنزَلۡنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءٗ فَأَسۡقَيۡنَٰكُمُوهُ وَمَآ أَنتُمۡ لَهُۥ بِخَٰزِنِينَ

en.text: And We have sent the fertilizing winds[673] and sent down water from the sky and given you drink from it. And you are not its retainers.
