en.footnotes: [673] Causing precipitation in rainclouds or carrying pollen. Another meaning is "pregnant winds," i.e., those carrying rainclouds.

so.text: 22. Waxaana soo dirnaa dabeylaha tallaala (daruuraha) markaasaan ka soo dejinnaa daruuraha biyo (roob), aan idinka waraa- binno, mana ahidin idinku kuwa kaydiya.

ayat.arabic: وَإِنَّا لَنَحۡنُ نُحۡيِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَنَحۡنُ ٱلۡوَٰرِثُونَ

en.text: And indeed, it is We who give life and cause death, and We are the Inheritor.[674]
en.footnotes: [674] Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) remains after all creation has passed away.

so.text: 23. Xaqiiq, waa Annaga (Allaah) Kuwa wax nooleeya, waxna dhinsiiya [8],  Annagaana ah dhaxlayaasha [9].
so.footnotes:
[8]. Nabigu s.c.w. wuxuu yidhi: “Hadduu qofka aadmiga ahi dhinto waxaa go’a camalkiisa marka laga reebo seddex arrimood: Sadaqa joogto ah (waqaf), cilmi lagu intifaaco, ama ilmo wanaagsan oo u soo duceeya. (W.w. Muslim).
[9]. Allaah subxaanahu wa tacaalaa baa hara markay uunka oo dhan dhintaan.

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ عَلِمۡنَا ٱلۡمُسۡتَقۡدِمِينَ مِنكُمۡ وَلَقَدۡ عَلِمۡنَا ٱلۡمُسۡتَـٔۡخِرِينَ

en.text: And We have already known the preceding [generations] among you, and We have already known the later [ones to come].

so.text: 24. Waxaan ognahay kuwiinnii hore ee tegay, Waxaana ognahay kuwa dib ka iman.

ayat.arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَحۡشُرُهُمۡۚ إِنَّهُۥ حَكِيمٌ عَلِيمٞ

en.text: And indeed, your Lord will gather them; indeed, He is Wise and Knowing.

so.text: 25. Hubaal Rabbigaa waa soo wada kulmin iyagoo dhan. Waa Xakiim, wax kasta Og.

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ مِن صَلۡصَٰلٖ مِّنۡ حَمَإٖ مَّسۡنُونٖ

en.text: And We did certainly create man out of clay from an altered black mud.

so.text: 26. Waxaan ka abuurnay aadmiga dhoobo shanqarta, madow doorsoon ah.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلۡجَآنَّ خَلَقۡنَٰهُ مِن قَبۡلُ مِن نَّارِ ٱلسَّمُومِ

en.text: And the jinn We created before from scorching fire.

so.text: 27. Jinkana, Waxaan ka abuurnay awal hore dab ololaya [10].
so.footnotes: [10]. Malaa’igtana nuur ifaya.

ayat.arabic: وَإِذۡ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّي خَٰلِقُۢ بَشَرٗا مِّن صَلۡصَٰلٖ مِّنۡ حَمَإٖ مَّسۡنُونٖ

en.text: And [mention, O Muḥammad], when your Lord said to the angels, "I will create a human being out of clay from an altered black mud.

so.text: 28. (Xus, Nabiyow) markuu Rabbigaa ku yidhi malaa’igta: Waxaan ka abuurayaa qof (Aadam) dhoobo shanqarta oo madow doorsoon ah.

ayat.arabic: فَإِذَا سَوَّيۡتُهُۥ وَنَفَخۡتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِي فَقَعُواْ لَهُۥ سَٰجِدِينَ

en.text: And when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My [created] soul,[675] then fall down to him in prostration."
en.footnotes: [675] The element of life and soul which Allāh created for that body, not His own spirit or part of Himself (as some mistakenly believe).

so.text: 29. Ee markaan sameeyo isagoo dhan oo aan ku afuufo ruuxda aan ugu tala galay [11] ula dhaca sujuud.
so.footnotes: [11].Walaxda nolosha iyo nafta uu Alle u abuuray jirkaa, ma aha ruux ilaahnimo ah ama qayb ka mid ah (sida uu yahayba fahanka gurracan ee gaalada).

ayat.arabic: فَسَجَدَ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمۡ أَجۡمَعُونَ

en.text: So the angels prostrated - all of them entirely,

so.text: 30. Markaasay malaa’igtii sujuudeen  kulligoodba iyagoo dhan.

ayat.arabic: إِلَّآ إِبۡلِيسَ أَبَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ

en.text: Except Iblees;[676] he refused to be with those who prostrated.
en.footnotes: [676] Who was of the jinn. See 18:50.

so.text: 31. Ibliis [12] maahee (ma yeelin): waa uu diiday inuu ka mid ahaado kuwa sujuuday [13].
so.footnotes:
[12].Wuxuu ka mid ahaa jinka sida ku soo arooray Suuradda 18: Aayadda 50. 
[13]. Sujuudda halkan loolama jeedo cibaado ee waxaa loola jeedaa salaan ka heybeysi iyo qaddarin iyo weyneyn ah adigoo madaxa hoos u soo rogaya. Waana tii Mucaad markuu soo arkay dad sidaa salaan madaxa ula soo roganaya hoos, uu damcay inuu sidaas oo kale u salaamo oo ugu sujuudo Nabi Muxammad s.c.w. waana uu ku diiday, waayo shareecada Nabi Muxammad s.c.w kuma bannaana in qofna loo rukuuco oo madax hoos loogu dhigo, Rukuuca sidaas ah sujuudna waa la yidhaahdaa. Rukuuca iyo sujuudda waa cibaado cidna xaq uma leh aan ahayn Alle subxaanahu watacaalaa.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ يَٰٓإِبۡلِيسُ مَا لَكَ أَلَّا تَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ

en.text: [Allāh] said, "O Iblees, what is [the matter] with you that you are not with those who prostrate?"

so.text: 32. (Alle) wuxuu yidhi: Ibliisoow! Maxaa kuugu wacan inaadan ahaan la jirka kuwaa sujuuday.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ لَمۡ أَكُن لِّأَسۡجُدَ لِبَشَرٍ خَلَقۡتَهُۥ مِن صَلۡصَٰلٖ مِّنۡ حَمَإٖ مَّسۡنُونٖ

en.text: He said, "Never would I prostrate to a human whom You created out of clay from an altered black mud."

so.text: 33. Wuxuu yidhi: Anigu ma ahi mid u sujuudaya qof aad ka abuurtay dhoobo shanqarta oo madow doorsoon ah.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ فَٱخۡرُجۡ مِنۡهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٞ

en.text: [Allāh] said, "Then depart from it,[677] for indeed, you are expelled.
en.footnotes: [677] Your position in the heavens.

so.text: 34. (Alle) wuxuu yidhi: Haddaba Ka bax (Jannada), adigu waa lagu deyrshaye.

ayat.arabic: وَإِنَّ عَلَيۡكَ ٱللَّعۡنَةَ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلدِّينِ

en.text: And indeed, upon you is the curse until the Day of Recompense."

so.text: 35. Waxaana xaqiiq dushaada ah Nacalad ilaa Maalinta is Abaal marinta 'Qiyaamada'.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرۡنِيٓ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ يُبۡعَثُونَ

en.text: He said, "My Lord, then reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected."

so.text: 36. Wuxuu yidhi: Rabbiyow! I sii waqti ilaa Maalinta la soo bixinayo (Qiyaamada).

ayat.arabic: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُنظَرِينَ

en.text: [Allāh] said, "So indeed, you are of those reprieved

so.text: 37.(Alle) wuxuu yidhi: Waxaad ka mid tahay kuwa la siiyey fursadda (ee la sugi).

ayat.arabic: إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡوَقۡتِ ٱلۡمَعۡلُومِ

en.text: Until the Day of the time well-known."

so.text: 38. Ilaa Maalinta (Qiyaamada) ee waqtiga la yaqaan leh (Alle keliya uu Og yahay).

ayat.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَآ أَغۡوَيۡتَنِي لَأُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَأُغۡوِيَنَّهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ

en.text: [Iblees] said, "My Lord, because You have put me in error, I will surely make [disobedience] attractive to them [i.e., mankind] on earth, and I will mislead them all

so.text: 39. (Shaydaan) wuxuu yidhi: Rabbiyow! Sidaad ii lumisayba, Waxaan u qurxin denbiyada dhulka korkiisa, waana dhumin  iyagoo dhan.

ayat.arabic: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنۡهُمُ ٱلۡمُخۡلَصِينَ

en.text: Except, among them, Your chosen servants."

so.text: 40. Addoomahaaga ku jira ee daacadda ah mooyee kuu keli iyo gaar yeela cibaadada.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ عَلَيَّ مُسۡتَقِيمٌ

en.text: [Allāh] said, "This is a path [of return] to Me [that is] straight.

so.text: 41. (Alle) wuxuu yidhi: Kani waa Jid Toosan oo Xaggeyga ah.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ عِبَادِي لَيۡسَ لَكَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ سُلۡطَٰنٌ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلۡغَاوِينَ

en.text: Indeed, My servants - no authority will you have over them, except those who follow you of the deviators.

so.text: 42. Addoomahayga kuma lihid awood dushooda, kuwa ku raaca ee iyagu lunsan mooyee.

ayat.arabic: وَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمَوۡعِدُهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ

en.text: And indeed, Hell is the promised place for them all.

so.text: 43. Oo hubaal waa Jahannama dhabtii madashooda iyagoo dhan.

ayat.arabic: لَهَا سَبۡعَةُ أَبۡوَٰبٖ لِّكُلِّ بَابٖ مِّنۡهُمۡ جُزۡءٞ مَّقۡسُومٌ

en.text: It has seven gates; for every gate is of them [i.e., Satan's followers] a portion designated."

so.text: 44. Waxay leedahay toddoba Albaabood, albaab walbaa waxaa ahaan qayb gaar ah oo ka mid ah (ehlu Naarka).

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّٰتٖ وَعُيُونٍ

en.text: Indeed, the righteous will be within gardens and springs,

so.text: 45. Hubaal, kuwa Alle ka dhowrsada (xumaha) waxay dhex ahaan  Beero iyo ilo.

ayat.arabic: ٱدۡخُلُوهَا بِسَلَٰمٍ ءَامِنِينَ

en.text: [Having been told], "Enter it in peace, safe [and secure]."

so.text: 46. (Waxaa lagu odhan): Ku gala (Jannada) nabad idinkoo aamin ah.

ayat.arabic: وَنَزَعۡنَا مَا فِي صُدُورِهِم مِّنۡ غِلٍّ إِخۡوَٰنًا عَلَىٰ سُرُرٖ مُّتَقَٰبِلِينَ

en.text: And We will remove whatever is in their breasts of resentment,[678] [so they will be] brothers, on thrones facing each other.
en.footnotes: [678] See footnote to 7:43.

so.text: 47. Waxaanu ka soo siibi wixii xumaan kala tirsi ah oo ku jira laabahooda, (waxay ahaan) walaalo ku sugan sariiro boqoreed dushood is qaabilsan fool ka fool.

ayat.arabic: لَا يَمَسُّهُمۡ فِيهَا نَصَبٞ وَمَا هُم مِّنۡهَا بِمُخۡرَجِينَ

en.text: No fatigue will touch them therein, nor from it will they [ever] be removed.

so.text: 48. Kuma taabanayo gudaheeda daal, xaggeedana lagama soo saarayo.

ayat.arabic: ۞ نَبِّئۡ عِبَادِيٓ أَنِّيٓ أَنَا ٱلۡغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

en.text: [O Muḥammad], inform My servants that it is I who am the Forgiving, the Merciful,

so.text: 49. Ogeysii addoomahayga inaan Anigu (Alle) ahay Denbi Dhaaf Badanaha, Naxariista Badan.

ayat.arabic: وَأَنَّ عَذَابِي هُوَ ٱلۡعَذَابُ ٱلۡأَلِيمُ

en.text: And that it is My punishment which is the painful punishment.

so.text: 50. Iyo in Cadaabkaygu uu yahay cadaabka xanuunka badan.

ayat.arabic: وَنَبِّئۡهُمۡ عَن ضَيۡفِ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ

en.text: And inform them about the guests of Abraham,

so.text: 51. Uga warran martidii Ibraahiim.

ayat.arabic: إِذۡ دَخَلُواْ عَلَيۡهِ فَقَالُواْ سَلَٰمٗا قَالَ إِنَّا مِنكُمۡ وَجِلُونَ

en.text: When they entered upon him and said, "Peace." [Abraham] said, "Indeed, we are fearful [i.e., apprehensive] of you."

so.text: 52. Markay u soo galeen, waxay yidhaadeen: Nabad ahaada. Wuxuu yidhi: Innagu waanu idinka cabsan.

ayat.arabic: قَالُواْ لَا تَوۡجَلۡ إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَٰمٍ عَلِيمٖ

en.text: [The angels] said, "Fear not. Indeed, we give you good tidings of a learned boy."

so.text: 53. Waxay (malaa’igtii) yidhaahdeen: Ha cabsan. Waxaanu xaqiiq kuugu bishaareyn wiil aqoon leh (Isxaaq).

ayat.arabic: قَالَ أَبَشَّرۡتُمُونِي عَلَىٰٓ أَن مَّسَّنِيَ ٱلۡكِبَرُ فَبِمَ تُبَشِّرُونَ

en.text: He said, "Have you given me good tidings although old age has come upon me? Then of what [wonder] do you inform?"

so.text: 54. (Ibraahiim) wuxuu yidhi: Ma waxaad iigu bishaareyneysaan (wiil) anigoo ay i soo taabatay da' weyni? Ee maxaad iigu bishaarayneysaan?

ayat.arabic: قَالُواْ بَشَّرۡنَٰكَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ فَلَا تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلۡقَٰنِطِينَ

en.text: They said, "We have given you good tidings in truth, so do not be of the despairing."

so.text: 55. Waxay (malaa'igtii) yidhaahdeen: Waxaan kuugu bishaaraynaynaa wax run ah. Ee ha ka mid noqon kuwa quusta.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ وَمَن يَقۡنَطُ مِن رَّحۡمَةِ رَبِّهِۦٓ إِلَّا ٱلضَّآلُّونَ

en.text: He said, "And who despairs of the mercy of his Lord except for those astray?"

so.text: 56. (Ibraahiim) wuxuu yidhi: Yaa ka quusta Naxariista Rabbigii aan ahayn kuwa lunsan.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ فَمَا خَطۡبُكُمۡ أَيُّهَا ٱلۡمُرۡسَلُونَ

en.text: [Abraham] said, "Then what is your business [here], O messengers?"

so.text: 57. (Ibraahiim) wuxuu yidhi: Waa maxay howsha aad u socotaan, kuwiinaan (malaa’igta ah ee) la soo dirayow?

ayat.arabic: قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّآ أُرۡسِلۡنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوۡمٖ مُّجۡرِمِينَ

en.text: They said, "Indeed, we have been sent to a people of criminals,

so.text: 58. Waxay (malaa’igtii) yidhaahdeen: Waxaa innaga naloo soo diray qolo denbiilayaal ah.

ayat.arabic: إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍ إِنَّا لَمُنَجُّوهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ

en.text: Except the family of Lot; indeed, we will save them all

so.text: 59. Reer Luud ma’ahee. Waanu badbaadin  iyagoo dhan.

ayat.arabic: إِلَّا ٱمۡرَأَتَهُۥ قَدَّرۡنَآ إِنَّهَا لَمِنَ ٱلۡغَٰبِرِينَ

en.text: Except his wife." We [i.e., Allāh] decreed that she is of those who remain behind.[679]
en.footnotes: [679] For having collaborated with the evildoers.

so.text: 60. Marwadiisa ma’ahee, waxaan qaddarnay inay ka mid ahaato kuwa ku haraya gadaal 'ee la cadaabi' [14].
so.footnotes: [14]. Kaalmeynteeda xuma falayaasha darteed.

ayat.arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ءَالَ لُوطٍ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلُونَ

en.text: And when the messengers came to the family of Lot,

so.text: 61. Markay u yimaadeen reer Luud Rusushii (malaa'igta ahayd ee) la soo diray.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ إِنَّكُمۡ قَوۡمٞ مُّنكَرُونَ

en.text: He said, "Indeed, you are people unknown."

so.text: 62. (Luud) wuxuu yidhi: Waxaad idinku dhabtii tihiin qolo aan la garanaynin.

ayat.arabic: قَالُواْ بَلۡ جِئۡنَٰكَ بِمَا كَانُواْ فِيهِ يَمۡتَرُونَ

en.text: They said, "But we have come to you with that about which they were disputing,

so.text: 63.Waxay (malaa’igtii) yidhaahdeen: Mayee waxaanu kuula nimid waxay ka doodayeen.

ayat.arabic: وَأَتَيۡنَٰكَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَإِنَّا لَصَٰدِقُونَ

en.text: And we have come to you with truth, and indeed, we are truthful.

so.text: 64. Waxaan kuula nimidna Xaq, oo run baynu sheegi.

ayat.arabic: فَأَسۡرِ بِأَهۡلِكَ بِقِطۡعٖ مِّنَ ٱلَّيۡلِ وَٱتَّبِعۡ أَدۡبَٰرَهُمۡ وَلَا يَلۡتَفِتۡ مِنكُمۡ أَحَدٞ وَٱمۡضُواْ حَيۡثُ تُؤۡمَرُونَ

en.text: So set out with your family during a portion of the night and follow behind them and let not anyone among you look back and continue on to where you are commanded."

so.text: 65. Ee la guuree ehelkaaga qayb ka mid ah habeenka, soco gadaashooda, yaanu midkiinna dib soo jalleecin, aadana halka la idinku amray.

ayat.arabic: وَقَضَيۡنَآ إِلَيۡهِ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡأَمۡرَ أَنَّ دَابِرَ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ مَقۡطُوعٞ مُّصۡبِحِينَ

en.text: And We conveyed to him [the decree] of that matter: that those [sinners] would be eliminated by early morning.

so.text: 66. Waxaana u waxyoonnay arrinkan ah in cidhibta kuwaas (gaalada ah) la goyn subaxa horeba.

ayat.arabic: وَجَآءَ أَهۡلُ ٱلۡمَدِينَةِ يَسۡتَبۡشِرُونَ

en.text: And the people of the city came rejoicing.[680]
en.footnotes: [680] At the news of Lot's visitors.

so.text: 67. Waxaana yimid dadkii magaalada iyagoo ku bishaareysan 'martida timid' [15],
so.footnotes: [15]. Ku faraxsan warka martida Luud ee yimid magaalada.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ ضَيۡفِي فَلَا تَفۡضَحُونِ

en.text: [Lot] said, "Indeed, these are my guests, so do not shame me.

so.text: 68. (Luud) wuxuu yidhi: Kuwakanu waa martidaydii ee ha igu fadayxeynina.

ayat.arabic: وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَلَا تُخۡزُونِ

en.text: And fear Allāh and do not disgrace me."

so.text: 69. Allena ka cabsada oo ha i ceebeynina.

ayat.arabic: قَالُوٓاْ أَوَلَمۡ نَنۡهَكَ عَنِ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

en.text: They said, "Have we not forbidden you from [protecting] people?"

so.text: 70. Waxay yidhaahdeen: Miyaanaan kaa reebin inaad (nagala hadasho) dadka shisheeyaha ah [16]?
so.footnotes: [16]. Waxay ku fali jireen xumaha fuulidda ragga ah martidooda, waxayna u handadeen Luud si uusan uga reebin ficilkaa xun ee khaniisnimada.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ بَنَاتِيٓ إِن كُنتُمۡ فَٰعِلِينَ

en.text: [Lot] said, "These are my daughters[681] - if you would be doers [of lawful marriage]."
en.footnotes: [681] i.e., the women of his community who were lawful for marriage.

so.text: 71. (Luud) wuxuu yidhi: Kuwaanu waa gabdhahaygii [17], haddaad yeeleysaan (inaad guursataan).
so.footnotes: [17]. Gabdhaha qoonkiisa ee u bannaan inay guursadaan.

ayat.arabic: لَعَمۡرُكَ إِنَّهُمۡ لَفِي سَكۡرَتِهِمۡ يَعۡمَهُونَ

en.text: By your life, [O Muḥammad], indeed they were, in their intoxication, wandering blindly.

so.text: 72. Waa igu Cimrigaaga'e (Nabi Muxammadow), waxay indho la’aan ku heehabayeen sakhraansanidoodii [18].
so.footnotes: [18]. Waxaa caadada Carabta ka mid aheyd inay ku dhaartaan qofka cumrigiisa. Wuxuu halkan Alle ku dhaartay cumriga Nabi Muxammad s.c.w. taasoo muujineysa meeqaankiisa iyo meesha weyn uu Nabigu s.c.w. ka joogo Alle kor ahaaye. Alle wuxuu doono buu ku dhaartaa, dadkuse waa ka xaaraan inay ku dhaartaan waxaan Alle ahayn.

ayat.arabic: فَأَخَذَتۡهُمُ ٱلصَّيۡحَةُ مُشۡرِقِينَ

en.text: So the shriek[682] seized them at sunrise.
en.footnotes: [682] See footnote to 11:67.

so.text: 73. Markaas baa qeylo weyn (qarax) qabtay qorrax soo bixiiba;

ayat.arabic: فَجَعَلۡنَا عَٰلِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَأَمۡطَرۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ حِجَارَةٗ مِّن سِجِّيلٍ

en.text: And We made the highest part [of the city] its lowest and rained upon them stones of hard clay.

so.text: 74. Waxaana u gambinnay korkoodii hoos oo roob kaga dhignay dushooda dhagaxyo dab naar ah.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّلۡمُتَوَسِّمِينَ

en.text: Indeed in that are signs for those who discern.

so.text: 75. Arrinkaas waxaa xaqiiq ugu sugan calaamooyin kuwa wax ka fiirsada.

ayat.arabic: وَإِنَّهَا لَبِسَبِيلٖ مُّقِيمٍ

en.text: And indeed, they [i.e., those cities] are [situated] on an established road.

so.text: 76. Waxayna ku taal 'magaaladaasi' [19] waddo weli la deggan yahay.
so.footnotes: [19]. Magaalada Sodom ee u dhow badda meytan ee hadda loo yaqaan Al-Baxrul Mutawasid ama Mideterean.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗ لِّلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ

en.text: Indeed in that is a sign for the believers.

so.text: 77. Arrinkaas waxaa xaqiiq ugu sugan calaamo mu’miniinta.

ayat.arabic: وَإِن كَانَ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡأَيۡكَةِ لَظَٰلِمِينَ

en.text: And the companions of the thicket [i.e., the people of Madyan] were [also] wrongdoers,

so.text: 78. Dadkii degganaa hawdka [20] waxay iyaguna ahaayeen daalimiin (gar diid).
so.footnotes: [20]. Dadka Aykah ama reer hawdka ama keynta waa qoonkii Shuacyb. Aykah waxay ahayd meel u dhow Madyan.

ayat.arabic: فَٱنتَقَمۡنَا مِنۡهُمۡ وَإِنَّهُمَا لَبِإِمَامٖ مُّبِينٖ

en.text: So We took retribution from them, and indeed, both [cities] are on a clear highway.

so.text: 79. Markaasaan ka aargudannay. Waxayna labaduba [21] ku yaallaan waddo cad (oo weli) la maro.
so.footnotes: [21]. Waxaa loola jeedaa magaalooyinka qoonkii Luud iyo Shucayb (Jetro).

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ كَذَّبَ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡحِجۡرِ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ

en.text: And certainly did the companions of al-Ḥijr[683] [i.e., the Thamūd] deny the messengers.
en.footnotes: [683] The valley of stone.

so.text: 80. Dadkii degganaana dhadhaabka [22] 'ee reer  Thamuud' waxay beeniyeen Rususha.
so.footnotes: [22]. Dhulkii dhagaxa.

ayat.arabic: وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُمۡ ءَايَٰتِنَا فَكَانُواْ عَنۡهَا مُعۡرِضِينَ

en.text: And We gave them Our signs, but from them they were turning away.

so.text: 81. Waxaanuna siinnay Aayadahayagii, waxayse ahaayeen kuwa ka jeesada.

ayat.arabic: وَكَانُواْ يَنۡحِتُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا ءَامِنِينَ

en.text: And they used to carve from the mountains, houses, feeling secure.

so.text: 82. Waxay ahaayeen kuwo ka qota buuraha guryo iyago aamin ah.

ayat.arabic: فَأَخَذَتۡهُمُ ٱلصَّيۡحَةُ مُصۡبِحِينَ

en.text: But the shriek seized them at early morning,

so.text: 83. Markaasaa waxaa qabtay qeylo (qarax) weyn waaberkiiba.

ayat.arabic: فَمَآ أَغۡنَىٰ عَنۡهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يَكۡسِبُونَ

en.text: So nothing availed them [from] what they used to earn.

so.text: 84. Waxbana uma tarin waxay kasbadeen (oo maal ah iyo dhismooyin dhaadheer).

ayat.arabic: وَمَا خَلَقۡنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلۡحَقِّۗ وَإِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ لَأٓتِيَةٞۖ فَٱصۡفَحِ ٱلصَّفۡحَ ٱلۡجَمِيلَ

en.text: And We have not created the heavens and earth and that between them except in truth. And indeed, the Hour is coming; so forgive with gracious forgiveness.

so.text: 85. Uma aanu abuurin samooyinka iyo arlada iyo waxa u dhexeeya waxaan Xaq ahayn. Hubaal Saacadda (Qiyaame) way imanaysaa, ee isaga jeeso adigoo saamaxaya gefefkooda saamixid qurxoon.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ ٱلۡخَلَّٰقُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ

en.text: Indeed, your Lord - He is the Knowing Creator.

so.text: 86. Hubaal Rabbigaa waa Abuuraha wax kasta ee jira, wax waliba Ogsoonaha ah.

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ ءَاتَيۡنَٰكَ سَبۡعٗا مِّنَ ٱلۡمَثَانِي وَٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ ٱلۡعَظِيمَ

en.text: And We have certainly given you, [O Muḥammad], seven of the often repeated [verses][684] and the great Qur’ān.
en.footnotes: [684] Referring to Sūrah al-Fātiḥah.

so.text: 87. Waxaan dhab ahaan ku siinnay toddobo soo noqnoqota (Faatixada) iyo Qur’aanka Weyn.

ayat.arabic: لَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيۡنَيۡكَ إِلَىٰ مَا مَتَّعۡنَا بِهِۦٓ أَزۡوَٰجٗا مِّنۡهُمۡ وَلَا تَحۡزَنۡ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَٱخۡفِضۡ جَنَاحَكَ لِلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ

en.text: Do not extend your eyes toward that by which We have given enjoyment to [certain] categories of them [i.e., the disbelievers], and do not grieve over them. And lower your wing [i.e., show kindness] to the believers.

so.text: 88. Ha u taagin indhahaaga waxaanu ugu raaxeynay qaybo ka mid ah (gaalada), hana u murugoon una raarici (nuglee) garabkaaga mu’miniinta (u muuji naxariis).

ayat.arabic: وَقُلۡ إِنِّيٓ أَنَا ٱلنَّذِيرُ ٱلۡمُبِينُ

en.text: And say, "Indeed, I am the clear warner" -

so.text: 89. Dheh: Anigu waxaan ahay dige cad.

ayat.arabic: كَمَآ أَنزَلۡنَا عَلَى ٱلۡمُقۡتَسِمِينَ

en.text: Just as We had revealed [scriptures] to the separators[685]
en.footnotes: [685] Those who separated from the teachings of their prophets. Another meaning is "As We sent down [punishment] on the sworn opponents [to Allāh's message]."

so.text: 90. Sidaan ugu soo dejinnayba kala qaybiyaashii 'Yuhuudda iyo Nasaarada' [23].
so.footnotes: [23]. Tafsiir kale waa sidaan ugu soo dejinay Cadaab kuwii isu dhaarsaday ka hortagga xaqa iyo diiddadi oo loola jeedo mushrikiintii Carbeed.

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ جَعَلُواْ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ عِضِينَ

en.text: Who have made the Qur’ān into portions.[686]
en.footnotes: [686] Accepting part and rejecting part according to their own inclinations.

so.text: 91.Kuwaas ka dhigay Qur’aanka qaybo [24].
so.footnotes: [24]. Iyagoo qaadanaya Kitaabka qaarki,  beeninayana qaar kale iyagoo raacaya hawadooda.

ayat.arabic: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَسۡـَٔلَنَّهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ

en.text: So by your Lord, We will surely question them all

so.text: 92. Waa igu Rabbigaaye waanu weydiin dhammaantood,

ayat.arabic: عَمَّا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ

en.text: About what they used to do.

so.text: 93. Waxay falayeen.

ayat.arabic: فَٱصۡدَعۡ بِمَا تُؤۡمَرُ وَأَعۡرِضۡ عَنِ ٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ

en.text: Then declare what you are commanded[687] and turn away from the polytheists.[688]
en.footnotes:
[687] The implication is "Thereby you will distinguish or separate the disbelievers from the believers."
[688] Any who persist in association of others with Allāh.

so.text: 94. Ee daaha ka qaad wax lagugu amray [25], oo iskaga jeeso Mushrikiinta [26].
so.footnotes:
[25]. Waa ugu yeedhidda dadka Towxiidka iyo ka digitaanka shirkiga si loo kala saaro mu’miniinta iyo gaalada. 
[26]. Mid kastoo ku adkeysta shirkiga oo ah in lala wadaajiyo cibaadada Alle cid kale.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّا كَفَيۡنَٰكَ ٱلۡمُسۡتَهۡزِءِينَ

en.text: Indeed, We are sufficient for you against the mockers

so.text: 95. Annagaa xaqiiq kaa kaafiyeyna jees-jeesayaasha (ku jeesjeesa Diinta).

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجۡعَلُونَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَۚ فَسَوۡفَ يَعۡلَمُونَ

en.text: Who make [equal] with Allāh another deity. But they are going to know.

so.text: 96. Kuwa u yeela ilaah kale la jirka Alle, wayna ogaan doonaan (waxa ku dhaca).

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ نَعۡلَمُ أَنَّكَ يَضِيقُ صَدۡرُكَ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ

en.text: And We already know that your breast is constrained by what they say.

so.text: 97. Waxaana dhab ahaan ognahay inay ka cidhiidhyoonto laabtaadu waxay sheegi.

ayat.arabic: فَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ وَكُن مِّنَ ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ

en.text: So exalt [Allāh] with praise of your Lord and be of those who prostrate [to Him].

so.text: 98. Ee ku tasbiixso ammaanaha Rabbigaa oo ka mid ahow kuwa u sujuuda [27].
so.footnotes:
[27]. Ibnu Cabbaas a.k.r. waxaa laga soo weriyey inuu yidhi: Waxaan ku garan jirey bogidda salaadda faralka kor ugu qaadista codka Xusidda Alle sida takbiirta.
(W.w. Al-Bukhaari)

ayat.arabic: وَٱعۡبُدۡ رَبَّكَ حَتَّىٰ يَأۡتِيَكَ ٱلۡيَقِينُ

en.text: And worship your Lord until there comes to you the certainty [i.e., death].

so.text: 99. Caabud Rabbigaa (Alle) ilaa uu kuu yimaado kaasi la hubo (mowtka- Geerida).

ayat.arabic: أَتَىٰٓ أَمۡرُ ٱللَّهِ فَلَا تَسۡتَعۡجِلُوهُۚ سُبۡحَٰنَهُۥ وَتَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُونَ

en.text: The command of Allāh is coming,[690] so be not impatient for it. Exalted is He and high above what they associate with Him.
en.footnotes: [690] Literally, "has come," indicating the certainty and nearness of the Last Hour.

so.text: 1. Amarka Alle (Saacadda Qiyaame ama halaagidda gaalada) waa wax iman (oo dhow) ee waxba ha doonina in la soo dedejiyo. Xurmo oo dhan Isagaa (Alle) iska leh oo ka hufan (xumaan iyo iin), waana ka Sarreeyaa [1] waxay la wadaajiyaan (cibaadada).
so.footnotes: [1]. Ataa Luqad ahaan macnaheedu waxaa weeye waa yimid waxaana loola jeedaa muujin in la hubo oo yaqiin tahay oo ay aad u soo dhowdahay Saacadda Qiyaame ama halaagidda gaalada iyo guusha ay heli doonaan Muslimiinta. Ataa Waa ficil maadi (fal tagey) laakiin loogala jeedo mudaaric fal markaa lagu gudo jiro ama soo socda oo imanaya. Sideedana waxaa jira sagaal meelood oo falka tagey loogala jeedo fal soo socda ama markaa ah, waxaa ka mid ah hadalkii lagu billaabo  fal tagey, falka tagey ee soo aroora kaddib mid ka mid ah xuruurfta sharadka sida idaa jaa’a, in makkaannaahum, ama kaddib mowsuul sidaa alladiina aamanuu, iwm falalka tagey halkan waxaa loola jeedi karaa fal jooga ama soo socda.

ayat.arabic: يُنَزِّلُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ بِٱلرُّوحِ مِنۡ أَمۡرِهِۦ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنۡ عِبَادِهِۦٓ أَنۡ أَنذِرُوٓاْ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱتَّقُونِ

en.text: He sends down the angels, with the inspiration [i.e., revelation] of His command, upon whom He wills of His servants, [telling them], "Warn that there is no deity except Me; so fear Me."

so.text: 2. Wuxuu (Alle) la soo diraa malaa’igta Waxyi Amarkiisa ah (uu ku soo dejiyo) cidduu doono oo addoomahiisa ka mid ah (Isagoo leh): U diga (dadka) inuusan jirin ilaah (xaq lagu caabudo) aan ahayn Aniga (Allaah), ee Aniga uun iga cabsada 'oo iska jira shirkiga iyo xumaha kale."

ayat.arabic: خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ بِٱلۡحَقِّۚ تَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُونَ

en.text: He created the heavens and earth in truth. High is He above what they associate with Him.

so.text: 3. (Alle) wuxuu u abuuray samooyinka iyo arlada Xaq. Waa ka Sarreeyaa oo ka Kor yahay waxay la wadaajiyaan (cibaadada).

ayat.arabic: خَلَقَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ مِن نُّطۡفَةٖ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٞ مُّبِينٞ

en.text: He created man from a sperm-drop; then at once[691] he is a clear adversary.
en.footnotes: [691] As soon as he becomes strong and independent.

so.text: 4. Wuxuu ka abuuray aadmiga dhibic mino nool ah, mise, waa dood badane col cad ah [2].
so.footnotes: [2]. Durba markuu xoog yeesho oo madax bannaanaado.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمَ خَلَقَهَاۖ لَكُمۡ فِيهَا دِفۡءٞ وَمَنَٰفِعُ وَمِنۡهَا تَأۡكُلُونَ

en.text: And the grazing livestock He has created for you; in them is warmth[692] and [numerous] benefits, and from them you eat.
en.footnotes: [692] i.e., in clothing, tents, furnishings, etc.

so.text: 5. Xoolaha wuu idiin abuuray; waxaad ka heshaan dhar dugaal leh iyo manaafacaad kale [3], xaggeedana wax ka cuntaan.
so.footnotes: [3]. Dhar ahaan loo xidho, teendhooyin, alaabooyin, iwm.

ayat.arabic: وَلَكُمۡ فِيهَا جَمَالٌ حِينَ تُرِيحُونَ وَحِينَ تَسۡرَحُونَ

en.text: And for you in them is [the enjoyment of] beauty when you bring them in [for the evening] and when you send them out [to pasture].

so.text: 6. Waxaa idiinku sugan (xoolaha) qurux markaad u soo celinaysaan galabnimada 'guriga' iyo markaad u foofinaysaan daaqa.

ayat.arabic: وَتَحۡمِلُ أَثۡقَالَكُمۡ إِلَىٰ بَلَدٖ لَّمۡ تَكُونُواْ بَٰلِغِيهِ إِلَّا بِشِقِّ ٱلۡأَنفُسِۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكُمۡ لَرَءُوفٞ رَّحِيمٞ

en.text: And they carry your loads to a land you could not have reached except with difficulty to yourselves. Indeed, your Lord is Kind and Merciful.

so.text: 7. Waxaad ugu rarataan culeysyadiinna xagga gobollo aydaan gaari karteen nafa- hoo dhibtooda ma’ahee. Hubaal Rabbigiin waa Turid Badane, Naxariis Badan.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلۡخَيۡلَ وَٱلۡبِغَالَ وَٱلۡحَمِيرَ لِتَرۡكَبُوهَا وَزِينَةٗۚ وَيَخۡلُقُ مَا لَا تَعۡلَمُونَ

en.text: And [He created] the horses, mules and donkeys for you to ride and [as] adornment. And He creates that which you do not know.

so.text: 8. (Oo Wuxuu Alle idiin abuuray) Fardo, baqallo iyo dameerro inaad kortaan iyo qurux ahaanba. Wuxuuna abuuri wax aydaan ogeyn (oo gaadiid kale ah - gaadiidka dhulka, cirka iyo baddaba).

ayat.arabic: وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ قَصۡدُ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَمِنۡهَا جَآئِرٞۚ وَلَوۡ شَآءَ لَهَدَىٰكُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ

en.text: And upon Allāh[693] is the direction of the [right] way, and among them [i.e., the various paths] are those deviating. And if He willed, He could have guided you all.
en.footnotes: [693] Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) has taken it upon Himself to guide man to the right path. The meaning has also been interpreted as "To Allāh..."

so.text: 9. Alle bay saaran tahay xilka inuu caadeeyo Jidka Toosan, waxaase jira (jidad) qallooc ah. Hadduu doono hubaal wuu idin wada hanuuin lahaa dhammaantiin.

ayat.arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءٗۖ لَّكُم مِّنۡهُ شَرَابٞ وَمِنۡهُ شَجَرٞ فِيهِ تُسِيمُونَ

en.text: It is He who sends down rain from the sky; from it is drink and from it is foliage in which you pasture [animals].

so.text: 10. Waa Isaga Kan idiinka soo dejiya biyo (roob) daruuraha, waxaad ka heshaan cabbitaan, biyahaasoo (soo saara sidoo kale) geedaha aad daaqsataan (xoolaha).

ayat.arabic: يُنۢبِتُ لَكُم بِهِ ٱلزَّرۡعَ وَٱلزَّيۡتُونَ وَٱلنَّخِيلَ وَٱلۡأَعۡنَٰبَ وَمِن كُلِّ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗ لِّقَوۡمٖ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ

en.text: He causes to grow for you thereby the crops, olives, palm trees, grapevines, and of all the fruits. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who give thought.

so.text: 11. Wuxuu idiinku soo bixiyaa sarac, zaytuun, geedaha timirta, canabyo iyo nooc walba oo midhaha ah. Arrinkani waxaa xaqiiq ugu sugan calaamo ciddii fikiri.

ayat.arabic: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيۡلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ وَٱلشَّمۡسَ وَٱلۡقَمَرَۖ وَٱلنُّجُومُ مُسَخَّرَٰتُۢ بِأَمۡرِهِۦٓۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّقَوۡمٖ يَعۡقِلُونَ

en.text: And He has subjected for you the night and day and the sun and moon, and the stars are subjected by His command. Indeed in that are signs for a people who reason.

so.text: 12. Wuxuu idiin sakhiray habeenka iyo maalinta iyo qorraxda iyo dayaxa; xiddigu- huna waxay ku sakhiran yihiin Amarkiisa. Hubaal, arrinkani waxaa ugu sugan calaamooyin ciddii garasho leh.

ayat.arabic: وَمَا ذَرَأَ لَكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مُخۡتَلِفًا أَلۡوَٰنُهُۥٓۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗ لِّقَوۡمٖ يَذَّكَّرُونَ

en.text: And [He has subjected] whatever He multiplied for you on the earth of varying colors. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who remember.

so.text: 13. Iyo wuxuu idiinku abuuray dhulka korkiisa oo midabbo kala duwan leh. Hubaal arrinkani waxaa ugu sugan calaamo ciddii xusuusan.

ayat.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي سَخَّرَ ٱلۡبَحۡرَ لِتَأۡكُلُواْ مِنۡهُ لَحۡمٗا طَرِيّٗا وَتَسۡتَخۡرِجُواْ مِنۡهُ حِلۡيَةٗ تَلۡبَسُونَهَاۖ وَتَرَى ٱلۡفُلۡكَ مَوَاخِرَ فِيهِ وَلِتَبۡتَغُواْ مِن فَضۡلِهِۦ وَلَعَلَّكُمۡ تَشۡكُرُونَ

en.text: And it is He who subjected the sea for you to eat from it tender meat and to extract from it ornaments which you wear. And you see the ships plowing through it, and [He subjected it] that you may seek of His bounty; and perhaps you will be grateful.

so.text: 14. Alle  Waa Kan idiin sakhiray badda si aad uga cuntaan hilib jilicsan (kalluun) iyo inaad kala soo baxdaan qurux aad xidhataan. Waxaad aragtaan doonyaha oo dhex maaxaya badda gudaheeda, (wuuna idiin layliyey) si aad ugu raadsataan (sidaa) wax ka mid ah Deeqdiisa, iyo si aad ugu mahad naqdaan.

ayat.arabic: وَأَلۡقَىٰ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ رَوَٰسِيَ أَن تَمِيدَ بِكُمۡ وَأَنۡهَٰرٗا وَسُبُلٗا لَّعَلَّكُمۡ تَهۡتَدُونَ

en.text: And He has cast into the earth firmly set mountains, lest it shift with you, and [made] rivers and roads, that you may be guided,

so.text: 15. Wuxuu (Alle) ku dhidbay si sugan buuro waaweyn dhulka, si uusan idiinla iilan (wuxuuna yeelay) webiyaal iyo waddooyin si aad toos ugu socotaan.

ayat.arabic: وَعَلَٰمَٰتٖۚ وَبِٱلنَّجۡمِ هُمۡ يَهۡتَدُونَ

en.text: And landmarks. And by the stars they are [also] guided.[694]
en.footnotes: [694] Through the desert or the sea at night.

so.text: 16. Iyo calaamooyin dhulka lagu garto,  xiddigahayna ku helaan dhabbaha toosan (markay saxraha joogaan ama badda).

ayat.arabic: أَفَمَن يَخۡلُقُ كَمَن لَّا يَخۡلُقُۚ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ

en.text: Then is He who creates like one who does not create? So will you not be reminded?

so.text: 17. Ma mid (waa Alle'e) wax abuura baa la mid ah kuwo aan wax abuurin? Ma waydaan waansameyn?

ayat.arabic: وَإِن تَعُدُّواْ نِعۡمَةَ ٱللَّهِ لَا تُحۡصُوهَآۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَغَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٞ

en.text: And if you should count the favors of Allāh, you could not enumerate them. Indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.

so.text: 18. Haddaad tirisaan Nicmooyinka Alle, ma koobi kartaan. Hubaal Alle waa Denbi Dhaaf Badane, Naxariis Badan.

ayat.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ يَعۡلَمُ مَا تُسِرُّونَ وَمَا تُعۡلِنُونَ

en.text: And Allāh knows what you conceal and what you declare.

so.text: 19. Alle wuu Og yahay waxaad qarisaan iyo waxaad muujisaanba.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ لَا يَخۡلُقُونَ شَيۡـٔٗا وَهُمۡ يُخۡلَقُونَ

en.text: And those they invoke other than Allāh create nothing, and they [themselves] are created.

so.text: 20. Kuwa ay baryaanna (caabudaan) Alle sokadi waxba ma abuuraan, iyagaase la abuuraa.

ayat.arabic: أَمۡوَٰتٌ غَيۡرُ أَحۡيَآءٖۖ وَمَا يَشۡعُرُونَ أَيَّانَ يُبۡعَثُونَ

en.text: They are [in fact] dead,[695] not alive, and they do not perceive when they will be resurrected.
en.footnotes: [695] i.e., inanimate or without understanding.

so.text: 21. (Waa) mayti aan nooleyn, mana oga goorta la soo bixinayo.

ayat.arabic: إِلَٰهُكُمۡ إِلَٰهٞ وَٰحِدٞۚ فَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ قُلُوبُهُم مُّنكِرَةٞ وَهُم مُّسۡتَكۡبِرُونَ

en.text: Your god is one God. But those who do not believe in the Hereafter - their hearts are disapproving, and they are arrogant.

so.text: 22. Ilaahiinnu waa Ilaah Mid Keliya ah (Allaah). Kuwase aan rumeysneyn Aakhirada, quluubtoodu way diidaan (Towxiidka), wayna isla weyn yihiin.

ayat.arabic: لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعۡلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعۡلِنُونَۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلۡمُسۡتَكۡبِرِينَ

en.text: Assuredly, Allāh knows what they conceal and what they declare. Indeed, He does not like the arrogant.

so.text: 23. Shaki ma leh, in Alle Ogsoon yahay waxay qariyaan iyo waxay muujiyaanba. Hubaal Alle ma jecla kuwa isla weyn.

ayat.arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُم مَّاذَآ أَنزَلَ رَبُّكُمۡ قَالُوٓاْ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ

en.text: And when it is said to them, "What has your Lord sent down?" they say, "Legends of the former peoples,"

so.text: 24. Marka (gaalada) lagu yidhaahdo: Muxuu soo dejiyey Rabbigiin? Waxay yidhaadaan: Sheekooyinka kuwii hore.

ayat.arabic: لِيَحۡمِلُوٓاْ أَوۡزَارَهُمۡ كَامِلَةٗ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ وَمِنۡ أَوۡزَارِ ٱلَّذِينَ يُضِلُّونَهُم بِغَيۡرِ عِلۡمٍۗ أَلَا سَآءَ مَا يَزِرُونَ

en.text: That they may bear their own burdens [i.e., sins] in full on the Day of Resurrection and some of the burdens of those whom they misguide without [i.e., by lack of] knowledge. Unquestionably, evil is that which they bear.

so.text: 25. Si ay u xambaaraan culeysyadooda (denbiyadooda) oo dhan Maalinta Qiyaamaha, iyo culeysyada (denbiyada) kuwa ay ku lumiyaan aqoon darro. Ogaada, wax xun waa waxay xambaaran (oo denbiyo ah).

ayat.arabic: قَدۡ مَكَرَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡ فَأَتَى ٱللَّهُ بُنۡيَٰنَهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡقَوَاعِدِ فَخَرَّ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلسَّقۡفُ مِن فَوۡقِهِمۡ وَأَتَىٰهُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابُ مِنۡ حَيۡثُ لَا يَشۡعُرُونَ

en.text: Those before them had already plotted, but Allāh came at [i.e., uprooted] their building from the foundations, so the roof fell upon them from above them,[696] and the punishment came to them from where they did not perceive.
en.footnotes: [696] i.e., Allāh caused their plan to fail and exposed their plot.

so.text: 26. Waxaa wax dhagray oo tab degay kuwii iyaga ka horreeyey, Wuxuuse Alle uga yimid dhismayaashoodii xagga aasaasyada, markaasuu saqafkii ku soo dumay korkooda, cadaabkuna wuxuu uga yimid meel aysan ka fileyn [4].
so.footnotes: [4]. Alle wuxuu sababay qorshahoodu inuu fashilmo oo bannaanka keenay dhagartooda iyo shirqoolkooda xun.

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ يُخۡزِيهِمۡ وَيَقُولُ أَيۡنَ شُرَكَآءِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ كُنتُمۡ تُشَٰٓقُّونَ فِيهِمۡۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡعِلۡمَ إِنَّ ٱلۡخِزۡيَ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ وَٱلسُّوٓءَ عَلَى ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ

en.text: Then on the Day of Resurrection He will disgrace them and say, "Where are My 'partners' for whom you used to oppose [the believers]?" Those who were given knowledge will say, "Indeed disgrace, this Day, and evil are upon the disbelievers" -

so.text: 27. Kaddib Maalinta Qiyaamaha wuu dullayn [5], wuxuuna odhan: Meeye shurakadii aad ila wadaajiseen cibaadada ee aad iyaga awgood u noqoteen col? Kuwa cilmiga la siiyey waxay odhan: Dulli iyo dar xumo waxay maanta haysataa gaalada.
so.footnotes: [5]. Macnaha waxaa weeye wuxuu ka yeeli inay mutaan ciqaab denbiyadooda badan dartood.

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ تَتَوَفَّىٰهُمُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ ظَالِمِيٓ أَنفُسِهِمۡۖ فَأَلۡقَوُاْ ٱلسَّلَمَ مَا كُنَّا نَعۡمَلُ مِن سُوٓءِۭۚ بَلَىٰٓۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمُۢ بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ

en.text: The ones whom the angels take in death [while] wronging themselves,[697] and [who] then offer submission, [saying], "We were not doing any evil." But, yes! Indeed, Allāh is Knowing of what you used to do.
en.footnotes: [697] i.e., having made punishment due to them for their numerous sins and crimes.

so.text: 28. Kuwa ay malaa’igtu oofsan6 iyagoo ku dulminaya nafahooda (shirki ama denbiyo  kale oo waaweyn). Waxayna markaas muujiyaan hoggaansamid (iyagoo leh): Ma ba aanu fali jirin wax xume ah. Haayoo, hubaal, Alle baa ogsoon waxaad falayseen.[6]
so.footnotes: [6]. Imaanshaha malaa’igta si ay u qaadaan nafahooda.

ayat.arabic: فَٱدۡخُلُوٓاْ أَبۡوَٰبَ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَاۖ فَلَبِئۡسَ مَثۡوَى ٱلۡمُتَكَبِّرِينَ

en.text: So enter the gates of Hell to abide eternally therein, and how wretched is the residence of the arrogant.

so.text: 29. Gala albaabbada Jahannama idinkoo ku waaraya dhexdeeda. Xumaa hoyga isla weynayaasha.

ayat.arabic: ۞ وَقِيلَ لِلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوۡاْ مَاذَآ أَنزَلَ رَبُّكُمۡۚ قَالُواْ خَيۡرٗاۗ لِّلَّذِينَ أَحۡسَنُواْ فِي هَٰذِهِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا حَسَنَةٞۚ وَلَدَارُ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ خَيۡرٞۚ وَلَنِعۡمَ دَارُ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ

en.text: And it will be said to those who feared Allāh, "What did your Lord send down?" They will say, "[That which is] good." For those who do good in this world is good; and the home of the Hereafter is better. And how excellent is the home of the righteous -

so.text: 30. Waxaa lagu yidhaahdaa kuwa ka dhowrsada (xumaha): Muxuu Rabbigiin soo dejiyey? Waxay yidhaahdaan: Khayr. Waxay leeyihiin kuwa sama ku fala adduunyadan samaan,  Daarta Aakhiraana khayr badan. Wanaagsanaa Daarta kuwa iska jira (xumaha ee dhowra amarrada Alle).

ayat.arabic: جَنَّٰتُ عَدۡنٖ يَدۡخُلُونَهَا تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُۖ لَهُمۡ فِيهَا مَا يَشَآءُونَۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يَجۡزِي ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ

en.text: Gardens of perpetual residence, which they will enter, beneath which rivers flow. They will have therein whatever they wish. Thus does Allāh reward the righteous -

so.text: 31. Beeraha negaadiga (jannatu cadan) bay gelayaan ay hoostoodu webiyo qulqulaan, waxay ku mudan gudaheeda waxay doonaan. Sidaasuu Alle ku abaal mariyaa kuwa iska jira ( xumaha ee dhowra Amarradiisa).

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ تَتَوَفَّىٰهُمُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ طَيِّبِينَ يَقُولُونَ سَلَٰمٌ عَلَيۡكُمُ ٱدۡخُلُواْ ٱلۡجَنَّةَ بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ

en.text: The ones whom the angels take in death, [being] good and pure; [the angels] will say, "Peace be upon you. Enter Paradise for what you used to do."

so.text: 32. Kuwa ay malaa’igtu oofsato iyagoo ku sugan xaalad wanaagsan iyagoo ku odhan: Nabad korkiinna ha ahaato: Gala Jannada waxaad (samo) fasheen darteed.

ayat.arabic: هَلۡ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّآ أَن تَأۡتِيَهُمُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ أَوۡ يَأۡتِيَ أَمۡرُ رَبِّكَۚ كَذَٰلِكَ فَعَلَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡۚ وَمَا ظَلَمَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَلَٰكِن كَانُوٓاْ أَنفُسَهُمۡ يَظۡلِمُونَ

en.text: Do they [i.e., the disbelievers] await except that the angels should come to them or there comes the command of your Lord? Thus did those do before them. And Allāh wronged them not, but they had been wronging themselves.

so.text: 33. Ma waxay sugayaan waxaan ahayn inay malaa’igtu u timaaddo ama Amarka Rabbigaa [7] u yimaado inuu fulo? Sidaasoo kale bay faleen kuwii ka horreeyey. Alle ma dulmin, iyagaase nafahooda dulmiyay.
so.footnotes: [7]. Ka imaanshaha cadaab xagga Alle si uu ugu halaago.

ayat.arabic: فَأَصَابَهُمۡ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا عَمِلُواْ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ

en.text: So they were struck by the evil consequences of what they did and were enveloped by what they used to ridicule.

so.text: 34. Waxaa ku dhacay xumaano waxay faleen, waxaana hareeyey (ciqaabtii) ay ku jeesjeesayeen.

ayat.arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَشۡرَكُواْ لَوۡ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مَا عَبَدۡنَا مِن دُونِهِۦ مِن شَيۡءٖ نَّحۡنُ وَلَآ ءَابَآؤُنَا وَلَا حَرَّمۡنَا مِن دُونِهِۦ مِن شَيۡءٖۚ كَذَٰلِكَ فَعَلَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡۚ فَهَلۡ عَلَى ٱلرُّسُلِ إِلَّا ٱلۡبَلَٰغُ ٱلۡمُبِينُ

en.text: And those who associate others with Allāh say, "If Allāh had willed, we would not have worshipped anything other than Him, neither we nor our fathers, nor would we have forbidden anything through other than Him." Thus did those do before them. So is there upon the messengers except [the duty of] clear notification?

so.text: 35. Kuwa Alle u shariig yeela waxay yidhaahdaan: Hadduu Alle doono ma aanu caabudneen waxba Sokadi innaga iyo aabbayaashayo midna, mana xaaraamayneen waxbana (Amarkiisa) la’aanti. Sidaasoo kale bay faleen kuwii ka horreeyey: Ee ma waxaa saaran Rususha waxaan aheyn gaarsiin cad?

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ بَعَثۡنَا فِي كُلِّ أُمَّةٖ رَّسُولًا أَنِ ٱعۡبُدُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَٱجۡتَنِبُواْ ٱلطَّٰغُوتَۖ فَمِنۡهُم مَّنۡ هَدَى ٱللَّهُ وَمِنۡهُم مَّنۡ حَقَّتۡ عَلَيۡهِ ٱلضَّلَٰلَةُۚ فَسِيرُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَٱنظُرُواْ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ

en.text: And We certainly sent into every nation a messenger, [saying], "Worship Allāh and avoid ṭāghūt."[698] And among them were those whom Allāh guided, and among them were those upon whom error was [deservedly] decreed. So proceed [i.e., travel] through the earth and observe how was the end of the deniers.
en.footnotes: [698] False objects of worship.

so.text: 36. Waxaan ka soo bixinnay ummad walba Rasuul (leh): Caabuda Alle Keliya, kana dheeraada Dhaaquut (sheydaanka iyo cibaadada wax Alle ka soo hadhay). Waxaa ka mid ah kuwo Alle uu hanuuniyey, waxaana ka mid ah kuwo habowga ku waajibay. Ee mara dhulka oo fiiriya siday aheyd cidhibta beeniyayaasha (Xaqa).

ayat.arabic: إِن تَحۡرِصۡ عَلَىٰ هُدَىٰهُمۡ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهۡدِي مَن يُضِلُّۖ وَمَا لَهُم مِّن نَّٰصِرِينَ

en.text: [Even] if you should strive for their guidance, [O Muḥammad], indeed, Allāh does not guide those He sends astray,[699] and they will have no helpers.
en.footnotes: [699] As a result of their choice to reject guidance.

so.text: 37. Haddaad ku dadaashid hanuunkooda, Alle ma hanuuniyo cid uu lumiyo [8], mana helaan wax u soo gargaara (Aakhirada).
so.footnotes: [8]. Sababta doorashadooda inay diidaan hanuunka.

ayat.arabic: وَأَقۡسَمُواْ بِٱللَّهِ جَهۡدَ أَيۡمَٰنِهِمۡ لَا يَبۡعَثُ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَمُوتُۚ بَلَىٰ وَعۡدًا عَلَيۡهِ حَقّٗا وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ

en.text: And they swear by Allāh their strongest oaths [that] Allāh will not resurrect one who dies. But yes - [it is] a true promise [binding] upon Him, but most of the people do not know.

so.text: 38. Waxay ku dhartaan Alle  dhaarahooda kuwa ugu adag inuusan Alle soo bixineyn cid dhimatay. Haayoo waa ballan saaran oo Xaq ah, dadkuse badankiisu ma oga.

ayat.arabic: لِيُبَيِّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلَّذِي يَخۡتَلِفُونَ فِيهِ وَلِيَعۡلَمَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ أَنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ كَٰذِبِينَ

en.text: [It is] so He will make clear to them [the truth of] that wherein they differ and so those who have disbelieved may know that they were liars.

so.text: 39. (Waa) si uu ugu caddeeyo (abbaarta) waxay isku khilaafsan yihiin, iyo inay ogaadaan kuwa gaalooba inay ahaayeen beenaalayaal.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّمَا قَوۡلُنَا لِشَيۡءٍ إِذَآ أَرَدۡنَٰهُ أَن نَّقُولَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ

en.text: Indeed, Our word to a thing when We intend it is but that We say to it, "Be," and it is.

so.text: 40. Sideedaba Qowlkayagu markaan wax doonno waa oo Keliya inaan ku nidhaahno: "Ahaw” waana uu yahay.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هَاجَرُواْ فِي ٱللَّهِ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا ظُلِمُواْ لَنُبَوِّئَنَّهُمۡ فِي ٱلدُّنۡيَا حَسَنَةٗۖ وَلَأَجۡرُ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ أَكۡبَرُۚ لَوۡ كَانُواْ يَعۡلَمُونَ

en.text: And those who emigrated for [the cause of] Allāh after they had been wronged - We will surely settle them in this world in a good place; but the reward of the Hereafter is greater, if only they could know.

so.text: 41. Kuwa u soo haajira Alle Darti, kaddib markii la dulmiyey, Waxaan ku siin meeqaan wanaagsan adduunka, ajarka Aakhiraana  ka weyn, hadday ogaan lahaayeen.

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ صَبَرُواْ وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمۡ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ

en.text: [They are] those who endured patiently and upon their Lord relied.

so.text: 42. Kuwa samra oo Rabbigood tala saarta.

ayat.arabic: وَمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مِن قَبۡلِكَ إِلَّا رِجَالٗا نُّوحِيٓ إِلَيۡهِمۡۖ فَسۡـَٔلُوٓاْ أَهۡلَ ٱلذِّكۡرِ إِن كُنتُمۡ لَا تَعۡلَمُونَ

en.text: And We sent not before you except men to whom We revealed [Our message]. So ask the people of the message [i.e., former scriptures] if you do not know.

so.text: 43. Ma aanu soo dirin adiga hortaa (Nabi Muxammadow) waxaan ahayn rag aan u waxyoonno (oo ma soo dirin malaa’ig). Ee weydiiya ehlu Dikirka (yaqaan Towraadda iyo Injiilka), haddaydaan ogeyn.

ayat.arabic: بِٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِ وَٱلزُّبُرِۗ وَأَنزَلۡنَآ إِلَيۡكَ ٱلذِّكۡرَ لِتُبَيِّنَ لِلنَّاسِ مَا نُزِّلَ إِلَيۡهِمۡ وَلَعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ

en.text: [We sent them] with clear proofs and written ordinances. And We revealed to you the message [i.e., the Qur’ān] that you may make clear to the people what was sent down to them and that they might give thought.

so.text: 44. Xujooyin cad iyo Kutub (baan la soo dirnay Rususha). Waxaana kugu soo dejinnay Waanada (Qur’aanka), si aad ugu caddaysid dadka waxa loo soo dejiyey, bal inay u fiiro yeeshaan oo ay wax ku qaataan.

ayat.arabic: أَفَأَمِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ مَكَرُواْ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ أَن يَخۡسِفَ ٱللَّهُ بِهِمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ أَوۡ يَأۡتِيَهُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابُ مِنۡ حَيۡثُ لَا يَشۡعُرُونَ

en.text: Then, do those who have planned evil deeds feel secure that Allāh will not cause the earth to swallow them or that the punishment will not come upon them from where they do not perceive?

so.text: 45. Ma waxay kuwa qoola xumaha aamin ka yihiin in Alle la gooyo dhulka, ama uga yimaado cadaabka meel aanay ka fileyn?

ayat.arabic: أَوۡ يَأۡخُذَهُمۡ فِي تَقَلُّبِهِمۡ فَمَا هُم بِمُعۡجِزِينَ

en.text: Or that He would not seize them during their [usual] activity, and they could not cause failure [i.e., escape from Him]?

so.text: 46. Ama qabto iyagoo ku jira howlahooda, markaas ma ka baxsan karaan (Ciqaabka)?

ayat.arabic: أَوۡ يَأۡخُذَهُمۡ عَلَىٰ تَخَوُّفٖ فَإِنَّ رَبَّكُمۡ لَرَءُوفٞ رَّحِيمٌ

en.text: Or that He would not seize them gradually [in a state of dread]?[700] But indeed, your Lord is Kind and Merciful.[701]
en.footnotes:
[700] i.e., being aware of what is about to strike them after having seen those near them succumb.
[701] Postponing deserved punishment and giving opportunities for repentance.

so.text: 47. Ama qabto iyagoo ku sugan cabsi isa soo tarta. Rabbiggiinna waa Turid Badane, Naxariis Badan [9].
so.footnotes: [9]. Isagoo dib ugu dhiga ciqaabka ay mudan yihiin oo siiya fursad ay ku toobad keenaan.

ayat.arabic: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ إِلَىٰ مَا خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ مِن شَيۡءٖ يَتَفَيَّؤُاْ ظِلَٰلُهُۥ عَنِ ٱلۡيَمِينِ وَٱلشَّمَآئِلِ سُجَّدٗا لِّلَّهِ وَهُمۡ دَٰخِرُونَ

en.text: Have they not considered what things Allāh has created? Their shadows incline to the right and to the left, prostrating to Allāh, while they [i.e., those creations] are humble.

so.text: 48. Miyeyna u fiirsan wax kastoo uu Alle abuuray, (sida) hoosaskoodu ugu iishaan midig iyo bidix, oo ugu sujuudaan Alle iyagoo u khushuucsan.

ayat.arabic: وَلِلَّهِۤ يَسۡجُدُۤ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مِن دَآبَّةٖ وَٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَهُمۡ لَا يَسۡتَكۡبِرُونَ

en.text: And to Allāh prostrates whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth of creatures, and the angels [as well], and they are not arrogant.

so.text: 49. Alle waxaa u sujuuda waxa ku sugan samooyinka iyo waxa ku sugan arlada oo nafley dhul socod ah iyo malaa’igta, iskamana weyneeyaan.

ayat.arabic: يَخَافُونَ رَبَّهُم مِّن فَوۡقِهِمۡ وَيَفۡعَلُونَ مَا يُؤۡمَرُونَ۩

en.text: They fear their Lord above them, and they do what they are commanded.

so.text: 50. Waxay ka cabasadaan Rabbigood ka korreeya, waxayna falaan waxa la amro.

ayat.arabic: ۞ وَقَالَ ٱللَّهُ لَا تَتَّخِذُوٓاْ إِلَٰهَيۡنِ ٱثۡنَيۡنِۖ إِنَّمَا هُوَ إِلَٰهٞ وَٰحِدٞ فَإِيَّٰيَ فَٱرۡهَبُونِ

en.text: And Allāh has said, "Do not take for yourselves two[702] deities. He [i.e., Allāh] is but one God, so fear only Me."
en.footnotes: [702] Meaning more than one.

so.text: 51. Alle wuxuu yidhi: Ha yeelannina labo ilaah. Waa uun Ilaah Keliya (Allaah). Ee Anigoo Keliya iga cabsada [10].
so.footnotes: [10]. Nabigu s.c.w. wuxuu yidhi: “Qofkii qiraa inuusan jirin ilaah Xaq ah aan aheyn Alle iyo inuusan laheyn wax shariik ah, iyo in Muxmmad yahay addoon Alle iyo Rasuulki, iyo in Ciise yahay addoon Alle iyo Rasuulki, iyo Kelmeddiisii uu Jabriil ku afuufay Maryam iyo ruux uu abuuray Alle, iyo in Jannadu run tahay, Naartuna run tahay, Alle wuxuu gelin Jannada si kastaba camalkiisa ha u yaraadee. W.w. Al-Bukhaari.

ayat.arabic: وَلَهُۥ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَهُ ٱلدِّينُ وَاصِبًاۚ أَفَغَيۡرَ ٱللَّهِ تَتَّقُونَ

en.text: And to Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth, and to Him is [due] worship constantly. Then is it other than Allāh that you fear?

so.text: 52. Alle baa iska leh Waxa ku sugan samooyinka iyo arlada, Waa in Isaga (Alle Keliya) loo gaar iyo gooni yeelo cibaadada oo la adeeco si joogta ah. Ee Ma waxaad ka cabsan waxaan ahayn Alle.

ayat.arabic: وَمَا بِكُم مِّن نِّعۡمَةٖ فَمِنَ ٱللَّهِۖ ثُمَّ إِذَا مَسَّكُمُ ٱلضُّرُّ فَإِلَيۡهِ تَجۡـَٔرُونَ

en.text: And whatever you have of favor - it is from Allāh. Then when adversity touches you, to Him you cry for help.

so.text: 53. Wax kastoo nicmo ah ee (lagu galladeystey) dushiinna waa xagga Alle, haddana marka dhibaato idin ku dhacdo, Xaggiisaad u calaacashaan idinkoo gargaar doon ah.

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ إِذَا كَشَفَ ٱلضُّرَّ عَنكُمۡ إِذَا فَرِيقٞ مِّنكُم بِرَبِّهِمۡ يُشۡرِكُونَ

en.text: Then when He removes the adversity from you, at once a party of you associates others with their Lord

so.text: 54. Markuu idinka faydo dhibaatadana, mise qaar idin ka mid ahi ayaa Rabbigood (Alle) la wadaajiya cibaadada cid kale.

ayat.arabic: لِيَكۡفُرُواْ بِمَآ ءَاتَيۡنَٰهُمۡۚ فَتَمَتَّعُواْ فَسَوۡفَ تَعۡلَمُونَ

en.text: So they will deny what We have given them. Then enjoy yourselves, for you are going to know.

so.text: 55. Si ay uga abaal dhacaan waxaan siinnay. Ee iska raaxeysta, waadse ogaan doontaan (waxa idinku dhaca).

ayat.arabic: وَيَجۡعَلُونَ لِمَا لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ نَصِيبٗا مِّمَّا رَزَقۡنَٰهُمۡۗ تَٱللَّهِ لَتُسۡـَٔلُنَّ عَمَّا كُنتُمۡ تَفۡتَرُونَ

en.text: And they assign to what they do not know[703] [i.e., false deities] a portion of that which We have provided them. By Allāh, you will surely be questioned about what you used to invent.
en.footnotes: [703] i.e., that of which they have no knowledge; rather, they have mere assumption based upon tradition or the claims of misguided men.

so.text: 56. Waxay u yeelaan qayb ka mid ah waxa aanu siinnay wax aanay garanayn 'oo ilaahyo  been ah' [11]. Tallaahi, waa la idin weydiin waxaad been abuurateen.
so.footnotes: [11]. Waxaa loola jeedaa wax ayan cilmi u heysan oo ah ilaahyadaa baadilka ay sameysteen, bal waxay wax ku dhisaan malooyin iyo caadooyin ama raacidda dad habowsan.

ayat.arabic: وَيَجۡعَلُونَ لِلَّهِ ٱلۡبَنَٰتِ سُبۡحَٰنَهُۥ وَلَهُم مَّا يَشۡتَهُونَ

en.text: And they attribute to Allāh daughters[704] - exalted is He - and for them is what they desire [i.e., sons].
en.footnotes: [704] By claiming that the angels are His daughters.

so.text: 57. Waxay u yeelaan Alle gabdho [12]. Xurmo oo dhan Isagaa leh oo ka hufan (ceeb iyo nuqsaan),  iyaguna waxay isa siiyeen waxay rabaan.
so.footnotes: [12]. Waxay yidhaahdeen Alle wuxuu leeyahay gabdho, iyagoo ula jeeda malaa’igta, iyagoo naf ahaantooda neceb inay yeeshaan gabdho siduu Alle ku xusay Aayaddan iyo tan ka dambeysaba.

ayat.arabic: وَإِذَا بُشِّرَ أَحَدُهُم بِٱلۡأُنثَىٰ ظَلَّ وَجۡهُهُۥ مُسۡوَدّٗا وَهُوَ كَظِيمٞ

en.text: And when one of them is informed of [the birth of] a female, his face becomes dark, and he suppresses grief.

so.text: 58. Marka loogu bishaareeyo midkood (dhalashada) dheddig, wuxuu noqdaa wejigiisa madow, isagoo tiiraanyeysan.

ayat.arabic: يَتَوَٰرَىٰ مِنَ ٱلۡقَوۡمِ مِن سُوٓءِ مَا بُشِّرَ بِهِۦٓۚ أَيُمۡسِكُهُۥ عَلَىٰ هُونٍ أَمۡ يَدُسُّهُۥ فِي ٱلتُّرَابِۗ أَلَا سَآءَ مَا يَحۡكُمُونَ

en.text: He hides himself from the people because of the ill of which he has been informed. Should he keep it in humiliation or bury it in the ground? Unquestionably, evil is what they decide.

so.text: 59. Wuxuu iska qariyaa dadka xumida waxa loogu bishaareeyey darteed. Ma wuxuu ku heystaa dulli mise ku aaasaa (iyadoo nool) carrada? Xumaa waxay xukumaan [13].
so.footnotes: [13]. Nabigu s.c.w. wuu xaaraanshay ku caasinta hooyooyinkiin, nolol xabaalidda gabdhaha, diidista bixinta xuquuqda dadka, baryada, ku tiri ku teenta iyo su’aasha badan, iyo luminta maalka. W.w.Al-Bukhaari.

ayat.arabic: لِلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ مَثَلُ ٱلسَّوۡءِۖ وَلِلَّهِ ٱلۡمَثَلُ ٱلۡأَعۡلَىٰۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ

en.text: For those who do not believe in the Hereafter is the description [i.e., an attribute] of evil;[705] and for Allāh is the highest attribute. And He is Exalted in Might, the Wise.
en.footnotes: [705] Such as that described in the previous two verses.

so.text: 60. Kuwa aan rumeysneyn Aakhirada waxaa u sugnaaday tusaale xun [14]. Alle waxaa u sugnaaday tilmaanta wanaagsan ee sare, waana  Adkaadaha, Xakiimka ah.
so.footnotes: [14]. Sida waxa lagu xusay labadii Aayadood ee hore.

ayat.arabic: وَلَوۡ يُؤَاخِذُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلنَّاسَ بِظُلۡمِهِم مَّا تَرَكَ عَلَيۡهَا مِن دَآبَّةٖ وَلَٰكِن يُؤَخِّرُهُمۡ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٖ مُّسَمّٗىۖ فَإِذَا جَآءَ أَجَلُهُمۡ لَا يَسۡتَـٔۡخِرُونَ سَاعَةٗ وَلَا يَسۡتَقۡدِمُونَ

en.text: And if Allāh were to impose blame on the people for their wrongdoing, He would not have left upon it [i.e., the earth] any creature, but He defers them for a specified term. And when their term has come, they will not remain behind an hour, nor will they precede [it].

so.text: 61. Hadduu Alle durba u qaban lahaa dadka dulmigay falaan darti, kagama tageen (dhulka) guudki nafley qudh ahi, wuxuuse ugu dib dhigaa muddo magacaa- ban, marka ajalkoodu yimaadana ma dib dhigi karaan Saacad mana soo hor marin karaan.

ayat.arabic: وَيَجۡعَلُونَ لِلَّهِ مَا يَكۡرَهُونَۚ وَتَصِفُ أَلۡسِنَتُهُمُ ٱلۡكَذِبَ أَنَّ لَهُمُ ٱلۡحُسۡنَىٰۚ لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّ لَهُمُ ٱلنَّارَ وَأَنَّهُم مُّفۡرَطُونَ

en.text: And they attribute to Allāh that which they dislike [i.e., daughters], and their tongues assert the lie that they will have the best [from Him]. Assuredly, they will have the Fire, and they will be [therein] neglected.[706]
en.footnotes: [706] Another meaning is "...and they will be made to precede [all others thereto]."

so.text: 62. Waxay u yeelaan Alle (gabdho) ay (iyaguba) nacaan, carrabyadooduna waxay sheegaan beenta ah inay mudan midda  wanaagsan; waxaa sugan inay leeyihiin Naar, oo loo hormarin doono [15].
so.footnotes: [15]. Macno kale waxaa weeye waxaa laga yeeli inay halkaasi kaga horreeyaan inta kale oo dhan.

ayat.arabic: تَٱللَّهِ لَقَدۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمَمٖ مِّن قَبۡلِكَ فَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ فَهُوَ وَلِيُّهُمُ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٞ

en.text: By Allāh, We did certainly send [messengers] to nations before you, but Satan made their deeds attractive to them. And he is their [i.e., the disbelievers] ally today [as well], and they will have a painful punishment.

so.text: 63. Tallaahiye, Waxaan u soo dirnay (Rusul) ummado kaa horreeyey, Wuxuuse u qurxiyey Shaydaanka camalladooda, Isagaana sokeeye u ah maanta, waxayna leeyihiin cadaab xanuun badan.

ayat.arabic: وَمَآ أَنزَلۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ إِلَّا لِتُبَيِّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلَّذِي ٱخۡتَلَفُواْ فِيهِ وَهُدٗى وَرَحۡمَةٗ لِّقَوۡمٖ يُؤۡمِنُونَ

en.text: And We have not revealed to you the Book, [O Muḥammad], except for you to make clear to them that wherein they have differed and as guidance and mercy for a people who believe.

so.text: 64. Kuuguma aannu soo dejin Kitaabka (Qur’aanka) waxaan ahayn inaad u caddeyso waxyaalaha ay isku khilaafsan yihiin, iyo hanuun ahaan iyo Naxariis ciddii rumeyn.

ayat.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءٗ فَأَحۡيَا بِهِ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ بَعۡدَ مَوۡتِهَآۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗ لِّقَوۡمٖ يَسۡمَعُونَ

en.text: And Allāh has sent down rain from the sky and given life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who listen.

so.text: 65. Alle waa Kan ka soo dejiyey biyo (roob) daruuraha, oo ku nooleeya arlada dhimashadeeda kaddib. Arrinkani waxaa ugu sugan calaamo ciddii wax maqli.

ayat.arabic: وَإِنَّ لَكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمِ لَعِبۡرَةٗۖ نُّسۡقِيكُم مِّمَّا فِي بُطُونِهِۦ مِنۢ بَيۡنِ فَرۡثٖ وَدَمٖ لَّبَنًا خَالِصٗا سَآئِغٗا لِّلشَّٰرِبِينَ

en.text: And indeed, for you in grazing livestock is a lesson. We give you drink from what is in their bellies - between excretion and blood - pure milk, palatable to drinkers.

so.text: 66. Waxaa xaqiiq idiinku sugan xoolaha cibrad. Waxaan idinka waraabinnaa waxaa ku jira uurarkooda uus iyo dhiig dhexdood, caano saafi ah, mari og hunguriga kuwa cabbi.

ayat.arabic: وَمِن ثَمَرَٰتِ ٱلنَّخِيلِ وَٱلۡأَعۡنَٰبِ تَتَّخِذُونَ مِنۡهُ سَكَرٗا وَرِزۡقًا حَسَنًاۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗ لِّقَوۡمٖ يَعۡقِلُونَ

en.text: And from the fruits of the palm trees and grapevines you take intoxicant and good provision.[707] Indeed in that is a sign for a people who reason.
en.footnotes: [707] This verse was revealed before the prohibition of intoxicants. It alludes to the fact that there are both evil and good possibilities in certain things.

so.text: 67. Iyo midhaha geedaha timirta iyo canabyada oo aad ka samaysataan cabbitaan culus [16] iyo risiq wanaagsan. Arrinkani waxaa ugu sugan calaamo ciddii garasho leh.
so.footnotes: [16]. Aayaddan waxaa la soo dejiyey ka hor inta aan la xarrimin khamriga. Waxay muujineysaa xaqiiqda in waxyaalaha qaarkood ay ku jiraan dhibaato iyo in sidoo kale lahaan karaan xoogaa wanaag ah.

ayat.arabic: وَأَوۡحَىٰ رَبُّكَ إِلَى ٱلنَّحۡلِ أَنِ ٱتَّخِذِي مِنَ ٱلۡجِبَالِ بُيُوتٗا وَمِنَ ٱلشَّجَرِ وَمِمَّا يَعۡرِشُونَ

en.text: And your Lord inspired to the bee, "Take for yourself among the mountains, houses [i.e., hives], and among the trees and [in] that which they construct.

so.text: 68. Wuxuu Rabbigaa u waxyooday shinnada 'dheddigta ah': Ka yeelo buuraha guryo iyo geedaha iyo waxay dhisaanba.

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ كُلِي مِن كُلِّ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ فَٱسۡلُكِي سُبُلَ رَبِّكِ ذُلُلٗاۚ يَخۡرُجُ مِنۢ بُطُونِهَا شَرَابٞ مُّخۡتَلِفٌ أَلۡوَٰنُهُۥ فِيهِ شِفَآءٞ لِّلنَّاسِۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗ لِّقَوۡمٖ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ

en.text: Then eat from all the fruits[708] and follow the ways of your Lord laid down [for you]." There emerges from their bellies a drink, varying in colors, in which there is healing for people. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who give thought.
en.footnotes: [708] i.e., delicious substances found by the bee.

so.text: 69. Markaas wax ka cun midhaha oo dhan, oo qaad jidadka Rabbigaa oo laylan. Waxaa ka soo baxa uurarkeeda sharaab kala midab ah oo caafimaad ugu jiro dadka. Hubaal arrinkani waxaa ugu sugan calaamo ciddii fikiri.

ayat.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ خَلَقَكُمۡ ثُمَّ يَتَوَفَّىٰكُمۡۚ وَمِنكُم مَّن يُرَدُّ إِلَىٰٓ أَرۡذَلِ ٱلۡعُمُرِ لِكَيۡ لَا يَعۡلَمَ بَعۡدَ عِلۡمٖ شَيۡـًٔاۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٞ قَدِيرٞ

en.text: And Allāh created you; then He will take you in death. And among you is he who is reversed to the most decrepit [old] age so that he will not know, after [having had] knowledge, a thing. Indeed, Allāh is Knowing and Competent.

so.text: 70. Alle baa idin abuuray, misna idin oofsan, waxaana idin ka mid ah mid loo celiyo cimriga u liita nolosha, si uu waxba aanu u ogaan kaddib waayo aqoontii. Hubaal Alle waa wax kasta Ogsoone, Awood Badan.

ayat.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ فَضَّلَ بَعۡضَكُمۡ عَلَىٰ بَعۡضٖ فِي ٱلرِّزۡقِۚ فَمَا ٱلَّذِينَ فُضِّلُواْ بِرَآدِّي رِزۡقِهِمۡ عَلَىٰ مَا مَلَكَتۡ أَيۡمَٰنُهُمۡ فَهُمۡ فِيهِ سَوَآءٌۚ أَفَبِنِعۡمَةِ ٱللَّهِ يَجۡحَدُونَ

en.text: And Allāh has favored some of you over others in provision. But those who were favored [i.e., given more] would not hand over their provision to those whom their right hands possess [i.e., slaves] so they would be equal to them therein.[709] Then is it the favor of Allāh they reject?
en.footnotes: [709] The argument presented in this verse is that if they cannot consider their own possessions equal to themselves, then how can they consider Allāh's creations as being equal to Him?

so.text: 71. Alle wuu uga roonaaday qaarkiinba qaar kale xagga risiqa, Marka, kuwa loo roonaaday sinnaba uma mulki siiyaan risiqooda kuwa (addoomaha ah) oo ay midigtoodu hanato si ay isku mid ugu noqdaan [17]. Ee ma Nicmadda Alle baa waxay diiddan yihiin?
so.footnotes: [17]. Xujada lagu xusay Aayaddan waxaa weeye: Hadday u arkin waxyaalaha ay leeyihiin wax la siman iyaga, haddaba sidee bay ula simi karaan Alle uunkiisa oo uga dhigi shariikyo.

ayat.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنۡ أَنفُسِكُمۡ أَزۡوَٰجٗا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنۡ أَزۡوَٰجِكُم بَنِينَ وَحَفَدَةٗ وَرَزَقَكُم مِّنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَٰتِۚ أَفَبِٱلۡبَٰطِلِ يُؤۡمِنُونَ وَبِنِعۡمَتِ ٱللَّهِ هُمۡ يَكۡفُرُونَ

en.text: And Allāh has made for you from yourselves mates and has made for you from your mates sons and grandchildren and has provided for you from the good things. Then in falsehood do they believe and in the favor of Allāh they disbelieve?

so.text: 72. Alle wuxuu idiinka yeelay nafahiinna xaasas idinla nooc ah, wuxuuna idinka siiyey xaasaskiinna ubad iyo ilmo ilmahood, wuxuuna ku galladeysatay korkiinna wax ka mid ah waxyaalaha wanaagsan. Ee ma baadil (shirki) baa waxay rumeysan yihiin, halka ay tahay Nicmadda Alle (Towxiidka) waxay diidaan inay rumeeyaan oo ku gaaloobaan?

ayat.arabic: وَيَعۡبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَمۡلِكُ لَهُمۡ رِزۡقٗا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ شَيۡـٔٗا وَلَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ

en.text: And they worship besides Allāh that which does not possess for them [the power of] provision from the heavens and the earth at all, and [in fact], they are unable.

so.text: 73. Waxay caabudaan Alle sokadi, waxaan uga hanan karin wax risiq ah xagga samooyinka iyo arlada, oo aan wax awood ahi lahayn.

ayat.arabic: فَلَا تَضۡرِبُواْ لِلَّهِ ٱلۡأَمۡثَالَۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعۡلَمُ وَأَنتُمۡ لَا تَعۡلَمُونَ

en.text: So do not assert similarities to Allāh.[710] Indeed, Allāh knows and you do not know.
en.footnotes: [710] As there is nothing comparable to Him.

so.text: 74. Ha u yeelina Alle wax aad la mid dhigtaan [18]. Hubaal, Alle wuu Og yahay (waxaad fashaan), idinkuse ma ogidin (khaladkiinna iyo cidhib xumidiinna).
so.footnotes: [18]. Ma leh wax la bar bar dhigo ama lagu matalo.

ayat.arabic: ۞ ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًا عَبۡدٗا مَّمۡلُوكٗا لَّا يَقۡدِرُ عَلَىٰ شَيۡءٖ وَمَن رَّزَقۡنَٰهُ مِنَّا رِزۡقًا حَسَنٗا فَهُوَ يُنفِقُ مِنۡهُ سِرّٗا وَجَهۡرًاۖ هَلۡ يَسۡتَوُۥنَۚ ٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِۚ بَلۡ أَكۡثَرُهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ

en.text: Allāh presents an example: a slave [who is] owned and unable to do a thing and he to whom We have provided from Us good provision, so he spends from it secretly and publicly. Can they be equal? Praise to Allāh! But most of them do not know.

so.text: 75. Alle wuxuu ka yeelaa tusaale [19]: addoon la leeyahay aan waxba awoodi karin, iyo mid aanu ka siinnay xaggeenna risiq wanaagsan, oo isagu wax ka bixiya sir iyo caddaanba. Miyey labadaasi siman yihiin? Ammaan oo idil iyo mahad waxaa mudan Allaah! Badankooduse ma oga.
so.footnotes: [19]. Waxaa tusaalahan jawaab ahaan loo siiyey mushrikiinta la mid dhiga Alle ee arzaaqa ee awoodda badan sanamyada aan xoog iyo xeelad midna lahayn.

ayat.arabic: وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلٗا رَّجُلَيۡنِ أَحَدُهُمَآ أَبۡكَمُ لَا يَقۡدِرُ عَلَىٰ شَيۡءٖ وَهُوَ كَلٌّ عَلَىٰ مَوۡلَىٰهُ أَيۡنَمَا يُوَجِّههُّ لَا يَأۡتِ بِخَيۡرٍ هَلۡ يَسۡتَوِي هُوَ وَمَن يَأۡمُرُ بِٱلۡعَدۡلِ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٖ مُّسۡتَقِيمٖ

en.text: And Allāh presents an example of two men, one of them dumb and unable to do a thing, while he is a burden to his guardian. Wherever he directs him, he brings no good. Is he equal to one who commands justice, while he is on a straight path?

so.text: 76. Wuxuu (kaloo) Alle tusaale ka yeelaa labo nin, oo midkood af la’yahay (hadli karin), kaasoo aan waxna karin inuu hagaajiyo, oo isagu ku ah culeys abaankiisa, meeshuu u diraba aan ka keenin khayr. Miyaa lala simi karaa mid amra caddaalad oo isagu (naf ahaantiisa) ku sugan Jid Toosan?

ayat.arabic: وَلِلَّهِ غَيۡبُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَمَآ أَمۡرُ ٱلسَّاعَةِ إِلَّا كَلَمۡحِ ٱلۡبَصَرِ أَوۡ هُوَ أَقۡرَبُۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٞ

en.text: And to Allāh belongs the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and the earth. And the command for the Hour is not but as a glance of the eye or even nearer. Indeed, Allāh is over all things competent.

so.text: 77. Alle baa iska leh waxaan muuqan ee jira samooyinka iyo arlada. Arrinka Saacadda (Qiyaamana) ma aha waxaan ahayn sida il biriqsi, ama ka dhowba. Hubaal Alle wax walba wuu Karaa.

ayat.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ أَخۡرَجَكُم مِّنۢ بُطُونِ أُمَّهَٰتِكُمۡ لَا تَعۡلَمُونَ شَيۡـٔٗا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمۡعَ وَٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرَ وَٱلۡأَفۡـِٔدَةَ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَشۡكُرُونَ

en.text: And Allāh has extracted you from the wombs of your mothers not knowing a thing, and He made for you hearing and vision and hearts [i.e., intellect] that perhaps you would be grateful.

so.text: 78. Alle wuxuu idinka soo saaray uurarka hooyooyinkiin idinkoo aan waxba garanayn. Wuxuuna idiin yeelay maqal iyo arag iyo qalbiyo inaad mahad naqdaan.

ayat.arabic: أَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ إِلَى ٱلطَّيۡرِ مُسَخَّرَٰتٖ فِي جَوِّ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَا يُمۡسِكُهُنَّ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّقَوۡمٖ يُؤۡمِنُونَ

en.text: Do they not see the birds controlled in the atmosphere of the sky? None holds them up except Allāh. Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe.

so.text: 79. Miyeyna arkayn shimbiraha loo sakhiray (oo ku duulaya) hawada samada? Cidina ma qaban karto aan ahayn Allaah. hubaal, arrinkani waxaa ugu sugan calaamooyin ciddii rumayn.

ayat.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنۢ بُيُوتِكُمۡ سَكَنٗا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّن جُلُودِ ٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمِ بُيُوتٗا تَسۡتَخِفُّونَهَا يَوۡمَ ظَعۡنِكُمۡ وَيَوۡمَ إِقَامَتِكُمۡ وَمِنۡ أَصۡوَافِهَا وَأَوۡبَارِهَا وَأَشۡعَارِهَآ أَثَٰثٗا وَمَتَٰعًا إِلَىٰ حِينٖ

en.text: And Allāh has made for you from your homes a place of rest and made for you from the hides of the animals tents which you find light on your day of travel and your day of encampment; and from their wool, fur and hair is furnishing and enjoyment [i.e., provision] for a time.

so.text: 80. Alle wuxuu idiinka yeelay guryihiinna degaan aad ku xasishaan, wuxuuna idinku galladeystey teendhooyin laga sameeyey hargaha xoolaha idiin fudud qaadistooda maalinta geeddigiinna iyo maalinta negaadigiinnaba, idiinkana yeelay (idaha) duftooda iyo (geela) dhogortooda iyo (riyaha) timahooda alaabo guri iyo sahay ilaa muddo ah.

ayat.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّمَّا خَلَقَ ظِلَٰلٗا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡجِبَالِ أَكۡنَٰنٗا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمۡ سَرَٰبِيلَ تَقِيكُمُ ٱلۡحَرَّ وَسَرَٰبِيلَ تَقِيكُم بَأۡسَكُمۡۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُتِمُّ نِعۡمَتَهُۥ عَلَيۡكُمۡ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تُسۡلِمُونَ

en.text: And Allāh has made for you, from that which He has created, shadows [i.e., shade] and has made for you from the mountains, shelters and has made for you garments which protect you from the heat and garments [i.e., coats of mail] which protect you from your [enemy in] battle. Thus does He complete His favor upon you that you might submit [to Him].

so.text: 81. Alle wuxuu idiinka yeelay wuxuu abuuray (geedaha) hoosas, wuxuuna idiinka yeelay buuraha gebiyo aad gashaan, idiin yeelayna dhar idinka celiya kuleylka (iyo qabowga) iyo dhar (jaakado bir ah) idinka celiya (dhibka) dirirtiinna. Sidaasuu idiinku iltiraa Nicmaddiisa inaad u hoggaansantaan (oo Xaqa raacdaan).

ayat.arabic: فَإِن تَوَلَّوۡاْ فَإِنَّمَا عَلَيۡكَ ٱلۡبَلَٰغُ ٱلۡمُبِينُ

en.text: But if they turn away, [O Muḥammad] - then only upon you is [responsibility for] clear notification.

so.text: 82. Haddayse (ka) jeesadaan (Iimaanka), xilkaagu waa oo keliya Gaarsiin cad.

ayat.arabic: يَعۡرِفُونَ نِعۡمَتَ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ يُنكِرُونَهَا وَأَكۡثَرُهُمُ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ

en.text: They recognize the favor of Allāh; then they deny it. And most of them are disbelievers.

so.text: 83. Waxay gartaan Nicmadda Alle (Islaamka), haddana way dafiraan,  badankooduna waa gaalo.

ayat.arabic: وَيَوۡمَ نَبۡعَثُ مِن كُلِّ أُمَّةٖ شَهِيدٗا ثُمَّ لَا يُؤۡذَنُ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَلَا هُمۡ يُسۡتَعۡتَبُونَ

en.text: And [mention] the Day when We will resurrect from every nation a witness [i.e., their prophet]. Then it will not be permitted to the disbelievers [to apologize or make excuses], nor will they be asked to appease [Allāh].

so.text: 84. (Xus) maalintaan ka soo saareyno ummad walba markhaati, markaas aan loo idmeyn kuwa gaaloobay (cudur daarasho), oo aan laga yeeleyn inay axsaan fal dalbaan.

ayat.arabic: وَإِذَا رَءَا ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ ٱلۡعَذَابَ فَلَا يُخَفَّفُ عَنۡهُمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يُنظَرُونَ

en.text: And when those who wronged see the punishment, it will not be lightened for them, nor will they be reprieved.

so.text: 85. Markay kuwa fala dulmiga (shirkiga iyo macaasida) arkaan cadaabka, lagama khafiifinayo, lamana siinayo fursad.

ayat.arabic: وَإِذَا رَءَا ٱلَّذِينَ أَشۡرَكُواْ شُرَكَآءَهُمۡ قَالُواْ رَبَّنَا هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ شُرَكَآؤُنَا ٱلَّذِينَ كُنَّا نَدۡعُواْ مِن دُونِكَۖ فَأَلۡقَوۡاْ إِلَيۡهِمُ ٱلۡقَوۡلَ إِنَّكُمۡ لَكَٰذِبُونَ

en.text: And when those who associated others with Allāh see their "partners," they will say, "Our Lord, these are our partners [to You] whom we used to invoke [in worship] besides You." But they will throw at them the statement, "Indeed, you are liars."

so.text: 86. Markay kuwa Alle u shariig yeela 'cid kale' [20] arkaan kuway la wadaajiyeen Alle (cibaadada) waxay odhan: Rabbigayow! Kuwaanu waa kuwa aan kula wadaajinnay cibaadada ee aan baryi jirnay adiga Sokadaa [21]. Waxayse (kuwaa) dib ugu celin hadalka (iyagoo leh): Waxaad tihiin beenaalayaal.
so.footnotes:
[20]. Waxaa shirki loola jeedaa wixii lala barbar caabudo Alle, sheydaankuna wuxuu amraa cibaadada asnaamta .
[21]. Waa rumeysnaanta inuu Alle leeyahay shuruko lala wadaajiyo cibaadada, shurukadaasina ay uga shafeeci Alle agti.

ayat.arabic: وَأَلۡقَوۡاْ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ يَوۡمَئِذٍ ٱلسَّلَمَۖ وَضَلَّ عَنۡهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يَفۡتَرُونَ

en.text: And they will impart to Allāh that Day [their] submission, and lost from them is what they used to invent.

so.text: 87. Waxayna (gaalada mushrikiinta ah) ula imaan Alle maalintaas hoggaansan dhan, wayna ka tegi oo waayi waxay been abuuran jireen (oo ilaahyo been ah).

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَصَدُّواْ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ زِدۡنَٰهُمۡ عَذَابٗا فَوۡقَ ٱلۡعَذَابِ بِمَا كَانُواْ يُفۡسِدُونَ

en.text: Those who disbelieved and averted [others] from the way of Allāh - We will increase them in punishment over [their] punishment for what corruption they were causing.

so.text: 88. Kuwa gaalooba oo ka hor istaaga dadka Jidka Alle (Islaamka), waxaan ugu dari cadaab cadaabkooda, waxay fasaad fali jireen awgii.

ayat.arabic: وَيَوۡمَ نَبۡعَثُ فِي كُلِّ أُمَّةٖ شَهِيدًا عَلَيۡهِم مِّنۡ أَنفُسِهِمۡۖ وَجِئۡنَا بِكَ شَهِيدًا عَلَىٰ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِۚ وَنَزَّلۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ تِبۡيَٰنٗا لِّكُلِّ شَيۡءٖ وَهُدٗى وَرَحۡمَةٗ وَبُشۡرَىٰ لِلۡمُسۡلِمِينَ

en.text: And [mention] the Day when We will resurrect among every nation a witness over them from themselves [i.e., their prophet]. And We will bring you, [O Muḥammad], as a witness over these [i.e., your nation]. And We have sent down to you the Book as clarification for all things and as guidance and mercy and good tidings for the Muslims.[711]
en.footnotes: [711] Those who have submitted themselves to Allāh.

so.text: 89. (Xus) Maalinka aan ka soo saari ummad walba markhaati ku marag fura oo iyaga ka mid ah, oo aan kuu keenno adiga (Nabiyow) inaad ka ahaato markhaati kuwan - Waxaana kugu soo dejinnay Kitaabka (Qur’aanka) u faahfaahinaya wax walba si cad , iyo inuu u ahaado Hanuun iyo Naxariis iyo bishaaro Muslimiinta [22].
so.footnotes: [22]. Muslimiin waa kuwa isu dhiiba Doonista Alle ee u hoggaansan.

ayat.arabic: ۞ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَأۡمُرُ بِٱلۡعَدۡلِ وَٱلۡإِحۡسَٰنِ وَإِيتَآيِٕ ذِي ٱلۡقُرۡبَىٰ وَيَنۡهَىٰ عَنِ ٱلۡفَحۡشَآءِ وَٱلۡمُنكَرِ وَٱلۡبَغۡيِۚ يَعِظُكُمۡ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَذَكَّرُونَ

en.text: Indeed, Allāh orders justice and good conduct and giving [help] to relatives and forbids immorality and bad conduct and oppression. He admonishes you that perhaps you will be reminded.

so.text: 90. Hubaal Alle wuxuu amraa caddaaladda, axsaan falka iyo siinta qaraabada, wuxuuna reebaa xumaanta, munkarka iyo gardarrada. Wuu idin waaninayaa, inaad ku waano qaadataan oo xusuusataan.

ayat.arabic: وَأَوۡفُواْ بِعَهۡدِ ٱللَّهِ إِذَا عَٰهَدتُّمۡ وَلَا تَنقُضُواْ ٱلۡأَيۡمَٰنَ بَعۡدَ تَوۡكِيدِهَا وَقَدۡ جَعَلۡتُمُ ٱللَّهَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ كَفِيلًاۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعۡلَمُ مَا تَفۡعَلُونَ

en.text: And fulfill the covenant of Allāh when you have taken it, [O believers], and do not break oaths after their confirmation while you have made Allāh, over you, a security [i.e., witness]. Indeed, Allāh knows what you do.

so.text: 91. Oofiya Ballanka Alle markaad gashaan, hana burinnina dhaaraha kaddib markaad adkeyseen, oo uga yeesheen Alle damiin. Alle wuu Og yahay waxaad falaysaan.

ayat.arabic: وَلَا تَكُونُواْ كَٱلَّتِي نَقَضَتۡ غَزۡلَهَا مِنۢ بَعۡدِ قُوَّةٍ أَنكَٰثٗا تَتَّخِذُونَ أَيۡمَٰنَكُمۡ دَخَلَۢا بَيۡنَكُمۡ أَن تَكُونَ أُمَّةٌ هِيَ أَرۡبَىٰ مِنۡ أُمَّةٍۚ إِنَّمَا يَبۡلُوكُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِهِۦۚ وَلَيُبَيِّنَنَّ لَكُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ مَا كُنتُمۡ فِيهِ تَخۡتَلِفُونَ

en.text: And do not be like she who untwisted her spun thread after it was strong [by] taking your oaths as [means of] deceit between you because one community is more plentiful [in number or wealth] than another community.[712] Allāh only tries you thereby. And He will surely make clear to you on the Day of Resurrection that over which you used to differ.
en.footnotes: [712] i.e., do not swear falsely or break a treaty or contract merely for a worldly advantage.

so.text: 92. Ha la mid noqonnina sida tan furfurta xadhiggeeda ay soohday iyadoo u googooneysa gabal gabal kaddib markuu yeeshay xoog. Waxaad ka yeeshaan dhaarahiinna dhagar dhexdiinna ah, inay ummad ka tiro badan tahay ummad kale 'darteed' [23]. Alle waa uun idinku imtixaami arrinkaas iyo inuu idiin caddeeyo Maalinta Qiyaamaha waxaad isku khilaafsaneydeen.
so.footnotes: [23]. Muslimiinta tiro ahaan way yaraayen, waxayna la galeen gaalada heshiis., Markii ay arkeen Quryash inay tiro badan yihiin, oo ay muslimiinta dheer yihiin xoog iyo xeeladba iyo waayo aragnimo, waxay door bideen inay uga baxaan heshiiska Nabiga s.c.w., ficilkan oo kalena Alle wuu reebay. Macnaha waa ha ugu dhaarannina been ama ha burinnina heshiis ama ka bixina ballan aad gasheen dano adduunyo darteed, si kastaba uga xoog badnaadee cadowgiinna.

ayat.arabic: وَلَوۡ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَجَعَلَكُمۡ أُمَّةٗ وَٰحِدَةٗ وَلَٰكِن يُضِلُّ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهۡدِي مَن يَشَآءُۚ وَلَتُسۡـَٔلُنَّ عَمَّا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ

en.text: And if Allāh had willed, He could have made you [of] one religion, but He sends astray whom He wills and guides whom He wills.[713] And you will surely be questioned about what you used to do.
en.footnotes: [713] According to His knowledge of each soul's preference.

so.text: 93. Hadduu Alle doono, wuxuu idinka yeeli lahaa ummad keliya, wuxuuse lumiyaa cidduu doono oo hanuuniyaa cidduu doono. Waana la idin weydiin waxaad falayseen.

ayat.arabic: وَلَا تَتَّخِذُوٓاْ أَيۡمَٰنَكُمۡ دَخَلَۢا بَيۡنَكُمۡ فَتَزِلَّ قَدَمُۢ بَعۡدَ ثُبُوتِهَا وَتَذُوقُواْ ٱلسُّوٓءَ بِمَا صَدَدتُّمۡ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَكُمۡ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٞ

en.text: And do not take your oaths as [means of] deceit between you, lest a foot slip after it was [once] firm, and you would taste evil [in this world] for what [people] you diverted from the way of Allāh,[714] and you would have [in the Hereafter] a great punishment.
en.footnotes: [714] Referring to those who would be dissuaded from Islām as a result of a Muslim's deceit and treachery.

so.text: 94. Ha ka dhigannina dhaarahiinna siyaalo aad isku khiyaantaan dhexdiinna, si aanay cagi u sidban kaddib sugnaashaheeda, oo aad dhadhamisaan xumaan (cadaab) inaad ka jeedsateen Jidka Alle darteed,  waxaadna mudan Cadaab weyn.

ayat.arabic: وَلَا تَشۡتَرُواْ بِعَهۡدِ ٱللَّهِ ثَمَنٗا قَلِيلًاۚ إِنَّمَا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ هُوَ خَيۡرٞ لَّكُمۡ إِن كُنتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُونَ

en.text: And do not exchange the covenant of Allāh for a small price. Indeed, what is with Allāh is best for you, if only you could know.

so.text: 95. Ha siisinnina Axdiga Alle qiimo yar (adduunyo). Hubaal waxa Alle agtiis ah baa idiin khayr badan haddaad og tihiin.

ayat.arabic: مَا عِندَكُمۡ يَنفَدُ وَمَا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ بَاقٖۗ وَلَنَجۡزِيَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ صَبَرُوٓاْ أَجۡرَهُم بِأَحۡسَنِ مَا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ

en.text: Whatever you have will end, but what Allāh has is lasting. And We will surely give those who were patient their reward according to the best of what they used to do.

so.text: 96. Waxa aad haysataan way dhammaan, waxase Alle agtiis ah baa baaqi ahaanaya. Waxaana ku abaal marin kuwa samra ajarkooda u qalma waxa ugu wanaagsan ay falayeen.

ayat.arabic: مَنۡ عَمِلَ صَٰلِحٗا مِّن ذَكَرٍ أَوۡ أُنثَىٰ وَهُوَ مُؤۡمِنٞ فَلَنُحۡيِيَنَّهُۥ حَيَوٰةٗ طَيِّبَةٗۖ وَلَنَجۡزِيَنَّهُمۡ أَجۡرَهُم بِأَحۡسَنِ مَا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ

en.text: Whoever does righteousness, whether male or female, while he is a believer - We will surely cause him to live a good life, and We will surely give them their reward [in the Hereafter] according to the best of what they used to do.

so.text: 97. Qofkii sama fala lab ama dheddig oo mu’min ah waxaan hubaal ka yeeli inuu noolaado nolol fiican oo farxad leh,  waxaanuna siin abaalgudkooda u qalma waxa ugu wanaagsan ay falayeen [24].
so.footnotes: [24]. Aayaddan waxay caddeysey inay ragga iyo dumarka ajar isku mid ah leeyiiin Alle agtiisa markay la yimaadaan camal san oo iimaan u wehliyo.

ayat.arabic: فَإِذَا قَرَأۡتَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ فَٱسۡتَعِذۡ بِٱللَّهِ مِنَ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنِ ٱلرَّجِيمِ

en.text: So when you recite the Qur’ān, [first] seek refuge in Allāh from Satan, the expelled [from His mercy].

so.text: 98. Ee markaad akhrineyso Qur’aanka, (hor iyo baataba) Alle ka magan gal shaydaanka la fogeeyey.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ لَيۡسَ لَهُۥ سُلۡطَٰنٌ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمۡ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ

en.text: Indeed, there is for him no authority over those who have believed and rely upon their Lord.

so.text: 99. Kuma dul laha awood kuwa (Xaqa) rumeysan oo Rabbigood tala saarta.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّمَا سُلۡطَٰنُهُۥ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ يَتَوَلَّوۡنَهُۥ وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِهِۦ مُشۡرِكُونَ

en.text: His authority is only over those who take him as an ally and those who through him associate others with Allāh.
