ayat.arabic: فَلَمَّا ٱعۡتَزَلَهُمۡ وَمَا يَعۡبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَهَبۡنَا لَهُۥٓ إِسۡحَٰقَ وَيَعۡقُوبَۖ وَكُلّٗا جَعَلۡنَا نَبِيّٗا

en.text: So when he had left them and those they worshipped other than Allāh, We gave him Isaac and Jacob, and each [of them] We made a prophet.

so.text: 49. Markuu ka fogaaday iyaga iyo waxay caabudi Alle sokadi, waxaan u hibeynay Isxaaq iyo Yacquub, mid walbaana Waxaan ka yeelnay Nabi.

ayat.arabic: وَوَهَبۡنَا لَهُم مِّن رَّحۡمَتِنَا وَجَعَلۡنَا لَهُمۡ لِسَانَ صِدۡقٍ عَلِيّٗا

en.text: And We gave them of Our mercy, and We made for them a mention [i.e., reputation] of high honor.

so.text: 50. Waxaana ka siinnay Naxariistayada (khayr iyo riziq badan), oo u yeelnay ammaan run ah oo sarreysa.

ayat.arabic: وَٱذۡكُرۡ فِي ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ مُوسَىٰٓۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مُخۡلَصٗا وَكَانَ رَسُولٗا نَّبِيّٗا

en.text: And mention in the Book, Moses. Indeed, he was chosen, and he was a messenger and a prophet.[817]
en.footnotes: [817] A messenger (rasūl) is one who was charged by Allāh to reform society. A prophet (nabī) is one who received revelation from Allāh, the latter being more numerous than the former.

so.text: 51. Ku xus Ktiaabka (Qur’aanka) Muuse. Wuxuu ahaa daacad, Rasuul Nabi ah [7].
so.footnotes: [7]. Rasuul waa midka Alle u xil saaro inuu hanuuniyo dadka oo gaarsiiyo Fartiintiisa, halka Nabi loola jeedo midka ka hela Waxyi xagga Alle aanse la amrin inuu dadka gaarsiiyo, anbiyada baana ka badan Rususha.

ayat.arabic: وَنَٰدَيۡنَٰهُ مِن جَانِبِ ٱلطُّورِ ٱلۡأَيۡمَنِ وَقَرَّبۡنَٰهُ نَجِيّٗا

en.text: And We called him from the side of the mount[818] at [his] right and brought him near, confiding [to him].
en.footnotes: [818] Mount Sinai.

so.text: 52. Waxaan uga dhawaaqnay dhinaca Buurta ee midigta ah [8], oo soo dhoweynay innagoo la faqeyna.
so.footnotes: [8]. Buurta Siinaay.

ayat.arabic: وَوَهَبۡنَا لَهُۥ مِن رَّحۡمَتِنَآ أَخَاهُ هَٰرُونَ نَبِيّٗا

en.text: And We gave him out of Our mercy his brother Aaron as a prophet.

so.text: 53. Waxaana ka siinnay Naxariistayada walaalkii Haaruun oo Nabi ah.

ayat.arabic: وَٱذۡكُرۡ فِي ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ إِسۡمَٰعِيلَۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صَادِقَ ٱلۡوَعۡدِ وَكَانَ رَسُولٗا نَّبِيّٗا

en.text: And mention in the Book, Ishmael. Indeed, he was true to his promise, and he was a messenger and a prophet.

so.text: 54. Ku xus Kitaabka (Qur’aanka) Ismaaciil. Wuxuu ahaa mid ka rumeeya ballanka uu galo, wuxuuna ahaa Rasuul Nabi ah.

ayat.arabic: وَكَانَ يَأۡمُرُ أَهۡلَهُۥ بِٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَٱلزَّكَوٰةِ وَكَانَ عِندَ رَبِّهِۦ مَرۡضِيّٗا

en.text: And he used to enjoin on his people prayer and zakāh and was to his Lord pleasing [i.e., accepted by Him].

so.text: 55. Wuxuu amri jiray ehelkiisa Salaadda iyo Sakada, wuxuuna ahaa mid Rabbigiis Raalli ka yahay.

ayat.arabic: وَٱذۡكُرۡ فِي ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ إِدۡرِيسَۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صِدِّيقٗا نَّبِيّٗا

en.text: And mention in the Book, Idrees. Indeed, he was a man of truth and a prophet.

so.text: 56. Kuna xus Kitaabka (Qur’aanka) Idriis. Wuxuu ahaa run badane Nabi ah.

ayat.arabic: وَرَفَعۡنَٰهُ مَكَانًا عَلِيًّا

en.text: And We raised him to a high station.

so.text: 57. Waxaan kor ugu qaadnay meel sare.

ayat.arabic: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنۡعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡهِم مِّنَ ٱلنَّبِيِّـۧنَ مِن ذُرِّيَّةِ ءَادَمَ وَمِمَّنۡ حَمَلۡنَا مَعَ نُوحٖ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّةِ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ وَمِمَّنۡ هَدَيۡنَا وَٱجۡتَبَيۡنَآۚ إِذَا تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ خَرُّواْۤ سُجَّدٗاۤ وَبُكِيّٗا۩

en.text: Those were the ones upon whom Allāh bestowed favor from among the prophets of the descendants of Adam and of those We carried [in the ship] with Noah, and of the descendants of Abraham and Israel [i.e., Jacob], and of those whom We guided and chose. When the verses of the Most Merciful were recited to them, they fell in prostration and weeping.

so.text: 58. Kuwaas waa  kuwuu Alle u nicmeeyey oo Nabiyadii ah, durriyadii Aadam, iyo kuwa aan kula qaadnay (Doonnida) Nuux, iyo durriyadii Ibraahiim iyo Israa’iil (Yacquub) iyo kuwa aan hanuuninnay oo aan doorannay. Marka kuwaasi Aayadka Raxmaanka loo akhriyo, waxay ula dhacaan dhulka sujuud iyo oohin.

ayat.arabic: ۞ فَخَلَفَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِمۡ خَلۡفٌ أَضَاعُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَٱتَّبَعُواْ ٱلشَّهَوَٰتِۖ فَسَوۡفَ يَلۡقَوۡنَ غَيًّا

en.text: But there came after them successors [i.e., later generations] who neglected prayer and pursued desires; so they are going to meet evil[819] -
en.footnotes: [819] Described as a valley in Hell or may be rendered "the consequence of error."

so.text: 59. Waxaase yimid iyaga ka dambow haraa (facyo dambe) ee dayacay salaadda oo raacay waxay naftu jecleysato (oo xun); marka waxay la kulmi hoog [9].
so.footnotes: [9]. Ghayyan waxaa lagu fasiray tog ku yaal Naarta, ama waxaa loola jeedaa wuxuu la kulmi “cidhibta xun ee camalkiisa”

ayat.arabic: إِلَّا مَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحٗا فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ يَدۡخُلُونَ ٱلۡجَنَّةَ وَلَا يُظۡلَمُونَ شَيۡـٔٗا

en.text: Except those who repent, believe and do righteousness; for those will enter Paradise and will not be wronged at all.

so.text: 60. Kan tawbad keena, oo rumeeya (Xaqa), oo sama fala mooyee. Kuwaasu waxay geli Jannada, iyagoon waxba laga dulmineyn.

ayat.arabic: جَنَّٰتِ عَدۡنٍ ٱلَّتِي وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ عِبَادَهُۥ بِٱلۡغَيۡبِۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ وَعۡدُهُۥ مَأۡتِيّٗا

en.text: [Therein are] gardens of perpetual residence which the Most Merciful has promised His servants in the unseen. Indeed, His promise has ever been eminent.[820]
en.footnotes: [820] Literally, "that to which all will come."

so.text: 61. Beero nagaya (Jannooyinka Cadni) oo uu Naxariistaha (Allaah) ugu yaboohay addoomahiisa Ghaybka (iyagoon arag). Yaboohiisu waa kii yimaada oo hirgala.

ayat.arabic: لَّا يَسۡمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغۡوًا إِلَّا سَلَٰمٗاۖ وَلَهُمۡ رِزۡقُهُمۡ فِيهَا بُكۡرَةٗ وَعَشِيّٗا

en.text: They will not hear therein any ill speech - only [greetings of] peace - and they will have their provision therein, morning and afternoon.

so.text: 62. Kuma maqlayaan gudaheeda wax Hadal macno darro ah, waa uun Salaan (is nabaadin). Waxayna ku lahaan risiqooda subax iyo galabba (kala go' la'aan).

ayat.arabic: تِلۡكَ ٱلۡجَنَّةُ ٱلَّتِي نُورِثُ مِنۡ عِبَادِنَا مَن كَانَ تَقِيّٗا

en.text: That is Paradise, which We give as inheritance to those of Our servants who were fearing of Allāh.

so.text: 63. Taasu waa Jannada aan dhaxalsiinno  addoomahayaga kooda ka dhowrsada xumaha (oo noo hoggaansan).

ayat.arabic: وَمَا نَتَنَزَّلُ إِلَّا بِأَمۡرِ رَبِّكَۖ لَهُۥ مَا بَيۡنَ أَيۡدِينَا وَمَا خَلۡفَنَا وَمَا بَيۡنَ ذَٰلِكَۚ وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ نَسِيّٗا

en.text: [Gabriel said],[821] "And we [angels] descend not except by the order of your Lord. To Him belongs that before us and that behind us and what is in between. And never is your Lord forgetful -
en.footnotes: [821] In answer to the Prophet's wish that Gabriel would visit him more often.

so.text: 64. (Jabriil wuxuu yidhi) oo Annagu (malaa’igta ah) kuma soo degno waxaan ahayn Amarka Rabbigaa [10]. Isagaa leh waxa hortayada ah iyo waxa gadaashaya- da ah iyo waxa labadaa u dhexeeyaba.  Ma aha Rabbigaa mid wax halmaama.
so.footnotes: [10]. Waa ka jawaabid doonista Nabiga s.c.w inuu Jabriil in badan soo siyaarto.

ayat.arabic: رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا فَٱعۡبُدۡهُ وَٱصۡطَبِرۡ لِعِبَٰدَتِهِۦۚ هَلۡ تَعۡلَمُ لَهُۥ سَمِيّٗا

en.text: Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them - so worship Him and have patience for His worship. Do you know of any similarity to Him?"

so.text: 65. Waa Rabbiga samooyinka iyo arlada iyo waxa u dhexeeya ee caabud Isagoo Keliya oo u samir yeelo cibaadadii. Miyaad garan wax la mid ah oo la Magac iyo Tilmaan ah?

ayat.arabic: وَيَقُولُ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ أَءِذَا مَا مِتُّ لَسَوۡفَ أُخۡرَجُ حَيًّا

en.text: And man [i.e., the disbeliever] says, "When I have died, am I going to be brought forth alive?"

so.text: 66. Aadmigu (kan gaalka ahi) wuxuu yidhaahdaa: “Ma markaan dhinto, miyaa la I soo bixin anigoo nool?”

ayat.arabic: أَوَلَا يَذۡكُرُ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقۡنَٰهُ مِن قَبۡلُ وَلَمۡ يَكُ شَيۡـٔٗا

en.text: Does man not remember that We created him before, while he was nothing?

so.text: 67. Miyuusan Aadmigu xusuusnayn inaan abuurnay kal hore isagoon waxba ahayn?

ayat.arabic: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَحۡشُرَنَّهُمۡ وَٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ ثُمَّ لَنُحۡضِرَنَّهُمۡ حَوۡلَ جَهَنَّمَ جِثِيّٗا

en.text: So by your Lord, We will surely gather them and the devils; then We will bring them to be present around Hell upon their knees.[822]
en.footnotes: [822] i.e., fallen on their knees from terror or dragged there unwillingly on their knees.

so.text: 68. Ee waa igu Rabbigaaye, waanu soo kulmin iyaga iyo shaydaammadaba, markaas waxaanu keeni hareeraha jahannama iyagoo jilba joogsan [11].
so.footnotes: [11]. Iyagoo kuf kufaya oo jilbahooda u dhacaya argagax darteed ama loo jiidayo Naarta iyagoo aan dooneyn oo jilbaha ku jooga oo dhulka ku jiidaya.

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ لَنَنزِعَنَّ مِن كُلِّ شِيعَةٍ أَيُّهُمۡ أَشَدُّ عَلَى ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ عِتِيّٗا

en.text: Then We will surely extract from every sect those of them who were worst against the Most Merciful in insolence.

so.text: 69. Markaas waxaan ka soo siibi qolo walba kuwooda ugu dar-darnaa xagga Raxmaanka (Allaah).

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ لَنَحۡنُ أَعۡلَمُ بِٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ أَوۡلَىٰ بِهَا صِلِيّٗا

en.text: Then, surely it is We who are most knowing of those most worthy of burning therein.

so.text: 70. Annagaana dhab u ogsoon kuwa u sii mudan Naarta geliddeeda oo ku gubtaan.

ayat.arabic: وَإِن مِّنكُمۡ إِلَّا وَارِدُهَاۚ كَانَ عَلَىٰ رَبِّكَ حَتۡمٗا مَّقۡضِيّٗا

en.text: And there is none of you except he will come to it.[823] This is upon your Lord an inevitability decreed.
en.footnotes: [823] i.e., be exposed to it. However, the people of Paradise will not be harmed thereby.

so.text: 71. Ma jiro mid idinka mid ah oo aan dul mareyn (Naarta) korkeeda; kani waa Guddoon  Rabbigaa waajib ah xukman.

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ نُنَجِّي ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَواْ وَّنَذَرُ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ فِيهَا جِثِيّٗا

en.text: Then We will save those who feared Allāh and leave the wrongdoers within it, on their knees.

so.text: 72. Markaas waxaanu badbaadin kuwii iska jiray (shirkiga iyo xumaha kale) oo uga tegi daalimiinta dhexdeeda iyagoo ku jilbo joogsan.

ayat.arabic: وَإِذَا تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ءَايَٰتُنَا بَيِّنَٰتٖ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ أَيُّ ٱلۡفَرِيقَيۡنِ خَيۡرٞ مَّقَامٗا وَأَحۡسَنُ نَدِيّٗا

en.text: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Which of [our] two parties is best in position and best in association?"[824]
en.footnotes: [824] In regard to worldly interests.

so.text: 73. Marka Aayadahayaga loo akhriyo xujooyin cad ahaan, waxay kuwa gaalooba ku yidhaahdaan kuwa (xaqa) rumeeyey, “Midkee baa labadaya qolo degmo wanaagsan oo joog fiican.

ayat.arabic: وَكَمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَا قَبۡلَهُم مِّن قَرۡنٍ هُمۡ أَحۡسَنُ أَثَٰثٗا وَرِءۡيٗا

en.text: And how many a generation have We destroyed before them who were better in possessions and [outward] appearance?

so.text: 74. Badanaa intaan halaagnay hortood fac, oo ka hanti, alaab iyo arag wanaagsanaa?.

ayat.arabic: قُلۡ مَن كَانَ فِي ٱلضَّلَٰلَةِ فَلۡيَمۡدُدۡ لَهُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ مَدًّاۚ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوۡاْ مَا يُوعَدُونَ إِمَّا ٱلۡعَذَابَ وَإِمَّا ٱلسَّاعَةَ فَسَيَعۡلَمُونَ مَنۡ هُوَ شَرّٞ مَّكَانٗا وَأَضۡعَفُ جُندٗا

en.text: Say, "Whoever is in error - let the Most Merciful extend for him an extension [in wealth and time] until, when they see that which they were promised - either punishment [in this world] or the Hour [of resurrection] - they will come to know who is worst in position and weaker in soldiers."

so.text: 75. Dheh, "kii ku jira habow, ha u fidiyo Raxmaanku waxa uu heysto fidin (maalka iyo waqtiga), jeer markay arkaan waxaa loogu gooddiyey, oo cadaab (adduunka) ah ama Saacadda (Qiyaame), way ogaan kan xun degmo ahaan oo tabar yar ciidan ahaan.

ayat.arabic: وَيَزِيدُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱهۡتَدَوۡاْ هُدٗىۗ وَٱلۡبَٰقِيَٰتُ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتُ خَيۡرٌ عِندَ رَبِّكَ ثَوَابٗا وَخَيۡرٞ مَّرَدًّا

en.text: And Allāh increases those who were guided, in guidance, and the enduring good deeds are better to your Lord[825] for reward and better for recourse.
en.footnotes: [825] i.e., in the sight or evaluation of Allāh.

so.text: 76. Wuxuu Alle u kordhiyaa kuwa hanuunay hanuun. Camallada wanaagsan ee baaqiga ah baana khayr roon Rabbigaa agtiis oo leh aayo wanaagsan.

ayat.arabic: أَفَرَءَيۡتَ ٱلَّذِي كَفَرَ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَقَالَ لَأُوتَيَنَّ مَالٗا وَوَلَدًا

en.text: Then, have you seen he who disbelieved in Our verses and said, "I will surely be given wealth and children [in the next life]"?

so.text: 77. Bal ka warran kan ku gaaloobay Aayadahayaga ee yidhi: Waxaa hubaal la i siin (Aakhiro) maal iyo carruur [12].”
so.footnotes: [12]. Halka aan ka siin lahayn maal iyo carruur, Alle wuxuu ka qaadi doonaa waxaas uu ku heysto nolosha adduunka uu ku faano waqtiga dhimashadiisa.

ayat.arabic: أَطَّلَعَ ٱلۡغَيۡبَ أَمِ ٱتَّخَذَ عِندَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ عَهۡدٗا

en.text: Has he looked into the unseen, or has he taken from the Most Merciful a promise?

so.text: 78. Ma wuxuu daalacday cilmi Ghaybka mise Raxmaanka buu ka helay ballan?

ayat.arabic: كَلَّاۚ سَنَكۡتُبُ مَا يَقُولُ وَنَمُدُّ لَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلۡعَذَابِ مَدّٗا

en.text: No! We will record what he says and extend [i.e., increase] for him from the punishment extensively.

so.text: 79. Mayee’ waanu qori wuxuu sheegi, oo waan u fidin (kordhin) cadaabka fidin;

ayat.arabic: وَنَرِثُهُۥ مَا يَقُولُ وَيَأۡتِينَا فَرۡدٗا

en.text: And We will inherit him [in] what he mentions,[826] and he will come to Us alone.
en.footnotes: [826] Instead of giving him wealth and children in the Hereafter, Allāh will take from him those he had in worldly life at the time of his death.

so.text: 80. Waxaanuna ka dhaxli wuxuu sheegi oo dhan wuxuuna noo iman isagoo keli ah.

ayat.arabic: وَٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةٗ لِّيَكُونُواْ لَهُمۡ عِزّٗا

en.text: And they have taken besides Allāh [false] deities that they would be for them [a source of] honor.

so.text: 81. Waxay yeeshaan Allaah sokadi ilaahyo (baadil ah) si ay u siiyaan ciso.

ayat.arabic: كَلَّاۚ سَيَكۡفُرُونَ بِعِبَادَتِهِمۡ وَيَكُونُونَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ضِدًّا

en.text: No! They [i.e., those "gods"] will deny their worship of them and will be against them opponents [on the Day of Judgement].

so.text: 82. Mayee’ iyagu (ilaahyadaa) waaba ay dafiri doonaan cibaadadoodii, wayna ka soo hor jeesan col ahaan (Qiyaamaha).

ayat.arabic: أَلَمۡ تَرَ أَنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا ٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ عَلَى ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ تَؤُزُّهُمۡ أَزّٗا

en.text: Do you not see that We have sent the devils upon the disbelievers, inciting them [to evil] with [constant] incitement?

so.text: 83. Miyaadan arag inaan ku soo dirno shayaadiinta gaalada iyagoo geliya (xumaan) gelin (joogto ah).

ayat.arabic: فَلَا تَعۡجَلۡ عَلَيۡهِمۡۖ إِنَّمَا نَعُدُّ لَهُمۡ عَدّٗا

en.text: So be not impatient over them. We only count out [i.e., allow] to them a [limited] number.[827]
en.footnotes: [827] Of breaths, of days, or of evil deeds.

so.text: 84. Ee ha u samir waayin, waxaan uun u tirinaynaa tiro [13] 'maalmo go’an'.
so.footnotes: [13]. Waxaan u tirinnaa neefahiisa uu neefsado, iyo maalmahiisa, ama camalladiisa xun.

ayat.arabic: يَوۡمَ نَحۡشُرُ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ إِلَى ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ وَفۡدٗا

en.text: On the Day We will gather the righteous to the Most Merciful as a delegation

so.text: 85. Maalinta aan u soo gelbin dhowrsana- yaasha xagga Raxmaanka iyagoo wafdi ah.

ayat.arabic: وَنَسُوقُ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ وِرۡدٗا

en.text: And will drive the criminals to Hell in thirst

so.text: 86. Oo aan u soo kaxeyn denbiilayaasha Jahannama iyagoo la asqoobay harraad.

ayat.arabic: لَّا يَمۡلِكُونَ ٱلشَّفَٰعَةَ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱتَّخَذَ عِندَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ عَهۡدٗا

en.text: None will have [power of] intercession except he who had taken from the Most Merciful a covenant.[828]
en.footnotes: [828] Not to worship other than Him.

so.text: 87. Ma hantaan shafeeco, mid maahee ka yeesha Raxmaanka agtiisa ballan [14].
so.footnotes: [14]. Inuusan caabudin cid kale aan ahayn Alle.

ayat.arabic: وَقَالُواْ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ وَلَدٗا

en.text: And they say, "The Most Merciful has taken [for Himself] a son."

so.text: 88. Waxay (gaaladu) yidhaahdeen: Raxamaanku (Allaah) wuxuu yeeshay ilmo.

ayat.arabic: لَّقَدۡ جِئۡتُمۡ شَيۡـًٔا إِدّٗا

en.text: You have done an atrocious thing.

so.text: 89. Waxaad la timaaddeen wax daran oo baas.

ayat.arabic: تَكَادُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ يَتَفَطَّرۡنَ مِنۡهُ وَتَنشَقُّ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَتَخِرُّ ٱلۡجِبَالُ هَدًّا

en.text: The heavens almost rupture therefrom and the earth splits open and the mountains collapse in devastation

so.text: 90. Samooyinka ay ku sigtaan inay la dildillaacaan, dhulkuna la jeexmo, oo ay la hoobtaan buuruhu burbur.

ayat.arabic: أَن دَعَوۡاْ لِلرَّحۡمَٰنِ وَلَدٗا

en.text: That they attribute to the Most Merciful a son.

so.text: 91. Inay ku sheegaan Raxmaanka inuu leeyahay wiil (ilmo).

ayat.arabic: وَمَا يَنۢبَغِي لِلرَّحۡمَٰنِ أَن يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدًا

en.text: And it is not appropriate for the Most Merciful that He should take a son.

so.text: 92. Kuma habboona Raxmaanka inuu yeesho wiil (ilmo).

ayat.arabic: إِن كُلُّ مَن فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ إِلَّآ ءَاتِي ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ عَبۡدٗا

en.text: There is no one in the heavens and earth but that he comes to the Most Merciful as a servant.

so.text: 93. Wax kastoo ku sugan samooyinka iyo arlada wuxuu u imaan (Allaah) Raxmaanka isagoo addoon ah.

ayat.arabic: لَّقَدۡ أَحۡصَىٰهُمۡ وَعَدَّهُمۡ عَدّٗا

en.text: He has enumerated them and counted them a [full] counting.

so.text: 94. Dhab ahaan wuu koobay oo tiriyey dhammaan tirin dhan.

ayat.arabic: وَكُلُّهُمۡ ءَاتِيهِ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ فَرۡدًا

en.text: And all of them are coming to Him on the Day of Resurrection alone.

so.text: 95. Mid walbaa wuxuu Alle u iman Maalinta Qiyaame isagoo keli ah.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ سَيَجۡعَلُ لَهُمُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ وُدّٗا

en.text: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - the Most Merciful will appoint for them affection.[829]
en.footnotes: [829] From Himself and from among each other.

so.text: 96. Xaqiiq kuwa (Xaqa) rumeeyey ee samaha fala, Raxmaanku wuxuu u yeeli maxabbad 'qalbiyada mu’miniinta' [15].
so.footnotes: [15]. Abuu Hurayra a.k.r. waxaa laga soo weriyey in Nabigu s.c.w. yidhi: Markuu Alle jeclaado addoon ka mid ah addoomahiisa, wuxuu u yeedhaa malag Jabriil oo u sheegaa in Alle Kor ahaaye jecel yahay hebel, ee adiguna jeclow. Markaas baa Jabriil jeclaadaa oo waxa cirka jooga u dhawaaqaa in Alle jecel yahay hebel, iyaguna sidaas darteed ay jeclaadaan, markaasay jeclaadaan waxa cirka jooga, dabeeto loo dhigaa aqbal iyo oggolaansho arlada dhexdeeda. (W.w. Al-Bukhaari).

ayat.arabic: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرۡنَٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لِتُبَشِّرَ بِهِ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ وَتُنذِرَ بِهِۦ قَوۡمٗا لُّدّٗا

en.text: So, [O Muḥammad], We have only made it [i.e., the Qur’ān] easy in your tongue [i.e., the Arabic language] that you may give good tidings thereby to the righteous and warn thereby a hostile people.

so.text: 97. Ee (Nabi Muxammadow) waxaan uun uga yeelnay (Qur’aanka) wax u fudud carrabkaaga si aad ugu bishaareyso dhowrsanayaasha, uguna digto qolo muran iyo been badan.

ayat.arabic: وَكَمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَا قَبۡلَهُم مِّن قَرۡنٍ هَلۡ تُحِسُّ مِنۡهُم مِّنۡ أَحَدٍ أَوۡ تَسۡمَعُ لَهُمۡ رِكۡزَۢا

en.text: And how many have We destroyed before them of generations? Do you perceive of them anyone or hear from them a sound?

so.text: 98. Badanaa intaan halaagnay hortood fac, ma ka aragtaa qof keliya oo ka mid ah iyaga mase ka maqashaa xaggooda in yar oo shanqar ah?.

ayat.arabic: طه

en.footnotes: [831] See footnote to 2:1.

so.text: 1. Daa Haa [1].
so.footnotes: [1]. Eeg sharaxa Suuradda 2 Al-Baqarah: Aayadda 1.

ayat.arabic: مَآ أَنزَلۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِتَشۡقَىٰٓ

en.text: We have not sent down to you the Qur’ān that you be distressed

so.text: 2. Kuuguma aanu soo dejin (Nabiyow) Qur’aanka (inaad naftaada ku halaagto) murugo (inaysan rumayn Xaqa darteed).

ayat.arabic: إِلَّا تَذۡكِرَةٗ لِّمَن يَخۡشَىٰ

en.text: But only as a reminder for those who fear [Allāh] -

so.text: 3. Waase u waano ciddii ka baqda 'Alle' [2].
so.footnotes: [2]. Nabigu s.c.w. wuxuu yidhi: “ Qofkuu Alle  la doono khayr wuxuu fahansiiyaa diinta”. W.w. Al-Bukhaari.

ayat.arabic: تَنزِيلٗا مِّمَّنۡ خَلَقَ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ ٱلۡعُلَى

en.text: A revelation from He who created the earth and highest heavens,

so.text: 4.Waa soo dejinta (Alle) ee abuuray arlada iyo samooyinka sare.

ayat.arabic: ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ عَلَى ٱلۡعَرۡشِ ٱسۡتَوَىٰ

en.text: The Most Merciful [who is] above the Throne established.[832]
en.footnotes: [832] i.e., having ascendancy over all creation. See footnotes to 2:19 and 7:54.

so.text: 5. Raxmaanku (Allaah) wuxuu kor ahaaday Carshigiisa dushiisha (si u qalanta Weynidiisa).

ayat.arabic: لَهُۥ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا وَمَا تَحۡتَ ٱلثَّرَىٰ

en.text: To Him belongs what is in the heavens and what is on the earth and what is between them and what is under the soil.

so.text: 6. Isagaa leh waxa ku sugan samooyinka iyo waxa ku sugan arlada iyo waxa u dhexeeya iyo waxa ka hooseeyaba rayska.

ayat.arabic: وَإِن تَجۡهَرۡ بِٱلۡقَوۡلِ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَعۡلَمُ ٱلسِّرَّ وَأَخۡفَى

en.text: And if you speak aloud - then indeed, He knows the secret and what is [even] more hidden.

so.text: 7. Haddaad kor codka ugu qaaddo hadalka, hubaal, Alle Wuu ogsoon yahay sirta iyo waxa weliba ka sii qarsoonaan badan.

ayat.arabic: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۖ لَهُ ٱلۡأَسۡمَآءُ ٱلۡحُسۡنَىٰ

en.text: Allāh - there is no deity except Him. To Him belong the best names.

so.text: 8. Allaah! Ma jiro ilaah (xaq ah) aan Isaga aheyn, Wuxuu leeyahay Magacyada Wanaagga iyo Quruxda Badan.

ayat.arabic: وَهَلۡ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰٓ

en.text: And has the story of Moses reached you? -

so.text: 9. Ma ku soo gaadhay qisadii Muuse?

ayat.arabic: إِذۡ رَءَا نَارٗا فَقَالَ لِأَهۡلِهِ ٱمۡكُثُوٓاْ إِنِّيٓ ءَانَسۡتُ نَارٗا لَّعَلِّيٓ ءَاتِيكُم مِّنۡهَا بِقَبَسٍ أَوۡ أَجِدُ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ هُدٗى

en.text: When he saw a fire and said to his family, "Stay here; indeed, I have perceived a fire; perhaps I can bring you a torch or find at the fire some guidance."

so.text: 10. Markuu arkay dab, oo ku yidhi reerkiisii: "Jooga halkan! Waxaan arkaa dab. Waa intaasoo aan idiinka keeno dhimbil aad kulaalsataan, ama aan ka helo dabka cid ii  i tusisa (waddada Masar)".

ayat.arabic: فَلَمَّآ أَتَىٰهَا نُودِيَ يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ

en.text: And when he came to it, he was called, "O Moses,

so.text: 11. Markuu yimid meeshuu ka ifiyey dabka, waa loo yeedhay: Muusow!

ayat.arabic: إِنِّيٓ أَنَا۠ رَبُّكَ فَٱخۡلَعۡ نَعۡلَيۡكَ إِنَّكَ بِٱلۡوَادِ ٱلۡمُقَدَّسِ طُوٗى

en.text: Indeed, I am your Lord, so remove your sandals. Indeed, you are in the blessed valley of Ṭuwā.

so.text: 12. Xaqiiq, Anigu waxaan ahay Rabbigaa! Ee iska siib kabahaaga, waxaad joogtaa togga daahirka ah ee Duwaa.

ayat.arabic: وَأَنَا ٱخۡتَرۡتُكَ فَٱسۡتَمِعۡ لِمَا يُوحَىٰٓ

en.text: And I have chosen you, so listen to what is revealed [to you].

so.text: 13. Aniga (Alle ah) baana ku doortay (Muusow) ee dhegayso waxa laguu Waxyoon.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّنِيٓ أَنَا ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱعۡبُدۡنِي وَأَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ لِذِكۡرِيٓ

en.text: Indeed, I am Allāh. There is no deity except Me, so worship Me and establish prayer for My remembrance.

so.text: 14. Anigu waxaan ahay Allaah. Ma jiro ilaah (xaq ah) aan aheyn Aniga, ee Anigoo Keliya i caabud, una oog salaadda Xuskayga.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ ءَاتِيَةٌ أَكَادُ أُخۡفِيهَا لِتُجۡزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفۡسِۭ بِمَا تَسۡعَىٰ

en.text: Indeed, the Hour is coming - I almost conceal it[833] - so that every soul may be recompensed according to that for which it strives.
en.footnotes: [833] Meaning that Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) keeps knowledge of the Hour hidden from everyone except Himself.

so.text: 15. Hubaal Saacadda (Qiyaame) waa imaanaysaa - waxaana u dhowahay inaan qariyo [3] si naf walba loogu abaal mariyo waxay camal fashay.
so.footnotes: [3]. Macnaha waxaa weeye in Alle subxaanahu watacaalaa uu ka qariyo cid walba ogaanshaha waqtiga Saacadda Qiyaame dhaceyso, oo Isaga uun baa Ogsoon Keliya.

ayat.arabic: فَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكَ عَنۡهَا مَن لَّا يُؤۡمِنُ بِهَا وَٱتَّبَعَ هَوَىٰهُ فَتَرۡدَىٰ

en.text: So do not let one avert you from it[834] who does not believe in it and follows his desire, for you [then] would perish.
en.footnotes: [834] From preparation for the Hour or for the Hereafter.

so.text: 16. “Yaanu kaa weecin xaggeeda [4] mid aan Rumaysnayn oo raaca hawadiisa, markaas waad halaagsami.
so.footnotes: [4].Waa inaad isugu diyaariso iimaan iyo ca- mallo wanaagsan Saacaddaa (Aakhirada).

ayat.arabic: وَمَا تِلۡكَ بِيَمِينِكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ

en.text: And what is that in your right hand, O Moses?"

so.text: 17. Waa maxay taasi ku jirta midigtaada Muusow?”

ayat.arabic: قَالَ هِيَ عَصَايَ أَتَوَكَّؤُاْ عَلَيۡهَا وَأَهُشُّ بِهَا عَلَىٰ غَنَمِي وَلِيَ فِيهَا مَـَٔارِبُ أُخۡرَىٰ

en.text: He said, "It is my staff; I lean upon it, and I bring down leaves for my sheep and I have therein other uses."

so.text: 18. Wuxuu yidhi: “Waa ushayda, waan cuskadaa, oo ugu lulaa caleemaha si ay ugu soo daataan arigayga dushiisa, waxaana iigu jira dano kale.”

ayat.arabic: قَالَ أَلۡقِهَا يَٰمُوسَىٰ

en.text: [Allāh] said, "Throw it down, O Moses."

so.text: 19. (Alle) wuxuu yidhi: “Bal hoos u tuur Muusow!”

ayat.arabic: فَأَلۡقَىٰهَا فَإِذَا هِيَ حَيَّةٞ تَسۡعَىٰ

en.text: So he threw it down, and thereupon it was a snake, moving swiftly.

so.text: 20. Markaasuu tuuray, mise! Waa abeeso ordaysa.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ خُذۡهَا وَلَا تَخَفۡۖ سَنُعِيدُهَا سِيرَتَهَا ٱلۡأُولَىٰ

en.text: [Allāh] said, "Seize it and fear not; We will return it to its former condition.

so.text: 21. (Alle) wuxuu yidhi: “Qaado, hana cabsan, Waxaanu ku celin sideedii hore.

ayat.arabic: وَٱضۡمُمۡ يَدَكَ إِلَىٰ جَنَاحِكَ تَخۡرُجۡ بَيۡضَآءَ مِنۡ غَيۡرِ سُوٓءٍ ءَايَةً أُخۡرَىٰ

en.text: And draw in your hand to your side; it will come out white without disease - another sign,

so.text: 22. Ku qabo gacantaada dhinacaaga, waxay soo bixi iyadoo cad (ifeysa) iin la’aan, waa calaamad kale.

ayat.arabic: لِنُرِيَكَ مِنۡ ءَايَٰتِنَا ٱلۡكُبۡرَى

en.text: That We may show you [some] of Our greater signs.

so.text: 23. “Si aanu kuu tusinno wax ka mid ah Aayadahayaga waaweyn.

ayat.arabic: ٱذۡهَبۡ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ

en.text: Go to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed [i.e., tyrannized]."

so.text: 24. “Ee aad xagga Fircoon! Waa uu xad gudbaye.”

ayat.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱشۡرَحۡ لِي صَدۡرِي

en.text: [Moses] said, "My Lord, expand [i.e., relax] for me my breast [with assurance]

so.text: 25. (Muuse) wuxuu yidhi: “Rabbiyow ii waasici (deji) laabtayda.

ayat.arabic: وَيَسِّرۡ لِيٓ أَمۡرِي

en.text: And ease for me my task

so.text: 26. “Ii fududee arrinkayga.

ayat.arabic: وَٱحۡلُلۡ عُقۡدَةٗ مِّن لِّسَانِي

en.text: And untie the knot from my tongue

so.text: 27. Ka fur guntintana carrabkayga,

ayat.arabic: يَفۡقَهُواْ قَوۡلِي

en.text: That they may understand my speech.

so.text: 28. “Si ay u fahmaan hadalkayga .

ayat.arabic: وَٱجۡعَل لِّي وَزِيرٗا مِّنۡ أَهۡلِي

en.text: And appoint for me a minister [i.e., assistant] from my family -

so.text: 29. “Ii yeelna wasiir (caawiye) ka mid ah ehelkayga,

ayat.arabic: هَٰرُونَ أَخِي

en.text: Aaron, my brother.

so.text: 30. Haaruun, walaalkay,

ayat.arabic: ٱشۡدُدۡ بِهِۦٓ أَزۡرِي

en.text: Increase through him my strength

so.text: 31. “Ku adkee (xooji) tabarteyda (dhabarkeyga),

ayat.arabic: وَأَشۡرِكۡهُ فِيٓ أَمۡرِي

en.text: And let him share my task

so.text: 32. Igala qayb geli (wadaaji) arrinkayga ( Nabinnimada).

ayat.arabic: كَيۡ نُسَبِّحَكَ كَثِيرٗا

en.text: That we may exalt You much

so.text: 33. Si aan kuugu tasbiixsanno in badan.

ayat.arabic: وَنَذۡكُرَكَ كَثِيرًا

en.text: And remember You much.

so.text: 34. Oo aan kuu xusno in badan,

ayat.arabic: إِنَّكَ كُنتَ بِنَا بَصِيرٗا

en.text: Indeed, You are of us ever Seeing."

so.text: 35. Hubaal, waxaad Adigu tahay Mid mar walba na Arka".

ayat.arabic: قَالَ قَدۡ أُوتِيتَ سُؤۡلَكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ

en.text: [Allāh] said, "You have been granted your request, O Moses.

so.text: 36. (Alle) wuxuu yidhi” “Waa lagu siiyey codsigaaga Muusow!

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ مَنَنَّا عَلَيۡكَ مَرَّةً أُخۡرَىٰٓ

en.text: And We had already conferred favor upon you another time,

so.text: 37. Waxaanuna dhab ahaan kuu nicmeennay waqti kale (oo hore),

ayat.arabic: إِذۡ أَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّكَ مَا يُوحَىٰٓ

en.text: When We inspired to your mother what We inspired,

so.text: 38. Markaan u waxyoonnay hooyadaa waxaan u waxyoonnay.

ayat.arabic: أَنِ ٱقۡذِفِيهِ فِي ٱلتَّابُوتِ فَٱقۡذِفِيهِ فِي ٱلۡيَمِّ فَلۡيُلۡقِهِ ٱلۡيَمُّ بِٱلسَّاحِلِ يَأۡخُذۡهُ عَدُوّٞ لِّي وَعَدُوّٞ لَّهُۥۚ وَأَلۡقَيۡتُ عَلَيۡكَ مَحَبَّةٗ مِّنِّي وَلِتُصۡنَعَ عَلَىٰ عَيۡنِيٓ

en.text: [Saying], 'Cast him into the chest and cast it into the river, and the river will throw it onto the bank; there will take him an enemy to Me and an enemy to him.' And I bestowed upon you love from Me[835] that you would be brought up under My eye [i.e., observation and care].
en.footnotes: [835] Allāh put love of Moses into the hearts of the people.

so.text: 39.(Waxaan ku nidhi): Ku rid isaga sanduuq oo ku tuur webiga (Niil), kolkaasna webigu wuxuu ku tuuri xeebta, halkaas waxaa qaadan mid cadow ii ah, isagana cadow u ah!  Waxaan yeelay dushaada jaceyl lagu jeclaado Xaggeyga ah [5], iyo in lagugu barbaariyo Ishayda horteed (waa Ilaalinteyda iyo Ogaanshaheyga),
so.footnotes: [5]. Alle wuxuu jeclaanta Muuse geliyey quluubta dadka.

ayat.arabic: إِذۡ تَمۡشِيٓ أُخۡتُكَ فَتَقُولُ هَلۡ أَدُلُّكُمۡ عَلَىٰ مَن يَكۡفُلُهُۥۖ فَرَجَعۡنَٰكَ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّكَ كَيۡ تَقَرَّ عَيۡنُهَا وَلَا تَحۡزَنَۚ وَقَتَلۡتَ نَفۡسٗا فَنَجَّيۡنَٰكَ مِنَ ٱلۡغَمِّ وَفَتَنَّٰكَ فُتُونٗاۚ فَلَبِثۡتَ سِنِينَ فِيٓ أَهۡلِ مَدۡيَنَ ثُمَّ جِئۡتَ عَلَىٰ قَدَرٖ يَٰمُوسَىٰ

en.text: [And We favored you] when your sister went and said, 'Shall I direct you to someone who will be responsible for him?' So We restored you to your mother that she might be content and not grieve. And you killed someone,[836] but We saved you from retaliation and tried you with a [severe] trial. And you remained [some] years among the people of Madyan. Then you came [here] at the decreed time, O Moses.
en.footnotes: [836] The Copt who died after being struck by Moses.

so.text: 40. (Waxaan kuu galnay wanaag mar kale) markay u tagtay walaashaa iyadoo leh: Ma idin tusaa cid idiin korin (nuujineysa)? Markaas baan kuu soo celinnay hooyadaa si ay u raalli noqoto oo aysan u murugoon. Waxaadna dishay nin [6], waanse kaa badbaadinnay walbahaar weyn, oo aan ku imtixaannay imtixaan culus, Waxaad ku negaatay sanooyin tirsan reer Madyan dhexdood. Waxaadna halkaan ku timid Qaddar Alle, Muusow!.
so.footnotes: [6]. Waa qibidigii Masriga ahaa ee dhintay kaddib markuu Muuse ku dhuftay Qibidigaa hal feedh.

ayat.arabic: وَٱصۡطَنَعۡتُكَ لِنَفۡسِي

en.text: And I produced you for Myself.[837]
en.footnotes: [837] Allāh had already selected Moses and made him strong in body and character according to the requirements of his mission.

so.text: 41. Waxaan kuu doortay Nafteyda [7].
so.footnotes: [7]. Alle baa doortay Muuse oo ka yeelay mid xoog leh jidh iyo shakshi ahaanba si uu u qaado xilka gaarsiinta diinta ilmaha Israa’iil.

ayat.arabic: ٱذۡهَبۡ أَنتَ وَأَخُوكَ بِـَٔايَٰتِي وَلَا تَنِيَا فِي ذِكۡرِي

en.text: Go, you and your brother, with My signs and do not slacken in My remembrance.

so.text: 42. “La taga adiga iyo walaalkaa Aayadahayga, hana ka daalina Xuskayga.

ayat.arabic: ٱذۡهَبَآ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ

en.text: Go, both of you, to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed.

so.text: 43. Aada xagga Fircoon, wuu xadgudbaye.

ayat.arabic: فَقُولَا لَهُۥ قَوۡلٗا لَّيِّنٗا لَّعَلَّهُۥ يَتَذَكَّرُ أَوۡ يَخۡشَىٰ

en.text: And speak to him with gentle speech that perhaps he may be reminded or fear [Allāh]."

so.text: 44. Kula hadlana hadal nugul, waa intaasoo uu waansamo ama ka baqo (Alle).

ayat.arabic: قَالَا رَبَّنَآ إِنَّنَا نَخَافُ أَن يَفۡرُطَ عَلَيۡنَآ أَوۡ أَن يَطۡغَىٰ

en.text: They said, "Our Lord, indeed we are afraid that he will hasten [punishment] against us or that he will transgress."

so.text: 45.Waxay yidhaahdeen: “Rabbigayow! Waxaanu ka cabsan inuu ku degdego inuu na ciqaabo ama nagu xadgudbo.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ لَا تَخَافَآۖ إِنَّنِي مَعَكُمَآ أَسۡمَعُ وَأَرَىٰ

en.text: [Allāh] said, "Fear not. Indeed, I am with you both; I hear and I see.

so.text: 46. (Alle) Wuxuu yidhi: Ha cabsannina, Anigaa idin la jira, waan maqli oo arkaa.

ayat.arabic: فَأۡتِيَاهُ فَقُولَآ إِنَّا رَسُولَا رَبِّكَ فَأَرۡسِلۡ مَعَنَا بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ وَلَا تُعَذِّبۡهُمۡۖ قَدۡ جِئۡنَٰكَ بِـَٔايَةٖ مِّن رَّبِّكَۖ وَٱلسَّلَٰمُ عَلَىٰ مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلۡهُدَىٰٓ

en.text: So go to him and say, 'Indeed, we are messengers of your Lord, so send with us the Children of Israel and do not torment them. We have come to you with a sign from your Lord. And peace[838] will be upon he who follows the guidance.
en.footnotes: [838] i.e., safety and security from Allāh's punishment.

so.text: 47. U taga (Fircoon) oo dhahaya: Waxaanu nahay Rususha Rabbigaa, ee nagu dar ilmaha Israa'iil hana caddabin, waxaan kuu keennay calaamad xagga Rabbigaa ah. Nabadna korkiisa ha ahaato [8] kan raaca hunuunka (Alle, Islaamka oo ku dhaqma).
so.footnotes: [8]. Ammaan iyo nabad uu ka ahaado cadaabka Alle.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّا قَدۡ أُوحِيَ إِلَيۡنَآ أَنَّ ٱلۡعَذَابَ عَلَىٰ مَن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ

en.text: Indeed, it has been revealed to us that the punishment will be upon whoever denies and turns away.'"

so.text: 48. Waxaa xaqiiq naloo waxyooday in cadaab ku dhici qofkii (Xaqa) beeniya oo ka jeesta.”.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ فَمَن رَّبُّكُمَا يَٰمُوسَىٰ

en.text: [Pharaoh] said, "So who is the Lord of you two, O Moses?"

so.text: 49. (Fircoon) wuxuu yidhi: “Waa Kuma Rabbigiin, Muusow?”

ayat.arabic: قَالَ رَبُّنَا ٱلَّذِيٓ أَعۡطَىٰ كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ خَلۡقَهُۥ ثُمَّ هَدَىٰ

en.text: He said, "Our Lord is He who gave each thing its form and then guided [it]."

so.text: 50. (Muuse) wuxuu yidhi: Rabbigayo waa kan siiyey wax walba qaabka uu leeyahay oo u tilmaamay (yoolkeed).”

ayat.arabic: قَالَ فَمَا بَالُ ٱلۡقُرُونِ ٱلۡأُولَىٰ

en.text: [Pharaoh] said, "Then what is the case of the former generations?"

so.text: 51. (Fircoon) wuxuu yidhi: “Ka warran xaalka facyadii hore?.”

ayat.arabic: قَالَ عِلۡمُهَا عِندَ رَبِّي فِي كِتَٰبٖۖ لَّا يَضِلُّ رَبِّي وَلَا يَنسَى

en.text: [Moses] said, "The knowledge thereof is with my Lord in a record. My Lord neither errs nor forgets."

so.text: 52. (Muuse) wuxuu yidhi: Cilmigoodu wuxuu la jiraa Rabbigay, Kitaab buu ku yaal (Looxa Maxfuudka). Rabbigay ma gefo, waxnana ma halmaamo.

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ مَهۡدٗا وَسَلَكَ لَكُمۡ فِيهَا سُبُلٗا وَأَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءٗ فَأَخۡرَجۡنَا بِهِۦٓ أَزۡوَٰجٗا مِّن نَّبَاتٖ شَتَّىٰ

en.text: [It is He] who has made for you the earth as a bed [spread out] and inserted therein for you roadways and sent down from the sky, rain and produced thereby categories of various plants.

so.text: 53. Waa Kan idiinka dhigay dhulka gogol (fidsan); oo idiinka furay waddooyin dhexdeeda, idiinkana soo dejiya biyo (roob) xagga daruuraha, markaasaan ku soo saarnaa dhir noocyo kala duwan ah.

ayat.arabic: كُلُواْ وَٱرۡعَوۡاْ أَنۡعَٰمَكُمۡۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّأُوْلِي ٱلنُّهَىٰ

en.text: Eat [therefrom] and pasture your livestock. Indeed in that are signs for those of intelligence.

so.text: 54. Cuna oo daaqsada xoolihiinna, hubaal, waxaa arrinkani ugu sugan calaamooyin (muujin Awoodda Alle  iyo mudnaantiisa Keligi cibaadada) ciddii leh caqli fayow.

ayat.arabic: ۞ مِنۡهَا خَلَقۡنَٰكُمۡ وَفِيهَا نُعِيدُكُمۡ وَمِنۡهَا نُخۡرِجُكُمۡ تَارَةً أُخۡرَىٰ

en.text: From it [i.e., the earth] We created you, and into it We will return you, and from it We will extract you another time.

so.text: 55. Xaggeedaan (arlada) idinka abuurnay, gudaheeda baan idinku celin, xaggeedaana la idinka soo saari mar kale (geeri kaddib).

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ أَرَيۡنَٰهُ ءَايَٰتِنَا كُلَّهَا فَكَذَّبَ وَأَبَىٰ

en.text: And We certainly showed him [i.e., Pharaoh] Our signs - all of them - but he denied and refused.

so.text: 56. Waxaan dhab ahaan tusnay (Fircoon) calaamooyinkayaga dhammaantood, waase beeniyey oo diiday.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ أَجِئۡتَنَا لِتُخۡرِجَنَا مِنۡ أَرۡضِنَا بِسِحۡرِكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ

en.text: He said, "Have you come to us to drive us out of our land with your magic, O Moses?

so.text: 57. (Fircoon) wuxuu yidhi: “Ma waxaad noogu timid inaad nooga saarto dhulkayaga sixirkaaga Muusow?.

ayat.arabic: فَلَنَأۡتِيَنَّكَ بِسِحۡرٖ مِّثۡلِهِۦ فَٱجۡعَلۡ بَيۡنَنَا وَبَيۡنَكَ مَوۡعِدٗا لَّا نُخۡلِفُهُۥ نَحۡنُ وَلَآ أَنتَ مَكَانٗا سُوٗى

en.text: Then we will surely bring you magic like it, so make between us and you an appointment, which we will not fail to keep and neither will you, in a place assigned."[839]
en.footnotes: [839] Literally, "marked," as to be known. Another meaning is "a place midway [between us]" or "a level place."

so.text: 58. Waxaanu kuula iman sixir la mid ah ee noo qabo ballan dhexdeenna aan ku kulanno, oo aanaan ka dib dhaceyn innaga iyo adiguba midna meel fagaare ah [9].
so.footnotes: [9]. Meel cayiman si loo ogaado, macno kale waa meel noo dhexeysa ee la isugu yimaado ama meel fagaare ah oo siman.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ مَوۡعِدُكُمۡ يَوۡمُ ٱلزِّينَةِ وَأَن يُحۡشَرَ ٱلنَّاسُ ضُحٗى

en.text: [Moses] said, "Your appointment is on the day of the festival when the people assemble at mid-morning."[840]
en.footnotes: [840] So that the signs of Allāh would be seen clearly.

so.text: 59. (Muuse) wuxuu yidhi: “Ballankiinnu waa maalinta Ciidda, hana la soo kulmiyo Dadka barqadii.

ayat.arabic: فَتَوَلَّىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنُ فَجَمَعَ كَيۡدَهُۥ ثُمَّ أَتَىٰ

en.text: So Pharaoh went away, put together his plan, and then came [to Moses].

so.text: 60. Markaasuu Fircoon tagey, isuna keenay tabihiisii, markaas yimid.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰ وَيۡلَكُمۡ لَا تَفۡتَرُواْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبٗا فَيُسۡحِتَكُم بِعَذَابٖۖ وَقَدۡ خَابَ مَنِ ٱفۡتَرَىٰ

en.text: Moses said to them [i.e., the magicians summoned by Pharaoh], "Woe to you! Do not invent a lie against Allāh or He will exterminate you with a punishment; and he has failed who invents [such falsehood]."

so.text: 61. Muuse wuxuu ku yidhi (sixiroolayaashii uu keenay Fircoon): "Magaciin bi'i waaye! Ha ka been sheegina Alle si uusan idiinku dabar goyn cadaab. Waxaana hoogay qofkii ka been sheega (Alle)”.

ayat.arabic: فَتَنَٰزَعُوٓاْ أَمۡرَهُم بَيۡنَهُمۡ وَأَسَرُّواْ ٱلنَّجۡوَىٰ

en.text: So they disputed over their affair among themselves and concealed their private conversation.

so.text: 62. Markaasay ka doodeen arrinkooda dhexdooda oo qarsadeen faqooda.

ayat.arabic: قَالُوٓاْ إِنۡ هَٰذَٰنِ لَسَٰحِرَٰنِ يُرِيدَانِ أَن يُخۡرِجَاكُم مِّنۡ أَرۡضِكُم بِسِحۡرِهِمَا وَيَذۡهَبَا بِطَرِيقَتِكُمُ ٱلۡمُثۡلَىٰ

en.text: They said, "Indeed, these are two magicians who want to drive you out of your land with their magic and do away with your most exemplary way [i.e., religion or tradition].

so.text: 63. Waxay yidhaahdeen: Kuwani waa labo saaxir oo doonaya inay idiinkaga saaraan dhulkiinna sixirkooda, oo ay bi'iyaan dariiqadiinna fiican (caadadiinna).

ayat.arabic: فَأَجۡمِعُواْ كَيۡدَكُمۡ ثُمَّ ٱئۡتُواْ صَفّٗاۚ وَقَدۡ أَفۡلَحَ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ مَنِ ٱسۡتَعۡلَىٰ

en.text: So resolve upon your plan and then come [forward] in line. And he has succeeded today who overcomes."

so.text: 64. Ee isu geeya Tabtiinna oo imaada idinkoo saf saf ah; waxaa liibaani maanta ciddii gacan sarreysa ”.

ayat.arabic: قَالُواْ يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ إِمَّآ أَن تُلۡقِيَ وَإِمَّآ أَن نَّكُونَ أَوَّلَ مَنۡ أَلۡقَىٰ

en.text: They said, "O Moses, either you throw or we will be the first to throw."

so.text: 65. Waxay yidhaahdeen: “Muusow! Ama tuur (usha) ama aan innagu ahaanno kuwa hor tuura?”

ayat.arabic: قَالَ بَلۡ أَلۡقُواْۖ فَإِذَا حِبَالُهُمۡ وَعِصِيُّهُمۡ يُخَيَّلُ إِلَيۡهِ مِن سِحۡرِهِمۡ أَنَّهَا تَسۡعَىٰ

en.text: He said, "Rather, you throw." And suddenly their ropes and staffs seemed to him from their magic that they were moving [like snakes].

so.text: 66. Wuxuu yidhi: “Bal tuura idinka (marka hore)"! Mise, xargahoodii iyo ulahoodii, waxaa loogu ekaysiiyey sixirkoodii dartiis sida inay ordi.

ayat.arabic: فَأَوۡجَسَ فِي نَفۡسِهِۦ خِيفَةٗ مُّوسَىٰ

en.text: And he sensed within himself apprehension, did Moses.

so.text: 67. Markaasuu Muuse ka dareemay naftiisii cabsi.

ayat.arabic: قُلۡنَا لَا تَخَفۡ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلۡأَعۡلَىٰ

en.text: We [i.e., Allāh] said, "Fear not. Indeed, it is you who are superior.

so.text: 68. Waxaanu nidhi: Ha cabsan, waa adiga xaqiiq kan sarreyne.

ayat.arabic: وَأَلۡقِ مَا فِي يَمِينِكَ تَلۡقَفۡ مَا صَنَعُوٓاْۖ إِنَّمَا صَنَعُواْ كَيۡدُ سَٰحِرٖۖ وَلَا يُفۡلِحُ ٱلسَّاحِرُ حَيۡثُ أَتَىٰ

en.text: And throw what is in your right hand; it will swallow up what they have crafted. What they have crafted is but the trick of a magician, and the magician will not succeed wherever he is."

so.text: 69. Tuurna waxa ku jira gacantaaada midig! Waxay liqi waxay sameeyeen, waxa ay sameeyeen waa uun tab sixirrow, mana liibaano sixirrow meeluu yimaadaba.

ayat.arabic: فَأُلۡقِيَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سُجَّدٗا قَالُوٓاْ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ هَٰرُونَ وَمُوسَىٰ

en.text: So the magicians fell down in prostration.[841] They said, "We have believed in the Lord of Aaron and Moses."
en.footnotes: [841] After they had seen the miracles which Allāh had given Moses and that they were realities and not merely impressions of magic.

so.text: 70. Saaxirintii waxay ula dhaceen dhulka sujuud [10].Waxay yidhaadeen: Waxaan rumeynay Rabbiga Haaruun iyo Muuse.”
so.footnotes: [10]. Kaddib markay arkeen mucjisooyinka uu Alle siiyey Muuse iyo inay yihiin xaqiiq oo aysan ahayn moodsiin sixir.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ ءَامَنتُمۡ لَهُۥ قَبۡلَ أَنۡ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمۡۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ ٱلَّذِي عَلَّمَكُمُ ٱلسِّحۡرَۖ فَلَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيۡدِيَكُمۡ وَأَرۡجُلَكُم مِّنۡ خِلَٰفٖ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمۡ فِي جُذُوعِ ٱلنَّخۡلِ وَلَتَعۡلَمُنَّ أَيُّنَآ أَشَدُّ عَذَابٗا وَأَبۡقَىٰ

en.text: [Pharaoh] said, "You believed him [i.e., Moses] before I gave you permission. Indeed, he is your leader who has taught you magic. So I will surely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will crucify you on the trunks of palm trees, and you will surely know which of us is more severe in [giving] punishment and more enduring."

so.text: 71. (Fircoon) wuxuu yidhi: “Ma waxaad rumeyseen ka hor inta aanan idiin idmin? Hubaal waa kan idiinku weyn ee idin baray sixirka. Waxaan u goyn gacmahiinna iyo lugahiinna isdhaaf, waxaana idinku daldali jirridaha geedaha timrta, waadna ogaan midkaayagii (aniga ama Rabbiga Muuse) cadaab daran oo daa’ insan.

ayat.arabic: قَالُواْ لَن نُّؤۡثِرَكَ عَلَىٰ مَا جَآءَنَا مِنَ ٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِ وَٱلَّذِي فَطَرَنَاۖ فَٱقۡضِ مَآ أَنتَ قَاضٍۖ إِنَّمَا تَقۡضِي هَٰذِهِ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنۡيَآ

en.text: They said, "Never will we prefer you over what has come to us of clear proofs and [over] He who created us.[842] So decree whatever you are to decree. You can only decree for this worldly life.
en.footnotes: [842] This phrase has also been interpreted as an oath, i.e., "...by Him who created us."

so.text: 72. Waxay yidhaahdeen: “Kaa dooran mayno waxa noo yimid oo Xujooyin cad ah iyo Kan (Allaah) ee na abuuray [11]. Ee go'aami waxaad rabto inaad go'aamiso, waxaad oo keliya wax ka go'aamin kartaa (wixii la xidhiidha) noloshan Adduunka.
so.footnotes: [11]. Weedhan ‘ walladdii fadaranaa” waxaa sidoo kale lagu fasiray dhaar ahaan macnaha markaa waxaa weeye: Waxaan ku dhaarannay Kan na abuuraye.”

ayat.arabic: إِنَّآ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّنَا لِيَغۡفِرَ لَنَا خَطَٰيَٰنَا وَمَآ أَكۡرَهۡتَنَا عَلَيۡهِ مِنَ ٱلسِّحۡرِۗ وَٱللَّهُ خَيۡرٞ وَأَبۡقَىٰٓ

en.text: Indeed, we have believed in our Lord that He may forgive us our sins and what you compelled us [to do] of magic. And Allāh is better and more enduring."[843]
en.footnotes: [843] In reward and in punishment.

so.text: 73. Waxaanu xaqiiq rumeynay Rabbigayo si uu noogu dhaafo gefefkayaga iyo waxaad nagu khasabtay ee (barashda) sixirka ah. Alle baana khayr badan (abaal marin ahaan), oo daa’insanaan badan [12] 'cadaab ahaan'.
so.footnotes: [12]. Ajar ahaan iyo ciqaab ahaanba.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ مَن يَأۡتِ رَبَّهُۥ مُجۡرِمٗا فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ جَهَنَّمَ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحۡيَىٰ

en.text: Indeed, whoever comes to his Lord as a criminal - indeed, for him is Hell; he will neither die therein nor live.

so.text: 74. Qofkii u yimaada Rabbigiis isagoo denbiile ah, abaalkiisu waa Jahannamo, uusan ku dhimaneyn, kuna noolaaneyn.

ayat.arabic: وَمَن يَأۡتِهِۦ مُؤۡمِنٗا قَدۡ عَمِلَ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمُ ٱلدَّرَجَٰتُ ٱلۡعُلَىٰ

en.text: But whoever comes to Him as a believer having done righteous deeds - for those will be the highest degrees [in position]:

so.text: 75.Qofkii se u yimaada isagoo mu’min ah oo samo fashay, kuwaasi waxay leeyihiin derejooyinka sare (nolosha dambe-Aakhiro)

ayat.arabic: جَنَّٰتُ عَدۡنٖ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَاۚ وَذَٰلِكَ جَزَآءُ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ

en.text: Gardens of perpetual residence beneath which rivers flow, wherein they abide eternally. And that is the reward of one who purifies himself.[844]
en.footnotes: [844] From all uncleanliness, the greatest of which is worship and obedience to other than Allāh.

so.text: 76. Beero (Jannooyin) ku yaal guryo san oo negaya (bay galayaan) oo ay hoos qul-qulaan webiyo, oo ay ku dhex waari weligood: kaasi waa abaalka kan ka daahiriya naftiisa 'shirkiga iyo macaasida' [13].
so.footnotes: [13]. Iska xala fadaro oo dhan, uu ugu daran yahay shirkiga.

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ أَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنۡ أَسۡرِ بِعِبَادِي فَٱضۡرِبۡ لَهُمۡ طَرِيقٗا فِي ٱلۡبَحۡرِ يَبَسٗا لَّا تَخَٰفُ دَرَكٗا وَلَا تَخۡشَىٰ

en.text: And We had inspired to Moses, "Travel by night with My servants and strike for them a dry path through the sea; you will not fear being overtaken [by Pharaoh] nor be afraid [of drowning]."

so.text: 77. Waxaan dhab ahaan u waxyoonnay Muuse (Annagoo ku leh): "Guureysii addoomahayga oo uga yeel waddo badda dhexdeeda qallalan, ha ka cabsan haleel [14] hana ka baqin (hafitaan)".
so.footnotes: [14]. Ku dhufashada badda usha, eeg Suuradda Ash-Shucaraa: Aayadda 63. Haleel macnaha inuu ku soo gaaro Fircoon.

ayat.arabic: فَأَتۡبَعَهُمۡ فِرۡعَوۡنُ بِجُنُودِهِۦ فَغَشِيَهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡيَمِّ مَا غَشِيَهُمۡ

en.text: So Pharaoh pursued them with his soldiers, and there covered them from the sea that which covered them,[845]
en.footnotes: [845] i.e., not only the water but that which only Allāh knows - terror, pain, regret, etc.

so.text: 78. Markaas waxaa raacay Fircoon oo wata askarahiisii, waxaana halkaas kaga daboo- lay xagga badda waxaasi daboolay [15].
so.footnotes: [15]. Ma daboolin oo qaadin biyo oo keliya, balse waxaa daboolay oo wada qaatay waxaa daboolay uu Alle Keliya Ogsoon yahay sida argagax, xanuun, qoomamo, cadaab, iwm.

ayat.arabic: وَأَضَلَّ فِرۡعَوۡنُ قَوۡمَهُۥ وَمَا هَدَىٰ

en.text: And Pharaoh led his people astray and did not guide [them].

so.text: 79. Wuxuu dhumiyey Fircoon qolodiisii,  mana uu hanuunin.

ayat.arabic: يَٰبَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ قَدۡ أَنجَيۡنَٰكُم مِّنۡ عَدُوِّكُمۡ وَوَٰعَدۡنَٰكُمۡ جَانِبَ ٱلطُّورِ ٱلۡأَيۡمَنَ وَنَزَّلۡنَا عَلَيۡكُمُ ٱلۡمَنَّ وَٱلسَّلۡوَىٰ

en.text: O Children of Israel, We delivered you from your enemy, and We made an appointment with you[846] at the right side of the mount, and We sent down to you manna and quails,
en.footnotes: [846] i.e., with your prophet, to receive the scripture for you.

so.text: 80. Ilmahii Israa’iilow! Waxaan idinka badbaadinnay cadowgiinnii, waxaana idinkula gallay ballan dhinaca midig ee Buurta (Siinnay), oo idiin soo dejinnay Manna iyo Salwaa.

ayat.arabic: كُلُواْ مِن طَيِّبَٰتِ مَا رَزَقۡنَٰكُمۡ وَلَا تَطۡغَوۡاْ فِيهِ فَيَحِلَّ عَلَيۡكُمۡ غَضَبِيۖ وَمَن يَحۡلِلۡ عَلَيۡهِ غَضَبِي فَقَدۡ هَوَىٰ

en.text: [Saying], "Eat from the good things with which We have provided you and do not transgress [or oppress others] therein, lest My anger should descend upon you. And he upon whom My anger descends has certainly fallen [i.e., perished]."

so.text: 81. Cuna waxyaalaha wanaagsan (ee xalaasha ah) oo aan idinku irsaaqnay, hana ku xadugudbina oo qooqina (dhulka, ha dulminina dadka hana is kibrinana), yeysan idinku dhicine Cadhadaydu. Kay ku dhacdo cadhadayduna hoog oo ba'.

ayat.arabic: وَإِنِّي لَغَفَّارٞ لِّمَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحٗا ثُمَّ ٱهۡتَدَىٰ

en.text: But indeed, I am the Perpetual Forgiver of whoever repents and believes and does righteousness and then continues in guidance.

so.text: 82. Oo xaqiiq, Anigu waan u denbi Dhaaf Badanahay qofkii tawbad keena oo (Xaqa) rumeeya oo sama fala,  markaas ku sugnaada hanuunka oo toosnaada.

ayat.arabic: ۞ وَمَآ أَعۡجَلَكَ عَن قَوۡمِكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ

en.text: [Allāh said], "And what made you hasten from your people, O Moses?"

so.text: 83. (Alle wuxuu yidhi), “Maxaa kaa soo dedejiyey qoladaadii, Muusow?”

ayat.arabic: قَالَ هُمۡ أُوْلَآءِ عَلَىٰٓ أَثَرِي وَعَجِلۡتُ إِلَيۡكَ رَبِّ لِتَرۡضَىٰ

en.text: He said, "They are close upon my tracks, and I hastened to You, my Lord, that You be pleased."

so.text: 84. Wuxuu yidhi: “Waa kuwaan ku soo jooga raadkayga, waana kuu soo deg-degay Rabbiyow si aad u raalli ahaato".

ayat.arabic: قَالَ فَإِنَّا قَدۡ فَتَنَّا قَوۡمَكَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِكَ وَأَضَلَّهُمُ ٱلسَّامِرِيُّ

en.text: [Allāh] said, "But indeed, We have tried your people after you [departed], and the Sāmirī[847] has led them astray."
en.footnotes: [847] Translated as "the Samaritan" (from Samaria), a hypocrite among them who led the Children of Israel into idol-worship.

so.text: 85.(Alle) wuxuu yidhi: Waxaanu imtixaannay qolodaadii gadaashaa, waxaana lumiyey As-Saamiri.’

ayat.arabic: فَرَجَعَ مُوسَىٰٓ إِلَىٰ قَوۡمِهِۦ غَضۡبَٰنَ أَسِفٗاۚ قَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ أَلَمۡ يَعِدۡكُمۡ رَبُّكُمۡ وَعۡدًا حَسَنًاۚ أَفَطَالَ عَلَيۡكُمُ ٱلۡعَهۡدُ أَمۡ أَرَدتُّمۡ أَن يَحِلَّ عَلَيۡكُمۡ غَضَبٞ مِّن رَّبِّكُمۡ فَأَخۡلَفۡتُم مَّوۡعِدِي

en.text: So Moses returned to his people, angry and grieved.[848] He said, "O my people, did your Lord not make you a good promise?[849] Then, was the time [of its fulfillment] too long for you, or did you wish that wrath from your Lord descend upon you, so you broke your promise [of obedience] to me?"
en.footnotes:
[848] The meaning may also be "angry and enraged."
[849] That He would send down the Torah, containing guidance for you.

so.text: 86. Markaasuu Muuse u noqday tolkiisii isagoo cadheysan oo ka xun, Wuxuu yidhi: “Tolkayow! Ma wuusan Rabbigiin idiin sameyn ballan qaad wanaagsan [16]? Ee ma waxaa idinku dheeraaday muddadii? Mise waxaad doonteen inay idiinka dhacdo Cadho xagga Rabbigiin, oo aad uga baxdeen ballankii aad ila gasheen?”
so.footnotes: [16]. La jirka Nabigiin si uu idiinku soo qaado Kitaabka Towreedda.

ayat.arabic: قَالُواْ مَآ أَخۡلَفۡنَا مَوۡعِدَكَ بِمَلۡكِنَا وَلَٰكِنَّا حُمِّلۡنَآ أَوۡزَارٗا مِّن زِينَةِ ٱلۡقَوۡمِ فَقَذَفۡنَٰهَا فَكَذَٰلِكَ أَلۡقَى ٱلسَّامِرِيُّ

en.text: They said, "We did not break our promise to you by our will, but we were made to carry burdens from the ornaments of the people [of Pharaoh], so we threw them [into the fire], and thus did the Sāmirī throw."

so.text: 87. Waxay yidhaahdeen: “Ugama aanu bixin Ballankii aan kula gallay ikhyaarka- yaga, waxaase nala saaray culaysyo ka mid ah alaab reer (Fircoon) isku qurxin jireen [17], markaas baan ku tuurnay (dabka), sidaasuuna u tuuray As-Saamiri.
so.footnotes: [17]. Waxaa horay loo amray inay soo qaataan waxyaalihii ay isku qurxin jireen dadkii Masar ee dahabka ahaa, markaasuu wuxuu amray Saamiri inay ku tuuraan dahabkaa dab si ay uga sameeyaan sanam leh muuqaal dibi oo kale, markaasay dabkii ku tuureen, Saamirina ku tuuray sidoo kale iyo carro uu ka soo qaaday raadka faraskii Jabriil oo uu arkay, markaasaa waxaa ka soo baxay sanam muuqaal dibi leh ay ilmihii Israa’iil qaarkood caabudeen. Saamiri wuxuu ahaa munaafiq ku dhex jiray ilmihii Israa’iil oo u horseeday sanam caabudka.

ayat.arabic: فَأَخۡرَجَ لَهُمۡ عِجۡلٗا جَسَدٗا لَّهُۥ خُوَارٞ فَقَالُواْ هَٰذَآ إِلَٰهُكُمۡ وَإِلَٰهُ مُوسَىٰ فَنَسِيَ

en.text: And he extracted for them [the statue of] a calf which had a lowing sound, and they said, "This is your god and the god of Moses, but he forgot."

so.text: 88. Wuxuuna uga soo saaray (muuqaal) dibi oo cod leh. Waxayna yidhaahdeen: "Kan waa ilaahiinna iyo ilaaha Muuse, wuuse illoobay.

ayat.arabic: أَفَلَا يَرَوۡنَ أَلَّا يَرۡجِعُ إِلَيۡهِمۡ قَوۡلٗا وَلَا يَمۡلِكُ لَهُمۡ ضَرّٗا وَلَا نَفۡعٗا

en.text: Did they not see that it could not return to them any speech [i.e., response] and that it did not possess for them any harm or benefit?

so.text: 89. Miyeynan arkayn in aanu u soo celin kareyn kelmadna (wax jawaab ah), oo aanu u haynin dhib iyo dheef midna?.

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ هَٰرُونُ مِن قَبۡلُ يَٰقَوۡمِ إِنَّمَا فُتِنتُم بِهِۦۖ وَإِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ فَٱتَّبِعُونِي وَأَطِيعُوٓاْ أَمۡرِي

en.text: And Aaron had already told them before [the return of Moses], "O my people, you are only being tested by it, and indeed, your Lord is the Most Merciful, so follow me and obey my order."

so.text: 90. Wuxuuna ku yidhi Haaruun kal hore (intaanu soo laaban Muuse):Tolkayow!  Waxaad tihiin kuwo uun lagu imtixaanay arrintani, Rabbigiinna waa Raxmaanka ee i soo raaca, adeecana amarkayga.

ayat.arabic: قَالُواْ لَن نَّبۡرَحَ عَلَيۡهِ عَٰكِفِينَ حَتَّىٰ يَرۡجِعَ إِلَيۡنَا مُوسَىٰ

en.text: They said, "We will never cease being devoted to it [i.e., the calf] until Moses returns to us."

so.text: 91. Waxay yidhaahdeen: “Ma deyneyno caabudidda (dibiga) intuu nooga soo noqon Muuse.”

ayat.arabic: قَالَ يَٰهَٰرُونُ مَا مَنَعَكَ إِذۡ رَأَيۡتَهُمۡ ضَلُّوٓاْ

en.text: [Moses] said, "O Aaron, what prevented you, when you saw them going astray,

so.text: 92. (Muuse) wuxuu yidhi: Haaruunow! Maxaa kuu diiday markaad aragtay inay lumeen.

ayat.arabic: أَلَّا تَتَّبِعَنِۖ أَفَعَصَيۡتَ أَمۡرِي

en.text: From following me? Then have you disobeyed my order?"

so.text: 93. Inaad I soo raacdo (oo ka soo tagto)? Ma waxaad caasiday amarkaygii?.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ يَبۡنَؤُمَّ لَا تَأۡخُذۡ بِلِحۡيَتِي وَلَا بِرَأۡسِيٓۖ إِنِّي خَشِيتُ أَن تَقُولَ فَرَّقۡتَ بَيۡنَ بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ وَلَمۡ تَرۡقُبۡ قَوۡلِي

en.text: [Aaron] said, "O son of my mother, do not seize [me] by my beard or by my head. Indeed, I feared that you would say, 'You caused division among the Children of Israel, and you did not observe [or await] my word.'"

so.text: 94. (Haaruun) wuxuu yidhi: “Ina hooyow! Ha iga soo qaban garkeyga ama madaxeyga midkoodna. Anigu waxaan ka baqay inaad tidhaahdo: “Waxaad kala qaybisay ilmihii Israa’iil, mana aadan dhowrin (sugin) qowlkeyga.”

ayat.arabic: قَالَ فَمَا خَطۡبُكَ يَٰسَٰمِرِيُّ

en.text: [Moses] said, "And what is your case, O Sāmirī?"

so.text: 95. (Muuse) wuxuu yidhi: “Muxuu yahay xaalkaagu Saamiriyow?

ayat.arabic: قَالَ بَصُرۡتُ بِمَا لَمۡ يَبۡصُرُواْ بِهِۦ فَقَبَضۡتُ قَبۡضَةٗ مِّنۡ أَثَرِ ٱلرَّسُولِ فَنَبَذۡتُهَا وَكَذَٰلِكَ سَوَّلَتۡ لِي نَفۡسِي

en.text: He said, "I saw what they did not see, so I took a handful [of dust] from the track of the messenger[850] and threw it,[851] and thus did my soul entice me."
en.footnotes:
[850] i.e., a hoof-print in the sand left by the angel Gabriel's horse.
[851] Into the fire upon the melted ornaments in order to form the calf.

so.text: 96. Wuxuu yidhi: “Waxaan arkay wax aysan arag. Waxaana ka soo qaaatay sacab muggi (oo carro ah) raadkii Rasuulka [18] (Faraskii Jabriil) oo aan ku tuuray [19]. Sidaasayna ii qurxisay nafteydu.
so.footnotes:
[18]. Raadka Rasuulka waxaa loola jeedaa Raadka qoobka faraskii uu watay Jabriil c.s. Waxaa kaloo lagu fasiray Raadka Rasuulka:Risaaladii Rasuulka oo ah sharciga uu la yimid Muuse, inuu Saamiri isaga tagay sharcigaas.
[19]. Dabkii lagu riday alaabadii ay isku qurxin jireen reer Fircoon si aan uga sameeyo sawir dibi.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ فَٱذۡهَبۡ فَإِنَّ لَكَ فِي ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ أَن تَقُولَ لَا مِسَاسَۖ وَإِنَّ لَكَ مَوۡعِدٗا لَّن تُخۡلَفَهُۥۖ وَٱنظُرۡ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَٰهِكَ ٱلَّذِي ظَلۡتَ عَلَيۡهِ عَاكِفٗاۖ لَّنُحَرِّقَنَّهُۥ ثُمَّ لَنَنسِفَنَّهُۥ فِي ٱلۡيَمِّ نَسۡفًا

en.text: [Moses] said, "Then go. And indeed, it is [decreed] for you in [this] life to say, 'No contact.'[852] And indeed, you have an appointment [in the Hereafter] you will not fail to keep. And look at your 'god' to which you remained devoted. We will surely burn it and blow it [i.e., its ashes] into the sea with a blast.
en.footnotes: [852] i.e., Do not touch me. As chastisement, he was to be completely shunned by all people.

so.text: 97. (Muuse) wuxuu yidhi: Tag oo naga fagow! Waxaa kuu sugnaaday noloshan inaad tidhaahdo: "Taabasho ma jirto" [20], waxaa kaloo  leedahay ballan aad dib uga dhici doonin (oo ah cadaabka Aakhiro). Eegna ilaah ku sheeggaagii aad in door ah dul joogtay ee aad caabudaysay. Waanu gubi (oo aanu ka dhigi dambas) aanu badda ku firdhinno oo waxba aanu ka hari doonin.’
so.footnotes: [20]. “ Ha i taabaannina” waa ciqaab ahaan adduunka, waayo waxaa la amray inay dadku u gooyaan si dhan oo waxba ku darsan. Aakhirona waxaa sugaya Naar olol badan.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّمَآ إِلَٰهُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۚ وَسِعَ كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ عِلۡمٗا

en.text: Your god is only Allāh, except for whom there is no deity. He has encompassed all things in knowledge."

so.text: 98. Ilaahiinnu waa oo keliya Allaah, ee aanu jirin Ilaah (xaq ah) oo aan Isaga ahayn. Wuxuu ku koobay wax walba Cilmi.

ayat.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ نَقُصُّ عَلَيۡكَ مِنۡ أَنۢبَآءِ مَا قَدۡ سَبَقَۚ وَقَدۡ ءَاتَيۡنَٰكَ مِن لَّدُنَّا ذِكۡرٗا

en.text: Thus, [O Muḥammad], We relate to you from the news of what has preceded. And We have certainly given you from Us a message [i.e., the Qur’ān].

so.text: 99. Sidaasaan (Muxammadow) kuugu soo tebinnaa warar ka mid ah wixii horey u dhacay. Waxaanuna xaqiiq kaa siinnay Xaggayaga waano (Qur’aankan).

ayat.arabic: مَّنۡ أَعۡرَضَ عَنۡهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَحۡمِلُ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ وِزۡرًا

en.text: Whoever turns away from it - then indeed, he will bear on the Day of Resurrection a burden [i.e., great sin],

so.text: 100. Qofkii ka jeesta wuxuu xambaaran Maalinta Qiyaame culaab culus (denbi).

ayat.arabic: خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهِۖ وَسَآءَ لَهُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ حِمۡلٗا

en.text: [Abiding] eternally therein,[853] and evil it is for them on the Day of Resurrection as a load -
en.footnotes: [853] i.e., in the state of sin.

so.text: 101. Iyagoo ku dhex waari (cadaabka). Xumaa maalinta Qiyaamaha culaabka ay qaadi.

ayat.arabic: يَوۡمَ يُنفَخُ فِي ٱلصُّورِۚ وَنَحۡشُرُ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ يَوۡمَئِذٖ زُرۡقٗا

en.text: The Day the Horn will be blown. And We will gather the criminals, that Day, blue-eyed.[854]
en.footnotes: [854] From terror, or blinded completely.

so.text: 102. Maaalinta buunka la afuufi [21], oo aan isu soo kulmin denbiilayaasha Maalintaa iyagoo indho cawlan [22].
so.footnotes:
[21]. Afuufka labaad, waana afuufka dadka ay ka soo bixi doonaan qubuurahooda iyagoo nool. 
[22]. Cabsi darteed, ama macnaha waa iyagoo indha la’ waxba aan arkayn.

ayat.arabic: يَتَخَٰفَتُونَ بَيۡنَهُمۡ إِن لَّبِثۡتُمۡ إِلَّا عَشۡرٗا

en.text: They will murmur among themselves, "You remained not but ten [days in the world]."

so.text: 103. Iyagoo  Hoos u wada hadlaya oo isku leh: Ma aydaan joogin waxaan aheyn toban (maalmood adduunka).”

ayat.arabic: نَّحۡنُ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ إِذۡ يَقُولُ أَمۡثَلُهُمۡ طَرِيقَةً إِن لَّبِثۡتُمۡ إِلَّا يَوۡمٗا

en.text: We are most knowing of what they say when the best of them in manner [i.e., wisdom or speech] will say, "You remained not but one day."

so.text: 104. Annagaa ka ogsoon waxay leeyihiin, marka kooda ugu jid wanaagsani odhan, “Ma aydaan joogin (adduunka) maalin mooyee.”

ayat.arabic: وَيَسۡـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلۡجِبَالِ فَقُلۡ يَنسِفُهَا رَبِّي نَسۡفٗا

en.text: And they ask you about the mountains, so say, "My Lord will blow them away with a blast.[855]
en.footnotes: [855] Once they have been reduced to dust.

so.text: 105. Waxay wax kaa weydiin buuraha, dheh: Rabbigay baa baabbi’in isagoo ka dhigaya sida budo ciid ah.

ayat.arabic: فَيَذَرُهَا قَاعٗا صَفۡصَفٗا

en.text: And He will leave it [i.e., the earth] a level plain;

so.text: 106. Wuxuu ka yeeli (arladana) ban siman.

ayat.arabic: لَّا تَرَىٰ فِيهَا عِوَجٗا وَلَآ أَمۡتٗا

en.text: You will not see therein a depression or an elevation."

so.text: 107. Aad ku dhex arkeyn meel hoosaysa ama sarreysa.”

ayat.arabic: يَوۡمَئِذٖ يَتَّبِعُونَ ٱلدَّاعِيَ لَا عِوَجَ لَهُۥۖ وَخَشَعَتِ ٱلۡأَصۡوَاتُ لِلرَّحۡمَٰنِ فَلَا تَسۡمَعُ إِلَّا هَمۡسٗا

en.text: That Day, they [i.e., everyone] will follow [the call of] the Caller[856] [with] no deviation therefrom, and [all] voices will be stilled before the Most Merciful, so you will not hear except a whisper [of footsteps].
en.footnotes: [856] To the gathering for judgement.

so.text: 108. Maalintaas waxay iyagu (qof walbaa) raaci (dhawaaqa) dhawaaqaha isagoon leexleexasho lahayn. Waxayna ahaan codadka oo dhan kuwo kushuucsan Raxmaanka (Alle) horti, mana maqleysid waxaan aheyn shanqarta (socodkooda).

ayat.arabic: يَوۡمَئِذٖ لَّا تَنفَعُ ٱلشَّفَٰعَةُ إِلَّا مَنۡ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ وَرَضِيَ لَهُۥ قَوۡلٗا

en.text: That Day, no intercession will benefit except [that of] one to whom the Most Merciful has given permission and has accepted his word.

so.text: 109. Maalintaas shafeeco wax ma tarto, mid maahee uu Raxmaanku (Alle) u idmo oo uu ka raalli yahay hadalkiisa.

ayat.arabic: يَعۡلَمُ مَا بَيۡنَ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ وَمَا خَلۡفَهُمۡ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِهِۦ عِلۡمٗا

en.text: He [i.e., Allāh] knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them,[857] but they do not encompass it [i.e., what He knows] in knowledge.
en.footnotes: [857] Allāh’s knowledge encompasses every aspect of His creations in the past, present and future.

so.text: 110. Wuxuu (Alle) og yahay waxa hortooda ah iyo waxa gadhaashooda ah, Mase ku koobi karaan (waxa uu Og yahay) Cilmi.

ayat.arabic: ۞ وَعَنَتِ ٱلۡوُجُوهُ لِلۡحَيِّ ٱلۡقَيُّومِۖ وَقَدۡ خَابَ مَنۡ حَمَلَ ظُلۡمٗا

en.text: And [all] faces will be humbled before the Ever-Living, the Self-Sustaining.[858] And he will have failed who carries injustice.[859]
en.footnotes:
[858] See footnotes describing these attributes in 2:255.
[859] i.e., sin or wrongdoing towards Allāh or any of His creation.

so.text: 111. Waxay dhammaan wejiyadu u khushuuci (Allaah), Noolaha Daa’inka ah, Irsaaqaha iyo Maamulaha waxa uunka jira oo dhan.  Waxaana khasaaray kii geystay dulmi [23].
so.footnotes: [23]. Qofkii gef ka galay Alle ee yidhi wiil buu leeyahay ama ilmo ama ku tilmaamay sifad xun ama gef ka galay mid ka mid ah uumankiisa.

ayat.arabic: وَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَهُوَ مُؤۡمِنٞ فَلَا يَخَافُ ظُلۡمٗا وَلَا هَضۡمٗا

en.text: But he who does of righteous deeds while he is a believer - he will neither fear injustice nor deprivation.

so.text: 112. Qofka se samo fala oo mu’min ah, ma ka cabsanayo dulmi loo geysto iyo wax loo dhimo midna.

ayat.arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَنزَلۡنَٰهُ قُرۡءَانًا عَرَبِيّٗا وَصَرَّفۡنَا فِيهِ مِنَ ٱلۡوَعِيدِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَّقُونَ أَوۡ يُحۡدِثُ لَهُمۡ ذِكۡرٗا

en.text: And thus We have sent it down as an Arabic Qur’ān[860] and have diversified therein the warnings that perhaps they will avoid [sin] or it would cause them remembrance.
en.footnotes: [860] i.e., revealed in the Arabic language.

so.text: 113. Sidaasaan kugu soo dejinnay Qur’aan af Carabi ah, oo ugu celcelinnay si cad digniiniha iyo gooddiyada, bal inay iska jiraan oo ka dhowrsadaan (shirkiga iyo xumaha kale), ama uu ku dhaliyo waantow.

ayat.arabic: فَتَعَٰلَى ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡمَلِكُ ٱلۡحَقُّۗ وَلَا تَعۡجَلۡ بِٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ مِن قَبۡلِ أَن يُقۡضَىٰٓ إِلَيۡكَ وَحۡيُهُۥۖ وَقُل رَّبِّ زِدۡنِي عِلۡمٗا

en.text: So high [above all] is Allāh, the Sovereign,[861] the Truth.[862] And, [O Muḥammad], do not hasten with [recitation of] the Qur’ān before its revelation is completed to you, and say, "My Lord, increase me in knowledge."
en.footnotes:
[861] And owner of everything in existence.
[862] Or "the True Reality," i.e., the real and permanent existence upon which all other existence depends.

so.text: 114. Ee waxaa Sarreeya oo ka kor ah (dhammaan uumanka) Allaah, Boqorka Xaqa ah. Ee (Muxammadow) ha ku degdegin Qur'aanka (akhriskiisa) ka hor inta aan laguu dhammayn Waxyigiisa, oo dheh: “Rabbiyow ii kordhi cilmi.”

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ عَهِدۡنَآ إِلَىٰٓ ءَادَمَ مِن قَبۡلُ فَنَسِيَ وَلَمۡ نَجِدۡ لَهُۥ عَزۡمٗا

en.text: And We had already taken a promise from Adam before, but he forgot; and We found not in him determination.[863]
en.footnotes: [863] To resist temptation.

so.text: 115. Waxaan dhab ahaan la galnay ballan Aadam mar hore [24], wuuse illoobay, kamana aanu helin go’aan adag.
so.footnotes: [24]. Waxaa axdigaa lagu xusay Suuradda 2 Al-Baqara : Aayadda 35, wuxuuna Allaah halkan ku xusay inaan laga helin Aadam go’aan adag si uu uga hortago fidnada shaydaanka.

ayat.arabic: وَإِذۡ قُلۡنَا لِلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ ٱسۡجُدُواْ لِأٓدَمَ فَسَجَدُوٓاْ إِلَّآ إِبۡلِيسَ أَبَىٰ

en.text: And [mention] when We said to the angels, "Prostrate to Adam," and they prostrated, except Iblees;[864] he refused.
en.footnotes: [864] See footnote to 2:34.

so.text: 116. (Xus) markaan ku nidhi malaa’igta: U sujuuda Aadam, wayna sujuudeen (dhammaan) Ibliis maahee, wuu diiday.

ayat.arabic: فَقُلۡنَا يَٰٓـَٔادَمُ إِنَّ هَٰذَا عَدُوّٞ لَّكَ وَلِزَوۡجِكَ فَلَا يُخۡرِجَنَّكُمَا مِنَ ٱلۡجَنَّةِ فَتَشۡقَىٰٓ

en.text: So We said, "O Adam, indeed this is an enemy to you and to your wife. Then let him not remove you from Paradise so you would suffer.

so.text: 117. Waxaanu nidhi: Aadamow! Kani (Ibliis) waa kuu cadow adiga iyo xaaskaagaba. Ee yuusan idinka saarin Jannada, si aydaan u dhibtoon.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ لَكَ أَلَّا تَجُوعَ فِيهَا وَلَا تَعۡرَىٰ

en.text: Indeed, it is [promised] for you not to be hungry therein or be unclothed.

so.text: 118. Waxaa kuu sugnaaday halkaan inaadan ku gaajoon kuna arradin.

ayat.arabic: وَأَنَّكَ لَا تَظۡمَؤُاْ فِيهَا وَلَا تَضۡحَىٰ

en.text: And indeed, you will not be thirsty therein or be hot from the sun."

so.text: 119. Oo aad ku harraadeyn, qorrax kulkeedna kugu dhaceyn.

ayat.arabic: فَوَسۡوَسَ إِلَيۡهِ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ قَالَ يَٰٓـَٔادَمُ هَلۡ أَدُلُّكَ عَلَىٰ شَجَرَةِ ٱلۡخُلۡدِ وَمُلۡكٖ لَّا يَبۡلَىٰ

en.text: Then Satan whispered to him; he said, "O Adam, shall I direct you to the tree of eternity and possession that will not deteriorate?"

so.text: 120. Markaasuu shaydaan si hoose wax ugu sheegay, isagoo ku leh: “Aadamow! Ma ku tusaa geedka waaridda iyo boqortooyo aan dhammaaneyn?”

ayat.arabic: فَأَكَلَا مِنۡهَا فَبَدَتۡ لَهُمَا سَوۡءَٰتُهُمَا وَطَفِقَا يَخۡصِفَانِ عَلَيۡهِمَا مِن وَرَقِ ٱلۡجَنَّةِۚ وَعَصَىٰٓ ءَادَمُ رَبَّهُۥ فَغَوَىٰ

en.text: And they [i.e., Adam and his wife] ate of it, and their private parts became apparent to them, and they began to fasten over themselves from the leaves of Paradise. And Adam disobeyed his Lord and erred.

so.text: 121. Markaasay (Aadam iyo Xawwaa) wax ka cuneen (geedkii), saa waxaa u muuqday cawradoodii, waxayna billaabeen inay ku dhejiyaan (asturaan) korkooda caleemihii Jannada. Wuxuu Aadam ku caasiyey Rabbigi oo wuu habaabay [25].
so.footnotes: [25]. Eeg sharaxa Suuradda 9 Al-Acraaf: Aayadda 19.

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ ٱجۡتَبَٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَتَابَ عَلَيۡهِ وَهَدَىٰ

en.text: Then his Lord chose him and turned to him in forgiveness and guided [him].

so.text: 122. Markaas waxaa doortay Rabbigiis wuuna ka tawbad aqbalay oo hanuuniyey.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ ٱهۡبِطَا مِنۡهَا جَمِيعَۢاۖ بَعۡضُكُمۡ لِبَعۡضٍ عَدُوّٞۖ فَإِمَّا يَأۡتِيَنَّكُم مِّنِّي هُدٗى فَمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ هُدَايَ فَلَا يَضِلُّ وَلَا يَشۡقَىٰ

en.text: [Allāh] said, "Descend from it [i.e., Paradise] - all, [your descendants] being enemies to one another. And if there should come to you guidance from Me - then whoever follows My guidance will neither go astray [in the world] nor suffer [in the Hereafter].

so.text: 123. (Alle) wuxuu yidhi: Ka dega (Jannadan) dhammaantiin, iyagoo qaarkiinba cadow u yahay qaar kale.  Hadduu idiinka yimaado Xaggayga hanuun, qofkii raaca hanuunkayga ma ku lumayo (adduunkan), mana ku dar xumaanayo (Aakhirada).

ayat.arabic: وَمَنۡ أَعۡرَضَ عَن ذِكۡرِي فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ مَعِيشَةٗ ضَنكٗا وَنَحۡشُرُهُۥ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ أَعۡمَىٰ

en.text: And whoever turns away from My remembrance - indeed, he will have a depressed [i.e., difficult] life, and We will gather [i.e., raise] him on the Day of Resurrection blind."

so.text: 124. Qofkii se ka jeesta Xuskayga (Qur’aankan) wuxuu mudan nolol adag oo cidhiidhi ah, waxaana la soo kulmin Maalinta Qiyaamaha isagoo indha la'.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ لِمَ حَشَرۡتَنِيٓ أَعۡمَىٰ وَقَدۡ كُنتُ بَصِيرٗا

en.text: He will say, "My Lord, why have you raised me blind while I was [once] seeing?"

so.text: 125. Wuxuu odhan: Rabbiyow! Maxaad ii soo kulmisay (ii keentay Qiyaamada) anoo indha la’ anoo (hadda ka hor) wax arki jiray.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ أَتَتۡكَ ءَايَٰتُنَا فَنَسِيتَهَاۖ وَكَذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ تُنسَىٰ

en.text: [Allāh] will say, "Thus did Our signs come to you, and you forgot [i.e., disregarded] them; and thus will you this Day be forgotten."

so.text: 126. (Alle) wuxuu odhan: Sidaasoo kale waxaa kuu yimid Aayadahayaga, waadse iska illowday (oo ka dan la’aatay), sidaas darteed Maanta, waxaa lagaaga tegi  oo lagugu illoobi (Naarta).”

ayat.arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي مَنۡ أَسۡرَفَ وَلَمۡ يُؤۡمِنۢ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِۦۚ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ أَشَدُّ وَأَبۡقَىٰٓ

en.text: And thus do We recompense he who transgressed and did not believe in the signs of his Lord. And the punishment of the Hereafter is more severe and more enduring.[865]
en.footnotes: [865] Than that of this world.

so.text: 127. Sidaasaan ku abaal marinnaa ciddii xadgudubta oo aan rumeyn Aayadaha Rabbigii, cadaabka Aakhiro ayaana sii daran oo joogto daa'in ah.

ayat.arabic: أَفَلَمۡ يَهۡدِ لَهُمۡ كَمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَا قَبۡلَهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡقُرُونِ يَمۡشُونَ فِي مَسَٰكِنِهِمۡۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّأُوْلِي ٱلنُّهَىٰ

en.text: Then, has it not become clear to them how many generations We destroyed before them as they walk among their dwellings? Indeed in that are signs for those of intelligence.

so.text: 128. Miyaanay u caddaan  intaan facyo hallignay iyaga hortood oo ay ku dul soc- daan guryahoodii? Arrinkani waxaa ugu sugan calaamooyin kuwa leh caqliga fayow.

ayat.arabic: وَلَوۡلَا كَلِمَةٞ سَبَقَتۡ مِن رَّبِّكَ لَكَانَ لِزَامٗا وَأَجَلٞ مُّسَمّٗى

en.text: And if not for a word[866] that preceded from your Lord, it [i.e., punishment] would have been an obligation [due immediately],[867] and [if not for] a specified term [decreed].
en.footnotes:
[866] See footnote to 10:19.
[867] Allāh would have punished the disbelievers in this world as He did with previous peoples.

so.text: 129. Haddayna jirin Kelmed hore oo ka soo fushay Rabbigaa, in dib loogu dhigo abaal marintooda maalin la yaqaan iyo ajal magacaabani waxaa ku waajibi laheyd [26] 'cadaab ku dhacda intay joogaan adduunka'.
so.footnotes: [26]. Alle wuxuu ku ciqaabi lahaa adduunkan sida uu u galayba dadkii hore.

ayat.arabic: فَٱصۡبِرۡ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ قَبۡلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمۡسِ وَقَبۡلَ غُرُوبِهَاۖ وَمِنۡ ءَانَآيِٕ ٱلَّيۡلِ فَسَبِّحۡ وَأَطۡرَافَ ٱلنَّهَارِ لَعَلَّكَ تَرۡضَىٰ

en.text: So be patient over what they say and exalt [Allāh] with praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting; and during periods of the night [exalt Him] and at the ends of the day, that you may be satisfied.

so.text: 130. Ee u samir waxay leeyihiin, oo ku tasbiixso ammaanaha Rabbigaa ka hor qorrax soo baxa iyo ka hor dhiciddeeda, oo (tuko) qaar ka mid ah saacadaha habeenka iyo dacallada maalinta si aad u raali noqoto.

ayat.arabic: وَلَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيۡنَيۡكَ إِلَىٰ مَا مَتَّعۡنَا بِهِۦٓ أَزۡوَٰجٗا مِّنۡهُمۡ زَهۡرَةَ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا لِنَفۡتِنَهُمۡ فِيهِۚ وَرِزۡقُ رَبِّكَ خَيۡرٞ وَأَبۡقَىٰ

en.text: And do not extend your eyes toward that by which We have given enjoyment to [some] categories of them, [its being but] the splendor of worldly life by which We test them. And the provision of your Lord is better and more enduring.

so.text: 131. Ha u taagin indhahaaga waxaan ugu raaxaynay qaarkood (gaalada) ee quruxda nolosha adduunka ah si aan ugu imtixaanno, risiqa Rabbigaa (Jannada gudaheeda) baana ka khayr badan (waxaa adduunka lagu siiyey) oo ka daa’in san.

ayat.arabic: وَأۡمُرۡ أَهۡلَكَ بِٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَٱصۡطَبِرۡ عَلَيۡهَاۖ لَا نَسۡـَٔلُكَ رِزۡقٗاۖ نَّحۡنُ نَرۡزُقُكَۗ وَٱلۡعَٰقِبَةُ لِلتَّقۡوَىٰ

en.text: And enjoin prayer upon your family [and people] and be steadfast therein. We ask you not for provision; We provide for you, and the [best] outcome is for [those of] righteousness.

so.text: 132. Ku amar salaadda ehelkaaga, oo u samir yeelo gudashada (salaadaha) kuma weydiisaneyno risiq; Annagaa ku irsaaqi. Cidhibta wanaagsan (ee Jannada) waxaa leh kuwa Alle ka cabsada ee ka dhowrsada (xumaha).

ayat.arabic: وَقَالُواْ لَوۡلَا يَأۡتِينَا بِـَٔايَةٖ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦٓۚ أَوَلَمۡ تَأۡتِهِم بَيِّنَةُ مَا فِي ٱلصُّحُفِ ٱلۡأُولَىٰ

en.text: And they say, "Why does he not bring us a sign from his Lord?" Has there not come to them evidence of what was in the former scriptures?[868]
en.footnotes: [868] Is not the Qur’ān an adequate proof of Muḥammad's prophethood and sufficient as a lasting miracle?

so.text: 133. Waxay (gaaladu) yidhaahdeen: Muxuu (Muxammad) noogu keeni waayey calaamo (mucjiso) xagga Rabbigii ah?” Miyaanay u imaan maraggii (ku sugnaa) Kutubtii hore (ee ku saabsanaa imaanshaha Nabiga Muxammad).

ayat.arabic: وَلَوۡ أَنَّآ أَهۡلَكۡنَٰهُم بِعَذَابٖ مِّن قَبۡلِهِۦ لَقَالُواْ رَبَّنَا لَوۡلَآ أَرۡسَلۡتَ إِلَيۡنَا رَسُولٗا فَنَتَّبِعَ ءَايَٰتِكَ مِن قَبۡلِ أَن نَّذِلَّ وَنَخۡزَىٰ

en.text: And if We had destroyed them with a punishment before him,[869] they would have said, "Our Lord, why did You not send to us a messenger so we could have followed Your verses [i.e., teachings] before we were humiliated and disgraced?"
en.footnotes: [869] Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ). Also interpreted as "before it," i.e., the Qur’ān.

so.text: 134. Haddaan ku halaagi laheyn cadaab isaga ka hor [27], waxay odhan lahaayeen: Rabbigayow! Maxaad noogu soo diri weydey Rasuul si aan u raacno Aayadahaa- ga, ka hor dullowga iyo dufowgannaga.
so.footnotes: [27]. Waa Nabi Muxammad s.c.w. . waxaa sidoo kale lagu fasiray weedha : Isaga hortiis” in loola jeedo Qur’aanka.

ayat.arabic: قُلۡ كُلّٞ مُّتَرَبِّصٞ فَتَرَبَّصُواْۖ فَسَتَعۡلَمُونَ مَنۡ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ ٱلسَّوِيِّ وَمَنِ ٱهۡتَدَىٰ

en.text: Say, "Each [of us] is waiting;[870] so wait. For you will know who are the companions of the sound path and who is guided."
en.footnotes: [870] For the outcome of this matter.

so.text: 135. Dheh: Mid walba oo naga mid ah wax buu sugayaaye, ee suga [28]. Waadna ogaan doontaan waa kuwama kuwa ku taagan Jidka Toosan iyo kuwa hanuunsan.
so.footnotes: [28]. Waxa ka soo baxa arrinkan oo uu ku dhammaado.

ayat.arabic: ٱقۡتَرَبَ لِلنَّاسِ حِسَابُهُمۡ وَهُمۡ فِي غَفۡلَةٖ مُّعۡرِضُونَ

en.text: [The time of] their account has approached for the people, while they are in heedlessness turning away.

so.text: 1. (Waqtiga) xisaabintooda (Qiyaamo) baa ku soo dhow dadka halka ay dhoohnaan la sii jeedaan.

ayat.arabic: مَا يَأۡتِيهِم مِّن ذِكۡرٖ مِّن رَّبِّهِم مُّحۡدَثٍ إِلَّا ٱسۡتَمَعُوهُ وَهُمۡ يَلۡعَبُونَ

en.text: No mention [i.e., revelation] comes to them anew from their Lord except that they listen to it while they are at play

so.text: 2. Ma jiro Xus (Waxyi) uga yimaada xagga Rabbbigood, waxayse dhegaystaan iyagoo iska cayaaraya.

ayat.arabic: لَاهِيَةٗ قُلُوبُهُمۡۗ وَأَسَرُّواْ ٱلنَّجۡوَى ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ هَلۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا بَشَرٞ مِّثۡلُكُمۡۖ أَفَتَأۡتُونَ ٱلسِّحۡرَ وَأَنتُمۡ تُبۡصِرُونَ

en.text: With their hearts distracted. And those who do wrong conceal their private conversation, [saying], "Is this [Prophet] except a human being like you? So would you approach magic while you are aware [of it]?"

so.text: 3. Qalbiyadoodu shuqloon tahay. Kuwaa fala dulmiga (shirkiga iyo macaasida) waxay qariyaan faqooda (iyagoo leh): Kani (Muxammad) ma wax aan ahayn baa qof idinkoo kale ah? Ma waxaad aqabaleysaan sixir [1] idinkoo arka?
so.footnotes: [1]. Sixir waxay ku sheegayaan halkan waa Aayadaha Qur’aanka, Inkastoo ay arkeen calaamooyin iyo mucjisooyin dhab ah.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّي يَعۡلَمُ ٱلۡقَوۡلَ فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ

en.text: He [the Prophet (ﷺ)] said, "My Lord knows whatever is said throughout the heaven and earth, and He is the Hearing, the Knowing."

so.text: 4. Wuxuu (Nabigu s.c.w) yidhi: “Rabbigay baa ogsoon qowl (kasta oo lagaga hadlo) samooyinka dhexdooda iyo arlada. Waana wax kasta Maqlaha, wax kasta Ogsoonaha ah.”

ayat.arabic: بَلۡ قَالُوٓاْ أَضۡغَٰثُ أَحۡلَٰمِۭ بَلِ ٱفۡتَرَىٰهُ بَلۡ هُوَ شَاعِرٞ فَلۡيَأۡتِنَا بِـَٔايَةٖ كَمَآ أُرۡسِلَ ٱلۡأَوَّلُونَ

en.text: But they say, "[The revelation is but] a mixture of false dreams; rather, he has invented it; rather, he is a poet. So let him bring us a sign just as the previous [messengers] were sent [with miracles]."

so.text: 5. Waxayse yidhaahdeen: “(Waxyigu wax kale maahee) waa hawaawi hadal hurdo! mayee isagaa hal abuuray - mayee waa gabyaa! Ee ha noo keeno mucjiso la mid ah (mucjisidihii) lala soo diray (anbiyadii) hore.

ayat.arabic: مَآ ءَامَنَتۡ قَبۡلَهُم مِّن قَرۡيَةٍ أَهۡلَكۡنَٰهَآۖ أَفَهُمۡ يُؤۡمِنُونَ

en.text: Not a [single] city which We destroyed believed before them,[872] so will they believe?
en.footnotes: [872] Even though they had witnessed signs and miracles.

so.text: 6. Ma ayna rumeynin hortaa magaalo aan halaag la doonnay (inkastoy arkeen calaamooyin iyo mucjisooyin) ee ma iyagaa rumeyn?.

ayat.arabic: وَمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا قَبۡلَكَ إِلَّا رِجَالٗا نُّوحِيٓ إِلَيۡهِمۡۖ فَسۡـَٔلُوٓاْ أَهۡلَ ٱلذِّكۡرِ إِن كُنتُمۡ لَا تَعۡلَمُونَ

en.text: And We sent not before you, [O Muḥammad], except men to whom We revealed [the message], so ask the people of the message [i.e., former scriptures] if you do not know.

so.text: 7. Ma aanu soo dirin hortaa adiga (Nabi Muxammadow) waxaan aheyn rag aan u waxyoonnay (Dhambaalka), ee weydiiya ehlu Kitaabka haddaydaan ogeyn.

ayat.arabic: وَمَا جَعَلۡنَٰهُمۡ جَسَدٗا لَّا يَأۡكُلُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ وَمَا كَانُواْ خَٰلِدِينَ

en.text: And We did not make them [i.e., the prophets] forms not eating food,[873] nor were they immortal [on earth].
en.footnotes: [873] Like the angels. Rather, they were human beings with human attributes.

so.text: 8. Uma aan yeelin (anbiyada) jirar aan cunin cunto [2] 'sida malaa’igta', mana aheyn kuwo aan dhiman oo ku waadha (arlada).
so.footnotes: [2]. Sida malaa’igta, waxayse ahaayeen aadmi leh tilmaamaha dadka.

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ صَدَقۡنَٰهُمُ ٱلۡوَعۡدَ فَأَنجَيۡنَٰهُمۡ وَمَن نَّشَآءُ وَأَهۡلَكۡنَا ٱلۡمُسۡرِفِينَ

en.text: Then[874] We fulfilled for them the promise, and We saved them and whom We willed and destroyed the transgressors.
en.footnotes: [874] Once they had conveyed the message.

so.text: 9. Markaas, Waanu u rumaynay ballankaan u qaadnay waana badbaadinnay iyagii iyo ciddaan doonno, waxaana hallignay xad gudbayaashii.

ayat.arabic: لَقَدۡ أَنزَلۡنَآ إِلَيۡكُمۡ كِتَٰبٗا فِيهِ ذِكۡرُكُمۡۚ أَفَلَا تَعۡقِلُونَ

en.text: We have certainly sent down to you a Book [i.e., the Qur’ān] in which is your mention.[875] Then will you not reason?
en.footnotes: [875] This implies the honor of having been mentioned or addressed. Another meaning is "your reminder."

so.text: 10. Waxaan idiin soo dejinnay (dadow) Kitaab (Qur’aan) idiinku sugan [3] xuskiinna (iyo sharaftiinna) ee miyeydaan garasho lahayn?.
so.footnotes: [3]. Kitaabka waa Qur’aanka, xuskiinna waxaa loola jeedaa la idinku sharfay ama la idinkula hadlay. Macno kale waa idiinku sugan waano.
