ayat.arabic: وَكَمۡ قَصَمۡنَا مِن قَرۡيَةٖ كَانَتۡ ظَالِمَةٗ وَأَنشَأۡنَا بَعۡدَهَا قَوۡمًا ءَاخَرِينَ

en.text: And how many a city which was unjust[876] have We shattered and produced after it another people.
en.footnotes: [876] i.e., its inhabitants persisting in wrongdoing.

so.text: 11. Badanaa intaan halaagnay magaalo [4] ay dadkeedu faleen dulmi (shirki iyo macaasi) oo aan soo saarnay iyaga kaddib qolo kale.
so.footnotes: [4]. Macnaha waa dadkeedu ay ku adkeysteen xumaan falidda.

ayat.arabic: فَلَمَّآ أَحَسُّواْ بَأۡسَنَآ إِذَا هُم مِّنۡهَا يَرۡكُضُونَ

en.text: And when they [i.e., its inhabitants] perceived Our punishment, at once they fled from it.

so.text: 12. Markay dareemeen cadaabkayagii, mise waxay billaabeen inay ka cararaan.

ayat.arabic: لَا تَرۡكُضُواْ وَٱرۡجِعُوٓاْ إِلَىٰ مَآ أُتۡرِفۡتُمۡ فِيهِ وَمَسَٰكِنِكُمۡ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تُسۡـَٔلُونَ

en.text: [Some angels said], "Do not flee but return to where you were given luxury and to your homes - perhaps you will be questioned."[877]
en.footnotes: [877] About what happened to you. This is said to them in sarcasm and ridicule.

so.text: 13. Ha cararina (haatan) ee dib ugu soo laabta wixii la idiinku raaxeeyey iyo guryihiinna, si wax la idiin weydiiyo [5].
so.footnotes: [5]. Waxa idinku dhacay. Waxaa hadalkan loo yidhi ku digasho ahaan.

ayat.arabic: قَالُواْ يَٰوَيۡلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ

en.text: They said, "O woe to us! Indeed, we were wrongdoers."

so.text: 14. Waxay yidhaahdeen: Hooggeenee! Waxaanu nahay daalimiin.

ayat.arabic: فَمَا زَالَت تِّلۡكَ دَعۡوَىٰهُمۡ حَتَّىٰ جَعَلۡنَٰهُمۡ حَصِيدًا خَٰمِدِينَ

en.text: And that declaration of theirs did not cease until We made them [as] a harvest [mowed down], extinguished [like a fire].

so.text: 15. Ma ay deyn calaalcalkoodaas ilaa aan ka yeelnay wax la shafay oo baqtiya.

ayat.arabic: وَمَا خَلَقۡنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا لَٰعِبِينَ

en.text: And We did not create the heaven and earth and that between them in play.

so.text: 16. Uma aan abuurinna samada iyo arlada iyo waxa u dhexeeya dheel.

ayat.arabic: لَوۡ أَرَدۡنَآ أَن نَّتَّخِذَ لَهۡوٗا لَّٱتَّخَذۡنَٰهُ مِن لَّدُنَّآ إِن كُنَّا فَٰعِلِينَ

en.text: Had We intended to take a diversion,[878] We could have taken it from [what is] with Us - if [indeed] We were to do so.
en.footnotes: [878] Such as a wife or a child.

so.text: 17. Haddaan rabno inaan yeelanno wax aan isku maaweelinno [6], waxaan ka yeelan lahayn waxa Agtannada ah, haddaan sidaas falayno.
so.footnotes: [6]. Sida xaas ama carruur.

ayat.arabic: بَلۡ نَقۡذِفُ بِٱلۡحَقِّ عَلَى ٱلۡبَٰطِلِ فَيَدۡمَغُهُۥ فَإِذَا هُوَ زَاهِقٞۚ وَلَكُمُ ٱلۡوَيۡلُ مِمَّا تَصِفُونَ

en.text: Rather, We dash the truth upon falsehood, and it destroys it,[879] and thereupon it departs. And for you is destruction from that which you describe.[880]
en.footnotes:
[879] Literally, "strikes its brain," disabling or killing it.
[880] Of untruth concerning Allāh, particularly here, the claim that He has a son or other "partner" in divinity.

so.text: 18. Waxaanse Xaqa ku gannaa baadilka, markaas buu madaxa kala jabiyaa, mise durba wuu baabba’aa. Hoog baadna leedihiin beentaasi aad naga sheegtaan darteed [7].
so.footnotes: [7]. waa odhaahdooda baadilka ah in Alle leeyahay xaas iyo ilmo.

ayat.arabic: وَلَهُۥ مَن فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَمَنۡ عِندَهُۥ لَا يَسۡتَكۡبِرُونَ عَنۡ عِبَادَتِهِۦ وَلَا يَسۡتَحۡسِرُونَ

en.text: To Him belongs whoever is in the heavens and the earth. And those near Him [i.e., the angels] are not prevented by arrogance from His worship, nor do they tire.

so.text: 19. Alle baa leh wax kasta oo ku sugan samooyinka iyo arlada; kuwa (Alle) agtiisa ahna ee u dhow (malaa’igta) iskama wey- neeyaan cibaadadiisa, kamana daalaan.

ayat.arabic: يُسَبِّحُونَ ٱلَّيۡلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ لَا يَفۡتُرُونَ

en.text: They exalt [Him] night and day [and] do not slacken.

so.text: 20.Waxay xurmo weyneeyaan oo hufaan habeen iyo maalinba, kamana noogaan.

ayat.arabic: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُوٓاْ ءَالِهَةٗ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ هُمۡ يُنشِرُونَ

en.text: Or have they [i.e., men] taken for themselves gods from the earth who resurrect [the dead]?

so.text: 21. Mise waxay yeesheen si ay u caabudaan ilaahyo dhulka jooga oo wax soo nooleeya?

ayat.arabic: لَوۡ كَانَ فِيهِمَآ ءَالِهَةٌ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ لَفَسَدَتَاۚ فَسُبۡحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَرۡشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ

en.text: Had there been within them [i.e., the heavens and earth] gods besides Allāh, they both would have been ruined. So exalted is Allāh, Lord of the Throne, above what they describe.

so.text: 22. Hadday jiri lahaayeen dhexdooda (cirarka iyo dhulka) ilaahyo aan ahayn Alle, way fasaadi lahaayeen. Wuu ka hufan yahay Alle Rabbiga Carshiga Weyn leh oo ka Sarreeyaa waxay ku tilmaami.

ayat.arabic: لَا يُسۡـَٔلُ عَمَّا يَفۡعَلُ وَهُمۡ يُسۡـَٔلُونَ

en.text: He is not questioned about what He does, but they will be questioned.

so.text: 23. (Alle) lama weydiiyo wuxuu Falo, iyagase (dadka) waa la weydiin.

ayat.arabic: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةٗۖ قُلۡ هَاتُواْ بُرۡهَٰنَكُمۡۖ هَٰذَا ذِكۡرُ مَن مَّعِيَ وَذِكۡرُ مَن قَبۡلِيۚ بَلۡ أَكۡثَرُهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ ٱلۡحَقَّۖ فَهُم مُّعۡرِضُونَ

en.text: Or have they taken gods besides Him? Say, [O Muḥammad], "Produce your proof. This [Qur’ān] is the message for those with me and the message of those before me."[881] But most of them do not know the truth, so they are turning away.
en.footnotes: [881] All previous prophets called for the worship of Allāh alone.

so.text: 24. Mise waxay yeesheen Isaga sokadi ilaahyo (kale) ay la barbar caabudaan? Dheh: “Keena Xujadiinna. Kani waa Xuska kuwa ila jooga iyo Xuska kuwii iga horreeyay [8]. Badankooduse ma gartaan Xaqa, marka way ka sii jeestaan.
so.footnotes: [8]. Dhammaan Rusushii hore waxay dadku ugu yeereen Towxiidka - caabudaadda Alle Keliya aan cid kale lala wadaajin cibaadada.

ayat.arabic: وَمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مِن قَبۡلِكَ مِن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا نُوحِيٓ إِلَيۡهِ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱعۡبُدُونِ

en.text: And We sent not before you any messenger except We revealed to him that, "There is no deity except Me, so worship Me."

so.text: 25. Ma aanu soo dirin hortaa Rasuulna aan u waxyoonin (Annagoo leh), "Ma jiro Ilaah (Xaq ah oo) aan Aniga (Allaah) ahayn, ee i caabuda (Anigoo keliya).”

ayat.arabic: وَقَالُواْ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ وَلَدٗاۗ سُبۡحَٰنَهُۥۚ بَلۡ عِبَادٞ مُّكۡرَمُونَ

en.text: And they say, "The Most Merciful has taken a son." Exalted is He! Rather, they[882] are [but] honored servants.
en.footnotes: [882] Those they claim to be "children" of Allāh, such as the angels, Ezra, Jesus, etc.

so.text: 26. Waxay (gaaladu) yidhaahdeen: Raxmaanku wuxuu yeeshay ilmo. Subxaanah! Wuu ka hufan yahay, waase addoomo (malaa’igta) la sharfay [9].
so.footnotes: [9]. Kuwaa ay ku andoocadaan inay yihiin ilaah sida ruuxul qudus, ama ilmahii Alle sida Ciise, malaa’igta, iwm waa addoommo la sharfay.

ayat.arabic: لَا يَسۡبِقُونَهُۥ بِٱلۡقَوۡلِ وَهُم بِأَمۡرِهِۦ يَعۡمَلُونَ

en.text: They cannot precede Him in word, and they act by His command.

so.text: 27. Kagama hormaraan hadal, iyaguna amarkiisa uun bay ku camal falaan.

ayat.arabic: يَعۡلَمُ مَا بَيۡنَ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ وَمَا خَلۡفَهُمۡ وَلَا يَشۡفَعُونَ إِلَّا لِمَنِ ٱرۡتَضَىٰ وَهُم مِّنۡ خَشۡيَتِهِۦ مُشۡفِقُونَ

en.text: He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them,[883] and they cannot intercede except on behalf of one whom He approves. And they, from fear of Him, are apprehensive.
en.footnotes: [883] See footnote to 20:110.

so.text: 28. Wuxuu og yahay waxa hortooda ah iyo waxa gadaashooda ah, umana shafeecaan mid uu isagu oggolaado maahee iyaguna cabsidiisay la digtoon yihiin oo baqaan.

ayat.arabic: ۞ وَمَن يَقُلۡ مِنۡهُمۡ إِنِّيٓ إِلَٰهٞ مِّن دُونِهِۦ فَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِيهِ جَهَنَّمَۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ

en.text: And whoever of them should say, "Indeed, I am a god besides Him" - that one We would recompense with Hell. Thus do We recompense the wrongdoers.

so.text: 29. Mid kastoo ka mid ah (uunka Alle sida Ibliis ama qeyrki) ee yidhaahda: “Waxaan anigu ahay Ilaah la jirkiis Isaga,” kaas oo kale waxaan ku abaal marin Jahannama. Sidaas oo kale baan ku abaal marinnaa daalimiinta.

ayat.arabic: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ أَنَّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ كَانَتَا رَتۡقٗا فَفَتَقۡنَٰهُمَاۖ وَجَعَلۡنَا مِنَ ٱلۡمَآءِ كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ حَيٍّۚ أَفَلَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ

en.text: Have those who disbelieved not considered that the heavens and the earth were a joined entity, and then We separated them and made from water every living thing? Then will they not believe?

so.text: 30. Miyaanay kuwa gaaloobay arag in samooyinka iyo arladu ay ahaayeen mid isku dheggan oo aan kala bixinnay,  Waxaana ka abuurnay biyo wax kasta oo nool. Ee miyaanay rumayneyn [10].
so.footnotes: [10]. Halka ay dalbi lahaayeen si gaalnimo iyo jeesjees leh in loo soo dedejiyo oo la tuso Cadaabka.

ayat.arabic: وَجَعَلۡنَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ رَوَٰسِيَ أَن تَمِيدَ بِهِمۡ وَجَعَلۡنَا فِيهَا فِجَاجٗا سُبُلٗا لَّعَلَّهُمۡ يَهۡتَدُونَ

en.text: And We placed within the earth firmly set mountains, lest it should shift with them, and We made therein [mountain] passes [as] roads that they might be guided.

so.text: 31. Waxaanu yeellay buuro adag dhulka gudahiisa si aanay ula dhaqdhaqaaqin,  waxaana yeellay dhexdeeda waddooyin ballaaran oo ay ku toosaan.

ayat.arabic: وَجَعَلۡنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ سَقۡفٗا مَّحۡفُوظٗاۖ وَهُمۡ عَنۡ ءَايَٰتِهَا مُعۡرِضُونَ

en.text: And We made the sky a protected ceiling, but they, from its signs,[884] are turning away.
en.footnotes: [884] The signs present in the heavens.

so.text: 32. Waxaanu ka yeelnay samada saqaf ilaashan, iyaguna calaamadaheeda way ka jeesadaan .

ayat.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلَّيۡلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ وَٱلشَّمۡسَ وَٱلۡقَمَرَۖ كُلّٞ فِي فَلَكٖ يَسۡبَحُونَ

en.text: And it is He who created the night and the day and the sun and the moon; all [heavenly bodies] in an orbit are swimming.

so.text: 33. (Alle) waa Kan Abuuray habeenka iyo maalinta iyo qorraxda iyo dayaxa, dhammaan (meertooyinka) ay si dhakhso badan ugu socdaan garangartooda.

ayat.arabic: وَمَا جَعَلۡنَا لِبَشَرٖ مِّن قَبۡلِكَ ٱلۡخُلۡدَۖ أَفَإِيْن مِّتَّ فَهُمُ ٱلۡخَٰلِدُونَ

en.text: And We did not grant to any man before you eternity [on earth]; so if you die - would they be eternal?

so.text: 34. Kama aanu yeelin qofna kaa horreeyey (Nabiyow) mid waadha. Ee haddaad adigu dhimato ma iyagaa waadhi?.

ayat.arabic: كُلُّ نَفۡسٖ ذَآئِقَةُ ٱلۡمَوۡتِۗ وَنَبۡلُوكُم بِٱلشَّرِّ وَٱلۡخَيۡرِ فِتۡنَةٗۖ وَإِلَيۡنَا تُرۡجَعُونَ

en.text: Every soul will taste death. And We test you with evil and with good as trial; and to Us you will be returned.

so.text: 35. Naf walbaa waa tii dhadhamisa geeri, waxaanu idinku imtixaani shar iyo khayrba kala saar darteed, Xaggayagaana la idiin soo celin.

ayat.arabic: وَإِذَا رَءَاكَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ إِن يَتَّخِذُونَكَ إِلَّا هُزُوًا أَهَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي يَذۡكُرُ ءَالِهَتَكُمۡ وَهُم بِذِكۡرِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ هُمۡ كَٰفِرُونَ

en.text: And when those who disbelieve see you, [O Muḥammad], they take you not except in ridicule, [saying], "Is this the one who mentions [i.e., insults] your gods?" And they are, at the mention of the Most Merciful, disbelievers.

so.text: 36. Markay ku arkaan kuwa gaaloobay, kaama dhigtaan waxaan ahayn jeesjees (waxayna yidhaahdaan):” Ma kan baa kan wax ka sheega ilaahyadiinna?” Halka iyagu ay ku gaaloobaan xusidda Raxmaanka.

ayat.arabic: خُلِقَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ مِنۡ عَجَلٖۚ سَأُوْرِيكُمۡ ءَايَٰتِي فَلَا تَسۡتَعۡجِلُونِ

en.text: Man was created of haste [i.e., impatience]. I will show you My signs [i.e., vengeance], so do not impatiently urge Me.

so.text: 37. Aadmigu waxaa 'ku jira' uu ka abuuran yahay degdegsanaan, waxaan idin tusi calaamooyinkayga ee ha iga dalbina inaan idiin soo dedejiyo.

ayat.arabic: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلۡوَعۡدُ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ

en.text: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"

so.text: 38. Waxay odhan: Waa goorma gooddigani (cadaabka) haddaad run sheegaysaan?”

ayat.arabic: لَوۡ يَعۡلَمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ حِينَ لَا يَكُفُّونَ عَن وُجُوهِهِمُ ٱلنَّارَ وَلَا عَن ظُهُورِهِمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يُنصَرُونَ

en.text: If those who disbelieved but knew the time when they will not avert the Fire from their faces or from their backs and they will not be aided...[885]
en.footnotes: [885] The completion of the sentence is understood to be "...they would not be asking in disbelief and ridicule to be shown the punishment."

so.text: 39. Hadday kuwa gaalooba ogaan lahaayeen markaan laga celinayn wejiyadooda Naarta iyo dhabarradoodaba oo aan loo gargaareyn (ma degdegsadeen Cadaabka).

ayat.arabic: بَلۡ تَأۡتِيهِم بَغۡتَةٗ فَتَبۡهَتُهُمۡ فَلَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ رَدَّهَا وَلَا هُمۡ يُنظَرُونَ

en.text: Rather, it will come to them unexpectedly and bewilder them, and they will not be able to repel it, nor will they be reprieved.

so.text: 40. Waxayse ugu iman Saacadda Qiyaame kedis, way jahawareerin, ma karayaan celinteeda, lamana siiyo fursad (tawbad keen ama cudur daarasho).

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدِ ٱسۡتُهۡزِئَ بِرُسُلٖ مِّن قَبۡلِكَ فَحَاقَ بِٱلَّذِينَ سَخِرُواْ مِنۡهُم مَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ

en.text: And already were messengers ridiculed before you, but those who mocked them were enveloped by what they used to ridicule.

so.text: 41. Waxaa lagu digtay Rusul (badan) oo kaa horreeyey, markaasaa waxaa ku dhacay kuwii ku jeesjeesay (oo gaalada ahaa) wixii (cadaabka) ay dheel dheesha u heysteen.

ayat.arabic: قُلۡ مَن يَكۡلَؤُكُم بِٱلَّيۡلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ مِنَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِۚ بَلۡ هُمۡ عَن ذِكۡرِ رَبِّهِم مُّعۡرِضُونَ

en.text: Say, "Who can protect you at night or by day from the Most Merciful?" But they are, from the remembrance of their Lord, turning away.

so.text: 42. Dheh: “Yaa idinka ilaalin kara habeen iyo maalinba (Cadaabka) Naxariistaha (Allaah)? Waxayse iyagu ka jeesadaan xusidda Rabbigood.

ayat.arabic: أَمۡ لَهُمۡ ءَالِهَةٞ تَمۡنَعُهُم مِّن دُونِنَاۚ لَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ نَصۡرَ أَنفُسِهِمۡ وَلَا هُم مِّنَّا يُصۡحَبُونَ

en.text: Or do they have gods to defend them other than Us? They are unable [even] to help themselves, nor can they be protected from Us.

so.text: 43. Mise ma waxay leeyihiin ilaahyo ka celin kara Ciqaabkayaga? Ma leh awood ay ugu gargaaraan nafahooda, mana ahaan doonaan kuwo nalaga magan geliyo.

ayat.arabic: بَلۡ مَتَّعۡنَا هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَءَابَآءَهُمۡ حَتَّىٰ طَالَ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلۡعُمُرُۗ أَفَلَا يَرَوۡنَ أَنَّا نَأۡتِي ٱلۡأَرۡضَ نَنقُصُهَا مِنۡ أَطۡرَافِهَآۚ أَفَهُمُ ٱلۡغَٰلِبُونَ

en.text: But, [on the contrary], We have provided good things for these [disbelievers] and their fathers until life was prolonged for them. Then do they not see that We set upon the land, reducing it from its borders?[886] Is it they who will overcome?
en.footnotes: [886] See footnote to 13:41.

so.text: 44. Mayee, waxaan u raaxaynay kuwani iyo aabbayaashoodba jeer uu la dheeraaday cimriga 'markaasay wax is bideen' [11]. Miyaanay arag inaan ku nimaanno arlada innagoo  ka soo nusqaamin cirifyadiisa [12]? Ee ma iyagaa adag?
so.footnotes:
[11]. Eeg sharaxa aan ku xusnay Suuradda 13: Aayadda 41.
[12]. Waa tilmaan guusha iyo fiditaanka Islaamka.

ayat.arabic: قُلۡ إِنَّمَآ أُنذِرُكُم بِٱلۡوَحۡيِۚ وَلَا يَسۡمَعُ ٱلصُّمُّ ٱلدُّعَآءَ إِذَا مَا يُنذَرُونَ

en.text: Say, "I only warn you by revelation." But the deaf do not hear the call when they are warned.

so.text: 45. Dheh waxaan uun idiinku digi Waxyiga (ka yimid Alle). Kuwase dhegaha li’i ma ay maqlaan dhawaaqa marka loo digi.

ayat.arabic: وَلَئِن مَّسَّتۡهُمۡ نَفۡحَةٞ مِّنۡ عَذَابِ رَبِّكَ لَيَقُولُنَّ يَٰوَيۡلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ

en.text: And if [as much as] a whiff of the punishment of your Lord should touch them, they would surely say, "O woe to us! Indeed, we have been wrongdoers."

so.text: 46.Hadduu taabto (kuwa xaqa beeniya) wax yar oo ka mid ah cadaabka Rabbigaa, waxay odhan: Hooggeennee! Waxaanu nahay daalimiin (gar ma qaatayaal).

ayat.arabic: وَنَضَعُ ٱلۡمَوَٰزِينَ ٱلۡقِسۡطَ لِيَوۡمِ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ فَلَا تُظۡلَمُ نَفۡسٞ شَيۡـٔٗاۖ وَإِن كَانَ مِثۡقَالَ حَبَّةٖ مِّنۡ خَرۡدَلٍ أَتَيۡنَا بِهَاۗ وَكَفَىٰ بِنَا حَٰسِبِينَ

en.text: And We place the scales of justice for the Day of Resurrection, so no soul will be treated unjustly at all. And if there is [even] the weight of a mustard seed,[887] We will bring it forth. And sufficient are We as accountant.
en.footnotes: [887] i.e., anything as small or insignificant as a mustard seed.

so.text: 47. Waxaanu dhigi miisaan caadil ah Maalinta Qiyaamaha, lagamana dulmiyo nafna waxba, haba ahaado wax le’eg iniinta sisinta [13] waanu keeni. Annagaana ku filan Xisaabiye ahaan.
so.footnotes: [13]. Ama wax ka yar ama wax ka weyn.

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ ءَاتَيۡنَا مُوسَىٰ وَهَٰرُونَ ٱلۡفُرۡقَانَ وَضِيَآءٗ وَذِكۡرٗا لِّلۡمُتَّقِينَ

en.text: And We had already given Moses and Aaron the criterion and a light and a reminder[888] for the righteous
en.footnotes: [888] These are three qualities of the Torah.

so.text: 48. Waxaanu dhab ahaan siinnay Muuse iyo Haaruun Furqaanka [14], iyo iftiin iyo waano [15] ay leeyihiin kuwa iska jira (xumaha ee dhowra Amarrada Alle).
so.footnotes:
[14]. Kala sooce samaanta iyo xumaanta.
[15]. Kuwani waa seddex tilmaamood oo lagu sifeeyey isla Towraadda.

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَخۡشَوۡنَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلۡغَيۡبِ وَهُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّاعَةِ مُشۡفِقُونَ

en.text: Who fear their Lord unseen,[889] while they are of the Hour apprehensive.
en.footnotes: [889] Which can mean "Him being unseen" by them or "though they are unseen" by others.

so.text: 49. Kuwa ka baqa Rabbigood sir 'iyo saaqba' [16], iyagoo Saacadda (Qiyaame) ka cabsan.
so.footnotes: [16]. Waxaa loola jeedaa Iyagoo aan arag ama iyagoo keli ah aan cidna u jeedin.

ayat.arabic: وَهَٰذَا ذِكۡرٞ مُّبَارَكٌ أَنزَلۡنَٰهُۚ أَفَأَنتُمۡ لَهُۥ مُنكِرُونَ

en.text: And this [Qur’ān] is a blessed message which We have sent down. Then are you with it unacquainted?[890]
en.footnotes: [890] i.e., pretending ignorance, disapproving or refusing to acknowledge it?

so.text: 50.Kanina (Qur'aanku) waa waano barakaysan aanu soo dejinnay, ee miyaad  diideysaan oo ka jeesinaysaan [17]?
so.footnotes: [17]. Idinkoo iska yeelaya inaydaan aqoon, inkiraya ama diidaya inaad qirtaan.

ayat.arabic: ۞ وَلَقَدۡ ءَاتَيۡنَآ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ رُشۡدَهُۥ مِن قَبۡلُ وَكُنَّا بِهِۦ عَٰلِمِينَ

en.text: And We had certainly given Abraham his sound judgement before,[891] and We were of him well-Knowing
en.footnotes: [891] i.e., before Moses. Allāh had guided him from early youth.

so.text: 51. Waxaanu dhab ahaan siinnay goor hore Ibraahiim (saamigiisa) hanuunka [18], Waxaaanuna uga war qabnay si dhan.
so.footnotes: [18]. Ka hor Muuse, Alle wuxuu hanuunshay Ibraahiim tan iyo yaraantii.

ayat.arabic: إِذۡ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوۡمِهِۦ مَا هَٰذِهِ ٱلتَّمَاثِيلُ ٱلَّتِيٓ أَنتُمۡ لَهَا عَٰكِفُونَ

en.text: When he said to his father and his people, "What are these statues to which you are devoted?"

so.text: 52. Markuu ku yidhi aabbihii iyo qoladiisii: “Waa maxay sanamyadan aad idinku dul fadhidaan (ee aad caabudeysaan)?”

ayat.arabic: قَالُواْ وَجَدۡنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا لَهَا عَٰبِدِينَ

en.text: They said, "We found our fathers worshippers of them."

so.text: 53. Waxay yidhaahdeen: “Waxaan hellay aabbayaashayo oo caabudaya.”

ayat.arabic: قَالَ لَقَدۡ كُنتُمۡ أَنتُمۡ وَءَابَآؤُكُمۡ فِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٖ

en.text: He said, "You were certainly, you and your fathers, in manifest error."

so.text: 54. (Ibraahiim) wuxuu yidhi: “ Waxaad idinka iyo aabbayaashiinba ku sugan tihiin habow cad?.”

ayat.arabic: قَالُوٓاْ أَجِئۡتَنَا بِٱلۡحَقِّ أَمۡ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱللَّٰعِبِينَ

en.text: They said, "Have you come to us with truth, or are you of those who jest?"

so.text: 55. Waxay yidhaahdeen: Ma waxaad noola timid xaq, mise adigu waad nagu ciyaari?.”

ayat.arabic: قَالَ بَل رَّبُّكُمۡ رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ ٱلَّذِي فَطَرَهُنَّ وَأَنَا۠ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّٰهِدِينَ

en.text: He said, "[No], rather, your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth who created them, and I, to that, am of those who testify.

so.text: 56. (Ibraahiim) wuxuu yidhi: Mayee’ Rabbigiin waa Rabbiga samooyinka iyo arlada ee ah Kan abuuray, aniguna waxaan ka mid ahay kuwa arrinkani ka marag kaci.

ayat.arabic: وَتَٱللَّهِ لَأَكِيدَنَّ أَصۡنَٰمَكُم بَعۡدَ أَن تُوَلُّواْ مُدۡبِرِينَ

en.text: And [I swear] by Allāh, I will surely plan against your idols after you have turned and gone away."

so.text: 57. Tallaahi, Waxaan u degi qorshe (tab) (si aan u baabbi’iyo) asnaamtiinna markaad jeedsataan idinkoo tegi [19].
so.footnotes: [19]. Ibraahiim c.s. wuxuu ka yidhi hadalladaa qalbigiisa oo keliya inuu tab u degeyo baabbi’inta sanammadooda.

ayat.arabic: فَجَعَلَهُمۡ جُذَٰذًا إِلَّا كَبِيرٗا لَّهُمۡ لَعَلَّهُمۡ إِلَيۡهِ يَرۡجِعُونَ

en.text: So he made them into fragments, except a large one among them, that they might return to it [and question].

so.text: 58. Markaasuu wuxuu ka dhigay digada (dhammaan) koodii u weynaa maahee, bal inay xaggiisa u noqdaan (oo ay weydiiyaan).

ayat.arabic: قَالُواْ مَن فَعَلَ هَٰذَا بِـَٔالِهَتِنَآ إِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ

en.text: They said, "Who has done this to our gods? Indeed, he is of the wrongdoers."

so.text: 59. Waxay yidhaahdeen: “Yaa ku falay sidan ilaahyadayada?, Kaasi waa daalime?”

ayat.arabic: قَالُواْ سَمِعۡنَا فَتٗى يَذۡكُرُهُمۡ يُقَالُ لَهُۥٓ إِبۡرَٰهِيمُ

en.text: They said, "We heard a young man mention them who is called Abraham."

so.text: 60. Waxay yidhaahdeen: Waxaan maqallay wiil hadal-haya oo la yidhaahdo Ibraahiim.”

ayat.arabic: قَالُواْ فَأۡتُواْ بِهِۦ عَلَىٰٓ أَعۡيُنِ ٱلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَشۡهَدُونَ

en.text: They said, "Then bring him before the eyes of the people that they may testify."[892]
en.footnotes: [892] To what they had heard him say. It may also mean "...that they may witness [what will be done to him as punishment]."

so.text: 61. Waxay yidhaahdeen: “Keena oo soo hor joojiya dadka si ay ugu arkaan indhahooda bal inay ku markahaati furaan [20]?.”
so.footnotes: [20]. Wuxuu sidoo kale macnaha u dhici karaa: si ay markhaati iyo goob joog uga ahaadaan waxa lagu dhigo oo ciqaab ah.

ayat.arabic: قَالُوٓاْ ءَأَنتَ فَعَلۡتَ هَٰذَا بِـَٔالِهَتِنَا يَٰٓإِبۡرَٰهِيمُ

en.text: They said, "Have you done this to our gods, O Abraham?"

so.text: 62. Waxay yidhaahdeen: “Ma adigaa kan si- daan ku falay ilaahyadayada, Ibraahiimow?

ayat.arabic: قَالَ بَلۡ فَعَلَهُۥ كَبِيرُهُمۡ هَٰذَا فَسۡـَٔلُوهُمۡ إِن كَانُواْ يَنطِقُونَ

en.text: He said, "Rather, this - the largest of them - did it, so ask them, if they should [be able to] speak."

so.text: 63. (Ibraahiim) wuxuu yidhi: “Mayee waxaa falay (fale uun) kooda u weyn (sanamyada) waa kane, ee weydiiya hadday hadli karaan!

ayat.arabic: فَرَجَعُوٓاْ إِلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمۡ فَقَالُوٓاْ إِنَّكُمۡ أَنتُمُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ

en.text: So they returned to [blaming] themselves and said [to each other], "Indeed, you are the wrongdoers."

so.text: 64. Markaasay dib isugu noqdeen oo ay yidhaahdeen: Xaqiiq idinkaa daalimiin ah.”

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ نُكِسُواْ عَلَىٰ رُءُوسِهِمۡ لَقَدۡ عَلِمۡتَ مَا هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ يَنطِقُونَ

en.text: Then they reversed themselves,[893] [saying], "You have already known that these do not speak!"
en.footnotes: [893] After first admitting their error, they were seized by pride and obstinacy.

so.text: 65. Markaasaa laga yeelay inay madaxa hoos u rogtaan [21] 'oo yidhaahdeen': Waad og tahay inayan kuwakani hadlin"!
so.footnotes: [21]. Kaddib markay qirteen gefkoodii, waxaa galay kibir iyo cinaad markaasay haddana ka horyimaadeen oo is rogeen.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ أَفَتَعۡبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنفَعُكُمۡ شَيۡـٔٗا وَلَا يَضُرُّكُمۡ

en.text: He said, "Then do you worship instead of Allāh that which does not benefit you at all or harm you?

so.text: 66. (Ibraahiim) wuxuu yidhi: “Ma waxaad caabudeysaan Alle sokadi waxaan waxba idin tari karin waxbana idin yeeli karin?

ayat.arabic: أُفّٖ لَّكُمۡ وَلِمَا تَعۡبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِۚ أَفَلَا تَعۡقِلُونَ

en.text: Uff[894] to you and to what you worship instead of Allāh. Then will you not use reason?"
en.footnotes: [894] An exclamation of anger and displeasure.

so.text: 67. “Uf baad leedihiin idinka iyo waxaad caabudeysaanba Alle sokadi. Miyeydaan wax fahmeyn?”

ayat.arabic: قَالُواْ حَرِّقُوهُ وَٱنصُرُوٓاْ ءَالِهَتَكُمۡ إِن كُنتُمۡ فَٰعِلِينَ

en.text: They said, "Burn him and support your gods - if you are to act."

so.text: 68. Waxay yidhaahdeen: “Guba oo u gargaara ilaahyadiinna, haddaad (wax) falaysaan.”

ayat.arabic: قُلۡنَا يَٰنَارُ كُونِي بَرۡدٗا وَسَلَٰمًا عَلَىٰٓ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ

en.text: We [i.e., Allāh] said, "O fire, be coolness and safety upon Abraham."

so.text: 69. Waxaanu nidhi: Dabkow! U noqo qabow iyo nabad Ibraahiim!”

ayat.arabic: وَأَرَادُواْ بِهِۦ كَيۡدٗا فَجَعَلۡنَٰهُمُ ٱلۡأَخۡسَرِينَ

en.text: And they intended for him a plan [i.e., harm], but We made them the greatest losers.

so.text: 70. Waxay la dooneen dhagar (dhib), waxaanse ka yeelnay kuwo khasaaray.

ayat.arabic: وَنَجَّيۡنَٰهُ وَلُوطًا إِلَى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ ٱلَّتِي بَٰرَكۡنَا فِيهَا لِلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

en.text: And We delivered him and Lot to the land which We had blessed for the worlds [i.e., peoples].

so.text: 71. Waxaanu badbaadinnay isaga iyo Luudba (innagoo u wareejinnay xagga) arladii [22] aan u barakaynay dadka oo dhan.
so.footnotes: [22]. Dhulkaa waxaa loola jeedaa arlada Shaam (oo ah: Falastiin, Urdun, Suuriya, Lubnaan iyo dhulalka hareerahooda ah). Wuxuuna Alle ku barakeeyey inuu ka soo diray badi anbiyada dhulkaasi, iyo inay sidoo kale tahay dhul wanaagsan oo barako iyo khayr badan.

ayat.arabic: وَوَهَبۡنَا لَهُۥٓ إِسۡحَٰقَ وَيَعۡقُوبَ نَافِلَةٗۖ وَكُلّٗا جَعَلۡنَا صَٰلِحِينَ

en.text: And We gave him Isaac and Jacob in addition, and all [of them] We made righteous.

so.text: 72. Waxaan siinnay Isxaaq iyo Yacquub oo wiil wiilki ah, waxaan ka yeelnay dhammaan kuwo wanaagsan.

ayat.arabic: وَجَعَلۡنَٰهُمۡ أَئِمَّةٗ يَهۡدُونَ بِأَمۡرِنَا وَأَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَيۡهِمۡ فِعۡلَ ٱلۡخَيۡرَٰتِ وَإِقَامَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَإِيتَآءَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةِۖ وَكَانُواْ لَنَا عَٰبِدِينَ

en.text: And We made them leaders guiding by Our command. And We inspired to them the doing of good deeds, establishment of prayer, and giving of zakāh; and they were worshippers of Us.

so.text: 73. Waxaanu ka yeelnay hoggaamiyeyaal ku hanuuniya (dadka) Amarkagaya, Waxaana u waxyoonnay falidda khayraadka, oogidda salaadda, iyo bixinta sakada, waxayna ahaayeen kuwo  na caabuda (Alle Keliya caabuda).

ayat.arabic: وَلُوطًا ءَاتَيۡنَٰهُ حُكۡمٗا وَعِلۡمٗا وَنَجَّيۡنَٰهُ مِنَ ٱلۡقَرۡيَةِ ٱلَّتِي كَانَت تَّعۡمَلُ ٱلۡخَبَٰٓئِثَۚ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ قَوۡمَ سَوۡءٖ فَٰسِقِينَ

en.text: And to Lot We gave judgement and knowledge, and We saved him from the city that was committing wicked deeds. Indeed, they were a people of evil, defiantly disobedient.

so.text: 74. Oo Luud Waxaanu siinnay garsoor wanaagsan iyo cilmi, Waxaana ka badbaadinnay magaaladii (Soodom) ee ahayd mid xumo [23] fasha. Waxay ahaayeen qolo xun oo fallaago ah.
so.footnotes: [23]. Xumahaas oo ahaa shirki, gaalnimo, fuulitaanka ragga 'khaniisnimo', tuugo, boob, dhac, jid gooyo, iwm iyagoo waxaasi oo idil u fali jiray si bareer ah.

ayat.arabic: وَأَدۡخَلۡنَٰهُ فِي رَحۡمَتِنَآۖ إِنَّهُۥ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ

en.text: And We admitted him into Our mercy. Indeed, he was of the righteous.

so.text: 75. Waxaana gelinnay Naxariistayada, wuxuu ka mid ahaa inta wanaagsan.

ayat.arabic: وَنُوحًا إِذۡ نَادَىٰ مِن قَبۡلُ فَٱسۡتَجَبۡنَا لَهُۥ فَنَجَّيۡنَٰهُ وَأَهۡلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلۡكَرۡبِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ

en.text: And [mention] Noah, when he called [to Allāh][895] before [that time], so We responded to him and saved him and his family from the great affliction [i.e., the flood].
en.footnotes: [895] i.e., supplicated against his people who had persisted in denial and animosity. See 71:26-28.

so.text: 76. Oo Nuux waa badbaadinnay, markuu noo dhawaaqday kol hore [24]. Waana ka ajiibnay baryadii, oo ka samatabixinnay isaga iyo intii raacday musiibadii weyneyd (harqintii qoonkiisii).
so.footnotes: [24]. Macnaha uu habaaray qolodiisii kuwaasoo ku adkeystey shirkiga iyo macaasida.

ayat.arabic: وَنَصَرۡنَٰهُ مِنَ ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآۚ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ قَوۡمَ سَوۡءٖ فَأَغۡرَقۡنَٰهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ

en.text: And We aided [i.e., saved] him from the people who denied Our signs. Indeed, they were a people of evil, so We drowned them, all together.

so.text: 77. Waana uga gargaarnay qolodii beeniyey Aayadahayaga, waxay ahaayeen qolo xun, mrkaasaan harqinnay dhammaan.

ayat.arabic: وَدَاوُۥدَ وَسُلَيۡمَٰنَ إِذۡ يَحۡكُمَانِ فِي ٱلۡحَرۡثِ إِذۡ نَفَشَتۡ فِيهِ غَنَمُ ٱلۡقَوۡمِ وَكُنَّا لِحُكۡمِهِمۡ شَٰهِدِينَ

en.text: And [mention] David and Solomon, when they judged concerning the field - when the sheep of a people overran it [at night],[896] and We were witness to their judgement.
en.footnotes: [896] Eating and destroying the crops.

so.text: 78.  (Xus) Daawuud iyo Sulaymaan, markay ka garsooreen arrinkii beerta markuu daaqay (beerta) adhi dad leeyihiin (goor habeen ah), Waxaanu aheyn Kuwo garsoorkoodii u marag ah 'arka' [25].
so.footnotes: [25]. Wuxuu Daawuud xukumay in adhigaa beertaa daaqay la siiyo ninkii lahaa beerta  khasaarahii loo geystey darteed.

ayat.arabic: فَفَهَّمۡنَٰهَا سُلَيۡمَٰنَۚ وَكُلًّا ءَاتَيۡنَا حُكۡمٗا وَعِلۡمٗاۚ وَسَخَّرۡنَا مَعَ دَاوُۥدَ ٱلۡجِبَالَ يُسَبِّحۡنَ وَٱلطَّيۡرَۚ وَكُنَّا فَٰعِلِينَ

en.text: And We gave understanding of it [i.e., the case] to Solomon, and to each [of them] We gave judgement and knowledge. And We subjected the mountains to exalt [Us], along with David and [also] the birds. And We were doing [that].[897]
en.footnotes: [897] Meaning that Allāh has always been capable of accomplishing whatever He wills.

so.text: 79. Waxaanse fahansiinnay Sulaymaan, mid walbaana waxaan siinnay garsoor wanaagsan iyo cilmi, Waxaana u sakhirnay Daawuud buuraha iyo shimbiraha inay la tasbiixsadaan oo Alle amaanaan. Waana Annaga kuwa falay 'waxaasi oo idil' [26].
so.footnotes: [26]. Macnaha waa inuu Alle mar waliba karo inuu fuliyo wuxuu doono. Nabi Sulaymaan wuxuu islaa arrinkaa u xukumay si ka duwan xukunkii Nabi Daawuud, wuxuu Sulaymaan guddoonshay in ninkii adhiga lahaa falo beertii adhigiisu halleeyey oo sideedii ku soo cesho, ninkii beerta lahaana uu ku sii intifaaco adhigiisa inta beertiisa looga hagaajinayo, kaddibna mid walbaa wixiisa qaato kii adhiga lahaa adhigiisa, kii beerta lahaana beertiisii oo loo hagaajiyey.

ayat.arabic: وَعَلَّمۡنَٰهُ صَنۡعَةَ لَبُوسٖ لَّكُمۡ لِتُحۡصِنَكُم مِّنۢ بَأۡسِكُمۡۖ فَهَلۡ أَنتُمۡ شَٰكِرُونَ

en.text: And We taught him the fashioning of coats of armor to protect you from your [enemy in] battle. So will you then be grateful?

so.text: 80. Waxaana barnay Daawuud sameynta jaakado bir ah aad labbisataan si ay idiinka dhowrto dhibaatada dagaalkiinna. Ee ma tihiin kuwo (Alle u) mahad naqaya?

ayat.arabic: وَلِسُلَيۡمَٰنَ ٱلرِّيحَ عَاصِفَةٗ تَجۡرِي بِأَمۡرِهِۦٓ إِلَى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ ٱلَّتِي بَٰرَكۡنَا فِيهَاۚ وَكُنَّا بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَٰلِمِينَ

en.text: And to Solomon [We subjected] the wind, blowing forcefully, proceeding by his command toward the land which We had blessed. And We are ever, of all things, Knowing.

so.text: 81. (Waxaan u sakhirnay) Sulaymaan dabeysha sida xoogga leh u socota, ee ugu ordeysa si xowli ah amarkiisa xagga dhulkii aan barakaynay (ee Falastiin iyo Suuriya). Waxaana nahay kuwo wax walba Ogsoon.

ayat.arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينِ مَن يَغُوصُونَ لَهُۥ وَيَعۡمَلُونَ عَمَلٗا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَۖ وَكُنَّا لَهُمۡ حَٰفِظِينَ

en.text: And of the devils [i.e., jinn] were those who dived for him and did work other than that. And We were of them a guardian.[898]
en.footnotes: [898] Preventing any disobedience or deviation by them from Solomon's instructions and protecting him from being harmed by them.

so.text: 82. Shaydaammada (dadka iyo jinkaba leh waan u sakhirnay) waxaana ka mid ahaa kuwo u quusa (badda) una fala camallo kale oo taa barbarkeed ah: Waana Annaga kuwa dhowrayey [27].
so.footnotes: [27]. Innagaa ka dhowrnay inay caasiyaan oo khilaafaan amarka Sulaymaan, oo ka dhowrnay Sulaymaan inay u geystaan wax waxyeello ah.

ayat.arabic: ۞ وَأَيُّوبَ إِذۡ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ ٱلضُّرُّ وَأَنتَ أَرۡحَمُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ

en.text: And [mention] Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, adversity has touched me, and You are the most merciful of the merciful."

so.text: 83. (Xus) Ayyuub markuu u dhawaaqay Rabbigi (isagoo leh): Waxaa I taabtay dhib (jirro iyo dad iyo duunyo beel), Adiguna waxaad tahay (Allow) Kan ugu Naxariista Badan inta naxariista.”

ayat.arabic: فَٱسۡتَجَبۡنَا لَهُۥ فَكَشَفۡنَا مَا بِهِۦ مِن ضُرّٖۖ وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُ أَهۡلَهُۥ وَمِثۡلَهُم مَّعَهُمۡ رَحۡمَةٗ مِّنۡ عِندِنَا وَذِكۡرَىٰ لِلۡعَٰبِدِينَ

en.text: So We responded to him and removed what afflicted him of adversity. And We gave him [back] his family and the like thereof with them as mercy from Us and a reminder for the worshippers [of Allāh].

so.text: 84. Waana ajiibnay, Waxaana ka feydnay dhibtii haysey (jirradii iyo faqrigii), waxaana siinnay ehelkiisii (uu waayey) iyo in le’eg oo wehlisa - Naxariis Xaggayaga ah, iyo xusuus ay u ahaato kuwa na caabuda.

ayat.arabic: وَإِسۡمَٰعِيلَ وَإِدۡرِيسَ وَذَا ٱلۡكِفۡلِۖ كُلّٞ مِّنَ ٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ

en.text: And [mention] Ishmael and Idrees and Dhul-Kifl; all were of the patient.

so.text: 85. (Xus) Ismaaciil, iyo Idriis, iyo Dul- Kifil, kulli waxay ka mid ahaayeen kuwa samra.

ayat.arabic: وَأَدۡخَلۡنَٰهُمۡ فِي رَحۡمَتِنَآۖ إِنَّهُم مِّنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ

en.text: And We admitted them into Our mercy. Indeed, they were of the righteous.

so.text: 86. Waxaana dhex gelinnay Naxariistayada. Waxay ka mid ahaayeen kuwa wanaagsan.

ayat.arabic: وَذَا ٱلنُّونِ إِذ ذَّهَبَ مُغَٰضِبٗا فَظَنَّ أَن لَّن نَّقۡدِرَ عَلَيۡهِ فَنَادَىٰ فِي ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ أَن لَّآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنتَ سُبۡحَٰنَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ

en.text: And [mention] the man of the fish [i.e., Jonah], when he went off in anger[899] and thought that We would not decree [anything] upon him.[900] And he called out within the darknesses,[901] "There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers."
en.footnotes:
[899] At the disbelief of his people.
[900] Or "would not restrict him" in the belly of the fish.
[901] That of the night, of the sea, and of the fish's interior.

so.text: 87. (Xus qisada) rafiiqii nibriga (Yuunus) markuu tegay isagoo (u) cadheysan 'dadkii loo  diray' [28], wuxuuna mooday inaanan cidhiidhyeyn 'aanu qabanayn' [29]! Markaasuu ka dhawaaqay mugdiyo dhexdooda [30] 'isagoo leh': Ma jiro Ilaah (Xaq ah) aan Adiga aheyn (Allow). Adigaa ka hufan (xumaan), anigu  waan gefay.
so.footnotes:
[28]. Ka cadheysan gaalnimada iyo caasiyoobidda dadkiisa. 
[29]. Macne kale waa aan ku cidhiidhyi doonin (caloosha nibriga).
[30]. Mugdiyadaas oo ah mugdiga habeenka, kan badda, iyo kan caloosha nibriga.

ayat.arabic: فَٱسۡتَجَبۡنَا لَهُۥ وَنَجَّيۡنَٰهُ مِنَ ٱلۡغَمِّۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُـۨجِي ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ

en.text: So We responded to him and saved him from the distress. And thus do We save the believers.

so.text: 88. Waana ajiibnnay baryadiisii, kana badbaadinnay murugadii. Sidaasaana u badbaadinnaa mu’miniinta.

ayat.arabic: وَزَكَرِيَّآ إِذۡ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥ رَبِّ لَا تَذَرۡنِي فَرۡدٗا وَأَنتَ خَيۡرُ ٱلۡوَٰرِثِينَ

en.text: And [mention] Zechariah, when he called to his Lord, "My Lord, do not leave me alone [with no heir], while You are the best of inheritors."

so.text: 89. (Xus) Zakariya, markuu u dhawaaqay Rabbigi (isagoo leh):” Rabbiyow! Ha igu dhaafin keli ahaan, Adigaana u Kheyr roon cid wax dhaxasha (u hadha)”.

ayat.arabic: فَٱسۡتَجَبۡنَا لَهُۥ وَوَهَبۡنَا لَهُۥ يَحۡيَىٰ وَأَصۡلَحۡنَا لَهُۥ زَوۡجَهُۥٓۚ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ يُسَٰرِعُونَ فِي ٱلۡخَيۡرَٰتِ وَيَدۡعُونَنَا رَغَبٗا وَرَهَبٗاۖ وَكَانُواْ لَنَا خَٰشِعِينَ

en.text: So We responded to him, and We gave to him John, and amended for him his wife. Indeed, they used to hasten to good deeds and supplicate[902] Us in hope and fear, and they were to Us humbly submissive.
en.footnotes: [902] i.e., worship.

so.text: 90. Waana ajiibnay baryadiisii, oo siinnay Yaxyaa, una hagaajinnay xaaskiisii. Waxay ahaayeen kuwo u degdega inay falaan camallo wanaagsan oo na barya (caabuda) si rajo iyo cabsiba leh, waxayna ahaayeen kuwo noo nugul (oo kal san).

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّتِيٓ أَحۡصَنَتۡ فَرۡجَهَا فَنَفَخۡنَا فِيهَا مِن رُّوحِنَا وَجَعَلۡنَٰهَا وَٱبۡنَهَآ ءَايَةٗ لِّلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

en.text: And [mention] the one who guarded her chastity [i.e., Mary], so We blew into her [garment] through Our angel [i.e., Gabriel], and We made her and her son a sign for the worlds.

so.text: 91. (Xus) tii xafidday jirkeeda (Maryam), oo aan ka afuufnay (jeebka canbuurkeeda ama maradeeda) Annagoo u xil saarnay (ku afuufidda ilmo uurkeeda) Ruuxayaga (Jabriil),  Waxaana uga yeelnay iyada iyo wiilkeedii (Ciise) calaamo caalamka.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦٓ أُمَّتُكُمۡ أُمَّةٗ وَٰحِدَةٗ وَأَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمۡ فَٱعۡبُدُونِ

en.text: Indeed this, your religion, is one religion,[903] and I am your Lord, so worship Me.
en.footnotes: [903] i.e., a collective way of life or course of conduct followed by a community.

so.text: 92. Hubaal, diintiinnani (Islaamka) waa diin mid ah [31], Oo Anigu 'Alle ah' waxaan ahay Rabbigiin, ee i caabuda 'Anigoo keliya'.
so.footnotes: [31]. Ummah waxaa loola jeedaa diin :hab nololeed ay jamaaco dhan wada qaataan oo raacaan, ama dhaqan iyo hannaan wanaagsan ay ummadi raacdo.

ayat.arabic: وَتَقَطَّعُوٓاْ أَمۡرَهُم بَيۡنَهُمۡۖ كُلٌّ إِلَيۡنَا رَٰجِعُونَ

en.text: And [yet] they divided their affair [i.e., that of their religion] among themselves,[904] [but] all to Us will return.
en.footnotes: [904] Becoming sects and denominations.

so.text: 93. Waxayse u kala goosgoosteen diintoodii (kooxo) dhexdooda [32]. Xaggayagay dhammaan u soo wada noqon.
so.footnotes: [32]. Iyagoo noqday dariiqooyin iyo kooxo kala duwan.

ayat.arabic: فَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَهُوَ مُؤۡمِنٞ فَلَا كُفۡرَانَ لِسَعۡيِهِۦ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ كَٰتِبُونَ

en.text: So whoever does righteous deeds while he is a believer - no denial will there be for his effort,[905] and indeed We [i.e., Our angels], of it, are recorders.
en.footnotes: [905] Such a person will not be deprived of his due reward.

so.text: 94. Ee qofkii fala camallo wanaagsan isagoo mu’min ah, lama duudsiyo ajarka camalkiisa. Oo hubaal Waan u qoreynaa.

ayat.arabic: وَحَرَٰمٌ عَلَىٰ قَرۡيَةٍ أَهۡلَكۡنَٰهَآ أَنَّهُمۡ لَا يَرۡجِعُونَ

en.text: And it is prohibited to [the people of] a city which We have destroyed that they will [ever] return[906]
en.footnotes: [906] They cannot return to this world, nor can they repent to Allāh.

so.text: 95. Waxaa ka reebban magaalo aan halaagnay inay dib u soo noqoto [33].
so.footnotes: [33]. Uma soo laaban karaan adduunkan, mana u tawbad keeni karaan Alle.

ayat.arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا فُتِحَتۡ يَأۡجُوجُ وَمَأۡجُوجُ وَهُم مِّن كُلِّ حَدَبٖ يَنسِلُونَ

en.text: Until when [the dam of] Gog and Magog has been opened and they, from every elevation, descend

so.text: 96. Ilaa laga soo furo (moos xirkii) Yuug iyo Yamaayuug, waxayna ka soo dhaadhici taag walba si degdeg ah.

ayat.arabic: وَٱقۡتَرَبَ ٱلۡوَعۡدُ ٱلۡحَقُّ فَإِذَا هِيَ شَٰخِصَةٌ أَبۡصَٰرُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ يَٰوَيۡلَنَا قَدۡ كُنَّا فِي غَفۡلَةٖ مِّنۡ هَٰذَا بَلۡ كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ

en.text: And [when] the true promise [i.e., the resurrection] has approached; then suddenly the eyes of those who disbelieved will be staring [in horror, while they say], "O woe to us; we had been unmindful of this; rather, we were wrongdoers."

so.text: 97. Markuu soo dhowaado Yabooha Xaqa ah (ee Qiyaamada la gaadho) mise indhaha kuwii gaaloobay way dhaygagi (iyagoo leh): Hoogeennee! Waxaan aheyn kuwo kaga sugan dhoohnaan waxakani;  waxaanuna aheyn daalimiin (gar ma qaatayaal).

ayat.arabic: إِنَّكُمۡ وَمَا تَعۡبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ حَصَبُ جَهَنَّمَ أَنتُمۡ لَهَا وَٰرِدُونَ

en.text: Indeed, you [disbelievers] and what you worship other than Allāh are the firewood of Hell. You will be coming to [enter] it.

so.text: 98. Hubaal, Idinka iyo waxaad caabud- daan Alle sokadi, waxaad ahaan shidaalka Naarta, xaggeedaad ku arooreysaan.

ayat.arabic: لَوۡ كَانَ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ ءَالِهَةٗ مَّا وَرَدُوهَاۖ وَكُلّٞ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ

en.text: Had these [false deities] been [actual] gods, they would not have come to it, but all are eternal therein.

so.text: 99. Hadday kuwakani ahaan lahaayeen ilaahyo ma ay galeen (Naarta), dhammaanna way ku waadhi.

ayat.arabic: لَهُمۡ فِيهَا زَفِيرٞ وَهُمۡ فِيهَا لَا يَسۡمَعُونَ

en.text: For them therein is heavy sighing, and they therein will not hear.

so.text: 100. Waxay ku leeyihiin gudaheeda cartan iyo hiinraag, oo waxna gudaheeda kuma maqlaan.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ سَبَقَتۡ لَهُم مِّنَّا ٱلۡحُسۡنَىٰٓ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ عَنۡهَا مُبۡعَدُونَ

en.text: Indeed, those for whom the best [reward] has preceded from Us - they are from it far removed.

so.text: 101. Hubaal, kuwa (Nabi Ciise, hooyadi Maryam, iyo addoomaha Alle ee kale ee wanaagsan) ay u hor martay xaggayaga wanaagga, kuwaasu xaggeeda (Naarta) waa laga fogeyn.

ayat.arabic: لَا يَسۡمَعُونَ حَسِيسَهَاۖ وَهُمۡ فِي مَا ٱشۡتَهَتۡ أَنفُسُهُمۡ خَٰلِدُونَ

en.text: They will not hear its sound, while they are, in that which their souls desire, abiding eternally.

so.text: 102. Ma maqlaan shanqarteeda, iyagoo ku dhex waadhi waxay nafahooda rabaan.

ayat.arabic: لَا يَحۡزُنُهُمُ ٱلۡفَزَعُ ٱلۡأَكۡبَرُ وَتَتَلَقَّىٰهُمُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ هَٰذَا يَوۡمُكُمُ ٱلَّذِي كُنتُمۡ تُوعَدُونَ

en.text: They will not be grieved by the greatest terror,[907] and the angels will meet them, [saying], "This is your Day which you have been promised" -
en.footnotes: [907] The events of the Last Hour or of the Resurrection.

so.text: 103. Argagaxa weyn (ee Maalinta Qiyaamada) ma murugo geliyo,  malaa’igtuna waxay ku soo dhoweyn (salaan diirran iyagoo ku leh): Kani waa Maalinkiinnii la idin yaboohay.

ayat.arabic: يَوۡمَ نَطۡوِي ٱلسَّمَآءَ كَطَيِّ ٱلسِّجِلِّ لِلۡكُتُبِۚ كَمَا بَدَأۡنَآ أَوَّلَ خَلۡقٖ نُّعِيدُهُۥۚ وَعۡدًا عَلَيۡنَآۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا فَٰعِلِينَ

en.text: The Day when We will fold the heaven like the folding of a [written] sheet for the records. As We began the first creation, We will repeat it. [That is] a promise binding upon Us. Indeed, We will do it.[908]
en.footnotes: [908] More literally, "Indeed, We are ever doers" of what We will.

so.text: 104. Maalinka aan u duubeyno samada sida loo duubo waraaqaha waxa lagu qoro, sidaan u billownay abuuriddii hore baan ku soo celineynaa, (waa) ballan aan qaadnay oo na saaran, hubaal waanu fali.

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ كَتَبۡنَا فِي ٱلزَّبُورِ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ ٱلذِّكۡرِ أَنَّ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ يَرِثُهَا عِبَادِيَ ٱلصَّٰلِحُونَ

en.text: And We have already written in the book [of Psalms][909] after the [previous] mention[910] that the land [of Paradise] is inherited by My righteous servants.
en.footnotes:
[909] Az-Zabūr can also mean "scriptures" in general.
[910] i.e., the Torah. The "mention" may also refer to the original inscription with Allāh, i.e., the Preserved Slate (al-Lawḥ al-Maḥfūẓ).

so.text: 105. Waxaanu ku qornay Zabuurka [34] kaddib (markaan horay ugu) xusnay Kitaabka [35] in arlada (Jannada) ay dhaxli addoomahyaga wanaagsan.
so.footnotes:
[34]. Zabuur waa kitaabkii loo waxyooday Nabi Daawuud c.s.Waxaa sidoo kale la yidhi waxaa loola jeedaa Kutubta Alle oo dhan. 
[35]. Waa Towraadda, waxaa sidoo kale lagu fasiray Looxa Maxfuudka.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ فِي هَٰذَا لَبَلَٰغٗا لِّقَوۡمٍ عَٰبِدِينَ

en.text: Indeed, in this [Qur’ān] is notification for a worshipping people.

so.text: 106. Hubaal, arrinkani waxaa ugu sugan Gaarsiin cad qolo na caabudda.

ayat.arabic: وَمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَٰكَ إِلَّا رَحۡمَةٗ لِّلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

en.text: And We have not sent you, [O Muḥammad], except as a mercy to the worlds.

so.text: 107. Kuuma aanu soo dirin (Nabi Muxammadow) waxaan aheyn Naxariis aad u ahaato uumanka oo idil.

ayat.arabic: قُلۡ إِنَّمَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَيَّ أَنَّمَآ إِلَٰهُكُمۡ إِلَٰهٞ وَٰحِدٞۖ فَهَلۡ أَنتُم مُّسۡلِمُونَ

en.text: Say, "It is only revealed to me that your god is but one God; so will you be Muslims [in submission to Him]?"

so.text: 108. Dheh: Waxaa uun la ii waxyooday inuu Ilaahiinnu yahay ilaah Keliya 'Allaah', ee ma u hoggaansameysaan Muslimiin ahaan?.

ayat.arabic: فَإِن تَوَلَّوۡاْ فَقُلۡ ءَاذَنتُكُمۡ عَلَىٰ سَوَآءٖۖ وَإِنۡ أَدۡرِيٓ أَقَرِيبٌ أَم بَعِيدٞ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ

en.text: But if they turn away, then say, "I have announced to [all of] you equally.[911] And I know not whether near or far is that which you are promised.
en.footnotes: [911] The Prophet (ﷺ) made this message known to all people, not concealing any of it from anyone or preferring any group over another.

so.text: 109.Haddiise ay (ka) jeesadaan (Iimaanka), ku dheh waxaan idin siiyey digniin cad ee xaq ah. Mana ogi in waxa la idiinku gooddiyo uu dhow yahay ama fog yahay.”

ayat.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ يَعۡلَمُ ٱلۡجَهۡرَ مِنَ ٱلۡقَوۡلِ وَيَعۡلَمُ مَا تَكۡتُمُونَ

en.text: Indeed, He knows what is declared of speech, and He knows what you conceal.

so.text: 110. Hubaal Wuxuu (Alle) Og yahay hadalka kii kor loo qaado, wuxuuna Og yahay waxaad qarineysaan.

ayat.arabic: وَإِنۡ أَدۡرِي لَعَلَّهُۥ فِتۡنَةٞ لَّكُمۡ وَمَتَٰعٌ إِلَىٰ حِينٖ

en.text: And I know not; perhaps it[912] is a trial for you and enjoyment for a time."
en.footnotes: [912] The postponement of punishment.

so.text: 111. Aniguse ma ogi, waa intaasoo ay idiin tahay fidmo (imtixaan dib u dhigidda cadaabka) iyo raaxo ku eg ilaa muddo.

ayat.arabic: قَٰلَ رَبِّ ٱحۡكُم بِٱلۡحَقِّۗ وَرَبُّنَا ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ ٱلۡمُسۡتَعَانُ عَلَىٰ مَا تَصِفُونَ

en.text: [The Prophet (ﷺ)] has said, "My Lord, judge [between us] in truth. And our Lord is the Most Merciful, the one whose help is sought against that which you describe."[913]
en.footnotes: [913] i.e., their lies and disbelief.

so.text: 112. (Nabigu isagoo baryaya Rabbigi) wuxuu yidhi: Rabbiyow! Noogu kala garsoor xaq. Rabbigayona waa (Allaah) Raxmaanka ah ee laga kaalmaysto waxaad sheegeysaan [36].
so.footnotes: [36]. Waa beenahooda iyo gaalnimadooda iyagoo ku sheega inuu Alle leeyahay ilmo, iyo in Muxammad s.c.w. yahay saaxir, jinnoole, gabyaa, iyo in Qur’aanka yahay gabay, sheeko xariir, sixir, iwm.

ayat.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ ٱتَّقُواْ رَبَّكُمۡۚ إِنَّ زَلۡزَلَةَ ٱلسَّاعَةِ شَيۡءٌ عَظِيمٞ

en.text: O mankind, fear your Lord. Indeed, the convulsion of the [final] Hour is a terrible thing.

so.text: 1. Dadow! Iska jira (Ciqaabka) Rabbigiin! Hubaal, Gariirka Saacadda (Qiyaame) waa wax weyn oo daran.

ayat.arabic: يَوۡمَ تَرَوۡنَهَا تَذۡهَلُ كُلُّ مُرۡضِعَةٍ عَمَّآ أَرۡضَعَتۡ وَتَضَعُ كُلُّ ذَاتِ حَمۡلٍ حَمۡلَهَا وَتَرَى ٱلنَّاسَ سُكَٰرَىٰ وَمَا هُم بِسُكَٰرَىٰ وَلَٰكِنَّ عَذَابَ ٱللَّهِ شَدِيدٞ

en.text: On the Day you see it every nursing mother will be distracted from that [child] she was nursing, and every pregnant woman will abort her pregnancy, and you will see the people [appearing] intoxicated while they are not intoxicated; but the punishment of Allāh is severe.

so.text: 2. Maalinta aad arkeysaan haweeney kasta oo ilmo nuujinaysa iyadoo ka tegi ilmahay naaska nuujinaysay, oo haweeney walboo uur leh dhicin waxay uurka ku siddo, waxaadna arki dadka oo (ah sida kuwo) sakhraansan, mana aha kuwo sakhraansan, Cadaabka Alle baase ah mid Daran.

ayat.arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يُجَٰدِلُ فِي ٱللَّهِ بِغَيۡرِ عِلۡمٖ وَيَتَّبِعُ كُلَّ شَيۡطَٰنٖ مَّرِيدٖ

en.text: And of the people is he who disputes about Allāh without knowledge and follows every rebellious devil.

so.text: 3. Waxaa ka mid ah dadka mid ka dooda arrinka Alle cilmi la’aan, raacana Shaydaan kastoo madax adag.

ayat.arabic: كُتِبَ عَلَيۡهِ أَنَّهُۥ مَن تَوَلَّاهُ فَأَنَّهُۥ يُضِلُّهُۥ وَيَهۡدِيهِ إِلَىٰ عَذَابِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ

en.text: It has been decreed for him [i.e., every devil] that whoever turns to him - he will misguide him and will lead him to the punishment of the Blaze.

so.text: 4. Waxaa loo qoray in qofkii raaca  (sheydaan) oo saaxiib ka yeesha inuu lumiyo oo ku hago cadaabka hurka badan.

ayat.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ إِن كُنتُمۡ فِي رَيۡبٖ مِّنَ ٱلۡبَعۡثِ فَإِنَّا خَلَقۡنَٰكُم مِّن تُرَابٖ ثُمَّ مِن نُّطۡفَةٖ ثُمَّ مِنۡ عَلَقَةٖ ثُمَّ مِن مُّضۡغَةٖ مُّخَلَّقَةٖ وَغَيۡرِ مُخَلَّقَةٖ لِّنُبَيِّنَ لَكُمۡۚ وَنُقِرُّ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡحَامِ مَا نَشَآءُ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٖ مُّسَمّٗى ثُمَّ نُخۡرِجُكُمۡ طِفۡلٗا ثُمَّ لِتَبۡلُغُوٓاْ أَشُدَّكُمۡۖ وَمِنكُم مَّن يُتَوَفَّىٰ وَمِنكُم مَّن يُرَدُّ إِلَىٰٓ أَرۡذَلِ ٱلۡعُمُرِ لِكَيۡلَا يَعۡلَمَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ عِلۡمٖ شَيۡـٔٗاۚ وَتَرَى ٱلۡأَرۡضَ هَامِدَةٗ فَإِذَآ أَنزَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهَا ٱلۡمَآءَ ٱهۡتَزَّتۡ وَرَبَتۡ وَأَنۢبَتَتۡ مِن كُلِّ زَوۡجِۭ بَهِيجٖ

en.text: O people, if you should be in doubt about the Resurrection, then [consider that] indeed, We created you from dust, then from a sperm-drop, then from a clinging clot, and then from a lump of flesh, formed and unformed[915] - that We may show you.[916] And We settle in the wombs whom We will for a specified term, then We bring you out as a child, and then [We develop you] that you may reach your [time of] maturity. And among you is he who is taken in [early] death, and among you is he who is returned to the most decrepit [old] age so that he knows, after [once having] knowledge, nothing. And you see the earth barren, but when We send down upon it rain, it quivers and swells and grows [something] of every beautiful kind.
en.footnotes:
[915] That which is incomplete. This may include what is aborted at that stage.
[916] Our power and creative ability.

so.text:
5. Dadow! Haddaad shaki ka qabtaan soo bixinta (iilka layska soo saari), Waxaanu idinka abuurnay carro, haddana dhibic mani ah, haddana xinjir, haddana
cad hilib ah, in ka mid ahi la abuuro inna aan la abuurin (qaadis xumo darteed), si aanu idiinku caddayno. Waxaana ku sugnaa ilmo galeennada waxaan doonno ilaa muddo magacaaban. Markaasaan idin soo bixinnaa idinkoo ilmo yar ah, si aad u gaartaan xooggiina. Waxaa idin ka mid ah mid la oofsado (isagoo yar), waxaana idinka mid ah mid loo celiyo cimriga u liita, si uusan waxba u ogaan ogaalkii kaddib. Waxaadna arkaysaa dhulkoo abaar ah, markase aan ku soo dejinno biyo korkeeda, la dhaqdhaqaaqda (nolol) oo fuurta oo soo saarta nooc walba oo dhir bilic san oo la jeclaado leh.

ayat.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلۡحَقُّ وَأَنَّهُۥ يُحۡيِ ٱلۡمَوۡتَىٰ وَأَنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٞ

en.text: That is because Allāh is the True Reality and because He gives life to the dead and because He is over all things competent

so.text: 6. Arrinkani waxaa ugu wacan in Alle Xaq yahay, oo uu nooleeyo meytida, iyo inuu wax walba Karo.

ayat.arabic: وَأَنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ ءَاتِيَةٞ لَّا رَيۡبَ فِيهَا وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَبۡعَثُ مَن فِي ٱلۡقُبُورِ

en.text: And [that they may know] that the Hour is coming - no doubt about it - and that Allāh will resurrect those in the graves.

so.text: 7. Iyo in Saacadda (Qiyaame) iman, shaki ku jirin, iyo in Alle soo bixin waxa ku jira qubuuraha.

ayat.arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يُجَٰدِلُ فِي ٱللَّهِ بِغَيۡرِ عِلۡمٖ وَلَا هُدٗى وَلَا كِتَٰبٖ مُّنِيرٖ

en.text: And of the people is he who disputes about Allāh without knowledge or guidance or an enlightening book [from Him],

so.text: 8. Waxaa ka mid ah dadka mid ka dooda arrinka Alle isagoon u haysan cilmi ama hanuun, ama kitaab wax ifaya.

ayat.arabic: ثَانِيَ عِطۡفِهِۦ لِيُضِلَّ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِۖ لَهُۥ فِي ٱلدُّنۡيَا خِزۡيٞۖ وَنُذِيقُهُۥ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ عَذَابَ ٱلۡحَرِيقِ

en.text: Twisting his neck [in arrogance] to mislead [people] from the way of Allāh. For him in the world is disgrace, and We will make him taste on the Day of Resurrection the punishment of the Burning Fire [while it is said],

so.text: 9. Dadbi luquntiisa (kibir darti, lunsan) oo ka lumiya (dadka) Jidka Alle. Kaasi waxaa u sugnaaday noloshan adduunka dulli, Waxaana dhadhansiin Maalinta Qiyaame cadaab wax gubta.

ayat.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ بِمَا قَدَّمَتۡ يَدَاكَ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَيۡسَ بِظَلَّٰمٖ لِّلۡعَبِيدِ

en.text: "That is for what your hands have put forth and because Allāh is not ever unjust to [His] servants."

so.text: 10. Arrinkani waa sababta waxay horey u geysteen gacmahaagu (oo denbiyo ah),  Alle ma dulmiyo addoomahiisa.

ayat.arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يَعۡبُدُ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ حَرۡفٖۖ فَإِنۡ أَصَابَهُۥ خَيۡرٌ ٱطۡمَأَنَّ بِهِۦۖ وَإِنۡ أَصَابَتۡهُ فِتۡنَةٌ ٱنقَلَبَ عَلَىٰ وَجۡهِهِۦ خَسِرَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَٱلۡأٓخِرَةَۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلۡخُسۡرَانُ ٱلۡمُبِينُ

en.text: And of the people is he who worships Allāh on an edge.[917] If he is touched by good, he is reassured by it; but if he is struck by trial, he turns on his face [to unbelief]. He has lost [this] world and the Hereafter. That is what is the manifest loss.
en.footnotes: [917] At the edge of his religion, so to speak, i.e., with uncertainty, hypocrisy or heedlessness.

so.text: 11. Waxaa ka mid ah dadka mid u caabuda Alle  si dhinac ka joog ah [1] 'shaki qaba'; hadduu khayr helo, ku xasila kheyrka (iyo diinta) haddiise la marsiiyo imtixaan, u gaddooma wejigiisa (gaalooba) wuxuu khasaaraa adduun iyo aakhiraba. Kaasi waa khasaaraha cad.
so.footnotes: [1]. Macnaha waa ka taagan qar diintiisa, waa qaba shaki, munaafiqnimo, ama dhoohnaan uu ka dhoohan yahay diintiisa aan dan u gelin inuu barto oo ku camal falo.

ayat.arabic: يَدۡعُواْ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَضُرُّهُۥ وَمَا لَا يَنفَعُهُۥۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلضَّلَٰلُ ٱلۡبَعِيدُ

en.text: He invokes instead of Allāh that which neither harms him nor benefits him. That is what is the extreme error.

so.text: 12. Wuxuu baryaa Alle sokadi waxaan wax yeeli karin waxna u tari karin, Kaasi waa habowga fog.

ayat.arabic: يَدۡعُواْ لَمَن ضَرُّهُۥٓ أَقۡرَبُ مِن نَّفۡعِهِۦۚ لَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡمَوۡلَىٰ وَلَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡعَشِيرُ

en.text: He invokes one whose harm is closer than his benefit - how wretched the protector and how wretched the associate.

so.text: 13. Wuxuu u yeedhaa oo baryaa mid dhibtiisu uga dhowdahay dheeftiisa; Isagaa u xun wax laga dhigto sokeeye, una xun wax laga dhigto xigaalo iyo saaxiib.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُدۡخِلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ جَنَّٰتٖ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَفۡعَلُ مَا يُرِيدُ

en.text: Indeed, Allāh will admit those who believe and do righteous deeds to gardens beneath which rivers flow. Indeed, Allāh does what He intends.

so.text: 14. Hubaal, Alle wuxuu gelin kuwa (Xaqa) rumeeyey oo samaha fala Jannooyin (beero) ay hoostoodu webiyo qul-qulaan. Hubaal Alle wuxuu Falaa wuxuu Doono.

ayat.arabic: مَن كَانَ يَظُنُّ أَن لَّن يَنصُرَهُ ٱللَّهُ فِي ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ فَلۡيَمۡدُدۡ بِسَبَبٍ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ ثُمَّ لۡيَقۡطَعۡ فَلۡيَنظُرۡ هَلۡ يُذۡهِبَنَّ كَيۡدُهُۥ مَا يَغِيظُ

en.text: Whoever should think that Allāh will not support him [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ)] in this world and the Hereafter - let him extend a rope to the ceiling, then cut off [his breath],[918] and let him see: will his effort remove that which enrages [him]?
en.footnotes: [918] i.e., strangle himself.

so.text: 15. Qofkii u malayn inaanu Alle u gargaarayn (Rasuulkiisa) adduun iyo aakhiraba, ha u fidsho wuxuun sabab ah xagga samada [2], markaas ha gooyo oo ha fiirsho inuu dhagartiisa ku ciil beelayo.
so.footnotes: [2]. Macnaha waa ha eego in sidaasi uu kaga go’ayo waxyiga iyo gargaarka Alle Nabiga ama inuu sidaas qofkaa uu ku ciil baxayo.

ayat.arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَنزَلۡنَٰهُ ءَايَٰتِۭ بَيِّنَٰتٖ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَهۡدِي مَن يُرِيدُ

en.text: And thus have We sent it [i.e., the Qur’ān] down as verses of clear evidence and because Allāh guides whom He intends.

so.text: 16. Sidaasaan u soo dejinnay (Qur’aankan) isagoo xujooyin cad ah, Allena wuxuu hanuuniyaa cidduu doono.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَٱلَّذِينَ هَادُواْ وَٱلصَّٰبِـِٔينَ وَٱلنَّصَٰرَىٰ وَٱلۡمَجُوسَ وَٱلَّذِينَ أَشۡرَكُوٓاْ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَفۡصِلُ بَيۡنَهُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ شَهِيدٌ

en.text: Indeed, those who have believed and those who were Jews and the Sabeans and the Christians and the Magians and those who associated with Allāh - Allāh will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed Allāh is, over all things, Witness.[919]
en.footnotes: [919] See footnote of 4:79.

so.text: 17. Hubaal, kuwa 'xaqa' rumeeyey (Muslimiinta) iyo kuwa heysta Yuhuudiyada, Saabi’iinta, Nasaarada, Majuusta iyo Mushrikiinta, Alle baa kala xukumi dhexdooda Maalinta Qiyaamaha. Alle wax walba waa ka Markhaati oo Arkaa.

ayat.arabic: أَلَمۡ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَسۡجُدُۤ لَهُۥۤ مَن فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَن فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَٱلشَّمۡسُ وَٱلۡقَمَرُ وَٱلنُّجُومُ وَٱلۡجِبَالُ وَٱلشَّجَرُ وَٱلدَّوَآبُّ وَكَثِيرٞ مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِۖ وَكَثِيرٌ حَقَّ عَلَيۡهِ ٱلۡعَذَابُۗ وَمَن يُهِنِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن مُّكۡرِمٍۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَفۡعَلُ مَا يَشَآءُ۩

en.text: Do you not see [i.e., know] that to Allāh prostrates whoever is in the heavens and whoever is on the earth and the sun, the moon, the stars, the mountains, the trees, the moving creatures and many of the people? But upon many the punishment has been justified.[920] And he whom Allāh humiliates - for him there is no bestower of honor. Indeed, Allāh does what He wills.
en.footnotes: [920] And therefore decreed.

so.text: 18. Miyaadan ogeyn inay Alle u sujuudaan (oo adeecaan) waxa ku sugan samooyinka iyo waxa ku sugan arlada: qorraxda,  dayaxa, xiddigaha, buuraha, geedaha, nafleyda dhul ku socodka ah, iyo in badan (oo dadka) ka mid ah, in badanna cadaabku u waajibay [3].  Qofkii uu Alle dulleeyo, ma leh wax darajeyn. Hubaal Alle wuxuu Falaa wuxuu doono.
so.footnotes: [3]. Oo sidaas awgeed loo qoray oo qaddaray.

ayat.arabic: ۞ هَٰذَانِ خَصۡمَانِ ٱخۡتَصَمُواْ فِي رَبِّهِمۡۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ قُطِّعَتۡ لَهُمۡ ثِيَابٞ مِّن نَّارٖ يُصَبُّ مِن فَوۡقِ رُءُوسِهِمُ ٱلۡحَمِيمُ

en.text: These[921] are two adversaries who have disputed over their Lord. But those who disbelieved will have cut out for them garments of fire. Poured upon their heads will be scalding water
en.footnotes: [921] i.e., the believers and the disbelievers.

so.text: 19. Kuwani [4] waa labo is-haya ee isku haya arrinka Rabbigood, kuwa gaaloobay waxaa loo goyn maryo Naar ah, waxaana lagu shubi madaxyadooda korkooda biyo kulul oo karaya .
so.footnotes: [4]. Waxaa loola jeedaa mu’miniinta iyo gaalada.

ayat.arabic: يُصۡهَرُ بِهِۦ مَا فِي بُطُونِهِمۡ وَٱلۡجُلُودُ

en.text: By which is melted that within their bellies and [their] skins.

so.text: 20. Waxaa lagula dhalaaliyaa waxa ku jira uurarkoooda iyo haragga (jirkooda).

ayat.arabic: وَلَهُم مَّقَٰمِعُ مِنۡ حَدِيدٖ

en.text: And for [striking] them are maces of iron.

so.text: 21. Waxay (gaaladu) ku mudan Naarta dubbayaal bir ah (oo lagu garaaco).

ayat.arabic: كُلَّمَآ أَرَادُوٓاْ أَن يَخۡرُجُواْ مِنۡهَا مِنۡ غَمٍّ أُعِيدُواْ فِيهَا وَذُوقُواْ عَذَابَ ٱلۡحَرِيقِ

en.text: Every time they want to get out of it [i.e., Hellfire] from anguish, they will be returned to it, and [it will be said], "Taste the punishment of the Burning Fire!"

so.text: 22. Mar kasta oo ay doonaan inay ka soo baxaan xaggeeda, murugada heysata darteed, dib baa loogu celiyaa (iyagoo lagu dhihi): “Dhadhamiya cadaabka gubashada leh."

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُدۡخِلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ جَنَّٰتٖ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ يُحَلَّوۡنَ فِيهَا مِنۡ أَسَاوِرَ مِن ذَهَبٖ وَلُؤۡلُؤٗاۖ وَلِبَاسُهُمۡ فِيهَا حَرِيرٞ

en.text: Indeed, Allāh will admit those who believe and do righteous deeds to gardens beneath which rivers flow. They will be adorned therein with bracelets of gold and pearl, and their garments therein will be silk.

so.text: 23. Hubaal, Alle  wuxuu gelin kuwa Xaqa rumeeyey oo samaha fala Jannooyin (beero) ay hoostoodu webiyo qul-qulaan, waxaa loo xidhi gudaheeda qurxin darteed jijimo dahab iyo luul ah, dharkooduna gudaheeda waa xadhiidh.

ayat.arabic: وَهُدُوٓاْ إِلَى ٱلطَّيِّبِ مِنَ ٱلۡقَوۡلِ وَهُدُوٓاْ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلۡحَمِيدِ

en.text: And they had been guided [in worldly life] to good speech, and they were guided to the path of the Praiseworthy.

so.text: 24. Waxaa lagu hanuuniyaa hadalka kiisa wanaagsan,  waxaana lagu hanuuniyaa Jidka la mahdiyo (waa Islaamka ee lagu galo Jannada).

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَيَصُدُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلۡمَسۡجِدِ ٱلۡحَرَامِ ٱلَّذِي جَعَلۡنَٰهُ لِلنَّاسِ سَوَآءً ٱلۡعَٰكِفُ فِيهِ وَٱلۡبَادِۚ وَمَن يُرِدۡ فِيهِ بِإِلۡحَادِۭ بِظُلۡمٖ نُّذِقۡهُ مِنۡ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٖ

en.text: Indeed, those who have disbelieved and avert [people] from the way of Allāh and [from] al-Masjid al-Ḥarām, which We made for the people - equal are the resident therein and one from outside - and [also] whoever intends [a deed] therein[922] of deviation [in religion] by wrongdoing - We will make him taste of a painful punishment.
en.footnotes: [922] Whether inside its boundaries or intending from afar to do evil therein. The Ḥaram is unique in that the mere intention of sin therein (whether or not it is actually carried out) is sufficient to bring punishment from Allāh.

so.text: 25. Hubaal, kuwa gaalooba oo ka hor istaaga (dadka) Jidka Alle iyo Masjidka Xaramka oo aan ka yeelnay (wax u furan) oo ay u siman yihiin dadka oo dhan, kan deggan dhexdeeda [5] iyo soo booqdahaba. Qofkii u liicda xume fal uu ka sameeyo dhexdeeda xaq darro, Waxaan dhadhansiin cadaab xanuun badan.
so.footnotes: [5]. Ama ha joogo markaa xuduuddeeda gudaheeda ama ha ka soo damco meel fog oo ka baxsan xuduuddeeda inuu ku sameeyo xumaan gudaheeda. Xaramku waa kaga duwan yahay arrinkan meelaha kale oo dhan, doonis keliya inuu qofku xumaan ku sameeyo (ama ha falo amase yuusan falin) ku filan inay u keento ciqaabka Alle.

ayat.arabic: وَإِذۡ بَوَّأۡنَا لِإِبۡرَٰهِيمَ مَكَانَ ٱلۡبَيۡتِ أَن لَّا تُشۡرِكۡ بِي شَيۡـٔٗا وَطَهِّرۡ بَيۡتِيَ لِلطَّآئِفِينَ وَٱلۡقَآئِمِينَ وَٱلرُّكَّعِ ٱلسُّجُودِ

en.text: And [mention, O Muḥammad], when We designated for Abraham the site of the House, [saying], "Do not associate anything with Me and purify My House for those who perform ṭawāf[923] and those who stand [in prayer] and those who bow and prostrate.
en.footnotes: [923] See footnote to 2:125.

so.text: 26. (Xus, Nabi Muxammadow) markaan u cayinnay Ibraahiim halka Beytka (Kacbada), Annagoo leh: “Ha ila wadaajin (cibaadada) waxba, una daahiri Baytkayga (Kacbada) kuwa dawaafi iyo kuwa u istaagi inay ku tukadaan iyo kuwa rukuuca ee sujuuda.”

ayat.arabic: وَأَذِّن فِي ٱلنَّاسِ بِٱلۡحَجِّ يَأۡتُوكَ رِجَالٗا وَعَلَىٰ كُلِّ ضَامِرٖ يَأۡتِينَ مِن كُلِّ فَجٍّ عَمِيقٖ

en.text: And proclaim to the people the ḥajj [pilgrimage]; they will come to you on foot and on every lean camel; they will come from every distant pass -

so.text: 27. Ogeysiina dadka Xajka, waxay kuugu imaan lug iyo iyagoo fuushan rukuub kasta  (oo munaasib ah), waxay ka imaan tub kasta oo fog.

ayat.arabic: لِّيَشۡهَدُواْ مَنَٰفِعَ لَهُمۡ وَيَذۡكُرُواْ ٱسۡمَ ٱللَّهِ فِيٓ أَيَّامٖ مَّعۡلُومَٰتٍ عَلَىٰ مَا رَزَقَهُم مِّنۢ بَهِيمَةِ ٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمِۖ فَكُلُواْ مِنۡهَا وَأَطۡعِمُواْ ٱلۡبَآئِسَ ٱلۡفَقِيرَ

en.text: That they may witness [i.e., attend] benefits for themselves and mention the name of Allāh on known [i.e., specific] days over what He has provided for them of [sacrificial] animals.[924] So eat of them and feed the miserable and poor.
en.footnotes: [924] Al-anʿām: camels, cattle, sheep and goats.

so.text: 28. Inay goob joogaan ka ahaadaan waxyaalo manaafacaad u leh darteed, oo ay ugu xusaan Magaca Alle maalmo la yaqaan [6] wuxuu siiyey oo xoolaha nicmooleyda ah, ee wax ka cuna, waxna ka siiya tabaaleysanaha, faqiirka.
so.footnotes: [6]. Waa maalinta ciidda Carrafo iyo maalmaha tashriiqa ( hilba waradka) waa maalmaha 11, 12, 13 bisha Dul Xijjah.

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ لۡيَقۡضُواْ تَفَثَهُمۡ وَلۡيُوفُواْ نُذُورَهُمۡ وَلۡيَطَّوَّفُواْ بِٱلۡبَيۡتِ ٱلۡعَتِيقِ

en.text: Then let them end their untidiness and fulfill their vows and perform ṭawāf around the ancient House."

so.text: 29. Markaas ha dhammeeyaan basaastooda [7], hana oofiyeen nidarraooda, oo ha ku dawaafeen Baytka horreeyey (Kacbada).
so.footnotes: [7]. Waxaa loola jeedaa ha dhammeeyaan basaastooda halkan howlaha ay u baahan yihiin ee leh xiiridda timaha, jaridda ciddiyaha, is nadiifinta, iwm.

ayat.arabic: ذَٰلِكَۖ وَمَن يُعَظِّمۡ حُرُمَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ فَهُوَ خَيۡرٞ لَّهُۥ عِندَ رَبِّهِۦۗ وَأُحِلَّتۡ لَكُمُ ٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمُ إِلَّا مَا يُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡكُمۡۖ فَٱجۡتَنِبُواْ ٱلرِّجۡسَ مِنَ ٱلۡأَوۡثَٰنِ وَٱجۡتَنِبُواْ قَوۡلَ ٱلزُّورِ

en.text: That [has been commanded], and whoever honors the sacred ordinances of Allāh - it is best for him in the sight of his Lord. And permitted to you are the grazing livestock, except what is recited to you.[925] So avoid the uncleanliness of idols and avoid false statement,

so.text: 30. Waa sidaase, qofkii weyneeya oo iska jira waxyaalahuu Alle caagay [8], isagay khayr u tahay Rabbigi agtiis. Waxaa la idiin xalaaleeyay xoolaha nicmooleyda ah, marka laga reebo (waxa la idinku dul) akhiryo 'oo laga soo reebay' [9] Ee ka fogaada waxa xun ee faddarada ah (caabudidda) sanamyada, kana fogaada hadalka beenta ah.
so.footnotes:
[8]. Xurumaat ee ku soo  arooray Aayadda waxaa loola jeedaa  bilaha xurmadda gaarka ah leh waa: Muxarram, Rajab, Dul Qicdah, iyo Dul Xijjah, waxyaalaha la reebay gaar ahaan bilahaas iyo guud ahaan bilaha oo dhanba. Waxaa sidoo kale loola jeedaa dhulka Xaramka ee ka caaggan in xitaa la damco in xumo lagu falo, waa Kacbada, maqaamu Ibraahiim, xuduudda Xaramka, iwm. Eeg Suuradda 2 Al-Baqara , Aayadda 191.
[9]. Eeg Suuradda 5: Aayadda 3.

ayat.arabic: حُنَفَآءَ لِلَّهِ غَيۡرَ مُشۡرِكِينَ بِهِۦۚ وَمَن يُشۡرِكۡ بِٱللَّهِ فَكَأَنَّمَا خَرَّ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَتَخۡطَفُهُ ٱلطَّيۡرُ أَوۡ تَهۡوِي بِهِ ٱلرِّيحُ فِي مَكَانٖ سَحِيقٖ

en.text: Inclining [only] to Allāh, not associating [anything] with Him. And he who associates with Allāh - it is as though he had fallen from the sky and was snatched by the birds or the wind carried him down into a remote place.

so.text: 31. Idinkoo u toosan Alle, oo aan la wadaajin cidna cibaadada. Qofkii Alle la wadaajiya cid kale cibaadada, wuxuu la mid yahay sida mid ka soo dhacay samada oo ay kala dafayaan shimbiruhu, ama sida mid ay ku tuurayso dabeyshu meel gun dheer oo fog.

ayat.arabic: ذَٰلِكَۖ وَمَن يُعَظِّمۡ شَعَٰٓئِرَ ٱللَّهِ فَإِنَّهَا مِن تَقۡوَى ٱلۡقُلُوبِ

en.text: That [is so]. And whoever honors the symbols [i.e., rites] of Allāh - indeed, it is from the piety of hearts.

so.text: 32. Waa sidaase, qofkii weyneeya (sharciga iyo) calaamooyinka Alle [10], tani waa camal muujinaya Alle ka cabsiga quluubta.
so.footnotes: [10]. Shacaa’irallaah waxaa loola jeedaa acmaasha Xajka iyo meelaha lagu cibaadeysto iyo cilmiga sharciga iyo culimada aqoonta u leh diinta ee ku camal fala ee towxiidka heysta oo ka fog shirkiga iyo macaasida, xalaasha quuta, oo hoos isu dhiga, una jajaban dadka.

ayat.arabic: لَكُمۡ فِيهَا مَنَٰفِعُ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٖ مُّسَمّٗى ثُمَّ مَحِلُّهَآ إِلَى ٱلۡبَيۡتِ ٱلۡعَتِيقِ

en.text: For you therein [i.e., the animals marked for sacrifice] are benefits for a specified term;[926] then their place of sacrifice is at the ancient House.[927]
en.footnotes:
[926] i.e., they may be milked or ridden (in the case of camels) before the time of slaughter.
[927] i.e., within the boundaries of the Ḥaram, which includes Minā.

so.text: 33. Waxaa idiinku sugan (xoolaha loo bixiyey sadaqada - hadyiga) manaafacaad tan iyo muddo magacaaban ah [11], markaas waxaa loo keenaa gowrac Baytka da’da weyn [12].
so.footnotes:
[11]. Waxaa loola jeedaa hadyiga, waa lagu intifaaci karaa ka hor inta aan la gowricin sida in la listo caanahooda, ama la fuulo, iwm ilaa maalinta gowraca. 
[12]. Xuduudda Xaramka, waxaana soo galaya sidoo kale Mina.

ayat.arabic: وَلِكُلِّ أُمَّةٖ جَعَلۡنَا مَنسَكٗا لِّيَذۡكُرُواْ ٱسۡمَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَىٰ مَا رَزَقَهُم مِّنۢ بَهِيمَةِ ٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمِۗ فَإِلَٰهُكُمۡ إِلَٰهٞ وَٰحِدٞ فَلَهُۥٓ أَسۡلِمُواْۗ وَبَشِّرِ ٱلۡمُخۡبِتِينَ

en.text: And for every [religious] community We have appointed a rite [of sacrifice][928] that they may mention the name of Allāh over what He has provided for them of [sacrificial] animals. For your god is one God, so to Him submit. And, [O Muḥammad], give good tidings to the humble [before their Lord]
en.footnotes: [928] i.e., the rite of sacrifice has always been a part of Allāh's revealed religion.

so.text: 34. Ummad walba waxaan u yeellay cibaado [13] 'ciid', si ay ugu xusaan Magaca Alle waxa uu siiyey ee xoolaha nicmooleyda ah. Ilaahiinnu waa Ilaah Keliya (Allaah) ee u hoggaansama oo u bishaaree kal samayaasha.
so.footnotes: [13]. Xagga hadyiga waxay ahayd mar waliba qayb ka mid ah diinta uu Alle soo waxyooday.

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِرَ ٱللَّهُ وَجِلَتۡ قُلُوبُهُمۡ وَٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ عَلَىٰ مَآ أَصَابَهُمۡ وَٱلۡمُقِيمِي ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَمِمَّا رَزَقۡنَٰهُمۡ يُنفِقُونَ

en.text: Who, when Allāh is mentioned, their hearts are fearful, and [to] the patient over what has afflicted them, and the establishers of prayer and those who spend from what We have provided them.

so.text: 35. Ee ah kuwa marka la xuso Alle ay baqo ka buuxsanto quluubtoodu, kuna samra waxa ku dhaca (oo musiiba ah) ee ooga salaadda, waxa aan siinnayna wax ka bixiya.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلۡبُدۡنَ جَعَلۡنَٰهَا لَكُم مِّن شَعَٰٓئِرِ ٱللَّهِ لَكُمۡ فِيهَا خَيۡرٞۖ فَٱذۡكُرُواْ ٱسۡمَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيۡهَا صَوَآفَّۖ فَإِذَا وَجَبَتۡ جُنُوبُهَا فَكُلُواْ مِنۡهَا وَأَطۡعِمُواْ ٱلۡقَانِعَ وَٱلۡمُعۡتَرَّۚ كَذَٰلِكَ سَخَّرۡنَٰهَا لَكُمۡ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَشۡكُرُونَ

en.text: And the camels and cattle We have appointed for you as among the symbols [i.e., rites] of Allāh; for you therein is good. So mention the name of Allāh upon them when lined up [for sacrifice]; and when they are [lifeless] on their sides, then eat from them and feed the needy [who does not seek aid] and the beggar. Thus have We subjected them to you that you may be grateful.

so.text: 36. Ishkinka (xoolaha waaweyn ee loo loogo hadyi ahaanta - lo'da iyo geela) waxaan idiinka yeelnay wax ka mid ah calaamooyinka (diinta) Alle, waxaa idiinku sugan khayr badan, ee ku xusa Magaca Alle korkeeda iyadoo jilib xidhan [14], markay u dhacdo dhinacna (waa idiin xalaal), ee wax ka cuna, oo wax ka quudiya miskiinka dhowrsoon iyo weydiistaha. Sidaasaan idiinku sakhirnay si aad ugu mahdisaan (Alle).
so.footnotes: [14]. Geela waxaa la bireeyaa iyagoo taagan.

ayat.arabic: لَن يَنَالَ ٱللَّهَ لُحُومُهَا وَلَا دِمَآؤُهَا وَلَٰكِن يَنَالُهُ ٱلتَّقۡوَىٰ مِنكُمۡۚ كَذَٰلِكَ سَخَّرَهَا لَكُمۡ لِتُكَبِّرُواْ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ مَا هَدَىٰكُمۡۗ وَبَشِّرِ ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ

en.text: Their meat will not reach Allāh, nor will their blood, but what reaches Him is piety from you. Thus have We subjected them to you that you may glorify Allāh for that [to] which He has guided you; and give good tidings to the doers of good.

so.text: 37. Ma gaadho Alle hilibkeedu iyo dhiiggeedu, waxase gaadha ee aqbalka ah Xaggiisa waa ka dhowrsoonidiinna (xumaha). Sidaasuu idiinku sakhiray si aad u weyneysaan Alle hanuunka uu idin hanuuniyey darteed. U bishaaree sama falayaasha.

ayat.arabic: ۞ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُدَٰفِعُ عَنِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ خَوَّانٖ كَفُورٍ

en.text: Indeed, Allāh defends those who have believed. Indeed, Allāh does not like everyone treacherous and ungrateful.

so.text: 38. Xaqiiq Alle wuu difaacaa addoomahiisa rumeysan. Xaqiiq, Alle ma jecla mid kastoo khiyaano badan, abaal dhac badan.

ayat.arabic: أُذِنَ لِلَّذِينَ يُقَٰتَلُونَ بِأَنَّهُمۡ ظُلِمُواْۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ نَصۡرِهِمۡ لَقَدِيرٌ

en.text: Permission [to fight] has been given to those who are being fought,[929] because they were wronged. And indeed, Allāh is competent to give them victory.
en.footnotes: [929] Referring here to the Prophet's companions.

so.text: 39. Waxaa loo idmay kuwa lala dagaallami 'inay dagaallamaan' [15] waayo waa la dulmiyey. Alle wuu Karaa inuu guul siiyo.
so.footnotes: [15]. Waxaa loola jeedaa halkan asxaabtii Nabiga s.c.w.

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ أُخۡرِجُواْ مِن دِيَٰرِهِم بِغَيۡرِ حَقٍّ إِلَّآ أَن يَقُولُواْ رَبُّنَا ٱللَّهُۗ وَلَوۡلَا دَفۡعُ ٱللَّهِ ٱلنَّاسَ بَعۡضَهُم بِبَعۡضٖ لَّهُدِّمَتۡ صَوَٰمِعُ وَبِيَعٞ وَصَلَوَٰتٞ وَمَسَٰجِدُ يُذۡكَرُ فِيهَا ٱسۡمُ ٱللَّهِ كَثِيرٗاۗ وَلَيَنصُرَنَّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَنصُرُهُۥٓۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَقَوِيٌّ عَزِيزٌ

en.text: [They are] those who have been evicted from their homes without right - only because they say, "Our Lord is Allāh." And were it not that Allāh checks the people, some by means of others, there would have been demolished monasteries, churches, synagogues, and mosques in which the name of Allāh is much mentioned [i.e., praised]. And Allāh will surely support those who support Him [i.e., His cause]. Indeed, Allāh is Powerful and Exalted in Might.

so.text: 40. Kuwa looga soo saaray guryahoodii xaq darro iyagoon waxba geysan, inay yidhaahdeen maahee: Rabbigayo waa Allaah.” Haddayna jirin ku difaacidda Alle dadka qaarkoodba qaar, waxaa la dumin lahaa sawmacado, kaniisado, macaabid, iyo masaajid gudahooda Magaca Alle in badan lagu xuso. Alle wuu u gargaari kuwa u gargaara (Diintiisa), hubaal Alle waa Xoog Badane, Adkaada.

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ إِن مَّكَّنَّٰهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ أَقَامُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتَوُاْ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَمَرُواْ بِٱلۡمَعۡرُوفِ وَنَهَوۡاْ عَنِ ٱلۡمُنكَرِۗ وَلِلَّهِ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلۡأُمُورِ

en.text: [And they are] those who, if We give them authority in the land, establish prayer and give zakāh and enjoin what is right and forbid what is wrong. And to Allāh belongs the outcome of [all] matters.

so.text: 41. Kuwa haddaan ku siinno awood arlada, ooga salaadda, bixiya Zakada, oo amra wanaagga, oo reeba xumaha. Alle baa ka taliya aayaha arrimaha oo idil.

ayat.arabic: وَإِن يُكَذِّبُوكَ فَقَدۡ كَذَّبَتۡ قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمُ نُوحٖ وَعَادٞ وَثَمُودُ

en.text: And if they deny you, [O Muḥammad] - so, before them, did the people of Noah and ʿAad and Thamūd deny [their prophets],

so.text: 42. Hadday ku beeniyaan (Nabiyow), waxaa hortood beeniyey qolodii Nuux, Caad, iyo Thamuud,

ayat.arabic: وَقَوۡمُ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ وَقَوۡمُ لُوطٖ

en.text: And the people of Abraham and the people of Lot

so.text: 43. Iyo qolodii Ibraahiim iyo qolodii Luud,

ayat.arabic: وَأَصۡحَٰبُ مَدۡيَنَۖ وَكُذِّبَ مُوسَىٰۖ فَأَمۡلَيۡتُ لِلۡكَٰفِرِينَ ثُمَّ أَخَذۡتُهُمۡۖ فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ

en.text: And the inhabitants of Madyan. And Moses was denied, so I prolonged enjoyment for the disbelievers; then I seized them, and how [terrible] was My reproach.

so.text: 44. Iyo reer Madyan, Muusena (sidoo kale) waa la beeniyey, markaasaan u seeto dheereeyey gaaladii, ka dambowna qabtay, ee sidee ahaa Ciqaabkeygii.

ayat.arabic: فَكَأَيِّن مِّن قَرۡيَةٍ أَهۡلَكۡنَٰهَا وَهِيَ ظَالِمَةٞ فَهِيَ خَاوِيَةٌ عَلَىٰ عُرُوشِهَا وَبِئۡرٖ مُّعَطَّلَةٖ وَقَصۡرٖ مَّشِيدٍ

en.text: And how many a city did We destroy while it was committing wrong - so it is [now] fallen into ruin[930] - and [how many] an abandoned well and [how many] a lofty palace.[931]
en.footnotes:
[930] Literally, "fallen in upon its roofs," i.e., after the roofs of its buildings had caved in, the walls collapsed over them.
[931] i.e., How many wells have been left inoperative, and how many palaces have been emptied of their occupants in the past.

so.text:
45. Badanaa inta magaalo aan halaagnay iyadoo dulmi fali, sidaa darteed iyadu ku dambeysay burbur (ilaa iyo maanta), 
 badanaana inta ceel laga qaxay iyo daaro waaweyn.

ayat.arabic: أَفَلَمۡ يَسِيرُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَتَكُونَ لَهُمۡ قُلُوبٞ يَعۡقِلُونَ بِهَآ أَوۡ ءَاذَانٞ يَسۡمَعُونَ بِهَاۖ فَإِنَّهَا لَا تَعۡمَى ٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرُ وَلَٰكِن تَعۡمَى ٱلۡقُلُوبُ ٱلَّتِي فِي ٱلصُّدُورِ

en.text: So have they not traveled through the earth and have hearts by which to reason and ears by which to hear? For indeed, it is not eyes that are blinded, but blinded are the hearts which are within the breasts.

so.text: 46. Miyeyna marin dhulka, si ay u yeeshaan qalbiyo ay wax ku gartaan ama dhego ay wax ku maqlaan? Hubaal, Ma aha indha beel isha oo arag beesha, ee indha beelka dhabta ah waa arag beelka quluubta ku jira laabaha.

ayat.arabic: وَيَسۡتَعۡجِلُونَكَ بِٱلۡعَذَابِ وَلَن يُخۡلِفَ ٱللَّهُ وَعۡدَهُۥۚ وَإِنَّ يَوۡمًا عِندَ رَبِّكَ كَأَلۡفِ سَنَةٖ مِّمَّا تَعُدُّونَ

en.text: And they urge you to hasten the punishment. But Allāh will never fail in His promise. And indeed, a day with your Lord is like a thousand years of those which you count.

so.text: 47. Waxay kaa dalbaan inaad u soo dedejiso cadaabka. Allena kama baxo Ballankiisa. Hubaal, maalin Rabbigaa agtiis ah waxay la mid tahay kun sano waxaad idinku tirsataan.

ayat.arabic: وَكَأَيِّن مِّن قَرۡيَةٍ أَمۡلَيۡتُ لَهَا وَهِيَ ظَالِمَةٞ ثُمَّ أَخَذۡتُهَا وَإِلَيَّ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ

en.text: And for how many a city did I prolong enjoyment while it was committing wrong. Then I seized it, and to Me is the [final] destination.

so.text: 48. Badanaa inta magaalo aan u seeto dheereeyey iyadoo la ceegaagan dulmi, kaddib aan qabtay, waana Xaggeyga halka loo soo laabmayo.

ayat.arabic: قُلۡ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ لَكُمۡ نَذِيرٞ مُّبِينٞ

en.text: Say, "O people, I am only to you a clear warner."

so.text: 49. Dheh: "Dadow! Waxaan uun anigu idiin ahay Dige Cad (ka digaya cadaab daran)".

ayat.arabic: فَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُم مَّغۡفِرَةٞ وَرِزۡقٞ كَرِيمٞ

en.text: And those who have believed and done righteous deeds - for them is forgiveness and noble provision.

so.text: 50. Kuwa (Xaqa) rumeeyey oo samaha fala, waxay leeyhiin denbi dhaaf iyo risiq wanaagsan (Jannada gudaheeda).

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ سَعَوۡاْ فِيٓ ءَايَٰتِنَا مُعَٰجِزِينَ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ

en.text: But the ones who strove against Our verses, [seeking] to cause failure[932] - those are the companions of Hellfire.
en.footnotes: [932] i.e., trying to undermine their credibility and thereby defeat the Prophet (ﷺ).

so.text: 51. Kuwase u xusul duubta ka hortagga Aayadahayaga, kuwaasi waa ehlu Naarka.

ayat.arabic: وَمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مِن قَبۡلِكَ مِن رَّسُولٖ وَلَا نَبِيٍّ إِلَّآ إِذَا تَمَنَّىٰٓ أَلۡقَى ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ فِيٓ أُمۡنِيَّتِهِۦ فَيَنسَخُ ٱللَّهُ مَا يُلۡقِي ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ ثُمَّ يُحۡكِمُ ٱللَّهُ ءَايَٰتِهِۦۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٞ

en.text: And We did not send before you any messenger or prophet except that when he spoke [or recited], Satan threw into it [some misunderstanding]. But Allāh abolishes that which Satan throws in; then Allāh makes precise His verses.[933] And Allāh is Knowing and Wise.
en.footnotes: [933] Clarifying those issues which were misunderstood to remove any doubt.

so.text: 52. Ma aanu soo dirin hortaa Rasuul ama Nabi aan markuu hadlayey (ama wax akhrinayey) aanu wax ku tuurin sheydaanku akhrintiisa, wuxuuse Alle nasakhaa oo tiraa waxa uu shaydaan soo tuuro, markaa Alle sugaa Aayadahiisa [16]. Alle waa wax kasta Oge, Xakiim ah.
so.footnotes: [16]. Markuu Nabigu s.c.w. akhriyo Aayad loogu digayo gaalada, waxay gaaladu ku kordhin jireen waxaan jirin ama u fasiri jireen si kale, markaasuu Alle caddeeyaa arrimahaa khaladka loo fahmay si uu meesha uga saaro wax mugdi ah ama shaki.

ayat.arabic: لِّيَجۡعَلَ مَا يُلۡقِي ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ فِتۡنَةٗ لِّلَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٞ وَٱلۡقَاسِيَةِ قُلُوبُهُمۡۗ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ لَفِي شِقَاقِۭ بَعِيدٖ

en.text: [That is] so He may make what Satan throws in [i.e., asserts] a trial for those within whose hearts is disease[934] and those hard of heart. And indeed, the wrongdoers are in extreme dissension.
en.footnotes: [934] See footnote to 2:10.

so.text: 53. Waa si u ugaga yeelo waxa uu Shaydaanku soo tuuro imtixaan kuwa uu ku jiro quluubtoodu cudur iyo kuwa quluubtoodu adag yihiin. Daalimiintu (gaalada) waxay ku sugan yihiin gaalnimo iyo khilaaf fog.

ayat.arabic: وَلِيَعۡلَمَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡعِلۡمَ أَنَّهُ ٱلۡحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكَ فَيُؤۡمِنُواْ بِهِۦ فَتُخۡبِتَ لَهُۥ قُلُوبُهُمۡۗ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَهَادِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٖ مُّسۡتَقِيمٖ

en.text: And so those who were given knowledge may know that it is the truth from your Lord and [therefore] believe in it, and their hearts humbly submit to it. And indeed is Allāh the Guide of those who have believed to a straight path.
