so.text: 54. Waa si ay u ogaadaan kuwa la siiyey cilmiga inuu (Qur’aankani) yahay xaq ka yimid Rabbigaa, oo ay rumeeyaan oo ay u khushuucdo quluubtoodu. Hubaal Alle wuu ku hanuunin kuwa rumeeyey (Xaqa) Jid Toosan (Islaamka).

ayat.arabic: وَلَا يَزَالُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فِي مِرۡيَةٖ مِّنۡهُ حَتَّىٰ تَأۡتِيَهُمُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ بَغۡتَةً أَوۡ يَأۡتِيَهُمۡ عَذَابُ يَوۡمٍ عَقِيمٍ

en.text: But those who disbelieve will not cease to be in doubt of it until the Hour comes upon them unexpectedly or there comes to them the punishment of a barren Day.[935]
en.footnotes: [935] One which will not be followed by night and therefore will not give birth to a new day, referring to the Day of Resurrection.

so.text: 55. Kuwa gaaloobana ma deyn doonaan inay shaki ka qabaan (Qur’aankani) jeer ay Saacdda (Qiyaame) ugu timaaddo kedis ama u timaado cadaab Maalin daran oo maalin kale ka dambeyn [17].
so.footnotes: [17]. Maalin daran oo ma dhaleys ah waa maalin aan habeen ka dambeyn, sidaas darteed aan dhali doonin maalin cusub, waxaana loola jeedaa Maalinta Qiyaamaha

ayat.arabic: ٱلۡمُلۡكُ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلَّهِ يَحۡكُمُ بَيۡنَهُمۡۚ فَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فِي جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ

en.text: [All] sovereignty that Day is for Allāh;[936] He will judge between them. So they who believed and did righteous deeds will be in the Gardens of Pleasure.
en.footnotes: [936] None will compete with Him for authority at that time.

so.text: 56. Xukunka Maalinkaas waxaa iska leh Allaah, Wuxuu kala xukumi dhexdooda.  Kuwa (Xaqa) rumeeyey ee samaha fala waxay geli beeraha barwaaqada ah (Janno).

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَكَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٞ مُّهِينٞ

en.text: And they who disbelieved and denied Our signs - for those there will be a humiliating punishment.

so.text: 57. Kuwase gaalooba ee beeniya Aayadahayaga, kuwaa weeye kuwa leh cadaab dulleysa.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هَاجَرُواْ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ قُتِلُوٓاْ أَوۡ مَاتُواْ لَيَرۡزُقَنَّهُمُ ٱللَّهُ رِزۡقًا حَسَنٗاۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَهُوَ خَيۡرُ ٱلرَّٰزِقِينَ

en.text: And those who emigrated for the cause of Allāh and then were killed or died - Allāh will surely provide for them a good provision. And indeed, it is Allāh who is the best of providers.

so.text: 58. Kuwa u soo haajira Alle darti, markaa la dilo ama dhinta, Wuxuu Alle siin risiq wanaagsan. Alle waa Kan u wanaagsan inta bixisa risiqa.

ayat.arabic: لَيُدۡخِلَنَّهُم مُّدۡخَلٗا يَرۡضَوۡنَهُۥۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلِيمٌ حَلِيمٞ

en.text: He will surely cause them to enter an entrance with which they will be pleased, and indeed, Allāh is Knowing and Forbearing.

so.text: 59. Wuxuu galin meel gelitaan ay ka raalli noqon (Janno). Alle waa wax kasta Ogsoone, Dul qaad Badan.

ayat.arabic: ۞ ذَٰلِكَۖ وَمَنۡ عَاقَبَ بِمِثۡلِ مَا عُوقِبَ بِهِۦ ثُمَّ بُغِيَ عَلَيۡهِ لَيَنصُرَنَّهُ ٱللَّهُۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَعَفُوٌّ غَفُورٞ

en.text: That [is so]. And whoever responds [to injustice] with the equivalent of that with which he was harmed and then is tyrannized - Allāh will surely aid him. Indeed, Allāh is Pardoning and Forgiving.[937]
en.footnotes: [937] In spite of His ability to take vengeance. The statement contains a suggestion that the believers pardon as well.

so.text: 60. Waa sidaase, kan isagu ku aar guta intii gef loo geystey in le’eg, kaasoo lagu gardarrooday, hubaal Alle wuu u gargaari. Hubaal Alle waa Cafis Badane, Denbi Dhaaf Badan [18].
so.footnotes: [18]. Isagoo awooda inuu aar guto. Waxaa laga qaadanayaa Aayadda inay sidoo kale mu’miniinta wax cafiyaan iyagoo aar goosan kara.

ayat.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُولِجُ ٱلَّيۡلَ فِي ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فِي ٱلَّيۡلِ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعُۢ بَصِيرٞ

en.text: That[938] is because Allāh causes the night to enter the day and causes the day to enter the night and because Allāh is Hearing and Seeing.
en.footnotes: [938] i.e., Allāh's capability to give assistance or victory to the oppressed.

so.text: 61. Arrinkani waxaa ku wacan inuu Alle habeenka dhex geliyo maalinta, maalintana  dhex geliyo habeenka (kala badiyo), Allena waa wax kasta Maqle, wax kasta Arka.

ayat.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلۡحَقُّ وَأَنَّ مَا يَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِهِۦ هُوَ ٱلۡبَٰطِلُ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلۡعَلِيُّ ٱلۡكَبِيرُ

en.text: That is because Allāh is the True Reality, and that which they call upon other than Him is falsehood, and because Allāh is the Most High, the Grand.

so.text: 62. Arrinkani waxaa ku wacan waa in Alle uu yahay Xaq, iyo in waxay baryaan (caabudaan) sokadi uu yahay Baadil, iyo in Alle yahay Sarreeyaha, Weyn .

ayat.arabic: أَلَمۡ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءٗ فَتُصۡبِحُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ مُخۡضَرَّةًۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَطِيفٌ خَبِيرٞ

en.text: Do you not see that Allāh has sent down rain from the sky and the earth becomes green? Indeed, Allāh is Subtle[939] and Aware.[940]
en.footnotes:
[939] Refer to footnote of 6:103.
[940] Of His creation and of the needs of His creatures.

so.text: 63. Miyaanad arag inuu Alle ka soo dejiyo biyo (roob) daruuraha, markaas dhulku noqdo doog? Hubaal, Alle waa Roonaan Badane, Xog-Ogaal ah.

ayat.arabic: لَّهُۥ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَهُوَ ٱلۡغَنِيُّ ٱلۡحَمِيدُ

en.text: To Him belongs what is in the heavens and what is on the earth. And indeed, Allāh is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy.

so.text: 64. Wuxuu leeyahay waxa ku sugan samooyinka iyo waxa ku sugan arlada. Hubaal, Alle waa Hodonka (ka deeqtoon wax waliba) la ammaanoo Mahadsan.

ayat.arabic: أَلَمۡ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَخَّرَ لَكُم مَّا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَٱلۡفُلۡكَ تَجۡرِي فِي ٱلۡبَحۡرِ بِأَمۡرِهِۦ وَيُمۡسِكُ ٱلسَّمَآءَ أَن تَقَعَ عَلَى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ إِلَّا بِإِذۡنِهِۦٓۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِٱلنَّاسِ لَرَءُوفٞ رَّحِيمٞ

en.text: Do you not see that Allāh has subjected to you whatever is on the earth and the ships which run through the sea by His command? And He restrains the sky from falling upon the earth, unless by His permission. Indeed Allāh, to the people, is Kind and Merciful.

so.text: 65. Miyaanad arag inuu Alle idiin sakhiray waxa ku sugan dhulka, iyo doonyaha ku socda badda Amarkiisa? Wuxuuna ka hayaa cirka inuu ku soo dhaco dhulka Isagoo idmo ma ahee. Alle waa Mid dadka u Turid iyo Naxariis Badan.

ayat.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَحۡيَاكُمۡ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمۡ ثُمَّ يُحۡيِيكُمۡۗ إِنَّ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ لَكَفُورٞ

en.text: And He is the one who gave you life; then He causes you to die and then will [again] give you life. Indeed, mankind is ungrateful.

so.text: 66. Waa Isaga 'Alle' Kan idin nooleeya, haddana idin dhinsiiya, haddana idin soo nooleyn mar kale (Qiyaamaha). Aadmigu xaqiiq waa mid abaal dhac badan.

ayat.arabic: لِّكُلِّ أُمَّةٖ جَعَلۡنَا مَنسَكًا هُمۡ نَاسِكُوهُۖ فَلَا يُنَٰزِعُنَّكَ فِي ٱلۡأَمۡرِۚ وَٱدۡعُ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَۖ إِنَّكَ لَعَلَىٰ هُدٗى مُّسۡتَقِيمٖ

en.text: For every [religious] community We have appointed rites which they perform. So, [O Muḥammad], let them [i.e., the disbelievers] not contend with you over the matter but invite [them] to your Lord. Indeed, you are upon straight guidance.

so.text: 67. Ummad walba waxaan u yeellay hab cibaado oo ay ku cibaadeystaan ee yeyna kugula doodin arrinka, oo ugu yeedh xagga Rabbigaa. Hubaal, Adigu waxaad ku sugan tahay hanuun toosan.

ayat.arabic: وَإِن جَٰدَلُوكَ فَقُلِ ٱللَّهُ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ

en.text: And if they dispute with you, then say, "Allāh is most knowing of what you do.

so.text: 68. Hadday kula doodaan, dheh: Alle baa dhab u ogsoon waxaad fashaan.

ayat.arabic: ٱللَّهُ يَحۡكُمُ بَيۡنَكُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ فِيمَا كُنتُمۡ فِيهِ تَخۡتَلِفُونَ

en.text: Allāh will judge between you on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which you used to differ."

so.text: 69. Alle baa idiin kala garsoori dhexdiinna Maalinta Qiyaamaha waxaad isku khilaafsaneydeen.

ayat.arabic: أَلَمۡ تَعۡلَمۡ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعۡلَمُ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ فِي كِتَٰبٍۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرٞ

en.text: Do you not know that Allāh knows what is in the heaven and earth? Indeed, that is in a Record.[941] Indeed that, for Allāh, is easy.
en.footnotes: [941] The Preserved Slate (al-Lawḥ al-Maḥfūẓ), which is with Allāh.

so.text: 70. Miyaadan ogayn inuu Alle og yahay waxa ku sugan samada iyo arlada? Hubaal, arrinkani wuxuu ku yaal Kitaab [19]. Hubaal, arrinkani wuu u fudud yahay Alle.
so.footnotes: [19]. Waxaa loola jeedaa Looxa Maxfuudka uu Alle ku heysto agtiisa.

ayat.arabic: وَيَعۡبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَمۡ يُنَزِّلۡ بِهِۦ سُلۡطَٰنٗا وَمَا لَيۡسَ لَهُم بِهِۦ عِلۡمٞۗ وَمَا لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ مِن نَّصِيرٖ

en.text: And they worship besides Allāh that for which He has not sent down authority and that of which they have no knowledge. And there will not be for the wrongdoers any helper.

so.text: 71. Waxay caabudaan Alle sokadi wax uusan u soo dejin wax xujo ah, iyo waxaa aysan u lahayn wax cilmi ah. Daalimiinta (gaalada, mushrikiinta, iwm) ma heli doonaan wax u soo gargaara.

ayat.arabic: وَإِذَا تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ءَايَٰتُنَا بَيِّنَٰتٖ تَعۡرِفُ فِي وُجُوهِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ ٱلۡمُنكَرَۖ يَكَادُونَ يَسۡطُونَ بِٱلَّذِينَ يَتۡلُونَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ءَايَٰتِنَاۗ قُلۡ أَفَأُنَبِّئُكُم بِشَرّٖ مِّن ذَٰلِكُمُۚ ٱلنَّارُ وَعَدَهَا ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْۖ وَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ

en.text: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, you recognize in the faces of those who disbelieve disapproval. They are almost on the verge of assaulting those who recite to them Our verses. Say, "Then shall I inform you of [what is] worse than that?[942] [It is] the Fire which Allāh has promised those who disbelieve, and wretched is the destination."
en.footnotes: [942] i.e., worse than the rage you feel against those who recite Allāh's verses or worse than your threats against them.

so.text: 72. Marka Aayadahayaga cad loo akhriyo, waxaad ka garan wejiyada kuwa gaalooba nac! Waxay ku sigtaan inay ku soo boodaan kuwa u akhriya Aayadahayaga. Dheh: “Ma idiin sheegaa wax waxakani ka xun [20]? waa Naarta, Alle wuxuu u yaboohay kuwa gaalada ah, iyadaana u xun meel la ahaado.
so.footnotes: [20]. Ka daran cadhada aad u qabtaan kuwa akhriya Aayadaha Alle ama ka daran waxa aad ugu gooddisaan.

ayat.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ ضُرِبَ مَثَلٞ فَٱسۡتَمِعُواْ لَهُۥٓۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ تَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ لَن يَخۡلُقُواْ ذُبَابٗا وَلَوِ ٱجۡتَمَعُواْ لَهُۥۖ وَإِن يَسۡلُبۡهُمُ ٱلذُّبَابُ شَيۡـٔٗا لَّا يَسۡتَنقِذُوهُ مِنۡهُۚ ضَعُفَ ٱلطَّالِبُ وَٱلۡمَطۡلُوبُ

en.text: O people, an example is presented, so listen to it. Indeed, those you invoke besides Allāh will never create [as much as] a fly, even if they gathered together for it [i.e., that purpose]. And if the fly should steal from them a [tiny] thing, they could not recover it from him. Weak are the pursuer and pursued.[943]
en.footnotes: [943] A comparison is made here to the worshipper of a false deity and that which he worships.

so.text: 73. Dadow! Waxaa la yeelay tusaale ee u dhegaysta (si wanaagsan). Kuwa aad baridaan (caabuddaan) Alle sokadi ma abuuri karaan duqsi, haba u kulmaane dhammaantood arrinkaa, hadduuna duqsigu wax ka dafo, kama soo ceshan karaan. Liidasho badanaa kan wax dooni (caabudaha asnaamta) iyo kan la dooni (asnaamta ay caabudaan).

ayat.arabic: مَا قَدَرُواْ ٱللَّهَ حَقَّ قَدۡرِهِۦٓۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَقَوِيٌّ عَزِيزٌ

en.text: They have not appraised Allāh with true appraisal.[944] Indeed, Allāh is Powerful and Exalted in Might.
en.footnotes: [944] They have not assessed Him with the assessment due to Him, meaning that they did not take into account His perfect attributes.

so.text: 74. Ma ay qaddarin Alle qaddarinta uu mudan yahay. Hubaal Alle waa Xoog Badane, Adkaada.

ayat.arabic: ٱللَّهُ يَصۡطَفِي مِنَ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ رُسُلٗا وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعُۢ بَصِيرٞ

en.text: Allāh chooses from the angels messengers and from the people. Indeed, Allāh is Hearing and Seeing.

so.text: 75. Alle wuxuu ka dhex doortaa Rusul malaa’igta iyo dadkaba. Hubaal, Alle waa wax kasta Maqle, wax kasta Arka.

ayat.arabic: يَعۡلَمُ مَا بَيۡنَ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ وَمَا خَلۡفَهُمۡۚ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ تُرۡجَعُ ٱلۡأُمُورُ

en.text: He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them.[945] And to Allāh will be returned [all] matters.
en.footnotes: [945] See footnote to 20:110.

so.text: 76. Wuxuu ogsoon yahay Waxa hortooda ah iyo waxa gadaashooda ah. Xagga Alle baana loo celiyaa umuurahoo dhan.

ayat.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ٱرۡكَعُواْ وَٱسۡجُدُواْۤ وَٱعۡبُدُواْ رَبَّكُمۡ وَٱفۡعَلُواْ ٱلۡخَيۡرَ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تُفۡلِحُونَ۩

en.text: O you who have believed, bow and prostrate and worship your Lord and do good - that you may succeed.

so.text: 77. Kuwa (Xaqa) rumeeyow! Rukuuca oo sujuuda oo caabuda Rabbigiin (idinkoon waxba la wadaajin cibaadada) falana khayr aad liibaantaane.

ayat.arabic: وَجَٰهِدُواْ فِي ٱللَّهِ حَقَّ جِهَادِهِۦۚ هُوَ ٱجۡتَبَىٰكُمۡ وَمَا جَعَلَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ فِي ٱلدِّينِ مِنۡ حَرَجٖۚ مِّلَّةَ أَبِيكُمۡ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَۚ هُوَ سَمَّىٰكُمُ ٱلۡمُسۡلِمِينَ مِن قَبۡلُ وَفِي هَٰذَا لِيَكُونَ ٱلرَّسُولُ شَهِيدًا عَلَيۡكُمۡ وَتَكُونُواْ شُهَدَآءَ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِۚ فَأَقِيمُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُواْ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَٱعۡتَصِمُواْ بِٱللَّهِ هُوَ مَوۡلَىٰكُمۡۖ فَنِعۡمَ ٱلۡمَوۡلَىٰ وَنِعۡمَ ٱلنَّصِيرُ

en.text: And strive for Allāh with the striving due to Him. He has chosen you and has not placed upon you in the religion any difficulty. [It is] the religion of your father, Abraham. He [i.e., Allāh] named you "Muslims" before [in former scriptures] and in this [revelation] that the Messenger may be a witness over you and you may be witnesses over the people. So establish prayer and give zakāh and hold fast to Allāh. He is your protector; and excellent is the protector, and excellent is the helper.

so.text: 78. Kun dadaala Arrinka Alle (xoojinta diinta Islaamka) dadaal dhab ah (idinkoo u huraya maalkiinna iyo nafahiinna). Isagaa (Alle) idin doortay, mana yeelin dushiinna xagga diinta waxaad ku dhib mudataan, waa diintii Aabbihiin Ibraahiim. Isaga (Alle) baa idiin bixiyey kol hor Muslimiin iyo Qur’aankan (dhexdiisaba) si uu Rasuulku idiinku ahaado markhaati, idinkuna aad markhaati kaga ahaataan dadka. Ee ooga salaadda oo bixiya zakada oo qabsada (Kitaabka) Alle (iyo Sunnada Rasuulkiisa) oo isku dhowra. Waa Alle Mudanahiin, Isagaa u fiican Mudane ahaan, Isagaana u Fiican Gargaare ahaan.

ayat.arabic: قَدۡ أَفۡلَحَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ

en.text: Certainly will the believers have succeeded:

so.text: 1.Waxaa dhab ahaan liibaanay mu’miniinta.

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ فِي صَلَاتِهِمۡ خَٰشِعُونَ

en.text: They who are during their prayer humbly intent

so.text: 2. Kuwa iyagu salaaddooda ku khushuuca.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ عَنِ ٱللَّغۡوِ مُعۡرِضُونَ

en.text: And they who turn away from ill speech

so.text: 3. Ee ah kuwa ka dhowrsada oo jeesada hadalka kiisa xun.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ لِلزَّكَوٰةِ فَٰعِلُونَ

en.text: And they who are observant of zakāh

so.text: 4. Ee ah kuwa fala zakada (bixiya).

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ لِفُرُوجِهِمۡ حَٰفِظُونَ

en.text: And they who guard their private parts

so.text: 5. Ee ah kuwa ilaaliya xubnahooda hoose ee gaarka ah.

ayat.arabic: إِلَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَزۡوَٰجِهِمۡ أَوۡ مَا مَلَكَتۡ أَيۡمَٰنُهُمۡ فَإِنَّهُمۡ غَيۡرُ مَلُومِينَ

en.text: Except from their wives or those their right hands possess,[947] for indeed, they will not be blamed -
en.footnotes: [947] Female slaves or captives under their ownership.

so.text: 6. Xaasaskooda ama kuwa ay gacmahoo- du midig hantaan mooyee [1], xaqiiq laguma eedo taasi;
so.footnotes: [1]. Ma aha addoon ama addoonad mid aan lagu soo qafaalan dagaal lala galay gaalada.

ayat.arabic: فَمَنِ ٱبۡتَغَىٰ وَرَآءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡعَادُونَ

en.text: But whoever seeks beyond that, then those are the transgressors -

so.text: 7. Qofkii se doona wax intaas dhaafsiisan, waa kuwaa xad gudbayaasha.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ لِأَمَٰنَٰتِهِمۡ وَعَهۡدِهِمۡ رَٰعُونَ

en.text: And they who are to their trusts and their promises attentive

so.text: 8. Ee ah kuwa ammaanooyinkooda iyo ballankooda dhowra.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ عَلَىٰ صَلَوَٰتِهِمۡ يُحَافِظُونَ

en.text: And they who carefully maintain their prayers -

so.text: 9. Ee ah kuwa xafida salaadahooda.

ayat.arabic: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡوَٰرِثُونَ

en.text: Those are the inheritors

so.text: 10. Waa kuwaa dhaxlayaasha.

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَرِثُونَ ٱلۡفِرۡدَوۡسَ هُمۡ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ

en.text: Who will inherit al-Firdaus.[948] They will abide therein eternally.
en.footnotes: [948] The highest part of Paradise.

so.text: 11. Kuwa dhaxli Al-Firdaws [2] way ku dhex waadhi weligood.
so.footnotes: [2]. Al-Firdaws waa qaybta ugu heer sarreysa Jannada.

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ مِن سُلَٰلَةٖ مِّن طِينٖ

en.text: And certainly did We create man from an extract of clay.

so.text: 12. Waxaan dhab ahaan ka abuurnay Aadmiga wax laga soo soocay dhoobo.

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ جَعَلۡنَٰهُ نُطۡفَةٗ فِي قَرَارٖ مَّكِينٖ

en.text: Then We placed him as a sperm-drop[949] in a firm lodging [i.e., the womb].
en.footnotes: [949] Or "as a zygote."

so.text: 13. Dabeeto ka yeellay (ka abuurnaa ilmaha Aadam) dhibic mani ah ku sugnaata gunta meel aamin ah (riximka).

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلنُّطۡفَةَ عَلَقَةٗ فَخَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡعَلَقَةَ مُضۡغَةٗ فَخَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡمُضۡغَةَ عِظَٰمٗا فَكَسَوۡنَا ٱلۡعِظَٰمَ لَحۡمٗا ثُمَّ أَنشَأۡنَٰهُ خَلۡقًا ءَاخَرَۚ فَتَبَارَكَ ٱللَّهُ أَحۡسَنُ ٱلۡخَٰلِقِينَ

en.text: Then We made the sperm-drop into a clinging clot, and We made the clot into a lump [of flesh], and We made [from] the lump, bones, and We covered the bones with flesh; then We developed him into another creation. So blessed is Allāh, the best of creators.[950]
en.footnotes: [950] i.e., the most skillful and only true Creator.

so.text: 14. Markaasaan ka abuurnaa dhibicdaa xinjir, kana abuurnaa xinjirta cad yar oo hilib ah, kana abuurnaa cadkaa hilibka lafo,  waxaana huwinnaa lafahaa hilib, markaasaan ka unugnaa abuur kale. Ee waxaa barako iyo khayr Badan Allaah, Kan u Wanaagsan abuurayaasha [3].
so.footnotes: [3]. Kan ugu farsamo wanaagsan ee ah abuuraha Keliya ee Runta ah.

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُم بَعۡدَ ذَٰلِكَ لَمَيِّتُونَ

en.text: Then indeed, after that you are to die.

so.text: 15. Markaas kaddib, waad dhimaneysaan.

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ تُبۡعَثُونَ

en.text: Then indeed you, on the Day of Resurrection, will be resurrected.

so.text: 16. Markaas Maalinta Qiyaamaha baa la idin soo bixin.

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا فَوۡقَكُمۡ سَبۡعَ طَرَآئِقَ وَمَا كُنَّا عَنِ ٱلۡخَلۡقِ غَٰفِلِينَ

en.text: And We have created above you seven layered heavens, and never have We been of [Our] creation unaware.

so.text: 17. Waxaana xaqiiq abuurnay korkiinna toddoba samo oo kala korreeya, mana nahin kuwo moog uunka.

ayat.arabic: وَأَنزَلۡنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءَۢ بِقَدَرٖ فَأَسۡكَنَّٰهُ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰ ذَهَابِۭ بِهِۦ لَقَٰدِرُونَ

en.text: And We have sent down rain from the sky in a measured amount and settled it in the earth. And indeed, We are Able to take it away.

so.text: 18. Waxaan ka soo dejinnay daruuraha biyo (roob) qiyaasan,  oo waxaan dejinnay dhulka, waana Karnaa inaan la tagno.

ayat.arabic: فَأَنشَأۡنَا لَكُم بِهِۦ جَنَّٰتٖ مِّن نَّخِيلٖ وَأَعۡنَٰبٖ لَّكُمۡ فِيهَا فَوَٰكِهُ كَثِيرَةٞ وَمِنۡهَا تَأۡكُلُونَ

en.text: And We brought forth for you thereby gardens of palm trees and grapevines in which for you are abundant fruits and from which you eat.

so.text: 19. Waxaana idiinku soo saarnay beero timir ah iyo canab oo aad ka heshaan midho badan oo aad wax ka cuntaan.

ayat.arabic: وَشَجَرَةٗ تَخۡرُجُ مِن طُورِ سَيۡنَآءَ تَنۢبُتُ بِٱلدُّهۡنِ وَصِبۡغٖ لِّلۡأٓكِلِينَ

en.text: And [We brought forth] a tree issuing from Mount Sinai which produces oil and food [i.e., olives] for those who eat.

so.text: 20. Iyo geed (zaytuun) ka baxa Buurta Siinaay, oo u soo saarta saliid iyo koosaar kuwa cuna.

ayat.arabic: وَإِنَّ لَكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمِ لَعِبۡرَةٗۖ نُّسۡقِيكُم مِّمَّا فِي بُطُونِهَا وَلَكُمۡ فِيهَا مَنَٰفِعُ كَثِيرَةٞ وَمِنۡهَا تَأۡكُلُونَ

en.text: And indeed, for you in livestock is a lesson. We give you drink from that which is in their bellies, and for you in them are numerous benefits, and from them you eat.

so.text: 21. Waxaa xaqiiq idiinku sugan xoolaha cibrad. Waxaan idinka waraabinnaa waxa ku jira uurarkooda, waxaana idiinku sugan, manaafacaad (kale) oo badan oo ay idiin leeyihiin, xaggeedaadna wax ka cuntaan.

ayat.arabic: وَعَلَيۡهَا وَعَلَى ٱلۡفُلۡكِ تُحۡمَلُونَ

en.text: And upon them and on ships you are carried.

so.text: 22. Korkeeda iyo doonyaha korkooda baana la idinku rar qaadaa.

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوۡمِهِۦ فَقَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ ٱعۡبُدُواْ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنۡ إِلَٰهٍ غَيۡرُهُۥٓۚ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

en.text: And We had certainly sent Noah to his people, and he said, "O my people, worship Allāh; you have no deity other than Him; then will you not fear Him?"

so.text: 23. Waxaan dhab ahaan u dirnay Nuux qolodiisii, wuxuuna yidhi: Tolkayow! Caabuda Alle Keliya. Ma lihidin ilaah (Xaq ah) aan Isaga aheyn, miyeydaan ka cabsaneyn Alle oo iska jireyn (shirkiga iyo xumaha kale)?

ayat.arabic: فَقَالَ ٱلۡمَلَؤُاْ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِن قَوۡمِهِۦ مَا هَٰذَآ إِلَّا بَشَرٞ مِّثۡلُكُمۡ يُرِيدُ أَن يَتَفَضَّلَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ وَلَوۡ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَأَنزَلَ مَلَٰٓئِكَةٗ مَّا سَمِعۡنَا بِهَٰذَا فِيٓ ءَابَآئِنَا ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ

en.text: But the eminent among those who disbelieved from his people said, "This is not but a man like yourselves who wishes to take precedence over you; and if Allāh had willed [to send a messenger], He would have sent down angels. We have not heard of this among our forefathers.

so.text: 24. Waxayse xildhibaannadii ka mid ahaa kuwaasi gaaloobay oo ka mid ah qolodiisii yidhaahdeen: Kanu ma aha waxaan ahayn qof idinla mid ah, raba inuu idin ka sare maro, hadduu Alle doono, wuxuu soo dejin lahaa malaa’ig, ma aanu ka maqal arrintan (towxiidka) aabbayaashayadii hore.

ayat.arabic: إِنۡ هُوَ إِلَّا رَجُلُۢ بِهِۦ جِنَّةٞ فَتَرَبَّصُواْ بِهِۦ حَتَّىٰ حِينٖ

en.text: He is not but a man possessed with madness, so wait concerning him for a time."

so.text: 25. Wax kalena ma uu aha ee waa uun nin jin ku jiro, ee u samra in muddo ah (intuu ka reysto ama dhinto).

ayat.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱنصُرۡنِي بِمَا كَذَّبُونِ

en.text: [Noah] said, "My Lord, support me because they have denied me."

so.text: 26. (Nuux) wuxuu yidhi: “Rabbiyow iiga gargaar beenintooda”.

ayat.arabic: فَأَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَيۡهِ أَنِ ٱصۡنَعِ ٱلۡفُلۡكَ بِأَعۡيُنِنَا وَوَحۡيِنَا فَإِذَا جَآءَ أَمۡرُنَا وَفَارَ ٱلتَّنُّورُ فَٱسۡلُكۡ فِيهَا مِن كُلّٖ زَوۡجَيۡنِ ٱثۡنَيۡنِ وَأَهۡلَكَ إِلَّا مَن سَبَقَ عَلَيۡهِ ٱلۡقَوۡلُ مِنۡهُمۡۖ وَلَا تُخَٰطِبۡنِي فِي ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓاْ إِنَّهُم مُّغۡرَقُونَ

en.text: So We inspired to him, "Construct the ship under Our observation and Our inspiration, and when Our command comes and the oven overflows,[951] put into it [i.e., the ship] from each [creature] two mates and your family, except him for whom the decree [of destruction] has proceeded. And do not address Me concerning those who have wronged; indeed, they are to be drowned.
en.footnotes: [951] See footnote to 11:40.

so.text: 27. Markaasaan u waxyoonnay (Annagoo leh): “Ku samee doonnida Indhahayaga hortood iyo (si waafaqsan) Waxyigayaga, markuu Amarkayagu yimaado, oo burqado tinnaarka, ku qaad doonnida noole walba lammaane (lab iyo dheddig) iyo intii ku raacday aan ahayn kuwaa qowlka (in la halligayo) horay ugu dhacay oo ka mid ah iyaga, hana igala hadlin (arrinka) kuwaa fala dulmiga (shirkiga iyo macaasida), hubaal waa kuwo la harqin doono.

ayat.arabic: فَإِذَا ٱسۡتَوَيۡتَ أَنتَ وَمَن مَّعَكَ عَلَى ٱلۡفُلۡكِ فَقُلِ ٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي نَجَّىٰنَا مِنَ ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ

en.text: And when you have boarded the ship, you and those with you, then say, 'Praise to Allāh who has saved us from the wrongdoing people.'

so.text: 28. Markaad ku dul fadhiisataan adiga iyo kuwaa ku wehliyaba doonnida, dheh: “Ammaan idilkeed iyo mahad waxaa leh Alle, ee naga babaadiyey qoloda daalimiinta ah (gar ma qaatayaasha).

ayat.arabic: وَقُل رَّبِّ أَنزِلۡنِي مُنزَلٗا مُّبَارَكٗا وَأَنتَ خَيۡرُ ٱلۡمُنزِلِينَ

en.text: And say, 'My Lord, let me land at a blessed landing place, and You are the best to accommodate [us].'"

so.text: 29. Oo dheh: “Rabbiyow! I deji degaan barakaysan, Adigaa ugu wanaagsane inta wax dejisa'e ”.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ وَإِن كُنَّا لَمُبۡتَلِينَ

en.text: Indeed in that are signs, and indeed, We are ever testing [Our servants].

so.text: 30. Hubaal, Arrinkaa waxaa ku sugan calaamooyin, waxaana nahay xaqiiq kuwa wax imtixaama.

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ أَنشَأۡنَا مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِمۡ قَرۡنًا ءَاخَرِينَ

en.text: Then We produced after them a generation of others.

so.text: 31. Markaasaan waxaan soo bixinnay iyaga kadambow fac kale (qoonkii Caad).

ayat.arabic: فَأَرۡسَلۡنَا فِيهِمۡ رَسُولٗا مِّنۡهُمۡ أَنِ ٱعۡبُدُواْ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنۡ إِلَٰهٍ غَيۡرُهُۥٓۚ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

en.text: And We sent among them a messenger[952] from themselves, [saying], "Worship Allāh; you have no deity other than Him; then will you not fear Him?"
en.footnotes: [952] Prophet Hūd, who was sent to the tribe of ʿAad.

so.text: 32. Waxaana u soo dirnay dhexdood Rasuul 'Nabi Huud' [4] ka mid ah (oo amraya) Caabuda Alle Keliya! Ma lihidin ilaah kale (Xaq ah) aan Isaga aheyn. Ee miyeydaan ka joogeyn (shirkiga iyo xumaha kale)?.
so.footnotes: [4]. Ee loo diray reer Caad.

ayat.arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلۡمَلَأُ مِن قَوۡمِهِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَكَذَّبُواْ بِلِقَآءِ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ وَأَتۡرَفۡنَٰهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا مَا هَٰذَآ إِلَّا بَشَرٞ مِّثۡلُكُمۡ يَأۡكُلُ مِمَّا تَأۡكُلُونَ مِنۡهُ وَيَشۡرَبُ مِمَّا تَشۡرَبُونَ

en.text: And the eminent among his people who disbelieved and denied the meeting of the Hereafter while We had given them luxury in the worldly life said, "This is not but a man like yourselves. He eats of that from which you eat and drinks of what you drink.

so.text: 33. Xildhibaannadii ka mid ahaa qolodiisa ee gaaloobay oo beeniyey la kulanka Aakhirada, kuwaasoo aan siinnay wax badan si ay ugu raaxeystaan noloshan adduunka waxay yidhaahdeen: “Kanu ma aha waxaan ahayn qof idin la mid ah cuna waxaad cuntaan,cabbana waxaad cabtaan.

ayat.arabic: وَلَئِنۡ أَطَعۡتُم بَشَرٗا مِّثۡلَكُمۡ إِنَّكُمۡ إِذٗا لَّخَٰسِرُونَ

en.text: And if you should obey a man like yourselves, indeed, you would then be losers.

so.text: 34. “Haddaad adeecdaanna qof idin la mid ah,idinku markaa xaqiiq waad khasaarteen.

ayat.arabic: أَيَعِدُكُمۡ أَنَّكُمۡ إِذَا مِتُّمۡ وَكُنتُمۡ تُرَابٗا وَعِظَٰمًا أَنَّكُم مُّخۡرَجُونَ

en.text: Does he promise you that when you have died and become dust and bones that you will be brought forth [once more]?

so.text: 35. “Ma wuxuu idiinku gooddiyaa in markaad dhimataan oo aad noqotaan carro iyo lafo in markaa la idin soo bixin (nooleyn mar kale).?

ayat.arabic: ۞ هَيۡهَاتَ هَيۡهَاتَ لِمَا تُوعَدُونَ

en.text: How far, how far, is that which you are promised.[953]
en.footnotes: [953] i.e., how distant and improbable it is.

so.text: 36. Waa wax fog, oo fog waxa la idiinku gooddiyey (oo aan dhaceyn).

ayat.arabic: إِنۡ هِيَ إِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا ٱلدُّنۡيَا نَمُوتُ وَنَحۡيَا وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمَبۡعُوثِينَ

en.text: It [i.e., life] is not but our worldly life - we die and live, but we will not be resurrected.

so.text: 37. “Ma jirto (nolol) aan aheyn noloshayada adduunka! Waanu dhiman (qaar) oo  noolaan (qaar)! Mana nihin kuwo la soo bixin (nooleyn dhimasho kaddib).

ayat.arabic: إِنۡ هُوَ إِلَّا رَجُلٌ ٱفۡتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبٗا وَمَا نَحۡنُ لَهُۥ بِمُؤۡمِنِينَ

en.text: He is not but a man who has invented a lie about Allāh, and we will not believe him."

so.text: 38. “Ma aha waxaan ahayn nin ku been abuurtay Alle, mana nihin kuwo rumeyn.”

ayat.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱنصُرۡنِي بِمَا كَذَّبُونِ

en.text: He said, "My Lord, support me because they have denied me."

so.text: 39. Wuxuu yidhi: “Rabbiyow! Iiga gargaar beenitooda .

ayat.arabic: قَالَ عَمَّا قَلِيلٖ لَّيُصۡبِحُنَّ نَٰدِمِينَ

en.text: [Allāh] said, "After a little, they will surely become regretful."

so.text: 40. (Alle) wuxuu yidhi: In yar kaddib, waxay ahaan kuwo shallaaya.

ayat.arabic: فَأَخَذَتۡهُمُ ٱلصَّيۡحَةُ بِٱلۡحَقِّ فَجَعَلۡنَٰهُمۡ غُثَآءٗۚ فَبُعۡدٗا لِّلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ

en.text: So the shriek[954] seized them in truth,[955] and We made them as [plant] stubble. Then away with the wrongdoing people.
en.footnotes:
[954] See footnote to 11:67.
[955] i.e., by right or in justice.

so.text: 41. Markaasaa waxaa qabtay qeylo si xaq ah, waxaana ka dhignay daad xoor. Ee meel daran ha ka dhaceen daalimiinta.

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ أَنشَأۡنَا مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِمۡ قُرُونًا ءَاخَرِينَ

en.text: Then We produced after them other generations.

so.text: 42. Markaasaan ahaysiinnay iyaga kadambow facyo kale (qolooyinkii Luud,  Shucayb, Ayyuub iyo Yuunus).

ayat.arabic: مَا تَسۡبِقُ مِنۡ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسۡتَـٔۡخِرُونَ

en.text: No nation will precede its time [of termination], nor will they remain [thereafter].

so.text: 43. Ma jirto ummad ka soo hor mari karta ajasheeda, ama ka dib mari karta.

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ أَرۡسَلۡنَا رُسُلَنَا تَتۡرَاۖ كُلَّ مَا جَآءَ أُمَّةٗ رَّسُولُهَا كَذَّبُوهُۖ فَأَتۡبَعۡنَا بَعۡضَهُم بَعۡضٗا وَجَعَلۡنَٰهُمۡ أَحَادِيثَۚ فَبُعۡدٗا لِّقَوۡمٖ لَّا يُؤۡمِنُونَ

en.text: Then We sent Our messengers in succession. Every time there came to a nation its messenger, they denied him, so We made them follow one another [to destruction], and We made them narrations.[956] So away with a people who do not believe.
en.footnotes: [956] i.e., history or lessons for mankind.

so.text: 44. Markaasaan soo dirnay Rusushayada oo is raacsan, mar kastoo uu u yimaado ummad Rasuulkeedu way beeniyaan, kolkaasaan ka yeellay qaarba inay raacaan qaar kale (halaagnay), oo ka dhignay wax lagu sheekeysto. Ee meel daran ha ka dhaceen qolodaan (Xaqa) rumeyn.

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مُوسَىٰ وَأَخَاهُ هَٰرُونَ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَسُلۡطَٰنٖ مُّبِينٍ

en.text: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron with Our signs and a clear authority[957]
en.footnotes: [957] i.e., evidences from Allāh.

so.text: 45. Markaa Waxaan soo dirnay Muuse iyo walaalki Haaruun oo wata Aayadahayaga [5] iyo Xujo Cad.
so.footnotes: [5]. waa sagaalkii mucjiso ee la siiyey Nabi Muuse.

ayat.arabic: إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَمَلَإِيْهِۦ فَٱسۡتَكۡبَرُواْ وَكَانُواْ قَوۡمًا عَالِينَ

en.text: To Pharaoh and his establishment, but they were arrogant and were a haughty people.

so.text: 46. Xagga Fircoon iyo xildhibaannadiisii, waxayse u dhaqmeen si isla weyni ah,  waxayna ahaayeen qolo isla sarreeya.

ayat.arabic: فَقَالُوٓاْ أَنُؤۡمِنُ لِبَشَرَيۡنِ مِثۡلِنَا وَقَوۡمُهُمَا لَنَا عَٰبِدُونَ

en.text: They said, "Should we believe two men like ourselves while their people are for us in servitude?"

so.text: 47. Waxay yidhaahdeen: “Ma waxaan rumeyn labo nin oo nala mid ah oo dadkoodu innaga noo adeegaaan.”

ayat.arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَكَانُواْ مِنَ ٱلۡمُهۡلَكِينَ

en.text: So they denied them and were of those destroyed.

so.text: 48. Markaasay beeniyeen oo ka mid noqdeen kuwii la halaagay.

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ ءَاتَيۡنَا مُوسَى ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَهۡتَدُونَ

en.text: And We certainly gave Moses the Scripture that perhaps they[958] would be guided.
en.footnotes: [958] The Children of Israel.

so.text: 49. Waxaanu dhab ahaan siinnay Muuse Kitaabka (Towraadda) si ay u hanuunaan [6].
so.footnotes: [6]. Ilmahii Israa’iil.

ayat.arabic: وَجَعَلۡنَا ٱبۡنَ مَرۡيَمَ وَأُمَّهُۥٓ ءَايَةٗ وَءَاوَيۡنَٰهُمَآ إِلَىٰ رَبۡوَةٖ ذَاتِ قَرَارٖ وَمَعِينٖ

en.text: And We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign and sheltered them within a high ground having level [areas] and flowing water.

so.text: 50. Waxaana ka yeelnay wiilkii Maryam iyo hooyadiis calaamad [7], waxaana ka siinnay hoy meel sare oo sugnaansho iyo biyo socda leh (ilo).
so.footnotes: [7]. Waa abuurista Ciise aabbe la'aan, iyo hooyadi oo uurkiisa qaadday iyadoo uu nin taaban.

ayat.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلرُّسُلُ كُلُواْ مِنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَٰتِ وَٱعۡمَلُواْ صَٰلِحًاۖ إِنِّي بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ عَلِيمٞ

en.text: [Allāh said], "O messengers, eat from the good foods and work righteousness. Indeed I, of what you do, am Knowing.

so.text: 51. (idinka) Rususha ahow! Ka cuna cuntada inta xalaasha ah wanaagsan oo sama fala. Anigu xaqiiq waxaad faleysaan waan Ogahaye.

ayat.arabic: وَإِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦٓ أُمَّتُكُمۡ أُمَّةٗ وَٰحِدَةٗ وَأَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمۡ فَٱتَّقُونِ

en.text: And indeed this, your religion, is one religion,[959] and I am your Lord, so fear Me."
en.footnotes: [959] See footnote to 21:92.

so.text: 52. Hubaal, diintiinnaan (Islaamka) waa diin mid keliya ah. Aniguna waxaan ahay Rabbiigiin, ee iga cabsada (oo ka fogaada shirkiga iyo xumaha kale) .

ayat.arabic: فَتَقَطَّعُوٓاْ أَمۡرَهُم بَيۡنَهُمۡ زُبُرٗاۖ كُلُّ حِزۡبِۭ بِمَا لَدَيۡهِمۡ فَرِحُونَ

en.text: But they [i.e., the people] divided their religion among them into portions [i.e., sects] - each faction, in what it has,[960] rejoicing.
en.footnotes: [960] Of beliefs, opinions, customs, etc.

so.text: 53. Waxayse u kala goosgoosteen diintooda dhexdooda kooxo, koox walbaa waxay haystaan [8] ay ku faraxsan yihiin.
so.footnotes: [8]. Oo caqiidooyin ah, dhaqammo, caadooyin, iwm.

ayat.arabic: فَذَرۡهُمۡ فِي غَمۡرَتِهِمۡ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ

en.text: So leave them in their confusion for a time.

so.text: 54. Ee iskaga tag jahliga daran ay ku jiraan ilaa iyo muddo.

ayat.arabic: أَيَحۡسَبُونَ أَنَّمَا نُمِدُّهُم بِهِۦ مِن مَّالٖ وَبَنِينَ

en.text: Do they think that what We extend to them of wealth and children

so.text: 55. Ma waxay moodaan waxa aanu siinno ee maal iyo carruur ah.

ayat.arabic: نُسَارِعُ لَهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡخَيۡرَٰتِۚ بَل لَّا يَشۡعُرُونَ

en.text: Is [because] We hasten for them good things? Rather, they do not perceive.[961]
en.footnotes: [961] That the good things given to them in this world are but a trial for them.

so.text: 56. Inaan ula soo dhaqsanno waxyaalaha wanaagsan? mase dareensana [9].
so.footnotes: [9]. In waxyaalaha wanaagsan ee lagu siiyey adduunkan ay keliya yihiin wax lagu imtixaamayo iyaga.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ هُم مِّنۡ خَشۡيَةِ رَبِّهِم مُّشۡفِقُونَ

en.text: Indeed, they who are apprehensive from fear of their Lord

so.text: 57. Hubaal Kuway cabsida Rabbigood ku weyn tahay;

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ يُؤۡمِنُونَ

en.text: And they who believe in the signs of their Lord

so.text: 58. Ee ah Kuwa Aayadaha Rabbigood rumeysan,

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِرَبِّهِمۡ لَا يُشۡرِكُونَ

en.text: And they who do not associate anything with their Lord

so.text: 59. Oo ah  kuwa aan cid kale la wadaajin Rabbigood (cibaadada);

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُؤۡتُونَ مَآ ءَاتَواْ وَّقُلُوبُهُمۡ وَجِلَةٌ أَنَّهُمۡ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمۡ رَٰجِعُونَ

en.text: And they who give what they give while their hearts are fearful[962] because they will be returning to their Lord -
en.footnotes: [962] Lest their deeds not be acceptable.

so.text: 60. Ah kuwa bixiya waxay bixiyaan (oo sadaqo ah ama fala camallo wanaagsan), iyagoo qalbiyadoodu baqo ka qabto [10] 'inaan laga aqbalin, oo yaqiinsan' inay Rabbigood u soo noqon.
so.footnotes: [10]. Waxaa la weydiiyey Nabiga s.c.w. in kuwaa ka baqa taasi ay yihiin kuwa wax xada ama zinaysta ama khamri cabba. Wuxuu yidhi: Ma aha kuwaasi, ee waa kuwa tukada salaadda, sooma oo wax sadaqeysta, haddana ka baqa in aan laga aqbalin.”

ayat.arabic: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ يُسَٰرِعُونَ فِي ٱلۡخَيۡرَٰتِ وَهُمۡ لَهَا سَٰبِقُونَ

en.text: It is those who hasten to good deeds, and they outstrip [others] therein.

so.text: 61. Kuwaasaa u degdega khayraadka, una dheereeya.

ayat.arabic: وَلَا نُكَلِّفُ نَفۡسًا إِلَّا وُسۡعَهَاۚ وَلَدَيۡنَا كِتَٰبٞ يَنطِقُ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَهُمۡ لَا يُظۡلَمُونَ

en.text: And We charge no soul except [with that within] its capacity, and with Us is a record which speaks with truth; and they will not be wronged.

so.text: 62. Ma saarno nafna culeys aan aheyn karaankeeda, Waxaana agtannada ah Kitaab ku hadla xaq iyagoon la dulmineyn.

ayat.arabic: بَلۡ قُلُوبُهُمۡ فِي غَمۡرَةٖ مِّنۡ هَٰذَا وَلَهُمۡ أَعۡمَٰلٞ مِّن دُونِ ذَٰلِكَ هُمۡ لَهَا عَٰمِلُونَ

en.text: But their hearts are covered with confusion over this, and they have [evil] deeds besides that [i.e., disbelief] which they are doing,

so.text: 63. Waxayse quluubtooda kaga jiraan jahli daran kan (Qur’aankani), waxayna leeyihiin acmaal (kale oo xun) oo kuwan u wehliya oo ay falaan.

ayat.arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَخَذۡنَا مُتۡرَفِيهِم بِٱلۡعَذَابِ إِذَا هُمۡ يَجۡـَٔرُونَ

en.text: Until when We seize their affluent ones with punishment,[963] at once they are crying [to Allāh] for help.
en.footnotes: [963] In worldly life, before the punishment of the Hereafter. Although general, the description includes specifically the punishment of the Quraysh by famine.

so.text: 64. Jeer markaan ku qabbanno kuwooda ladan ee ka mid ah cadaab [11], markaasay calaacalaan.
so.footnotes: [11]. Waa ciqaabka Quraysh lagu ciqaabay abaarta iyo gaajada. Waxaa sidoo kale jab iyo hoog ku soo gaaray dagaalkii Badar, iyagoo badi madaxdoodii lagu dilay Badar, qaarna lagu soo qafaashay.

ayat.arabic: لَا تَجۡـَٔرُواْ ٱلۡيَوۡمَۖ إِنَّكُم مِّنَّا لَا تُنصَرُونَ

en.text: Do not cry out today. Indeed, by Us you will not be helped.

so.text: 65. Ha calaacalina maanta! Hubaal idinku xaggayaga laydiin kama gargaaro’e.

ayat.arabic: قَدۡ كَانَتۡ ءَايَٰتِي تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡكُمۡ فَكُنتُمۡ عَلَىٰٓ أَعۡقَٰبِكُمۡ تَنكِصُونَ

en.text: My verses had already been recited to you, but you were turning back on your heels

so.text: 66. Aayadahaygii baa la idiin akhrinayey, waxaadse ahaydeen kuwo dib ugu gurta cirbihiinna (oo Xaq iyo Nabad diid ah).

ayat.arabic: مُسۡتَكۡبِرِينَ بِهِۦ سَٰمِرٗا تَهۡجُرُونَ

en.text: In arrogance regarding it,[964] conversing by night, speaking evil.
en.footnotes: [964] The revelation. Or "him," i.e., the Prophet (ﷺ).

so.text: 67. Idinkoo isku kibrin (inaad tihiin ehlu Xaramka - Kacbada), ku caweeya habeenka hadal xun aad ka sheegtaan [12].
so.footnotes: [12]. Qur’aanka ama waxaa loola jeedaa Nabiga s.c.w.

ayat.arabic: أَفَلَمۡ يَدَّبَّرُواْ ٱلۡقَوۡلَ أَمۡ جَآءَهُم مَّا لَمۡ يَأۡتِ ءَابَآءَهُمُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ

en.text: Then have they not reflected over the word [i.e., the Qur’ān], or has there come to them that which had not come to their forefathers?

so.text: 68. Miyaanay (gaalada) u fiirsan Qowlka (Qur’aanka), mise waxaa u yimid waxaan u iman aabbayaashoodii hore?

ayat.arabic: أَمۡ لَمۡ يَعۡرِفُواْ رَسُولَهُمۡ فَهُمۡ لَهُۥ مُنكِرُونَ

en.text: Or did they not know their Messenger, so they are toward him disacknowledging?

so.text: 69. Mise waxaanay garan Rasuulkooda (Muxammad) sidaas darteed diidaan?.

ayat.arabic: أَمۡ يَقُولُونَ بِهِۦ جِنَّةُۢۚ بَلۡ جَآءَهُم بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَأَكۡثَرُهُمۡ لِلۡحَقِّ كَٰرِهُونَ

en.text: Or do they say, "In him is madness"? Rather, he brought them the truth, but most of them, to the truth, are averse.

so.text: 70. Mise waxay leeyihiin: “jin baa ku jira?” mayee, wuxuu u keenay Xaq (Qur’aanka), badankooduse Xaqa bay neceb yihiin [13].
so.footnotes: [13]. Towxiidka, halkii ay fahmi lahaayeen ama garowsan lahaayeen.

ayat.arabic: وَلَوِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلۡحَقُّ أَهۡوَآءَهُمۡ لَفَسَدَتِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ وَٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَمَن فِيهِنَّۚ بَلۡ أَتَيۡنَٰهُم بِذِكۡرِهِمۡ فَهُمۡ عَن ذِكۡرِهِم مُّعۡرِضُونَ

en.text: But if the Truth [i.e., Allāh] had followed their inclinations, the heavens and the earth and whoever is in them would have been ruined. Rather, We have brought them their message,[965] but they, from their message, are turning away.
en.footnotes: [965] Or "reminder."

so.text: 71. Hadduu Xaqu raaci lahaa hawadooda, waxaa fasaadi lahaa samooyinka iyo arlada iyo waxa ku sugan. Waxaanse u keennay xuskooda (Qur'aankan), ha yeeshee xuskooda way ka sii jeestaan.

ayat.arabic: أَمۡ تَسۡـَٔلُهُمۡ خَرۡجٗا فَخَرَاجُ رَبِّكَ خَيۡرٞۖ وَهُوَ خَيۡرُ ٱلرَّٰزِقِينَ

en.text: Or do you, [O Muḥammad], ask them for payment? But the reward of your Lord is best, and He is the best of providers.

so.text: 72. Mise waxaad adigu weydiisataa kharaj (ujuuro)? Kharajka Rabbigaa baa se kheyr badan, waana Isaga Kan u wanaagsan inta risiq bixisa.

ayat.arabic: وَإِنَّكَ لَتَدۡعُوهُمۡ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٖ مُّسۡتَقِيمٖ

en.text: And indeed, you invite them to a straight path.

so.text: 73. Waxaadna adigu (Nabiyow) ugu yeedhaa Jid Toosan (Islaamka).

ayat.arabic: وَإِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ عَنِ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ لَنَٰكِبُونَ

en.text: But indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter are deviating from the path.

so.text: 74. Kuwa aan rumeysneyn Aakhirona Jidka (Toosan) way ka iishaan.

ayat.arabic: ۞ وَلَوۡ رَحِمۡنَٰهُمۡ وَكَشَفۡنَا مَا بِهِم مِّن ضُرّٖ لَّلَجُّواْ فِي طُغۡيَٰنِهِمۡ يَعۡمَهُونَ

en.text: And even if We gave them mercy and removed what was upon them of affliction, they would persist in their transgression, wandering blindly.

so.text: 75. Haddaan u naxariisanno oo aan ka feydno waxa haya oo dhib ah, waxay weli ku sii adkeysan lahaayeen xad gudub- kooda iyagoo ku indha la’.

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ أَخَذۡنَٰهُم بِٱلۡعَذَابِ فَمَا ٱسۡتَكَانُواْ لِرَبِّهِمۡ وَمَا يَتَضَرَّعُونَ

en.text: And We had gripped them with suffering [as a warning], but they did not yield to their Lord, nor did they humbly supplicate, [and will continue thus]

so.text: 76. Waxaanu ku qabannay cadaab, umase ayan hoggaansamin Rabbigood, umana baryin si khushuuc leh.

ayat.arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا فَتَحۡنَا عَلَيۡهِم بَابٗا ذَا عَذَابٖ شَدِيدٍ إِذَا هُمۡ فِيهِ مُبۡلِسُونَ

en.text: Until when We have opened before them a door of severe punishment, immediately they will be therein in despair.

so.text: 77. Ilaa, markaan ku furno irrid cadaab daran ah, markaasay quustaan.

ayat.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنشَأَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمۡعَ وَٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرَ وَٱلۡأَفۡـِٔدَةَۚ قَلِيلٗا مَّا تَشۡكُرُونَ

en.text: And it is He who produced for you hearing and vision and hearts [i.e., intellect]; little are you grateful.

so.text: 78. (Alle) waa Kan idiin unkay dhegaha, indhaha iyo laabaha; waa yar tahay inta aad mahdisaan (Alle).

ayat.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي ذَرَأَكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَإِلَيۡهِ تُحۡشَرُونَ

en.text: And it is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered.

so.text: 79. Waana Isaga Kan idinku fidiyey dhulka, Xaggiisaana la idiin soo kulmin.

ayat.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي يُحۡيِۦ وَيُمِيتُ وَلَهُ ٱخۡتِلَٰفُ ٱلَّيۡلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِۚ أَفَلَا تَعۡقِلُونَ

en.text: And it is He who gives life and causes death, and His is the alternation of the night and the day. Then will you not reason?

so.text: 80. Waa Kan baxsha nolol, ee sababa dhimasho, ee leh (Agaasinka) isdhaafka habeenka iyo maalinta; ee miyeydaan wax fahmeyn.

ayat.arabic: بَلۡ قَالُواْ مِثۡلَ مَا قَالَ ٱلۡأَوَّلُونَ

en.text: Rather,[966] they say like what the former peoples said.
en.footnotes: [966] Instead of understanding or reasoning.

so.text: 81. Waxayse yidhaahdeen wax la mid ah waxay dadkii hore yidhaahdeen.

ayat.arabic: قَالُوٓاْ أَءِذَا مِتۡنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابٗا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبۡعُوثُونَ

en.text: They said, "When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?

so.text: 82. Waxay yidhaahdeen: “Ma markaan dhimanno oo aan noqonno carro iyo lafo, miyaa markaa nala soo bixin?

ayat.arabic: لَقَدۡ وُعِدۡنَا نَحۡنُ وَءَابَآؤُنَا هَٰذَا مِن قَبۡلُ إِنۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّآ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ

en.text: We have been promised this, we and our forefathers, before; this is not but legends of the former peoples."

so.text: 83.Waa naloogu yaboohay waxakan, innaga iyo aabbayaashayadii horeba! Waxa kani ma aha waxaan ahayn warkii dadkii hore.

ayat.arabic: قُل لِّمَنِ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَمَن فِيهَآ إِن كُنتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُونَ

en.text: Say, [O Muḥammad], "To whom belongs the earth and whoever is in it, if you should know?"

so.text: 84. Dheh: “Yaa leh dhulka iyo waxa ku sugan, haddaad garaneysaan?!’’

ayat.arabic: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِۚ قُلۡ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ

en.text: They will say, "To Allāh." Say, "Then will you not remember?"

so.text: 85. Waxay (gaaladu) odhan: "Allaah!” Dheh: Miyaydaan haddaba waansameyn?

ayat.arabic: قُلۡ مَن رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ ٱلسَّبۡعِ وَرَبُّ ٱلۡعَرۡشِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ

en.text: Say, "Who is Lord of the seven heavens and Lord of the Great Throne?"

so.text: 86. Dheh: “Waa kuma Rabbiga samooyinka toddobada ah iyo Rabbiga Carshiga Weyn [14]?
so.footnotes: [14]. Nabigu s.c.w. wuxuu yidhi: “Xaalka Alle waa ka weyn yahay sidaas, Carshigiisuna waa sidaas, wuxuu ku tilmaamay gacantiisa sida qubbad”.

ayat.arabic: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِۚ قُلۡ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

en.text: They will say, "[They belong] to Allāh." Say, "Then will you not fear Him?"

so.text: 87. Waxay odhan: “Allaah.” Dheh:  Miyeydaan iska jireyn Cadaabkiisa?.

ayat.arabic: قُلۡ مَنۢ بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ وَهُوَ يُجِيرُ وَلَا يُجَارُ عَلَيۡهِ إِن كُنتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُونَ

en.text: Say, "In whose hand is the realm of all things - and He protects while none can protect against Him - if you should know?"

so.text: 88. Dheh: “Yey Gacantiisa ku jiraan mulkiga iyo maamulka wax walba ee Isagu wax u gargaara, Isagana aan waxba laga gargaarsan karin, haddaad garanaysaan?

ayat.arabic: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِۚ قُلۡ فَأَنَّىٰ تُسۡحَرُونَ

en.text: They will say, "[All belongs] to Allāh." Say, "Then how are you deluded?"

so.text: 89. Waxay odhan: "Allaah". Dheh: “ Xaggee baa haddaba la idiin sixray?”

ayat.arabic: بَلۡ أَتَيۡنَٰهُم بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَإِنَّهُمۡ لَكَٰذِبُونَ

en.text: Rather, We have brought them the truth, and indeed they are liars.

so.text: 90. Waxaanse u keennay Xaq, oo xaqiiq waa beenalayaal.

ayat.arabic: مَا ٱتَّخَذَ ٱللَّهُ مِن وَلَدٖ وَمَا كَانَ مَعَهُۥ مِنۡ إِلَٰهٍۚ إِذٗا لَّذَهَبَ كُلُّ إِلَٰهِۭ بِمَا خَلَقَ وَلَعَلَا بَعۡضُهُمۡ عَلَىٰ بَعۡضٖۚ سُبۡحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ

en.text: Allāh has not taken any son, nor has there ever been with Him any deity. [If there had been], then each deity would have taken what it created, and some of them would have [sought to] overcome others. Exalted is Allāh above what they describe [concerning Him].

so.text: 91. Alle ma yeelan wiil (ilmo), mana aha la jirkiis ilaah (kale) - markaas wuxuu la tagi lahaa ilaah walba wuxuu abuuray, oo qaarkood waxay ka adkaan lahaayeen qaar kale. Ka hufan Allaah (ceeb iyo nuqsaan oo dhan) waana ka Sarreeyaa waxyaalaha ay ku tilmaamayaan.

ayat.arabic: عَٰلِمِ ٱلۡغَيۡبِ وَٱلشَّهَٰدَةِ فَتَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُونَ

en.text: [He is] Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, so high is He above what they associate [with Him].

so.text: 92. Waa ogsoonaha waxa qarsoon iyo waxa muuqda! Wuu ka sarreeyaa waxay la wadaajiyaan (cibaadada).

ayat.arabic: قُل رَّبِّ إِمَّا تُرِيَنِّي مَا يُوعَدُونَ

en.text: Say, [O Muḥammad], "My Lord, if You should show me that which they are promised,

so.text: 93. Dheh: Rabbiyow! Haddaad i tuseyso waxa loogu gooddiyo (cadaabka).

ayat.arabic: رَبِّ فَلَا تَجۡعَلۡنِي فِي ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ

en.text: My Lord, then do not place me among the wrongdoing people."

so.text: 94. Rabbiyow! Ha iga mid yeelin qoloda daalimiinta (gar ma qaatayaasha) ah.”

ayat.arabic: وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّرِيَكَ مَا نَعِدُهُمۡ لَقَٰدِرُونَ

en.text: And indeed, We are Able to show you what We have promised them.

so.text: 95. Annaguna inaan xaqiiqdii ku tusno waxaan ugu gooddinno waan Awoodnaa.

ayat.arabic: ٱدۡفَعۡ بِٱلَّتِي هِيَ أَحۡسَنُ ٱلسَّيِّئَةَۚ نَحۡنُ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَا يَصِفُونَ

en.text: Repel, by [means of] what is best, [their] evil. We are most knowing of what they describe.

so.text: 96. Ku tir xumaanta sida u wanaagsan, Annagaa Ogsoon waxay sheegayaan.

ayat.arabic: وَقُل رَّبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنۡ هَمَزَٰتِ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينِ

en.text: And say, "My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the incitements of the devils,

so.text: 97. Dheh: “Rabbiyow! Waxaan kaa magan gali waswaasinta shayaadiinta.

ayat.arabic: وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ رَبِّ أَن يَحۡضُرُونِ

en.text: And I seek refuge in You, my Lord, lest they be present with me."

so.text: 98. Waxaana kaa magan gali Rabbiyow inay ii yimaadaan shayaadiintu.

ayat.arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَ أَحَدَهُمُ ٱلۡمَوۡتُ قَالَ رَبِّ ٱرۡجِعُونِ

en.text: [For such is the state of the disbelievers] until, when death comes to one of them, he says, "My Lord, send me back

so.text: 99. Ilaa markay geeridu u timaaddo midkood (gaalada), wuxuu yidhaahdaa; Rabbiyow! Dib ii celi (adduunkii).

ayat.arabic: لَعَلِّيٓ أَعۡمَلُ صَٰلِحٗا فِيمَا تَرَكۡتُۚ كَلَّآۚ إِنَّهَا كَلِمَةٌ هُوَ قَآئِلُهَاۖ وَمِن وَرَآئِهِم بَرۡزَخٌ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ يُبۡعَثُونَ

en.text: That I might do righteousness in that which I left behind."[967] No! It is only a word he is saying; and behind them is a barrier until the Day they are resurrected.
en.footnotes: [967] Or "in that which I neglected."

so.text: 100. Si aan ugu falo wanaag waxaan ka soo tegay [15]. “May, ma jirto! Waa uun kelmad uu isaga hadlo, waxaana horti ah Barzakh 'xayir [16] aan furmeyn ilaa Maalinta la soo bixin doono (Qiyaamada).
so.footnotes:
[15]. Waxaasi aan ka dan iyo muraad la’aaday. 
[16]. Barzakh waa xaalka qofka uu ku sugnaan marka uu dhinto ilaa laga soo bixinayo, waana xaal iyo moos xir u dhexeeya adduunka iyo Aakhirada.

ayat.arabic: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِي ٱلصُّورِ فَلَآ أَنسَابَ بَيۡنَهُمۡ يَوۡمَئِذٖ وَلَا يَتَسَآءَلُونَ

en.text: So when the Horn is blown, no relationship will there be among them that Day, nor will they ask about one another.

so.text: 101. Marka la afuufo buunka, ma jirto qaraabbannimo dhexdooda ah Maalintaas, waxnana isma warsadaan.

ayat.arabic: فَمَن ثَقُلَتۡ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡمُفۡلِحُونَ

en.text: And those whose scales are heavy [with good deeds] - it is they who are the successful.

so.text: 102. Qofkay cuslaato miisaanka camalladiisa wanaagsan, kuwaa weeye kuwa ah liibaanayaasha.

ayat.arabic: وَمَنۡ خَفَّتۡ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓاْ أَنفُسَهُمۡ فِي جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدُونَ

en.text: But those whose scales are light - those are the ones who have lost their souls, [being] in Hell, abiding eternally.

so.text: 103. Qofkayse fududaato miisaanka camalladiisa wanaagsan - kuwaa weeye kuwa khasaaray nafahooda, Jahannamayna ku dhex waadhi.

ayat.arabic: تَلۡفَحُ وُجُوهَهُمُ ٱلنَّارُ وَهُمۡ فِيهَا كَٰلِحُونَ

en.text: The Fire will sear their faces, and they therein will have taut smiles.[968]
en.footnotes: [968] Their lips having been contracted by scorching until the teeth are exposed.

so.text: 104. Naartu waxay diiran wajiyadooda, iyagoo kuduudsan oo faruuran [17].
so.footnotes: [17]. Waxay noqon kuwo faruuran ilaa ilkuhu fool xumo muuqdaan.

ayat.arabic: أَلَمۡ تَكُنۡ ءَايَٰتِي تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡكُمۡ فَكُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ

en.text: [It will be said], "Were not My verses recited to you and you used to deny them?"

so.text: 105. (Waxaa lagu dhihi): Sow Aayadahayga la idiin ma akhriyi jirin oo ma aydaan beenin jirin.?”

ayat.arabic: قَالُواْ رَبَّنَا غَلَبَتۡ عَلَيۡنَا شِقۡوَتُنَا وَكُنَّا قَوۡمٗا ضَآلِّينَ

en.text: They will say, "Our Lord, our wretchedness overcame us, and we were a people astray.

so.text: 106. Waxay odhan: “Rabbigayow! Ayaandarradayadii baa naga adkaatay,  waxaana aheyn qolo habowsan.

ayat.arabic: رَبَّنَآ أَخۡرِجۡنَا مِنۡهَا فَإِنۡ عُدۡنَا فَإِنَّا ظَٰلِمُونَ

en.text: Our Lord, remove us from it, and if we were to return [to evil], we would indeed be wrongdoers."

so.text: 107. Rabbigayow! Naga bixi xaggeeda (Naarta); haddaan u noqonno (xumaan fal), innagaa daalimiin (gar ma qaatayaal) ah.”

ayat.arabic: قَالَ ٱخۡسَـُٔواْ فِيهَا وَلَا تُكَلِّمُونِ

en.text: He will say, "Remain despised therein and do not speak to Me.

so.text: 108. (Alle) Wuxuu odhan: Ku dullooba dhexdeeda (Naarta), hana ila hadlina.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فَرِيقٞ مِّنۡ عِبَادِي يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا فَٱغۡفِرۡ لَنَا وَٱرۡحَمۡنَا وَأَنتَ خَيۡرُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ

en.text: Indeed, there was a party of My servants who said, 'Our Lord, we have believed, so forgive us and have mercy upon us, and You are the best of the merciful.'

so.text: 109. Waxaa xaqiiq jiray qaar ka mid ah Addoomahayga oo odhan jiray: “Rabbigayow! waan rumaynay (Xaqa) ee noo denbi dhaaf, noona naxariiso,  Adigaa u wanaagsan inta naxariisata.”

ayat.arabic: فَٱتَّخَذۡتُمُوهُمۡ سِخۡرِيًّا حَتَّىٰٓ أَنسَوۡكُمۡ ذِكۡرِي وَكُنتُم مِّنۡهُمۡ تَضۡحَكُونَ

en.text: But you took them in mockery to the point that they made you forget My remembrance, and you used to laugh at them.

so.text: 110. Waxaadse ka yeelateen jees-jees, ilaa ay idin illowsiiyeen Xusiddeydii, waadna ku qosli jirteen.

ayat.arabic: إِنِّي جَزَيۡتُهُمُ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ بِمَا صَبَرُوٓاْ أَنَّهُمۡ هُمُ ٱلۡفَآئِزُونَ

en.text: Indeed, I have rewarded them this Day for their patient endurance - that they are the attainers [of success]."

so.text: 111. Waxaan anigu ku abaal mariyey Maanta samirkoodii darti inay iyagu yihiin guuleystayaasha.

ayat.arabic: قَٰلَ كَمۡ لَبِثۡتُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ عَدَدَ سِنِينَ

en.text: [Allāh] will say, "How long did you remain on earth in number of years?"

so.text: 112. (Alle) wuxuu odhan: “Immisa sano baad joogteen arlada?”

ayat.arabic: قَالُواْ لَبِثۡنَا يَوۡمًا أَوۡ بَعۡضَ يَوۡمٖ فَسۡـَٔلِ ٱلۡعَآدِّينَ

en.text: They will say, "We remained a day or part of a day; ask those who enumerate."

so.text: 113. Waxay odhan: “Waxaan joognay maalin ama maalin gelinkeed. Weydiiya kuwa wax tiriya (malaa'igta).”

ayat.arabic: قَٰلَ إِن لَّبِثۡتُمۡ إِلَّا قَلِيلٗاۖ لَّوۡ أَنَّكُمۡ كُنتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُونَ

en.text: He will say, "You stayed not but a little - if only you had known.

so.text: 114. Wuxuu odhan: “Ma aydaan joogin adduunka in yar ma’ahee haddaad ogaan lahaydeen.

ayat.arabic: أَفَحَسِبۡتُمۡ أَنَّمَا خَلَقۡنَٰكُمۡ عَبَثٗا وَأَنَّكُمۡ إِلَيۡنَا لَا تُرۡجَعُونَ

en.text: Then did you think that We created you uselessly and that to Us you would not be returned?"

so.text: 115. Ma waxaad mooddaan inaan idiin abuurnay dheel, oo aan Xaggayaga la idiin soo celineyn?

ayat.arabic: فَتَعَٰلَى ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡمَلِكُ ٱلۡحَقُّۖ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلۡعَرۡشِ ٱلۡكَرِيمِ

en.text: So exalted is Allāh, the Sovereign,[969] the Truth;[970] there is no deity except Him, Lord of the Noble Throne.
en.footnotes:
[969] And owner of everything in existence.
[970] Or "the True Reality."

so.text: 116. Waxaa Kor ah oo Sarreeya Allaah Boqorka Runta ah, ma jiro Ilaah (Xaq ah) aan Isaga ahayn, waa Rabbiga Carshiga Sharafta Badan.

ayat.arabic: وَمَن يَدۡعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ لَا بُرۡهَٰنَ لَهُۥ بِهِۦ فَإِنَّمَا حِسَابُهُۥ عِندَ رَبِّهِۦٓۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُفۡلِحُ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ

en.text: And whoever invokes besides Allāh another deity for which he has no proof - then his account is only with his Lord. Indeed, the disbelievers will not succeed.

so.text: 117. Qofkii barya (caabuda) Alle la jirkiis ilaah kale, uma heysto wax xujo ah arrinkani, xisaabintiisu waxay uun la jirtaa Rabbigi. Hubaal gaaladu ma liibaanaan.

ayat.arabic: وَقُل رَّبِّ ٱغۡفِرۡ وَٱرۡحَمۡ وَأَنتَ خَيۡرُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ

en.text: And, [O Muḥammad], say, "My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and You are the best of the merciful."

so.text: 118. Dheh: Rabbiyow! Denbi dhaaf oo Naxariiso, Adigaa u wanaagsan inta naxariisata.”

ayat.arabic: سُورَةٌ أَنزَلۡنَٰهَا وَفَرَضۡنَٰهَا وَأَنزَلۡنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَٰتِۭ بَيِّنَٰتٖ لَّعَلَّكُمۡ تَذَكَّرُونَ

en.text: [This is] a sūrah which We have sent down and made [that within it] obligatory and revealed therein verses of clear evidence that you might remember.

so.text: 1. (Tani) waa suurad aan soo dejinnay oo waajibinnay (ku camal falka axkaanteeda), kuna soo dejinnay dhexdeeda Aayado cad cad inaad xusuusataan (oo ku waano qaadataan).

ayat.arabic: ٱلزَّانِيَةُ وَٱلزَّانِي فَٱجۡلِدُواْ كُلَّ وَٰحِدٖ مِّنۡهُمَا مِاْئَةَ جَلۡدَةٖۖ وَلَا تَأۡخُذۡكُم بِهِمَا رَأۡفَةٞ فِي دِينِ ٱللَّهِ إِن كُنتُمۡ تُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلۡيَوۡمِ ٱلۡأٓخِرِۖ وَلۡيَشۡهَدۡ عَذَابَهُمَا طَآئِفَةٞ مِّنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ

en.text: The [unmarried] woman or [unmarried] man found guilty of sexual intercourse[972] - lash each one of them with a hundred lashes,[973] and do not be taken by pity for them in the religion [i.e., law] of Allāh,[974] if you should believe in Allāh and the Last Day. And let a group of the believers witness their punishment.
en.footnotes:
[972] Either by voluntary confession of the offender or the testimony of four male witnesses to having actually seen the act take place. Otherwise, there can be no conviction.
[973] The ruling in this verse is applicable to unmarried fornicators. Execution by stoning is confirmed in the sunnah for convicted adulterers.
[974] i.e., Do not let sympathy for a guilty person move you to alter anything ordained by Allāh, for in His law is protection of society as a whole.

so.text: 2. Zaaniydda iyo Zaaniga [1] ku jeedala midkood walba boqol jeedal [2]. Yeysanna turid [3] aad u tureysaan idinka celin fulinta Amarka Alle, haddaad rumeysan tihiin Alle iyo Maalinta Aakhiro, waana inay koox mu’miniin ah goob joog ka ahaadaan ciqaabkooda.
so.footnotes:
[1]. Zaaniyadda (dhillada) iyo zaaniga (dhillayga) waxaa lagu fulin ciqaabkaa hadday iskood u qirtaan inay faleen galmo xaaraan ah ama hadday ku marag furaan afar nin oo caadil ah.
[2]. Xukunka ku soo arooray Aayaddan wuxuu ku gaar yahay kuwa ku dhaca denbiga zinada (galmada xaaraanta ah) iyagoo aan horay marnaba u guursan, waa in la jeedalo boqol jeedal oo sannad la fogeeyo sida in la xabbiso. Qofkiise zineysta isagoo xaas ah ama horay u soo guursaday oo si dhan u qirta denbigaa, ama ay ku markhaati furaan afar nin oo caadil ah, waa in lagu shiido dhagax ilaa uu ka dhinto. 
[3]. Waa inaysan turid aad u tureysaan dhillada iyo dhillayga idiin horseedin inaad wax ka beddeshaan wuxuu Alle qoray oo soo gooyey, waayo xeerarkiisa waxaa ugu jira dhowris iyo daryeel danaha dadweynaha oo dhan.

ayat.arabic: ٱلزَّانِي لَا يَنكِحُ إِلَّا زَانِيَةً أَوۡ مُشۡرِكَةٗ وَٱلزَّانِيَةُ لَا يَنكِحُهَآ إِلَّا زَانٍ أَوۡ مُشۡرِكٞۚ وَحُرِّمَ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ

en.text: The fornicator does not marry except a [female] fornicator or polytheist, and none marries her except a fornicator[975] or a polytheist, and that [i.e., marriage to such persons] has been made unlawful to the believers.
en.footnotes: [975] Included in this ruling is the adulterer as well. Such persons cannot be married to believers unless they have repented and reformed.

so.text: 3. Zaanigu (dhillaygu) ma uu la galmo galo waxaan aheyn Zaaniyad (dhillo) ama Mushrikad (gaalad),  Zaaniyaddana (dhillada) ma ay la galmo galaan waxaan aheyn zaani (dhillay) ama Mushrik (gaal),  waana ka xaaraan mu’miniinta 'guursiga kuwaasi iyaga ah' [4].
so.footnotes: [4]. Dadkaa oo kale (dhillada ama dhillayga) looma guurin karo mu’miniinta in maahee ay tawbad keeneen oo toosnaadeen oo laga arko isbeddel wanaagsan iyo hanuun. Waxaa sidoo kale lagu fasiray ninka zaaniga ah (dhillayga) ma guursado waxaan ahayn zaaniyad (dhillo) la mid ah ama gaalad, haweenta zaaniyadda ahina (dhillada) waxaa guursada uun zaani (dhillay) la mid ah ama gaal, waana laga xaaraanshay mu’miniinta guursiga kuwaasi iyaga ah.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَرۡمُونَ ٱلۡمُحۡصَنَٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمۡ يَأۡتُواْ بِأَرۡبَعَةِ شُهَدَآءَ فَٱجۡلِدُوهُمۡ ثَمَٰنِينَ جَلۡدَةٗ وَلَا تَقۡبَلُواْ لَهُمۡ شَهَٰدَةً أَبَدٗاۚ وَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡفَٰسِقُونَ

en.text: And those who accuse chaste women and then do not produce four witnesses - lash them with eighty lashes and do not accept from them testimony ever after. And those are the defiantly disobedient,

so.text: 4. Kuwa qadfa (ku sheega) dumar (ama rag) dhowrsoon (zino-dhilleysi), oo aan keenin afar markhaati ah, jeedala siddeetan jeedal, hana ka yeelina wax marag fur ah abadkood, kuwaasina waa uun faasiqiin.

ayat.arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ تَابُواْ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ ذَٰلِكَ وَأَصۡلَحُواْ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٞ

en.text: Except for those who repent thereafter and reform, for indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.

so.text: 5. Kuwa tawbad keena intaas kaddib ma’ahee, oo samaada,  hubaal Alle waa Denbi Dhaaf Badane, Naxariis Badan.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَرۡمُونَ أَزۡوَٰجَهُمۡ وَلَمۡ يَكُن لَّهُمۡ شُهَدَآءُ إِلَّآ أَنفُسُهُمۡ فَشَهَٰدَةُ أَحَدِهِمۡ أَرۡبَعُ شَهَٰدَٰتِۭ بِٱللَّهِ إِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ

en.text: And those who accuse their wives [of adultery] and have no witnesses except themselves - then the witness of one of them[976] [shall be] four testimonies [swearing] by Allāh that indeed, he is of the truthful.
en.footnotes: [976] The husbands who have been betrayed.

so.text: 6. Kuwa qadfa (ku sheega zino- dhilleysi) xaasaskooda oo aan haysan markhaati aan aheyn nafahooda, marag furka midkood walba oo ka mid ah (waa in la dhaariyo) afar jeer, isagoo markhaati gashanaya Alle inuu  run sheegayo.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلۡخَٰمِسَةُ أَنَّ لَعۡنَتَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيۡهِ إِن كَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡكَٰذِبِينَ

en.text: And the fifth [oath will be] that the curse of Allāh be upon him if he should be of the liars.

so.text: 7. Tan shanaad (waa inuu ku dhaarto) in Nacaladda Alle ku dhacdo hadduu been sheegayo.

ayat.arabic: وَيَدۡرَؤُاْ عَنۡهَا ٱلۡعَذَابَ أَن تَشۡهَدَ أَرۡبَعَ شَهَٰدَٰتِۭ بِٱللَّهِ إِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلۡكَٰذِبِينَ

en.text: But it will prevent punishment from her if she gives four testimonies [swearing] by Allāh that indeed, he is of the liars.

so.text: 8. Waxaa ka baajin iyadana ciqaabta inay dhaarato afar jeer, iyadoo marag gashaneysa Alle inuu been sheegayo.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلۡخَٰمِسَةَ أَنَّ غَضَبَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيۡهَآ إِن كَانَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ

en.text: And the fifth [oath will be] that the wrath of Allāh be upon her if he was of the truthful.

so.text: 9. Tan shanaadna (waxay ku dhaaran) in Cadhada Alle ku dhacdo hadduu run sheegayo.

ayat.arabic: وَلَوۡلَا فَضۡلُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيۡكُمۡ وَرَحۡمَتُهُۥ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ تَوَّابٌ حَكِيمٌ

en.text: And if not for the favor of Allāh upon you and His mercy...[977] and because Allāh is Accepting of Repentance and Wise.
en.footnotes: [977] The phrase omitted is estimated to be "...you would have surely been punished, destroyed or scandalized," or "...you would have suffered many difficult situations."

so.text: 10. Hadduuna jirin Fadliga Alle korkiinna iyo Naxariistiisa [5], iyo inuu Alle yahay mid Tawbad Aqbal Badan, Xakiim ah.
so.footnotes: [5]. Hadalka inta ka go’an waa la qiyaasi karaa, wuxuu u dhacayaa waxaa ku dhici lahaa beenaalaha cadaab daran’.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ جَآءُو بِٱلۡإِفۡكِ عُصۡبَةٞ مِّنكُمۡۚ لَا تَحۡسَبُوهُ شَرّٗا لَّكُمۖ بَلۡ هُوَ خَيۡرٞ لَّكُمۡۚ لِكُلِّ ٱمۡرِيٕٖ مِّنۡهُم مَّا ٱكۡتَسَبَ مِنَ ٱلۡإِثۡمِۚ وَٱلَّذِي تَوَلَّىٰ كِبۡرَهُۥ مِنۡهُمۡ لَهُۥ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٞ

en.text: Indeed, those who came with falsehood[978] are a group among you. Do not think it bad for you; rather, it is good for you. For every person among them is what [punishment] he has earned from the sin, and he who took upon himself the greater portion thereof[979] - for him is a great punishment [i.e., Hellfire].
en.footnotes:
[978] Referring to the incident when the Prophet's wife ʿĀ’ishah was falsely accused by the hypocrites.
[979] i.e., ʿAbdullāh bin ʿUbayy, leader of the hypocrites.

so.text: 11. Xaqiiq, kuwa la yimid  been abuurka 'qadafka Caa'isha, xaaskii Nabiga s.c w.' [6] waa koox idin ka mid ah; ha u arkina inay shar idiin tahay, mayee’ waa idiin khayr (axkaanta ka soo degtay darteed). Qof kasta oo ka mid ahina wuxuu mudan wuxuu kasbaday oo denbi ah. Kan qaybta weyn ka qaatay [7] ee ka mid ah wuxuu leeyahay cadaab weyn.
so.footnotes:
[6]. Waxay tilmaameysaa dhacdadii markii xaaska Nabiga s.c.w. Caa’isha a.k.r ay been ugu tuhmeen munaafiqiinta inay la timid gogol dhaaf.
[7]. Waa Cabdullaah bin Ubay bin Salool, madaxii munaafiqiinta waagaas.

ayat.arabic: لَّوۡلَآ إِذۡ سَمِعۡتُمُوهُ ظَنَّ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنَٰتُ بِأَنفُسِهِمۡ خَيۡرٗا وَقَالُواْ هَٰذَآ إِفۡكٞ مُّبِينٞ

en.text: Why, when you heard it, did not the believing men and believing women think good of themselves [i.e., one another] and say, "This is an obvious falsehood"?

so.text: 12. Maxaydaan markaad maqasheen (qadafkaa) ugu malayn mu’miniinta rag iyo haweenba khayr isla dadkoodaasi, oo ay u odhan: “Waxakani waa been abuur cad?”

ayat.arabic: لَّوۡلَا جَآءُو عَلَيۡهِ بِأَرۡبَعَةِ شُهَدَآءَۚ فَإِذۡ لَمۡ يَأۡتُواْ بِٱلشُّهَدَآءِ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ هُمُ ٱلۡكَٰذِبُونَ

en.text: Why did they [who slandered] not produce for it four witnesses? And when they do not produce the witnesses, then it is they, in the sight of Allāh, who are the liars.

so.text: 13. Maxayse u keeni waayeen afar markhaati? Maadaama aysan keenin markhaatiyaal, kuwaasu Alle agtiisa waxay ka yihiin beenalayaal.

ayat.arabic: وَلَوۡلَا فَضۡلُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيۡكُمۡ وَرَحۡمَتُهُۥ فِي ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ لَمَسَّكُمۡ فِي مَآ أَفَضۡتُمۡ فِيهِ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ

en.text: And if it had not been for the favor of Allāh upon you and His mercy in this world and the Hereafter, you would have been touched for that [lie] in which you were involved by a great punishment

so.text: 14. Hadduuna jirin Fadliga Alle korkiinna iyo Naxariistiisu adduun iyo Aakhiraba, waxaa idinku taaban lahaa waxaad ku hadasheen darteed cadaab daran.

ayat.arabic: إِذۡ تَلَقَّوۡنَهُۥ بِأَلۡسِنَتِكُمۡ وَتَقُولُونَ بِأَفۡوَاهِكُم مَّا لَيۡسَ لَكُم بِهِۦ عِلۡمٞ وَتَحۡسَبُونَهُۥ هَيِّنٗا وَهُوَ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ عَظِيمٞ

en.text: When you received it with your tongues[980] and said with your mouths that of which you had no knowledge and thought it was insignificant while it was, in the sight of Allāh, tremendous.
en.footnotes: [980] Rather than your ears, i.e., not thinking about what you had heard but hastening to repeat it carelessly.

so.text: 15. Markaad ku gaddonteen (qadafkaa) carrabyadiinna [8], oo aad ka laheydeen afafkiinnna wax aydaan ogeyn, waxaad mooddeen arrin fudud, halka Alle agtiis ay aheyd wax daran oo baas.
so.footnotes: [8]. Halkaad ku maqli lahaydeen dhegahiinna macnaha waa idinkoo aan ka fekerin waxa aad maqasheen oo u fiirsan bal u degdegay inaad iska sheegsheegtaan warkaa been abuurka ah idinkoo aan tixgelin waxa aad leedihiin oo ku hadleysaan.

ayat.arabic: وَلَوۡلَآ إِذۡ سَمِعۡتُمُوهُ قُلۡتُم مَّا يَكُونُ لَنَآ أَن نَّتَكَلَّمَ بِهَٰذَا سُبۡحَٰنَكَ هَٰذَا بُهۡتَٰنٌ عَظِيمٞ

en.text: And why, when you heard it, did you not say, "It is not for us to speak of this. Exalted are You, [O Allāh]; this is a great slander"?

so.text: 16. Maxaydaan markaad maqasheen u odhan: "Nooma habboona inaan ka hadallo waxakani. Adigaa hufan (Allow)! Kani (qadafkan) waa been abuur weyn".

ayat.arabic: يَعِظُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ أَن تَعُودُواْ لِمِثۡلِهِۦٓ أَبَدًا إِن كُنتُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ

en.text: Allāh warns you against returning to the likes of this [conduct], ever, if you should be believers.

so.text: 17. Alle wuu idinka waanin inaad u noqotaan waxaasoo kale weligiin, haddaad tihiin mu’miniin dhab ah.

ayat.arabic: وَيُبَيِّنُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمُ ٱلۡأٓيَٰتِۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ

en.text: And Allāh makes clear to you the verses [i.e., His rulings], and Allāh is Knowing and Wise.

so.text: 18. Wuxuu Alle idiin caddeyn Aayadaha. Alle waa wax walba Oge, Xikmad Badan.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُحِبُّونَ أَن تَشِيعَ ٱلۡفَٰحِشَةُ فِي ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٞ فِي ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَٱلۡأٓخِرَةِۚ وَٱللَّهُ يَعۡلَمُ وَأَنتُمۡ لَا تَعۡلَمُونَ

en.text: Indeed, those who like that immorality[981] should be spread [or publicized] among those who have believed will have a painful punishment in this world and the Hereafter. And Allāh knows[982] and you do not know.
en.footnotes:
[981] Specifically, unlawful sexual relations.
[982] The hidden aspects of all things: what is beneficial and what is harmful.

so.text: 19. Xaqiiq, kuwa jecel inay xumaantu [9] ku faafto mu’miniinta dhexdooda, waxay leeyihiin cadaab xanuun badan adduun iyo Aakhiraba. Alle baana Og, idinkuna ma ogidin [10].
so.footnotes:
[9]. Waxaa gaar ahaan loola jeedaa zinada iyo xiriirrada xun ee aan bannaaeyn: galmada xaaraanta ah. 
[10]. Arrimaha qarsoon ee wax waliba: Waxa wanaagsan ee dani ku jirto iyo faa’idada iyo waxa xun ee dhibaatada leh.

ayat.arabic: وَلَوۡلَا فَضۡلُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيۡكُمۡ وَرَحۡمَتُهُۥ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ رَءُوفٞ رَّحِيمٞ

en.text: And if it had not been for the favor of Allāh upon you and His mercy...[983] and because Allāh is Kind and Merciful.
en.footnotes: [983] See footnote to verse 10.

so.text: 20. Hadduuna jirin Fadliga Alle korkiinna iyo Naxariistiisu iyo inuu Alle yahay Turid Badane, Naxariis Badan (waad halaagsami laheydeen).

ayat.arabic: ۞ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَا تَتَّبِعُواْ خُطُوَٰتِ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنِۚ وَمَن يَتَّبِعۡ خُطُوَٰتِ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنِ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَأۡمُرُ بِٱلۡفَحۡشَآءِ وَٱلۡمُنكَرِۚ وَلَوۡلَا فَضۡلُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيۡكُمۡ وَرَحۡمَتُهُۥ مَا زَكَىٰ مِنكُم مِّنۡ أَحَدٍ أَبَدٗا وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُزَكِّي مَن يَشَآءُۗ وَٱللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٞ

en.text: O you who have believed, do not follow the footsteps of Satan. And whoever follows the footsteps of Satan - indeed, he enjoins immorality and wrongdoing. And if not for the favor of Allāh upon you and His mercy, not one of you would have been pure, ever, but Allāh purifies whom He wills, and Allāh is Hearing and Knowing.

so.text: 21. Kuwa (Xaqa) rumeeyow! Ha raacina tallaabooyinka (jidadka) shaydaanka. Qofkii raaca tallaaboyinka shaydaanka, wuxuu amraa xumaanta iyo waxa la karho. Hadduusan jirin Fadliga Alle korkiinna iyo Naxariistiisa, ma daahir noqdeen qofna idinka mid ah weligi. Alle baase daahiriya qofkuu doono. Alle waa wax kasta Maqle, wax kasta Og.

ayat.arabic: وَلَا يَأۡتَلِ أُوْلُواْ ٱلۡفَضۡلِ مِنكُمۡ وَٱلسَّعَةِ أَن يُؤۡتُوٓاْ أُوْلِي ٱلۡقُرۡبَىٰ وَٱلۡمَسَٰكِينَ وَٱلۡمُهَٰجِرِينَ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِۖ وَلۡيَعۡفُواْ وَلۡيَصۡفَحُوٓاْۗ أَلَا تُحِبُّونَ أَن يَغۡفِرَ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمۡۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٌ

en.text: And let not those of virtue among you and wealth swear not to give [aid] to their relatives and the needy and the emigrants for the cause of Allāh, and let them pardon and overlook. Would you not like that Allāh should forgive you? And Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.

so.text: 22. Yey ka dhaaranna kuwaa idinka mid ah ee leh fadliga dheeraadka ah ee ladan inay siiyaan (kaalmo) qaraabadooda, masaakiinta, iyo kuwa uga soo haajiray guryahooda Alle Dartiis. Ha iska cafiyeen hana saamaxeen. Miyeydaan jecleyn in Alle idiin denbi Dhaafo [11]?Alle waa Denbi Dhaaf Badane, Naxariis Badan.
so.footnotes: [11]. Abuu Bakar a.k.r. markay soo degeen Aayadahan oo Alle yidhi: Miyeydaan jecleyn inuu Alle idiin denbi dhaafo? Wuxuu yidhi: Haayoo, waan jeclahay, wuxuuna dib u billaabay inuu siiyo Misdax oo ay qaraabo ahaayeen oo ka mid ahaa raggii beenta ka fidshay Caa’isha a.k.r. kaalmadii uu siin jirey, oo kafaara gud ka sameeyey dhaartii uu ka dhaartay.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَرۡمُونَ ٱلۡمُحۡصَنَٰتِ ٱلۡغَٰفِلَٰتِ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنَٰتِ لُعِنُواْ فِي ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٞ

en.text: Indeed, those who [falsely] accuse chaste, unaware and believing women are cursed in this world and the Hereafter; and they will have a great punishment

so.text: 23. Xaqiiq, kuwa ku sheega (zino) dumarka dhawrsoon mu’minaatka ah, ee moog oo ka war la’ 'xumo oo dhan' [12], waa lagu nacladay adduun iyo aakhiraba, waxayna mudan cadaab weyn.
so.footnotes: [12]. Waxaa loola jeedaa mu’minaatka moog oo ka war la’ xumaha, mu’minaatka aanay marnaba ku soo dhicin qalbigooda inay falaan wax xun ee iyagu nadiifka ah dhowrsoon.

ayat.arabic: يَوۡمَ تَشۡهَدُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ أَلۡسِنَتُهُمۡ وَأَيۡدِيهِمۡ وَأَرۡجُلُهُم بِمَا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ

en.text: On a Day when their tongues, their hands and their feet will bear witness against them as to what they used to do.

so.text: 24. Maalinta carrabyadoodu, gacmahoodu, iyo lugahoodu ay ku markhaati furi waxay falayeen.

ayat.arabic: يَوۡمَئِذٖ يُوَفِّيهِمُ ٱللَّهُ دِينَهُمُ ٱلۡحَقَّ وَيَعۡلَمُونَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلۡحَقُّ ٱلۡمُبِينُ

en.text: That Day, Allāh will pay them in full their true [i.e., deserved] recompense, and they will know that it is Allāh who is the manifest Truth [i.e., perfect in justice].

so.text: 25. Maalintaas Alle wuxuu ugu oofin si dhan abaalgudkooda sugan, waxayna ogaan inuu Alle yahay Xaqa muuqda.

ayat.arabic: ٱلۡخَبِيثَٰتُ لِلۡخَبِيثِينَ وَٱلۡخَبِيثُونَ لِلۡخَبِيثَٰتِۖ وَٱلطَّيِّبَٰتُ لِلطَّيِّبِينَ وَٱلطَّيِّبُونَ لِلطَّيِّبَٰتِۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ مُبَرَّءُونَ مِمَّا يَقُولُونَۖ لَهُم مَّغۡفِرَةٞ وَرِزۡقٞ كَرِيمٞ

en.text: Evil words are for evil men, and evil men are [subjected] to evil words. And good words are for good men, and good men are [an object] of good words.[984] Those [good people] are declared innocent of what they [i.e., slanderers] say. For them is forgiveness and noble provision.
en.footnotes: [984] Another accepted interpretation is "Evil women are for evil men, and evil men are for evil women. And good women are for good men, and good men are for good women."

so.text: 26. Hadallo (iyo camallo) xun (waxaa leh  oo lagu yaqaan) dadka xun. Dadka xumina waxay (ku hadlaan oo falaan) hadallo (iyo camallo) xun, hadallo (iyo camallo) fiican [13] waxaa (leh oo lagu yaqaan) dadka fiican, dadka fiicanna waxay (ku hadlaan oo falaan) hadallo (iyo camallo) fiican. Kuwani (Caa'isha iyo eynigeed) waa ka barii (fog yihiin) waxay ka sheegayaan, waxayna leeyhiin denbi dhaaf iyo risiq wanaagsan.
so.footnotes:
[13]. Waxaa sidoo kale lagu fasiray: Haweenka xun waxay u sugnaadeen nimanka xun, nimanka xunna waxaa u sugnaaday haween xun, haweenka wanaagsan waxay u sugnaadeen nimanka wanaagsan, nimanka wanaagsanna waxaa u sugnaaday haween wanaagsan. Arrinkanina waa sida qaalibka ah laakiin way dhacdaa inkastoo ayan badneyn in naag xumi uu ku soo aado nin wanaagsan, nin xunna ay ku soo aaddo naag wanaagsan, naag wanaagsanina uu ku soo aado nin xun, nin wanaagsanina ay ku soo aaddo naag xun. Laakiin waa in yar.
Alle wuxuu Aayadahan ku barii yeelay hooyadii mu'miniinta Caa'isha a.k.r.

ayat.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَا تَدۡخُلُواْ بُيُوتًا غَيۡرَ بُيُوتِكُمۡ حَتَّىٰ تَسۡتَأۡنِسُواْ وَتُسَلِّمُواْ عَلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِهَاۚ ذَٰلِكُمۡ خَيۡرٞ لَّكُمۡ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَذَكَّرُونَ

en.text: O you who have believed, do not enter houses other than your own houses until you ascertain welcome and greet[985] their inhabitants. That is best for you; perhaps you will be reminded [i.e., advised].
en.footnotes: [985] By the words "As-salāmu ʿalaykum" ("Peace be upon you").

so.text: 27. Kuwa (Xaqa) rumeeyow! Ha gelina guryo aan aheyn guryihiinna jeer aad idan weydiisataan, oo salaantaan ehelkooda [14], sidaasaa idiin khayr badan inaad xusuusnaataan.
so.footnotes: [14]. Waa aad ku salaantaan salaanta islaamka: Assalaamu Calaykum (Nabad dushiinna ha ahaato).

ayat.arabic: فَإِن لَّمۡ تَجِدُواْ فِيهَآ أَحَدٗا فَلَا تَدۡخُلُوهَا حَتَّىٰ يُؤۡذَنَ لَكُمۡۖ وَإِن قِيلَ لَكُمُ ٱرۡجِعُواْ فَٱرۡجِعُواْۖ هُوَ أَزۡكَىٰ لَكُمۡۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ عَلِيمٞ

en.text: And if you do not find anyone therein, do not enter them until permission has been given you. And if it is said to you, "Go back,"[986] then go back; it is purer for you. And Allāh is Knowing of what you do.
en.footnotes: [986] Or a similar expression showing that the occupants are not prepared to receive visitors (which should be respected).

so.text: 28. Haddaydaan ka helin cidna gudahooda, markaa ha gelina jeer la idin siiyo idan.  Haddii la idin yidhaahdona noqda [15], markaa noqda; sidaasaa idiin daahirsan. Alle waa Og yahay waxaad fashaan.
so.footnotes: [15]. Ama weedh la mid ah noqda ee muujineysa in reerka guriga iska leh diyaar u ahayn inay qaabilaan dad soo booqda ( taasoo ah in la tixgeliyo).

ayat.arabic: لَّيۡسَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ جُنَاحٌ أَن تَدۡخُلُواْ بُيُوتًا غَيۡرَ مَسۡكُونَةٖ فِيهَا مَتَٰعٞ لَّكُمۡۚ وَٱللَّهُ يَعۡلَمُ مَا تُبۡدُونَ وَمَا تَكۡتُمُونَ

en.text: There is no blame upon you for entering houses not inhabited in which there is convenience[987] for you. And Allāh knows what you reveal and what you conceal.
en.footnotes: [987] Some benefit such as rest, shelter, commodities, one's personal belongings, etc.

so.text: 29. Ma aha korkiinna denbi inaad gashaan (idan la’aan) guryo aan la degganayn ay gudahooda idiin yaalaan alaabadiinna [16]. Alle wuu Ogsoon yahay waxaad si cad u fashaan iyo waxaad qarisaanba.
so.footnotes: [16]. Idiin yaallaan xoogaa manfaco ah sida nasiino, hoyaad, alaabo, qofka waxyaalahiiisa gaarka ah, iwm

ayat.arabic: قُل لِّلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ يَغُضُّواْ مِنۡ أَبۡصَٰرِهِمۡ وَيَحۡفَظُواْ فُرُوجَهُمۡۚ ذَٰلِكَ أَزۡكَىٰ لَهُمۡۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ خَبِيرُۢ بِمَا يَصۡنَعُونَ

en.text: Tell the believing men to reduce [some] of their vision[988] and guard their private parts.[989] That is purer for them. Indeed, Allāh is [fully] Aware of what they do.
en.footnotes:
[988] Looking only at what is lawful and averting their eyes from what is unlawful.
[989] From being seen and from unlawful acts.

so.text: 30. Waxaad ku dhahdaa mu’miniinta ha ka laabeen aragyadooda 'xaaraanta' [17], hana ilaashadeen xubnahooda gaarka ah [18], sidaasaa u daahirsan. Hubaal, Alle waa u Xog Ogaal waxay sameyn.
so.footnotes:
[17]. Iyagoo eegaya oo keliya waxa bannaan oo ka jeedinaya indhahood waxa aan u bannaaneyn in la eego. 
[18]. Ha ka ilaaliyeen galmo xaaraan ah, iyo inay soo bandhigaan cawradooda, cawrada ninkana waa inta u dhexeysa xuddunta iyo jilibka, oo ha ka xafitaan sidoo kale ficillada aan bannaaneyn (galmooyinka xaaraanta ah).

ayat.arabic: وَقُل لِّلۡمُؤۡمِنَٰتِ يَغۡضُضۡنَ مِنۡ أَبۡصَٰرِهِنَّ وَيَحۡفَظۡنَ فُرُوجَهُنَّ وَلَا يُبۡدِينَ زِينَتَهُنَّ إِلَّا مَا ظَهَرَ مِنۡهَاۖ وَلۡيَضۡرِبۡنَ بِخُمُرِهِنَّ عَلَىٰ جُيُوبِهِنَّۖ وَلَا يُبۡدِينَ زِينَتَهُنَّ إِلَّا لِبُعُولَتِهِنَّ أَوۡ ءَابَآئِهِنَّ أَوۡ ءَابَآءِ بُعُولَتِهِنَّ أَوۡ أَبۡنَآئِهِنَّ أَوۡ أَبۡنَآءِ بُعُولَتِهِنَّ أَوۡ إِخۡوَٰنِهِنَّ أَوۡ بَنِيٓ إِخۡوَٰنِهِنَّ أَوۡ بَنِيٓ أَخَوَٰتِهِنَّ أَوۡ نِسَآئِهِنَّ أَوۡ مَا مَلَكَتۡ أَيۡمَٰنُهُنَّ أَوِ ٱلتَّٰبِعِينَ غَيۡرِ أُوْلِي ٱلۡإِرۡبَةِ مِنَ ٱلرِّجَالِ أَوِ ٱلطِّفۡلِ ٱلَّذِينَ لَمۡ يَظۡهَرُواْ عَلَىٰ عَوۡرَٰتِ ٱلنِّسَآءِۖ وَلَا يَضۡرِبۡنَ بِأَرۡجُلِهِنَّ لِيُعۡلَمَ مَا يُخۡفِينَ مِن زِينَتِهِنَّۚ وَتُوبُوٓاْ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ جَمِيعًا أَيُّهَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تُفۡلِحُونَ

en.text: And tell the believing women to reduce [some] of their vision[990] and guard their private parts and not expose their adornment[991] except that which [necessarily] appears thereof[992] and to wrap [a portion of] their headcovers over their chests and not expose their adornment [i.e., beauty] except to their husbands, their fathers, their husbands' fathers, their sons, their husbands' sons, their brothers, their brothers' sons, their sisters' sons, their women, that which their right hands possess [i.e., slaves], or those male attendants having no physical desire,[993] or children who are not yet aware of the private aspects of women. And let them not stamp their feet to make known what they conceal of their adornment. And turn to Allāh in repentance, all of you, O believers, that you might succeed.
en.footnotes:
[990] Looking only at what is lawful and averting their eyes from what is unlawful.
[991] Both natural beauty, such as hair or body shape, and that with which a woman beautifies herself of clothing, jewelry, etc.
[992] i.e., the outer garments or whatever might appear out of necessity, such as a part of the face or the hands.
[993] Referring to an abnormal condition in which a man is devoid of sexual feeling.

so.text: 31.
