Waxaad ku dhahdaa mu’minaatka ha ka laabeen aragyadooda 'xaaraanta' [19] hana xafitaan xubnahooda gaarka ah, yey muujinna quruxdooda [20] wixii iska muuqda maahee [21], hana ku soo dadaan hagoogtooda luqumahooda dushooda iyo laabahooda, yeysanna u muujin quruxdooda (dhan) waxaan aheyn nimankooda qaba, ama (wax ka mid ah quruxdaa sida wejiyadooda, luqumahooda, iyo gacmahooda oo qudha) aabbayaashood, ama aabbayaasha nimankooda qaba, ama wiilashooda, ama wiilasha nimankooda qaba, ama walaalahood, ama wiilasha walaalahood, ama wiilasha walaalooyinkood, ama haweenkooda, ama kuwaa ay gacmahoodu midig hantaan, ama kuwa raacsan ee labka ah oo aan laheyn haweysi dumar [22], ama ilmaha aan weli yeelan dareen ay ku fiirsadaan cawro dumar. Yeysanna ku garaacin (dhulka) lugahooda si loo ogaado waxay qariyaan oo quruxdooda ah. U tawbad keena Alle idinkoo dhan, mu’miniintoy aad liibaantaane.
so.footnotes:
[19]. Iyagoo eegaya oo keliya waxa bannaan oo ka jeedinaya indhahood waxa aan u bannaaneyn in la eego. Cawrada haweenta markay debedda u baxeyso waa jirkooda oo dhan waa inayan waxba ka muuqan.
[20]. Haddii ay tahay quruxdooda dabiiciga ah sida timaha ama qaabka jirkooda, ama waxay dumarka isku qurxiyaan ee leh dharka qurxoon ama dahabka ay xidhaan, iwm. 
[21]. Waa shukada ay dusha ka gashtaan dumarka oo jirkooda ku qarsadsaan ama wixii ka muuqda oo baahi keento ay ka fursan waayaan.
[22]. Waxay tilmaameysaa xaalad aan caadi ahayn oo ah nin aan innaba lahayn dareen galmo iyo u tegis haween iyo shahwo.

ayat.arabic: وَأَنكِحُواْ ٱلۡأَيَٰمَىٰ مِنكُمۡ وَٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ مِنۡ عِبَادِكُمۡ وَإِمَآئِكُمۡۚ إِن يَكُونُواْ فُقَرَآءَ يُغۡنِهِمُ ٱللَّهُ مِن فَضۡلِهِۦۗ وَٱللَّهُ وَٰسِعٌ عَلِيمٞ

en.text: And marry the unmarried among you and the righteous among your male slaves and female slaves. If they should be poor, Allāh will enrich them from His bounty, and Allāh is all-Encompassing and Knowing.

so.text: 32. U guuriya [23] kuwaa idinka midka ah ee doobka ah iyo kuwa wanaagsan ee ka mid ah addoomahiinna (ragga ah), iyo addoonnadiinna (dumarka ahi), hadday yihiin fuqaro, Alle baa ugu deeqi Fadlgiisa. Alle waa deeq Ballaarne, wax kasta Ogsoon.
so.footnotes: [23]. Waxaa loola jeedaa addoomahaa doonaya inay iska xoreeyaan kuwaasi iska leh ee milkiyey iyagoo siinaya qiimo ay ku wada heshiiyaan.

ayat.arabic: وَلۡيَسۡتَعۡفِفِ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَجِدُونَ نِكَاحًا حَتَّىٰ يُغۡنِيَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ مِن فَضۡلِهِۦۗ وَٱلَّذِينَ يَبۡتَغُونَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ مِمَّا مَلَكَتۡ أَيۡمَٰنُكُمۡ فَكَاتِبُوهُمۡ إِنۡ عَلِمۡتُمۡ فِيهِمۡ خَيۡرٗاۖ وَءَاتُوهُم مِّن مَّالِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِيٓ ءَاتَىٰكُمۡۚ وَلَا تُكۡرِهُواْ فَتَيَٰتِكُمۡ عَلَى ٱلۡبِغَآءِ إِنۡ أَرَدۡنَ تَحَصُّنٗا لِّتَبۡتَغُواْ عَرَضَ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَاۚ وَمَن يُكۡرِههُّنَّ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ إِكۡرَٰهِهِنَّ غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٞ

en.text: But let them who find not [the means for] marriage abstain [from sexual relations] until Allāh enriches them from His bounty. And those who seek a contract [for eventual emancipation] from among whom your right hands possess[994] - then make a contract with them if you know there is within them goodness and give them from the wealth of Allāh which He has given you. And do not compel your slave girls to prostitution, if they desire chastity, to seek [thereby] the temporary interests of worldly life. And if someone should compel them, then indeed, Allāh is [to them], after their compulsion, Forgiving and Merciful.
en.footnotes: [994] i.e., those slaves who desire to purchase their freedom from their owners for a price agreed upon by both.

so.text: 33. Ha dhowrsadeen kuwa aan heli karin waxay ku guursadaaan inta uu Alle kaga hodmin Fadligiisa. Kuwa dalbana qoritaan (is-xoreyn) ee ka mid ah kuwaa ay gacmahiinna midig hantaan, siiya qoraalkaasi, haddaad ku og tihiin wanaag. Oo wax ka siiyana maalka Alle uu idin siiyey. Hana ku qasbina gabdhahiinna addoonadaha ah zino hadday rabaan inay ku sugnaadaan dhowrsanaan idinkoo doonaya sadka dhammaanaya ee noloshan adduunka. Ciddii qasabta, hubaal Alle, ku qasbiddooda kaddib, waa Denbi Dhaaf Badane, Naxariis Badan.

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ أَنزَلۡنَآ إِلَيۡكُمۡ ءَايَٰتٖ مُّبَيِّنَٰتٖ وَمَثَلٗا مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَلَوۡاْ مِن قَبۡلِكُمۡ وَمَوۡعِظَةٗ لِّلۡمُتَّقِينَ

en.text: And We have certainly sent down to you distinct verses[995] and examples from those who passed on before you and an admonition for those who fear Allāh.
en.footnotes: [995] i.e., rulings and ordinances, in particular those in this sūrah.

so.text: 34. Waxaan idiin soo dejinnay Aayado cad cad [24], iyo tusaale kuwii tegay hortiin, iyo waanada kuwa (ka) dhowrsada (xumaha).
so.footnotes: [24]. Waa xukunnada iyo xeerarka, gaar ahaan kuwa ku soo arooray Suuraddan.

ayat.arabic: ۞ ٱللَّهُ نُورُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ مَثَلُ نُورِهِۦ كَمِشۡكَوٰةٖ فِيهَا مِصۡبَاحٌۖ ٱلۡمِصۡبَاحُ فِي زُجَاجَةٍۖ ٱلزُّجَاجَةُ كَأَنَّهَا كَوۡكَبٞ دُرِّيّٞ يُوقَدُ مِن شَجَرَةٖ مُّبَٰرَكَةٖ زَيۡتُونَةٖ لَّا شَرۡقِيَّةٖ وَلَا غَرۡبِيَّةٖ يَكَادُ زَيۡتُهَا يُضِيٓءُ وَلَوۡ لَمۡ تَمۡسَسۡهُ نَارٞۚ نُّورٌ عَلَىٰ نُورٖۚ يَهۡدِي ٱللَّهُ لِنُورِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُۚ وَيَضۡرِبُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡأَمۡثَٰلَ لِلنَّاسِۗ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيمٞ

en.text: Allāh is the Light[996] of the heavens and the earth. The example of His light[997] is like a niche within which is a lamp;[998] the lamp is within glass, the glass as if it were a pearly [white] star lit from [the oil of] a blessed olive tree, neither of the east nor of the west, whose oil would almost glow even if untouched by fire. Light upon light. Allāh guides to His light whom He wills. And Allāh presents examples for the people, and Allāh is Knowing of all things.
en.footnotes:
[996] i.e., the source and bestower of light and enlightenment.
[997] His guidance in the heart of a believing servant.
[998] Literally, "a burning wick," which is the essence of a lamp.

so.text: 35. Alle waa Nuuriyaha [25] samooyinka iyo arlada, tusaalaha Nuurkiisa [26] waa sida feynuus uu ku jiro nal, nalkuna uu ku jiro dhalo [27], dhaladana la moodo xiddig kaah badan, laga huriyey geed barakaysan, geed-zaytuun aan bari ahayn iyo galbeed midna, ay saliiddiisu u dhowdahay inay iska ifto walow uusan dab taaban, nuur lagu kordhiyey nuur, Alle wuxuu ku hanuuniyaa Nuurkiisa qofkuu doono. Alle wuxuu u yeelaa tusaalooyin dadka. Alle wax walba waa Og yahay.
so.footnotes:
[25]. Alle waa kan bixiya iyo halka uu ka yimaado nuurka iyo hanuunka. 
[26]. Hanuunkiisa uu ku galladeysto qalbiga addoonkiisa mu’minka ah.
[27]. Misbaax erey ahaan waxaa weeye liifad ololeysa oo ah gunta nalka.

ayat.arabic: فِي بُيُوتٍ أَذِنَ ٱللَّهُ أَن تُرۡفَعَ وَيُذۡكَرَ فِيهَا ٱسۡمُهُۥ يُسَبِّحُ لَهُۥ فِيهَا بِٱلۡغُدُوِّ وَٱلۡأٓصَالِ

en.text: [Such niches are] in houses [i.e., mosques] which Allāh has ordered to be raised and that His name be mentioned [i.e., praised] therein; exalting Him within them in the morning and the evenings[999]
en.footnotes: [999] The term used here can refer to either afternoon or evening.

so.text: 36. (Nuurkaas waxaa laga helaa) Guryo gudahood uu Alle idmay in la kor yeelo [28], Magaciisana lagu xuso, halkaa waxaa ku xurmo weyneeya oo tasbiixsada gudahood subax iyo galabba,
so.footnotes:
[28]. Waa Masaajida Alle. 
Abuu Qataadah bin Ribci Al-Ansaari a.k.r. waxaa laga soo weriyey inuu yidhi: Nabigu s.c.w. wuxuu yidhi: Markuu midkiin soo galo masjid waa inuusan fadhiisan jeer uu tukado labo rakcadood. (W.w. Al-Bukhaari)
Abuu Hurayra a.k.r. waxaa laga soo weriyey inuu yiri: Rasuulkii Alle s.c.w. wuxuu yidhi: Ajarka salaadda ninka ragga ahi uu ku tukado jamaaco ahaan masjid waxay dheer tahay shan iyo labaatan jeer labo laab salaadda uu qofku ku tukado gurigiisa ama dukaankiisa. Maxaa yeelay markuu qofku si fiican u weeseysto oo u aado masjidka salaadda darteed, tallaabadii uu qaadaba waxaa kor loo qaadaa meeqaankiisa hal derejo, hal denbina waa looga tiraa, markuu tukadana, malaa'igtaa u duceysa intuu weesada qabo oo meeshiisa fadhiyo, iyagoo leh: Allow u denbi dhaaf, Allow u naxaariso, intuu salaadda sugayana wuxuu la mid yahay isagoo ku jira salaad. (W.w. Al-Bukhaari).

ayat.arabic: رِجَالٞ لَّا تُلۡهِيهِمۡ تِجَٰرَةٞ وَلَا بَيۡعٌ عَن ذِكۡرِ ٱللَّهِ وَإِقَامِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَإِيتَآءِ ٱلزَّكَوٰةِ يَخَافُونَ يَوۡمٗا تَتَقَلَّبُ فِيهِ ٱلۡقُلُوبُ وَٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرُ

en.text: [Are] men whom neither commerce nor sale distracts from the remembrance of Allāh and performance of prayer and giving of zakāh. They fear a Day in which the hearts and eyes will [fearfully] turn about -

so.text: 37. Rag aanay ka shuqlin ganacsi iyo iib midna xusidda Alle iyo oogidda saaladda iyo bixinta Zakada. Waxay ka cabsadaan Maalin quluubta iyo aragyada rogmi doonaan (baqo iyo argagax awgi).

ayat.arabic: لِيَجۡزِيَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ أَحۡسَنَ مَا عَمِلُواْ وَيَزِيدَهُم مِّن فَضۡلِهِۦۗ وَٱللَّهُ يَرۡزُقُ مَن يَشَآءُ بِغَيۡرِ حِسَابٖ

en.text: That Allāh may reward them [according to] the best of what they did and increase them from His bounty. And Allāh gives provision to whom He wills without account [i.e., limit].

so.text: 38. Si uu Alle u siiyo abaal gud waafaqsan kan ugu wanagsanaa waxay faleen, oo waliba uu siiyo deeq dheeri ah ka mid ah Fadligiisa. Alle wuxuu irsaaqaa qofkuu doono xisaab la'aan.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ أَعۡمَٰلُهُمۡ كَسَرَابِۭ بِقِيعَةٖ يَحۡسَبُهُ ٱلظَّمۡـَٔانُ مَآءً حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَهُۥ لَمۡ يَجِدۡهُ شَيۡـٔٗا وَوَجَدَ ٱللَّهَ عِندَهُۥ فَوَفَّىٰهُ حِسَابَهُۥۗ وَٱللَّهُ سَرِيعُ ٱلۡحِسَابِ

en.text: But those who disbelieved - their deeds are like a mirage in a lowland which a thirsty one thinks is water until, when he comes to it, he finds it is nothing but finds Allāh before him, and He will pay him in full his due; and Allāh is swift in account.

so.text: 39. Kuwase gaaloobay acmaashoodu waa sida dhalanteed ka muuqda bannaan dhul siman, oo uu kan oommani moodo biyo, jeer markuu yimaado waxba aanu ka helin [29], oo uu halkaas ka helo Alle oo abaal marsha una oofiyo si dhan xisaabtiisa, Alle wuu ku Dhaqsi Badan yahay xisaab qaadista.
so.footnotes: [29]. Waayo gaaladu acmaashooda kuma dhisna towxiid iyo ku iimaan qab Alle Keliya iyagoo aan la wadaajin cibaadada cidna.

ayat.arabic: أَوۡ كَظُلُمَٰتٖ فِي بَحۡرٖ لُّجِّيّٖ يَغۡشَىٰهُ مَوۡجٞ مِّن فَوۡقِهِۦ مَوۡجٞ مِّن فَوۡقِهِۦ سَحَابٞۚ ظُلُمَٰتُۢ بَعۡضُهَا فَوۡقَ بَعۡضٍ إِذَآ أَخۡرَجَ يَدَهُۥ لَمۡ يَكَدۡ يَرَىٰهَاۗ وَمَن لَّمۡ يَجۡعَلِ ٱللَّهُ لَهُۥ نُورٗا فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن نُّورٍ

en.text: Or [they are] like darknesses within an unfathomable sea which is covered by waves, upon which are waves, over which are clouds - darknesses, some of them upon others. When one puts out his hand [therein], he can hardly see it. And he to whom Allāh has not granted light - for him there is no light.

so.text: 40. Ama (waa) sida mugdiyo daran bad weyn salkeed ah, hir uu daboolo, korkiisuna hir kale sii yahay, oo ay daruuro sii kor joogaan, (dabaqyo) mugdiyo daran ah midba mid kale kor saaran yahay, markuu soo saaro gacantiisa uu ku sigan inuu arki waayo!  Qofkaan Alle u yeelin Nuur, ma uu laha Nuur.

ayat.arabic: أَلَمۡ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُسَبِّحُ لَهُۥ مَن فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَٱلطَّيۡرُ صَٰٓفَّٰتٖۖ كُلّٞ قَدۡ عَلِمَ صَلَاتَهُۥ وَتَسۡبِيحَهُۥۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمُۢ بِمَا يَفۡعَلُونَ

en.text: Do you not see that Allāh is exalted by whomever is within the heavens and the earth and [by] the birds with wings spread [in flight]? Each [of them] has known his [means of] prayer and exalting [Him], and Allāh is Knowing of what they do.

so.text: 41. Miyaadan ogayn in Alle ay xurmo weyneeyaan oo u tasbiixsadaan (ka hufaan  xumaan) waxa ku sugan samooyinka iyo arlada iyo shimbiraha fidiya garbahooda (markay duulliyaan)? Wuu Og yahay mid kasta salaaddiisa iyo tasbiixdiisa. Alle wuu Og yahay waxay fali.

ayat.arabic: وَلِلَّهِ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ

en.text: And to Allāh belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth, and to Allāh is the destination.

so.text: 42. Alle baa iska leh (Mulkiga, Maamulka iyo)  Boqortooyada (runta ah ee) samooyinka iyo arlada, waana xagga Alle halka loo noqon dhammaan.

ayat.arabic: أَلَمۡ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُزۡجِي سَحَابٗا ثُمَّ يُؤَلِّفُ بَيۡنَهُۥ ثُمَّ يَجۡعَلُهُۥ رُكَامٗا فَتَرَى ٱلۡوَدۡقَ يَخۡرُجُ مِنۡ خِلَٰلِهِۦ وَيُنَزِّلُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مِن جِبَالٖ فِيهَا مِنۢ بَرَدٖ فَيُصِيبُ بِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَصۡرِفُهُۥ عَن مَّن يَشَآءُۖ يَكَادُ سَنَا بَرۡقِهِۦ يَذۡهَبُ بِٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرِ

en.text: Do you not see that Allāh drives clouds? Then He brings them together; then He makes them into a mass, and you see the rain emerge from within it. And He sends down from the sky, mountains [of clouds] within which is hail, and He strikes with it whom He wills and averts it from whom He wills. The flash of its lightning almost takes away the eyesight.

so.text: 43. Miyaadan arkayn in Alle soo kaxeeyo daruuro, markaas isu dumo, oo ka dhigo fadad isdulsaraan, sidaas darteed waxaad arki roobka oo ka soo da’aya dhexdooda, Wuxuuna ka soo dejiyaa daruuraha buuraha la moodo qabow (baraf), isagoo ku rida cidduu doono, kana duwa cidduu doono, iftiinka hillaaciisu daruuraha gudahood ah wuxuu sigaa inuu la tago aragga.

ayat.arabic: يُقَلِّبُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّيۡلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبۡرَةٗ لِّأُوْلِي ٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرِ

en.text: Allāh alternates the night and the day. Indeed in that is a lesson for those who have vision.

so.text: 44.Alle Wuxuu gedgeddiyaa oo is dhaafiyaa habeenka iyo maalinta. Arrinkani waxaa xaqiiq ugu sugan cibro kuwa aragtida dheer.

ayat.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ خَلَقَ كُلَّ دَآبَّةٖ مِّن مَّآءٖۖ فَمِنۡهُم مَّن يَمۡشِي عَلَىٰ بَطۡنِهِۦ وَمِنۡهُم مَّن يَمۡشِي عَلَىٰ رِجۡلَيۡنِ وَمِنۡهُم مَّن يَمۡشِي عَلَىٰٓ أَرۡبَعٖۚ يَخۡلُقُ ٱللَّهُ مَا يَشَآءُۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٞ

en.text: Allāh has created every [living] creature from water. And of them are those that move on their bellies, and of them are those that walk on two legs, and of them are those that walk on four. Allāh creates what He wills. Indeed, Allāh is over all things competent.

so.text: 45. Alle wuxuu ka abuuray noole kasta oo jira biyo. Waxaa ka mid ah mid ku xammaarta calooshiisa, waxaa ka mid ah mid ku socda labo lugood, waxaana ka mid ah mid ku socda afar. Alle Wuxuu abuuraa wuxuu doono. Hubaal, Alle wax kasta wuu Karaa.

ayat.arabic: لَّقَدۡ أَنزَلۡنَآ ءَايَٰتٖ مُّبَيِّنَٰتٖۚ وَٱللَّهُ يَهۡدِي مَن يَشَآءُ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٖ مُّسۡتَقِيمٖ

en.text: We have certainly sent down distinct verses. And Allāh guides whom He wills to a straight path.

so.text: 46. Waxaan dhab ahaan soo dejinnay Aayado cad cad. Alle wuxuu ku hanuuniyaa cidduu doono Jid Toosan (Islaamka).

ayat.arabic: وَيَقُولُونَ ءَامَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ وَبِٱلرَّسُولِ وَأَطَعۡنَا ثُمَّ يَتَوَلَّىٰ فَرِيقٞ مِّنۡهُم مِّنۢ بَعۡدِ ذَٰلِكَۚ وَمَآ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ بِٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ

en.text: But they [i.e., the hypocrites] say, "We have believed in Allāh and in the Messenger, and we obey"; then a party of them turns away after that. And those are not believers.

so.text: 47. Waxay (munaafiqiintu) yidhaahdaan: “Waxaanu rumeynay Allaah iyo Rasuulka oo adeecnay, markaasay koox ka mid ahi jeesadaan intaas kaddib, kuwaasina ma aha mu’miniin.

ayat.arabic: وَإِذَا دُعُوٓاْ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ لِيَحۡكُمَ بَيۡنَهُمۡ إِذَا فَرِيقٞ مِّنۡهُم مُّعۡرِضُونَ

en.text: And when they are called to [the words of] Allāh and His Messenger to judge between them, at once a party of them turns aside [in refusal].

so.text: 48.Marka loogu yeedho Alle iyo Rasuulkiisa si uu u kala garsooro dhexdooda, mise koox ka mid ahi dhinac bay u jeestaan.

ayat.arabic: وَإِن يَكُن لَّهُمُ ٱلۡحَقُّ يَأۡتُوٓاْ إِلَيۡهِ مُذۡعِنِينَ

en.text: But if the right is theirs, they come to him in prompt obedience.

so.text: 49. Haddayse garta leeyihiin waa u yimaadaan dhaqso, iyagoo adeecsan.

ayat.arabic: أَفِي قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ أَمِ ٱرۡتَابُوٓاْ أَمۡ يَخَافُونَ أَن يَحِيفَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَرَسُولُهُۥۚ بَلۡ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ

en.text: Is there disease in their hearts? Or have they doubted? Or do they fear that Allāh will be unjust to them, or His Messenger? Rather, it is they who are the wrongdoers [i.e., the unjust].

so.text: 50. Ma qalbigay ka bukaan (jirro munaafiqnimo ah), mise shaki bay ka qabaan (Nabinnamada Muxammad), mise waxay cabsi ka qabaan in Alle iyo Rasuulkiiisu ka eexdaan? Mayee, kuwaasi waa kuwo daalimiin (gar ma qaatayaal) ah.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّمَا كَانَ قَوۡلَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ إِذَا دُعُوٓاْ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ لِيَحۡكُمَ بَيۡنَهُمۡ أَن يَقُولُواْ سَمِعۡنَا وَأَطَعۡنَاۚ وَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡمُفۡلِحُونَ

en.text: The only statement of the [true] believers when they are called to Allāh and His Messenger to judge between them is that they say, "We hear and we obey." And those are the successful.

so.text: 51. Qowlka mu’miniinta, marka loogu yeedho Alle iyo Rasuulkiisa si uu u kala garsooro dhexdooda, waa uun inay yidhaahdaan: “Maqallay oo yeelnay. kuwaasina waa kuwa ah liibaanayaasha.

ayat.arabic: وَمَن يُطِعِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ وَيَخۡشَ ٱللَّهَ وَيَتَّقۡهِ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡفَآئِزُونَ

en.text: And whoever obeys Allāh and His Messenger and fears Allāh and is conscious of Him - it is those who are the attainers.

so.text: 52. Qofkii adeeca Alle iyo Rasuulkiisa, oo ka baqa Alle, dhowrana amarradiisa, kuwaa weeye kuwa ah guuleysatayaasha.

ayat.arabic: ۞ وَأَقۡسَمُواْ بِٱللَّهِ جَهۡدَ أَيۡمَٰنِهِمۡ لَئِنۡ أَمَرۡتَهُمۡ لَيَخۡرُجُنَّۖ قُل لَّا تُقۡسِمُواْۖ طَاعَةٞ مَّعۡرُوفَةٌۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ خَبِيرُۢ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ

en.text: And they swear by Allāh their strongest oaths that if you ordered them, they would go forth [in Allāh's cause]. Say, "Do not swear. [Such] obedience is known.[1000] Indeed, Allāh is [fully] Aware of that which you do."
en.footnotes: [1000] i.e., the hypocrites' pretense of obedience is known to be a lie.

so.text: 53. Waxay (munaafiqiintu) ku dhaartaan Alle kan ugu adag dhaarahooda, in haddaad amarto ay (u) baxayaan (jihaad). Dheh waxba ha dhaarannina: adeecid fiican 'baa la dooni' [30]. Alle waa u Xog Ogaal waxaad falaysaan.
so.footnotes: [30]. Macno kale waa daacad la yaqaan macnaha waa oggolaanshaha iyo maqlidda ay muujiyaan munaafiqiinta waa mid la yaqaan inay been tahay.

ayat.arabic: قُلۡ أَطِيعُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُواْ ٱلرَّسُولَۖ فَإِن تَوَلَّوۡاْ فَإِنَّمَا عَلَيۡهِ مَا حُمِّلَ وَعَلَيۡكُم مَّا حُمِّلۡتُمۡۖ وَإِن تُطِيعُوهُ تَهۡتَدُواْۚ وَمَا عَلَى ٱلرَّسُولِ إِلَّا ٱلۡبَلَٰغُ ٱلۡمُبِينُ

en.text: Say, "Obey Allāh and obey the Messenger; but if you turn away - then upon him is only that [duty] with which he has been charged, and upon you is that with which you have been charged. And if you obey him, you will be [rightly] guided. And there is not upon the Messenger except the [responsibility for] clear notification."

so.text: 54. Dheh: “Adeeca Allaah oo adeeca Rasuulka, haddiise aad jeesataan, waxaa (Nabiga) saaran oo keliya xilka la saaray. idinkana waxaa idin saaran waxa la idin saaray (Xaq raacid). Haddaad adeecdaan (Nabiga) waad hanuunaysaan. Rasuulkana ma saarna waxaan ahayn Gaadhsiin Cad.

ayat.arabic: وَعَدَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ مِنكُمۡ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَيَسۡتَخۡلِفَنَّهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ كَمَا ٱسۡتَخۡلَفَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡ وَلَيُمَكِّنَنَّ لَهُمۡ دِينَهُمُ ٱلَّذِي ٱرۡتَضَىٰ لَهُمۡ وَلَيُبَدِّلَنَّهُم مِّنۢ بَعۡدِ خَوۡفِهِمۡ أَمۡنٗاۚ يَعۡبُدُونَنِي لَا يُشۡرِكُونَ بِي شَيۡـٔٗاۚ وَمَن كَفَرَ بَعۡدَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡفَٰسِقُونَ

en.text: Allāh has promised those who have believed among you and done righteous deeds that He will surely grant them succession [to authority] upon the earth just as He granted it to those before them and that He will surely establish for them [therein] their religion which He has preferred for them and that He will surely substitute for them, after their fear, security, [for] they worship Me, not associating anything with Me. But whoever disbelieves[1001] after that - then those are the defiantly disobedient.
en.footnotes: [1001] i.e., denies the favor of Allāh or does not live by His ordinance.

so.text: 55. Alle wuxuu u ballan qaaday kuwiinna idinka mid ah ee (Xaqa) rumeeyey oo samaha fala inay u hadhi dhulka oy xukumi, siduu uga yeelayba inay u hadhaan oo xukumaan kuwii ka horreeyay, iyo inuu u makanin diintooda uu uga raalli yahay. Wuxuu ugu beddeli cabsidoodii kaddib nabadgelyo; waase inay i caabudaan (Anigoo Keliya) iyagoon ila wadaajinayn (cibaadada) waxba. Ciddii gaalowda intaas kaddibna [31], kuwaa weeye kuwa ah caasiyaasha.
so.footnotes: [31]. Waa dafira nicmadda Alle ama aan ku noolaan si waafaqsan xukunkiisa iyo xeerarkiisa.

ayat.arabic: وَأَقِيمُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُواْ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَطِيعُواْ ٱلرَّسُولَ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تُرۡحَمُونَ

en.text: And establish prayer and give zakāh and obey the Messenger - that you may receive mercy.

so.text: 56. Ee ooga salaadda, bxiyana Zakada, oo adeeca Rasuulka si la idiinku naxariisto.

ayat.arabic: لَا تَحۡسَبَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مُعۡجِزِينَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَمَأۡوَىٰهُمُ ٱلنَّارُۖ وَلَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ

en.text: Never think that the disbelievers are causing failure [to Allāh] upon the earth. Their refuge will be the Fire - and how wretched the destination.

so.text: 57. Ha moodina in kuwa gaalooba ku fakan karaan dhulka, hoygoodu waa Naarta, iyadaana u xun meel la ahaado.

ayat.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لِيَسۡتَـٔۡذِنكُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ مَلَكَتۡ أَيۡمَٰنُكُمۡ وَٱلَّذِينَ لَمۡ يَبۡلُغُواْ ٱلۡحُلُمَ مِنكُمۡ ثَلَٰثَ مَرَّٰتٖۚ مِّن قَبۡلِ صَلَوٰةِ ٱلۡفَجۡرِ وَحِينَ تَضَعُونَ ثِيَابَكُم مِّنَ ٱلظَّهِيرَةِ وَمِنۢ بَعۡدِ صَلَوٰةِ ٱلۡعِشَآءِۚ ثَلَٰثُ عَوۡرَٰتٖ لَّكُمۡۚ لَيۡسَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ وَلَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ جُنَاحُۢ بَعۡدَهُنَّۚ طَوَّٰفُونَ عَلَيۡكُم بَعۡضُكُمۡ عَلَىٰ بَعۡضٖۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمُ ٱلۡأٓيَٰتِۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٞ

en.text: O you who have believed, let those whom your right hands possess and those who have not [yet] reached puberty among you ask permission of you [before entering] at three times: before the dawn prayer and when you put aside your clothing [for rest] at noon and after the night prayer. [These are] three times of privacy[1002] for you. There is no blame upon you nor upon them beyond these [periods], for they continually circulate among you - some of you, among others. Thus does Allāh make clear to you the verses [i.e., His ordinances]; and Allāh is Knowing and Wise.
en.footnotes: [1002] Literally, "exposure" or "being uncovered."

so.text: 58. Kuwa (Xaqa) rumeeyow! Waa inay kuwaa ay gacmahiinnu midig hantaan iyo kuwa idinka mid ah aan weli qaan gaarin (intay idiin soo gelin) weydiistaan idan saddex waqti [32]; ka hor salaadda subax, iyo markaad dharka dhigataan duhurkii kuleylaha, iyo kaddib salaadda cishaha; kuwani waa saddex waqti gaar idiin ah, idinma saarna denbi idinka iyo iyagaba waxaan ahayn waqtiyadan in qaarkiin u soo galaan qaar kale iyagoon idan qaadan. Sidaasuu Alle idiinku caddeeyaa Aayada- ha. Alle waa wax kasta oge, Xakiim ah.
so.footnotes: [32]. Waa seddex waqti oo badi dadku jirkooda daboolneyn oo furan yihiin, sidaas awgeed buu Alle uga reebay addoomaha ka adeega guryaha iyo carruurta aan qaan gaarin inay u soo galaan qolka hurdada ninka iyo naagtiisa.

ayat.arabic: وَإِذَا بَلَغَ ٱلۡأَطۡفَٰلُ مِنكُمُ ٱلۡحُلُمَ فَلۡيَسۡتَـٔۡذِنُواْ كَمَا ٱسۡتَـٔۡذَنَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمۡ ءَايَٰتِهِۦۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٞ

en.text: And when the children among you reach puberty, let them ask permission [at all times] as those before them have done. Thus does Allāh make clear to you His verses; and Allāh is Knowing and Wise.

so.text: 59. Markay carruurtiinna qaan gaadhaan, ha idin weydiistaan idan, sida kuwii ka horreeyeyba ay idan u qaataan [33]. Sidaasuu Alle idiinku caddeeyaa Aayadihiisa. Alle waa wax kasta Ogsoone, Xakiim ah.
so.footnotes: [33]. Waa kuwii ka weynaa da’ ahaan ay idan u qaataan. Wiilka kurayga ah ama addoonka waa inuu idan qaato ka hor soo gelidda qolka.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلۡقَوَٰعِدُ مِنَ ٱلنِّسَآءِ ٱلَّٰتِي لَا يَرۡجُونَ نِكَاحٗا فَلَيۡسَ عَلَيۡهِنَّ جُنَاحٌ أَن يَضَعۡنَ ثِيَابَهُنَّ غَيۡرَ مُتَبَرِّجَٰتِۭ بِزِينَةٖۖ وَأَن يَسۡتَعۡفِفۡنَ خَيۡرٞ لَّهُنَّۗ وَٱللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٞ

en.text: And women of post-menstrual age who have no desire for marriage - there is no blame upon them for putting aside their outer garments [but] not displaying adornment. But to modestly refrain [from that] is better for them. And Allāh is Hearing and Knowing.

so.text: 60. Dumarka gaboobay ee ka fadhiistay (quustay dhalmada) ee aan rajaynin guur, ma saarna denbi hadday iska dhigaan (khafiifiyaan) maryahooda dusha kore ah [34] iyagoon isku muujineyn inay is qurxiyaan. Inay isdhowraan [35] baa u khayr badan. Alle waa wax kasta Maqle, wax kasta Ogsoon.
so.footnotes:
[34]. Xijaabka (cabbaayada) ay dusha ka xirtaan ee hadday iska dhigaan aanay muuqaneyn cowradooda bal uu kaga hooseeyo canbuur astura, iwm dhib ma leh xagga dumarka da’da ah ee duqoobay  inayan dedin luqumahooda ama qayb ka mid ah gacmahooda.
[35]. Oo xijaabkooda kore dhigin oo wejiga dabooshaan.

ayat.arabic: لَّيۡسَ عَلَى ٱلۡأَعۡمَىٰ حَرَجٞ وَلَا عَلَى ٱلۡأَعۡرَجِ حَرَجٞ وَلَا عَلَى ٱلۡمَرِيضِ حَرَجٞ وَلَا عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِكُمۡ أَن تَأۡكُلُواْ مِنۢ بُيُوتِكُمۡ أَوۡ بُيُوتِ ءَابَآئِكُمۡ أَوۡ بُيُوتِ أُمَّهَٰتِكُمۡ أَوۡ بُيُوتِ إِخۡوَٰنِكُمۡ أَوۡ بُيُوتِ أَخَوَٰتِكُمۡ أَوۡ بُيُوتِ أَعۡمَٰمِكُمۡ أَوۡ بُيُوتِ عَمَّٰتِكُمۡ أَوۡ بُيُوتِ أَخۡوَٰلِكُمۡ أَوۡ بُيُوتِ خَٰلَٰتِكُمۡ أَوۡ مَا مَلَكۡتُم مَّفَاتِحَهُۥٓ أَوۡ صَدِيقِكُمۡۚ لَيۡسَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ جُنَاحٌ أَن تَأۡكُلُواْ جَمِيعًا أَوۡ أَشۡتَاتٗاۚ فَإِذَا دَخَلۡتُم بُيُوتٗا فَسَلِّمُواْ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِكُمۡ تَحِيَّةٗ مِّنۡ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ مُبَٰرَكَةٗ طَيِّبَةٗۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمُ ٱلۡأٓيَٰتِ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَعۡقِلُونَ

en.text: There is not upon the blind [any] constraint nor upon the lame constraint nor upon the ill constraint nor upon yourselves when you eat from your [own] houses or the houses of your fathers or the houses of your mothers or the houses of your brothers or the houses of your sisters or the houses of your father's brothers or the houses of your father's sisters or the houses of your mother's brothers or the houses of your mother's sisters or [from houses] whose keys you possess or [from the house] of your friend. There is no blame upon you whether you eat together or separately. But when you enter houses, give greetings of peace[1003] upon each other - a greeting from Allāh, blessed and good. Thus does Allāh make clear to you the verses [of ordinance] that you may understand.
en.footnotes: [1003] Saying, "As-salāmu ʿalaykum" ("Peace be upon you").

so.text: 61. Ma saarna wax denbi ah Indhoolaha, iyo laan garaha, iyo bukaanka midna, iyo nafahiinnaba inaad wax ka cuntaan guryihiinna, ama guryaha aabbayaashiin, ama guryaha hooyooyinkiin, ama guryaha walaalihiin, ama guryaha walaalooyinkiin, ama guryaha adeerradiin, ama guryaha eeddooyinkiin, ama guryaha abtiyaashiin, ama guryaha habaryarahiin, ama waxaad hanataan furayaashooda [36], ama (guryaha) saaxiibkiin, idinkumana saarna denbi haddaad wax u cuntaan wadajir ama kala jir. Markase aad galeysaan guryaha, ku salaama dadkiinna salaan xagga Alle ah, barakaysan (oo) wanaagsan [37]. Sidaasuu Alle idiinku caddeeyaa Aayadaha si aad u fahantaan.
so.footnotes:
[36]. Guryaha aad deggan tihiin. 
[37]. Waa inaad dhahdaan “Assalaamu Calaykum (Nabad dushiinna ha ahaato).

ayat.arabic: إِنَّمَا ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَإِذَا كَانُواْ مَعَهُۥ عَلَىٰٓ أَمۡرٖ جَامِعٖ لَّمۡ يَذۡهَبُواْ حَتَّىٰ يَسۡتَـٔۡذِنُوهُۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَسۡتَـٔۡذِنُونَكَ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦۚ فَإِذَا ٱسۡتَـٔۡذَنُوكَ لِبَعۡضِ شَأۡنِهِمۡ فَأۡذَن لِّمَن شِئۡتَ مِنۡهُمۡ وَٱسۡتَغۡفِرۡ لَهُمُ ٱللَّهَۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٞ

en.text: The believers are only those who believe in Allāh and His Messenger and, when they are [meeting] with him for a matter of common interest, do not depart until they have asked his permission. Indeed, those who ask your permission, [O Muḥammad] - those are the ones who believe in Allāh and His Messenger. So when they ask your permission due to something of their affairs, then give permission to whom you will among them and ask forgiveness for them of Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.

so.text: 62. Mu’miniinta waa uun kuwa rumeeyey Alle iyo Rasuulkiisa, oo markay ku wehliyaan arrin guud oo loo dhan yahay aan tegin jeeray idan qaataan. Hubaal, kuwa idan kaa qaata waa iyaga kuwa rumeeyey Alle iyo Rasuulkiisa. Ee hadday idan kuu weydiistaan danahooda qaarkood, u idan koodii aad doonto oo ka mid ah, ugana bari denbi dhaaf Alle. Hubaal Alle waa Denbi Dhaaf Badane, Naxariis Badan.

ayat.arabic: لَّا تَجۡعَلُواْ دُعَآءَ ٱلرَّسُولِ بَيۡنَكُمۡ كَدُعَآءِ بَعۡضِكُم بَعۡضٗاۚ قَدۡ يَعۡلَمُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَتَسَلَّلُونَ مِنكُمۡ لِوَاذٗاۚ فَلۡيَحۡذَرِ ٱلَّذِينَ يُخَالِفُونَ عَنۡ أَمۡرِهِۦٓ أَن تُصِيبَهُمۡ فِتۡنَةٌ أَوۡ يُصِيبَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ

en.text: Do not make [your] calling of the Messenger among yourselves as the call of one of you to another. Already Allāh knows those of you who slip away, concealed by others. So let those beware who dissent from his [i.e., the Prophet's] order,[1004] lest fitnah[1005] strike them or a painful punishment.
en.footnotes:
[1004] Meaning also his way or his sunnah.
[1005] Trials, affliction, dissension, strife, etc.

so.text: 63. Ha ka yeelina u yeedhidda Rasuulka (Muxammad) dhexdiinna sida u yeedhidda qaarkiinba qaar. Alle dhab ahaan wuu ogsoon yahay kuwaa dhuunta iyagoo gabban (aan kaa idan qaadan Nabiyow), Ee ha is jiraan kuwaa ka hor yimaada amariiska [38] si ayan ugu dhicin balaayo ama ugu dhicin [39] cadaab xanuun badan.
so.footnotes:
[38]. Macnaha sidoo kale waxaa weeye dhabbahiisa ama sunnadiisa. Nabigu s.c.w. wuxuu yidhi: “Qofkii la yimaado camal aan ahayn amarkayaga waa lagu soo celin oo lagama aqbalayo.” 
[39]. Imtixaan la marsiiyo, musiibooyin ku dhaca, is nac dhexdooda, iyo kala qaybsanaan, dhibaato soo gaadha, gaajo iyo abaaro, iwm.

ayat.arabic: أَلَآ إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ قَدۡ يَعۡلَمُ مَآ أَنتُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ وَيَوۡمَ يُرۡجَعُونَ إِلَيۡهِ فَيُنَبِّئُهُم بِمَا عَمِلُواْۗ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيمُۢ

en.text: Unquestionably, to Allāh belongs whatever is in the heavens and earth. Already He knows that upon which you [stand][1006] and [knows] the Day[1007] when they will be returned to Him and He will inform them of what they have done. And Allāh is Knowing of all things.
en.footnotes:
[1006] i.e., your position - the basis for your actions (whether sincere faith or hypocrisy) and the condition of your souls.
[1007] The meaning can also be rendered "...and [let them beware of] the Day..."

so.text: 64. Ogaada, hubaal, Alle baa iska leh waxa ku sugan samooyinka iyo arlada. Wuxuu dhab ahaan ogsoon yahay waxaad ku sugan tihiin [40]. Maalintana [41] loo celin Xaggiisa, wuxuu u sheegi waxay faleen. Alle wax walba wuu Ogsoon yahay.
so.footnotes:
[40]. Halka aad ku sugan tihiin – gunta iyo ujeeddada aad ka leedihiin camalladiinna ( hadday daacad idinka tahay iyo Dar Alle ama munaafiqnimo) iyo xaaladda nafahiinna ay ku sugan yihiin. 
[41]. Macnaha wuxuu sidoo kale u dhacayaa: “Oo ( ha ka digtoonadaan) Maalintaa.

ayat.arabic: تَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِي نَزَّلَ ٱلۡفُرۡقَانَ عَلَىٰ عَبۡدِهِۦ لِيَكُونَ لِلۡعَٰلَمِينَ نَذِيرًا

en.text: Blessed is He who sent down the Criterion upon His Servant that he may be to the worlds a warner -

so.text: 1. Waxaa Barako iyo Khayr badan Kan (Alle) ee ku soo dejiyey Al-Furqaan [1] addoonkiisa [2] si uu ugu noqdo caalamka dige.
so.footnotes:
[1]. Al-Furqaan waa Magac kale ee lagu magacaabo Qur’aanka, macnaha Al-Furqaan waxaa weeye kala saaraha runta iyo beenta, samaanta iyo xumaanta, xalaasha iyo xaaraanta. 
[2]. Waxaa loola jeedaa addoonkiisa Nabi Muxammad s.c.w. waana sharfid sidaas.

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِي لَهُۥ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَمۡ يَتَّخِذۡ وَلَدٗا وَلَمۡ يَكُن لَّهُۥ شَرِيكٞ فِي ٱلۡمُلۡكِ وَخَلَقَ كُلَّ شَيۡءٖ فَقَدَّرَهُۥ تَقۡدِيرٗا

en.text: He to whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and who has not taken a son and has not had a partner in dominion and has created each thing and determined it with [precise] determination.

so.text: 2. (Alle) ee iska leh (Mulkiga, Maamulka iyo) Boqortooyada (runta ah ee) samooyinka iyo arlada, aan yeelan wiil (ilmo) oo aan lahayn wax shariig ah (la wadaaga) Mulkiga (iyo Maamulka uunka). abuurayna wax walba, oo u qaddaray si qiyaasan oo isku jaan go'an.

ayat.arabic: وَٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةٗ لَّا يَخۡلُقُونَ شَيۡـٔٗا وَهُمۡ يُخۡلَقُونَ وَلَا يَمۡلِكُونَ لِأَنفُسِهِمۡ ضَرّٗا وَلَا نَفۡعٗا وَلَا يَمۡلِكُونَ مَوۡتٗا وَلَا حَيَوٰةٗ وَلَا نُشُورٗا

en.text: But they have taken besides Him gods which create nothing, while they are created, and possess not for themselves any harm or benefit and possess not [power to cause] death or life or resurrection.

so.text: 3. Waxay yeesheenna Alle sokadi ilaahyo aan waxba abuuri karin iyagase la abuuray, oo aan u hanan karin nafahooda wax dhib ama dheef ah, oo aan laheyn wax awood ah (ay ku sababaan) dhimasho, ama noolaansho, ama soo nooleyn meydadka.

ayat.arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ إِنۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّآ إِفۡكٌ ٱفۡتَرَىٰهُ وَأَعَانَهُۥ عَلَيۡهِ قَوۡمٌ ءَاخَرُونَۖ فَقَدۡ جَآءُو ظُلۡمٗا وَزُورٗا

en.text: And those who disbelieve say, "This [Qur’ān] is not except a falsehood he invented, and another people assisted him in it." But they have committed an injustice and a lie.

so.text: 4. Kuwa gaaloobay waxay yidhaahdeen: “Kanu (Qur’aanka) ma aha waxaan aheyn been uu isagu (Muxammad) hal abuurtay, oo ay dad kale ku kaalmeeyeen. Waxay dhab ahaan la yimaadeen gef iyo been abuur.”

ayat.arabic: وَقَالُوٓاْ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ ٱكۡتَتَبَهَا فَهِيَ تُمۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِ بُكۡرَةٗ وَأَصِيلٗا

en.text: And they say, "Legends of the former peoples which he has written down, and they are dictated to him morning and afternoon."

so.text: 5. Waxay yidhaahdeen: “Waa sheekooyinkii dadkii hore - waa uu soo qortay, marka waxaa loo soo yeedhiyaa subax iyo galabba.

ayat.arabic: قُلۡ أَنزَلَهُ ٱلَّذِي يَعۡلَمُ ٱلسِّرَّ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفُورٗا رَّحِيمٗا

en.text: Say, [O Muḥammad], "It has been revealed by He who knows [every] secret within the heavens and the earth. Indeed, He is ever Forgiving and Merciful."

so.text: 6. (Nabiyow) dheh: “Waxaa (Qur’aankan) soo dejiyey (Allaah ee ah) Kan ogsoon sirta samooyinka iyo arlada. Hubaal, Alle waa Denbi Dhaaf Badane, Naxariis Badan.

ayat.arabic: وَقَالُواْ مَالِ هَٰذَا ٱلرَّسُولِ يَأۡكُلُ ٱلطَّعَامَ وَيَمۡشِي فِي ٱلۡأَسۡوَاقِ لَوۡلَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيۡهِ مَلَكٞ فَيَكُونَ مَعَهُۥ نَذِيرًا

en.text: And they say, "What is this messenger that eats food and walks in the markets? Why was there not sent down to him an angel so he would be with him a warner?

so.text: 7. Waxay (gaaladii) yidhaahdeen:“Muxuu yahay arrinka Rasuulkan uu u cuni cunto, una socon suuqyada (sidayada oo kale). Maxaa malag loola soo diri waayey ee ahaada mid la jirki wax u diga?

ayat.arabic: أَوۡ يُلۡقَىٰٓ إِلَيۡهِ كَنزٌ أَوۡ تَكُونُ لَهُۥ جَنَّةٞ يَأۡكُلُ مِنۡهَاۚ وَقَالَ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ إِن تَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا رَجُلٗا مَّسۡحُورًا

en.text: Or [why is not] a treasure presented to him [from heaven], or does he [not] have a garden from which he eats?" And the wrongdoers say, "You follow not but a man affected by magic."

so.text: 8. “Ama (maxaa) looga soo dejin waayey xagga samada khaznad maal (ka buuxo uu kaga maarmo xoogsiga), ama u ahaato beer uu wax ka cuno? Waxayna daalimiintu yidhaahdeen: Ma raacdaan (Mu’miniintoy) waxaan aheyn nin sixran.”

ayat.arabic: ٱنظُرۡ كَيۡفَ ضَرَبُواْ لَكَ ٱلۡأَمۡثَٰلَ فَضَلُّواْ فَلَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ سَبِيلٗا

en.text: Look how they strike for you comparisons;[1009] but they have strayed, so they cannot [find] a way.
en.footnotes: [1009] From their own imaginations in order to deny and discredit you.

so.text: 9. Eeg siday kuugu yeeleen tusaalooyin [3], oo ay u lumeen, una karin (qaadidda) Jid (Toosan).
so.footnotes: [3]. Oo malahooda ah si ay kuu beeniyaan oo wax kuugu dhimaan.

ayat.arabic: تَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِيٓ إِن شَآءَ جَعَلَ لَكَ خَيۡرٗا مِّن ذَٰلِكَ جَنَّٰتٖ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ وَيَجۡعَل لَّكَ قُصُورَۢا

en.text: Blessed is He who, if He willed, could have made for you [something] better than that - gardens beneath which rivers flow - and could make for you palaces.

so.text: 10. Waxaa barako iyo khayr badan Kan (Alle) ee hadduu doono ku siin wax ka khayr badan taasi - jannooyin (beero) ay hoostoodu webiyo qul-qulaan, wuxuuna ku siin daaro waaweyn (Jannada gudaheeda).

ayat.arabic: بَلۡ كَذَّبُواْ بِٱلسَّاعَةِۖ وَأَعۡتَدۡنَا لِمَن كَذَّبَ بِٱلسَّاعَةِ سَعِيرًا

en.text: But they have denied the Hour, and We have prepared for those who deny the Hour a Blaze.

so.text: 11. Waxayse beeniyeen Saacadda (Qiyaame), waxaana u diyaarinnay qofkii beeniya Saacadda dab huraya.

ayat.arabic: إِذَا رَأَتۡهُم مِّن مَّكَانِۭ بَعِيدٖ سَمِعُواْ لَهَا تَغَيُّظٗا وَزَفِيرٗا

en.text: When it [i.e., the Hellfire] sees them from a distant place, they will hear its fury and roaring.

so.text: 12. Markay (Naartu) ka aragto meel fog, waxay ka maqlaan cadho daran iyo cartan.

ayat.arabic: وَإِذَآ أُلۡقُواْ مِنۡهَا مَكَانٗا ضَيِّقٗا مُّقَرَّنِينَ دَعَوۡاْ هُنَالِكَ ثُبُورٗا

en.text: And when they are thrown into a narrow place therein bound in chains, they will cry out thereupon for destruction.

so.text: 13. Marka lagu tuuro dhexdeeda meel cidhiidhi ah iyagoo isku xidhan, waxay u yeedhan halkaa halaag [4].
so.footnotes: [4]. Waxay u rajeeyaan halaaggaa oo u yeertaan thubuur (dhimasho) si aan loogu cadaabin cadaabka daran ee Naarta.

ayat.arabic: لَّا تَدۡعُواْ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ ثُبُورٗا وَٰحِدٗا وَٱدۡعُواْ ثُبُورٗا كَثِيرٗا

en.text: [They will be told], "Do not cry this Day for one destruction but cry for much destruction."

so.text: 14. (Waxaa la odhan): Ha u yeedhannina maanta halaag keliya, ee u yeedha halaag badan [5].
so.footnotes: [5]. Thubuuraa waa weedh ay Carabta odhan jireen markay la kulmaan cadow ka xoog badan ama ku dhacdo musiibo weyn, macnaheeduna waxaa weeye Allow naga soo gaadh oo na badbaadi ama nafta naga qaad.

ayat.arabic: قُلۡ أَذَٰلِكَ خَيۡرٌ أَمۡ جَنَّةُ ٱلۡخُلۡدِ ٱلَّتِي وُعِدَ ٱلۡمُتَّقُونَۚ كَانَتۡ لَهُمۡ جَزَآءٗ وَمَصِيرٗا

en.text: Say, "Is that better or the Garden of Eternity which is promised to the righteous? It will be for them a reward and destination.

so.text: 15. Dheh: Ma taasaa wanaagsan - mise Jannada waaridda ee loo yaboohay kuwa iska jira (shirkiga iyo xumaha kale)? Taasi waa u  abaal marin iyo aayo wanaagsan.

ayat.arabic: لَّهُمۡ فِيهَا مَا يَشَآءُونَ خَٰلِدِينَۚ كَانَ عَلَىٰ رَبِّكَ وَعۡدٗا مَّسۡـُٔولٗا

en.text: For them therein is whatever they wish, [while] abiding eternally. It is ever upon your Lord a promise [worthy to be] requested.[1010]
en.footnotes: [1010] Or "...a promise requested [for them by the angels]."

so.text: 16. Waxay leeyihiin gudaheeda (Jannada) waxay doonaan iyagoo ku waadhaya; waa yabooh ku habboon in la weydiisto Rabbigaa [6].
so.footnotes: [6]. Waa yabooh ay malaa’igta u dalbaan mu’miniinta oo Alle uga baryaan, mu’miniintana sidoo kale Alle weydiistaan.

ayat.arabic: وَيَوۡمَ يَحۡشُرُهُمۡ وَمَا يَعۡبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَيَقُولُ ءَأَنتُمۡ أَضۡلَلۡتُمۡ عِبَادِي هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ أَمۡ هُمۡ ضَلُّواْ ٱلسَّبِيلَ

en.text: And [mention] the Day He will gather them and that which they worship besides Allāh and will say, "Did you mislead these, My servants, or did they [themselves] stray from the way?"

so.text: 17. (Xus) Maalintuu soo kulmin (gaalada)  iyo waxay caabudayeen Alle sokadi, markaas wuxuu odhan: “Ma idinkaa lumiyey addoomahaygaan, mise iyagaa iskood uga lumay Jidka (Toosan ee Islaamka)?.”

ayat.arabic: قَالُواْ سُبۡحَٰنَكَ مَا كَانَ يَنۢبَغِي لَنَآ أَن نَّتَّخِذَ مِن دُونِكَ مِنۡ أَوۡلِيَآءَ وَلَٰكِن مَّتَّعۡتَهُمۡ وَءَابَآءَهُمۡ حَتَّىٰ نَسُواْ ٱلذِّكۡرَ وَكَانُواْ قَوۡمَۢا بُورٗا

en.text: They will say, "Exalted are You! It was not for us to take besides You any allies [i.e., protectors]. But You provided comforts for them and their fathers until they forgot the message and became a people ruined."

so.text: 18. Waxay odhan: “Xurmo oo dhan Adigaa (Allow) iska leh oo ka hufan (xumaan)! Naguma habboona inaan yeelanno awliyo (gargaarayaal) Adiga ka sokow, waxaadse u raaxeysay iyaga iyo aabbayaashood ilaa ay halmaameen waanada, waxayna ahaayeen qolo hoogay oo ba'ay.

ayat.arabic: فَقَدۡ كَذَّبُوكُم بِمَا تَقُولُونَ فَمَا تَسۡتَطِيعُونَ صَرۡفٗا وَلَا نَصۡرٗاۚ وَمَن يَظۡلِم مِّنكُمۡ نُذِقۡهُ عَذَابٗا كَبِيرٗا

en.text: So they will deny you, [disbelievers], in what you say,[1011] and you cannot avert [punishment] or [find] help. And whoever commits injustice[1012] among you - We will make him taste a great punishment.
en.footnotes:
[1011] At the time of Judgement the false objects of worship will betray their worshippers and deny them.
[1012] Specifically, association of others with Allāh.

so.text: 19. Sidaasay dhab ahaan idiinku beenin waxaad sheegaysaan, markaasna ma kartaan is furasho iyo gargaar midna. Ciddiina wax dulmida [7] oo idinka mid ah waxaanu dhadhansiin cadaab weyn.
so.footnotes: [7]. La timaadda shirki ama denbiyo kale oo weyn oo sidaa ku dhinta.

ayat.arabic: وَمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا قَبۡلَكَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ إِلَّآ إِنَّهُمۡ لَيَأۡكُلُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ وَيَمۡشُونَ فِي ٱلۡأَسۡوَاقِۗ وَجَعَلۡنَا بَعۡضَكُمۡ لِبَعۡضٖ فِتۡنَةً أَتَصۡبِرُونَۗ وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ بَصِيرٗا

en.text: And We did not send before you, [O Muḥammad], any of the messengers except that they ate food and walked in the markets. And We have made some of you [people] as trial for others - will you have patience? And ever is your Lord, Seeing.

so.text: 20. Ma aan dirinna hortaa adiga (Nabiyow) wax Rusul ah oo aan cunayn cunnada, soconayna suuqyada (shaqeysanayn). Waxaana uga yeelnay qaarkiinba qaar kale imtixaan ee ma samreysaan? Rabbigaa waa Mid Arka (oo u jeeda wax walba).

ayat.arabic: ۞ وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَرۡجُونَ لِقَآءَنَا لَوۡلَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيۡنَا ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ أَوۡ نَرَىٰ رَبَّنَاۗ لَقَدِ ٱسۡتَكۡبَرُواْ فِيٓ أَنفُسِهِمۡ وَعَتَوۡ عُتُوّٗا كَبِيرٗا

en.text: And those who do not expect the meeting with Us say, "Why were not angels sent down to us, or [why] do we [not] see our Lord?" They have certainly become arrogant within themselves[1013] and [become] insolent with great insolence.
en.footnotes: [1013] Additional meanings are "among themselves" and "over [the matter of] themselves."

so.text: 21. Kuwa aan rajeynayn la Kulankayaga waxay yidhaahdeen: “Maxaa malaa’ig na loogu soo diri waayey ama (maan) aragno Rabbigayo (Alle)?” Xaqiiq way isla weynaadeen (kibreen) oo ka madax adeygeen (Xaqa) madax adayg weyn.

ayat.arabic: يَوۡمَ يَرَوۡنَ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ لَا بُشۡرَىٰ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ وَيَقُولُونَ حِجۡرٗا مَّحۡجُورٗا

en.text: The day they see the angels[1014] - no good tidings will there be that day for the criminals, and [the angels] will say, "Prevented and inaccessible."[1015]
en.footnotes:
[1014] i.e., at the time of death.
[1015] Referring to any good tidings.

so.text: 22. Maalinta ay arki malaa’igta [8] uma ahaan doonto farxad Maalintaas denbiilayaasha, waxayna (malaa’igtu) odhan: “Waa wax idinka xarriman 'jannada' oo gebigeedaba idinka reebban [9].
so.footnotes:
[8]. Waqtiga dhimashadooda. 
[9]. Ma jiro war san iyo wanaag oo dhan.

ayat.arabic: وَقَدِمۡنَآ إِلَىٰ مَا عَمِلُواْ مِنۡ عَمَلٖ فَجَعَلۡنَٰهُ هَبَآءٗ مَّنثُورًا

en.text: And We will approach [i.e., regard][1016] what they have done of deeds and make them as dust dispersed.
en.footnotes: [1016] On the Day of Judgement.

so.text: 23. Waxaanu hor keeni [10] waxay (mushrikiinta, gaalada) ay camal san faleen, oo ka yeeli (qiimo la'aan) sida boor hawada ku baabba’ay.
so.footnotes: [10]. Maalinta Qiyaamaha.

ayat.arabic: أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡجَنَّةِ يَوۡمَئِذٍ خَيۡرٞ مُّسۡتَقَرّٗا وَأَحۡسَنُ مَقِيلٗا

en.text: The companions of Paradise, that Day, are [in] a better settlement and better resting place.

so.text: 24. Ehlu-Jannuhuse waxay Maalintaas ku sugnaan rug halka u khayr badan iyo meel harsimaysi iyo raaxo wanaagsan.

ayat.arabic: وَيَوۡمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِٱلۡغَمَٰمِ وَنُزِّلَ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ تَنزِيلًا

en.text: And [mention] the Day when the heaven will split open with [emerging] clouds,[1017] and the angels will be sent down in successive descent.
en.footnotes: [1017] Within which are the angels.

so.text: 25. (Xus) Maalinta marka samada dillaac la furmi oo daruuro "cad ka soo baxayaan' [11], lana soo dejin malaa’gta soo dejin.
so.footnotes: [11]. Daruurahaasoo ay malaa’ig ku jiraan.

ayat.arabic: ٱلۡمُلۡكُ يَوۡمَئِذٍ ٱلۡحَقُّ لِلرَّحۡمَٰنِۚ وَكَانَ يَوۡمًا عَلَى ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ عَسِيرٗا

en.text: True sovereignty, that Day, is for the Most Merciful. And it will be upon the disbelievers a difficult Day.

so.text: 26. Boqortooyada Maalintaas waxaa run ahaan iska leh Raxmaanka (Allaah), oo maalin daran bay u ahaan gaalada.

ayat.arabic: وَيَوۡمَ يَعَضُّ ٱلظَّالِمُ عَلَىٰ يَدَيۡهِ يَقُولُ يَٰلَيۡتَنِي ٱتَّخَذۡتُ مَعَ ٱلرَّسُولِ سَبِيلٗا

en.text: And the Day the wrongdoer will bite on his hands [in regret] he will say, "Oh, I wish I had taken with the Messenger a way.[1018]
en.footnotes: [1018] i.e., followed the Prophet (ﷺ) on a path of guidance.

so.text: 27.Oo (ka digtoonaada) Maalinta uu garmaqaataha qaniini doono gacmihiisa (shallayti iyo qoomamo) darteed isagoo leh: “Hoogayeey! Maxaan ula raaci waayey jidka 'toosan' Rasuulka [12].
so.footnotes: [12]. Nabiga la soo diray, jidkaas oo ah Islaamka.

ayat.arabic: يَٰوَيۡلَتَىٰ لَيۡتَنِي لَمۡ أَتَّخِذۡ فُلَانًا خَلِيلٗا

en.text: Oh, woe to me! I wish I had not taken that one[1019] as a friend.
en.footnotes: [1019] The person who misguided him.

so.text: 28. Alla Hoogay oo ba'aye! Maxaan hebel saaxiib uga yeeshay [13].
so.footnotes: [13]. Wuxuu sheegayaa qofkii habaabiyey.

ayat.arabic: لَّقَدۡ أَضَلَّنِي عَنِ ٱلذِّكۡرِ بَعۡدَ إِذۡ جَآءَنِيۗ وَكَانَ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ لِلۡإِنسَٰنِ خَذُولٗا

en.text: He led me away from the remembrance[1020] after it had come to me. And ever is Satan, to man, a deserter."[1021]
en.footnotes:
[1020] i.e., the Qur’ān or the remembrance of Allāh.
[1021] Forsaking him once he has led him into evil.

so.text: 29. Wuxuu iga habaabiyey waanada [14], intuu ii yimid kaddib. Shaydaanna wuxuu abad uga tagaa qofka meel xun [15] oo hungo ah.
so.footnotes:
[14]. Wuxuu ula jeedaa Qur’aanka iyo Sunnaha.
[15]. Wuu isaga tagaa oo cidla’ uga dhaqaaqaa markuu lumiyo kaddib oo u horseedo xumaanta.

ayat.arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلرَّسُولُ يَٰرَبِّ إِنَّ قَوۡمِي ٱتَّخَذُواْ هَٰذَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ مَهۡجُورٗا

en.text: And the Messenger has said, "O my Lord, indeed my people have taken this Qur’ān as [a thing] abandoned."[1022]
en.footnotes: [1022] i.e., avoiding it, not listening to or understanding it, not living by it, or preferring something else to it.

so.text: 30. Wuxuu Rasuulkuna odhan: “Rabbiyow! Dadkeygii waxay ka yeesheen Qur’aankan wax laga tagey [16].
so.footnotes: [16]. Iyagoo iska dhinac mara, iyagoo aan dhageysan ama aan fahmin, aan sidoo kale ku dhaqmin, ama wax kale ka hormariya oo ka soo dhoweysta.

ayat.arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ جَعَلۡنَا لِكُلِّ نَبِيٍّ عَدُوّٗا مِّنَ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَۗ وَكَفَىٰ بِرَبِّكَ هَادِيٗا وَنَصِيرٗا

en.text: And thus have We made for every prophet an enemy from among the criminals. But sufficient is your Lord as a guide and a helper.

so.text: 31. Sidaasaan ugu yeellay Nabi walba cadow ka mid ah denbiilayaasha. Ku filan Rabbigaa Hanuuniye iyo Hiilliye uu ahaado.

ayat.arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَوۡلَا نُزِّلَ عَلَيۡهِ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانُ جُمۡلَةٗ وَٰحِدَةٗۚ كَذَٰلِكَ لِنُثَبِّتَ بِهِۦ فُؤَادَكَۖ وَرَتَّلۡنَٰهُ تَرۡتِيلٗا

en.text: And those who disbelieve say, "Why was the Qur’ān not revealed to him all at once?" Thus [it is] that We may strengthen thereby your heart. And We have spaced it distinctly.[1023]
en.footnotes: [1023] Also, "recited it with distinct recitation."

so.text: 32. Gaaladu waxay yidhaahdeen: Maxaa Qur'aanka loogu soo dejin waayey mar keliya isagoo dhan”? Sidaasu waa si aan ugu sugno laabtaada [17], waxaana u soo Waxyoonnay oo kuugu akhrinnay qayb qayb si aayar ah iyo tartiib.
so.footnotes: [17]. Macnaha waxaa Qur’aanka looga dhigay Aayad Aayad iyo Suurad  Suurad oo loogu soo dejiyey qaybqaybta 23 sano gudahood si aan ugu sugno laabtaada.

ayat.arabic: وَلَا يَأۡتُونَكَ بِمَثَلٍ إِلَّا جِئۡنَٰكَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَأَحۡسَنَ تَفۡسِيرًا

en.text: And they do not come to you with an example [i.e., argument] except that We bring you the truth and the best explanation.

so.text: 33. Ma jirtona dood ay (gaalada) kuula iman, balse waxaannu kuu keeni (mid) Xaq ah oo ka fasiraad wanaagsan (oo burin waxay ku doodayaan).

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يُحۡشَرُونَ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمۡ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ شَرّٞ مَّكَانٗا وَأَضَلُّ سَبِيلٗا

en.text: The ones who are gathered on their faces to Hell - those are the worst in position and farthest astray in [their] way.

so.text: 34. Kuwaa (gaalada ah ee) laysugu soo kulmin (iyagoo ku socda) wejiyadooda xagga Naarta, kuwaas baa ugu meeqaan xun, kana sii habowsan Jidka (Islaamka).

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ ءَاتَيۡنَا مُوسَى ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَجَعَلۡنَا مَعَهُۥٓ أَخَاهُ هَٰرُونَ وَزِيرٗا

en.text: And We had certainly given Moses the Scripture and appointed with him his brother Aaron as an assistant.

so.text: 35. Waxaanu siinnay Muuse Kitaabka (Towraadda) waxaana ka yeellay la jirkiis walaalkiis Haaruun wasiir ahaan.

ayat.arabic: فَقُلۡنَا ٱذۡهَبَآ إِلَى ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا فَدَمَّرۡنَٰهُمۡ تَدۡمِيرٗا

en.text: And We said, "Go both of you to the people who have denied Our signs." Then We destroyed them with [complete] destruction.

so.text: 36. Waxaana nidhi: Aada qoladaa beeniyey Aayadahayaga, markaasaan baabbi’innay (qolodii Fircoon) baabbi’in dhan.

ayat.arabic: وَقَوۡمَ نُوحٖ لَّمَّا كَذَّبُواْ ٱلرُّسُلَ أَغۡرَقۡنَٰهُمۡ وَجَعَلۡنَٰهُمۡ لِلنَّاسِ ءَايَةٗۖ وَأَعۡتَدۡنَا لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ عَذَابًا أَلِيمٗا

en.text: And the people of Noah - when they denied the messengers,[1024] We drowned them, and We made them for mankind a sign. And We have prepared for the wrongdoers a painful punishment.
en.footnotes: [1024] Their denial of Noah was as if they had denied all those who brought the same message from Allāh.

so.text: 37. Qolodii Nuuxna, markay beeniyeen Rusushii baan harqinnay ugana yeellay dadka calaamo. Waxaana u diyaarinnay daalimiinta (gar diidka) cadaab daran.

ayat.arabic: وَعَادٗا وَثَمُودَاْ وَأَصۡحَٰبَ ٱلرَّسِّ وَقُرُونَۢا بَيۡنَ ذَٰلِكَ كَثِيرٗا

en.text: And [We destroyed] ʿAad and Thamūd and the companions of the well[1025] and many generations between them.
en.footnotes: [1025] Said to be a people who denied Prophet Shuʿayb or possibly those mentioned in Sūrah Yā Seen, 36:13-29.

so.text: 38. Sidaan Caad (u halaagnay) iyo Thamuud iyo qoladii Ar-Rass [18] iyo qaaruumo intaas u dhexeeya oo badan.
so.footnotes: [18]. Ar-Rass wuxuu ahaa ceel la yaqaan oo caan ah oo biyuhu ka gureen. Waxaa la yidhi dadkii ceelkan waxay ahaayeen dadkii beeniyey Nabi Shucayb.

ayat.arabic: وَكُلّٗا ضَرَبۡنَا لَهُ ٱلۡأَمۡثَٰلَۖ وَكُلّٗا تَبَّرۡنَا تَتۡبِيرٗا

en.text: And for each We presented examples [as warnings], and each We destroyed with [total] destruction.

so.text: 39. Dhammaan waxaanu siinnay oo u yeelnay tusaalooyin (mase rumeyn), dhammaanna waanu halaagnay halaagid.

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ أَتَوۡاْ عَلَى ٱلۡقَرۡيَةِ ٱلَّتِيٓ أُمۡطِرَتۡ مَطَرَ ٱلسَّوۡءِۚ أَفَلَمۡ يَكُونُواْ يَرَوۡنَهَاۚ بَلۡ كَانُواْ لَا يَرۡجُونَ نُشُورٗا

en.text: And they have already come upon the town which was showered with a rain of evil [i.e., stones]. So have they not seen it? But they are not expecting resurrection.[1026]
en.footnotes: [1026] So they do not benefit from lessons of the past.

so.text: 40. Waxay (wax badan) soo ag mareen magaaladii (Sodom) ee lagu halaagay roobka xun. Ee miyaanay ku arag (indhahooda)? Mayee waxaanay rajeyneyn in la soo bixin doono iyagoo nool dhimasho kaddib 'oo la xisaabin' [19].
so.footnotes: [19]. Marka kama ayan faa’ideysan oo kuma ay cibrad qaadan tusaalooyinkii dadkii hore ee tagey iyo wixii ku dhacay.

ayat.arabic: وَإِذَا رَأَوۡكَ إِن يَتَّخِذُونَكَ إِلَّا هُزُوًا أَهَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي بَعَثَ ٱللَّهُ رَسُولًا

en.text: And when they see you, [O Muḥammad], they take you not except in ridicule, [saying], "Is this the one whom Allāh has sent as a messenger?

so.text: 41. Markay ku arkaan (gaalada) kaama dhigtaan (Nabiyow) waxaan ahayn jees-jees (iyagoo leh): Ma kan baa kan uu Alle u soo diray Rasuul ahaan?

ayat.arabic: إِن كَادَ لَيُضِلُّنَا عَنۡ ءَالِهَتِنَا لَوۡلَآ أَن صَبَرۡنَا عَلَيۡهَاۚ وَسَوۡفَ يَعۡلَمُونَ حِينَ يَرَوۡنَ ٱلۡعَذَابَ مَنۡ أَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا

en.text: He almost would have misled us from our gods had we not been steadfast in [worship of] them." But they are going to know, when they see the punishment, who is farthest astray in [his] way.

so.text: 42. Wuxuu u dhowaaday inuu naga lumiyo ilaahyadayada, haddaanan ku samrin oo sugnaanin. Wayse ogaan markay arkaan cadaabka kan ka lunsan Jidka (Toosan).

ayat.arabic: أَرَءَيۡتَ مَنِ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَٰهَهُۥ هَوَىٰهُ أَفَأَنتَ تَكُونُ عَلَيۡهِ وَكِيلًا

en.text: Have you seen the one who takes as his god his own desire? Then would you be responsible for him?

so.text: 43. Ka warran kan isagu ka yeesha hawadiisa ilaahiisa? Ma waxaad adigu u noqon wakiil?

ayat.arabic: أَمۡ تَحۡسَبُ أَنَّ أَكۡثَرَهُمۡ يَسۡمَعُونَ أَوۡ يَعۡقِلُونَۚ إِنۡ هُمۡ إِلَّا كَٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمِ بَلۡ هُمۡ أَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا

en.text: Or do you think that most of them hear or reason? They are not except like livestock.[1027] Rather, they are [even] more astray in [their] way.
en.footnotes: [1027] i.e., cattle or sheep, that follow without question wherever they are led.

so.text: 44. Mise waxaad mooddaa inay badankoo- du wax maqli ama wax fahmi? Ma aha waxaan xoolo oo kale ahayn [20], iyagaabase ka sii lunsan jid ahaan.
so.footnotes: [20]. Geela, lo’da ama adhiga ee wax iska raaca weydiin la’aan meeshii loo kaxeeyaba.

ayat.arabic: أَلَمۡ تَرَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَيۡفَ مَدَّ ٱلظِّلَّ وَلَوۡ شَآءَ لَجَعَلَهُۥ سَاكِنٗا ثُمَّ جَعَلۡنَا ٱلشَّمۡسَ عَلَيۡهِ دَلِيلٗا

en.text: Have you not considered your Lord - how He extends the shadow, and if He willed, He could have made it stationary? Then We made the sun for it an indication.[1028]
en.footnotes: [1028] i.e., showing the existence of a shadow or making it apparent by contrast.

so.text: 45. Miyaadan arag sida Rabbigaa u fidiyo hadhka? Hadduu doonona wuxuu ka yeeli lahaa mid xasilan 'taagan', markaasaan uga yeelnay qorraxda tilmaan ay leedahay [21].
so.footnotes: [21]. Kaasoo tusineysa jiritaanka hadhka, ama ka yeesha wax u muuqda siyaalo kala duwan. Markaasaan soo qabannaa qabasho qarsoon oo soo ururinnaa oo xaggeenna u soo noqdaa ilaa la waayo hadh oo dhan.

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ قَبَضۡنَٰهُ إِلَيۡنَا قَبۡضٗا يَسِيرٗا

en.text: Then We [retract and] hold it with Us for a brief grasp.[1029]
en.footnotes: [1029] i.e., when the sun is overhead at noon.

so.text: 46. Markaasaan u soo qabannaa xaggayaga qabasho aayar ah oo yar [22].
so.footnotes: [22]. Marka qorraxdu ku aaddan tahay madaxayaga oo maalinta kala baranto.

ayat.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيۡلَ لِبَاسٗا وَٱلنَّوۡمَ سُبَاتٗا وَجَعَلَ ٱلنَّهَارَ نُشُورٗا

en.text: And it is He who has made the night for you as clothing[1030] and sleep [a means for] rest and has made the day a resurrection.[1031]
en.footnotes:
[1030] Covering you in darkness and providing rest.
[1031] For renewal of life and activity.

so.text: 47. (Alle) waa Kan idiin ka yeelay habeenka hu' [23], hurdadana nasasho, kana dhigay maalinta foof [24].
so.footnotes:
[23]. Macnaha waa idinku daboola oo qariya mugdigiisa.
[24]. Waxaa loola jeedaa cusbooneysiinta nolosha iyo dhaqdhaqaaqa.

ayat.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَرۡسَلَ ٱلرِّيَٰحَ بُشۡرَۢا بَيۡنَ يَدَيۡ رَحۡمَتِهِۦۚ وَأَنزَلۡنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءٗ طَهُورٗا

en.text: And it is He who sends the winds as good tidings before His mercy [i.e., rainfall], and We send down from the sky pure water

so.text: 48. Waa Kan soo dira dabeylaha bishaaro ahaan ka horreeya Raxmaddiisa (roobka), Waxaana ka soo dejinnaa daruuraha biyo daahir ah.

ayat.arabic: لِّنُحۡـِۧيَ بِهِۦ بَلۡدَةٗ مَّيۡتٗا وَنُسۡقِيَهُۥ مِمَّا خَلَقۡنَآ أَنۡعَٰمٗا وَأَنَاسِيَّ كَثِيرٗا

en.text: That We may bring to life thereby a dead land and give it as drink to those We created of numerous livestock and men.

so.text: 49. Si aan ugu nooleyno dhul dhintay, oo ugu waraabinno waxaan abuurnay oo duunyo iyo dad badanba leh.

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ صَرَّفۡنَٰهُ بَيۡنَهُمۡ لِيَذَّكَّرُواْ فَأَبَىٰٓ أَكۡثَرُ ٱلنَّاسِ إِلَّا كُفُورٗا

en.text: And We have certainly distributed it among them that they might be reminded,[1032] but most of the people refuse except disbelief.
en.footnotes: [1032] Of Allāh's ability to bring the dead to life.

so.text: 50. Waana u kala duwnay (badinnay) qaybinta (roobka, biyaha) bal inay waansamaan [25], wayse diideen dadku badankiisu waxaan aheyn gaalnimo.
so.footnotes: [25]. Waa inuu Alle awoodo inuu soo nooleyn karo meytida.

ayat.arabic: وَلَوۡ شِئۡنَا لَبَعَثۡنَا فِي كُلِّ قَرۡيَةٖ نَّذِيرٗا

en.text: And if We had willed, We could have sent into every city a warner.[1033]
en.footnotes: [1033] However, Allāh willed that Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ) be sent as the final messenger for all peoples of the earth until the Day of Resurrection.

so.text: 51. Haddaan doonno, waxaan u soo diri laheyn magaalo walba dige [26].
so.footnotes: [26]. Wuxuuse Alle doonay inuu soo diro Nabi Muxammad s.c.w. inuu ahaado Rasuulka lagu khatimo Rususha Alle oo dhan, isagoo loo diray dhammaan dadka arlada jooga ilaa Qiyaamaha.

ayat.arabic: فَلَا تُطِعِ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ وَجَٰهِدۡهُم بِهِۦ جِهَادٗا كَبِيرٗا

en.text: So do not obey the disbelievers, and strive against them with it [i.e., the Qur’ān] a great striving.

so.text: 52. Ee ha adeecin gaalada, kulana dadaal dadaal weyn (gaarsiinta Qur'aanka ee u muujiya Xaqa si dhan, buriyana baadilka).

ayat.arabic: ۞ وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي مَرَجَ ٱلۡبَحۡرَيۡنِ هَٰذَا عَذۡبٞ فُرَاتٞ وَهَٰذَا مِلۡحٌ أُجَاجٞ وَجَعَلَ بَيۡنَهُمَا بَرۡزَخٗا وَحِجۡرٗا مَّحۡجُورٗا

en.text: And it is He who has released [simultaneously] the two seas [i.e., bodies of water], one fresh and sweet and one salty and bitter, and He placed between them a barrier and prohibiting partition.

so.text: 53. (Alle) waa Kan isku dara labada badood, kan waa macaan lagu oon baxo, kanna waa qadhaadh (afka huriya),  Wuxuuna yeelay xayir iyo xijaab kala dhex yaal.

ayat.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ مِنَ ٱلۡمَآءِ بَشَرٗا فَجَعَلَهُۥ نَسَبٗا وَصِهۡرٗاۗ وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ قَدِيرٗا

en.text: And it is He who has created from water [i.e., semen] a human being and made him [a relative by] lineage and marriage. And ever is your Lord competent [concerning creation].

so.text: 54. Waa Kan ka abuuray dadka biyo, markaas u yeelay xigto iyo xididba. Rabbigaa waa Mid Wax Walba Kara.

ayat.arabic: وَيَعۡبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنفَعُهُمۡ وَلَا يَضُرُّهُمۡۗ وَكَانَ ٱلۡكَافِرُ عَلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ ظَهِيرٗا

en.text: But they worship rather than Allāh that which does not benefit them or harm them, and the disbeliever is ever, against his Lord, an assistant [to Satan].

so.text: 55. Waxayse caabudaan Alle sokadi, waxaan wax tari karin, waxna yeeli karin,  gaalna waa sheydaan kalkaal ka soo hor jeeda Rabbigi.

ayat.arabic: وَمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَٰكَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرٗا وَنَذِيرٗا

en.text: And We have not sent you, [O Muḥammad], except as a bringer of good tidings and a warner.

so.text: 56. Kuuma aanu soo dirin (Nabi Muxammadow) waxaan ahayn inaad bishaareeye iyo dige ahaato.

ayat.arabic: قُلۡ مَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرٍ إِلَّا مَن شَآءَ أَن يَتَّخِذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلٗا

en.text: Say, "I do not ask of you for it any payment - only that whoever wills might take to his Lord a way."

so.text: 57. Dheh: “Idinkuma weydiisto wax ajar ah ( gaarsiinta Dhambaalkan), qofkiise dooni inuu ka yeesho Rabbigi xaggiisa waddo (ha samo falo)".

ayat.arabic: وَتَوَكَّلۡ عَلَى ٱلۡحَيِّ ٱلَّذِي لَا يَمُوتُ وَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِهِۦۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِهِۦ بِذُنُوبِ عِبَادِهِۦ خَبِيرًا

en.text: And rely upon the Ever-Living who does not die, and exalt [Allāh] with His praise. And sufficient is He to be, with the sins of His servants, [fully] Aware -

so.text: 58. Tala saarona Allaah, Noolaha (Daa’inka) ah aan dhiman, kuna tasbiixso Ammaanahiisa. Rabbi ku Filan ogaanshaha denbiyada addoomahiisa.

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٖ ثُمَّ ٱسۡتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلۡعَرۡشِۖ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ فَسۡـَٔلۡ بِهِۦ خَبِيرٗا

en.text: He who created the heavens and the earth and what is between them in six days and then established Himself above the Throne[1034] - the Most Merciful, so ask about Him one well informed [i.e., the Prophet (ﷺ)].
en.footnotes: [1034] See footnotes to 2:19 and 7:54.

so.text: 59. (Alle) waa Kan ku abuuray samooyinka iyo arlada iyo waxa u dhexeeya lix maalmood, markaas kor ahaaday Carshiga (si u qalanta Weynadiisa). Naxariis Badanaha wax ka weydii mid Xog ogaal ah.

ayat.arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱسۡجُدُواْۤ لِلرَّحۡمَٰنِ قَالُواْ وَمَا ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ أَنَسۡجُدُ لِمَا تَأۡمُرُنَا وَزَادَهُمۡ نُفُورٗا۩

en.text: And when it is said to them, "Prostrate to the Most Merciful," they say, "And what is the Most Merciful? Should we prostrate to that which you order us?" And it increases them in aversion.

so.text: 60. Marka lagu yidhaahdo: “U sujuuda Raxmaanka.Waxay (gaaladu) yidhaahdaan: Muxuu yahay Ar-Raxmaan? Ma waxaan u sujuudeynaa waxaad nagu amreyso? Wuxuuna u kordhiyaa didmo.

ayat.arabic: تَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ بُرُوجٗا وَجَعَلَ فِيهَا سِرَٰجٗا وَقَمَرٗا مُّنِيرٗا

en.text: Blessed is He who has placed in the sky great stars and placed therein a [burning] lamp and luminous moon.

so.text:
61. Waxaa khayr iyo barako badan Kan 'Alle' ee u yeelay samada xiddigo waaweyn,    
 yeelayna dhexdeeda nal 'qorrax' iyo dayax ifiya.

ayat.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ ٱلَّيۡلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ خِلۡفَةٗ لِّمَنۡ أَرَادَ أَن يَذَّكَّرَ أَوۡ أَرَادَ شُكُورٗا

en.text: And it is He who has made the night and the day in succession for whoever desires to remember or desires gratitude.

so.text: 62. Waa Isaga (Alle) Kan uga yeelay habeenka iyo maalinta is dhaaf qofkii raba inuu waano qaato ama raba inuu ku mahdiyo (Alle).

ayat.arabic: وَعِبَادُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ ٱلَّذِينَ يَمۡشُونَ عَلَى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ هَوۡنٗا وَإِذَا خَاطَبَهُمُ ٱلۡجَٰهِلُونَ قَالُواْ سَلَٰمٗا

en.text: And the servants of the Most Merciful are those who walk upon the earth easily,[1035] and when the ignorant address them [harshly], they say [words of] peace,[1036]
en.footnotes:
[1035] i.e., gently, with dignity but without arrogance.
[1036] Or "safety," i.e., words free from fault or evil.

so.text: 63. Addoomaha Raxmaanka (Alle) waa kuwa ku mara dhulka miyir [27], markay maangaabyada kula hadlaan (ereyo xun) ku yidhaahda salaamaa 'nabadgelyo' [28].
so.footnotes:
[27]. Xasillooni si sharaf leh aan iskibrin lahayn. 
[28]. Salaamaa macnaha waa hadal nabad ah ka maran gef ama xumaan.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَبِيتُونَ لِرَبِّهِمۡ سُجَّدٗا وَقِيَٰمٗا

en.text: And those who spend [part of] the night to their Lord prostrating and standing [in prayer]

so.text: 64. Waa kuwa ku dhaxa habeenkii iyagoo u sujuudsan Rabbigood oo u taagan 'salaad'.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا ٱصۡرِفۡ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَۖ إِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَامًا

en.text: And those who say, "Our Lord, avert from us the punishment of Hell. Indeed, its punishment is ever adhering;

so.text: 65. Kuwa yidhaahda: Rabbigayow! Naga duw cadaabka Jahannama, hubaal! Cadaabkeedu waa wax joogta ah.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّهَا سَآءَتۡ مُسۡتَقَرّٗا وَمُقَامٗا

en.text: Indeed, it is evil as a settlement and residence."

so.text: 66. Hubaal waa hoy xun iyo meel baas ee la dego.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَآ أَنفَقُواْ لَمۡ يُسۡرِفُواْ وَلَمۡ يَقۡتُرُواْ وَكَانَ بَيۡنَ ذَٰلِكَ قَوَامٗا

en.text: And [they are] those who, when they spend, do so not excessively or sparingly but are ever, between that, [justly] moderate

so.text: 67. Waa kuwa markay wax bixiyaan aan xad gudbin ama aan wax ciriiryin, oo intaas dhexdooda ku toosnaada.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَدۡعُونَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ وَلَا يَقۡتُلُونَ ٱلنَّفۡسَ ٱلَّتِي حَرَّمَ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَلَا يَزۡنُونَۚ وَمَن يَفۡعَلۡ ذَٰلِكَ يَلۡقَ أَثَامٗا

en.text: And those who do not invoke[1037] with Allāh another deity or kill the soul which Allāh has forbidden [to be killed], except by right, and do not commit unlawful sexual intercourse. And whoever should do that will meet a penalty.
en.footnotes: [1037] Or "worship."

so.text: 68. Ee ah kuwa aan baryin (caabudin) ilaah kale la jirka Alle, oo aan ku dilin nafta uu Alle xarrimay waxaan ahayn xaq, oo aan zineyzan (dhilleysan), qofkii falana waxaa, wuxuu la kulmi eedsiin denbiguu galay ah.

ayat.arabic: يُضَٰعَفۡ لَهُ ٱلۡعَذَابُ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ وَيَخۡلُدۡ فِيهِۦ مُهَانًا

en.text: Multiplied for him is the punishment on the Day of Resurrection, and he will abide therein humiliated -

so.text: 69. Waxaa loo laba laabi Cadaabka Maalin- ta Qiyaamaha, wuuna ku dhex waari isagoo dulleysan.

ayat.arabic: إِلَّا مَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ عَمَلٗا صَٰلِحٗا فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ يُبَدِّلُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمۡ حَسَنَٰتٖۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورٗا رَّحِيمٗا

en.text: Except for those who repent, believe and do righteous work. For them Allāh will replace their evil deeds with good. And ever is Allāh Forgiving and Merciful.

so.text: 70. Qofkii tawbad keena oo rumeeya (Xaqa) oo sama fala mooyee, kuwaas wuxuu Alle ugu beddeli xumohoodii xasanaad. Alle waa Denbi Dhaaf Badane, Naxariis Badan.

ayat.arabic: وَمَن تَابَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحٗا فَإِنَّهُۥ يَتُوبُ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ مَتَابٗا

en.text: And he who repents and does righteousness does indeed turn to Allāh with [accepted] repentance.

so.text:
71. Qofkii tawbad keena oo sama fala, wuxuu hubaal u soo laaban (oo tawbad 
keeni) xagga Alle laabasho (towbad) wanaagsan.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَشۡهَدُونَ ٱلزُّورَ وَإِذَا مَرُّواْ بِٱللَّغۡوِ مَرُّواْ كِرَامٗا

en.text: And [they are] those who do not testify to falsehood, and when they pass near ill speech, they pass by with dignity.

so.text: 72. Waa kuwa aan furin markhaati been ah, markay maqlaanna wax uun hadal macno darro ah ku mara sharaf (ka jeesada).

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِّرُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ لَمۡ يَخِرُّواْ عَلَيۡهَا صُمّٗا وَعُمۡيَانٗا

en.text: And those who, when reminded of the verses of their Lord, do not fall upon them deaf and blind.

so.text: 73. Waa kuwa marka lagu waaniyo Aayadaha Rabbigood aan uga dhul dhicin dhega la’aan iyo indho la’aan.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا هَبۡ لَنَا مِنۡ أَزۡوَٰجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّٰتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعۡيُنٖ وَٱجۡعَلۡنَا لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا

en.text: And those who say, "Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes[1038] and make us a leader [i.e., example] for the righteous."
en.footnotes: [1038] i.e., a source of happiness due to their righteousness.

so.text: 74. Waa kuwa yidhaahda: Rabbigayow! Naga sii xaasaskayaga iyo ubadkayaga waxay indhaheenna ku farxaan [29], noogana yeel kuwa Alle ka cabsada Iimaam (ay ku daydaan).
so.footnotes: [29]. Macnaha waa aan ku faraxno oo il qabowsanno sababta toosnidooda darteed iyo Alle ka cabsigooda.

ayat.arabic: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ يُجۡزَوۡنَ ٱلۡغُرۡفَةَ بِمَا صَبَرُواْ وَيُلَقَّوۡنَ فِيهَا تَحِيَّةٗ وَسَلَٰمًا

en.text: Those will be awarded the Chamber[1039] for what they patiently endured, and they will be received therein with greetings and [words of] peace,
en.footnotes: [1039] The most elevated portion of Paradise.

so.text: 75. Kuwaasi waxaa lagu abaal marin dabaqyo sare 'jannada gudaheeda' [30] samirkoodii dartiis, waxayna kula kulmi  dhexdeeda salaan iyo soo dhoweyn sare.
so.footnotes: [30]. Waa halka ugu sarreysa uguna fiican Jannada.

ayat.arabic: خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَاۚ حَسُنَتۡ مُسۡتَقَرّٗا وَمُقَامٗا

en.text: Abiding eternally therein. Good is the settlement and residence.

so.text: 76. Iyagoo ku dhex waaraya weligood, wanaagsanaa hoy iyo degmo ahaan.

ayat.arabic: قُلۡ مَا يَعۡبَؤُاْ بِكُمۡ رَبِّي لَوۡلَا دُعَآؤُكُمۡۖ فَقَدۡ كَذَّبۡتُمۡ فَسَوۡفَ يَكُونُ لِزَامَۢا

en.text: Say, "What would my Lord care for you if not for your supplication?"[1040] For you [disbelievers] have denied, so it [i.e., your denial] is going to be adherent.[1041]
en.footnotes:
[1040] i.e., faith and worship. An alternative meaning is "What would my Lord do with you..."
[1041] It will remain with them, causing punishment to be required and imperative upon them.

so.text: 77. Dheh: “Rabbigay dan idiinma galeen haddaydaan barideen [31]. Haatanse waad beeniseen (Xaqa). Wuxuuna ahaan mid idin laasuma 'cadaabka' [32].
so.footnotes:
[31]. Codsigiinna in la idiin soo diro Rasuul.
[32]. Waa idinku lammaanaan si joogto ah.

ayat.arabic: طسٓمٓ

en.text: Ṭā, Seen, Meem.[1043]
en.footnotes: [1043] See footnote to 2:1.

so.text: 1. Taa Siin Miim [1].
so.footnotes: [1]. Eeg sharaxa Suuradda 2 Al-Baqarah: Aayadda 1.

ayat.arabic: تِلۡكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ ٱلۡمُبِينِ

en.text: These are the verses of the clear Book.

so.text: 2. Kuwakani waa Aayadaha Kitaabka (Qur’aanka) ee Cad.

ayat.arabic: لَعَلَّكَ بَٰخِعٞ نَّفۡسَكَ أَلَّا يَكُونُواْ مُؤۡمِنِينَ

en.text: Perhaps, [O Muḥammad], you would kill yourself with grief that they will not be believers.

so.text: 3. Waa intaasoo aad naftaada ku disho (murugo) inaysan rumayn (Xaqa) darteed.

ayat.arabic: إِن نَّشَأۡ نُنَزِّلۡ عَلَيۡهِم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ ءَايَةٗ فَظَلَّتۡ أَعۡنَٰقُهُمۡ لَهَا خَٰضِعِينَ

en.text: If We willed, We could send down to them from the sky a sign for which their necks would remain humbled.[1044]
en.footnotes: [1044] i.e., they would be compelled to believe.

so.text: 4. Haddaan doonno, Waxaan kaga soo dejin calaamo cirka, ay luqumahoodu u hogtaan [2].
so.footnotes: [2]. Macnaha waxaa lagu qasbayaa inay rumeeyaan.

ayat.arabic: وَمَا يَأۡتِيهِم مِّن ذِكۡرٖ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ مُحۡدَثٍ إِلَّا كَانُواْ عَنۡهُ مُعۡرِضِينَ

en.text: And no mention [i.e., revelation] comes to them anew from the Most Merciful except that they turn away from it.

so.text: 5. Uga ma yimaado waano (Qur'aan) xagga Raxmaanka 'Alle' iyagoo cusub oo is daba jooga, waase ka jeesadaan.

ayat.arabic: فَقَدۡ كَذَّبُواْ فَسَيَأۡتِيهِمۡ أَنۢبَٰٓؤُاْ مَا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ

en.text: For they have already denied, but there will come to them the news of that which they used to ridicule.

so.text: 6. Waxay dhab ahaan beeniyeen (Xaqa), sidaas darteed waxaa u imaan wararka waxay ku jees-jeesayeen.

ayat.arabic: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ إِلَى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ كَمۡ أَنۢبَتۡنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوۡجٖ كَرِيمٍ

en.text: Did they not look at the earth - how much We have produced therein from every noble kind?

so.text: 7. Miyeyna arkayn dhulka intee baan nooc kasta oo dhir wanaagsan ah sababnay inuu ka soo baxo?

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ

en.text: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

so.text: 8. Hubaal, waxaa arrinkaa ku sugan calaamo, mase aha badankoodu kuwo rumeyn.

ayat.arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

en.text: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

so.text: 9. Hubaalna Rabbigaa waa Adkaadaha Sare, Naxariista Badan.

ayat.arabic: وَإِذۡ نَادَىٰ رَبُّكَ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱئۡتِ ٱلۡقَوۡمَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ

en.text: And [mention] when your Lord called Moses, [saying], "Go to the wrongdoing people -

so.text: 10. (Xus) markuu Rabbigaa u yeedhay Muuse (Isagoo leh): U tag qoloda daalimiinta (gar ma qaatayaasha) ah.

ayat.arabic: قَوۡمَ فِرۡعَوۡنَۚ أَلَا يَتَّقُونَ

en.text: The people of Pharaoh. Will they not fear Allāh?"

so.text: 11. Qolada Fircoon, miyaanay iska jireyn (xumaha oo u hoggaansameyn Alle)?

ayat.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ أَن يُكَذِّبُونِ

en.text: He said, "My Lord, indeed I fear that they will deny me

so.text: 12. (Muuse) wuxuu yidhi: Rabbiyow! Waxaan ka cabsan inay i beeniyaan,

ayat.arabic: وَيَضِيقُ صَدۡرِي وَلَا يَنطَلِقُ لِسَانِي فَأَرۡسِلۡ إِلَىٰ هَٰرُونَ

en.text: And that my breast will tighten and my tongue will not be fluent, so send for Aaron.

so.text: 13. Oo ay cidhiidhyoonto laabteydu, oo caddeyn kari waayo (hadalka) carrabkaygu. Ee dir la jirkay Haaruun (inuu i caawiyo).

ayat.arabic: وَلَهُمۡ عَلَيَّ ذَنۢبٞ فَأَخَافُ أَن يَقۡتُلُونِ

en.text: And they have upon me a [claim due to] sin, so I fear that they will kill me."

so.text: 14. Waxayna igu heystaan denbi (dil aan geystey ah), sidaas darteed waxaan ka cabsan inay i dilaan.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ كَلَّاۖ فَٱذۡهَبَا بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآۖ إِنَّا مَعَكُم مُّسۡتَمِعُونَ

en.text: [Allāh] said, "No. Go both of you with Our signs; indeed, We are with you, listening.

so.text: 15. (Alle) wuxuu yidhi: “Ma jirto! Ee la taga idinku Aayadahayaga. Hubaal, Annagaa idinla jirna oo idin maqleyna.

ayat.arabic: فَأۡتِيَا فِرۡعَوۡنَ فَقُولَآ إِنَّا رَسُولُ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

en.text: Go to Pharaoh and say, 'We are the messengers[1045] of the Lord of the worlds,
en.footnotes: [1045] The singular form in Arabic indicates that both were sent with a single message.

so.text: 16. U taga Fircoon oo ku dhaha: "Innagu waxaanu nahay Rusuulka Rabbiga uumanka".

ayat.arabic: أَنۡ أَرۡسِلۡ مَعَنَا بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ

en.text: [Commanded to say], "Send with us the Children of Israel."'"

so.text: 17.Ee nagu dar hana raacaane reer Israa’iil.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ أَلَمۡ نُرَبِّكَ فِينَا وَلِيدٗا وَلَبِثۡتَ فِينَا مِنۡ عُمُرِكَ سِنِينَ

en.text: [Pharaoh] said, "Did we not raise you among us as a child, and you remained among us for years of your life?

so.text: 18. (Fircoon) wuxuu yidhi: Ma waanaan kugu barbaarin dhexdayada adigoo ilmo yar ah? Oo aad nala joogin sannado badan ka mid ah cimrigaaga?

ayat.arabic: وَفَعَلۡتَ فَعۡلَتَكَ ٱلَّتِي فَعَلۡتَ وَأَنتَ مِنَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ

en.text: And [then] you did your deed which you did,[1046] and you were of the ungrateful."
en.footnotes: [1046] i.e., striking the Copt, who died as a result.

so.text: 19. Oo aad fashay falkaagii aad fashay (dishay nin) waxaadna tahay abaal laawe.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ فَعَلۡتُهَآ إِذٗا وَأَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ

en.text: [Moses] said, "I did it, then, while I was of those astray [i.e., ignorant].

so.text: 20. (Muuse) wuxuu yidhi: “Waxaan falay  anigoon wax garanayn.

ayat.arabic: فَفَرَرۡتُ مِنكُمۡ لَمَّا خِفۡتُكُمۡ فَوَهَبَ لِي رَبِّي حُكۡمٗا وَجَعَلَنِي مِنَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ

en.text: So I fled from you when I feared you. Then my Lord granted me judgement [i.e., wisdom and prophethood] and appointed me [as one] of the messengers.

so.text: 21. Waana idinka cararay markaan idinka cabsaday, markaasuu Rabbigay I siiyey Nabinnimo (iyo Cilmi), oo iga yeelay mid ka mid ah Rususha.

ayat.arabic: وَتِلۡكَ نِعۡمَةٞ تَمُنُّهَا عَلَيَّ أَنۡ عَبَّدتَّ بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ

en.text: And is this a favor of which you remind me - that you have enslaved the Children of Israel?"

so.text: 22. Oo taasi (inaan ku soo barbaaray gurigaaga) - ma nicmad baa aad iigu lib sheegan, adigoo addoonsaday reer Israa’iil?

ayat.arabic: قَالَ فِرۡعَوۡنُ وَمَا رَبُّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

en.text: Said Pharaoh, "And what is the Lord of the worlds?"

so.text: 23. Fircoon wuxuu yidhi: Muxuu yahay Rabbiga uumanka?

ayat.arabic: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَآۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ

en.text: [Moses] said, "The Lord of the heavens and earth and that between them, if you should be convinced."

so.text: 24. (Muuse) wuxuu yidhi: “Waa Rabbiga samooyinka iyo arlada iyo waxa u dhexeeya, haddaad (rumeyn) idinkoo yaqiinsan.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ لِمَنۡ حَوۡلَهُۥٓ أَلَا تَسۡتَمِعُونَ

en.text: [Pharaoh] said to those around him, "Do you not hear?"

so.text: 25. (Fircoon) wuxuu ku yidhi kuwii hareera joogay: Ma waydaan maqleyn?

ayat.arabic: قَالَ رَبُّكُمۡ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ

en.text: [Moses] said, "Your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers."

so.text: 26. (Muuse) Wuxuu yidhi: (Alle) waa Rabbigiin iyo Rabbiga aabbayaashiinnii hore.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَكُمُ ٱلَّذِيٓ أُرۡسِلَ إِلَيۡكُمۡ لَمَجۡنُونٞ

en.text: [Pharaoh] said,[1047] "Indeed, your 'messenger' who has been sent to you is mad."
en.footnotes: [1047] Angrily addressing those present.

so.text: 27. (Fircoon) wuxuu yidhi [3]: Hubaal Rasuulkiinna la idiin soo diray waa jinnoole.
so.footnotes: [3]. Isagoo si ay cadho badan ku jirto ula hadlaya dadkii goob joogga ahaa.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلۡمَشۡرِقِ وَٱلۡمَغۡرِبِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَآۖ إِن كُنتُمۡ تَعۡقِلُونَ

en.text: [Moses] said, "Lord of the east and the west and that between them, if you were to reason."

so.text: 28. (Muuse) wuxuu yidhi: Waa Rabbiga bariga iyo galbeedka iyo inta u dhexeysa, haddaad wax fahmeysaan.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ لَئِنِ ٱتَّخَذۡتَ إِلَٰهًا غَيۡرِي لَأَجۡعَلَنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلۡمَسۡجُونِينَ

en.text: [Pharaoh] said, "If you take a god other than me, I will surely place you among those imprisoned."

so.text: 29. (Fircoon) wuxuu yidhi: Haddaad yeelato ilaah kale aan aniga ahayn, Waxaan kaa mid dhigayaa kuwa xabbisan.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ أَوَلَوۡ جِئۡتُكَ بِشَيۡءٖ مُّبِينٖ

en.text: [Moses] said, "Even if I brought you something [i.e., proof] manifest?"

so.text: 30.(Muuse) wuxuu yidhi:“Ma xitaa haddaan kuula imaado wax cad?

ayat.arabic: قَالَ فَأۡتِ بِهِۦٓ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ

en.text: [Pharaoh] said, "Then bring it, if you should be of the truthful."

so.text: 31. (Fircoon) wuxuu yidhi: La imow, haddaad run sheegi.

ayat.arabic: فَأَلۡقَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِيَ ثُعۡبَانٞ مُّبِينٞ

en.text: So [Moses] threw his staff, and suddenly it was a serpent manifest.[1048]
en.footnotes: [1048] i.e., clearly genuine.

so.text: 32. Markaasuu (Muuse) tuuray ushiisii, mise waa mas muuqda.

ayat.arabic: وَنَزَعَ يَدَهُۥ فَإِذَا هِيَ بَيۡضَآءُ لِلنَّٰظِرِينَ

en.text: And he drew out his hand; thereupon it was white for the observers.

so.text: 33. Oo soo saaray gacantiisii mise, waa mid u cad (ifeysa) kuwa eegaya.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ لِلۡمَلَإِ حَوۡلَهُۥٓ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَسَٰحِرٌ عَلِيمٞ

en.text: [Pharaoh] said to the eminent ones around him, "Indeed, this is a learned magician.

so.text: 34. (Fircoon) wuxuu ku yidhi xildhibaannadii hareera joogay: Kanu xaqiiq waa saaxir xeel dheer.

ayat.arabic: يُرِيدُ أَن يُخۡرِجَكُم مِّنۡ أَرۡضِكُم بِسِحۡرِهِۦ فَمَاذَا تَأۡمُرُونَ

en.text: He wants to drive you out of your land by his magic, so what do you advise?"

so.text: 35. Raba inuu idin kaga saaro dhulkiinna sixirkiisa, ee maxaad ku talineysaan?

ayat.arabic: قَالُوٓاْ أَرۡجِهۡ وَأَخَاهُ وَٱبۡعَثۡ فِي ٱلۡمَدَآئِنِ حَٰشِرِينَ

en.text: They said, "Postpone [the matter of] him and his brother and send among the cities gatherers

so.text: 36. Waxay yidhaahdeen: Dib u dhig isaga iyo walaalki (xaalkooda in yar) oo u dir magaalooyinka kuwo soo kulmiya [4].
so.footnotes: [4]. Kuwa keena saaxiriin oo soo qora ciidammo badan si looga joojiyo reer Israa’iil inay ka tagaan oo ka baxaan halkaasi.

ayat.arabic: يَأۡتُوكَ بِكُلِّ سَحَّارٍ عَلِيمٖ

en.text: Who will bring you every learned, skilled magician."

so.text: 37. Inay kuu keenaan saaxir kasta oo xeel dheer.

ayat.arabic: فَجُمِعَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ لِمِيقَٰتِ يَوۡمٖ مَّعۡلُومٖ

en.text: So the magicians were assembled for the appointment of a well-known day.[1049]
en.footnotes: [1049] i.e., the morning of the day of festival. See 20:58-59.

so.text: 38. Markaasaa sixiroolayaashii la isugu soo wada kulmiyey madal maalin la yaqaan.

ayat.arabic: وَقِيلَ لِلنَّاسِ هَلۡ أَنتُم مُّجۡتَمِعُونَ

en.text: And it was said to the people, "Will you congregate

so.text: 39. Waxaa lagu yidhi dadkii: Ma soo kulmeysaan?

ayat.arabic: لَعَلَّنَا نَتَّبِعُ ٱلسَّحَرَةَ إِن كَانُواْ هُمُ ٱلۡغَٰلِبِينَ

en.text: That we might follow the magicians if they are the predominant?"

so.text: 40. Inaan raacno sixiroolayasha hadday adkaadaan.

ayat.arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ قَالُواْ لِفِرۡعَوۡنَ أَئِنَّ لَنَا لَأَجۡرًا إِن كُنَّا نَحۡنُ ٱلۡغَٰلِبِينَ
