en.text: And when the magicians arrived, they said to Pharaoh, "Is there indeed for us a reward if we are the predominant?"

so.text: 41. Markay yimaadeen sixiroolayaashii, waxay ku yidhaahdeen Fircoon: “Ma leennahay abaalgud haddaan innagu adkaanno?

ayat.arabic: قَالَ نَعَمۡ وَإِنَّكُمۡ إِذٗا لَّمِنَ ٱلۡمُقَرَّبِينَ

en.text: He said, "Yes, and indeed, you will then be of those near [to me]."

so.text: 42. (Fircoon) wuxuu yidhi: Haah, idinkuna markaas waxaad ka mid ahaaneysaan kuwa ii dhow.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰٓ أَلۡقُواْ مَآ أَنتُم مُّلۡقُونَ

en.text: Moses said to them, "Throw whatever you will throw."

so.text: 43. Muuse wuxuu ku yidhi: Tuura waxaad idinku tuuraysaan.

ayat.arabic: فَأَلۡقَوۡاْ حِبَالَهُمۡ وَعِصِيَّهُمۡ وَقَالُواْ بِعِزَّةِ فِرۡعَوۡنَ إِنَّا لَنَحۡنُ ٱلۡغَٰلِبُونَ

en.text: So they threw their ropes and their staffs and said, "By the might of Pharaoh, indeed it is we who are predominant."

so.text: 44. Markaasay tuureen xargahoodii iyo ulahoodii oo yidhaahdeen: “Waa nagu sharafta Fircoone, innagaa adkaan".

ayat.arabic: فَأَلۡقَىٰ مُوسَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِيَ تَلۡقَفُ مَا يَأۡفِكُونَ

en.text: Then Moses threw his staff, and at once it devoured what they falsified.

so.text: 45. Markaasuu tuuray Muuse ushiisii, mise waxay guratay oo liqliqday waxay been maleegeen.

ayat.arabic: فَأُلۡقِيَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سَٰجِدِينَ

en.text: So the magicians fell down in prostration [to Allāh].

so.text: 46. Sixiroolayaashiina dhulkay la dhaceen sujuud.

ayat.arabic: قَالُوٓاْ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

en.text: They said, "We have believed in the Lord of the worlds,

so.text: 47. Waxay yidhaahdeen: Waxaynu rumeynay Rabbiga uumanka.

ayat.arabic: رَبِّ مُوسَىٰ وَهَٰرُونَ

en.text: The Lord of Moses and Aaron."

so.text: 48. Rabbiga Muuse iyo Haaruun.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ ءَامَنتُمۡ لَهُۥ قَبۡلَ أَنۡ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمۡۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ ٱلَّذِي عَلَّمَكُمُ ٱلسِّحۡرَ فَلَسَوۡفَ تَعۡلَمُونَۚ لَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيۡدِيَكُمۡ وَأَرۡجُلَكُم مِّنۡ خِلَٰفٖ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ

en.text: [Pharaoh] said, "You believed him [i.e., Moses] before I gave you permission. Indeed, he is your leader who has taught you magic, but you are going to know. I will surely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will surely crucify you all."

so.text: 49. (Fircoon) wuxuu yidhi: Ma waxaad rumeyseen (Muuse) ka hor intaan idiin idmin; waa kan idiinku weyn ee idin baray sixirka, waadse ogaan dontaan, waxaan u goyn  gacmahiinna iyo lugahiinna isdhaaf waana idin daldali dhammaan.

ayat.arabic: قَالُواْ لَا ضَيۡرَۖ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا مُنقَلِبُونَ

en.text: They said, "No harm. Indeed, to our Lord we will return.

so.text: 50. Waxay yidhaahdeen: Dhib ma laha; Innagu Xagga Rabigayo baan u noqon.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّا نَطۡمَعُ أَن يَغۡفِرَ لَنَا رَبُّنَا خَطَٰيَٰنَآ أَن كُنَّآ أَوَّلَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ

en.text: Indeed, we aspire that our Lord will forgive us our sins because we were the first of the believers."

so.text: 51. Waxaanu rajayneynaa inuu Rabbigayo noo dhaafo gefefkayaga, inaanu nahay kuwa u hor rumeeeyey (Xaqa).

ayat.arabic: ۞ وَأَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنۡ أَسۡرِ بِعِبَادِيٓ إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ

en.text: And We inspired to Moses, "Travel by night with My servants; indeed, you will be pursued."

so.text: 52. Waxaanu u waxyoonnay Muuse Annagoo leh: “La bax Addoomahayga idinkoo ku baxaya guuro habeennimo, waa la idiin soo raaciye.

ayat.arabic: فَأَرۡسَلَ فِرۡعَوۡنُ فِي ٱلۡمَدَآئِنِ حَٰشِرِينَ

en.text: Then Pharaoh sent among the cities gatherers[1050]
en.footnotes: [1050] Recruiters of an army to prevent the emigration of the Children of Israel.

so.text: 53. Markaasuu Fircoon u diray magaaloo- yinka kuwo soo kulmiya (askartiisii).

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَشِرۡذِمَةٞ قَلِيلُونَ

en.text: [And said], "Indeed, those are but a small band,

so.text: 54. (Isagoo leh) xaqiiq kuwani wax koox yar,

ayat.arabic: وَإِنَّهُمۡ لَنَا لَغَآئِظُونَ

en.text: And indeed, they are enraging us,

so.text: 55. Wayna na cadho geliyeen runtii;

ayat.arabic: وَإِنَّا لَجَمِيعٌ حَٰذِرُونَ

en.text: And indeed, we are a cautious society..."

so.text: 56. Waxaanu nahay xaqiiq kuwo had iyo jeer digtoon.

ayat.arabic: فَأَخۡرَجۡنَٰهُم مِّن جَنَّٰتٖ وَعُيُونٖ

en.text: So We removed them from gardens and springs

so.text: 57. Markaasaan ka saarnay beero iyo ilo.

ayat.arabic: وَكُنُوزٖ وَمَقَامٖ كَرِيمٖ

en.text: And treasures and honorable station[1051] -
en.footnotes: [1051] Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) caused them to abandon their wealth and property in pursuit of the Israelites.

so.text: 58. Iyo maaliyad iyo meeqaan wanaagsan.

ayat.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَۖ وَأَوۡرَثۡنَٰهَا بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ

en.text: Thus. And We caused to inherit it the Children of Israel.

so.text: 59. Waa sidaase, waxaan dhaxalsiinnay reer Israa’iil.

ayat.arabic: فَأَتۡبَعُوهُم مُّشۡرِقِينَ

en.text: So they pursued them at sunrise.

so.text: 60. Markaasay (Fircoon iyo askartiisii) soo raacdeysteen goor qorrax soo bax ah.

ayat.arabic: فَلَمَّا تَرَٰٓءَا ٱلۡجَمۡعَانِ قَالَ أَصۡحَٰبُ مُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّا لَمُدۡرَكُونَ

en.text: And when the two companies saw one another, the companions of Moses said, "Indeed, we are to be overtaken!"

so.text: 61. Markay labadii ciidan isu muuqdeen, Waxay yidhaahdeen asxaabtii Muuse: “Xaqiiq, waa nala haleelay”.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ كَلَّآۖ إِنَّ مَعِيَ رَبِّي سَيَهۡدِينِ

en.text: [Moses] said, "No! Indeed, with me is my Lord; He will guide me."

so.text: 62. (Muuse) wuxuu yidhi: Ma jirto. Waxaa ila jira Rabbigay, wuxuu i tusi jid aan ka baxo.

ayat.arabic: فَأَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱضۡرِب بِّعَصَاكَ ٱلۡبَحۡرَۖ فَٱنفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرۡقٖ كَٱلطَّوۡدِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ

en.text: Then We inspired to Moses, "Strike with your staff the sea," and it parted, and each portion was like a great towering mountain.

so.text: 63. Markaasaan u waxyoonnay Muuse (Annagoo leh): Ku dhufo badda ushaada. Markaasay kala dhanbalantay oo qayb walba waxay noqotay sida buur weyn.

ayat.arabic: وَأَزۡلَفۡنَا ثَمَّ ٱلۡأٓخَرِينَ

en.text: And We advanced thereto the others [i.e., the pursuers].

so.text: 64. Waxaana ku soo dhoweynay halkaa kuwii kale (qoladii Fircoon).

ayat.arabic: وَأَنجَيۡنَا مُوسَىٰ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥٓ أَجۡمَعِينَ

en.text: And We saved Moses and those with him, all together.

so.text: 65. Waxaanu badbaadinnay Muuse iyo intii la jirtay dhammaan.

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ أَغۡرَقۡنَا ٱلۡأٓخَرِينَ

en.text: Then We drowned the others.

so.text: 66. Kaddib waxaan harqinnay kuwii kale (Fircoon iyo qolodiisii).

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ

en.text: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

so.text: 67. Hubaal, Waxaa arrinkaa ku sugan calaamo, mase aha badankoodu kuwo rumeyn.

ayat.arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

en.text: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

so.text: 68. Hubaalna Rabbigaa (Alle) waa Adkaadaha Sare, Naxariista badan.

ayat.arabic: وَٱتۡلُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ نَبَأَ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ

en.text: And recite to them the news of Abraham,

so.text: 69. Oo u akhri qisadii Ibraahiim.

ayat.arabic: إِذۡ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوۡمِهِۦ مَا تَعۡبُدُونَ

en.text: When he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship?"

so.text: 70. Markuu ku yidhi aabbihi iyo qolodiisii: “Waa maxay waxaad caabudaysaan?

ayat.arabic: قَالُواْ نَعۡبُدُ أَصۡنَامٗا فَنَظَلُّ لَهَا عَٰكِفِينَ

en.text: They said, "We worship idols and remain to them devoted."

so.text: 71. Waxay yidhaahdeen: Waxaan caa-    budi asnaam, oo ag yuruursan (fadhin).

ayat.arabic: قَالَ هَلۡ يَسۡمَعُونَكُمۡ إِذۡ تَدۡعُونَ

en.text: He said, "Do they hear you when you supplicate?

so.text: 72. (Ibraahiim) wuxuu yidhi: Miyey idin maqlayaan markaad baryeysaan?.

ayat.arabic: أَوۡ يَنفَعُونَكُمۡ أَوۡ يَضُرُّونَ

en.text: Or do they benefit you, or do they harm?"

so.text: 73. Waxse ma idin tari karaan ama idin yeeli karaan?

ayat.arabic: قَالُواْ بَلۡ وَجَدۡنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا كَذَٰلِكَ يَفۡعَلُونَ

en.text: They said, "But we found our fathers doing thus."

so.text: 74. Waxay yidhaahdeen: Mayee, waxaan hellay aabbayaashayadii hore oo sidaas falaya.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ أَفَرَءَيۡتُم مَّا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡبُدُونَ

en.text: He said, "Then do you see what you have been worshipping,

so.text: 75. Wuxuu yidhi: Bal ka warrama waxaad caabudeysaan -

ayat.arabic: أَنتُمۡ وَءَابَآؤُكُمُ ٱلۡأَقۡدَمُونَ

en.text: You and your ancient forefathers?

so.text: 76. “Idinka iyo aabbayaashiinnii horeba?-

ayat.arabic: فَإِنَّهُمۡ عَدُوّٞ لِّيٓ إِلَّا رَبَّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

en.text: Indeed, they are enemies to me, except the Lord of the worlds,[1052]
en.footnotes: [1052] The people worshipped idols in addition to Allāh.

so.text: 77.Iyagu waa cadowgay oo col baan nahay, mase aha (sidaa) Rabbiga uumanka [5].
so.footnotes: [5]. Waayo dadkaasi waxay caabudayeen sannamo la jirka Alle, marka wuxuu Ibraahiim u sheegay inuu barii ka yahay dhammaan waxay caabudaan marka laga soo reebo Alle, Rabbiga uumanka, waan jeclahay Isaga.

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَنِي فَهُوَ يَهۡدِينِ

en.text: Who created me, and He [it is who] guides me.

so.text: 78. “(Alle), ee i abuuray, ahna Kan i hanuunsha.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّذِي هُوَ يُطۡعِمُنِي وَيَسۡقِينِ

en.text: And it is He who feeds me and gives me drink.

so.text: 79. Ee ah Kan I quudiya oo i waraabsha.

ayat.arabic: وَإِذَا مَرِضۡتُ فَهُوَ يَشۡفِينِ

en.text: And when I am ill, it is He who cures me

so.text: 80. Markaan bukoodo, Isagaa (Alle) I bogsiya.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّذِي يُمِيتُنِي ثُمَّ يُحۡيِينِ

en.text: And who will cause me to die and then bring me to life

so.text: 81. Waa Kan i dhinsiin, haddana ii soo nooleyn (mar kale);

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّذِيٓ أَطۡمَعُ أَن يَغۡفِرَ لِي خَطِيٓـَٔتِي يَوۡمَ ٱلدِّينِ

en.text: And who I aspire that He will forgive me my sin on the Day of Recompense."

so.text: 82. Waana Kan aan rajeeyo inuu ii dhaafo gefkayga Maalinta Abaal marinta'Qiyaame'.

ayat.arabic: رَبِّ هَبۡ لِي حُكۡمٗا وَأَلۡحِقۡنِي بِٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ

en.text: [And he said], "My Lord, grant me authority and join me with the righteous.

so.text: 83. Rabbiyow! I sii cilmi (iyo fahmo), ina haleeshii kuwa wanaagsan.

ayat.arabic: وَٱجۡعَل لِّي لِسَانَ صِدۡقٖ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرِينَ

en.text: And grant me a mention [i.e., reputation] of honor among later generations.

so.text: 84. Oo ii yeel xus fiican facyada dambe dhexdood.

ayat.arabic: وَٱجۡعَلۡنِي مِن وَرَثَةِ جَنَّةِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ

en.text: And place me among the inheritors of the Garden of Pleasure.

so.text: 85. Iga mid yeel dhaxlayaasha Jannada barwaaqada ah.

ayat.arabic: وَٱغۡفِرۡ لِأَبِيٓ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ

en.text: And forgive my father. Indeed, he has been of those astray.

so.text: 86. U denbi dhaaf aabbahay, wuxuu ka mid yahay kuwaa lunsane.

ayat.arabic: وَلَا تُخۡزِنِي يَوۡمَ يُبۡعَثُونَ

en.text: And do not disgrace me on the Day they are [all] resurrected -

so.text: 87. Ha i dulleynna Maalinta la soo bixin (dadka - Maalinta Qiyaame).

ayat.arabic: يَوۡمَ لَا يَنفَعُ مَالٞ وَلَا بَنُونَ

en.text: The Day when there will not benefit [anyone] wealth or children

so.text: 88. Maalinta aysan wax tareyn maal iyo ilmo midna.

ayat.arabic: إِلَّا مَنۡ أَتَى ٱللَّهَ بِقَلۡبٖ سَلِيمٖ

en.text: But only one who comes to Allāh with a sound heart."

so.text: 89. Mid maahee ula yimaada Alle qalbi fayow [6].
so.footnotes: [6]. Qalbi ka fayow shirki, gaalnimo, munaafiqnimo, shaki, isla weyni, is cjabin, xasad, xin, xumaato, khiyaano,dhagar, iwm.

ayat.arabic: وَأُزۡلِفَتِ ٱلۡجَنَّةُ لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ

en.text: And Paradise will be brought near [that Day] to the righteous.

so.text: 90. Waxaa loo soo dhoweynna Jannada  kuwa Alle ka cabsada 'ee iska jira xumaha'.

ayat.arabic: وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلۡجَحِيمُ لِلۡغَاوِينَ

en.text: And Hellfire will be brought forth for the deviators,

so.text: 91. Loo muujinna Naarta kuwa habowsan.

ayat.arabic: وَقِيلَ لَهُمۡ أَيۡنَ مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡبُدُونَ

en.text: And it will be said to them, "Where are those you used to worship

so.text: 92. Waxaa lagu odhan: Meeye waxaad caabudeyseen?

ayat.arabic: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ هَلۡ يَنصُرُونَكُمۡ أَوۡ يَنتَصِرُونَ

en.text: Other than Allāh? Can they help you or help themselves?"

so.text: 93. Alle sokadi? Miyey idiin gargaari karaan,mase u gargaari karaan nafahooda?

ayat.arabic: فَكُبۡكِبُواْ فِيهَا هُمۡ وَٱلۡغَاوُۥنَ

en.text: So they will be overturned into it [i.e., Hellfire], they and the deviators

so.text: 94. Markaasaa waxaa loogu tuuri wejiweji (Naarta) - iyaga iyo kuwa habowsanba.

ayat.arabic: وَجُنُودُ إِبۡلِيسَ أَجۡمَعُونَ

en.text: And the soldiers of Iblees, all together.

so.text: 95. Iyo askartii ibliis oo dhan.

ayat.arabic: قَالُواْ وَهُمۡ فِيهَا يَخۡتَصِمُونَ

en.text: They will say while they dispute therein,

so.text: 96. Waxay odhan iyagoo ku murmaya dhexdeeda (Naarta),

ayat.arabic: تَٱللَّهِ إِن كُنَّا لَفِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٍ

en.text: "By Allāh, we were indeed in manifest error

so.text: 97. Tallaahi, waxaanu ahayn kuwo ku sugan habow cad.

ayat.arabic: إِذۡ نُسَوِّيكُم بِرَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

en.text: When we equated you with the Lord of the worlds.

so.text: 98. Markaan idin la sinnay Rabbiga uumanka.

ayat.arabic: وَمَآ أَضَلَّنَآ إِلَّا ٱلۡمُجۡرِمُونَ

en.text: And no one misguided us except the criminals.

so.text: 99. Cidna nama aysan luminna aan ahayn denbiilayaasha (madax xun, wadaaddo xun, faaliyayaal, saaxiibbo xun, iwm).

ayat.arabic: فَمَا لَنَا مِن شَٰفِعِينَ

en.text: So now we have no intercessors

so.text: 100. Haatan ma lihin wax garab na siiya.

ayat.arabic: وَلَا صَدِيقٍ حَمِيمٖ

en.text: And not a devoted friend.

so.text: 101. Iyo saaxiib run ah midna.

ayat.arabic: فَلَوۡ أَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةٗ فَنَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ

en.text: Then if we only had a return [to the world] and could be of the believers..."[1053]
en.footnotes: [1053] The conclusion of this verse is estimated as "...we would do this or that."

so.text: 102. Haddii na la siin lahaa hal fursad si aan ugu laabanno (dunidii) waxaan ka mid ahaan lahayn mu'miniinta [7].
so.footnotes: [7]. Dhammaadka hadalka ka go’an waa la iska qiyaasi karaa oo waxaa weeye waxaynu fali lahayn sidaa ama sidaasi.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ

en.text: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

so.text: 103. Hubaal, waxaa arrinkaa ku sugan calaamo, mase aha badankoodu kuwo rumayn.

ayat.arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

en.text: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

so.text: 104. Hubaalna Rabbigaa (Alle) waa Adkaadaha Sare, Naxariista Badan.

ayat.arabic: كَذَّبَتۡ قَوۡمُ نُوحٍ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ

en.text: The people of Noah denied the messengers[1054]
en.footnotes: [1054] See footnote to 25:37.

so.text: 105. Qolodii Nuux waxay beeniyeen Rusushii (Alle).

ayat.arabic: إِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ أَخُوهُمۡ نُوحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

en.text: When their brother Noah said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?

so.text: 106. Markuu walaalkood Nuux ku yidhi: “Miyeydaan ka dhowrsaneyn (shirkiga)?

ayat.arabic: إِنِّي لَكُمۡ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٞ

en.text: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.

so.text: 107. Anigu waxaan xaqiiq idiin ahay Rasuul aamin ah.

ayat.arabic: فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ

en.text: So fear Allāh and obey me.

so.text: 108. Ee Alle ka cabsada oo i adeeca.

ayat.arabic: وَمَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرٍۖ إِنۡ أَجۡرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

en.text: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.

so.text: 109. “Idinkuma weydiisto wax abaalgud ah (Diinta Alle), abaal gudkeyga waxaan ka sugaa oo keliya Rabbiga uumanka.

ayat.arabic: فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ

en.text: So fear Allāh and obey me."

so.text: 110. Ee Alle ka cabsada oo i adeeca.

ayat.arabic: ۞ قَالُوٓاْ أَنُؤۡمِنُ لَكَ وَٱتَّبَعَكَ ٱلۡأَرۡذَلُونَ

en.text: They said, "Should we believe you while you are followed by the lowest [class of people]?"

so.text: 111. Waxay yidhaahdeen: Ma adigaan ku rumaysannaa iyagoo kuwii u liitay (dadka) ay ku raaceen?

ayat.arabic: قَالَ وَمَا عِلۡمِي بِمَا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ

en.text: He said, "And what is my knowledge of what they used to do?

so.text: 112. Wuxuu yidhi: Maxaan ka ogahay waxay fali jireen?

ayat.arabic: إِنۡ حِسَابُهُمۡ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّيۖ لَوۡ تَشۡعُرُونَ

en.text: Their account is only upon my Lord, if you [could] perceive.

so.text: 113. “Xisaabtoodu waxaa leh oo keliya Rabbigay, haddaad garanaysaan.

ayat.arabic: وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِطَارِدِ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ

en.text: And I am not one to drive away the believers.

so.text: 114. Oo anigu ma eryayo mu’miniinta.

ayat.arabic: إِنۡ أَنَا۠ إِلَّا نَذِيرٞ مُّبِينٞ

en.text: I am only a clear warner."

so.text: 115. Ma ahi anigu waxaan ahayn dige cad.

ayat.arabic: قَالُواْ لَئِن لَّمۡ تَنتَهِ يَٰنُوحُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلۡمَرۡجُومِينَ

en.text: They said, "If you do not desist, O Noah, you will surely be of those who are stoned."

so.text: 116. Waxay yidhaahdeen: Haddaad joojin oo aadan ka harin 'ku baaqaaga Towxiidka' Nuuxow! Waxaad ka mid noqon kuwa la dhagaxyeeyo.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنَّ قَوۡمِي كَذَّبُونِ

en.text: He said, "My Lord, indeed my people have denied me.

so.text: 117. (Nuux) wuxuu yidhi: Rabbiyow! Qoonkeygii way i beeniyeen.

ayat.arabic: فَٱفۡتَحۡ بَيۡنِي وَبَيۡنَهُمۡ فَتۡحٗا وَنَجِّنِي وَمَن مَّعِيَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ

en.text: Then judge between me and them with decisive judgement and save me and those with me of the believers."

so.text: 118. Ee noo kala garsoor aniga iyo iyaga garsoor (xaq ah), ina badbaadi aniga iyo kuwa ila jira ee mu'miniinta ah.

ayat.arabic: فَأَنجَيۡنَٰهُ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥ فِي ٱلۡفُلۡكِ ٱلۡمَشۡحُونِ

en.text: So We saved him and those with him in the laden ship.

so.text: 119. Markaasaan badbaadinnay isaga iyo intii kula jirtayba Doonidii buuxday.

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ أَغۡرَقۡنَا بَعۡدُ ٱلۡبَاقِينَ

en.text: Then We drowned thereafter the remaining ones.

so.text: 120. Kaddibna waxaan harqinnay kuwii hadhay (gaaladii).

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ

en.text: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

so.text: 121. Hubaal, arrinkaa waxaa ku sugan calaamo, mase aha badankoodu kuwo rumeyn.

ayat.arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

en.text: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

so.text: 122. Hubaalna Rabbigaa (Alle), waa Adkaadaha Sare, Naxariista Badan.

ayat.arabic: كَذَّبَتۡ عَادٌ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ

en.text: ʿAad denied the messengers

so.text: 123. Caad waxay beeniyeen Rusushii (Alle).

ayat.arabic: إِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ أَخُوهُمۡ هُودٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

en.text: When their brother Hūd said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?

so.text: 124. Markuu walaalkood Huud ku yidhi: “Ma waydaan ka joogeyn (shirkiga iyo xumaha kale)?.

ayat.arabic: إِنِّي لَكُمۡ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٞ

en.text: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.

so.text: 125. Xaqiiq, anigu Waxaan idiin ahay Rasuul Aamin ah.

ayat.arabic: فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ

en.text: So fear Allāh and obey me.

so.text: 126. Ee Alle ka cabsada oo i adeeca.

ayat.arabic: وَمَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرٍۖ إِنۡ أَجۡرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

en.text: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.

so.text: 127. “Idinkuma weydiisto wax abaalgud ah (Diinta Alle), abaalgudkeyga waxaan ka sugaa oo keliya Rabbiga uumanka.

ayat.arabic: أَتَبۡنُونَ بِكُلِّ رِيعٍ ءَايَةٗ تَعۡبَثُونَ

en.text: Do you construct on every elevation a sign,[1055] amusing yourselves,
en.footnotes: [1055] i.e., a symbol or indication of their wealth and power. They used to build lofty structures along the road to be seen by all who passed by.

so.text: 128. Ma waxaad ka dhistaan taag waliba taallo [8]? Macno daranaa waxaas aad fashaan.
so.footnotes: [8]. Taallo ama wax muujinaya maalka iyo awooddooda. Waxay ka dhisi jireen dhismooyin dhaadheer agagaarka waddooyinka.

ayat.arabic: وَتَتَّخِذُونَ مَصَانِعَ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَخۡلُدُونَ

en.text: And take for yourselves constructions [i.e., palaces and fortresses] that you might abide eternally?

so.text: 129. Oo yeelataan dhismooyin adag inaad waartaan.

ayat.arabic: وَإِذَا بَطَشۡتُم بَطَشۡتُمۡ جَبَّارِينَ

en.text: And when you strike, you strike as tyrants.

so.text: 130. Markaad cid soo qabaneysaanna  waxaad u soo qabataan si daran idinkoo daalimiin ah?

ayat.arabic: فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ

en.text: So fear Allāh and obey me.

so.text: 131. Ee Alle ka cabsada oo i adeeca.

ayat.arabic: وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَمَدَّكُم بِمَا تَعۡلَمُونَ

en.text: And fear He who provided you with that which you know,

so.text: 132. Ka cabsada 'Alle ee ah' Kan idin siiyey (waxyaalaha wanaagsan) aad ogtihiin.

ayat.arabic: أَمَدَّكُم بِأَنۡعَٰمٖ وَبَنِينَ

en.text: Provided you with grazing livestock and children

so.text: 133. Idin siiyey xoolo iyo ilmo.

ayat.arabic: وَجَنَّٰتٖ وَعُيُونٍ

en.text: And gardens and springs.

so.text: 134. Iyo beero tanaad ah iyo ilo.

ayat.arabic: إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ عَذَابَ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيمٖ

en.text: Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a terrible day."

so.text: 135. Waxaan xaqiiq idiinka cabsan (oo digayaa) cadaab Maalin weyn.

ayat.arabic: قَالُواْ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيۡنَآ أَوَعَظۡتَ أَمۡ لَمۡ تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلۡوَٰعِظِينَ

en.text: They said, "It is all the same to us whether you advise or are not of the advisors.

so.text: 136. Waxay yidhaahdeen: Waa isugu kaaya mid haddaad na wacdido ama aad ka mid ahaan kuwa dadka wacdiya.

ayat.arabic: إِنۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا خُلُقُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ

en.text: This is not but the custom of the former peoples,

so.text: 137. Kanu ma aha waxaan aheyn caadadii dadkii hore (ee laga tagay).

ayat.arabic: وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ

en.text: And we are not to be punished."

so.text: 138. Oo ma nihin kuwo la cadaabayo.

ayat.arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَهۡلَكۡنَٰهُمۡۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ

en.text: And they denied him, so We destroyed them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

so.text: 139. Wayse beeniyeen, markaasaan halaagnay. Hubaal, arrinkaa waxaa ku sugan calaamo, mase aha badankoodu kuwo rumayn.

ayat.arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

en.text: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

so.text: 140. Hubaalna Rabbigaa (Alle), waa Adkaadaha Sare, Naxariista Badan.

ayat.arabic: كَذَّبَتۡ ثَمُودُ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ

en.text: Thamūd denied the messengers

so.text: 141. Thamuud waxay beenisay Rusushii.

ayat.arabic: إِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ أَخُوهُمۡ صَٰلِحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

en.text: When their brother Ṣāliḥ said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?

so.text: 142. Markuu walaalkood Saalix ku yidhi: “Miyeydaan iska jireyn (shirkiga iyo xumaha kale)?

ayat.arabic: إِنِّي لَكُمۡ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٞ

en.text: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.

so.text: 143. Xaqiiq, waxaan anigu idiin ahay Rasuul Aamin ah.

ayat.arabic: فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ

en.text: So fear Allāh and obey me.

so.text: 144. Ee Alle ka cabsada oo i adeeca.

ayat.arabic: وَمَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرٍۖ إِنۡ أَجۡرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

en.text: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.

so.text: 145. Idinkuma weydiisto wax abaal gud ah (Diinta Alle), abaalgudkeygu waxaan ka sugayaa oo keliya Rabbiga uumanka.

ayat.arabic: أَتُتۡرَكُونَ فِي مَا هَٰهُنَآ ءَامِنِينَ

en.text: Will you be left in what is here, secure [from death],

so.text: 146. Ma waxaa la idiinkaga tagi halkan idinkoo nabad ah?

ayat.arabic: فِي جَنَّٰتٖ وَعُيُونٖ

en.text: Within gardens and springs

so.text: 147. Ku sugan beero iyo ilo.

ayat.arabic: وَزُرُوعٖ وَنَخۡلٖ طَلۡعُهَا هَضِيمٞ

en.text: And fields of crops and palm trees with softened fruit?

so.text: 148. Iyo dhir iyo geedo timir fiiddeedu bisayl tahay.

ayat.arabic: وَتَنۡحِتُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡجِبَالِ بُيُوتٗا فَٰرِهِينَ

en.text: And you carve out of the mountains, homes, with skill.

so.text: 149. Oo aad ka qodataan guryo buuraha idinkoo isla weyn.

ayat.arabic: فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ

en.text: So fear Allāh and obey me.

so.text: 150. Ee Alle ka cabsada oo i adeeca.

ayat.arabic: وَلَا تُطِيعُوٓاْ أَمۡرَ ٱلۡمُسۡرِفِينَ

en.text: And do not obey the order of the transgressors,

so.text: 151. Oo ha adeecina amarka xad gudbayaasha.

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يُفۡسِدُونَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَا يُصۡلِحُونَ

en.text: Who cause corruption in the land and do not amend."

so.text: 152. Kuwa fasahaadiya arlada oo aan hagaajin.

ayat.arabic: قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُسَحَّرِينَ

en.text: They said, "You are only of those affected by magic.

so.text: 153. Waxay yidhaahdeen: Waxaad tahay oo keliya mid ka mid ah kuwa sixran.

ayat.arabic: مَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٞ مِّثۡلُنَا فَأۡتِ بِـَٔايَةٍ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ

en.text: You are but a man like ourselves, so bring a sign, if you should be of the truthful."

so.text: 154. Ma ahid waxaan ahayn qof nala mid ah. Ee noo keen calaamo haddaad run sheegayso.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ هَٰذِهِۦ نَاقَةٞ لَّهَا شِرۡبٞ وَلَكُمۡ شِرۡبُ يَوۡمٖ مَّعۡلُومٖ

en.text: He said, "This is a she-camel.[1056] For her is a [time of] drink, and for you is a [time of] drink, [each] on a known day.
en.footnotes: [1056] Miraculously sent to them as a sign by Allāh.

so.text: 155. (Saalix) wuxuu yidhi: Tani waa Hal [9]; waxay u leedahay xaq inay cabto (biyo) maalin, idinkuna waxaad u leedihin xaq inaad cabtaan (biyo) maalin la yaqaan.
so.footnotes: [9]. Hal Mucjiso ahaan loogu soo diray Calaamo ahaan ka timid xagga Alle.

ayat.arabic: وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوٓءٖ فَيَأۡخُذَكُمۡ عَذَابُ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيمٖ

en.text: And do not touch her with harm, lest you be seized by the punishment of a terrible day."

so.text: 156. Ee ha ku taabannina wax xumaan (dhib) ah, yeysan idin qabane cadaab Maalin weyn.

ayat.arabic: فَعَقَرُوهَا فَأَصۡبَحُواْ نَٰدِمِينَ

en.text: But they hamstrung her and so became regretful.

so.text: 157. Waase boqna gooyeen hashii (oo dileen), markaasay ka shallaayeen.

ayat.arabic: فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابُۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ

en.text: And the punishment seized them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

so.text: 158. Markaasaa waxaa qabtay cadaab. Arrinkaa waxaa xaqiiq ku sugan calaamo, mase aha badankoodu kuwo rumayn.

ayat.arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

en.text: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

so.text: 159. Hubaalna Rabbigaa (Alle) waa Adkaadaha Sare, Naxariista Badan.

ayat.arabic: كَذَّبَتۡ قَوۡمُ لُوطٍ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ

en.text: The people of Lot denied the messengers

so.text: 160. Qoonkii Luud waxay beeniyeen Rusushii (Alle).

ayat.arabic: إِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ أَخُوهُمۡ لُوطٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

en.text: When their brother Lot said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?

so.text: 161. Markuu walaalkood Luud ku yidhi: “Ma waydaan iska jireyn (shirkiga iyo xumaha kale)?

ayat.arabic: إِنِّي لَكُمۡ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٞ

en.text: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.

so.text: 162. Xaqiiq, waxaan anigu idiin ahay Rasuul aamin ah.

ayat.arabic: فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ

en.text: So fear Allāh and obey me.

so.text: 163. Ee Alle ka cabsada oo i adeeca.

ayat.arabic: وَمَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرٍۖ إِنۡ أَجۡرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

en.text: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.

so.text: 164. Idinkuma weydiisto wax abaalgud ah (Diinta Alle), abaalgudkeyga waxaan ka sugaa oo keliya Rabbiga uumanka.

ayat.arabic: أَتَأۡتُونَ ٱلذُّكۡرَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

en.text: Do you approach males among the worlds[1057]
en.footnotes: [1057] i.e., Are there, out of all Allāh's creatures, any besides you who commit this unnatural act?

so.text: 165. Ma waxaad u tagtaan (galmootaan) labka oo aad kaga soocmaysaan arrinkaas Uumanka [10].
so.footnotes: [10]. Miyey jiraan wax ka mid ah uumanka Alle aan idinka ahayn oo fala falkaa xun oo ah fal aan caadi ahayn?

ayat.arabic: وَتَذَرُونَ مَا خَلَقَ لَكُمۡ رَبُّكُم مِّنۡ أَزۡوَٰجِكُمۚ بَلۡ أَنتُمۡ قَوۡمٌ عَادُونَ

en.text: And leave what your Lord has created for you as mates? But you are a people transgressing."

so.text: 166. Oo aad ka tagtaan wuxuu Rabbigiin idiin abuuray oo xaasaskiinna ah? Mayee, waxaad tihiin qolo xadgudba.

ayat.arabic: قَالُواْ لَئِن لَّمۡ تَنتَهِ يَٰلُوطُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلۡمُخۡرَجِينَ

en.text: They said, "If you do not desist, O Lot, you will surely be of those evicted."

so.text: 167. Waxay yidhaahdeen: Haddaadan joojin Luudow (baaqaagan)! Waxaad ka mid noqon kuwa debedda loo saaro.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ إِنِّي لِعَمَلِكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡقَالِينَ

en.text: He said, "Indeed, I am, toward your deed, of those who detest [it].

so.text: 168. (Luud) wuxuu yidhi: Anigu waxaan ka mid ahay kuwa diiddan ee neceb camalkiinna (xun).

ayat.arabic: رَبِّ نَجِّنِي وَأَهۡلِي مِمَّا يَعۡمَلُونَ

en.text: My Lord, save me and my family from [the consequence of] what they do."

so.text: 169. Rabbiyow! iga badbaadi aniga iyo Ehelkaygaba waxay falaan.

ayat.arabic: فَنَجَّيۡنَٰهُ وَأَهۡلَهُۥٓ أَجۡمَعِينَ

en.text: So We saved him and his family, all,

so.text: 170. Markaasaan badbaadinnay isaga iyo ehelkiisiiba, dhammaan.

ayat.arabic: إِلَّا عَجُوزٗا فِي ٱلۡغَٰبِرِينَ

en.text: Except an old woman[1058] among those who remained behind.
en.footnotes: [1058] Lot's wife, who had collaborated with the evildoers.

so.text: 171. Habar duqowday ma ahee [11] ka mid aheyd kuwaasi ku haray gadaal 'cadaabka'.
so.footnotes: [11]. Xaaskii Luud, taasoo kaalmeyn jirtey dadkeeda xun.

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ دَمَّرۡنَا ٱلۡأٓخَرِينَ

en.text: Then We destroyed the others.

so.text: 172. Markaasaan baabbi’innay intii kale.

ayat.arabic: وَأَمۡطَرۡنَا عَلَيۡهِم مَّطَرٗاۖ فَسَآءَ مَطَرُ ٱلۡمُنذَرِينَ

en.text: And We rained upon them a rain [of stones], and evil was the rain of those who were warned.

so.text: 173. Waxaana ku soo daadinnay roob (dhagxaan naar ah). Xumaa roobka kuwa loo digay.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ

en.text: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

so.text: 174. Hubaal, arrinkaa waxaa ku sugan calaamo, mase aha badankoodu kuwo rumayn.

ayat.arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

en.text: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

so.text: 175. Hubaalna Rabbigaa (Alle), waa Adkaadaha Sare, Naxariista Badan.

ayat.arabic: كَذَّبَ أَصۡحَٰبُ لۡـَٔيۡكَةِ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ

en.text: The companions of the thicket [i.e., the people of Madyan] denied the messengers

so.text: 176. Reer Hawdkii (dadkii Madyan) waxay beeniyeen Rusushii (Alle).

ayat.arabic: إِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ شُعَيۡبٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

en.text: When Shuʿayb said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?

so.text: 177. Markuu Shucayb ku yidhi: “Ma waydaan ka joogeyn (shirkiga iyo Xumaha kale)?.

ayat.arabic: إِنِّي لَكُمۡ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٞ

en.text: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.

so.text: 178. Xaqiiq, waxaan anigu idiin ahay Rasuul aamin ah.

ayat.arabic: فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ

en.text: So fear Allāh and obey me.

so.text: 179. “Ee Alle ka cabsada oo i adeeca.

ayat.arabic: وَمَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرٍۖ إِنۡ أَجۡرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

en.text: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.

so.text: 180. Idinkuma weydiisto wax abaalgud ah (Diinta Alle), abaalgudkeyga waxaan ka sugaa oo keliya Rabbiga uumanka.

ayat.arabic: ۞ أَوۡفُواْ ٱلۡكَيۡلَ وَلَا تَكُونُواْ مِنَ ٱلۡمُخۡسِرِينَ

en.text: Give full measure and do not be of those who cause loss.

so.text: 181. Bixiya beeg dhan hana ka mid noqonnina kuwa wax ka dhima.

ayat.arabic: وَزِنُواْ بِٱلۡقِسۡطَاسِ ٱلۡمُسۡتَقِيمِ

en.text: And weigh with an even [i.e., honest] balance.

so.text: 182. Oo wax ku miisaama Miisaan toosan.

ayat.arabic: وَلَا تَبۡخَسُواْ ٱلنَّاسَ أَشۡيَآءَهُمۡ وَلَا تَعۡثَوۡاْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مُفۡسِدِينَ

en.text: And do not deprive people of their due and do not commit abuse on earth, spreading corruption.

so.text: 183. Ha ka dhimina dadka waxyaala- hooda ay xaq u leeyihiin, oo ha ku bi'innina (hallaynina) arlada ku falid fasahaad.

ayat.arabic: وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَكُمۡ وَٱلۡجِبِلَّةَ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ

en.text: And fear He who created you and the former creation."[1059]
en.footnotes: [1059] i.e., previous generations.

so.text: 184. Oo ka cabsada (Alle ee ah) Kan idin abuuray idinka iyo uumankii horeba.

ayat.arabic: قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُسَحَّرِينَ

en.text: They said, "You are only of those affected by magic.

so.text: 185. Waxay yidhaahdeen: Waxaad tahay oo keliya mid ka mid ah kuwa sixran [12].
so.footnotes: [12]. Waa haddii loo akhriyo “ minal mussaxariin” waxaa sidoo kale loo akhiryaa akhrin kale “ minal mussaxiriin” markaas mancaha waa kuwa wax sixra.

ayat.arabic: وَمَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٞ مِّثۡلُنَا وَإِن نَّظُنُّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلۡكَٰذِبِينَ

en.text: You are but a man like ourselves, and indeed, we think you are among the liars.

so.text: 186. Ma ahid waxaan ahayn qof nala mid ah, waxaana malaynaynaa inaad ka mid tahay beenlowyada.

ayat.arabic: فَأَسۡقِطۡ عَلَيۡنَا كِسَفٗا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ

en.text: So cause to fall upon us fragments of the sky, if you should be of the truthful."

so.text: 187. Ee nagu soo rid gabal samada ah haddaad run sheegi.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّيٓ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ

en.text: He said, "My Lord is most knowing of what you do."

so.text: 188. Wuxuu yidhi: Rabbigay baa Ogsoon waxaad fashaan.

ayat.arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَهُمۡ عَذَابُ يَوۡمِ ٱلظُّلَّةِۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَذَابَ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيمٍ

en.text: And they denied him, so the punishment of the day of the black cloud seized them. Indeed, it was the punishment of a terrible day.

so.text: 189. Wayse beeniyeen, markaasaa cadaab maalintii harka (daruur madow) qabatay, waxay aheyd cadaab Maalin daran.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ

en.text: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

so.text: 190. Hubaal, arrinkaa waxaa ku sugan calaamo, mase aha badankoodu kuwo rumayn.

ayat.arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

en.text: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

so.text: 191. Hubaalna Rabbigaa (Alle) waa Adkaadaha Sare, Naxariista Badan.

ayat.arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَتَنزِيلُ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

en.text: And indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is the revelation of the Lord of the worlds.

so.text: 192. Oo hubaal, (Qur’aan)kani waa Waxyi ka soo degay xagga Rabbiga uumanka.

ayat.arabic: نَزَلَ بِهِ ٱلرُّوحُ ٱلۡأَمِينُ

en.text: The Trustworthy Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] has brought it down

so.text: 193. Ruuxa aaminka ah (Jabriil) baa la soo degey (oo ku shubay) .

ayat.arabic: عَلَىٰ قَلۡبِكَ لِتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُنذِرِينَ

en.text: Upon your heart, [O Muḥammad] - that you may be of the warners

so.text: 194. Qalbigaaga (Nabi Muxammadow) si aad uga mid noqoto Digayaasha.

ayat.arabic: بِلِسَانٍ عَرَبِيّٖ مُّبِينٖ

en.text: In a clear Arabic language.

so.text: 195. Isagoo af Carabi faseex ah.

ayat.arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَفِي زُبُرِ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ

en.text: And indeed, it is [mentioned] in the scriptures of former peoples.

so.text: 196. Wuxuuna xaqiiq ku yaal Kutubtii dadkii hore (Towraadda iyo Injiilka).

ayat.arabic: أَوَلَمۡ يَكُن لَّهُمۡ ءَايَةً أَن يَعۡلَمَهُۥ عُلَمَٰٓؤُاْ بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ

en.text: And has it not been a sign to them that it is recognized by the scholars of the Children of Israel?

so.text: 197. Miyeyna calaamo u ahayn inay culimidii reer Israa'iil ogaayeen?

ayat.arabic: وَلَوۡ نَزَّلۡنَٰهُ عَلَىٰ بَعۡضِ ٱلۡأَعۡجَمِينَ

en.text: And even if We had revealed it to one among the foreigners[1060]
en.footnotes: [1060] i.e., the non-Arabs or those who are not fluent in the Arabic language.

so.text: 198. Haddaan ku soo dejin laheyn (Qur’aankani) cajamiga midkood [13].
so.footnotes: [13]. Macnaha waa aan ku soo dejin lahayn Qur’aanka cid kale aan Carab ahayn, ama si fiican u aqoon afka Carabiga oo aan faseex ahayn.

ayat.arabic: فَقَرَأَهُۥ عَلَيۡهِم مَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ مُؤۡمِنِينَ

en.text: And he had recited it to them [perfectly],[1061] they would [still] not have been believers in it.
en.footnotes: [1061] As a miracle from Allāh.

so.text: 199. Oo uu ku dul akhriyi lahaa, ma ay rumeeyeen waxa ku soo arooray [14].
so.footnotes: [14]. Mucjiso ahaan xagga Alle.

ayat.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ سَلَكۡنَٰهُ فِي قُلُوبِ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ

en.text: Thus have We inserted it [i.e., disbelief] into the hearts of the criminals.

so.text: 200. Sidaasaan u galinnaa 'diiddada Xaqa' quluubta denbiilayaasha.

ayat.arabic: لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِهِۦ حَتَّىٰ يَرَوُاْ ٱلۡعَذَابَ ٱلۡأَلِيمَ

en.text: They will not believe in it until they see the painful punishment.

so.text: 201. Ma ay rumaynayaan (Xaqa) jeeray arkaan cadaabka xanuunka badan.

ayat.arabic: فَيَأۡتِيَهُم بَغۡتَةٗ وَهُمۡ لَا يَشۡعُرُونَ

en.text: And it will come to them suddenly while they perceive [it] not.

so.text: 202. Oo ugu imaan si kedis ah iyagoo aan fileyn.

ayat.arabic: فَيَقُولُواْ هَلۡ نَحۡنُ مُنظَرُونَ

en.text: And they will say, "May we be reprieved?"

so.text: 203. Markaasay odhan: Ma nala siinayaa fursad (aan ku rumeyno)?

ayat.arabic: أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسۡتَعۡجِلُونَ

en.text: So for Our punishment are they impatient?

so.text: 204. Ee ma cadaabkayaga bay degdegsan?

ayat.arabic: أَفَرَءَيۡتَ إِن مَّتَّعۡنَٰهُمۡ سِنِينَ

en.text: Then have you considered if We gave them enjoyment for years

so.text: 205. Bal ka warran, haddaan u deyno inay raaxeystaan sanooyin.

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ جَآءَهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يُوعَدُونَ

en.text: And then there came to them that which they were promised?

so.text: 206. Markaas uu u yimaado ciqaabka loogu gooddiyo.

ayat.arabic: مَآ أَغۡنَىٰ عَنۡهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يُمَتَّعُونَ

en.text: They would not be availed by the enjoyment with which they were provided.

so.text: 207. Maxay u tari Waxa loogu raaxeeyey?

ayat.arabic: وَمَآ أَهۡلَكۡنَا مِن قَرۡيَةٍ إِلَّا لَهَا مُنذِرُونَ

en.text: And We did not destroy any city except that it had warners

so.text: 208. Ma jirtona magaalo aan halaagno Annagoon marka hore u dirin Digayaal.

ayat.arabic: ذِكۡرَىٰ وَمَا كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ

en.text: As a reminder; and never have We been unjust.

so.text: 209. Si loo waaniyo, mana nihin kuwo ku gardarrooda (dadka).

ayat.arabic: وَمَا تَنَزَّلَتۡ بِهِ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينُ

en.text: And the devils have not brought it [i.e., the revelation] down.[1062]
en.footnotes: [1062] As was asserted by the disbelievers. Rather, it was brought by Gabriel, the Trustworthy Spirit.

so.text: 210. Ma ayan keenin [15] 'Qur’aankan' Shaydaammada.
so.footnotes: [15]. Siday yidhaahdaan gaalada, waxaase Alle Xaggiisa ka keenay malag Jabriil, Ruuxa aaminka ah oo ku soo dejiyey Nabi Muxammad s.c.w.

ayat.arabic: وَمَا يَنۢبَغِي لَهُمۡ وَمَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ

en.text: It is not allowable for them, nor would they be able.

so.text: 211. Kuma habboona, mana laha awood (sheydaammadu) inay isagoo kale (Qur’aankan) keenaan.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّهُمۡ عَنِ ٱلسَّمۡعِ لَمَعۡزُولُونَ

en.text: Indeed they, from [its] hearing, are removed.[1063]
en.footnotes: [1063] As mentioned in 72:9.

so.text: 212. Waa kuwo laga fogeeyey inay maqalaan 'Qur’aanka' [16].
so.footnotes: [16]. Sida lagu xusay Suuradda 72: Aayadda 9.

ayat.arabic: فَلَا تَدۡعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُعَذَّبِينَ

en.text: So do not invoke[1064] with Allāh another deity and [thus] be among the punished.
en.footnotes: [1064] Or "worship."

so.text: 213. Ee ha la baryin (caabudin) ilaah kale la jirka Alle si aadan uga mid noqon kuwa la cadaabayo.

ayat.arabic: وَأَنذِرۡ عَشِيرَتَكَ ٱلۡأَقۡرَبِينَ

en.text: And warn, [O Muḥammad], your closest kindred.

so.text: 214. U dig xigtadaada kuu dhow.

ayat.arabic: وَٱخۡفِضۡ جَنَاحَكَ لِمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ

en.text: And lower your wing [i.e., show kindness] to those who follow you of the believers.

so.text: 215. Oo u raarici garabkaaga ciddii ku raacda ee ka mid ah mu’miiinta.

ayat.arabic: فَإِنۡ عَصَوۡكَ فَقُلۡ إِنِّي بَرِيٓءٞ مِّمَّا تَعۡمَلُونَ

en.text: And if they disobey you, then say, "Indeed, I am disassociated from what you are doing."

so.text: 216. Haddayse ku caasiyaan dheh: Anigu barii baan ka ahay waxaad fashaan.

ayat.arabic: وَتَوَكَّلۡ عَلَى ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

en.text: And rely upon the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,

so.text: 217. Talo saarona (Alle) Adkaadaha Sare, Naxariista Badan,

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِي يَرَىٰكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ

en.text: Who sees you when you arise[1065]
en.footnotes: [1065] From your bed at night for prayer while you are alone.

so.text: 218. Ee ku arka markaad kaceyso [17].
so.footnotes: [17]. Markaad ka soo kacdo gogoshaada habeenkii si aad u tukato salaatu leyl adigoo keligaa ah.

ayat.arabic: وَتَقَلُّبَكَ فِي ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ

en.text: And your movement among those who prostrate.[1066]
en.footnotes: [1066] i.e., among those who pray with you in congregation.

so.text: 219. Iyo gad-gaddoonkaaga dhexdood [18] kuwa u sujuuda (Alle).
so.footnotes: [18]. Adigoo ku dhex jira kuwaasi kula tukada jameeco ahaanta.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ

en.text: Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.

so.text: 220. Hubaal (Alle) waa wax kasta Maqlaha, wax kasta Ogsoon.

ayat.arabic: هَلۡ أُنَبِّئُكُمۡ عَلَىٰ مَن تَنَزَّلُ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينُ

en.text: Shall I inform you upon whom the devils descend?

so.text: 221. Ma idiin sheegaa (dadow) kan ay ku soo degaan shaydaammada?

ayat.arabic: تَنَزَّلُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ أَفَّاكٍ أَثِيمٖ

en.text: They descend upon every sinful liar.

so.text: 222. Waxay ku soo degaan beenaale kasta, denbiile ah.

ayat.arabic: يُلۡقُونَ ٱلسَّمۡعَ وَأَكۡثَرُهُمۡ كَٰذِبُونَ

en.text: They pass on what is heard,[1067] and most of them are liars.
en.footnotes: [1067] This was before they were prevented, as described in 72:8-9.

so.text: 223. Waxay dhigtaan dhegaha [19], badankoodna waa beenlawyo.
so.footnotes: [19]. Tani waxay ahayd ka hor inta aan arrinkaa laga mamnuucin shayaadiinta oo laga hor joogsan, sida ku soo aroortay Suuradda 72: Aayadaha 8-9.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلشُّعَرَآءُ يَتَّبِعُهُمُ ٱلۡغَاوُۥنَ

en.text: And the poets - [only] the deviators follow them.

so.text: 224. Gabyaayadana waxaa raaca kuwa habowsan.

ayat.arabic: أَلَمۡ تَرَ أَنَّهُمۡ فِي كُلِّ وَادٖ يَهِيمُونَ

en.text: Do you not see that in every valley they roam[1068]
en.footnotes: [1068] Speaking lies indiscriminately and praising and disparaging others according to whim.

so.text: 225. Miyaadan arag inay tog kasta la wareegeystaan (wareer ku jira, iyagoo ku ammaana dad run iyo beenba)?

ayat.arabic: وَأَنَّهُمۡ يَقُولُونَ مَا لَا يَفۡعَلُونَ

en.text: And that they say what they do not do? -

so.text: 226. Iyo inay sheegaan waxaysan falayn [20].
so.footnotes: [20]. Waxaa loola jeedaa in gabyaayada qaarkood iska tiriyaan gabayga iyagoo aan ugala jeedin khayr fidin, aan lahayn wax mowqif cad ah, iyagoo ku hadla been iyagoo aan wax kala saarin, wax iska ammaana ama caaya iyagoo uun raacaya hawadooda iyo danahooda.

ayat.arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَذَكَرُواْ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرٗا وَٱنتَصَرُواْ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا ظُلِمُواْۗ وَسَيَعۡلَمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓاْ أَيَّ مُنقَلَبٖ يَنقَلِبُونَ

en.text: Except those [poets] who believe and do righteous deeds and remember Allāh often and defend [the Muslims][1069] after they were wronged. And those who have wronged are going to know to what [kind of] return they will be returned.
en.footnotes: [1069] By replying through poetry to the attacks of hostile poets.

so.text: 227. Kuwa (Xaqa) rumeeyey ma'ahee oo samaha fala, oo xusa Alle in badan, oo difaaca nafahooda (iyo mu’miniintaba)  marka la dulmiyo kaddib [21]. Way ogaan kuwa fala dulmiga (shirkiga iyo macaasida) rogmasho noocee ah bay rogmi 'Qiyaamada' [22]?
so.footnotes:
[21]. Ee ugu jawaaba gabay ahaan wax sheegga gabyaayada cadowga. 
[22]. Nabigu s.c.w. wuxuu yidhi: In laabta midkiin malax ka buuxsanto baa ka fiican inuu ka buuxsamo gabay.” Waa gabayada xun aan qiimaha lahayn.

ayat.arabic: طسٓۚ تِلۡكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ وَكِتَابٖ مُّبِينٍ

en.text: Ṭā, Seen.[1071] These are the verses of the Qur’ān [i.e., recitation] and a clear Book
en.footnotes: [1071] See footnote to 2:1.

so.text: 1. Daa Siin [1]. Kuwaanu waa Aayadaha Qur'aanka oo Kitaab cad ah.
so.footnotes: [1]. Eeg sharaxa Suuradda 2: Aayadda 1.

ayat.arabic: هُدٗى وَبُشۡرَىٰ لِلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ

en.text: As guidance and good tidings for the believers

so.text: 2. U ah hanuun iyo bishaaro mu’miniinta.

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يُقِيمُونَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤۡتُونَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَهُم بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ هُمۡ يُوقِنُونَ

en.text: Who establish prayer and give zakāh, and of the Hereafter they are certain [in faith].

so.text: 3. Ee ah kuwa ooga salaadda oo bixiya Sakada, ahna kuwo iyagu Aakhiro yaqiinsan.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ زَيَّنَّا لَهُمۡ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ فَهُمۡ يَعۡمَهُونَ

en.text: Indeed, for those who do not believe in the Hereafter, We have made pleasing to them their deeds, so they wander blindly.

so.text: 4. Xaqiiq kuwaan rumeyn Aakhirada, waxaan u qurxinnay acmaashooda, waana ku jaha wareersan yihiin habowgooda.

ayat.arabic: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَهُمۡ سُوٓءُ ٱلۡعَذَابِ وَهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ هُمُ ٱلۡأَخۡسَرُونَ

en.text: Those are the ones for whom there will be the worst of punishment, and in the Hereafter they are the greatest losers.

so.text: 5. Kuwaa waa kuwa mudan cadaab xun (adduunkan), Aakhirana iyaga uun baa ugu khasaare badan.

ayat.arabic: وَإِنَّكَ لَتُلَقَّى ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ مِن لَّدُنۡ حَكِيمٍ عَلِيمٍ

en.text: And indeed, [O Muḥammad], you receive the Qur’ān from one Wise and Knowing.

so.text: 6. Wuxuu adigu (Rasuul Allow) kaaga yimaadaa Qur'aankan xagga Mid Xakiim ah, wax kasta Ogsoon (Allaah).

ayat.arabic: إِذۡ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِأَهۡلِهِۦٓ إِنِّيٓ ءَانَسۡتُ نَارٗا سَـَٔاتِيكُم مِّنۡهَا بِخَبَرٍ أَوۡ ءَاتِيكُم بِشِهَابٖ قَبَسٖ لَّعَلَّكُمۡ تَصۡطَلُونَ

en.text: [Mention] when Moses said to his family, "Indeed, I have perceived a fire. I will bring you from there information or will bring you a burning torch that you may warm yourselves."

so.text: 7. (Xus) markuu Muuse ku yidhi ehelkiisii: “Waxaan arkaa dab, Waxaan idiinka keeni  war [2] ama waxaan idiinka keeni  dhimbilo dab ah inaad kulaashaan.
so.footnotes: [2]. Waddada loo maro Masar.

ayat.arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهَا نُودِيَ أَنۢ بُورِكَ مَن فِي ٱلنَّارِ وَمَنۡ حَوۡلَهَا وَسُبۡحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

en.text: But when he came to it, he was called, "Blessed is whoever is at the fire and whoever is around it. And exalted is Allāh, Lord of the worlds.

so.text: 8. Markiise uu yimid, cod baa dhawaaqay leh: “Waa la barakeeyey waxa dabka agti ah iyo waxa hareera joogaba, xurmona waxaa leh oo ka hufan (ceeb iyo nuqsaan) Allaah, Rabbiga uumanka oo dhan.

ayat.arabic: يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَنَا ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ

en.text: O Moses, indeed it is I - Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Wise."

so.text: 9. “Muusow! Xaqiiq waa Aniga Allaah, Adkaadaha Sare, Xikmadda Badan.

ayat.arabic: وَأَلۡقِ عَصَاكَۚ فَلَمَّا رَءَاهَا تَهۡتَزُّ كَأَنَّهَا جَآنّٞ وَلَّىٰ مُدۡبِرٗا وَلَمۡ يُعَقِّبۡۚ يَٰمُوسَىٰ لَا تَخَفۡ إِنِّي لَا يَخَافُ لَدَيَّ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلُونَ

en.text: And [he was told], "Throw down your staff." But when he saw it writhing as if it were a snake, he turned in flight and did not return.[1072] [Allāh said], "O Moses, fear not. Indeed, in My presence the messengers do not fear.
en.footnotes: [1072] Or "did not look back."

so.text: 10. “Oo tuur ushaada; markiise uu arkay iyadoo dhaq-dhaqaaqaysa sidii mas, buu dib isu rogay oo carar is dhigay, dibna umuu soo jaleecin. Muusow! Ha cabsan, kuma cabsadaan agtayda Rusushu.

ayat.arabic: إِلَّا مَن ظَلَمَ ثُمَّ بَدَّلَ حُسۡنَۢا بَعۡدَ سُوٓءٖ فَإِنِّي غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٞ

en.text: Otherwise, he who wrongs, then substitutes good after evil - indeed, I am Forgiving and Merciful.

so.text: 11. Ciddiise dulma fasha markaas wanaag ku beddesha xumaan kaddib, Anigu waxaan ahay Denbi Dhaaf Badane, Naxariis Badan.

ayat.arabic: وَأَدۡخِلۡ يَدَكَ فِي جَيۡبِكَ تَخۡرُجۡ بَيۡضَآءَ مِنۡ غَيۡرِ سُوٓءٖۖ فِي تِسۡعِ ءَايَٰتٍ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَقَوۡمِهِۦٓۚ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ قَوۡمٗا فَٰسِقِينَ

en.text: And put your hand into the opening of your garment [at the breast]; it will come out white without disease. [These are] among the nine signs [you will take] to Pharaoh and his people. Indeed, they have been a people defiantly disobedient."

so.text: 12. Gali gacantaada goshaada, waxay soo bixi durbaba caddaan (baras iyo) cudur la’aan. (kuwakani waa) qaar ka mid ah sagaalka calaamadood (aad ula tegi doonto) Fircoon iyo qolodiisa. Xaqiiq, waa qolo fallaago ah.

ayat.arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتۡهُمۡ ءَايَٰتُنَا مُبۡصِرَةٗ قَالُواْ هَٰذَا سِحۡرٞ مُّبِينٞ

en.text: But when there came to them Our visible signs, they said, "This is obvious magic."

so.text: 13. Markiise Aayadahayaga cad ay u yimaadeen (Fircoon iyo qolodiisii), waxay yidhaahdeen: Kani waa sixir cad.

ayat.arabic: وَجَحَدُواْ بِهَا وَٱسۡتَيۡقَنَتۡهَآ أَنفُسُهُمۡ ظُلۡمٗا وَعُلُوّٗاۚ فَٱنظُرۡ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلۡمُفۡسِدِينَ

en.text: And they rejected them, while their [inner] selves were convinced thereof, out of injustice and haughtiness. So see how was the end of the corrupters.

so.text: 14. Way dafireen Aayadahaa dulmi iyo kibir darti, inkastoo ay nafahoodu yaqiinsadeen. Ee fiiri siday aheyd cidhibtii xume 'iyo  fasahaad' wadeenka.

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ ءَاتَيۡنَا دَاوُۥدَ وَسُلَيۡمَٰنَ عِلۡمٗاۖ وَقَالَا ٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي فَضَّلَنَا عَلَىٰ كَثِيرٖ مِّنۡ عِبَادِهِ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ

en.text: And We had certainly given to David and Solomon knowledge, and they said, "Praise [is due] to Allāh, who has favored us over many of His believing servants."

so.text: 15. Waxaan dhab ahaan siinnay Daawuud iyo Sulaymaan cilmi. Waxay yidhaahdeen: Ammaan idilkeed iyo mahadba waxaa leh Allaah, ee naga faddilay in badan oo ka mid ah addoomahiisa mu'miniinta ah.

ayat.arabic: وَوَرِثَ سُلَيۡمَٰنُ دَاوُۥدَۖ وَقَالَ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ عُلِّمۡنَا مَنطِقَ ٱلطَّيۡرِ وَأُوتِينَا مِن كُلِّ شَيۡءٍۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلۡفَضۡلُ ٱلۡمُبِينُ

en.text: And Solomon inherited David. He said, "O people, we have been taught the language of birds, and we have been given from all things. Indeed, this is evident bounty."

so.text: 16. Wuxuu dhaxlay Sulaymaan (aqoontii iyo xikmaddii) Daawuud. Wuxuu yidhi: Dadow! Waxaa nala baray hadalka shimbiraha, waxaana wax nalaga siiyey wax walba [3]. Hubaal, kani waa Fadli 'Alle baxsho' oo cad.
so.footnotes: [3]. Nabi Sulaymaan c.s. waxaa la siiyey Nabinnimada iyo Boqortooyada kaddib aabbihi Nabi Daawuud c.s.

ayat.arabic: وَحُشِرَ لِسُلَيۡمَٰنَ جُنُودُهُۥ مِنَ ٱلۡجِنِّ وَٱلۡإِنسِ وَٱلطَّيۡرِ فَهُمۡ يُوزَعُونَ

en.text: And gathered for Solomon were his soldiers of the jinn and men and birds, and they were [marching] in rows

so.text: 17. Waxaa loo soo kulmiyey Sulaymaan askartiisii oo jin, dad iyo shimbiraba leh iyagoo loo abuubalay kooxo ahaan.

ayat.arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَتَوۡاْ عَلَىٰ وَادِ ٱلنَّمۡلِ قَالَتۡ نَمۡلَةٞ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّمۡلُ ٱدۡخُلُواْ مَسَٰكِنَكُمۡ لَا يَحۡطِمَنَّكُمۡ سُلَيۡمَٰنُ وَجُنُودُهُۥ وَهُمۡ لَا يَشۡعُرُونَ

en.text: Until, when they came upon the valley of the ants, an ant said, "O ants, enter your dwellings that you not be crushed by Solomon and his soldiers while they perceive not."

so.text: 18. ilaa, markay yimaadeen toggii qudhaanjada, qudhaanjo baa waxay tidhi: “Qudhaanjooy! Gala guryihiinna si ayan idiin jajabin Sulaymaan iyo askartiisa iyagoo aan dareemayn.

ayat.arabic: فَتَبَسَّمَ ضَاحِكٗا مِّن قَوۡلِهَا وَقَالَ رَبِّ أَوۡزِعۡنِيٓ أَنۡ أَشۡكُرَ نِعۡمَتَكَ ٱلَّتِيٓ أَنۡعَمۡتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَٰلِدَيَّ وَأَنۡ أَعۡمَلَ صَٰلِحٗا تَرۡضَىٰهُ وَأَدۡخِلۡنِي بِرَحۡمَتِكَ فِي عِبَادِكَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ

en.text: So [Solomon] smiled, amused at her speech, and said, "My Lord, enable me[1073] to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to do righteousness of which You approve. And admit me by Your mercy into [the ranks of] Your righteous servants."[1074]
en.footnotes:
[1073] More literally, "gather within me the utmost strength and ability."
[1074] Or "with Your righteous servants [into Paradise]."

so.text: 19. Markaasuu (Sulaymaan) muusooday, isagoo ku qosli hadalkeeda, oo yidhi: Rabbiyow! I waafaji inaan ku shukriyo Nicmaddaada aad ugu nicmaysay aniga iyo waalidkayba iyo inaan  falo camal san aad ka raalli tahay, oo igu geli [4] Naxariistaada addoomahaaga wanaagsan dhexdooda [5].
so.footnotes:
[4]. Erey ahaan macnaha waxaa weeye igu dhex kulmi oo faafi quwad iyo awood aad u sarreysa ee I sahasha adeeciddaada iyo gudashada cibaadada. 
[5]. Macnaha sidoo kale wuxuu noqon karaa: “ oo I geli la jirka addoomahaaga wanaagsan (jannada) lagu waadho.

ayat.arabic: وَتَفَقَّدَ ٱلطَّيۡرَ فَقَالَ مَالِيَ لَآ أَرَى ٱلۡهُدۡهُدَ أَمۡ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡغَآئِبِينَ

en.text: And he took attendance of the birds and said, "Why do I not see the hoopoe - or is he among the absent?

so.text: 20. Wuxuu (Sulaymaan) kormeeray shimbirihii, markaasuu yidhi: Maxaa dhacay oo aan u arki la'ahay hud-hudkii [6], mise ma wuxuu ka mid yahay kuwa maqan?
so.footnotes: [6]. Hud-hud gaar ah oo heer sare ah ka mid ah shimbiraha.

ayat.arabic: لَأُعَذِّبَنَّهُۥ عَذَابٗا شَدِيدًا أَوۡ لَأَاْذۡبَحَنَّهُۥٓ أَوۡ لَيَأۡتِيَنِّي بِسُلۡطَٰنٖ مُّبِينٖ

en.text: I will surely punish him with a severe punishment or slaughter him unless he brings me clear authorization."[1075]
en.footnotes: [1075] i.e., a valid excuse.

so.text: 21. Waxaan ciqaabi ciqaab daran ama waan gowrici ama wuxuu ii keeni xujo cad.

ayat.arabic: فَمَكَثَ غَيۡرَ بَعِيدٖ فَقَالَ أَحَطتُ بِمَا لَمۡ تُحِطۡ بِهِۦ وَجِئۡتُكَ مِن سَبَإِۭ بِنَبَإٖ يَقِينٍ

en.text: But he [i.e., the hoopoe] stayed not long and said, "I have encompassed [in knowledge] that which you have not encompassed, and I have come to you from Sheba with certain news.

so.text: 22.Mase maqnaan muddo dheer, (wuxuuna joogsaday meel aan fogeyn) oo yidhi: Waxaan soo koobay (ogaalka wax) aad  koobin, waxaana kaaga keenay Saba [7] war la hubo.
so.footnotes: [7]. Saba’ waa magaca boqortooyo jirtay Yaman waa’ hore.

ayat.arabic: إِنِّي وَجَدتُّ ٱمۡرَأَةٗ تَمۡلِكُهُمۡ وَأُوتِيَتۡ مِن كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ وَلَهَا عَرۡشٌ عَظِيمٞ

en.text: Indeed, I found [there] a woman ruling them, and she has been given of all things, and she has a great throne.

so.text: 23.Waxaan helay haweeney [8] xukumeysa, oo la siiyey wax walba 'oo mulki adduun ah' [9], waxayna leedahay Carshi Weyn.
so.footnotes:
[8]. Balqiis (ama Makeda) waxay ka talineysey Saba’ waagii Sulaymaan. 
[9]. Sida maal, beero badan, macaadinta dhulka, iwm.

ayat.arabic: وَجَدتُّهَا وَقَوۡمَهَا يَسۡجُدُونَ لِلشَّمۡسِ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ فَصَدَّهُمۡ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ فَهُمۡ لَا يَهۡتَدُونَ

en.text: I found her and her people prostrating to the sun instead of Allāh, and Satan has made their deeds pleasing to them and averted them from [His] way, so they are not guided,

so.text: 24. Waxaan helay iyada iyo dadkeeda oo u sujuudaya qorraxda halkii Alle, wuxuuna u qurxiyey shaydaan camalladooda (xun), oo ka duway Jidka (Toosan ee Islaamka), marka ma ay hanuunsana.

ayat.arabic: أَلَّاۤ يَسۡجُدُواْۤ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي يُخۡرِجُ ٱلۡخَبۡءَ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَيَعۡلَمُ مَا تُخۡفُونَ وَمَا تُعۡلِنُونَ

en.text: [And] so they do not prostrate to Allāh, who brings forth what is hidden within the heavens and the earth and knows what you conceal and what you declare -

so.text: 25. May u sujuudaan Alle ee soo bixiya waxa ku qarsoon samooyinka iyo arlada oo Ogsoon waxaad qarisaan, iyo waxaad muujisaanba.

ayat.arabic: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلۡعَرۡشِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ۩

en.text: Allāh - there is no deity except Him, Lord of the Great Throne."

so.text: 26. Allaah, ma jiro Ilaah (Xaq ah) aan Isaga ahayn, waa Rabbiga Carshiga Weyn.

ayat.arabic: ۞ قَالَ سَنَنظُرُ أَصَدَقۡتَ أَمۡ كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلۡكَٰذِبِينَ

en.text: [Solomon] said, "We will see whether you were truthful or were of the liars.

so.text: 27. (Sulaymaan) wuxuu yidhi: Waanu eegi inaad run sheegi ama inaad ka mid tahay beenlowyada.

ayat.arabic: ٱذۡهَب بِّكِتَٰبِي هَٰذَا فَأَلۡقِهۡ إِلَيۡهِمۡ ثُمَّ تَوَلَّ عَنۡهُمۡ فَٱنظُرۡ مَاذَا يَرۡجِعُونَ

en.text: Take this letter of mine and deliver it to them. Then leave them and see what [answer] they will return."

so.text: 28. Qaad warqaddaydaan oo u dhiib, kana soo laabo, markaas fiiri waxay (jawaab) soo celiyaan”.

ayat.arabic: قَالَتۡ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡمَلَؤُاْ إِنِّيٓ أُلۡقِيَ إِلَيَّ كِتَٰبٞ كَرِيمٌ

en.text: She said, "O eminent ones, indeed, to me has been delivered a noble letter.

so.text: 29. Waxay tidhi: Mudanayaal! Waxaa la iigu dhiibay halkaan waraaq sharaf leh.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ مِن سُلَيۡمَٰنَ وَإِنَّهُۥ بِسۡمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

en.text: Indeed, it is from Solomon, and indeed, it is [i.e., reads]: 'In the name of Allāh, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful,

so.text: 30. Waxaa soo diray Sulaymaan, (waxaana ku yaal): Bismillaahir Raxmaanir Raxiim.

ayat.arabic: أَلَّا تَعۡلُواْ عَلَيَّ وَأۡتُونِي مُسۡلِمِينَ

en.text: Be not haughty with me but come to me in submission [as Muslims].'"

so.text: 31. Ha iska kay weyneynina oo ii imaada idinkoo hoggaansan oo Muslimiin ah.

ayat.arabic: قَالَتۡ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡمَلَؤُاْ أَفۡتُونِي فِيٓ أَمۡرِي مَا كُنتُ قَاطِعَةً أَمۡرًا حَتَّىٰ تَشۡهَدُونِ

en.text: She said, "O eminent ones, advise me in my affair. I would not decide a matter until you witness [for] me."[1076]
en.footnotes: [1076] i.e., are present with me or testify in my favor.

so.text: 32. Waxay tidhi: Mudanayaal! Iga siiya talo arrinkaygaan. Anigu ma gooyo talo jeer aad goob joog tihiin [10].
so.footnotes: [10]. Inaad ila joogtaan maahee golaha wada tashiga (baarlamaanka), oo aad oggolaansho cad i siisaan.

ayat.arabic: قَالُواْ نَحۡنُ أُوْلُواْ قُوَّةٖ وَأُوْلُواْ بَأۡسٖ شَدِيدٖ وَٱلۡأَمۡرُ إِلَيۡكِ فَٱنظُرِي مَاذَا تَأۡمُرِينَ

en.text: They said, "We are men of strength and of great military might, but the command is yours, so see what you will command."

so.text: 33. Waxay yidhaahdeen: Waxaanu nahay kuwo xoog leh oo dagaal aqoon daran leh iyo geesinnimo, amarkase adigaa leh; ee ka fiirso waxaad amreyso.

ayat.arabic: قَالَتۡ إِنَّ ٱلۡمُلُوكَ إِذَا دَخَلُواْ قَرۡيَةً أَفۡسَدُوهَا وَجَعَلُوٓاْ أَعِزَّةَ أَهۡلِهَآ أَذِلَّةٗۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ يَفۡعَلُونَ

en.text: She said, "Indeed kings - when they enter a city, they ruin it and render the honored of its people humbled. And thus do they do.

so.text: 34. Waxay tidhi: Hubaal! Boqorradu, markay (ku) galaan magaalo (xoog) waa kharribaan, oo ka yeelaan ehelkeeda sharafta leh kuwa hoos ah. Sidaasayna falaan.

ayat.arabic: وَإِنِّي مُرۡسِلَةٌ إِلَيۡهِم بِهَدِيَّةٖ فَنَاظِرَةُۢ بِمَ يَرۡجِعُ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلُونَ

en.text: But indeed, I will send to them a gift and see with what [reply] the messengers will return."

so.text: 35. Waxaanse u diri hadiyad oo sugi waxay (jawaab) la soo noqdaan ergaydu.

ayat.arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ سُلَيۡمَٰنَ قَالَ أَتُمِدُّونَنِ بِمَالٖ فَمَآ ءَاتَىٰنِۦَ ٱللَّهُ خَيۡرٞ مِّمَّآ ءَاتَىٰكُمۚ بَلۡ أَنتُم بِهَدِيَّتِكُمۡ تَفۡرَحُونَ

en.text: So when they came to Solomon, he said, "Do you provide me with wealth? But what Allāh has given me is better than what He has given you. Rather, it is you who rejoice in your gift.

so.text: 36. Markii (ergaygii oo sida hadiyadda) u yimid Sulaymaan, wuxuu yidhi: Ma waxaad iigu deeqeysaan maal? Waxa se uu I siiyey Alle baa ka khayr badan waxa uu idin siiyey. Waxaadse idinku ku faraxsan tihiin hadiyaddiinna.

ayat.arabic: ٱرۡجِعۡ إِلَيۡهِمۡ فَلَنَأۡتِيَنَّهُم بِجُنُودٖ لَّا قِبَلَ لَهُم بِهَا وَلَنُخۡرِجَنَّهُم مِّنۡهَآ أَذِلَّةٗ وَهُمۡ صَٰغِرُونَ

en.text: Return to them, for we will surely come to them with soldiers that they will be powerless to encounter, and we will surely expel them therefrom in humiliation, and they will be debased."

so.text: 37. U celi iyaga, waxaan ula imaaneynaa  ciidammo aysan awood u lahayn inay ka hor tagaan, waxaana ka saari  magaalada iyagoo dullaysan oo ku jira xaalad liidasho.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡمَلَؤُاْ أَيُّكُمۡ يَأۡتِينِي بِعَرۡشِهَا قَبۡلَ أَن يَأۡتُونِي مُسۡلِمِينَ

en.text: [Solomon] said, "O assembly [of jinn], which of you will bring me her throne before they come to me in submission?"

so.text: 38. (Sulaymaan) wuxuu yidhi: Mudanayaal! Kiinnee baa ii keeni carshigeeda ka hor inta aanay ii imaan iyagoo hoggaansan oo Muslimiin ah?”

ayat.arabic: قَالَ عِفۡرِيتٞ مِّنَ ٱلۡجِنِّ أَنَا۠ ءَاتِيكَ بِهِۦ قَبۡلَ أَن تَقُومَ مِن مَّقَامِكَۖ وَإِنِّي عَلَيۡهِ لَقَوِيٌّ أَمِينٞ

en.text: A powerful one from among the jinn said, "I will bring it to you before you rise from your place, and indeed, I am for this [task] strong and trustworthy."

so.text: 39. Cifriit ka mid ah jinka baa wuxuu yidhi: Anigaa kuu keenaya ka hor intaad ka kicin golahaaga, oo xaqiiq waxaan anigu ahay mid xoog u leh oo aamin ah.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ ٱلَّذِي عِندَهُۥ عِلۡمٞ مِّنَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ أَنَا۠ ءَاتِيكَ بِهِۦ قَبۡلَ أَن يَرۡتَدَّ إِلَيۡكَ طَرۡفُكَۚ فَلَمَّا رَءَاهُ مُسۡتَقِرًّا عِندَهُۥ قَالَ هَٰذَا مِن فَضۡلِ رَبِّي لِيَبۡلُوَنِيٓ ءَأَشۡكُرُ أَمۡ أَكۡفُرُۖ وَمَن شَكَرَ فَإِنَّمَا يَشۡكُرُ لِنَفۡسِهِۦۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ رَبِّي غَنِيّٞ كَرِيمٞ

en.text: Said one who had knowledge from the Scripture, "I will bring it to you before your glance returns to you." And when [Solomon] saw it placed before him, he said, "This is from the favor of my Lord to test me whether I will be grateful or ungrateful. And whoever is grateful - his gratitude is only for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever is ungrateful - then indeed, my Lord is Free of need and Generous."

so.text: 40. Mid haystay cilmi Kitaabka ah [11] wuxuu yidhi: Anigaa kuugu keenaya il biriqsi gudaheed. Markuu (Sulaymaan) arkay isagoo barbarkiisa yaal (carshigeedii), wuxuu yidhi: Kani waa fadliga Rabbigay - si uu ii imtixaano inaan ku mahdiyo ama aan ka abaal dhaco. Qofkii (Alle) ku mahdiya wuxuu uun u mahdiyey naftiisa, qofkiina ka abaal dhaca, hubaal Rabbigay waa mid kaaftoon, sharaf Badan.
so.footnotes: [11]. Waxaa loola jeedaa Kitaab halkan Kitaabkii la soo dejiyey ka hor Sulaymaan oo ah Towraadda iyo Zabuurka.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ نَكِّرُواْ لَهَا عَرۡشَهَا نَنظُرۡ أَتَهۡتَدِيٓ أَمۡ تَكُونُ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَهۡتَدُونَ

en.text: He said, "Disguise for her her throne; we will see whether she will be guided [to truth] or will be of those who is not guided."

so.text: 41. (Sulaymaan) wuxuu yidhi: Dooriya carshigeeda si aan u aragno inay garato, mise inay noqoto mid aan garanayn.

ayat.arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتۡ قِيلَ أَهَٰكَذَا عَرۡشُكِۖ قَالَتۡ كَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَۚ وَأُوتِينَا ٱلۡعِلۡمَ مِن قَبۡلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسۡلِمِينَ

en.text: So when she arrived, it was said [to her], "Is your throne like this?" She said, "[It is] as though it was it." [Solomon said], "And we were given knowledge before her, and we have been Muslims [in submission to Allāh].

so.text: 42. Markay timid baa waxaa lagu yidhi: Ma sidan baa Carshigaagu?. Waxay tidhi: Waxaadba mooddaa isagii. (Sulaymaan wuxuu yidhi): Waxaana nala siiyey cilmi horteed, waxaanu nahay Muslimiin.

ayat.arabic: وَصَدَّهَا مَا كَانَت تَّعۡبُدُ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِۖ إِنَّهَا كَانَتۡ مِن قَوۡمٖ كَٰفِرِينَ

en.text: And that which she was worshipping other than Allāh had averted her [from submission to Him]. Indeed, she was from a disbelieving people."

so.text: 43. Waxaa (Xaqa) ka jeediyey waxay caabudeysey Alle sokadi, waxay ka mid aheyd qolo gaalo ah [12].
so.footnotes: [12]. Balqiis waxay ku ogaatay Nabinnimada Sulaymaan ka hor inta aan la keenin carshigeeda xagga Falastiin soo celintii dib loogu soo celiyey hadiyaddii ay dirtay.

ayat.arabic: قِيلَ لَهَا ٱدۡخُلِي ٱلصَّرۡحَۖ فَلَمَّا رَأَتۡهُ حَسِبَتۡهُ لُجَّةٗ وَكَشَفَتۡ عَن سَاقَيۡهَاۚ قَالَ إِنَّهُۥ صَرۡحٞ مُّمَرَّدٞ مِّن قَوَارِيرَۗ قَالَتۡ رَبِّ إِنِّي ظَلَمۡتُ نَفۡسِي وَأَسۡلَمۡتُ مَعَ سُلَيۡمَٰنَ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

en.text: She was told, "Enter the palace." But when she saw it, she thought it was a body of water[1077] and uncovered her shins [to wade through]. He said, "Indeed, it is a palace [whose floor is] made smooth with glass." She said, "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, and I submit with Solomon to Allāh, Lord of the worlds."
en.footnotes: [1077] The floor was transparent, and beneath it was flowing water.

so.text: 44. Waxaa lagu yidhi: Gal Daarta [13], markay aragtay, waxay moodday biyo dhig badan, markaasay xaydatay oo labadeedii kub muuqdeen; Sulaymaan wuxuu yidhi: Waa sar salaax sugan oo quraarad ah. Waxay tidhi “Rabbiyow! Anigu waxaan dulmiyey naftayda, haddase islaamay oo waxaan si dhan isugu dhiibay la jirka Sulaymaan Alle, Rabbiga uumanka.
so.footnotes: [13]. Daartaa waxay ahayd mid loo malaasay si qurux badan, aad u salaaxan, marmarkeedu ka sameysan yahay muraayado layska arko, hoostiisana waxaa sii ahaa biyo badan oo socda, iyo kalluun, iwm.

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَآ إِلَىٰ ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمۡ صَٰلِحًا أَنِ ٱعۡبُدُواْ ٱللَّهَ فَإِذَا هُمۡ فَرِيقَانِ يَخۡتَصِمُونَ

en.text: And We had certainly sent to Thamūd their brother Ṣāliḥ, [saying], "Worship Allāh," and at once they were two parties conflicting.

so.text: 45. Waxaan u dirnay (reer) Thamuud walaalkood Saalix, wuxuu yidhi: Caabuda Alle (Keliya). Mise waxay noqdeen labo kooxood (gaalo iyo mu’miniin) doodaya [14].
so.footnotes: [14]. Nabi Saalix c.s iyo qolodiisii.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ لِمَ تَسۡتَعۡجِلُونَ بِٱلسَّيِّئَةِ قَبۡلَ ٱلۡحَسَنَةِۖ لَوۡلَا تَسۡتَغۡفِرُونَ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تُرۡحَمُونَ

en.text: He said, "O my people, why are you impatient for evil before [i.e., instead of] good?[1078] Why do you not seek forgiveness of Allāh that you may receive mercy?"
en.footnotes: [1078] By challenging Ṣāliḥ to bring on the promised punishment rather than asking for mercy from Allāh.

so.text: 46. (Saalix) wuxuu yidhi: “Tolkaygiyow! Maxaad u doontaan in la idiin soo dedjiyo xumaanta halkii samaanta [15]? Maxaad uga dalbi weydeen Denbi Dhaaf Alle inuu idiin naxariisto?
so.footnotes: [15]. Iyagoo kula dooday Saalix inuu u keeno cadaabka uu ugu gooddiyey, halkii ay dalbi lahaayeen Naxariis Alle.

ayat.arabic: قَالُواْ ٱطَّيَّرۡنَا بِكَ وَبِمَن مَّعَكَۚ قَالَ طَٰٓئِرُكُمۡ عِندَ ٱللَّهِۖ بَلۡ أَنتُمۡ قَوۡمٞ تُفۡتَنُونَ

en.text: They said, "We consider you a bad omen, you and those with you." He said, "Your omen [i.e., fate] is with Allāh. Rather, you are a people being tested."[1079]
en.footnotes: [1079] Or "being tempted [by Satan]."

so.text: 47.Waxay yidhahdeen: Waan ku shareysan- nay adiga iyo kuwa kula jira. Wuxuu yidhi: "Waxa idinku dhaca (khayr ama shar) waa Alle agti [16]; waxaadse tihiin qolo la imtaxaanayo.”
so.footnotes: [16]. Qaddarka iyo qadahiisa.

ayat.arabic: وَكَانَ فِي ٱلۡمَدِينَةِ تِسۡعَةُ رَهۡطٖ يُفۡسِدُونَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَا يُصۡلِحُونَ

en.text: And there were in the city nine family heads causing corruption in the land and not amending [its affairs].

so.text: 48. Waxaa magaalada [17] ku sugnaa sagaal nin [18], ku fala fasahaad arlada aan wax hagaajin.
so.footnotes:
[17]. Mufasiriinta qaarkood waxay yidhaahdeen waxaa loola jeedaa magaalada halkan magaaladii qolodii Thamuud, waana magaaladii Al-Xijir. 
[18]. Oo ahaa madaxdoodii iyo wiilasha ay dhaleen oo diinta colaadinayey.

ayat.arabic: قَالُواْ تَقَاسَمُواْ بِٱللَّهِ لَنُبَيِّتَنَّهُۥ وَأَهۡلَهُۥ ثُمَّ لَنَقُولَنَّ لِوَلِيِّهِۦ مَا شَهِدۡنَا مَهۡلِكَ أَهۡلِهِۦ وَإِنَّا لَصَٰدِقُونَ

en.text: They said, "Take a mutual oath by Allāh that we will kill him by night, he and his family. Then we will say to his executor,[1080] 'We did not witness the destruction of his family, and indeed, we are truthful.'"
en.footnotes: [1080] i.e., the one responsible for executing his will and avenging his blood.

so.text: 49. Waxay yidhaahdeen: Isku dhaarsada Alle inaan ku qaadno weerar kedo ah (Saalix) iyo ehelkiisa goor habeen ah, markaas waxaan ku odhan xigtadiisa  dhow [19]: Maa aanu joogin meeshuu ku halaagsamay ehelkiisu,run baynuna sheegi.
so.footnotes: [19]. Midka ay saaran tahay inuu fuliyo dardaarankiisa, oo leh diyadiisa.

ayat.arabic: وَمَكَرُواْ مَكۡرٗا وَمَكَرۡنَا مَكۡرٗا وَهُمۡ لَا يَشۡعُرُونَ

en.text: And they planned a plan, and We planned a plan, while they perceived not.

so.text: 50. Waxay tabeeyeen tab, Annaguna waxaanu tabeennay tab, iyagoo aan dareemayn.

ayat.arabic: فَٱنظُرۡ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ مَكۡرِهِمۡ أَنَّا دَمَّرۡنَٰهُمۡ وَقَوۡمَهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ

en.text: Then look how was the outcome of their plan - that We destroyed them and their people, all.

so.text: 51. Ee fiiri siday aheyd cidhibtii tabtooda inaan baabbi’innay iyaga iyo dadkoodii oo dhan.

ayat.arabic: فَتِلۡكَ بُيُوتُهُمۡ خَاوِيَةَۢ بِمَا ظَلَمُوٓاْۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗ لِّقَوۡمٖ يَعۡلَمُونَ

en.text: So those are their houses, desolate because of the wrong they had done. Indeed in that is a sign for people who know.

so.text: 52. Waana kuwaas guryahoodii iyagoo maran oo burbur ku sugan dulmigoodii darti. Hubaal, arrinkaa waxaa ugu sugan calaamo ciddii wax garan.

ayat.arabic: وَأَنجَيۡنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَكَانُواْ يَتَّقُونَ

en.text: And We saved those who believed and used to fear Allāh.

so.text: 53. Waxaanu badbaaddinnay kuwii (xaqa) rumeeyey oo ka dhowrsanayey (shirkiga iyo macaasida).

ayat.arabic: وَلُوطًا إِذۡ قَالَ لِقَوۡمِهِۦٓ أَتَأۡتُونَ ٱلۡفَٰحِشَةَ وَأَنتُمۡ تُبۡصِرُونَ

en.text: And [mention] Lot, when he said to his people, "Do you commit immorality[1081] while you are seeing?[1082]
en.footnotes:
[1081] Homosexual acts.
[1082] i.e., openly. Another meaning is "...while you are aware [that it is wrong]."

so.text: 54. (Waxaana dirnay) Luud markuu ku lahaa qolodiisii: Ma waxaad la imanaysaan faaxisho [20] idinkoo arka [21]?
so.footnotes:
[20]. Faaxishah wax xille oo foolxun waxaa halkan loola jeedaa zinada iyo ficilkii qoomu luud -Falalka khaniisnimada ah, iwm.
[21]. Si caddaan ah, tafsiir kale waa idinkoo ogsoon inay tahay denbi weyn.

ayat.arabic: أَئِنَّكُمۡ لَتَأۡتُونَ ٱلرِّجَالَ شَهۡوَةٗ مِّن دُونِ ٱلنِّسَآءِۚ بَلۡ أَنتُمۡ قَوۡمٞ تَجۡهَلُونَ

en.text: Do you indeed approach men with desire instead of women? Rather, you are a people behaving ignorantly."

so.text: 55. Ma waxaad u tageysaan ragga idinkoo u hawoonaya halkii haweenka? Waxaadse tihiin qolo jaahiliin ah aan garan (Weynida Alle iyo mudnaantiisa Keligi cibaadada).

ayat.arabic: ۞ فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوۡمِهِۦٓ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُوٓاْ أَخۡرِجُوٓاْ ءَالَ لُوطٖ مِّن قَرۡيَتِكُمۡۖ إِنَّهُمۡ أُنَاسٞ يَتَطَهَّرُونَ

en.text: But the answer of his people was not except that they said, "Expel the family of Lot from your city. Indeed, they are people who keep themselves pure."

so.text: 56.Mase ahayn jawaabtii qolodiisii waxaan ahayn inay yidhaahdeen: “Ka saara reer Luud magaaladiinna, waa dad is daahirine.

ayat.arabic: فَأَنجَيۡنَٰهُ وَأَهۡلَهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱمۡرَأَتَهُۥ قَدَّرۡنَٰهَا مِنَ ٱلۡغَٰبِرِينَ

en.text: So We saved him and his family, except for his wife; We destined her to be of those who remained behind.

so.text: 57. Markaasaan badbaadinnay isaga iyo ehelkiisii marwadiisii maahee. Waxaan qaddarnay inay ka mid ahaato kuwa ku haray gadaal (ee la halaagay).

ayat.arabic: وَأَمۡطَرۡنَا عَلَيۡهِم مَّطَرٗاۖ فَسَآءَ مَطَرُ ٱلۡمُنذَرِينَ

en.text: And We rained upon them a rain [of stones], and evil was the rain of those who were warned.

so.text: 58. Waxaana ku soo daadinnay korkooda roob (dhagaxyo naar ah). Xumaa roobka kuwa loo digay.

ayat.arabic: قُلِ ٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِ وَسَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰ عِبَادِهِ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱصۡطَفَىٰٓۗ ءَآللَّهُ خَيۡرٌ أَمَّا يُشۡرِكُونَ

en.text: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Praise be to Allāh, and peace upon His servants whom He has chosen. Is Allāh better or what they associate with Him?"

so.text: 59. Dheh: Ammaan idilkeed iyo mahad waxaa leh Allaah, nabadna ha ahaato addoomahiisa uu doortay dushooda. Ma Alle baa wanaagsan, mise kuwa (ilaahyada beenta ah) ay la wadaajiyaan cibaadada shariigyo ahaan?

ayat.arabic: أَمَّنۡ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَأَنزَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءٗ فَأَنۢبَتۡنَا بِهِۦ حَدَآئِقَ ذَاتَ بَهۡجَةٖ مَّا كَانَ لَكُمۡ أَن تُنۢبِتُواْ شَجَرَهَآۗ أَءِلَٰهٞ مَّعَ ٱللَّهِۚ بَلۡ هُمۡ قَوۡمٞ يَعۡدِلُونَ

en.text: [More precisely], is He [not best] who created the heavens and the earth and sent down for you rain from the sky, causing to grow thereby gardens of joyful beauty which you could not [otherwise] have grown the trees thereof? Is there a deity with Allāh?[1083] [No], but they are a people who ascribe equals [to Him].
en.footnotes: [1083] Three meanings are implied: "Is there another god who did all of this with Allāh?" or "Is there any deity worthy to be worshipped along with Allāh?" or "Is there a deity to be compared with Allāh?"

so.text: 60. Mayee, (Alle baa wanaagsan) ee ah Kan abuuray cirarka iyo dhulka, oo idiinka soo dejiya biyo (roob) daruuraha, oo aan ku soo bixinno beero cajab leh oo bilic iyo barwaaqo badan; Ma aha wax aad kartaan inaad soo saartaan geedahooda. Ma waxaa jira ilaah la jirka Alle? Mayee, waa qolo ka weecata (Xaqa oo la wadaajiya Alle cibaadada cid kale oo la mid dhiga).

ayat.arabic: أَمَّن جَعَلَ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ قَرَارٗا وَجَعَلَ خِلَٰلَهَآ أَنۡهَٰرٗا وَجَعَلَ لَهَا رَوَٰسِيَ وَجَعَلَ بَيۡنَ ٱلۡبَحۡرَيۡنِ حَاجِزًاۗ أَءِلَٰهٞ مَّعَ ٱللَّهِۚ بَلۡ أَكۡثَرُهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ

en.text: Is He [not best] who made the earth a stable ground and placed within it rivers and made for it firmly set mountains and placed between the two seas a barrier? Is there a deity with Allāh? [No], but most of them do not know.

so.text: 61. (Waxaa wanaagsan Alle ee) ka dhigay dhulka meel la dego oo ka yeelay dhexdiisa webiyo, oo u yeelay buuro suga, yeelayna dhexdooda labada badood xidh. Ee ma waxaa jira ilaah la jirka Alle? Mayee, badankood garasho ma leh.

ayat.arabic: أَمَّن يُجِيبُ ٱلۡمُضۡطَرَّ إِذَا دَعَاهُ وَيَكۡشِفُ ٱلسُّوٓءَ وَيَجۡعَلُكُمۡ خُلَفَآءَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِۗ أَءِلَٰهٞ مَّعَ ٱللَّهِۚ قَلِيلٗا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ

en.text: Is He [not best] who responds to the desperate one when he calls upon Him and removes evil and makes you inheritors of the earth?[1084] Is there a deity with Allāh? Little do you remember.
en.footnotes: [1084] Generation after generation.

so.text: 62. (Waxaa Wanaagsan Alle ee ah) Kan ajiiba dhibbanaha markuu baryo oo ka qaada dhibka, idinkana yeela kuwa u hadha (oo isku beddela) dhulka [22]. Ma waxaa jira ilaah la jirka Alle? Yaraa intaad xusuusataan  (oo waantowdaan).
so.footnotes: [22]. Fac walba uu xigsado fac kale.

ayat.arabic: أَمَّن يَهۡدِيكُمۡ فِي ظُلُمَٰتِ ٱلۡبَرِّ وَٱلۡبَحۡرِ وَمَن يُرۡسِلُ ٱلرِّيَٰحَ بُشۡرَۢا بَيۡنَ يَدَيۡ رَحۡمَتِهِۦٓۗ أَءِلَٰهٞ مَّعَ ٱللَّهِۚ تَعَٰلَى ٱللَّهُ عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُونَ

en.text: Is He [not best] who guides you through the darknesses of the land and sea and who sends the winds as good tidings before His mercy? Is there a deity with Allāh? High is Allāh above whatever they associate with Him.

so.text: 63. (Waxaa wanaagsan Alle ee ah) Kan idin haga markaad ku dhex jirtaan mugdiyada berriga iyo badda oo ah Kan soo dira dabeylaha ceelalyo ahaan bishaara sida ka horreeya Raxmaddiisa (roobka)? Ma waxaa jira ilaah la jirka Alle? Waa ka sarreeyaa Alle waxay la wadaajiyaan cibaadada (oo la mid dhigaan).

ayat.arabic: أَمَّن يَبۡدَؤُاْ ٱلۡخَلۡقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُۥ وَمَن يَرۡزُقُكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۗ أَءِلَٰهٞ مَّعَ ٱللَّهِۚ قُلۡ هَاتُواْ بُرۡهَٰنَكُمۡ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ

en.text: Is He [not best] who begins creation and then repeats it and who provides for you from the heaven and earth? Is there a deity with Allāh? Say, "Produce your proof, if you should be truthful."

so.text: 64. (Alle ee ah) Kan billaaba asal ahaan abuurka, haddana soo celin, ee ah Kan idinka irsaaqa samada iyo arlada? Ma waxaa jira ilaah la jirka Alle? Dheh: Keena Xujadiinna, haddaad run sheegaysaan.

ayat.arabic: قُل لَّا يَعۡلَمُ مَن فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ ٱلۡغَيۡبَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُۚ وَمَا يَشۡعُرُونَ أَيَّانَ يُبۡعَثُونَ

en.text: Say, "None in the heavens and earth knows the unseen except Allāh, and they do not perceive when they will be resurrected."

so.text: 65. Dheh: Ma jiraan cid ku sugan samooyinka iyo arlada oo ogsoon Ghaybka (waxa qarsoon ee aan muuqan) Alle ma’ahee, mana ay oga goorta la soo bixin.

ayat.arabic: بَلِ ٱدَّٰرَكَ عِلۡمُهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِۚ بَلۡ هُمۡ فِي شَكّٖ مِّنۡهَاۖ بَلۡ هُم مِّنۡهَا عَمُونَ

en.text: Rather, their knowledge is arrested concerning the Hereafter. Rather, they are in doubt about it. Rather, they are, concerning it, blind.

so.text: 66. Mayee’, Cilmigooda xagga Aakhirada waa wax yar oo aan dhammeyn. Waxaybase ka qabaan shaki, wayna ka indha la' yihiin xaggeeda.

ayat.arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ أَءِذَا كُنَّا تُرَٰبٗا وَءَابَآؤُنَآ أَئِنَّا لَمُخۡرَجُونَ

en.text: And those who disbelieve say, "When we have become dust as well as our forefathers, will we indeed be brought out [of the graves]?

so.text: 67. Kuwa gaalooba waxay dhahaan: Ma markaan noqonno carro, innaga iyo aabba- yaashayo, miyaa nala soo bixin (mar kale)?

ayat.arabic: لَقَدۡ وُعِدۡنَا هَٰذَا نَحۡنُ وَءَابَآؤُنَا مِن قَبۡلُ إِنۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّآ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ

en.text: We have been promised this, we and our forefathers, before. This is not but legends of the former peoples."

so.text: 68. Waxaa naloo yaboohay (arrin)kan, innaga iyo aabbayaashayaba mar hore, waxakanu ma aha waxaan aheyn sheeko xariirtii kuwii hore.

ayat.arabic: قُلۡ سِيرُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَٱنظُرُواْ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ

en.text: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Proceed [i.e., travel] through the land and observe how was the end of the criminals."

so.text: 69. Dheh: Mara dhulka, markaas fiiriya siday aheyd cidhibtii denbiilayaasha.

ayat.arabic: وَلَا تَحۡزَنۡ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَلَا تَكُن فِي ضَيۡقٖ مِّمَّا يَمۡكُرُونَ

en.text: And grieve not over them or be in distress from what they conspire.

so.text: 70. Ee ha u murugoon, hana ka cidhiidhyamin waxay dhagar dhigi darteed.

ayat.arabic: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلۡوَعۡدُ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ

en.text: And they say, "When is [the fulfillment of] this promise, if you should be truthful?"

so.text: 71. Waxay yidhaahdaan: Waa goorma yaboohaasi haddaad run sheegaysaan?

ayat.arabic: قُلۡ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونَ رَدِفَ لَكُم بَعۡضُ ٱلَّذِي تَسۡتَعۡجِلُونَ

en.text: Say, "Perhaps it is close behind you [i.e., very near] - some of that for which you are impatient.

so.text: 72. Dheh: Waa intaasoo ay yihiin wax dhow oo gadaashiinna ah qaar ka mid ah waxaad rabtaan in la soo dedjiyo (Cadaabka).

ayat.arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَذُو فَضۡلٍ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَا يَشۡكُرُونَ

en.text: And indeed, your Lord is the possessor of bounty for the people, but most of them are not grateful."

so.text: 73. Hubaalna Rabbigaa waa u Roon yahay dadka, badankooduse ma mahad naqaan.

ayat.arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَيَعۡلَمُ مَا تُكِنُّ صُدُورُهُمۡ وَمَا يُعۡلِنُونَ

en.text: And indeed, your Lord knows what their breasts conceal and what they declare.

so.text: 74. Xaqiiq Rabbigaa waa Og yahay waxay laabahoodu qarin iyo waxay muujinba.

ayat.arabic: وَمَا مِنۡ غَآئِبَةٖ فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ إِلَّا فِي كِتَٰبٖ مُّبِينٍ

en.text: And there is nothing concealed[1085] within the heaven and the earth except that it is in a clear Register.[1086]
en.footnotes:
[1085] Literally, "absent [from the senses]."
[1086] The Preserved Slate (al-Lawḥ al-Maḥfūẓ), which is with Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā).

so.text: 75. Ma jiro wax ku qarsoon samada iyo arlada oo aan ku qorneyni Kitaab cad [23].
so.footnotes: [23]. Looxa Maxfuudka.
