ayat.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ يَقُصُّ عَلَىٰ بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ أَكۡثَرَ ٱلَّذِي هُمۡ فِيهِ يَخۡتَلِفُونَ

en.text: Indeed, this Qur’ān relates to the Children of Israel most of that over which they disagree.

so.text: 76. Xaqiiq, Qur’aankani wuxuu kaga warrami reer Israa’iil badi waxay isku hayeen oo ay isku khilaafsanaayeen.

ayat.arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَهُدٗى وَرَحۡمَةٞ لِّلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ

en.text: And indeed, it is guidance and mercy for the believers.

so.text: 77. Xaqiiqna, waa u Hanuun iyo Naxariis mu’miniinta.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَقۡضِي بَيۡنَهُم بِحُكۡمِهِۦۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ

en.text: Indeed, your Lord will judge between them by His [wise] judgement. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.

so.text: 78. Hubaal Rabbigaa wuxuu ugu kala garsoori dhexdooda xukunkiisa, waana Adkaadaha, wax kasta Ogsoon.

ayat.arabic: فَتَوَكَّلۡ عَلَى ٱللَّهِۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَى ٱلۡحَقِّ ٱلۡمُبِينِ

en.text: So rely upon Allāh; indeed, you are upon the clear truth.

so.text: 79. Ee talo saaro Alle; hubaal, waxaad ku sugan tahay Xaq Cad.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّكَ لَا تُسۡمِعُ ٱلۡمَوۡتَىٰ وَلَا تُسۡمِعُ ٱلصُّمَّ ٱلدُّعَآءَ إِذَا وَلَّوۡاْ مُدۡبِرِينَ

en.text: Indeed, you will not make the dead hear, nor will you make the deaf hear the call when they have turned their backs retreating.

so.text:
80. Adigu dhabtii wax ma maqashiin kartid    
 meytida, mana maqashiin kartid dhagoolaha dhawaaqa markay tagaan oo dhabarka jeediyaan.

ayat.arabic: وَمَآ أَنتَ بِهَٰدِي ٱلۡعُمۡيِ عَن ضَلَٰلَتِهِمۡۖ إِن تُسۡمِعُ إِلَّا مَن يُؤۡمِنُ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا فَهُم مُّسۡلِمُونَ

en.text: And you cannot guide the blind away from their error. You will only make hear those who believe in Our verses so they are Muslims [i.e., submitting to Allāh].

so.text: 81. Oo ma thid mid ka toosin kara indhoolayaasha habowgooda, cidna wax wax maqashiin kartid aan ahayn kuwa rumeysan Aayadahayaga ee iyagu  Muslimiin ah (Alle u hoggaansan).

ayat.arabic: ۞ وَإِذَا وَقَعَ ٱلۡقَوۡلُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ أَخۡرَجۡنَا لَهُمۡ دَآبَّةٗ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ تُكَلِّمُهُمۡ أَنَّ ٱلنَّاسَ كَانُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا لَا يُوقِنُونَ

en.text: And when the word [i.e., decree] befalls them,[1087] We will bring forth for them a creature from the earth speaking to them, [saying] that the people were, of Our verses, not certain [in faith].
en.footnotes: [1087] At the approach of the Hour.

so.text: 82. Markuu Qawlka (Cadaabka) ku fulo dushooda [24], Waxaan uga soo bixin Neef (dugaag) arlada la hadleysa inay dadku ahaayeen kuwo aan yaqiinsaneyn Aayadahayaga.
so.footnotes: [24]. Markay soo dhowaato Saacadda Qiyaame.

ayat.arabic: وَيَوۡمَ نَحۡشُرُ مِن كُلِّ أُمَّةٖ فَوۡجٗا مِّمَّن يُكَذِّبُ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا فَهُمۡ يُوزَعُونَ

en.text: And [warn of] the Day when We will gather from every nation a company of those who deny Our signs, and they will be [driven] in rows

so.text: 83. (Oo ka dig) Maalintaan ka soo saari ummad walba koox ah kuwii beeniyey Aayadahayaga iyagoo is cidhiidhyi.

ayat.arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءُو قَالَ أَكَذَّبۡتُم بِـَٔايَٰتِي وَلَمۡ تُحِيطُواْ بِهَا عِلۡمًا أَمَّاذَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ

en.text: Until, when they arrive [at the place of Judgement], He will say, "Did you deny My signs while you encompassed them not in knowledge, or what [was it that] you were doing?"

so.text: 84. Ilaa markay yimaadaan (Rabbigood hortiis) Wuxuu ku odhan: Ma waxaad beeniseen Aayadahaygii idinkoon ku koobin cilmi, maxaadse fali jirteen?

ayat.arabic: وَوَقَعَ ٱلۡقَوۡلُ عَلَيۡهِم بِمَا ظَلَمُواْ فَهُمۡ لَا يَنطِقُونَ

en.text: And the decree will befall them[1088] for the wrong they did, and they will not [be able to] speak.
en.footnotes: [1088] Allāh's decree will come into effect upon them, and His promise will be fulfilled.

so.text: 85.Waxaa ku fuli Qowlkii 'Cadaabka' [25], dulmigoodii darti, marka ma hadlayaan.
so.footnotes: [25]. Qaddarka Alle baa ku dhaboobi korkooda, oo yaboohiisa waa fuli.

ayat.arabic: أَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ أَنَّا جَعَلۡنَا ٱلَّيۡلَ لِيَسۡكُنُواْ فِيهِ وَٱلنَّهَارَ مُبۡصِرًاۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّقَوۡمٖ يُؤۡمِنُونَ

en.text: Do they not see that We made the night that they may rest therein and the day giving sight? Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe.

so.text: 86. Mawaysan arkayn inaan uga yeelnay habeenka inay ku xasilaan, Maalintana iftiin? Hubaal, arrinkani waxaa ugu sugan calaamooyin ciddii rumeyn (Xaqa).

ayat.arabic: وَيَوۡمَ يُنفَخُ فِي ٱلصُّورِ فَفَزِعَ مَن فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَن فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ إِلَّا مَن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُۚ وَكُلٌّ أَتَوۡهُ دَٰخِرِينَ

en.text: And [warn of] the Day the Horn will be blown, and whoever is in the heavens and whoever is on the earth will be terrified except whom Allāh wills. And all will come to Him humbled.

so.text: 87. (Ka dig) Maalinta buunka la afuufi, oo ay argagixi kuwa ku sugan cirarka iyo kuwa ku sugan dhulka cidduu Alle doono mooyee, kullina waxay u imaan iyagoo dullaysan.

ayat.arabic: وَتَرَى ٱلۡجِبَالَ تَحۡسَبُهَا جَامِدَةٗ وَهِيَ تَمُرُّ مَرَّ ٱلسَّحَابِۚ صُنۡعَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَتۡقَنَ كُلَّ شَيۡءٍۚ إِنَّهُۥ خَبِيرُۢ بِمَا تَفۡعَلُونَ

en.text: And you see the mountains, thinking them motionless,[1089] while they will pass as the passing of clouds. [It is] the work of Allāh, who perfected all things. Indeed, He is Aware of that which you do.
en.footnotes: [1089] Or "solid and rigid."

so.text: 88. Waxaad arkaysaa buurahii aad u maleyn wax adag oo sugan, iyagoo socon socodka daruuraha oo kale, waa Sancada Alle ee hagaajiyey wax waliba. Hubaal, waa u Xog ogaal waxaad fashaan.

ayat.arabic: مَن جَآءَ بِٱلۡحَسَنَةِ فَلَهُۥ خَيۡرٞ مِّنۡهَا وَهُم مِّن فَزَعٖ يَوۡمَئِذٍ ءَامِنُونَ

en.text: Whoever comes [at Judgement] with a good deed will have better than it, and they, from the terror of that Day, will be safe.

so.text: 89. Qofkii la yimaada wanaag [26] wuxuu leeyahay wax ka khayr badan (Janno), argagaxa Maalinta (Qiyaamena) waa ka aamin.
so.footnotes: [26]. Halkan wanaagga waxaa loola jeedaa towxiidka iyo camal kastoo san.

ayat.arabic: وَمَن جَآءَ بِٱلسَّيِّئَةِ فَكُبَّتۡ وُجُوهُهُمۡ فِي ٱلنَّارِ هَلۡ تُجۡزَوۡنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ

en.text: And whoever comes with an evil deed[1090] - their faces will be overturned into the Fire, [and it will be said], "Are you recompensed except for what you used to do?"
en.footnotes: [1090] Without having repented. It may refer generally to any sin or more specifically to association of another with Allāh.

so.text: 90. Qofkiise la yimaada xumaan [27] waxaa loogu tuuri weji weji Naarta: Ma waxaa la idinku abaal marin waxaan ahayn waxaad fasheen (wax la mid ah oo xumaan ah)?
so.footnotes: [27]. Halkan xumaanta waxaa loola jeedaa shirkiga iyo macaasida.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّمَآ أُمِرۡتُ أَنۡ أَعۡبُدَ رَبَّ هَٰذِهِ ٱلۡبَلۡدَةِ ٱلَّذِي حَرَّمَهَا وَلَهُۥ كُلُّ شَيۡءٖۖ وَأُمِرۡتُ أَنۡ أَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُسۡلِمِينَ

en.text: [Say, O Muḥammad], "I have only been commanded to worship the Lord of this city,[1091] who made it sacred and to whom [belongs] all things. And I am commanded to be of the Muslims [i.e., those who submit to Allāh]
en.footnotes: [1091] Or region, meaning Makkah and its surroundings.

so.text: 91. Waxaa aniga la I amray sideedaba in aan caabudo Rabbiga magaaladaan [28] (Makkah) ee ah Kan xurmada u yeelay oo iska leh wax walba. Waxaana la I amray inaan ka mid ahaado Muslimiinta (kuwa isu dhiiba Alle ee u hoggaansan).
so.footnotes: [28]. Waxaa loola jeedaa Makkah iyo hareeraheeda.

ayat.arabic: وَأَنۡ أَتۡلُوَاْ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَۖ فَمَنِ ٱهۡتَدَىٰ فَإِنَّمَا يَهۡتَدِي لِنَفۡسِهِۦۖ وَمَن ضَلَّ فَقُلۡ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلۡمُنذِرِينَ

en.text: And to recite the Qur’ān." And whoever is guided is only guided for [the benefit of] himself; and whoever strays - say, "I am only [one] of the warners."

so.text: 92. Iyo inaan akhriyo Qur’aanka. Qofkii hanuuna, wuxuu uun u hanuunaa naftiisa,  qofkiise lumaa, dheh: Anigu waxaan ahay uun mid ka mid ah digayaasha.

ayat.arabic: وَقُلِ ٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِ سَيُرِيكُمۡ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ فَتَعۡرِفُونَهَاۚ وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِغَٰفِلٍ عَمَّا تَعۡمَلُونَ

en.text: And say, "[All] praise is [due] to Allāh. He will show you His signs, and you will recognize them. And your Lord is not unaware of what you do."

so.text: 93. Dheh: Ammaan idilkeed iyo mahad waxaa leh Alle. Wuxuu idin tusi calaamoo- yinkiisa, waadna garan doontaan. Ma aha Rabbigaa mid moog waxaad falaysaan.

ayat.arabic: طسٓمٓ

en.text: Ṭā, Seen, Meem.[1093]
en.footnotes: [1093] See footnote to 2:1.

so.text: 1. Daa siin Miim [1].
so.footnotes: [1]. Eeg sharaxa Suuradda 2 Al-Baqarah: Aayadda 1.

ayat.arabic: تِلۡكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ ٱلۡمُبِينِ

en.text: These are verses of the clear Book.

so.text: 2. Kuwakani waa Aayadaha Kitaabka (Qur’aanka) ee cad.

ayat.arabic: نَتۡلُواْ عَلَيۡكَ مِن نَّبَإِ مُوسَىٰ وَفِرۡعَوۡنَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ لِقَوۡمٖ يُؤۡمِنُونَ

en.text: We recite to you from the news of Moses and Pharaoh in truth for a people who believe.

so.text: 3. Waxaan kugu akhrin wax ka mid ah warkii Muuse iyo Fircoon oo xaq ah ciddii rumayn.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ فِرۡعَوۡنَ عَلَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَجَعَلَ أَهۡلَهَا شِيَعٗا يَسۡتَضۡعِفُ طَآئِفَةٗ مِّنۡهُمۡ يُذَبِّحُ أَبۡنَآءَهُمۡ وَيَسۡتَحۡيِۦ نِسَآءَهُمۡۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُفۡسِدِينَ

en.text: Indeed, Pharaoh exalted himself in the land and made its people into factions, oppressing a sector among them, slaughtering their [newborn] sons and keeping their females alive. Indeed, he was of the corrupters.

so.text: 4. Hubaal, Fircoon waa isku sare yeelay dhulka, wuxuuna ka yeelay dadkeedii kooxo, isagoo dulleysan (dulmin) koox ka mid ah (reer Israa’iil), gowracaya wiilashooda, una deynaya nolol haweenkooda (si ay ugu adeegtaan). hubaal, wuxuu ka mid ahaa kuwa wax fasaadiya (xumo wadeenka).

ayat.arabic: وَنُرِيدُ أَن نَّمُنَّ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسۡتُضۡعِفُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَنَجۡعَلَهُمۡ أَئِمَّةٗ وَنَجۡعَلَهُمُ ٱلۡوَٰرِثِينَ

en.text: And We wanted to confer favor upon those who were oppressed in the land and make them leaders and make them inheritors

so.text: 5. Waxaana doonnay inaan u galno wanaag kuwii loo arkay daciif ee lagu dulleysanayey arlada, kana yeello hooggaamiyayaal, oo ka yeello iyaga dhaxlayaasha (arlada Masar).

ayat.arabic: وَنُمَكِّنَ لَهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَنُرِيَ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَهَٰمَٰنَ وَجُنُودَهُمَا مِنۡهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يَحۡذَرُونَ

en.text: And establish them in the land and show Pharaoh and [his minister] Hāmān and their soldiers through them[1094] that which they had feared.
en.footnotes: [1094] By means of those whom they had oppressed and enslaved.

so.text: 6. Oo aan ku awood siinno arlada oo tusinno  Fircoon iyo Haamaan iyo askartoodii waxay ka digtoonaayeen [2].
so.footnotes: [2]. Inaan ku caddibno isla gacanta kuway ku gardarroonayeen oo addoonsayeen.

ayat.arabic: وَأَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنۡ أَرۡضِعِيهِۖ فَإِذَا خِفۡتِ عَلَيۡهِ فَأَلۡقِيهِ فِي ٱلۡيَمِّ وَلَا تَخَافِي وَلَا تَحۡزَنِيٓۖ إِنَّا رَآدُّوهُ إِلَيۡكِ وَجَاعِلُوهُ مِنَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ

en.text: And We inspired to the mother of Moses, "Suckle him; but when you fear for him, cast him into the river and do not fear and do not grieve. Indeed, We will return him to you and will make him [one] of the messengers."

so.text: 7. Waxaan u waxyoonnay Muuse hooyadi (Annagoo leh): Nuuji (Muuse), markaadse u cabsato ku tuur webiga (Niil), ha cabsan, hana murugoon. Annagaa kuu soo celin, oo ka yeeli mid ka mid ah Rususha (Alle).

ayat.arabic: فَٱلۡتَقَطَهُۥٓ ءَالُ فِرۡعَوۡنَ لِيَكُونَ لَهُمۡ عَدُوّٗا وَحَزَنًاۗ إِنَّ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَهَٰمَٰنَ وَجُنُودَهُمَا كَانُواْ خَٰطِـِٔينَ

en.text: And the family of Pharaoh picked him up [out of the river] so that he would become to them an enemy and a [cause of] grief. Indeed, Pharaoh and Hāmān and their soldiers were deliberate sinners.

so.text: 8. Waxaa soo qaatay reer Fircoon isagoo u noqon cadow iyo (sabab u keenta ciil iyo) murugo. Hubaal Fircoon iyo Haamaan iyo askartoodii waxay ahaayeen kuwo gef badan.

ayat.arabic: وَقَالَتِ ٱمۡرَأَتُ فِرۡعَوۡنَ قُرَّتُ عَيۡنٖ لِّي وَلَكَۖ لَا تَقۡتُلُوهُ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَنفَعَنَآ أَوۡ نَتَّخِذَهُۥ وَلَدٗا وَهُمۡ لَا يَشۡعُرُونَ

en.text: And the wife of Pharaoh said, "[He will be] a comfort of the eye [i.e., pleasure] for me and for you. Do not kill him; perhaps he may benefit us, or we may adopt him as a son." And they perceived not.[1095]
en.footnotes: [1095] What would be the result of that.

so.text: 9. Marwadii Fircoon waxay tidhi: Waa il qabawsigeenna aniga iyo adigaba. Ha dilina, waa intaasoo uu na anfaco ama aan ka dhiganno wiil, iyagoon dareensaneyn [3].
so.footnotes: [3]. Waxay noqon doonto cidhibta arrinkaasi.

ayat.arabic: وَأَصۡبَحَ فُؤَادُ أُمِّ مُوسَىٰ فَٰرِغًاۖ إِن كَادَتۡ لَتُبۡدِي بِهِۦ لَوۡلَآ أَن رَّبَطۡنَا عَلَىٰ قَلۡبِهَا لِتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ

en.text: And the heart of Moses' mother became empty [of all else]. She was about to disclose [the matter concerning] him had We not bound fast her heart that she would be of the believers.

so.text: 10. Wuxuu ahaaday qalbigii Muuse hooyadi mid maran [4], waxay ku sigatay inay kashifto (arrinkiisa) haddaanaan adkaynin qalbigeeda si ay uga mid ahaato mu’miniinta.
so.footnotes: [4]  ka maran arrin kaloo dhan ka fekerka wiilkeeda Muuse ma ahee.

ayat.arabic: وَقَالَتۡ لِأُخۡتِهِۦ قُصِّيهِۖ فَبَصُرَتۡ بِهِۦ عَن جُنُبٖ وَهُمۡ لَا يَشۡعُرُونَ

en.text: And she said to his sister, "Follow him"; so she watched him from a distance while they perceived not.

so.text: 11. Waxay ku tidhi walaashiis (Miriam): Raad raac, waxayna ka eegeysay dhinac fog si qarsoodi ah iyagoon dareemeyn.

ayat.arabic: ۞ وَحَرَّمۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ ٱلۡمَرَاضِعَ مِن قَبۡلُ فَقَالَتۡ هَلۡ أَدُلُّكُمۡ عَلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِ بَيۡتٖ يَكۡفُلُونَهُۥ لَكُمۡ وَهُمۡ لَهُۥ نَٰصِحُونَ

en.text: And We had prevented from him [all] wet nurses before,[1096] so she said, "Shall I direct you to a household that will be responsible for him for you while they are to him [for his upbringing] sincere?"
en.footnotes: [1096] Prior to that, Moses had refused to nurse from any other woman.

so.text: 12. Waxaanu horey u qaddarnay inuu diido nuujiso (kale) oo dhan [5], markaasay (walaashiis timid oo) tidhi: Ma idin tusaa reer idiin daryeelaya, oo iyagu u roonaan.
so.footnotes: [5]. Muuse wuu diiday inay nuujiso haweeney kale oo dhan aan ahayn hooyadiis.

ayat.arabic: فَرَدَدۡنَٰهُ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّهِۦ كَيۡ تَقَرَّ عَيۡنُهَا وَلَا تَحۡزَنَ وَلِتَعۡلَمَ أَنَّ وَعۡدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقّٞ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ

en.text: So We restored him to his mother that she might be content and not grieve and that she would know that the promise of Allāh is true. But most of them [i.e., the people] do not know.

so.text: 13. Waxaan ku soo celinnay hooyadiis si ay u il qabawsato oo u murugoon, una ogaato in wacadka Alle Xaq yahay, dadka badankiisuse ma ogsoona.

ayat.arabic: وَلَمَّا بَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُۥ وَٱسۡتَوَىٰٓ ءَاتَيۡنَٰهُ حُكۡمٗا وَعِلۡمٗاۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ

en.text: And when he attained his full strength and was [mentally] mature, We bestowed upon him judgement and knowledge. And thus do We reward the doers of good.

so.text: 14. Markuu (Muuse) tabar galay oo buuxsamay (caqli ahaan), Waxaanu siinnay garsoor wanaagsan iyo cilmi. Sidaasaan ku abaal marinnaa sama falayaasha.

ayat.arabic: وَدَخَلَ ٱلۡمَدِينَةَ عَلَىٰ حِينِ غَفۡلَةٖ مِّنۡ أَهۡلِهَا فَوَجَدَ فِيهَا رَجُلَيۡنِ يَقۡتَتِلَانِ هَٰذَا مِن شِيعَتِهِۦ وَهَٰذَا مِنۡ عَدُوِّهِۦۖ فَٱسۡتَغَٰثَهُ ٱلَّذِي مِن شِيعَتِهِۦ عَلَى ٱلَّذِي مِنۡ عَدُوِّهِۦ فَوَكَزَهُۥ مُوسَىٰ فَقَضَىٰ عَلَيۡهِۖ قَالَ هَٰذَا مِنۡ عَمَلِ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنِۖ إِنَّهُۥ عَدُوّٞ مُّضِلّٞ مُّبِينٞ

en.text: And he entered the city at a time of inattention by its people[1097] and found therein two men fighting: one from his faction and one from among his enemy. And the one from his faction called for help to him against the one from his enemy, so Moses struck him and [unintentionally] killed him. [Moses] said, "This is from the work of Satan. Indeed, he is a manifest, misleading enemy."
en.footnotes: [1097] i.e., during the noon period of rest.

so.text: 15. Wuxuu soo galay magaalada gooray war la' yihiin dadkeedu [6], markaasuu wuxuu kula kulmay halkaa labo nin oo diriraya -  midi ka mid yahay qoladiisa [7], kan kalena ka tirsan yahay cadowgiisa. Ninkii qoladiisa ahaa baa uga kaalmo warsaday oo qeyshaday xagga kii ahaa cadowgiisa, markaasuu Muuse feedhay mar keliya oo kaw kaga siiyey. (Muuse) wuxuu yidhi: kanu waa camal Shaydaan, hubaal waa cadow, wax dhumiya oo cad.
so.footnotes:
[6]. Waxay aheyd harsiimadii goor Duhur ah ay dadku nasanayeen. 
[7]. Muslim - ka mid ahaa ilmahii Israa’iil, kan kalena ee cadowgiisa ah wuxuu ahaa qoladii Fircoon Qibdi Masri ah.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّي ظَلَمۡتُ نَفۡسِي فَٱغۡفِرۡ لِي فَغَفَرَ لَهُۥٓۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

en.text: He said, "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, so forgive me," and He forgave him. Indeed, He is the Forgiving, the Merciful.

so.text: 16. (Muuse) wuxuu yidhi: Rabbiyow! Waxaan dulmiyey naftayda ee ii denbi dhaaf, wuuna u denbi dhaafay. Hubaal Alle waa Denbi Dhaaf Badanaha, Naxariista Badan.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَآ أَنۡعَمۡتَ عَلَيَّ فَلَنۡ أَكُونَ ظَهِيرٗا لِّلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ

en.text: He said, "My Lord, for the favor You bestowed upon me, I will never be an assistant to the criminals."

so.text: 17. (Muuse) wuxuu yidhi:Rabbiyow!Waxaad igu galladeysatay darteed (oo denbi dhaaf ah), marnaba dib dambe uguma noqon doono caawiye denbiilayaasha.

ayat.arabic: فَأَصۡبَحَ فِي ٱلۡمَدِينَةِ خَآئِفٗا يَتَرَقَّبُ فَإِذَا ٱلَّذِي ٱسۡتَنصَرَهُۥ بِٱلۡأَمۡسِ يَسۡتَصۡرِخُهُۥۚ قَالَ لَهُۥ مُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّكَ لَغَوِيّٞ مُّبِينٞ

en.text: And he became inside the city fearful and anticipating [exposure], when suddenly the one who sought his help the previous day cried out to him [once again]. Moses said to him, "Indeed, you are an evident, [persistent] deviator."

so.text: 18. Wuxuu ku sugnaa magaalada isagoo cabsanaya, digtoon, mise kii gargaarka warsaday maalintii hore baa u qeyshanaya inuu u soo hiilliyo (mar kale). (Muuse) wuxuu ku yidhi: Adigu waxaad tahay baadiyeeye iska cad.

ayat.arabic: فَلَمَّآ أَنۡ أَرَادَ أَن يَبۡطِشَ بِٱلَّذِي هُوَ عَدُوّٞ لَّهُمَا قَالَ يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ أَتُرِيدُ أَن تَقۡتُلَنِي كَمَا قَتَلۡتَ نَفۡسَۢا بِٱلۡأَمۡسِۖ إِن تُرِيدُ إِلَّآ أَن تَكُونَ جَبَّارٗا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا تُرِيدُ أَن تَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُصۡلِحِينَ

en.text: And when he wanted to strike the one who was an enemy to both of them, he[1098] said, "O Moses, do you intend to kill me as you killed someone yesterday? You only want to be a tyrant in the land and do not want to be of the amenders."
en.footnotes: [1098] i.e., the Israelite, thinking that Moses meant to strike him. Some commentators have attributed the words to the Copt; however, the Israelite was the only one who knew of the previous occurrence.

so.text: 19. Markuu se doonay inuu qabto (oo wax yeelo) kii cadowga u ahaa, wuxuu yidhi: Muusow! Ma waxaad dooneysaa inaad I disho sidaad u dishayba naf (kale) shalay? Ma dooneysid waxaan aheyn inaad ka noqoto macangag isla weyn arlada, mana dooneysid inaad ka mid ahaato kuwa wax hagaajiya [8].
so.footnotes: [8]. Waxaa sidaa yidhi ninkii israa’iiliga ahaa isagoo moodaya inuu Muuse doonayo inuu garaaco isaga.

ayat.arabic: وَجَآءَ رَجُلٞ مِّنۡ أَقۡصَا ٱلۡمَدِينَةِ يَسۡعَىٰ قَالَ يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّ ٱلۡمَلَأَ يَأۡتَمِرُونَ بِكَ لِيَقۡتُلُوكَ فَٱخۡرُجۡ إِنِّي لَكَ مِنَ ٱلنَّٰصِحِينَ

en.text: And a man came from the farthest end of the city, running. He said, "O Moses, indeed the eminent ones are conferring over you [intending] to kill you, so leave [the city]; indeed, I am to you of the sincere advisors."

so.text: 20. Nin baa ka yimid magaalada xaggeeda shishe isagoo rooraya. Wuxuu yidhi: Muusow! Xildhibaannadii waxay ku tashanayaan inay ku dilaan ee baxso, waxaan anigu xaqiiq kuu ahay daacade.

ayat.arabic: فَخَرَجَ مِنۡهَا خَآئِفٗا يَتَرَقَّبُۖ قَالَ رَبِّ نَجِّنِي مِنَ ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ

en.text: So he left it, fearful and anticipating [apprehension]. He said, "My Lord, save me from the wrongdoing people."

so.text: 21. Markaasuu (Muuse) ka baxay (magaalada) isagoo cabsanaya, digtoon. Wuxuuna yidhi: Rabbiyow! Iga badbaadi qolodaa daalimiinta (gar diidka) ah.

ayat.arabic: وَلَمَّا تَوَجَّهَ تِلۡقَآءَ مَدۡيَنَ قَالَ عَسَىٰ رَبِّيٓ أَن يَهۡدِيَنِي سَوَآءَ ٱلسَّبِيلِ

en.text: And when he directed himself toward Madyan, he said, "Perhaps my Lord will guide me to the sound way."

so.text: 22. Markuu u jahaystay xagga (arlada) Madyan wuxuu yidhi: Waa intaasoo Rabbigay igu hanuuniyo dhabbo Toosan.

ayat.arabic: وَلَمَّا وَرَدَ مَآءَ مَدۡيَنَ وَجَدَ عَلَيۡهِ أُمَّةٗ مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِ يَسۡقُونَ وَوَجَدَ مِن دُونِهِمُ ٱمۡرَأَتَيۡنِ تَذُودَانِۖ قَالَ مَا خَطۡبُكُمَاۖ قَالَتَا لَا نَسۡقِي حَتَّىٰ يُصۡدِرَ ٱلرِّعَآءُۖ وَأَبُونَا شَيۡخٞ كَبِيرٞ

en.text: And when he came to the water [i.e., well] of Madyan, he found there a crowd of people watering [their flocks], and he found aside from them two women holding back [their flocks]. He said, "What is your circumstance?" They said, "We do not water until the shepherds dispatch [their flocks]; and our father is an old man."

so.text: 23. Markuu soo gaaray biyihii Madyan wuxuu ka helay halkaa koox rag ah oo waraabsanaya (xoolahooda), sokadooda wuxuu ka helay labo haween ah oo horaya (xoolahooda). (Muuse) wuxuu yidhi: Muxuu xaalkiinnu yahay? Waxay yidhaahdeen: Ma waraabinno (xoolaheenna) jeeray raacata- du fulaan oo kaxeystaan (xoolahooda), aabbaheenna waa oday weyn oo da' ah.

ayat.arabic: فَسَقَىٰ لَهُمَا ثُمَّ تَوَلَّىٰٓ إِلَى ٱلظِّلِّ فَقَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّي لِمَآ أَنزَلۡتَ إِلَيَّ مِنۡ خَيۡرٖ فَقِيرٞ

en.text: So he watered [their flocks] for them; then he went back to the shade and said, "My Lord, indeed I am, for whatever good You would send down to me, in need."

so.text: 24. Markaasuu u waraabiyey (xoolahoodii), wuxuuna u jeesaday oo aaday xagga meel har leh, oo yidhi: Rabbiyow! Waxaad I siiso oo khayr ah waan u baahnahay.

ayat.arabic: فَجَآءَتۡهُ إِحۡدَىٰهُمَا تَمۡشِي عَلَى ٱسۡتِحۡيَآءٖ قَالَتۡ إِنَّ أَبِي يَدۡعُوكَ لِيَجۡزِيَكَ أَجۡرَ مَا سَقَيۡتَ لَنَاۚ فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُۥ وَقَصَّ عَلَيۡهِ ٱلۡقَصَصَ قَالَ لَا تَخَفۡۖ نَجَوۡتَ مِنَ ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ

en.text: Then one of the two women came to him walking with shyness. She said, "Indeed, my father invites you that he may reward you for having watered for us." So when he came to him[1099] and related to him the story, he said, "Fear not. You have escaped from the wrongdoing people."
en.footnotes: [1099] Prophet Shuʿayb, the father of the two women.

so.text: 25. Markaasaa labadii gabdhood middood u timid iyadoo u soconaysa si xishood leh oo tidhi: Aabbahay baa kuu yeedhaya si uu kuu siiyo abaalgudka waraabintii darteed aad noo waraabisay (xoolahayaga). Markuu u yimid [9] oo uga warramay wixii qisooyin dhacay, wuxuu yidhi: Ha cabsan. Waad ka badbaadday qoloda daalimiinta (gar ma qaatayaasha) ah.
so.footnotes: [9]. Wuxuu ahaa nin saalix ah, aabbaha labadaasi gabdhood la yidhaahdo Shucayb - Jethro.

ayat.arabic: قَالَتۡ إِحۡدَىٰهُمَا يَٰٓأَبَتِ ٱسۡتَـٔۡجِرۡهُۖ إِنَّ خَيۡرَ مَنِ ٱسۡتَـٔۡجَرۡتَ ٱلۡقَوِيُّ ٱلۡأَمِينُ

en.text: One of the women said, "O my father, hire him. Indeed, the best one you can hire is the strong and the trustworthy."

so.text: 26. Waxay tidhi middood (labadii gabdhood): Aabbow ijaaro! Hubaal waxaa u fiican cid la ijaarto xoog badanaha, aaminka ah [10].
so.footnotes: [10]. Iyadoo u sheegtay inuu dhagax aad u weyn keligi ceelka afki ka qaaday, inuu ku yidhi, 'socda gadaasheyda', iyo inuu markay u imaneysay uu hoos madaxa u dhigay,  oo aanu fiirinin.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ إِنِّيٓ أُرِيدُ أَنۡ أُنكِحَكَ إِحۡدَى ٱبۡنَتَيَّ هَٰتَيۡنِ عَلَىٰٓ أَن تَأۡجُرَنِي ثَمَٰنِيَ حِجَجٖۖ فَإِنۡ أَتۡمَمۡتَ عَشۡرٗا فَمِنۡ عِندِكَۖ وَمَآ أُرِيدُ أَنۡ أَشُقَّ عَلَيۡكَۚ سَتَجِدُنِيٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ

en.text: He said, "Indeed, I wish to wed you one of these, my two daughters, on [the condition] that you serve me for eight years; but if you complete ten, it will be [as a favor] from you. And I do not wish to put you in difficulty. You will find me, if Allāh wills, from among the righteous."

so.text: 27. (Shucayb - Jethro) wuxuu yidhi: Waxaan rabaa inaan kuu guuriyo mid ka mid ah labadaydaan gabdhood, waxaase shardi ah inaad ii shaqeyso siddeed sano, haddiise aad buuxiso toban, waxay ahaan (axsaan) xaggaaga ah, ma doonayo inaan ku dhibo. Haddii Alle idmo, waxaad heli (igu ogaan) inaan ka mid ahay kuwa wanaagsan.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ ذَٰلِكَ بَيۡنِي وَبَيۡنَكَۖ أَيَّمَا ٱلۡأَجَلَيۡنِ قَضَيۡتُ فَلَا عُدۡوَٰنَ عَلَيَّۖ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ مَا نَقُولُ وَكِيلٞ

en.text: [Moses] said, "That is [established] between me and you. Whichever of the two terms I complete - there is no injustice to me, and Allāh, over what we say, is Witness."

so.text: 28. (Muuse) wuxuu yidhi: Sidaasi waa (ballan) dhexdeenna ah aniga iyo adiga midkaan labada muddo oofiyo, ma jiri doonto wax laygu colaadiyo, Alle baana ka damiin 'markhaati' ah waxaanu sheegeyno.

ayat.arabic: ۞ فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ مُوسَى ٱلۡأَجَلَ وَسَارَ بِأَهۡلِهِۦٓ ءَانَسَ مِن جَانِبِ ٱلطُّورِ نَارٗاۖ قَالَ لِأَهۡلِهِ ٱمۡكُثُوٓاْ إِنِّيٓ ءَانَسۡتُ نَارٗا لَّعَلِّيٓ ءَاتِيكُم مِّنۡهَا بِخَبَرٍ أَوۡ جَذۡوَةٖ مِّنَ ٱلنَّارِ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَصۡطَلُونَ

en.text: And when Moses had completed the term and was traveling with his family, he perceived from the direction of the mount a fire. He said to his family, "Stay here; indeed, I have perceived a fire. Perhaps I will bring you from there [some] information or burning wood from the fire that you may warm yourselves."

so.text: 29. Markuu dhammaystay Muuse muddadii (toban sano), oo la tagay reerkiisii iyagoo jidka haya (u socda Masar) buu wuxuu ka arkay dhinaca buurta (Duur) dab, wuxuu ku yidhi reerkiisii: “Suga, waxaan arkay dab, waa intaasoo aan idiinka keeno war ama dhimibil dab ah inaad kulaashaan.

ayat.arabic: فَلَمَّآ أَتَىٰهَا نُودِيَ مِن شَٰطِيِٕ ٱلۡوَادِ ٱلۡأَيۡمَنِ فِي ٱلۡبُقۡعَةِ ٱلۡمُبَٰرَكَةِ مِنَ ٱلشَّجَرَةِ أَن يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ إِنِّيٓ أَنَا ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

en.text: But when he came to it, he was called from the right side of the valley in a blessed spot - from the tree,[1100] "O Moses, indeed I am Allāh, Lord of the worlds."
en.footnotes: [1100] Which was within the fire.

so.text: 30. Markuu yimid halkii (dabka), cod baa ka dhawaaqay dhanka midig ee togga ee rugta barakaysan ee geedka [11] leh: “Muusow! Waxaan Anigu ahay Allaah, Rabbigii uumanka.
so.footnotes: [11]. Geedkaasoo dabka gudahiisa ahaa.

ayat.arabic: وَأَنۡ أَلۡقِ عَصَاكَۚ فَلَمَّا رَءَاهَا تَهۡتَزُّ كَأَنَّهَا جَآنّٞ وَلَّىٰ مُدۡبِرٗا وَلَمۡ يُعَقِّبۡۚ يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ أَقۡبِلۡ وَلَا تَخَفۡۖ إِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلۡأٓمِنِينَ

en.text: And [he was told], "Throw down your staff." But when he saw it writhing as if it was a snake, he turned in flight and did not return.[1101] [Allāh said], "O Moses, approach and fear not. Indeed, you are of the secure.
en.footnotes: [1101] Or "did not look back."

so.text: 31. Ee tuur ushaada. Markiise uu arkay iyadoo dhaq-dhaqaaqaysa oo la moodo mas, buu isgaddiyey, mana soo dhugan gadaal. (Waxaa la yidhi): Muusow! Kaalay soo dhowow, hana cabsan, adigu waxaad tahay mid ka mid ah kuwa aaminka ah.

ayat.arabic: ٱسۡلُكۡ يَدَكَ فِي جَيۡبِكَ تَخۡرُجۡ بَيۡضَآءَ مِنۡ غَيۡرِ سُوٓءٖ وَٱضۡمُمۡ إِلَيۡكَ جَنَاحَكَ مِنَ ٱلرَّهۡبِۖ فَذَٰنِكَ بُرۡهَٰنَانِ مِن رَّبِّكَ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَمَلَإِيْهِۦٓۚ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ قَوۡمٗا فَٰسِقِينَ

en.text: Insert your hand into the opening of your garment; it will come out white, without disease. And draw in your arm close to you [as prevention] from fear, for those are two proofs from your Lord to Pharaoh and his establishment. Indeed, they have been a people defiantly disobedient."

so.text: 32. Geli gacantaada goshaada, waxay noqon durbaba caddaan cudur la’aan, ku nabna gacantaada garabkaaga si ay kaaga ba’do cabsida (aad ka qaadday maska, sidoo kalena gacantaadu waxay u noqon sideedii hore). Marka kuwakani waa labo caddaymo xagga Rabbigaa looga soo diray Fircoon iyo xildhibaannadiisa, waa qolo caasiyaal ahe.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّي قَتَلۡتُ مِنۡهُمۡ نَفۡسٗا فَأَخَافُ أَن يَقۡتُلُونِ

en.text: He said, "My Lord, indeed I killed from among them someone, and I fear they will kill me.

so.text: 33. (Muuse) wuxuu yidhi: Rabbiyow! Waxaan dilay nin ka mid ah, waxaan ka cabsan inay i dilaan.

ayat.arabic: وَأَخِي هَٰرُونُ هُوَ أَفۡصَحُ مِنِّي لِسَانٗا فَأَرۡسِلۡهُ مَعِيَ رِدۡءٗا يُصَدِّقُنِيٓۖ إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ أَن يُكَذِّبُونِ

en.text: And my brother Aaron is more fluent than me in tongue, so send him with me as support, verifying me. Indeed, I fear that they will deny me."

so.text: 34. Walaalkay Haaruun baana iga faseexsan carrab (hadal ahaan) ee ila dir garab ahaan si uu ii rumeeyo. Waxaan ka cabsan inay I beeniyaan.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ سَنَشُدُّ عَضُدَكَ بِأَخِيكَ وَنَجۡعَلُ لَكُمَا سُلۡطَٰنٗا فَلَا يَصِلُونَ إِلَيۡكُمَا بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآۚ أَنتُمَا وَمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكُمَا ٱلۡغَٰلِبُونَ

en.text: [Allāh] said, "We will strengthen your arm through your brother and grant you both supremacy so they will not reach you. [It will be] through Our signs; you and those who follow you will be the predominant."

so.text: 35. (Alle) Wuxuu yidhi: Waxaan ku adkeyn cududdaada walaalkaa, waxaana idiin yeeli awood (xujo) marka idinma gaar siin karaan (wax dhib ah), Aayadahayaga dartood, idinka iyo intii idin raacda baa adkaan.

ayat.arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم مُّوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا بَيِّنَٰتٖ قَالُواْ مَا هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحۡرٞ مُّفۡتَرٗى وَمَا سَمِعۡنَا بِهَٰذَا فِيٓ ءَابَآئِنَا ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ

en.text: But when Moses came to them with Our signs as clear evidences, they said, "This is not except invented magic, and we have not heard of this [religion] among our forefathers."

so.text: 36.Markuu Muuse ula yimid Aayadahayaga cad, waxay yidhaahdeen: Kani ma aha waxaan ahayn sixir la been abuurtay, mana aanaan ku maqal waxakan oo kale aabbayashayadii hore dhexdood.

ayat.arabic: وَقَالَ مُوسَىٰ رَبِّيٓ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَن جَآءَ بِٱلۡهُدَىٰ مِنۡ عِندِهِۦ وَمَن تَكُونُ لَهُۥ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلدَّارِۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُفۡلِحُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ

en.text: And Moses said, "My Lord is more knowing [than we or you] of who has come with guidance from Him and to whom will be succession in the home.[1102] Indeed, wrongdoers do not succeed."
en.footnotes: [1102] i.e., in this world or in the Hereafter.

so.text: 37. Muuse wuxuu yidhi: Rabbigay baa dhab u ogsoon kan kala yimid hanuun Xaggiisa iyo kan lahaan cidhibta wanaagsan ee Daarta [12]. Hubaal daalimiintu ma liibaanaan.
so.footnotes: [12]. Waa adduunka ama Aakhirada

ayat.arabic: وَقَالَ فِرۡعَوۡنُ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡمَلَأُ مَا عَلِمۡتُ لَكُم مِّنۡ إِلَٰهٍ غَيۡرِي فَأَوۡقِدۡ لِي يَٰهَٰمَٰنُ عَلَى ٱلطِّينِ فَٱجۡعَل لِّي صَرۡحٗا لَّعَلِّيٓ أَطَّلِعُ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَٰهِ مُوسَىٰ وَإِنِّي لَأَظُنُّهُۥ مِنَ ٱلۡكَٰذِبِينَ

en.text: And Pharaoh said, "O eminent ones, I have not known you to have a god other than me. Then ignite for me, O Hāmān, [a fire] upon the clay[1103] and make for me a tower that I may look at the God of Moses. And indeed, I do think he is among the liars."
en.footnotes: [1103] From which bricks are made.

so.text: 38. Fircoonna wuxuu yidhi: Xildhibaannow! Anigu idiin ma ogi inaad leedihiin ilaah kale aan ahayn aniga, ee ii huri dab Haamaanow lagu dul shido dhoobada [13], markaa ii samee sar aad u dheer, si aan u soo eego ilaaha Muuse; waxaan qabaa inuu ka mid yahay beenlowyada.
so.footnotes: [13]. Ee laga sameeyo bulukeetiga.

ayat.arabic: وَٱسۡتَكۡبَرَ هُوَ وَجُنُودُهُۥ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ بِغَيۡرِ ٱلۡحَقِّ وَظَنُّوٓاْ أَنَّهُمۡ إِلَيۡنَا لَا يُرۡجَعُونَ

en.text: And he was arrogant, he and his soldiers, in the land, without right, and they thought that they would not be returned to Us.

so.text: 39. Waxay isku kibriyeen isaga iyo askartiisuba arlada xaq darro, waxayna moodeen inaan Xaggeenna loo soo celinayn.

ayat.arabic: فَأَخَذۡنَٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذۡنَٰهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡيَمِّۖ فَٱنظُرۡ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ

en.text: So We took him and his soldiers and threw them into the sea.[1104] So see how was the end of the wrongdoers.
en.footnotes: [1104] Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) caused them to leave all their worldly wealth behind and enter the sea in pursuit of the Children of Israel. See 26:52-66.

so.text: 40. Markaasaan qabannay isaga iyo askartiisiiba oo ku tuurnay badda [14], ee fiiri siday ahayd cidhibtii daalimiinta.
so.footnotes: [14]. Alle s.w.t. wuxuu sababay inay dadkii Fircoon kaga soo tagaan gadaashooda waxay hanti iyo maal lahaayeen, oo soo galaan badda iyagoo ku jooga raadka reer Israa’iil. Eeg Suuradda 26: Aayadaha 52- 66.

ayat.arabic: وَجَعَلۡنَٰهُمۡ أَئِمَّةٗ يَدۡعُونَ إِلَى ٱلنَّارِۖ وَيَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ لَا يُنصَرُونَ

en.text: And We made them leaders[1105] inviting to the Fire, and on the Day of Resurrection they will not be helped.
en.footnotes: [1105] i.e., examples or precedents, followed by subsequent tyrants.

so.text: 41. Waxaanu ka yeelnay madax [15] wax ugu yeedha Naarta, Maalinta Qiyaamana looma gargaaro.
so.footnotes: [15]. Macnaha waa tusaale, ama mataal xun ay raacaan diktaatoorrada oo dhan iyo madaxda khaa’imiinta ah.

ayat.arabic: وَأَتۡبَعۡنَٰهُمۡ فِي هَٰذِهِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا لَعۡنَةٗۖ وَيَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ هُم مِّنَ ٱلۡمَقۡبُوحِينَ

en.text: And We caused to overtake them in this world a curse, and on the Day of Resurrection they will be of the despised.[1106]
en.footnotes: [1106] Literally, "those made hideous," who will be far removed from all good and mercy.

so.text: 42. Waxaan raacinnay adduunyadan Lacnad, Maalinta Qiyaamahana waxay ka mid ahaan kuwa (laga yaqyaqsado) falalkooda xun (ee laga dheereeyey Naxariista Alle).

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ ءَاتَيۡنَا مُوسَى ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَآ أَهۡلَكۡنَا ٱلۡقُرُونَ ٱلۡأُولَىٰ بَصَآئِرَ لِلنَّاسِ وَهُدٗى وَرَحۡمَةٗ لَّعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ

en.text: And We gave Moses the Scripture, after We had destroyed the former generations, as enlightenment for the people and guidance and mercy that they might be reminded.

so.text: 43. Waxaana dhab ahaan siinnay Muuse Kitaabka (Towraadda) kaddib markaan halaagnay qaaruumihii hore, isagoo tusmooyin u ah dadka, iyo hanuun iyo naxariis inay xusuustaan (oo ku waantoobaan).

ayat.arabic: وَمَا كُنتَ بِجَانِبِ ٱلۡغَرۡبِيِّ إِذۡ قَضَيۡنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَى ٱلۡأَمۡرَ وَمَا كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلشَّٰهِدِينَ

en.text: And you, [O Muḥammad], were not on the western side [of the mount] when We revealed to Moses the command, and you were not among the witnesses [to that].

so.text: 44. Adigu (Nabi Muxammadow) ma aad joogin dhinaca galbeed (ee buurta), markaan siinnay Muuse amarka (Nabinnimada), mana aad ka mid aheyn kuwa  ahaa goob joogga.

ayat.arabic: وَلَٰكِنَّآ أَنشَأۡنَا قُرُونٗا فَتَطَاوَلَ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلۡعُمُرُۚ وَمَا كُنتَ ثَاوِيٗا فِيٓ أَهۡلِ مَدۡيَنَ تَتۡلُواْ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ءَايَٰتِنَا وَلَٰكِنَّا كُنَّا مُرۡسِلِينَ

en.text: But We produced [many] generations [after Moses], and prolonged was their duration.[1107] And you were not a resident among the people of Madyan, reciting to them Our verses, but We were senders [of this message].[1108]
en.footnotes:
[1107] So they forgot and neglected the ordinances of Allāh.
[1108] The Prophet (ﷺ) had no way of obtaining this information except through Allāh's revelation.

so.text: 45. Waxaanse abuurnay Facyo (is xigsada Muuse kaddib) waxaana ku dheeraaday cumrigii [16]. Adiguna ma aheyn mid dhex joogay reer Madyan, adigoo u akhrinaya Aayadahayaga. Annaga baase ku soo dirnay 'Rusuul ahaan' [17].
so.footnotes:
[16]. Markaasay hilmaameen oo dayaceen amarradii Alle.
[17]. Nabigu s.c.w. ma heysto dariiq kale uu ku ogaado wararkan aan ahayn Waxyiga Alle u soo waxyooday.

ayat.arabic: وَمَا كُنتَ بِجَانِبِ ٱلطُّورِ إِذۡ نَادَيۡنَا وَلَٰكِن رَّحۡمَةٗ مِّن رَّبِّكَ لِتُنذِرَ قَوۡمٗا مَّآ أَتَىٰهُم مِّن نَّذِيرٖ مِّن قَبۡلِكَ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ

en.text: And you were not at the side of the mount when We called [Moses] but [were sent] as a mercy from your Lord to warn a people to whom no warner had come before you that they might be reminded.

so.text: 46. Ma aad joogin dhinca Buurta (Duur) markaan u dhawaaqnay Muuse. (Waxaase laguu soo diray) naxariis ahaan xagga Rabbigaa si aad ugu digto qolo uusan u imaan dige hortaa inay xusuustaan (oo waantoobaan).

ayat.arabic: وَلَوۡلَآ أَن تُصِيبَهُم مُّصِيبَةُۢ بِمَا قَدَّمَتۡ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ فَيَقُولُواْ رَبَّنَا لَوۡلَآ أَرۡسَلۡتَ إِلَيۡنَا رَسُولٗا فَنَتَّبِعَ ءَايَٰتِكَ وَنَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ

en.text: And if not that a disaster should strike them for what their hands put forth [of sins] and they would say, "Our Lord, why did You not send us a messenger so we could have followed Your verses and been among the believers?"...[1109]
en.footnotes: [1109] The conclusion of the sentence is understood to be "...We would not have sent messengers," meaning that Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) sent messengers and sent Muḥammad (ﷺ) with the final scripture to mankind so that no one could claim that punishment was imposed unjustly without warning.

so.text: 47. Haddaysan jirin in markay ku dhacdo masiibo waxay gacmahoodu geysteen ( oo denbiyo ah) darteed, markaasna ay yidhaahdaan: Rabbigayow! Maxaad noogu soo diri weyday Rasuul si aan u raacno Aayadahaaga oo aan uga mid ahaanno mu’miniinta (waa la ciqaabi lahaa).

ayat.arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلۡحَقُّ مِنۡ عِندِنَا قَالُواْ لَوۡلَآ أُوتِيَ مِثۡلَ مَآ أُوتِيَ مُوسَىٰٓۚ أَوَلَمۡ يَكۡفُرُواْ بِمَآ أُوتِيَ مُوسَىٰ مِن قَبۡلُۖ قَالُواْ سِحۡرَانِ تَظَٰهَرَا وَقَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا بِكُلّٖ كَٰفِرُونَ

en.text: But when the truth came to them from Us, they said, "Why was he not given like that which was given to Moses?" Did they not disbelieve in that which was given to Moses before? They said, "[They are but] two works of magic supporting each other,[1110] and indeed we are, in both, disbelievers."
en.footnotes: [1110] The reference is by the disbelievers of Quraysh to the Qur’ān and the Torah.

so.text: 48. Markiise uu Xaqa uga yimid Xaggayaga, waxay yidhaahdeen: Maxaa loo siin waayey wax la mid ah wixii la siiyey Muuse? Ma waysan ku gaaloobin wixii la siiyey Muuse awal hore? Waxay yidhaahdeen:“Waa labo sixir (Towraadda iyo Qur’aanka) oo is kaalmaystay [18]. Waxayna yidhaahdeen: Innagu dhammaan waan ku gaalownay.
so.footnotes: [18]. Camalka labo sixir oo is kaalmaystay: Waxay gaaladii Quraysh ula jeedeen: Towraadda iyo Qur’aanka.

ayat.arabic: قُلۡ فَأۡتُواْ بِكِتَٰبٖ مِّنۡ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ هُوَ أَهۡدَىٰ مِنۡهُمَآ أَتَّبِعۡهُ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ

en.text: Say, "Then bring a scripture from Allāh which is more guiding than either of them that I may follow it, if you should be truthful."

so.text: 49. Dheh: Ka keena Kitaab (kale) xagga Alle, oo ka hanuun wanaagsan labadooda aan raacee haddaad run sheegaysaan.

ayat.arabic: فَإِن لَّمۡ يَسۡتَجِيبُواْ لَكَ فَٱعۡلَمۡ أَنَّمَا يَتَّبِعُونَ أَهۡوَآءَهُمۡۚ وَمَنۡ أَضَلُّ مِمَّنِ ٱتَّبَعَ هَوَىٰهُ بِغَيۡرِ هُدٗى مِّنَ ٱللَّهِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهۡدِي ٱلۡقَوۡمَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ

en.text: But if they do not respond to you - then know that they only follow their [own] desires. And who is more astray than one who follows his desire without guidance from Allāh? Indeed, Allāh does not guide the wrongdoing people.

so.text: 50. Haddayna ku ajiibin, ogow inay uun raacaan hawadooda. Yaana ka dhunsanaan badan mid raaca hawadiisa hanuun la’aan xagga Alle? Hubaal, Alle ma hanuuniyo qoloda daalimiinta ah.

ayat.arabic: ۞ وَلَقَدۡ وَصَّلۡنَا لَهُمُ ٱلۡقَوۡلَ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ

en.text: And We have [repeatedly] conveyed to them the word [i.e., the Qur’ān] that they might be reminded.

so.text: 51. Waxaan si xidhiidhsan (oo qayb qayb ah) u soo gaarsiinnay Qowlka (Qur’aanka), inay xusuustaan (oo waantoobaan).

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَاتَيۡنَٰهُمُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ مِن قَبۡلِهِۦ هُم بِهِۦ يُؤۡمِنُونَ

en.text: Those to whom We gave the Scripture before it - they[1111] are believers in it.
en.footnotes: [1111] i.e., the sincere believers among them.

so.text: 52. Kuwaannu siinnay Kitaabka (Towraadda iyo Injiilka) ka hor kani (Qur'aanka) - baa rumeyn [19] waxa ku soo arooray (Qur’aanka).
so.footnotes: [19]. Waa mu’miniinta daacadda ah ee ku jira ehlu kitaabka dhexdooda.

ayat.arabic: وَإِذَا يُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِمۡ قَالُوٓاْ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦٓ إِنَّهُ ٱلۡحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا مِن قَبۡلِهِۦ مُسۡلِمِينَ

en.text: And when it is recited to them, they say, "We have believed in it; indeed, it is the truth from our Lord. Indeed we were, [even] before it, Muslims [i.e., submitting to Allāh]."

so.text: 53. Marka loo akhriyona (Qur'aanka), waxay yidhaahdaan: Waanu rumaysannahay. hubaal, waa Xaq ka yimid Rabbigayo. Waxaanu ahayn isaga ka horba Muslimiin.

ayat.arabic: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ يُؤۡتَوۡنَ أَجۡرَهُم مَّرَّتَيۡنِ بِمَا صَبَرُواْ وَيَدۡرَءُونَ بِٱلۡحَسَنَةِ ٱلسَّيِّئَةَ وَمِمَّا رَزَقۡنَٰهُمۡ يُنفِقُونَ

en.text: Those will be given their reward twice for what they patiently endured and [because] they avert evil through good, and from what We have provided them they spend.

so.text: 54. Kuwaas waxaa la siin ajarkooda labo jeer samirkoodii darti, waxayna ku qaabilaan wixii xumaan ah samaan, waxaan ku irsaaqnona wax ka bixiyaan.

ayat.arabic: وَإِذَا سَمِعُواْ ٱللَّغۡوَ أَعۡرَضُواْ عَنۡهُ وَقَالُواْ لَنَآ أَعۡمَٰلُنَا وَلَكُمۡ أَعۡمَٰلُكُمۡ سَلَٰمٌ عَلَيۡكُمۡ لَا نَبۡتَغِي ٱلۡجَٰهِلِينَ

en.text: And when they hear ill speech, they turn away from it and say, "For us are our deeds, and for you are your deeds. Peace will be upon you;[1112] we seek not the ignorant."
en.footnotes: [1112] This is not the Islāmic greeting of "Peace be upon you." Rather, it means "You are secure from being treated in a like manner by us."

so.text: 55. Markay maqlaanna hadal macno darro ah way ka jeesadaan, oo yidhaahdaan: Waxaanu leennahay camalladayada, idinkuna waxaad leedihiin camalladiinna. Nabad gelyo [20], ma rabno (dhaqanka) jaahiliinta.
so.footnotes: [20]. Salaamu calaykum halkan loolama jeedo salaanta Muslimka, ee waxaa loola jeedaa waa ka nabad galeysaan afkayaga iyo addinkayaga qowl iyo ficilba oo wax xun inaan ku hadalno aamin iyo nabad baad ka tihiin, iyo inaan u dhaqanno sidiinna oo kale si jaahilnimo ah.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّكَ لَا تَهۡدِي مَنۡ أَحۡبَبۡتَ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَهۡدِي مَن يَشَآءُۚ وَهُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِٱلۡمُهۡتَدِينَ

en.text: Indeed, [O Muḥammad], you do not guide whom you like, but Allāh guides whom He wills. And He is most knowing of the [rightly] guided.

so.text: 56. Adigu (Nabi Muxammadow) Ma hanuu- nin kartid ciddaad jecleysato, Alle baase hanuuniya qofkuu doono. Isagaana dhab u ogsoon kuwa hanuunsan.

ayat.arabic: وَقَالُوٓاْ إِن نَّتَّبِعِ ٱلۡهُدَىٰ مَعَكَ نُتَخَطَّفۡ مِنۡ أَرۡضِنَآۚ أَوَلَمۡ نُمَكِّن لَّهُمۡ حَرَمًا ءَامِنٗا يُجۡبَىٰٓ إِلَيۡهِ ثَمَرَٰتُ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ رِّزۡقٗا مِّن لَّدُنَّا وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ

en.text: And they [i.e., the Quraysh] say, "If we were to follow the guidance with you, we would be swept[1113] from our land." Have We not established for them a safe sanctuary to which are brought the fruits of all things as provision from Us? But most of them do not know.
en.footnotes: [1113] By the other Arab tribes.

so.text: 57.Waxay (gaaladii Makkaad) yidhaahdeen: Haddaan kula raacno hanuunka, waxaa nalaga dafi dhulkayaga [21]. Ma waannaan dejin Xaram aammin ah, oo midho nooc walba leh la keeno - risiq Xaggayaga ah, badankooduse ma oga.
so.footnotes: [21]. Waxaa nagu soo xadgudabaya oo na kala dafaya qabiilooyinka kale ee Carabta.

ayat.arabic: وَكَمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَا مِن قَرۡيَةِۭ بَطِرَتۡ مَعِيشَتَهَاۖ فَتِلۡكَ مَسَٰكِنُهُمۡ لَمۡ تُسۡكَن مِّنۢ بَعۡدِهِمۡ إِلَّا قَلِيلٗاۖ وَكُنَّا نَحۡنُ ٱلۡوَٰرِثِينَ

en.text: And how many a city have We destroyed that was insolent in its [way of] living, and those are their dwellings which have not been inhabited after them except briefly.[1114] And it is We who were the inheritors.
en.footnotes: [1114] By travelers seeking temporary shelter. The reference is to the ruins which were visible to the Quraysh during their journeys.

so.text: 58. Badanaa intaan magaalo halaagnay, ku kibirtay nolosheeda (caasiday Alle iyo Rusushiisa). Marka waa kuwan guryahoodii aan la degin iyaga kadambow in yar ma ahee [22] waana Annaga dhaxlayaasha (u hadha).
so.footnotes: [22]. Musaafiriinta doonaya meel ay degaan in yar oo markaa ka tagaan. Waxaana halkan loogu tilmaamayaa burburkii magaalooyinkaa ay arki jireen Quraysh markay halkaa socdaal ku marayaan.

ayat.arabic: وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ مُهۡلِكَ ٱلۡقُرَىٰ حَتَّىٰ يَبۡعَثَ فِيٓ أُمِّهَا رَسُولٗا يَتۡلُواْ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ءَايَٰتِنَاۚ وَمَا كُنَّا مُهۡلِكِي ٱلۡقُرَىٰٓ إِلَّا وَأَهۡلُهَا ظَٰلِمُونَ

en.text: And never would your Lord have destroyed the cities until He had sent to their mother [i.e., principal city] a messenger reciting to them Our verses. And We would not destroy the cities except while their people were wrongdoers.

so.text: 59. Ma aha Rabbigaana mid halaaga magaalooyinka jeer uu u diro magaalada u hooyada ah (xaruntooda) Rasuul u akhrinaya Aayadahayaga. Ma halaagno magaalooyinka haddayan aheyn dadkeedu daalimiin (gar ma qaatayaal).

ayat.arabic: وَمَآ أُوتِيتُم مِّن شَيۡءٖ فَمَتَٰعُ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَزِينَتُهَاۚ وَمَا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ خَيۡرٞ وَأَبۡقَىٰٓۚ أَفَلَا تَعۡقِلُونَ

en.text: And whatever thing you [people] have been given - it is [only for] the enjoyment of worldly life and its adornment. And what is with Allāh is better and more lasting; so will you not use reason?

so.text: 60. Waxa la idin siiyona oo wuxuun ah waa uun sahay nolosha adduunkan iyo quruxdeeda, waxase (Aakhirada) Alle agtiis ah baa khayr roon oo daa’insan. Ee mawaydaan fahmeyn?

ayat.arabic: أَفَمَن وَعَدۡنَٰهُ وَعۡدًا حَسَنٗا فَهُوَ لَٰقِيهِ كَمَن مَّتَّعۡنَٰهُ مَتَٰعَ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا ثُمَّ هُوَ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ مِنَ ٱلۡمُحۡضَرِينَ

en.text: Then is he whom We have promised a good promise which he will meet [i.e., obtain] like he for whom We provided enjoyment of worldly life [but] then he is, on the Day of Resurrection, among those presented [for punishment in Hell]?

so.text: 61. Ma mid aan u ballan qaadnay ballan qaad wanaagsan (Janno) oo la kulmi, baa la mid ah mid aan siinnay sahayda nolosha adduunkan (ee dhammaaneysa), markaas Maalinta Qiyaamaha ka mid noqon kuwa la soo xaadirnayo (la keenayo cadaabka)?

ayat.arabic: وَيَوۡمَ يُنَادِيهِمۡ فَيَقُولُ أَيۡنَ شُرَكَآءِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ كُنتُمۡ تَزۡعُمُونَ

en.text: And [warn of] the Day He will call them and say, "Where are My 'partners' which you used to claim?"

so.text: 62. (Ka dig) Maalinta uu (Alle) u yeedhi  (mushrikiinta) oo odhan: Meeye kuwaad ila wadaajiseen (cibaadada) oo aad u heysateen inay yihiin shurakadeyda?

ayat.arabic: قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ حَقَّ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلۡقَوۡلُ رَبَّنَا هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ ٱلَّذِينَ أَغۡوَيۡنَآ أَغۡوَيۡنَٰهُمۡ كَمَا غَوَيۡنَاۖ تَبَرَّأۡنَآ إِلَيۡكَۖ مَا كَانُوٓاْ إِيَّانَا يَعۡبُدُونَ

en.text: Those upon whom the word[1115] will have come into effect will say, "Our Lord, these are the ones we led to error. We led them to error just as we were in error. We declare our disassociation [from them] to You. They did not used to worship [i.e., obey] us."[1116]
en.footnotes:
[1115] The decree for their punishment.
[1116] i.e., We did not compel them, and they did not obey us; instead, they obeyed their own desires and inclinations.

so.text: 63. Kuwa uu Qawlka ku dhaboobi [23] (in la cadaabo) waxay odhan: “Rabbiyow! Kuwaani waa kuwaan habaabinnay. Waxaan u habaabinnay sidaan u habownay. Waxaan ka nahay barii Adiga hortaada. Ma aheyn innaga waxay caabudayeen [24].
so.footnotes:
[23]. Loo qaddaray in la cadaabo.
[24]. Macnaha waxaa weeye ma aanu qasbin iyaga, mana ay na adeeceyn, ee waxay raacayeen oo adeecayeen keliya hawada nafahooda iyo waxa liita ay rabaan oo ay u iishaan.

ayat.arabic: وَقِيلَ ٱدۡعُواْ شُرَكَآءَكُمۡ فَدَعَوۡهُمۡ فَلَمۡ يَسۡتَجِيبُواْ لَهُمۡ وَرَأَوُاْ ٱلۡعَذَابَۚ لَوۡ أَنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ يَهۡتَدُونَ

en.text: And it will be said, "Invoke your 'partners,'" and they will invoke them; but they will not respond to them, and they will see the punishment. If only they had followed guidance!

so.text: 64. Waxaana lagu odhan: U yeedha Ilaahaydiinnii aad shurakada kala dhigteen (Alle), markaasay u yeedhan, mase ajiibayaan, waxayna arki cadaabka. Markaasay shallaayaan hadday uun hanuuni lahaayeen.

ayat.arabic: وَيَوۡمَ يُنَادِيهِمۡ فَيَقُولُ مَاذَآ أَجَبۡتُمُ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ

en.text: And [mention] the Day He will call them and say, "What did you answer the messengers?"

so.text: 65. (Xus) Maalinta uu (Alle) u yeedhi oo odhan: Maxaad ugu jawaabteen Rusushii?

ayat.arabic: فَعَمِيَتۡ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلۡأَنۢبَآءُ يَوۡمَئِذٖ فَهُمۡ لَا يَتَسَآءَلُونَ

en.text: But the information[1117] will be unapparent to them that Day, so they will not [be able to] ask one another.
en.footnotes: [1117] By which they might invent lies or excuses.

so.text: 66. Markaasay waayi xujooyin [25] maalintaas, waxnana isma weydiinayaan.
so.footnotes: [25]. Si ay been u sheegaan ama u cudur daartaan.

ayat.arabic: فَأَمَّا مَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحٗا فَعَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُفۡلِحِينَ

en.text: But as for one who had repented, believed, and done righteousness, it is expected [i.e., promised by Allāh] that he will be among the successful.

so.text: 67. Qofkii ka tawbad keena (shirkiga iyo macaasida) oo (Xaqa) rumeeya oo raaca oo fala camallo wanaagsan (nolosha adduunkan) waa intaasoo uu ka mid ahaado liibaanayaasha.

ayat.arabic: وَرَبُّكَ يَخۡلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُ وَيَخۡتَارُۗ مَا كَانَ لَهُمُ ٱلۡخِيَرَةُۚ سُبۡحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ وَتَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُونَ

en.text: And your Lord creates what He wills and chooses; not for them was the choice. Exalted is Allāh and high above what they associate with Him.

so.text: 68. Rabbigaa wuxuu abuuraa wuxuu doono oo doortaa, ma leh iyaguse doorashada. Wuu ka hufan yahay Alle (ceeb iyo nuqsaan) oo ka Sarreeyaa waxay la wadaajiyaan cibaadada.

ayat.arabic: وَرَبُّكَ يَعۡلَمُ مَا تُكِنُّ صُدُورُهُمۡ وَمَا يُعۡلِنُونَ

en.text: And your Lord knows what their breasts conceal and what they declare.

so.text: 69. Rabbigaa waa Ogsoon yahay waxay  qarin laabahooda iyo waxay muujinba.

ayat.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۖ لَهُ ٱلۡحَمۡدُ فِي ٱلۡأُولَىٰ وَٱلۡأٓخِرَةِۖ وَلَهُ ٱلۡحُكۡمُ وَإِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُونَ

en.text: And He is Allāh; there is no deity except Him. To Him is [due all] praise in the first [life] and the Hereafter. And His is the [final] decision, and to Him you will be returned.

so.text: 70. Waa Allaah (Macbuudka Xaqa ah), ma jiro Ilaah (Xaq lagu caabudo) aan Isaga ahayn, Isagaa leh ammaan oo idil iyo mahad tan hore (aduuunka) iyo tan dambe (Aakhirada), Isagaana leh Xukunka, Xaggiisaana idinkoo idil la idiin soo celin.

ayat.arabic: قُلۡ أَرَءَيۡتُمۡ إِن جَعَلَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡكُمُ ٱلَّيۡلَ سَرۡمَدًا إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ مَنۡ إِلَٰهٌ غَيۡرُ ٱللَّهِ يَأۡتِيكُم بِضِيَآءٍۚ أَفَلَا تَسۡمَعُونَ

en.text: Say, "Have you considered:[1118] if Allāh should make for you the night continuous until the Day of Resurrection, what deity other than Allāh could bring you light? Then will you not hear?"
en.footnotes: [1118] Meaning "Inform me if you really know."

so.text: 71. Dheh: bal ka warrama, hadduu Alle ka yeelo habeenka joogto tan iyo maalinta Qiyaamaha, Ma ilaah baa jira aan ahayn Alle oo idiin keeni kara iftiin, miyeydaan wax maqleyn?.

ayat.arabic: قُلۡ أَرَءَيۡتُمۡ إِن جَعَلَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡكُمُ ٱلنَّهَارَ سَرۡمَدًا إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ مَنۡ إِلَٰهٌ غَيۡرُ ٱللَّهِ يَأۡتِيكُم بِلَيۡلٖ تَسۡكُنُونَ فِيهِۚ أَفَلَا تُبۡصِرُونَ

en.text: Say, "Have you considered: if Allāh should make for you the day continuous until the Day of Resurrection, what deity other than Allāh could bring you a night in which you may rest? Then will you not see?"

so.text: 72. Dheh: Bal ka warrama, hadduu Alle ka yeelo dharaarta joogto tan iyo Maalinta Qiyaamaha, Ma ilaah baa jira aan ahayn Alle oo idiin keeni kara habeen aad ku xasishaan, mawaydaan wax arkayn?

ayat.arabic: وَمِن رَّحۡمَتِهِۦ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيۡلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ لِتَسۡكُنُواْ فِيهِ وَلِتَبۡتَغُواْ مِن فَضۡلِهِۦ وَلَعَلَّكُمۡ تَشۡكُرُونَ

en.text: And out of His mercy He made for you the night and the day that you may rest therein and [by day] seek from His bounty and [that] perhaps you will be grateful.

so.text: 73. Waxaa ka mid ah Naxariista Alle inuu idiin yeelay habeenka si aad ugu nasataan,  iyo maalinta si aad u doonataan Deeqdiisa, iyo inaad u mahad naqdaan.

ayat.arabic: وَيَوۡمَ يُنَادِيهِمۡ فَيَقُولُ أَيۡنَ شُرَكَآءِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ كُنتُمۡ تَزۡعُمُونَ

en.text: And [warn of] the Day He will call them and say, "Where are My 'partners' which you used to claim?"

so.text: 74. (Ka dig) Maalinta aan u yeedhi (mushrikiinta) oo odhan: Meeye kuwaad u heysateen inay yihiin shurakadeyda ee aad ila wadaajiseen cibaadada?

ayat.arabic: وَنَزَعۡنَا مِن كُلِّ أُمَّةٖ شَهِيدٗا فَقُلۡنَا هَاتُواْ بُرۡهَٰنَكُمۡ فَعَلِمُوٓاْ أَنَّ ٱلۡحَقَّ لِلَّهِ وَضَلَّ عَنۡهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يَفۡتَرُونَ

en.text: And We will extract from every nation a witness and say, "Produce your proof," and they will know that the truth belongs to Allāh, and lost from them is that which they used to invent.

so.text: 75. Waxaanu ka soo saari ummad walba markhaati, oo odhan: Keena xujadiinna. Markaasay ogaan inuu Garta leeyahay Alle (Keliya), wayna waayi waxay been abuuran jireen (oo ilaahyo ah).

ayat.arabic: ۞ إِنَّ قَٰرُونَ كَانَ مِن قَوۡمِ مُوسَىٰ فَبَغَىٰ عَلَيۡهِمۡۖ وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُ مِنَ ٱلۡكُنُوزِ مَآ إِنَّ مَفَاتِحَهُۥ لَتَنُوٓأُ بِٱلۡعُصۡبَةِ أُوْلِي ٱلۡقُوَّةِ إِذۡ قَالَ لَهُۥ قَوۡمُهُۥ لَا تَفۡرَحۡۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلۡفَرِحِينَ

en.text: Indeed, Qārūn was from the people of Moses, but he tyrannized them. And We gave him of treasures whose keys would burden a band of strong men; thereupon his people said to him, "Do not exult. Indeed, Allāh does not like the exultant.

so.text: 76. Xaqiiq, wuxuu Qaaruun ka mid ahaa qolodii Muuse, wuuse ka fallaagoobay, waxaana ka siinnay kaydadka (maalka) wax aad u tiro badan heer furayaashoodu cusleyneysay jirka rag xoog leh. Markay qolodiisii ku yidhaahdeen: Ha farax taraarin (kibrin), Alle ma jecla kuwa farxa (kibree).

ayat.arabic: وَٱبۡتَغِ فِيمَآ ءَاتَىٰكَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلدَّارَ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةَۖ وَلَا تَنسَ نَصِيبَكَ مِنَ ٱلدُّنۡيَاۖ وَأَحۡسِن كَمَآ أَحۡسَنَ ٱللَّهُ إِلَيۡكَۖ وَلَا تَبۡغِ ٱلۡفَسَادَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلۡمُفۡسِدِينَ

en.text: But seek, through that which Allāh has given you, the home of the Hereafter; and [yet], do not forget your share of the world. And do good as Allāh has done good to you. And desire not corruption in the land. Indeed, Allāh does not like corrupters."

so.text: 77. Oo ku doono waxa (khayr ah) uu Alle ku siiyey Daarta Aakhiro, hana halmaamin qaybtaada ah adduunka, oo sama fal sida uuba Alle kuugu sama falay. Ha la doonin fasahaad arlada. Alle ma jecla kuwa wax fasaadiya.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أُوتِيتُهُۥ عَلَىٰ عِلۡمٍ عِندِيٓۚ أَوَلَمۡ يَعۡلَمۡ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَدۡ أَهۡلَكَ مِن قَبۡلِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلۡقُرُونِ مَنۡ هُوَ أَشَدُّ مِنۡهُ قُوَّةٗ وَأَكۡثَرُ جَمۡعٗاۚ وَلَا يُسۡـَٔلُ عَن ذُنُوبِهِمُ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمُونَ

en.text: He said, "I was only given it because of knowledge I have." Did he not know that Allāh had destroyed before him of generations those who were greater than him in power and greater in accumulation [of wealth]? But the criminals, about their sins, will not be asked.[1119]
en.footnotes: [1119] There will be no need to enumerate their sins separately, as their quantity is obvious and more than sufficient to warrant punishment in Hell.

so.text: 78. Wuxuu yidhi: Waxaa la igu siiyey maalkan oo keliya aqoonteyda. Miyuusan ogayn inuu Alle halaagay horti qaaruumo, kuwo isaga ka xoog badan oo ka badan waxay isu keeneen. Lamana weydiiyo denbiyadooda denbiilayaasha.

ayat.arabic: فَخَرَجَ عَلَىٰ قَوۡمِهِۦ فِي زِينَتِهِۦۖ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يُرِيدُونَ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا يَٰلَيۡتَ لَنَا مِثۡلَ مَآ أُوتِيَ قَٰرُونُ إِنَّهُۥ لَذُو حَظٍّ عَظِيمٖ

en.text: So he came out before his people in his adornment. Those who desired the worldly life said, "Oh, would that we had like what was given to Qārūn. Indeed, he is one of great fortune."

so.text: 79. Markaasuu u soo baxay qolodiisii isagoo xarragoonaya oo ay u dhan tahay quruxdiisii. Kuwii doonayey nolosha adduunkan waxay yidhaahdeen: “Wayoo waye, haddaanu lahaan lahayn wax la mid ah waxa Qaaruun la siiyey? Isagu runtii wuu nasiib badan yahay.

ayat.arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡعِلۡمَ وَيۡلَكُمۡ ثَوَابُ ٱللَّهِ خَيۡرٞ لِّمَنۡ ءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحٗاۚ وَلَا يُلَقَّىٰهَآ إِلَّا ٱلصَّٰبِرُونَ

en.text: But those who had been given knowledge said, "Woe to you! The reward of Allāh is better for he who believes and does righteousness. And none are granted it except the patient."

so.text: 80. Kuwii se la siiyey cilmiga waxay yidhaahdeen: Magaciin bi'i waaye! Abaalka Alle (ee Aakhirada) baa u wanaagsan kuwa (Xaqa) rumeeyey oo sama fala, lamana waafajiyo waxaan ahayn kuwa samra.

ayat.arabic: فَخَسَفۡنَا بِهِۦ وَبِدَارِهِ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ فَمَا كَانَ لَهُۥ مِن فِئَةٖ يَنصُرُونَهُۥ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُنتَصِرِينَ

en.text: And We caused the earth to swallow him and his home. And there was for him no company to aid him other than Allāh, nor was he of those who [could] defend themselves.

so.text: 81. Markaasaan la goynay isagii (Qaaruun) iyo daartiisiiba dhulka. Mana uusan helin koox u gargaarta Alle ka sokow, mana ahayn mid is difaaci kara.

ayat.arabic: وَأَصۡبَحَ ٱلَّذِينَ تَمَنَّوۡاْ مَكَانَهُۥ بِٱلۡأَمۡسِ يَقُولُونَ وَيۡكَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَبۡسُطُ ٱلرِّزۡقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ مِنۡ عِبَادِهِۦ وَيَقۡدِرُۖ لَوۡلَآ أَن مَّنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡنَا لَخَسَفَ بِنَاۖ وَيۡكَأَنَّهُۥ لَا يُفۡلِحُ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ

en.text: And those who had wished for his position the previous day began to say, "Oh, how Allāh extends provision to whom He wills of His servants and restricts it! If not that Allāh had conferred favor on us, He would have caused it to swallow us. Oh, how the disbelievers do not succeed!"

so.text: 82. Kuwii u hanqal taagayey (meeqaan la mid) meeqaankiisa maalintii horreysay waxay billaabeen inay yidhaahdaan: Shaki ma leh waa Alle Kan u fidiya risiqa qofkuu doono oo ka mid ah addoomahiisa ama ku cidhiidhiya. Haddii aysan jirteen in Alle yahay mid noo Roonaan badan, wuxuu nala goyn lahaa dhulka (sidoo kale). Shaki ma leh, ma liibaanto gaalo.

ayat.arabic: تِلۡكَ ٱلدَّارُ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةُ نَجۡعَلُهَا لِلَّذِينَ لَا يُرِيدُونَ عُلُوّٗا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَا فَسَادٗاۚ وَٱلۡعَٰقِبَةُ لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ

en.text: That home of the Hereafter We assign to those who do not desire exaltedness upon the earth or corruption. And the [best] outcome is for the righteous.

so.text: 83. Taasi ah Daarta Aakhiro (Jannada) waxaanu dhaxalsiin kuwa aan ku dooneyn sarreyn dhulka, aanna ku falin fasahaad. Cidhibta wanaagsanna waxaa leh kuwa iska jira'xumaha ee dhowra amarrada Alle".

ayat.arabic: مَن جَآءَ بِٱلۡحَسَنَةِ فَلَهُۥ خَيۡرٞ مِّنۡهَاۖ وَمَن جَآءَ بِٱلسَّيِّئَةِ فَلَا يُجۡزَى ٱلَّذِينَ عَمِلُواْ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ إِلَّا مَا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ

en.text: Whoever comes [on the Day of Judgement] with a good deed will have better than it; and whoever comes with an evil deed - then those who did evil deeds will not be recompensed except [as much as] what they used to do.

so.text: 84.Qofkii la yimaada wanaag [26], wuxuu leeyahay wax ka khayr badan (Janno), qofkiise la yimaada xumaan (shirki iyo macaasi), laguma abaal mariyo kuwa fala camallada xun waxaa ahayn waxay falayeen (wax la mid ah oo xumaan ah).
so.footnotes: [26]. Towxiid iyo camallo san oo sharciga waafaqsan.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِي فَرَضَ عَلَيۡكَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لَرَآدُّكَ إِلَىٰ مَعَادٖۚ قُل رَّبِّيٓ أَعۡلَمُ مَن جَآءَ بِٱلۡهُدَىٰ وَمَنۡ هُوَ فِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٖ

en.text: Indeed, [O Muḥammad], He who imposed upon you the Qur’ān will take you back to a place of return.[1120] Say, "My Lord is most knowing of who brings guidance and who is in clear error."
en.footnotes: [1120] Meaning to Makkah (in this life) or to Paradise (in the Hereafter).

so.text: 85. Hubaal (Alle ee) kugu faral yeelay Qur’aanka wuxuu dib kuugu soo celin Xagga halkii ballantu ahayd [27]. Dheh: Rabbigay baa cid kasta ka ogsoon kan la yimid hanuun iyo kan ku sugan habow cad.
so.footnotes: [27]. Waxaa loolaa jeedaa Makkah (noloshan adduunka) ama Jannada (Aakhirada).

ayat.arabic: وَمَا كُنتَ تَرۡجُوٓاْ أَن يُلۡقَىٰٓ إِلَيۡكَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبُ إِلَّا رَحۡمَةٗ مِّن رَّبِّكَۖ فَلَا تَكُونَنَّ ظَهِيرٗا لِّلۡكَٰفِرِينَ

en.text: And you were not expecting that the Book would be conveyed to you, but [it is] a mercy from your Lord. So do not be an assistant to the disbelievers.[1121]
en.footnotes: [1121] In their religion by making any concessions to their beliefs.

so.text: 86. Ma aad aheyn (Nabiyow) mid rajeyn in lagugu soo dejiyo Kitaabka (Qur’aanka), hase yeeshee waa Naxariis xagga Rabbigaa ah. Ee ha noqonin mid garab siiya gaalada [28].
so.footnotes: [28]. Ha ugu kaalmeyn diintooda adigoo waafaqaya caqiidadooda ama ansixinaya.

ayat.arabic: وَلَا يَصُدُّنَّكَ عَنۡ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ بَعۡدَ إِذۡ أُنزِلَتۡ إِلَيۡكَۖ وَٱدۡعُ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَۖ وَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ

en.text: And never let them avert you from the verses of Allāh after they have been revealed to you. And invite [people] to your Lord. And never be of those who associate others with Allāh.

so.text: 87. Oo yeysan kaa jeedin Aayadaha Alle kaddib marka lagagu soo dejiyey, uguna yeedh 'dadka' xagga Rabbigaa, oo ha ka mid noqonnin Mushrikiinta.

ayat.arabic: وَلَا تَدۡعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَۘ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۚ كُلُّ شَيۡءٍ هَالِكٌ إِلَّا وَجۡهَهُۥۚ لَهُ ٱلۡحُكۡمُ وَإِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُونَ

en.text: And do not invoke with Allāh another deity. There is no deity except Him. Everything will be destroyed except His Face.[1122] His is the judgement, and to Him you will be returned.
en.footnotes: [1122] i.e., except Himself.

so.text: 88. Ha baryin (caabudin) la jirka Alle ilaah kale. Ma jiro Ilaah (xaq lagu caabudo) aan Isaga ahayn. Wax waliba way halaagsami Wejgiisa maahee [29]. Isagaa leh xukunka, Xaggiisaana la idiin soo celin.
so.footnotes: [29]. Waa Alle maahee.

ayat.arabic: الٓمٓ

en.text: Alif, Lām, Meem.[1124]
en.footnotes: [1124] See footnote to 2:1.

so.text: 1. Alif Laam-Miim [1].
so.footnotes: [1]. Eeg sharaxa Suuradda 2: Aayadda 1.

ayat.arabic: أَحَسِبَ ٱلنَّاسُ أَن يُتۡرَكُوٓاْ أَن يَقُولُوٓاْ ءَامَنَّا وَهُمۡ لَا يُفۡتَنُونَ

en.text: Do the people think that they will be left to say, "We believe" and they will not be tried?

so.text: 2. Ma waxay dadku moodaan in loogaga tegayo inay yidhaahdaan: “Waan rumeynay (Xaqa) iyagoo aan la imtixaameyn?

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ فَتَنَّا ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡۖ فَلَيَعۡلَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ صَدَقُواْ وَلَيَعۡلَمَنَّ ٱلۡكَٰذِبِينَ

en.text: But We have certainly tried those before them, and Allāh will surely make evident those who are truthful, and He will surely make evident the liars.

so.text: 3. Waxaanu imtixaannay kuwii ka horreeyey iyaga. Alle wuu muujin kuwa uu run ka yahay (Iimaanka), wuuna muujin beenlowyada.

ayat.arabic: أَمۡ حَسِبَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَعۡمَلُونَ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ أَن يَسۡبِقُونَاۚ سَآءَ مَا يَحۡكُمُونَ

en.text: Or do those who do evil deeds think they can outrun [i.e., escape] Us? Evil is what they judge.

so.text: 4. Mise ma waxay moodaan kuwa fala xumaatooyinka [2] inay naga fakan karaan? Xumaa waxay xukumi.
so.footnotes: [2]. Shirkiga iyo xumaha kale sida dilka xaq darrada ah, zinada-dhilleysiga, xatooyada, kibirka, beenta, khiyaanada, xasadka, iwm.

ayat.arabic: مَن كَانَ يَرۡجُواْ لِقَآءَ ٱللَّهِ فَإِنَّ أَجَلَ ٱللَّهِ لَأٓتٖۚ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ

en.text: Whoever should hope for the meeting with Allāh - indeed, the term [decreed by] Allāh is coming. And He is the Hearing, the Knowing.

so.text: 5. Qofkii rajeyn la kulanka Alle, hubaal ajasha uu Alle (qoray) way imaan (ee ha isu diyaariyo). Alle waa wax kasta Maqlaha, wax kasta Ogsoonaha ah.

ayat.arabic: وَمَن جَٰهَدَ فَإِنَّمَا يُجَٰهِدُ لِنَفۡسِهِۦٓۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَغَنِيٌّ عَنِ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

en.text: And whoever strives only strives for [the benefit of] himself. Indeed, Allāh is Free from need of the worlds.

so.text: 6. Qofkii dadaala, wuxuu u dadaalayaa naftiisa. Hubaal, Alle waa ka deeqtoon yahay uumanka.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَنُكَفِّرَنَّ عَنۡهُمۡ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمۡ وَلَنَجۡزِيَنَّهُمۡ أَحۡسَنَ ٱلَّذِي كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ

en.text: And those who believe and do righteous deeds - We will surely remove from them their misdeeds and will surely reward them according to the best of what they used to do.

so.text: 7. Kuwa (xaqa) rumeeyey oo samaha fala, waxaanu xaqiiq u asturi denbiyadooda, waxaana u abaal marin si waafaqsan waxa u wanaagsan ay falayeen.

ayat.arabic: وَوَصَّيۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ بِوَٰلِدَيۡهِ حُسۡنٗاۖ وَإِن جَٰهَدَاكَ لِتُشۡرِكَ بِي مَا لَيۡسَ لَكَ بِهِۦ عِلۡمٞ فَلَا تُطِعۡهُمَآۚ إِلَيَّ مَرۡجِعُكُمۡ فَأُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ

en.text: And We have enjoined upon man goodness to parents. But if they endeavor to make you associate with Me that of which you have no knowledge,[1125] do not obey them. To Me is your return, and I will inform you about what you used to do.
en.footnotes: [1125] i.e., no knowledge of its divinity. There can be no knowledge about something which is non-existent or untrue.

so.text: 8. Waxaan ku waajibannay aadmiga inuu wanaajiyo oo baarri u ahaado labadiisa waalid, haddiise ay kugula dadaalaan inaad ila wadaajiso (cibaadada) waxaad u heysan cilmi [3], ha ku adeecin. Waa Xaggayga noqodkiinnu, waxaana idiin sheegi (oo idinka abaal marin) waxaad camal fali jirteen (oo dhan).
so.footnotes: [3]. Waa aydaan wax xujo ah u heysan ilaahnimadooda. Ma jiraan wax cilmi ah oo loo heli karo waxaan jirin ama aan run ahayn.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَنُدۡخِلَنَّهُمۡ فِي ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ

en.text: And those who believe and do righteous deeds - We will surely admit them among the righteous [into Paradise].

so.text: 9. Kuwase (Xaqa) rumeeyey oo samaha fala, Waxaanu gelin iyaga la jirka suubbanayaasha (Jannada sare).

ayat.arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يَقُولُ ءَامَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ فَإِذَآ أُوذِيَ فِي ٱللَّهِ جَعَلَ فِتۡنَةَ ٱلنَّاسِ كَعَذَابِ ٱللَّهِۖ وَلَئِن جَآءَ نَصۡرٞ مِّن رَّبِّكَ لَيَقُولُنَّ إِنَّا كُنَّا مَعَكُمۡۚ أَوَلَيۡسَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَعۡلَمَ بِمَا فِي صُدُورِ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

en.text: And of the people are some who say, "We believe in Allāh," but when one [of them] is harmed for [the cause of] Allāh, he considers the trial [i.e., harm] of the people as [if it were] the punishment of Allāh. But if victory comes from your Lord, they say, "Indeed, We were with you." Is not Allāh most knowing of what is within the breasts of the worlds [i.e., all creatures]?

so.text: 10. Waxaa ka mid ah dadka kuwo yidhaahda: Waxaanu rumeynay Alle, markiise lagu dhibaateeyo Alle darti, mooda fidmada dadka sida Cadaabka Alle, hadduuna ka yimaado gargaar xagga Rabbigaa, waxay (munaafiqiinta) hubaal odhan: Waxaanu aheyn la jirkiin. Miyuusan Alle ahayn kan dhab u Ogsoon waxa ku jira laabaha (dadka).

ayat.arabic: وَلَيَعۡلَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَلَيَعۡلَمَنَّ ٱلۡمُنَٰفِقِينَ

en.text: And Allāh will surely make evident those who believe, and He will surely make evident the hypocrites.

so.text: 11. Xaqiiq, Alle wuu muujin kuwa rumeeyey, wuuna muujin munaafiqiinta.

ayat.arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ٱتَّبِعُواْ سَبِيلَنَا وَلۡنَحۡمِلۡ خَطَٰيَٰكُمۡ وَمَا هُم بِحَٰمِلِينَ مِنۡ خَطَٰيَٰهُم مِّن شَيۡءٍۖ إِنَّهُمۡ لَكَٰذِبُونَ

en.text: And those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Follow our way, and we will carry your sins."[1126] But they will not carry anything of their sins. Indeed, they are liars.
en.footnotes: [1126] The phrase may also read: "and let us carry your sins," i.e., the responsibility for your sins.

so.text: 12. Kuwa gaalooba waxay ku yidhaahdaan kuwa rumeeyey: Soo raaca jidkayaga waxaan idinka qaadi denbiyadiinna [4]. Ma aha kuwo ka qaadi denbiyadooda waxba; xaqiiq, waa beenlawyo.
so.footnotes: [4]. Macnahu wuxuu sidoo kale noqon karaa: Markaa aan qaadnee denbiyadiinna, macnaha waa innagaa nala weydiin oo mas’uul ka ah denbiyadiinna.

ayat.arabic: وَلَيَحۡمِلُنَّ أَثۡقَالَهُمۡ وَأَثۡقَالٗا مَّعَ أَثۡقَالِهِمۡۖ وَلَيُسۡـَٔلُنَّ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ عَمَّا كَانُواْ يَفۡتَرُونَ

en.text: But they will surely carry their [own] burdens and [other] burdens along with their burdens,[1127] and they will surely be questioned on the Day of Resurrection about what they used to invent.
en.footnotes: [1127] Besides their own sins, they will carry those of the people they misled, although it will not lessen the burden of the latter.

so.text: 13. Waxay qaadi culaysyadooda [5], iyo culaysyo kale oo la jira culaysyadooda,  waxaana la weydiin Maalinta Qiyaamaha waxay been abuuran jireen.
so.footnotes: [5]. Waxay qaadi doonaan denbiyadooda, ay u dheer yihiin denbiyada dadka ay lumiyeen, iyagoo kuwaasi dambe aan iyagana denbiga sidaa uusan kaga dhaceyn oo lagaga naaqusineyn.

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوۡمِهِۦ فَلَبِثَ فِيهِمۡ أَلۡفَ سَنَةٍ إِلَّا خَمۡسِينَ عَامٗا فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلطُّوفَانُ وَهُمۡ ظَٰلِمُونَ

en.text: And We certainly sent Noah to his people, and he remained among them a thousand years minus fifty years, and the flood seized them while they were wrongdoers.

so.text: 14. Waxaanu dhab ahaan u dirnay Nuux qolodiisii, wuxuuna dhex joogay kun sano oo dhimman konton sano, waxaana qaaday Duufaan iyagoo ah daalimiin.

ayat.arabic: فَأَنجَيۡنَٰهُ وَأَصۡحَٰبَ ٱلسَّفِينَةِ وَجَعَلۡنَٰهَآ ءَايَةٗ لِّلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

en.text: But We saved him and the companions of the ship, and We made it[1128] a sign for the worlds.
en.footnotes: [1128] i.e., the ship, the event or the story.

so.text: 15. Markaasaan badbaadinnay (Nuux) iyo kuwii kula jiray Doonnida, waxaana uga yeelnay calaamo [6] 'digniin' ummadaha.
so.footnotes: [6]. Waxaa loola jeedaa doonnida, ama dhacdadaasi weyn.

ayat.arabic: وَإِبۡرَٰهِيمَ إِذۡ قَالَ لِقَوۡمِهِ ٱعۡبُدُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَٱتَّقُوهُۖ ذَٰلِكُمۡ خَيۡرٞ لَّكُمۡ إِن كُنتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُونَ

en.text: And [We sent] Abraham, when he said to his people, "Worship Allāh and fear Him. That is best for you, if you should know.

so.text: 16. (Waxaana soo dirnay) Ibraahiim markuu ku lahaa qolodiisii: Caabuda Alle (Keliya) oo ka cabsada (iskana jira xuma falka), arrinkan baa idiin khayr badan, haddaad og tihiin.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّمَا تَعۡبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَوۡثَٰنٗا وَتَخۡلُقُونَ إِفۡكًاۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ تَعۡبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ لَا يَمۡلِكُونَ لَكُمۡ رِزۡقٗا فَٱبۡتَغُواْ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرِّزۡقَ وَٱعۡبُدُوهُ وَٱشۡكُرُواْ لَهُۥٓۖ إِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُونَ

en.text: You only worship, besides Allāh, idols, and you produce a falsehood. Indeed, those you worship besides Allāh do not possess for you [the power of] provision. So seek from Allāh provision and worship Him and be grateful to Him. To Him you will be returned."

so.text: 17. Waxaad uun caabuddaan asnaam halkii Alle, oo been abuur sameysaan. Kuwaad caabuddaan Alle sokadi idiin ma hanan karaan risiq, ee ka doonta risiqa Alle agtiis (oo keliya) oo caabuda Isagoo Keliya oo ku mahdiya. Xaggiisaa la idiin soo celin.

ayat.arabic: وَإِن تُكَذِّبُواْ فَقَدۡ كَذَّبَ أُمَمٞ مِّن قَبۡلِكُمۡۖ وَمَا عَلَى ٱلرَّسُولِ إِلَّا ٱلۡبَلَٰغُ ٱلۡمُبِينُ

en.text: And if you [people] deny [the message] - already nations before you have denied. And there is not upon the Messenger except [the duty of] clear notification.[1129]
en.footnotes: [1129] Commentators have differed over this verse - whether it is a continuation of the words of Prophet Abraham or words of comfort given by Allāh to Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ), which according to context seems more likely.

so.text: 18. Haddaad beenisaan (Xaqa), waxaa beeniyey ummado idinka horreeyey. Ma saarna Rasuulka waxaan ahayn Gaarsiin cad 'ee Diinta Alle' [7].
so.footnotes: [7]. Mufasiriinta waxay isku khilaafeen Aayaddan inay tahay mid la socota hadalkii Nabi Ibraahiim, ama hadal uu Alle ku samirsiinayo oo ugu laab qaboojinayo Nabi Muxammad s.c.w., sidase ka muuqata hal dhaca hadalka waa inay u tahay samirsiin iyo laab qaboojin Nabi Muxammad s.c.w.

ayat.arabic: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ كَيۡفَ يُبۡدِئُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡخَلۡقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُۥٓۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرٞ

en.text: Have they not considered how Allāh begins creation and then repeats it? Indeed that, for Allāh, is easy.

so.text: 19. Miyeyna u fiirsan sida Alle u billaaba abuuridda (uunka), haddana u soo celin? Hubaal arrinkaasi Alle wuu u fudud yahay.

ayat.arabic: قُلۡ سِيرُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَٱنظُرُواْ كَيۡفَ بَدَأَ ٱلۡخَلۡقَۚ ثُمَّ ٱللَّهُ يُنشِئُ ٱلنَّشۡأَةَ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةَۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٞ

en.text: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Travel through the land and observe how He began creation. Then Allāh will produce the final creation [i.e., development]. Indeed Allāh, over all things, is competent."

so.text: 20. Dheh: Mara dhulka oo fiiriya sida (Alle) u billaabay uunka, haddana Alle u ahaysiinayo abuuridda dambe. Hubaal, Alle wax walba wuu Karaa.

ayat.arabic: يُعَذِّبُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَرۡحَمُ مَن يَشَآءُۖ وَإِلَيۡهِ تُقۡلَبُونَ

en.text: He punishes whom He wills and has mercy upon whom He wills, and to Him you will be returned.

so.text: 21. Wuxuu cadaabi qofkuu doono, oo u naxariisan qofkuu doono, Xaggiisaana la idiin celin.

ayat.arabic: وَمَآ أَنتُم بِمُعۡجِزِينَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَا فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِۖ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَلِيّٖ وَلَا نَصِيرٖ

en.text: And you will not cause failure [to Allāh] upon the earth or in the heaven. And you have not other than Allāh any protector or any helper.

so.text: 22. Idinku ma ku fakan kartaan dhulka iyo cirka midna, mana lihidin Alle sokadi sokeeye iyo gargaare midna.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِقَآئِهِۦٓ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ يَئِسُواْ مِن رَّحۡمَتِي وَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٞ

en.text: And the ones who disbelieve in the signs of Allāh and the meeting with Him - those have despaired of My mercy, and they will have a painful punishment.

so.text: 23. Kuwa ku gaalooba Aayadaha Alle iyo la Kulankiisa, kuwaasi waxay ka quusteen Naxariistayda, waxaana kuwaa u sugnaaday cadaab xanuun badan.

ayat.arabic: فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوۡمِهِۦٓ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُواْ ٱقۡتُلُوهُ أَوۡ حَرِّقُوهُ فَأَنجَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّقَوۡمٖ يُؤۡمِنُونَ

en.text: And the answer of his [i.e., Abraham's] people was not but that they said, "Kill him or burn him," but Allāh saved him from the fire. Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe.

so.text: 24. Ma ahayn jawaabtii qolodiisii waxaan aheyn inay yidhaahdeen: 'Dila isaga ama guba'. Markaasuu Alle ka badbaadiyey dabkii. Hubaal, arrinkani waxaa ugu sugan calaamooyin ciddii rumeyn.

ayat.arabic: وَقَالَ إِنَّمَا ٱتَّخَذۡتُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَوۡثَٰنٗا مَّوَدَّةَ بَيۡنِكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَاۖ ثُمَّ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ يَكۡفُرُ بَعۡضُكُم بِبَعۡضٖ وَيَلۡعَنُ بَعۡضُكُم بَعۡضٗا وَمَأۡوَىٰكُمُ ٱلنَّارُ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن نَّٰصِرِينَ

en.text: And [Abraham] said, "You have only taken, other than Allāh, idols as [a bond of] affection among you in worldly life. Then on the Day of Resurrection you will deny one another and curse one another, and your refuge will be the Fire, and you will not have any helpers."

so.text: 25.  Wuxuu (Ibraahiim) ku yidhi: Waxaad u samaysateen (caabudid darteed) asnaam Alle sokadi, jaceylka dhexdiinna ah waa oo keliya inta nolosha adduunkan ah, Maalinta Qiyaamahase, wuxuu qaarkiinba dafiri qaarka kale, oo qaarkiin lacnadi  qaarka kale, hoygiinnuna waa Naar, mana jiro wax idiin soo gargaari.

ayat.arabic: ۞ فَـَٔامَنَ لَهُۥ لُوطٞۘ وَقَالَ إِنِّي مُهَاجِرٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّيٓۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ

en.text: And Lot believed him. [Abraham] said, "Indeed, I will emigrate to [the service of] my Lord. Indeed, He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise."

so.text: 26. Waxaa rumeeyey Luud.  Wuxuuna (Ibraahiim) yidhi: Waxaan u haajirayaa xagga Rabbigay. Hubaal, Alle waa Adkaadaha Sare, Xakiimka ah.

ayat.arabic: وَوَهَبۡنَا لَهُۥٓ إِسۡحَٰقَ وَيَعۡقُوبَ وَجَعَلۡنَا فِي ذُرِّيَّتِهِ ٱلنُّبُوَّةَ وَٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُ أَجۡرَهُۥ فِي ٱلدُّنۡيَاۖ وَإِنَّهُۥ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ لَمِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ

en.text: And We gave to him Isaac and Jacob and placed in his descendants prophethood and scripture. And We gave him his reward in this world, and indeed, he is in the Hereafter among the righteous.

so.text: 27. Waxaanu u hibeynay Isxaaq iyo Yac- quub, oo waxaan ka yeelnay Nabinnimada iyo Kitaabka inay ahaadaan ubadkiisa dhexdooda, Waxaana ku siinnay abaal- gudkiisa adduunkan, Aakhirana wuxuu hubaal ka mid yahay inta wanaagsan.

ayat.arabic: وَلُوطًا إِذۡ قَالَ لِقَوۡمِهِۦٓ إِنَّكُمۡ لَتَأۡتُونَ ٱلۡفَٰحِشَةَ مَا سَبَقَكُم بِهَا مِنۡ أَحَدٖ مِّنَ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

en.text: And [mention] Lot, when he said to his people, "Indeed, you commit such immorality as no one has preceded you with from among the worlds.

so.text: 28.  (Waxaan kaloo soo dirnay) Luud, markuu ku lahaa qolodiisii: Waxaad la timaaddeen xumaan uusanba idiinka horrayn axad ka mid ah ummadaha.

ayat.arabic: أَئِنَّكُمۡ لَتَأۡتُونَ ٱلرِّجَالَ وَتَقۡطَعُونَ ٱلسَّبِيلَ وَتَأۡتُونَ فِي نَادِيكُمُ ٱلۡمُنكَرَۖ فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوۡمِهِۦٓ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُواْ ٱئۡتِنَا بِعَذَابِ ٱللَّهِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ

en.text: Indeed, you approach men and obstruct the road[1130] and commit in your meetings [every] evil." And the answer of his people was not but that they said, "Bring us the punishment of Allāh, if you should be of the truthful."
en.footnotes: [1130] i.e., commit highway robbery and acts of aggression against travelers.

so.text: 29. Ma waxaad idinku u galmoonaysaan ragga, oo aad goynaysaan jidka [8], oo kula imaanaysaan Munkar (shirki, gaalnimo, xumaano) kulamadiinna dhexdood, Mase aheyn jawaabtii qoonkiisii waxaan ahayn inay yidhaahdeen: Noo keen Cadaabka Alle haddaad run sheegeyso.
so.footnotes: [8]. Idinkoo jidka gooya oo burcad ah oo u geysta dhac iyo boob socotada. Wuxuu sidoo kale macnaha u dhici karaa gooya taranka u tegidiinna ragga darteed halkii dumarka, taasoo keeneysa tarmid la’aan dadka.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱنصُرۡنِي عَلَى ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلۡمُفۡسِدِينَ

en.text: He said, "My Lord, support me against the corrupting people."

so.text: 30. (Luud) wuxuu yidhi: “Rabbiyow! Iiga gargaar qolodan wax fasaadiya.

ayat.arabic: وَلَمَّا جَآءَتۡ رُسُلُنَآ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ بِٱلۡبُشۡرَىٰ قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا مُهۡلِكُوٓاْ أَهۡلِ هَٰذِهِ ٱلۡقَرۡيَةِۖ إِنَّ أَهۡلَهَا كَانُواْ ظَٰلِمِينَ

en.text: And when Our messengers [i.e., angels] came to Abraham with the good tidings,[1131] they said, "Indeed, we will destroy the people of that [i.e., Lot's] city. Indeed, its people have been wrongdoers."
en.footnotes: [1131] Of the birth of Isaac and his descendant, Jacob.

so.text: 31. Markay Rusushayadii (malaa’igta ahayd) ula yimaadeen Ibraahiim bishaarada [9] waxay yidhaahdeen: Waxaan innagu halaagaynaa dadka magaaladan (Sodom), waayo dadkeedu waa daalimiin (gar ma qaatayaal).
so.footnotes: [9]. Waa dhalashada Isxaaq, iyo wiil wiilki Yacquub.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ إِنَّ فِيهَا لُوطٗاۚ قَالُواْ نَحۡنُ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَن فِيهَاۖ لَنُنَجِّيَنَّهُۥ وَأَهۡلَهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱمۡرَأَتَهُۥ كَانَتۡ مِنَ ٱلۡغَٰبِرِينَ

en.text: [Abraham] said, "Indeed, within it is Lot." They said, "We are more knowing of who is within it. We will surely save him and his family, except his wife. She is to be of those who remain behind."

so.text: 32. (Ibraahiim) wuxuu yidhi: Waxaa ku sugan Luud. Waxay yidhaahdeen: Innaga baa kaa ogsoon cidda dhexdeeda ah, waanu badbaadin (Luud) iyo ehelkiisaba - marka laga reebo marwadiisa, waxay ahaan mid ku harta gadaal 'cadaabka' [10].
so.footnotes: [10]. Waxaa lala cadaabay dadkeeda maadaama ay ku kaalmeyneysey xumahooda.

ayat.arabic: وَلَمَّآ أَن جَآءَتۡ رُسُلُنَا لُوطٗا سِيٓءَ بِهِمۡ وَضَاقَ بِهِمۡ ذَرۡعٗاۖ وَقَالُواْ لَا تَخَفۡ وَلَا تَحۡزَنۡ إِنَّا مُنَجُّوكَ وَأَهۡلَكَ إِلَّا ٱمۡرَأَتَكَ كَانَتۡ مِنَ ٱلۡغَٰبِرِينَ
