en.text: And when Our messengers [i.e., angels] came to Lot, he was distressed for them and felt for them great discomfort.[1132] They said, "Fear not, nor grieve. Indeed, we will save you and your family, except your wife; she is to be of those who remain behind.
en.footnotes: [1132] See footnote to 11:77.

so.text: 33. Markay Rusushayadii 'malaa’igta ahayd' u timid Luud wuu ka murugooday [11], oo cidhiidhi dareemay dartood; waxay yidhaahdeen: Ha cabsan hana murugoon. Waanu ku badbaadin adiga iyo ahelkaaga- ba marka laga reebo marwadaada, waxay ahaan mid ka mid ah kuwaa ku hari gadaal.
so.footnotes: [11]. Eeg sharaxa Suuradda 11: Aayadda 77.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّا مُنزِلُونَ عَلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِ هَٰذِهِ ٱلۡقَرۡيَةِ رِجۡزٗا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَا كَانُواْ يَفۡسُقُونَ

en.text: Indeed, we will bring down on the people of this city punishment from the sky because they have been defiantly disobedient."

so.text: 34. Waxaanu ku soo dejin dadka magaaladan cadaab kaga iman samada caasintooda darteed.

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَد تَّرَكۡنَا مِنۡهَآ ءَايَةَۢ بَيِّنَةٗ لِّقَوۡمٖ يَعۡقِلُونَ

en.text: And We have certainly left of it a sign as clear evidence for a people who use reason.

so.text: 35. Waxaana uga tagnay halkaa calaamo cad (haraaga burburkii magaaladaa) ciddii garasho leh.

ayat.arabic: وَإِلَىٰ مَدۡيَنَ أَخَاهُمۡ شُعَيۡبٗا فَقَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ ٱعۡبُدُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَٱرۡجُواْ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ ٱلۡأٓخِرَ وَلَا تَعۡثَوۡاْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مُفۡسِدِينَ

en.text: And to Madyan [We sent] their brother Shuʿayb, and he said, "O my people, worship Allāh and expect the Last Day and do not commit abuse on the earth, spreading corruption."

so.text: 36. Reer Madyanna (waxaan u dirnay) walaalkood Shucayb, wuxuu yidhi: Tolkayow! Caabuda Alle Keliya oo (ku) rajeeya (cibaadadiinna abaal marinta) Maalinta Aakhiro, hana ku bi'innina arlada fasahaad.

ayat.arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَتۡهُمُ ٱلرَّجۡفَةُ فَأَصۡبَحُواْ فِي دَارِهِمۡ جَٰثِمِينَ

en.text: But they denied him, so the earthquake seized them, and they became within their home [corpses] fallen prone.

so.text: 37. Wayse beeniyeen, markaasaa waxaa qabtay dhul gariir daran (iyo qarax weyn), waxayna noqdeen kuwo (baqti) ah oo degaankooda daadsan.

ayat.arabic: وَعَادٗا وَثَمُودَاْ وَقَد تَّبَيَّنَ لَكُم مِّن مَّسَٰكِنِهِمۡۖ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ فَصَدَّهُمۡ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَكَانُواْ مُسۡتَبۡصِرِينَ

en.text: And [We destroyed] ʿAad and Thamūd, and it has become clear to you from their [ruined] dwellings. And Satan had made pleasing to them their deeds and averted them from the path, and they were endowed with perception.

so.text: 38.Oo (waxaan halaagnay) Caad iyo Thamuud. (Halaaggooduna) wuxuu idiinka muuqdaa guryahoodii. Wuxuu shaydaan u qurxiyey camalladoodii (xumaa) oo ka duway Jidka, inkastoo ay ahaayeen dad il bax ah [12].
so.footnotes: [12]. Hadday waantoobayaan yacni waxay ahaayeen kuwo reer magaal ah leh aqoon hab agaasin ku dhisan oo loola jeedo in arrimaha adduunka baxaalligooda iyo salkooda la gaaro, si fiicanna dhulka loo camiro, oo saro dhaadheer loogaga dhiso, wax kastana maamul fiican loo sameeyo.

ayat.arabic: وَقَٰرُونَ وَفِرۡعَوۡنَ وَهَٰمَٰنَۖ وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَهُم مُّوسَىٰ بِٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِ فَٱسۡتَكۡبَرُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا كَانُواْ سَٰبِقِينَ

en.text: And [We destroyed] Qārūn and Pharaoh and Hāmān. And Moses had already come to them with clear evidences, and they were arrogant in the land, but they were not outrunners [of Our punishment].

so.text: 39. Qaaruun, Fircoon iyo Haamaanna (waa la halaagay). Wuxuuna Muuse ula yimid Aayado cad cad, waxayse ku kibreen arlada, mana aheyn kuwo ka baxsan kara (Cadaabkayaga).

ayat.arabic: فَكُلًّا أَخَذۡنَا بِذَنۢبِهِۦۖ فَمِنۡهُم مَّنۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ حَاصِبٗا وَمِنۡهُم مَّنۡ أَخَذَتۡهُ ٱلصَّيۡحَةُ وَمِنۡهُم مَّنۡ خَسَفۡنَا بِهِ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمِنۡهُم مَّنۡ أَغۡرَقۡنَاۚ وَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيَظۡلِمَهُمۡ وَلَٰكِن كَانُوٓاْ أَنفُسَهُمۡ يَظۡلِمُونَ

en.text: So each We seized for his sin; and among them were those upon whom We sent a storm of stones, and among them were those who were seized by the blast [from the sky], and among them were those whom We caused the earth to swallow, and among them were those whom We drowned. And Allāh would not have wronged them, but it was they who were wronging themselves.

so.text: 40. Mid walbaa (oo ka mid ah) waxaan ku qaadnay denbigiisa, waxaa ka mid ahaa kuwo aan u dirnay dabeyl daran [13], waxaa ka mid ahaa kuwo uu qabsaday qarax weyn [14], waxaa ka mid ahaa mid aan la goynay dhulka [15]; waxaana ka mid ahaa kuwo aan harqinnay [16]. Mana aheyn Alle inuu dulmiyey, iyagaase nafahooda dulminayay.
so.footnotes:
[13]. Oo dhagaxyo wadata sida qoonkii Luud.
[14]. Sida Thamuud iyo qoonkii Shucayb.
[15]. Sida Qaaruun.
[16]. Qoonkii Nuux iyo Fircoon.

ayat.arabic: مَثَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَوۡلِيَآءَ كَمَثَلِ ٱلۡعَنكَبُوتِ ٱتَّخَذَتۡ بَيۡتٗاۖ وَإِنَّ أَوۡهَنَ ٱلۡبُيُوتِ لَبَيۡتُ ٱلۡعَنكَبُوتِۚ لَوۡ كَانُواْ يَعۡلَمُونَ

en.text: The example of those who take allies other than Allāh is like that of the spider who takes [i.e., constructs] a home. And indeed, the weakest of homes is the home of the spider, if they only knew.

so.text: 41. Tusaalaha kuwa sameysta awliyo (ay caabudaan) Alle sokadi waa sida tusaalaha caadho taasoo yeelatay guri, waxaana ugu liita guryaha, guriga caadhada; hadday og yihiin.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعۡلَمُ مَا يَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِهِۦ مِن شَيۡءٖۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ

en.text: Indeed, Allāh knows whatever thing they call upon[1133] other than Him. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
en.footnotes: [1133] In worship.

so.text: 42. Hubaal, Alle wuu ogsoon yahay waxay baryaan Isaga sokadi. Waana Adkaadaha Sare, Xakiimka ah.

ayat.arabic: وَتِلۡكَ ٱلۡأَمۡثَٰلُ نَضۡرِبُهَا لِلنَّاسِۖ وَمَا يَعۡقِلُهَآ إِلَّا ٱلۡعَٰلِمُونَ

en.text: And these examples We present to the people, but none will understand them except those of knowledge.

so.text: 43. Tusaalooyinkan waxaan u soo gudbinnaa dadka, cidise ma fahanto aan aheyn kuwa cilmiga leh.

ayat.arabic: خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ بِٱلۡحَقِّۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗ لِّلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ

en.text: Allāh created the heavens and the earth in truth. Indeed in that is a sign for the believers.

so.text: 44. Alle wuxuu u abuuray samooyinka iyo arlada Xaq. Hubaal, arrinkani waxaa ugu sugan calaamo mu'miniinta.

ayat.arabic: ٱتۡلُ مَآ أُوحِيَ إِلَيۡكَ مِنَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ وَأَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَۖ إِنَّ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ تَنۡهَىٰ عَنِ ٱلۡفَحۡشَآءِ وَٱلۡمُنكَرِۗ وَلَذِكۡرُ ٱللَّهِ أَكۡبَرُۗ وَٱللَّهُ يَعۡلَمُ مَا تَصۡنَعُونَ

en.text: Recite, [O Muḥammad], what has been revealed to you of the Book and establish prayer. Indeed, prayer prohibits immorality and wrongdoing, and the remembrance of Allāh is greater. And Allāh knows that which you do.

so.text: 45. Akhri (Nabi Muxammadow) waxa laguu soo waxyooday oo ka mid ah Kitaabka (Qur’aanka), oogna salaadda. hubaal, salaaddu waxay ka reebtaa (qofka) xumaanta iyo munkarka (falalka la naco). Xusidda Alle baa xaqiiq weyn. Alle wuu Og yahay waxaad sameyneysaan.

ayat.arabic: ۞ وَلَا تُجَٰدِلُوٓاْ أَهۡلَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ إِلَّا بِٱلَّتِي هِيَ أَحۡسَنُ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ مِنۡهُمۡۖ وَقُولُوٓاْ ءَامَنَّا بِٱلَّذِيٓ أُنزِلَ إِلَيۡنَا وَأُنزِلَ إِلَيۡكُمۡ وَإِلَٰهُنَا وَإِلَٰهُكُمۡ وَٰحِدٞ وَنَحۡنُ لَهُۥ مُسۡلِمُونَ

en.text: And do not argue with the People of the Scripture except in a way that is best, except for those who commit injustice among them, and say, "We believe in that which has been revealed to us and revealed to you. And our God and your God is one; and we are Muslims [in submission] to Him."

so.text: 46. Ha la doodinina ehlu Kitaabka si wanaagsan maahee, marka laga reebo kuwooda dulmiga fala, dhahana: Waxaanu rumeysannahay waxa nalagu soo dejiyey iyo waxa la idinku soo dejiyey oo Waxyi ah; Ilaahayaga iyo Ilaahiinnuna waa Mid Keliya, innaguna Isagaan u hoggaansannahay.

ayat.arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَنزَلۡنَآ إِلَيۡكَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَۚ فَٱلَّذِينَ ءَاتَيۡنَٰهُمُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِهِۦۖ وَمِنۡ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ مَن يُؤۡمِنُ بِهِۦۚ وَمَا يَجۡحَدُ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ إِلَّا ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ

en.text: And thus We have sent down to you the Book [i.e., the Qur’ān]. And those to whom We [previously] gave the Scripture believe in it. And among these [people of Makkah] are those who believe in it. And none reject Our verses except the disbelievers.

so.text: 47. Sidaasaan kuugu soo dejinnay (Nabiyow) Kitaabka (Qur’aanka). Kuwa aanu siinnay Kitaabka (ee gartay) way rumeysan yihiin, kuwaana (Carabta iyo qeyrkoodba) waxaa ka mid ah kuwo rumeysan, mana diidaan Aayadahayaga waxaan ahayn gaalada (macangagga ah).

ayat.arabic: وَمَا كُنتَ تَتۡلُواْ مِن قَبۡلِهِۦ مِن كِتَٰبٖ وَلَا تَخُطُّهُۥ بِيَمِينِكَۖ إِذٗا لَّٱرۡتَابَ ٱلۡمُبۡطِلُونَ

en.text: And you did not recite before it any scripture, nor did you inscribe one with your right hand. Then [i.e., otherwise] the falsifiers would have had [cause for] doubt.

so.text: 48. Ma aadna akhriyin horti (Nabiyow) wax Kitaab ah, mana aad ku qorin gacantaada midig, markaas kuwa ehlu baadilka ahi way shakiyi lahaayeen.

ayat.arabic: بَلۡ هُوَ ءَايَٰتُۢ بَيِّنَٰتٞ فِي صُدُورِ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡعِلۡمَۚ وَمَا يَجۡحَدُ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ إِلَّا ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ

en.text: Rather, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is distinct verses [preserved] within the breasts of those who have been given knowledge. And none reject Our verses except the wrongdoers.

so.text: 49. Waase Aayado cad cad Qur’aanku oo ku sugan laabaha kuwa la siiyey cilmiga. Ma diidaan Aayadahayaga waxaan ahayn daalimiinta (gar ma qaatayaasha).

ayat.arabic: وَقَالُواْ لَوۡلَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيۡهِ ءَايَٰتٞ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦۚ قُلۡ إِنَّمَا ٱلۡأٓيَٰتُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَإِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٞ مُّبِينٌ

en.text: But they say, "Why are not signs sent down to him from his Lord?" Say, "The signs are only with Allāh, and I am only a clear warner."

so.text: 50. Waxay (gaaladu) yidhaahdaan: Maxaa calaamooyin (mucjisooyin) loogaga soo dejin waayey xagga Rabbigiis? Dheh: Calaamooyinka sideedaba waa uun xagga Alle, aniguse waxaan uun ahay dige cad.

ayat.arabic: أَوَلَمۡ يَكۡفِهِمۡ أَنَّآ أَنزَلۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ يُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِمۡۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَرَحۡمَةٗ وَذِكۡرَىٰ لِقَوۡمٖ يُؤۡمِنُونَ

en.text: And is it not sufficient for them that We revealed to you the Book [i.e., the Qur’ān] which is recited to them? Indeed in that is a mercy and reminder for a people who believe.

so.text: 51. Miyaanay ku fillayn inaan kugu soo dejinnay (Nabiyow) Kitaabka (Qur’aanka) loo akhriyo? Xaqiiq, arrinkani waxaa ugu sugan naxariis iyo waano ciddii rumayn.

ayat.arabic: قُلۡ كَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ بَيۡنِي وَبَيۡنَكُمۡ شَهِيدٗاۖ يَعۡلَمُ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۗ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ بِٱلۡبَٰطِلِ وَكَفَرُواْ بِٱللَّهِ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡخَٰسِرُونَ

en.text: Say, "Sufficient is Allāh between me and you as Witness. He knows what is in the heavens and earth. And they who have believed in falsehood and disbelieved in Allāh - it is those who are the losers."

so.text: 52. Dheh: Alle baa ku filan markhaati ahaan aniga iyo idinka noo dhexeeya. Wuxuu Ogsoon yahay waxa ku sugan samooyinka iyo arlada. kuwase rumeysan waxyaalaha aan jirin ee beenta ah oo ku gaalooba Alle, waa kuwaa uun kuwa iyagu khasaari (ee ku dambeyn hoog iyo halaag).

ayat.arabic: وَيَسۡتَعۡجِلُونَكَ بِٱلۡعَذَابِ وَلَوۡلَآ أَجَلٞ مُّسَمّٗى لَّجَآءَهُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابُۚ وَلَيَأۡتِيَنَّهُم بَغۡتَةٗ وَهُمۡ لَا يَشۡعُرُونَ

en.text: And they urge you to hasten the punishment. And if not for [the decree of] a specified term, punishment would have reached them. But it will surely come to them suddenly while they perceive not.

so.text: 53. Waxay ku warsadaan inaad u soo dedejiso cadaabka, haddii aanay lahaan lahayn muddo go'an, wuu u iman lahaa cadaabka. Wuxuuna ugu iman kedis iyagoo aan dareemayn.

ayat.arabic: يَسۡتَعۡجِلُونَكَ بِٱلۡعَذَابِ وَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمُحِيطَةُۢ بِٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ

en.text: They urge you to hasten the punishment. And indeed, Hell will be encompassing of the disbelievers

so.text: 54. Waxay ku warsadaan inaad u soo dedejiso cadaabka, oo hubaal Naarta waxay ku hareersan tahay gaalada.

ayat.arabic: يَوۡمَ يَغۡشَىٰهُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابُ مِن فَوۡقِهِمۡ وَمِن تَحۡتِ أَرۡجُلِهِمۡ وَيَقُولُ ذُوقُواْ مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ

en.text: On the Day the punishment will cover them from above them and from below their feet and it is said, "Taste [the result of] what you used to do."

so.text: 55. Maalinta marka cadaabka ka dabooli  (gaalada) dushooda iyo lugahooda hoostoodaba, wuxuuna Alle ku odhan: Dhadhamiya waxaad camal xun fali jirteen.

ayat.arabic: يَٰعِبَادِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِنَّ أَرۡضِي وَٰسِعَةٞ فَإِيَّٰيَ فَٱعۡبُدُونِ

en.text: O My servants who have believed, indeed My earth is spacious, so worship only Me.

so.text: 56. Addoomahayga (Xaqa) rumeeyow! dhulkaygu wuu ballaaran yahaye, ee Anigoo (Keliya) i caabuda.

ayat.arabic: كُلُّ نَفۡسٖ ذَآئِقَةُ ٱلۡمَوۡتِۖ ثُمَّ إِلَيۡنَا تُرۡجَعُونَ

en.text: Every soul will taste death. Then to Us will you be returned.

so.text: 57. Naf walbaa waa tii dhadhamisa geeri. Xaggayagaana la idiin soo celin.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَنُبَوِّئَنَّهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡجَنَّةِ غُرَفٗا تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَاۚ نِعۡمَ أَجۡرُ ٱلۡعَٰمِلِينَ

en.text: And those who have believed and done righteous deeds - We will surely assign to them of Paradise [elevated] chambers beneath which rivers flow, wherein they abide eternally. Excellent is the reward of the [righteous] workers

so.text: 58. Kuwa (Xaqa) rumeeyey oo samaha fala waxaanu ka siin hoy rugaha sare ee Jannada dhexdeeda, ay webiyadu hoostoodu qul-qulaan iyagoo ku waaraya weligood, Wanaagsanaa abaalka kuwa camal fiican fasha.

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ صَبَرُواْ وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمۡ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ

en.text: Who have been patient and upon their Lord rely.

so.text: 59. Ee ah kuwa samra oo Rabbigood ku kalsoon oo tala saarta.

ayat.arabic: وَكَأَيِّن مِّن دَآبَّةٖ لَّا تَحۡمِلُ رِزۡقَهَا ٱللَّهُ يَرۡزُقُهَا وَإِيَّاكُمۡۚ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ

en.text: And how many a creature carries not its [own] provision. Allāh provides for it and for you. And He is the Hearing, the Knowing.

so.text: 60. Badanaa noole dhul socod ah oo aan xambaarsaneyn risiqeeda, Alle baa arsaaqa iyo idinkaba. Alle Waa wax kasta Maqlaha, wax kasta Ogsoonaha ah.

ayat.arabic: وَلَئِن سَأَلۡتَهُم مَّنۡ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَسَخَّرَ ٱلشَّمۡسَ وَٱلۡقَمَرَ لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُۖ فَأَنَّىٰ يُؤۡفَكُونَ

en.text: If you asked them, "Who created the heavens and earth and subjected the sun and the moon?" they would surely say, "Allāh." Then how are they deluded?

so.text: 61. Haddaad (gaalada) weydiiso: Yaa abuuray samooyinka iyo arlada oo sakhiray qorraxda iyo dayaxa? Waxay odhan: Allaah. Ee xaggee baa loo iilay?

ayat.arabic: ٱللَّهُ يَبۡسُطُ ٱلرِّزۡقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ مِنۡ عِبَادِهِۦ وَيَقۡدِرُ لَهُۥٓۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيمٞ

en.text: Allāh extends provision for whom He wills of His servants and restricts for him. Indeed Allāh is, of all things, Knowing.

so.text: 62. Alle wuxuu u waasiciyaa risiqa kuu doono ee ka mid ah addoomahiisa, oo ku cidhiidhiyaa (kuu doono). Hubaal, Alle wax walba wuu Ogsoon yahay.

ayat.arabic: وَلَئِن سَأَلۡتَهُم مَّن نَّزَّلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءٗ فَأَحۡيَا بِهِ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَوۡتِهَا لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُۚ قُلِ ٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِۚ بَلۡ أَكۡثَرُهُمۡ لَا يَعۡقِلُونَ

en.text: And if you asked them, "Who sends down rain from the sky and gives life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness?" they would surely say, "Allāh." Say, "Praise to Allāh"; but most of them do not reason.

so.text: 63. Haddaad (gaalada) weydiiso: Yaa ka soo dejiya biyo (roob) daruuraha, oo ku nooleeya arlada dhimashadeeda kaddib? Waxay odhan: Allaah. Dheh: Ammaan idilkeed iyo mahad waxaa iska leh Allaah. Badankooduse wax ma gartaan.

ayat.arabic: وَمَا هَٰذِهِ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنۡيَآ إِلَّا لَهۡوٞ وَلَعِبٞۚ وَإِنَّ ٱلدَّارَ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةَ لَهِيَ ٱلۡحَيَوَانُۚ لَوۡ كَانُواْ يَعۡلَمُونَ

en.text: And this worldly life is not but diversion and amusement. And indeed, the home of the Hereafter - that is the [eternal] life, if only they knew.

so.text: 64. Ma aha noloshatan adduunku waxaan aheyn madaddaalo iyo ciyaar. Oo hubaal Daarta dambeysa - taasi weeyaan nolosha dhabta ah (ee waarista), waase hadday og yihiin.

ayat.arabic: فَإِذَا رَكِبُواْ فِي ٱلۡفُلۡكِ دَعَوُاْ ٱللَّهَ مُخۡلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ فَلَمَّا نَجَّىٰهُمۡ إِلَى ٱلۡبَرِّ إِذَا هُمۡ يُشۡرِكُونَ

en.text: And when they board a ship, they supplicate Allāh, sincere to Him in religion [i.e., faith and hope]. But when He delivers them to the land, at once they associate others with Him

so.text: 65. Markay koraan doonyaha, waxay baryaan Alle (Keliya), iyagoo u keli yeelaya cibaadada, markase uu nabad ku keeno barriga, markaasay u shariik yeelaan.

ayat.arabic: لِيَكۡفُرُواْ بِمَآ ءَاتَيۡنَٰهُمۡ وَلِيَتَمَتَّعُواْۚ فَسَوۡفَ يَعۡلَمُونَ

en.text: So that they will deny what We have granted them, and they will enjoy themselves. But they are going to know.[1134]
en.footnotes: [1134] Grammatically, the verse may also be read as a threat, i.e., "So let them deny what We have granted them and let them enjoy themselves, for they are going to know."

so.text: 66. Sidaasay uga abaal dhacaan waxaanu siinnay, sidaas darteed ha iska raaxeysteen [17], wayse ogaan doonaan (cidhibteeda).
so.footnotes: [17]. Waxaa sidoo kale Aayadda loo fasiri karaa gooddin ahaan: “Ee ha ka abaal dhacaan waxa aanu siinnay oo ha iska raaxeystaan, wayse ogaan doonaan waxa ku dhaca.

ayat.arabic: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ أَنَّا جَعَلۡنَا حَرَمًا ءَامِنٗا وَيُتَخَطَّفُ ٱلنَّاسُ مِنۡ حَوۡلِهِمۡۚ أَفَبِٱلۡبَٰطِلِ يُؤۡمِنُونَ وَبِنِعۡمَةِ ٱللَّهِ يَكۡفُرُونَ

en.text: Have they not seen that We made [Makkah] a safe sanctuary, while people are being taken away[1135] all around them? Then in falsehood do they believe, and in the favor of Allāh they disbelieve?
en.footnotes: [1135] i.e., killed and taken captive.

so.text: 67. Miyeyna arkayn (gaaladii Quraysheed) inaanu yeellay (dejinnay) Xaram Aamin ah, halka dadka laga dafo hareerahooda [18]? Ee ma baadil (shirki) bay rumeyn, oo ku gaaloobi Nicmadda Alle (Towxiidka)?
so.footnotes: [18]. Macnaha waa in la dilo oo loo soo qaato qafaal ahaan.

ayat.arabic: وَمَنۡ أَظۡلَمُ مِمَّنِ ٱفۡتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا أَوۡ كَذَّبَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُۥٓۚ أَلَيۡسَ فِي جَهَنَّمَ مَثۡوٗى لِّلۡكَٰفِرِينَ

en.text: And who is more unjust than one who invents a lie about Allāh or denies the truth when it has come to him? Is there not in Hell a [sufficient] residence for the disbelievers?

so.text: 68. Yaa ka dulmi badan kan ka been sheega Alle ama beeniya Xaqa markuu u yimid? Miyaanay ahayn Naarta hoyga gaalada?

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ جَٰهَدُواْ فِينَا لَنَهۡدِيَنَّهُمۡ سُبُلَنَاۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَمَعَ ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ

en.text: And those who strive for Us - We will surely guide them to Our ways.[1136] And indeed, Allāh is with the doers of good.
en.footnotes: [1136] The various ways and means to attain the acceptance and pleasure of Allāh.

so.text: 69. Kuwase aad ugu dadaala Arrinkayaga (diinta oo ku camal fala), waxaanu ku hanuunin Jidadkayaga (lagu nabad galo). Oo Alle wuxuu la jiraa sama falayaasha.

ayat.arabic: الٓمٓ

en.text: Alif, Lām, Meem.[1138]
en.footnotes: [1138] See footnote to 2:1.

so.text: 1. Alif laam-miim [1].
so.footnotes: [1]. Eeg sharaxa hoose ee Suuradda 2 Al-Baqarah: Aayadda koowaad.

ayat.arabic: غُلِبَتِ ٱلرُّومُ

en.text: The Byzantines have been defeated[1139]
en.footnotes: [1139] By the Persians.

so.text: 2. Ruum waxaa lagaga adkaaday.

ayat.arabic: فِيٓ أَدۡنَى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَهُم مِّنۢ بَعۡدِ غَلَبِهِمۡ سَيَغۡلِبُونَ

en.text: In the nearest land.[1140] But they, after their defeat, will overcome
en.footnotes: [1140] Another meaning is "in the lowest land."

so.text: 3. Dhulka soke ee hooseeya (Shaam), iyaguna, kaddib markii laga adkaaday [2], way adkaan doonaan.
so.footnotes: [2]. Waxaa ka adkaaday Furus. Furus ama Peershiya waa magacii hore ee loo yiqiin Iiraan.

ayat.arabic: فِي بِضۡعِ سِنِينَۗ لِلَّهِ ٱلۡأَمۡرُ مِن قَبۡلُ وَمِنۢ بَعۡدُۚ وَيَوۡمَئِذٖ يَفۡرَحُ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ

en.text: Within three to nine years. To Allāh belongs the command [i.e., decree] before and after. And that day the believers will rejoice

so.text: 4. Dhowr sano gudahood, Amarka Alle baa iska leh hor iyo gadaalba. Maalintaasayna mu’miniintu ku farxi [3].
so.footnotes: [3]. Guusha uu Alle siin ehlu kitaabka  darteed, ay ka guuleysan Furuskii dab caabudka ahaa waagaas.

ayat.arabic: بِنَصۡرِ ٱللَّهِۚ يَنصُرُ مَن يَشَآءُۖ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

en.text: In the victory of Allāh.[1141] He gives victory to whom He wills, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
en.footnotes: [1141] i.e., the victory given by Allāh to a people of the Scripture (Christians) over the Magians of Persia.

so.text: 5. Gargaarka Alle, wuxuu (Alle) u gargaaraa cidduu doono, waana Adkaadaha Sare, Naxariista Badan.

ayat.arabic: وَعۡدَ ٱللَّهِۖ لَا يُخۡلِفُ ٱللَّهُ وَعۡدَهُۥ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ

en.text: [It is] the promise of Allāh. Allāh does not fail in His promise, but most of the people do not know.

so.text: 6. Waa Ballan Alle, kama uu baxo Alle Ballankiisa, dadka badankiisuse ma oga.

ayat.arabic: يَعۡلَمُونَ ظَٰهِرٗا مِّنَ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَهُمۡ عَنِ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ هُمۡ غَٰفِلُونَ

en.text: They know what is apparent of the worldly life, but they, of the Hereafter, are unaware.

so.text: 7. Waxay yaqaanaan (dadku) daahirka muuqaalka nolosha adduunkan, nolosha dambe se (Aakhirada) way moog yihiin.

ayat.arabic: أَوَلَمۡ يَتَفَكَّرُواْ فِيٓ أَنفُسِهِمۗ مَّا خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَأَجَلٖ مُّسَمّٗىۗ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرٗا مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِ بِلِقَآيِٕ رَبِّهِمۡ لَكَٰفِرُونَ

en.text: Do they not contemplate within themselves?[1142] Allāh has not created the heavens and the earth and what is between them except in truth and for a specified term. And indeed, many of the people, in the meeting with their Lord, are disbelievers.
en.footnotes: [1142] An additional meaning is "Do they not contemplate concerning themselves."

so.text: 8. Miyeyna ka fakarin nafahooda: Alle uma abuurin samooyinka iyo arlada iyo waxa u dhexeeya waxaan ahayn Xaq iyo muddo magacaaban? In badan oo dadka ka mid ahna waxay beeniyaan la kulanka Rabbigood.

ayat.arabic: أَوَلَمۡ يَسِيرُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَيَنظُرُواْ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡۚ كَانُوٓاْ أَشَدَّ مِنۡهُمۡ قُوَّةٗ وَأَثَارُواْ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَعَمَرُوهَآ أَكۡثَرَ مِمَّا عَمَرُوهَا وَجَآءَتۡهُمۡ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِۖ فَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيَظۡلِمَهُمۡ وَلَٰكِن كَانُوٓاْ أَنفُسَهُمۡ يَظۡلِمُونَ

en.text: Have they not traveled through the earth and observed how was the end of those before them? They were greater than them in power, and they plowed [or excavated] the earth and built it up more than they [i.e., the Makkans] have built it up, and their messengers came to them with clear evidences. And Allāh would not ever have wronged them, but they were wronging themselves.

so.text: 9. Miyeyna marin (gaalada) dhulka oo eegin siday aheyd cidhibta kuwii ka horreeyay (ee beeniyey Rusushii Alle)? Waxay ahaayeen kuwo ka xoog iyo awood badan, waxay beerteen dhulka oo u dhiseen si ka badan siday kuwani u dhiseen, waxaana halkaa ula yimid xujooyin cad Rusushii loo soo diray. Alle ma aha mid dulmiya (dadka), iyaga baase nafahooda ku dulmiya (macaasi).

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسَٰٓـُٔواْ ٱلسُّوٓأَىٰٓ أَن كَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَكَانُواْ بِهَا يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ

en.text: Then the end of those who did evil was the worst [consequence] because they denied the signs of Allāh and used to ridicule them.

so.text: 10. Markaasay noqotay cidhibtii kuwii xuma falay xumaan (Naar), beenintay Aayadaha Alle beeniyeen darteed, waxayna ahaayeen kuwo ku jees-jeesa.

ayat.arabic: ٱللَّهُ يَبۡدَؤُاْ ٱلۡخَلۡقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُۥ ثُمَّ إِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُونَ

en.text: Allāh begins creation; then He will repeat it; then to Him you will be returned.

so.text: 11. Alle baa billaabay uunka, haddana dib u soo nooleyn (dhimasho kaddib), Xaggiisaana la idiin soo celin.

ayat.arabic: وَيَوۡمَ تَقُومُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ يُبۡلِسُ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمُونَ

en.text: And the Day the Hour appears the criminals will be in despair.

so.text: 12. Maalintay dhici Saacadda (Qiyaame) way quusan denbiilayaashu.

ayat.arabic: وَلَمۡ يَكُن لَّهُم مِّن شُرَكَآئِهِمۡ شُفَعَٰٓؤُاْ وَكَانُواْ بِشُرَكَآئِهِمۡ كَٰفِرِينَ

en.text: And there will not be for them among their [alleged] partners any intercessors, and they will [then] be disbelievers in their partners.

so.text: 13. Ugama sugnaan wax shafeecayaal ah dhexdooda kuway (Alle) la wadaajiyeen (cibaadada), waxayna dafiri kuway Alle la wadaajiyeen (cibaadada).

ayat.arabic: وَيَوۡمَ تَقُومُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ يَوۡمَئِذٖ يَتَفَرَّقُونَ

en.text: And the Day the Hour appears - that Day they will become separated.

so.text: 14. Maalintay dhici Saacaddu waa Maalintay kala bixi (dadku).

ayat.arabic: فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَهُمۡ فِي رَوۡضَةٖ يُحۡبَرُونَ

en.text: And as for those who had believed and done righteous deeds, they will be in a garden [of Paradise], delighted.

so.text: 15. Kuwa (Xaqa) rumeeyey oo samaha falay, waxaa lagu maamuusi beer (Janno) gudaheed iyagoo faraxsan.

ayat.arabic: وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَكَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَلِقَآيِٕ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ فِي ٱلۡعَذَابِ مُحۡضَرُونَ

en.text: But as for those who disbelieved and denied Our verses and the meeting of the Hereafter, those will be brought into the punishment [to remain].

so.text: 16. Kuwase gaaloobay oo beeniyey Aayadahayaga iyo kulanka Aakhirada - kuwaa cadaabka ayaa lagu kulmin.

ayat.arabic: فَسُبۡحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ حِينَ تُمۡسُونَ وَحِينَ تُصۡبِحُونَ

en.text: So exalted is Allāh when you reach the evening and when you reach the morning.

so.text: 17. Ee Xurmad weyneeya Alle oo ka hufa (ceeb iyo nuqsaan) markaad galabsataan [4] iyo markaad waabariisataanba [5].
so.footnotes:
[4]. Salaadaha Maghribka iyo Cishaha. 
[5]. Salaadda Subax.

ayat.arabic: وَلَهُ ٱلۡحَمۡدُ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَعَشِيّٗا وَحِينَ تُظۡهِرُونَ

en.text: And to Him is [due all] praise throughout the heavens and the earth. And [exalted is He] at night and when you are at noon.

so.text: 18. (Alle) baana leh ammaan idilkeed iyo mahad samooyinka iyo arlada gudahood, oo mudan ammaan iyo mahdin Casarka iyo duhurnimadaba [6].
so.footnotes: [6]. Salaadaha Duhurka iyo Casarka. Cashiyyan waxaa sidoo kale lagu fasiray habeenka waqtiga caweysinka - Cishaha.

ayat.arabic: يُخۡرِجُ ٱلۡحَيَّ مِنَ ٱلۡمَيِّتِ وَيُخۡرِجُ ٱلۡمَيِّتَ مِنَ ٱلۡحَيِّ وَيُحۡيِ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ بَعۡدَ مَوۡتِهَاۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ تُخۡرَجُونَ

en.text: He brings the living out of the dead and brings the dead out of the living and brings to life the earth after its lifelessness. And thus will you be brought out.[1143]
en.footnotes: [1143] Of the graves or out of the earth at the time of resurrection.

so.text: 19. Wuxuu (Alle) ka soo saaraa wax nool wax dhintay, oo ka soo saaraa wax dhintay wax nool. Wuxuu nooleeyaa arlada dhimashadeeda kaddib. Sidaasaa la idiin soo bixin (dhimasho kaddib).

ayat.arabic: وَمِنۡ ءَايَٰتِهِۦٓ أَنۡ خَلَقَكُم مِّن تُرَابٖ ثُمَّ إِذَآ أَنتُم بَشَرٞ تَنتَشِرُونَ

en.text: And of His signs is that He created you from dust; then, suddenly you were human beings dispersing [throughout the earth].

so.text: 20. Waxaa ka mid ah Calaamooyinka (Alle ee muujinaya Awooddiisa iyo mudnaantiisa Keligi cibaadada) inuu idinka abuuray carro, mise waxaad tihiin dad ku faafa arlada.

ayat.arabic: وَمِنۡ ءَايَٰتِهِۦٓ أَنۡ خَلَقَ لَكُم مِّنۡ أَنفُسِكُمۡ أَزۡوَٰجٗا لِّتَسۡكُنُوٓاْ إِلَيۡهَا وَجَعَلَ بَيۡنَكُم مَّوَدَّةٗ وَرَحۡمَةًۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّقَوۡمٖ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ

en.text: And of His signs is that He created for you from yourselves mates that you may find tranquility in them; and He placed between you affection and mercy. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought.

so.text: 21. Waxaa ka mid ah Calaamooyinkiisa inuu idiinka abuuray nafahiinna lammaan idinla nooc ah si aad ugu xasishaan,  Wuxuu dhexdiinna yeelay kalgacal iyo naxariis, hubaal, arrinkani waxaa ugu sugan calaamooyin ciddii fikiri.

ayat.arabic: وَمِنۡ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ خَلۡقُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَٱخۡتِلَٰفُ أَلۡسِنَتِكُمۡ وَأَلۡوَٰنِكُمۡۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّلۡعَٰلِمِينَ

en.text: And of His signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth and the diversity of your languages and your colors. Indeed in that are signs for those of knowledge.

so.text: 22. Waxaa ka mid ah Calaamooyinkiisa abuurista samooyinka iyo arlada iyo kala duwanaanta carrabyadiinna iyo midabya- diinna. Hubaal, waxaa arrinkani ugu sugan Calaamooyin kuwa aqoonta leh.

ayat.arabic: وَمِنۡ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ مَنَامُكُم بِٱلَّيۡلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ وَٱبۡتِغَآؤُكُم مِّن فَضۡلِهِۦٓۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّقَوۡمٖ يَسۡمَعُونَ

en.text: And of His signs is your sleep by night and day and your seeking of His bounty. Indeed in that are signs for a people who listen.

so.text: 23. Waxaa ka mid ah Calaamooyinkiisa hurdadiinna habeenka iyo doonashadiinna Deeqdiisa maalinta. Xaqiiq Waxaa arrinkani ugu sugan Calaamooyin ciddii wax maqli.

ayat.arabic: وَمِنۡ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ يُرِيكُمُ ٱلۡبَرۡقَ خَوۡفٗا وَطَمَعٗا وَيُنَزِّلُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءٗ فَيُحۡيِۦ بِهِ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ بَعۡدَ مَوۡتِهَآۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّقَوۡمٖ يَعۡقِلُونَ

en.text: And of His signs is [that] He shows you the lightning [causing] fear and aspiration, and He sends down rain from the sky by which He brings to life the earth after its lifelessness. Indeed in that are signs for a people who use reason.

so.text: 24. Waxaa ka mid ah Calaamooyinkiisa inuu idin tusiyo hillaaca oo baqdin iyo rajoba leh, Wuxuu ka soo dejiyaa biyo (roob) daruuraha oo ku nooleeyaa arlada dhimashadeeda kaddib. Hubaal, waxaa arrinkani ugu sugan calaamooyin ciddii wax fahmi.

ayat.arabic: وَمِنۡ ءَايَٰتِهِۦٓ أَن تَقُومَ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلۡأَرۡضُ بِأَمۡرِهِۦۚ ثُمَّ إِذَا دَعَاكُمۡ دَعۡوَةٗ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ إِذَآ أَنتُمۡ تَخۡرُجُونَ

en.text: And of His signs is that the heaven and earth stand [i.e., remain] by His command. Then when He calls you with a [single] call from the earth, immediately you will come forth.

so.text: 25. Waxaa ka mid ah Calaamooyinkiisa inay samada iyo arlada ku taagan yihiin (jiraan) Amarkiisa, haddana markuu idiinka yeedho yeermo keliya dhulka, aad kolkiiba soo baxeysaan.

ayat.arabic: وَلَهُۥ مَن فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ كُلّٞ لَّهُۥ قَٰنِتُونَ

en.text: And to Him belongs whoever is in the heavens and earth. All are to Him devoutly obedient.

so.text: 26. (Alle) baa iska leh waxa ku sugan samooyinka iyo arlada, kulligood Isagay u hoggaansan yihiin (oo adeecaan).

ayat.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي يَبۡدَؤُاْ ٱلۡخَلۡقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُۥ وَهُوَ أَهۡوَنُ عَلَيۡهِۚ وَلَهُ ٱلۡمَثَلُ ٱلۡأَعۡلَىٰ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ

en.text: And it is He who begins creation; then He repeats it, and that is [even] easier for Him. To Him belongs the highest description [i.e., attribute] in the heavens and earth. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

so.text: 27. Waa Kan billaabay uunka, haddana soo nooleyn dhimasho kaddib, wayna u fududdahay arrintaasu. Isagaa iska leh sifooyinka sare samooyinka iyo arlada gudahooda. Waa Adkaadaha Sare, Xakiimka ah.

ayat.arabic: ضَرَبَ لَكُم مَّثَلٗا مِّنۡ أَنفُسِكُمۡۖ هَل لَّكُم مِّن مَّا مَلَكَتۡ أَيۡمَٰنُكُم مِّن شُرَكَآءَ فِي مَا رَزَقۡنَٰكُمۡ فَأَنتُمۡ فِيهِ سَوَآءٞ تَخَافُونَهُمۡ كَخِيفَتِكُمۡ أَنفُسَكُمۡۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نُفَصِّلُ ٱلۡأٓيَٰتِ لِقَوۡمٖ يَعۡقِلُونَ

en.text: He presents to you an example from yourselves. Do you have among those whom your right hands possess [i.e., slaves] any partners in what We have provided for you so that you are equal therein [and] would fear them as your fear of one another [within a partnership]?[1144] Thus do We detail the verses for a people who use reason.
en.footnotes: [1144] See footnote to 16:71.

so.text: 28. Wuxuu idiin yeelay tusaale nafahiinna ah, miyey idinla wadaaagaan kuway midigtiinnu hanato waxa aan idin siinnay oo aad idinku u wada siman tihiin oo aad uga cabsataan sidaad isaga cabsataan intiinna xorta ahi? Sidaasaan ugu yeelnaa Aayadaha caddaan ciddii wax fahmi.

ayat.arabic: بَلِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓاْ أَهۡوَآءَهُم بِغَيۡرِ عِلۡمٖۖ فَمَن يَهۡدِي مَنۡ أَضَلَّ ٱللَّهُۖ وَمَا لَهُم مِّن نَّٰصِرِينَ

en.text: But those who wrong follow their [own] desires without knowledge. Then who can guide one whom Allāh has sent astray? And for them there are no helpers.

so.text: 29. Hase yeeshee, kuwa fala dulmiga (shirkiga iyo xumaha kale) waxay raacaan hawadooda cilmi la'aan, ee yaa hanuunin mid uu Alle lumiyo? Mana laha wax u soo gargaari (Aakhirada).

ayat.arabic: فَأَقِمۡ وَجۡهَكَ لِلدِّينِ حَنِيفٗاۚ فِطۡرَتَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّتِي فَطَرَ ٱلنَّاسَ عَلَيۡهَاۚ لَا تَبۡدِيلَ لِخَلۡقِ ٱللَّهِۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلدِّينُ ٱلۡقَيِّمُ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ

en.text: So direct your face [i.e., self] toward the religion, inclining to truth. [Adhere to] the fiṭrah[1145] of Allāh upon which He has created [all] people. No change should there be in the creation of Allāh.[1146] That is the correct religion, but most of the people do not know.
en.footnotes:
[1145] The natural inborn inclination of man to worship his Creator prior to the corruption of his nature by external influences. Thus, Islāmic monotheism is described as the religion of fiṭrah - that of the inherent nature of mankind.
[1146] i.e., let people remain true to their fiṭrah within the religion of Islām.

so.text: 30. Ee u jeedi wejigaaga toos diinta adigoo aan ka iilan, waa abuurista (wanaagsan) uu Alle ku beeray dadka. Waa inaysan jirin beddelaad uunka Alle (iyo diintiisa), sidaa uu (kugu amray) baa ah Jidka Toosan, dadka badankiisuse ma ay oga.

ayat.arabic: ۞ مُنِيبِينَ إِلَيۡهِ وَٱتَّقُوهُ وَأَقِيمُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَلَا تَكُونُواْ مِنَ ٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ

en.text: [Adhere to it], turning in repentance to Him, and fear Him and establish prayer and do not be of those who associate others with Allāh

so.text: 31. (idinkoo) Alle u noqon oo tawbad keen ah, dhowrana (amarradiisa), oo ooga salaadda, hana ka mid ahaannina Mushrikiinta.

ayat.arabic: مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ فَرَّقُواْ دِينَهُمۡ وَكَانُواْ شِيَعٗاۖ كُلُّ حِزۡبِۭ بِمَا لَدَيۡهِمۡ فَرِحُونَ

en.text: [Or] of those who have divided their religion and become sects, every faction rejoicing in what it has.[1147]
en.footnotes: [1147] Of beliefs, opinions, customs, etc.

so.text: 32. Kuwaasi kala qaybshay diintooda oo noqday kooxo, xizbi walbaa waxay haystaan [7] ay ku faraxsan yihiin.
so.footnotes: [7]. Waxay heystaan oo caqiidooyin ah, caadooyin , dhaqammo, iwm.

ayat.arabic: وَإِذَا مَسَّ ٱلنَّاسَ ضُرّٞ دَعَوۡاْ رَبَّهُم مُّنِيبِينَ إِلَيۡهِ ثُمَّ إِذَآ أَذَاقَهُم مِّنۡهُ رَحۡمَةً إِذَا فَرِيقٞ مِّنۡهُم بِرَبِّهِمۡ يُشۡرِكُونَ

en.text: And when adversity touches the people, they call upon their Lord, turning in repentance to Him. Then when He lets them taste mercy from Him, at once a party of them associate others with their Lord,

so.text: 33. Markuu dhib taabto dadka, waxay baryaan Rabbigood iyagoo u soo noqodkiis badiya, markase uu ka dhadhansiiyo Xaggiissa Naxariis, mise qaarkood waxay billaabaan inay (cid kale) Rabbigood u shariig yeelaan oo la wadaajiyaan cibaadada.

ayat.arabic: لِيَكۡفُرُواْ بِمَآ ءَاتَيۡنَٰهُمۡۚ فَتَمَتَّعُواْ فَسَوۡفَ تَعۡلَمُونَ

en.text: So that they will deny what We have granted them.[1148] Then enjoy yourselves, for you are going to know.
en.footnotes: [1148] Or "So let them deny what We have granted them."

so.text: 34. Si ay uga abaal dhacaan waxa aan siinnay. Iskase raaxeysta (xoogaa yar) waad ogaan doontaan (waxa idinku dhaca).

ayat.arabic: أَمۡ أَنزَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ سُلۡطَٰنٗا فَهُوَ يَتَكَلَّمُ بِمَا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يُشۡرِكُونَ

en.text: Or have We sent down to them an authority [i.e., a proof or scripture], and it speaks of what they have been associating with Him?

so.text: 35. Mise waxaan ku soo dejinnay xujo cad, oo sheegi waxay Alle u shariig yeelaan?

ayat.arabic: وَإِذَآ أَذَقۡنَا ٱلنَّاسَ رَحۡمَةٗ فَرِحُواْ بِهَاۖ وَإِن تُصِبۡهُمۡ سَيِّئَةُۢ بِمَا قَدَّمَتۡ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ إِذَا هُمۡ يَقۡنَطُونَ

en.text: And when We let the people taste mercy, they rejoice therein, but if evil afflicts them for what their hands have put forth, immediately they despair.

so.text: 36. Markaan dhadhsansiinno dadka Naxariis, way ku farxaan, haddayse soo gaarto xumaato ay sababtay waxay gacmahoodu horey u geysteen (oo denbiyo ah), mise wayba quustaan.

ayat.arabic: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَبۡسُطُ ٱلرِّزۡقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقۡدِرُۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّقَوۡمٖ يُؤۡمِنُونَ

en.text: Do they not see that Allāh extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it]? Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe.

so.text: 37. Miyeyna arkayn inuu Alle u ballaariyo risiqa cidduu doono, oo ku cidhiidhiyo (cidduu doono).Waxaa arrinkani xaqiiq ugu sugan calaamooyin ciddii rumayn (Xaqa).

ayat.arabic: فَـَٔاتِ ذَا ٱلۡقُرۡبَىٰ حَقَّهُۥ وَٱلۡمِسۡكِينَ وَٱبۡنَ ٱلسَّبِيلِۚ ذَٰلِكَ خَيۡرٞ لِّلَّذِينَ يُرِيدُونَ وَجۡهَ ٱللَّهِۖ وَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡمُفۡلِحُونَ

en.text: So give the relative his right, as well as the needy and the traveler. That is best for those who desire the face [i.e., approval] of Allāh, and it is they who will be the successful.

so.text: 38. Ee sii kan qaraabada kula ah xaqiisa iyo miskiinka iyo tub socotada (go'doonsan). Sidaasaa u khayr badan kuwa doonaya Wejiga Alle, waana kuwaa liibaanayaasha.

ayat.arabic: وَمَآ ءَاتَيۡتُم مِّن رِّبٗا لِّيَرۡبُوَاْ فِيٓ أَمۡوَٰلِ ٱلنَّاسِ فَلَا يَرۡبُواْ عِندَ ٱللَّهِۖ وَمَآ ءَاتَيۡتُم مِّن زَكَوٰةٖ تُرِيدُونَ وَجۡهَ ٱللَّهِ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡمُضۡعِفُونَ

en.text: And whatever you give for interest [i.e., advantage] to increase within the wealth of people[1149] will not increase with Allāh. But what you give in zakāh,[1150] desiring the face [i.e., approval] of Allāh - those are the multipliers.[1151]
en.footnotes:
[1149] The phrase includes several connotations, among them: a) that which is given as usury or interest, b) that which is given on the condition that it be repaid with interest, and c) a gift given with the intention of obtaining from the recipient greater benefit or a larger gift.
[1150] The meaning of ṣadaqah (voluntary charity) is included here.
[1151] Of their blessings on earth and their rewards in the Hereafter.

so.text: 39. Waxaad bixisaan oo ribo ah, si aad uga badsataan maalka dadka [8], ma badnaado Alle agtiis; wixiise aad bixisaan oo sako [9] ah idinkoo doonaya Wejiga Alle, waa kuwaa kuwa heli ajar labo laab ah [10].
so.footnotes:
[8]. Weedhan waxay leedahay dhowr macne, waxaa ka mid ah macnooyinkaa: a) waxa loo bixiyo ribo ahaan ama kor saar b) waxa la bixiyo iyadoo lagu xiro shardi ah in la gudo iyadoo faa’ido la saartay ha yaraaato ama ha badnaatee faa’idadaa. Iyo c) inaad cid siiso hadiyad adigoo uga jeeda inaad ka hesho ciddaas aad hadiyadda siisay wax ka badan oo ka weyn hadiyadda aad siisay.
[9]. Sakada halkan waxaa sidoo kale soo galaya sadaqada tabaruca ah aad Dar Alle ula baxdo. 
[10]. Waa loo labo jibbaaraa khayrka iyo barakooyinka lagu siiyo arlada iyo ajarka Aakhirada.

ayat.arabic: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَكُمۡ ثُمَّ رَزَقَكُمۡ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمۡ ثُمَّ يُحۡيِيكُمۡۖ هَلۡ مِن شُرَكَآئِكُم مَّن يَفۡعَلُ مِن ذَٰلِكُم مِّن شَيۡءٖۚ سُبۡحَٰنَهُۥ وَتَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُونَ

en.text: Allāh is the one who created you, then provided for you, then will cause you to die, and then will give you life. Are there any of your "partners" who does anything of that? Exalted is He and high above what they associate with Him.

so.text: 40. Alle waa Kan idin abuuray, haddana idin irsaaqa, haddana idin dhinsiin, haddana idin soo nooleyn. Miyey jiraan kuwa aad Alle la wadaajisaan cibaadada mid fali kara wax ka mid ah waxaa? Xurmo oo dhan Isagaa iska leh oo ka hufan (xumaan), wuuna ka Sarreeyaa waxay u shariig yeelaan.

ayat.arabic: ظَهَرَ ٱلۡفَسَادُ فِي ٱلۡبَرِّ وَٱلۡبَحۡرِ بِمَا كَسَبَتۡ أَيۡدِي ٱلنَّاسِ لِيُذِيقَهُم بَعۡضَ ٱلَّذِي عَمِلُواْ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَرۡجِعُونَ

en.text: Corruption has appeared throughout the land and sea by [reason of] what the hands of people have earned so He [i.e., Allāh] may let them taste part of [the consequence of] what they have done that perhaps they will return [to righteousness].

so.text: 41. Waxaa ka muuqday fasahaad barriga iyo badda waxay gacmahu dadku kasbadeen darteed (oo denbiyo ah), si uu Alle u dhadhansiiyo qaar ka mid ah waxay faleen, bal inay in u soo noqdaan (Xaqa).

ayat.arabic: قُلۡ سِيرُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَٱنظُرُواْ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلُۚ كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّشۡرِكِينَ

en.text: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Travel through the land and observe how was the end of those before. Most of them were associators [of others with Allāh].

so.text: 42. Dheh: Mara dhulka oo fiiriya siday aheyd cidhibta kuwii hore (ee beeniyey Xaqa). Waxay ahaayeen badankoodu gaalo mushrikiin ah.

ayat.arabic: فَأَقِمۡ وَجۡهَكَ لِلدِّينِ ٱلۡقَيِّمِ مِن قَبۡلِ أَن يَأۡتِيَ يَوۡمٞ لَّا مَرَدَّ لَهُۥ مِنَ ٱللَّهِۖ يَوۡمَئِذٖ يَصَّدَّعُونَ

en.text: So direct your face [i.e., self] toward the correct religion before a Day comes from Allāh of which there is no repelling. That Day, they will be divided.[1152]
en.footnotes: [1152] Into those destined for Paradise and those destined for Hell.

so.text: 43. Ee u jeedi wejigaaga xagga diinta toosan (Islaamka) ka hor inta aysan ka imaan Alle Maalin aanu jirin qof celin kara. Maalintaasi dadku way kala bixi [11].
so.footnotes: [11]. Waa la kala sooci kuwaa gali Jannada iyo kuwaa gali Naarta.

ayat.arabic: مَن كَفَرَ فَعَلَيۡهِ كُفۡرُهُۥۖ وَمَنۡ عَمِلَ صَٰلِحٗا فَلِأَنفُسِهِمۡ يَمۡهَدُونَ

en.text: Whoever disbelieves - upon him is [the consequence of] his disbelief. And whoever does righteousness - they are for themselves preparing,

so.text: 44. Qofkii gaalooba (isaga bay dhibeysaa) gaalnimadiisu, qofkiise wanaag fala, Kuwaasu waxay u gogol dhigaan nafahooda meel san.

ayat.arabic: لِيَجۡزِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ مِن فَضۡلِهِۦٓۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ

en.text: That He may reward those who have believed and done righteous deeds out of His bounty. Indeed, He does not like the disbelievers.

so.text: 45. Si uu Alle ugu abaal mariyo kuwa (Xaqa) rumeeyey oo samaha fala deeqdiisa; hubaal Alle ma uu jecla gaalada.

ayat.arabic: وَمِنۡ ءَايَٰتِهِۦٓ أَن يُرۡسِلَ ٱلرِّيَاحَ مُبَشِّرَٰتٖ وَلِيُذِيقَكُم مِّن رَّحۡمَتِهِۦ وَلِتَجۡرِيَ ٱلۡفُلۡكُ بِأَمۡرِهِۦ وَلِتَبۡتَغُواْ مِن فَضۡلِهِۦ وَلَعَلَّكُمۡ تَشۡكُرُونَ

en.text: And of His signs is that He sends the winds as bringers of good tidings and to let you taste His mercy [i.e., rain] and so the ships may sail at His command and so you may seek of His bounty, and perhaps you will be grateful.

so.text: 46. Waxaa ka mid ah Calaamooyinka (Alle  ee muujinaya Weynidiisa iyo mudnaantiisa Keligi cibaadada) inuu soo diro dabeylaha iyagoo ku bishaareyn (roob) iyo inuu idin dhadhansiiyo wax ka mid ah Naxariistiisa iyo in doomuhu ku socdaan Amarkiisa oo aad dalabtaan Deeqdiisa, inaad Alle ku mahdisaan.

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مِن قَبۡلِكَ رُسُلًا إِلَىٰ قَوۡمِهِمۡ فَجَآءُوهُم بِٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِ فَٱنتَقَمۡنَا مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجۡرَمُواْۖ وَكَانَ حَقًّا عَلَيۡنَا نَصۡرُ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ

en.text: And We have already sent messengers before you to their peoples, and they came to them with clear evidences; then We took retribution from those who committed crimes, and incumbent upon Us was support[1153] of the believers.
en.footnotes: [1153] i.e., aid or the bestowal of victory.

so.text: 47. Waxaan dhab ahaan u soo dirnay hortaa Rusul xagga dadkoodii, markaasay ula yimaadeen Xujooyin cad cad, waana ka aarsannay kuwii denbi falay. Waa xaq na saaran u gargaarka mu’miniinta.

ayat.arabic: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي يُرۡسِلُ ٱلرِّيَٰحَ فَتُثِيرُ سَحَابٗا فَيَبۡسُطُهُۥ فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ كَيۡفَ يَشَآءُ وَيَجۡعَلُهُۥ كِسَفٗا فَتَرَى ٱلۡوَدۡقَ يَخۡرُجُ مِنۡ خِلَٰلِهِۦۖ فَإِذَآ أَصَابَ بِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنۡ عِبَادِهِۦٓ إِذَا هُمۡ يَسۡتَبۡشِرُونَ

en.text: It is Allāh who sends the winds, and they stir the clouds and spread them in the sky however He wills, and He makes them fragments so you see the rain emerge from within them. And when He causes it to fall upon whom He wills of His servants, immediately they rejoice

so.text: 48. Alle waa Kan soo dira dabeylaha, markaas kicisa daruur, uu ugu fidiyo cirka siduu doono, kana dhiga goosimo, oo aad aragto roobka oo ka soo dhex baxaya, markuu u shubo cidduu doono oo ka mid ah addoomahiisa, mise way ku farxaan.

ayat.arabic: وَإِن كَانُواْ مِن قَبۡلِ أَن يُنَزَّلَ عَلَيۡهِم مِّن قَبۡلِهِۦ لَمُبۡلِسِينَ

en.text: Although they were, before it was sent down upon them - before that, in despair.

so.text: 49. Inkastoo ay ahaayeen ka hor intaan lagu soo di’in roobka wax yar horti, kuwo  quus ka joogay.

ayat.arabic: فَٱنظُرۡ إِلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِ رَحۡمَتِ ٱللَّهِ كَيۡفَ يُحۡيِ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ بَعۡدَ مَوۡتِهَآۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَمُحۡيِ ٱلۡمَوۡتَىٰۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٞ

en.text: So observe the effects of the mercy of Allāh - how He gives life to the earth after its lifelessness. Indeed, that [same one] will give life to the dead, and He is over all things competent.

so.text: 50. Ee fiiri raadadka Raxmadda Alle; siduu u nooleeyo arlada dhimashadeeda kaddib. Hubaal, Kaasi wuu soo nooleyn meytida. Alle wax walba wuu Karaa.

ayat.arabic: وَلَئِنۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا رِيحٗا فَرَأَوۡهُ مُصۡفَرّٗا لَّظَلُّواْ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِۦ يَكۡفُرُونَ

en.text: But if We should send a [bad] wind and they saw [their crops] turned yellow, they would remain thereafter disbelievers.[1154]
en.footnotes: [1154] Denying and ungrateful for the previous favors of Allāh.

so.text: 51. Haddaan ku dirno dabeyl daran (beertooda), oo ay arkaan iyadoo doorsoontay oo caddaatay, waxay markaas noqdaan kuwo ka abaal dhaca 'Alle' [12].
so.footnotes: [12]. Ka abaal dhacaan galladihuu siiyey.

ayat.arabic: فَإِنَّكَ لَا تُسۡمِعُ ٱلۡمَوۡتَىٰ وَلَا تُسۡمِعُ ٱلصُّمَّ ٱلدُّعَآءَ إِذَا وَلَّوۡاْ مُدۡبِرِينَ

en.text: So indeed, you will not make the dead hear, nor will you make the deaf hear the call when they turn their backs, retreating.

so.text: 52. Ee adigu (Nabiyow) wax ma maqashiin kartid maytida, mana maqashiin kartid kuwa dhegaha la’ dhawaaqa, markay tagaan oo dhabarka jeediyaan.

ayat.arabic: وَمَآ أَنتَ بِهَٰدِ ٱلۡعُمۡيِ عَن ضَلَٰلَتِهِمۡۖ إِن تُسۡمِعُ إِلَّا مَن يُؤۡمِنُ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا فَهُم مُّسۡلِمُونَ

en.text: And you cannot guide the blind away from their error. You will only make hear those who believe in Our verses so they are Muslims [in submission to Allāh].

so.text: 53. Ma ka hanuunin kartid kuwa ka indha la’ (Xaqa) lunsanaantooda, cidna ma maqashiin kartid (Xaqa) aan ahayn kuwa rumeysan Aayadahayaga oo u hoggaansan (Muslimiimta ah).

ayat.arabic: ۞ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَكُم مِّن ضَعۡفٖ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ ضَعۡفٖ قُوَّةٗ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ قُوَّةٖ ضَعۡفٗا وَشَيۡبَةٗۚ يَخۡلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ ٱلۡقَدِيرُ

en.text: Allāh is the one who created you from weakness, then made after weakness strength, then made after strength weakness and white hair. He creates what He wills, and He is the Knowing, the Competent.

so.text: 54. Alle waa Kan idinka abuuray (xaalad) tabar yari, haddana baxshay xoog tabar yari kaddib, haddana qaddaray tabar yari iyo cirro xoog kaddib, Wuxuu abuuraa wuxuu doono. Waana Isaga wax kasta Ogsoonaha, wax walba Kara.

ayat.arabic: وَيَوۡمَ تَقُومُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ يُقۡسِمُ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمُونَ مَا لَبِثُواْ غَيۡرَ سَاعَةٖۚ كَذَٰلِكَ كَانُواْ يُؤۡفَكُونَ

en.text: And the Day the Hour appears the criminals will swear they had remained but an hour. Thus they were deluded.

so.text: 55. Maalinta saacadda (Qiyaame) dhacdona, waxay ku dhaaran denbiilayaashu inaysan nagaanin waxaan ahayn saacad, sidaasay xaqa uga iishaan.

ayat.arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡعِلۡمَ وَٱلۡإِيمَٰنَ لَقَدۡ لَبِثۡتُمۡ فِي كِتَٰبِ ٱللَّهِ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡبَعۡثِۖ فَهَٰذَا يَوۡمُ ٱلۡبَعۡثِ وَلَٰكِنَّكُمۡ كُنتُمۡ لَا تَعۡلَمُونَ

en.text: But those who were given knowledge and faith will say, "You remained the extent of Allāh's decree until the Day of Resurrection, and this is the Day of Resurrection, but you did not used to know."[1155]
en.footnotes: [1155] i.e., acknowledge the truth.

so.text: 56. Kuwa la siiyey Cilmiga iyo Iimaanka waxay odhan: Waxaad negaateen in waafaqsan Kitaabka (Qaddarka) Alle ilaa iyo maalinka isa soo Bixinta, marka kani waa Maalinkii isa soo bixinta, ma aydaanse ogeyn [13].
so.footnotes: [13]. Macnaha waa ma aydaan rumeysneyn Xaqa.

ayat.arabic: فَيَوۡمَئِذٖ لَّا يَنفَعُ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ مَعۡذِرَتُهُمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يُسۡتَعۡتَبُونَ

en.text: So that Day, their excuse will not benefit those who wronged, nor will they be asked to appease [Allāh].

so.text: 57. Maalinkaas (Qiyaamaha) ma anfacdo kuwii falay dulmiga (shirki iyo macaasi) cudur daarasho iyo tawbad keen midna.

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ ضَرَبۡنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِي هَٰذَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ مِن كُلِّ مَثَلٖۚ وَلَئِن جِئۡتَهُم بِـَٔايَةٖ لَّيَقُولَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ إِنۡ أَنتُمۡ إِلَّا مُبۡطِلُونَ

en.text: And We have certainly presented to the people in this Qur’ān from every [kind of] example. But, [O Muḥammad], if you should bring them a sign, the disbelievers will surely say, "You [believers] are but falsifiers."

so.text: 58. Waxaan ugu soo qaadannay dadka (nooc) kasta oo tusaale ah Qur’aankan gudahi, haddiise aad (Nabi Muxammadow) ula timaaddo calaamad, gaalada waxay hubaal odhan: Ma tihin idinku waxaan ahayn been ku doodayaal.

ayat.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ يَطۡبَعُ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ

en.text: Thus does Allāh seal the hearts of those who do not know.[1156]
en.footnotes: [1156] i.e., those who do not wish to know the truth and refuse it.

so.text: 59. Sidaasuu Alle u daboolaa quluubta kuwa aan wax ogeyn [14].
so.footnotes: [14]. Waa kuwa aan dooneyn inay bartaan Xaqa oo ku dhaqmaan ee ka dhoohan.

ayat.arabic: فَٱصۡبِرۡ إِنَّ وَعۡدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقّٞۖ وَلَا يَسۡتَخِفَّنَّكَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُوقِنُونَ

en.text: So be patient. Indeed, the promise of Allāh is truth. And let them not disquiet you who are not certain [in faith].

so.text: 60. Ee samir yeelo, hubaal Ballanka Alle waa xaq, yeysanna ku liidsan kuwa aan (Aakhirada) yaqiinsaneyn (oo kaa dhigin mid aan ku sugnaan diintiisa).

ayat.arabic: الٓمٓ

en.text: Alif, Lām, Meem.[1158]
en.footnotes: [1158] See footnote to 2:1.

so.text: 1. Alif Laam Miim [1].
so.footnotes: [1]. Eeg sharaxa hoose ee Suuradda 2: Aayadda 1.

ayat.arabic: تِلۡكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ ٱلۡحَكِيمِ

en.text: These are verses of the wise[1159] Book,
en.footnotes: [1159] See footnote to 10:1.

so.text: 2. Kuwakani waa Aayado ka mid ah Kitaabka (Qur’aanka) Xikmadda badan [2].
so.footnotes: [2]. Xakiim waa tilmaanta qofka warkiisa iyo ficilkiisa salka ku hayaan garasho iyo aragti dheer. waxaa loola jeedaa tilmaamaha doonista, hadaf yeelashada, war samida, falsamada, wax kala saaridda iyo xog ogaanta, aragti dheerida, abwaanka ah.

ayat.arabic: هُدٗى وَرَحۡمَةٗ لِّلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ

en.text: As guidance and mercy for the doers of good

so.text: 3. Hanuun iyo Naxariis u ah sama falayaasha.

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يُقِيمُونَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤۡتُونَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَهُم بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ هُمۡ يُوقِنُونَ

en.text: Who establish prayer and give zakāh, and they, of the Hereafter, are certain [in faith].

so.text: 4. Kuwa ooga salaadda, bixiyana Zakada, ahna kuwo iyagu Aakhiro yaqiinsan.

ayat.arabic: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ عَلَىٰ هُدٗى مِّن رَّبِّهِمۡۖ وَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡمُفۡلِحُونَ

en.text: Those are on [right] guidance from their Lord, and it is those who are the successful.

so.text: 5. Kuwaasi waxay ku sugan yihiin hanuun xagga Rabbigood ah, waana kuwaa liibaanayaasha.

ayat.arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يَشۡتَرِي لَهۡوَ ٱلۡحَدِيثِ لِيُضِلَّ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ بِغَيۡرِ عِلۡمٖ وَيَتَّخِذَهَا هُزُوًاۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٞ مُّهِينٞ

en.text: And of the people is he who buys the amusement of speech[1160] to mislead [others] from the way of Allāh without knowledge and who takes it [i.e., His way] in ridicule. Those will have a humiliating punishment.
en.footnotes: [1160] i.e., that which has no benefit. Described by different ṣaḥābah as shirk (association with Allāh), misleading stories, frivolous songs, or music but includes all which distracts or diverts one from the Qur’ān and remembrance of Allāh.

so.text: 6. Waxaa ka mid ah dadka mid gadan hadal uu isku maaweeliyo [3] si uu uga lumiyo (naftiisa iyo dadkaba) Jidka Alle (Islaamka) cilmi la'aan, oo ku  jees-jeesa (diinta). Kuwaa waxay leeyihiin Cadaab Silcisa.
so.footnotes: [3]. Hadalka maaweelada ah waxay culimadu qaar ku fasireen shirkiga, qaarna wararka dadka lagu lumiyo, heesaha anshax darrada ah, ama Miyuusigga ruxa dadka ee keena is walaaqa, waxaase dhab ahaan soo galaya hadalka maaweelada ah wax kasta oo dadka ka shuqliya Qur’aanka iyo Sunnada Rasuulka.

ayat.arabic: وَإِذَا تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا وَلَّىٰ مُسۡتَكۡبِرٗا كَأَن لَّمۡ يَسۡمَعۡهَا كَأَنَّ فِيٓ أُذُنَيۡهِ وَقۡرٗاۖ فَبَشِّرۡهُ بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ

en.text: And when Our verses are recited to him, he turns away arrogantly as if he had not heard them, as if there was in his ears deafness. So give him tidings of a painful punishment.

so.text: 7. Marka loo akhriyo Aayadahayaga (Qur’aanka), ka jeesta kibir darti, sida inaanu maqal, sidiiyoo uu qabo dhego culeys, ee ugu bishaaree Cadaab xanuun badan.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمۡ جَنَّٰتُ ٱلنَّعِيمِ

en.text: Indeed, those who believe and do righteous deeds - for them are the Gardens of Pleasure,

so.text: 8. Kuwa (Xaqa) rumeeyey oo samaha fala, waxay leeyihiin beero barwaaqo ah 'Janno'.

ayat.arabic: خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَاۖ وَعۡدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقّٗاۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ

en.text: Wherein they abide eternally; [it is] the promise of Allāh [which is] truth. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

so.text: 9. Iyagoo ku waaraya dhexdeeda weligood, waa Ballan Alle oo Xaq ah. Alle waa Adkaadaha Sare , Xakiimka ah.

ayat.arabic: خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ بِغَيۡرِ عَمَدٖ تَرَوۡنَهَاۖ وَأَلۡقَىٰ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ رَوَٰسِيَ أَن تَمِيدَ بِكُمۡ وَبَثَّ فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ دَآبَّةٖۚ وَأَنزَلۡنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءٗ فَأَنۢبَتۡنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوۡجٖ كَرِيمٍ

en.text: He created the heavens without pillars that you see and has cast into the earth firmly set mountains, lest it should shift with you, and dispersed therein from every creature. And We sent down rain from the sky and made grow therein [plants] of every noble kind.

so.text: 10. Wuxuu abuuray samooyinka tiirar la’aan aad aragtaan, wuxuuna ku tuuray dhulka buuro sugan si aanu idiin la dhaqdhaqaaqin, wuxuuna ku fidiyey dhexdeeda nafley nooc kasta leh. Waxaanu ka soo dejinnay biyo (roob) daruuraha, waxaana ku soo bixinnay (dhir) nooc kasta oo wanaagsan.

ayat.arabic: هَٰذَا خَلۡقُ ٱللَّهِ فَأَرُونِي مَاذَا خَلَقَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن دُونِهِۦۚ بَلِ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ فِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٖ

en.text: This is the creation of Allāh. So show Me what those other than Him have created. Rather, the wrongdoers are in clear error.

so.text: 11. Kani waa Abuurka Alle ee i tusa waxay abuureen kuwa sokadi (la caabudo). Mayee, dulmi (shirki iyo xume) falayaashu waxay ku jiraan habow cad.

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ ءَاتَيۡنَا لُقۡمَٰنَ ٱلۡحِكۡمَةَ أَنِ ٱشۡكُرۡ لِلَّهِۚ وَمَن يَشۡكُرۡ فَإِنَّمَا يَشۡكُرُ لِنَفۡسِهِۦۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِيٌّ حَمِيدٞ

en.text: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy.

so.text: 12. Waxaanu dhab ahaan siinnay Luqmaan Xikmad (oo aanu ku nidhi): Ku mahadi Alle. Qofkii ku mahdiya wuxuu uun u mahdiyey naftiisa, qofkiise (Alle) ka abaal dhaca, hubaal Alle waa Hodan, Ammaanan.

ayat.arabic: وَإِذۡ قَالَ لُقۡمَٰنُ لِٱبۡنِهِۦ وَهُوَ يَعِظُهُۥ يَٰبُنَيَّ لَا تُشۡرِكۡ بِٱللَّهِۖ إِنَّ ٱلشِّرۡكَ لَظُلۡمٌ عَظِيمٞ

en.text: And [mention, O Muḥammad], when Luqmān said to his son while he was instructing him, "O my son, do not associate [anything] with Allāh. Indeed, association [with Him] is great injustice."

so.text: 13. (Xus) markuu Luqmaan ku yidhi wiilkiisa isagoo waaninaya: Maandhow! Ha u shariig yeelin Alle waxba. Shirkigu waa dulmi (gef) aad u Weyne [4].
so.footnotes: [4]. Nabigu s.c.w. wuxuu yidhi: Aayadda Qur'aanka ee leh: 'Aan ku dheehin iimaankooda dulmi (gef ama gardarro)" loolama jeedo denbiyada yar yar ee dadku galaan ha ka galeen Alle ama iyaga ha iska galeene) waxaase loola jeedaa shirkiga, soo ma aydaan maqal Qowlka Alle : «Xaqiiq, shirkigu hubaal waa dulmi (gef) weyn. (W.w. Al-Bukhaari).

ayat.arabic: وَوَصَّيۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ بِوَٰلِدَيۡهِ حَمَلَتۡهُ أُمُّهُۥ وَهۡنًا عَلَىٰ وَهۡنٖ وَفِصَٰلُهُۥ فِي عَامَيۡنِ أَنِ ٱشۡكُرۡ لِي وَلِوَٰلِدَيۡكَ إِلَيَّ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ

en.text: And We have enjoined upon man [care] for his parents. His mother carried him, [increasing her] in weakness upon weakness, and his weaning is in two years. Be grateful to Me and to your parents; to Me is the [final] destination.

so.text: 14. Waxaan ku faral yeelnay aadmiga inuu (daryeelo oo) baarri u ahaadolabadiisa waalid. Hooyadii waxay uur ku siddaa iyadoo tabar yar tabar yari kalena u dheer tahay, gudhinta naas nuujintiisuna waa labo sano dhexdood - ee ku mahadi Aniga iyo labadaada waalidba. Waa Xaggayga meel noqodka dambe.

ayat.arabic: وَإِن جَٰهَدَاكَ عَلَىٰٓ أَن تُشۡرِكَ بِي مَا لَيۡسَ لَكَ بِهِۦ عِلۡمٞ فَلَا تُطِعۡهُمَاۖ وَصَاحِبۡهُمَا فِي ٱلدُّنۡيَا مَعۡرُوفٗاۖ وَٱتَّبِعۡ سَبِيلَ مَنۡ أَنَابَ إِلَيَّۚ ثُمَّ إِلَيَّ مَرۡجِعُكُمۡ فَأُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ

en.text: But if they endeavor to make you associate with Me that of which you have no knowledge,[1161] do not obey them but accompany them in [this] world with appropriate kindness and follow the way of those who turn back to Me [in repentance]. Then to Me will be your return, and I will inform you about what you used to do.
en.footnotes: [1161] See footnote to 29:8.

so.text: 15. Hadday kugula dadaalaan (labadaada waalid) inaad ii shariig yeesho (ila wadaajiso cid kale cibaadada) wax aad u cilmi lahayn, ha ku adeecin, kulase soco adduunkan si fiican, raacna jidka kan Aniga ii soo noqodka badiya. Waa Xaggeyga halka la idiin soo celin, markaas waxaan idiin sheegi waxaad fali jirteen.

ayat.arabic: يَٰبُنَيَّ إِنَّهَآ إِن تَكُ مِثۡقَالَ حَبَّةٖ مِّنۡ خَرۡدَلٖ فَتَكُن فِي صَخۡرَةٍ أَوۡ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ أَوۡ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ يَأۡتِ بِهَا ٱللَّهُۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَطِيفٌ خَبِيرٞ

en.text: [And Luqmān said], "O my son, indeed if it [i.e., a wrong] should be the weight of a mustard seed and should be within a rock or [anywhere] in the heavens or in the earth, Allāh will bring it forth. Indeed, Allāh is Subtle[1162] and Aware.
en.footnotes: [1162] Refer to footnote of 6:103.

so.text: 16. Maandhow! Hubaal hadday tahay (wax uun) le’eg iniin sisin, walowba xitaa ay ku jirto dhadhaab ama taal cirka kore ama dhulka hoose, Alle wuu keeni. Hubaal, Alle waa Dhimriye, Xog Ogaal ah Xeel Dheer.

ayat.arabic: يَٰبُنَيَّ أَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَأۡمُرۡ بِٱلۡمَعۡرُوفِ وَٱنۡهَ عَنِ ٱلۡمُنكَرِ وَٱصۡبِرۡ عَلَىٰ مَآ أَصَابَكَۖ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ مِنۡ عَزۡمِ ٱلۡأُمُورِ

en.text: O my son, establish prayer, enjoin what is right, forbid what is wrong, and be patient over what befalls you. Indeed, [all] that is of the matters [requiring] resolve.[1163]
en.footnotes: [1163] For the reason that they are enjoined by Allāh.

so.text: 17. Maandhow! Oog salaadda oo amar samaanta oo reeb xumaanta oo u samir waxa kugu dhaca, hubaal umuurahan waxay rabaan geesinnimo lagu go’aan qaato.

ayat.arabic: وَلَا تُصَعِّرۡ خَدَّكَ لِلنَّاسِ وَلَا تَمۡشِ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مَرَحًاۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ مُخۡتَالٖ فَخُورٖ

en.text: And do not turn your cheek [in contempt] toward people[1164] and do not walk through the earth exultantly. Indeed, Allāh does not like everyone self-deluded and boastful.
en.footnotes: [1164] Rather, respect them by directing your face and attention to them.

so.text: 18. Ha ka jeedin wajigaaga dadka isla weyni darteed [5], hana ku marin dhulka is qaad qaad. Hubaal Alle ma jecla isla weyne walba oo faan badan.
so.footnotes: [5]. Bal waxa la doonayo waa inaad qaddariso dadka oo ku soo qaabisho wejigaaga oo dhan adigoo muusoonaya muujinaya farxad, oo aad u dhageysato si baraarug leh adigoo aad u daneynaya waxa ay kuu sheegayaan oo ka kala goyneyn hadalka.

ayat.arabic: وَٱقۡصِدۡ فِي مَشۡيِكَ وَٱغۡضُضۡ مِن صَوۡتِكَۚ إِنَّ أَنكَرَ ٱلۡأَصۡوَٰتِ لَصَوۡتُ ٱلۡحَمِيرِ

en.text: And be moderate in your pace and lower your voice; indeed, the most disagreeable of sounds is the voice of donkeys."

so.text: 19. Raac sida toosan ee dhexdhexaadka ah xagga socodkaaga, hoosna u dhig codkaaga. Hubaal, kan ugu xun codadka waa cida dameeraha.

ayat.arabic: أَلَمۡ تَرَوۡاْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَخَّرَ لَكُم مَّا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَأَسۡبَغَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ نِعَمَهُۥ ظَٰهِرَةٗ وَبَاطِنَةٗۗ وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يُجَٰدِلُ فِي ٱللَّهِ بِغَيۡرِ عِلۡمٖ وَلَا هُدٗى وَلَا كِتَٰبٖ مُّنِيرٖ

en.text: Do you not see that Allāh has made subject to you whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth and amply bestowed upon you His favors, [both] apparent and unapparent? But of the people is he who disputes about Allāh without knowledge or guidance or an enlightening Book [from Him].

so.text: 20. Miyeydaan arkayn inuu Alle idiin sakhiray wax waliba oo ku sugan samooyinka iyo wax waliba oo ku sugan arlada, oo idiin taam yeelay Nicmooyinkiisa kuwo muuqda iyo kuwo qarsoonba?  Waxaa ka mid ah dadka mid ka dooda arrinka Alle isagoon u lahayn cilmi iyo hanuun iyo kitaab wax iftiimiya midna.

ayat.arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱتَّبِعُواْ مَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ قَالُواْ بَلۡ نَتَّبِعُ مَا وَجَدۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ ءَابَآءَنَآۚ أَوَلَوۡ كَانَ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ يَدۡعُوهُمۡ إِلَىٰ عَذَابِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ

en.text: And when it is said to them, "Follow what Allāh has revealed," they say, "Rather, we will follow that upon which we found our fathers." Even if Satan was inviting them to the punishment of the Blaze?

so.text: 21. Marka lagu yidhaahdona: Raaca waxa Alle soo dejiyey oo Waxyi ah, Waxay yidhaahdaan: Mayee, waxaanu raacaynaa waxaanu ka hellay aabayaashayo. Ma xitaa hadduu shaydaan ugu yeedhayo cadaabka dabka huritaanka badan.

ayat.arabic: ۞ وَمَن يُسۡلِمۡ وَجۡهَهُۥٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَهُوَ مُحۡسِنٞ فَقَدِ ٱسۡتَمۡسَكَ بِٱلۡعُرۡوَةِ ٱلۡوُثۡقَىٰۗ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلۡأُمُورِ

en.text: And whoever submits his face [i.e., self] to Allāh while he is a doer of good - then he has grasped the most trustworthy handhold. And to Allāh will be the outcome of [all] matters.

so.text: 22. Qofkii isu dhiiba isagoo dhan Alle (adeeca, baarri u ah) oo ah samo fale, wuxuu dhab ahaan qabsaday guntin adag (aan go'eyn - waa Tawxiidka). Alle baa loo celiyaa cidhibta arrimaha oo idil.

ayat.arabic: وَمَن كَفَرَ فَلَا يَحۡزُنكَ كُفۡرُهُۥٓۚ إِلَيۡنَا مَرۡجِعُهُمۡ فَنُنَبِّئُهُم بِمَا عَمِلُوٓاْۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمُۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ

en.text: And whoever has disbelieved - let not his disbelief grieve you. To Us is their return, and We will inform them of what they did. Indeed, Allāh is Knowing of that within the breasts.

so.text: 23. Qofkii gaalooba yey ku murugo gelin gaalnimadiisu, waa Xaggayaga meel noqodkoodu, Waxaana u sheegi waxay faleen. Hubaal Alle waa Ogsoon yahay waxa ku jira laabaha (dadka).

ayat.arabic: نُمَتِّعُهُمۡ قَلِيلٗا ثُمَّ نَضۡطَرُّهُمۡ إِلَىٰ عَذَابٍ غَلِيظٖ

en.text: We grant them enjoyment for a little; then We will force them to a massive punishment.

so.text: 24. Waxaan u raaxeyn wax yar, markaasaan ku dirqin cadaab adag.

ayat.arabic: وَلَئِن سَأَلۡتَهُم مَّنۡ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُۚ قُلِ ٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِۚ بَلۡ أَكۡثَرُهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ

en.text: And if you asked them, "Who created the heavens and earth?" they would surely say, "Allāh." Say, "[All] praise is [due] to Allāh"; but most of them do not know.

so.text: 25. Haddaad (gaalada) weydiiso: Yaa abuuray samooyinka iyo arlada? Waxay odhan: Allaah. Dheh: Ammaan idilkeed iyo mahad waxaa leh Alle. Badankooduse ma oga.

ayat.arabic: لِلَّهِ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلۡغَنِيُّ ٱلۡحَمِيدُ

en.text: To Allāh belongs whatever is in the heavens and earth. Indeed, Allāh is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy.

so.text: 26. Alle baa iska leh waxa ku sugan samooyinka iyo arlada. Hubaal, Alle waa Hodan Deeqtoon, Ammaanan.

ayat.arabic: وَلَوۡ أَنَّمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مِن شَجَرَةٍ أَقۡلَٰمٞ وَٱلۡبَحۡرُ يَمُدُّهُۥ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِۦ سَبۡعَةُ أَبۡحُرٖ مَّا نَفِدَتۡ كَلِمَٰتُ ٱللَّهِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٞ

en.text: And if whatever trees upon the earth were pens and the sea [was ink], replenished thereafter by seven [more] seas, the words[1165] of Allāh would not be exhausted. Indeed, Allāh is Exalted in Might and Wise.
en.footnotes: [1165] See footnote to 18:109.

so.text: 27. Hadday waxa dhulka ku sugan oo geedo ah qalimmo noqdaan, badduna (ku taakuleyso khad) iyadoo toddobo badood ay kaydsiinayaan, ma dhammaadeen Kelmedaha (amarrada) Alle. Hubaal, Alle waa Adkaade Sare, Xakiim ah.

ayat.arabic: مَّا خَلۡقُكُمۡ وَلَا بَعۡثُكُمۡ إِلَّا كَنَفۡسٖ وَٰحِدَةٍۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعُۢ بَصِيرٌ

en.text: Your creation and your resurrection will not be but as that of a single soul.[1166] Indeed, Allāh is Hearing and Seeing.
en.footnotes: [1166] The re-creation and resurrection of one or of all is accomplished with equal ease by Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā).

so.text: 28. Ma aha abuuriddiinna iyo soo bixintiinnu idinkoo dhammi waxaan ahayn sida (abuuridda iyo soo bixinta) naf keliya. Hubaal, Alle waa Wax kasta Maqle, wax kasta Arka.

ayat.arabic: أَلَمۡ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُولِجُ ٱلَّيۡلَ فِي ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فِي ٱلَّيۡلِ وَسَخَّرَ ٱلشَّمۡسَ وَٱلۡقَمَرَۖ كُلّٞ يَجۡرِيٓ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٖ مُّسَمّٗى وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ خَبِيرٞ

en.text: Do you not see [i.e., know] that Allāh causes the night to enter the day and causes the day to enter the night and has subjected the sun and the moon, each running [its course] for a specified term, and that Allāh, of whatever you do, is Aware?

so.text: 29. Miyeydaan ogeyn in Alle  habeenka dhex galiyo maalinta, maalintana dhex gasho habeenka (oo kala badiyo), Wuxuuna idiin sakhiray qorraxda iyo dayaxa, uu mid walba ku roorayo waddadiisa ilaa muddo magacaaban; iyo in Alle waxaad fashaan Og yahay?

ayat.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلۡحَقُّ وَأَنَّ مَا يَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِهِ ٱلۡبَٰطِلُ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلۡعَلِيُّ ٱلۡكَبِيرُ

en.text: That is because Allāh is the True Reality, and that what they call upon[1167] other than Him is falsehood, and because Allāh is the Most High, the Grand.
en.footnotes: [1167] In worship.

so.text: 30. Arrinkaasi waxaa ugu wacan in Alle uu Xaq yahay, waxa ka sokeeya ay baryaanna (caabudaan) uu baadil yahay, iyo inuu Alle yahay  Sarreeyaha Weyn.

ayat.arabic: أَلَمۡ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱلۡفُلۡكَ تَجۡرِي فِي ٱلۡبَحۡرِ بِنِعۡمَتِ ٱللَّهِ لِيُرِيَكُم مِّنۡ ءَايَٰتِهِۦٓۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّكُلِّ صَبَّارٖ شَكُورٖ

en.text: Do you not see that ships sail through the sea by the favor of Allāh that He may show you of His signs? Indeed in that are signs for everyone patient and grateful.

so.text: 31. Miyaadan ogeyn inay doomuhu ku dul maaxaan badda Nicmadda Alle [7], si uu idiin tusiyo wax ka mid ah Calaamooyinkiisa? Hubaal, arrinkani waxaa ugu sugan Calaamooyin samir badane kastoo, mahad naq badan.
so.footnotes: [7]. Nabigu s.c.w. wuxuu yidhi: “Allahayow ma koobi karno nicmooyinka aad noo gashay iyo ammaantaada ee waa sida aad Adigu isu ammaantay.”

ayat.arabic: وَإِذَا غَشِيَهُم مَّوۡجٞ كَٱلظُّلَلِ دَعَوُاْ ٱللَّهَ مُخۡلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ فَلَمَّا نَجَّىٰهُمۡ إِلَى ٱلۡبَرِّ فَمِنۡهُم مُّقۡتَصِدٞۚ وَمَا يَجۡحَدُ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ إِلَّا كُلُّ خَتَّارٖ كَفُورٖ

en.text: And when waves come over them like canopies, they supplicate Allāh, sincere to Him in religion [i.e., faith]. But when He delivers them to the land, there are [some] of them who are moderate [in faith]. And none rejects Our signs except everyone treacherous and ungrateful.

so.text: 32. Markuu hir buuro la moodo uu daboolo (dadka), waxay baryaan Alle Keligii oo u gaar yeelaan cibaadada. Markase uu nabad ku keeno barriga, waxaa ka mid ah mid dhexdhexeysan [8]. Ma diidona Aayadahayaga waxaan aheyn axdi laawe kastoo khaa’in ah, abaal dhac badan.
so.footnotes: [8]. Muqtasid waxaa loola jeeedaa qofka aan ugu mahdin Alle oo u badhax tirin cibaadada si dhan oo kaamil ah ee istaagaa meel u dhexeysa Iimaan iyo gaalnimo.

ayat.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ ٱتَّقُواْ رَبَّكُمۡ وَٱخۡشَوۡاْ يَوۡمٗا لَّا يَجۡزِي وَالِدٌ عَن وَلَدِهِۦ وَلَا مَوۡلُودٌ هُوَ جَازٍ عَن وَالِدِهِۦ شَيۡـًٔاۚ إِنَّ وَعۡدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقّٞۖ فَلَا تَغُرَّنَّكُمُ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَلَا يَغُرَّنَّكُم بِٱللَّهِ ٱلۡغَرُورُ

en.text: O mankind, fear your Lord and fear a Day when no father will avail his son, nor will a son avail his father at all. Indeed, the promise of Allāh is truth, so let not the worldly life delude you and be not deceived about Allāh by the Deceiver [i.e., Satan].

so.text: 33. Dadow! Ka cabsada Rabbigiin, oo ka baqa Maalin aanu waalid u geleyn wax abaal ah ilmihiisa, ilmuhuna u geleyn wax abaal ah waalid. Hubaal, Ballanka Alle waa Xaq, ee yeysan idin hodin nolosha Adduunku, yaanuna idinka hodin kan wax hoda (shaydaanka) xagga Alle.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عِندَهُۥ عِلۡمُ ٱلسَّاعَةِ وَيُنَزِّلُ ٱلۡغَيۡثَ وَيَعۡلَمُ مَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡحَامِۖ وَمَا تَدۡرِي نَفۡسٞ مَّاذَا تَكۡسِبُ غَدٗاۖ وَمَا تَدۡرِي نَفۡسُۢ بِأَيِّ أَرۡضٖ تَمُوتُۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ خَبِيرُۢ

en.text: Indeed, Allāh [alone] has knowledge of the Hour and sends down the rain and knows what is in the wombs.[1168] And no soul perceives what it will earn tomorrow, and no soul perceives in what land it will die. Indeed, Allāh is Knowing and Aware.
en.footnotes: [1168] i.e., every aspect of the fetus' present and future existence.

so.text: 34. Hubaal Alle Keliya baa Og waqtiga Saacadda (Qiyaame dhaceyso), oo soo dejiya roobka, Wuxuu Og yahay waxa ku jira ilma galeennada [9]. Nafina ma oga waxay mudan berri [10], nafina ma oga dhulkee bay ku dhiman. Hubaal, Alle waa wax kasta Oge, Xog Ogaal ah 'Xeel  Dheer' [11].
so.footnotes:
[9]. Wuxuu Ogsoon yahay waxa kasta oo ku saabsan ilmahaa yar hadday tahay markaasi iyo aayaha dambe waxa uu noqon. 
[10]. Dadku ma hubaan waxay fali doonaan berritoole ama ay kasban doonaan, iyadoo sidaas tahay waa inay dadaalaan oo doontaan waxa anfacaya if iyo Aakhiro. 
[11]. Nabigu s.c.w. wuxuu yidhi: “Shan Alle Keliya uun baa ogsoon:  waqtiga Saacadda Qiyaame, Roobka kolkuu iman, waxa uurka ku jira, nafi waxay mudan waqtiga soo socda iyo nafi meel ay ku dhiman.”

ayat.arabic: الٓمٓ

en.text: Alif, Lām, Meem.[1170]
en.footnotes: [1170] See footnote to 2:1.

so.text: 1. Alif laam-miim [1].
so.footnotes: [1]. Eeg sharaxa hoose ee Suuradda 2: Aayadda 1.

ayat.arabic: تَنزِيلُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ لَا رَيۡبَ فِيهِ مِن رَّبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

en.text: [This is] the revelation of the Book about which there is no doubt from the Lord of the worlds.

so.text: 2. Soo dejinta Kitaabka (Qur’aanka), shaki kuma jiro, waa xagga Rabbiga uumanka.

ayat.arabic: أَمۡ يَقُولُونَ ٱفۡتَرَىٰهُۚ بَلۡ هُوَ ٱلۡحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكَ لِتُنذِرَ قَوۡمٗا مَّآ أَتَىٰهُم مِّن نَّذِيرٖ مِّن قَبۡلِكَ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَهۡتَدُونَ

en.text: Or do they say, "He invented it"? Rather, it is the truth from your Lord, [O Muḥammad], that you may warn a people to whom no warner has come before you [so] perhaps they will be guided.

so.text: 3. Mise waxay leeyihiin waa uu been abuurtay? Mayee! Waa Xaq ka yimid Rabbigaa, si aad ugu digtid qolo aanu dige u iman hortaa adiga (Nabi Muxammadow) si ay u hanuunaan.

ayat.arabic: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٖ ثُمَّ ٱسۡتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلۡعَرۡشِۖ مَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِهِۦ مِن وَلِيّٖ وَلَا شَفِيعٍۚ أَفَلَا تَتَذَكَّرُونَ

en.text: It is Allāh who created the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them in six days; then He established Himself above the Throne.[1171] You have not besides Him any protector or any intercessor; so will you not be reminded?
en.footnotes: [1171] See footnotes to 2:19 and 7:54.

so.text: 4. Alle waa Kan ku abuuray samooyinka iyo arlada iyo waxa u dhexeeya lix Maalmood, markaas dul ahaaday Carshiga [2]. Ma lihidin Alle sokadi wax gargaare ah ama Shafeece. Ee miyeydaan waansameyn?
so.footnotes: [2]. Istawaa waa ka kor ahaansho Carshiga, waana tilmaan waajib ah in la rumeeyo si ku habboon Weynida iyo Heybadda Alle iyo Awooddiisa.

ayat.arabic: يُدَبِّرُ ٱلۡأَمۡرَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِلَى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ ثُمَّ يَعۡرُجُ إِلَيۡهِ فِي يَوۡمٖ كَانَ مِقۡدَارُهُۥٓ أَلۡفَ سَنَةٖ مِّمَّا تَعُدُّونَ

en.text: He arranges [each] matter from the heaven to the earth; then it will ascend to Him in a Day, the extent of which is a thousand years of those which you count.

so.text: 5. Wuxuu (Alle) agaasimaa arrinka ka jira samada ilaa arlada, markaasuu arrinka Xaggiisa kor u aadaa Maalin qaddarkeedu yahay kun sano waxaad tirsataan ah [3].
so.footnotes: [3]. Waa arrinka ay soo qaadaan malaa’igta. Aayaddan waxay muujineysaa awoodda Alle iyo Weynidiisa iyo mudnaantiisa Keligi cibaadada.

ayat.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ عَٰلِمُ ٱلۡغَيۡبِ وَٱلشَّهَٰدَةِ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

en.text: That is the Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,

so.text: 6. Kaasi waa Ogsoonaha waxa aan muuqan iyo waxa muuqda, Adkaadaha Sare, Naxariis Badnaha.

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِيٓ أَحۡسَنَ كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ خَلَقَهُۥۖ وَبَدَأَ خَلۡقَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنِ مِن طِينٖ

en.text: Who perfected everything which He created and began the creation of man from clay.

so.text: 7. Ee ah Kan u dhammeystiray wanaag wax kastuu abuuray, oo ka billaabay abuurista aadmiga dhoobo.

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ جَعَلَ نَسۡلَهُۥ مِن سُلَٰلَةٖ مِّن مَّآءٖ مَّهِينٖ

en.text: Then He made his posterity out of the extract of a liquid disdained.

so.text: 8. Markaas ka dhigay tarankiisa miir biyo la liidsado.

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ سَوَّىٰهُ وَنَفَخَ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِهِۦۖ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمۡعَ وَٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرَ وَٱلۡأَفۡـِٔدَةَۚ قَلِيلٗا مَّا تَشۡكُرُونَ

en.text: Then He proportioned him and breathed into him from His [created] soul[1172] and made for you hearing and vision and hearts [i.e., intellect]; little are you grateful.
en.footnotes: [1172] i.e., element of life. See footnote to 15:29.

so.text: 9. Markaas ka yeelay mid dhan oo ku afuufay wax ka mid ah Ruuxdiisa (uu u abuuray), oo idiin yeelay maqalka iyo aragga iyo kasha, wax yar baadse mahdisaan.

ayat.arabic: وَقَالُوٓاْ أَءِذَا ضَلَلۡنَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ أَءِنَّا لَفِي خَلۡقٖ جَدِيدِۭۚ بَلۡ هُم بِلِقَآءِ رَبِّهِمۡ كَٰفِرُونَ

en.text: And they say, "When we are lost [i.e., disintegrated] within the earth, will we indeed be [recreated] in a new creation?" Rather, they are, in the meeting with their Lord, disbelievers.

so.text: 10. Waxay (gaaladu) yidhahdaan: Ma markaan (dhiminno oo noqonno) kuwa ku baabba’a dhulka, miyaa noqon abuur cusub? Mayee’ waxayan rumeysneyn la Kulanka Rabbigood (ee Aakhirada).

ayat.arabic: ۞ قُلۡ يَتَوَفَّىٰكُم مَّلَكُ ٱلۡمَوۡتِ ٱلَّذِي وُكِّلَ بِكُمۡ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمۡ تُرۡجَعُونَ

en.text: Say, "The angel of death who has been entrusted with you will take you. Then to your Lord you will be returned."

so.text: 11. Dheh: Waxaa idin oofsan Malakul mowd la idiin xil saaray, markaasaa xagga Rabbigiin la idin soo celin.

ayat.arabic: وَلَوۡ تَرَىٰٓ إِذِ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمُونَ نَاكِسُواْ رُءُوسِهِمۡ عِندَ رَبِّهِمۡ رَبَّنَآ أَبۡصَرۡنَا وَسَمِعۡنَا فَٱرۡجِعۡنَا نَعۡمَلۡ صَٰلِحًا إِنَّا مُوقِنُونَ

en.text: If you could but see when the criminals are hanging their heads before their Lord, [saying], "Our Lord, we have seen and heard, so return us [to the world]; we will work righteousness. Indeed, we are [now] certain."

so.text: 12. Haddaad arki lahayd markay denbiila- yaashu hoos u rogi madaxyadooda Rabbigood horti (iyagoo leh): Rabbigayow! Waan aragnay (Xaqa aan beenineynay) oo maqallay (waxay Rusushu la yimaadeen), ee dib noogu celi (adduunka), waxaanu fali camal san, haatan waanu yaqiinsannaye.

ayat.arabic: وَلَوۡ شِئۡنَا لَأٓتَيۡنَا كُلَّ نَفۡسٍ هُدَىٰهَا وَلَٰكِنۡ حَقَّ ٱلۡقَوۡلُ مِنِّي لَأَمۡلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنَ ٱلۡجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ أَجۡمَعِينَ

en.text: And if We had willed, We could have given every soul its guidance, but the word[1173] from Me will come into effect [that] "I will surely fill Hell with jinn and people all together.
en.footnotes: [1173] Deserved by the evildoers.

so.text: 13. Haddaan doonno waxaan siin laheyn naf walba hanuunkeeda, Qawl xaq ah baase horay iiga dhacay inaan ka buuxin Jahannama jinka iyo insiga (igu caasiya) dhammaan.

ayat.arabic: فَذُوقُواْ بِمَا نَسِيتُمۡ لِقَآءَ يَوۡمِكُمۡ هَٰذَآ إِنَّا نَسِينَٰكُمۡۖ وَذُوقُواْ عَذَابَ ٱلۡخُلۡدِ بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ

en.text: So taste [punishment] because you forgot the meeting of this, your Day; indeed, We have [accordingly] forgotten you. And taste the punishment of eternity for what you used to do."

so.text: 14. Ee dhadhamiya, waayo waxaad illowdeen (dan u geli weydeen) la Kulanka Maalintiinnaan (Qiyaame), Annaguna waanu idin illoowi (oo idiinka tageynaa Naarta), dhadhamiya cadaabka waaridda camalkiinnii xumaa dartiis.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّمَا يُؤۡمِنُ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِّرُواْ بِهَا خَرُّواْۤ سُجَّدٗاۤ وَسَبَّحُواْ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّهِمۡ وَهُمۡ لَا يَسۡتَكۡبِرُونَ۩

en.text: Only those believe in Our verses who, when they are reminded by them, fall down in prostration and exalt [Allāh] with praise of their Lord, and they are not arrogant.

so.text: 15. Sideedaba waxaa rumeysan Aayada- hayaga kuwa marka lagu waaniyo, la dhaca sujuud [4] oo ku tasbiixsada Ammaanaha Rabbigood, oo aan iyagu is kibrinin.
so.footnotes: [4]. Waxay u sujuudaan Alle si khushuuc leh. Waxaa sunno ah in lala yimaado sujuud tilaawa halkan hadduu qofku akhriyo ama maqlo Aayaddan oo kale.

ayat.arabic: تَتَجَافَىٰ جُنُوبُهُمۡ عَنِ ٱلۡمَضَاجِعِ يَدۡعُونَ رَبَّهُمۡ خَوۡفٗا وَطَمَعٗا وَمِمَّا رَزَقۡنَٰهُمۡ يُنفِقُونَ

en.text: Their sides part [i.e., they arise] from [their] beds; they supplicate their Lord in fear and aspiration, and from what We have provided them, they spend.[1174]
en.footnotes: [1174] In the cause of Allāh.

so.text: 16. Waxay ka dheeraadaan dhinacyadoodu gogollada jiifka, baryaan Rabbigood si cabsi leh iyo Rajaba, waxaanu siinnayna wax ka bixiyaan (sadaqeystaan).

ayat.arabic: فَلَا تَعۡلَمُ نَفۡسٞ مَّآ أُخۡفِيَ لَهُم مِّن قُرَّةِ أَعۡيُنٖ جَزَآءَۢ بِمَا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ

en.text: And no soul knows what has been hidden for them of comfort for eyes [i.e., satisfaction] as reward for what they used to do.

so.text: 17. Ma oga nafi waxa loo qariyey (Jannada dhexdeeda) oo ay indho ku qabowsadaan, abaal marin awgeed waxay camal san falayeen.

ayat.arabic: أَفَمَن كَانَ مُؤۡمِنٗا كَمَن كَانَ فَاسِقٗاۚ لَّا يَسۡتَوُۥنَ

en.text: Then is one who was a believer like one who was defiantly disobedient? They are not equal.

so.text: 18. Ma mid mu'min ah baa la mid ah mid caasi ah? Ma ay sinna.

ayat.arabic: أَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَلَهُمۡ جَنَّٰتُ ٱلۡمَأۡوَىٰ نُزُلَۢا بِمَا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ

en.text: As for those who believed and did righteous deeds, for them will be the Gardens of Refuge as accommodation for what they used to do.

so.text: 19. Kuwa (Xaqa) rumeeyey ee fala samaha, Beeraha barwaaqada ah (Jannada) waa hoygooda daa’inka ah, marti soor ahaan waxay camal san falayeen.

ayat.arabic: وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ فَسَقُواْ فَمَأۡوَىٰهُمُ ٱلنَّارُۖ كُلَّمَآ أَرَادُوٓاْ أَن يَخۡرُجُواْ مِنۡهَآ أُعِيدُواْ فِيهَا وَقِيلَ لَهُمۡ ذُوقُواْ عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ ٱلَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
