ayat.arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَن نُّؤۡمِنَ بِهَٰذَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ وَلَا بِٱلَّذِي بَيۡنَ يَدَيۡهِۗ وَلَوۡ تَرَىٰٓ إِذِ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ مَوۡقُوفُونَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمۡ يَرۡجِعُ بَعۡضُهُمۡ إِلَىٰ بَعۡضٍ ٱلۡقَوۡلَ يَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسۡتُضۡعِفُواْ لِلَّذِينَ ٱسۡتَكۡبَرُواْ لَوۡلَآ أَنتُمۡ لَكُنَّا مُؤۡمِنِينَ

en.text: And those who disbelieve say, "We will never believe in this Qur’ān nor in that before it." But if you could see when the wrongdoers are made to stand before their Lord, refuting each others' words...[1234] Those who were oppressed will say to those who were arrogant, "If not for you, we would have been believers."
en.footnotes: [1234] Having been left to the imagination, the conclusion of this sentence is estimated to be "...you would see a dreadful sight."

so.text: 31. Kuwa gaaloobay waxay yidhaahdeen: "Ma rumeyneyno Qur’aankan iyo wixii ka horreeyay midna (oo Kutub Alle ah)". Haddaadse arki lahayd marka daalimiinta la soo hor joojin Rabbigood, iyagoo isku tuurtuuraya hadalka oo qaarba qaarka kale eedeynayo. Kuwii la daciifsaday (raciyadda) waxay ku odhan kuwii isla weynaa (madaxda): Haddaydaan jirteen waxaan ahaan laheyn mu’miniin.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسۡتَكۡبَرُواْ لِلَّذِينَ ٱسۡتُضۡعِفُوٓاْ أَنَحۡنُ صَدَدۡنَٰكُمۡ عَنِ ٱلۡهُدَىٰ بَعۡدَ إِذۡ جَآءَكُمۖ بَلۡ كُنتُم مُّجۡرِمِينَ

en.text: Those who were arrogant will say to those who were oppressed, "Did we avert you from guidance after it had come to you? Rather, you were criminals."

so.text: 32. Kuwii isla weynaa (madaxdii) waxay ku odhan kuwii la daciifsaday (raciyaddii): Ma innagaa iska kiin hortaagnay hanuunka kaddib markuu idiin yimid? Mayee’ idinka (naf ahaantiinna) ayaa ahaa denbiilayaal.

ayat.arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسۡتُضۡعِفُواْ لِلَّذِينَ ٱسۡتَكۡبَرُواْ بَلۡ مَكۡرُ ٱلَّيۡلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذۡ تَأۡمُرُونَنَآ أَن نَّكۡفُرَ بِٱللَّهِ وَنَجۡعَلَ لَهُۥٓ أَندَادٗاۚ وَأَسَرُّواْ ٱلنَّدَامَةَ لَمَّا رَأَوُاْ ٱلۡعَذَابَۚ وَجَعَلۡنَا ٱلۡأَغۡلَٰلَ فِيٓ أَعۡنَاقِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْۖ هَلۡ يُجۡزَوۡنَ إِلَّا مَا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ

en.text: Those who were oppressed will say to those who were arrogant, "Rather, [it was your] conspiracy of night and day when you were ordering us to disbelieve in Allāh and attribute to Him equals." But they will [all] confide regret when they see the punishment; and We will put shackles on the necks of those who disbelieved. Will they be recompensed except for what they used to do?

so.text: 33. Kuwii la daciifsaday (raciyaddii) waxay ku odhan  kuwii isla weynaa (madaxdii): Mayee’ waa dabinkaad noo dhigeyseen habeen iyo maalinba, markaad na amarteen inaan ku gaalowno Alle oo u yeello shariigyo. Waxayna muujin qoomamo markay arkaan cadaabka, waxaanu u suri  luqumaha kuwa gaaloobay mereegyo bir ah. Miyaa laga abaal marin (gaalada) waxay camal xun faleen mooyee?

ayat.arabic: وَمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا فِي قَرۡيَةٖ مِّن نَّذِيرٍ إِلَّا قَالَ مُتۡرَفُوهَآ إِنَّا بِمَآ أُرۡسِلۡتُم بِهِۦ كَٰفِرُونَ

en.text: And We did not send into a city any warner except that its affluent said, "Indeed we, in that with which you were sent, are disbelievers."

so.text: 34. Ma jirto magaalo aan u dirnay dige, oo aysan ladanayaasheedii odhan: Innagu waxa la idinla soo diray ku gaalownay.

ayat.arabic: وَقَالُواْ نَحۡنُ أَكۡثَرُ أَمۡوَٰلٗا وَأَوۡلَٰدٗا وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ

en.text: And they[1235] said, "We are more [than the believers] in wealth and children, and we are not to be punished."
en.footnotes: [1235] The affluent ones in general or the people of Makkah specifically.

so.text: 35. Waxayna yidhaahdeen: Innagaa idinka maal iyo awlaad badan, mana nihin kuwa la cadaabayo [17].
so.footnotes: [17]. Waxaa hoda gaalada waxa uu Alle ku siiyey adduunka, waxayna moodaan inuu u naxariisan Aakhirada oo cadaabeyn.

ayat.arabic: قُلۡ إِنَّ رَبِّي يَبۡسُطُ ٱلرِّزۡقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقۡدِرُ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ

en.text: Say, "Indeed, my Lord extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it], but most of the people do not know."

so.text: 36. Dheh: Rabbigay wuxuu u fidiyaa risiqa qofkuu doono oo ku cidhiidhiyaa (qofkuu doono), dadka badankiisuse ma oga.

ayat.arabic: وَمَآ أَمۡوَٰلُكُمۡ وَلَآ أَوۡلَٰدُكُم بِٱلَّتِي تُقَرِّبُكُمۡ عِندَنَا زُلۡفَىٰٓ إِلَّا مَنۡ ءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحٗا فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمۡ جَزَآءُ ٱلضِّعۡفِ بِمَا عَمِلُواْ وَهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡغُرُفَٰتِ ءَامِنُونَ

en.text: And it is not your wealth or your children that bring you nearer to Us in position, but it is [by being] one who has believed and done righteousness. For them there will be the double reward for what they did, and they will be in the upper chambers [of Paradise], safe [and secure].

so.text: 37. Ma aha maalkiinna iyo awlaaddiinna waxa noo kiin soo dhoweeya meeqaan ahaan, hase yeeshee qofkii (Xaqa) rumeeya oo sama fala, waa kuwan kuwa iska leh abaalmarin labolaab ah waxay camalsan faleen darteed, waxayna ku sugnaan iyagoo nabdoon rugaha ugu sarreeya (ee Jannada).

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَسۡعَوۡنَ فِيٓ ءَايَٰتِنَا مُعَٰجِزِينَ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ فِي ٱلۡعَذَابِ مُحۡضَرُونَ

en.text: And the ones who strive against Our verses to cause [them] failure[1236] - those will be brought into the punishment [to remain].
en.footnotes: [1236] See footnote to 34:5.

so.text: 38. Kuwase ku dadaala ka hor imaanshaha Aayadahayaga, kuwaas cadaabkaa la keeni.

ayat.arabic: قُلۡ إِنَّ رَبِّي يَبۡسُطُ ٱلرِّزۡقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ مِنۡ عِبَادِهِۦ وَيَقۡدِرُ لَهُۥۚ وَمَآ أَنفَقۡتُم مِّن شَيۡءٖ فَهُوَ يُخۡلِفُهُۥۖ وَهُوَ خَيۡرُ ٱلرَّٰزِقِينَ

en.text: Say, "Indeed, my Lord extends provision for whom He wills of His servants and restricts [it] for him. But whatever thing you spend [in His cause] - He will compensate it; and He is the best of providers."

so.text: 39. Dheh: Rabbigay wuxuu u fidiyaa risiqa qofkuu doono oo addoomahiisa ka mid ah, oo ku cidhiidhiyaa (qofkuu doono), waxaad bixisaanna oo wuxuun ah (sadaqo ah), wax ka khayr badan buu idin siin. Alle waa Kan u wanaagsan inta wax arsaaqda.

ayat.arabic: وَيَوۡمَ يَحۡشُرُهُمۡ جَمِيعٗا ثُمَّ يَقُولُ لِلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ أَهَٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِيَّاكُمۡ كَانُواْ يَعۡبُدُونَ

en.text: And [mention] the Day when He will gather them all and then say to the angels, "Did these [people] used to worship you?"

so.text: 40. (Xus) Maalinta markuu soo wada kulmin  iyagoo dhan (gaalada), markaasuu ku odhan malaa’igta: Kuwani ma idinkay idin caabudayeen?

ayat.arabic: قَالُواْ سُبۡحَٰنَكَ أَنتَ وَلِيُّنَا مِن دُونِهِمۖ بَلۡ كَانُواْ يَعۡبُدُونَ ٱلۡجِنَّۖ أَكۡثَرُهُم بِهِم مُّؤۡمِنُونَ

en.text: They will say, "Exalted are You! You, [O Allāh], are our benefactor excluding [i.e., not] them. Rather, they used to worship the jinn; most of them were believers in them."

so.text: 41. Waxay odhan: Xurmo oo dhan Adigaa iska leh (Allow) oo ka hufan (xumaan iyo nuqsaan), Adiga ayaa ah Gargaarahayaga iyagu ma aha. Mayee’ Waxay caabudayeen jinka oo badankoodu rumaysnaayeen.

ayat.arabic: فَٱلۡيَوۡمَ لَا يَمۡلِكُ بَعۡضُكُمۡ لِبَعۡضٖ نَّفۡعٗا وَلَا ضَرّٗا وَنَقُولُ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ ذُوقُواْ عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ ٱلَّتِي كُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ

en.text: But today [i.e., the Day of Judgement] you do not hold for one another [the power of] benefit or harm, and We will say to those who wronged, "Taste the punishment of the Fire, which you used to deny."

so.text: 42. Marka Maalintaa (Qiyaame) uma hana- nayo midkiinna midka kale dheef iyo dhib midna,waxaanu ku odhan kuwaasi dulmiga (shirkiga iyo macaasida) falay: Dhadhami- ya Cadaabka Naarta aad beeninayseen.

ayat.arabic: وَإِذَا تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ءَايَٰتُنَا بَيِّنَٰتٖ قَالُواْ مَا هَٰذَآ إِلَّا رَجُلٞ يُرِيدُ أَن يَصُدَّكُمۡ عَمَّا كَانَ يَعۡبُدُ ءَابَآؤُكُمۡ وَقَالُواْ مَا هَٰذَآ إِلَّآ إِفۡكٞ مُّفۡتَرٗىۚ وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لِلۡحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمۡ إِنۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحۡرٞ مُّبِينٞ

en.text: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, they say, "This is not but a man who wishes to avert you from that which your fathers were worshipping." And they say, "This is not except a lie invented." And those who disbelieve say of the truth when it has come to them, "This is not but obvious magic."

so.text: 43. Marka loo akhriyo Aayadahayaga cad, waxay yidhaahdaan: Kani (Muxammad) ma aha waxaan ahayn Nin raba inuu idinka jeediyo waxay caabudayeen aabbayaashiin Waxayna yidhaahdaan: Kanu (Qur’aanku) wax kale ma’aha aan ahayn been abuurasho. Kuwa gaalada ahina waxay ka yidhaahdaan Xaqa markuu u yimid: Kanu (Qur’aanku) ma aha waxaan ahayn sixir cad.

ayat.arabic: وَمَآ ءَاتَيۡنَٰهُم مِّن كُتُبٖ يَدۡرُسُونَهَاۖ وَمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَآ إِلَيۡهِمۡ قَبۡلَكَ مِن نَّذِيرٖ

en.text: And We had not given them any scriptures which they could study, and We had not sent to them before you, [O Muḥammad], any warner.

so.text: 44. Ma aanu siin wax Kutub (Xaggayaga) ah ay akhriyaan, umana aanu soo dirin hortaa wax dige ah.

ayat.arabic: وَكَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡ وَمَا بَلَغُواْ مِعۡشَارَ مَآ ءَاتَيۡنَٰهُمۡ فَكَذَّبُواْ رُسُلِيۖ فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ

en.text: And those before them denied, and they [i.e., the people of Makkah] have not attained a tenth of what We had given them. But they [i.e., the former peoples] denied My messengers, so how [terrible] was My reproach.

so.text: 45. Kuwii ka horreeyey waxay beeniyeen (Xaqa), kuwanna (Nabiga beeniyey) ma gaadhin toban meeloodoo meel wax ka mid ah waxa aan siinnay kuwaasi; Waxayse beeniyeen Rusushayadii, ee sidee buu mid daran u ahaa Ciqaabkeygii (aan ciqaabay kuwa Xaqa beeniyey).

ayat.arabic: ۞ قُلۡ إِنَّمَآ أَعِظُكُم بِوَٰحِدَةٍۖ أَن تَقُومُواْ لِلَّهِ مَثۡنَىٰ وَفُرَٰدَىٰ ثُمَّ تَتَفَكَّرُواْۚ مَا بِصَاحِبِكُم مِّن جِنَّةٍۚ إِنۡ هُوَ إِلَّا نَذِيرٞ لَّكُم بَيۡنَ يَدَيۡ عَذَابٖ شَدِيدٖ

en.text: Say, "I only advise you of one [thing] - that you stand for Allāh, [seeking truth] in pairs and individually, and then give thought." There is not in your companion any madness. He is only a warner to you before a severe punishment.

so.text: 46. Dheh: Waxaan uun idinku waaninayaa mid keliya; inaad u kacdaan Alle Darti labo-labo iyo mid mid [18], markaas aad fekertaan: kuma jiro jin saaxiibkiin (Nabi Muxammad), waa oo keliya ka dige cadaab daran oo soo fool leh.
so.footnotes: [18]. Labo labo iyo mid mid, sidaas awgeed hadduu la faqayo Alle, wuxuu u gudan si deggan oo wanaagsan.

ayat.arabic: قُلۡ مَا سَأَلۡتُكُم مِّنۡ أَجۡرٖ فَهُوَ لَكُمۡۖ إِنۡ أَجۡرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَى ٱللَّهِۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ شَهِيدٞ

en.text: Say, "Whatever payment I might have asked of you - it is yours. My payment is only from Allāh, and He is, over all things, Witness."

so.text: 47. Dheh (Nabiyow): Waxaan idin weydiiyo oo ajar ah, waa waxaad idinku leedihiin [19]. ajarkeyga waxaan ka sugayaa Alle  Keliya. Wax walbana Alle wuu u Jeedaa.
so.footnotes: [19]. Rasuulka Alle s.c.w. kama dalbo wax abaal gud ah iyaga, ee wuxuu ka dalbaa inay rumeeyaan Alle oo camallo san fashaan, sidaasina iyagay khayr u tahay.

ayat.arabic: قُلۡ إِنَّ رَبِّي يَقۡذِفُ بِٱلۡحَقِّ عَلَّٰمُ ٱلۡغُيُوبِ

en.text: Say, "Indeed, my Lord projects the truth, Knower of the unseen."

so.text: 48. Dheh: Rabbigay wuxuu soo diraa Xaqa (oo xumaanta ku tiraa), waa Ogsoonaha sare ee waxaan muuqan (Ghaybka).

ayat.arabic: قُلۡ جَآءَ ٱلۡحَقُّ وَمَا يُبۡدِئُ ٱلۡبَٰطِلُ وَمَا يُعِيدُ

en.text: Say, "The truth has come, and falsehood can neither begin [anything] nor repeat [it]."[1237]
en.footnotes: [1237] This expression alludes to complete inability, meaning that falsehood was abolished.

so.text: 49. Dheh: Xaqu (Qur’aanka) waa yimid, Baadilkuna (Ibliis) waxna ma abuuri karo mana soo nooleyn karo [20].
so.footnotes: [20]. Weedhan waxaa laga qaadanayaa inuu baadilku si dhan u awood beelayo, macnaha waa in la tirtirayo baadilka oo gebigaba meesha laga saarayo. Marka uu xaqu hirgalo, baadilka wuu hoobtaa.

ayat.arabic: قُلۡ إِن ضَلَلۡتُ فَإِنَّمَآ أَضِلُّ عَلَىٰ نَفۡسِيۖ وَإِنِ ٱهۡتَدَيۡتُ فَبِمَا يُوحِيٓ إِلَيَّ رَبِّيٓۚ إِنَّهُۥ سَمِيعٞ قَرِيبٞ

en.text: Say, "If I should err, I would only err against myself. But if I am guided, it is by what my Lord reveals to me. Indeed, He is Hearing and near."

so.text: 50. Dheh: Haddaan gefo waxaan uun u gefaa nafteyda. haddaan hanuunana, waa sababta wuxuu ii waxyoodo Rabbigay. Hubaal waa wax kasta Maqle, aad u Dhow.

ayat.arabic: وَلَوۡ تَرَىٰٓ إِذۡ فَزِعُواْ فَلَا فَوۡتَ وَأُخِذُواْ مِن مَّكَانٖ قَرِيبٖ

en.text: And if you could see[1238] when they are terrified but there is no escape, and they will be seized from a place nearby.
en.footnotes: [1238] i.e., have a glimpse of the Hereafter.

so.text: 51. Haddaad arki lahayd [21] markay (gaalada) noqon kuwo qarracansan, oo meelay u cararaan lahayn, waxaana laga soo qabqaban meel dhow.
so.footnotes: [21]. Waxaad arki lahayd wax weyn.

ayat.arabic: وَقَالُوٓاْ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلتَّنَاوُشُ مِن مَّكَانِۭ بَعِيدٖ

en.text: And they will [then] say, "We believe in it!" But how for them will be the taking[1239] [of faith] from a place far away?[1240]
en.footnotes:
[1239] Literally, "taking of something within easy reach," in other words, "How can they expect to obtain faith at this point?"
[1240] i.e., their former life on earth, wherein they had every opportunity but which is now gone, never to return.

so.text: 52. Waxay (markay arkaan cadaabka Aakhiro) odhan: Waanu rumeynay (haatan). Sidee bayse qaadashada (Iimaanka) uga suura gali meel fog (inay u soo laabtaan noloshii adduunka)?

ayat.arabic: وَقَدۡ كَفَرُواْ بِهِۦ مِن قَبۡلُۖ وَيَقۡذِفُونَ بِٱلۡغَيۡبِ مِن مَّكَانِۭ بَعِيدٖ

en.text: And they had already disbelieved in it before and would assault[1241] the unseen from a place far away.[1242]
en.footnotes:
[1241] Verbally, by conjecture and denial.
[1242] i.e., a position far from truth.

so.text: 53. Waxay dhab ahaan horey [22] ugu gaaloobeen (Xaqa), waxayna kaga sheegayeen been waxyaalaha aan muuqan ee Ghaybka ahaa xagga meel fog [23].
so.footnotes:
[22]. Noloshoodii hore ee arlada, ay ku heysteen fursad kasta, ha yeeshee hadda dhaaftay, waana fursad aan marnaba soo laabanayn. 
[23]. Af ahaan, iyagoo wax iska mala awaalayey, oo inkirayey Xaqa sida Aakhirada, Naarta, Jannada, Iska soo bixinta qubuuraha, iwm.

ayat.arabic: وَحِيلَ بَيۡنَهُمۡ وَبَيۡنَ مَا يَشۡتَهُونَ كَمَا فُعِلَ بِأَشۡيَاعِهِم مِّن قَبۡلُۚ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ فِي شَكّٖ مُّرِيبِۭ

en.text: And prevention will be placed between them and what they desire,[1243] as was done with their kind before. Indeed, they were in disquieting doubt [i.e., denial].
en.footnotes: [1243] Meaning the attainment of faith and its benefits or entrance into Paradise.

so.text: 54. Waase la kala ooday iyaga iyo waxay rabeen [24], sidii loo galay kuwii la midka ahaa ee ka horreeyey. Hubaal waxay ahaayeen kuwo ku sugan shaki walaac leh.
so.footnotes: [24]. Macnaha waa haleelidda iimaanka iyo waxa khayr ku jira iyo faa’idooyin aad u badan ama gelitaanka Jannada.

ayat.arabic: ٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِ فَاطِرِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ جَاعِلِ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ رُسُلًا أُوْلِيٓ أَجۡنِحَةٖ مَّثۡنَىٰ وَثُلَٰثَ وَرُبَٰعَۚ يَزِيدُ فِي ٱلۡخَلۡقِ مَا يَشَآءُۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٞ

en.text: [All] praise is [due] to Allāh, Creator of the heavens and the earth, [who] made the angels messengers having wings, two or three or four. He increases in creation what He wills. Indeed, Allāh is over all things competent.

so.text: 1. Ammaan oo dhan iyo mahad waxaa mudan Allaah, askumaha (abuuray) samooyinka iyo arlada, ka yeelay malaa’igta Rusul (farriin sidayaal ah) leh garbo (baalal ay ku duulaan), labo iyo saddex iyo afarba. Wuxuu ku kordhiyaa abuurista wuxuu doono. Hubaal Alle wax walba wuu Karaa.

ayat.arabic: مَّا يَفۡتَحِ ٱللَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ مِن رَّحۡمَةٖ فَلَا مُمۡسِكَ لَهَاۖ وَمَا يُمۡسِكۡ فَلَا مُرۡسِلَ لَهُۥ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِۦۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ

en.text: Whatever Allāh grants to people of mercy - none can withhold it; and whatever He withholds - none can release it thereafter. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

so.text: 2.Wax kastoo Alle u furo dadka oo Naxariis ah, ma jiro wax celin kara, wuxuu celiyana ma jiro wax soo diri kara Isaga kadambow. Waana Adkaadaha, Xakiimka ah.

ayat.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ ٱذۡكُرُواْ نِعۡمَتَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيۡكُمۡۚ هَلۡ مِنۡ خَٰلِقٍ غَيۡرُ ٱللَّهِ يَرۡزُقُكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۖ فَأَنَّىٰ تُؤۡفَكُونَ

en.text: O mankind, remember the favor of Allāh upon you. Is there any creator other than Allāh who provides for you from the heaven and earth? There is no deity except Him, so how are you deluded?

so.text: 3. Dadow! Xusuusnaada Nicamadda Alle dushiinna; Ma waxaa jira abuure kale aan ahayn Allaah oo idinka arsaaqa cirka iyo dhulka? Ma jiro Ilaah (Xaq ah) aan Isaga ahayn. Ee xaggee baa la idiinka iilay?

ayat.arabic: وَإِن يُكَذِّبُوكَ فَقَدۡ كُذِّبَتۡ رُسُلٞ مِّن قَبۡلِكَۚ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ تُرۡجَعُ ٱلۡأُمُورُ

en.text: And if they deny you, [O Muḥammad] - already were messengers denied before you. And to Allāh are returned [all] matters.

so.text: 4. Hadday ku beeniyaan (Nabiyow), waxaa la beeniyey Rusul kaa horreeyey. Alle baa loo celiyaa umuurahoo dhan.

ayat.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ إِنَّ وَعۡدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقّٞۖ فَلَا تَغُرَّنَّكُمُ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَلَا يَغُرَّنَّكُم بِٱللَّهِ ٱلۡغَرُورُ

en.text: O mankind, indeed the promise of Allāh is truth, so let not the worldly life delude you and be not deceived about Allāh by the Deceiver [i.e., Satan].

so.text: 5. Dadow! Hubaal Ballanka Alle waa Xaq. Ee yeysan idin hodin noloshan soke ee adduunka, yuusanna kan hodista badan (shaydaanka) idinka hodin arrinka Alle.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنَ لَكُمۡ عَدُوّٞ فَٱتَّخِذُوهُ عَدُوًّاۚ إِنَّمَا يَدۡعُواْ حِزۡبَهُۥ لِيَكُونُواْ مِنۡ أَصۡحَٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ

en.text: Indeed, Satan is an enemy to you; so take him as an enemy. He only invites his party to be among the companions of the Blaze.

so.text: 6. Xaqiiq, shaydaanku wuxuu idiin yahay cadow, ee idinkuna ka yeesha cadow. Wuxuu uun ugu yeedhaa Xisbigiisa inay ka mid noqdaan asxaabta Naarta hureysa.

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٞ شَدِيدٞۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُم مَّغۡفِرَةٞ وَأَجۡرٞ كَبِيرٌ

en.text: Those who disbelieve will have a severe punishment, and those who believe and do righteous deeds will have forgiveness and great reward.

so.text: 7. Kuwa gaalooba waxay leeyihiin cadaab daran; kuwase rumeeyey (Xaqa) oo samaha fala, waxay leeyihiin denbi dhaaf iyo abaalgud Weyn (Janno).

ayat.arabic: أَفَمَن زُيِّنَ لَهُۥ سُوٓءُ عَمَلِهِۦ فَرَءَاهُ حَسَنٗاۖ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُضِلُّ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهۡدِي مَن يَشَآءُۖ فَلَا تَذۡهَبۡ نَفۡسُكَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ حَسَرَٰتٍۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمُۢ بِمَا يَصۡنَعُونَ

en.text: Then is one to whom the evil of his deed has been made attractive so he considers it good [like one rightly guided]? For indeed, Allāh sends astray whom He wills and guides whom He wills. So do not let yourself perish over them in regret. Indeed, Allāh is Knowing of what they do.

so.text: 8. Ma mid isaga loo qurxiyey camalkiisa xun, heer uu u arko wax wanaagsan (baa la siman mid isagu hanuunsan)? Alle wuxuu lumiyaa qofkuu doono, oo hanuuniyaa qofkuu doono, ee yeysan naftaadu ku tegin murugo dartood kuu qabata. Allaah wuu Ogsoon yahay waxay samayne.

ayat.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَرۡسَلَ ٱلرِّيَٰحَ فَتُثِيرُ سَحَابٗا فَسُقۡنَٰهُ إِلَىٰ بَلَدٖ مَّيِّتٖ فَأَحۡيَيۡنَا بِهِ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ بَعۡدَ مَوۡتِهَاۚ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلنُّشُورُ

en.text: And it is Allāh who sends the winds, and they stir the clouds, and We drive them to a dead land and give life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness. Thus is the resurrection.

so.text: 9. Allaah waa Kan soo dira dabeylaha ee kicisa daruur, oo aanu u kaxeyno beled dhintay (abaar ah), markaasaan ku noolaynaa arlada kaddib dhimashadeeda. Sidaas oo kale weeyaan soo Bixintiinna (Qiyaamada).

ayat.arabic: مَن كَانَ يُرِيدُ ٱلۡعِزَّةَ فَلِلَّهِ ٱلۡعِزَّةُ جَمِيعًاۚ إِلَيۡهِ يَصۡعَدُ ٱلۡكَلِمُ ٱلطَّيِّبُ وَٱلۡعَمَلُ ٱلصَّٰلِحُ يَرۡفَعُهُۥۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ يَمۡكُرُونَ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٞ شَدِيدٞۖ وَمَكۡرُ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُوَ يَبُورُ

en.text: Whoever desires honor [through power] - then to Allāh belongs all honor.[1245] To Him ascends good speech, and righteous work raises it.[1246] But they who plot evil deeds will have a severe punishment, and the plotting of those - it will perish.
en.footnotes:
[1245] See footnote to 4:139.
[1246] For acceptance by Allāh, meaning that righteous deeds are confirmation and proof of what is uttered by the tongue.

so.text: 10. Qofkii raba sharaf (iyo cizo), Alle baa iska leh Sharaf iyo Cizoo dhan. Xaggiisay kor u aadaan weedhaha san oo idil, camalka sanna wuu kor yeelaa. Kuwase dhiga dabin ee xuma qoola waxay leeyihiin cadaab daran. Kuwaasu qorshahooda xun wuu iska baabbi’i.

ayat.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ خَلَقَكُم مِّن تُرَابٖ ثُمَّ مِن نُّطۡفَةٖ ثُمَّ جَعَلَكُمۡ أَزۡوَٰجٗاۚ وَمَا تَحۡمِلُ مِنۡ أُنثَىٰ وَلَا تَضَعُ إِلَّا بِعِلۡمِهِۦۚ وَمَا يُعَمَّرُ مِن مُّعَمَّرٖ وَلَا يُنقَصُ مِنۡ عُمُرِهِۦٓ إِلَّا فِي كِتَٰبٍۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرٞ

en.text: And Allāh created you from dust, then from a sperm-drop; then He made you mates. And no female conceives nor does she give birth except with His knowledge. And no aged person is granted [additional] life nor is his lifespan lessened but that it is in a register. Indeed, that for Allāh is easy.

so.text: 11. Alle wuxuu idinka abuuray carro, haddana dhibic mino ah, haddana wuxuu idinka yeelay lammaan (lab iyo dheddig); ma jirto dheddig uur qaadda, mana ku soo debed dhigto waxaan ahayn ogaalkiisa, mana jiro ku cimrigiisu la dheereeyo ama wax laga dhimo cimrigiisa oo aan dhammaan ku qornayn Kitaab (Looxa Maxfuudka). Hubaal arrinkaa waa mid Alle u Fudud.

ayat.arabic: وَمَا يَسۡتَوِي ٱلۡبَحۡرَانِ هَٰذَا عَذۡبٞ فُرَاتٞ سَآئِغٞ شَرَابُهُۥ وَهَٰذَا مِلۡحٌ أُجَاجٞۖ وَمِن كُلّٖ تَأۡكُلُونَ لَحۡمٗا طَرِيّٗا وَتَسۡتَخۡرِجُونَ حِلۡيَةٗ تَلۡبَسُونَهَاۖ وَتَرَى ٱلۡفُلۡكَ فِيهِ مَوَاخِرَ لِتَبۡتَغُواْ مِن فَضۡلِهِۦ وَلَعَلَّكُمۡ تَشۡكُرُونَ

en.text: And not alike are the two seas [i.e., bodies of water]. One is fresh and sweet, palatable for drinking, and one is salty and bitter. And from each you eat tender meat and extract ornaments which you wear, and you see the ships plowing through [them] that you might seek of His bounty; and perhaps you will be grateful.

so.text: 12. Ma aha isku mid labada badood, mid waa macaan lagu harraad baxo ay wanaagsan tahay cabbiddiisu, kan kalena waa milix lagu gubto dhanaankeeda daran awgi, mid walbaana oo ka mid ah waxaad ka cuntaan hilib cusub oo jileec ah (kalluun), oo waxaad kala soo baxdaan (badda) waxyaalo aad qurux u xidhataan. Waxaad arkaysaa doonyaha oo dhex maaxaya badda, si aad u raadsataan Deeqdiisa, iyo inaad (Alle) ku mahdisaan.

ayat.arabic: يُولِجُ ٱلَّيۡلَ فِي ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فِي ٱلَّيۡلِ وَسَخَّرَ ٱلشَّمۡسَ وَٱلۡقَمَرَۖ كُلّٞ يَجۡرِي لِأَجَلٖ مُّسَمّٗىۚ ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمۡ لَهُ ٱلۡمُلۡكُۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ تَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِهِۦ مَا يَمۡلِكُونَ مِن قِطۡمِيرٍ

en.text: He causes the night to enter the day, and He causes the day to enter the night and has subjected the sun and the moon - each running [its course] for a specified term. That is Allāh, your Lord; to Him belongs sovereignty. And those whom you invoke other than Him do not possess [as much as] the membrane of a date seed.

so.text: 13. Wuxuu (Alle) habeenka dhex galiyaa maalinta, maalintana dhex galiyaa habeenka (macnaha kala badiyaa). Wuxuu idiin sakhiray qorraxda iyo dayaxa, mid walba uu ku socdo marriinkiisa muddo magacaaban. Kaasi waa Allaah, Rabbigiin; Isagaa leh Boqortooyada (Runta ah), kuwase aad baridaan (caabuddaan) Alle sokadi ma hantaan xitaa xuub laf timireed.

ayat.arabic: إِن تَدۡعُوهُمۡ لَا يَسۡمَعُواْ دُعَآءَكُمۡ وَلَوۡ سَمِعُواْ مَا ٱسۡتَجَابُواْ لَكُمۡۖ وَيَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ يَكۡفُرُونَ بِشِرۡكِكُمۡۚ وَلَا يُنَبِّئُكَ مِثۡلُ خَبِيرٖ

en.text: If you invoke them, they do not hear your supplication; and if they heard, they would not respond to you. And on the Day of Resurrection they will deny your association.[1247] And none can inform you like [one] Aware [of all matters].
en.footnotes: [1247] Of them with Allāh or your worship of them.

so.text: 14. Haddaad u yeedhataan ma maqlaan ducadiinna, hadday idin maqli lahaa- yeenna ma idin ajiibeen. Maalinta Qiyaamahana way diidi shirkigiinna [1]. Ma jiro cid wax kuugu sheegi kartaa sida Midka ah Xog ogaal Xeel dheer (Alle).
so.footnotes: [1]. Kuwa aad baridaan la jirka Alle oo aad caabuddaan.

ayat.arabic: ۞ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ أَنتُمُ ٱلۡفُقَرَآءُ إِلَى ٱللَّهِۖ وَٱللَّهُ هُوَ ٱلۡغَنِيُّ ٱلۡحَمِيدُ

en.text: O mankind, you are those in need of Allāh, while Allāh is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy.

so.text: 15. Dadow! Idinka weeye kuwa u baahan Alle. Alle waa Hodanka, Ammaanan.

ayat.arabic: إِن يَشَأۡ يُذۡهِبۡكُمۡ وَيَأۡتِ بِخَلۡقٖ جَدِيدٖ

en.text: If He wills, He can do away with you and bring forth a new creation.

so.text: 16. Hadduu doono, wuu idin tegsiin, oo keeni uun cusub.

ayat.arabic: وَمَا ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ بِعَزِيزٖ

en.text: And that is for Allāh not difficult.

so.text: 17. Waxnana kuma adka Alle.

ayat.arabic: وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٞ وِزۡرَ أُخۡرَىٰۚ وَإِن تَدۡعُ مُثۡقَلَةٌ إِلَىٰ حِمۡلِهَا لَا يُحۡمَلۡ مِنۡهُ شَيۡءٞ وَلَوۡ كَانَ ذَا قُرۡبَىٰٓۗ إِنَّمَا تُنذِرُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخۡشَوۡنَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلۡغَيۡبِ وَأَقَامُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَۚ وَمَن تَزَكَّىٰ فَإِنَّمَا يَتَزَكَّىٰ لِنَفۡسِهِۦۚ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ

en.text: And no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another. And if a heavily laden soul calls [another] to [carry some of] its load, nothing of it will be carried, even if he should be a close relative. You can only warn those who fear their Lord unseen and have established prayer. And whoever purifies himself only purifies himself for [the benefit of] his soul. And to Allāh is the [final] destination.

so.text: 18. Nafna naf kale denbigeed ma qaaddo; haddii naf culaabeysan u yeedhato (mid kale inuu qaado) culayskeeda, waxba kama qaado, qaraaboba ha ahaadeene. Waxaad uun u digi kuwa ka baqa Rabbigood sir 'iyo saaqba' [2], oo ooga salaadda. Qofkii is daahiriya [3], naftiisu uun buu isu daahiriyey, waana Xagga Alle meesha loo socdaa (geeri dabadeed).
so.footnotes:
[2]. Mufasiriinta qaarkood waxay yidhaahdeen: Ghaybka –maqnaanta- halkan waxaa loola jeedaa marka uu qofku keli yahay aan la arkayn. 
[3]. Nabi Muxammad s.c.w. ma hanuunin karo mushrikiinta quluubtooda ka xidhan yahay iimaanka aan iyagu dooneyn hanuunka oo dan ka lahayn.

ayat.arabic: وَمَا يَسۡتَوِي ٱلۡأَعۡمَىٰ وَٱلۡبَصِيرُ

en.text: Not equal are the blind and the seeing,

so.text: 19. Ma sinna indhoolaha iyo mid wax arka.

ayat.arabic: وَلَا ٱلظُّلُمَٰتُ وَلَا ٱلنُّورُ

en.text: Nor are the darknesses and the light,

so.text: 20. Iyo mugdiyada iyo nuurka.

ayat.arabic: وَلَا ٱلظِّلُّ وَلَا ٱلۡحَرُورُ

en.text: Nor are the shade and the heat,[1248]
en.footnotes: [1248] Of the sun or of a scorching wind.

so.text: 21. Iyo harka iyo kuleylka [4].
so.footnotes: [4]. Kuleylka qorraxda ama hanfiga dabeysha kulul.

ayat.arabic: وَمَا يَسۡتَوِي ٱلۡأَحۡيَآءُ وَلَا ٱلۡأَمۡوَٰتُۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُسۡمِعُ مَن يَشَآءُۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ بِمُسۡمِعٖ مَّن فِي ٱلۡقُبُورِ

en.text: And not equal are the living and the dead. Indeed, Allāh causes to hear whom He wills, but you cannot make hear those in the graves.[1249]
en.footnotes: [1249] The four comparisons given by Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) in verses 19-22 are those of the believer and unbeliever, various kinds of misbelief and (true) belief, Paradise and Hellfire, and those receptive to guidance and those unreceptive.

so.text: 22. Ma sinna kuwa nool iyo kuwa meydka ah [5]. Alle Wuxuu wax maqashiiyaa cidduu doono [6], adiguna wax ma maqashiin kartid kuwa ku jira qubuuraha.
so.footnotes:
[5]. Waa tusaalaha ay kala leeyihiin mu’minka iyo gaalka, noocyada kala duwan ee gaalnimada iyo iimaanka runta ah, Jannada iyo Naarta, hanuunka iyo habowga. 
[6]. Alle wuxuu hanuuniyaa qofkuu doono, oo maqashiiyaa Xaqa qofkuu doono.

ayat.arabic: إِنۡ أَنتَ إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ

en.text: You, [O Muḥammad], are not but a warner.

so.text: 23. Adigu (Nabi Muxammadow) ma tihid waxaan ahayn dige.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَٰكَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ بَشِيرٗا وَنَذِيرٗاۚ وَإِن مِّنۡ أُمَّةٍ إِلَّا خَلَا فِيهَا نَذِيرٞ

en.text: Indeed, We have sent you with the truth as a bringer of good tidings and a warner. And there was no nation but that there had passed within it a warner.

so.text: 24. Waxaan kula soo dirnay (Nabiyow) Xaqa bishaareeye iyo dige ahaan. Ma jirto ummad aanu soo marin dige.

ayat.arabic: وَإِن يُكَذِّبُوكَ فَقَدۡ كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡ جَآءَتۡهُمۡ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِ وَبِٱلزُّبُرِ وَبِٱلۡكِتَٰبِ ٱلۡمُنِيرِ

en.text: And if they deny you - then already have those before them denied. Their messengers came to them with clear proofs and written ordinances and with the enlightening Scripture.

so.text: 25. Hadday ku beeeniyaan, waxaa sidoo kale beeniyey kuwii ka horreeyey; Rusushoodii waxay ula yimaadeen xujooyin cad cad iyo Qoraallo iyo kitaab iftiimaya.

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ أَخَذۡتُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْۖ فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ

en.text: Then I seized the ones who disbelieved, and how [terrible] was My reproach.

so.text: 26. Markaasaan qabtay gaaladii, ee sidee buu ahaa Ciqaabkeygii (aan ku ciqaabay kuwa Xaqa beeniyey).

ayat.arabic: أَلَمۡ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءٗ فَأَخۡرَجۡنَا بِهِۦ ثَمَرَٰتٖ مُّخۡتَلِفًا أَلۡوَٰنُهَاۚ وَمِنَ ٱلۡجِبَالِ جُدَدُۢ بِيضٞ وَحُمۡرٞ مُّخۡتَلِفٌ أَلۡوَٰنُهَا وَغَرَابِيبُ سُودٞ

en.text: Do you not see that Allāh sends down rain from the sky, and We produce thereby fruits of varying colors? And in the mountains are tracts, white and red of varying shades and [some] extremely black.

so.text: 27. Miyaadan arag in Alle ka soo dejiyo biyo (roob) daruuraha, markaas aanu ku soo saarno midho midabbo kala duwan leh. Buuraha waxaa ka mid ah kuwo leh diillimo cad cad iyo kuwo casaan ah oo midabbo kala duwan iyo kuwo madow daran ah.

ayat.arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ وَٱلدَّوَآبِّ وَٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمِ مُخۡتَلِفٌ أَلۡوَٰنُهُۥ كَذَٰلِكَۗ إِنَّمَا يَخۡشَى ٱللَّهَ مِنۡ عِبَادِهِ ٱلۡعُلَمَٰٓؤُاْۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ غَفُورٌ

en.text: And among people and moving creatures and grazing livestock are various colors similarly. Only those fear Allāh, from among His servants, who have knowledge. Indeed, Allāh is Exalted in Might and Forgiving.

so.text: 28. Dadka iyo nafleyda dhul ku socotada ah iyo xoolaha daaqana waa kuwo kala midab duwan sidoo kale. Sideedaba waxaa uun ka baqa Alle kuwa cilmiga leh ee ka mid ah addoomahiisa. Hubaal Alle waa Adkaade, Denbi Dhaaf Badan.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَتۡلُونَ كِتَٰبَ ٱللَّهِ وَأَقَامُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَأَنفَقُواْ مِمَّا رَزَقۡنَٰهُمۡ سِرّٗا وَعَلَانِيَةٗ يَرۡجُونَ تِجَٰرَةٗ لَّن تَبُورَ

en.text: Indeed, those who recite the Book of Allāh and establish prayer and spend [in His cause] out of what We have provided them, secretly and publicly, [can] expect a transaction [i.e., profit] that will never perish -

so.text: 29. Hubaal kuwa akhriya Kitaabka Alle oo ooga salaadda, oo wax ka bixiya 'sadaqo ahaan' waxaan siinnay sir iyo caddaanba, waxay rajeeyaan ganacsi la hubo faa’ideeda aan weligeed baareyn.

ayat.arabic: لِيُوَفِّيَهُمۡ أُجُورَهُمۡ وَيَزِيدَهُم مِّن فَضۡلِهِۦٓۚ إِنَّهُۥ غَفُورٞ شَكُورٞ

en.text: That He may give them in full their rewards and increase for them of His bounty. Indeed, He is Forgiving and Appreciative.[1250]
en.footnotes: [1250] i.e., He gives much in return for little and multiplies rewards.

so.text: 30. Si uu Alle ugu gudo si dhan ujuura- doodii, waxna uga ziyaadiyo Deeqdiisa. Hubaal, Alle Waa Denbi Dhaaf Badane, Mahdin badan.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّذِيٓ أَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَيۡكَ مِنَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ هُوَ ٱلۡحَقُّ مُصَدِّقٗا لِّمَا بَيۡنَ يَدَيۡهِۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِعِبَادِهِۦ لَخَبِيرُۢ بَصِيرٞ

en.text: And that which We have revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], of the Book is the truth, confirming what was before it. Indeed Allāh, of His servants, is Aware and Seeing.

so.text: 31. Kaan kuu waxyoonnay (Nabiyow) ee Kitaabka 'Qur'aanka' ah waa Xaq rumeynaya wixii ka horreeyey (oo Kutub Alle ah). Hubaal, Alle addoomahiisa wuu ka War Qabaa, Arkaa.

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ أَوۡرَثۡنَا ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱصۡطَفَيۡنَا مِنۡ عِبَادِنَاۖ فَمِنۡهُمۡ ظَالِمٞ لِّنَفۡسِهِۦ وَمِنۡهُم مُّقۡتَصِدٞ وَمِنۡهُمۡ سَابِقُۢ بِٱلۡخَيۡرَٰتِ بِإِذۡنِ ٱللَّهِۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلۡفَضۡلُ ٱلۡكَبِيرُ

en.text: Then We caused to inherit the Book those We have chosen of Our servants;[1251] and among them is he who wrongs himself [i.e., sins], and among them is he who is moderate, and among them is he who is foremost in good deeds by permission of Allāh. That [inheritance] is what is the great bounty.
en.footnotes: [1251] The followers of Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ).

so.text: 32. Kaddib waxaan dhaxalsiinnay Kitaabka kuwa aan doorannay oo addoomahayaga ka mid ah. Waxaa ka mid ah mid dulmiya naftiisa [7], iyo mid dhexdhexeysta [8], iyo mid u dheereeya khayrka Idanka Alle [9]. Kaa weeye Fadliga Weyn.
so.footnotes:
[7]. Qofka dulmiya naftiisa waa qofkay khaladaadkiisa ka badan yihiin saxiisa.
[8]. Muqtasidna oo ah midka dhexdhexysta waa qofkay camalladiisa wanaagsan le’eg yihiin camalladiisa xun.
[9]. Qofka u dheereeya khayraadkana waa qofka ay acmaashiisa san badan yihiin .

ayat.arabic: جَنَّٰتُ عَدۡنٖ يَدۡخُلُونَهَا يُحَلَّوۡنَ فِيهَا مِنۡ أَسَاوِرَ مِن ذَهَبٖ وَلُؤۡلُؤٗاۖ وَلِبَاسُهُمۡ فِيهَا حَرِيرٞ

en.text: [For them are] gardens of perpetual residence which they will enter. They will be adorned therein with bracelets of gold and pearls, and their garments therein will be silk.

so.text: 33. Jannooyin cadni (beero lagu waari) bay geli, waxaa lagu qurxin inay xidhaan gudaheeda jinjimooyin dahab iyo luul ah, dharkooduna gudaheeda waa xariir.

ayat.arabic: وَقَالُواْ ٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَذۡهَبَ عَنَّا ٱلۡحَزَنَۖ إِنَّ رَبَّنَا لَغَفُورٞ شَكُورٌ

en.text: And they will say, "Praise to Allāh, who has removed from us [all] sorrow. Indeed, our Lord is Forgiving and Appreciative -

so.text: 34. Waxay odhan: Ammaan (oo dhan) iyo mahad waxaa leh Allaah, ee naga tagsiiyey murugo (oo dhan). Hubaal Rabbigayo waa Denbi Dhaaf Badane, Mahdin Badan.

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِيٓ أَحَلَّنَا دَارَ ٱلۡمُقَامَةِ مِن فَضۡلِهِۦ لَا يَمَسُّنَا فِيهَا نَصَبٞ وَلَا يَمَسُّنَا فِيهَا لُغُوبٞ

en.text: He who has settled us in the home of duration [i.e., Paradise] out of His bounty. There touches us not in it any fatigue, and there touches us not in it weariness [of mind]."

so.text: 35. Kan nagu dejiyey Daarta Negaadeysa (Jannada) Fadligiisa; nagu taaban maayo dhexdeeda dhibi, naguna taaban maayo daal.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَهُمۡ نَارُ جَهَنَّمَ لَا يُقۡضَىٰ عَلَيۡهِمۡ فَيَمُوتُواْ وَلَا يُخَفَّفُ عَنۡهُم مِّنۡ عَذَابِهَاۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي كُلَّ كَفُورٖ

en.text: And for those who disbelieve will be the fire of Hell. [Death] is not decreed for them[1252] so they may die, nor will its torment be lightened for them. Thus do We recompense every ungrateful one.
en.footnotes: [1252] Or "They are not killed."

so.text: 36. Kuwase gaalooba abaalkooda waa Naarta Jahannama. Laguma xukumo geeri si ay u dhintaan, lagamana khafiifiyo cadaabkeeda. Sidaas baan ku abaal marinnaa mid kastoo gaalnimo badan.

ayat.arabic: وَهُمۡ يَصۡطَرِخُونَ فِيهَا رَبَّنَآ أَخۡرِجۡنَا نَعۡمَلۡ صَٰلِحًا غَيۡرَ ٱلَّذِي كُنَّا نَعۡمَلُۚ أَوَلَمۡ نُعَمِّرۡكُم مَّا يَتَذَكَّرُ فِيهِ مَن تَذَكَّرَ وَجَآءَكُمُ ٱلنَّذِيرُۖ فَذُوقُواْ فَمَا لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ مِن نَّصِيرٍ

en.text: And they will cry out therein, "Our Lord, remove us;[1253] we will do righteousness - other than what we were doing!" But did We not grant you life enough for whoever would remember therein to remember, and the warner had come to you? So taste [the punishment], for there is not for the wrongdoers any helper.
en.footnotes: [1253] The implication is "Return us to the previous world."

so.text: 37. Waxay ku qeyliyi dhexdeeda: Rabbiyow! Naga saar (halkan Naarta), waxaanu fali camal san aan aheyn kaan horay u fali jirnay. (Waxaa lagu odhan): Miyaanaan idin cimri siin in ku filan inuu ku waantoobo qofkii waansami [10]? Oo idiin iman Dige. Ee dhadhamiya (Naarta), waayo daalimiinta ma leh wax u soo gargaari (Aakhirada oo u shafeeci).
so.footnotes: [10]. Nabigu s.c.w. wuxuu yidhi: “Alle waa u dhammeystiray cudur daar qofkii uu dib u dhigay ilaa uu ka gaaro lixdan sano.”

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَٰلِمُ غَيۡبِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمُۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ

en.text: Indeed, Allāh is Knower of the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and earth. Indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.

so.text: 38. Hubaal, Alle waa Ogsoonaha waxa ku qarsoon aan muuqan cirarka iyo dhulka gudahooda. Hubaal waa Isaga Ogsoonaha waxa ku jira laabaha (dadka).

ayat.arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَكُمۡ خَلَٰٓئِفَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ فَمَن كَفَرَ فَعَلَيۡهِ كُفۡرُهُۥۖ وَلَا يَزِيدُ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ كُفۡرُهُمۡ عِندَ رَبِّهِمۡ إِلَّا مَقۡتٗاۖ وَلَا يَزِيدُ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ كُفۡرُهُمۡ إِلَّا خَسَارٗا

en.text: It is He who has made you successors upon the earth. And whoever disbelieves - upon him will be [the consequence of] his disbelief. And the disbelief of the disbelievers does not increase them in the sight of their Lord except in hatred; and the disbelief of the disbelievers does not increase them except in loss.

so.text: 39. Waa Isaga 'Alle' Kan idinka dhigay kuwo dhulka ku tarma ee isaga dambeeya, ee qofkii gaalooba isagay u daran tahay gaalnimadiisu. Uma kordhiso gaalada gaalnimadooda Rabbigood agtiis waxaan nac aheyn, oo uma kordhiso gaalada gaalnimadooda waxaan khasaaro aheyn.

ayat.arabic: قُلۡ أَرَءَيۡتُمۡ شُرَكَآءَكُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ تَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَرُونِي مَاذَا خَلَقُواْ مِنَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ أَمۡ لَهُمۡ شِرۡكٞ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ أَمۡ ءَاتَيۡنَٰهُمۡ كِتَٰبٗا فَهُمۡ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَتٖ مِّنۡهُۚ بَلۡ إِن يَعِدُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ بَعۡضُهُم بَعۡضًا إِلَّا غُرُورًا

en.text: Say, "Have you considered[1254] your 'partners' whom you invoke besides Allāh? Show me what they have created from the earth, or have they partnership [with Him] in the heavens? Or have We given them a book so they are [standing] on evidence therefrom? [No], rather, the wrongdoers do not promise each other except delusion."[1255]
en.footnotes:
[1254] Understood to mean "Tell me about..."
[1255] By telling their followers that the so-called deities will intercede for them with Allāh.

so.text: 40. Dheh: Bal ka warrama ilaahyada aad (Alle) shurukada uga dhigtaan, kuwaasoo aad baridaan (caabuddaan) Alle sokadi, i tusa wax arlada ka mid ah ay abuureen, mise ma waxay ku leeyihiin wax saami ah samooyinka? Mise ma waxaan siinnay Kitaab sidaa awgeed ay raacaan xujo cad Xaggiisa ah? Mayee’ daalimiinta uma ballan qaadaan qaarkoodba qaar kale waxaan uun hoditaan aheyn.

ayat.arabic: ۞ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُمۡسِكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ أَن تَزُولَاۚ وَلَئِن زَالَتَآ إِنۡ أَمۡسَكَهُمَا مِنۡ أَحَدٖ مِّنۢ بَعۡدِهِۦٓۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ حَلِيمًا غَفُورٗا

en.text: Indeed, Allāh holds the heavens and the earth, lest they cease. And if they should cease, no one could hold them [in place] after Him. Indeed, He is Forbearing[1256] and Forgiving.
en.footnotes: [1256] Refer to footnote in 2:225.

so.text: 41. Alle baa ka haya samooyinka iyo arlada inay ka gilgashaan (tagaan) halkooda, hadday gilgashaanna, ma jiro mid qaban kara oo Isaga ka dambeeya. Hubaal Alle waa Dul-qaadasho Badne, Denbi Dhaaf Badan.

ayat.arabic: وَأَقۡسَمُواْ بِٱللَّهِ جَهۡدَ أَيۡمَٰنِهِمۡ لَئِن جَآءَهُمۡ نَذِيرٞ لَّيَكُونُنَّ أَهۡدَىٰ مِنۡ إِحۡدَى ٱلۡأُمَمِۖ فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمۡ نَذِيرٞ مَّا زَادَهُمۡ إِلَّا نُفُورًا

en.text: And they swore by Allāh their strongest oaths that if a warner came to them, they would be more guided than [any] one of the [previous] nations. But when a warner came to them, it did not increase them except in aversion

so.text: 42. Waxay ku dhaarteen Alle kan ugu culus dhaarahooda; in hadduu u yimaado dige ay ahaanayaan kuwa ka sii hanuunsan ummadahii kale oo dhan (ee ka horreeyey), markase uu u yimid dige (Nabi Muxammad), uma kordhin waxaan didmo aheyn.

ayat.arabic: ٱسۡتِكۡبَارٗا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَكۡرَ ٱلسَّيِّيِٕۚ وَلَا يَحِيقُ ٱلۡمَكۡرُ ٱلسَّيِّئُ إِلَّا بِأَهۡلِهِۦۚ فَهَلۡ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا سُنَّتَ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَۚ فَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّتِ ٱللَّهِ تَبۡدِيلٗاۖ وَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّتِ ٱللَّهِ تَحۡوِيلًا

en.text: [Due to] arrogance in the land and plotting of evil; but the evil plot does not encompass except its own people. Then do they await except the way [i.e., fate] of the former peoples? But you will never find in the way [i.e., established method] of Allāh any change, and you will never find in the way of Allāh[1257] any alteration.[1258]
en.footnotes:
[1257] i.e., in His punishment of those who deny the prophets.
[1258] Or "transfer" of punishment to others in place of them.

so.text: 43. Isla weyni ay ku kibraan arlada iyo sameyn dhagar xun. Dhagarta xumina kuma dhacdo cidna aan ahayn kuwa soo abaabula. Ma waxay sugayaan wax kale aan aheyn waddadii (aayihii) kuwii hore? Ma heleysid wax beddela Xeerka Alle; mana heleysid wax wareejiya Xeerka Alle.

ayat.arabic: أَوَلَمۡ يَسِيرُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَيَنظُرُواْ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡ وَكَانُوٓاْ أَشَدَّ مِنۡهُمۡ قُوَّةٗۚ وَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيُعۡجِزَهُۥ مِن شَيۡءٖ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَلَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَلِيمٗا قَدِيرٗا

en.text: Have they not traveled through the land and observed how was the end of those before them? And they were greater than them in power. But Allāh is not to be caused failure [i.e., prevented] by anything in the heavens or on the earth. Indeed, He is ever Knowing and Competent.

so.text: 44. Miyaanay marin dhulka oo fiirin siday aheyd cidhibta kuwii ka horreeyey (ee beeniyey Rusushii Alle), kuwaasoo ahaa kuwo ka xoog badan kuwakani awood ahaan? Ma jiro wax Alle ka baxsan kara oo jooga samooyinka ama arlada midna. Hubaal Alle waa wax kasta Oge, wax walba Kara.

ayat.arabic: وَلَوۡ يُؤَاخِذُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلنَّاسَ بِمَا كَسَبُواْ مَا تَرَكَ عَلَىٰ ظَهۡرِهَا مِن دَآبَّةٖ وَلَٰكِن يُؤَخِّرُهُمۡ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٖ مُّسَمّٗىۖ فَإِذَا جَآءَ أَجَلُهُمۡ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ بِعِبَادِهِۦ بَصِيرَۢا

en.text: And if Allāh were to impose blame on the people for what they have earned, He would not leave upon it [i.e., the earth] any creature. But He defers them for a specified term. And when their time comes, then indeed Allāh has ever been, of His servants, Seeing.

so.text: 45. Hadduu Alle u qaban lahaa dadka waxay kasbadaan (oo denbiyo ah), kagama tageen (arlada) korkeeda nafley dhul ku socod ah, wuxuuse u dib dhigaa ilaa muddo magacaaban, markase uu ajalkooda yimaado, hubaal Alle wuu arkaa xaalka addoomahiisa .

ayat.arabic: يسٓ

en.text: Yā, Seen.[1260]
en.footnotes: [1260] See footnote to 2:1.

so.text: 1. Yaasiin [1].
so.footnotes: [1]. Eeg sharaxa hoose ee Suuradda 2: Aayadda 1

ayat.arabic: وَٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ ٱلۡحَكِيمِ

en.text: By the wise[1261] Qur’ān,
en.footnotes: [1261] See footnote to 10:1.

so.text: 2. Waxaan ku dhaartay Qur’aanka, Xikmadda Badan.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ

en.text: Indeed you, [O Muḥammad], are from among the messengers,

so.text: 3. Hubaal adigu (Muxammadow) waxaad ka mid tahay (Rususha Alle) soo diray.

ayat.arabic: عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٖ مُّسۡتَقِيمٖ

en.text: On a straight path.

so.text: 4. Waxaad ku sugan tahay Jid Toosan.

ayat.arabic: تَنزِيلَ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

en.text: [This is] a revelation of the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,

so.text: 5. (Qur’aankani waa) Waxyi ka soo degay (xagga Alle) Adkaadaha, Naxariista Badan.

ayat.arabic: لِتُنذِرَ قَوۡمٗا مَّآ أُنذِرَ ءَابَآؤُهُمۡ فَهُمۡ غَٰفِلُونَ

en.text: That you may warn a people whose forefathers were not warned, so they are unaware.

so.text: 6. Inaad u digto qolo aan aabbayaashood loo digin, ee iyagu ah kuwo dhoohan.

ayat.arabic: لَقَدۡ حَقَّ ٱلۡقَوۡلُ عَلَىٰٓ أَكۡثَرِهِمۡ فَهُمۡ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ

en.text: Already the word [i.e., decree] has come into effect upon most of them, so they do not believe.

so.text: 7. Waxaa dhab ahaan ku rumoobay badankood Qowlka (Cadaabka), marka ma ay rumeeyaan (Xaqa).

ayat.arabic: إِنَّا جَعَلۡنَا فِيٓ أَعۡنَٰقِهِمۡ أَغۡلَٰلٗا فَهِيَ إِلَى ٱلۡأَذۡقَانِ فَهُم مُّقۡمَحُونَ

en.text: Indeed, We have put shackles on their necks, and they are to their chins, so they are with heads [kept] aloft.

so.text: 8. (Waa sida) inaan yeelnay mareegyo bir ah luqumahooda oo gaadha ilaa gararkooda, sidaa awgeed madaxyadooda  kor u taagan yihiin [2].
so.footnotes: [2]. Marka way ka xidhan yihiin khayr oo dhan, Xaqana ma arkaan.

ayat.arabic: وَجَعَلۡنَا مِنۢ بَيۡنِ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ سَدّٗا وَمِنۡ خَلۡفِهِمۡ سَدّٗا فَأَغۡشَيۡنَٰهُمۡ فَهُمۡ لَا يُبۡصِرُونَ

en.text: And We have put before them a barrier and behind them a barrier and covered them, so they do not see.

so.text: 9. Waxaan yeellay hortooda xidh, gadaashoodana xidh kale, waana arag daboolnay marka ma arkaan (Xaqa).

ayat.arabic: وَسَوَآءٌ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ءَأَنذَرۡتَهُمۡ أَمۡ لَمۡ تُنذِرۡهُمۡ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ

en.text: And it is all the same for them whether you warn them or do not warn them - they will not believe.

so.text: 10. Waa isugu mid haddaad u digto ama aad u digin, (marna) ma rumeeyaan (Xaqa).

ayat.arabic: إِنَّمَا تُنذِرُ مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلذِّكۡرَ وَخَشِيَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنَ بِٱلۡغَيۡبِۖ فَبَشِّرۡهُ بِمَغۡفِرَةٖ وَأَجۡرٖ كَرِيمٍ

en.text: You can only warn one who follows the message and fears the Most Merciful unseen. So give him good tidings of forgiveness and noble reward.

so.text: 11.Waxaad uun u digi (oo ay anfaci digadu) kan raaca Qur’aanka oo ka baqa Raxmaan- ka sir (iyo saaqba). Ee ugu bishaaree denbi dhaaf iyo abaalgud sharaf leh (Janno).

ayat.arabic: إِنَّا نَحۡنُ نُحۡيِ ٱلۡمَوۡتَىٰ وَنَكۡتُبُ مَا قَدَّمُواْ وَءَاثَٰرَهُمۡۚ وَكُلَّ شَيۡءٍ أَحۡصَيۡنَٰهُ فِيٓ إِمَامٖ مُّبِينٖ

en.text: Indeed, it is We who bring the dead to life and record what they have put forth and what they left behind, and all things We have enumerated in a clear register.

so.text: 12. Xaqiiq waa Annaga kuwa nooleyn meytida, oo qora waxay hormarsadaan iyo raadadkoodaba (waxay gadaal uga soo tagaan khayr ama shar). Wax walba waxaynu ku koobnay [3] (oo qornay) Kitaab cad (Looxa Maxfuudka).
so.footnotes: [3]. Nabigu s.c.w. wuxuu yidhi: “Qofka markuu dhinto wuu go’aa camalkiisu seddex mooyee: Cilmi lagu intifaaco, ilmo wanaagsan oo u soo duceeya iyo sadaqo u socota (waqaf)”.

ayat.arabic: وَٱضۡرِبۡ لَهُم مَّثَلًا أَصۡحَٰبَ ٱلۡقَرۡيَةِ إِذۡ جَآءَهَا ٱلۡمُرۡسَلُونَ

en.text: And present to them an example: the people of the city, when the messengers came to it -

so.text: 13. Waxaad ugu soo qaadataa tusaale; (qisada) dadkii magaalada (Antaakiya), markay u yimaadeen Rusushii (loo soo diray).

ayat.arabic: إِذۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَآ إِلَيۡهِمُ ٱثۡنَيۡنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزۡنَا بِثَالِثٖ فَقَالُوٓاْ إِنَّآ إِلَيۡكُم مُّرۡسَلُونَ

en.text: When We sent to them two but they denied them, so We strengthened [them] with a third, and they said, "Indeed, we are messengers to you."

so.text: 14. Markaan u dirnay Xaggooda labo (xertii Ciise ah), markaasay labadiiba beeniyeen, markaasaan ku xoojinnay mid seddexaad, waxayna yidhaahdeen: Waxaanu nahay Rusul xaggiinna loo soo diray.

ayat.arabic: قَالُواْ مَآ أَنتُمۡ إِلَّا بَشَرٞ مِّثۡلُنَا وَمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ مِن شَيۡءٍ إِنۡ أَنتُمۡ إِلَّا تَكۡذِبُونَ

en.text: They said, "You are not but human beings like us, and the Most Merciful has not revealed a thing. You are only telling lies."

so.text: 15.Waxay 'dadkii magaalada' yidhaahdeen: Ma ahidin waxaan ahayn dad nala mid ah, mana soo dejin Raxmaanku waxba, ee been uun baad sheegeysaan.

ayat.arabic: قَالُواْ رَبُّنَا يَعۡلَمُ إِنَّآ إِلَيۡكُمۡ لَمُرۡسَلُونَ

en.text: They said, "Our Lord knows that we are messengers to you,

so.text: 16. Waxay (Rusushii) yidhaahdeen: Rabbigayo waa Og yahay inaan nahay Rusul xaggiinna loo soo diray.

ayat.arabic: وَمَا عَلَيۡنَآ إِلَّا ٱلۡبَلَٰغُ ٱلۡمُبِينُ

en.text: And we are not responsible except for clear notification."

so.text: 17. Nama saarna waxaan ahayn gaarsiin cad (ee Diinta Alle - Islaamka).

ayat.arabic: قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا تَطَيَّرۡنَا بِكُمۡۖ لَئِن لَّمۡ تَنتَهُواْ لَنَرۡجُمَنَّكُمۡ وَلَيَمَسَّنَّكُم مِّنَّا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٞ

en.text: They said, "Indeed, we consider you a bad omen. If you do not desist, we will surely stone you, and there will surely touch you, from us, a painful punishment."

so.text: 18. Waxay 'dadkii magaalada' yidhaahdeen: Waan idin shareysannay, haddaydaan joojin (waxaad waddaan), waan idin dhagaxyeyn waxaana idinka taaban xaggayaga cadaab xanuun badan.

ayat.arabic: قَالُواْ طَٰٓئِرُكُم مَّعَكُمۡ أَئِن ذُكِّرۡتُمۚ بَلۡ أَنتُمۡ قَوۡمٞ مُّسۡرِفُونَ

en.text: They said, "Your omen [i.e., fate] is with yourselves. Is it[1262] because you were reminded? Rather, you are a transgressing people."
en.footnotes: [1262] Your threat against us.

so.text: 19. Waxay (Rusushii) yidhaahdeen: Shareysigiinnu waa la jirkiin (waana sababta shirkigiinna iyo xume falkiinna),  ma in la idin waaniyey darteed [4]? Mayee, waxaad tihiin qolo xadgudub badan.
so.footnotes: [4]. Gooddinta aad noo gooddineysaan ma waxaa u sabab ah inaan wax xaq ah idiin sheegno oo idinku waaninno.

ayat.arabic: وَجَآءَ مِنۡ أَقۡصَا ٱلۡمَدِينَةِ رَجُلٞ يَسۡعَىٰ قَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ ٱتَّبِعُواْ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ

en.text: And there came from the farthest end of the city a man, running. He said, "O my people, follow the messengers.

so.text: 20. Waxaa ka yimid magaalada dhan- keeda shishe nin rooraya, wuxuu yidhi: tolkayow! Raaca Rususha;

ayat.arabic: ٱتَّبِعُواْ مَن لَّا يَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ أَجۡرٗا وَهُم مُّهۡتَدُونَ

en.text: Follow those who do not ask of you [any] payment, and they are [rightly] guided.

so.text: 21. Raaca kuwo aan idin weydiisan wax abaal gud ah, oo hanuunsan.

ayat.arabic: وَمَالِيَ لَآ أَعۡبُدُ ٱلَّذِي فَطَرَنِي وَإِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُونَ

en.text: And why should I not worship He who created me and to whom you will be returned?

so.text: 22. Maxaan u caabudeynin (Alle Keliya) ee ah kan i abuuray? Xaggiisaana la idin soo celin.

ayat.arabic: ءَأَتَّخِذُ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةً إِن يُرِدۡنِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ بِضُرّٖ لَّا تُغۡنِ عَنِّي شَفَٰعَتُهُمۡ شَيۡـٔٗا وَلَا يُنقِذُونِ

en.text: Should I take other than Him [false] deities [while], if the Most Merciful intends for me some adversity, their intercession will not avail me at all, nor can they save me?

so.text: 23. Ma waxaan yeeshaa (Alle) sokadi ilaahyo (kale), hadduu Raxmaanku (Alle) ila doono dhibaato, ayan i tareyn  garab siintoodu waxba, oo aan awoodinba  inay i badbaadiyaan?

ayat.arabic: إِنِّيٓ إِذٗا لَّفِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٍ

en.text: Indeed, I would then be in manifest error.

so.text: 24. Markaa xaqiiq waxaan ku suganahay habow cad.

ayat.arabic: إِنِّيٓ ءَامَنتُ بِرَبِّكُمۡ فَٱسۡمَعُونِ

en.text: Indeed, I have believed in your Lord, so listen to me."

so.text: 25. Hubaal anigu waxaan rumeeyey Rabbigiin, ee i maqla.

ayat.arabic: قِيلَ ٱدۡخُلِ ٱلۡجَنَّةَۖ قَالَ يَٰلَيۡتَ قَوۡمِي يَعۡلَمُونَ

en.text: It was said, "Enter Paradise."[1263] He said, "I wish my people could know
en.footnotes: [1263] An abrupt transfer to the Hereafter conveys the meaning that the man met a violent death at the hands of the disbelievers and so was martyred for the cause of Allāh.

so.text: 26. Waxaa la yidhi: Gal jannada. Wuxuu yidhi: Alla dadkaygu may ogaadaan [5].
so.footnotes: [5]. Ninkaa waxaa la odhan jirey Xabiib oo ahaa geed qore, sidaas darteed baa waxaa loo yiqiin Xabiib Al-Najjaar. Inta aysan nafta ka bixin waxaa soo degay malaa’ig ugu bishaaraysay in loo dhaafay dhammaan dunuubtiisa oo uu geli doono Jannada. Magaaladaas waxay ahayd Antaakiya.

ayat.arabic: بِمَا غَفَرَ لِي رَبِّي وَجَعَلَنِي مِنَ ٱلۡمُكۡرَمِينَ

en.text: Of how my Lord has forgiven me and placed me among the honored."

so.text: 27. Sida Rabbigay iigu denbi dhaafay, oo uu iiga mid yeelay kuwa la sharfay!

ayat.arabic: ۞ وَمَآ أَنزَلۡنَا عَلَىٰ قَوۡمِهِۦ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِۦ مِن جُندٖ مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا كُنَّا مُنزِلِينَ

en.text: And We did not send down upon his people after him any soldiers from the heaven, nor would We have done so.

so.text: 28. Kuma aanu soo dejin qolodiisii  gadaashi wax ciidan ah aan kaga keennay samada, mana aanu falno sidaas.

ayat.arabic: إِن كَانَتۡ إِلَّا صَيۡحَةٗ وَٰحِدَةٗ فَإِذَا هُمۡ خَٰمِدُونَ

en.text: It was not but one shout,[1264] and immediately they were extinguished.
en.footnotes: [1264] From Gabriel or a blast from the sky.

so.text: 29. Waxay ahayd dhawaaq qaylo keliya ah, markaasay wada baseen.

ayat.arabic: يَٰحَسۡرَةً عَلَى ٱلۡعِبَادِۚ مَا يَأۡتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ

en.text: How regretful for the servants. There did not come to them any messenger except that they used to ridicule him.

so.text: 30. Maxay qoomamo u ahaatay addoomaha! Ma jiro Rasuul u yimaada aanay ku jeesjeesin.

ayat.arabic: أَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ كَمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَا قَبۡلَهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡقُرُونِ أَنَّهُمۡ إِلَيۡهِمۡ لَا يَرۡجِعُونَ

en.text: Have they not considered how many generations We destroyed before them - that they to them[1265] will not return?
en.footnotes: [1265] i.e., to those living presently in the world.

so.text: 31. Miyeyna ogaan intee baan facyo halaagnay hortood, aan xaggooda u soo noqonayn?

ayat.arabic: وَإِن كُلّٞ لَّمَّا جَمِيعٞ لَّدَيۡنَا مُحۡضَرُونَ

en.text: And indeed, all of them will yet be brought present before Us.

so.text: 32. Kulligoodna iyagoo dhan Hortayadaa la keeni.

ayat.arabic: وَءَايَةٞ لَّهُمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ ٱلۡمَيۡتَةُ أَحۡيَيۡنَٰهَا وَأَخۡرَجۡنَا مِنۡهَا حَبّٗا فَمِنۡهُ يَأۡكُلُونَ

en.text: And a sign for them is the dead earth. We have brought it to life and brought forth from it grain, and from it they eat.

so.text: 33. Waxaa Calaamo u ah arlada meydka ah aanu nooleyno, kana soo saarno hadhuudh ay wax ka cunaan.

ayat.arabic: وَجَعَلۡنَا فِيهَا جَنَّٰتٖ مِّن نَّخِيلٖ وَأَعۡنَٰبٖ وَفَجَّرۡنَا فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلۡعُيُونِ

en.text: And We placed therein gardens of palm trees and grapevines and caused to burst forth therefrom some springs -

so.text: 34. Waxaana yeellay dhexdeeda beero timir ah iyo canabyo, oo ka burqinnay dhexdeeda ilo (biyo ah).

ayat.arabic: لِيَأۡكُلُواْ مِن ثَمَرِهِۦ وَمَا عَمِلَتۡهُ أَيۡدِيهِمۡۚ أَفَلَا يَشۡكُرُونَ

en.text: That they may eat of His fruit.[1266] And their hands have not produced it,[1267] so will they not be grateful?
en.footnotes:
[1266] i.e., that which Allāh has produced for them.
[1267] An alternative meaning is "And [eat from] what their hands have produced [i.e., planted and harvested]." Both are grammatically correct.

so.text: 35. Si ay wax uga cunaan midhahiisa, mana ayan sameyn gacmahoodu [6]. Ee Ma waysan (Alle u) mahad naqeyn?
so.footnotes: [6]. Macno kale: Waa inay wax ka cunaan waxa ay gacmahoodu faleen (beereen oo soo goosteen). Labada macnoba waa sax.

ayat.arabic: سُبۡحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلۡأَزۡوَٰجَ كُلَّهَا مِمَّا تُنۢبِتُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَمِنۡ أَنفُسِهِمۡ وَمِمَّا لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ

en.text: Exalted is He who created all pairs[1268] - from what the earth grows and from themselves and from that which they do not know.
en.footnotes: [1268] Or "all species."

so.text: 36. Waxaa xurmo oo dhan iska leh oo ka hufan  (xumaan, Alle ee) abuuray noocyada dhammaan wuxuu dhulka soo saaro, iyo nafahooda iyo waxa aysan ogayn.

ayat.arabic: وَءَايَةٞ لَّهُمُ ٱلَّيۡلُ نَسۡلَخُ مِنۡهُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فَإِذَا هُم مُّظۡلِمُونَ

en.text: And a sign for them is the night. We remove[1269] from it the [light of] day, so they are [left] in darkness.
en.footnotes: [1269] Literally, "strip" or "peel." Sunlight projected onto the earth is removed from it as the earth turns and night approaches.

so.text: 37. waxaa Calaamo ugu sugan habeenka, aan ka soo saarno maalinta, oo markaas ay mugdi galaan.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلشَّمۡسُ تَجۡرِي لِمُسۡتَقَرّٖ لَّهَاۚ ذَٰلِكَ تَقۡدِيرُ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡعَلِيمِ

en.text: And the sun runs [on course] toward its stopping point. That is the determination of the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.

so.text: 38. Qorraxdu waxay ku oroddaa rugo ay leedahay. (Arrin)kaasi waa Qaddarka (Alle) Adkaadaha Sare, wax kasta Ogsoonaha ah.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلۡقَمَرَ قَدَّرۡنَٰهُ مَنَازِلَ حَتَّىٰ عَادَ كَٱلۡعُرۡجُونِ ٱلۡقَدِيمِ

en.text: And the moon - We have determined for it phases, until it returns [appearing] like the old date stalk.

so.text: 39. Dayaxa waxaanu u qaddarnay heerar uu maro ilaa uu soo noqdo mar kale sida laan timireed qallalan oo gabowday.

ayat.arabic: لَا ٱلشَّمۡسُ يَنۢبَغِي لَهَآ أَن تُدۡرِكَ ٱلۡقَمَرَ وَلَا ٱلَّيۡلُ سَابِقُ ٱلنَّهَارِۚ وَكُلّٞ فِي فَلَكٖ يَسۡبَحُونَ

en.text: It is not allowable [i.e., possible] for the sun to reach the moon, nor does the night overtake the day, but each, in an orbit, is swimming.

so.text: 40. Looma oggola qorraxda inay haleesho dayaxa, habeenkuna ma ka hor maro maalinta. Dhammaan waxay ku dabaashaan mareeg (garangar) dhexdi.

ayat.arabic: وَءَايَةٞ لَّهُمۡ أَنَّا حَمَلۡنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡفُلۡكِ ٱلۡمَشۡحُونِ

en.text: And a sign for them is that We carried their forefathers[1270] in a laden ship.
en.footnotes: [1270] Usually meaning "descendants" or "offspring," the word "dhurriyyah" is used here to denote forefathers (their being the offspring of Noah), who were saved from the flood.

so.text: 41. Waxaa Calaamo ugu filan inaan ku qaadnay ubadkoodii [7] Doonidii buuxday.
so.footnotes: [7]. Weedha durriyad halkan waxaa loola jeedaa fir (waa inay yihiin firkii Nuux) ee laga badbaadshay daadkii weynaa ee lagu halaagay qoonkii Nuux.

ayat.arabic: وَخَلَقۡنَا لَهُم مِّن مِّثۡلِهِۦ مَا يَرۡكَبُونَ

en.text: And We created for them from the likes of it that which they ride.

so.text: 42. Waxaana uga abuurnay wax caynkeed ah waxay fuulaan.

ayat.arabic: وَإِن نَّشَأۡ نُغۡرِقۡهُمۡ فَلَا صَرِيخَ لَهُمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يُنقَذُونَ

en.text: And if We should will, We could drown them; then no one responding to a cry would there be for them, nor would they be saved

so.text: 43. Haddaan doonnona waanu harqin, markaa ma helaan wax u soo gurmada, lamana badbaadiyo.

ayat.arabic: إِلَّا رَحۡمَةٗ مِّنَّا وَمَتَٰعًا إِلَىٰ حِينٖ

en.text: Except as a mercy from Us and provision for a time.

so.text: 44. Naxariis Xaggayaga ah mooyee iyo raaxo ilaa muddo ah.

ayat.arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱتَّقُواْ مَا بَيۡنَ أَيۡدِيكُمۡ وَمَا خَلۡفَكُمۡ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تُرۡحَمُونَ

en.text: But when it is said to them, "Beware of what is before you and what is behind you;[1271] perhaps you will receive mercy..."[1272]
en.footnotes:
[1271] Of sins or of life in this world and the Hereafter.
[1272] The conclusion of this sentence is understood to be "...they ignored the warning."

so.text: 45. Marka (gaalada) lagu yidhaahdo: Iska jira waxa ah hortiinna iyo waxa ah gadaashiinna [8] si la idiinkugu naxariisto 'ma maqlaan' [9].
so.footnotes:
[8]. Waxaa loola jeedaa Aakhirada iyo cadaabkeeda iyo adduunka iyo xaaladahiisa kala duwan. 
[9]. Macnaha way iska dhego tiraan waanooyinka oo dan u geli waayaan digniinaha.

ayat.arabic: وَمَا تَأۡتِيهِم مِّنۡ ءَايَةٖ مِّنۡ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ إِلَّا كَانُواْ عَنۡهَا مُعۡرِضِينَ

en.text: And no sign comes to them from the signs of their Lord except that they are from it turning away.

so.text: 46. Uma timaaddo calaamad ka mid ah calaamooyinka Rabbigood, wayse ka sii jeesadaan.

ayat.arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمۡ أَنفِقُواْ مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ أَنُطۡعِمُ مَن لَّوۡ يَشَآءُ ٱللَّهُ أَطۡعَمَهُۥٓ إِنۡ أَنتُمۡ إِلَّا فِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٖ

en.text: And when it is said to them, "Spend from that which Allāh has provided for you," those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Should we feed one whom, if Allāh had willed, He would have fed? You are not but in clear error."

so.text: 47. Marka lagu yidhaahdo: Wax ka bixiya waxa uu Alle idinku irsaaqay, kuwa gaalooba waxay ku yidhaahdaan kuwa (xaqa) rumeeyey: Ma waxaan quudinnaa`mid hadduu doono Alle uu quudin lahaa? Idinku kuma sugnidin waxaan ahayn habow cad.

ayat.arabic: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلۡوَعۡدُ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ

en.text: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"

so.text: 48.Waxay (gaaladu) odhan: Goormay gooddintani fuli, haddaad run sheegaysaan?

ayat.arabic: مَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا صَيۡحَةٗ وَٰحِدَةٗ تَأۡخُذُهُمۡ وَهُمۡ يَخِصِّمُونَ

en.text: They do not await except one blast[1273] which will seize them while they are disputing.
en.footnotes: [1273] Literally, "cry" or "shriek," meaning the first blast of the Horn which will strike dead every living thing on the earth without warning.

so.text: 49. Ma sugayaan (gaaladu) wax kale aan aheyn hal Qaylo [10], qabaneysa iyagoo murmi.
so.footnotes: [10]. Erey ahaan macnaha waa dhawaaq ama qeylo daran, waxaana loola jeedaa afuufka koowaad ee Buunka uu dhiman noole kasta oo dhulka jooga digniin hore la’aan.

ayat.arabic: فَلَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ تَوۡصِيَةٗ وَلَآ إِلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِهِمۡ يَرۡجِعُونَ

en.text: And they will not be able [to give] any instruction, nor to their people can they return.

so.text: 50. Markaas ma karaan dardaaran, ehelkoodiina uma soo noqdaan.

ayat.arabic: وَنُفِخَ فِي ٱلصُّورِ فَإِذَا هُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَجۡدَاثِ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمۡ يَنسِلُونَ

en.text: And the Horn will be blown;[1274] and at once from the graves to their Lord they will hasten.
en.footnotes: [1274] For the second time, signaling the Resurrection.

so.text: 51. Buunkaa la aafuufi [11], mise kolkaa bay qubuurahooda ka soo yaaci iygoo u degdegaya xagga Rabbigood.
so.footnotes: [11]. Waxaa loola jeedaa afuufka labaad ee Buunka, markaasoo ay ka soo bixi doonaan qubuuraha iyagoo la soo nooleeyey.

ayat.arabic: قَالُواْ يَٰوَيۡلَنَا مَنۢ بَعَثَنَا مِن مَّرۡقَدِنَاۜۗ هَٰذَا مَا وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ وَصَدَقَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلُونَ

en.text: They will say, "O woe to us! Who has raised us up from our sleeping place?" [The reply will be], "This is what the Most Merciful had promised, and the messengers told the truth."

so.text: 52. Waxay odhan: Hoognaye! Yaa naga soo kiciyey meeshayadii aan hurudnay? (Waxaa lagu odhan): Kanu waa wuxuu Raxmaan- ku ballan qaaday, Rusushuna run bay sheegeen.

ayat.arabic: إِن كَانَتۡ إِلَّا صَيۡحَةٗ وَٰحِدَةٗ فَإِذَا هُمۡ جَمِيعٞ لَّدَيۡنَا مُحۡضَرُونَ

en.text: It will not be but one blast, and at once they are all brought present before Us.

so.text:
53. Ma ahaaneyso wax kale aan aheyn hal Qaylo keliya, Mise kolkaa! Waxay dham-     
 maan ahaan kuwo Hortayada la keeno.

ayat.arabic: فَٱلۡيَوۡمَ لَا تُظۡلَمُ نَفۡسٞ شَيۡـٔٗا وَلَا تُجۡزَوۡنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ

en.text: So today [i.e., the Day of Judgement] no soul will be wronged at all, and you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do.

so.text: 54. Marka Maanta (Qiyaamada) lagama dulmiyo nafna waxba, la idinkana abaal marin maayo waxaad camal fasheen mooyee.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ أَصۡحَٰبَ ٱلۡجَنَّةِ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ فِي شُغُلٖ فَٰكِهُونَ

en.text: Indeed the companions of Paradise, that Day, will be amused in [joyful] occupation -

so.text: 55. Hubaal ehlu-jannuhu, waxay maalintaas ku sugnaan shuqul (la raaxeysi xaasaskooda) iyagoo faraxsan.

ayat.arabic: هُمۡ وَأَزۡوَٰجُهُمۡ فِي ظِلَٰلٍ عَلَى ٱلۡأَرَآئِكِ مُتَّكِـُٔونَ

en.text: They and their spouses - in shade, reclining on adorned couches.

so.text: 56. Iyaga iyo xaasaskoodu waxay ku sugnaan hoosas harac ah, iyagoo ku dangiigsanaan sariiro sare.

ayat.arabic: لَهُمۡ فِيهَا فَٰكِهَةٞ وَلَهُم مَّا يَدَّعُونَ

en.text: For them therein is fruit, and for them is whatever they request [or wish]

so.text: 57. Waxay ku lahaan midho gudaheeda waxayna lahaan waxay doonaanba.

ayat.arabic: سَلَٰمٞ قَوۡلٗا مِّن رَّبّٖ رَّحِيمٖ

en.text: [And] "Peace," a word from a Merciful Lord.

so.text: 58. Salaam (Nabad ahaada): waa qowl uga imaan Rabbi, Naxariis Badan (Allaah Kor ahaaye).

ayat.arabic: وَٱمۡتَٰزُواْ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ أَيُّهَا ٱلۡمُجۡرِمُونَ

en.text: [Then He will say], "But stand apart today, you criminals.[1275]
en.footnotes: [1275] i.e., remove yourself from the ranks of the believers to be distinguished from them.

so.text: 59. Soocma maanta denbiilayaashow [12]!
so.footnotes: [12]. Waa ka baxa safka mu’miniinta oo gooni u istaaga si la idiinka garto iyaga.

ayat.arabic: ۞ أَلَمۡ أَعۡهَدۡ إِلَيۡكُمۡ يَٰبَنِيٓ ءَادَمَ أَن لَّا تَعۡبُدُواْ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنَۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمۡ عَدُوّٞ مُّبِينٞ

en.text: Did I not enjoin upon you, O children of Adam, that you not worship Satan - [for] indeed, he is to you a clear enemy -

so.text: 60. Miyaanan idiin xil saarin Ilma Aadanow inaydaan caabudin Shaydaan? Hubaal, wuxuu idiin yahay cadow cad.

ayat.arabic: وَأَنِ ٱعۡبُدُونِيۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٞ مُّسۡتَقِيمٞ

en.text: And that you worship [only] Me? This is a straight path.

so.text: 61. Iyo inaad i caabudaan Aniga (Allaah Keliya) wa kaa Jidka Toosane.

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ أَضَلَّ مِنكُمۡ جِبِلّٗا كَثِيرًاۖ أَفَلَمۡ تَكُونُواْ تَعۡقِلُونَ

en.text: And he had already led astray from among you much of creation, so did you not use reason?

so.text: 62. Wuxuu (Shaydaan) dhab ahaan habaabiyey dad badan oo idinka mid ah. Ee miyeydaan aheyn kuwo wax garta?

ayat.arabic: هَٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِي كُنتُمۡ تُوعَدُونَ

en.text: This is the Hellfire which you were promised.

so.text: 63. Waa tan Jahannamadii la idiinku gooddinayey.

ayat.arabic: ٱصۡلَوۡهَا ٱلۡيَوۡمَ بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَكۡفُرُونَ

en.text: [Enter to] burn therein today for what you used to deny."[1276]
en.footnotes: [1276] Or "because you used to disbelieve."

so.text: 64. Ee gala oo ku gubta (Naarta) maanta gaalnimadiinnii darteed.

ayat.arabic: ٱلۡيَوۡمَ نَخۡتِمُ عَلَىٰٓ أَفۡوَٰهِهِمۡ وَتُكَلِّمُنَآ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ وَتَشۡهَدُ أَرۡجُلُهُم بِمَا كَانُواْ يَكۡسِبُونَ

en.text: That Day, We will seal over their mouths, and their hands will speak to Us, and their feet will testify about what they used to earn.

so.text: 65. Maanta Waxaynu dabooli afafkooda, waxaa nala hadli gacmahooda, waxaana ku marag furi lugahooda waxay kasbadeen (oo denbiyo ah darteed).

ayat.arabic: وَلَوۡ نَشَآءُ لَطَمَسۡنَا عَلَىٰٓ أَعۡيُنِهِمۡ فَٱسۡتَبَقُواْ ٱلصِّرَٰطَ فَأَنَّىٰ يُبۡصِرُونَ

en.text: And if We willed, We could have obliterated their eyes, and they would race to [find] the path, and how could they see?[1277]
en.footnotes: [1277] Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) could have left man without means of guidance in the life of this world, although in His mercy He did not.

so.text: 66. Haddaan doonno, waxaan malaasay- naa indhahooda, markaasay hadba dhinac u cararayaan iyagoo raadinaya Jidka, Sidee bayse u arkayaan [13]?
so.footnotes: [13]. Alle s.w.t. wuu kaga tegi karay aadmiga hanuunin la’aan nolosha adduunkan, ha yeeshee ma uusan yeelin sidaas Naxariistiisa awgeed.

ayat.arabic: وَلَوۡ نَشَآءُ لَمَسَخۡنَٰهُمۡ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِهِمۡ فَمَا ٱسۡتَطَٰعُواْ مُضِيّٗا وَلَا يَرۡجِعُونَ

en.text: And if We willed, We could have deformed them, [paralyzing them] in their places so they would not be able to proceed, nor could they return.[1278]
en.footnotes: [1278] He (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) could have prevented man from taking any action to benefit himself in this world or the Hereafter, yet He did not.

so.text: 67. Haddaan doonnona, waxaan ku masakhaynaa halkooda, markaas ma kara- yaan tagitaan iyo soo noqosho midna [14].
so.footnotes: [14]. Alle s.w.t. wuu ka celin karay aadmiga inuu sameeyo wax dan u ah adduunkan ama Aakhirada, sidaas oy tahay ma uusan yeelin.

ayat.arabic: وَمَن نُّعَمِّرۡهُ نُنَكِّسۡهُ فِي ٱلۡخَلۡقِۚ أَفَلَا يَعۡقِلُونَ

en.text: And he to whom We grant long life We reverse in creation;[1279] so will they not understand?
en.footnotes: [1279] In his physical and mental capacity.

so.text: 68. Qofkaan siinno cimri dherer, Waanu tabar yareynaa abuur ahaan (oo asaasiqinnaa). Ee miyeyna wax fahmeyn?

ayat.arabic: وَمَا عَلَّمۡنَٰهُ ٱلشِّعۡرَ وَمَا يَنۢبَغِي لَهُۥٓۚ إِنۡ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكۡرٞ وَقُرۡءَانٞ مُّبِينٞ

en.text: And We did not give him [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ)] knowledge of poetry, nor is it befitting for him. It is not but a message and a clear Qur’ān

so.text: 69. Ma aanu barin isaga (Nabi Muxammad) gabay, mana aha wax ku habboon. Kani ma aha waxaan ahayn Waano iyo Qur’aan cad.

ayat.arabic: لِّيُنذِرَ مَن كَانَ حَيّٗا وَيَحِقَّ ٱلۡقَوۡلُ عَلَى ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ

en.text: To warn whoever is alive[1280] and justify the word [i.e., decree] against the disbelievers.
en.footnotes: [1280] In heart and mind, i.e., the believers.

so.text: 70. Si uu ugu digo kan nool (mu'miniinta) oo Weedha (Cadaabka) ugu rumowdo gaalada.

ayat.arabic: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ أَنَّا خَلَقۡنَا لَهُم مِّمَّا عَمِلَتۡ أَيۡدِينَآ أَنۡعَٰمٗا فَهُمۡ لَهَا مَٰلِكُونَ

en.text: Do they not see that We have created for them from what Our hands[1281] have made, grazing livestock, and [then] they are their owners?
en.footnotes: [1281] See footnote to 2:19.

so.text: 71. Miyeyna arkaynin inaan u abuurnay xoolo ka mid ah waxay Gacmahayagu sameeyeen, ay iyagu hantaan oo leeyihiin?

ayat.arabic: وَذَلَّلۡنَٰهَا لَهُمۡ فَمِنۡهَا رَكُوبُهُمۡ وَمِنۡهَا يَأۡكُلُونَ

en.text: And We have tamed them for them, so some of them they ride, and some of them they eat.

so.text: 72. Oo aan u laylinnay, sidaa awgeed waxna way adeegsadaan rukuub ahaan, waxna wax ka cunaan.

ayat.arabic: وَلَهُمۡ فِيهَا مَنَٰفِعُ وَمَشَارِبُۚ أَفَلَا يَشۡكُرُونَ

en.text: And for them therein are [other] benefits and drinks, so will they not be grateful?

so.text: 73. Waxaana ugu sugan manaafacaad kale iyo cabbitaanno. Ee Miyayna mahadineyn?

ayat.arabic: وَٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةٗ لَّعَلَّهُمۡ يُنصَرُونَ

en.text: But they have taken besides Allāh [false] deities that perhaps they would be helped.

so.text: 74. Waxayse yeesheen Alle ka sokow ilaahyo kale si ay ugu gargaaraan.

ayat.arabic: لَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ نَصۡرَهُمۡ وَهُمۡ لَهُمۡ جُندٞ مُّحۡضَرُونَ

en.text: They are not able to help them, and they [themselves] are for them soldiers in attendance.[1282]
en.footnotes: [1282] Maintaining and protecting their "gods." Another interpretation is that they (i.e., the gods) will be soldiers set against them in Hellfire.

so.text: 75. Ma karaan inay u gargaaraan, oo iyaga (naf ahaantooda) baa u ah ciidan u soo gurmada [15].
so.footnotes: [15]. Iyagoo ilaaliya oo dhowra ilaahyadooda beenta ah. Tafsiir kale waa inay ilaahyadaasi ahaan askar colkood ah iyaga Naarta gudaheeda.

ayat.arabic: فَلَا يَحۡزُنكَ قَوۡلُهُمۡۘ إِنَّا نَعۡلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعۡلِنُونَ

en.text: So let not their speech grieve you. Indeed, We know what they conceal and what they declare.

so.text: 76. Ee yuusan hadalkoodu ku murugo gelin, hubaal Waan ognahay waxay u falaan qarsoodiga iyo waxay caddaystaanba.

ayat.arabic: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقۡنَٰهُ مِن نُّطۡفَةٖ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٞ مُّبِينٞ

en.text: Does man not consider that We created him from a [mere] sperm-drop - then at once[1283] he is a clear adversary?
en.footnotes: [1283] i.e., as soon as he becomes self-sufficient.

so.text: 77. Miyuusan aadmigu arag inaan ka abuurnay dhibic mino ah. Mise waa col iska cad oo dood badan [16].
so.footnotes: [16]. Waa markuu kaaftoomo oo isku filnaado.

ayat.arabic: وَضَرَبَ لَنَا مَثَلٗا وَنَسِيَ خَلۡقَهُۥۖ قَالَ مَن يُحۡيِ ٱلۡعِظَٰمَ وَهِيَ رَمِيمٞ

en.text: And he presents for Us an example[1284] and forgets his [own] creation. He says, "Who will give life to bones while they are disintegrated?"
en.footnotes: [1284] Attempting to establish the finality of death.

so.text: 78. Wuxuu soo qaatay tusaale uu Annaga noola dan leeyahay, oo hilmaamay abuurkiisa. Wuxuu yidhi: Yaa nooleyn lafo baaliyoobay [17]?
so.footnotes: [17]. Isagoo isku dayaya inuu sugo inaanay jirin iska soo saarid qubuuraha.

ayat.arabic: قُلۡ يُحۡيِيهَا ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنشَأَهَآ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٖۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلۡقٍ عَلِيمٌ

en.text: Say, "He will give them life who produced them the first time; and He is, of all creation, Knowing."

so.text: 79. Dheh: Waxaa nooleyn Kan ifka keenay kolkii horeba. Isagaana (Alle) u Xog ogaal ah uunka oo idil.

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّجَرِ ٱلۡأَخۡضَرِ نَارٗا فَإِذَآ أَنتُم مِّنۡهُ تُوقِدُونَ

en.text: [It is] He who made for you from the green tree, fire, and then from it you ignite.

so.text: 80. Waa Kan idiinka yeelay geedka cagaaran dab oo markaas aad hursataan.

ayat.arabic: أَوَلَيۡسَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَخۡلُقَ مِثۡلَهُمۚ بَلَىٰ وَهُوَ ٱلۡخَلَّٰقُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ

en.text: Is not He who created the heavens and the earth Able to create the likes of them? Yes, [it is so]; and He is the Knowing Creator.

so.text: 81. Miyuusan (Alle ee ah) Kan abuuray samooyinka iyo arlada awoodin inuu abuuro iyagoo kale [18]? Haaheey, Waana Abuuraha Sare, wax kasta Ogsoonaha ah.
so.footnotes: [18]. Soo nooleeyo aadmiga oo dib u abuuro.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّمَآ أَمۡرُهُۥٓ إِذَآ أَرَادَ شَيۡـًٔا أَن يَقُولَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ

en.text: His command is only when He intends a thing that He says to it, "Be," and it is.

so.text: 82. Amarkiisu markuu doono wax uun, waa inuu keliya ku yidhaahdo: Ahaw, waana yahay.

ayat.arabic: فَسُبۡحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِي بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ وَإِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُونَ

en.text: So exalted is He in whose hand is the realm of all things, and to Him you will be returned.

so.text: 83. Ee xurmo oo dhan waxaa iska leh oo (xumaan ka) hufan (Alle) ay Gacantiisu ku jiraan Mulkiga (iyo Maamulka) wax kasta,  Xaggiisaana dib la idiinku soo celin [19].
so.footnotes: [19]. Maalinta uu Alle u kala garsoori doono addoomahiisa oo abaal marin.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلصَّٰٓفَّٰتِ صَفّٗا

en.text: By those [angels] lined up in rows

so.text: 1. Waxaan Anigu (Alle ah) ku dhaartay 'malaa’igta' safta safafka siman.

ayat.arabic: فَٱلزَّٰجِرَٰتِ زَجۡرٗا

en.text: And those who drive [the clouds]

so.text: 2. Iyo (malaa’igta) soo kaxeeya (daruuraha) soo kaxeyn.

ayat.arabic: فَٱلتَّٰلِيَٰتِ ذِكۡرًا

en.text: And those who recite the message,[1286]
en.footnotes: [1286] To the prophets or among themselves. Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) swears by these three kinds of angels to the fact mentioned in the following verse.

so.text: 3. Iyo (malaa’igta) akhriya "Qur’aanka' [1].
so.footnotes: [1]. Alle s.w.t. wuxuu ku dhaartay malaa’igtaa, wuxuuna ku dhaartay xaqiiqda lagu xusay Aayadda xigta.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ إِلَٰهَكُمۡ لَوَٰحِدٞ

en.text: Indeed, your God is One,

so.text: 4.Hubaal, Ilaahiinnu (Runta ahi) waa Mid keliya (Allaah).

ayat.arabic: رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا وَرَبُّ ٱلۡمَشَٰرِقِ

en.text: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them and Lord of the sunrises.[1287]
en.footnotes: [1287] i.e., each point or place of sunrise.

so.text: 5. Rabbiga samooyinka iyo arlada iyo waxa u dhexeeya, iyo Rabbiga bariyada [2].
so.footnotes: [2]. Xagal kasta ama meelaha ay ka soo baxdo qorraxda.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّا زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا بِزِينَةٍ ٱلۡكَوَاكِبِ

en.text: Indeed, We have adorned the nearest heaven with an adornment of stars

so.text: 6. Waxaanu xaqiiq ku qurxinnay samada soke qurux xiddigaha ah [3].
so.footnotes: [3]. Xiddigaha waxaa loo abuuray seddex waxyaalood: in lagu gano shayaadiinta, in lagu tilmaan qaato oo lagu garto jihooyinka iyo qurux ahaan samada soke.

ayat.arabic: وَحِفۡظٗا مِّن كُلِّ شَيۡطَٰنٖ مَّارِدٖ

en.text: And as protection against every rebellious devil

so.text: 7. Iyo ka ilaalin shaydaan walboo fallaago ah ee Naxariis (Alle) laga fogeeyey.

ayat.arabic: لَّا يَسَّمَّعُونَ إِلَى ٱلۡمَلَإِ ٱلۡأَعۡلَىٰ وَيُقۡذَفُونَ مِن كُلِّ جَانِبٖ

en.text: [So] they may not listen to the exalted assembly [of angels] and are pelted from every side,[1288]
en.footnotes: [1288] By flaming meteors.

so.text: 8. Ma dhegaysan karaan (shayaadiinta) kulanka sare (ee malaa’igta samada)  waxaana laga soo ganaa dhan kasta.

ayat.arabic: دُحُورٗاۖ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابٞ وَاصِبٌ

en.text: Repelled; and for them is a constant punishment,

so.text: 9. Iyagoo (Shayaadiintaa) la soo eryey,  waxayna leeyihiin cadaab joogto ah.

ayat.arabic: إِلَّا مَنۡ خَطِفَ ٱلۡخَطۡفَةَ فَأَتۡبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٞ ثَاقِبٞ

en.text: Except one who snatches [some words] by theft, but they are pursued by a burning flame, piercing [in brightness].

so.text: 10. Marka laga reebo mid mid dafa (hadal uu ka maqlay samada), markaasaa waxaa laga daba geeyaa danab dab ololoya ah.

ayat.arabic: فَٱسۡتَفۡتِهِمۡ أَهُمۡ أَشَدُّ خَلۡقًا أَم مَّنۡ خَلَقۡنَآۚ إِنَّا خَلَقۡنَٰهُم مِّن طِينٖ لَّازِبِۭ

en.text: Then inquire of them, [O Muḥammad], "Are they a stronger [or more difficult] creation or those [others] We have created?" Indeed, We created them [i.e., men] from sticky clay.

so.text: 11. Ee weydii (gaalada) ma iyagaa abuur adag mise waxaa (kale sida malaa’igta,  samooyinka, iyo arlada) ee aan abuurnay?. Waxaanu ka abuurnay (dadka) dhoobo dhagta.

ayat.arabic: بَلۡ عَجِبۡتَ وَيَسۡخَرُونَ

en.text: But you wonder, while they mock,

so.text: 12. Waxaadse la yaabtaa (beenintooda Xaqa), iyaguna way iska jees-jeesi.

ayat.arabic: وَإِذَا ذُكِّرُواْ لَا يَذۡكُرُونَ

en.text: And when they are reminded, they remember not.

so.text: 13. Marka la waaniyona ma waantoobaan.

ayat.arabic: وَإِذَا رَأَوۡاْ ءَايَةٗ يَسۡتَسۡخِرُونَ

en.text: And when they see a sign, they ridicule.

so.text: 14. Markay arkaanna Calaamo (mucjizo) way ku jees-jeesaan.

ayat.arabic: وَقَالُوٓاْ إِنۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحۡرٞ مُّبِينٌ

en.text: And say, "This is not but obvious magic.

so.text: 15. Waxayna yidhaahdaan: Waxa kanu ma aha waxaan ahayn sixir cad.

ayat.arabic: أَءِذَا مِتۡنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابٗا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبۡعُوثُونَ

en.text: When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?

so.text: 16. Ma markaan dhimanno oo aan noqonno carro iyo lafo, miyaa  nala soo bixin?

ayat.arabic: أَوَءَابَآؤُنَا ٱلۡأَوَّلُونَ

en.text: And our forefathers [as well]?"

so.text: 17. Iyo aabbayaashayadii hore (iyagana ma la so bixin dhimasho kaddib)?.

ayat.arabic: قُلۡ نَعَمۡ وَأَنتُمۡ دَٰخِرُونَ

en.text: Say, "Yes, and you will be [rendered] contemptible."

so.text: 18. Dheh: Haah, idinkoo waliba dulleysan.

ayat.arabic: فَإِنَّمَا هِيَ زَجۡرَةٞ وَٰحِدَةٞ فَإِذَا هُمۡ يَنظُرُونَ

en.text: It will be only one shout, and at once they will be observing.

so.text: 19. Waa uun afuuf mar keliya ah (buunka), markaasay (ka soo bixi qubuuraha) iyagoo wax eegi.

ayat.arabic: وَقَالُواْ يَٰوَيۡلَنَا هَٰذَا يَوۡمُ ٱلدِّينِ

en.text: They will say, "O woe to us! This is the Day of Recompense."

so.text: 20. Waxayna odhan: Hoog baa noo sug-naadaye! Kanu waa Maalinka Jaazeynta.

ayat.arabic: هَٰذَا يَوۡمُ ٱلۡفَصۡلِ ٱلَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ

en.text: [They will be told], "This is the Day of Judgement which you used to deny."

so.text: 21. Kani waa Maalinka kala baxa ee aad beenin jirteen.

ayat.arabic: ۞ ٱحۡشُرُواْ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ وَأَزۡوَٰجَهُمۡ وَمَا كَانُواْ يَعۡبُدُونَ

en.text: [The angels will be ordered], "Gather those who committed wrong, their kinds,[1289] and what they used to worship
en.footnotes: [1289] Those similar to them in evil deeds. Another possible meaning is "their wives."

so.text: 22. (Malaa'igay), soo kulmiya kuwii dulmi falka ahaa iyo eynigoodii [4] iyo waxay caabudi jireen.
so.footnotes: [4]. Tafsiir kale waa xaasaskooda ama kuwa aan xaqa raacin ee la midka ah.

ayat.arabic: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَٱهۡدُوهُمۡ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ

en.text: Other than Allāh, and guide them to the path of Hellfire

so.text: 23. Alle sokadi, oo u taxaaba Naarta ololka badan.

ayat.arabic: وَقِفُوهُمۡۖ إِنَّهُم مَّسۡـُٔولُونَ

en.text: And stop them; indeed, they are to be questioned."

so.text: 24. Joojiya, wax baa la weydiine (oo lagu qiri).

ayat.arabic: مَا لَكُمۡ لَا تَنَاصَرُونَ

en.text: [They will be asked], "What is [wrong] with you? Why do you not help each other?"

so.text: 25. Maxaad leedihiin oo aydaan isugu gargaareyn?

ayat.arabic: بَلۡ هُمُ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ مُسۡتَسۡلِمُونَ

en.text: But they, that Day, are in surrender.

so.text: 26.Mayee, Maalintaa dhammaan way is dhiibi doonaan.

ayat.arabic: وَأَقۡبَلَ بَعۡضُهُمۡ عَلَىٰ بَعۡضٖ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ

en.text: And they will approach one another asking [i.e., blaming] each other.

so.text: 27. Waxay ku jeesan qaarkoodba qaar iyagoo is weydiin?.

ayat.arabic: قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّكُمۡ كُنتُمۡ تَأۡتُونَنَا عَنِ ٱلۡيَمِينِ
