en.text: They will say, "Indeed, you used to come at us from the right."[1290]
en.footnotes: [1290] i.e., from our position of strength, oppressing us. Or from where we would have grasped the truth, preventing us.

so.text: 28. Waxay (raciyadii ku) odhan (madaxdoodii): Waxaad nooga iman jirteen dhanka midig [5].
so.footnotes: [5]. Idinkoo noo diidaya ku dhaqanka wanaagga iyo diinta oo xoog noo sheeganaya.

ayat.arabic: قَالُواْ بَل لَّمۡ تَكُونُواْ مُؤۡمِنِينَ

en.text: They [i.e., the oppressors] will say, "Rather, you [yourselves] were not believers,

so.text: 29. Waxay (madaxdii) odhan: Ma aha, ee idinkaan mu’miniin ahayn.

ayat.arabic: وَمَا كَانَ لَنَا عَلَيۡكُم مِّن سُلۡطَٰنِۭۖ بَلۡ كُنتُمۡ قَوۡمٗا طَٰغِينَ

en.text: And we had over you no authority, but you were a transgressing people.

so.text: 30. Kuma aanu laheyn wax awood ah korkiinna. Ee waxaad ahaydeen qolo xad gudub badan.

ayat.arabic: فَحَقَّ عَلَيۡنَا قَوۡلُ رَبِّنَآۖ إِنَّا لَذَآئِقُونَ

en.text: So the word [i.e., decree] of our Lord has come into effect upon us; indeed, we will taste [punishment].

so.text: 31. Sidaas awgeed waxaa nagu dhaboobay Qawlka Rabbigeen, xaqiiq waanu dhadhamin (Cadaabka).

ayat.arabic: فَأَغۡوَيۡنَٰكُمۡ إِنَّا كُنَّا غَٰوِينَ

en.text: And we led you to deviation; indeed, we were deviators."

so.text: 32. Waan idin luminnay [6], innaguna waa lunsanayn.
so.footnotes: [6]. Waxay madaxda ula yimaadeen dadweynaha dhagar weyn.

ayat.arabic: فَإِنَّهُمۡ يَوۡمَئِذٖ فِي ٱلۡعَذَابِ مُشۡتَرِكُونَ

en.text: So indeed they, that Day, will be sharing in the punishment.

so.text: 33. Iyagu (raciyaddii iyo kuwii la raacay) xaqiiq Maalinkaas cadaabkay wadaagi.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَفۡعَلُ بِٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ

en.text: Indeed, that is how We deal with the criminals.

so.text: 34. Sidaasaan ku fallaa denbiilayaasha.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُوٓاْ إِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمۡ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ يَسۡتَكۡبِرُونَ

en.text: Indeed they, when it was said to them, "There is no deity but Allāh," were arrogant

so.text: 35. Waxay xaqiiq ahaayeen marka lagu yidhaahdo: Ma jiro Ilaah (Xaq ah) aan ahayn Allaah, kuwa iska weyneeya.

ayat.arabic: وَيَقُولُونَ أَئِنَّا لَتَارِكُوٓاْ ءَالِهَتِنَا لِشَاعِرٖ مَّجۡنُونِۭ

en.text: And were saying, "Are we to leave our gods for a mad poet?"

so.text: 36. Iyagoo leh: Ma waxaan isaga dayn ilaahyadayada gabyaa Jinnoole ah?

ayat.arabic: بَلۡ جَآءَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَصَدَّقَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ

en.text: Rather, he [i.e., the Prophet (ﷺ)] has come with the truth and confirmed the [previous] messengers.

so.text: 37. Mayee’ wuxuu (Nabigu) la yimid Xaq, oo rumeeyey Rusushii (Alle soo diray).

ayat.arabic: إِنَّكُمۡ لَذَآئِقُواْ ٱلۡعَذَابِ ٱلۡأَلِيمِ

en.text: Indeed, you [disbelievers] will be tasters of the painful punishment,

so.text: 38. Waxaad idinku (gaaloy) dhadhamin cadaabka xanuunka badan.

ayat.arabic: وَمَا تُجۡزَوۡنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ

en.text: And you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do -

so.text: 39. La idinkamana abaal mariyo waxaan aheyn waxaad fasheen.

ayat.arabic: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡمُخۡلَصِينَ

en.text: But not the chosen servants of Allāh.

so.text: 40. Addoommaha Alle maahee ee daacadda ah u Keli yeela Alle cibaadada.

ayat.arabic: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمۡ رِزۡقٞ مَّعۡلُومٞ

en.text: Those will have a provision determined -

so.text: 41. Kuwaasi waxay leeyihiin risiq la yaqaan aan go'eyn (Jannada gudaheeda).

ayat.arabic: فَوَٰكِهُ وَهُم مُّكۡرَمُونَ

en.text: Fruits;[1291] and they will be honored
en.footnotes: [1291] Meaning everything delicious.

so.text: 42. Midho,  iyagoo lagu sharfi.

ayat.arabic: فِي جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ

en.text: In gardens of pleasure

so.text: 43. Beeraha barwaaqada (Jannada).

ayat.arabic: عَلَىٰ سُرُرٖ مُّتَقَٰبِلِينَ

en.text: On thrones facing one another.

so.text: 44. Sariiro sarreeya korkooda is qaabilsan fool ka fool (si farxad iyo reyn reyn leh).

ayat.arabic: يُطَافُ عَلَيۡهِم بِكَأۡسٖ مِّن مَّعِينِۭ

en.text: There will be circulated among them a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring,

so.text: 45. Waxaa lagula wareegi koobab (khamri daahir ah) ka soo shubma il (webiyo) saafi ah.

ayat.arabic: بَيۡضَآءَ لَذَّةٖ لِّلشَّٰرِبِينَ

en.text: White and delicious to the drinkers;

so.text: 46. Cad, oo u macaan kuwa cabbi.

ayat.arabic: لَا فِيهَا غَوۡلٞ وَلَا هُمۡ عَنۡهَا يُنزَفُونَ

en.text: No bad effect is there in it, nor from it will they be intoxicated.

so.text: 47. Ma leh wax dhibaato ah, lagumana sarkhaamo (khamrada Jannada).

ayat.arabic: وَعِندَهُمۡ قَٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرۡفِ عِينٞ

en.text: And with them will be women limiting [their] glances,[1292] with large, [beautiful] eyes,
en.footnotes: [1292] i.e., chaste and modest, looking only at their mates.

so.text: 48. Waxaana la jirkood ahaan haween dhowrsoon soo kooba araggooda, leh indho aad u qurxoon.

ayat.arabic: كَأَنَّهُنَّ بَيۡضٞ مَّكۡنُونٞ

en.text: As if they were [delicate] eggs, well-protected.

so.text: 49. La moodo ukummo aad loo dhowray.

ayat.arabic: فَأَقۡبَلَ بَعۡضُهُمۡ عَلَىٰ بَعۡضٖ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ

en.text: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other.

so.text: 50. Waxay qaabili qaarkoodba qaarka kale (ehlu Jannaha) iyagoo is weydiin.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ قَآئِلٞ مِّنۡهُمۡ إِنِّي كَانَ لِي قَرِينٞ

en.text: A speaker among them will say, "Indeed, I had a companion [on earth].

so.text: 51. Midkood hadlaya baa odhan: Waxaan anigu lahaa saaxiib.

ayat.arabic: يَقُولُ أَءِنَّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلۡمُصَدِّقِينَ

en.text: Who would say, 'Are you indeed of those who believe

so.text: 52. Kaasoo odhan jiray: Ma waxaad ka mid tahay kuwa rumeysan (soo bixinta Qiyaame)?

ayat.arabic: أَءِذَا مِتۡنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابٗا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَدِينُونَ

en.text: That when we have died and become dust and bones, we will indeed be recompensed?'"

so.text: 53.Ma markaan dhimanno oo aan noqonno carro iyo lafo, miyaa nala abaal marin?.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ هَلۡ أَنتُم مُّطَّلِعُونَ

en.text: He will say,[1293] "Would you [care to] look?"
en.footnotes: [1293] To his companions in Paradise.

so.text: 54. Wuxuu odhan: Ma ila dhuganeysaan?

ayat.arabic: فَٱطَّلَعَ فَرَءَاهُ فِي سَوَآءِ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ

en.text: And he will look and see him[1294] in the midst of the Hellfire.
en.footnotes: [1294] The companion who had tried to dissuade him from belief on earth.

so.text: 55. Markaasuu dhugtaa oo ku arkaa Naarta bartankeeda.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ تَٱللَّهِ إِن كِدتَّ لَتُرۡدِينِ

en.text: He will say, "By Allāh, you almost ruined me.

so.text: 56. Wuxuu odhan: Tallaahi! Waxaad sigtay inaad i halaagto (i dhumiso).

ayat.arabic: وَلَوۡلَا نِعۡمَةُ رَبِّي لَكُنتُ مِنَ ٱلۡمُحۡضَرِينَ

en.text: If not for the favor of my Lord, I would have been of those brought in [to Hell].

so.text: 57. Haddayna jirin Nicmadda Rabbigay, waxaan ka mid ahaan lahaa kuwa la soo keenayo (Naarta).

ayat.arabic: أَفَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمَيِّتِينَ

en.text: Then, are we not to die

so.text: 58. Ma nihin miyaa kuwo dhiman.

ayat.arabic: إِلَّا مَوۡتَتَنَا ٱلۡأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ

en.text: Except for our first death, and we will not be punished?"

so.text: 59. Dhimashadayadii hore mooyaane? mana layna cadaabayo?

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡعَظِيمُ

en.text: Indeed, this is the great attainment.

so.text: 60. Hubaal (arrin)kani waa Liibaanta Weyn.

ayat.arabic: لِمِثۡلِ هَٰذَا فَلۡيَعۡمَلِ ٱلۡعَٰمِلُونَ

en.text: For the like of this let the workers [on earth] work.

so.text: 61. Ee (arrin)kanoo kale ha u camal fashaan kuwa camal fali.

ayat.arabic: أَذَٰلِكَ خَيۡرٞ نُّزُلًا أَمۡ شَجَرَةُ ٱلزَّقُّومِ

en.text: Is that [i.e., Paradise] a better accommodation or the tree of zaqqūm?

so.text: 62. Ma (arrin)kani (Jannada) baa marti- qaad wanaagsan mise geedka Zaquum.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّا جَعَلۡنَٰهَا فِتۡنَةٗ لِّلظَّٰلِمِينَ

en.text: Indeed, We have made it a torment for the wrongdoers.

so.text: 63. Waxaanu Annagu uga dhignay fidno (imtixaan) daalimiinta (gar diidka ah).

ayat.arabic: إِنَّهَا شَجَرَةٞ تَخۡرُجُ فِيٓ أَصۡلِ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ

en.text: Indeed, it is a tree issuing from the bottom of the Hellfire,

so.text: 64.Waa geed ka soo baxa Naarta salkeeda,

ayat.arabic: طَلۡعُهَا كَأَنَّهُۥ رُءُوسُ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينِ

en.text: Its emerging fruit as if it was heads of the devils.

so.text: 65. Miraheeda la moodo madaxyada shaydaammada;

ayat.arabic: فَإِنَّهُمۡ لَأٓكِلُونَ مِنۡهَا فَمَالِـُٔونَ مِنۡهَا ٱلۡبُطُونَ

en.text: And indeed, they will eat from it and fill with it their bellies.

so.text: 66. Waxay (ehlu naarku) wax ka cuni (geedkaa) oo ka buuxin caloolahooda.

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّ لَهُمۡ عَلَيۡهَا لَشَوۡبٗا مِّنۡ حَمِيمٖ

en.text: Then indeed, they will have after it a mixture of scalding water.

so.text: 67. Waxay leeyihiin intaa kaddib cabbitaan isku dhaf kulul ah oo karaya.

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّ مَرۡجِعَهُمۡ لَإِلَى ٱلۡجَحِيمِ

en.text: Then indeed, their return will be to the Hellfire.

so.text: 68. Markaa waxay ku noqon xagga Naarta holaca badan.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّهُمۡ أَلۡفَوۡاْ ءَابَآءَهُمۡ ضَآلِّينَ

en.text: Indeed they found their fathers astray.

so.text: 69. Waxay heleen aabbayaashood oo habowsan.

ayat.arabic: فَهُمۡ عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِهِمۡ يُهۡرَعُونَ

en.text: So they hastened [to follow] in their footsteps.

so.text: 70. Iyaguna raadkoodii bay ku  degdegi.

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ ضَلَّ قَبۡلَهُمۡ أَكۡثَرُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ

en.text: And there had already strayed before them most of the former peoples,

so.text: 71. Waxaa dhab ahaan lumay iyaga hortood badi dadkii hore.

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا فِيهِم مُّنذِرِينَ

en.text: And We had already sent among them warners.

so.text: 72. Waxaana dhab ahaan u dirnay digayaal.

ayat.arabic: فَٱنظُرۡ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلۡمُنذَرِينَ

en.text: Then look how was the end of those who were warned -

so.text: 73. Ee eeg siday aheyd cidhibta kuwii loo digay (aanse waansamin).

ayat.arabic: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡمُخۡلَصِينَ

en.text: But not the chosen servants of Allāh.

so.text: 74. Addoommaha Alle ee daacadda ah maahee u Keli yeela cibaadada (kuwaa dhib ma arkaan).

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ نَادَىٰنَا نُوحٞ فَلَنِعۡمَ ٱلۡمُجِيبُونَ

en.text: And Noah had certainly called Us, and [We are] the best of responders.

so.text: 75. Waxaa dhab ahaan noo dhawaaqday Nuux, Annagaana u fiican wax ajiiba (baryada).

ayat.arabic: وَنَجَّيۡنَٰهُ وَأَهۡلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلۡكَرۡبِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ

en.text: And We saved him and his family from the great affliction.

so.text: 76. Waxaana ka badbaadinnay isaga iyo ehelkiisiiba kurbaddii weyneyd (haraqii).

ayat.arabic: وَجَعَلۡنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُۥ هُمُ ٱلۡبَاقِينَ

en.text: And We made his descendants those remaining [on the earth]

so.text: 77. Oo ka yeellay durriyaddiisa kuwa soo hadhay uun.

ayat.arabic: وَتَرَكۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرِينَ

en.text: And left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:

so.text: 78. Waxaana u reebnay (ammaan wanaagsan) facyada dambe dhexdood.

ayat.arabic: سَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰ نُوحٖ فِي ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

en.text: "Peace upon Noah among the worlds."

so.text: 79. Salaan (Nabadgelyo iyo Ammaan Alle) korkiisa ha ahaato Nuux.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ

en.text: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.

so.text: 80. Sidaasaan ku abaal marinnaa sama falayaasha.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ مِنۡ عِبَادِنَا ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ

en.text: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.

so.text: 81. Hubaal Wuxuu ka mid ahaa addoomahayaga mu’miniinta ah.

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ أَغۡرَقۡنَا ٱلۡأٓخَرِينَ

en.text: Then We drowned the others [i.e., disbelievers].

so.text: 82. Markaasaan harqinnay intii kale.

ayat.arabic: ۞ وَإِنَّ مِن شِيعَتِهِۦ لَإِبۡرَٰهِيمَ

en.text: And indeed, among his kind was Abraham,

so.text:
83. Waxaana ka mid  ah kuwa raacay 
jidkiisa Ibraahiim [7].
so.footnotes: [7]. Nabi Ibraahiim c.s. wuxuu raacay dhabbihii Nabi Nuux iyo intii rumeysey towxiidka iyo mabaadiida diinta Islaamka.

ayat.arabic: إِذۡ جَآءَ رَبَّهُۥ بِقَلۡبٖ سَلِيمٍ

en.text: When he came to his Lord with a sound heart

so.text: 84. Markuu ula yimid Rabbigi qalbi fayow [8].
so.footnotes: [8]. Qalbiga fayow waa kan ka nabad galay shirki, kibir, xasad, is cajabin, iwm ee daacadda ah u hoggaansan Alle.

ayat.arabic: إِذۡ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوۡمِهِۦ مَاذَا تَعۡبُدُونَ

en.text: [And] when he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship?

so.text: 85. Markuu ku yidhi aabbihi iyo dadkiisii: Waa maxay waxaad caabudaysaan?

ayat.arabic: أَئِفۡكًا ءَالِهَةٗ دُونَ ٱللَّهِ تُرِيدُونَ

en.text: Is it falsehood [as] gods other than Allāh you desire?

so.text: 86. been abuur, Ilaahyo aad barbar dhig- taan Allaah-miyaad dooneysaan idinku.

ayat.arabic: فَمَا ظَنُّكُم بِرَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

en.text: Then what is your thought about the Lord of the worlds?"

so.text: 87. Maxaadse ka maleysaneysaan Rabbiga uumanka?

ayat.arabic: فَنَظَرَ نَظۡرَةٗ فِي ٱلنُّجُومِ

en.text: And he cast a look at the stars

so.text: 88. Markaasuu eegay eegmo xiddigaha,

ayat.arabic: فَقَالَ إِنِّي سَقِيمٞ

en.text: And said, "Indeed, I am [about to be] ill."

so.text: 89. Wuxuuna yidhi: Anigu waa bukaa.

ayat.arabic: فَتَوَلَّوۡاْ عَنۡهُ مُدۡبِرِينَ

en.text: So they turned away from him, departing.

so.text: 90. Markaasay ka jeesteen oo tageen.

ayat.arabic: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِهِمۡ فَقَالَ أَلَا تَأۡكُلُونَ

en.text: Then he turned to their gods and said, "Do you not eat?[1295]
en.footnotes: [1295] Consume the offerings placed before them.

so.text: 91. Markaasuu aaday ilaahyadoodii, oo yidhi: Miyeydaan (wax) cuneyn [9].
so.footnotes: [9]. Inay cunaan qurbaannada hortooda la dhigay. Waana ku jeesjees iyo muujin caqli xumada dadkaa sanammada hor dhigay raashinka iyo hadiyooyinka.

ayat.arabic: مَا لَكُمۡ لَا تَنطِقُونَ

en.text: What is [wrong] with you that you do not speak?"

so.text: 92. Maxaad leedihiin oo aydaan la hadleyn?

ayat.arabic: فَرَاغَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ضَرۡبَۢا بِٱلۡيَمِينِ

en.text: And he turned upon them a blow with [his] right hand.

so.text: 93. Markaasuu ku jeestay oo ku garaacay gacanta midig.

ayat.arabic: فَأَقۡبَلُوٓاْ إِلَيۡهِ يَزِفُّونَ

en.text: Then they [i.e., the people] came toward him, hastening.

so.text: 94. Markaasay soo aadeen (dadkii) xaggiisa iyagoo soo degdegaya.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ أَتَعۡبُدُونَ مَا تَنۡحِتُونَ

en.text: He said, "Do you worship that which you [yourselves] carve,

so.text: 95. (Ibraahiim) wuxuu yidhi: Ma waxaad caabudaysaan waxaad qoraysaan (idinku sameysaan)?

ayat.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ خَلَقَكُمۡ وَمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ

en.text: While Allāh created you and that which you do?"

so.text: 96. Allaah baana idin abuuray idinka iyo waxaad sameysaanba?

ayat.arabic: قَالُواْ ٱبۡنُواْ لَهُۥ بُنۡيَٰنٗا فَأَلۡقُوهُ فِي ٱلۡجَحِيمِ

en.text: They said, "Construct for him a structure [i.e., furnace] and throw him into the burning fire."

so.text: 97. Waxay yidhaahdeen: U dhisa meel (dab lagu shido) kuna tuura dabkaa ololaya.

ayat.arabic: فَأَرَادُواْ بِهِۦ كَيۡدٗا فَجَعَلۡنَٰهُمُ ٱلۡأَسۡفَلِينَ

en.text: And they intended for him a plan [i.e., harm], but We made them the most debased.

so.text: 98. Waxay la dooneen dabin ka dhan ah, iyagaanse ka dhignay kuwa hooseeya.

ayat.arabic: وَقَالَ إِنِّي ذَاهِبٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّي سَيَهۡدِينِ

en.text: And [then] he said, "Indeed, I will go to [where I am ordered by] my Lord; He will guide me.

so.text: 99. (Ibraahiim) wuxuu yidhi: Anigu waxaan aadayaa xagga Rabbigay. Wuu i hanuunin.

ayat.arabic: رَبِّ هَبۡ لِي مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ

en.text: My Lord, grant me [a child] from among the righteous."

so.text: 100. Rabbiyow! I sii (ubad) wanaagsan.

ayat.arabic: فَبَشَّرۡنَٰهُ بِغُلَٰمٍ حَلِيمٖ

en.text: So We gave him good tidings of a forbearing boy.

so.text: 101. Waxaana ugu bishaaraynay wiil dul qaad badan (Ismaaciil).

ayat.arabic: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ ٱلسَّعۡيَ قَالَ يَٰبُنَيَّ إِنِّيٓ أَرَىٰ فِي ٱلۡمَنَامِ أَنِّيٓ أَذۡبَحُكَ فَٱنظُرۡ مَاذَا تَرَىٰۚ قَالَ يَٰٓأَبَتِ ٱفۡعَلۡ مَا تُؤۡمَرُۖ سَتَجِدُنِيٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ

en.text: And when he reached with him [the age of] exertion,[1296] he said, "O my son, indeed I have seen in a dream that I [must] sacrifice you, so see what you think." He said, "O my father, do as you are commanded. You will find me, if Allāh wills, of the steadfast."
en.footnotes: [1296] i.e., the ability to work and be of assistance.

so.text: 102.Markuu gaaray da' inuu la shaqeeyo oo hanaqaaday [10], (Ibraahiim) wuxuu yidhi: Maandhow! Waxaan ku arkay riyo anigoo kuu gawracaya (qurbaan ahaan Alle darti), ee bal eegoo maxay kula tahay. (Ismaaciil) wuxuu yidhi: Aabbow! Fal waxa lagu amray, hadduu Alle idmo, waxaad heli inaan ka mid noqdo kuwa samir yeesha.
so.footnotes: [10]. Ismaaciil awood u yeeshay inuu la shaqeeyo oo kaalmeeyo aabbihi Ibraahiim.

ayat.arabic: فَلَمَّآ أَسۡلَمَا وَتَلَّهُۥ لِلۡجَبِينِ

en.text: And when they had both submitted[1297] and he put him down upon his forehead,
en.footnotes: [1297] To the command of Allāh.

so.text: 103. Markay hoggaansameen oo uu u dhigay dhabanka (si uu u gowraco).

ayat.arabic: وَنَٰدَيۡنَٰهُ أَن يَٰٓإِبۡرَٰهِيمُ

en.text: We called to him, "O Abraham,

so.text: 104. baan u dhawaaqnay Annagoo leh: Ibraahiimow.

ayat.arabic: قَدۡ صَدَّقۡتَ ٱلرُّءۡيَآۚ إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ

en.text: You have fulfilled the vision." Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.

so.text: 105.Waxaad ka rumeysay riyadii. Sidaas baan ku abaal marinnaa sama falayaasha.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلۡبَلَٰٓؤُاْ ٱلۡمُبِينُ

en.text: Indeed, this was the clear trial.

so.text: 106. Xaqiiq, arrinkani wuxuu ahaa imtixaan cad.

ayat.arabic: وَفَدَيۡنَٰهُ بِذِبۡحٍ عَظِيمٖ

en.text: And We ransomed him with a great sacrifice,[1298]
en.footnotes: [1298] Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) sent a huge ram to be sacrificed in place of Ishmael.

so.text: 107. Waxaana (Ismaaciil) ku furannay wan weyn (oo buuran).

ayat.arabic: وَتَرَكۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرِينَ

en.text: And We left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:

so.text: 108. Waxaana ugu dhaafnay (Ibraahiim ammaan fiican) facyada dambe (oo dhan) dhexdood.

ayat.arabic: سَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰٓ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ

en.text: "Peace upon Abraham."

so.text: 109. Salaan (Nabadgelyo iyo Ammaan Alle) korkiisa ha ahaato Ibraahiim.

ayat.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ

en.text: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.

so.text: 110. Sidaasaan ku abaal marinnaa sama falayaasha.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ مِنۡ عِبَادِنَا ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ

en.text: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.

so.text: 111. Wuxuu ka mid ahaa addoomahayaga mu'miniinta ah.

ayat.arabic: وَبَشَّرۡنَٰهُ بِإِسۡحَٰقَ نَبِيّٗا مِّنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ

en.text: And We gave him good tidings of Isaac, a prophet from among the righteous.[1299]
en.footnotes: [1299] This verifies that the firstborn son who was to be sacrificed was Ishmael and not Isaac, as claimed by the Jews and Christians.

so.text: 112. Waxaan (markaa kaddib) ugu bishaareynay Isxaaq [11] _ Nabi ka mid ah kuwa wanaagsan.
so.footnotes: [11]. Tani waxay caddeyneysaa in wiilkiisa curadka ee la doonayey in la gowraco uu ahaa Ismaaciil oo ma uusan ahayn Isxaaq, sida ay sheegaan Yuhuudda iyo Nasaarada.

ayat.arabic: وَبَٰرَكۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ وَعَلَىٰٓ إِسۡحَٰقَۚ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا مُحۡسِنٞ وَظَالِمٞ لِّنَفۡسِهِۦ مُبِينٞ

en.text: And We blessed him and Isaac. But among their descendants is the doer of good and the clearly unjust to himself [i.e., sinner].

so.text: 113. Waanu barakaynay isaga iyo Isxaaqba, ubadkoodana waxaa ka mid ah mid sama fala iyo mid naftiisa u dulmiya si cad.

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ مَنَنَّا عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَهَٰرُونَ

en.text: And We did certainly confer favor upon Moses and Aaron.

so.text: 114. Waxaanu dhab ahaan ku mannaysannay wanaag Muuse iyo Haaruun.

ayat.arabic: وَنَجَّيۡنَٰهُمَا وَقَوۡمَهُمَا مِنَ ٱلۡكَرۡبِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ

en.text: And We saved them and their people from the great affliction,

so.text: 115. Oo ka badbaadinnay iyaga iyo dadkoodii kurbaddii weynayd (harqintii iyo addoonsigii iyo dulleysigii lagu hayey).

ayat.arabic: وَنَصَرۡنَٰهُمۡ فَكَانُواْ هُمُ ٱلۡغَٰلِبِينَ

en.text: And We supported them so it was they who overcame.

so.text: 116. Waanu u gargaarnay, sidaa darteed waxay ahaayeen kuwa adkaaday.

ayat.arabic: وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُمَا ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ ٱلۡمُسۡتَبِينَ

en.text: And We gave them the explicit Scripture [i.e., the Torah],

so.text: 117. Waxaanuna siinnay Kitaabka (Towraadda) Xujada cad ah.

ayat.arabic: وَهَدَيۡنَٰهُمَا ٱلصِّرَٰطَ ٱلۡمُسۡتَقِيمَ

en.text: And We guided them on the straight path.

so.text: 118. Oo ku hanuuninnay Jidka Toosan 'ee Islaamka' [12];
so.footnotes: [12]. Jidka toosan waa diinta Islaamka, waana diinta uu Alle la soo diray nabiyada oo dhan.

ayat.arabic: وَتَرَكۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمَا فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرِينَ

en.text: And We left for them [favorable mention] among later generations:

so.text: 119. Waxaan ugu dhaafnay (ammaan) facyada dambe (oo dhan) dhexdood .

ayat.arabic: سَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَهَٰرُونَ

en.text: "Peace upon Moses and Aaron."

so.text: 120.Salaan (Nabad gelyo iyo Ammaan Alle) korkooda ha ahaato Muuse iyo Haaruun.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ

en.text: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.

so.text: 121. Sidaasaan ku abaal marinnaa sama falayaasha.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّهُمَا مِنۡ عِبَادِنَا ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ

en.text: Indeed, they were of Our believing servants.

so.text: 122. Waxay xaqiiq ka mid ahaayeen addoomahayaga mu'miniinta ah.

ayat.arabic: وَإِنَّ إِلۡيَاسَ لَمِنَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ

en.text: And indeed, Elias was from among the messengers,

so.text: 123. Oo xaqiiq Ilyaas wuxuu ka mid ahaa Rususha.

ayat.arabic: إِذۡ قَالَ لِقَوۡمِهِۦٓ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

en.text: When he said to his people, "Will you not fear Allāh?

so.text: 124. Markuu ku yidhi tolkiisii, Miyeydaan ka dhowrsanayn (shirkiga iyo xumaha kale)?

ayat.arabic: أَتَدۡعُونَ بَعۡلٗا وَتَذَرُونَ أَحۡسَنَ ٱلۡخَٰلِقِينَ

en.text: Do you call upon Baʿl[1300] and leave the best of creators -
en.footnotes: [1300] The name of a great idol worshipped by the people and said to mean "lord."

so.text: 125. Ma waxaad baridaan Bacal [13] oo ka tagtaan Kan u wanaagsan abuurayaasha.
so.footnotes: [13]. Bacal Waa magaca sanam weyn ay caabudi jireen dadkii Phenisia, oo ay u heysteen inuu Rabbigood yahay.

ayat.arabic: ٱللَّهَ رَبَّكُمۡ وَرَبَّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ

en.text: Allāh, your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers?"

so.text: 126. Allaah, ee ah Rabbigiin (Runta ah) iyo Rabbiga Aabbayaashiinnii hore?.

ayat.arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَإِنَّهُمۡ لَمُحۡضَرُونَ

en.text: And they denied him, so indeed, they will be brought [for punishment],

so.text: 127. Wayse beeniyeen, waxaana xaqiiq loo soo kulmin (Cadaab),

ayat.arabic: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡمُخۡلَصِينَ

en.text: Except the chosen servants of Allāh.

so.text: 128. Addoomaha Alle maahee ee daacadda ah u keli yeela cibaadada.

ayat.arabic: وَتَرَكۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرِينَ

en.text: And We left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:

so.text: 129. Waxaana ugu dhaafnay (ammaan) facyada dambe (oo dhan) dhexdood.

ayat.arabic: سَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰٓ إِلۡ يَاسِينَ

en.text: "Peace upon Elias."[1301]
en.footnotes: [1301] Ilyāseen is said by some commentators to be a plural form, meaning "Elias and those who followed him."

so.text: 130. Salaan (Nabad gelyo iyo Ammaan Alle) korkiisa ha ahaato Ilyaasiin [14].
so.footnotes: [14]. Ilyaasiin waa wadarta Ilyaas, waxaana loola jeedaa Ilyaas iyo kuwii raacay.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ

en.text: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.

so.text: 131. Sidaasaan ku abaal marinnaa sama falayaasha.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ مِنۡ عِبَادِنَا ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ

en.text: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.

so.text: 132. Wuxuu ka mid ahaa addoomahayaga mu’miniinta ah.

ayat.arabic: وَإِنَّ لُوطٗا لَّمِنَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ

en.text: And indeed, Lot was among the messengers.

so.text: 133. Oo xaqiiq Luud wuxuu ka mid ahaa Rususha.

ayat.arabic: إِذۡ نَجَّيۡنَٰهُ وَأَهۡلَهُۥٓ أَجۡمَعِينَ

en.text: [So mention] when We saved him and his family, all,

so.text: 134. (Xus) markaan badbaadinnay isaga iyo ehelkiisaba, dhammaan,

ayat.arabic: إِلَّا عَجُوزٗا فِي ٱلۡغَٰبِرِينَ

en.text: Except an old woman [i.e., his wife] among those who remained [with the evildoers].

so.text: 135. Habar duq ah (marwadiisii) maahee oo ku hadhay (halaagga).

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ دَمَّرۡنَا ٱلۡأٓخَرِينَ

en.text: Then We destroyed the others.

so.text: 136. Kaddib waxaan baabbi’innay intii kale.

ayat.arabic: وَإِنَّكُمۡ لَتَمُرُّونَ عَلَيۡهِم مُّصۡبِحِينَ

en.text: And indeed, you pass by them in the morning

so.text: 137. Waxaadna xaqiiq ag martaan (dhulkoodii) subaxnimo,

ayat.arabic: وَبِٱلَّيۡلِۚ أَفَلَا تَعۡقِلُونَ

en.text: And at night. Then will you not use reason?

so.text: 138. Iyo habeennimo, ee miyeydaan  wax garan?

ayat.arabic: وَإِنَّ يُونُسَ لَمِنَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ

en.text: And indeed, Jonah was among the messengers.

so.text: 139. Oo xaqiiq Yuunus wuxuu ka mid ahaa Rusushii (la soo diray).

ayat.arabic: إِذۡ أَبَقَ إِلَى ٱلۡفُلۡكِ ٱلۡمَشۡحُونِ

en.text: [Mention] when he ran away to the laden ship.

so.text: 140. (Xus) markuu u cararay doonnidii buuxday.

ayat.arabic: فَسَاهَمَ فَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُدۡحَضِينَ

en.text: And he drew lots[1302] and was among the losers.
en.footnotes: [1302] To determine who would be cast overboard in order to save the other passengers. Having been overloaded, the ship was on the verge of sinking.

so.text: 141. Marka wuu la qori tuurtay [15], wuxuuse noqday mid laga raayey (baddana lagu tuuray).
so.footnotes: [15]. Si loo cayimo qofka laga tuurayo doonnida si loo badbaadiyo rikaabka kale. Waxaa ku soo baxay qori tuurkii Yuunus c.s., markaasay ku tuureen badda.

ayat.arabic: فَٱلۡتَقَمَهُ ٱلۡحُوتُ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٞ

en.text: Then the fish swallowed him, while he was blameworthy.[1303]
en.footnotes: [1303] For having given up hope on his people prematurely and having left them without permission from Allāh.

so.text: 142. Markaasuu nibirigu liqay isagoo eedeysan [16].
so.footnotes: [16]. Isagoo eedeysan, waayo wuxuu ka quustay dadkiisii ahaa xuma falka, wuxuuna ka soo tagay isagoo aan ka helin idan xagga Alle.

ayat.arabic: فَلَوۡلَآ أَنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُسَبِّحِينَ

en.text: And had he not been of those who exalt Allāh,

so.text: 143. Haddiise ay ahaateen inuu ka mid ahaa kuwa na xurmo weyneeya oo tasbiixsada (ee ehlu salaadka ah).

ayat.arabic: لَلَبِثَ فِي بَطۡنِهِۦٓ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ يُبۡعَثُونَ

en.text: He would have remained inside its belly until the Day they are resurrected.[1304]
en.footnotes: [1304] Meaning that the belly of the fish would have become his grave.

so.text: 144. Wuxuu ku negaan lahaa caloosha (nibriga) tan iyo Maalinta Qiyaamaha.

ayat.arabic: ۞ فَنَبَذۡنَٰهُ بِٱلۡعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ سَقِيمٞ

en.text: But We threw him onto the open shore while he was ill.

so.text: 145. Waxaana ku soo tuurnay bannaan cid la' ah isagoo buka.

ayat.arabic: وَأَنۢبَتۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ شَجَرَةٗ مِّن يَقۡطِينٖ

en.text: And We caused to grow over him a gourd vine.[1305]
en.footnotes: [1305] Which is known to give cooling shade and to be a repellent of flies.

so.text: 146. Waxaana u soo bixinnay geed Aredube ah [17].
so.footnotes: [17]. Maadaamana Nabi Yuunus xeebta lagu soo tuuray isagoo aan dub lahayn. Wuxuu Alle u soo saaaray geedkaasi bocorka (aredube, ubo) si uu u harsiiyo oo uga ilaaliyo cayaayin wax yeela.

ayat.arabic: وَأَرۡسَلۡنَٰهُ إِلَىٰ مِاْئَةِ أَلۡفٍ أَوۡ يَزِيدُونَ

en.text: And We sent him[1306] to [his people of] a hundred thousand or more.
en.footnotes: [1306] i.e., returned him thereafter.

so.text: 147. Waxaana u dirnay Boqol kun ama ka badanba.

ayat.arabic: فَـَٔامَنُواْ فَمَتَّعۡنَٰهُمۡ إِلَىٰ حِينٖ

en.text: And they believed, so We gave them enjoyment [of life] for a time.

so.text: 148. Wayna rumeeyeen; waxaana u raaxeynay ilaa muddo.

ayat.arabic: فَٱسۡتَفۡتِهِمۡ أَلِرَبِّكَ ٱلۡبَنَاتُ وَلَهُمُ ٱلۡبَنُونَ

en.text: So inquire of them, [O Muḥammad], "Does your Lord have daughters while they have sons?[1307]
en.footnotes: [1307] The people of Makkah claimed that the angels were daughters of Allāh, yet they preferred sons for themselves.

so.text: 149. Ee weydii (gaalada) in Rabbigaa gabdho leeyahay, iyaguna wiilal?

ayat.arabic: أَمۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ إِنَٰثٗا وَهُمۡ شَٰهِدُونَ

en.text: Or did We create the angels as females while they were witnesses?"

so.text: 150. Mise ma waxaan abuurnay malaa'igta dheddig ahaan, iyaguna ay goob joog ka ahaayeen?

ayat.arabic: أَلَآ إِنَّهُم مِّنۡ إِفۡكِهِمۡ لَيَقُولُونَ

en.text: Unquestionably, it is out of their [invented] falsehood that they say,

so.text: 151. Ogaada, taasi xaqiiq waa been abuurashadooda inay yidhaahdaan:

ayat.arabic: وَلَدَ ٱللَّهُ وَإِنَّهُمۡ لَكَٰذِبُونَ

en.text: "Allāh has begotten," and indeed, they are liars.

so.text: 152. Allaa ilmo leh, waana beenaalayaal dhabtii.

ayat.arabic: أَصۡطَفَى ٱلۡبَنَاتِ عَلَى ٱلۡبَنِينَ

en.text: Has He chosen daughters over sons?

so.text: 153. Ma wuxuu gabdho ka doortay wiilal?

ayat.arabic: مَا لَكُمۡ كَيۡفَ تَحۡكُمُونَ

en.text: What is [wrong] with you? How do you make judgement?

so.text: 154. Maxaa si idin ka ah, sidee baad wax u xukumeysaan?

ayat.arabic: أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ

en.text: Then will you not be reminded?

so.text: 155. Ee miyeydaan xusuusanayn (inuusan Alle lahayn xaas, wiil, gabdho, kuna habbooneyn inuu yeesho ilmo)?

ayat.arabic: أَمۡ لَكُمۡ سُلۡطَٰنٞ مُّبِينٞ

en.text: Or do you have a clear authority?[1308]
en.footnotes: [1308] i.e., evidence.

so.text: 156.Mise ma waxaad heysataan Xujo Cad?

ayat.arabic: فَأۡتُواْ بِكِتَٰبِكُمۡ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ

en.text: Then produce your scripture, if you should be truthful.

so.text: 157. Ee keena Kitaabkiinna (caddayn) haddaad run sheegaysaan?

ayat.arabic: وَجَعَلُواْ بَيۡنَهُۥ وَبَيۡنَ ٱلۡجِنَّةِ نَسَبٗاۚ وَلَقَدۡ عَلِمَتِ ٱلۡجِنَّةُ إِنَّهُمۡ لَمُحۡضَرُونَ

en.text: And they have made [i.e., claimed] between Him and the jinn a lineage, but the jinn have already known that they [who made such claims] will be brought [to punishment].

so.text: 158. Waxayse yeelaan (qaraabo) nasab Isaga (Alle) iyo malaa’igta dhexdooda, oo dhab ahaan waxay malaa’igtu og yihiin in (kuwa sidaa yidhaahda) la keeni 'cadaabka Naarta' [18].
so.footnotes: [18]. Jin waa khalqi aan Aadmigu arag oo ka qarsoon waana jinka iyo malaa’igta.

ayat.arabic: سُبۡحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ

en.text: Exalted is Allāh above what they describe,

so.text: 159. Xurmo waxaa iska leh Allaah, Wuu ka hufan yahay waxay ku sheegayaan.

ayat.arabic: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡمُخۡلَصِينَ

en.text: Except the chosen servants of Allāh [who do not share in that sin].

so.text: 160. Addoomaha Alle maahee ee daacadda ah u keli yeela cibaadada.

ayat.arabic: فَإِنَّكُمۡ وَمَا تَعۡبُدُونَ

en.text: So indeed, you [disbelievers] and whatever you worship,

so.text: 161. Xaqiiq, idinka iyo waxaad caabudaysaanba (gaaloy).

ayat.arabic: مَآ أَنتُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ بِفَٰتِنِينَ

en.text: You cannot tempt [anyone] away from Him

so.text: 162. Cidna kuma fidnayn kartaan [19].
so.footnotes: [19].Si uu u qaato gaalnimo iyo camallo xun.

ayat.arabic: إِلَّا مَنۡ هُوَ صَالِ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ

en.text: Except he who is to [enter and] burn in the Hellfire.[1309]
en.footnotes: [1309] Due to his disbelief and evil deeds.

so.text: 163. Mid maahee Naarta geli oo ku guban.

ayat.arabic: وَمَا مِنَّآ إِلَّا لَهُۥ مَقَامٞ مَّعۡلُومٞ

en.text: [The angels say],[1310] "There is not among us any except that he has a known position.[1311]
en.footnotes:
[1310] Refuting what the disbelievers had said about them.
[1311] For worship. Or "an assigned task" to perform.

so.text: 164. Ma jiro mid naga mid ah (malaa’igta) aan lahayn meel lagu og yahay [20].
so.footnotes: [20]. Cibaado ahaan, ama ma jiro mid aan lahayn howl la yaqaan uu qabto.

ayat.arabic: وَإِنَّا لَنَحۡنُ ٱلصَّآفُّونَ

en.text: And indeed, we are those who line up [for prayer].

so.text: 165. Waana innaga (malaa’igta ah) xaqiiq kuwa u safta safafka siman.

ayat.arabic: وَإِنَّا لَنَحۡنُ ٱلۡمُسَبِّحُونَ

en.text: And indeed, we are those who exalt Allāh."

so.text: 166. Waana innaga (malaa'igta ah) xaqiiq kuwa xurmo weyneeya oo hufa 'Alle' [21].
so.footnotes: [21]. Iyagoo beeninaya waxay gaalada ka sheegaan Alle inuu leeyahay wiil ama gabdho ama shariigyo.

ayat.arabic: وَإِن كَانُواْ لَيَقُولُونَ

en.text: And indeed, they [i.e., the disbelievers] used to say,[1312]
en.footnotes: [1312] Before the revelation of the Qur’ān.

so.text: 167. Waxayna (gaaladu) odhan jireen:

ayat.arabic: لَوۡ أَنَّ عِندَنَا ذِكۡرٗا مِّنَ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ

en.text: "If we had a message from [those of] the former peoples,

so.text: 168. Hadduu yahay agtannada xuskii (warkii) kuwii hore 'Kitaab' [22] .
so.footnotes: [22]. Ka hor soo waxyoodka Qur’aanka.

ayat.arabic: لَكُنَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡمُخۡلَصِينَ

en.text: We would have been the chosen servants of Allāh."

so.text: 169. Waxaan ahaan laheyn addoomaha Alle ee daacadda ah u keli yeela cibaadada.

ayat.arabic: فَكَفَرُواْ بِهِۦۖ فَسَوۡفَ يَعۡلَمُونَ

en.text: But they disbelieved in it,[1313] so they are going to know.
en.footnotes: [1313] i.e., in their own message, the Qur’ān.

so.text: 170. Wayse ku gaaloobaan 'haatan' [23], marka way ogaan doonaan.
so.footnotes: [23]. Dhambaalka iyaga loo soo diray, Qur’aanka.

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ سَبَقَتۡ كَلِمَتُنَا لِعِبَادِنَا ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ

en.text: And Our word [i.e., decree] has already preceded for Our servants, the messengers,

so.text: 171. Waxaa dhab ahaan ugu hormaray Kelmaddayada (Yaboohayaga) addoomahayaga Rususha ah.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّهُمۡ لَهُمُ ٱلۡمَنصُورُونَ

en.text: [That] indeed, they would be those given victory

so.text: 172. Inay yihiin kuwa xaqiiq loo gargaari.

ayat.arabic: وَإِنَّ جُندَنَا لَهُمُ ٱلۡغَٰلِبُونَ

en.text: And [that] indeed, Our soldiers [i.e., the believers] will be those who overcome.[1314]
en.footnotes: [1314] If not in this world, then definitely in the Hereafter.

so.text: 173. Iyo in ciidammadayadu ay yihiin xaqiiq kuwa adkaan.

ayat.arabic: فَتَوَلَّ عَنۡهُمۡ حَتَّىٰ حِينٖ

en.text: So, [O Muḥammad], leave them for a time.

so.text: 174. Ee isaga jeeso ilaa muddo,

ayat.arabic: وَأَبۡصِرۡهُمۡ فَسَوۡفَ يُبۡصِرُونَ

en.text: And see [what will befall] them, for they are going to see.

so.text: 175. Aragna (waxa ku dhaca), iyaguna sidoo kale way arki.

ayat.arabic: أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسۡتَعۡجِلُونَ

en.text: Then for Our punishment are they impatient?

so.text: 176. Ma Cadaabkanaga bay (gaaladu) degdegsanayaan?

ayat.arabic: فَإِذَا نَزَلَ بِسَاحَتِهِمۡ فَسَآءَ صَبَاحُ ٱلۡمُنذَرِينَ

en.text: But when it descends in their territory, then evil is the morning of those who were warned.

so.text: 177. Markase uu ku soo dego ardaagooda, waxaa xumaan subaxa kuwa loo digay.

ayat.arabic: وَتَوَلَّ عَنۡهُمۡ حَتَّىٰ حِينٖ

en.text: And leave them for a time.

so.text: 178. Ee isaga jeeso iyaga ilaa muddo.

ayat.arabic: وَأَبۡصِرۡ فَسَوۡفَ يُبۡصِرُونَ

en.text: And see, for they are going to see.

so.text: 179. Aragna (waxa ku dhaca), iyaguna sidoo kale way arki.

ayat.arabic: سُبۡحَٰنَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ ٱلۡعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ

en.text: Exalted is your Lord, the Lord of might, above what they describe.

so.text: 180. Xurmo oo dhan waxaa iska leh oo (xumaan ka) hufan Rabbigaa (Allaah), Rabbiga Sharafta leh, ka sarreeya waxay (gaaladu) ku tilmaamaan (sida inuu leeyahay wiil, gabdho, xaas, iwm).

ayat.arabic: وَسَلَٰمٌ عَلَى ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ

en.text: And peace upon the messengers.

so.text: 181. Nabadi korkooda ha ahaato Rususha (Alle).

ayat.arabic: وَٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

en.text: And praise to Allāh, Lord of the worlds.

so.text: 182. Ammaan oo dhan iyo mahad waxaa leh Allaah, Rabbiga uumanka.

ayat.arabic: صٓۚ وَٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ ذِي ٱلذِّكۡرِ

en.text: Ṣād.[1316] By the Qur’ān containing reminder...[1317]
en.footnotes:
[1316] See footnote to 2:1.
[1317] The completion of the oath is understood to be that the Qur’ān is inimitable and thus a miracle from Allāh.

so.text: 1. Saad [1], Waxaan (waa Alle'e) ku dhaartay Qur’aanka sharafta leh ee waanada badan [2].
so.footnotes:
[1]. Eeg sharaxa hoose ee Suuradda 2 Al-Baqarah: Aayadda 1.
[2]. Inta hadalka ka go’an waa inaysan jirin ilaahyo badan balse uu Ilaaha Xaqa yahay Mid Keliya - Allaah iyo in soo bixinta Qiyaame Xaq tahay.

ayat.arabic: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فِي عِزَّةٖ وَشِقَاقٖ

en.text: But those who disbelieve are in pride and dissension.

so.text: 2. Kuwase gaalada ahi waxay ku sugan yihiin qabwayni iyo collaytan (xaq diiddo).

ayat.arabic: كَمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَا مِن قَبۡلِهِم مِّن قَرۡنٖ فَنَادَواْ وَّلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصٖ

en.text: How many a generation have We destroyed before them, and they [then] called out; but it was not a time for escape.

so.text: 3. Badanaa intaan halaagnay hortood facyo (Xaqa beeniyey), markaasay calaacaleen (oo tawbad keeneen) goor calaalal (tawbad keen la aqbalayn), lagana baxsan karin (Cadaabka Alle).

ayat.arabic: وَعَجِبُوٓاْ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٞ مِّنۡهُمۡۖ وَقَالَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا سَٰحِرٞ كَذَّابٌ

en.text: And they wonder that there has come to them a warner [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ)] from among themselves. And the disbelievers say, "This is a magician and a liar.

so.text: 4. Waxay la yaabeen inuu u yimid dige ka mid ah (Nabi Muxammad). Waxay gaaladu yidhaahdeen: Kanu waa saaxir, beenaale.

ayat.arabic: أَجَعَلَ ٱلۡأٓلِهَةَ إِلَٰهٗا وَٰحِدًاۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَيۡءٌ عُجَابٞ

en.text: Has he made the gods [only] one God? Indeed, this is a curious thing."

so.text: 5. Ma wuxuu ka dhigay ilaahyadii Ilaah Keliya? Waxakani waa wax la yaab leh.

ayat.arabic: وَٱنطَلَقَ ٱلۡمَلَأُ مِنۡهُمۡ أَنِ ٱمۡشُواْ وَٱصۡبِرُواْ عَلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِكُمۡۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَيۡءٞ يُرَادُ

en.text: And the eminent among them went forth, [saying], "Continue, and be patient over [the defense of] your gods. Indeed, this is a thing intended.[1318]
en.footnotes: [1318] Planned by Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ) in order to gain influence and prestige for himself.

so.text: 6. Odayaashii ka mid ahaana way soo baxeen (iyagoo ku leh dadkoodii): Socda, oo ku samra oo sugnaada ilaahyadiinna. (arrin)kani waa wax laynala dooni [3].
so.footnotes: [3]. Uu isku soo dubbariday Muxammad si uu idiin qabsado oo magac iyo sharaf ugu qaato.

ayat.arabic: مَا سَمِعۡنَا بِهَٰذَا فِي ٱلۡمِلَّةِ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ إِنۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا ٱخۡتِلَٰقٌ

en.text: We have not heard of this in the latest religion.[1319] This is not but a fabrication.
en.footnotes: [1319] Referring to Christianity or possibly the pagan religion of the Quraysh.

so.text: 7. Weligayo kuma aanu maqal (arrin)kan oo kale diintii kale [4]. (Arrin)kani ma aha waxaan aheyn been abuur.
so.footnotes: [4]. Waxay ugala jeedaan diintii kale diinta Nasaarada ama diintii shirkiga oo ay Quraysh heysatay.

ayat.arabic: أَءُنزِلَ عَلَيۡهِ ٱلذِّكۡرُ مِنۢ بَيۡنِنَاۚ بَلۡ هُمۡ فِي شَكّٖ مِّن ذِكۡرِيۚ بَل لَّمَّا يَذُوقُواْ عَذَابِ

en.text: Has the message been revealed to him out of [all of] us?" Rather, they are in doubt about My message. Rather, they have not yet tasted My punishment.

so.text:
8. Ma waxaa lagu soo dejiyey Qur’aanka isagoo (Muxammad) na dhex jooga? 
Mayee waxay ka shakisan yihiin Waanadeyda. Mayee, wali ma aysan dhadhamin Cadaabkayga.

ayat.arabic: أَمۡ عِندَهُمۡ خَزَآئِنُ رَحۡمَةِ رَبِّكَ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡوَهَّابِ

en.text: Or do they have the depositories of the mercy of your Lord, the Exalted in Might, the Bestower?[1320]
en.footnotes: [1320] Refer to footnote of verse 3:8.

so.text: 9. Mise ma waxay hayaan khasnadaha Naxariista Rabbigaa, Adkaadaha Sare, Deeqsiga ah aad wax u bixiya?

ayat.arabic: أَمۡ لَهُم مُّلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَاۖ فَلۡيَرۡتَقُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَسۡبَٰبِ

en.text: Or is theirs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and what is between them? Then let them ascend through [any] ways of access.[1321]
en.footnotes: [1321] To oversee the affairs of their dominion.

so.text: 10. Mise ma waxay leeyihiin Mulkiga (iyo maamulka) cirarka iyo dhulka iyo waxa u dhexeeya? Ee ha u koreen salaanno xagga 'samada hadday karaan' [5].
so.footnotes: [5]. Si ay ugu soo dejiyaan waxyiga kay doonaan. Waa dhaleeceyn iyo caajiz gelin.

ayat.arabic: جُندٞ مَّا هُنَالِكَ مَهۡزُومٞ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَحۡزَابِ

en.text: [They are but] soldiers [who will be] defeated there among the companies [of disbelievers].

so.text: 11. Ciidanka halkaas jooga (gaalada) waa xisbiyo [6] la jabin (lagana adkaan).
so.footnotes: [6]. Aayaddanina waxay tilmaameysaa dagaalkii Godka (Al-Axzaab) labadaba waa loo yaqaan. Mufasiriinta qaarna waxay yidhaahdeen waxay tilmaameysaa dagaalkii Badar.

ayat.arabic: كَذَّبَتۡ قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمُ نُوحٖ وَعَادٞ وَفِرۡعَوۡنُ ذُو ٱلۡأَوۡتَادِ

en.text: The people of Noah denied before them, and [the tribe of] ʿAad and Pharaoh, the owner of stakes,[1322]
en.footnotes: [1322] By which he tortured people.

so.text: 12. Waxaa beeniyey (Rususha) iyaga hortood qoladii Nuux, Caad iyo Fircoon ee lahaa boqortooyo xoog leh [7].
so.footnotes: [7]. Dhismooyin dhaadheer iyo ciidammo tiro badan iyo tiirar uu dadka geeyo ciqaab ahaan.

ayat.arabic: وَثَمُودُ وَقَوۡمُ لُوطٖ وَأَصۡحَٰبُ لۡـَٔيۡكَةِۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلۡأَحۡزَابُ

en.text: And [the tribe of] Thamūd and the people of Lot and the companions of the thicket [i.e., people of Madyan]. Those are the companies.[1323]
en.footnotes: [1323] That were defeated, among whom will be the disbelievers of Quraysh and others.

so.text: 13. Iyo Thamuud iyo qoladii Luud, iyo reer howdkii (loo diray Nabi Shucayb), kuwaa bay ahaayeen xisbiyada.

ayat.arabic: إِن كُلٌّ إِلَّا كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقَابِ

en.text: Each of them denied the messengers, so My penalty was justified.

so.text: 14. Ma jiro mid iyaga ka mid ah oo aan beenin Rususha, Markaasay xaq noqotay cadaabi inay ku dhacdo.

ayat.arabic: وَمَا يَنظُرُ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِلَّا صَيۡحَةٗ وَٰحِدَةٗ مَّا لَهَا مِن فَوَاقٖ

en.text: And these [disbelievers] await not but one blast [of the Horn]; for it there will be no delay.[1324]
en.footnotes: [1324] Or "respite." More literally, "a period between two milkings of a she-camel," which also alludes to the meanings of "return" or "repetition."

so.text: 15. Kuwaana (gaaladani) ma sugayaan waxaan aheyn hal Qeylo aanan daah lahayn iyo dib u dhac midna [8].
so.footnotes: [8]. Ama fursad. Erey ahaan macnaha xiskin waa waqti u dhexeeya labada lisitaan ee caanaha hasha. Dhawaaqaas waa calaamo Qiyaamaha.

ayat.arabic: وَقَالُواْ رَبَّنَا عَجِّل لَّنَا قِطَّنَا قَبۡلَ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡحِسَابِ

en.text: And they say, "Our Lord, hasten for us our share [of the punishment] before the Day of Account."

so.text: 16. Waxayna yidhaahdeen: Rabbigayow! Noo soo dedeji saamigayaga (ciqaabka ) ka hor Maalinta Xisaabta (Qiyaamada).

ayat.arabic: ٱصۡبِرۡ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱذۡكُرۡ عَبۡدَنَا دَاوُۥدَ ذَا ٱلۡأَيۡدِۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ

en.text: Be patient over what they say and remember Our servant, David, the possessor of strength; indeed, he was one who repeatedly turned back [to Allāh].

so.text: 17. U samir (adkeyso) waxay leeyihiin, xusuusona addoonkayaga Daawuud, ee xoogga iyo kartida lahaa. Wuxuu ahaa mid (Alle) u soo noqda, tawbad keen badan .

ayat.arabic: إِنَّا سَخَّرۡنَا ٱلۡجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحۡنَ بِٱلۡعَشِيِّ وَٱلۡإِشۡرَاقِ

en.text: Indeed, We subjected the mountains [to praise] with him, exalting [Allāh] in the [late] afternoon and [after] sunrise.

so.text: 18. Waxaanu u sakhirnay buuraha inay kula tasbiixsadaan (Alle) ammaan iyo mahdin galab dhaca iyo qorrax soo baxaba.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلطَّيۡرَ مَحۡشُورَةٗۖ كُلّٞ لَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٞ

en.text: And the birds were assembled, all with him repeating [praises].

so.text: 19. Iyo shimbiraha la soo kulunshay wada jir, dhammaan la qaadaan 'Alle' ammaanka.

ayat.arabic: وَشَدَدۡنَا مُلۡكَهُۥ وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُ ٱلۡحِكۡمَةَ وَفَصۡلَ ٱلۡخِطَابِ

en.text: And We strengthened his kingdom and gave him wisdom and discernment in speech.

so.text: 20. Waana adkaynay boqortooyadiisa, Waxaanuna siinnay Xikmad (Nabinnimo) iyo garsoor wanaagsan.

ayat.arabic: ۞ وَهَلۡ أَتَىٰكَ نَبَؤُاْ ٱلۡخَصۡمِ إِذۡ تَسَوَّرُواْ ٱلۡمِحۡرَابَ

en.text: And has there come to you the news of the adversaries, when they climbed over the wall of [his] prayer chamber -

so.text: 21. Ma ku soo gaaray warka dood qabayaa- shii, markay Mixraabka ugu soo dhaceen.

ayat.arabic: إِذۡ دَخَلُواْ عَلَىٰ دَاوُۥدَ فَفَزِعَ مِنۡهُمۡۖ قَالُواْ لَا تَخَفۡۖ خَصۡمَانِ بَغَىٰ بَعۡضُنَا عَلَىٰ بَعۡضٖ فَٱحۡكُم بَيۡنَنَا بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَلَا تُشۡطِطۡ وَٱهۡدِنَآ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ

en.text: When they entered upon David and he was alarmed by them? They said, "Fear not. [We are] two adversaries, one of whom has wronged the other, so judge between us with truth and do not exceed [it] and guide us to the sound path.

so.text: 22. U soo galeen Daawuud, markaasuu (is)ku naxay; waxay yidhaahdeen: Ha cabsan! (waxaanu nahay) labo dood qabta, uu midkayo ku gardarrooday midka kale, sidaa darteed noogu kala garsoor si caddaalad ah, iskana jir gar eexo, oo nagu hanuuni jidka toosan (xaqa).

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَآ أَخِي لَهُۥ تِسۡعٞ وَتِسۡعُونَ نَعۡجَةٗ وَلِيَ نَعۡجَةٞ وَٰحِدَةٞ فَقَالَ أَكۡفِلۡنِيهَا وَعَزَّنِي فِي ٱلۡخِطَابِ

en.text: Indeed this, my brother, has ninety-nine ewes, and I have one ewe; so he said, 'Entrust her to me,' and he overpowered me in speech."

so.text: 23. Kani waa walaalkay; wuxuu leeyahay sagaal iyo sagaashan ido ah, halkaan anigu leeyahay lax keliya. Wuxuuna yidhi: i sii iyadana, waana iga dood adkaaday.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ لَقَدۡ ظَلَمَكَ بِسُؤَالِ نَعۡجَتِكَ إِلَىٰ نِعَاجِهِۦۖ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرٗا مِّنَ ٱلۡخُلَطَآءِ لَيَبۡغِي بَعۡضُهُمۡ عَلَىٰ بَعۡضٍ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَقَلِيلٞ مَّا هُمۡۗ وَظَنَّ دَاوُۥدُ أَنَّمَا فَتَنَّٰهُ فَٱسۡتَغۡفَرَ رَبَّهُۥ وَخَرَّۤ رَاكِعٗاۤ وَأَنَابَ۩

en.text: [David] said, "He has certainly wronged you in demanding your ewe [in addition] to his ewes. And indeed, many associates oppress one another, except for those who believe and do righteous deeds - and few are they." And David became certain that We had tried him, and he asked forgiveness of his Lord[1325] and fell down bowing [in prostration] and turned in repentance [to Allāh].
en.footnotes: [1325] For his errors, such as fear and suspicion of the two men at the outset, any mistake in judgement he might have made, concealed feelings of partiality, etc.

so.text: 24. (Daawuud) wuxuu yidhi: Waa uu kugu dulmiyey ku weydiisigiisa laxdaada si uu ugu darsado idahiisa. In badanna oo kuwa wax isku darsada ahi way isku xadgudbaan qaarkoodba qaarka kale, kuwa (Xaqa) rumeeyey oo samaha fala mooyee, aad bayna u yar yihiin kuwaasu. Wuxuu Daawuud gartay inaan imtixaannay, markaasuu ka dalbay Denbi Dhaaf Rabbigi oo la dhacay rukuuc (sujuud), una soo noqday 'Alle" [9] isagoo tawbad keen ah.
so.footnotes: [9]. Hadday ka dhaceen wax khalad ah xagga u kala garsoorka dadka, iwm.

ayat.arabic: فَغَفَرۡنَا لَهُۥ ذَٰلِكَۖ وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلۡفَىٰ وَحُسۡنَ مَـَٔابٖ

en.text: So We forgave him that; and indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a good place of return.

so.text: 25.Markaasaan u denbi dhaafnay, wuxuuna Agtayada ku leeyahay dhowaansho iyo meel noqod wanaagsan (Aakhirada).

ayat.arabic: يَٰدَاوُۥدُ إِنَّا جَعَلۡنَٰكَ خَلِيفَةٗ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَٱحۡكُم بَيۡنَ ٱلنَّاسِ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَلَا تَتَّبِعِ ٱلۡهَوَىٰ فَيُضِلَّكَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَضِلُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٞ شَدِيدُۢ بِمَا نَسُواْ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡحِسَابِ

en.text: [We said], "O David, indeed We have made you a successor upon the earth, so judge between the people in truth and do not follow [your own] desire, as it will lead you astray from the way of Allāh." Indeed, those who go astray from the way of Allāh will have a severe punishment for having forgotten the Day of Account.

so.text: 26. Daawuudow! Waxaan kaaga dhignay taliye dhulka, ee ku kala xukun dadka si xaq ah, hana raacin hawadaada - si ayan kaaga lumin Jidka Alle (Islaamka). Kuwa ka luma Jidka Alle waxay leeyihiin cadaab daran, illowgooda Maalinta Xisaabta (Qiyaamada) darteed.

ayat.arabic: وَمَا خَلَقۡنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا بَٰطِلٗاۚ ذَٰلِكَ ظَنُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْۚ فَوَيۡلٞ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ

en.text: And We did not create the heaven and the earth and that between them aimlessly. That is the assumption of those who disbelieve, so woe to those who disbelieve from the Fire.

so.text: 27. Uma aanu abuurin samooyinka iyo arlada iyo waxa u dhexeeya ujeeddo la’aan. Sidaasu waa malaha gaalada. Ee hoog baa u sugnaaday gaalada xagga Naarta ah.

ayat.arabic: أَمۡ نَجۡعَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ كَٱلۡمُفۡسِدِينَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ أَمۡ نَجۡعَلُ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ كَٱلۡفُجَّارِ

en.text: Or should We treat those who believe and do righteous deeds like corrupters in the land? Or should We treat those who fear Allāh like the wicked?

so.text: 28. Mise ma waxaanu la mid yeeli kuwa (Xaqa) rumeeyey oo samaha fala sida kuwa ku fala fasahaad arlada? mise ma waxaanu la mid yeeli kuwa iska jira xumaha sida faajiriinta?

ayat.arabic: كِتَٰبٌ أَنزَلۡنَٰهُ إِلَيۡكَ مُبَٰرَكٞ لِّيَدَّبَّرُوٓاْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ وَلِيَتَذَكَّرَ أُوْلُواْ ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ

en.text: [This is] a blessed Book which We have revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], that they might reflect upon its verses and that those of understanding would be reminded.

so.text: 29. (Kani Qur'aanku) waa Kitaab aan kugu soo dejinnay (Nabiyow) barako badan si ay uga fiirsadaan Aayadihiisa oo wax garadku ugu waantoobaan.

ayat.arabic: وَوَهَبۡنَا لِدَاوُۥدَ سُلَيۡمَٰنَۚ نِعۡمَ ٱلۡعَبۡدُ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ

en.text: And to David We gave Solomon. An excellent servant, indeed he was one repeatedly turning back [to Allāh].

so.text: 30. Waxaan Daawuud siinnay Sulaymaan. Wacanaa addoonku. Wuxuu ahaa mid Alle u soo noqda (oo tawbad keen badan).

ayat.arabic: إِذۡ عُرِضَ عَلَيۡهِ بِٱلۡعَشِيِّ ٱلصَّٰفِنَٰتُ ٱلۡجِيَادُ

en.text: [Mention] when there were exhibited before him in the afternoon the poised [standing] racehorses.

so.text: 31. (Xus) marka loo soo bandhigay goor galab ah (fardo) sugan markay taagan yihiin, dheereeya markay ordayaan -

ayat.arabic: فَقَالَ إِنِّيٓ أَحۡبَبۡتُ حُبَّ ٱلۡخَيۡرِ عَن ذِكۡرِ رَبِّي حَتَّىٰ تَوَارَتۡ بِٱلۡحِجَابِ

en.text: And he said, "Indeed, I gave preference to the love of good [things] over the remembrance of my Lord until it [i.e., the sun] disappeared into the curtain [of darkness]."

so.text: 32. Markaasuu wuxuu yidhi: Ma waxaan ka door biday maal adduunyo xuska Rabbigay ilaa ay dhacday qorraxdii.

ayat.arabic: رُدُّوهَا عَلَيَّۖ فَطَفِقَ مَسۡحَۢا بِٱلسُّوقِ وَٱلۡأَعۡنَاقِ

en.text: [He said], "Return them to me," and set about striking[1326] [their] legs and necks.
en.footnotes: [1326] With his sword as expiation. Some commentaries have also suggested the meaning of "stroking" with the hand.

so.text: 33. Ii soo celiya, markaasuu wuxuu billaabay inuu ka masaxo addimmada iyo luqumahooda [10].
so.footnotes: [10]. Mufasiriinta qaarkood waxay ku fasireen inuu u gowracay Alle darti u dhowaansho Xaggiisa.

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ فَتَنَّا سُلَيۡمَٰنَ وَأَلۡقَيۡنَا عَلَىٰ كُرۡسِيِّهِۦ جَسَدٗا ثُمَّ أَنَابَ

en.text: And We certainly tried Solomon and placed on his throne a body;[1327] then he returned.[1328]
en.footnotes:
[1327] Said to be a devil or a lifeless body (one without capability), but Allāh alone knows.
[1328] To sovereignty and to Allāh in repentance.

so.text: 34. Waxaanu dhab ahaan imtixaannay Sulaymaan, oo ku tuurnay kursigiisii oogo, markaasuu 'u' soo laabtay 'Alle' [11].
so.footnotes: [11]. Wuxuu u soo laabtay Alle isagoo tawbad keen ah.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱغۡفِرۡ لِي وَهَبۡ لِي مُلۡكٗا لَّا يَنۢبَغِي لِأَحَدٖ مِّنۢ بَعۡدِيٓۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلۡوَهَّابُ

en.text: He said, "My Lord, forgive me and grant me a kingdom such as will not belong to anyone after me. Indeed, You are the Bestower."

so.text: 35. Wuxuu yidhi : Rabbiyow! Ii Denbi dhaaf oo i sii boqortooyo aan ku habbooneyn (inuu dhaxlo) cid iga dambeysa. Adigaa Bixin Badane ahe.

ayat.arabic: فَسَخَّرۡنَا لَهُ ٱلرِّيحَ تَجۡرِي بِأَمۡرِهِۦ رُخَآءً حَيۡثُ أَصَابَ

en.text: So We subjected to him the wind blowing by his command, gently, wherever he directed,

so.text: 36. Markaasaan u sakhirnay dabeysha, oo ku soconeysey amarkiisa iyadoo nugul meeshuu doonaba,

ayat.arabic: وَٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ كُلَّ بَنَّآءٖ وَغَوَّاصٖ

en.text: And [also] the devils [of jinn] - every builder and diver

so.text: 37. Iyo shaydaammada, mid walboo wax dhisa iyo mid quusa.

ayat.arabic: وَءَاخَرِينَ مُقَرَّنِينَ فِي ٱلۡأَصۡفَادِ

en.text: And others bound together in irons.

so.text: 38. Iyo kuwo kaloo ku xirxiran silsilado.

ayat.arabic: هَٰذَا عَطَآؤُنَا فَٱمۡنُنۡ أَوۡ أَمۡسِكۡ بِغَيۡرِ حِسَابٖ

en.text: [We said], "This is Our gift, so grant or withhold without account."

so.text: 39. Kani waa siismadeenna ee bixi waxaad doonto ama hayso xisaab la’aan.

ayat.arabic: وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلۡفَىٰ وَحُسۡنَ مَـَٔابٖ

en.text: And indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a good place of return.

so.text: 40. Wuxuu (Sulaymaan) ku leeyahay Agtayada dhowaansho iyo meel noqod wanaagsan (Janno).

ayat.arabic: وَٱذۡكُرۡ عَبۡدَنَآ أَيُّوبَ إِذۡ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ بِنُصۡبٖ وَعَذَابٍ

en.text: And remember Our servant Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, Satan has touched me with hardship and torment."

so.text: 41. Xus addoonkayaga Ayyuub, markuu u dhawaaqay (baryey) Rabbigi (isagoo leh): Wuxuu Shaydaan igu taabtay dhib iyo xanuun [12].
so.footnotes: [12]. Waxaa lagu imtixaanay Nabi Ayyuub c.s. jirro halis ah oo oogada ah muddo aad u dheer. Markaasuu Alle baryey inuu caafiyo, markaasuu reystey.

ayat.arabic: ٱرۡكُضۡ بِرِجۡلِكَۖ هَٰذَا مُغۡتَسَلُۢ بَارِدٞ وَشَرَابٞ

en.text: [So he was told], "Strike [the ground] with your foot; this is a [spring for a] cool bath and drink."

so.text: 42. (Waxaanu ku nidhi): Ku garaac (dhulka) lugtaada; tani (waa il leh) meyrasho qabow iyo cabbitaan.

ayat.arabic: وَوَهَبۡنَا لَهُۥٓ أَهۡلَهُۥ وَمِثۡلَهُم مَّعَهُمۡ رَحۡمَةٗ مِّنَّا وَذِكۡرَىٰ لِأُوْلِي ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ

en.text: And We granted him his family and a like [number] with them as mercy from Us and a reminder for those of understanding.

so.text: 43. Waxaanu siinnay ehelkii uu beelay, iyo kuwo la mid ah oo la jira, Naxariis Xaggayaga ah, waanona u ah wax garadka.

ayat.arabic: وَخُذۡ بِيَدِكَ ضِغۡثٗا فَٱضۡرِب بِّهِۦ وَلَا تَحۡنَثۡۗ إِنَّا وَجَدۡنَٰهُ صَابِرٗاۚ نِّعۡمَ ٱلۡعَبۡدُ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٞ

en.text: [We said], "And take in your hand a bunch [of grass] and strike with it and do not break your oath."[1329] Indeed, We found him patient, an excellent servant. Indeed, he was one repeatedly turning back [to Allāh].
en.footnotes: [1329] At a point during his illness, Job became angry with his wife and swore that if he recovered, he would punish her with one hundred lashes. According to Allāh's instruction, the oath was fulfilled by striking her once with one hundred blades of grass.

so.text: 44. (Waxaanu nidhi): Ku qaad gacantaada xirmo dhangado yar yar ah oo ku dhufo hal mar oo ha jabin dhaartaada [13]; waxaanu hellay inuu yahay samir badne. Wacanaa addoonku, wuxuu ahaa mid (Ilaahay) u soo noqda (oo tawbad keen badan).
so.footnotes: [13]. Mar ay xaaskiisa muujisay samir yari, wuxuu ku dhaartay Ayuub inuu garaacayo hadduu reysto. Alle wuxuu amray inuu kaga dhabeeyo dhaartiisa oo hal mar ku dhufto boqol dhangadood oo yar yar oo isku duuban.

ayat.arabic: وَٱذۡكُرۡ عِبَٰدَنَآ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسۡحَٰقَ وَيَعۡقُوبَ أُوْلِي ٱلۡأَيۡدِي وَٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرِ

en.text: And remember Our servants, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob - those of strength and [religious] vision.

so.text: 45. Xus addoomahayaga Ibraahiim iyo Isxaaq iyo Yacquub, ee ku xoog badnaa (daacada Alle) kuna arag dheeraa (diinta).

ayat.arabic: إِنَّآ أَخۡلَصۡنَٰهُم بِخَالِصَةٖ ذِكۡرَى ٱلدَّارِ

en.text: Indeed, We chose them for an exclusive quality: remembrance of the home [of the Hereafter].

so.text: 46. Waxaanu xaqiiq ku gaar yeelnay tilmaan wanaagsan xusuusnaanta Daarta (Aakhiro).

ayat.arabic: وَإِنَّهُمۡ عِندَنَا لَمِنَ ٱلۡمُصۡطَفَيۡنَ ٱلۡأَخۡيَارِ

en.text: And indeed they are, to Us, among the chosen and outstanding.

so.text: 47. Waxayna xaqiiq iyagu ka mid yihiin agtannada xulka akhyaarta ah.

ayat.arabic: وَٱذۡكُرۡ إِسۡمَٰعِيلَ وَٱلۡيَسَعَ وَذَا ٱلۡكِفۡلِۖ وَكُلّٞ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَخۡيَارِ

en.text: And remember Ishmael, Elisha and Dhul-Kifl, and all are among the outstanding.

so.text: 48. Oo xus Ismaaciil iyo Al-Yasac iyo Dul-Kifil, dhammaan waxay ka mid yihiin akhyaarta.

ayat.arabic: هَٰذَا ذِكۡرٞۚ وَإِنَّ لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ لَحُسۡنَ مَـَٔابٖ

en.text: This is a reminder. And indeed, for the righteous is a good place of return -

so.text: 49. Kani (Qur'aanku) waa waano (sharaf iyo darajo), waxayna leeyihiin kuwa iska jira (xumaha) meeqaan iyo meel noqod san.

ayat.arabic: جَنَّٰتِ عَدۡنٖ مُّفَتَّحَةٗ لَّهُمُ ٱلۡأَبۡوَٰبُ

en.text: Gardens of perpetual residence, whose doors will be opened to them.

so.text: 50. Jannada cadni (beero negaan) loo furay Albaabadooda.

ayat.arabic: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا يَدۡعُونَ فِيهَا بِفَٰكِهَةٖ كَثِيرَةٖ وَشَرَابٖ

en.text: Reclining within them, they will call therein for abundant fruit and drink.

so.text: 51. Waxay ku dangiigsan dhexdeeda (sariiro) korreeya iyagoo u yeedhan midho tiro badan iyo cabbitaan (macaan).

ayat.arabic: ۞ وَعِندَهُمۡ قَٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرۡفِ أَتۡرَابٌ

en.text: And with them will be women limiting [their] glances[1330] and of equal age.
en.footnotes: [1330] To their mates alone.

so.text: 52. Waxaana la jirkood ahaan haween dhowrsoon, ku kooba araggooda (nimankooda), oo isku fil (da' ah).

ayat.arabic: هَٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِيَوۡمِ ٱلۡحِسَابِ

en.text: This is what you, [the righteous], are promised for the Day of Account.

so.text: 53. Kani waa waxa la idiin yaboohay Maalinta Xisaabta (Qiyaamada).

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَرِزۡقُنَا مَا لَهُۥ مِن نَّفَادٍ

en.text: Indeed, this is Our provision; for it there is no depletion.

so.text: 54.Kani (barwaaqada iyo baraarahan) waa risiqayaga (la idiin yaboohay Qiyaamada) aan dhammaaneyn weligii.

ayat.arabic: هَٰذَاۚ وَإِنَّ لِلطَّٰغِينَ لَشَرَّ مَـَٔابٖ

en.text: This [is so]. But indeed, for the transgressors is an evil place of return -

so.text: 55. Waa sidaase! Xadgudbayaashana waxaa xaqiiq sugaya rug laabasho xun.

ayat.arabic: جَهَنَّمَ يَصۡلَوۡنَهَا فَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡمِهَادُ

en.text: Hell, which they will [enter to] burn, and wretched is the resting place.

so.text: 56. Jahannama yay geli oo ku guban, oo ugu xun gogol la dhinac dhigo.

ayat.arabic: هَٰذَا فَلۡيَذُوقُوهُ حَمِيمٞ وَغَسَّاقٞ

en.text: This - so let them taste it - is scalding water and [foul] purulence.

so.text: 57. Waa sidaase! Ee ha dhadhamiyeen, biyo kulul oo karkaraya iyo malax qurmuun.

ayat.arabic: وَءَاخَرُ مِن شَكۡلِهِۦٓ أَزۡوَٰجٌ

en.text: And other [punishments] of its type [in various] kinds.

so.text: 58. Iyo (cadaab) kaloo la cayn ah oo noocyo kala duwan ah.

ayat.arabic: هَٰذَا فَوۡجٞ مُّقۡتَحِمٞ مَّعَكُمۡ لَا مَرۡحَبَۢا بِهِمۡۚ إِنَّهُمۡ صَالُواْ ٱلنَّارِ

en.text: [Its inhabitants will say], "This is a company bursting in with you. No welcome for them. Indeed, they will burn in the Fire."

so.text: 59. Kani waa guuto idinla soo gali Naarta. Ma jirto iyagu soo dhoweyn ay leeyihiin! Hubaal, waxay ku guban oo gamaari Naarta.

ayat.arabic: قَالُواْ بَلۡ أَنتُمۡ لَا مَرۡحَبَۢا بِكُمۡۖ أَنتُمۡ قَدَّمۡتُمُوهُ لَنَاۖ فَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡقَرَارُ

en.text: They will say, "Nor you! No welcome for you. You, [our leaders], brought this upon us, and wretched is the settlement."

so.text: 60. Waxay ku odhan (madaxdoodii): Balse idinka ma jirto soo dhoweyn aad leedihiin! Idinkaa noo keenay 'cadaabkan'. Ee u xumaa halkan meel la degaa.

ayat.arabic: قَالُواْ رَبَّنَا مَن قَدَّمَ لَنَا هَٰذَا فَزِدۡهُ عَذَابٗا ضِعۡفٗا فِي ٱلنَّارِ

en.text: They will say, "Our Lord, whoever brought this upon us - increase for him double punishment in the Fire."

so.text: 61. Waxay (raciyadii) odhan: Rabbigayow! Kii noo horseeday waxakani u kordhi cadaab laban laab ah Naarta gudaheeda.

ayat.arabic: وَقَالُواْ مَا لَنَا لَا نَرَىٰ رِجَالٗا كُنَّا نَعُدُّهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَشۡرَارِ

en.text: And they will say, "Why do we not see men whom we used to count among the worst?[1331]
en.footnotes: [1331] They are referring to the believers.

so.text: 62. Waxayna (madaxdii) odhan: Maxaanu u arki la'nahay niman aanu ku tirin jirnay ehlu sharka [14]?
so.footnotes: [14]. Waxay ula jeedaan mu’miniinta.

ayat.arabic: أَتَّخَذۡنَٰهُمۡ سِخۡرِيًّا أَمۡ زَاغَتۡ عَنۡهُمُ ٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرُ

en.text: Is it [because] we took them in ridicule, or has [our] vision turned away from them?"

so.text: 63. Miyaan ku diganaynay (oo waan qaldaneyn), mise indhahayagaa (haatan) ka iishay oo arki waayey?

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَحَقّٞ تَخَاصُمُ أَهۡلِ ٱلنَّارِ

en.text: Indeed, that is truth [i.e., reality] - the quarreling of the people of the Fire.

so.text: 64. Hubaal arrinkani waa xaq aan shaki lahayn - waa doodda ehlu Naarka.

ayat.arabic: قُلۡ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ مُنذِرٞۖ وَمَا مِنۡ إِلَٰهٍ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡوَٰحِدُ ٱلۡقَهَّارُ

en.text: Say, [O Muḥammad], "I am only a warner, and there is not any deity except Allāh, the One, the Prevailing,[1332]
en.footnotes: [1332] Refer to footnotes in 12:39.

so.text: 65. Dheh (Nabiyow) anigu sideedaba waxaan ahay oo keliya dige, mana jiro ilaah (Xaq ah) aan ahayn Allaah, Waaxidka, Sandulleeyaha (daalimiinta iyo isla weynayaasha).

ayat.arabic: رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡغَفَّٰرُ

en.text: Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Exalted in Might,[1333] the Perpetual Forgiver."[1334]
en.footnotes:
[1333] Honored for absolute power associated with wisdom and justice.
[1334] Who continually conceals sins and faults.

so.text: 66. Rabbiga samooyinka iyo arlada iyo waxa u dhexeeya, Adkaadaha Sare, Denbi Dhaafka Badan.

ayat.arabic: قُلۡ هُوَ نَبَؤٌاْ عَظِيمٌ

en.text: Say, "It is great news

so.text: 67. Dheh: Kani waa dhambaal ahmiyad weyn leh.

ayat.arabic: أَنتُمۡ عَنۡهُ مُعۡرِضُونَ

en.text: From which you turn away.

so.text: 68. Oo aad idinku ka jeedsataan.

ayat.arabic: مَا كَانَ لِيَ مِنۡ عِلۡمِۭ بِٱلۡمَلَإِ ٱلۡأَعۡلَىٰٓ إِذۡ يَخۡتَصِمُونَ

en.text: I had no knowledge of the exalted assembly [of angels] when they were disputing [the creation of Adam].

so.text: 69. Uma lahayn wax cilmi ah kulanka sare (malaa’igta) markay doodayeen.

ayat.arabic: إِن يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَيَّ إِلَّآ أَنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٞ مُّبِينٌ

en.text: It has not been revealed to me except that I am a clear warner."

so.text: 70. Waxaa uun la ii waxyooday, inaan ahay dige iska cad.

ayat.arabic: إِذۡ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّي خَٰلِقُۢ بَشَرٗا مِّن طِينٖ

en.text: [So mention] when your Lord said to the angels, "Indeed, I am going to create a human being from clay.

so.text: 71. (Xus) markuu Rabbigaa ku yidhi ma- laa’igta: Waxaan ka abuuri aadmi dhoobo.

ayat.arabic: فَإِذَا سَوَّيۡتُهُۥ وَنَفَخۡتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِي فَقَعُواْ لَهُۥ سَٰجِدِينَ

en.text: So when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My [created] soul,[1335] then fall down to him in prostration."
en.footnotes: [1335] See footnote to 15:29.

so.text: 72. Ee markaan ebyo sameyntiisa isagoo dhan oo aan ku afuufo Ruuxda (aan u abuuray), markaas ula dhaca sujuud.

ayat.arabic: فَسَجَدَ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمۡ أَجۡمَعُونَ

en.text: So the angels prostrated - all of them entirely,

so.text: 73. Malaa’igtii way sujuudeen kulligood oo dhan.

ayat.arabic: إِلَّآ إِبۡلِيسَ ٱسۡتَكۡبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ

en.text: Except Iblees;[1336] he was arrogant and became among the disbelievers.
en.footnotes: [1336] See footnote to 2:34.

so.text: 74. Ibliis maahee, wuu is kibriyey, oo noqday gaal (abaal lahayn, fallaago ah).

ayat.arabic: قَالَ يَٰٓإِبۡلِيسُ مَا مَنَعَكَ أَن تَسۡجُدَ لِمَا خَلَقۡتُ بِيَدَيَّۖ أَسۡتَكۡبَرۡتَ أَمۡ كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلۡعَالِينَ

en.text: [Allāh] said, "O Iblees, what prevented you from prostrating to that which I created with My hands?[1337] Were you arrogant [then], or were you [already] among the haughty?"
en.footnotes: [1337] See footnote to 2:19.

so.text: 75. (Alle) wuxuu yidhi: Ibliisow! Maxaa kuu diiday inaad u sujuuddo mid aan ku abuuray labadeyda Gacmood, miyaad isla weyn tahay, mise isla sarreysaa?

ayat.arabic: قَالَ أَنَا۠ خَيۡرٞ مِّنۡهُ خَلَقۡتَنِي مِن نَّارٖ وَخَلَقۡتَهُۥ مِن طِينٖ

en.text: He said, "I am better than him. You created me from fire and created him from clay."

so.text: 76. (Ibliis) wuxuu yidhi: Anaa ka khayr badan, waxaad iga abuurtay dab, isagana waxaad ka abuurtay dhoobo.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ فَٱخۡرُجۡ مِنۡهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٞ

en.text: [Allāh] said, "Then get out of it [i.e., Paradise], for indeed, you are expelled.

so.text: 77. (Alle) wuxuu yidhi: Ka bax halkan, waxaad tahay dayro dufeysan laga fogeeyey Naxariisteyda.

ayat.arabic: وَإِنَّ عَلَيۡكَ لَعۡنَتِيٓ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلدِّينِ

en.text: And indeed, upon you is My curse until the Day of Recompense."

so.text: 78. Nacaladdayda baana korkaaga ah ilaa Maalinta Is-Abaal marinta (Qiyaamada).

ayat.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرۡنِيٓ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ يُبۡعَثُونَ

en.text: He said, "My Lord, then reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected."

so.text: 79. (Ibliis) wuxuu yidhi: Rabbiyow! Ii sug ilaa Maalinta la soo bixinayo (Qiyaamaha).

ayat.arabic: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُنظَرِينَ

en.text: [Allāh] said, "So indeed, you are of those reprieved

so.text: 80. (Alle) wuxuu yidhi: Waxaad ka mid tahay kuwa la sugayo (fursad la siin).

ayat.arabic: إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡوَقۡتِ ٱلۡمَعۡلُومِ

en.text: Until the Day of the time well-known."

so.text: 81. Ilaa Maalinta waqtiga la yaqaan leh.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ فَبِعِزَّتِكَ لَأُغۡوِيَنَّهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ

en.text: [Iblees] said, "By Your might, I will surely mislead them all

so.text: 82. (Shaydaan) wuxuu yidhi: Waa igu Cisa- daadee, waan dhumin dhammaantood.

ayat.arabic: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنۡهُمُ ٱلۡمُخۡلَصِينَ

en.text: Except, among them, Your chosen servants."

so.text: 83. Addoomahaaga kuwooda daacadda ah maahee aan waxba kula wadaajin cibaadada.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ فَٱلۡحَقُّ وَٱلۡحَقَّ أَقُولُ

en.text: [Allāh] said, "The truth [is My oath], and the truth I say -

so.text: 84. (Alle) wuxuu yidhi: Runtu waxaa weeye, runtaana ku hadlaaye -

ayat.arabic: لَأَمۡلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنكَ وَمِمَّن تَبِعَكَ مِنۡهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ

en.text: [That] I will surely fill Hell with you and those of them that follow you all together."

so.text: 85. Waxaan hubaal ka buuxin Jahannama adiga iyo kuwooda ka mid ah oo ku raaca oo dhan.

ayat.arabic: قُلۡ مَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرٖ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلۡمُتَكَلِّفِينَ

en.text: Say, [O Muḥammad], "I do not ask you for it [i.e., the Qur’ān] any payment, and I am not of the pretentious.

so.text: 86. Dheh: Idinkuma weydiisanayo wax abaalgud ah (gaarsiinta Dhambaalkan), mana ahi mid ka mid ah kuwa is yeel yeela (oo isku dhiba waxaan la amrin).

ayat.arabic: إِنۡ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكۡرٞ لِّلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

en.text: It is but a reminder to the worlds.

so.text: 87. Ma ahana (Qur’aankani) waxaan ahayn Waano ku socota uumanka oo dhan.

ayat.arabic: وَلَتَعۡلَمُنَّ نَبَأَهُۥ بَعۡدَ حِينِۭ

en.text: And you will surely know [the truth of] its information after a time."

so.text: 88. Oo xaqiiq waad ogaan doontaan warkiisa muddo yar kaddib [15].
so.footnotes: [15]. Ogaanshaha run ahaanta waxa ku soo arooray Qur’aanka sida inuu Alle u gargaari doono mu’miniinta, iyo wararka la xidhiidha Aakhirada.

ayat.arabic: تَنزِيلُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡحَكِيمِ

en.text: The revelation of the Book [i.e., the Qur’ān] is from Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

so.text: 1. Soo dejinta Kitaabka (Qur’aanka) waa xagga Alle, Adkaadaha Sare, Xakiimka ah.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّآ أَنزَلۡنَآ إِلَيۡكَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ فَٱعۡبُدِ ٱللَّهَ مُخۡلِصٗا لَّهُ ٱلدِّينَ

en.text: Indeed, We have sent down to you the Book, [O Muḥammad], in truth. So worship Allāh, [being] sincere to Him in religion.

so.text: 2. Waxaan kuugu soo dejinnay (Nabiyow) Kitaabka (Qur’aanka) si Xaq ah. Ee caabud Alle Keliya, adigoo u daacad ah aan waxba la wadaajin cibaadada.

ayat.arabic: أَلَا لِلَّهِ ٱلدِّينُ ٱلۡخَالِصُۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوۡلِيَآءَ مَا نَعۡبُدُهُمۡ إِلَّا لِيُقَرِّبُونَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ زُلۡفَىٰٓ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَحۡكُمُ بَيۡنَهُمۡ فِي مَا هُمۡ فِيهِ يَخۡتَلِفُونَۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهۡدِي مَنۡ هُوَ كَٰذِبٞ كَفَّارٞ

en.text: Unquestionably, for Allāh is the pure religion.[1339] And those who take protectors besides Him [say], "We only worship them that they may bring us nearer to Allāh in position." Indeed, Allāh will judge between them concerning that over which they differ. Indeed, Allāh does not guide he who is a liar and [confirmed] disbeliever.
en.footnotes: [1339] i.e., acceptable to Allāh is that none be associated with Him in worship and obedience.

so.text: 3. Ogaada, hubaal, cibaado barax tidhan [1] aan waxba lala wadaajin cid kale waxaa Xaq u leh Alle (Keliya). Kuwase yeesha awliyo (gargaarayaal, sokeeyayaal, ay la) barbar caabudaan (iyagoo leh): Uma caabudno waxaan ahayn inay noo dhoweeyaan Alle dhowaansho. Alle baa ku kala xukumi dhexdooda waxay isku khilaafsan yihiin. Alle ma hanuuniyo been badne, gaalnimo badan.
so.footnotes: [1]. Diinta uu Alle aqbalo waa diinta Islaamka ee daahirka ah, ee aan Alle lala wadaajin cidna cibaadada iyo adeecidda iyo maxabbada.

ayat.arabic: لَّوۡ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ أَن يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدٗا لَّٱصۡطَفَىٰ مِمَّا يَخۡلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُۚ سُبۡحَٰنَهُۥۖ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡوَٰحِدُ ٱلۡقَهَّارُ

en.text: If Allāh had intended to take a son, He could have chosen from what He creates whatever He willed. Exalted is He; He is Allāh, the One, the Prevailing.[1340]
en.footnotes: [1340] Refer to footnotes in 12:39.

so.text: 4. Hadduu doono Alle inuu yeesho wiil (siday leeyihiin gaalada) wuxuu ka dooran lahaa wuxuu abuuray wuxuu doono. Xurmo oo dhan Isagaa leh oo ka hufan (xumaan). Waa Allaah, Waaxidka Keliga ah, Sandulleeyaha (daalimiinta iyo isla weynayaasha).

ayat.arabic: خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ بِٱلۡحَقِّۖ يُكَوِّرُ ٱلَّيۡلَ عَلَى ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُكَوِّرُ ٱلنَّهَارَ عَلَى ٱلَّيۡلِۖ وَسَخَّرَ ٱلشَّمۡسَ وَٱلۡقَمَرَۖ كُلّٞ يَجۡرِي لِأَجَلٖ مُّسَمًّىۗ أَلَا هُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡغَفَّٰرُ

en.text: He created the heavens and earth in truth. He wraps the night over the day and wraps the day over the night and has subjected the sun and the moon, each running [its course] for a specified term. Unquestionably, He is the Exalted in Might, the Perpetual Forgiver.[1341]
en.footnotes: [1341] Refer to footnotes in 38:66.

so.text: 5. Wuxuu ku abuuray samooyinka iyo arlada Xaq. Wuxuu habeenka ku daboolaa maalinta, maalintana ku daboolaa habeenka. Wuxuuna layliyay qorraxda iyo dayaxa. Mid walbaa wuxuu ku socdaa muddo magacaaban. Ogaada Alle waa Adkaadaha Sare, Denbi Dhaafka Badan.

ayat.arabic: خَلَقَكُم مِّن نَّفۡسٖ وَٰحِدَةٖ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنۡهَا زَوۡجَهَا وَأَنزَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمِ ثَمَٰنِيَةَ أَزۡوَٰجٖۚ يَخۡلُقُكُمۡ فِي بُطُونِ أُمَّهَٰتِكُمۡ خَلۡقٗا مِّنۢ بَعۡدِ خَلۡقٖ فِي ظُلُمَٰتٖ ثَلَٰثٖۚ ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمۡ لَهُ ٱلۡمُلۡكُۖ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۖ فَأَنَّىٰ تُصۡرَفُونَ

en.text: He created you from one soul. Then He made from it its mate, and He produced for you from the grazing livestock eight mates.[1342] He creates you in the wombs of your mothers, creation after creation, within three darknesses.[1343] That is Allāh, your Lord; to Him belongs dominion. There is no deity except Him, so how are you averted?
en.footnotes:
[1342] See 6:143-144.
[1343] i.e., the belly, the womb, and the amniotic membrane.

so.text: 6. Wuxuu idinka abuuray naf keliya (Aadam) kaddib ka yeelay (abuuray) lammaankiisa (Xawwaa) xaggeeda. Wuxuuna idiin soo dejiyey xoolaha siddeed nooc. Wuxuu idinku abuuraa uurarka hooyooyinkiin abuuris ka dambeysa abuuris saddex mugdi [2] dhexdood, kaas waa Allaah - Rabbigiin. Isagaa leh Boqortooyada (runta ah). Ma jiro Ilaah (Xaq lagu caabudo) aan Isaga ahayn. Ee xagee baa la idiinka iilay?
so.footnotes: [2]. Seddexdaa mugdi waa mugdiga caloosha, mugdiga riximka, iyo mugdiga xuubka ku dahaaran riximka.

ayat.arabic: إِن تَكۡفُرُواْ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِيٌّ عَنكُمۡۖ وَلَا يَرۡضَىٰ لِعِبَادِهِ ٱلۡكُفۡرَۖ وَإِن تَشۡكُرُواْ يَرۡضَهُ لَكُمۡۗ وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٞ وِزۡرَ أُخۡرَىٰۚ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُم مَّرۡجِعُكُمۡ فَيُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمُۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ

en.text: If you disbelieve - indeed, Allāh is Free from need of you. And He does not approve for His servants disbelief. And if you are grateful, He approves [i.e., likes] it for you; and no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another. Then to your Lord is your return, and He will inform you about what you used to do. Indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.

so.text: 7. Haddaad gaalowdaan (dadow), Allaah waa idinka deeqtoon yahay, ugamana raalli aha  addoomahiisa gaalnimo. Haddaad ku mahdisaanna wuu idinka raalli noqon.  Nafnana naf kale denbigeeda ma qaaddo. Waana xagga Rabbigiin meel noqodkiinnu, markaasuu idiin sheegi waxaad fali jirteen. (Alle) Wuu Ogsoon yahay waxa ku jira laabaha (dadka).

ayat.arabic: ۞ وَإِذَا مَسَّ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ ضُرّٞ دَعَا رَبَّهُۥ مُنِيبًا إِلَيۡهِ ثُمَّ إِذَا خَوَّلَهُۥ نِعۡمَةٗ مِّنۡهُ نَسِيَ مَا كَانَ يَدۡعُوٓاْ إِلَيۡهِ مِن قَبۡلُ وَجَعَلَ لِلَّهِ أَندَادٗا لِّيُضِلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦۚ قُلۡ تَمَتَّعۡ بِكُفۡرِكَ قَلِيلًا إِنَّكَ مِنۡ أَصۡحَٰبِ ٱلنَّارِ

en.text: And when adversity touches man, he calls upon his Lord, turning to Him [alone]; then when He bestows on him a favor from Himself, he forgets Him whom he called upon before,[1344] and he attributes to Allāh equals to mislead [people] from His way. Say, "Enjoy your disbelief for a little; indeed, you are of the companions of the Fire."
en.footnotes: [1344] Or "that for which he called upon Him before."

so.text: 8. Markay dhibi taabato aadmiga wuxuu baryaa Rabbigiis (Alle Keliya) isagoo badiya u noqodka Xaggiisa (tawbad keen ah), markase uu siiyo nicmo Xaggiisa ah, waa halmaamaa wuxuu ka baryey kal hore, wuxuuna u yeelaa shariigyo, si uu (u lumo oo aadmigana) uga lumiyo Jidkiisa. Dheh: Ku raaxeyso gaalnimadaada wax yar [3], waxaad xaqiiq ka mid tahay ehlu Naarka.
so.footnotes: [3]. Arrinkan waa ogeysiin cadhada uu Alle u qabo mushrikiinta inkiraaddooda baaqa Towxiidka darti, waa gooddin adag.

ayat.arabic: أَمَّنۡ هُوَ قَٰنِتٌ ءَانَآءَ ٱلَّيۡلِ سَاجِدٗا وَقَآئِمٗا يَحۡذَرُ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةَ وَيَرۡجُواْ رَحۡمَةَ رَبِّهِۦۗ قُلۡ هَلۡ يَسۡتَوِي ٱلَّذِينَ يَعۡلَمُونَ وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَۗ إِنَّمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ أُوْلُواْ ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ

en.text: Is one who is devoutly obedient during periods of the night, prostrating and standing [in prayer], fearing the Hereafter and hoping for the mercy of his Lord, [like one who does not]? Say, "Are those who know equal to those who do not know?" Only they will remember [who are] people of understanding.

so.text: 9. Ma mid daacad ah tukada saacado habeenka ah isagoo sujuudsan oo taagan, ka digtoon Aakhirada oo rajeeya Naxariista Rabbigiis (miyaa la mid ah mid aan sidaasi ahayn)!? Dheh: Miyey kuwa wax og iyo kuwa aan waxba ogeyn siman yihiin? Waxaa sideedaba waantooba keliya kuwa wax garadka ah.

ayat.arabic: قُلۡ يَٰعِبَادِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ٱتَّقُواْ رَبَّكُمۡۚ لِلَّذِينَ أَحۡسَنُواْ فِي هَٰذِهِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا حَسَنَةٞۗ وَأَرۡضُ ٱللَّهِ وَٰسِعَةٌۗ إِنَّمَا يُوَفَّى ٱلصَّٰبِرُونَ أَجۡرَهُم بِغَيۡرِ حِسَابٖ

en.text: Say,[1345] "O My servants who have believed, fear your Lord. For those who do good in this world is good, and the earth of Allāh is spacious. Indeed, the patient will be given their reward without account [i.e., limit]."
en.footnotes: [1345] The Prophet (ﷺ) is instructed to say on behalf of Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) to His believing servants.

so.text: 10. Dheh: Addoommahayga (Xaqa) rumeeyow, Dhowra (xilkuu idin saaray) Rabbigiin, kuwa sama fala adduunyadan, (abaalkooda) waa samaan, arlada AIlena waa waasic (ee ku caabuda Isagoo Keliya). Waxaa uun loo oofiyaa kuwa samra Abaalkooda si dhan xisaab la’aan.

ayat.arabic: قُلۡ إِنِّيٓ أُمِرۡتُ أَنۡ أَعۡبُدَ ٱللَّهَ مُخۡلِصٗا لَّهُ ٱلدِّينَ

en.text: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Indeed, I have been commanded to worship Allāh, [being] sincere to Him in religion.

so.text: 11. Dheh: Waxaa la i amray inaan caabudo Alle Keliya anigoo u daacad ah aan waxba la wadaajineyn cibaadada.

ayat.arabic: وَأُمِرۡتُ لِأَنۡ أَكُونَ أَوَّلَ ٱلۡمُسۡلِمِينَ

en.text: And I have been commanded to be the first [among you] of the Muslims."

so.text: 12. Oo waxaa la i amray inaan ahaado kan ugu horreeya Muslimiinta (isu dhiiba Alle).

ayat.arabic: قُلۡ إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ إِنۡ عَصَيۡتُ رَبِّي عَذَابَ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيمٖ

en.text: Say, "Indeed I fear, if I should disobey my Lord, the punishment of a tremendous Day."

so.text: 13. Dheh: Waxaan ka cabsan haddaan ku caasiyo Rabbigey Cadaab Maalin weyn.

ayat.arabic: قُلِ ٱللَّهَ أَعۡبُدُ مُخۡلِصٗا لَّهُۥ دِينِي

en.text: Say, "Allāh [alone] do I worship, sincere to Him in my religion,

so.text: 14. Dheh: Alle keliyaan caabudi anigoo u daacad ah waxbana la wadaajin cibaadada.

ayat.arabic: فَٱعۡبُدُواْ مَا شِئۡتُم مِّن دُونِهِۦۗ قُلۡ إِنَّ ٱلۡخَٰسِرِينَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓاْ أَنفُسَهُمۡ وَأَهۡلِيهِمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِۗ أَلَا ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلۡخُسۡرَانُ ٱلۡمُبِينُ

en.text: So worship what you will besides Him." Say, "Indeed, the losers are the ones who will lose themselves and their families on the Day of Resurrection. Unquestionably, that is the manifest loss."

so.text: 15. Ee caabuda idinku waxaad doontaan Isaga sokadi. Dheh: Khasaare qabaayaasha waa kuwa khaasari nafahooda iyo ehelkoodaba Maalinta Qiyaamaha; ogaada, kaasi weeye khasaaraha cad.

ayat.arabic: لَهُم مِّن فَوۡقِهِمۡ ظُلَلٞ مِّنَ ٱلنَّارِ وَمِن تَحۡتِهِمۡ ظُلَلٞۚ ذَٰلِكَ يُخَوِّفُ ٱللَّهُ بِهِۦ عِبَادَهُۥۚ يَٰعِبَادِ فَٱتَّقُونِ

en.text: They will have canopies [i.e., layers] of fire above them and below them, canopies. By that Allāh threatens [i.e., warns] His servants. O My servants, then fear Me.

so.text: 16. Waxay mudan daboollo dab Naar ah korkooda, iyo daboollo Naar ah hoostooda. Arrinkaasi waa waxa uu Alle ku cabsi geliyo addoomahiisa ee addoomahaygow iga cabsada (iskana jira xumaha).

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱجۡتَنَبُواْ ٱلطَّٰغُوتَ أَن يَعۡبُدُوهَا وَأَنَابُوٓاْ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ لَهُمُ ٱلۡبُشۡرَىٰۚ فَبَشِّرۡ عِبَادِ

en.text: But those who have avoided ṭāghūt,[1346] lest they worship it, and turned back to Allāh - for them are good tidings. So give good tidings to My servants
en.footnotes: [1346] i.e., Satan or any false object of worship.

so.text: 17. Kuwa ka fogaada inay caabudaan Daaquut 'ilaahyada beenta' [4] oo u laabta Allaah (iyagoo tawbad keen ah), waxay leeyihiin bishaaro; ee u bishaaree addoomahayga.
so.footnotes: [4]. Daaquut waxaa loola jeedaa shaydaanka, ama wax kastoo la caabudo Alle sokadi iyagoo ku raalli ah caabudiddaas.

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَسۡتَمِعُونَ ٱلۡقَوۡلَ فَيَتَّبِعُونَ أَحۡسَنَهُۥٓۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ هَدَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُۖ وَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمۡ أُوْلُواْ ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ

en.text: Who listen to speech and follow the best of it. Those are the ones Allāh has guided, and those are people of understanding.

so.text: 18. Kuwa dhegaysta hadalka waanada ah oo raaca kiisa u fiican [5], kuwaa weeye (kuwa) uu Alle hanuunshay, waana kuwaa kuwa wax garadka ah.
so.footnotes: [5]. Waa kuwa markay maqlaan samaan iyo xumaan, ka warrama samaanta , kana taga hadalka kiisa xun oo aan ka sheekeynin. Hadal la raacana waxaa u wanaagsan hadalka Alle oo ah Qur’aanka iyo kan Rasuulkiisa (Sunnada Nabiga scw).

ayat.arabic: أَفَمَنۡ حَقَّ عَلَيۡهِ كَلِمَةُ ٱلۡعَذَابِ أَفَأَنتَ تُنقِذُ مَن فِي ٱلنَّارِ

en.text: Then, is one who has deserved the decree of punishment [to be guided]? Then, can you save one who is in the Fire?

so.text: 19. Ma mid ay u waajibtay kelmedda cadaabka. Ma adigaa (Nabiyow) badbaadin kara mid geli Naarta.

ayat.arabic: لَٰكِنِ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوۡاْ رَبَّهُمۡ لَهُمۡ غُرَفٞ مِّن فَوۡقِهَا غُرَفٞ مَّبۡنِيَّةٞ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُۖ وَعۡدَ ٱللَّهِ لَا يُخۡلِفُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡمِيعَادَ
