en.text: But those who have feared their Lord - for them are chambers,[1347] above them chambers built high, beneath which rivers flow. [This is] the promise of Allāh. Allāh does not fail in [His] promise.
en.footnotes: [1347] i.e., elevated rooms, dwellings or palaces.

so.text: 20. Kuwase ka cabsada Rabbigood (oo ka dhowrsada xumaha) waxay leeyihiin dabaqyo sare ay ka korreeyaan dabaqyo kale loo dhisay (iyaga), oo ay webiyadu hoos qulqulaan; (Kani waa) Ballan Alle, Alle marnaba kama baxo Ballankiisa.

ayat.arabic: أَلَمۡ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءٗ فَسَلَكَهُۥ يَنَٰبِيعَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ ثُمَّ يُخۡرِجُ بِهِۦ زَرۡعٗا مُّخۡتَلِفًا أَلۡوَٰنُهُۥ ثُمَّ يَهِيجُ فَتَرَىٰهُ مُصۡفَرّٗا ثُمَّ يَجۡعَلُهُۥ حُطَٰمًاۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكۡرَىٰ لِأُوْلِي ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ

en.text: Do you not see that Allāh sends down rain from the sky and makes it flow as springs [and rivers] in the earth; then He produces thereby crops of varying colors; then they dry and you see them turned yellow; then He makes them [scattered] debris. Indeed in that is a reminder for those of understanding.

so.text: 21. Miyaadan arag inuu Alle ka soo dejiyo biyo (roob) daruuraha, haddana ka yeelo inay ku socdaan dhulka iyagoo ilo ah, markaas uu ku soo bixiyo dhir kala midab ah, haddana qallalaan sidaas darteed waxaad aragtaa isagoo caddaaday oo cawlan, haddana Wuxuu ka dhigaa wax baabba’ay oo u burburay gaballo? Hubaal, arrinkani waxaa ugu sugan waano dadka wax garadka ah.

ayat.arabic: أَفَمَن شَرَحَ ٱللَّهُ صَدۡرَهُۥ لِلۡإِسۡلَٰمِ فَهُوَ عَلَىٰ نُورٖ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦۚ فَوَيۡلٞ لِّلۡقَٰسِيَةِ قُلُوبُهُم مِّن ذِكۡرِ ٱللَّهِۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ فِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٍ

en.text: So is one whose breast Allāh has expanded to [accept] Islām and he is upon [i.e., guided by] a light from his Lord [like one whose heart rejects it]? Then woe to those whose hearts are hardened against the remembrance of Allāh. Those are in manifest error.

so.text: 22. Ma mid uu qalbigiisa Alle u furay islaamka sidaas darteed ku sugan Nuur xagga Rabbigi ah (baa la mid ah mid qalbi adag)? Waxaa hoog leh kuwa ay qalbiyadoodu ay yihiin adeyg xagga Xusidda Alle. Kuwaasu waxay ku sugan yihiin habow cad.

ayat.arabic: ٱللَّهُ نَزَّلَ أَحۡسَنَ ٱلۡحَدِيثِ كِتَٰبٗا مُّتَشَٰبِهٗا مَّثَانِيَ تَقۡشَعِرُّ مِنۡهُ جُلُودُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخۡشَوۡنَ رَبَّهُمۡ ثُمَّ تَلِينُ جُلُودُهُمۡ وَقُلُوبُهُمۡ إِلَىٰ ذِكۡرِ ٱللَّهِۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُدَى ٱللَّهِ يَهۡدِي بِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُۚ وَمَن يُضۡلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِنۡ هَادٍ

en.text: Allāh has sent down the best statement: a consistent Book wherein is reiteration. The skins shiver therefrom of those who fear their Lord; then their skins and their hearts relax at the remembrance [i.e., mention] of Allāh. That is the guidance of Allāh by which He guides whom He wills. And one whom Allāh sends astray - for him there is no guide.

so.text: 23. Alle wuxuu soo dejiyey hadal kan u fiican, Kitaab qaybahiisu isu eg yihiin oo soo noqnoqda [6], ay la jiriiricoodaan dubabka kuwa ka baqa Rabbigood. markaasay dubabkooda iyo qalbiyadoodu u jilcaan Xuska Alle (Qur'aanka iyo Sunnada Rasuulkiisa). Kaasi waa hanuunka Alle. Wuxuu ku hanuuniyaa cidduu doono, qofkuu Alle lumiyaana ma leh cid hanuunin.
so.footnotes: [6]. Axkaanta, cilmiga, qisooyinka, iwm waa lagu soo celceliyaa Qur’aanka gudahi si loogu cibrad iyo waano qaato oo dadka u saameyso.

ayat.arabic: أَفَمَن يَتَّقِي بِوَجۡهِهِۦ سُوٓءَ ٱلۡعَذَابِ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِۚ وَقِيلَ لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ ذُوقُواْ مَا كُنتُمۡ تَكۡسِبُونَ

en.text: Then is he who will shield with his face[1348] the worst of the punishment on the Day of Resurrection [like one secure from it]? And it will be said to the wrongdoers, "Taste what you used to earn."
en.footnotes: [1348] Rather than his hands, which will be chained to his neck.

so.text: 24. Ma mid kaga gabbada wejigiisa [7] cadaabka xun Maalinta Qiyaamaha (baa la mid ah mid aan sidaas ahayn) waxaana lagu odhan daalimiinta: Dhadhamiya waxa aad kasbateen (oo denbiyo ah).
so.footnotes: [7]. Halkii gacmahiisa, oo markaasi ku xirnaan doono luquntiisa.

ayat.arabic: كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡ فَأَتَىٰهُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابُ مِنۡ حَيۡثُ لَا يَشۡعُرُونَ

en.text: Those before them denied, and punishment came upon them from where they did not perceive.

so.text: 25. Waxaa beeniyey (Xaqa) kuwii ka horreeyey (gaaladan), wuxuuna uga yimid cadaabku meelo aysan dreemeyn.

ayat.arabic: فَأَذَاقَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡخِزۡيَ فِي ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَاۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ أَكۡبَرُۚ لَوۡ كَانُواْ يَعۡلَمُونَ

en.text: So Allāh made them taste disgrace in worldly life. But the punishment of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew.

so.text: 26. Markaasuu Alle ku dhadhansiiyey dulli noloshan adduunka, cadaabka Aakhiraana ka sii weyn; hadday ogaan lahaayen.

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ ضَرَبۡنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِي هَٰذَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ مِن كُلِّ مَثَلٖ لَّعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ

en.text: And We have certainly presented for the people in this Qur’ān from every [kind of] example - that they might remember.

so.text: 27. Waxaan dhab ahaan ugu soo qaadannay dadka Qur'aankan dhexdi tusaale nooc kasta leh inay waantoobaan.

ayat.arabic: قُرۡءَانًا عَرَبِيًّا غَيۡرَ ذِي عِوَجٖ لَّعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَّقُونَ

en.text: [It is] an Arabic Qur’ān, without any deviance[1349] that they might become righteous.[1350]
en.footnotes:
[1349] From the truth.
[1350] Through consciousness of Allāh.

so.text: 28. Qur’aan af Carabi ah, aan wax qallooc ahi lahayn [8], si ay (xumaha uga) dhowrsadaan (oo Alle u hoggaansamaan).
so.footnotes: [8]. Aan lahayn wax ka weecasho ah xaqa.

ayat.arabic: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلٗا رَّجُلٗا فِيهِ شُرَكَآءُ مُتَشَٰكِسُونَ وَرَجُلٗا سَلَمٗا لِّرَجُلٍ هَلۡ يَسۡتَوِيَانِ مَثَلًاۚ ٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِۚ بَلۡ أَكۡثَرُهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ

en.text: Allāh presents an example: a man [i.e., slave] owned by quarreling partners and another belonging exclusively to one man - are they equal in comparison? Praise be to Allāh! But most of them do not know.

so.text: 29. Allaah wuxuu soo qaataa tusaale: addoon ay wadaagaan niman badan oo is khilaaafsan, iyo addoon kale oo gebigiba uu wada leeyahay hal nin. Miyey labadaasu isku mid yihiin xaal ahaan? Ammaan oo dhan iyo mahad waxaa leh Allaah,  badankooduse ma oga.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّكَ مَيِّتٞ وَإِنَّهُم مَّيِّتُونَ

en.text: Indeed, you are to die, and indeed, they are to die.

so.text: 30. Hubaal waad dhiman, iyaguna (sidoo kale) way dhiman.

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ عِندَ رَبِّكُمۡ تَخۡتَصِمُونَ

en.text: Then indeed you, on the Day of Resurrection, before your Lord, will dispute.

so.text: 31. Maalinta Qiyaamahana waxaad hubaal ku doodeysaan Rabbigiin horti.

ayat.arabic: ۞ فَمَنۡ أَظۡلَمُ مِمَّن كَذَبَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ وَكَذَّبَ بِٱلصِّدۡقِ إِذۡ جَآءَهُۥٓۚ أَلَيۡسَ فِي جَهَنَّمَ مَثۡوٗى لِّلۡكَٰفِرِينَ

en.text: So who is more unjust than one who lies about Allāh and denies the truth when it has come to him? Is there not in Hell a residence for the disbelievers?

so.text: 32. Yaa ka dulmi badan kan ka been sheega Alle (oo yidhaahda wuxuu leeyahay shuruko ama ilmo), oo beeniya Xaqa (Qur’aanka) markuu u yimid, miyaanay ugu sugneyn Naarta hoy gaalada?

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّذِي جَآءَ بِٱلصِّدۡقِ وَصَدَّقَ بِهِۦٓ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡمُتَّقُونَ

en.text: And the one who has brought the truth [i.e., the Prophet (ﷺ)] and [they who] believed in it - those are the righteous.

so.text: 33. Kan se la yimid Runta (Nabi Muxammad) iyo (kan) rumeeyey, kuwaa weeye kuwa (xumaha ka) dhowrsada (ee Alle u hoggaansan).

ayat.arabic: لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمۡۚ ذَٰلِكَ جَزَآءُ ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ

en.text: They will have whatever they desire with their Lord. That is the reward of the doers of good -

so.text: 34. Waxay leeyihiin waxay doonaan Rabbigood agtiisa; kaasi waa abaalgudka sama falayaasha.

ayat.arabic: لِيُكَفِّرَ ٱللَّهُ عَنۡهُمۡ أَسۡوَأَ ٱلَّذِي عَمِلُواْ وَيَجۡزِيَهُمۡ أَجۡرَهُم بِأَحۡسَنِ ٱلَّذِي كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ

en.text: That Allāh may remove from them the worst of what they did and reward them their due for the best of what they used to do.

so.text: 35. Si uu Alle ugu asturo wixii xumaa ay faleen, oo u siiyo ajarkooda si waafaqsan waxa u wanaagsan ay falaan.

ayat.arabic: أَلَيۡسَ ٱللَّهُ بِكَافٍ عَبۡدَهُۥۖ وَيُخَوِّفُونَكَ بِٱلَّذِينَ مِن دُونِهِۦۚ وَمَن يُضۡلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِنۡ هَادٖ

en.text: Is not Allāh sufficient for His Servant [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ)]? And [yet], they threaten you with those [they worship] other than Him. And whoever Allāh leaves astray - for him there is no guide.

so.text: 36. Miyuusan Alle ahayn mid ku Filan addoonkiisa? Waxayna kugu cabsi geliyaan kuwa ay sokadi (caabudaan). Qofkuu Alle lumiyo, ma leh wax hanuunin.

ayat.arabic: وَمَن يَهۡدِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن مُّضِلٍّۗ أَلَيۡسَ ٱللَّهُ بِعَزِيزٖ ذِي ٱنتِقَامٖ

en.text: And whoever Allāh guides - for him there is no misleader. Is not Allāh Exalted in Might and Owner of Retribution?

so.text: 37. Qofkuu hanuuniyona ma jiro wax lumin kara. Miyuusan Alle ahayn Adkaade, Aargudasho leh?

ayat.arabic: وَلَئِن سَأَلۡتَهُم مَّنۡ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُۚ قُلۡ أَفَرَءَيۡتُم مَّا تَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ إِنۡ أَرَادَنِيَ ٱللَّهُ بِضُرٍّ هَلۡ هُنَّ كَٰشِفَٰتُ ضُرِّهِۦٓ أَوۡ أَرَادَنِي بِرَحۡمَةٍ هَلۡ هُنَّ مُمۡسِكَٰتُ رَحۡمَتِهِۦۚ قُلۡ حَسۡبِيَ ٱللَّهُۖ عَلَيۡهِ يَتَوَكَّلُ ٱلۡمُتَوَكِّلُونَ

en.text: And if you asked them, "Who created the heavens and the earth?" they would surely say, "Allāh." Say, "Then have you considered[1351] what you invoke besides Allāh? If Allāh intended me harm, are they removers of His harm; or if He intended me mercy, are they withholders of His mercy?" Say, "Sufficient for me is Allāh; upon Him [alone] rely the [wise] reliers."
en.footnotes: [1351] i.e., "Tell me about..."

so.text: 38. Haddaad (gaalada) weydiiso: Yaa abuuray samooyinka iyo arlada? Waxay odhan: Alle. Dheh: Bal ka warrama waxa aad caabuddaan Alle sokadi - hadduu Alle ila maago dhib, miyey yihiin kuwa faydi kara dhibkiisa? ama hadduu ila maago Naxariis, miyey yihiin kuwa celin kara Naxariistiisa? Dheh: Alle baa igu Filan,  Isagay tala saartaan kuwa tala saarta ee ku kalsoon.

ayat.arabic: قُلۡ يَٰقَوۡمِ ٱعۡمَلُواْ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِكُمۡ إِنِّي عَٰمِلٞۖ فَسَوۡفَ تَعۡلَمُونَ

en.text: Say, "O my people, work according to your position, [for] indeed, I am working; and you are going to know

so.text: 39. Dheh: Dadkaygiiyow! U camal fasha sidiinnaas, anna waan camal fali, waadse ogaan doontaan.

ayat.arabic: مَن يَأۡتِيهِ عَذَابٞ يُخۡزِيهِ وَيَحِلُّ عَلَيۡهِ عَذَابٞ مُّقِيمٌ

en.text: To whom will come a torment disgracing him and on whom will descend an enduring punishment."

so.text: 40. Waa kee kan ay u iman cadaab dulleysa iyo kan ay ku dhici cadaab ma guuraan ah.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّآ أَنزَلۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ لِلنَّاسِ بِٱلۡحَقِّۖ فَمَنِ ٱهۡتَدَىٰ فَلِنَفۡسِهِۦۖ وَمَن ضَلَّ فَإِنَّمَا يَضِلُّ عَلَيۡهَاۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيۡهِم بِوَكِيلٍ

en.text: Indeed, We sent down to you the Book for the people in truth. So whoever is guided - it is for [the benefit of] his soul; and whoever goes astray only goes astray to its detriment. And you are not a manager [i.e., authority] over them.

so.text: 41. Xaqiiq, waxaan kuugu soo dejinnay Kitaabka (Qur’aanka) dadka darti si Xaq ah. Qofkii hanuuna waxay dan u tahay naftiisa,  qofkii lumaana isaga uun bay ka go’an tahay lumitaankiisa, adiguna ma tihid mid xil kaa saaran yahay oo wakiil ka ah.

ayat.arabic: ٱللَّهُ يَتَوَفَّى ٱلۡأَنفُسَ حِينَ مَوۡتِهَا وَٱلَّتِي لَمۡ تَمُتۡ فِي مَنَامِهَاۖ فَيُمۡسِكُ ٱلَّتِي قَضَىٰ عَلَيۡهَا ٱلۡمَوۡتَ وَيُرۡسِلُ ٱلۡأُخۡرَىٰٓ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٖ مُّسَمًّىۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّقَوۡمٖ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ

en.text: Allāh takes the souls at the time of their death, and those that do not die [He takes] during their sleep. Then He keeps those for which He has decreed death and releases the others for a specified term. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought.

so.text: 42. Alle baa oofsada nafaha waqtiga dhimashadooda, iyo kuwaas aan dhiman intay ku jiraan hurdadooda. Wuxuu hayn tii uu ku xukumay dhimashada, wuxuuna soo diri tii kale ilaa iyo muddo magacaaban. Waxaa arrinkaasi ugu sugan calaamooyin ciddii fikireysa.

ayat.arabic: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ شُفَعَآءَۚ قُلۡ أَوَلَوۡ كَانُواْ لَا يَمۡلِكُونَ شَيۡـٔٗا وَلَا يَعۡقِلُونَ

en.text: Or have they taken other than Allāh as intercessors? Say, "Even though they do not possess [power over] anything, nor do they reason?"

so.text: 43. Mise ma waxay yeesheen shafeecayaal Alle sokadi? Dheh: Ma xitaa haddayna wax hananeyn, waxnana garaneyn?

ayat.arabic: قُل لِّلَّهِ ٱلشَّفَٰعَةُ جَمِيعٗاۖ لَّهُۥ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ ثُمَّ إِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُونَ

en.text: Say, "To Allāh belongs [the right to allow] intercession entirely. To Him belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. Then to Him you will be returned."

so.text: 44. Dheh: Allaah baa iska leh shafeeco oo dhan; Isagaa leh Boqortooyada (runta ah ee) samooyinka iyo arlada, Xaggiisaana la idiin soo celin.

ayat.arabic: وَإِذَا ذُكِرَ ٱللَّهُ وَحۡدَهُ ٱشۡمَأَزَّتۡ قُلُوبُ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِۖ وَإِذَا ذُكِرَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ إِذَا هُمۡ يَسۡتَبۡشِرُونَ

en.text: And when Allāh is mentioned alone, the hearts of those who do not believe in the Hereafter shrink with aversion, but when those [worshipped] other than Him are mentioned, immediately they rejoice.

so.text: 45. Marka Alle Keliya la xuso, quluubta kuwa aan rumeysneyn Aakhirada way qaloodaan, markase la xuso kuwa ay sokadi (caabudaan), markaasay farxaan.

ayat.arabic: قُلِ ٱللَّهُمَّ فَاطِرَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ عَٰلِمَ ٱلۡغَيۡبِ وَٱلشَّهَٰدَةِ أَنتَ تَحۡكُمُ بَيۡنَ عِبَادِكَ فِي مَا كَانُواْ فِيهِ يَخۡتَلِفُونَ

en.text: Say, "O Allāh, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, You will judge between your servants concerning that over which they used to differ."

so.text: 46. Dheh: Allahayow, uumaha cirarka iyo dhulkow, Ogsoonaha waxa qarsoon iyo waxa muuqdow. Adiga (Keliyaa) u kala garsoori addoomahaaga waxay isku khilaafaan.

ayat.arabic: وَلَوۡ أَنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ مَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ جَمِيعٗا وَمِثۡلَهُۥ مَعَهُۥ لَٱفۡتَدَوۡاْ بِهِۦ مِن سُوٓءِ ٱلۡعَذَابِ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِۚ وَبَدَا لَهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَمۡ يَكُونُواْ يَحۡتَسِبُونَ

en.text: And if those who did wrong had all that is in the earth entirely and the like of it with it, they would [attempt to] ransom themselves thereby from the worst of the punishment on the Day of Resurrection. And there will appear to them from Allāh that which they had not taken into account.[1352]
en.footnotes: [1352] Of His anger and punishment.

so.text: 47. Haddii kuwa dulmiga (shirkiga iyo macaasida) fala ay lahaan lahaayeen waxa yaal dhulka oo dhan iyo wax le’eg oo wehliya way iskaga furan lahaayeen xumaanta cadaabka Maalinta Qiyaamaha; waxaana uga muuqan xagga Alle wax aysan marnaba maleysanaynin [9].
so.footnotes: [9]. Aanay fileyn oo ah Cadhadiisa iyo Ciqaabkiisa.

ayat.arabic: وَبَدَا لَهُمۡ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا كَسَبُواْ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ

en.text: And there will appear to them the evils they had earned, and they will be enveloped by what they used to ridicule.

so.text: 48. Waxaana u muuqan (ciqaabka) xumaantay kasbadeen, oo waxaa ku dhici waxay ku jees-jeesi jireen (oo cadaab ah).

ayat.arabic: فَإِذَا مَسَّ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ ضُرّٞ دَعَانَا ثُمَّ إِذَا خَوَّلۡنَٰهُ نِعۡمَةٗ مِّنَّا قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أُوتِيتُهُۥ عَلَىٰ عِلۡمِۭۚ بَلۡ هِيَ فِتۡنَةٞ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ

en.text: And when adversity touches man, he calls upon Us; then when We bestow on him a favor from Us, he says, "I have only been given it because of [my] knowledge." Rather, it is a trial, but most of them do not know.

so.text: 49. Markuu dhib taabato Aadmiga, wuu na baryaa, markaanse siinno nicmo Xaggayaga ah wuxuu yidhaahdaa: Wax kale ma’ahee’ waxaa uun laygu siiyey aqoonta (aan u leeyahay jidadka lagu helo), mayee’ waa imtixaan, badankooduse ma oga.

ayat.arabic: قَدۡ قَالَهَا ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡ فَمَآ أَغۡنَىٰ عَنۡهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يَكۡسِبُونَ

en.text: Those before them had already said it, but they were not availed by what they used to earn.

so.text: 50. Kuwii ka horreeyey baa sidaas yidhi, waxbase uma tarin waxay kasbadeen.

ayat.arabic: فَأَصَابَهُمۡ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا كَسَبُواْۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ مِنۡ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ سَيُصِيبُهُمۡ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا كَسَبُواْ وَمَا هُم بِمُعۡجِزِينَ

en.text: And the evil consequences of what they earned struck them. And those who have wronged of these [people] will be struck [i.e., afflicted] by the evil consequences of what they earned; and they will not cause failure.[1353]
en.footnotes: [1353] i.e., prevent Allāh from what He wills or escape from the punishment.

so.text: 51. Markaasaa waxaa ku dhacay xumaanta waxay kasbadeen; oo kuwaa fala dulmiga ee ka mid ah kuwani waxaa iyagana ku dhici doona xumaanta waxay kasbadaan, mana baxsan karaan [10].
so.footnotes: [10]. Macnaha waa ma karaan inay ka joojiyaan Allaah inuu falo waxa uu doono ama inay ka fakadaan Ciqaabkiisa.

ayat.arabic: أَوَلَمۡ يَعۡلَمُوٓاْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَبۡسُطُ ٱلرِّزۡقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقۡدِرُۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّقَوۡمٖ يُؤۡمِنُونَ

en.text: Do they not know that Allāh extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it]? Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe.

so.text: 52. Miyeyna ogeyn inuu Alle u fidiyo risiqa cidduu doono, oo ku cidhiidhiyo (cidduu doono). Arrinkani waxaa ugu sugan calaamooyin ciddii rumeyn.

ayat.arabic: ۞ قُلۡ يَٰعِبَادِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسۡرَفُواْ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمۡ لَا تَقۡنَطُواْ مِن رَّحۡمَةِ ٱللَّهِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَغۡفِرُ ٱلذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعًاۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

en.text: Say, "O My servants who have transgressed against themselves [by sinning], do not despair of the mercy of Allāh. Indeed, Allāh forgives all sins.[1354] Indeed, it is He who is the Forgiving, the Merciful."
en.footnotes: [1354] For those who repent and correct themselves.

so.text: 53. Dheh: Addoomahaygow ku xad-gudbay nafahooda, ha ka quusannina Naxariista Alle. Alle wuu dhaafaa denbiyada oo dhan [11]. Hubaal Alle waa Denbi Dhaaf Badanaha, Naxariista Badan.
so.footnotes: [11]. Waa waxaan ahayn qofkii ku dhinta shirki ama gaalnimo.

ayat.arabic: وَأَنِيبُوٓاْ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمۡ وَأَسۡلِمُواْ لَهُۥ مِن قَبۡلِ أَن يَأۡتِيَكُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابُ ثُمَّ لَا تُنصَرُونَ

en.text: And return [in repentance] to your Lord and submit to Him before the punishment comes upon you; then you will not be helped.

so.text: 54. Oo u noqda xagga Rabbigiin idinkoo tawbad keen ah, una  hoggaansama ka hor intaanu idiin imaan cadaabku, markaasoo aan la idiin gargaareyn.

ayat.arabic: وَٱتَّبِعُوٓاْ أَحۡسَنَ مَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيۡكُم مِّن رَّبِّكُم مِّن قَبۡلِ أَن يَأۡتِيَكُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابُ بَغۡتَةٗ وَأَنتُمۡ لَا تَشۡعُرُونَ

en.text: And follow the best of what was revealed to you from your Lord [i.e., the Qur’ān] before the punishment comes upon you suddenly while you do not perceive,

so.text: 55. Raaca kan wanaagga badan ee la idiinka soo dejiyey xagga Rabbigiin (Qur’aanka), ka hor intaanu kedis idiinku imaan cadaabku, idinkoon dareemeyn.

ayat.arabic: أَن تَقُولَ نَفۡسٞ يَٰحَسۡرَتَىٰ عَلَىٰ مَا فَرَّطتُ فِي جَنۢبِ ٱللَّهِ وَإِن كُنتُ لَمِنَ ٱلسَّٰخِرِينَ

en.text: Lest a soul should say,[1355] "Oh, [how great is] my regret over what I neglected in regard to Allāh and that I was among the mockers."
en.footnotes: [1355] On the Day of Resurrection.

so.text: 56. Si ayan nafi u odhan [12]: Alla waxaan ku gabood falay oo ka gaabiyey caabudidda Alle, waxaana ka mid ahaa kuwa ku jees-jeesa (Xaqa).
so.footnotes: [12]. Maalinta Qiyaamaha

ayat.arabic: أَوۡ تَقُولَ لَوۡ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هَدَىٰنِي لَكُنتُ مِنَ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ

en.text: Or [lest] it say, "If only Allāh had guided me, I would have been among the righteous."

so.text: 57. Ama aysan odhan: Haddii Alle i hanuunin lahaa, waxaan ka mid ahaan lahaa kuwa ka dhowrsada (shirkiga iyo macaasida).

ayat.arabic: أَوۡ تَقُولَ حِينَ تَرَى ٱلۡعَذَابَ لَوۡ أَنَّ لِي كَرَّةٗ فَأَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ

en.text: Or [lest] it say when it sees the punishment, "If only I had another turn[1356] so I could be among the doers of good."
en.footnotes: [1356] At worldly life.

so.text: 58. Ama aysan odhan markay aragto cadaabka: Haddaan heli lahaa hal noqosho oo keliya [13] waxaan ka mid ahaan lahaa sama falayaasha.
so.footnotes: [13]. La i siiyo fursad aan dib ugu laabto adduunka waxaan fali lahaa camallo san.

ayat.arabic: بَلَىٰ قَدۡ جَآءَتۡكَ ءَايَٰتِي فَكَذَّبۡتَ بِهَا وَٱسۡتَكۡبَرۡتَ وَكُنتَ مِنَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ

en.text: But yes, there had come to you My verses, but you denied them and were arrogant, and you were among the disbelievers.

so.text: 59. Haayoo, waxaa kuu yimid Aayadahayga waadse beenisay, oo is kibrisay, waxaadna ka mid ahayd gaalada.

ayat.arabic: وَيَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ تَرَى ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَبُواْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ وُجُوهُهُم مُّسۡوَدَّةٌۚ أَلَيۡسَ فِي جَهَنَّمَ مَثۡوٗى لِّلۡمُتَكَبِّرِينَ

en.text: And on the Day of Resurrection you will see those who lied about Allāh [with] their faces blackened. Is there not in Hell a residence for the arrogant?

so.text: 60. Maalinta Qiyaamana waxaad arki kuwii ka been sheegay Alle [14] oo wejiyadoodu madow yihiin. Miyaanay ugu sugnaan Naarta hoy islaweynayaasha?
so.footnotes: [14]. Ee yidhi wuxuu leeyahay xaas ama ilmo ama shuruko.

ayat.arabic: وَيُنَجِّي ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوۡاْ بِمَفَازَتِهِمۡ لَا يَمَسُّهُمُ ٱلسُّوٓءُ وَلَا هُمۡ يَحۡزَنُونَ

en.text: And Allāh will save those who feared Him by their attainment;[1357] no evil will touch them, nor will they grieve.
en.footnotes: [1357] i.e., their success in the trials of worldly life and attainment of Paradise.

so.text: 61. Wuxuuna Alle (ka) badbaadin (Naar) Kuwa (xumaha) iska jira liibaantooda darteed [15], ma taabato xumaan, mana murugoodaan.
so.footnotes: [15]. Ay ku muteysteen Jannada.

ayat.arabic: ٱللَّهُ خَٰلِقُ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ وَكِيلٞ

en.text: Allāh is the Creator of all things, and He is, over all things, Disposer of affairs.

so.text: 62. Alle waa abuuraha wax walba, wax walbana Isagaa talada u haya oo maamula.

ayat.arabic: لَّهُۥ مَقَالِيدُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۗ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡخَٰسِرُونَ

en.text: To Him belong the keys of the heavens and the earth. And they who disbelieve in the verses of Allāh - it is those who are the losers.

so.text: 63. Isagaa iska leh khaznadaha samooyinka iyo arlada. Kuwana ku gaalooba Aayadaha Alle, kuwaa weeye kuwa khasaaray.

ayat.arabic: قُلۡ أَفَغَيۡرَ ٱللَّهِ تَأۡمُرُوٓنِّيٓ أَعۡبُدُ أَيُّهَا ٱلۡجَٰهِلُونَ

en.text: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Is it other than Allāh that you order me to worship, O ignorant ones?"

so.text: 64. Dheh: Ma waxaan ahayn Alle baad i amreysaan inaan caabudo kuwiinaan jaahilka ahow?

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ أُوحِيَ إِلَيۡكَ وَإِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِكَ لَئِنۡ أَشۡرَكۡتَ لَيَحۡبَطَنَّ عَمَلُكَ وَلَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلۡخَٰسِرِينَ

en.text: And it was already revealed to you and to those before you that if you should associate [anything] with Allāh, your work would surely become worthless, and you would surely be among the losers.

so.text: 65. Waxaa dhab ahaan laguu waxyooday adiga (Nabiyow) iyo kuwii (anbiyadii) kaa horreeyey: Haddaad wax la wadaajiso Alle cibaadada, waxaa xaqiiq buraya camalkaaga, waxaadna xaqiiq ka mid noqon kuwa khasaaray.

ayat.arabic: بَلِ ٱللَّهَ فَٱعۡبُدۡ وَكُن مِّنَ ٱلشَّٰكِرِينَ

en.text: Rather, worship [only] Allāh and be among the grateful.

so.text: 66. Ee Allaah Keliya uun caabud, kana mid ahow kuwa ku mahdiya.

ayat.arabic: وَمَا قَدَرُواْ ٱللَّهَ حَقَّ قَدۡرِهِۦ وَٱلۡأَرۡضُ جَمِيعٗا قَبۡضَتُهُۥ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ وَٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ مَطۡوِيَّٰتُۢ بِيَمِينِهِۦۚ سُبۡحَٰنَهُۥ وَتَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُونَ

en.text: They have not appraised Allāh with true appraisal,[1358] while the earth entirely will be [within] His grip[1359] on the Day of Resurrection, and the heavens will be folded in His right hand.[1360] Exalted is He and high above what they associate with Him.
en.footnotes:
[1358] i.e., appreciation of His attributes.
[1359] Literally, "no more than a handful of His."
[1360] See footnote to 2:19.

so.text: 67. Ma ayan qaddarin Alle qaddarinta uu mudan yahay [16], isagoo dhulka oo dhammi ahaan Qabashadiisa Maalinta Qiyaamaha, samooyinkana ku duuban yihiin Gacantiisa Midig [17]. Xurmoo dhan Isagaa iska leh oo ka hufan (xumaan) waana ka sarreeyaa waxay la wadaajiyaan cibaadada.
so.footnotes:
[16]. Waa ma ay tixgelin tilmaamahiisa wanaagga iyo quruxda badan. 
[17]. Macnaha waa ma aha wax ka badan Sacabkiisa muggiis, oo sidaas bay u yar yihiin xagga Alle.

ayat.arabic: وَنُفِخَ فِي ٱلصُّورِ فَصَعِقَ مَن فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَن فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ إِلَّا مَن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُۖ ثُمَّ نُفِخَ فِيهِ أُخۡرَىٰ فَإِذَا هُمۡ قِيَامٞ يَنظُرُونَ

en.text: And the Horn will be blown, and whoever is in the heavens and whoever is on the earth will fall dead except whom Allāh wills. Then it will be blown again, and at once they will be standing, looking on.

so.text: 68. Waxaa la afuufi Buunka (Qiyaame), markaasay suuxi (dhiman) dhammaan waxa jooga samooyinka iyo dhammaan waxa jooga arlada kuu doono Alle maahee. Misna la afuufi mar kale, mise dadkii wayba taagan yihiin oo sugayaan (Xukunka Alle).

ayat.arabic: وَأَشۡرَقَتِ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ بِنُورِ رَبِّهَا وَوُضِعَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبُ وَجِاْيٓءَ بِٱلنَّبِيِّـۧنَ وَٱلشُّهَدَآءِ وَقُضِيَ بَيۡنَهُم بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَهُمۡ لَا يُظۡلَمُونَ

en.text: And the earth will shine with the light of its Lord, and the record [of deeds] will be placed, and the prophets and the witnesses will be brought, and it will be judged between them in truth, and they will not be wronged.

so.text: 69.Waxayna la ifi arlada Nuurka Rabbigeed, Kitaabka (camallada) baana la soo dhigi, waxaana la keeni Nabiyada iyo markhaatiyada, looguna kala garsoori (addoomaha Alle) dhexdooda si Xaq ah, iyagoon la dulmineyn.

ayat.arabic: وَوُفِّيَتۡ كُلُّ نَفۡسٖ مَّا عَمِلَتۡ وَهُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَا يَفۡعَلُونَ

en.text: And every soul will be fully compensated [for] what it did; and He is most knowing[1361] of what they do.
en.footnotes: [1361] With no need for any record or witnesses, which are but means to establish proof to the soul itself in addition to its own knowledge of what it has done.

so.text: 70. Naf walbana waxaa loogu oofin si dhan waxay fashay; Isagaana (Alle) dhab u Ogsoon waxay camal falaan [18].
so.footnotes: [18]. Waa wax uu aad u Ogsoon yahay, mana u baahna qoritaan iyo markhaati.

ayat.arabic: وَسِيقَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ زُمَرًاۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءُوهَا فُتِحَتۡ أَبۡوَٰبُهَا وَقَالَ لَهُمۡ خَزَنَتُهَآ أَلَمۡ يَأۡتِكُمۡ رُسُلٞ مِّنكُمۡ يَتۡلُونَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّكُمۡ وَيُنذِرُونَكُمۡ لِقَآءَ يَوۡمِكُمۡ هَٰذَاۚ قَالُواْ بَلَىٰ وَلَٰكِنۡ حَقَّتۡ كَلِمَةُ ٱلۡعَذَابِ عَلَى ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ

en.text: And those who disbelieved will be driven to Hell in groups until, when they reach it, its gates are opened and its keepers will say, "Did there not come to you messengers from yourselves, reciting to you the verses of your Lord and warning you of the meeting of this Day of yours?" They will say, "Yes, but the word [i.e., decree] of punishment has come into effect upon the disbelievers."

so.text: 71. Waxaana loo kaxeyn kuwii gaaloobay xagga Jahannama iyagoo rac-rac (wada jira) ah,  markay yimaadaan (Naartana) waxaa la furaa Albaabbadeeda. Furahayeennadeeduna waxay ku odhan: Miyeyna idiin iman Rusul idinka mid ah oo idiin akhirayaya Aayaadka Rabbigiin, idiinkana digaya la kulanka Maalintiinnaan? Waxay odhan:Haah, waxaase ku rumowday Kelmedda cadaabka gaalada dushooda.

ayat.arabic: قِيلَ ٱدۡخُلُوٓاْ أَبۡوَٰبَ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَاۖ فَبِئۡسَ مَثۡوَى ٱلۡمُتَكَبِّرِينَ

en.text: [To them] it will be said, "Enter the gates of Hell to abide eternally therein, and wretched is the residence of the arrogant."

so.text: 72. Waxaa la odhan: Gala albaabbada Jahannama idinkoo ku waaraya, maxay ahaatay meel xun oo baas hoyga islaweynayaasha.

ayat.arabic: وَسِيقَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوۡاْ رَبَّهُمۡ إِلَى ٱلۡجَنَّةِ زُمَرًاۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءُوهَا وَفُتِحَتۡ أَبۡوَٰبُهَا وَقَالَ لَهُمۡ خَزَنَتُهَا سَلَٰمٌ عَلَيۡكُمۡ طِبۡتُمۡ فَٱدۡخُلُوهَا خَٰلِدِينَ

en.text: But those who feared their Lord will be driven to Paradise in groups until, when they reach it while its gates have been opened and its keepers say, "Peace be upon you; you have become pure; so enter it to abide eternally therein," [they will enter].[1362]
en.footnotes: [1362] In such honor and joy that is beyond description - thus, the omission of this conclusion in the Arabic text.

so.text: 73. Waxaa loo kaxeyn kuwii dhowray (amarrada) Rabbigood (oo iska jiray xumaha) xagga Jannada, iyagoo rac-rac (wada jira) ah, markay ku yimaadaan waxay la kulmi iyadoo la furay albaabbadeeda [19] (mar hore soo dhoweyn ahaan), furahayeennadeeduna waxay ku odhan: Nabadi korkiinna ha ahaato, waad wanaagsan tihiine,  gala Jannada idinkoo ku waari dhexdeeda [20].
so.footnotes:
[19]. Furaha jannada waa ashahaadada (Laa ilaaha illal laah). 
[20]. Iyagoo heli soo dhoweyn sare, sharfid, iyo maamusid aan la tilmaami karin.

ayat.arabic: وَقَالُواْ ٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي صَدَقَنَا وَعۡدَهُۥ وَأَوۡرَثَنَا ٱلۡأَرۡضَ نَتَبَوَّأُ مِنَ ٱلۡجَنَّةِ حَيۡثُ نَشَآءُۖ فَنِعۡمَ أَجۡرُ ٱلۡعَٰمِلِينَ

en.text: And they will say, "Praise to Allāh, who has fulfilled for us His promise and made us inherit the earth [so] we may settle in Paradise wherever we will. And excellent is the reward of [righteous] workers."

so.text: 74. Waxayna odhan: Ammaan idilkeed iyo mahad waxaa leh Allaah, ee nooga dhabeeyey Ballan qaadkiisa, oo na dhaxal siiyey dhulka (Jannada). Waxaan ka degnaa Jannada meeshaan doonno, ee fiicanaa abaalgudka kuwa camal san fashay.

ayat.arabic: وَتَرَى ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ حَآفِّينَ مِنۡ حَوۡلِ ٱلۡعَرۡشِ يُسَبِّحُونَ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّهِمۡۚ وَقُضِيَ بَيۡنَهُم بِٱلۡحَقِّۚ وَقِيلَ ٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

en.text: And you will see the angels surrounding the Throne, exalting [Allāh] with praise of their Lord. And it will be judged between them in truth, and it will be said, "[All] praise to Allāh, Lord of the worlds."

so.text: 75. Waxaad arkaysaa malaa’igtoo ku wareegsan Carshiga hareerihiisa iyagoo ku tasbiixsanaya ammaanaha Rabbigood;  waana loo kala garsoori (addoomaha) dhexdooda si xaq ah, waxaana la odhan: Ammaan idilkeed iyo mahad waxaa leh Allaah, Rabbiga uumanka.

ayat.arabic: حمٓ

en.text: Ḥā, Meem.[1364]
en.footnotes: [1364] See footnote to 2:1.

so.text: 1. Xaa Miim [1].
so.footnotes: [1]. Eeg sharaxa hoose ee Suuradda 2 Al-Baqarah: Aayadda 1

ayat.arabic: تَنزِيلُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡعَلِيمِ

en.text: The revelation of the Book [i.e., the Qur’ān] is from Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Knowing,

so.text: 2. Soo dejinta Kitaabka (Qur’aanka) waa Xagga Alle, Adkaadaha Sare, wax kasta Ogsoonaha ah.

ayat.arabic: غَافِرِ ٱلذَّنۢبِ وَقَابِلِ ٱلتَّوۡبِ شَدِيدِ ٱلۡعِقَابِ ذِي ٱلطَّوۡلِۖ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۖ إِلَيۡهِ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ

en.text: The forgiver of sin, acceptor of repentance, severe in punishment, owner of abundance. There is no deity except Him; to Him is the destination.

so.text: 3. Denbi dhaafaha, Tawbad aqbalaha,  Daran yahay Ciqaabkiisu, Rabbiga Nicmadda Badan. Ma jiro ilaah (Xaq lagu caabudo) aan Isaga aheyn. Waa Xaggiisa meel Noqodka Dambe.

ayat.arabic: مَا يُجَٰدِلُ فِيٓ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فَلَا يَغۡرُرۡكَ تَقَلُّبُهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡبِلَٰدِ

en.text: No one disputes concerning the signs of Allāh except those who disbelieve, so be not deceived by their [uninhibited] movement throughout the land.

so.text: 4. Cidina kama dooddo Aayadaha Alle aan ahayn kuwa gaalooba. Ee yeysan ku hodin gadgaddoonkooda iyo galoobaxooda magaalooyinka.

ayat.arabic: كَذَّبَتۡ قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمُ نُوحٖ وَٱلۡأَحۡزَابُ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِمۡۖ وَهَمَّتۡ كُلُّ أُمَّةِۭ بِرَسُولِهِمۡ لِيَأۡخُذُوهُۖ وَجَٰدَلُواْ بِٱلۡبَٰطِلِ لِيُدۡحِضُواْ بِهِ ٱلۡحَقَّ فَأَخَذۡتُهُمۡۖ فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عِقَابِ

en.text: The people of Noah denied before them and the [disbelieving] factions after them, and every nation intended [a plot] for their messenger to seize him, and they disputed by [using] falsehood to [attempt to] invalidate thereby the truth. So I seized them, and how [terrible] was My penalty.

so.text: 5. Qoladii Nuux iyo xizbiyadii ka dambeeyay (sida Caad, Thamuud, iwm) baa beeniyey (anbiyadii Alle) iyaga hortood, ummad walbana waxay doontay Rasuulkoodii inay qabato (oo ay dilaan), waxayna ku doodeen baadil si ay ugu tirtiraan Xaqa, markaasaan qabtay, ee siduu mid daran u ahaa Ciqaabkaygii (aan ku ciqaabay kuwa Xaqa beeniyey).

ayat.arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ حَقَّتۡ كَلِمَتُ رَبِّكَ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ أَنَّهُمۡ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ

en.text: And thus has the word [i.e., decree] of your Lord come into effect upon those who disbelieved that they are companions of the Fire.

so.text: 6. Sidaasay Kelmedda Rabbigaa (Ciqaabtiisu) ugu waajibtay kuwa gaalooba inay yihiin ehlu-Naarka.

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَحۡمِلُونَ ٱلۡعَرۡشَ وَمَنۡ حَوۡلَهُۥ يُسَبِّحُونَ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّهِمۡ وَيُؤۡمِنُونَ بِهِۦ وَيَسۡتَغۡفِرُونَ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْۖ رَبَّنَا وَسِعۡتَ كُلَّ شَيۡءٖ رَّحۡمَةٗ وَعِلۡمٗا فَٱغۡفِرۡ لِلَّذِينَ تَابُواْ وَٱتَّبَعُواْ سَبِيلَكَ وَقِهِمۡ عَذَابَ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ

en.text: Those [angels] who carry the Throne and those around it exalt [Allāh] with praise of their Lord and believe in Him and ask forgiveness for those who have believed, [saying], "Our Lord, You have encompassed all things in mercy and knowledge, so forgive those who have repented and followed Your way and protect them from the punishment of Hellfire.

so.text: 7. Kuwa sida Carshiga iyo kuwa hareera jooga (ee Malaai'gta ah) waxay ku tasbiixsadaan ammaanaha Rabbigood oo ay rumaysan yihiin, waxayna u denbi dhaaf dalbaan mu'miniinta (iyagoo leh): Rabbigayow! Waxaad ku koobtaa wax walba Naxariis iyo cilmi ee u denbi dhaaf kuwa tawbad keena oo raaca Jidkaaga, kana dhowr Cadaabta Naarta ololeysa.

ayat.arabic: رَبَّنَا وَأَدۡخِلۡهُمۡ جَنَّٰتِ عَدۡنٍ ٱلَّتِي وَعَدتَّهُمۡ وَمَن صَلَحَ مِنۡ ءَابَآئِهِمۡ وَأَزۡوَٰجِهِمۡ وَذُرِّيَّٰتِهِمۡۚ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ

en.text: Our Lord, and admit them to gardens of perpetual residence which You have promised them and whoever was righteous among their forefathers, their spouses and their offspring. Indeed, it is You who is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

so.text: 8. Rabbigayow! Gali kuwaasi Beeraha negaya (Jannada) ee aad u ballan qaadday, iyo kuwa wanaagsan oo ka mid ah aabbayaashood iyo xaasaskooda iyo ubadkooda. Waxaad Adigu tahay (Allow) Adkaadaha Sarreeya, Xakiimka ah.

ayat.arabic: وَقِهِمُ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِۚ وَمَن تَقِ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ يَوۡمَئِذٖ فَقَدۡ رَحِمۡتَهُۥۚ وَذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡعَظِيمُ

en.text: And protect them from the evil consequences [of their deeds]. And he whom You protect from evil consequences that Day - You will have given him mercy. And that is the great attainment."

so.text: 9. Oo ka dhowr xumo oo dhan, qofka aad ka dhowrto xumo Maalintaa, waad u naxariistay, taasina waa Liibaanta Weyn.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ يُنَادَوۡنَ لَمَقۡتُ ٱللَّهِ أَكۡبَرُ مِن مَّقۡتِكُمۡ أَنفُسَكُمۡ إِذۡ تُدۡعَوۡنَ إِلَى ٱلۡإِيمَٰنِ فَتَكۡفُرُونَ

en.text: Indeed, those who disbelieve will be addressed, "The hatred of Allāh for you was [even] greater than your hatred of yourselves [this Day in Hell] when you were invited to faith, but you disbelieved [i.e., refused]."

so.text: 10. Hubaal, kuwa gaalooba waxaa loogu dhawaaqi: Naceybka Alle idiin qabay (xilligii adduunka) ayaa ka weynaa naceybka aad hadda u qabtaan nafahiinna, iyadoo la idiinku yeedhay Iimaanka aadse diiddeen.

ayat.arabic: قَالُواْ رَبَّنَآ أَمَتَّنَا ٱثۡنَتَيۡنِ وَأَحۡيَيۡتَنَا ٱثۡنَتَيۡنِ فَٱعۡتَرَفۡنَا بِذُنُوبِنَا فَهَلۡ إِلَىٰ خُرُوجٖ مِّن سَبِيلٖ

en.text: They will say, "Our Lord, You made us lifeless twice and gave us life twice, and we have confessed our sins. So is there to an exit any way?"

so.text: 11. Waxay odhan: Rabbigayow! Waxaad naga yeeshay meyd (aan nafi ku jirin) labo jeer, oo na siisay nolol labo jeer [2]. waan qirsannahay dunuubtayada’e, ee ma jiraa jid looga baxo (Naarta)?
so.footnotes: [2]. Meyd labo jeer waa markuu qofka ku jiray uurka hooyadi ka hor intaan nafta la gelin iyo markuu dhinto. Nolol labo jeer waa marka nafta la geliyo isagoo uurka hooyadi ku jira iyo Aakhirada marka la soo nooleeyo dhimasho kaddib.

ayat.arabic: ذَٰلِكُم بِأَنَّهُۥٓ إِذَا دُعِيَ ٱللَّهُ وَحۡدَهُۥ كَفَرۡتُمۡ وَإِن يُشۡرَكۡ بِهِۦ تُؤۡمِنُواْۚ فَٱلۡحُكۡمُ لِلَّهِ ٱلۡعَلِيِّ ٱلۡكَبِيرِ

en.text: [They will be told], "That is because, when Allāh was called upon alone, you disbelieved; but if others were associated with Him, you believed. So the judgement is with Allāh, the Most High, the Grand."

so.text: 12. (Cadaab)kaasi (aad mudateen gaaloy) waxaa u sabab ah marka la idiinku yeedho Towxiidka iyo in Alle loo Keliya yeelo cibaadada aad gaalowdaan, markase loo shariig yeelo aad rumaysaan. Xukunka waxaa iska leh Allaah, Sarreeyaha, Weyn.

ayat.arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِي يُرِيكُمۡ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ وَيُنَزِّلُ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ رِزۡقٗاۚ وَمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ إِلَّا مَن يُنِيبُ

en.text: It is He who shows you His signs and sends down to you from the sky, provision. But none will remember except he who turns back [in repentance].

so.text: 13. (Alle waa) Kan idin tusiya Calaamooyin- kiisa oo idiinka soo dejiya risiq (roob) samada, cidise kuma waantowdo aan ahayn kawa u laabashada badan (Alle) ee tawbad keenka badan.

ayat.arabic: فَٱدۡعُواْ ٱللَّهَ مُخۡلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ وَلَوۡ كَرِهَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ

en.text: So invoke Allāh, [being] sincere to Him in religion, although the disbelievers dislike it.

so.text: 14. Ee barya Allaah (Keliya) idinkoo u gaar yeelaya cibaadada, haba naceen gaaladuye.

ayat.arabic: رَفِيعُ ٱلدَّرَجَٰتِ ذُو ٱلۡعَرۡشِ يُلۡقِي ٱلرُّوحَ مِنۡ أَمۡرِهِۦ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنۡ عِبَادِهِۦ لِيُنذِرَ يَوۡمَ ٱلتَّلَاقِ

en.text: [He is] the Exalted above [all] degrees, Owner of the Throne; He places the inspiration of His command [i.e., revelation] upon whom He wills of His servants to warn of the Day of Meeting.

so.text: 15. (Alle) waa Kan iska leh Darajada ugu Sarreysa ee Kaamilka ah, waa Rabbiga Carshiga (Weyn). Wuxuu ku soo dejiyaa waxyiga Amarkiisa ah qofkuu doono oo ka mid ah Addoomahiisa si uu ugaga digo (dadka) Maalinta kulanka (Qiyaamada).

ayat.arabic: يَوۡمَ هُم بَٰرِزُونَۖ لَا يَخۡفَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ مِنۡهُمۡ شَيۡءٞۚ لِّمَنِ ٱلۡمُلۡكُ ٱلۡيَوۡمَۖ لِلَّهِ ٱلۡوَٰحِدِ ٱلۡقَهَّارِ

en.text: The Day they come forth nothing concerning them will be concealed from Allāh. To whom belongs [all] sovereignty this Day? To Allāh, the One, the Prevailing.[1365]
en.footnotes: [1365] Refer to footnotes in 12:39.

so.text: 16. Maalinta banka la keeni, ma jiro wax xaggooda ah oo ka qarsoon Alle: Yaa leh Boqortooyada Maanta? Allaah, Waaxidka, Sandulleeyaha (daalimiinta iyo isla weynayaasha).

ayat.arabic: ٱلۡيَوۡمَ تُجۡزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفۡسِۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتۡۚ لَا ظُلۡمَ ٱلۡيَوۡمَۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَرِيعُ ٱلۡحِسَابِ

en.text: This Day every soul will be recompensed for what it earned. No injustice today! Indeed, Allāh is swift in account.

so.text: 17. Maalinta (Qiyaamaha) naf walba waxaa lagu abaal marin waxay kasbatay (khayr ama shar), dulmi ma jiro Maalintaa [3]. Hubaal, Alle wuu ku Dhaqso badan yahay xisaabinta.
so.footnotes: [3]. Xadiis qudsi ah:  Alle  wuxuu yidhi: “Addoomaheygow aniga waan iska xaaraanshay dulmiga, waxaana ka yeelay xaaraan dhexdiinna ee ha is dulmina".

ayat.arabic: وَأَنذِرۡهُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡأٓزِفَةِ إِذِ ٱلۡقُلُوبُ لَدَى ٱلۡحَنَاجِرِ كَٰظِمِينَۚ مَا لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ مِنۡ حَمِيمٖ وَلَا شَفِيعٖ يُطَاعُ

en.text: And warn them, [O Muḥammad], of the Approaching Day, when hearts are at the throats, filled [with distress]. For the wrongdoers there will be no devoted friend and no intercessor [who is] obeyed.

so.text: 18. Uga dig Maalinta dhow, markay quluubtu iman dhuumaha (cabsi darteed) iyagoo walbahaarsan. Ma leh daalimiinta saaxiib iyo shafeece midna la maqlayo.

ayat.arabic: يَعۡلَمُ خَآئِنَةَ ٱلۡأَعۡيُنِ وَمَا تُخۡفِي ٱلصُّدُورُ

en.text: He knows that which deceives the eyes and what the breasts conceal.

so.text: 19. (Alle) Wuu Og yahay khiyaanada isha loo dabo iyo waxay laabuhu qarsadaanba.

ayat.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ يَقۡضِي بِٱلۡحَقِّۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ يَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِهِۦ لَا يَقۡضُونَ بِشَيۡءٍۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡبَصِيرُ

en.text: And Allāh judges with truth, while those they invoke[1366] besides Him judge not with anything. Indeed, Allāh - He is the Hearing, the Seeing.
en.footnotes: [1366] In worship.

so.text: 20. Alle wuxuu wax ku xukumaa Xaq, kuwase ay u yeedhaan Isaga sokadi, ma xukumi karaan waxba. Hubaal, Alle, waa wax kasta Maqlaha, wax kasta Arka.

ayat.arabic: ۞ أَوَلَمۡ يَسِيرُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَيَنظُرُواْ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَانُواْ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡۚ كَانُواْ هُمۡ أَشَدَّ مِنۡهُمۡ قُوَّةٗ وَءَاثَارٗا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِذُنُوبِهِمۡ وَمَا كَانَ لَهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَاقٖ

en.text: Have they not traveled through the land and observed how was the end of those who were before them? They were greater than them in strength and in impression on the land, but Allāh seized them for their sins. And they had not from Allāh any protector.

so.text: 21. Miyeyna marin dhulka oo fiirin siday aheyd cidhibta kuwii ka horreeyey? Waxay ahaayeen kuwo ka xoog badan oo ka camiraad badan arlada, wuxuuse Alle u qabtay denbiyaday faleen. Umana sugnaan iyaga wax Alle ka difaaca.

ayat.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمۡ كَانَت تَّأۡتِيهِمۡ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِ فَكَفَرُواْ فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱللَّهُۚ إِنَّهُۥ قَوِيّٞ شَدِيدُ ٱلۡعِقَابِ

en.text: That was because their messengers were coming to them with clear proofs, but they disbelieved, so Allāh seized them. Indeed, He is Powerful and severe in punishment.

so.text: 22. (Cadaab)kaasi waxaa ugu wacan waxay ula yimaadeen Rusushoodii xujooyin cad, wayse gaaloobeen. Markaa Alle baa qabtay. Hubaal waa Xoog Badane, Ciqaabkiisu daran yahay.

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مُوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَسُلۡطَٰنٖ مُّبِينٍ

en.text: And We did certainly send Moses with Our signs and a clear authority[1367]
en.footnotes: [1367] i.e., evidences from Allāh.

so.text: 23. Waxaanu dhab ahaan la dirnay Muuse Aayadahayaga iyo awood cad.

ayat.arabic: إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَهَٰمَٰنَ وَقَٰرُونَ فَقَالُواْ سَٰحِرٞ كَذَّابٞ

en.text: To Pharaoh, Hāmān and Qārūn, but they said, "[He is] a magician and a liar."

so.text: 24. Xagga Fircoon iyo Haamaan iyo Qaaruun, waxayse yidhaahdeen: (waa) Saaxir, beenaale ah.

ayat.arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم بِٱلۡحَقِّ مِنۡ عِندِنَا قَالُواْ ٱقۡتُلُوٓاْ أَبۡنَآءَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ مَعَهُۥ وَٱسۡتَحۡيُواْ نِسَآءَهُمۡۚ وَمَا كَيۡدُ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ إِلَّا فِي ضَلَٰلٖ

en.text: And when he brought them the truth from Us, they said, "Kill the sons of those who have believed with him and keep their women alive." But the plan of the disbelievers is not except in error.

so.text: 25. Markuu u keenay Xaqa ka yimid Xaggayaga waxay yidhaahdeen: Dila wiilasha kuwa (xaqa) rumeeyey la jirki una daaya haweenkooda nolol (si aad ugu adeegataan oo u addoonsataan). Dhagarta gaaladu ma aha waxaan ahayn (wax ku dhammaada) khasaaro iyo fashil.

ayat.arabic: وَقَالَ فِرۡعَوۡنُ ذَرُونِيٓ أَقۡتُلۡ مُوسَىٰ وَلۡيَدۡعُ رَبَّهُۥٓۖ إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ أَن يُبَدِّلَ دِينَكُمۡ أَوۡ أَن يُظۡهِرَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ ٱلۡفَسَادَ

en.text: And Pharaoh said, "Let me kill Moses and let him call upon his Lord. Indeed, I fear that he will change your religion or that he will cause corruption[1368] in the land."
en.footnotes: [1368] i.e., dissension or civil strife.

so.text: 26. Fircoon wuxuu yidhi: I daaya aan dilee Muuse, hana u yeedho Rabbigiis, waxaan ka cabsan inuu idinka beddelo diintiinna ama uu ka muujiyo arlada fasahaad [4].
so.footnotes: [4]. Tafaraaruq idin geliyo ama dagaal sokeeye.

ayat.arabic: وَقَالَ مُوسَىٰٓ إِنِّي عُذۡتُ بِرَبِّي وَرَبِّكُم مِّن كُلِّ مُتَكَبِّرٖ لَّا يُؤۡمِنُ بِيَوۡمِ ٱلۡحِسَابِ

en.text: But Moses said, "Indeed, I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord from every arrogant one who does not believe in the Day of Account."

so.text: 27. Wuxuu Muuse yidhi: Anigu Waxaan ka magan galay Rabbigay iyo Rabbigiinba mid kastoo islaweyn oo aan rumaysnayn Maalinta Xisaabta (Qiyaamada).

ayat.arabic: وَقَالَ رَجُلٞ مُّؤۡمِنٞ مِّنۡ ءَالِ فِرۡعَوۡنَ يَكۡتُمُ إِيمَٰنَهُۥٓ أَتَقۡتُلُونَ رَجُلًا أَن يَقُولَ رَبِّيَ ٱللَّهُ وَقَدۡ جَآءَكُم بِٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِ مِن رَّبِّكُمۡۖ وَإِن يَكُ كَٰذِبٗا فَعَلَيۡهِ كَذِبُهُۥۖ وَإِن يَكُ صَادِقٗا يُصِبۡكُم بَعۡضُ ٱلَّذِي يَعِدُكُمۡۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهۡدِي مَنۡ هُوَ مُسۡرِفٞ كَذَّابٞ

en.text: And a believing man from the family of Pharaoh who concealed his faith said, "Do you kill a man [merely] because he says, 'My Lord is Allāh' while he has brought you clear proofs from your Lord? And if he should be lying, then upon him is [the consequence of] his lie; but if he should be truthful, there will strike you some of what he promises you. Indeed, Allāh does not guide one who is a transgressor and a liar.

so.text: 28. Nin mu’min ah oo ka mid ah reer Fircoon [5] oo qarsanayey Iimaankiisa wuxuu yidhi: Ma waxaad ku dileysaan nin sababta ah inuu yidhi: Rabbigay waa Allaah, wuxuuna idiinka keenay Xujooyin Cad xagga Rabbigiin? Hadduu been sheegayo, isagay dhibi beentiisu; haddiise uu run sheegayo, waxaa idinku dhici qaar waxaa uu idinku gooddiyo. Hubaal Alle ma hanuuniyo mid ah xad gudbe, been badne.
so.footnotes: [5]. Waa Xizqil, Fircoon ina Adeerki,  khaznad hayahii dawladda.

ayat.arabic: يَٰقَوۡمِ لَكُمُ ٱلۡمُلۡكُ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ ظَٰهِرِينَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَمَن يَنصُرُنَا مِنۢ بَأۡسِ ٱللَّهِ إِن جَآءَنَاۚ قَالَ فِرۡعَوۡنُ مَآ أُرِيكُمۡ إِلَّا مَآ أَرَىٰ وَمَآ أَهۡدِيكُمۡ إِلَّا سَبِيلَ ٱلرَّشَادِ

en.text: O my people, sovereignty is yours today, [your being] dominant in the land. But who would protect us from the punishment of Allāh if it came to us?" Pharaoh said, "I do not show you except what I see, and I do not guide you except to the way of right conduct."

so.text: 29. Tolkayow! Idinkaa leh xukunka maanta, una adag arlada. Yaase nooga gargaari Ciqaabka Alle hadduu noo yimaado. Fircoon wuxuu yidhi: Idin tusi maayo waxaan aheyn waxaan anigu u arko wanaag, idinkumana hanuuniyo waxaan aheyn dhabbaha toosan ee abbaarta ah.

ayat.arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِيٓ ءَامَنَ يَٰقَوۡمِ إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيۡكُم مِّثۡلَ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡأَحۡزَابِ

en.text: And he who believed said, "O my people, indeed I fear for you [a fate] like the day of the companies[1369] -
en.footnotes: [1369] i.e., the days on which Allāh sent His punishment upon those who rejected their prophets in former times.

so.text: 30. Kii rumeeyey (Xaqa) wuxuu yidhi: Tolkayow! Waxaan idiinka cabsan sidii Maalintii xizbiyadii [6].
so.footnotes: [6]. Waa maalmaha uu Alle u soo diro Ciqaabkiisa kuwaasi diiday nabiyadii loo soo diray .

ayat.arabic: مِثۡلَ دَأۡبِ قَوۡمِ نُوحٖ وَعَادٖ وَثَمُودَ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِمۡۚ وَمَا ٱللَّهُ يُرِيدُ ظُلۡمٗا لِّلۡعِبَادِ

en.text: Like the custom of the people of Noah and of ʿAad and Thamūd and those after them. And Allāh wants no injustice for [His] servants.

so.text: 31. Wixii ku dhacay oo kale qolodii Nuux, Caad, Thamuud, iyo kuwii ka dambeeyey. Alle ma aha mid la doona dulmi addoomahiisa oo ku gardarrooda.

ayat.arabic: وَيَٰقَوۡمِ إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلتَّنَادِ

en.text: And O my people, indeed I fear for you the Day of Calling[1370] -
en.footnotes: [1370] i.e., the Day of Judgement, when the criminals will cry out in terror, the people will call to each other (see 7:44-51), and the angels will call out the results of each person's judgement.

so.text: 32. Tolkaygow! Waxaan anigu idiinka cabsan Maalinta isu Yeeridda [7].
so.footnotes: [7]. Waa maalinta Qiyaamaha, markay denbiilayaasha la qeylin argarax, dadku waa isu yeeran goobta Qiyaamaha iyagoo in loo shafeeco raba.

ayat.arabic: يَوۡمَ تُوَلُّونَ مُدۡبِرِينَ مَا لَكُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ مِنۡ عَاصِمٖۗ وَمَن يُضۡلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِنۡ هَادٖ

en.text: The Day you will turn your backs fleeing; there is not for you from Allāh any protector. And whoever Allāh sends astray - there is not for him any guide.

so.text: 33. Maalinta aad jeedin dhabarradiinna idinkoo carari, ma jiro wax idinka badbaadin Alle. Qofkuu Alle lumiyo ma uu laha wax hanuunin.

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَكُمۡ يُوسُفُ مِن قَبۡلُ بِٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِ فَمَا زِلۡتُمۡ فِي شَكّٖ مِّمَّا جَآءَكُم بِهِۦۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا هَلَكَ قُلۡتُمۡ لَن يَبۡعَثَ ٱللَّهُ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِۦ رَسُولٗاۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَنۡ هُوَ مُسۡرِفٞ مُّرۡتَابٌ

en.text: And Joseph had already come to you before with clear proofs, but you remained in doubt of that which he brought to you, until when he died, you said, 'Never will Allāh send a messenger after him.' Thus does Allāh leave astray he who is a transgressor and skeptic."

so.text: 34. Wuxuu dhab ahaan Yuusuf idiinla yimid mar hore Xujooyin cad, kamase bixin shakigii aad ka qabteen wuxuu idiin keenay, jeer markuu dhintay aad tidhaahdeen: Alle ma soo dirayo wax Rasuul ah isaga kadambow. Sidaasuu Alle u lumiyaa kan ah xad gudbe, shaki qabeen.

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يُجَٰدِلُونَ فِيٓ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ بِغَيۡرِ سُلۡطَٰنٍ أَتَىٰهُمۡۖ كَبُرَ مَقۡتًا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَعِندَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يَطۡبَعُ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ قَلۡبِ مُتَكَبِّرٖ جَبَّارٖ

en.text: Those who dispute concerning the signs of Allāh without an authority[1371] having come to them - great is hatred [of them] in the sight of Allāh and in the sight of those who have believed. Thus does Allāh seal over every heart [belonging to] an arrogant tyrant.
en.footnotes: [1371] i.e., evidence.

so.text: 35. Kuwa ka dooda Aayadaha Alle iyagoon heysan wax xujo ah uu siiyey, waa wax uu Alle aad u neceb yahay (ka doodkaasi) oo (sidoo kale ay neceb yihiin) mu'miniinta. Sidaasuu Alle u daboolaa qalbiga mid kastoo ah islaweyne, jujuubaa.

ayat.arabic: وَقَالَ فِرۡعَوۡنُ يَٰهَٰمَٰنُ ٱبۡنِ لِي صَرۡحٗا لَّعَلِّيٓ أَبۡلُغُ ٱلۡأَسۡبَٰبَ

en.text: And Pharaoh said, "O Hāmān, construct for me a tower that I might reach the ways[1372] -
en.footnotes: [1372] Means of ascent, pathways.

so.text: 36. Fircoon wuxuu yidhi: Haamaanow! Ii dhis sar dheer si aan ugu gaadho waddooyinka [8].
so.footnotes: [8]. Waa siyaabo kor lagu aado.

ayat.arabic: أَسۡبَٰبَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ فَأَطَّلِعَ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَٰهِ مُوسَىٰ وَإِنِّي لَأَظُنُّهُۥ كَٰذِبٗاۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ زُيِّنَ لِفِرۡعَوۡنَ سُوٓءُ عَمَلِهِۦ وَصُدَّ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِۚ وَمَا كَيۡدُ فِرۡعَوۡنَ إِلَّا فِي تَبَابٖ

en.text: The ways into the heavens - so that I may look at the deity of Moses; but indeed, I think he is a liar." And thus was made attractive to Pharaoh the evil of his deed, and he was averted from the [right] way. And the plan of Pharaoh was not except in ruin.

so.text: 37. Waddooyinka loo maro cirarka, si aan u soo dhugto ilaaha Muuse; waxaana u maleyn inuu yahay beenaale. Sidaasaa xumaanta camalkiisa loogu qurxiyey Fircoon, loogana duway Jidka (Toosan).  Ma ahayn dhagartii Fircoon waxaan ahayn (wax ku dhammaada) baabba’a isaga ku dhacay.

ayat.arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِيٓ ءَامَنَ يَٰقَوۡمِ ٱتَّبِعُونِ أَهۡدِكُمۡ سَبِيلَ ٱلرَّشَادِ

en.text: And he who believed said, "O my people, follow me; I will guide you to the way of right conduct.

so.text: 38. Oo kii (Xaqa) rumeeyey wuxuu yidhi: Tolkayow i soo raaca, waxaan idinku hagi Jidka hanuunka.

ayat.arabic: يَٰقَوۡمِ إِنَّمَا هَٰذِهِ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنۡيَا مَتَٰعٞ وَإِنَّ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةَ هِيَ دَارُ ٱلۡقَرَارِ

en.text: O my people, this worldly life is only [temporary] enjoyment, and indeed, the Hereafter - that is the home of [permanent] settlement.

so.text: 39. Tolkayow! Noloshan Adduunka waa uun raaxo (yar oo tageysa), Aakhiradaana ah Daarta negaadiga.

ayat.arabic: مَنۡ عَمِلَ سَيِّئَةٗ فَلَا يُجۡزَىٰٓ إِلَّا مِثۡلَهَاۖ وَمَنۡ عَمِلَ صَٰلِحٗا مِّن ذَكَرٍ أَوۡ أُنثَىٰ وَهُوَ مُؤۡمِنٞ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ يَدۡخُلُونَ ٱلۡجَنَّةَ يُرۡزَقُونَ فِيهَا بِغَيۡرِ حِسَابٖ

en.text: Whoever does an evil deed will not be recompensed except by the like thereof; but whoever does righteousness, whether male or female, while he is a believer - those will enter Paradise, being given provision therein without account.

so.text: 40. Qofkii falaa camal xun, laguma abaal mariyo waxaan aheyn wax la mid ah. Qofkiise fala wanaag lab ama dheddig oo mu’min ah, kuwaa waxay geli Jannada, iyagoo lagu arsaaqi xisaab la’aan.

ayat.arabic: ۞ وَيَٰقَوۡمِ مَا لِيٓ أَدۡعُوكُمۡ إِلَى ٱلنَّجَوٰةِ وَتَدۡعُونَنِيٓ إِلَى ٱلنَّارِ

en.text: And O my people, how is it that I invite you to salvation while you invite me to the Fire?

so.text: 41. Tolkayow! Maxaa ugu wacan inaan idiinku yeedho badbaadada, halkaad iigu yeedhaan Naar.

ayat.arabic: تَدۡعُونَنِي لِأَكۡفُرَ بِٱللَّهِ وَأُشۡرِكَ بِهِۦ مَا لَيۡسَ لِي بِهِۦ عِلۡمٞ وَأَنَا۠ أَدۡعُوكُمۡ إِلَى ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡغَفَّٰرِ

en.text: You invite me to disbelieve in Allāh and associate with Him that of which I have no knowledge, and I invite you to the Exalted in Might, the Perpetual Forgiver.[1373]
en.footnotes: [1373] Refer to footnotes in 38:66.

so.text: 42. Waxaad iigu yeedhaan inaan ku gaa- loobo Alle oo la wadaajiyo (cibaadada) wax aan u heysan wax cilmi ah, aniguna waxaan idiinku yeedhaa xagga (Allaah) Adkaadaha Sarreeya, Denbi Dhaafka Badan.

ayat.arabic: لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّمَا تَدۡعُونَنِيٓ إِلَيۡهِ لَيۡسَ لَهُۥ دَعۡوَةٞ فِي ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَلَا فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ وَأَنَّ مَرَدَّنَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَأَنَّ ٱلۡمُسۡرِفِينَ هُمۡ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ

en.text: Assuredly, that to which you invite me has no [response to a] supplication in this world or in the Hereafter; and indeed, our return is to Allāh, and indeed, the transgressors will be companions of the Fire.

so.text: 43. Shaki ma leh, waxaad iigu yeedheysaan Xaggiisa ma hayaan (dhib iyo dheef) loogu yeedho adduun iyo aakhiraba, waxaana laynoo celin xagga Alle, kuwa ahna xad gudbayaasha waa iyaga uun Ehlu-Naarka.

ayat.arabic: فَسَتَذۡكُرُونَ مَآ أَقُولُ لَكُمۡۚ وَأُفَوِّضُ أَمۡرِيٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بَصِيرُۢ بِٱلۡعِبَادِ

en.text: And you will remember what I [now] say to you, and I entrust my affair to Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is Seeing of [His] servants."

so.text: 44. Marka waad xusuusan doontaan waxaan idinku leeyahay, waxaana u tala saartay arrinkayga Alle. Hubaal Alle wuu Arkaa addoomahiisa.

ayat.arabic: فَوَقَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِ مَا مَكَرُواْۖ وَحَاقَ بِـَٔالِ فِرۡعَوۡنَ سُوٓءُ ٱلۡعَذَابِ

en.text: So Allāh protected him from the evils they plotted, and the people of Pharaoh were enveloped by the worst of punishment -

so.text: 45. Markaasuu Alle ka dhowray xumaha waxay qooleen, oo cadaab tan u daran waxay ku degtay reer Fircoon.

ayat.arabic: ٱلنَّارُ يُعۡرَضُونَ عَلَيۡهَا غُدُوّٗا وَعَشِيّٗاۚ وَيَوۡمَ تَقُومُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدۡخِلُوٓاْ ءَالَ فِرۡعَوۡنَ أَشَدَّ ٱلۡعَذَابِ

en.text: The Fire; they are exposed to it morning and evening.[1374] And the Day the Hour appears [it will be said], "Make the people of Pharaoh enter the severest punishment."
en.footnotes: [1374] From the time of their death until the Day of Resurrection, when they will be driven into it.

so.text: 46. Naarta, waxaa loo soo bandhigaa aroor iyo galab 'kastaba' [9], Maalintay Saacadda (Qiyaame) dhacdona (waxaa la odhan): Ka yeela reer Fircoon inay galaan cadaab tan ugu daran.
so.footnotes: [9]. Laga billaabo markay dhintaan ilaa Maalinta Qiyaamaha, marka loo kaxeyn xagga Naarta.

ayat.arabic: وَإِذۡ يَتَحَآجُّونَ فِي ٱلنَّارِ فَيَقُولُ ٱلضُّعَفَٰٓؤُاْ لِلَّذِينَ ٱسۡتَكۡبَرُوٓاْ إِنَّا كُنَّا لَكُمۡ تَبَعٗا فَهَلۡ أَنتُم مُّغۡنُونَ عَنَّا نَصِيبٗا مِّنَ ٱلنَّارِ

en.text: And [mention] when they will argue within the Fire, and the weak will say to those who had been arrogant, "Indeed, we were [only] your followers, so will you relieve us of a share of the Fire?"

so.text: 47. (Xus) markay iskula doodayaan Naarta gudaheeda, waxay kuwii ducafada (raciyada ahaa) ku odhan  kuwii (madaxda ahaa) ee isla weynaa: Waxaan innagu ahayn kuwo idinka idin raacsan, ee ma naga qaadeysaan qayb ka mid ah Naarta?.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسۡتَكۡبَرُوٓاْ إِنَّا كُلّٞ فِيهَآ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَدۡ حَكَمَ بَيۡنَ ٱلۡعِبَادِ

en.text: Those who had been arrogant will say, "Indeed, all [of us] are in it. Indeed, Allāh has judged between the servants."

so.text: 48. Kuwii isla weynaa waxay odhan: Waxaanu innagu dhammaan nahay kuwo ku jira; hubaal Alle waa kala xukumay addoomahiisa dhexdooda.

ayat.arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِي ٱلنَّارِ لِخَزَنَةِ جَهَنَّمَ ٱدۡعُواْ رَبَّكُمۡ يُخَفِّفۡ عَنَّا يَوۡمٗا مِّنَ ٱلۡعَذَابِ

en.text: And those in the Fire will say to the keepers of Hell, "Supplicate your Lord to lighten for us a day from the punishment."

so.text: 49. Oo kuwaas ku jira Naarta waxay ku odhan  furahayeennada Naarta: Noo barya Rabbigiin hanaga fudaydsho maalin keliya cadaabka.

ayat.arabic: قَالُوٓاْ أَوَلَمۡ تَكُ تَأۡتِيكُمۡ رُسُلُكُم بِٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِۖ قَالُواْ بَلَىٰۚ قَالُواْ فَٱدۡعُواْۗ وَمَا دُعَٰٓؤُاْ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ إِلَّا فِي ضَلَٰلٍ

en.text: They will say, "Did there not come to you your messengers with clear proofs?" They will say, "Yes." They will reply, "Then supplicate [yourselves], but the supplication of the disbelievers is not except in error [i.e., futility]."

so.text: 50. Waxay odhan: Miyeyna Rusushiinnii idiinla iman Xujooyin cad? Waxay odhan: Haah, Waxay odhan: Marka barya idinku. Baryada gaaladuna ma aha waxaan aheyn baadi iyo khasaaro.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّا لَنَنصُرُ رُسُلَنَا وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ فِي ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَيَوۡمَ يَقُومُ ٱلۡأَشۡهَٰدُ

en.text: Indeed, We will support Our messengers and those who believe during the life of this world and on the Day when the witnesses will stand -

so.text: 51. Annagaa xaqiiq u gargaari Rusuhayada iyo mu'miniinta noloshan adduunka iyo Maalintay markhaatiyadu istaagi.

ayat.arabic: يَوۡمَ لَا يَنفَعُ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ مَعۡذِرَتُهُمۡۖ وَلَهُمُ ٱللَّعۡنَةُ وَلَهُمۡ سُوٓءُ ٱلدَّارِ

en.text: The Day their excuse will not benefit the wrongdoers, and they will have the curse, and they will have the worst home [i.e., Hell].

so.text: 52. Maalinta aysan waxba u tareyn daalimiinta cudur daarashadoodu. Waxayna leeyihiin nacalad oo waxay leeyihiin Daarta xun (Naar).

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ ءَاتَيۡنَا مُوسَى ٱلۡهُدَىٰ وَأَوۡرَثۡنَا بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ

en.text: And We had certainly given Moses guidance, and We caused the Children of Israel to inherit the Scripture

so.text: 53. Waxaanu dhab ahaan siinnay Muuse hanuun, dhaxalsiinnayna ilmahii Israa’iil Kitaabka (Towraadda),

ayat.arabic: هُدٗى وَذِكۡرَىٰ لِأُوْلِي ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ

en.text: As guidance and a reminder for those of understanding.

so.text: 54. Hanuun iyo waano u ah waxgaradka.

ayat.arabic: فَٱصۡبِرۡ إِنَّ وَعۡدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقّٞ وَٱسۡتَغۡفِرۡ لِذَنۢبِكَ وَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ بِٱلۡعَشِيِّ وَٱلۡإِبۡكَٰرِ

en.text: So be patient, [O Muḥammad]. Indeed, the promise of Allāh is truth. And ask forgiveness for your sin[1375] and exalt [Allāh] with praise of your Lord in the evening and the morning.
en.footnotes: [1375] What is intended is "fault" or "error" in judgement, since all prophets were protected by Allāh from falling into sin. The implication is that all believers should seek forgiveness for their sins.

so.text: 55. Ee samir yeelo; hubaal Ballan qaadka Alle waa Xaq, oo ka istiqfaarso denbigaaga [10], kuna tasbiixso ammaanaha iyo mahdinta Rabbigaa galab iyo aroorba.
so.footnotes: [10]. Waxaa loola jeedaa wixii gef kaa dhaca xagga garsoorka, Waxaa laga qaadanayaa in dhammaan mu’miniinta weydiistaan denbi dhaaf Alle.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُجَٰدِلُونَ فِيٓ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ بِغَيۡرِ سُلۡطَٰنٍ أَتَىٰهُمۡ إِن فِي صُدُورِهِمۡ إِلَّا كِبۡرٞ مَّا هُم بِبَٰلِغِيهِۚ فَٱسۡتَعِذۡ بِٱللَّهِۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡبَصِيرُ

en.text: Indeed, those who dispute concerning the signs of Allāh without [any] evidence having come to them - there is not within their breasts except pride, [the extent of] which they cannot reach. So seek refuge in Allāh. Indeed, it is He who is the Hearing, the Seeing.

so.text: 56. Hubaal, kuwa ka dooda Aayadaha Alle xujo la’aan u timid ma ku jiro laabahooda waxaan ahayn (doonis) is weyneyn ayan weligood gaadheyn ee magan gal weydiiso Allaah, hubaal waa wax kasta Maqlaha, wax kasta Arka.

ayat.arabic: لَخَلۡقُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ أَكۡبَرُ مِنۡ خَلۡقِ ٱلنَّاسِ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ

en.text: The creation of the heavens and earth is greater than the creation of mankind, but most of the people do not know.

so.text: 57. Abuuridda samooyinka iyo arlada baa xaqiiq ka weyn abuuridda dadka, laakiinse dadka badankiisu ma oga.

ayat.arabic: وَمَا يَسۡتَوِي ٱلۡأَعۡمَىٰ وَٱلۡبَصِيرُ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَلَا ٱلۡمُسِيٓءُۚ قَلِيلٗا مَّا تَتَذَكَّرُونَ

en.text: And not equal are the blind and the seeing, nor are those who believe and do righteous deeds and the evildoer. Little do you remember.

so.text: 58. Ma sinna kan indhaha la’ iyo kan wax arka, iyo kuwa (Xaqa) rumeysan oo samaha fala iyo kuwa xumaanta fala. Wax yar weeye intaad waantowdaan.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ لَأٓتِيَةٞ لَّا رَيۡبَ فِيهَا وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ

en.text: Indeed, the Hour is coming - no doubt about it - but most of the people do not believe.

so.text: 59. Hubaal Saacadda (Qiyaame) waa imaanaysaa, shaki kuma jiro, dadka badankiisuse ma ay rumaysna.

ayat.arabic: وَقَالَ رَبُّكُمُ ٱدۡعُونِيٓ أَسۡتَجِبۡ لَكُمۡۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَسۡتَكۡبِرُونَ عَنۡ عِبَادَتِي سَيَدۡخُلُونَ جَهَنَّمَ دَاخِرِينَ

en.text: And your Lord says, "Call upon Me; I will respond to you." Indeed, those who disdain My worship will enter Hell [rendered] contemptible.

so.text: 60. (Allaah) Rabbigiin wuxuu yidhi: I barya [11] waan idinka aqbaliye (baryada); hubaal kuwa iska weyneeya baryadeyda [12], waxay geli Naar iyagoo dullaysan.
so.footnotes:
[11]. Nabigu s.c.w. wuxuu yidhi: “Barya Alle idinkoo yaqiinsan in la idinka aqbalayo baryada, oo ogaada inuusan Alle aqbalin baryada qof maahsan".
[12]. Nabigu s.c.w. wuxuu yidhi: “Baryadu waa cibaado”.

ayat.arabic: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيۡلَ لِتَسۡكُنُواْ فِيهِ وَٱلنَّهَارَ مُبۡصِرًاۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَذُو فَضۡلٍ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَشۡكُرُونَ

en.text: It is Allāh who made for you the night that you may rest therein and the day giving sight.[1376] Indeed, Allāh is the possessor of bounty for the people, but most of them are not grateful.
en.footnotes: [1376] i.e., making things visible.

so.text: 61. Alle waa Kan idiin yeelay habeenka inaad ku xasishaan, maalintana idiinka yeelay iftiin si aad wax u aragtaan. Alle waa u Roon yahay dadka, dadku badankooduse kuma mahdiyaan.

ayat.arabic: ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمۡ خَٰلِقُ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ لَّآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۖ فَأَنَّىٰ تُؤۡفَكُونَ

en.text: That is Allāh, your Lord, Creator of all things; there is no deity except Him, so how are you deluded?

so.text: 62. Kaasi waa Allaah, Rabbigiin, Abuuraha wax walba, Ma jiro ilaah (Xaq ah) aan Isaga ahayn. ee xaggee baa la idiinka iilay?

ayat.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ يُؤۡفَكُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَانُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ يَجۡحَدُونَ

en.text: Thus were those [before you] deluded who were rejecting the signs of Allāh.

so.text: 63. Sidaas oo kale baa loo iilay kuwii Aayadaha Alle diiday.

ayat.arabic: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ قَرَارٗا وَٱلسَّمَآءَ بِنَآءٗ وَصَوَّرَكُمۡ فَأَحۡسَنَ صُوَرَكُمۡ وَرَزَقَكُم مِّنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَٰتِۚ ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمۡۖ فَتَبَارَكَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

en.text: It is Allāh who made for you the earth a place of settlement and the sky a structure [i.e., ceiling] and formed you and perfected your forms and provided you with good things. That is Allāh, your Lord; then blessed is Allāh, Lord of the worlds.

so.text: 64. Alle waa kan idiinka dhigay dhulka meel aad degtaan, cirkana saqaf, oo idin suureeyey wanaajiyeyna suuradahiinna, oo idinku arsaaqay waxyaalo wanaagsan. Kaasi waa Allaah, Rabbigiin, waxaa khayr iyo barako badnaaday Allaah Rabbiga uumanka.

ayat.arabic: هُوَ ٱلۡحَيُّ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَٱدۡعُوهُ مُخۡلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَۗ ٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

en.text: He is the Ever-Living;[1377] there is no deity except Him, so call upon Him, [being] sincere to Him in religion. [All] praise is [due] to Allāh, Lord of the worlds.
en.footnotes: [1377] Whose life is without beginning or end, and upon whom all created life depends.

so.text: 65. Waa Noolaha Daa'inka ah. Ma jiro ilaah (Xaq) ah aan Isaga aheyn, ee barya idinkoo u Keli yeelaya cibaadada. Ammaan idilkeed waxaa leh Allaah, Rabbiga uumanka.

ayat.arabic: ۞ قُلۡ إِنِّي نُهِيتُ أَنۡ أَعۡبُدَ ٱلَّذِينَ تَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ لَمَّا جَآءَنِيَ ٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتُ مِن رَّبِّي وَأُمِرۡتُ أَنۡ أُسۡلِمَ لِرَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

en.text: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Indeed, I have been forbidden to worship those you call upon besides Allāh once the clear proofs have come to me from my Lord, and I have been commanded to submit to the Lord of the worlds."

so.text: 66. Dheh: Aniga waa la iga reebay inaan caabudo kuwaad u yeedhataan (baridaan) Alle sokadi, markay xujooyin cad iiga yimaadeen xagga Rabbigay, waxaana la i amray inaan isu dhiibo Rabbiga uumanka.

ayat.arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَكُم مِّن تُرَابٖ ثُمَّ مِن نُّطۡفَةٖ ثُمَّ مِنۡ عَلَقَةٖ ثُمَّ يُخۡرِجُكُمۡ طِفۡلٗا ثُمَّ لِتَبۡلُغُوٓاْ أَشُدَّكُمۡ ثُمَّ لِتَكُونُواْ شُيُوخٗاۚ وَمِنكُم مَّن يُتَوَفَّىٰ مِن قَبۡلُۖ وَلِتَبۡلُغُوٓاْ أَجَلٗا مُّسَمّٗى وَلَعَلَّكُمۡ تَعۡقِلُونَ

en.text: It is He who created you from dust, then from a sperm-drop, then from a clinging clot; then He brings you out as a child; then [He develops you] that you reach your [time of] maturity, then [further] that you become elders. And among you is he who is taken in death before [that], so that you reach a specified term;[1378] and perhaps you will use reason.
en.footnotes: [1378] The time decreed for your death.

so.text: 67. (Alle) waa Kan idinka abuuray carro, haddana dhibic mino ah, haddana xinjir, haddana wuxuu idin soo bixiyaa idinkoo ilmo ah, haddana (idinka yeelaa inaad kortaan) si aad u gaadhaan da'da xooggiinna dhan, haddana si aad u noqotaan odayo da’ ah, waxaase jira qaar idinka mid ah oo la oofsado intaas ka hor, iyo inaad gaadhaan muddo magacaaban [13] inaad garataan (inuusan jirin cid kaloo mudan cibaado Isaga Alle mooyaane).
so.footnotes: [13]. Waa waqtiga loo qabtay dhimashadiinna.

ayat.arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِي يُحۡيِۦ وَيُمِيتُۖ فَإِذَا قَضَىٰٓ أَمۡرٗا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ

en.text: He it is who gives life and causes death; and when He decrees a matter, He but says to it, "Be," and it is.

so.text: 68. (Alle) waa Kan wax nooleeya, waxna dhinsiiya, markuu arrin guddoomiyo wuxuu uun ku yidhaahdaa: Ahow, wuuna yahay.

ayat.arabic: أَلَمۡ تَرَ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ يُجَٰدِلُونَ فِيٓ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ أَنَّىٰ يُصۡرَفُونَ

en.text: Do you not consider those who dispute concerning the signs of Allāh - how are they averted?

so.text: 69. Miyaadan arag kuwaa ka dooda Aayadaha Alle: Xaggee baa loo iilay?

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُواْ بِٱلۡكِتَٰبِ وَبِمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا بِهِۦ رُسُلَنَاۖ فَسَوۡفَ يَعۡلَمُونَ

en.text: Those who deny the Book [i.e., the Qur’ān] and that with which We sent Our messengers - they are going to know,

so.text: 70. Kuwa beeniyay Kitaabka (Qur’aanka) iyo waxa aan la soo dirnay Rusushayada, wayse ogaan doonaan (waxa ku dhaca).

ayat.arabic: إِذِ ٱلۡأَغۡلَٰلُ فِيٓ أَعۡنَٰقِهِمۡ وَٱلسَّلَٰسِلُ يُسۡحَبُونَ

en.text: When the shackles are around their necks and the chains; they will be dragged

so.text: 71. Marka mareegyada birta ah iyo silsiladaha la yeelo luqumahooda; waxaa lagu jiidi.

ayat.arabic: فِي ٱلۡحَمِيمِ ثُمَّ فِي ٱلنَّارِ يُسۡجَرُونَ

en.text: In boiling water; then in the Fire they will be filled [with flame].

so.text: 72. Biyo kulul oo karaya dhexdood, haddana Naar baa laga buuxin oo hurin.

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ قِيلَ لَهُمۡ أَيۡنَ مَا كُنتُمۡ تُشۡرِكُونَ

en.text: Then it will be said to them, "Where is that which you used to associate [with Him in worship]

so.text: 73. Markaas baa lagu odhan, Meeye waxaad u shariik yeeli jirteen?

ayat.arabic: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِۖ قَالُواْ ضَلُّواْ عَنَّا بَل لَّمۡ نَكُن نَّدۡعُواْ مِن قَبۡلُ شَيۡـٔٗاۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ

en.text: Other than Allāh?" They will say, "They have departed from us; rather, we did not used to invoke previously anything." Thus does Allāh put astray the disbelievers.

so.text: 74. Alle ka sokow? Waxay odhan: Way naga tageen: mayee, umaba aanu yeedhan jirin waxna kal hore. Sidaasuu Alle u lumiyaa gaalada.

ayat.arabic: ذَٰلِكُم بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَفۡرَحُونَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ بِغَيۡرِ ٱلۡحَقِّ وَبِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَمۡرَحُونَ

en.text: [The angels will say], "That was because you used to exult upon the earth without right and you used to behave insolently.

so.text: 75. (Cadaab)kaasi waxaa idiinku wacan waxaad ugu farxi jirteen dhulka dhexdiisa xaq darro iyo waxaad la kibri jirteen.

ayat.arabic: ٱدۡخُلُوٓاْ أَبۡوَٰبَ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَاۖ فَبِئۡسَ مَثۡوَى ٱلۡمُتَكَبِّرِينَ

en.text: Enter the gates of Hell to abide eternally therein, and wretched is the residence of the arrogant."

so.text: 76. Gala albaabbada Naarta idinkoo ku waaraya dhexdeeda. Maxay meel baas tahay rugta isla weynayaasha.

ayat.arabic: فَٱصۡبِرۡ إِنَّ وَعۡدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقّٞۚ فَإِمَّا نُرِيَنَّكَ بَعۡضَ ٱلَّذِي نَعِدُهُمۡ أَوۡ نَتَوَفَّيَنَّكَ فَإِلَيۡنَا يُرۡجَعُونَ

en.text: So be patient, [O Muḥammad]; indeed, the promise of Allāh is truth. And whether We show you some of what We have promised them or We take you in death, it is to Us they will be returned.

so.text: 77. Ee samir (adkayso Nabiyow), hubaal Ballan qaadka Alle waa Xaq, oo haddaanu ku tusinno qaar ka mid ah waxa aan ugu gooddinno, ama aan ku oofsanno (intaas ka hor),waa Xaggayaga halka loo soo celin.

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا رُسُلٗا مِّن قَبۡلِكَ مِنۡهُم مَّن قَصَصۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ وَمِنۡهُم مَّن لَّمۡ نَقۡصُصۡ عَلَيۡكَۗ وَمَا كَانَ لِرَسُولٍ أَن يَأۡتِيَ بِـَٔايَةٍ إِلَّا بِإِذۡنِ ٱللَّهِۚ فَإِذَا جَآءَ أَمۡرُ ٱللَّهِ قُضِيَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَخَسِرَ هُنَالِكَ ٱلۡمُبۡطِلُونَ

en.text: And We have already sent messengers before you. Among them are those [whose stories] We have related to you, and among them are those [whose stories] We have not related to you. And it was not for any messenger to bring a sign [or verse] except by permission of Allāh. So when the command of Allāh comes, it will be concluded [i.e., judged] in truth, and the falsifiers will thereupon lose [all].

so.text: 78. Waxaanu soo dirnay Rusul hortaa; waxaa jira kuwo ka mid ah aan kaaga qisoonnay, iyo kuwo aanu kaaga qisoon.  Ma aha suura gal Rasuulna inuu la yimaado Calaamo (Mucjiso) Idanka Alle ma’ahee. Markase uu Amarka Alle yimaado, waxaa wax lagu xukumi Xaq, waxaana ku khasaara halkaa kuwa baadilka raaca ee xume falka ah.

ayat.arabic: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمَ لِتَرۡكَبُواْ مِنۡهَا وَمِنۡهَا تَأۡكُلُونَ

en.text: It is Allāh who made for you the grazing animals upon which you ride, and some of them you eat.

so.text: 79. Alle waa Kan idiin yeelay nicmooleyda (xoolaha) si aad u fuushaan qaar ka mid ah qaar ka mid ahna aad wax ka cuntaan.

ayat.arabic: وَلَكُمۡ فِيهَا مَنَٰفِعُ وَلِتَبۡلُغُواْ عَلَيۡهَا حَاجَةٗ فِي صُدُورِكُمۡ وَعَلَيۡهَا وَعَلَى ٱلۡفُلۡكِ تُحۡمَلُونَ

en.text: And for you therein are [other] benefits and that you may realize upon them a need which is in your breasts;[1379] and upon them and upon ships you are carried.
en.footnotes: [1379] i.e., that you may use the animals to carry your loads to distant places, according to need.

so.text: 80. Waxaana jira Manaafacaad (kale oo badan) oo idiinku sugan, iyo inaad ku gaartaan dan aad leedihiin oo ku jirta laabihiinna, oo dushooda iyaga iyo doonyaha baa la idinku qaadaa.

ayat.arabic: وَيُرِيكُمۡ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ فَأَيَّ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ تُنكِرُونَ

en.text: And He shows you His signs. So which of the signs of Allāh do you deny?

so.text: 81. Wuxuu (Alle) idin tusiyaa Calaamooyin- kiisa, ee middee baa Calaamooyinka Alle beenineysaan?

ayat.arabic: أَفَلَمۡ يَسِيرُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَيَنظُرُواْ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡۚ كَانُوٓاْ أَكۡثَرَ مِنۡهُمۡ وَأَشَدَّ قُوَّةٗ وَءَاثَارٗا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَمَآ أَغۡنَىٰ عَنۡهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يَكۡسِبُونَ

en.text: Have they not traveled through the land and observed how was the end of those before them? They were more numerous than themselves and greater in strength and in impression on the land, but they were not availed by what they used to earn.

so.text: 82. Miyeyna marin dhulka oo fiirin siday aheyd cidhibta kuwii ka horreeyey? Waxay ahaayeen kuwo ka tiro badan kuwani (gaaladan), oo ka xoog badan, iyo camiraadba arlada, waxbase uma tarin waxay kasbadeen.

ayat.arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتۡهُمۡ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِ فَرِحُواْ بِمَا عِندَهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡعِلۡمِ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ

en.text: And when their messengers came to them with clear proofs, they [merely] rejoiced in what they had of knowledge, but they were enveloped by what they used to ridicule.

so.text: 83. Markay Rusushoodii ula yimaadeen xujooyin cad, waxay ku farxeen waxay heysteen oo cilmi ah [14], waxaana ku degay (gaalada) waxay ku jeesjeesi jireen.
so.footnotes: [14]. Waxay moodeen inuu ku filan yahay cilmigooda, oo ayan u baahneyn cilmiga kale ay keeneen Rususha Alle.

ayat.arabic: فَلَمَّا رَأَوۡاْ بَأۡسَنَا قَالُوٓاْ ءَامَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ وَحۡدَهُۥ وَكَفَرۡنَا بِمَا كُنَّا بِهِۦ مُشۡرِكِينَ

en.text: And when they saw Our punishment, they said, "We believe in Allāh alone and disbelieve in that which we used to associate with Him."

so.text: 84. Markay arkeen Cadaabkayagii waxay yidhaahdeen: Waxaanu rumeynay Alle Keliya, oo ku gaalownay (haatan) waxaan cibaadada la wadaajin jirnay.

ayat.arabic: فَلَمۡ يَكُ يَنفَعُهُمۡ إِيمَٰنُهُمۡ لَمَّا رَأَوۡاْ بَأۡسَنَاۖ سُنَّتَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّتِي قَدۡ خَلَتۡ فِي عِبَادِهِۦۖ وَخَسِرَ هُنَالِكَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ

en.text: But never did their faith benefit them once they saw Our punishment. [It is] the established way of Allāh which has preceded among His servants. And the disbelievers thereupon lost [all].

so.text: 85. Iimaankooduse ma ahayn mid anfacaya markay arkeen Cadaabkayaga, waa xeerka Alle oo horay ugu meel martay addoomahiisa. Waxaana ku khasaara halkaas gaalada (xaq iyo nabad diid oo dhan).

ayat.arabic: حمٓ

en.text: Ḥā, Meem.[1381]
en.footnotes: [1381] See footnote to 2:1.

so.text: 1. Xaa Miim [1].
so.footnotes: [1]. Eeg sharaxa hoose ee Suuradda 2 Al-Baqarah: Aayadda 1.

ayat.arabic: تَنزِيلٞ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

en.text: [This is] a revelation from the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful -

so.text: 2. Soo dejinta (Waxyigan) waa xagga (Alle) Naxariistaha, Naxariista Badan.

ayat.arabic: كِتَٰبٞ فُصِّلَتۡ ءَايَٰتُهُۥ قُرۡءَانًا عَرَبِيّٗا لِّقَوۡمٖ يَعۡلَمُونَ

en.text: A Book whose verses have been detailed, an Arabic Qur’ān[1382] for a people who know,
en.footnotes: [1382] i.e., revealed in the Arabic language.

so.text: 3. Waa Kitaab Aayadihiisu cad yihiin, Qur'aan af Carabi ah ciddii wax garan.

ayat.arabic: بَشِيرٗا وَنَذِيرٗا فَأَعۡرَضَ أَكۡثَرُهُمۡ فَهُمۡ لَا يَسۡمَعُونَ

en.text: As a giver of good tidings and a warner; but most of them turn away, so they do not hear.

so.text: 4. Waa u bishaareeye (Qofkii rumeeya Towxiidka) iyo u dige (qofkii u shariig yeela Alle oo xuma fala), waase ka jeesadeen badankoodu, marka wax ma maqlaan.

ayat.arabic: وَقَالُواْ قُلُوبُنَا فِيٓ أَكِنَّةٖ مِّمَّا تَدۡعُونَآ إِلَيۡهِ وَفِيٓ ءَاذَانِنَا وَقۡرٞ وَمِنۢ بَيۡنِنَا وَبَيۡنِكَ حِجَابٞ فَٱعۡمَلۡ إِنَّنَا عَٰمِلُونَ

en.text: And they say, "Our hearts are within coverings [i.e., screened] from that to which you invite us, and in our ears is deafness, and between us and you is a partition, so work;[1383] indeed, we are working."
en.footnotes: [1383] For your own religion or work against us.

so.text: 5. Waxay yidhaahdeen: Quluubtayadu waa ka daboolan yihiin waxaad noogu yeedhi (Islaamka), waxaana ah culeys dhegahayaga, daah baana xidhan dhexdeenna innaga iyo adiga, ee camal falo; innaguna sidoo kale waanu camal falan [2].
so.footnotes: [2]. U camal fasha diintiinna, innaguna waynu u camal fali.

ayat.arabic: قُلۡ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ بَشَرٞ مِّثۡلُكُمۡ يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَيَّ أَنَّمَآ إِلَٰهُكُمۡ إِلَٰهٞ وَٰحِدٞ فَٱسۡتَقِيمُوٓاْ إِلَيۡهِ وَٱسۡتَغۡفِرُوهُۗ وَوَيۡلٞ لِّلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ

en.text: Say, [O Muḥammad], "I am only a man like you to whom it has been revealed that your god is but one God; so take a straight course to Him and seek His forgiveness." And woe to those who associate others with Allāh –

so.text: 6. Dheh: Anigu waxaan uun ahay qof idinla mid ah, waxaa la ii waxyooday inuu ilaahiinnu yahay Ilaah keliya (Allaah aan wax shariig ah lahayn), ee raaca dhabbaha toosan Xaggiisa ah, weydiistana denbi dhaaf, Hoogna waxaa leh Mushrikiinta.

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤۡتُونَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَهُم بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ هُمۡ كَٰفِرُونَ

en.text: Those who do not give zakāh, and in the Hereafter they are disbelievers.

so.text: 7. Kuwa aan (ka daahirin naftooda shirkiga, salaad tukan oo aan) bixin Zakada, ahna kuwo aan Aakhiro rumeysnayn (iyo Janno iyo Naar).

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمۡ أَجۡرٌ غَيۡرُ مَمۡنُونٖ

en.text: Indeed, those who believe and do righteous deeds - for them is a reward uninterrupted.

so.text: 8. Hubaal, kuwa (Xaqa) rumeysan oo samaha fala. Waxay leeyihiin abaal gud aan go’eynin (Janno).

ayat.arabic: ۞ قُلۡ أَئِنَّكُمۡ لَتَكۡفُرُونَ بِٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ فِي يَوۡمَيۡنِ وَتَجۡعَلُونَ لَهُۥٓ أَندَادٗاۚ ذَٰلِكَ رَبُّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

en.text: Say, "Do you indeed disbelieve in He who created the earth in two days and attribute to Him equals? That is the Lord of the worlds."

so.text: 9. Dheh: Ma waxaad ku gaaloobeysaan Kan (Allaah ee) ku abuuray arlada labo maalmood oo u yeeleysaan shariigyo (xagga cibaadada)? Kaasi waa Rabbiga uumanka.

ayat.arabic: وَجَعَلَ فِيهَا رَوَٰسِيَ مِن فَوۡقِهَا وَبَٰرَكَ فِيهَا وَقَدَّرَ فِيهَآ أَقۡوَٰتَهَا فِيٓ أَرۡبَعَةِ أَيَّامٖ سَوَآءٗ لِّلسَّآئِلِينَ

en.text: And He placed on it [i.e., the earth] firmly set mountains over its surface, and He blessed it and determined therein its [creatures'] sustenance in four days without distinction[1384] - for [the information of] those who ask.
en.footnotes: [1384] Also "four equal days" or "four days of completion."

so.text: 10. Wuxuu yeelay dhulka dhexdiisa buuro ka kor ah oo sugan, wuuna barakeeyey oo u qaddaray cuntooyinkeeda afar maalmood gudahood siman ciddii ku weydiisa 'uunka'.

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ ٱسۡتَوَىٰٓ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَهِيَ دُخَانٞ فَقَالَ لَهَا وَلِلۡأَرۡضِ ٱئۡتِيَا طَوۡعًا أَوۡ كَرۡهٗا قَالَتَآ أَتَيۡنَا طَآئِعِينَ

en.text: Then He directed Himself[1385] to the heaven while it was smoke and said to it and to the earth, "Come [into being],[1386] willingly or by compulsion." They said, "We have come willingly."
en.footnotes:
[1385] See footnote to 2:19.
[1386] Literally, "become" or "do [as commanded]."

so.text: 11. Kaddib Wuxuu u qasday xagga samada oo qiiq ah, markaasuu wuxuu ku yidhi iyada iyo arlada: "Ku ahaada samo iyo arlo Amarkayga) oggolaan ama khasab; waxay yidhaahdeen: Waxaanu nimid innagoo ku adeecsan.

ayat.arabic: فَقَضَىٰهُنَّ سَبۡعَ سَمَٰوَاتٖ فِي يَوۡمَيۡنِ وَأَوۡحَىٰ فِي كُلِّ سَمَآءٍ أَمۡرَهَاۚ وَزَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا بِمَصَٰبِيحَ وَحِفۡظٗاۚ ذَٰلِكَ تَقۡدِيرُ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡعَلِيمِ

en.text: And He completed them as seven heavens within two days and inspired [i.e., made known] in each heaven its command. And We adorned the nearest heaven with lamps [i.e., stars, for beauty] and as protection.[1387] That is the determination of the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.
en.footnotes: [1387] From the devils who attempt to steal information from the angels.
