so.text: 12. Wuxuu ku dhammeystiray toddoba samood ahaan labo maalmood gudahood, wuxuuna u waxyooday samo waliba arrinkeeda. Waxaanu ku qurxinnay samada soke xiddigo, isla markaana xafid u ah [3]. Arrinkaasi waa Qaddarka (Alle) Adkaadaha Sarreeya, Wax kasta Ogsoon.
so.footnotes: [3]. Waxaa lagaga dhowray shayaadiinta isku daya inay ka soo maqlaan war malaa’igta cirka jira oo waxaa lagu soo ganaa dambaaburo dab ah.

ayat.arabic: فَإِنۡ أَعۡرَضُواْ فَقُلۡ أَنذَرۡتُكُمۡ صَٰعِقَةٗ مِّثۡلَ صَٰعِقَةِ عَادٖ وَثَمُودَ

en.text: But if they turn away, then say, "I have warned you of a thunderbolt like the thunderbolt [that struck] ʿAad and Thamūd.

so.text: 13. Hadday ka jeesadaan (Xaqa), markaa dheh: Waxaan idiinka digay cadaab daran  la mid ah cadaabkii ku dhacay (reer) Caad iyo Thamuud.

ayat.arabic: إِذۡ جَآءَتۡهُمُ ٱلرُّسُلُ مِنۢ بَيۡنِ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ وَمِنۡ خَلۡفِهِمۡ أَلَّا تَعۡبُدُوٓاْ إِلَّا ٱللَّهَۖ قَالُواْ لَوۡ شَآءَ رَبُّنَا لَأَنزَلَ مَلَٰٓئِكَةٗ فَإِنَّا بِمَآ أُرۡسِلۡتُم بِهِۦ كَٰفِرُونَ

en.text: [That occurred] when the messengers had come to them before them and after them, [saying], "Worship not except Allāh." They said, "If our Lord had willed,[1388] He would have sent down the angels, so indeed we, in that with which you have been sent, are disbelievers."
en.footnotes: [1388] To send messengers.

so.text: 14. Markay Rusushu ugaga yimaadeen hortooda iyo gadaashooda [4] 'iyagoo ku leh': Ha caabudina cidaan ahayn Alle. Waxay yidhaahdeen: Hadduu Rabbigayo doono [5], wuxuu soo diri lahaa malaa’ig. Ee innagu waxa la idinla soo diray waa ku gaalownay.
so.footnotes:
[4]. Waxa loola jeedaa hortooda iyo gadaashooda waxay uga yimaadeen dhinac kasta. 
[5]. Inuu soo diro Rusul.

ayat.arabic: فَأَمَّا عَادٞ فَٱسۡتَكۡبَرُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ بِغَيۡرِ ٱلۡحَقِّ وَقَالُواْ مَنۡ أَشَدُّ مِنَّا قُوَّةًۖ أَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَهُمۡ هُوَ أَشَدُّ مِنۡهُمۡ قُوَّةٗۖ وَكَانُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا يَجۡحَدُونَ

en.text: As for ʿAad, they were arrogant upon the earth without right and said, "Who is greater than us in strength?" Did they not consider that Allāh who created them was greater than them in strength? But they were rejecting Our signs.

so.text: 15. Ma Caad, waxay isku kibriyeen arlada xaq darro, oo yidhaahdeen: Yaa naga xoog badan? Miyeyna arag in Alle ee abuuray uu ka xoog badan yahay? Waxayna ahaayeen kuwo Aayadahayaga diida.

ayat.arabic: فَأَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ رِيحٗا صَرۡصَرٗا فِيٓ أَيَّامٖ نَّحِسَاتٖ لِّنُذِيقَهُمۡ عَذَابَ ٱلۡخِزۡيِ فِي ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَاۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ أَخۡزَىٰۖ وَهُمۡ لَا يُنصَرُونَ

en.text: So We sent upon them a screaming wind during days of misfortune to make them taste the punishment of disgrace in the worldly life; but the punishment of the Hereafter is more disgracing, and they will not be helped.

so.text: 16. Markaasaan u dirnay dabeyl hugmaysa maalmo baas u leh, si aan u dhadhansiinno cadaabka dulliga nolosha adduunka,  cadaabka Aakhiraana ka sii dulli badan, loomana gargaaro.

ayat.arabic: وَأَمَّا ثَمُودُ فَهَدَيۡنَٰهُمۡ فَٱسۡتَحَبُّواْ ٱلۡعَمَىٰ عَلَى ٱلۡهُدَىٰ فَأَخَذَتۡهُمۡ صَٰعِقَةُ ٱلۡعَذَابِ ٱلۡهُونِ بِمَا كَانُواْ يَكۡسِبُونَ

en.text: And as for Thamūd, We guided them, but they preferred blindness over guidance, so the thunderbolt of humiliating punishment seized them for what they used to earn.

so.text: 17. Ma Thamuud se, waxaan tusnay dhabbaha toosan (ee Islaamka), waxayse ka jeclaadeen indha la'aan (habow) halkii hanuunka, markaasaa waxaa ku dhacay cadaab daran wax dulleysa waxay kasbadeen awgeed (oo denbiyo ah).

ayat.arabic: وَنَجَّيۡنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَكَانُواْ يَتَّقُونَ

en.text: And We saved those who believed and used to fear Allāh.

so.text: 18. Waxaana badbaadinnay kuwii (Xaqa) rumeeyey ee (xumaha) ka dhowrsaday.

ayat.arabic: وَيَوۡمَ يُحۡشَرُ أَعۡدَآءُ ٱللَّهِ إِلَى ٱلنَّارِ فَهُمۡ يُوزَعُونَ

en.text: And [mention, O Muḥammad], the Day when the enemies of Allāh will be gathered to the Fire while they are [driven], assembled in rows,

so.text: 19. (Xus, Nabiyow) Maalinta cadowyada Alle (gaalada) loo soo wada kulmin Naarta, iyagoo loo wado saf saf oo is cidhiidhyi.

ayat.arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا مَا جَآءُوهَا شَهِدَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ سَمۡعُهُمۡ وَأَبۡصَٰرُهُمۡ وَجُلُودُهُم بِمَا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ

en.text: Until, when they reach it, their hearing and their eyes and their skins will testify against them of what they used to do.

so.text: 20. Markay yimaadaan (Naarta oo dafiraan denbiyadooda), waxaa ku marag furi maqalkooda iyo araggooda iyo haraggooda waxay fali jireen.

ayat.arabic: وَقَالُواْ لِجُلُودِهِمۡ لِمَ شَهِدتُّمۡ عَلَيۡنَاۖ قَالُوٓاْ أَنطَقَنَا ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنطَقَ كُلَّ شَيۡءٖۚ وَهُوَ خَلَقَكُمۡ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٖ وَإِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُونَ

en.text: And they will say to their skins, "Why have you testified against us?" They will say, "We were made to speak by Allāh, who has made everything speak; and He created you the first time, and to Him you are returned.

so.text: 21. Waxay ku odhan haraggooda: Maxaad noogu marag furteen? Waxay odhan: Alle baa naga hadliyey ee ka hadliya wax walba, Isagaana idin abuuray kal horeba, Xaggiisaana dib la idiinku soo celin.

ayat.arabic: وَمَا كُنتُمۡ تَسۡتَتِرُونَ أَن يَشۡهَدَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ سَمۡعُكُمۡ وَلَآ أَبۡصَٰرُكُمۡ وَلَا جُلُودُكُمۡ وَلَٰكِن ظَنَنتُمۡ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَعۡلَمُ كَثِيرٗا مِّمَّا تَعۡمَلُونَ

en.text: And you were not covering [i.e., protecting] yourselves,[1389] lest your hearing testify against you or your sight or your skins, but you assumed that Allāh does not know much of what you do.
en.footnotes: [1389] With righteousness or by fearing Allāh.

so.text: 22. Ma aydaan ahayn kuwo isku astura (ka cabsashada Alle oo dhowrsada) si aysan maqalkiinnu iyo araggiinnu iyo haragiinnu idiinku markhaati furin [6], waxaadse mooddeen inaanu Alle ogeyn in badan oo waxaad fashaan ah.
so.footnotes: [6]. Ma dareensanayn in maqalkooda iyo araggooda iyo oogadooda ku marag furi doonaan waxay faleen oo dhan.

ayat.arabic: وَذَٰلِكُمۡ ظَنُّكُمُ ٱلَّذِي ظَنَنتُم بِرَبِّكُمۡ أَرۡدَىٰكُمۡ فَأَصۡبَحۡتُم مِّنَ ٱلۡخَٰسِرِينَ

en.text: And that was your assumption which you assumed about your Lord. It has brought you to ruin, and you have become among the losers."

so.text: 23. Kaasi Malihiinna (xun) aad ku maleyseen Rabbigiin, waa waxa idin halligay, marka waad khasaarteen.

ayat.arabic: فَإِن يَصۡبِرُواْ فَٱلنَّارُ مَثۡوٗى لَّهُمۡۖ وَإِن يَسۡتَعۡتِبُواْ فَمَا هُم مِّنَ ٱلۡمُعۡتَبِينَ

en.text: So [even] if they are patient, the Fire is a residence for them; and if they ask to appease [Allāh], they will not be of those who are allowed to appease.

so.text: 24. Marka hadday samri oo adkaysan (iyo haddii kaleba) waa Naarta hoygooda, haddayna dalbaan in loo cudur daaro, lagama aqbalo cudur daarasho.

ayat.arabic: ۞ وَقَيَّضۡنَا لَهُمۡ قُرَنَآءَ فَزَيَّنُواْ لَهُم مَّا بَيۡنَ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ وَمَا خَلۡفَهُمۡ وَحَقَّ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلۡقَوۡلُ فِيٓ أُمَمٖ قَدۡ خَلَتۡ مِن قَبۡلِهِم مِّنَ ٱلۡجِنِّ وَٱلۡإِنسِۖ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ خَٰسِرِينَ

en.text: And We appointed for them companions[1390] who made attractive to them what was before them and what was behind them [of sin], and the word [i.e., decree] has come into effect upon them among nations which had passed on before them of jinn and men. Indeed, they [all] were losers.
en.footnotes: [1390] In this world among the evil jinn and men.

so.text: 25. Waxaana u yeellay (gaalada) saaxiibbo ku xidhiidha [7], markaasay u qurxiyeen waxa hortooda ah iyo waxa gadaashooda (oo denbiyo) ah [8], waxaana ku dhaboobay Qawlka (cadaabka) siduu ugu (dhaboobayba) kuwo ka mid ahaa ummadahii hortood tegay oo jin iyo insiba leh – inay iyagu yihiin kuwo khasaaraya.
so.footnotes:
[7]. Adduunkan gudahi ee ka mid ah jinka iyo dadka.
[8]. Waxa hortood ah ee leh macmacaanno, barwaaqooyin, waxaana loola jeedaa waxa gadaashood ah hididdiilooyin been ah.

ayat.arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَا تَسۡمَعُواْ لِهَٰذَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ وَٱلۡغَوۡاْ فِيهِ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَغۡلِبُونَ

en.text: And those who disbelieve say, "Do not listen to this Qur’ān and speak noisily[1391] during [the recitation of] it that perhaps you will overcome."
en.footnotes: [1391] Other meanings include "speak improperly" and/or "make a clamor." The purpose of this was to prevent the hearing or understanding of the Qur’ān.

so.text: 26. Kuwa gaaloobay waxay yidhaahdeen: Ha dhegaysannina Qur’aankan oo ku fura buuq waa intaasoo aad adkaataane [9].
so.footnotes: [9]. Waxay arrintan uga dan lahaayeen inay dadka ka celiyaan dhageysiga ama fahmidda Qur’aanka

ayat.arabic: فَلَنُذِيقَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ عَذَابٗا شَدِيدٗا وَلَنَجۡزِيَنَّهُمۡ أَسۡوَأَ ٱلَّذِي كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ

en.text: But We will surely cause those who disbelieve to taste a severe punishment, and We will surely recompense them for the worst of what they had been doing.

so.text: 27. Waxaanu xaqiiq dhadhansiin kuwa gaalooba cadaab daran, waxaana xaqiiq u abaal marin si waafaqsan wixii u xumaa ay fali jireen.

ayat.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ جَزَآءُ أَعۡدَآءِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلنَّارُۖ لَهُمۡ فِيهَا دَارُ ٱلۡخُلۡدِ جَزَآءَۢ بِمَا كَانُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا يَجۡحَدُونَ

en.text: That is the recompense of the enemies of Allāh - the Fire. For them therein is the home of eternity as recompense for what they, of Our verses, were rejecting.

so.text: 28. Kaasu waa abaalka cadawyada Alle (gaalada): Naar, ay ku leeyihiin daar lagu waaro, waa jazaha waxay Aayadahayaga beenin jireen darteed.

ayat.arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ رَبَّنَآ أَرِنَا ٱلَّذَيۡنِ أَضَلَّانَا مِنَ ٱلۡجِنِّ وَٱلۡإِنسِ نَجۡعَلۡهُمَا تَحۡتَ أَقۡدَامِنَا لِيَكُونَا مِنَ ٱلۡأَسۡفَلِينَ

en.text: And those who disbelieved will [then] say, "Our Lord, show us those who misled us of the jinn and men [so] we may put them under our feet[1392] that they will be among the lowest."
en.footnotes: [1392] In the lowest depths of Hell. Or "that we may step on them" in revenge.

so.text: 29. Kuwa gaalooba waxay odhan: Rabbigayow! Na tus kuwii na lumiyey oo jin iyo insiba lahaa si aanu u marinno cagahayaga hoosteeda, oo ay u noqdaan halka ugu hooseeysa 'Naarta' [10].
so.footnotes: [10]. Halka u hooseysa dabaqyada Naarta. Ama macnaha waa si aan cagta u marinno oo ugu dul soconno aar goosi ahaan.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُواْ رَبُّنَا ٱللَّهُ ثُمَّ ٱسۡتَقَٰمُواْ تَتَنَزَّلُ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ أَلَّا تَخَافُواْ وَلَا تَحۡزَنُواْ وَأَبۡشِرُواْ بِٱلۡجَنَّةِ ٱلَّتِي كُنتُمۡ تُوعَدُونَ

en.text: Indeed, those who have said, "Our Lord is Allāh" and then remained on a right course - the angels will descend upon them, [saying], "Do not fear and do not grieve but receive good tidings of Paradise, which you were promised.

so.text: 30. Hubaal, kuwa yidhaahda: Rabbigayo waa Allaah, markaa haya oo ku socda jidka toosan (ee Islaamka) malaa’igtaa ku soo degta (waqtiga dhimashadooda iyagoo leh): Ha cabsannina, hana murugoonnina, kuna bishaareysta Jannadii la idiin yaboohay.

ayat.arabic: نَحۡنُ أَوۡلِيَآؤُكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَفِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِۖ وَلَكُمۡ فِيهَا مَا تَشۡتَهِيٓ أَنفُسُكُمۡ وَلَكُمۡ فِيهَا مَا تَدَّعُونَ

en.text: We [angels] were your allies in worldly life and [are so] in the Hereafter. And you will have therein whatever your souls desire, and you will have therein whatever you request [or wish]

so.text: 31. Annagaa ah gargaarayaashiin nolosha adduunkan iyo Aakhiradaba, waxaadna leedihiin gudaheeda waxay nafahiinnu doonaan, oo waxaad leedihiin gudaheeda waxaad dalabtaan.

ayat.arabic: نُزُلٗا مِّنۡ غَفُورٖ رَّحِيمٖ

en.text: As accommodation from a [Lord who is] Forgiving and Merciful."

so.text: 32. Waa martiqaad xagga (Alle) Denbi Dhaaf Badane, Naxariis Badan.

ayat.arabic: وَمَنۡ أَحۡسَنُ قَوۡلٗا مِّمَّن دَعَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحٗا وَقَالَ إِنَّنِي مِنَ ٱلۡمُسۡلِمِينَ

en.text: And who is better in speech than one who invites to Allāh and does righteousness and says, "Indeed, I am of the Muslims."

so.text: 33. Yaa ka hadal wanaagsan kan ugu baaqa (dadka) xagga Alle, kaasoo isagu naf ahaantiisa sama fala oo yidhaahda: Waxaan anigu ka mid ahay Muslimiinta.

ayat.arabic: وَلَا تَسۡتَوِي ٱلۡحَسَنَةُ وَلَا ٱلسَّيِّئَةُۚ ٱدۡفَعۡ بِٱلَّتِي هِيَ أَحۡسَنُ فَإِذَا ٱلَّذِي بَيۡنَكَ وَبَيۡنَهُۥ عَدَٰوَةٞ كَأَنَّهُۥ وَلِيٌّ حَمِيمٞ

en.text: And not equal are the good deed and the bad. Repel [evil] by that [deed] which is better; and thereupon, the one whom between you and him is enmity [will become] as though he was a devoted friend.

so.text: 34. Ma sinna samaanta iyo xumaantu, ku qaabil (xumaha) waxa wax u wanaagsan (cafis iyo masaamax iyo asxaan fal), markaas eeg! Kii ay idiin dhexeysay isaga iyo adiga cadaawadi (wuxuu noqonayaa) sidii saaxiib aad isku weyn tihiin.

ayat.arabic: وَمَا يُلَقَّىٰهَآ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ صَبَرُواْ وَمَا يُلَقَّىٰهَآ إِلَّا ذُو حَظٍّ عَظِيمٖ

en.text: But none is granted it except those who are patient, and none is granted it except one having a great portion [of good].

so.text: 35. Lama siiyo (tilmaantaa la soo xusay) waxaan ahayn kuwa samir yeesha, oo lama siiyo waxaan aheyn mid leh nasiib weyn.

ayat.arabic: وَإِمَّا يَنزَغَنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنِ نَزۡغٞ فَٱسۡتَعِذۡ بِٱللَّهِۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ

en.text: And if there comes to you from Satan an evil suggestion, then seek refuge in Allāh. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.

so.text: 36. Hadduu ku waswaasiyo shaydaan waswaasin (kuugu yeedho xume fal iyo cadho) ka magan gal Alle. Hubaal waa wax kasta Maqlaha, wax kasta Ogsoon.

ayat.arabic: وَمِنۡ ءَايَٰتِهِ ٱلَّيۡلُ وَٱلنَّهَارُ وَٱلشَّمۡسُ وَٱلۡقَمَرُۚ لَا تَسۡجُدُواْ لِلشَّمۡسِ وَلَا لِلۡقَمَرِ وَٱسۡجُدُواْۤ لِلَّهِۤ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَهُنَّ إِن كُنتُمۡ إِيَّاهُ تَعۡبُدُونَ

en.text: And of His signs are the night and day and the sun and moon. Do not prostrate to the sun or to the moon, but prostrate to Allāh, who created them, if it should be Him that you worship.[1393]
en.footnotes: [1393] i.e., Do not worship Allāh through His creations but worship Him directly and exclusively.

so.text: 37. Calaamooyinka (Alle ee muujin Weynadiisa iyo Waxdaaniyadiisa) waxaa ka mid ah habeenka iyo maalinta iyo qorraxda iyo dayaxa. Ha u sujuudina qorraxda iyo dayaxa midna ee u sujuuda Alle (Keliya) ee abuuray, haddaad Isaga uun caabudi [11].
so.footnotes: [11]. Macnaha waa ha caabudina Alle idinkoo u maraya uumankiisa, e caabuda si toos ah Keligi idinkoo aan waxba la wadaajin cibaadada.

ayat.arabic: فَإِنِ ٱسۡتَكۡبَرُواْ فَٱلَّذِينَ عِندَ رَبِّكَ يُسَبِّحُونَ لَهُۥ بِٱلَّيۡلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ وَهُمۡ لَا يَسۡـَٔمُونَ۩

en.text: But if they are arrogant - then those who are near your Lord [i.e., the angels] exalt Him by night and by day, and they do not become weary.

so.text: 38. Hadday iska kibriyaan (cibaadada), kuwaa ah Rabbigaa agtiisa (malaa’igta) baa u tasbiixsada habeen iyo maalinba kamana daalaan (caabudiddiisa).

ayat.arabic: وَمِنۡ ءَايَٰتِهِۦٓ أَنَّكَ تَرَى ٱلۡأَرۡضَ خَٰشِعَةٗ فَإِذَآ أَنزَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهَا ٱلۡمَآءَ ٱهۡتَزَّتۡ وَرَبَتۡۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَحۡيَاهَا لَمُحۡيِ ٱلۡمَوۡتَىٰٓۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٌ

en.text: And of His signs is that you see the earth stilled, but when We send down upon it rain, it quivers and grows. Indeed, He who has given it life is the Giver of Life to the dead. Indeed, He is over all things competent.

so.text: 39. Calaamooyinka Alle waxaa ka mid ah  inaad aragto dhulka oo bas (abaar) ah, markase aan ku soo da’inno biyo (roob) uu noolaado oo soo kor noqdo. Hubaal Kan (Allaah ee) nooleeya wuxuu nooleyn maytida. Hubaal wax walba wuu Karaa.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُلۡحِدُونَ فِيٓ ءَايَٰتِنَا لَا يَخۡفَوۡنَ عَلَيۡنَآۗ أَفَمَن يُلۡقَىٰ فِي ٱلنَّارِ خَيۡرٌ أَم مَّن يَأۡتِيٓ ءَامِنٗا يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِۚ ٱعۡمَلُواْ مَا شِئۡتُمۡ إِنَّهُۥ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ

en.text: Indeed, those who inject deviation into Our verses[1394] are not concealed from Us. So, is he who is cast into the Fire better or he who comes secure on the Day of Resurrection? Do whatever you will; indeed, He is Seeing of what you do.
en.footnotes: [1394] Through deviant recitations or interpretations.

so.text: 40. Kuwa iiliya Aayadahayaga [12] nagama qarsoona. Ma mid lagu tuuri Naarta baa khayr badan, mise mid Iman isagoo nabad ah Maalinta Qiyaamaha? Fala waxaad doontaan 'Alle 'waxaad fashaan wuu arkaa.
so.footnotes: [12]. Iyagoo u akhriyaya si leexsan ama u fasiraya si khaldan.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِٱلذِّكۡرِ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمۡۖ وَإِنَّهُۥ لَكِتَٰبٌ عَزِيزٞ

en.text: Indeed, those who disbelieve in the message [i.e., the Qur’ān][1395] after it has come to them...[1396] And indeed, it is a mighty[1397] Book.
en.footnotes:
[1395] i.e., reject it or prefer deviant interpretation.
[1396] The conclusion is understood to be "...will have earned an indescribable punishment."
[1397] Inimitable, resistant to attack, protected by Allāh.

so.text: 41. Hubaal kuwa ku gaalooba Waanada [13] (Qur’aanka) markuu u yimid 'waa laga jazayn' [14] oo (kani Qur’aanka) waa Kitaab sharaf weyn leh.
so.footnotes:
[13]. Kuwa diida xaqa ama door bida tafsiirka qalloocan Alle ma hanuuniyo. 
[14]. Hadalka inta ka go’an waa la iska garan karaa oo waxaa weeye: Waxay la kulmi doonaan ciqaab aan la suureysan karin.”

ayat.arabic: لَّا يَأۡتِيهِ ٱلۡبَٰطِلُ مِنۢ بَيۡنِ يَدَيۡهِ وَلَا مِنۡ خَلۡفِهِۦۖ تَنزِيلٞ مِّنۡ حَكِيمٍ حَمِيدٖ

en.text: Falsehood cannot approach it from before it or from behind it; [it is] a revelation from a [Lord who is] Wise and Praiseworthy.

so.text: 42. Baadil ugama yimaado hortiisa ama gadaashiisa [15]; waa Waxyi laga soo dejiyey xagga Xakiim, Ammaanan (Alle).
so.footnotes: [15]. Aan isagoo kale la keeni karin, aan waxba looga qaadin in wax laga sheego, uuna yahay Kitaab uu Alle dhowray.

ayat.arabic: مَّا يُقَالُ لَكَ إِلَّا مَا قَدۡ قِيلَ لِلرُّسُلِ مِن قَبۡلِكَۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَذُو مَغۡفِرَةٖ وَذُو عِقَابٍ أَلِيمٖ

en.text: Nothing is said to you, [O Muḥammad], except what was already said to the messengers before you. Indeed, your Lord is a possessor of forgiveness and a possessor of painful penalty.

so.text: 43. Waxba lagu odhan maayo (Nabi Muxammadow) aan aheyn wixii lagu yidhi Rusushii kaa horreysay. Hubaal Rabbigaa waa Rabbiga Denbi dhaafka leh, iyo Rabbiga leh Ciqaab Xanuun Badan.

ayat.arabic: وَلَوۡ جَعَلۡنَٰهُ قُرۡءَانًا أَعۡجَمِيّٗا لَّقَالُواْ لَوۡلَا فُصِّلَتۡ ءَايَٰتُهُۥٓۖ ءَا۬عۡجَمِيّٞ وَعَرَبِيّٞۗ قُلۡ هُوَ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ هُدٗى وَشِفَآءٞۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ فِيٓ ءَاذَانِهِمۡ وَقۡرٞ وَهُوَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ عَمًىۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ يُنَادَوۡنَ مِن مَّكَانِۭ بَعِيدٖ

en.text: And if We had made it a foreign [i.e., non-Arabic] Qur’ān, they would have said, "Why are its verses not explained in detail [in our language]? Is it a foreign [recitation] and an Arab [messenger]?" Say, "It is, for those who believe, a guidance and cure." And those who do not believe - in their ears is deafness, and it is upon them blindness. Those are being called from a distant place.[1398]
en.footnotes: [1398] For all practical purposes, since they neither hear nor understand.

so.text: 44. Haddaan ka dhigi lahayn Qu’raan af shisheeye ku soo dega, waxay odhan lahaayeen: Maxaa Aayadihiisa looga dhigi waayey kuwo cad? Waa maxay acjami (carrab) shisheeye isagoo Carab ah? Dheh: Wuxuu u yahay kuwa rumeysan hanuun iyo caafimaad. Kuwase aan rumeysnayn waxaa ah culeys dhegahooda, waana ka indha la' yihiin, kuwaa waxaa looga yeedhaa meel fog.

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ ءَاتَيۡنَا مُوسَى ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ فَٱخۡتُلِفَ فِيهِۚ وَلَوۡلَا كَلِمَةٞ سَبَقَتۡ مِن رَّبِّكَ لَقُضِيَ بَيۡنَهُمۡۚ وَإِنَّهُمۡ لَفِي شَكّٖ مِّنۡهُ مُرِيبٖ

en.text: And We had already given Moses the Scripture, but it came under disagreement.[1399] And if not for a word [i.e., decree][1400] that preceded from your Lord, it would have been concluded between them. And indeed they are, concerning it [i.e., the Qur’ān], in disquieting doubt.
en.footnotes:
[1399] An alternative meaning is "he was opposed over it."
[1400] See footnote to 10:19.

so.text: 45. Waxaanu dhab ahaan siinnay Muuse Kitaabka (Towraadda), waase la isku khilaafay. Haddiina aysan jiri lahayn erey ka hormaray Rabbigaa (in dib loogu dhigo cadaabka) waa la kala xukumi lahaa dhexdooda, waxayse ka qabaan (Qur’aanka) shaki walaac leh.

ayat.arabic: مَّنۡ عَمِلَ صَٰلِحٗا فَلِنَفۡسِهِۦۖ وَمَنۡ أَسَآءَ فَعَلَيۡهَاۗ وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِظَلَّٰمٖ لِّلۡعَبِيدِ

en.text: Whoever does righteousness - it is for his [own] soul; and whoever does evil [does so] against it. And your Lord is not ever unjust to [His] servants.

so.text: 46. Qofkii sama fala naftiisay (dan) u tahay, kii xumaan falana isagay u daran tahay, Rabbigaa ma aha mid dulmiya addoomaha.

ayat.arabic: ۞ إِلَيۡهِ يُرَدُّ عِلۡمُ ٱلسَّاعَةِۚ وَمَا تَخۡرُجُ مِن ثَمَرَٰتٖ مِّنۡ أَكۡمَامِهَا وَمَا تَحۡمِلُ مِنۡ أُنثَىٰ وَلَا تَضَعُ إِلَّا بِعِلۡمِهِۦۚ وَيَوۡمَ يُنَادِيهِمۡ أَيۡنَ شُرَكَآءِي قَالُوٓاْ ءَاذَنَّٰكَ مَا مِنَّا مِن شَهِيدٖ

en.text: To Him [alone] is attributed knowledge of the Hour. And fruits emerge not from their coverings nor does a female conceive or give birth except with His knowledge. And the Day He will call to them, "Where are My 'partners'?" they will say, "We announce to You that there is [no longer] among us any witness [to that]."

so.text: 47. Xaggiisaa loo celiyaa cilmiga Saacadda 'Qiyaame' [16]. Kama soo baxaan wax ka mid ah midhaha galalkooda, oo ma jirto dheddig uur qaaddaa, kumana dhasho waxaan aheyn Ogaalkiisa. Maalinta markuu u yeedhi: Meeye kuwa aad ila wadaajiseen 'cibaadada' [17]? Waxay odhan: Waxaan ku ogeysiin naguma jiro mid ka markhaati kici (inay yihiin shariigyadaada).
so.footnotes:
[16]. Ma jiro axad ogsoon goorta ay dhici doonto Qiyaamaha aan ahayn Allaah. 
[17]. Asnaamta waxay ka dhigeen kuwo la shuruko ah ama la siman Alle.

ayat.arabic: وَضَلَّ عَنۡهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يَدۡعُونَ مِن قَبۡلُۖ وَظَنُّواْ مَا لَهُم مِّن مَّحِيصٖ

en.text: And lost from them will be those they were invoking before, and they will be certain that they have no place of escape.

so.text: 48. Waxay waayi waxay horey ugu dhawaaqan jireen (oo ilaahyo been ah),  waxayna yaqiinsan inaysan laheyn meel ay u baxsadaan.

ayat.arabic: لَّا يَسۡـَٔمُ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ مِن دُعَآءِ ٱلۡخَيۡرِ وَإِن مَّسَّهُ ٱلشَّرُّ فَيَـُٔوسٞ قَنُوطٞ

en.text: Man is not weary of supplication for good [things], but if evil touches him, he is hopeless and despairing.

so.text: 49. Aadmigu marnaba kama daalo khayr bariga, hadduuse shar taabto, markaas waa quustaa, rajo beel ah.

ayat.arabic: وَلَئِنۡ أَذَقۡنَٰهُ رَحۡمَةٗ مِّنَّا مِنۢ بَعۡدِ ضَرَّآءَ مَسَّتۡهُ لَيَقُولَنَّ هَٰذَا لِي وَمَآ أَظُنُّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ قَآئِمَةٗ وَلَئِن رُّجِعۡتُ إِلَىٰ رَبِّيٓ إِنَّ لِي عِندَهُۥ لَلۡحُسۡنَىٰۚ فَلَنُنَبِّئَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِمَا عَمِلُواْ وَلَنُذِيقَنَّهُم مِّنۡ عَذَابٍ غَلِيظٖ

en.text: And if We let him taste mercy from Us after an adversity which has touched him, he will surely say, "This is [due] to me,[1401] and I do not think the Hour will occur; and [even] if I should be returned to my Lord, indeed, for me there will be with Him the best." But We will surely inform those who disbelieved about what they did, and We will surely make them taste a massive punishment.
en.footnotes: [1401] Because of my effort, knowledge, excellence, etc.

so.text: 50. Haddaan dhadhansiinno naxariis Xaggayaga ah kaddib dhibaato taabatay, wuxuu odhan: Kan anaa leh [18], mana filayo inay dhici Saacadda (Qiyaame), haddii la ii celiyona xagga Rabbigay, waxaan ka heli agtiisa wanaag. Waxaan u sheegi kuwa gaaloobay waxay faleen, waxaana dhadhansiin Cadaab Adag.
so.footnotes: [18]. Macnaha waa waxaan ku helay xoogsigeyga, aqoonteyda, iyo wanaagga aan leeyahay, fadliga aan dheerahay dadka kale darteed, iwm.

ayat.arabic: وَإِذَآ أَنۡعَمۡنَا عَلَى ٱلۡإِنسَٰنِ أَعۡرَضَ وَنَـَٔا بِجَانِبِهِۦ وَإِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلشَّرُّ فَذُو دُعَآءٍ عَرِيضٖ

en.text: And when We bestow favor upon man, he turns away and distances himself; but when evil touches him, then he is full of extensive supplication.

so.text: 51. Markaan u nicmeyno Aadmiga, wuu jeesadaa oo dhinac u baxaa, markuuse dhib taabto, wuu baryootan badan yahay.

ayat.arabic: قُلۡ أَرَءَيۡتُمۡ إِن كَانَ مِنۡ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ كَفَرۡتُم بِهِۦ مَنۡ أَضَلُّ مِمَّنۡ هُوَ فِي شِقَاقِۭ بَعِيدٖ

en.text: Say, "Have you considered: if it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is from Allāh and you disbelieved in it, who would be more astray than one who is in extreme dissension?"

so.text: 52. Dheh: Bal ka warrama hadduu ka yimid (Qur’aanka) xagga Alle, markaas aad ku gaalowdaan - yaa ka lunsanaan badan kan ku sugan gaalnimo iyo khilaaf fog.

ayat.arabic: سَنُرِيهِمۡ ءَايَٰتِنَا فِي ٱلۡأٓفَاقِ وَفِيٓ أَنفُسِهِمۡ حَتَّىٰ يَتَبَيَّنَ لَهُمۡ أَنَّهُ ٱلۡحَقُّۗ أَوَلَمۡ يَكۡفِ بِرَبِّكَ أَنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ شَهِيدٌ

en.text: We will show them Our signs in the horizons and within themselves until it becomes clear to them that it is the truth.[1402] But is it not sufficient concerning your Lord that He is, over all things, a Witness?[1403]
en.footnotes:
[1402] Or "that He (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) is the Truth."
[1403] See footnote of 4:79.

so.text: 53. Waxaan ka tusi doonnaa Calaamooyin- kayaga koonka iyo xagga nafahoodaba ilaa ay uga caddaato inuu (Alle, Qur’aanka) yahay Xaq. Miyuusan ku fillayn Rabbigaa inuu u jeedo wax walba oo ka yahay marag.

ayat.arabic: أَلَآ إِنَّهُمۡ فِي مِرۡيَةٖ مِّن لِّقَآءِ رَبِّهِمۡۗ أَلَآ إِنَّهُۥ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٖ مُّحِيطُۢ

en.text: Unquestionably, they are in doubt about the meeting with their Lord. Unquestionably He is, of all things, encompassing.

so.text: 54. Ogaada, hubaal, Waxay (gaaladu) ka shaki qabaan la kulanka Rabbigood, ogaada, hubaal, (Alle) wuu koobaa wax kasta oo Ku Xeeran yahay.

ayat.arabic: حمٓ

en.text: Ḥā, Meem.

so.text: 1. Xaa Miim.

ayat.arabic: عٓسٓقٓ

en.text: ʿAyn, Seen, Qāf.[1405]
en.footnotes: [1405] See footnote to 2:1.

so.text: 2. Cayn Siin Qaaf [1].
so.footnotes: [1]. Eeg sharaxa hoose ee Suuradda 2 Al-Baqarah: Aayadda 1.

ayat.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ يُوحِيٓ إِلَيۡكَ وَإِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِكَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ

en.text: Thus has He revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], and to those before you - Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

so.text: 3. Sidaasuu Alle, Adkaadaha, Xakiimka ah, kuugu waxyoodaa siduu ugu (waxyoodayba Nabiyadii) kaa horreeyay.

ayat.arabic: لَهُۥ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَلِيُّ ٱلۡعَظِيمُ

en.text: To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth, and He is the Most High, the Most Great.[1406]
en.footnotes: [1406] See footnote to 2:255.

so.text: 4. (Alle) baa iska leh waxa ku sugan samooyinka iyo waxa ku sugan arlada. Waana Sarreeyaha, Weyn.

ayat.arabic: تَكَادُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ يَتَفَطَّرۡنَ مِن فَوۡقِهِنَّۚ وَٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ يُسَبِّحُونَ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّهِمۡ وَيَسۡتَغۡفِرُونَ لِمَن فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۗ أَلَآ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلۡغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

en.text: The heavens almost break from above them,[1407] and the angels exalt [Allāh] with praise of their Lord and ask forgiveness for those on earth. Unquestionably, it is Allāh who is the Forgiving, the Merciful.
en.footnotes: [1407] i.e., from the grandeur of Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) above them.

so.text: 5. Samooyinku waxay ku sigtaan inay ka kor dil-dillaacan [2], malaa’igtuna waxay ku tasbiixsadaan ammaanaha Rabbigood, una weydiiyaan denbi dhaaf kuwaa dhulka korkiisa ah, hubaal, Alle waa Denbi Dhaaf Badanaha, Naxariista Badan.
so.footnotes: [2]. Haybadda iyo Weynida Alle s.w.t darteed ee ka korreeya iyaga.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوۡلِيَآءَ ٱللَّهُ حَفِيظٌ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيۡهِم بِوَكِيلٖ

en.text: And those who take as allies other than Him - Allāh is [yet] Guardian over them; and you, [O Muḥammad], are not over them a manager -

so.text: 6. Kuwase yeesha Alle ka sokow awliyo (ay caabudaan), Alle baa u jeeda oo dhowraya, adiguna kama tihid wakiil.

ayat.arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَيۡكَ قُرۡءَانًا عَرَبِيّٗا لِّتُنذِرَ أُمَّ ٱلۡقُرَىٰ وَمَنۡ حَوۡلَهَا وَتُنذِرَ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡجَمۡعِ لَا رَيۡبَ فِيهِۚ فَرِيقٞ فِي ٱلۡجَنَّةِ وَفَرِيقٞ فِي ٱلسَّعِيرِ

en.text: And thus We have revealed to you an Arabic Qur’ān that you may warn the Mother of Cities [i.e., Makkah] and those around it[1408] and warn of the Day of Assembly, about which there is no doubt. A party will be in Paradise and a party in the Blaze.
en.footnotes: [1408] i.e., all other peoples.

so.text: 7. Sidaasaan kuugu waxyoonnay Qur’aan Carabi ah si aad ugu digto magaalada xarunta ah (Makkah) iyo waxa hareerahee- da ah [3], iyo inaad ka digto Maalinta Kulanka (Qiyaamada) ee uusan ku jirin shaki, koox waxay gali Janno, kooxna Naar huraysa.
so.footnotes: [3]. Waa dadka kale oo dhan.

ayat.arabic: وَلَوۡ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَجَعَلَهُمۡ أُمَّةٗ وَٰحِدَةٗ وَلَٰكِن يُدۡخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِي رَحۡمَتِهِۦۚ وَٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ مَا لَهُم مِّن وَلِيّٖ وَلَا نَصِيرٍ

en.text: And if Allāh willed, He could have made them [of] one religion, but He admits whom He wills[1409] into His mercy. And the wrongdoers have not any protector or helper.
en.footnotes: [1409] i.e., those who desire His guidance and His acceptance of them.

so.text: 8. Hadduu doono Alle, wuxuu ka yeeli lahaa dadka ummad keliya, wuxuuse geliyaa cidduu doono Naxariistiisa [4]. Daalimiintu ma leh sokeeye iyo gargaare midna.
so.footnotes: [4]. Wuxuu geliyaa Naxariistiisa kuwaasi doonaya hanuunkiisa iyo inuu aqbalo camalkooda.

ayat.arabic: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوۡلِيَآءَۖ فَٱللَّهُ هُوَ ٱلۡوَلِيُّ وَهُوَ يُحۡيِ ٱلۡمَوۡتَىٰ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٞ

en.text: Or have they taken protectors [or allies] besides Him? But Allāh - He is the Protector, and He gives life to the dead, and He is over all things competent.

so.text: 9. Mise waxay yeesheen Alle ka sokow awliyo (ay caabudaan)? Allaah baase ah Waliga (Sokeeyaha iyo Gargaaraha dhabta ah), Isagaana nooleeya maytida, Isagaana wax walba Kara.

ayat.arabic: وَمَا ٱخۡتَلَفۡتُمۡ فِيهِ مِن شَيۡءٖ فَحُكۡمُهُۥٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِۚ ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبِّي عَلَيۡهِ تَوَكَّلۡتُ وَإِلَيۡهِ أُنِيبُ

en.text: And in anything over which you disagree - its ruling is [to be referred] to Allāh. [Say], "That is Allāh, my Lord; upon Him I have relied, and to Him I turn back."[1410]
en.footnotes: [1410] In remembrance and repentance.

so.text: 10. Waxaad isku khilaaftaan oo wuxuun ah go’aankiisa waa (in loo celiyaa) Allaah, Kaasi waa Allaah, Rabbigay, Isagaan tala saartaa, Xaggiisaana u noqdaa [5].
so.footnotes: [5]. Xusid iyo tawbad keen ahaan.

ayat.arabic: فَاطِرُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنۡ أَنفُسِكُمۡ أَزۡوَٰجٗا وَمِنَ ٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمِ أَزۡوَٰجٗا يَذۡرَؤُكُمۡ فِيهِۚ لَيۡسَ كَمِثۡلِهِۦ شَيۡءٞۖ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡبَصِيرُ

en.text: [He is] Creator of the heavens and the earth. He has made for you from yourselves, mates, and among the cattle, mates; He multiplies you thereby. There is nothing like unto Him,[1411] and He is the Hearing, the Seeing.[1412]
en.footnotes:
[1411] There is no similarity whatsoever between the Creator and His creation in essence, in attributes or in deed.
[1412] See footnotes to 17:1.

so.text: 11. (Waa) uumaha samooyinka iyo arlada wuxuu idiinka yeelay nafahiinna noocyo (lab iyo dheddig); xoolahana (sidoo kale) noocyo. Sidaasuu idinku tarmiyaa. Ma jiro wax la mid ah [6], waana Isaga wax kasta Maqlaha, wax kasta Arka.
so.footnotes: [6]. Ma jiro wax isu ekaansho ah haba yaraatee ee ka dhexeeya Abuuraha iyo uunkiisa xag kasta, tilmaamo iyo camallo ahaan.

ayat.arabic: لَهُۥ مَقَالِيدُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ يَبۡسُطُ ٱلرِّزۡقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقۡدِرُۚ إِنَّهُۥ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيمٞ

en.text: To Him belong the keys of the heavens and the earth. He extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it]. Indeed He is, of all things, Knowing.

so.text: 12. (Alle) baa iska leh khaznadaha samooyinka iyo arlada, wuxuu u waasiciyaa risiqa qofkuu doono oo ku cidhiidhiyaa (qofkuu doono), wax walbana (Alle) wuu Og yahay.

ayat.arabic: ۞ شَرَعَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلدِّينِ مَا وَصَّىٰ بِهِۦ نُوحٗا وَٱلَّذِيٓ أَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَيۡكَ وَمَا وَصَّيۡنَا بِهِۦٓ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ وَعِيسَىٰٓۖ أَنۡ أَقِيمُواْ ٱلدِّينَ وَلَا تَتَفَرَّقُواْ فِيهِۚ كَبُرَ عَلَى ٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ مَا تَدۡعُوهُمۡ إِلَيۡهِۚ ٱللَّهُ يَجۡتَبِيٓ إِلَيۡهِ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهۡدِيٓ إِلَيۡهِ مَن يُنِيبُ

en.text: He has ordained for you of religion what He enjoined upon Noah and that which We have revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], and what We enjoined upon Abraham and Moses and Jesus - to establish the religion and not be divided therein. Difficult for those who associate others with Allāh is that to which you invite them. Allāh chooses for Himself whom He wills and guides to Himself whoever turns back [to Him].

so.text: 13. Wuxuu idiin jideeyey xagga diinta wuxuu u dardaarmay Nuux, iyo waxaan kuu waxyoonnay, iyo waxaan u dardaarannay Ibraahiim, Muuse, iyo Ciise: Inaad oogtaan diinta oo ku kala qaybsamin. Waa ku adag tahay mushrikiinta waxaad (Towxiidka) aad ugu yeedhaan. Alle wuxuu u doortaa Xaggiiisa qofkuu doono,  wuxuuna u hanuuniyaa Xaggiiisa kan u soo laabadka badiya (xusid iyo tawbad ahaan).

ayat.arabic: وَمَا تَفَرَّقُوٓاْ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلۡعِلۡمُ بَغۡيَۢا بَيۡنَهُمۡۚ وَلَوۡلَا كَلِمَةٞ سَبَقَتۡ مِن رَّبِّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٖ مُّسَمّٗى لَّقُضِيَ بَيۡنَهُمۡۚ وَإِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أُورِثُواْ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِمۡ لَفِي شَكّٖ مِّنۡهُ مُرِيبٖ

en.text: And they did not become divided until after knowledge had come to them - out of jealous animosity between themselves. And if not for a word[1413] that preceded from your Lord [postponing the penalty] until a specified time, it would have been concluded between them. And indeed, those who were granted inheritance of the Scripture after them are, concerning it, in disquieting doubt.
en.footnotes: [1413] Decree. See footnote to 10:19.

so.text: 14. Ma ay noqon kuwo kala qaybsan (xagga diinta) markuu u yimid cilmiga kaddib mahee xasad darti dhexdooda ah. Haddii aysan jirteenna Kelmed uga dhacday horay Rabbigaa oo muddo magacaaban ah (in lala sugo Qiyaamada), waa la kala xukumi lahaa dhexdooda. Kuwana la dhaxal siiyey Kitaabka iyaga kaddib (Yuhuudda iyo Nasaarada) shaki weyn bay ka qabaan (diinta).

ayat.arabic: فَلِذَٰلِكَ فَٱدۡعُۖ وَٱسۡتَقِمۡ كَمَآ أُمِرۡتَۖ وَلَا تَتَّبِعۡ أَهۡوَآءَهُمۡۖ وَقُلۡ ءَامَنتُ بِمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ مِن كِتَٰبٖۖ وَأُمِرۡتُ لِأَعۡدِلَ بَيۡنَكُمُۖ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّنَا وَرَبُّكُمۡۖ لَنَآ أَعۡمَٰلُنَا وَلَكُمۡ أَعۡمَٰلُكُمۡۖ لَا حُجَّةَ بَيۡنَنَا وَبَيۡنَكُمُۖ ٱللَّهُ يَجۡمَعُ بَيۡنَنَاۖ وَإِلَيۡهِ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ

en.text: So to that [religion of Allāh] invite, [O Muḥammad],[1414] and remain on a right course as you are commanded and do not follow their inclinations but say, "I have believed in what Allāh has revealed of scripture [i.e., the Qur’ān], and I have been commanded to do justice among you. Allāh is our Lord and your Lord. For us are our deeds, and for you your deeds.[1415] There is no [need for] argument between us and you.[1416] Allāh will bring us together, and to Him is the [final] destination."
en.footnotes:
[1414] Another meaning understood from the Arabic is "So because of that [division and separation into sects], invite [them back to Allāh]..."
[1415] i.e., the consequences thereof.
[1416] Since the truth has been made clear and since those who refuse it do so only out of stubbornness or worldly interests.

so.text: 15. Arrin(kani) (Towxiidka) ku baaq adigoo ku sugnaan dhabbaha toosan sida lagu amray [7], hana raacin hawadooda (xun) oo dheh: Waxaan rumeynay wuxuu Alle soo dejiyey oo Kitaab ah, waxaana la i amray inaan falo caddaalad dhexdiinna, Allaah baa ah Rabbigayo iyo Rabbigiinba. Waxaan mudan acmaashayada idinkuna waxaad mudan acmaashiinna [8], xujo (hadda) inama dhex taallo [9]. Allaah baa ina soo kulmin innagoo dhan, waana Xaggiisa meel noqodka dambe.
so.footnotes:
[7]. Inta ka go’an hadalka waa ugu yeedh inay tawbad keenaan.
[8]. Waa natiijada camalladooda.
[9]. Marba haddii laga yeelay Xaqa caddaan, kuwaasi Xaqa diida waxay sidaasi u yeelaan oo keliya kibir darti iyo u xilasho dano adduun.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُحَآجُّونَ فِي ٱللَّهِ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا ٱسۡتُجِيبَ لَهُۥ حُجَّتُهُمۡ دَاحِضَةٌ عِندَ رَبِّهِمۡ وَعَلَيۡهِمۡ غَضَبٞ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابٞ شَدِيدٌ

en.text: And those who argue concerning Allāh after He has been responded to[1417] - their argument is invalid with their Lord, and upon them is [His] wrath, and for them is a severe punishment.
en.footnotes: [1417] i.e., after people have accepted the truth from Allāh, in an attempt to turn the believers away from His religion of Islām.

so.text: 16. Kuwa ka dooda Arrinka Alle inta la ajiibay kaddib, xujadoodu qiimo kuma fadhido Rabbigood agti [10], dushoodana Cadho (Alle) baa ah, waxayna leeyihiin Cadaab Daran.
so.footnotes: [10]. Kaddib markay dadku aqbaleen Xaqa ka yimid Alle, waxayna isku dayaan gaalada inay ka weecshaan mu’miniinta xagga Diinta Islaamka.

ayat.arabic: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنزَلَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَٱلۡمِيزَانَۗ وَمَا يُدۡرِيكَ لَعَلَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ قَرِيبٞ

en.text: It is Allāh who has sent down the Book in truth and [also] the balance [i.e., justice]. And what will make you perceive? Perhaps the Hour is near.

so.text: 17. Alle waa Kan ku soo dejiyey Kitaabka (Qur’aanka) Xaq iyo Miisaanka (caddaaladda). Maxaa ku ogeysiin waa intaasoo Saacadda 'Qiyaame' Dhowdahay?

ayat.arabic: يَسۡتَعۡجِلُ بِهَا ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِهَاۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ مُشۡفِقُونَ مِنۡهَا وَيَعۡلَمُونَ أَنَّهَا ٱلۡحَقُّۗ أَلَآ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُمَارُونَ فِي ٱلسَّاعَةِ لَفِي ضَلَٰلِۭ بَعِيدٍ

en.text: Those who do not believe in it are impatient for it,[1418] but those who believe are fearful of it and know that it is the truth. Unquestionably, those who dispute concerning the Hour are in extreme error.
en.footnotes: [1418] They had challenged the Prophet (ﷺ) to bring it on immediately.

so.text: 18. Kuwa aan rumeysneyn baa degdegsa- da [11], halka kuwa rumeysan ay ka cabsi qabaan, waxayna og yihiin inay tahay Xaq. Kuwa uga doodana si gurracan arrinka Saacadda 'Qiyaame' waxay ku sugan yihiin habow fog.
so.footnotes: [11]. Waxay yidhaahdeen haddii ay run yihiin waxaad sheegeyso noo keen cadaabka isla hadda dib u dhig la’aan.

ayat.arabic: ٱللَّهُ لَطِيفُۢ بِعِبَادِهِۦ يَرۡزُقُ مَن يَشَآءُۖ وَهُوَ ٱلۡقَوِيُّ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ

en.text: Allāh is Subtle[1419] with His servants; He gives provision to whom He wills. And He is the Powerful, the Exalted in Might.
en.footnotes: [1419] See footnote in 12:100.

so.text: 19. Alle waa u Roon yahay addoomahiisa. Wuxuu irsaaqaa cidduu doono, waana Xoog Badanaha, Adkaadaha ah.

ayat.arabic: مَن كَانَ يُرِيدُ حَرۡثَ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ نَزِدۡ لَهُۥ فِي حَرۡثِهِۦۖ وَمَن كَانَ يُرِيدُ حَرۡثَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا نُؤۡتِهِۦ مِنۡهَا وَمَا لَهُۥ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ مِن نَّصِيبٍ

en.text: Whoever desires the harvest of the Hereafter - We increase for him in his harvest [i.e., reward]. And whoever desires the harvest [i.e., benefits] of this world - We give him thereof, but there is not for him in the Hereafter any share.

so.text: 20. Qofkii rabaa dalagga (kasabka iyo ajarka) Aakhiro, waan u kordhinnaa dallagiisa (ajarkiisa), Qofkiise raba dalag (kasab) adduunyo wax baan ka siinnaa,  Aakhiradana kuma laha wax saami ah.

ayat.arabic: أَمۡ لَهُمۡ شُرَكَٰٓؤُاْ شَرَعُواْ لَهُم مِّنَ ٱلدِّينِ مَا لَمۡ يَأۡذَنۢ بِهِ ٱللَّهُۚ وَلَوۡلَا كَلِمَةُ ٱلۡفَصۡلِ لَقُضِيَ بَيۡنَهُمۡۗ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٞ

en.text: Or have they partners [i.e., other deities] who have ordained for them a religion to which Allāh has not consented? But if not for the decisive word,[1420] it would have been concluded between them. And indeed, the wrongdoers will have a painful punishment.
en.footnotes: [1420] Decree. See footnote to 10:19.

so.text: 21. Mise waxay leeyihiin shurako (ilaahyo) u jideeyey diin uusan Alle idmin. Haddayna jirin Kelmedda kala bixinta (Qiyaamada in lala sugo oo dib loogu dhigo cadaabka), waa loo kala garsoori lahaa dhexdooda. Daalimiintu waxay leeyihiin (Maalinta Qiyaame) cadaab xanuun badan.

ayat.arabic: تَرَى ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ مُشۡفِقِينَ مِمَّا كَسَبُواْ وَهُوَ وَاقِعُۢ بِهِمۡۗ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فِي رَوۡضَاتِ ٱلۡجَنَّاتِۖ لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمۡۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلۡفَضۡلُ ٱلۡكَبِيرُ

en.text: You will see the wrongdoers fearful of what they have earned, and it will [certainly] befall them. And those who have believed and done righteous deeds will be in lush regions of the gardens [in Paradise] having whatever they will in the presence of their Lord. That is what is the great bounty.

so.text: 22. Waxaad arki daalimiinta oo cabsi ka buuxdo waxay kasbadeen darteed (oo denbiyo ah), wuuna ku dhici iyaga, kuwase (xaqa) rumeeyey oo samaha fala waxay gali keymaha beeraha (Jannada), waxay ka heli  wax kasta ay doonaan Rabbigood agtiisa. (Arrin)kaasi baa ah Fadliga Weyn.

ayat.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلَّذِي يُبَشِّرُ ٱللَّهُ عِبَادَهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِۗ قُل لَّآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ أَجۡرًا إِلَّا ٱلۡمَوَدَّةَ فِي ٱلۡقُرۡبَىٰۗ وَمَن يَقۡتَرِفۡ حَسَنَةٗ نَّزِدۡ لَهُۥ فِيهَا حُسۡنًاۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٞ شَكُورٌ

en.text: It is that of which Allāh gives good tidings to His servants who believe and do righteous deeds. Say, [O Muḥammad], "I do not ask you for it [i.e., this message] any payment [but] only good will through [i.e., due to] kinship." And whoever commits a good deed - We will increase for him good therein. Indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Appreciative.[1421]
en.footnotes: [1421] See footnote in 35:30.

so.text: 23. (Arrin)kaasi waa waxa uu Alle ugu bishaareeyo addoomahiisa (Xaqa) rumeysan oo samaha fala. Dheh: Idinku weydiisan maayo wax abaalgud ah baaqakani, aan aheyn kalgacal qaraabannimo. Qofkii kasbada wanaagna waxaanu siin wanaag ka badan.Hubaal Alle waa Denbi Dhaaf Badane, Mahdin Badan.

ayat.arabic: أَمۡ يَقُولُونَ ٱفۡتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبٗاۖ فَإِن يَشَإِ ٱللَّهُ يَخۡتِمۡ عَلَىٰ قَلۡبِكَۗ وَيَمۡحُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡبَٰطِلَ وَيُحِقُّ ٱلۡحَقَّ بِكَلِمَٰتِهِۦٓۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمُۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ

en.text: Or do they say, "He has invented about Allāh a lie"? But if Allāh willed, He could seal over your heart.[1422] And Allāh eliminates falsehood and establishes the truth by His words. Indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.
en.footnotes: [1422] i.e., He could make you forget the Qur’ān and deprive you of it.

so.text: 24. Mise waxay leeyihin: Wuxuu ka been sheegay Alle? Hadduu doono Alle, wuxuu dabooli lahaa qalbigaaga [12].  Alle wuu tirtiri baadilka, kuna sugi xaqa Kelmadihiisa. Hubaal Alle wuu Ogsoon yahay waxa ku jira laabaha (dadka).
so.footnotes: [12]. Wuxuu kaa yeeli karaa inaad illowdo Qur’aanka oo lagu hilmaansiiyo.

ayat.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي يَقۡبَلُ ٱلتَّوۡبَةَ عَنۡ عِبَادِهِۦ وَيَعۡفُواْ عَنِ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ وَيَعۡلَمُ مَا تَفۡعَلُونَ

en.text: And it is He who accepts repentance from His servants and pardons misdeeds, and He knows what you do.

so.text: 25. (Alle) waa Kan ka aqbala tawbada addoomahiisa ee cafiya denbiyada, wuuna Og yahay waxaad fashaan.

ayat.arabic: وَيَسۡتَجِيبُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَيَزِيدُهُم مِّن فَضۡلِهِۦۚ وَٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٞ شَدِيدٞ

en.text: And He answers [the supplication of] those who have believed and done righteous deeds and increases [for] them from His bounty. But the disbelievers will have a severe punishment.

so.text: 26. Wuxuu (Alle) ajiibaa kuwa (Xaqa) rumeeyey oo samaha fala oo siiyaa wax badan oo ka mid ah Fadligiisa. Gaaladuse waxay leeyihiin Cadaab Daran.

ayat.arabic: ۞ وَلَوۡ بَسَطَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلرِّزۡقَ لِعِبَادِهِۦ لَبَغَوۡاْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَٰكِن يُنَزِّلُ بِقَدَرٖ مَّا يَشَآءُۚ إِنَّهُۥ بِعِبَادِهِۦ خَبِيرُۢ بَصِيرٞ

en.text: And if Allāh had extended [excessively] provision for His servants, they would have committed tyranny throughout the earth. But He sends [it] down in an amount which He wills. Indeed He is, of His servants, Aware and Seeing.

so.text: 27. Hadduu Alle u fidin lahaa risiqa addoomahiisa, waxay ku qooqi lahaayeen arlada, Wuxuuse u soo dejiyaa qaddar waafaqsan siduu rabo. Alle addoomahiisa waa u Xog ogaal, Arkaa.

ayat.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي يُنَزِّلُ ٱلۡغَيۡثَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا قَنَطُواْ وَيَنشُرُ رَحۡمَتَهُۥۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡوَلِيُّ ٱلۡحَمِيدُ

en.text: And it is He who sends down the rain after they had despaired and spreads His mercy. And He is the Protector, the Praiseworthy.

so.text: 28. (Alle) waa Kan soo dejiya roobka kaddib markay quusteen oo faafiya Raxmaddiisa. Waa Isaga Gargaaraha mudan ammaan idilkeed ee la mahdiyo.

ayat.arabic: وَمِنۡ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ خَلۡقُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَثَّ فِيهِمَا مِن دَآبَّةٖۚ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ جَمۡعِهِمۡ إِذَا يَشَآءُ قَدِيرٞ

en.text: And of His signs is the creation of the heavens and earth and what He has dispersed throughout them of creatures. And He, for gathering them when He wills, is competent.

so.text: 29. Waxaa ka mid ah Calaamooyinkiisa (muujin Weynadiisa iyo Waxdaaniyadiisa) abuurista samooyinka iyo arlada iyo wuxuu ku fidiyey (abuuray) dhexdooda oo (nafley) dhul socod ah. Alle inuu soo kulmiyo dhammaantood markuu doono wuu Karaa.

ayat.arabic: وَمَآ أَصَٰبَكُم مِّن مُّصِيبَةٖ فَبِمَا كَسَبَتۡ أَيۡدِيكُمۡ وَيَعۡفُواْ عَن كَثِيرٖ

en.text: And whatever strikes you of disaster - it is for what your hands have earned; but He pardons much.

so.text: 30. Wixii idinku dhaca oo masiibo ah waa waxay kasbadeen gacmiihiinnu (oo denbiyo ah), Wuxuuna (Alle) idinka cafiyaa wax badan.

ayat.arabic: وَمَآ أَنتُم بِمُعۡجِزِينَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَلِيّٖ وَلَا نَصِيرٖ

en.text: And you will not cause failure [to Allāh][1423] upon the earth. And you have not besides Allāh any protector or helper.
en.footnotes: [1423] i.e., escape from Him.

so.text: 31. Kuma baxsan kartaan dhulka, mana lihidin Alle ka sokow ilaaliye iyo gargaare midna.

ayat.arabic: وَمِنۡ ءَايَٰتِهِ ٱلۡجَوَارِ فِي ٱلۡبَحۡرِ كَٱلۡأَعۡلَٰمِ

en.text: And of His signs are the ships in the sea, like mountains.

so.text: 32. Waxaa ka mid ah Calaamooyinka Alle doonyaha badda maaxa buuro oo kale ah.

ayat.arabic: إِن يَشَأۡ يُسۡكِنِ ٱلرِّيحَ فَيَظۡلَلۡنَ رَوَاكِدَ عَلَىٰ ظَهۡرِهِۦٓۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّكُلِّ صَبَّارٖ شَكُورٍ

en.text: If He willed, He could still the wind, and they would remain motionless on its surface. Indeed in that are signs for everyone patient and grateful.

so.text: 33. Hadduu doono, Wuxuu xasiliyaa (joojiyaa) dabeysha, markaasay fadhiistaan biyaha korkooda. Hubaal (arrin)kani waxaa ugu sugan calaamooyin mid kasta oo samir iyo mahad naq badan.

ayat.arabic: أَوۡ يُوبِقۡهُنَّ بِمَا كَسَبُواْ وَيَعۡفُ عَن كَثِيرٖ

en.text: Or He could destroy them[1424] for what they earned; but He pardons much.
en.footnotes: [1424] Meaning that Allāh could sink the ships by means of violent winds.

so.text:
34. Ama waa intaasoo uu u halligo [13] waxay kasbadeen awgeed (oo denbiyo ah), 
 wax badanna (Alle) wuu ka cafiyaa.
so.footnotes: [13]. Macnaha waxaa weeye wuxuu Alle awoodaa inuu harqiyo doomaha isagoo ku keenayo dabeylo daran.

ayat.arabic: وَيَعۡلَمَ ٱلَّذِينَ يُجَٰدِلُونَ فِيٓ ءَايَٰتِنَا مَا لَهُم مِّن مَّحِيصٖ

en.text: And [that is so] those who dispute concerning Our signs may know that for them there is no place of escape.

so.text: 35. Waxayna ogaan kuwa ka dooda Aayadahayaga inaysan u sugnaanin meel ay magan galaan.

ayat.arabic: فَمَآ أُوتِيتُم مِّن شَيۡءٖ فَمَتَٰعُ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَاۚ وَمَا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ خَيۡرٞ وَأَبۡقَىٰ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمۡ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ

en.text: So whatever thing you have been given - it is but [for] enjoyment of the worldly life. But what is with Allāh is better and more lasting for those who have believed and upon their Lord rely

so.text: 36. Wixii la idin siiyo oo wuxuun ah waa uun sahay dhammaaneysa ee nolosha adduunkan, waxase Alle agtiisa ah baa u khayr badan oo daa’insan kuwa (Xaqa) rumeysan ee Rabbigood tala saarta.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَجۡتَنِبُونَ كَبَٰٓئِرَ ٱلۡإِثۡمِ وَٱلۡفَوَٰحِشَ وَإِذَا مَا غَضِبُواْ هُمۡ يَغۡفِرُونَ

en.text: And those who avoid the major sins and immoralities, and when they are angry, they forgive,

so.text: 37.  Ee ah kuwa ka fogaada denbiyada waaweyn iyo xumaha, markay cadhoodaanna wax iska cafiya.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱسۡتَجَابُواْ لِرَبِّهِمۡ وَأَقَامُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَأَمۡرُهُمۡ شُورَىٰ بَيۡنَهُمۡ وَمِمَّا رَزَقۡنَٰهُمۡ يُنفِقُونَ

en.text: And those who have responded to their Lord and established prayer and whose affair is [determined by] consultation among themselves, and from what We have provided them, they spend,

so.text: 38. Ee ah kuwa ajiiba Rabbigood oo ooga salaadda, xukunkooduna wada tashi yahay dhexdooda, waxaan ku irsaaqnayna wax ka bixiya.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَآ أَصَابَهُمُ ٱلۡبَغۡيُ هُمۡ يَنتَصِرُونَ

en.text: And those who, when tyranny strikes them, they retaliate [in a just manner].[1425]
en.footnotes: [1425] Restoring their rights and not allowing aggressors to take advantage of them out of weakness.

so.text: 39. Ee ah kuwa marka la dulmiyo is difaaca [14] 'xad gudub la'aan'.
so.footnotes: [14]. Nabigu s.c.w. wuxuu yiri: “Saamaxaadda wuxuu Alle ugu ziyaadiyaa qofka sharaf iyo ciso.”

ayat.arabic: وَجَزَٰٓؤُاْ سَيِّئَةٖ سَيِّئَةٞ مِّثۡلُهَاۖ فَمَنۡ عَفَا وَأَصۡلَحَ فَأَجۡرُهُۥ عَلَى ٱللَّهِۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ

en.text: And the retribution for an evil act is an evil one like it, but whoever pardons and makes reconciliation - his reward is [due] from Allāh. Indeed, He does not like wrongdoers.

so.text: 40. Abaalka hal xume waa xume la mid ah, qofkii se iska cafiya oo wax hagaajiya, wuxuu ka heli ajarkiisa xagga Alle. Hubaal Alle ma uu jecla daalimiinta (gar diidka).

ayat.arabic: وَلَمَنِ ٱنتَصَرَ بَعۡدَ ظُلۡمِهِۦ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ مَا عَلَيۡهِم مِّن سَبِيلٍ

en.text: And whoever retaliates after having been wronged - those have not upon them any cause [for blame].

so.text: 41. Qofkii is difaaca kaddib marka la dulmiyey, kuwan weeye kuwa aan lagu lahayn jid (lagu eedo).

ayat.arabic: إِنَّمَا ٱلسَّبِيلُ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ يَظۡلِمُونَ ٱلنَّاسَ وَيَبۡغُونَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ بِغَيۡرِ ٱلۡحَقِّۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٞ

en.text: The cause is only against the ones who wrong the people and tyrannize upon the earth without right. Those will have a painful punishment.

so.text: 42. Waxaa sideedaba jid lagu leeyahay (oo eed leh) kuwa dulmiya dadka, oo ku fallaagooba arlada xaq darro, kuwani waxay leeyihiin (Maalinta Qiyaamaha) cadaab xanuun badan.

ayat.arabic: وَلَمَن صَبَرَ وَغَفَرَ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَمِنۡ عَزۡمِ ٱلۡأُمُورِ

en.text: And whoever is patient and forgives - indeed, that is of the matters [worthy] of resolve.[1426]
en.footnotes: [1426] On the part of those seeking the reward of Allāh.

so.text: 43.Qofkii sabra oo wax iska cafiya, kaasi [15] waa arrin loo qasdo (la go'aansado).
so.footnotes: [15]. Xagga kuwa doonaya abaalgduka Alle.

ayat.arabic: وَمَن يُضۡلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن وَلِيّٖ مِّنۢ بَعۡدِهِۦۗ وَتَرَى ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ لَمَّا رَأَوُاْ ٱلۡعَذَابَ يَقُولُونَ هَلۡ إِلَىٰ مَرَدّٖ مِّن سَبِيلٖ

en.text: And he whom Allāh sends astray - for him there is no protector beyond Him. And you will see the wrongdoers, when they see the punishment, saying, "Is there for return [to the former world] any way?"

so.text: 44. Qofkii uu Alle lumiyo, ma uu laha gargaare Isaga kaddib. Waxaadna arki daalimiinta markay arkaan cadaabka, iyagoo leh: Miyey jirtaa jid loogu laabto (adduunkii si aan u tawbad keenno).

ayat.arabic: وَتَرَىٰهُمۡ يُعۡرَضُونَ عَلَيۡهَا خَٰشِعِينَ مِنَ ٱلذُّلِّ يَنظُرُونَ مِن طَرۡفٍ خَفِيّٖۗ وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِنَّ ٱلۡخَٰسِرِينَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓاْ أَنفُسَهُمۡ وَأَهۡلِيهِمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِۗ أَلَآ إِنَّ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ فِي عَذَابٖ مُّقِيمٖ

en.text: And you will see them being exposed to it [i.e., the Fire], humbled from humiliation, looking from [behind] a covert glance. And those who had believed will say, "Indeed, the [true] losers are the ones who lost themselves and their families on the Day of Resurrection. Unquestionably, the wrongdoers are in an enduring punishment."

so.text: 45. Waxaad arki (gaalada) iyagoo la hor keenay (Naarta) la tabaaleysan dulli (oo) ku eegaya libiqsi qarsoon. Kuwa (Xaqa) rumeeyey waxay odhan: Hubaal Khasaara- yaasha waa kuwa khasaaray nafahooda iyo eheladooda Maalinta Qiyaamaha. Ogaada, hubaal, daalimiintu waxay ku sugnaan (Qiyaamada) cadaab ma guuraan ah.

ayat.arabic: وَمَا كَانَ لَهُم مِّنۡ أَوۡلِيَآءَ يَنصُرُونَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِۗ وَمَن يُضۡلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن سَبِيلٍ

en.text: And there will not be for them any allies to aid them other than Allāh. And whoever Allāh sends astray - for him there is no way.

so.text: 46. Uma sugnaan awliyo u soo gargaari Alle ka sokow. Qofkii uu Alle lumiyo, uma sugna  wax jid ah (uu ku tooso).

ayat.arabic: ٱسۡتَجِيبُواْ لِرَبِّكُم مِّن قَبۡلِ أَن يَأۡتِيَ يَوۡمٞ لَّا مَرَدَّ لَهُۥ مِنَ ٱللَّهِۚ مَا لَكُم مِّن مَّلۡجَإٖ يَوۡمَئِذٖ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن نَّكِيرٖ

en.text: Respond to your Lord before a Day comes from Allāh of which there is no repelling. No refuge will you have that Day, nor for you will there be any denial.[1427]
en.footnotes: [1427] Of your sins or "disapproval" of your punishment.

so.text: 47. Ajiiba Rabbigiin ka hor inta aanay iman Maalin xagga Alle ah aan la celin karin. Ma leh meel aad magan gashaan Maalintaas, mana inkiri kartaan denbiyadiinna [16].
so.footnotes: [16]. Ma suurowdo inaad inkirtaan denbiyadiinna ama ka hor timaaddaan Ciqaabka Alle.

ayat.arabic: فَإِنۡ أَعۡرَضُواْ فَمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَٰكَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ حَفِيظًاۖ إِنۡ عَلَيۡكَ إِلَّا ٱلۡبَلَٰغُۗ وَإِنَّآ إِذَآ أَذَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ مِنَّا رَحۡمَةٗ فَرِحَ بِهَاۖ وَإِن تُصِبۡهُمۡ سَيِّئَةُۢ بِمَا قَدَّمَتۡ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ فَإِنَّ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ كَفُورٞ

en.text: But if they turn away - then We have not sent you, [O Muḥammad], over them as a guardian; upon you is only [the duty of] notification. And indeed, when We let man taste mercy from Us, he rejoices in it; but if evil afflicts him for what his hands have put forth, then indeed, man is ungrateful.

so.text: 48. Hadday jeesadaan, kuuma aanu soo dirin ilaaliye ahaan korkooda. Ee waxa keliya ee ku saarani waa inaad gaarsiiso (Fartiinta). Markaanna dhadhansiinno Aadmiga naxariis Xaggayaga ah, wuu ku farxaa, haddayse musiibo gaadho waxay horay gacmahoodu u faleen darteed ah, Aadmigu wuu abaal dhac badan yahay.

ayat.arabic: لِّلَّهِ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ يَخۡلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُۚ يَهَبُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ إِنَٰثٗا وَيَهَبُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ ٱلذُّكُورَ

en.text: To Allāh belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth; He creates what He wills. He gives to whom He wills female [children], and He gives to whom He wills males.

so.text: 49. Alle baa iska leh Mulkiga (iyo Maamulka) samooyinka iyo arlada. Wuxuu abuuraa Wuxuu doono. Wuxuu ugu deeqaa qofkuu doono gabdho, oo ugu deeqaa qofkuu doono wiilal.

ayat.arabic: أَوۡ يُزَوِّجُهُمۡ ذُكۡرَانٗا وَإِنَٰثٗاۖ وَيَجۡعَلُ مَن يَشَآءُ عَقِيمًاۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٞ قَدِيرٞ

en.text: Or He makes them [both] males and females, and He renders whom He wills barren. Indeed, He is Knowing and Competent.

so.text: 50. Ama Wuxuu isugu daraa labada noocyoodba’ lab iyo dheddig, wuxuuna ka dhigaa qofkuu doono ma dhaleys. Hubaal Alle waa wax kasta Oge, Awood Badan.

ayat.arabic: ۞ وَمَا كَانَ لِبَشَرٍ أَن يُكَلِّمَهُ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا وَحۡيًا أَوۡ مِن وَرَآيِٕ حِجَابٍ أَوۡ يُرۡسِلَ رَسُولٗا فَيُوحِيَ بِإِذۡنِهِۦ مَا يَشَآءُۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيٌّ حَكِيمٞ

en.text: And it is not for any human being that Allāh should speak to him except by revelation or from behind a partition or that He sends a messenger [i.e., angel] to reveal, by His permission, what He wills. Indeed, He is Most High and Wise.

so.text: 51.Uma suurowda in Aadmi uu Alle toos ula hadlo Waxyi mooyee, ama kala hadlo daah gadaashi ama uu u soo diro Rasuul (malag ah) oo Idanki wuxuu doono ugu waxyooda. Hubaal (Alle) waa Sarreeye, Xakiim ah.

ayat.arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَيۡكَ رُوحٗا مِّنۡ أَمۡرِنَاۚ مَا كُنتَ تَدۡرِي مَا ٱلۡكِتَٰبُ وَلَا ٱلۡإِيمَٰنُ وَلَٰكِن جَعَلۡنَٰهُ نُورٗا نَّهۡدِي بِهِۦ مَن نَّشَآءُ مِنۡ عِبَادِنَاۚ وَإِنَّكَ لَتَهۡدِيٓ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٖ مُّسۡتَقِيمٖ

en.text: And thus We have revealed to you an inspiration of Our command [i.e., the Qur’ān]. You did not know what is the Book or [what is] faith, but We have made it a light by which We guide whom We will of Our servants. And indeed, [O Muḥammad], you guide to a straight path -

so.text: 52. Sidaasaan kuugu waxyoonnay Ruux (Qur’aan) Amarkayaga ah, ma aadan ogeyn wuxuu yahay Kitaab iyo Iimaan midna? Waxaanse ka yeelnay Nuur aan ku hanuuninno ciddaan doonno oo ka mid ah addoomahayaga. Oo xaqiiq Adigu (Nabi Muxammadow) waxaad ku hanuunisaa (dadka) Jid Toosan.

ayat.arabic: صِرَٰطِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِي لَهُۥ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۗ أَلَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ تَصِيرُ ٱلۡأُمُورُ

en.text: The path of Allāh, to whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Unquestionably, to Allāh do [all] matters evolve [i.e., return].

so.text: 53. Jidka Alle, ee ah Kan iska leh waxa ku sugan samooyinka iyo waxa ku sugan arlada. Ogaada, xagga Alle bay u ahaan umuuraha oo idil (wuuna idin abaal marin, qof walba iyo camalki).

ayat.arabic: حمٓ

en.text: Ḥā, Meem.[1429]
en.footnotes: [1429] See footnote to 2:1.

so.text: 1. Xaa Miim [1].
so.footnotes: [1]. Eeg sharaxa hoose ee Suuradda 2 Al-Baqarah: Aayadda 1.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلۡكِتَٰبِ ٱلۡمُبِينِ

en.text: By the clear Book,

so.text: 2. Waxaan ku dhaartay Kitaabka (Qur’aanka) ee caddeeya (Xaqa).

ayat.arabic: إِنَّا جَعَلۡنَٰهُ قُرۡءَٰنًا عَرَبِيّٗا لَّعَلَّكُمۡ تَعۡقِلُونَ

en.text: Indeed, We have made it an Arabic Qur’ān that you might understand.

so.text: 3. Hubaal Annagaa (Alle ah) ka yeellay Qur’aan af Carabi ah, si aad u fahantaan.

ayat.arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ فِيٓ أُمِّ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ لَدَيۡنَا لَعَلِيٌّ حَكِيمٌ

en.text: And indeed it is, in the Mother of the Book[1430] with Us, exalted and full of wisdom.[1431]
en.footnotes:
[1430] i.e., the Preserved Slate (al-Lawḥ al-Maḥfūẓ).
[1431] Also, "precise" or "specific."

so.text: 4. Wuxuuna xaqiiq ku sugan yahay asalka Kitaabka [2] nala yaal, Kor ah, Xikmad Badan.
so.footnotes: [2]. Waxaa loola jeedaa Looxa Maxfuudka.

ayat.arabic: أَفَنَضۡرِبُ عَنكُمُ ٱلذِّكۡرَ صَفۡحًا أَن كُنتُمۡ قَوۡمٗا مُّسۡرِفِينَ

en.text: Then should We turn the message away, disregarding you, because you are a transgressing people?

so.text: 5. Miyaan idinka deysannaa (Qur’aanka) gebigiisaba inaad tihiin qolo xad gudub badan awgeed?

ayat.arabic: وَكَمۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مِن نَّبِيّٖ فِي ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ

en.text: And how many a prophet We sent among the former peoples,

so.text: 6. Badanaa intaan Nabi u dirnay kuwii hore dhexdood!

ayat.arabic: وَمَا يَأۡتِيهِم مِّن نَّبِيٍّ إِلَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ

en.text: But there would not come to them a prophet except that they used to ridicule him.

so.text: 7. Ma jirin Nabi u yimaada oo aysan ku jees-jeesin.

ayat.arabic: فَأَهۡلَكۡنَآ أَشَدَّ مِنۡهُم بَطۡشٗا وَمَضَىٰ مَثَلُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ

en.text: And We destroyed greater than them[1432] in [striking] power, and the example of the former peoples has preceded.
en.footnotes: [1432] The disbelievers of the Quraysh, who denied Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ).

so.text: 8. Markaasaan hallignay kuwo [3] ka xoog iyo qabasho badnaa, waxaana hore u tagay mataalka kuwii hore (ee la halaagay).
so.footnotes: [3]. Waxaa loola jeedaa gaalada ku jira Quraysh, iwm.

ayat.arabic: وَلَئِن سَأَلۡتَهُم مَّنۡ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ خَلَقَهُنَّ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ

en.text: And if you should ask them, "Who has created the heavens and the earth?" they would surely say, "They were created by the Exalted in Might, the Knowing,"

so.text: 9. Haddaad (gaaladaa) weydiiso: Yaa abuuray samooyinka iyo arlada? Waxay odhan: Waxaa abuuray (Alle) Adkaadaha, Wax kasta Ogaha ah.

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ مَهۡدٗا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمۡ فِيهَا سُبُلٗا لَّعَلَّكُمۡ تَهۡتَدُونَ

en.text: [The one] who has made for you the earth a bed and made for you upon it roads that you might be guided

so.text: 10. Kan idiinka dhigay dhulka gogol, idiinkuna yeelay dhexdiisa waddooyin si aad ugu toostaan.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّذِي نَزَّلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءَۢ بِقَدَرٖ فَأَنشَرۡنَا بِهِۦ بَلۡدَةٗ مَّيۡتٗاۚ كَذَٰلِكَ تُخۡرَجُونَ

en.text: And who sends down rain from the sky in measured amounts, and We revive thereby a dead land - thus will you be brought forth -

so.text: 11. Ee ah Kan ka soo dejiya daruuraha biyo qaddaran oo aan ku nooleyno magaalo dhimatay, sidaasaa la idiin soo bixin (dhimasho kaddib).

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلۡأَزۡوَٰجَ كُلَّهَا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡفُلۡكِ وَٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمِ مَا تَرۡكَبُونَ

en.text: And who created the species, all of them, and has made for you of ships and animals those which you mount

so.text: 12. Ee ah Kan abuuray noocyada wax waliba oo idiin yeelay doonyo [4] iyo xoolo [5] aad fuushan.
so.footnotes:
[4]. Sidoo kale diyaarado, tareenno, gawaadhi, iwm.
[5]. Geel, lo', fardo, iwm.

ayat.arabic: لِتَسۡتَوُۥاْ عَلَىٰ ظُهُورِهِۦ ثُمَّ تَذۡكُرُواْ نِعۡمَةَ رَبِّكُمۡ إِذَا ٱسۡتَوَيۡتُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ وَتَقُولُواْ سُبۡحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُۥ مُقۡرِنِينَ

en.text: That you may settle yourselves upon their backs and then remember the favor of your Lord when you have settled upon them and say, "Exalted is He who has subjected this to us, and we could not have [otherwise] subdued it.[1433]
en.footnotes: [1433] Literally, "made it a companion" or "made it compatible."

so.text: 13. Si aad u kortaan dushooda, markaas aad xustaan Nicmadda Rabbigiin markaad dushooda kortaan, oo tidhaahdaan: waxaa ka hufan (xumaan) Kan 'Alle' ee noo sakhiray waxakan, mana aheyn kuwo kara leyligeeda.

ayat.arabic: وَإِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ

en.text: And indeed we, to our Lord, will [surely] return."

so.text: 14. Innaguna xaqiiq xagga Rabbigayo (Allaah) yaanu u guddoomeynaa.

ayat.arabic: وَجَعَلُواْ لَهُۥ مِنۡ عِبَادِهِۦ جُزۡءًاۚ إِنَّ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ لَكَفُورٞ مُّبِينٌ

en.text: But they have attributed to Him from His servants a portion.[1434] Indeed, man is clearly ungrateful.
en.footnotes: [1434] By claiming that He (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) has a son or daughters, as it is said that a child is part of his parent. This concept is totally incompatible with Allāh's unity and exclusiveness.

so.text: 15. Waxayse ka yeelaan qayb ka mid ah addoomihiisa 'shariigyo la wadaaga Alle cibaadada' [6]; Hubaal Aadmigu waa abaal darane caddaysatay.
so.footnotes: [6]. Iyagoo ku andacooda inuu Alle s.w.t. leeyahay wiil ama gabdho. Arrinkanna kuma habboona Alle, waayo waa Keli aan wax shariik ah lahayn iyo xaas iyo ilmo midna.

ayat.arabic: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذَ مِمَّا يَخۡلُقُ بَنَاتٖ وَأَصۡفَىٰكُم بِٱلۡبَنِينَ

en.text: Or has He taken, out of what He has created, daughters and chosen you for [having] sons?

so.text: 16. Ma wuxuu (Alle) ka yeeshay  wuxuu abuuray qaarkood (malaa’igta) gabdho, oo idiin dooray wiilal.

ayat.arabic: وَإِذَا بُشِّرَ أَحَدُهُم بِمَا ضَرَبَ لِلرَّحۡمَٰنِ مَثَلٗا ظَلَّ وَجۡهُهُۥ مُسۡوَدّٗا وَهُوَ كَظِيمٌ

en.text: And when one of them is given good tidings of that which he attributes to the Most Merciful in comparison [i.e., a daughter], his face becomes dark, and he suppresses grief.

so.text: 17. Marka loogu bishaareeyo midkood waxa (gabdhaha) uu u nisbeeyo Raxmaanka 'Alle' ugana yeelo tusaale, wuxuu wejigiisu noqdaa madow isagoo walbahaarsan.

ayat.arabic: أَوَمَن يُنَشَّؤُاْ فِي ٱلۡحِلۡيَةِ وَهُوَ فِي ٱلۡخِصَامِ غَيۡرُ مُبِينٖ

en.text: So is one brought up in ornaments while being during conflict unevident[1435] [attributed to Allāh]?
en.footnotes: [1435] Not "obvious" or "distinct" in an argument. Or not "seen," i.e., absent from battles. The reference is to a daughter.

so.text: 18. Ma (Allay ku sheegaan inuu dhalay gabdho) ah kuwo ku barbaara isqurxin oo aan doodna caddeyn karin?

ayat.arabic: وَجَعَلُواْ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ ٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ عِبَٰدُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ إِنَٰثًاۚ أَشَهِدُواْ خَلۡقَهُمۡۚ سَتُكۡتَبُ شَهَٰدَتُهُمۡ وَيُسۡـَٔلُونَ

en.text: And they described the angels, who are servants of the Most Merciful, as females. Did they witness their creation? Their testimony will be recorded, and they will be questioned.

so.text: 19. Oo waxay ka yeelaan malaa’igta ah addoomaha Raxmaanka dheddig, miyey joogeen abuurkoodii? Maraggooda waa la qori oo la weydiin 'arrinkaa' [7].
so.footnotes: [7]. Mushrikiintu waxay yidhaahdaan malaa’igtu waa gabdhahii Alle, laakiin sida dhabta ah waa inay malaa’igtu yihiin qaar ka mid ah addoomaha Ilaahay ee la sharfay.

ayat.arabic: وَقَالُواْ لَوۡ شَآءَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ مَا عَبَدۡنَٰهُمۗ مَّا لَهُم بِذَٰلِكَ مِنۡ عِلۡمٍۖ إِنۡ هُمۡ إِلَّا يَخۡرُصُونَ

en.text: And they said, "If the Most Merciful had willed, we would not have worshipped them." They have of that no knowledge. They are not but misjudging.

so.text: 20. Waxay yidhaahdeen: Hadduu doono Raxmaanku, marnaba ma aanu caabudneen (wax kale). Uma ay laha wax cilmi ah (arrin)kani, been uun bay sheegi.

ayat.arabic: أَمۡ ءَاتَيۡنَٰهُمۡ كِتَٰبٗا مِّن قَبۡلِهِۦ فَهُم بِهِۦ مُسۡتَمۡسِكُونَ

en.text: Or have We given them a book before it [i.e., the Qur’ān] to which they are adhering?

so.text: 21. Mise waxaan siinnay Kitaab ka horreeyey (Qur’aanka oo amri inay caabudaan Alle qeyrki) oo ay heystaan?

ayat.arabic: بَلۡ قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا وَجَدۡنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا عَلَىٰٓ أُمَّةٖ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِهِم مُّهۡتَدُونَ

en.text: Rather, they say, "Indeed, we found our fathers upon a religion, and we are in their footsteps [rightly] guided."

so.text: 22. Waxayse yidhaahdeen: Waxaan hellay aabbayaashayoo ku sugan dariiqo, innaguna iyaga raadkoodii baan ku hanuunsannahay.

ayat.arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مِن قَبۡلِكَ فِي قَرۡيَةٖ مِّن نَّذِيرٍ إِلَّا قَالَ مُتۡرَفُوهَآ إِنَّا وَجَدۡنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا عَلَىٰٓ أُمَّةٖ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِهِم مُّقۡتَدُونَ

en.text: And similarly, We did not send before you any warner into a city except that its affluent said, "Indeed, we found our fathers upon a religion, and we are, in their footsteps, following."

so.text: 23. Sidaasoo kale, Uma aanu soo dirin hortaa wax dige ah magaalana oo aysan kuwooda ladnaa ee ku jiray odhan: Waxaan hellay aabbayaashayoo ku sugan dariiqo, waxaan annaguna raacnaa raadadkoodii.

ayat.arabic: ۞ قَٰلَ أَوَلَوۡ جِئۡتُكُم بِأَهۡدَىٰ مِمَّا وَجَدتُّمۡ عَلَيۡهِ ءَابَآءَكُمۡۖ قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا بِمَآ أُرۡسِلۡتُم بِهِۦ كَٰفِرُونَ

en.text: [Each warner] said, "Even if I brought you better guidance than that [religion] upon which you found your fathers?" They said, "Indeed we, in that with which you were sent, are disbelievers."

so.text: 24. (Digihii) wuxuu yidhi: Ma xitaa haddaan idiin keeno hanuun ka fiican waxaad ka he- sheen aabbayaashiin? Waxay yidhaahdeen: Innagu ku gaalownay waxa (Xaqa) la idinla soo diray.

ayat.arabic: فَٱنتَقَمۡنَا مِنۡهُمۡۖ فَٱنظُرۡ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ

en.text: So We took retribution from them; then see how was the end of the deniers.

so.text: 25. Markaasaan ka aarsannay ee fiiri siday aheyd cidhibta xaq diidayaasha.

ayat.arabic: وَإِذۡ قَالَ إِبۡرَٰهِيمُ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوۡمِهِۦٓ إِنَّنِي بَرَآءٞ مِّمَّا تَعۡبُدُونَ

en.text: And [mention, O Muḥammad], when Abraham said to his father and his people, "Indeed, I am disassociated from that which you worship

so.text: 26. (Xus) markuu Ibraahiim ku yidhi aabbihi iyo qolodiisii: Anigu waxaan xaqiiq barii ka ahay waxaad caabuddaan oo dhan.

ayat.arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِي فَطَرَنِي فَإِنَّهُۥ سَيَهۡدِينِ

en.text: Except for He who created me; and indeed, He will guide me."

so.text: 27. Aan ahayn Kan i abuuray (Allaah), Isagaa i hanuunin.

ayat.arabic: وَجَعَلَهَا كَلِمَةَۢ بَاقِيَةٗ فِي عَقِبِهِۦ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَرۡجِعُونَ

en.text: And he made it[1436] a word remaining among his descendants that they might return [to it].
en.footnotes: [1436] i.e., his testimony that none is worthy of worship except Allāh.

so.text: 28. Wuxuuna ka yeelay Kalimadda [8] (Towxiidka) mid ku baaqi ah durriyaddiisa dhexdooda [9], si ay (Xaqa) ugu noqdaan.
so.footnotes:
[8]. Waa Kalimada Laa ilaaha illal Laah. 
[9]. Nabi Ibraahiim c.s. wuxuu ka dhigay towxiidka wax ku baaqi ah firkiisa.

ayat.arabic: بَلۡ مَتَّعۡتُ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَءَابَآءَهُمۡ حَتَّىٰ جَآءَهُمُ ٱلۡحَقُّ وَرَسُولٞ مُّبِينٞ

en.text: However, I gave enjoyment to these [people of Makkah] and their fathers[1437] until there came to them the truth and a clear Messenger.[1438]
en.footnotes:
[1437] The descendants of Abraham.
[1438] i.e., one who is obvious with a clear message, meaning Muḥammad (ﷺ).

so.text: 29. Waxaanse ugu raaxeeyey kuwaas (gaalada) iyo aabbayaashoodba (adduunka) ilaa uu u yimid Xaqu (Qur’aanka) iyo Rasuul cad [10].
so.footnotes: [10]. Waxaa loola jeedaa Nabi Muxammad s.c.w.

ayat.arabic: وَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلۡحَقُّ قَالُواْ هَٰذَا سِحۡرٞ وَإِنَّا بِهِۦ كَٰفِرُونَ

en.text: But when the truth came to them, they said, "This is magic, and indeed we are, concerning it, disbelievers."

so.text: 30. Markuu u yimid Xaqa waxay yidhaah- deen: Kani (Qur’aanku) waa sixir, innaguna xaqiiq ku gaalownay.

ayat.arabic: وَقَالُواْ لَوۡلَا نُزِّلَ هَٰذَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانُ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٖ مِّنَ ٱلۡقَرۡيَتَيۡنِ عَظِيمٍ

en.text: And they said, "Why was this Qur’ān not sent down upon a great man from [one of] the two cities?"[1439]
en.footnotes: [1439] Referring to Makkah and aṭ-Ṭā’if.

so.text: 31. Waxay yidhaahdeen: Maxaa Qur’aankan loogu soo dejin waayey nin darajo weyn oo ka tirsan labada magaalo [11]?
so.footnotes: [11]. Waxaa loola jeedaa labaadaa magaalo Makkah iyo Daa’if.

ayat.arabic: أَهُمۡ يَقۡسِمُونَ رَحۡمَتَ رَبِّكَۚ نَحۡنُ قَسَمۡنَا بَيۡنَهُم مَّعِيشَتَهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَاۚ وَرَفَعۡنَا بَعۡضَهُمۡ فَوۡقَ بَعۡضٖ دَرَجَٰتٖ لِّيَتَّخِذَ بَعۡضُهُم بَعۡضٗا سُخۡرِيّٗاۗ وَرَحۡمَتُ رَبِّكَ خَيۡرٞ مِّمَّا يَجۡمَعُونَ

en.text: Do they distribute the mercy of your Lord? It is We who have apportioned among them their livelihood in the life of this world and have raised some of them above others in degrees [of rank] that they may make use of one another for service. But the mercy of your Lord is better than whatever they accumulate.

so.text: 32. Ma iyagaa ah kuwa qaybiya Naxariista Rabbigaa? Annagaa (Alle ah) ka qaybinna dhexdooda maciishaddooda nolosha adduunkan, oo ka kormarinnay qaarkoodba qaarka kale derejooyin, si ay qaarkood qaarka kale ugu adeegtaan.  Naxariista Rabbigaa baana ka khayr badan waxay urursadaan (oo maal adduunyo ah).

ayat.arabic: وَلَوۡلَآ أَن يَكُونَ ٱلنَّاسُ أُمَّةٗ وَٰحِدَةٗ لَّجَعَلۡنَا لِمَن يَكۡفُرُ بِٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ لِبُيُوتِهِمۡ سُقُفٗا مِّن فِضَّةٖ وَمَعَارِجَ عَلَيۡهَا يَظۡهَرُونَ

en.text: And if it were not that the people would become one community [of disbelievers],[1440] We would have made for those who disbelieve in the Most Merciful - for their houses - ceilings and stairways of silver upon which to mount.
en.footnotes: [1440] Who assumed that Allāh's generosity to them was a sign of His approval or who would hasten to disbelief in order to obtain wealth.

so.text: 33. Hadduusan dadku noqonayn ummad keliya (isku jid ah dhammaantood) waxaan ka yeeli laheyn kuwa ku gaalooba Raxmaanka guryahooda saqafyo fiddo ah iyo salaanno (fiddo ah) ay ku koraan [12].
so.footnotes: [12]. Allaah wuxuu leeyahay waxaan ku siin lahayn gaalada wax kasta adduunka haddii aanay dad kale ku fidnoobeyn arrinkaasi, waayo Aakhiro ma leh gaaladaa waxaan aheyn Naar.

ayat.arabic: وَلِبُيُوتِهِمۡ أَبۡوَٰبٗا وَسُرُرًا عَلَيۡهَا يَتَّكِـُٔونَ

en.text: And for their houses - doors and couches [of silver] upon which to recline

so.text: 34. Guryahoodana albaabbo (fiddo ah) iyo sariiro 'sare'ay korkooda ku dangiigsadaan.

ayat.arabic: وَزُخۡرُفٗاۚ وَإِن كُلُّ ذَٰلِكَ لَمَّا مَتَٰعُ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَاۚ وَٱلۡأٓخِرَةُ عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ

en.text: And gold ornament. But all that is not but the enjoyment of worldly life. And the Hereafter with your Lord is for the righteous.

so.text: 35. Iyo qurxinno (kaloo) dahab ah. Waxa- kani oo dhammina ma aha waxaan aheyn raaxada nolosha adduunkan (ee dhammaa- neysa). Aakhirada Rabbigaa agti ahna waxaa leh oo keliya dhowrsanayaasha.

ayat.arabic: وَمَن يَعۡشُ عَن ذِكۡرِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ نُقَيِّضۡ لَهُۥ شَيۡطَٰنٗا فَهُوَ لَهُۥ قَرِينٞ

en.text: And whoever is blinded from remembrance of the Most Merciful - We appoint for him a devil, and he is to him a companion.

so.text: 36. Qofkii ka jeesada xuska Raxmaanka (Qur’aanka) waxaanu u xil saarnaa Shaydaan oo ku lammaansanaan.

ayat.arabic: وَإِنَّهُمۡ لَيَصُدُّونَهُمۡ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَيَحۡسَبُونَ أَنَّهُم مُّهۡتَدُونَ

en.text: And indeed, they [i.e., the devils] avert them from the way [of guidance] while they think that they are [rightly] guided

so.text: 37. Waxay ka duwaanna Jidka (Xaqa),  waxayna isu maleyn inay hanuunsan yihiin.

ayat.arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَنَا قَالَ يَٰلَيۡتَ بَيۡنِي وَبَيۡنَكَ بُعۡدَ ٱلۡمَشۡرِقَيۡنِ فَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡقَرِينُ

en.text: Until, when he comes to Us [at Judgement], he says [to his companion], "How I wish there was between me and you the distance between the east and west; and what a wretched companion."

so.text: 38. Jeer markuu noo yimaado wuxuu ku yidhaahdaa (shaydaankaa): wayee, may dhexdeenna ahaato intay isu jiraan bariga iyo galbeedka oo kale; adigaa u xune cid lala xidhiidho.

ayat.arabic: وَلَن يَنفَعَكُمُ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ إِذ ظَّلَمۡتُمۡ أَنَّكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡعَذَابِ مُشۡتَرِكُونَ

en.text: And never will it benefit you that Day, when you have wronged, that you are [all] sharing in the punishment.

so.text: 39. Wax idiinma tareyso (gaaloy) Maalintan (Qiyaamada) maadaama  aad dulmi fasheen inaad cadaabka (musiibada) wadaagtaan.

ayat.arabic: أَفَأَنتَ تُسۡمِعُ ٱلصُّمَّ أَوۡ تَهۡدِي ٱلۡعُمۡيَ وَمَن كَانَ فِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٖ

en.text: Then will you make the deaf hear, [O Muḥammad], or guide the blind or he who is in clear error?

so.text: 40. Ma adigaa wax maqashiin kara (Nabiyow) dhegoolaha, mase hanuunin kartaa indhoolaha iyo mid ku jira habow cad?

ayat.arabic: فَإِمَّا نَذۡهَبَنَّ بِكَ فَإِنَّا مِنۡهُم مُّنتَقِمُونَ

en.text: And whether [or not] We take you away [in death], indeed, We will take retribution upon them.

so.text: 41. Haddaan ku oofsanno, Annaga uun baa ka aarsan iyaga (gaalada).

ayat.arabic: أَوۡ نُرِيَنَّكَ ٱلَّذِي وَعَدۡنَٰهُمۡ فَإِنَّا عَلَيۡهِم مُّقۡتَدِرُونَ

en.text: Or whether [or not] We show you that which We have promised them, indeed, We are Perfect in Ability.

so.text: 42. Ama aan ku tusinno waxaan ugu gooddinno oo cadaab ah, waxaanu ku leennahay dushooda awood buuxda.

ayat.arabic: فَٱسۡتَمۡسِكۡ بِٱلَّذِيٓ أُوحِيَ إِلَيۡكَۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٖ مُّسۡتَقِيمٖ

en.text: So adhere to that which is revealed to you. Indeed, you are on a straight path.

so.text: 43. Ee qabso waxaa laguu waxyooday (Qur’aanka), waxaad ku sugan tahay Tub Toosan (Islaamka).

ayat.arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَذِكۡرٞ لَّكَ وَلِقَوۡمِكَۖ وَسَوۡفَ تُسۡـَٔلُونَ

en.text: And indeed, it is a remembrance[1441] for you and your people, and you [all] are going to be questioned.
en.footnotes: [1441] i.e., an honor. Or "a reminder."

so.text: 44. (Qur’aankanina) waa kuu waano (sharaf iyo darajo) adiga iyo dadkaaba, waana la idin weydiin.

ayat.arabic: وَسۡـَٔلۡ مَنۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مِن قَبۡلِكَ مِن رُّسُلِنَآ أَجَعَلۡنَا مِن دُونِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ ءَالِهَةٗ يُعۡبَدُونَ

en.text: And ask those We sent before you of Our messengers; have We made besides the Most Merciful deities to be worshipped?

so.text: 45. Weydii kuwaa ka midka ah Rusushayada aan soo dirnay hortaa: Ma waxaan yeellay Raxmaanka (Allaah) ka sokow ilaahyo la caabudo ?

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مُوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَمَلَإِيْهِۦ فَقَالَ إِنِّي رَسُولُ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

en.text: And certainly did We send Moses with Our signs to Pharaoh and his establishment, and he said, "Indeed, I am the messenger of the Lord of the worlds."

so.text: 46. Waxaanu dhab ahaan Muuse la soo dirnay Aayadahayaga xagga Fircoon iyo xildhibaannadiisii, markaasuu yidhi: Anigu waxaan ahay Rasuulka Rabbiga uumanka.

ayat.arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ إِذَا هُم مِّنۡهَا يَضۡحَكُونَ

en.text: But when he brought them Our signs, at once they laughed at them.

so.text: 47. Markiise uu ula yimid Calaamooyinka- yaga mise wayba ku qosleen.

ayat.arabic: وَمَا نُرِيهِم مِّنۡ ءَايَةٍ إِلَّا هِيَ أَكۡبَرُ مِنۡ أُخۡتِهَاۖ وَأَخَذۡنَٰهُم بِٱلۡعَذَابِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَرۡجِعُونَ

en.text: And We showed them not a sign except that it was greater than its sister, and We seized them with affliction that perhaps they might return [to faith].

so.text: 48. Ma jirin mucjiso aan tusinnay oo aan ka weyneyn eynigeed kale, waxaana ku qabannay cadaab [13] bal inay u soo laabtaan (Xaqa).
so.footnotes: [13]. Cadaabkaas waa cadaab adduunka ah sida raashinka oo ku yaraaday, beeraha oo lagu salliday ayax tiro badan, xoolaha oo ay abaar ka leysey, iwm.

ayat.arabic: وَقَالُواْ يَٰٓأَيُّهَ ٱلسَّاحِرُ ٱدۡعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ بِمَا عَهِدَ عِندَكَ إِنَّنَا لَمُهۡتَدُونَ

en.text: And they said [to Moses], "O magician, invoke for us your Lord by what He has promised you. Indeed, we will be guided."

so.text: 49. Waxay yidhaahdeen: Kan Saaxirka  (caalimka) ahow! Noo bari Rabbigaa wuxuu kuugula ballantamay. (Haddii nalaga feydo cadaabka) waanu hanuuni (raaci Xaqa).

ayat.arabic: فَلَمَّا كَشَفۡنَا عَنۡهُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابَ إِذَا هُمۡ يَنكُثُونَ

en.text: But when We removed from them the affliction, at once they broke their word.

so.text: 50. Markiise aan ka faydnay cadaabka, mise, markiiba waxay ka baxeen ballankii.

ayat.arabic: وَنَادَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنُ فِي قَوۡمِهِۦ قَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ أَلَيۡسَ لِي مُلۡكُ مِصۡرَ وَهَٰذِهِ ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِيٓۚ أَفَلَا تُبۡصِرُونَ

en.text: And Pharaoh called out among his people; he said, "O my people, does not the kingdom of Egypt belong to me, and these rivers flowing beneath me; then do you not see?

so.text: 51. Wuxuu ka dhawaaqay Fircoon dadkiisii dhexdood isagoo leh: Dadkaygiiyow! Miyaanan anigu iska lahayn boqortooyada Masar iyo webiyadan qul-qula hoosteyda. Ee miyeydaan arkeyn?.

ayat.arabic: أَمۡ أَنَا۠ خَيۡرٞ مِّنۡ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي هُوَ مَهِينٞ وَلَا يَكَادُ يُبِينُ

en.text: Or am I [not] better than this one [i.e., Moses] who is insignificant and hardly makes himself clear?[1442]
en.footnotes: [1442] That was true previous to his appointment as a prophet, at which time Allāh corrected his speech impediment.

so.text: 52. Sow aniga kama fiicni midkani liita ee aan kareyn inuu caddeeyo hadalkiisa [14].
so.footnotes: [14]. Waxay ula jeedaan Nabi Muuse c.s. Taasina dhab bay ahayd ka hor inta aan Muuse laga dhigin Nabi, markii la soo diray isagoo Nabi ah wuxuu Allaah ka furay guntinta carrabkiisa oo ka dhigay cod kar hadal cad.

ayat.arabic: فَلَوۡلَآ أُلۡقِيَ عَلَيۡهِ أَسۡوِرَةٞ مِّن ذَهَبٍ أَوۡ جَآءَ مَعَهُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ مُقۡتَرِنِينَ

en.text: Then why have there not been placed upon him bracelets of gold or come with him the angels in conjunction?"

so.text: 53. Maxaa loo siin waayey jinjimo dahab ah, ama maxay ula iman weydey malaa’ig raacsan oo taageerta?

ayat.arabic: فَٱسۡتَخَفَّ قَوۡمَهُۥ فَأَطَاعُوهُۚ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ قَوۡمٗا فَٰسِقِينَ

en.text: So he bluffed his people, and they obeyed him. Indeed, they were [themselves] a people defiantly disobedient [of Allāh].

so.text: 54. Wuxuu fudaydsaday qolodiisii, wayna adeeceen: waxay ahaayeen qolo caasi ah.

ayat.arabic: فَلَمَّآ ءَاسَفُونَا ٱنتَقَمۡنَا مِنۡهُمۡ فَأَغۡرَقۡنَٰهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ

en.text: And when they angered Us, We took retribution from them and drowned them all.

so.text: 55. Markay naga Cadheysiiyeen, waan ka aarsannay, waana harqinnay dhammaan.

ayat.arabic: فَجَعَلۡنَٰهُمۡ سَلَفٗا وَمَثَلٗا لِّلۡأٓخِرِينَ

en.text: And We made them a precedent and an example for the later peoples.

so.text: 56. Waxaanu ka yeelnay wax tegay oo ay ku tusaale qaataan facyada dambe.

ayat.arabic: ۞ وَلَمَّا ضُرِبَ ٱبۡنُ مَرۡيَمَ مَثَلًا إِذَا قَوۡمُكَ مِنۡهُ يَصِدُّونَ

en.text: And when the son of Mary was presented as an example,[1443] immediately your people laughed aloud.
en.footnotes: [1443] Of a creation of Allāh which is being worshipped along with Him.
