so.text: 57. Markaan uga yeellayna ina Maryam (Ciise) tusaale, mise qolodaada (mushrikiinta ah) way ka jeesadeen 'tusaalahaa' [15].
so.footnotes: [15]. Inuu ka mid yahay uunka Ilaahay, kuwaasoo lala barbar caabudo Allaah.

ayat.arabic: وَقَالُوٓاْ ءَأَٰلِهَتُنَا خَيۡرٌ أَمۡ هُوَۚ مَا ضَرَبُوهُ لَكَ إِلَّا جَدَلَۢاۚ بَلۡ هُمۡ قَوۡمٌ خَصِمُونَ

en.text: And they said, "Are our gods better, or is he?"[1444] They did not present it [i.e., the comparison] except for [mere] argument. But, [in fact], they are a people prone to dispute.
en.footnotes: [1444] Implying that they must all be the same.

so.text: 58. Waxay yidhaahdeen: Ma ilaahyadayada baa fiican mise isaga? Uma ayan soo qaadan tusaalahaa waxaan aheyn muran. Waase qolo dood badan [16].
so.footnotes: [16]. Iyagoo qaba inay dhammaan isku mid yihiin.

ayat.arabic: إِنۡ هُوَ إِلَّا عَبۡدٌ أَنۡعَمۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ وَجَعَلۡنَٰهُ مَثَلٗا لِّبَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ

en.text: He [i.e., Jesus] was not but a servant upon whom We bestowed favor, and We made him an example for the Children of Israel.

so.text: 59. Ma uu aheyn (Ciise) wax ka badan addoon aan ugu nicmaynay (Nabinnimo), waxaana uga yeelnay tusaale reer Israa’iil.

ayat.arabic: وَلَوۡ نَشَآءُ لَجَعَلۡنَا مِنكُم مَّلَٰٓئِكَةٗ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ يَخۡلُفُونَ

en.text: And if We willed, We could have made [instead] of you angels succeeding [one another][1445] on the earth.
en.footnotes: [1445] Or "succeeding [you]."

so.text: 60. Haddaan doonno, waxaan idinka yeeli lahayn malaa'ig dhulka u hadha [17].
so.footnotes: [17]. Ama idin xigsada idinka.

ayat.arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَعِلۡمٞ لِّلسَّاعَةِ فَلَا تَمۡتَرُنَّ بِهَا وَٱتَّبِعُونِۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٞ مُّسۡتَقِيمٞ

en.text: And indeed, he [i.e., Jesus] will be [a sign for] knowledge of the Hour, so be not in doubt of it, and follow Me.[1446] This is a straight path.
en.footnotes: [1446] i.e., follow the guidance and instruction of Allāh.

so.text: 61. isagu (Ciise iyo soo degitaanki) waa calaamad (muujin soo dhowaanshaha) Saacadda (Qiyaame), ee ha ka shakiyina arrinkeeda ee i soo raaca [18]: Kan baa ah Jid Toosan.
so.footnotes: [18]. Waa raaca hanuunka iyo shareecada Alle (Islaamka).

ayat.arabic: وَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكُمُ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمۡ عَدُوّٞ مُّبِينٞ

en.text: And never let Satan avert you. Indeed, he is to you a clear enemy.

so.text: 62. Yuu idinka leexin shaydaanka (Jidka), hubaal wuxuu idiin yahay cadow iska cad.

ayat.arabic: وَلَمَّا جَآءَ عِيسَىٰ بِٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِ قَالَ قَدۡ جِئۡتُكُم بِٱلۡحِكۡمَةِ وَلِأُبَيِّنَ لَكُم بَعۡضَ ٱلَّذِي تَخۡتَلِفُونَ فِيهِۖ فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ

en.text: And when Jesus brought clear proofs, he said, "I have come to you with wisdom [i.e., prophethood] and to make clear to you some of that over which you differ, so fear Allāh and obey me.

so.text: 63. Markuuse Ciise ula yimid xujooyin cad, wuxuu yidhi: Waxaan idiin la imid Xikmad (Nabinnimo) iyo inaan idiin caddeeyo qaar ka mid ah waxaad isku khilaafsan tihiin, ee  Alle ka cabsada oo i adeeca.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ رَبِّي وَرَبُّكُمۡ فَٱعۡبُدُوهُۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٞ مُّسۡتَقِيمٞ

en.text: Indeed, Allāh is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. This is a straight path."

so.text: 64. Hubaal Alle waa Rabbigay iyo Rabbigiinba, Ee caabuda Isaga (Keliya). Kan baa ah Jid Toosan.

ayat.arabic: فَٱخۡتَلَفَ ٱلۡأَحۡزَابُ مِنۢ بَيۡنِهِمۡۖ فَوَيۡلٞ لِّلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ مِنۡ عَذَابِ يَوۡمٍ أَلِيمٍ

en.text: But the denominations from among them differed [and separated], so woe to those who have wronged from the punishment of a painful Day.

so.text: 65. Wayse is khilaafeen xisbiyadii (ehlu Kitaabkii) dhexdooda (xagga arrinka Ciise). Ee hoog waxaa leh kuwii dulmi falay xagga cadaab Maalin xanuun badan.

ayat.arabic: هَلۡ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا ٱلسَّاعَةَ أَن تَأۡتِيَهُم بَغۡتَةٗ وَهُمۡ لَا يَشۡعُرُونَ

en.text: Are they waiting except for the Hour to come upon them suddenly while they perceive not?

so.text: 66. Ma waxay sugayaan waxaan ahayn Saacadda (Qiyaame) - taasoo ugu iman kedis iyagoo aan dreemeyn.

ayat.arabic: ٱلۡأَخِلَّآءُ يَوۡمَئِذِۭ بَعۡضُهُمۡ لِبَعۡضٍ عَدُوٌّ إِلَّا ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ

en.text: Close friends, that Day, will be enemies to each other, except for the righteous

so.text: 67. Saaxiibbadu Maalintaas waxay isu ahaan cadow qaarkoodba qaarka kale kuwa ka dhowrsada (xumaha) mooyee.

ayat.arabic: يَٰعِبَادِ لَا خَوۡفٌ عَلَيۡكُمُ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ وَلَآ أَنتُمۡ تَحۡزَنُونَ

en.text: [To whom Allāh will say], "O My servants, no fear will there be concerning you this Day, nor will you grieve,

so.text: 68. Addoomahaygiiyoow! Cabsi ma aha korkiinna maanta, mana murugooneysaan.

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَكَانُواْ مُسۡلِمِينَ

en.text: [You] who believed in Our verses and were Muslims.

so.text: 69. Kuwa rumeeyey Aayadahayaga ee ahaa Muslimiinta.

ayat.arabic: ٱدۡخُلُواْ ٱلۡجَنَّةَ أَنتُمۡ وَأَزۡوَٰجُكُمۡ تُحۡبَرُونَ

en.text: Enter Paradise, you and your kinds,[1447] delighted."
en.footnotes: [1447] i.e., those like you. Another meaning may be "your spouses," i.e., the righteous among them.

so.text: 70. Gala Jannada, idinka iyo xaasaskiinnuba [19]; waa laydinka farxine.
so.footnotes: [19]. Macno kale waa kuwaasi eynigiin ah.

ayat.arabic: يُطَافُ عَلَيۡهِم بِصِحَافٖ مِّن ذَهَبٖ وَأَكۡوَابٖۖ وَفِيهَا مَا تَشۡتَهِيهِ ٱلۡأَنفُسُ وَتَلَذُّ ٱلۡأَعۡيُنُۖ وَأَنتُمۡ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ

en.text: Circulated among them will be plates and vessels of gold. And therein is whatever the souls desire and [what] delights the eyes, and you will abide therein eternally.

so.text: 71. Waxaa lagula kor wareegi xeedhooyin dahab ah iyo koobab, waxayna ka heli (Jannada) waxay doonaan nafahooda,  indhuhuna ku raaxaystaan, idinkoo dhexdeeda ku waadhi.

ayat.arabic: وَتِلۡكَ ٱلۡجَنَّةُ ٱلَّتِيٓ أُورِثۡتُمُوهَا بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ

en.text: And that is Paradise which you are made to inherit for what you used to do.

so.text: 72. Taasi waa Jannadii aad ku dhaxasheen waxaad camalsan fasheen.

ayat.arabic: لَكُمۡ فِيهَا فَٰكِهَةٞ كَثِيرَةٞ مِّنۡهَا تَأۡكُلُونَ

en.text: For you therein is much fruit[1448] from which you will eat.
en.footnotes: [1448] Meaning everything delicious.

so.text: 73. Waxaad ku leedihiin gudaheeda midho tiro badan, xaggeedaa wax ka cuntaan [20].
so.footnotes: [20]. Waxaa loola jeedaa wax kastoo macaan oo dhadhan fiican.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ فِي عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدُونَ

en.text: Indeed, the criminals will be in the punishment of Hell, abiding eternally.

so.text: 74. Hubaal denbiilayaashu waxay geli  cadaabka Naarta iyagoo ku waadhi.

ayat.arabic: لَا يُفَتَّرُ عَنۡهُمۡ وَهُمۡ فِيهِ مُبۡلِسُونَ

en.text: It will not be allowed to subside for them, and they, therein, are in despair.

so.text: 75. Lagama nuxuusiyo (Naarta), iyagoo halkaa gudaheeda ku quusan.

ayat.arabic: وَمَا ظَلَمۡنَٰهُمۡ وَلَٰكِن كَانُواْ هُمُ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ

en.text: And We did not wrong them, but it was they who were the wrongdoers.

so.text: 76. Ma aanu dulmin, iyagaase ahaa daalimiin (gar ma qaatayaal).

ayat.arabic: وَنَادَوۡاْ يَٰمَٰلِكُ لِيَقۡضِ عَلَيۡنَا رَبُّكَۖ قَالَ إِنَّكُم مَّٰكِثُونَ

en.text: And they will call, "O Mālik,[1449] let your Lord put an end to us!" He will say, "Indeed, you will remain."
en.footnotes: [1449] Addressing the keeper of Hell.

so.text: 77. Waxay u dhawaaqi (fura hayeenka Naarta iyagoo leh): Maaligow! Rabbigaa ha noo yeelo dhammaad. Wuxuu odhan: Waad ku waadhi (Naarta).

ayat.arabic: لَقَدۡ جِئۡنَٰكُم بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَكُمۡ لِلۡحَقِّ كَٰرِهُونَ

en.text: We had certainly brought you the truth, but most of you, to the truth, were averse.

so.text: 78. Waxaan idiin la nimid Xaq, badankiinnuse Xaqa baad nacdaan.

ayat.arabic: أَمۡ أَبۡرَمُوٓاْ أَمۡرٗا فَإِنَّا مُبۡرِمُونَ

en.text: Or have they devised [some] affair?[1450] But indeed, We are devising [a plan].
en.footnotes: [1450] Conspiracy against the Prophet (ﷺ). The reference here is to the disbelievers of Makkah.

so.text: 79. Mise ma waxay goosteen arrin (qorshe)? Annaguna wax baynu qorsheynaynaa (Ciqaabkooda).

ayat.arabic: أَمۡ يَحۡسَبُونَ أَنَّا لَا نَسۡمَعُ سِرَّهُمۡ وَنَجۡوَىٰهُمۚ بَلَىٰ وَرُسُلُنَا لَدَيۡهِمۡ يَكۡتُبُونَ

en.text: Or do they think that We hear not their secrets and their private conversations? Yes, [We do], and Our messengers [i.e., angels] are with them recording.

so.text: 80. Mise ma waxay moodaan inaanaan maqleyn sirahooda iyo faqooda gaarka ah? Mayee Rusushayada (malaa’igta ah) baa ag joogta oo qoreysa.

ayat.arabic: قُلۡ إِن كَانَ لِلرَّحۡمَٰنِ وَلَدٞ فَأَنَا۠ أَوَّلُ ٱلۡعَٰبِدِينَ

en.text: Say, [O Muḥammad], "If the Most Merciful had a son, then I would be the first of [his] worshippers."[1451]
en.footnotes: [1451] Only supposing it were so, which it is not.

so.text: 81. Dheh: Haddii Raxmaanku (Alle, aad leedihiin wuxuu) leeyahay ilmo, waxaan anigu ahay kan u horreeya ee waxida (oo ka hufa inuu leeyahay ilmo ama xaas ama shariig, iwm).

ayat.arabic: سُبۡحَٰنَ رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَرۡشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ

en.text: Exalted is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, Lord of the Throne, above what they describe.

so.text: 82. Waxaa xurmo oo dhan iska leh (Allaah) Rabbiga samooyinka iyo arlada, Rabbiga Carshiga, oo ka hufan waxay ku tilmaamaan.

ayat.arabic: فَذَرۡهُمۡ يَخُوضُواْ وَيَلۡعَبُواْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُواْ يَوۡمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِي يُوعَدُونَ

en.text: So leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised.

so.text: 83. Ee iska daa ha dhunbadeen (baadilkaas) oo ha iska cayaareene intay kala kulmaan Maalintooda loo yaboohay.

ayat.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِلَٰهٞ وَفِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ إِلَٰهٞۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ

en.text: And it is He [i.e., Allāh] who is [the only] deity in the heaven, and on the earth [the only] deity. And He is the Wise, the Knowing.

so.text: 84. (Alle) waa Isaga Ilaaha Keliyee Xaqa ah somooyinka gudahood iyo Ilaaha Keliyee Xaqa ah arlada gudaheed. Waa Xakiimka, wax kasta Ogsoon.

ayat.arabic: وَتَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِي لَهُۥ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا وَعِندَهُۥ عِلۡمُ ٱلسَّاعَةِ وَإِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُونَ

en.text: And blessed is He to whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them and with whom is knowledge of the Hour and to whom you will be returned.

so.text: 85. Waxaa khayr iyo barako badan (Allaah) ee iska leh Boqortooyada (runta ah ee) samooyinka iyo arlada iyo waxa u dhexeeya, oo ay agti tahay ogaanshaha Saacadda (Qiyaame), Xaggiisaana dib la idiinku soo celin.

ayat.arabic: وَلَا يَمۡلِكُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِهِ ٱلشَّفَٰعَةَ إِلَّا مَن شَهِدَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَهُمۡ يَعۡلَمُونَ

en.text: And those they invoke[1452] besides Him do not possess [power of] intercession; but only those who testify to the truth [can benefit], and they know.[1453]
en.footnotes:
[1452] i.e., worship.
[1453] That intercession is granted exclusively by permission of Allāh to those He wills.

so.text: 86. Oo uma leh awood shafeeco kuwa ay baryaan (Alle) ka sokow, hase ahaatee ciddii qirta xaqa (ashahaadada ee ku dhaqma) oo aqoon san u leh (waxbay u shafeeci Idanka Alle kaddib).

ayat.arabic: وَلَئِن سَأَلۡتَهُم مَّنۡ خَلَقَهُمۡ لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُۖ فَأَنَّىٰ يُؤۡفَكُونَ

en.text: And if you asked them[1454] who created them, they would surely say, "Allāh." So how are they deluded?
en.footnotes: [1454] Those who associate others with Allāh.

so.text: 87. Haddaad (gaalada) weydiiso yaa abuuray iyaga, waxay hubaal odhan: Allaah. Ee xaggee baa loo iilay?

ayat.arabic: وَقِيلِهِۦ يَٰرَبِّ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوۡمٞ لَّا يُؤۡمِنُونَ

en.text: And [Allāh acknowledges] his saying,[1455] "O my Lord, indeed these are a people who do not believe."
en.footnotes: [1455] i.e., the complaint of Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ) about his people.

so.text: 88. (Nabigu) wuxuu yidhi: Rabbiyow! Xaqiiq kuwaanu waa qolo aan rumayneyn (Xaqa).

ayat.arabic: فَٱصۡفَحۡ عَنۡهُمۡ وَقُلۡ سَلَٰمٞۚ فَسَوۡفَ يَعۡلَمُونَ

en.text: So turn aside from them and say, "Peace."[1456] But they are going to know.
en.footnotes: [1456] Meaning safety or security, i.e., "I will not harm you." This was before permission was granted for armed struggle.

so.text: 89. Ee iska saamax oo dheh: Nabadgelyo, wayse ogaan (waxa ku dhaca).

ayat.arabic: حمٓ

en.text: Ḥā, Meem.[1458]
en.footnotes: [1458] See footnote to 2:1.

so.text: 1. Xaa Mim [1].
so.footnotes: [1]. Eeg sharaxa hoose ee Suuradda 2 Al-Baqarah: Aayadda 1.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلۡكِتَٰبِ ٱلۡمُبِينِ

en.text: By the clear Book,

so.text: 2. Waxaan (Aniga Alle ah) ku dhaartay kitaabka (Qur’aanka) ee caddeeya (Xaqa).

ayat.arabic: إِنَّآ أَنزَلۡنَٰهُ فِي لَيۡلَةٖ مُّبَٰرَكَةٍۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنذِرِينَ

en.text: Indeed, We sent it down during a blessed night.[1459] Indeed, We were to warn [mankind].
en.footnotes: [1459] The Night of Decree (Qadr). See Sūrah al-Qadr.

so.text: 3. Xaqiiq, waxaanu soo dejinnay (Qur’aanka) habeen barakaysan [2]. Waxaanu nahay kuwa diga.
so.footnotes: [2]. Waa Laylatul Qaddarka ee loo soo waxyooday Nabiga s.c.w. Qur’aanka.

ayat.arabic: فِيهَا يُفۡرَقُ كُلُّ أَمۡرٍ حَكِيمٍ

en.text: Therein [i.e., on that night] is made distinct[1460] every precise matter -
en.footnotes: [1460] Or "is separated" or "apportioned," from what is inscribed in the Preserved Slate. The angels record and descend with whatever Allāh has decreed for the coming year.

so.text: 4. Habeenkaas (Laylatul Qaddarka) baa la gooyaa arrin kasta oo xigmo leh.

ayat.arabic: أَمۡرٗا مِّنۡ عِندِنَآۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُرۡسِلِينَ

en.text: [Every] matter [proceeding] from Us. Indeed, We were to send [a messenger]

so.text: 5. Amar ka yimid Xaggayaga. Hubaal waxaanu nahay kuwa soo dira (Rusul),

ayat.arabic: رَحۡمَةٗ مِّن رَّبِّكَۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ

en.text: As mercy from your Lord. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing,

so.text: 6. Naxariis ka ahaatay xagga Rabbigaa (Alle). Waa wax kasta Maqlaha, wax kasta Ogsoon.

ayat.arabic: رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَآۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ

en.text: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them, if you would be certain.

so.text: 7. Rabbiga samooyinka iyo arlada iyo waxa u dhexeeya, haddaad yaqiinsaneysaan.

ayat.arabic: لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحۡيِۦ وَيُمِيتُۖ رَبُّكُمۡ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ

en.text: There is no deity except Him; He gives life and causes death. [He is] your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers.

so.text: 8. Ma jiro ilaah (Xaq lagu caabudo) aan Isaga aheyn, Waa isaga Kan bixiya nolol, oo sababa dhimasho, waa Rabbigiin iyo Rabbiga aabbayaashiinnii hore.

ayat.arabic: بَلۡ هُمۡ فِي شَكّٖ يَلۡعَبُونَ

en.text: But they are in doubt, amusing themselves.

so.text: 9. Waxayse ku sugan yihiin shaki, iyagoo iska cayaari.

ayat.arabic: فَٱرۡتَقِبۡ يَوۡمَ تَأۡتِي ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِدُخَانٖ مُّبِينٖ

en.text: Then watch for the Day when the sky will bring a visible smoke

so.text: 10. Ee sug Maalinta ay samadu keeni qiiq muuqda.

ayat.arabic: يَغۡشَى ٱلنَّاسَۖ هَٰذَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٞ

en.text: Covering the people; this is a painful torment.

so.text: 11. kaasoo dabooli dadka, kani waa cadaab xanuun badan.

ayat.arabic: رَّبَّنَا ٱكۡشِفۡ عَنَّا ٱلۡعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤۡمِنُونَ

en.text: [They will say], "Our Lord, remove from us the torment; indeed, we are believers."

so.text: 12. (Waxay odhan), "Rabbigayow! Naga feyd cadaabka [3], waan rumeynaye".
so.footnotes: [3]. Waxaa loola jeedaa abaartii iyo habaaskii iyo gaajadii lagu salladay kufaaru Quraysh beenintooda Nabiga s.c.w. awgeed.

ayat.arabic: أَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلذِّكۡرَىٰ وَقَدۡ جَآءَهُمۡ رَسُولٞ مُّبِينٞ

en.text: How will there be for them a reminder [at that time]? And there had come to them a clear Messenger.

so.text: 13. Goormay waantoobi, waxaana u yimid Rasuul iska cad (Nabi Muxammad).

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوۡاْ عَنۡهُ وَقَالُواْ مُعَلَّمٞ مَّجۡنُونٌ

en.text: Then they turned away from him and said, "[He was] taught [and is] a madman."

so.text: 14. Markaasay ka jeesteen oo yidhaahdeen: waa mid si fiican wax la soo baray, Jinnoole ah.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّا كَاشِفُواْ ٱلۡعَذَابِ قَلِيلًاۚ إِنَّكُمۡ عَآئِدُونَ

en.text: Indeed, We will remove the torment for a little. Indeed, you [disbelievers] will return [to disbelief].

so.text: 15.Waxaan idinka feydi cadaabka wax yar. Waxaadse ku noqoneysaan (gaalnimo).

ayat.arabic: يَوۡمَ نَبۡطِشُ ٱلۡبَطۡشَةَ ٱلۡكُبۡرَىٰٓ إِنَّا مُنتَقِمُونَ

en.text: The Day We will strike with the greatest assault, indeed, We will take retribution.

so.text: 16. Maalintaan qabaneyno qabashada  weyn [4]. Hubaal waanu aarsan.
so.footnotes: [4]. Qabashadii weyneyd waxay dhacday dagaalkii Badar markii la jabiyey gaaladii oo badi madaxdoodii lagu dilay dagaalkaasi, qaar kalena la soo qafaashay.

ayat.arabic: ۞ وَلَقَدۡ فَتَنَّا قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمَ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَجَآءَهُمۡ رَسُولٞ كَرِيمٌ

en.text: And We had already tried before them the people of Pharaoh, and there came to them a noble messenger [i.e., Moses],

so.text: 17. Waxaanu dhab ahaan imtixaannay hortood qolodii Fircoon, waxaana u yimid Rasuul sharaf leh (Nabi Muuse).

ayat.arabic: أَنۡ أَدُّوٓاْ إِلَيَّ عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِۖ إِنِّي لَكُمۡ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٞ

en.text: [Saying], "Render to me the servants of Allāh.[1461] Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger,"
en.footnotes: [1461] i.e., the Children of Israel.

so.text: 18. 'Isagoo leh': Ii dhiiba adoommaha Alle [5]. Waxaan anigu idiin ahay Rasuul aamin ah.
so.footnotes: [5]. Reer Israa’iil.

ayat.arabic: وَأَن لَّا تَعۡلُواْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِۖ إِنِّيٓ ءَاتِيكُم بِسُلۡطَٰنٖ مُّبِينٖ

en.text: And [saying], "Be not haughty with Allāh. Indeed, I have come to you with clear evidence.

so.text: 19. Ha iska sare yeelina Alle. Waxaan idiinla imid xujo cade.

ayat.arabic: وَإِنِّي عُذۡتُ بِرَبِّي وَرَبِّكُمۡ أَن تَرۡجُمُونِ

en.text: And indeed, I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord, lest you stone me.[1462]
en.footnotes: [1462] To death. Or "lest you assault me [with your tongues or harm me otherwise]."

so.text: 20. Waxaana ka magan galay Rabbigay iyo Rabbigiin inaad i dhagaxyeysaan [6].
so.footnotes: [6]. Si aydaan dhagax iigu shiidin ilaa geeri. Ama si aydaan iigu dhaleeceyn carrabyadiinna ama si aydaan iigu dhibaateyn si kale.

ayat.arabic: وَإِن لَّمۡ تُؤۡمِنُواْ لِي فَٱعۡتَزِلُونِ

en.text: But if you do not believe me, then leave me alone."

so.text: 21. Ee hadddaydaan i rumeyn, iga fogaada (I daaya).

ayat.arabic: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوۡمٞ مُّجۡرِمُونَ

en.text: And [finally] he called to his Lord that these were a criminal people.

so.text: 22. Markaasuu (markay beeniyeen) u dhawaaqay Rabbigi (isagoo leh): Kuwakanu waa qolo denbiilayaal ah.

ayat.arabic: فَأَسۡرِ بِعِبَادِي لَيۡلًا إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ

en.text: [Allāh said], "Then set out with My servants by night. Indeed, you are to be pursued.

so.text: 23. (Alle wuxuu yidhi), "La Guuree (Muusow) addoomahayga habeennimo. Waa la idin soo daba galiye.

ayat.arabic: وَٱتۡرُكِ ٱلۡبَحۡرَ رَهۡوًاۖ إِنَّهُمۡ جُندٞ مُّغۡرَقُونَ

en.text: And leave the sea in stillness.[1463] Indeed, they are an army to be drowned."
en.footnotes: [1463] After it has parted, in order that the soldiers of Pharaoh would follow the Children of Israel and be drowned.

so.text: 24. Oo dhaaf baddoo deggan [7] oo qaybsan: waa ciidan la qarqine".
so.footnotes: [7]. Kaddib markay labo u kala dhanbalantay, si ay askarta Fircoon u soo raacaan ilmahii Israa’iil oo markaa Fircoon iyo dadkiisa loo qarqiyo.

ayat.arabic: كَمۡ تَرَكُواْ مِن جَنَّٰتٖ وَعُيُونٖ

en.text: How much they left behind of gardens and springs

so.text: 25. Intee bay ka tageen beero iyo ilo.

ayat.arabic: وَزُرُوعٖ وَمَقَامٖ كَرِيمٖ

en.text: And crops and noble sites

so.text: 26. Iyo dalagyo iyo degaan wanaagsan.

ayat.arabic: وَنَعۡمَةٖ كَانُواْ فِيهَا فَٰكِهِينَ

en.text: And comfort wherein they were amused.

so.text: 27. Iyo nicmooyin ay ku raaxaysanayeen.

ayat.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَۖ وَأَوۡرَثۡنَٰهَا قَوۡمًا ءَاخَرِينَ

en.text: Thus. And We caused to inherit it another people.

so.text: 28. Waa sidaase! Waxaanu dhaxalsiinnay qolo kale (reer Israa’iil).

ayat.arabic: فَمَا بَكَتۡ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَمَا كَانُواْ مُنظَرِينَ

en.text: And the heaven and earth wept not for them, nor were they reprieved.

so.text: 29. Uma ay ooyin samada iyo arladu, lamana siin wax fursad (kansho) ah.

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ نَجَّيۡنَا بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ مِنَ ٱلۡعَذَابِ ٱلۡمُهِينِ

en.text: And We certainly saved the Children of Israel from the humiliating torment -

so.text: 30. Waxaana dhab ahaan ka badbaadinnay ilmihii Israa’iil cadaab wax dulleeya.

ayat.arabic: مِن فِرۡعَوۡنَۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَالِيٗا مِّنَ ٱلۡمُسۡرِفِينَ

en.text: From Pharaoh. Indeed, he was a haughty one among the transgressors.

so.text: 31. Xagga Fircoon ah; wuxuu ahaa islaweyne, ka mid ahaa xadgudbayaasha.

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدِ ٱخۡتَرۡنَٰهُمۡ عَلَىٰ عِلۡمٍ عَلَى ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

en.text: And We certainly chose them by knowledge over [all] the worlds.

so.text: 32. Waxaana ka doorannay (dadkii waqtigoodii), Annagoo ogsoon.

ayat.arabic: وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأٓيَٰتِ مَا فِيهِ بَلَٰٓؤٞاْ مُّبِينٌ

en.text: And We gave them of signs that in which there was a clear trial.

so.text: 33. Waxaana siinnay calaamado [8] ay ku sugnaayeen imtixaan cad.
so.footnotes: [8]. Sida in lagu hareeyey daruuraha, loo soo dejiyey Manni iyo Salwaa, biyo looga burqiyey dhagax, badda cas oo loo kala dhanbalay, iwm.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَيَقُولُونَ

en.text: Indeed, these [disbelievers] are saying,

so.text: 34. Kuwaasi (gaaladu) waxay yidhaahdaan:

ayat.arabic: إِنۡ هِيَ إِلَّا مَوۡتَتُنَا ٱلۡأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمُنشَرِينَ

en.text: "There is not but our first death, and we will not be resurrected.

so.text: 35. Ma jirto waxaa aheyn dhimashadayada hore mana nihin kuwo dib loo soo nooleyn.

ayat.arabic: فَأۡتُواْ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ

en.text: Then bring [back] our forefathers, if you should be truthful."

so.text: 36. Ee (dib) u soo cesha aabbayaashayadii hore, haddaad run sheegaysaan.

ayat.arabic: أَهُمۡ خَيۡرٌ أَمۡ قَوۡمُ تُبَّعٖ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَٰهُمۡۚ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ مُجۡرِمِينَ

en.text: Are they better or the people of Tubbaʿ[1464] and those before them? We destroyed them, [for] indeed, they were criminals.
en.footnotes: [1464] The tribe of Saba’.

so.text: 37. Ma iyagaa khayr badan mise qolodii Tubbac [9] iyo kuwii ka horreeyey? Waanu hallignay, waxay ahaayeen denbiilayaal.
so.footnotes: [9]. Waxaa loolaa jeedaa reer Ximyar ee degganaa Yaman, Tubbacna waa naynaasta boqorkooda.

ayat.arabic: وَمَا خَلَقۡنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا لَٰعِبِينَ

en.text: And We did not create the heavens and earth and that between them in play.

so.text: 38. Uma aanu abuurin samooyinka iyo arlada iyo waxa u dhexeeya ciyaar.

ayat.arabic: مَا خَلَقۡنَٰهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ

en.text: We did not create them except in truth, but most of them do not know.

so.text: 39. Uma aanu abuurin waxaan Xaq aheyn, badankooduse ma oga.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡفَصۡلِ مِيقَٰتُهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ

en.text: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is the appointed time for them all -

so.text: 40. Maalinta kala Baxa yaa u ballan ah dhammaan.

ayat.arabic: يَوۡمَ لَا يُغۡنِي مَوۡلًى عَن مَّوۡلٗى شَيۡـٔٗا وَلَا هُمۡ يُنصَرُونَ

en.text: The Day when no relation[1465] will avail a relation at all, nor will they be helped -
en.footnotes: [1465] i.e., patron, protector or close associate.

so.text: 41. Maalintaan qaraabannimo waxba laysugu tareyn laysuna gargaareyn.

ayat.arabic: إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ ٱللَّهُۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

en.text: Except those [believers] on whom Allāh has mercy. Indeed, He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

so.text: 42. Mid uu Alle u Naxariisto ma’ahee: hubaal waa Adkaadaha, Naxariista Badan.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ شَجَرَتَ ٱلزَّقُّومِ

en.text: Indeed, the tree of zaqqūm

so.text: 43. Hubaal geedka Zaquumka,

ayat.arabic: طَعَامُ ٱلۡأَثِيمِ

en.text: Is food for the sinful.

so.text: 44. Waa cunnada denbiilaha,

ayat.arabic: كَٱلۡمُهۡلِ يَغۡلِي فِي ٱلۡبُطُونِ

en.text: Like murky oil, it boils within bellies

so.text: 45. Sida laami buu ugu kar-kari caloolaha (gaalada).

ayat.arabic: كَغَلۡيِ ٱلۡحَمِيمِ

en.text: Like the boiling of scalding water.

so.text: 46. Sida kar-karka biyo aad u kulul.

ayat.arabic: خُذُوهُ فَٱعۡتِلُوهُ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ

en.text: [It will be commanded], "Seize him and drag him into the midst of the Hellfire,

so.text: 47. (Waxaa la dhihi): Qabta (gaalka), oo u jiida Naarta bartankeeda.

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ صُبُّواْ فَوۡقَ رَأۡسِهِۦ مِنۡ عَذَابِ ٱلۡحَمِيمِ

en.text: Then pour over his head from the torment of scalding water."

so.text: 48. Markaas ku shuba madaxiisa korkiisa cadaabka biyo kar-karaya.

ayat.arabic: ذُقۡ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡكَرِيمُ

en.text: [It will be said], "Taste! Indeed, you are the honored, the noble![1466]
en.footnotes: [1466] As he had claimed upon the earth. He is taunted with these words in Hell as a reminder and additional torment.

so.text: 49. (Waxaa lagu dhihi): Dhadhami (Cadaabka), Waxaad (iska yeeleysay) inaad tahay adkaadaha, sharafta leh [10].
so.footnotes: [10]. Waa sida uu sheeganayey intii uu joogay arlada. Waxaa lagu odhanayaa ereyadan digasho ahaan si loo xusuusiyo oo loo liido iyo cadaab dheeri ah ahaan.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَا مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَمۡتَرُونَ

en.text: Indeed, this is what you used to dispute."

so.text: 50. Hubaal kanu (Cadaabka) waa waxaad ka shaki qabteen oo ka doodeyseen.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ فِي مَقَامٍ أَمِينٖ

en.text: Indeed, the righteous will be in a secure place:

so.text: 51. Hubaap kuwa (u) hoggaansan (Amarrada Alle) ee iska jira (xumaha) waxay ku sugnaan meel aamin ah (Janno).

ayat.arabic: فِي جَنَّٰتٖ وَعُيُونٖ

en.text: Within gardens and springs,

so.text: 52. Beero dhexdood iyo ilo.

ayat.arabic: يَلۡبَسُونَ مِن سُندُسٖ وَإِسۡتَبۡرَقٖ مُّتَقَٰبِلِينَ

en.text: Wearing [garments of] fine silk and brocade, facing each other.

so.text: 53. Waxay xidhan xariir jilicsan iyo mid adagba, iyagoo u fadhiya fool ka fool (si farxad iyo reyn reyn leh).

ayat.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ وَزَوَّجۡنَٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٖ

en.text: Thus. And We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes.

so.text: 54. Waa sidaase, Waxaanu u guurin xuurul ceyn.

ayat.arabic: يَدۡعُونَ فِيهَا بِكُلِّ فَٰكِهَةٍ ءَامِنِينَ

en.text: They will call therein for every [kind of] fruit - safe and secure.

so.text: 55. Waxay u yeedhan midho nooc kasta ah, iyagoo nabdoon [11].
so.footnotes: [11]. Aan ka cabsaneyn inay ka dhammaadaan, oo ka cabsaneyn jirro.

ayat.arabic: لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا ٱلۡمَوۡتَ إِلَّا ٱلۡمَوۡتَةَ ٱلۡأُولَىٰۖ وَوَقَىٰهُمۡ عَذَابَ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ

en.text: They will not taste death therein except the first death, and He will have protected them from the punishment of Hellfire

so.text: 56. Ma ku dhadhaminayaan (jannada) dhexdeeda dhimasho aan aheyn dhimashadii hore, wuxuuna (Alle) ka dhowray cadaabka Naarta Ololka badan.

ayat.arabic: فَضۡلٗا مِّن رَّبِّكَۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡعَظِيمُ

en.text: As bounty from your Lord. That is what is the great attainment.

so.text: 57. Waa fadli xagga Rabbigaa ah. (Arrin)kani weeye Liibaanta Weyni.

ayat.arabic: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرۡنَٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ

en.text: And indeed, We have eased it [i.e., the Qur’ān] in your tongue that they might be reminded.

so.text: 58. Waxaan uun ugu fududaynay Qur’aanka carrabkaaga inay ku waantoobaan.

ayat.arabic: فَٱرۡتَقِبۡ إِنَّهُم مُّرۡتَقِبُونَ

en.text: So watch, [O Muḥammad]; indeed, they are watching [for your end].

so.text: 59. Ee dhowr (oo eeg xaalkooda); iyaguna waxay dhowrayaan (waxaad ku dambeysaan).

ayat.arabic: حمٓ

en.text: Ḥā, Meem.[1468]
en.footnotes: [1468] See footnote to 2:1.

so.text: 1. Xaa Miim [1].
so.footnotes: [1]. Eeg sharaxa hoose ee Suuradda 2 Al-Baqarah: Aayadda 1.

ayat.arabic: تَنزِيلُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡحَكِيمِ

en.text: The revelation of the Book is from Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

so.text: 2. Soo dejinta Kitaabka (Qur’aanka) waa xagga Alle, Adkaadaha, Xakiimka ah.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ

en.text: Indeed, within the heavens and earth are signs for the believers.

so.text: 3. Xaqiiq, waxaa samooyinka iyo arlada ugu sugan calaamooyin mu’miniinta.

ayat.arabic: وَفِي خَلۡقِكُمۡ وَمَا يَبُثُّ مِن دَآبَّةٍ ءَايَٰتٞ لِّقَوۡمٖ يُوقِنُونَ

en.text: And in the creation of yourselves and what He disperses of moving creatures are signs for people who are certain [in faith].

so.text: 4.Iyo abuuristiinnaba iyo wuxuu (Alle) ku fidiyey (ku abuuray dhulka) oo nafley socota ah, waxaa ugu sugan calaamooyin ciddii yaqiinsan.

ayat.arabic: وَٱخۡتِلَٰفِ ٱلَّيۡلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ وَمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مِن رِّزۡقٖ فَأَحۡيَا بِهِ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ بَعۡدَ مَوۡتِهَا وَتَصۡرِيفِ ٱلرِّيَٰحِ ءَايَٰتٞ لِّقَوۡمٖ يَعۡقِلُونَ

en.text: And [in] the alternation of night and day and [in] what Allāh sends down from the sky of provision [i.e., rain] and gives life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness and [in His] directing of the winds are signs for a people who reason.

so.text: 5. Iyo isdhaafka habeenka iyo maalinta iyo waxa uu Alle ka soo dejiyo daruuraha oo risiq (roob) ah, markaas uu ku nooleeyo arlada dhimashadeeda kaddib, iyo gadgaddoonka dabeylaha waxaa ugu sugan calaamooyin ciddii fahmi.

ayat.arabic: تِلۡكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱللَّهِ نَتۡلُوهَا عَلَيۡكَ بِٱلۡحَقِّۖ فَبِأَيِّ حَدِيثِۭ بَعۡدَ ٱللَّهِ وَءَايَٰتِهِۦ يُؤۡمِنُونَ

en.text: These are the verses of Allāh which We recite to you in truth. Then in what statement after Allāh and His verses will they believe?

so.text: 6. Kuwakani waa Aayadaha Alle aan kuugu akhrinno (Nabiyow) si xaq ah, ee hadalkee bay Alle iyo Aayadihiisa kaddib rumeyn?

ayat.arabic: وَيۡلٞ لِّكُلِّ أَفَّاكٍ أَثِيمٖ

en.text: Woe to every sinful liar

so.text: 7. Hoog waxaa leh beenaale kastoo denbiile ah.

ayat.arabic: يَسۡمَعُ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِ ثُمَّ يُصِرُّ مُسۡتَكۡبِرٗا كَأَن لَّمۡ يَسۡمَعۡهَاۖ فَبَشِّرۡهُ بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٖ

en.text: Who hears the verses of Allāh recited to him, then persists arrogantly as if he had not heard them. So give him tidings of a painful punishment.

so.text: 8. Ee maqla Aayadaha Alle oo loo akhriyo, haddana ka dhega adayga isagoo islaweyn sida inaanu maqalba. Ee ugu bishaaree cadaab xanuun badan.

ayat.arabic: وَإِذَا عَلِمَ مِنۡ ءَايَٰتِنَا شَيۡـًٔا ٱتَّخَذَهَا هُزُوًاۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٞ مُّهِينٞ

en.text: And when he knows anything of Our verses, he takes them in ridicule. Those will have a humiliating punishment.

so.text: 9. Markuu wax ka ogaadana Aayadahayaga, wuxuu ka dhigtaa jees-jees. Kuwaa weeye kuwa mudan cadaab dulleysa.

ayat.arabic: مِّن وَرَآئِهِمۡ جَهَنَّمُۖ وَلَا يُغۡنِي عَنۡهُم مَّا كَسَبُواْ شَيۡـٔٗا وَلَا مَا ٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَوۡلِيَآءَۖ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ

en.text: Before them[1469] is Hell, and what they had earned will not avail them at all nor what they had taken besides Allāh as allies. And they will have a great punishment.
en.footnotes: [1469] See footnote to 14:16.

so.text: 10. Waxaa ka dambeysa Naar, waxna uma taraan waxay kasbadeen, iyo midna kuwaa ay ka dhigteen awliyo (gargaarayaal ama difaacayaal) Alle ka sokow, waxayna leeyihiin cadaab Daran.

ayat.arabic: هَٰذَا هُدٗىۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٞ مِّن رِّجۡزٍ أَلِيمٌ

en.text: This [Qur’ān] is guidance. And those who have disbelieved in the verses of their Lord will have a painful punishment of foul nature.

so.text: 11. Kani (Qur'aanku) waa hanuun. Kuwase ku gaalooba Aayadaha Rabbigood, waxay leeyihiin  cadaab daran oo xanuun badan.

ayat.arabic: ۞ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلۡبَحۡرَ لِتَجۡرِيَ ٱلۡفُلۡكُ فِيهِ بِأَمۡرِهِۦ وَلِتَبۡتَغُواْ مِن فَضۡلِهِۦ وَلَعَلَّكُمۡ تَشۡكُرُونَ

en.text: It is Allāh who subjected to you the sea so that ships may sail upon it by His command and that you may seek of His bounty; and perhaps you will be grateful.

so.text: 12. Alle waa Kan idiin sakhiray badda, si ay ugu socdaan Doonyuhu dhexdeeda Amarkiisa, iyo si aad u raadsataan Deeqdiisa, iyo inaad ku mahdisaan.

ayat.arabic: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُم مَّا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ جَمِيعٗا مِّنۡهُۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّقَوۡمٖ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ

en.text: And He has subjected to you whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth - all from Him. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought.

so.text: 13. Wuxuu kaloo idiin sakhiray waxa ku sugan samooyinka iyo waxa ku sugan arlada, dhammaan waa Gallad iyo Naxariis Xaggiisa ah. Hubaal, waxaa (arrin) kani ugu sugan calaamooyin ciddii fikiri.

ayat.arabic: قُل لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ يَغۡفِرُواْ لِلَّذِينَ لَا يَرۡجُونَ أَيَّامَ ٱللَّهِ لِيَجۡزِيَ قَوۡمَۢا بِمَا كَانُواْ يَكۡسِبُونَ

en.text: Say, [O Muḥammad], to those who have believed that they [should] forgive those who expect not the days of Allāh [i.e., of His retribution] so that He may recompense a people[1470] for what they used to earn.
en.footnotes: [1470] In the Hereafter, where those who forgive will be rewarded and those who earned evil will be punished. This was at the outset of daʿwah (invitation to Allāh) before permission for jihād.

so.text: 14. Waxaad ku dhahdaa kuwa (Xaqa) rumeeyey inay iska dhaafaan [2] kuwa aan ka rajo qabin Ayaamaha Alle [3], si uu ugu abaal mariyo qolo waxay kasbadeen.
so.footnotes:
[2]. Waa billowgii baaqa Islaamka ka hor inta aan la idmin jihaadka.
[3]. Ayaamaha Alle waxaa loola jeedaa maalmihii uu Alle ku soo dejiyey gaalada cadaabka, oo badbaadiyey kuwa xaqa rumeeyey.

ayat.arabic: مَنۡ عَمِلَ صَٰلِحٗا فَلِنَفۡسِهِۦۖ وَمَنۡ أَسَآءَ فَعَلَيۡهَاۖ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمۡ تُرۡجَعُونَ

en.text: Whoever does a good deed - it is for himself; and whoever does evil - it is against it [i.e., the self or soul]. Then to your Lord you will be returned.

so.text: 15. Qofkii sama fala naftiisay dan u tahay, kiina xumaan fala waa dushiisa. Waxaana dib la idiinku soo celin  xagga Rabbigiin.

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ ءَاتَيۡنَا بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَٱلۡحُكۡمَ وَٱلنُّبُوَّةَ وَرَزَقۡنَٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَٰتِ وَفَضَّلۡنَٰهُمۡ عَلَى ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

en.text: And We did certainly give the Children of Israel the Scripture and judgement[1471] and prophethood, and We provided them with good things and preferred them over the worlds.
en.footnotes: [1471] Understanding of the law.

so.text: 16. Waxaan dhab ahaan siinnay reer Israa’iil Kitaabka (Towraadda) iyo xukun [4] iyo Nabinnimo, waxaana ku arsaaqnay waxyaalaha wanaagsan, oo ka faddilnay dadkii (waqtigoodii).
so.footnotes: [4]. Al-Xukma waxaa loola jeedaa fahanka caqiidada iyo xeerarka islaamka iyo ku dhaqankooda iyo garsoor wanaagsan.

ayat.arabic: وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُم بَيِّنَٰتٖ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَمۡرِۖ فَمَا ٱخۡتَلَفُوٓاْ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلۡعِلۡمُ بَغۡيَۢا بَيۡنَهُمۡۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَقۡضِي بَيۡنَهُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ فِيمَا كَانُواْ فِيهِ يَخۡتَلِفُونَ

en.text: And We gave them clear proofs of the matter [of religion]. And they did not differ except after knowledge had come to them - out of jealous animosity between themselves. Indeed, your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ.

so.text: 17. Waxaanu siinnay xujooyin cad oo arrimaha nolosha la xiriira, ismana khilaafin kaddib intuu u yimid cilmiga maahee, xasad dhexdooda ah awgi. Rabbigaa waa u kala garsoori dhexdooda Maalinta Qiyaamaha waxay isku khilaafsanaayeen.

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ جَعَلۡنَٰكَ عَلَىٰ شَرِيعَةٖ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَمۡرِ فَٱتَّبِعۡهَا وَلَا تَتَّبِعۡ أَهۡوَآءَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ

en.text: Then We put you, [O Muḥammad], on an ordained way concerning the matter [of religion]; so follow it and do not follow the inclinations of those who do not know.

so.text: 18. Markaas waxaanu kuu yeelnay waddo cad oo amar (keenna) ah ee raac, hana raacin hawada kuwa aan wax ogeyn.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّهُمۡ لَن يُغۡنُواْ عَنكَ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيۡـٔٗاۚ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ بَعۡضُهُمۡ أَوۡلِيَآءُ بَعۡضٖۖ وَٱللَّهُ وَلِيُّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ

en.text: Indeed, they will never avail you against Allāh at all. And indeed, the wrongdoers are allies of one another; but Allāh is the protector of the righteous.

so.text: 19. Iyagu kaagama taraan xagga Alle waxba; daalimiintana  waa isu sokeeye qaarba qaarka kale. Alle waa Gargaaraha kuwa ka dhowrsada (xumaha).

ayat.arabic: هَٰذَا بَصَٰٓئِرُ لِلنَّاسِ وَهُدٗى وَرَحۡمَةٞ لِّقَوۡمٖ يُوقِنُونَ

en.text: This [Qur’ān] is enlightenment for mankind and guidance and mercy for a people who are certain [in faith].

so.text: 20.Kuwakani waa u tusmooyin cad dadka, iyo hanuun iyo naxariis ciddii wax yaqiinsan.

ayat.arabic: أَمۡ حَسِبَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱجۡتَرَحُواْ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ أَن نَّجۡعَلَهُمۡ كَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ سَوَآءٗ مَّحۡيَاهُمۡ وَمَمَاتُهُمۡۚ سَآءَ مَا يَحۡكُمُونَ

en.text: Or do those who commit evils think We will make them like those who have believed and done righteous deeds - [make them] equal in their life and their death?[1472] Evil is that which they judge [i.e., assume].
en.footnotes: [1472] Another meaning is "...[the evildoers being] equal in their life and their death," i.e., unresponsive to guidance.

so.text: 21. Mise ma waxay moodaan kuwa kasbada xumaha inaan la mid dhigeyno kuwa (Xaqa) rumeeyey oo samaha fala, oo noloshooda [5] iyo geeridooda sinnaan? Xumaa siday wax u xukumaan.
so.footnotes: [5]. Tafsiir kale waa: Xumaan falayaasha waa isku mid noloshooda iyo geeridooda. Macnaha waa ma aqbalaan hanuunka.

ayat.arabic: وَخَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَلِتُجۡزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفۡسِۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتۡ وَهُمۡ لَا يُظۡلَمُونَ

en.text: And Allāh created the heavens and earth in truth and so that every soul may be recompensed for what it has earned, and they will not be wronged.

so.text: 22. Allaah wuxuu u abuuray samooyinka iyo arlada xaq iyo in naf waliba laga abaal mariyo waxay kasbatay iyagoon la dulmineyn.

ayat.arabic: أَفَرَءَيۡتَ مَنِ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَٰهَهُۥ هَوَىٰهُ وَأَضَلَّهُ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ عِلۡمٖ وَخَتَمَ عَلَىٰ سَمۡعِهِۦ وَقَلۡبِهِۦ وَجَعَلَ عَلَىٰ بَصَرِهِۦ غِشَٰوَةٗ فَمَن يَهۡدِيهِ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ ٱللَّهِۚ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ

en.text: Have you seen he who has taken as his god his [own] desire, and Allāh has sent him astray due to knowledge[1473] and has set a seal upon his hearing and his heart and put over his vision a veil? So who will guide him after Allāh? Then will you not be reminded?
en.footnotes: [1473] This can refer to Allāh's knowledge of that person and of his preference for his own inclinations or to that person's knowledge of the truth while he refuses it.

so.text: 23. Ka warran mid ka yeesha hawadiisa ilaahiisa, oo Alle u lumiyey ogaal oo daboolay maqalkiisa iyo qalbigiisa, yeelayna caad araggiisa. Yaa hanuunin Alle kaddib? Miyeydaan waansameyn?

ayat.arabic: وَقَالُواْ مَا هِيَ إِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا ٱلدُّنۡيَا نَمُوتُ وَنَحۡيَا وَمَا يُهۡلِكُنَآ إِلَّا ٱلدَّهۡرُۚ وَمَا لَهُم بِذَٰلِكَ مِنۡ عِلۡمٍۖ إِنۡ هُمۡ إِلَّا يَظُنُّونَ

en.text: And they say, "There is not but our worldly life; we die and live,[1474] and nothing destroys us except time." And they have of that no knowledge; they are only assuming.
en.footnotes: [1474] i.e., some people die and others live, replacing them.

so.text: 24. Waxay yidhaahdeen: Ma jirto waxaan ahayn noloshayada adduunkan, waa iska noolaannaa [6] oo dhimannaa namana halaagaan waxaan aheyn waayaha. Uma laha (arrin)kaasi wax cilmi ah, way uun iska malo awaali.
so.footnotes: [6]. Macnaha waa dad baa dhinta qaar kale dhashaan, oo lagu beddelaa.

ayat.arabic: وَإِذَا تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ءَايَٰتُنَا بَيِّنَٰتٖ مَّا كَانَ حُجَّتَهُمۡ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُواْ ٱئۡتُواْ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ

en.text: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, their argument is only that they say, "Bring [back] our forefathers, if you should be truthful."

so.text: 25. Marka Aayadahayaga cad loo akhriyo, dooddoodu ma aha wax kale aan aheyn inay yidhaahdaan: (Dib) Noogu keena aabbayaashayo (meytan) haddaad run sheegaysaan.

ayat.arabic: قُلِ ٱللَّهُ يُحۡيِيكُمۡ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمۡ ثُمَّ يَجۡمَعُكُمۡ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ لَا رَيۡبَ فِيهِ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ

en.text: Say, "Allāh causes you to live, then causes you to die; then He will assemble you for the Day of Resurrection, about which there is no doubt, but most of the people do not know."

so.text: 26. Dheh: Alle baa idin nooleyn, haddana idin dhinsiin, haddana idiin soo kulmin Maalinta Qiyaamaha aan shaki ku jirin, dadka badankiisuse ma oga.

ayat.arabic: وَلِلَّهِ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَيَوۡمَ تَقُومُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ يَوۡمَئِذٖ يَخۡسَرُ ٱلۡمُبۡطِلُونَ

en.text: And to Allāh belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And the Day the Hour appears - that Day the falsifiers will lose.

so.text: 27. Allaah ba iska leh Boqortooyada (runta ah ee) samooyinka iyo arlada.  Maalintay Saacadda (Qiyaame) dhacdo, Maalintaasay khasaari ehlu baadilka.

ayat.arabic: وَتَرَىٰ كُلَّ أُمَّةٖ جَاثِيَةٗۚ كُلُّ أُمَّةٖ تُدۡعَىٰٓ إِلَىٰ كِتَٰبِهَا ٱلۡيَوۡمَ تُجۡزَوۡنَ مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ

en.text: And you will see every nation kneeling [from fear]. Every nation will be called to its record [and told], "Today you will be recompensed for what you used to do.

so.text: 28. Waxaad arki ummad waliba iyagoo jilbo jabsan, ummad kasta waxaa loogu yeedhi Kitaabkii (camalkeeda); Maanta waxaa la idinku abaal marin waxaad fasheen.

ayat.arabic: هَٰذَا كِتَٰبُنَا يَنطِقُ عَلَيۡكُم بِٱلۡحَقِّۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا نَسۡتَنسِخُ مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ

en.text: This, Our record, speaks about you in truth. Indeed, We were having transcribed[1475] whatever you used to do."
en.footnotes: [1475] By recording angels.

so.text: 29. Kani waa Kitaabkayaga oo idiinka hadlaya si xaq ah, Waanu qoraynay waxaad camal faleyseen [7].
so.footnotes: [7]. Malaa’igta wax qorta baa qoreysey acmaashooda oo dhan.

ayat.arabic: فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَيُدۡخِلُهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ فِي رَحۡمَتِهِۦۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡمُبِينُ

en.text: So as for those who believed and did righteous deeds, their Lord will admit them into His mercy. That is what is the clear attainment.

so.text: 30. Kuwa (Xaqa) rumeeyey oo sama falay, Rabbigood wuxuu galin Naxariistiisa (Jannada), taasina waa Liibaanta Cad.

ayat.arabic: وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ أَفَلَمۡ تَكُنۡ ءَايَٰتِي تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡكُمۡ فَٱسۡتَكۡبَرۡتُمۡ وَكُنتُمۡ قَوۡمٗا مُّجۡرِمِينَ

en.text: But as for those who disbelieved, [it will be said], "Were not Our verses recited to you, but you were arrogant and became a criminal people?

so.text: 31. Kuwase gaaloobay (waxaa lagu dhihi): Sow ma ahayn Aayadahayga kuwo la idiin akhriyo? Waxaadse aheydeen kuwo isla weyn oo aheydeen qolo denbiilayaal ah.

ayat.arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ إِنَّ وَعۡدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقّٞ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ لَا رَيۡبَ فِيهَا قُلۡتُم مَّا نَدۡرِي مَا ٱلسَّاعَةُ إِن نَّظُنُّ إِلَّا ظَنّٗا وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمُسۡتَيۡقِنِينَ

en.text: And when it was said, 'Indeed, the promise of Allāh is truth and the Hour [is coming] - no doubt about it,' you said, 'We know not what is the Hour. We assume only assumption, and we are not convinced.'"

so.text: 32. Marka la yidhaahdo: Ballan qaadka Alle waa Xaq, Saacadda (Qiyaamana) shaki kuma jiro, waxaad tidhaahdeen: Ma naqaan waxay Saacaddu tahay,  waan maleyn uun malo (aan xag jirin), mana nihin kuwo huba (arrinkaasi).

ayat.arabic: وَبَدَا لَهُمۡ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا عَمِلُواْ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ

en.text: And the evil consequences of what they did will appear to them, and they will be enveloped by what they used to ridicule.

so.text: 33. Waxaa u muuqan (gaalada) xume waxay faleen (ciqaabteedii), waxaana koobi waxay ku jees-jeesi jireen (oo cadaab ah).

ayat.arabic: وَقِيلَ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ نَنسَىٰكُمۡ كَمَا نَسِيتُمۡ لِقَآءَ يَوۡمِكُمۡ هَٰذَا وَمَأۡوَىٰكُمُ ٱلنَّارُ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن نَّٰصِرِينَ

en.text: And it will be said, "Today We will forget you as you forgot the meeting of this Day of yours, and your refuge is the Fire, and for you there are no helpers.

so.text: 34. Waxaana la odhan: Maanta waan idin halmaameynaa (idiinka tegi Naarta) sida aad u halmaanteen la Kulanka Maalintiinnaan (aydaan ugu diyaar garoobin Towxiid iyo camallo san), hoygiinnuna waa Naarta, mana jiro cid idiin soo gargaari.

ayat.arabic: ذَٰلِكُم بِأَنَّكُمُ ٱتَّخَذۡتُمۡ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ هُزُوٗا وَغَرَّتۡكُمُ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنۡيَاۚ فَٱلۡيَوۡمَ لَا يُخۡرَجُونَ مِنۡهَا وَلَا هُمۡ يُسۡتَعۡتَبُونَ

en.text: That is because you took the verses of Allāh in ridicule, and worldly life deluded you." So that Day they will not be removed from it, nor will they be asked to appease [Allāh].

so.text: 35. (Cadaab)kaasi waxaad ku mudateen inaad ka dhigateen Aayadahii Ilaahay jees-jees, noloshii adduunka baana idin hodday. Marka Maanta lagama soo saarayo halkaa, lagamana yeelayo cudur daarasho.

ayat.arabic: فَلِلَّهِ ٱلۡحَمۡدُ رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَرَبِّ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

en.text: Then, to Allāh belongs [all] praise - Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, Lord of the worlds.

so.text: 36. Ee Ammaan idilkeed iyo Mahadba Alle baa u mudan, Rabbiga samooyinka iyo Rabbiga arlada, Rabbiga uumanka oo dhan.

ayat.arabic: وَلَهُ ٱلۡكِبۡرِيَآءُ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ

en.text: And to Him belongs [all] grandeur within the heavens and the earth, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

so.text: 37. Isagaa (Alle) iska leh Weynaan (oo dhan) samooyinka iyo arlada gudahooda, waana Adkaadaha, Xakiimka ah.

ayat.arabic: حمٓ

en.text: Ḥā, Meem.[1477]
en.footnotes: [1477] See footnote to 2:1.

so.text: 1. Xaa Miim [1].
so.footnotes: [1]. Eeg sharaxa hoose ee Suuradda 2 Al-Baqarah: Aayadda 1.

ayat.arabic: تَنزِيلُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡحَكِيمِ

en.text: The revelation of the Book is from Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

so.text: 2. Soo dejinta Kitaabka (Qur’aanka) waa xagga Alle, Adkaadaha, Xakiimka ah.

ayat.arabic: مَا خَلَقۡنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَأَجَلٖ مُّسَمّٗىۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ عَمَّآ أُنذِرُواْ مُعۡرِضُونَ

en.text: We did not create the heavens and earth and what is between them except in truth and [for] a specified term. But those who disbelieve, from that of which they are warned, are turning away.

so.text: 3. Uma aanu abuurin samooyinka iyo arlada iyo waxa u dhexeeya waxaan aheyn Xaq iyo Muddo magacaaban. Kuwase gaalooba dhinac bay uga jeestaan waxa looga digo (oo cadaab ah).

ayat.arabic: قُلۡ أَرَءَيۡتُم مَّا تَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَرُونِي مَاذَا خَلَقُواْ مِنَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ أَمۡ لَهُمۡ شِرۡكٞ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِۖ ٱئۡتُونِي بِكِتَٰبٖ مِّن قَبۡلِ هَٰذَآ أَوۡ أَثَٰرَةٖ مِّنۡ عِلۡمٍ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ

en.text: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Have you considered that which you invoke besides Allāh? Show me what they have created of the earth; or did they have partnership in [creation of] the heavens? Bring me a scripture [revealed] before this or a [remaining] trace of knowledge, if you should be truthful."

so.text: 4.Dheh: Bal ka warrama waxaad caabudey- saan Alle sokadi? I tusa maxay abuureen oo ka mid ah arlada, mise ma waxay ku leeyihiin qayb samooyinka? Ii keena Kitaab kan (Qur’aanka) horti ah ama wax raad cilmi (hore) ah (oo daliil u ah waxaad leedihiin) haddaad run sheegeysaan.

ayat.arabic: وَمَنۡ أَضَلُّ مِمَّن يَدۡعُواْ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَن لَّا يَسۡتَجِيبُ لَهُۥٓ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ وَهُمۡ عَن دُعَآئِهِمۡ غَٰفِلُونَ

en.text: And who is more astray than he who invokes besides Allāh those who will not respond to him until the Day of Resurrection [i.e., never], and they, of their invocation, are unaware.

so.text: 5. Yaa ka lunsanaan badan mid barya (caabuda) Alle sokadi kuwo aan wax jawaab ah u soo celineyn ilaa Maalinta Qiyaamaha oo ah kuwo moog baryadooda?

ayat.arabic: وَإِذَا حُشِرَ ٱلنَّاسُ كَانُواْ لَهُمۡ أَعۡدَآءٗ وَكَانُواْ بِعِبَادَتِهِمۡ كَٰفِرِينَ

en.text: And when the people are gathered [that Day], they [who were invoked] will be enemies to them, and they will be deniers of their worship.

so.text: 6. Marka dadka la isu wada keenana ahaan cadowyadooda, oo ahaan  kuwo caabudiddooda dafira.

ayat.arabic: وَإِذَا تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ءَايَٰتُنَا بَيِّنَٰتٖ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لِلۡحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمۡ هَٰذَا سِحۡرٞ مُّبِينٌ

en.text: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, those who disbelieve say of the truth when it has come to them, "This is obvious magic."

so.text: 7. Marka Aayadahayaga cad loo akhriyo, waxay kuwa gaalada ahi ka yidhaahdaan Xaqa markuu u yimaado: Kani waa sixir cad.

ayat.arabic: أَمۡ يَقُولُونَ ٱفۡتَرَىٰهُۖ قُلۡ إِنِ ٱفۡتَرَيۡتُهُۥ فَلَا تَمۡلِكُونَ لِي مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيۡـًٔاۖ هُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَا تُفِيضُونَ فِيهِۚ كَفَىٰ بِهِۦ شَهِيدَۢا بَيۡنِي وَبَيۡنَكُمۡۖ وَهُوَ ٱلۡغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

en.text: Or do they say, "He has invented it"? Say, "If I have invented it, you will not possess for me [the power of protection] from Allāh at all. He is most knowing of that in which you are involved.[1478] Sufficient is He as Witness between me and you, and He is the Forgiving, the Merciful."
en.footnotes: [1478] Of false implications and suggestions.

so.text: 8. Mise ma waxay leeyihiin: Waa uu been abuurtay (Qur’aanka). Dheh (Nabiyow): Haddaan been abuurtay, waxba iigama tareysaan xagga Alle; Isagaa Ogsoon waxaad dhumbataan 'oo been ah' [2]. Alle  baana marag ugu Filan dhexdeenna aniga iyo idinka. Waana Isaga Denbi Dhaaf Badanaha, Naxariista Badan.
so.footnotes: [2]. Waxa aad ku jirtaan oo male awaal ah iyo fikrado aad qabtaan.

ayat.arabic: قُلۡ مَا كُنتُ بِدۡعٗا مِّنَ ٱلرُّسُلِ وَمَآ أَدۡرِي مَا يُفۡعَلُ بِي وَلَا بِكُمۡۖ إِنۡ أَتَّبِعُ إِلَّا مَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَيَّ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ إِلَّا نَذِيرٞ مُّبِينٞ

en.text: Say, "I am not something new among the messengers,[1479] nor do I know what will be done with me or with you. I only follow that which is revealed to me, and I am not but a clear warner."
en.footnotes: [1479] i.e., I am neither the first messenger to be sent, nor do I bring something different from the other messengers.

so.text: 9. Dheh: ma ahi Rasuul kii ugu horreeyey oo ka mid ah Rususha [3] mana ogi (cilmi Ghaybka iyo) waxa laygu fali aniga ama idinka. Anigu ma raaco waxaan ahayn waxa la ii waxyoodo (ee Qur’aanka ah),  aniguna ma ahi waxaan ahayn dige cad.
so.footnotes: [3]. Lama iman wax ka duwan waxay la yimaadeen Rusushii hore, ama arrin cusub.

ayat.arabic: قُلۡ أَرَءَيۡتُمۡ إِن كَانَ مِنۡ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ وَكَفَرۡتُم بِهِۦ وَشَهِدَ شَاهِدٞ مِّنۢ بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ عَلَىٰ مِثۡلِهِۦ فَـَٔامَنَ وَٱسۡتَكۡبَرۡتُمۡۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهۡدِي ٱلۡقَوۡمَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ

en.text: Say, "Have you considered: if it [i.e., the Qur’ān] was from Allāh, and you disbelieved in it while a witness from the Children of Israel has testified to something similar[1480] and believed while you were arrogant...?"[1481] Indeed, Allāh does not guide the wrongdoing people.
en.footnotes:
[1480] Based upon information from the Torah.
[1481] The conclusion is estimated to be "...would you not then be the most unjust of people?" or "...in what condition would you then be?"

so.text: 10. Dheh: Bal ka warrama hadduu (Qur’aanka) ka yimid xagga Alle, oo aad ku gaalowdeen, uuna ka marag furay marag fure ka mid ah ilmahii Israa’iil [4] inuu  la mid yahay (Towraadda), markaasuu rumeeyey [5] halka aad idinku is kibriseen. Hubaal Alle ma hanuuniyo qoloda daalimiinta ah (gar ma qaatayaasha).
so.footnotes:
[4]. Waxaa loola jeedaa Cabdullaah bin Salaam. 
[5]. Hadalka ka go’an waa: Soo ma ahaaneysaan markaa kuwa ugu gef badan dadka? Ama xaalad noocee baad markaa ku sugnaan doontaan?

ayat.arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَوۡ كَانَ خَيۡرٗا مَّا سَبَقُونَآ إِلَيۡهِۚ وَإِذۡ لَمۡ يَهۡتَدُواْ بِهِۦ فَسَيَقُولُونَ هَٰذَآ إِفۡكٞ قَدِيمٞ

en.text: And those who disbelieve say of those who believe, "If it had [truly] been good, they would not have preceded us to it." And when they are not guided by it, they will say, "This is an ancient falsehood."

so.text: 11. Waxay kuwii gaaloobay ku yidhaahdeen kuwii (Xaqa) rumeeyey hadduu khayr yahay noogama horreeyeen [6] rumeyntiisa, maadaamayna dooneyn inay ku hanuunsamaan, waxay yidhaahdaan: Kanu (Qur’aanka) waa beenihii hore.
so.footnotes: [6]. Waxay ula jeedeen Bilaal, Cammaar, Suhayb, Khabaab iyo qeyrkood a.k.r. kuwaasoo laga tol iyo tabar roonaa.

ayat.arabic: وَمِن قَبۡلِهِۦ كِتَٰبُ مُوسَىٰٓ إِمَامٗا وَرَحۡمَةٗۚ وَهَٰذَا كِتَٰبٞ مُّصَدِّقٞ لِّسَانًا عَرَبِيّٗا لِّيُنذِرَ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ وَبُشۡرَىٰ لِلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ

en.text: And before it was the scripture of Moses to lead and as a mercy. And this is a confirming Book in an Arabic tongue to warn those who have wronged and as good tidings to the doers of good.

so.text: 12. (Qur’aanka) hortina waxaa ahaa Kitaabka Muuse hanuun iyo naxariis, kanina waa Kitaab rumeyn oo af Carabi ah si uu ugu digo kuwa fala dulmiga (shirkiga iyo macaasida), waana u bishaaro kuwo sama falayaasha ah.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُواْ رَبُّنَا ٱللَّهُ ثُمَّ ٱسۡتَقَٰمُواْ فَلَا خَوۡفٌ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يَحۡزَنُونَ

en.text: Indeed, those who have said, "Our Lord is Allāh," and then remained on a right course - there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve.

so.text: 13. Hubaal, kuwa yidhaahda: Rabbigayo waa Allaah, markaas toosnaada [7], ma aha cabsi dushooda, mana murugoonayaan.
so.footnotes: [7]. Markaas ku toosnaada diinta waa ku hanuunsanaada mabaadiida towxiidka, iimaanka iyo camallada wanaagsan oo ku sugnaada.

ayat.arabic: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡجَنَّةِ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا جَزَآءَۢ بِمَا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ

en.text: Those are the companions of Paradise, abiding eternally therein as reward for what they used to do.

so.text: 14. Kuwaa waa ehlu Jannaha iyagoo ku waaraya dhexdeeda - abaalgud ahaan waxay camalsan faleen darteed.

ayat.arabic: وَوَصَّيۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ بِوَٰلِدَيۡهِ إِحۡسَٰنًاۖ حَمَلَتۡهُ أُمُّهُۥ كُرۡهٗا وَوَضَعَتۡهُ كُرۡهٗاۖ وَحَمۡلُهُۥ وَفِصَٰلُهُۥ ثَلَٰثُونَ شَهۡرًاۚ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا بَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُۥ وَبَلَغَ أَرۡبَعِينَ سَنَةٗ قَالَ رَبِّ أَوۡزِعۡنِيٓ أَنۡ أَشۡكُرَ نِعۡمَتَكَ ٱلَّتِيٓ أَنۡعَمۡتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَٰلِدَيَّ وَأَنۡ أَعۡمَلَ صَٰلِحٗا تَرۡضَىٰهُ وَأَصۡلِحۡ لِي فِي ذُرِّيَّتِيٓۖ إِنِّي تُبۡتُ إِلَيۡكَ وَإِنِّي مِنَ ٱلۡمُسۡلِمِينَ

en.text: And We have enjoined upon man, to his parents, good treatment. His mother carried him with hardship and gave birth to him with hardship, and his gestation and weaning [period] is thirty months. [He grows] until, when he reaches maturity and reaches [the age of] forty years, he says, "My Lord, enable me[1482] to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to work righteousness of which You will approve and make righteous for me my offspring. Indeed, I have repented to You, and indeed, I am of the Muslims."
en.footnotes: [1482] Literally, "gather within me the utmost strength and ability."

so.text: 15. Waxaan ku waajibinnay Aadmiga inuu wanaajiyo oo daryeelo waalidkiis. Hooyadiis waxay ku sidday uurka iyadoo ku dhibtootay oo dhashay iyadoo ku dhibtootay; oo (uur ku) sidkiisu iyo ka goynta (naas nuujintiisu) waa soddon bilood, jeer markuu tabar galo oo afartan jirsado yidhaahdo (kan fiican): Rabbiyow! I solansii inaan ka mahad naqo Nicmaddaada aad iigu nicmeysay aniga iyo labadayda waalid, iyo inaan falo camal san oo aad ka raalli tahay; oo ii hagaaji durriyadayda, Adigaan kuu tawbad keenaye, waxaana anigu ka mid ahay Muslimiinta.

ayat.arabic: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ نَتَقَبَّلُ عَنۡهُمۡ أَحۡسَنَ مَا عَمِلُواْ وَنَتَجَاوَزُ عَن سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمۡ فِيٓ أَصۡحَٰبِ ٱلۡجَنَّةِۖ وَعۡدَ ٱلصِّدۡقِ ٱلَّذِي كَانُواْ يُوعَدُونَ

en.text: Those are the ones from whom We will accept the best of what they did and overlook their misdeeds, [their being] among the companions of Paradise. [That is] the promise of truth which they had been promised.

so.text: 16. Kuwaa weeye kuwa aanu ka aqbalno camalkooda fiican oo aan iska dhaafno camalladooda xun, ka mid ah ehlu Jannaha - ballan qaad run ah oo loo ballan qaaday.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّذِي قَالَ لِوَٰلِدَيۡهِ أُفّٖ لَّكُمَآ أَتَعِدَانِنِيٓ أَنۡ أُخۡرَجَ وَقَدۡ خَلَتِ ٱلۡقُرُونُ مِن قَبۡلِي وَهُمَا يَسۡتَغِيثَانِ ٱللَّهَ وَيۡلَكَ ءَامِنۡ إِنَّ وَعۡدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقّٞ فَيَقُولُ مَا هَٰذَآ إِلَّآ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ

en.text: But one who says to his parents, "Uff[1483] to you; do you promise me that I will be brought forth [from the earth] when generations before me have already passed on [into oblivion]?" while they call to Allāh for help [and to their son], "Woe to you! Believe! Indeed, the promise of Allāh is truth." But he says, "This is not but legends of the former peoples" -
en.footnotes: [1483] An expression of distaste and irritation.

so.text: 17. Kan se ku yidhaahda waalidkiis: Uf baad tihiin. Ma waxaad iigu gooddisaan in la i soo saarayo iyagoo dhab ahaan ay facyo tageen hortay? Waxayna labadiisa waalid gargaar weydiistaan Allaah (iyagoo ku leh wiilkooda): Magacaa bi'i waaye! Rumee! Ballan qaadka Alle waa Xaqe. wuxuuse yidhaahdaa: Kanu ma aha waxaan aheyn sheekooyinkii kuwii hore.

ayat.arabic: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ حَقَّ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلۡقَوۡلُ فِيٓ أُمَمٖ قَدۡ خَلَتۡ مِن قَبۡلِهِم مِّنَ ٱلۡجِنِّ وَٱلۡإِنسِۖ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ خَٰسِرِينَ

en.text: Those are the ones upon whom the word [i.e., decree] has come into effect, [who will be] among nations which had passed on before them of jinn and men. Indeed, they [all] were losers.

so.text: 18. Kuwanu waa kuwa uu kula waajibay Qawlka (Cadaabka) ummado tegay hortood oo jin iyo inisiba leh. Waa kuwo xaqiiq khasaaray.

ayat.arabic: وَلِكُلّٖ دَرَجَٰتٞ مِّمَّا عَمِلُواْۖ وَلِيُوَفِّيَهُمۡ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ وَهُمۡ لَا يُظۡلَمُونَ

en.text: And for all there are degrees [of reward and punishment] for what they have done, and [it is] so that He may fully compensate them for their deeds, and they will not be wronged.

so.text: 19. Dhammaan waxay leeyihiin derejooyin waafaqsan waxay faleen, iyo si uu ugu oofiyo si dhan camalladooda iyagoon la dulmineyn.

ayat.arabic: وَيَوۡمَ يُعۡرَضُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ أَذۡهَبۡتُمۡ طَيِّبَٰتِكُمۡ فِي حَيَاتِكُمُ ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَٱسۡتَمۡتَعۡتُم بِهَا فَٱلۡيَوۡمَ تُجۡزَوۡنَ عَذَابَ ٱلۡهُونِ بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَسۡتَكۡبِرُونَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ بِغَيۡرِ ٱلۡحَقِّ وَبِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَفۡسُقُونَ

en.text: And the Day those who disbelieved are exposed to the Fire [it will be said], "You exhausted your pleasures during your worldly life and enjoyed them, so this Day you will be awarded the punishment of [extreme] humiliation because you were arrogant upon the earth without right and because you were defiantly disobedient."

so.text: 20. Maalinta marka kuwa gaalooba loo soo bandhigi Naarta (waxaa lagu odhan): Waxaad wanaaggiinnii ku soo dhammeysateen noloshii adduunka oo ku raaxaysateen in muddo ah, maantase waxaa la idinku abaal marin cadaab silic badan, waxaad isku weyneyn jirteen arlada gudaheeda xaq darro, iyo caasiyoobiddiin- nii darteed.

ayat.arabic: ۞ وَٱذۡكُرۡ أَخَا عَادٍ إِذۡ أَنذَرَ قَوۡمَهُۥ بِٱلۡأَحۡقَافِ وَقَدۡ خَلَتِ ٱلنُّذُرُ مِنۢ بَيۡنِ يَدَيۡهِ وَمِنۡ خَلۡفِهِۦٓ أَلَّا تَعۡبُدُوٓاْ إِلَّا ٱللَّهَ إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ عَذَابَ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيمٖ

en.text: And mention, [O Muḥammad], the brother of ʿAad,[1484] when he warned his people in [the region of] al-Aḥqāf - and warners had already passed on before him and after him - [saying], "Do not worship except Allāh. Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a terrible day."[1485]
en.footnotes:
[1484] i.e., the prophet Hūd.
[1485] Upon the earth. It could also refer to "a tremendous Day," i.e., that of resurrection.

so.text: 21. Xus (reer) Caad walaalkood [8], markuu ugu digey qolodiisii Al-Axqaaf (Buur ciideedda) dhab ahaanna digayaal baa la soo diray hortiis isaga iyo gadaashiiba (isagoo leh): Ha caabudina waxaan ahayn Allaah; waxaan anigu idiinka cabsan Cadaab Maalin Daran.
so.footnotes: [8]. Nabi Huud c.s.

ayat.arabic: قَالُوٓاْ أَجِئۡتَنَا لِتَأۡفِكَنَا عَنۡ ءَالِهَتِنَا فَأۡتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَآ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ

en.text: They said, "Have you come to delude us away from our gods? Then bring us what you promise us, if you should be of the truthful."

so.text: 22. Waxay yidhaahdeen: Ma waxaad noogu timid inaad naga jeediso ilaahyadayada? Ee bal soo daa waxaad noogu gooddiso, haddaad run sheegeyso.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ إِنَّمَا ٱلۡعِلۡمُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَأُبَلِّغُكُم مَّآ أُرۡسِلۡتُ بِهِۦ وَلَٰكِنِّيٓ أَرَىٰكُمۡ قَوۡمٗا تَجۡهَلُونَ

en.text: He said, "Knowledge [of its time] is only with Allāh, and I convey to you that with which I was sent; but I see you [to be] a people behaving ignorantly."

so.text: 23. Wuxuu yidhi: Alle baa ku Cilmi leh (goorta caddibaaddiinna), waxaana idin soo gaarsiin Fartiinta la ila soo diray, waxaanse arkaa inaad tihiin qolo jaahiliin ah moog (Weynida Alle iyo mudnaantiisa Keligi cibaadada).

ayat.arabic: فَلَمَّا رَأَوۡهُ عَارِضٗا مُّسۡتَقۡبِلَ أَوۡدِيَتِهِمۡ قَالُواْ هَٰذَا عَارِضٞ مُّمۡطِرُنَاۚ بَلۡ هُوَ مَا ٱسۡتَعۡجَلۡتُم بِهِۦۖ رِيحٞ فِيهَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٞ

en.text: And when they saw it as a cloud approaching their valleys, they said, "This is a cloud bringing us rain!" Rather, it is that for which you were impatient:[1486] a wind, within it a painful punishment,
en.footnotes: [1486] When you challenged your prophet. See verse 22 of this sūrah.

so.text: 24. Markay arkeen isagoo sidii daruur hogal ah ka muuqda samada ku soo aaddan togaggooda, waxay yidhaahdeen: waa daruur roob noo keeni.Ma jirto’ ee waa waxaad dalabteen in la soo dedejiyo [9]. Waa dabeyl wadata cadaab xanuun badan.
so.footnotes: [9]. Markaad ka hortimaaddeen Nabigiinna oo aad tidhaahdeen noo keen waxa aad noogu gooddisey. Eeg Aayadda 22 ee Suuraddan.

ayat.arabic: تُدَمِّرُ كُلَّ شَيۡءِۭ بِأَمۡرِ رَبِّهَا فَأَصۡبَحُواْ لَا يُرَىٰٓ إِلَّا مَسَٰكِنُهُمۡۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي ٱلۡقَوۡمَ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ

en.text: Destroying everything by command of its Lord. And they became so that nothing was seen [of them] except their dwellings. Thus do We recompense the criminal people.

so.text: 25. Ku baabbi’ineysa wax walba Amarka Rabbigeed; markaasay waxay noqdeen kuwo aan la arkeyn guryahoodii ma’ahee. Sidaas oo kale baan u jaazeynaa qoloda denbiilayaasha ah.

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ مَكَّنَّٰهُمۡ فِيمَآ إِن مَّكَّنَّٰكُمۡ فِيهِ وَجَعَلۡنَا لَهُمۡ سَمۡعٗا وَأَبۡصَٰرٗا وَأَفۡـِٔدَةٗ فَمَآ أَغۡنَىٰ عَنۡهُمۡ سَمۡعُهُمۡ وَلَآ أَبۡصَٰرُهُمۡ وَلَآ أَفۡـِٔدَتُهُم مِّن شَيۡءٍ إِذۡ كَانُواْ يَجۡحَدُونَ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ

en.text: And We had certainly established them in such as We have not established you, and We made for them hearing and vision and hearts [i.e., intellect]. But their hearing and vision and hearts availed them not from anything [of the punishment] when they were [continually] rejecting the signs of Allāh; and they were enveloped by what they used to ridicule.

so.text: 26. Waxaanu u suurta gelinnay wax aanaan idiin suurta galin, waxaana u yeellay maqal, arag iyo laabo, waxbase uma tarin maqalkoodii, araggoodii iyo laabahoodii, waayo waxay dafireen Aayadaha Alle, waxaana ku dhacay oo koobay waxay ku jees-jeesayeen.

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَا مَا حَوۡلَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡقُرَىٰ وَصَرَّفۡنَا ٱلۡأٓيَٰتِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَرۡجِعُونَ

en.text: And We have already destroyed what surrounds you of [those] cities, and We have diversified the signs [or verses] that perhaps they might return [from disbelief].

so.text: 27. Waxaan horay u hallignay wixii hareerihiinna ahaa ee magaalooyin,  waxaana ugu celcelinnay Aayadaha (digniinaha) bal inay (ka) soo noqdaan (gaalnimada iyo denbiyada).

ayat.arabic: فَلَوۡلَا نَصَرَهُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ قُرۡبَانًا ءَالِهَةَۢۖ بَلۡ ضَلُّواْ عَنۡهُمۡۚ وَذَٰلِكَ إِفۡكُهُمۡ وَمَا كَانُواْ يَفۡتَرُونَ

en.text: Then why did those they took besides Allāh as deities by which to approach [Him][1487] not aid them? But they had strayed [i.e., departed] from them. And that was their falsehood and what they were inventing.
en.footnotes: [1487] According to their claim.

so.text: 28. Maxay ugu soo gargaari waayeen kuway ka dhigteen Alle ka sokow ilaahyo [10] si ay ugu dhoweeyaan Alle? Mayee’ way ka dhumeen, kaasina waa baadilkoodii iyo waxay been abuuran jireen.
so.footnotes: [10]. Sidaad ku andacootaan.

ayat.arabic: وَإِذۡ صَرَفۡنَآ إِلَيۡكَ نَفَرٗا مِّنَ ٱلۡجِنِّ يَسۡتَمِعُونَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ فَلَمَّا حَضَرُوهُ قَالُوٓاْ أَنصِتُواْۖ فَلَمَّا قُضِيَ وَلَّوۡاْ إِلَىٰ قَوۡمِهِم مُّنذِرِينَ

en.text: And [mention, O Muḥammad], when We directed to you a few of the jinn, listening to the Qur’ān. And when they attended it, they said, "Listen attentively." And when it was concluded, they went back to their people as warners.

so.text: 29. (Xus) markaan u soo weecinnay xaggaaga koox jin ah oo dhegaysan Qur’aanka, markay yimaadeen halkaasi, waxay yidhaahdeen: Aamusa. Markii la dhammeeyey waxay dib ugu laabteen tolkoodii iyagoo u digaya.

ayat.arabic: قَالُواْ يَٰقَوۡمَنَآ إِنَّا سَمِعۡنَا كِتَٰبًا أُنزِلَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مُوسَىٰ مُصَدِّقٗا لِّمَا بَيۡنَ يَدَيۡهِ يَهۡدِيٓ إِلَى ٱلۡحَقِّ وَإِلَىٰ طَرِيقٖ مُّسۡتَقِيمٖ

en.text: They said, "O our people, indeed we have heard a [recited] Book revealed after Moses confirming what was before it which guides to the truth and to a straight path.

so.text: 30. Waxay yidhaahdeen: Tolkayagow! Waxaan maqallay Kitaab (waa Qur'aanka) la soo dejiyey Muuse kaddib, oo rumeynaya wixii ka horreeyey (oo Kutub Allle ah), oo wax ku hanuuninaya Xaqa iyo Jid Toosan .

ayat.arabic: يَٰقَوۡمَنَآ أَجِيبُواْ دَاعِيَ ٱللَّهِ وَءَامِنُواْ بِهِۦ يَغۡفِرۡ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمۡ وَيُجِرۡكُم مِّنۡ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٖ

en.text: O our people, respond to the Caller [i.e., Messenger] of Allāh[1488] and believe in him; He [i.e., Allāh] will forgive for you your sins and protect you from a painful punishment.
en.footnotes: [1488] Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ).

so.text: 31. Tolkanagow! Raaca daaciga Alle [11] oo rumeeya, Wuxuu (Alle) idiin dhaafi denbiyadiinna, idinkana badbaadin cadaab xanuun badan.
so.footnotes: [11]. Ugu yeerahaa dadka xagga Alle waa Nabi Muxammad s.c.w.

ayat.arabic: وَمَن لَّا يُجِبۡ دَاعِيَ ٱللَّهِ فَلَيۡسَ بِمُعۡجِزٖ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَيۡسَ لَهُۥ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوۡلِيَآءُۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ فِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٍ

en.text: But he who does not respond to the Caller of Allāh will not cause failure [to Him] upon earth, and he will not have besides Him any protectors. Those are in manifest error."

so.text: 32. Qofkaan raacin daaciga Alle, kuma baxsanayo dhulka, mana jiro wax u gargaari (Alle) sokadi. Kuwaa waxay ku sugan yihiin habow cad.

ayat.arabic: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَلَمۡ يَعۡيَ بِخَلۡقِهِنَّ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُحۡـِۧيَ ٱلۡمَوۡتَىٰۚ بَلَىٰٓۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٞ

en.text: Do they not see that Allāh, who created the heavens and earth and did not fail in their creation, is able to give life to the dead? Yes. Indeed, He is over all things competent.

so.text: 33. Miyeyna ogayn in Alle ee abuuray samooyinka iyo arlada, oo aan ku daalin abuuristooda uu awoodo inuu nooleeyo meytida? Haayoo, hubaal waa Kan wax walba Kara.

ayat.arabic: وَيَوۡمَ يُعۡرَضُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ أَلَيۡسَ هَٰذَا بِٱلۡحَقِّۖ قَالُواْ بَلَىٰ وَرَبِّنَاۚ قَالَ فَذُوقُواْ ٱلۡعَذَابَ بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَكۡفُرُونَ

en.text: And the Day those who disbelieved are exposed to the Fire [it will be said], "Is this not the truth?" They will say, "Yes, by our Lord." He will say, "Then taste the punishment for what you used to deny."[1489]
en.footnotes: [1489] Or "because you used to disbelieve."

so.text: 34. Maalinta loo soo bandhigi kuwa gaalooba Naarta (waxaa lagu odhan): Waxakani sow ma aha Xaq? Waxay odhan: Haah Waa nagu Rabbigeene. Wuxuu odhan: Dhadhamiya Cadaabka, gaalnimadiinnii darteed.

ayat.arabic: فَٱصۡبِرۡ كَمَا صَبَرَ أُوْلُواْ ٱلۡعَزۡمِ مِنَ ٱلرُّسُلِ وَلَا تَسۡتَعۡجِل لَّهُمۡۚ كَأَنَّهُمۡ يَوۡمَ يَرَوۡنَ مَا يُوعَدُونَ لَمۡ يَلۡبَثُوٓاْ إِلَّا سَاعَةٗ مِّن نَّهَارِۭۚ بَلَٰغٞۚ فَهَلۡ يُهۡلَكُ إِلَّا ٱلۡقَوۡمُ ٱلۡفَٰسِقُونَ

en.text: So be patient, [O Muḥammad], as were those of determination among the messengers and do not be impatient for them.[1490] It will be - on the Day they see that which they are promised - as though they had not remained [in the world] except an hour of a day. [This is] notification. And will [any] be destroyed except the defiantly disobedient people?
en.footnotes: [1490] i.e., for Allāh's punishment of the disbelievers.

so.text: 35. Ee samir siday Rushushii sugnaanta iyo go’aanka adag lahaa u samreen [12], hana doondoonin in loo soo dedejiyo  (cadaabka). Maalintay arki  waxa loo yaboohay waxay ahaan sida inayan (ku) negaan (adduunka) waxaan ahayn saacad ka mid ah maalin; waa gaarsiin cad ee ma waxaa la rogaa waxaan aheyn fallaagada.
so.footnotes: [12]. Rusushaas go’aanka adag waa Nuux, Ibraahiim,  Muuse,  Ciise,  iyo Muxammad.

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَصَدُّواْ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ أَضَلَّ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ

en.text: Those who disbelieve and avert [people] from the way of Allāh - He will waste their deeds.[1492]
en.footnotes: [1492] i.e., cause them to be lost or make them worthless, earning no reward.

so.text: 1. Kuwa gaalooba oo ka hor istaaga (dadka) Jidka Alle wuxuu (Alle) burin acmaashooda san [1].
so.footnotes: [1]. Maadaama ayan towxiidka qaadan iyo caqiidada saxiixa ah.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَءَامَنُواْ بِمَا نُزِّلَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٖ وَهُوَ ٱلۡحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّهِمۡ كَفَّرَ عَنۡهُمۡ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمۡ وَأَصۡلَحَ بَالَهُمۡ

en.text: And those who believe and do righteous deeds and believe in what has been sent down upon Muḥammad - and it is the truth from their Lord - He will remove from them their misdeeds and amend their condition.

so.text: 2. Kuwase (Xaqa) rumeeyey oo fala samaha oo rumeeyey (Qur’aanka) lagu soo dejiyey Muxammad oo ah Xaq ka yimid Rabbigood, wuxuu (Alle) ka tiritiri xumahay faleen, hagaajinna xaalkooda [2].
so.footnotes: [2]. Si ay u ogaadaan natiijada waxay doorteen.

ayat.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ ٱتَّبَعُواْ ٱلۡبَٰطِلَ وَأَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ٱتَّبَعُواْ ٱلۡحَقَّ مِن رَّبِّهِمۡۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يَضۡرِبُ ٱللَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ أَمۡثَٰلَهُمۡ

en.text: That is because those who disbelieve follow falsehood, and those who believe follow the truth from their Lord. Thus does Allāh present to the people their comparisons.[1493]
en.footnotes: [1493] So that they may know the results of their choice.

so.text: 3. Sidaas waxaa ugu wacan kuwaa gaalooba waxay raacaan been iyo baadil aan jirin, kuwase mu'miniinta ah waxay raacaan Xaqa ka yimid Rabbigood. Sidaasuu Alle ugu soo tusaale qaadaa dadka.

ayat.arabic: فَإِذَا لَقِيتُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فَضَرۡبَ ٱلرِّقَابِ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَثۡخَنتُمُوهُمۡ فَشُدُّواْ ٱلۡوَثَاقَ فَإِمَّا مَنَّۢا بَعۡدُ وَإِمَّا فِدَآءً حَتَّىٰ تَضَعَ ٱلۡحَرۡبُ أَوۡزَارَهَاۚ ذَٰلِكَۖ وَلَوۡ يَشَآءُ ٱللَّهُ لَٱنتَصَرَ مِنۡهُمۡ وَلَٰكِن لِّيَبۡلُوَاْ بَعۡضَكُم بِبَعۡضٖۗ وَٱلَّذِينَ قُتِلُواْ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ فَلَن يُضِلَّ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ

en.text: So when you meet those who disbelieve [in battle], strike [their] necks until, when you have inflicted slaughter upon them, then secure [their] bonds,[1494] and either [confer] favor[1495] afterwards or ransom [them] until the war lays down its burdens.[1496] That [is the command]. And if Allāh had willed, He could have taken vengeance upon them [Himself], but [He ordered armed struggle] to test some of you by means of others. And those who are killed in the cause of Allāh - never will He waste their deeds.
en.footnotes:
[1494] i.e., take those remaining as captives.
[1495] i.e., release them without ransom.
[1496] i.e., its armor, machinery, etc., meaning "until the war is over."

so.text: 4. Ee markaad kula kulantaan dagaal gaalada ka garaaca luqumaha; markaad jabisaanna, ku adkeeya xadhigga 'maxaabiista dagaalka' [3], intaa kaddib ku sii daaya axsaan fal [4] ama ha is furteen jeer ay car-carta dagaalku degto (oo nabaddu faafto). Waa sidaase, haddii Alle doono, Isaga Naf ahaantiisa baa ka aarsan lahaa (dagaal la'aan), waase si uu ugu imtixaano qaarkiinba qaar kale [5]. Kuwa lagu dilaa Jidka Alle marnaba (Alle) ma luminayo camalladooda.
so.footnotes:
[3]. Inta harta u soo qaata qafaal ahaan. 
[4]. Sii daaya idinkoon ka qaadan wax madax furasho ah. 
[5]. Ilaa la dhigo hubka iyo qalabka dagaalka, waxaa loola jeedaa ilaa dagaalka ka dhammaado oo nabaddu faafto.

ayat.arabic: سَيَهۡدِيهِمۡ وَيُصۡلِحُ بَالَهُمۡ

en.text: He will guide them and amend their condition

so.text: 5. (Alle) wuu hanuunin kuwaas oo hagaajin  xaalkooda.

ayat.arabic: وَيُدۡخِلُهُمُ ٱلۡجَنَّةَ عَرَّفَهَا لَهُمۡ

en.text: And admit them to Paradise, which He has made known to them.

so.text: 6. Wuxuu gelin janno uu uga yeelay wax ay yaqaanaan.

ayat.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِن تَنصُرُواْ ٱللَّهَ يَنصُرۡكُمۡ وَيُثَبِّتۡ أَقۡدَامَكُمۡ

en.text: O you who have believed, if you support Allāh, He will support you and plant firmly your feet.

so.text: 7. Kuwa (Xaqa) rumeeyow! Haddaad u gargaartaan (diinta) Alle, Wuu idiin gargaari oo idiin sugi cagahiinna.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فَتَعۡسٗا لَّهُمۡ وَأَضَلَّ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ

en.text: But those who disbelieve - for them is misery, and He will waste their deeds.

so.text: 8. Kuwase gaalooba, hoog baa u sugnaaday, wuuna burin camalladooda.

ayat.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمۡ كَرِهُواْ مَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ فَأَحۡبَطَ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ

en.text: That is because they disliked what Allāh revealed, so He rendered worthless their deeds.

so.text: 9. Waxaa sidaas ugu wacan waxay naceen waxa uu Alle soo dejiyey (oo Xaq ah), markaasuu ka yeelay acmaashooda waxaan waxba ka jirin.

ayat.arabic: ۞ أَفَلَمۡ يَسِيرُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَيَنظُرُواْ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡۖ دَمَّرَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡهِمۡۖ وَلِلۡكَٰفِرِينَ أَمۡثَٰلُهَا

en.text: Have they not traveled through the land and seen how was the end of those before them? Allāh destroyed [everything] over them,[1497] and for the disbelievers is something comparable.
en.footnotes: [1497] i.e., destroyed them and all they owned.

so.text: 10. Miyeyna marin dhulka oo fiirin siday aheyd cidhibta kuwii ka horreeyey? Alle baa ku keenay baabba’ dhan [6], gaaladuna waxay la kulmi isla aayahaas oo kale.
so.footnotes: [6]. Wuu baabbi’iyey iyagoo dhan iyo waxay lahaayeenba.

ayat.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَوۡلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَأَنَّ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ لَا مَوۡلَىٰ لَهُمۡ

en.text: That is because Allāh is the protector of those who have believed and because the disbelievers have no protector.

so.text: 11. Sidaas waxaa ugu wacan in Alle yahay gargaaraha kuwa rumeysan, gaaladuna ma leh gargaare dhab ah.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُدۡخِلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ جَنَّٰتٖ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ يَتَمَتَّعُونَ وَيَأۡكُلُونَ كَمَا تَأۡكُلُ ٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمُ وَٱلنَّارُ مَثۡوٗى لَّهُمۡ

en.text: Indeed, Allāh will admit those who have believed and done righteous deeds to gardens beneath which rivers flow, but those who disbelieve enjoy themselves and eat as grazing livestock eat, and the Fire will be a residence for them.

so.text: 12. Hubaal Alle wuxuu gelin kuwa (xaqa) rumeeyey oo fala samaha beero (Jannooyin) ay hoos qul-qulaan webiyo, kuwa gaalada ahina way iska raaxeystaan oo wax u cunaan sida xooluhu wax u cunaan, Naartana waa hoygooda.

ayat.arabic: وَكَأَيِّن مِّن قَرۡيَةٍ هِيَ أَشَدُّ قُوَّةٗ مِّن قَرۡيَتِكَ ٱلَّتِيٓ أَخۡرَجَتۡكَ أَهۡلَكۡنَٰهُمۡ فَلَا نَاصِرَ لَهُمۡ

en.text: And how many a city was stronger than your city [i.e., Makkah] which drove you out? We destroyed them; and there was no helper for them.

so.text: 13. Badanaa inta magaalo ka xoog badan magaaladaada ku soo saartay, aan ha- laagnay,marka ma jirin wax u soo gargaara.

ayat.arabic: أَفَمَن كَانَ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٖ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ كَمَن زُيِّنَ لَهُۥ سُوٓءُ عَمَلِهِۦ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓاْ أَهۡوَآءَهُم

en.text: So is he who is on clear evidence from his Lord like him to whom the evil of his work has been made attractive and they follow their [own] desires?

so.text: 14. Ma qof (mu'min ah) xujo cad ka haysta Rabbigi, baa la mid ah qof (gaal) camalkiisa xun loo qurxiyey, oo raaca hawadooda.

ayat.arabic: مَّثَلُ ٱلۡجَنَّةِ ٱلَّتِي وُعِدَ ٱلۡمُتَّقُونَۖ فِيهَآ أَنۡهَٰرٞ مِّن مَّآءٍ غَيۡرِ ءَاسِنٖ وَأَنۡهَٰرٞ مِّن لَّبَنٖ لَّمۡ يَتَغَيَّرۡ طَعۡمُهُۥ وَأَنۡهَٰرٞ مِّنۡ خَمۡرٖ لَّذَّةٖ لِّلشَّٰرِبِينَ وَأَنۡهَٰرٞ مِّنۡ عَسَلٖ مُّصَفّٗىۖ وَلَهُمۡ فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ وَمَغۡفِرَةٞ مِّن رَّبِّهِمۡۖ كَمَنۡ هُوَ خَٰلِدٞ فِي ٱلنَّارِ وَسُقُواْ مَآءً حَمِيمٗا فَقَطَّعَ أَمۡعَآءَهُمۡ

en.text: Is the description of Paradise, which the righteous are promised, wherein are rivers of water unaltered,[1498] rivers of milk the taste of which never changes, rivers of wine delicious to those who drink, and rivers of purified honey, in which they will have from all [kinds of] fruits and forgiveness from their Lord... [Are its inhabitants] like those who abide eternally in the Fire and are given to drink scalding water that will sever their intestines?
en.footnotes: [1498] In taste or smell, neither stagnant nor polluted.

so.text: 15. Tilmaanta Jannada loo ballan qaaday kuwa ka dhowrsada (xumaha) waa mid gudaheeda ay yihiin webiyo biyo ah oo aan isbeddelin [7], iyo webiyo caano ah oo uusan dhadhankoodu marnaba doorsoomin, iyo webiyaal khamro (xalaal) ah oo u macaan kuwa cabba, iyo webiyaal malab ah la saafi yeelay; waxayna ku leeyihiin (Jannada) gudaheeda midho nooc kasta iyo astur xagga Rabbigood, (kuwani) ma la mid baa kuwaa ku waaraya Naarta, lagana waraabin biyo karaya markaas goyn xiidmahooda.
so.footnotes: [7]. Dhadhan iyo caraf ahaanba, ma aha kuwo doorsama ama wasakh gasho.

ayat.arabic: وَمِنۡهُم مَّن يَسۡتَمِعُ إِلَيۡكَ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا خَرَجُواْ مِنۡ عِندِكَ قَالُواْ لِلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡعِلۡمَ مَاذَا قَالَ ءَانِفًاۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ طَبَعَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمۡ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓاْ أَهۡوَآءَهُمۡ

en.text: And among them, [O Muḥammad], are those who listen to you, until when they depart from you, they say to those who were given knowledge,[1499] "What has he said just now?" Those are the ones of whom Allāh has sealed over their hearts and who have followed their [own] desires.
en.footnotes: [1499] From among the Prophet's companions.

so.text: 16. Waxaa ka mid ah (munaafiqiinta) kuwo ku dhegaysta (waqtiga khudbadda), markay ka baxaanna agtaada, waxay ku yidhaahdaan kuwaa la siiyey cilmiga [8]: Muxuu lahaa goor dhoweyd? Kuwan waa kuwa Alle daboolay quluubtooda, waxayna raacaan hawadooda (xun).
so.footnotes: [8]. Ka mid ah asxaabtii Nabiga s.c.w.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱهۡتَدَوۡاْ زَادَهُمۡ هُدٗى وَءَاتَىٰهُمۡ تَقۡوَىٰهُمۡ

en.text: And those who are guided - He increases them in guidance and gives them their righteousness.[1500]
en.footnotes: [1500] Taqwā, meaning piety, consciousness and fear of Allāh, and care to avoid His displeasure.

so.text: 17. Kuwa hanuunayna, (Alle) wuxuu u kordhiyaa hanuun, oo uu ku galladeystaa khayr uu waafajiyo iyo shar uu ka fogeeyo.

ayat.arabic: فَهَلۡ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا ٱلسَّاعَةَ أَن تَأۡتِيَهُم بَغۡتَةٗۖ فَقَدۡ جَآءَ أَشۡرَاطُهَاۚ فَأَنَّىٰ لَهُمۡ إِذَا جَآءَتۡهُمۡ ذِكۡرَىٰهُمۡ

en.text: Then do they await except that the Hour should come upon them unexpectedly? But already there have come [some of] its indications. Then how [i.e., what good] to them, when it has come, will be their remembrance?

so.text: 18. Ma waxay sugayaan waxaan ahayn Saacadda (Qiyaame) inay ugu timaaddo kedis? Waxaase yimidba calaamooyinkee- dii, ee sidee bay u waantoobi, markay saacaddu ku dul dhacdo.

ayat.arabic: فَٱعۡلَمۡ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ وَٱسۡتَغۡفِرۡ لِذَنۢبِكَ وَلِلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنَٰتِۗ وَٱللَّهُ يَعۡلَمُ مُتَقَلَّبَكُمۡ وَمَثۡوَىٰكُمۡ
