en.text: So know, [O Muḥammad], that there is no deity except Allāh and ask forgiveness for your sin[1501] and for the believing men and believing women. And Allāh knows of your movement and your resting place.
en.footnotes: [1501] See footnote to 40:55.

so.text: 19. Ee ogow (kuna sugnow) inuusan jirin Ilaah (Xaq lagu caabudo) aan aheyn Alle, una denbi dhaaf dalab naftaada iyo mu’miniinta iyo mu’minooyinka. Alle wuu Og yahay socsocodkiinna iyo negaantiinnaba.

ayat.arabic: وَيَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَوۡلَا نُزِّلَتۡ سُورَةٞۖ فَإِذَآ أُنزِلَتۡ سُورَةٞ مُّحۡكَمَةٞ وَذُكِرَ فِيهَا ٱلۡقِتَالُ رَأَيۡتَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٞ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَيۡكَ نَظَرَ ٱلۡمَغۡشِيِّ عَلَيۡهِ مِنَ ٱلۡمَوۡتِۖ فَأَوۡلَىٰ لَهُمۡ

en.text: Those who believe say, "Why has a sūrah[1502] not been sent down?" But when a precise sūrah is revealed and battle is mentioned therein, you see those in whose hearts is disease [i.e., hypocrisy] looking at you with a look of one overcome by death. And more appropriate for them[1503] [would have been]
en.footnotes:
[1502] i.e., one in which permission is given the believers to fight their enemies.
[1503] The words "awlā lahum" can also be interpreted as "woe to them!" In that case, the following verse would begin, "[Better for them would have been] obedience and good words."

so.text: 20. Kuwa (Xaqa) rumeeyey waxay yidhaahdeen: Maxaa Suurad loo soo dejin waayey (na amreysa ku jihaadka gaalada)? Markase la soo dejiyo Suurad cad yahay amarkeedu oo dagaal gal lagu xuso [9], waxaad arkaysaa kuwa uu qalbigoodu ku jiro cudur (nifaaq) oo kugu soo fiirin fiiro ruux sakaraatul mowd hayo oo kale. Waxaase la gudboon oo u khayr roonaan lahaa.
so.footnotes: [9]. Suuraddaasoo loogu idmay mu’miniinta inay la dagaal galaan cadowyadooda.

ayat.arabic: طَاعَةٞ وَقَوۡلٞ مَّعۡرُوفٞۚ فَإِذَا عَزَمَ ٱلۡأَمۡرُ فَلَوۡ صَدَقُواْ ٱللَّهَ لَكَانَ خَيۡرٗا لَّهُمۡ

en.text: Obedience and good words. And when the matter [of fighting] was determined, if they had been true to Allāh, it would have been better for them.

so.text: 21. Daacadnimo iyo horaarsan. Markase arrinka la go’aamiyo hadday Alle u run sheegaan baa u khayr badnaan lahayd.

ayat.arabic: فَهَلۡ عَسَيۡتُمۡ إِن تَوَلَّيۡتُمۡ أَن تُفۡسِدُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَتُقَطِّعُوٓاْ أَرۡحَامَكُمۡ

en.text: So would you perhaps, if you turned away,[1504] cause corruption on earth and sever your [ties of] relationship?
en.footnotes: [1504] From Islām or from jihād (struggling in the cause of Allāh).

so.text: 22. Ma laga yaabaa haddaad (Xaqa) ka jeesataan [10], inaad fasahaadisaan arlada, oo goysaan qaraabadiinna?
so.footnotes: [10]. Sidoo kale waxa lagu fasiraa haddaad xil iyo jago qabataan.

ayat.arabic: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَعَنَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ فَأَصَمَّهُمۡ وَأَعۡمَىٰٓ أَبۡصَٰرَهُمۡ

en.text: Those [who do so] are the ones that Allāh has cursed, so He deafened them and blinded their vision.

so.text: 23. Kuwaasi weeye kuwa uu Alle nacladay, markaasuu ka dhego iyo indho tiray (Xaqa).

ayat.arabic: أَفَلَا يَتَدَبَّرُونَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ أَمۡ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبٍ أَقۡفَالُهَآ

en.text: Then do they not reflect upon the Qur’ān, or are there locks upon [their] hearts?

so.text: 24. Miyeyna u dhug yeelan Qur’aanka mise qufulaa ku xidhan quluubtooda.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱرۡتَدُّواْ عَلَىٰٓ أَدۡبَٰرِهِم مِّنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلۡهُدَى ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ سَوَّلَ لَهُمۡ وَأَمۡلَىٰ لَهُمۡ

en.text: Indeed, those who reverted back [to disbelief] after guidance had become clear to them - Satan enticed them and prolonged hope for them.

so.text: 25. Hubaal kuwa riddoobay kaddib marka hanuunka u caddaaday, shaydaan baa u qurxiyey oo rajo (been ah) geliyay.

ayat.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمۡ قَالُواْ لِلَّذِينَ كَرِهُواْ مَا نَزَّلَ ٱللَّهُ سَنُطِيعُكُمۡ فِي بَعۡضِ ٱلۡأَمۡرِۖ وَٱللَّهُ يَعۡلَمُ إِسۡرَارَهُمۡ

en.text: That is because they said to those who disliked what Allāh sent down,[1505] "We will obey you in part of the matter." And Allāh knows what they conceal.
en.footnotes: [1505] i.e., the Jews of Madīnah.

so.text: 26. Sidaasi waxaa ugu wacan waxay ku yidhaahdeen kuwa nacay [11] waxa Alle soo dejiyey oo Waxyi ah: Waxaynu idinku adeeci arrinka qaarkiis (colnimada Nabiga). Alle wuu Og yahay sirahooda.
so.footnotes: [11]. Waxaa loola jeedaa Yuhuudddii Madiina degganayd waagaas.

ayat.arabic: فَكَيۡفَ إِذَا تَوَفَّتۡهُمُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ يَضۡرِبُونَ وُجُوهَهُمۡ وَأَدۡبَٰرَهُمۡ

en.text: Then how [will it be] when the angels take them in death, striking their faces and their backs?

so.text: 27. Sidee bayse ahaan, markay malaa’igtu qaadayso nafahooda iyagoo garaacaya wejiyadooda iyo dhabarradooda.

ayat.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمُ ٱتَّبَعُواْ مَآ أَسۡخَطَ ٱللَّهَ وَكَرِهُواْ رِضۡوَٰنَهُۥ فَأَحۡبَطَ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ

en.text: That is because they followed what angered Allāh and disliked [what earns] His pleasure, so He rendered worthless their deeds.

so.text: 28. Sidaasi waxaa ugu wacan waxay raaceen waxa Alle ka cadheysiiya, naceenna waxa raalli geliya. Markaasuu buriyey acmaashooda.

ayat.arabic: أَمۡ حَسِبَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ أَن لَّن يُخۡرِجَ ٱللَّهُ أَضۡغَٰنَهُمۡ

en.text: Or do those in whose hearts is disease think that Allāh would never expose their [feelings of] hatred?

so.text: 29. Mise ma waxay moodaan kuwa uu ku jiro quluubtoodu cudur (munaafiqnimo ah) inuusan Allaah soo saareyn xumaanta laabaha kaga jira?.

ayat.arabic: وَلَوۡ نَشَآءُ لَأَرَيۡنَٰكَهُمۡ فَلَعَرَفۡتَهُم بِسِيمَٰهُمۡۚ وَلَتَعۡرِفَنَّهُمۡ فِي لَحۡنِ ٱلۡقَوۡلِۚ وَٱللَّهُ يَعۡلَمُ أَعۡمَٰلَكُمۡ

en.text: And if We willed, We could show them to you, and you would know them by their mark; but you will surely know them by the tone of [their] speech. And Allāh knows your deeds.

so.text: 30. Haddaan doonno, waan ku tusi karnaa kuwaasi, waxaadna ku garan astaamahoo- da; waxaad kaloo ku garan hadalkooda leexsan. Alle wuu Og yahay camalladiinna.

ayat.arabic: وَلَنَبۡلُوَنَّكُمۡ حَتَّىٰ نَعۡلَمَ ٱلۡمُجَٰهِدِينَ مِنكُمۡ وَٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ وَنَبۡلُوَاْ أَخۡبَارَكُمۡ

en.text: And We will surely test you until We make evident those who strive among you [for the cause of Allāh] and the patient, and We will test your affairs.

so.text: 31. Waanu idin imtixaani ilaa aan muujinno kuwiinna jihaadi iyo kuwa samri oo sugnaan, waana imtixaani arrimahiinna.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَصَدُّواْ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَشَآقُّواْ ٱلرَّسُولَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلۡهُدَىٰ لَن يَضُرُّواْ ٱللَّهَ شَيۡـٔٗا وَسَيُحۡبِطُ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ

en.text: Indeed, those who disbelieved and averted [people] from the path of Allāh and opposed the Messenger after guidance had become clear to them - never will they harm Allāh at all, and He will render worthless their deeds.

so.text: 32. Hubaal kuwa gaalooba oo ka hor istaaga (dadka) jidka Alle, khilaafana Rasuulka, kaddib markuu u caddaaday hanuunka, waxna ma yeeli karaan Alle, wuuna burin acmaashooda.

ayat.arabic: ۞ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ أَطِيعُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُواْ ٱلرَّسُولَ وَلَا تُبۡطِلُوٓاْ أَعۡمَٰلَكُمۡ

en.text: O you who have believed, obey Allāh and obey the Messenger and do not invalidate your deeds.

so.text: 33. Kuwa (Xaqa) rumeeyow! Adeeca Allaah oo adeeca Rasuulka, hana burinnina acmaashiinna.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَصَدُّواْ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ مَاتُواْ وَهُمۡ كُفَّارٞ فَلَن يَغۡفِرَ ٱللَّهُ لَهُمۡ

en.text: Indeed, those who disbelieved and averted [people] from the path of Allāh and then died while they were disbelievers - never will Allāh forgive them.

so.text: 34. Hubaal kuwa gaalooba oo ka hor istaaga (dadka) Jidka Alle, markaas dhinta iyagoo gaalo ah, Alle sinnaba uguma denbi dhaafo.

ayat.arabic: فَلَا تَهِنُواْ وَتَدۡعُوٓاْ إِلَى ٱلسَّلۡمِ وَأَنتُمُ ٱلۡأَعۡلَوۡنَ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَكُمۡ وَلَن يَتِرَكُمۡ أَعۡمَٰلَكُمۡ

en.text: So do not weaken and call for peace while you are superior; and Allāh is with you and will never deprive you of [the reward of] your deeds.

so.text: 35. Ha tabar darraanina (mu’miniintoy), hana weydiisannina nabad (baryo ah cadowyada Islaamka), idinkaa ka sarreyn, Allena idin la jiraa, mana idinkama nusqaaminayo acmaashiinna.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّمَا ٱلۡحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنۡيَا لَعِبٞ وَلَهۡوٞۚ وَإِن تُؤۡمِنُواْ وَتَتَّقُواْ يُؤۡتِكُمۡ أُجُورَكُمۡ وَلَا يَسۡـَٔلۡكُمۡ أَمۡوَٰلَكُمۡ

en.text: [This] worldly life is only amusement and diversion. And if you believe and fear Allāh, He will give you your rewards and not ask you for your properties.

so.text: 36. Nolosha adduunkan waa uun ciyaar iyo madaddaalo, haddaad (Xaqa) rumeysaan, oo aad iska dhowrtaan (xumaha), Wuxuu idin siin abaalgudkiinna, idinmana weydiisanayo maalkiinna.

ayat.arabic: إِن يَسۡـَٔلۡكُمُوهَا فَيُحۡفِكُمۡ تَبۡخَلُواْ وَيُخۡرِجۡ أَضۡغَٰنَكُمۡ

en.text: If He should ask you for them and press you, you would withhold, and He would expose your hatred [i.e., unwillingness].

so.text: 37. Hadduu idin weydiiyo (maalkiinna dhammaan) idinkuna adkeeyo waad bakhayli laheydeen lexejecli darteed, wuxuuna debedda u soo saari lahaa xiqdigiinna (colnimadiinna).

ayat.arabic: هَٰٓأَنتُمۡ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ تُدۡعَوۡنَ لِتُنفِقُواْ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ فَمِنكُم مَّن يَبۡخَلُۖ وَمَن يَبۡخَلۡ فَإِنَّمَا يَبۡخَلُ عَن نَّفۡسِهِۦۚ وَٱللَّهُ ٱلۡغَنِيُّ وَأَنتُمُ ٱلۡفُقَرَآءُۚ وَإِن تَتَوَلَّوۡاْ يَسۡتَبۡدِلۡ قَوۡمًا غَيۡرَكُمۡ ثُمَّ لَا يَكُونُوٓاْ أَمۡثَٰلَكُم

en.text: Here you are - those invited to spend in the cause of Allāh - but among you are those who withhold [out of greed]. And whoever withholds only withholds [benefit] from himself; and Allāh is the Free of need, while you are the needy. And if you turn away [i.e., refuse], He will replace you with another people; then they will not be the likes of you.

so.text: 38. Eega! Waa idinka kuwa loogu yeedho inaad wax ku bixisaan Jidka Alle (jihaadka iyo u gargaarka diinta Alle), waxaase idinku jira kuwo bakhayla, qofkiise bakhayla wuxuu uun ka bakhaylay naftiisa. Alle waa Hodan idinka Deeqtoon, idinkuna waxaad tihiin fuqaro. Haddaad (Xaqa) ka jeesataan Wuxuu Alle idinku beddeli qolo kale oo aan idinla mid noqoneyn.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّا فَتَحۡنَا لَكَ فَتۡحٗا مُّبِينٗا

en.text: Indeed, We have given you, [O Muḥammad], a clear conquest[1507]
en.footnotes: [1507] Ibn Masʿūd said, "You [people] consider the conquest to be that of Makkah, but we consider it to be the Treaty of al-Ḥudaybiyyah." Al-Bukhārī reported a similar quotation from al-Barā’ bin ʿĀzib. Although initially regarded by the companions as a setback, the treaty, in effect, served to promote the spread of Islām, which led to the conquest of Makkah two years later.

so.text: 1. Waxaanu ku siinnay (Nabi Muxammadow) guul cad [1].
so.footnotes: [1]. Al-Fatax: Furashada ama Guusha. Waxaana loola jeedaa heshiiskii Al-Xudaybiyah ee sababta u ahaa furashada Makkah iyo magaalooyin kaleba.

ayat.arabic: لِّيَغۡفِرَ لَكَ ٱللَّهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِن ذَنۢبِكَ وَمَا تَأَخَّرَ وَيُتِمَّ نِعۡمَتَهُۥ عَلَيۡكَ وَيَهۡدِيَكَ صِرَٰطٗا مُّسۡتَقِيمٗا

en.text: That Allāh may forgive for you what preceded of your sin [i.e., errors] and what will follow and complete His favor upon you and guide you to a straight path

so.text: 2. Si uu Alle kuugu dhaafo wixii horay kaaga dhacay oo denbi ah, iyo waxa dib kaaga dhici karaba, kuuguna dhammaysti- ro Nicmaddiisa, oo kuugu hanuuniyo Tub Toosan.

ayat.arabic: وَيَنصُرَكَ ٱللَّهُ نَصۡرًا عَزِيزًا

en.text: And [that] Allāh may aid you with a mighty victory.

so.text: 3. Oo kuu gargaaro Alle gargaar weyn.

ayat.arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنزَلَ ٱلسَّكِينَةَ فِي قُلُوبِ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ لِيَزۡدَادُوٓاْ إِيمَٰنٗا مَّعَ إِيمَٰنِهِمۡۗ وَلِلَّهِ جُنُودُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمٗا

en.text: It is He who sent down tranquility into the hearts of the believers that they would increase in faith along with their [present] faith. And to Allāh belong the soldiers of the heavens and the earth, and ever is Allāh Knowing and Wise.

so.text: 4. Alle waa Kan ku soo dejiyey xasillooni quluubta mu’miniinta, si ay iimaan ugu ziyaadsadaan iimaankoodii; Alle baana iska leh ciidammada samooyinka iyo arlada. Alle waa wax kasta Oge, Xakiim ah.

ayat.arabic: لِّيُدۡخِلَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنَٰتِ جَنَّٰتٖ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا وَيُكَفِّرَ عَنۡهُمۡ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمۡۚ وَكَانَ ذَٰلِكَ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ فَوۡزًا عَظِيمٗا

en.text: [And] that He may admit the believing men and the believing women to gardens beneath which rivers flow to abide therein eternally and remove from them their misdeeds - and ever is that, in the sight of Allāh, a great attainment –

so.text: 5. Si uu u geliyo mu’miniinta iyo mu’minoo- yinka  jannooyin (beero) ay webiyo hoos qul-qulaan iyagoo ku waaraya dhexdeeda weligood, oo uga tirtiro xume falkooda, (arrin)kaasina Alle agtiis waa Liibaan Weyn

ayat.arabic: وَيُعَذِّبَ ٱلۡمُنَٰفِقِينَ وَٱلۡمُنَٰفِقَٰتِ وَٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ وَٱلۡمُشۡرِكَٰتِ ٱلظَّآنِّينَ بِٱللَّهِ ظَنَّ ٱلسَّوۡءِۚ عَلَيۡهِمۡ دَآئِرَةُ ٱلسَّوۡءِۖ وَغَضِبَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَلَعَنَهُمۡ وَأَعَدَّ لَهُمۡ جَهَنَّمَۖ وَسَآءَتۡ مَصِيرٗا

en.text: And [that] He may punish the hypocrite men and hypocrite women, and the polytheist men and polytheist women - those who assume about Allāh an assumption of evil nature. Upon them is a misfortune of evil nature; and Allāh has become angry with them and has cursed them and prepared for them Hell, and evil it is as a destination.

so.text: 6. Iyo si uu u cadaabo munaafiqiinta iyo munaafiqooyinka iyo mushrikiinta iyo mushrikooyinka ee ku maleeya malaha xun Alle, xumaanta korkooda ha ku wareegto, Alle ha u cadhoodo, hana naclado, wuxuuna u diyaariyey Naar - oo u xun meel la ahaado.

ayat.arabic: وَلِلَّهِ جُنُودُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَزِيزًا حَكِيمًا

en.text: And to Allāh belong the soldiers of the heavens and the earth. And ever is Allāh Exalted in Might and Wise.

so.text: 7. Allaah baana leh ciidammada samooyinka iyo arlada. Alle waa Adkaade, Xakiim ah.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَٰكَ شَٰهِدٗا وَمُبَشِّرٗا وَنَذِيرٗا

en.text: Indeed, We have sent you as a witness and a bringer of good tidings and a warner

so.text: 8. Xaqiiq Annagaa (Alle ah) kuu soo dirnay (Nabi Muxammadow) inaad ahaato markhaati,  bishaareeye, iyo digeba.

ayat.arabic: لِّتُؤۡمِنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَتُعَزِّرُوهُ وَتُوَقِّرُوهُۚ وَتُسَبِّحُوهُ بُكۡرَةٗ وَأَصِيلًا

en.text: That you [people] may believe in Allāh and His Messenger and honor him and respect him [i.e., the Prophet (ﷺ)] and exalt Him [i.e., Allāh] morning and afternoon.

so.text: 9. Si aad (dadow) u rumeysaan Alle iyo Rasuulkiisa oo ugu gargaartaan oo aad u qaddarisaan, iyo inaad xurmo weyneysaan oo ugu tasbiixsataan subax iyo galabba.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُبَايِعُونَكَ إِنَّمَا يُبَايِعُونَ ٱللَّهَ يَدُ ٱللَّهِ فَوۡقَ أَيۡدِيهِمۡۚ فَمَن نَّكَثَ فَإِنَّمَا يَنكُثُ عَلَىٰ نَفۡسِهِۦۖ وَمَنۡ أَوۡفَىٰ بِمَا عَٰهَدَ عَلَيۡهُ ٱللَّهَ فَسَيُؤۡتِيهِ أَجۡرًا عَظِيمٗا

en.text: Indeed, those who pledge allegiance to you, [O Muḥammad] - they are actually pledging allegiance to Allāh. The hand[1508] of Allāh is over their hands.[1509] So he who breaks his word only breaks it to the detriment of himself. And he who fulfills that which he has promised Allāh - He will give him a great reward.
en.footnotes:
[1508] See footnote to 2:19.
[1509] Meaning that He (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) accepted their pledge.

so.text: 10. Hubaal kuwa kugula gala wacad (u hiillinta diinta) Waxay uun Wacad la gali Alle. Gacanta Alle baa ka kor ah gacmahooda [2]. Ee qofkii ka baxaa wacadkiisa, wuxuu uun uga baxayaa naftii- sa, qofkii oofiyana wuxuu kula galay Alle ballanka, Wuxuu siin Ajar Weyn (Janno).
so.footnotes: [2]. Macnaha waa inuu Allaah Subxaanahuu watacaalaa ka aqbalay wacadka ay galeen.

ayat.arabic: سَيَقُولُ لَكَ ٱلۡمُخَلَّفُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡأَعۡرَابِ شَغَلَتۡنَآ أَمۡوَٰلُنَا وَأَهۡلُونَا فَٱسۡتَغۡفِرۡ لَنَاۚ يَقُولُونَ بِأَلۡسِنَتِهِم مَّا لَيۡسَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمۡۚ قُلۡ فَمَن يَمۡلِكُ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيۡـًٔا إِنۡ أَرَادَ بِكُمۡ ضَرًّا أَوۡ أَرَادَ بِكُمۡ نَفۡعَۢاۚ بَلۡ كَانَ ٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ خَبِيرَۢا

en.text: Those who remained behind[1510] of the bedouins will say to you, "Our properties and our families occupied us, so ask forgiveness for us." They say with their tongues what is not within their hearts. Say, "Then who could prevent Allāh at all if He intended for you harm or intended for you benefit? Rather, ever is Allāh, of what you do, Aware.
en.footnotes: [1510] See footnote to 9:81.

so.text: 11. Waxay kugu odhan kuwii ka haray (jihaadka) ee ah reer miyiga (deggan Madiinah hareeraheeda): Waxaa na shuqliyey Maalkayaga iyo ehelkayaga, ee noo denbi dhaaf dalab. Waxay ka yidhaahdaan carrabyadooda waxaan ku jirin quluubtooda. Dheh: Yaa idinka celin Alle hadduu idin la doono dhib ama idin la doono dheef? Alle waa u Xog Ogaal waxaad fashaan.

ayat.arabic: بَلۡ ظَنَنتُمۡ أَن لَّن يَنقَلِبَ ٱلرَّسُولُ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِيهِمۡ أَبَدٗا وَزُيِّنَ ذَٰلِكَ فِي قُلُوبِكُمۡ وَظَنَنتُمۡ ظَنَّ ٱلسَّوۡءِ وَكُنتُمۡ قَوۡمَۢا بُورٗا

en.text: But you thought that the Messenger and the believers would never return to their families, ever, and that was made pleasing in your hearts. And you assumed an assumption of evil and became a people ruined."

so.text: 12. Waxaadse u maleyseen in Rasuulka iyo mu’miniintu aysan u soo noqoneyn ehelkooda weligood, sidaasaana loo qurxiyey quluubtiinna, oo maleyseen malooyin xun, waayo waxaad tihin qoon belo ah (aan khayr lahayn).

ayat.arabic: وَمَن لَّمۡ يُؤۡمِنۢ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ فَإِنَّآ أَعۡتَدۡنَا لِلۡكَٰفِرِينَ سَعِيرٗا

en.text: And whoever has not believed in Allāh and His Messenger - then indeed, We have prepared for the disbelievers a Blaze.

so.text: 13. Qofkaan rumeyn Alle iyo Rasuulkiisa, hubaal Waxaanu u diyaarinnay gaalada dab huraya.

ayat.arabic: وَلِلَّهِ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ يَغۡفِرُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيُعَذِّبُ مَن يَشَآءُۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورٗا رَّحِيمٗا

en.text: And to Allāh belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. He forgives whom He wills and punishes whom He wills. And ever is Allāh Forgiving and Merciful.

so.text: 14. Allaah baa iska leh Boqortooyada (runta ah ee) samooyinka iyo arlada, wuxuu u denbi dhaafaa qofkuu doono, oo cadaabaa qofkuu doono. Alle waa Denbi Dhaaf Badane, Naxariis Badan.

ayat.arabic: سَيَقُولُ ٱلۡمُخَلَّفُونَ إِذَا ٱنطَلَقۡتُمۡ إِلَىٰ مَغَانِمَ لِتَأۡخُذُوهَا ذَرُونَا نَتَّبِعۡكُمۡۖ يُرِيدُونَ أَن يُبَدِّلُواْ كَلَٰمَ ٱللَّهِۚ قُل لَّن تَتَّبِعُونَا كَذَٰلِكُمۡ قَالَ ٱللَّهُ مِن قَبۡلُۖ فَسَيَقُولُونَ بَلۡ تَحۡسُدُونَنَاۚ بَلۡ كَانُواْ لَا يَفۡقَهُونَ إِلَّا قَلِيلٗا

en.text: Those who remained[1511] behind will say when you set out toward the war booty to take it, "Let us follow you." They wish to change the words of Allāh. Say, "Never will you follow us. Thus did Allāh say before." So they will say, "Rather, you envy us." But [in fact] they were not understanding except a little.[1512]
en.footnotes:
[1511] See footnote to 9:81.
[1512] i.e., they only understood the material aspects of life.

so.text: 15. Waxay kuwaasi ka haray (jihaadka) odhan: Markaad u baxeysaan si aad u soo qaadataan qaniimooyinka (Khaybar): Noo oggolaada inaan idin raacno. Waxay doonayaan inay beddelaan Hadalka Alle. Dheh: Marnaba nama raaceysaan. Sidaasuu Alle horay u yidhi. Markaa waxay odhan: Mayee’ waad na xasdeysaan.Waase kuwo aan wax fahmeyn in yar mooyee [3].
so.footnotes: [3]. Ee diinta.Waa caado qaatayaal aan aqoon waxaan ahayn dheef adduunyo oo soori qaadday.

ayat.arabic: قُل لِّلۡمُخَلَّفِينَ مِنَ ٱلۡأَعۡرَابِ سَتُدۡعَوۡنَ إِلَىٰ قَوۡمٍ أُوْلِي بَأۡسٖ شَدِيدٖ تُقَٰتِلُونَهُمۡ أَوۡ يُسۡلِمُونَۖ فَإِن تُطِيعُواْ يُؤۡتِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ أَجۡرًا حَسَنٗاۖ وَإِن تَتَوَلَّوۡاْ كَمَا تَوَلَّيۡتُم مِّن قَبۡلُ يُعَذِّبۡكُمۡ عَذَابًا أَلِيمٗا

en.text: Say to those who remained behind of the bedouins, "You will be called to [face] a people of great military might; you may fight them, or they will submit.[1513] So if you obey, Allāh will give you a good reward; but if you turn away as you turned away before, He will punish you with a painful punishment."
en.footnotes: [1513] To Allāh in Islām.

so.text: 16. Ku dheh kuwaa reer miyiga ah ee 'ka' hadhay (jihaadka): Waxaa la idiinku yeedhi qolo dagaal aqoon daran leh, waa inaad la dirirtaan intay iska dhiibaan [4], ee haddaad adeecdaan Alle Wuxuu idin siin abaalgud fiican, haddiise aad dhabarka jeedisaan sidaad horeyba ugu jeediseen dhabarka, Wuxuu idinku cadaabi cadaab xanuun badan.
so.footnotes: [4]. Intay isu dhiibaan Alle Muslimiin ahaan.

ayat.arabic: لَّيۡسَ عَلَى ٱلۡأَعۡمَىٰ حَرَجٞ وَلَا عَلَى ٱلۡأَعۡرَجِ حَرَجٞ وَلَا عَلَى ٱلۡمَرِيضِ حَرَجٞۗ وَمَن يُطِعِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ يُدۡخِلۡهُ جَنَّٰتٖ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُۖ وَمَن يَتَوَلَّ يُعَذِّبۡهُ عَذَابًا أَلِيمٗا

en.text: There is not upon the blind any guilt or upon the lame any guilt or upon the ill any guilt [for remaining behind]. And whoever obeys Allāh and His Messenger - He will admit him to gardens beneath which rivers flow; but whoever turns away - He will punish him with a painful punishment.

so.text: 17. Ma saarna eed indhoolaha, mana saarna wax eed ahi naafada, oo ma saarna eed bukaanka (haddayan u bixin Jihaadka Jidka Alle). Qofkiise adeeca Allaah iyo Rasuulkiisa Wuxuu gelin Jannooyin (beero) ay webiyo hoos qul-qulaan, qofkiina dhabarka jeediya wuxuu cadaabi cadaab xanuun badan.

ayat.arabic: ۞ لَّقَدۡ رَضِيَ ٱللَّهُ عَنِ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ إِذۡ يُبَايِعُونَكَ تَحۡتَ ٱلشَّجَرَةِ فَعَلِمَ مَا فِي قُلُوبِهِمۡ فَأَنزَلَ ٱلسَّكِينَةَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَأَثَٰبَهُمۡ فَتۡحٗا قَرِيبٗا

en.text: Certainly was Allāh pleased with the believers when they pledged allegiance to you, [O Muḥammad], under the tree, and He knew what was in their hearts, so He sent down tranquility upon them and rewarded them with an imminent conquest[1514]
en.footnotes: [1514] That of Khaybar, which preceded the conquest of Makkah.

so.text: 18. Alle wuxuu ka raalli noqday mu’miniinta markay wacad u hiillin (diinta ah) ay kugula galeen geedka hoostiisa, Alle wuxuu ogaa waxa ku jiray quluubtooda (oo iimaan iyo daacadnimo ah), markaasuu ku soo dejiyey xasilloooni korkooda, kuna abaal mariyey guul dhow [5].
so.footnotes: [5]. Kaasoo ahaa furashadii Khaybar, ee ka horreeyey furashadii Makkah.

ayat.arabic: وَمَغَانِمَ كَثِيرَةٗ يَأۡخُذُونَهَاۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَزِيزًا حَكِيمٗا

en.text: And much war booty which they will take. And ever is Allāh Exalted in Might and Wise.

so.text: 19. Iyo qaniimooyin badan oo ay qaadan. Alle waa Adkaade, Xakiim ah.

ayat.arabic: وَعَدَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ مَغَانِمَ كَثِيرَةٗ تَأۡخُذُونَهَا فَعَجَّلَ لَكُمۡ هَٰذِهِۦ وَكَفَّ أَيۡدِيَ ٱلنَّاسِ عَنكُمۡ وَلِتَكُونَ ءَايَةٗ لِّلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَيَهۡدِيَكُمۡ صِرَٰطٗا مُّسۡتَقِيمٗا

en.text: Allāh has promised you much booty that you will take [in the future] and has hastened for you this [victory] and withheld the hands of people from you - that it may be a sign for the believers and [that] He may guide you to a straight path.

so.text: 20. Allaah wuxuu idiin ballan qaaday qaniimooyin badan aad qaadaneysaan, markaasuu idiin soo dedejiyey middatan (qaniimada Khaybar), idinkana celiyey gacmihii dadka, si ay ugu ahaato calaamo mu’miniinta, idinkuna hanuuniyo Jid Toosan.

ayat.arabic: وَأُخۡرَىٰ لَمۡ تَقۡدِرُواْ عَلَيۡهَا قَدۡ أَحَاطَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَاۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٗا

en.text: And [He promises] other [victories] that you were [so far] unable to [realize] which Allāh has already encompassed.[1515] And ever is Allāh, over all things, competent.
en.footnotes: [1515] i.e., prepared for you or decreed.

so.text: 21. Iyo (qaniimooyin) kale oo aydaan awooddeen [6], Alle baa dhab ahaan koobay. Alle wax walba wuu Karaa.
so.footnotes: [6]. Alle Idiin diyaariyey ama qaddaray.

ayat.arabic: وَلَوۡ قَٰتَلَكُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَوَلَّوُاْ ٱلۡأَدۡبَٰرَ ثُمَّ لَا يَجِدُونَ وَلِيّٗا وَلَا نَصِيرٗا

en.text: And if those [Makkans] who disbelieve had fought you, they would have turned their backs [in flight]. Then they would not find a protector or a helper.

so.text: 22. Hadday kuwa gaalooba idinla daggaalamaan, waxay jeedin dhabarra(dooda) mana helayaan ilaaliye iyo gargaare midna.

ayat.arabic: سُنَّةَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّتِي قَدۡ خَلَتۡ مِن قَبۡلُۖ وَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّةِ ٱللَّهِ تَبۡدِيلٗا

en.text: [This is] the established way of Allāh which has occurred before. And never will you find in the way of Allāh any change.

so.text: 23. Waa Hannaanka Alle ee dhab ahaan uga dhex jirey ummadahii hore ee tegay. Kama heleysid wax isbeddel ah Hannaanka iyo Hab raaca Alle.

ayat.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي كَفَّ أَيۡدِيَهُمۡ عَنكُمۡ وَأَيۡدِيَكُمۡ عَنۡهُم بِبَطۡنِ مَكَّةَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ أَنۡ أَظۡفَرَكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِمۡۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ بَصِيرًا

en.text: And it is He who withheld their hands from you and your hands from them within [the area of] Makkah after He caused you to overcome them. And ever is Allāh, of what you do, Seeing.

so.text: 24. Alle waa Kan idinka celiyey gac- mahooda iyo gacmahiinna togga Makkah agti, kaddib markuu idin siiyey guusha oo aad ka adkaateen (kuwii idiin galay cimilka markaad u socoteen Makkah). Alle waa Arkaha waxaad fashaan.

ayat.arabic: هُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَصَدُّوكُمۡ عَنِ ٱلۡمَسۡجِدِ ٱلۡحَرَامِ وَٱلۡهَدۡيَ مَعۡكُوفًا أَن يَبۡلُغَ مَحِلَّهُۥۚ وَلَوۡلَا رِجَالٞ مُّؤۡمِنُونَ وَنِسَآءٞ مُّؤۡمِنَٰتٞ لَّمۡ تَعۡلَمُوهُمۡ أَن تَطَـُٔوهُمۡ فَتُصِيبَكُم مِّنۡهُم مَّعَرَّةُۢ بِغَيۡرِ عِلۡمٖۖ لِّيُدۡخِلَ ٱللَّهُ فِي رَحۡمَتِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُۚ لَوۡ تَزَيَّلُواْ لَعَذَّبۡنَا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِنۡهُمۡ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا

en.text: They are the ones who disbelieved and obstructed you from al-Masjid al-Ḥarām while the offering[1516] was prevented from reaching its place of sacrifice. And if not for believing men and believing women whom you did not know - that you might trample [i.e., kill] them and there would befall you because of them dishonor without [your] knowledge - [you would have been permitted to enter Makkah]. [This was so] that Allāh might admit to His mercy whom He willed. If they had been apart [from them], We would have punished those who disbelieved among them with painful punishment
en.footnotes: [1516] i.e., seventy camels intended for sacrifice and feeding of the poor.

so.text: 25. Waa iyaga kuwa gaaloobay oo idinka celiyey Al-Masjid Al-Xaraam oo (ka xayiray) hadyiga inuu gaaro meeshiisa gawraca [7]. Haddii aysan jireen rag mu’miniin ah iyo haween mu’minooyin ah oo aydaan ogeyn, oo laga yaabo inaad wax yeeshaan, taasoo denbi idinka soo gaarayo iyo mashaqo ogaal la’aan darteed (Alle wuu idiin fasaxi lahaa); waa si uu Alle u geliyo Naxariistiisa cidduu doono. Haddii iyagu (mu’miniinta iyo gaalada) kala soocmi lahaayeen, waxaan cadaabi laheyn kuwooda gaaloobay cadaab xanuun badan.
so.footnotes: [7]. Toddobaatan neef oo geel ah oo loo keenay hadyi ahaan iyo in laga quudiyo fuqarada iyo masaakiinta Xaramka.

ayat.arabic: إِذۡ جَعَلَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فِي قُلُوبِهِمُ ٱلۡحَمِيَّةَ حَمِيَّةَ ٱلۡجَٰهِلِيَّةِ فَأَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ سَكِينَتَهُۥ عَلَىٰ رَسُولِهِۦ وَعَلَى ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَأَلۡزَمَهُمۡ كَلِمَةَ ٱلتَّقۡوَىٰ وَكَانُوٓاْ أَحَقَّ بِهَا وَأَهۡلَهَاۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيمٗا

en.text: When those who disbelieved had put into their hearts chauvinism - the chauvinism of the time of ignorance. But Allāh sent down His tranquility upon His Messenger and upon the believers and imposed upon them the word of righteousness, and they were more deserving of it and worthy of it. And ever is Allāh, of all things, Knowing.

so.text: 26. Markuu Alle yeelay kuwa gaaloobay quluubtooda ficilo - ficiladii waqtigii jaahiliyada - Wuxuuse Alle ku soo dejiyey xasilloonidiisa Rasuulkiisa iyo mu’miniinta, waafajiyeyna ku sugnaanta Ereyga dhowrsashada [8], waxayna ahaayeen kuwo mudan oo ehelkeed ah. Alle wax walba waa Og yahay.
so.footnotes: [8]. Kelmedda taqwada, waxaa loola jeedaa kelmedda Towxiidka, oo ah in Alle loo gaar iyo gooni yeelo cibaadada.

ayat.arabic: لَّقَدۡ صَدَقَ ٱللَّهُ رَسُولَهُ ٱلرُّءۡيَا بِٱلۡحَقِّۖ لَتَدۡخُلُنَّ ٱلۡمَسۡجِدَ ٱلۡحَرَامَ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ءَامِنِينَ مُحَلِّقِينَ رُءُوسَكُمۡ وَمُقَصِّرِينَ لَا تَخَافُونَۖ فَعَلِمَ مَا لَمۡ تَعۡلَمُواْ فَجَعَلَ مِن دُونِ ذَٰلِكَ فَتۡحٗا قَرِيبًا

en.text: Certainly has Allāh showed to His Messenger the vision [i.e., dream] in truth. You will surely enter al-Masjid al-Ḥarām, if Allāh wills, in safety, with your heads shaved and [hair] shortened,[1517] not fearing [anyone]. He knew what you did not know and has arranged before that a conquest near [at hand].
en.footnotes: [1517] i.e., having completed the rites of ʿumrah.

so.text: 27. Alle wuu u rumeeyey Rasuulkiisa riyada si dhab ah: waxaad gali Masjidka Xaramka hadduu Alle idmo idinkoo aamin ah, (qaar) timaha ay xiidhan, (qaar kalena) ay gaabsan idinkoo aan cabsi qabin [9], Wuxuu Og yahay wax aydaan idinku ogeyn, markaasuu (gelitaanka Makka) ka sokow keenay furasho dhow 'Heshiikii Xudaybyah'.
so.footnotes: [9]. Markaad dhammeysaan howlaha cumrada.

ayat.arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَرۡسَلَ رَسُولَهُۥ بِٱلۡهُدَىٰ وَدِينِ ٱلۡحَقِّ لِيُظۡهِرَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلدِّينِ كُلِّهِۦۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ شَهِيدٗا

en.text: It is He who sent His Messenger with guidance and the religion of truth to manifest it over all religion. And sufficient is Allāh as Witness.

so.text: 28. Alle waa Kan la soo diray Rasuulkiisa Hanuun iyo Diin Xaq ah si uu uga sare mariyo diimaha kaloo dhan. Alle ku filan Marag uu ahaado.

ayat.arabic: مُّحَمَّدٞ رَّسُولُ ٱللَّهِۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ مَعَهُۥٓ أَشِدَّآءُ عَلَى ٱلۡكُفَّارِ رُحَمَآءُ بَيۡنَهُمۡۖ تَرَىٰهُمۡ رُكَّعٗا سُجَّدٗا يَبۡتَغُونَ فَضۡلٗا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِضۡوَٰنٗاۖ سِيمَاهُمۡ فِي وُجُوهِهِم مِّنۡ أَثَرِ ٱلسُّجُودِۚ ذَٰلِكَ مَثَلُهُمۡ فِي ٱلتَّوۡرَىٰةِۚ وَمَثَلُهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡإِنجِيلِ كَزَرۡعٍ أَخۡرَجَ شَطۡـَٔهُۥ فَـَٔازَرَهُۥ فَٱسۡتَغۡلَظَ فَٱسۡتَوَىٰ عَلَىٰ سُوقِهِۦ يُعۡجِبُ ٱلزُّرَّاعَ لِيَغِيظَ بِهِمُ ٱلۡكُفَّارَۗ وَعَدَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ مِنۡهُم مَّغۡفِرَةٗ وَأَجۡرًا عَظِيمَۢا

en.text: Muḥammad is the Messenger of Allāh; and those with him are forceful against the disbelievers, merciful among themselves. You see them bowing and prostrating [in prayer], seeking bounty from Allāh and [His] pleasure. Their sign is in their faces from the effect of prostration [i.e., prayer]. That is their description in the Torah. And their description in the Gospel is as a plant which produces its offshoots and strengthens them so they grow firm and stand upon their stalks, delighting the sowers - so that He [i.e., Allāh] may enrage by them[1518] the disbelievers. Allāh has promised those who believe and do righteous deeds among them forgiveness and a great reward.
en.footnotes: [1518] The given examples depict the Prophet (ﷺ) and his companions.

so.text: 29. Muxammad waa Rasuulka Alle, kuwa la jirana waa qalbi sugan yihiin lidka gaalada, isu naxariis badan yihiin dhexdooda, waxaad arki iyagoo Rukuucsan, sujuudsan, dalbaya deeqda Alle (iyo) Raallinimodiisa. Astaamahooda waxay ka muuqdaan wejiyadooda raadka sujuuddooda darteed; Taasi waa tilmaantooda ku taal Towraadda. Tilmaantooda ku taalna Injiilka waa sida (abuur) la beeray, soo bixisay fiidda, markaas xoogeysatay oo noqotay gahayr, oo ku istaagtay iyadoo toosan salkeeda, farax geliseyna beeroleyda - si uu Alle ugu ciilo (tilmaamahooda) gaalada. Alle wuxuu u ballan qaaday kuwaa iyaga ah ee xaqa rumeeyey oo samaha falay denbi dhaaf iyo abaal gud weyn 'Janno' [10].
so.footnotes: [10]. Tusaalahaa la bixiyey waxaa ku sifoobay Nabiga s.c.w. iyo asxaabtiisa.

ayat.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَا تُقَدِّمُواْ بَيۡنَ يَدَيِ ٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦۖ وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٞ

en.text: O you who have believed, do not put [yourselves] before Allāh and His Messenger[1520] but fear Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is Hearing and Knowing.
en.footnotes: [1520] Rather, wait for instruction and follow the way of the Prophet (ﷺ).

so.text: 1. Kuwa (Xaqa) rumeeyow! Ha ka hor marinnina (qowlkiinna) (qowlka) Alle iyo Rasuulkiisa [1]. Alle ka cabsada. Hubaal Alle waa wax kasta Maqle, Wax kasta Og.
so.footnotes: [1]. Waxaa loola jeedaa uma bannaana mu’miniinta inay ka bixiyaan wax xukun ah arrin ay ahaataba haddii aanay oggolaansho iyo daliil ka heysan Alle iyo Rasuulkiisa.

ayat.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَا تَرۡفَعُوٓاْ أَصۡوَٰتَكُمۡ فَوۡقَ صَوۡتِ ٱلنَّبِيِّ وَلَا تَجۡهَرُواْ لَهُۥ بِٱلۡقَوۡلِ كَجَهۡرِ بَعۡضِكُمۡ لِبَعۡضٍ أَن تَحۡبَطَ أَعۡمَٰلُكُمۡ وَأَنتُمۡ لَا تَشۡعُرُونَ

en.text: O you who have believed, do not raise your voices above the voice of the Prophet or be loud to him in speech like the loudness of some of you to others, lest your deeds become worthless while you perceive not.

so.text: 2. Kuwa (Xaqa) rumeeyow! Ha u qaadina kor codadkiinna si ka sarreysa codka Nabiga, hana kula tannaagoogina hadalka sida aad isugula tannaagootaan qaarkiinba qaarka kale, si aan camalkiinna u burin idinkoo aan dreemeyn.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَغُضُّونَ أَصۡوَٰتَهُمۡ عِندَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱمۡتَحَنَ ٱللَّهُ قُلُوبَهُمۡ لِلتَّقۡوَىٰۚ لَهُم مَّغۡفِرَةٞ وَأَجۡرٌ عَظِيمٌ

en.text: Indeed, those who lower their voices before the Messenger of Allāh - they are the ones whose hearts Allāh has tested for righteousness. For them is forgiveness and great reward.

so.text: 3. Hubaal kuwa hoos u dhiga cododkooda marka ay hor joogaan Rasuulka Alle, waa kuwaas kuwa uu Quluubtooda Alle imtixaanay xagga dhowrsashadooda, waxay leeyihiin denbi dhaaf iyo abaalgud weyn (Janno).

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُنَادُونَكَ مِن وَرَآءِ ٱلۡحُجُرَٰتِ أَكۡثَرُهُمۡ لَا يَعۡقِلُونَ

en.text: Indeed, those who call you, [O Muḥammad], from behind the chambers - most of them do not use reason.

so.text: 4. Kuwase kaaga dhawaaqa qololka gadaashood, badankoodu ma aha wax garad.

ayat.arabic: وَلَوۡ أَنَّهُمۡ صَبَرُواْ حَتَّىٰ تَخۡرُجَ إِلَيۡهِمۡ لَكَانَ خَيۡرٗا لَّهُمۡۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٞ

en.text: And if they had been patient until you [could] come out to them, it would have been better for them. But Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.

so.text: 5. Hadday samri lahaayeenna intaad uga soo bixi,baa u khayr badnaan laheyd. Alle waa Denbi Dhaaf Badane, Naxariis Badan.

ayat.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِن جَآءَكُمۡ فَاسِقُۢ بِنَبَإٖ فَتَبَيَّنُوٓاْ أَن تُصِيبُواْ قَوۡمَۢا بِجَهَٰلَةٖ فَتُصۡبِحُواْ عَلَىٰ مَا فَعَلۡتُمۡ نَٰدِمِينَ

en.text: O you who have believed, if there comes to you a disobedient one with information, investigate, lest you harm a people out of ignorance and become, over what you have done, regretful.

so.text: 6. Kuwa (Xaqa) rumeeyow! Hadduu mid caasi ah idiinla yimaado war, iska hubiya, si aydaan wax ugu yeelin dad ogaansho la’aan, markaasna aad ka shallaydaan waxaad fasheen.

ayat.arabic: وَٱعۡلَمُوٓاْ أَنَّ فِيكُمۡ رَسُولَ ٱللَّهِۚ لَوۡ يُطِيعُكُمۡ فِي كَثِيرٖ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَمۡرِ لَعَنِتُّمۡ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ حَبَّبَ إِلَيۡكُمُ ٱلۡإِيمَٰنَ وَزَيَّنَهُۥ فِي قُلُوبِكُمۡ وَكَرَّهَ إِلَيۡكُمُ ٱلۡكُفۡرَ وَٱلۡفُسُوقَ وَٱلۡعِصۡيَانَۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلرَّٰشِدُونَ

en.text: And know that among you is the Messenger of Allāh. If he were to obey you in much of the matter, you would be in difficulty, but Allāh has endeared to you the faith and has made it pleasing in your hearts and has made hateful to you disbelief, defiance and disobedience. Those are the [rightly] guided.

so.text: 7. Ogaadana inuu idinku dhex jiro Rasuulkii Alle, hadduu idinka yeeli lahaa in badan oo arrimo ah, waa dhibtoon laheydeen, Alle baase idin jeclaysiiyey Iimaanka kuna qurxiyey quluubtiinna, oo ka yeelay wax aad neceb tihiin gaalnimo, faasiqnimo iyo caasinnimo. Kuwaasi waa kuwa hanuunsan.

ayat.arabic: فَضۡلٗا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَنِعۡمَةٗۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٞ

en.text: [It is] as bounty from Allāh and favor. And Allāh is Knowing and Wise.

so.text: 8. Waa Deeq xag Alle ah iyo Nicmad. Alle waa wax kasta Ogsoone, Xakiim ah.

ayat.arabic: وَإِن طَآئِفَتَانِ مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ ٱقۡتَتَلُواْ فَأَصۡلِحُواْ بَيۡنَهُمَاۖ فَإِنۢ بَغَتۡ إِحۡدَىٰهُمَا عَلَى ٱلۡأُخۡرَىٰ فَقَٰتِلُواْ ٱلَّتِي تَبۡغِي حَتَّىٰ تَفِيٓءَ إِلَىٰٓ أَمۡرِ ٱللَّهِۚ فَإِن فَآءَتۡ فَأَصۡلِحُواْ بَيۡنَهُمَا بِٱلۡعَدۡلِ وَأَقۡسِطُوٓاْۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلۡمُقۡسِطِينَ

en.text: And if two factions among the believers should fight, then make settlement between the two. But if one of them oppresses the other, then fight against the one that oppresses until it returns to the ordinance of Allāh. And if it returns, then make settlement between them in justice and act justly. Indeed, Allāh loves those who act justly.

so.text: 9. Hadday labo kooxood oo mu’miniinta ka mid ahi daggaalamaan, ka sameeya heshiis dhexdooda, haddiise middood ku xadgudubto tan kale markaa la dirira tan xadgudubtay jeer ay u soo noqoto Amarka Alle, hadday u soo noqoto, heshiisiiya dhexdooda si caddaalad ah, oo caadil ahaada. Alle wuu jecel yahay kuwa caadilka ah.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّمَا ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ إِخۡوَةٞ فَأَصۡلِحُواْ بَيۡنَ أَخَوَيۡكُمۡۚ وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تُرۡحَمُونَ

en.text: The believers are but brothers, so make settlement between your brothers. And fear Allāh that you may receive mercy.

so.text: 10. Mu’miniintu waa uun walaalo [2]. ee  heshiisiiya walaalihiin. Alle ka cabsada, si uu idiinku naxariisto.
so.footnotes: [2]. Nabigu s.c w wuxuu yidhi: Muslimka waa walaalka Muslimka, waa inuusan ku gardarroon, hagran, u gacan gelin cadow, wax ka beensan, qofka muslimka ah waa ka xaaraan muslimka kale: maalkiisa, sharafkiisa, xoolahiisa, xilahiisa, iyo dhiiggiisuba, waxaana shar ugu filan qof inuu quursado walaalki Muslimka ah”.

ayat.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَا يَسۡخَرۡ قَوۡمٞ مِّن قَوۡمٍ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونُواْ خَيۡرٗا مِّنۡهُمۡ وَلَا نِسَآءٞ مِّن نِّسَآءٍ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُنَّ خَيۡرٗا مِّنۡهُنَّۖ وَلَا تَلۡمِزُوٓاْ أَنفُسَكُمۡ وَلَا تَنَابَزُواْ بِٱلۡأَلۡقَٰبِۖ بِئۡسَ ٱلِٱسۡمُ ٱلۡفُسُوقُ بَعۡدَ ٱلۡإِيمَٰنِۚ وَمَن لَّمۡ يَتُبۡ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ

en.text: O you who have believed, let not a people ridicule [another] people; perhaps they may be better than them; nor let women ridicule [other] women; perhaps they may be better than them. And do not insult one another and do not call each other by [offensive] nicknames. Wretched is the name [i.e., mention] of disobedience after [one's] faith. And whoever does not repent - then it is those who are the wrongdoers.

so.text: 11. Kuwa (Xaqa) rumeeyow! Qolona yey yasin qolo kale, waxaa laga yaabaa inay ka khayr badan yihiin, oo yey dumarna yasin dumar kale, waxaa laga yaabaa inay ka khayr badan yihiin; hana is ceebeynina, waxna ha iska sheegina, oo ha isugu yeedhina naaneysyo xun. Xumaa inaad magacyo iyo tilmaamo xun isugu yeedhaan kaddib Iimaanka. Qofkaan tawbad keenin [3] waa kuwaas kuwa ah daalimiinta.
so.footnotes: [3]. Oo Xaqa u soo laaban oo aan u muujin walaalladi maxabbad, maamuus iyo qalbi san.

ayat.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ٱجۡتَنِبُواْ كَثِيرٗا مِّنَ ٱلظَّنِّ إِنَّ بَعۡضَ ٱلظَّنِّ إِثۡمٞۖ وَلَا تَجَسَّسُواْ وَلَا يَغۡتَب بَّعۡضُكُم بَعۡضًاۚ أَيُحِبُّ أَحَدُكُمۡ أَن يَأۡكُلَ لَحۡمَ أَخِيهِ مَيۡتٗا فَكَرِهۡتُمُوهُۚ وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ تَوَّابٞ رَّحِيمٞ

en.text: O you who have believed, avoid much [negative] assumption. Indeed, some assumption is sin. And do not spy or backbite each other. Would one of you like to eat the flesh of his brother when dead? You would detest it. And fear Allāh; indeed, Allāh is Accepting of Repentance and Merciful.

so.text: 12. Kuwa (Xaqa) rumeeyow! Ka dheeraada malaha badanki, malaha qaarki waa denbi. Ha is jaasuusina, qaarkiinna yaanay xaman qaar kale; miyuu jecel yahay midkiin inuu cuno hilibka walaalkiis oo mayd ah? Waad naceysaane (naca xanta). Alle ka cabsada  (iskana jira xumaha). Hubaal Alle waa Tawbad Aqbal Badane, Naxariis Badan.

ayat.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ إِنَّا خَلَقۡنَٰكُم مِّن ذَكَرٖ وَأُنثَىٰ وَجَعَلۡنَٰكُمۡ شُعُوبٗا وَقَبَآئِلَ لِتَعَارَفُوٓاْۚ إِنَّ أَكۡرَمَكُمۡ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ أَتۡقَىٰكُمۡۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ خَبِيرٞ

en.text: O mankind, indeed We have created you from male and female and made you peoples and tribes that you may know one another. Indeed, the most noble of you in the sight of Allāh is the most righteous[1521] of you. Indeed, Allāh is Knowing and Aware.
en.footnotes: [1521] Literally, "he who has the most taqwā," i.e., consciousness and fear of Allāh, piety and righteousness.

so.text: 13. Dadow! Waxaanu idinka abuurnay lab (Aadam) iyo dhedddig (Xawwaa), idinkana dhignay shucuub iyo qabaa’il si aad isu aqoonsataan. Hubaal, kan idiinku sharaf badan Alle agti waa kan idiinku dhowris badan (amarrada Alle ee ka jooga xumaha). Hubaal Alle waa wax kasta Oge, Xog Ogaal ah, Xeel Dheer.

ayat.arabic: ۞ قَالَتِ ٱلۡأَعۡرَابُ ءَامَنَّاۖ قُل لَّمۡ تُؤۡمِنُواْ وَلَٰكِن قُولُوٓاْ أَسۡلَمۡنَا وَلَمَّا يَدۡخُلِ ٱلۡإِيمَٰنُ فِي قُلُوبِكُمۡۖ وَإِن تُطِيعُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ لَا يَلِتۡكُم مِّنۡ أَعۡمَٰلِكُمۡ شَيۡـًٔاۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٌ

en.text: The bedouins say, "We have believed." Say, "You have not [yet] believed; but say [instead], 'We have submitted,' for faith has not yet entered your hearts. And if you obey Allāh and His Messenger, He will not deprive you from your deeds[1522] of anything. Indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful."
en.footnotes: [1522] i.e., the reward thereof.

so.text: 14. Reer miyigii (degganaa Madiinah  hareeraheeda) waxay yidhaahdeen: Waanu rumeynay (Xaqa). Dheh: Ma aydaan rumeynin (weli) dhahase, waanu islaamnay (hoggaansannay); waayo Iimaanku weli ma gelin quluubtiinna.  Haddaadse adeecdaan Alle iyo Rasuulkiisa, waxba idinkama uu dhimayo ka mid ah acmaashiinna. Hubaal Alle waa Denbi Dhaaf Badane, Naxariis Badan.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّمَا ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ ثُمَّ لَمۡ يَرۡتَابُواْ وَجَٰهَدُواْ بِأَمۡوَٰلِهِمۡ وَأَنفُسِهِمۡ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلصَّٰدِقُونَ

en.text: The believers are only the ones who have believed in Allāh and His Messenger and then doubt not but strive with their properties and their lives in the cause of Allāh. It is those who are the truthful.

so.text: 15. Mu’miniintu waa uun kuwa rumeysan Alle iyo Rasuulkiisa, markaas aan shakiyin, una hura maalkooda iyo nafahooda Jidka Alle. Kuwaasi waa kuwa runlowyda ah.

ayat.arabic: قُلۡ أَتُعَلِّمُونَ ٱللَّهَ بِدِينِكُمۡ وَٱللَّهُ يَعۡلَمُ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيمٞ

en.text: Say, "Would you acquaint Allāh with your religion while Allāh knows whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth, and Allāh is Knowing of all things?"

so.text: 16. Dheh: Ma waxaad u sheegeysaan Alle (xaalka) diintiinna (iyo camalladiinna) Isagoo Alle og yahay waxaa ku sugan samooyinka iyo waxaa ku sugan arlada. Alle wax walba wuu Og yahay.

ayat.arabic: يَمُنُّونَ عَلَيۡكَ أَنۡ أَسۡلَمُواْۖ قُل لَّا تَمُنُّواْ عَلَيَّ إِسۡلَٰمَكُمۖ بَلِ ٱللَّهُ يَمُنُّ عَلَيۡكُمۡ أَنۡ هَدَىٰكُمۡ لِلۡإِيمَٰنِ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ

en.text: They consider it a favor to you that they have accepted Islām. Say, "Do not consider your Islām a favor to me. Rather, Allāh has conferred favor upon you that He has guided you to the faith, if you should be truthful."

so.text: 17. Waxay kuugu abaal sheegan inay islaameen darteed. Dheh: Ha iigu abaal sheegannina islaamiddiinna. Bal Alle baa idiinku abaal sheeganaya idinku hanuunintiinna Iimaanka darteed, haddaad run sheegeysaan.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعۡلَمُ غَيۡبَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَٱللَّهُ بَصِيرُۢ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ

en.text: Indeed, Allāh knows the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and the earth. And Allāh is Seeing of what you do.

so.text: 18. Hubaal Alle baa ogsoon waxa aan muuqan ee ah samooyinka iyo arlada. Alle wuu Arkaa waxaad fashaan.

ayat.arabic: قٓۚ وَٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ ٱلۡمَجِيدِ

en.text: Qāf.[1524] By the honored Qur’ān...[1525]
en.footnotes:
[1524] See footnote to 2:1.
[1525] See footnote to 38:1.

so.text: 1. Qaaf [1]; Waxaan (waa Alle'e) ku dhaartay Qur’aanka Sharafka Badan [2].
so.footnotes:
[1]. Eeg sharaxa hoose ee Suuradda 2 Al-Baqarah: Aayadda 1.
[2]. Eeg sharaxa hoose ee Suuradda 38: 1

ayat.arabic: بَلۡ عَجِبُوٓاْ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٞ مِّنۡهُمۡ فَقَالَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا شَيۡءٌ عَجِيبٌ

en.text: But they wonder that there has come to them a warner from among themselves, and the disbelievers say, "This is an amazing thing.

so.text: 2. Waxayse la yaabeen inuu u yimid dige ka mid ah (Nabi Muxammad). Gaaladu waxay yidhaahdeen: Kanu waa wax la yaab leh.

ayat.arabic: أَءِذَا مِتۡنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابٗاۖ ذَٰلِكَ رَجۡعُۢ بَعِيدٞ

en.text: When we have died and have become dust, [we will return to life]? That is a distant [i.e., unlikely] return."

so.text: 3. Ma markaan dhimanno oo aan noqonno carro (miyaa na la soo nooleyn)? (arrin)kaasu waa soo Noqosho Fog.

ayat.arabic: قَدۡ عَلِمۡنَا مَا تَنقُصُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ مِنۡهُمۡۖ وَعِندَنَا كِتَٰبٌ حَفِيظُۢ

en.text: We know what the earth diminishes [i.e., consumes] of them, and with Us is a retaining record.

so.text: 4. Waxaan ognahay wuxuu dhulku ka dhimo (jidhkooda). Agtannadana waxaa yaal Kitaab wax walba kooba oo xafidan (Looxa Maxfuudka).

ayat.arabic: بَلۡ كَذَّبُواْ بِٱلۡحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمۡ فَهُمۡ فِيٓ أَمۡرٖ مَّرِيجٍ

en.text: But they denied the truth when it came to them, so they are in a confused condition.

so.text: 5. Waxayse beeniyeen Xaqa markuu u yimid, waxayna (gaaladu) ku sugan yihiin xaalad murugsan.

ayat.arabic: أَفَلَمۡ يَنظُرُوٓاْ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَوۡقَهُمۡ كَيۡفَ بَنَيۡنَٰهَا وَزَيَّنَّٰهَا وَمَا لَهَا مِن فُرُوجٖ

en.text: Have they not looked at the heaven above them - how We structured it and adorned it and [how] it has no rifts?

so.text: 6. Miyeyna fiirin samada korkooda ah, sidaan u dhisnay oo u qurxinnay, ma laha wax duleello ah?

ayat.arabic: وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ مَدَدۡنَٰهَا وَأَلۡقَيۡنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِيَ وَأَنۢبَتۡنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوۡجِۭ بَهِيجٖ

en.text: And the earth - We spread it out and cast therein firmly set mountains and made grow therein [something] of every beautiful kind,

so.text: 7. Dhulkana waanu fidinnay, oo ku sugnay buuro, waxaana ka soo bixinnay dhexdiisa dhir qurxoon oo cayn walba leh.

ayat.arabic: تَبۡصِرَةٗ وَذِكۡرَىٰ لِكُلِّ عَبۡدٖ مُّنِيبٖ

en.text: Giving insight and a reminder for every servant who turns [to Allāh].

so.text: 8. Tusmo iyo waano u ah addoon kasta  u soo noqda (Alle) oo tawbad keen badan.

ayat.arabic: وَنَزَّلۡنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءٗ مُّبَٰرَكٗا فَأَنۢبَتۡنَا بِهِۦ جَنَّٰتٖ وَحَبَّ ٱلۡحَصِيدِ

en.text: And We have sent down blessed rain from the sky and made grow thereby gardens and grain from the harvest

so.text: 9. Waxaanu ka soo dejinnaa daruuraha biyo (roob) barakaysan, oo aan ku soo saarnaa beero iyo baad.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلنَّخۡلَ بَاسِقَٰتٖ لَّهَا طَلۡعٞ نَّضِيدٞ

en.text: And lofty palm trees having fruit arranged in layers -

so.text: 10. Iyo geedo timireed dhaadheer leh fiido wax ka soo dhashaan oo is dul saaran.

ayat.arabic: رِّزۡقٗا لِّلۡعِبَادِۖ وَأَحۡيَيۡنَا بِهِۦ بَلۡدَةٗ مَّيۡتٗاۚ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡخُرُوجُ

en.text: As provision for the servants, and We have given life thereby to a dead land. Thus is the emergence [i.e., resurrection].

so.text: 11. Risiq ay leeyihiin addoomaha (Alle). Waxaana ku nooleynaa (biyahaa) dhul dhintay. Sidaasoo kale bay ahaan soo bixinta (Qiyaamada).

ayat.arabic: كَذَّبَتۡ قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمُ نُوحٖ وَأَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلرَّسِّ وَثَمُودُ

en.text: The people of Noah denied before them,[1526] and the companions of the well[1527] and Thamūd
en.footnotes:
[1526] i.e., before the disbelievers of Makkah.
[1527] See footnote to 25:38.

so.text: 12. Qolodii Nuux baa beeniyey hortood [3], iyo qoladii ceelkii (Azerbaijan) iyo Thamuud.
so.footnotes: [3]. Waa ka hor gaalada reer Makkah.

ayat.arabic: وَعَادٞ وَفِرۡعَوۡنُ وَإِخۡوَٰنُ لُوطٖ

en.text: And ʿAad and Pharaoh and the brothers [i.e., people] of Lot

so.text: 13. Iyo Caad iyo Fircoon iyo Luud walaalihi.

ayat.arabic: وَأَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡأَيۡكَةِ وَقَوۡمُ تُبَّعٖۚ كُلّٞ كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعِيدِ

en.text: And the companions of the thicket and the people of Tubbaʿ. All denied the messengers, so My threat was justly fulfilled.

so.text: 14. Iyo reer hawdkii (loo diray Nabi Shucayb) iyo qolodii Tubbac (ee Yaman); dhammaan waxay beeniyeen Rususha, waxaana ku dhacay gooddigeyga.

ayat.arabic: أَفَعَيِينَا بِٱلۡخَلۡقِ ٱلۡأَوَّلِۚ بَلۡ هُمۡ فِي لَبۡسٖ مِّنۡ خَلۡقٖ جَدِيدٖ

en.text: Did We fail in the first creation? But they are in confusion over a new creation.

so.text: 15. Ma Waxaan ku daalnay abuuristii hore? Mayee, waxay ka shakisan yihiin abuuris cusub (Aakhirada).

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ وَنَعۡلَمُ مَا تُوَسۡوِسُ بِهِۦ نَفۡسُهُۥۖ وَنَحۡنُ أَقۡرَبُ إِلَيۡهِ مِنۡ حَبۡلِ ٱلۡوَرِيدِ

en.text: And We have already created man and know what his soul whispers to him, and We are closer[1528] to him than [his] jugular vein.
en.footnotes: [1528] In absolute knowledge of everything about him. "We" has also been interpreted to mean the angels who are mentioned in the following verse.

so.text: 16. Waxaan dhab ahaan abuurnay aadmiga, waana ognahay waxay naftiisu kula hadasho. Waxaana (waa Alle'e oo ku kooba Ogaal iyo Awood ahaan ama malaa’igtiisa) uga dhownahay xididka dhuunta.

ayat.arabic: إِذۡ يَتَلَقَّى ٱلۡمُتَلَقِّيَانِ عَنِ ٱلۡيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ قَعِيدٞ

en.text: When the two receivers [i.e., recording angels] receive,[1529] seated on the right and on the left.
en.footnotes: [1529] And record each word and deed.

so.text: 17.Markay labada qorayaal (malaa’igta wax qoreysa) ku kulmi, iyagoo ka kala fadhiya dhinaca midig, iyo dhinaca bidix (ee qofka).

ayat.arabic: مَّا يَلۡفِظُ مِن قَوۡلٍ إِلَّا لَدَيۡهِ رَقِيبٌ عَتِيدٞ

en.text: He [i.e., man] utters no word except that with him is an observer prepared [to record].

so.text: 18. Ma jiro eray (aadmiga) ka soo baxa, oo uusan ag joogin ilaaliye (malag) u diyaar ah (inuu qoro).

ayat.arabic: وَجَآءَتۡ سَكۡرَةُ ٱلۡمَوۡتِ بِٱلۡحَقِّۖ ذَٰلِكَ مَا كُنتَ مِنۡهُ تَحِيدُ

en.text: And the intoxication of death will bring the truth; that is what you were trying to avoid.

so.text: 19. Waxaa u iman sakaraadka mowdka oo xaq ah: kaasi waa waxaad ka carareysay.

ayat.arabic: وَنُفِخَ فِي ٱلصُّورِۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوۡمُ ٱلۡوَعِيدِ

en.text: And the Horn will be blown. That is the Day of [carrying out] the threat.

so.text: 20. Buunkii (Qiyaamana) waa la afuufi - kaasu waa Maalinkii laysu yaboohay.

ayat.arabic: وَجَآءَتۡ كُلُّ نَفۡسٖ مَّعَهَا سَآئِقٞ وَشَهِيدٞ

en.text: And every soul will come, with it a driver and a witness.[1530]
en.footnotes: [1530] i.e., one angel driving the soul to the Judgement and one to testify as to its deeds.

so.text: 21. Naf walbana waxay iman iyadoo uu la socdo (labo malag) mid hoggaaminaya iyo mid ku markhaati furaya.

ayat.arabic: لَّقَدۡ كُنتَ فِي غَفۡلَةٖ مِّنۡ هَٰذَا فَكَشَفۡنَا عَنكَ غِطَآءَكَ فَبَصَرُكَ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ حَدِيدٞ

en.text: [It will be said], "You were certainly in unmindfulness of this, and We have removed from you your cover,[1531] so your sight, this Day, is sharp."
en.footnotes: [1531] Of heedlessness, or that which had sealed your hearing, your vision and your heart from guidance.

so.text: 22. (Waxaa la odhan): Waad ka dhoohnayd arrinkan, haatanse kaa qaadnay daboolkaagii, marka araggaagu maanta waa xoog badan yahay.

ayat.arabic: وَقَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ هَٰذَا مَا لَدَيَّ عَتِيدٌ

en.text: And his companion, [the angel], will say, "This [record] is what is with me, prepared."

so.text: 23.(Malaggii) la xidhiidhayna wuxuu odhan: Kani waa waxa agteyda ku diyaarka ah.

ayat.arabic: أَلۡقِيَا فِي جَهَنَّمَ كُلَّ كَفَّارٍ عَنِيدٖ

en.text: [Allāh will say], "Throw into Hell every obstinate disbeliever,

so.text: 24. (Alle wuxuu odhan) Ku tuura Naar mid kastoo abaal dhac badan, madax adag.

ayat.arabic: مَّنَّاعٖ لِّلۡخَيۡرِ مُعۡتَدٖ مُّرِيبٍ

en.text: Preventer of good, aggressor, and doubter,

so.text: 25.Khayr diide ah, xadgudbe, shaki qabeen.

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَأَلۡقِيَاهُ فِي ٱلۡعَذَابِ ٱلشَّدِيدِ

en.text: Who made [as equal] with Allāh another deity; then throw him into the severe punishment."

so.text: 26. Ee yeelay la jirka Alle, ilaah kale, oo ku tuura cadaab daran.

ayat.arabic: ۞ قَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ رَبَّنَا مَآ أَطۡغَيۡتُهُۥ وَلَٰكِن كَانَ فِي ضَلَٰلِۭ بَعِيدٖ

en.text: His [devil] companion will say, "Our Lord, I did not make him transgress, but he [himself] was in extreme error."

so.text: 27. (sheydaankii) la xidhiidhay wuxuu odhan: Rabbigayow! Anigu ma aanan u horseedin xadgudub, isagaase naf ahaantiisa ku sugnaa habow fog.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ لَا تَخۡتَصِمُواْ لَدَيَّ وَقَدۡ قَدَّمۡتُ إِلَيۡكُم بِٱلۡوَعِيدِ

en.text: [Allāh] will say, "Do not dispute before Me, while I had already presented to you the threat [i.e., warning].

so.text: 28. (Alle) wuxuu odhan: Ha ku doodina Hortayda, waxaana horay idiinku soo diray gooddiga.

ayat.arabic: مَا يُبَدَّلُ ٱلۡقَوۡلُ لَدَيَّ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِظَلَّٰمٖ لِّلۡعَبِيدِ

en.text: The word [i.e., decree] will not be changed with Me, and never will I be unjust to the servants."

so.text: 29. Qowlka iga soo fulaa lama beddelo, mana dulmiyo Addoomaha.

ayat.arabic: يَوۡمَ نَقُولُ لِجَهَنَّمَ هَلِ ٱمۡتَلَأۡتِ وَتَقُولُ هَلۡ مِن مَّزِيدٖ

en.text: On the Day We will say to Hell, "Have you been filled?" and it will say, "Are there some more,"

so.text: 30. Maalinta aan ku odhan Jahannama: Ma buuxsantay? Oo markaa ay dhihi: Ma jiraan wax dheeraad ah oo la soo wado?

ayat.arabic: وَأُزۡلِفَتِ ٱلۡجَنَّةُ لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ غَيۡرَ بَعِيدٍ

en.text: And Paradise will be brought near to the righteous, not far,

so.text: 31. Oo Jannada loo soo dhoweyn kuwa ka dhowrsada xumaha, iyadoo aan fogeynba.

ayat.arabic: هَٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِكُلِّ أَوَّابٍ حَفِيظٖ

en.text: [It will be said], "This is what you were promised - for every returner [to Allāh] and keeper [of His covenant].

so.text: 32. Kani waa waxa loo yaboohay qof walboo tawbad keen badan, dhowra (ballanka iyo wax kastoo Alle u dhoweyn).

ayat.arabic: مَّنۡ خَشِيَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنَ بِٱلۡغَيۡبِ وَجَآءَ بِقَلۡبٖ مُّنِيبٍ

en.text: Who feared the Most Merciful in the unseen and came with a heart returning [in repentance].

so.text: 33.Kan ka baqa Raxmaanka sir 'iyo caadba' oo la yimaada qalbi tawbad keen badan.

ayat.arabic: ٱدۡخُلُوهَا بِسَلَٰمٖۖ ذَٰلِكَ يَوۡمُ ٱلۡخُلُودِ

en.text: Enter it in peace. This is the Day of Eternity."

so.text: 34. (Waxaa lagu odhan), "Ku gala nabad (Jannada); kaasi waa Maalinka waaridda".

ayat.arabic: لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ فِيهَا وَلَدَيۡنَا مَزِيدٞ

en.text: They will have whatever they wish therein, and with Us is more.

so.text: 35.Waxay ku leeyihiin 'Jannada' gudaheeda waxay doonaan - waxaana u heynaa weliba wax intaa ka badan [4].
so.footnotes: [4]. Waa raalli ahaansho dhan ee xagga Alle ah iyo eegidda Wejigiisa Sharafta Badan.

ayat.arabic: وَكَمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَا قَبۡلَهُم مِّن قَرۡنٍ هُمۡ أَشَدُّ مِنۡهُم بَطۡشٗا فَنَقَّبُواْ فِي ٱلۡبِلَٰدِ هَلۡ مِن مَّحِيصٍ

en.text: And how many a generation before them did We destroy who were greater than them in [striking] power and had explored throughout the lands. Is there any place of escape?

so.text: 36. Badanaa inta fac aan halaagnay iyaga hortood, kuwaasoo ahaa kuwo ka xoog badan oo dhulalka xulay. Ma jirto meel (Alle) laga magan galo oo looga cararo.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكۡرَىٰ لِمَن كَانَ لَهُۥ قَلۡبٌ أَوۡ أَلۡقَى ٱلسَّمۡعَ وَهُوَ شَهِيدٞ

en.text: Indeed in that is a reminder for whoever has a heart or who listens while he is present [in mind].

so.text: 37. Arrinkani waxaa hubaal ugu sugan waano kan qalbi leh ama maqalka raariciya isagoo baraarugsan.

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٖ وَمَا مَسَّنَا مِن لُّغُوبٖ

en.text: And We did certainly create the heavens and earth and what is between them in six days, and there touched Us no weariness.

so.text: 38. Waxaanu dhab ahaan ku abuurnay samooyinka iyo arlada iyo waxa u dhexeeya lix maalmood namana soo gaarin wax daal ah.

ayat.arabic: فَٱصۡبِرۡ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ قَبۡلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمۡسِ وَقَبۡلَ ٱلۡغُرُوبِ

en.text: So be patient, [O Muḥammad], over what they say and exalt [Allāh] with praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting,

so.text: 39. Ee u samir waxay leeyihiin, kuna tasbiixso Ammaanaha Rabbigaa ka hor qorrax soo baxa iyo ka hor intaanay dhicin.

ayat.arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيۡلِ فَسَبِّحۡهُ وَأَدۡبَٰرَ ٱلسُّجُودِ

en.text: And [in part] of the night exalt Him and after prostration [i.e., prayer].

so.text: 40. Habeenka in ka mid ahna ku tasbiixso Ammaanahiisa iyo salaadaha ka dambow.

ayat.arabic: وَٱسۡتَمِعۡ يَوۡمَ يُنَادِ ٱلۡمُنَادِ مِن مَّكَانٖ قَرِيبٖ

en.text: And listen on the Day when the Caller[1532] will call out from a place that is near -
en.footnotes: [1532] An angel who will call out Allāh's command for the Resurrection.

so.text: 41. Dhageyso Maalinka markuu dhawaaquhu ka dhawaaqi meel dhow.

ayat.arabic: يَوۡمَ يَسۡمَعُونَ ٱلصَّيۡحَةَ بِٱلۡحَقِّۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوۡمُ ٱلۡخُرُوجِ

en.text: The Day they will hear the blast [of the Horn] in truth. That is the Day of Emergence [from the graves].

so.text: 42. Maalinka ay maqli qaylo Xaq ah, kaasu waa Maalinka soo bixinta (Qiyaame).

ayat.arabic: إِنَّا نَحۡنُ نُحۡيِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَإِلَيۡنَا ٱلۡمَصِيرُ

en.text: Indeed, it is We who give life and cause death, and to Us is the destination

so.text: 43. Annagaa (Alle ah) xaqiiq wax nooleyna waxna dhinsiinna; waana Xaggayaga meel noqodka dambe (Aakhirada).

ayat.arabic: يَوۡمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ عَنۡهُمۡ سِرَاعٗاۚ ذَٰلِكَ حَشۡرٌ عَلَيۡنَا يَسِيرٞ

en.text: On the Day the earth breaks away from them [and they emerge] rapidly; that is a gathering easy for Us.

so.text: 44. Maalinta uu dhulku ka dillaaci gaballo hoostooda, markaasay dhaqso ku soo bixi, kaasu waa soo kulmin noo fudud.

ayat.arabic: نَّحۡنُ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيۡهِم بِجَبَّارٖۖ فَذَكِّرۡ بِٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ مَن يَخَافُ وَعِيدِ

en.text: We are most knowing of what they say, and you are not over them a tyrant.[1533] But remind by the Qur’ān whoever fears My threat.
en.footnotes: [1533] Forcing people to belief or submission.

so.text: 45. Annagaa ogsoon waxay (gaaladu) leeyihiin; adiguna ma ahid mid qasab ku leh. Ee ku waani Qur’aanka kan ka cabsada Gooddigayga.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلذَّٰرِيَٰتِ ذَرۡوٗا

en.text: By the [winds] scattering [dust], dispersing [it]

so.text: 1. Waxaan ku dhaartay (dabeylaha) boorka kiciya [1].
so.footnotes: [1]. Ad-Daariyaat: Dabeylaha boorka kiciya.

ayat.arabic: فَٱلۡحَٰمِلَٰتِ وِقۡرٗا

en.text: And the [clouds] carrying a load [of water]

so.text: 2. Iyo (duruuraha) xambaarsan culayska (roobka).

ayat.arabic: فَٱلۡجَٰرِيَٰتِ يُسۡرٗا

en.text: And the ships sailing with ease

so.text: 3. Iyo doonyaha sida fudud ugu socda (badaha).

ayat.arabic: فَٱلۡمُقَسِّمَٰتِ أَمۡرًا

en.text: And the [angels] apportioning [each] matter,

so.text: 4. Iyo kuwaa (malaa’igta) ku qaybiya (risiqa, roobka, iwm) Amarkeenna.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَصَادِقٞ

en.text: Indeed, what you are promised is true.

so.text: 5. (Dadow) waxa la idiinku gooddin (Qiyaamada, Xisaabta) xaqiiq waa run.

ayat.arabic: وَإِنَّ ٱلدِّينَ لَوَٰقِعٞ

en.text: And indeed, the recompense is to occur.

so.text: 6. Abaalmarintuna (jaazeynta Aakhiro) waa la hubaa inay dhaceyso.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلۡحُبُكِ

en.text: By the heaven containing pathways,[1535]
en.footnotes: [1535] Explained as tracks, layers or orbits.

so.text: 7. Waxaan kaloo (waa Alle'e) ku dhaartay samada quruxda iyo waddooyinka leh,

ayat.arabic: إِنَّكُمۡ لَفِي قَوۡلٖ مُّخۡتَلِفٖ

en.text: Indeed, you are in differing speech.[1536]
en.footnotes: [1536] About Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ) and the Qur’ān.

so.text: 8. Waxaad idinku (dadow) kaga sugan tihiin (Nabiga iyo Qur’aanka) hadal kala duwan .

ayat.arabic: يُؤۡفَكُ عَنۡهُ مَنۡ أُفِكَ

en.text: Deluded away from it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is he who is deluded.

so.text: 9. Waxaa laga duwaa (Qur’aanka iyo Nabiga) kan isaga iska duwa.

ayat.arabic: قُتِلَ ٱلۡخَرَّٰصُونَ

en.text: Destroyed are the misinformers[1537]
en.footnotes: [1537] Or "May they be destroyed" or "cursed."

so.text: 10. Nacladi ha ku dhacdo beenalayaasha mala awaalka badan.

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ فِي غَمۡرَةٖ سَاهُونَ

en.text: Who are within a flood [of confusion] and heedless.

so.text: 11. Kuwa ku sugan guluf (colaadeed) ee iyagu maahsan (ka maahsan Aakhirada).

ayat.arabic: يَسۡـَٔلُونَ أَيَّانَ يَوۡمُ ٱلدِّينِ

en.text: They ask, "When is the Day of Recompense?"

so.text: 12. Waxay weydiin: Waa goorma Maalinta Abaal marintu (Jaazeyntu)?

ayat.arabic: يَوۡمَ هُمۡ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ يُفۡتَنُونَ

en.text: [It is] the Day they will be tormented over the Fire

so.text: 13. Waa Maalinta Naarta lagu gubi.

ayat.arabic: ذُوقُواْ فِتۡنَتَكُمۡ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَسۡتَعۡجِلُونَ

en.text: [And will be told], "Taste your torment. This is that for which you were impatient."

so.text: 14. Dhadhamiya cadaabkiinna. Kanu waa waxaad degdegsanayseen.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّٰتٖ وَعُيُونٍ

en.text: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and springs,

so.text: 15. Hubaal kuwa ka dhowrsada xumaha waxay ku sugnaan beero iyo ilo (Janno).

ayat.arabic: ءَاخِذِينَ مَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡۚ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ قَبۡلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُحۡسِنِينَ

en.text: Accepting what their Lord has given them. Indeed, they were before that doers of good.

so.text: 16. Iyagoo qaadan waxa uu Rabbigood siiyey. Waxay ahaayeen horay sama falayaal.

ayat.arabic: كَانُواْ قَلِيلٗا مِّنَ ٱلَّيۡلِ مَا يَهۡجَعُونَ

en.text: They used to sleep but little of the night,[1538]
en.footnotes: [1538] i.e., spending a portion of the night in prayer and supplication.

so.text: 17. Waxay seexan jireen habeenkii wax yar ma ahee [2].
so.footnotes: [2]. Macnaha qayb ka mid ah bay u qoondeyn jireen salaatu leyl, cishaha kaddib ama Aakhiru leylka.

ayat.arabic: وَبِٱلۡأَسۡحَارِ هُمۡ يَسۡتَغۡفِرُونَ

en.text: And in the hours before dawn they would ask forgiveness,

so.text: 18. Waqtiyada suxuurtana way denbi dhaaf weydiisanayeen,

ayat.arabic: وَفِيٓ أَمۡوَٰلِهِمۡ حَقّٞ لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلۡمَحۡرُومِ

en.text: And from their properties was [given] the right of the [needy] petitioner and the deprived.

so.text: 19. Maalkooda waxaa ahaa qayb uu ku leeyahay weydiistaha iyo kaan wax heysan.

ayat.arabic: وَفِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ ءَايَٰتٞ لِّلۡمُوقِنِينَ

en.text: And on the earth are signs for the certain [in faith]

so.text: 20. Dhulka waxaa ugu sugan calaamooyin kuwa yaqiinsan.

ayat.arabic: وَفِيٓ أَنفُسِكُمۡۚ أَفَلَا تُبۡصِرُونَ

en.text: And in yourselves. Then will you not see?

so.text: 21. Iyo nafahiinnaba, ee miyeydaan arkeyn.

ayat.arabic: وَفِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ رِزۡقُكُمۡ وَمَا تُوعَدُونَ

en.text: And in the heaven is your provision and whatever you are promised.

so.text: 22. Samada yuuna jiraa risiqiinna iyo waxa la idiin yaboohay.

ayat.arabic: فَوَرَبِّ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ إِنَّهُۥ لَحَقّٞ مِّثۡلَ مَآ أَنَّكُمۡ تَنطِقُونَ

en.text: Then by the Lord of the heaven and earth, indeed, it is truth - just as [sure as] it is that you are speaking.

so.text: 23. Rabbiga samada iyo arlada yaan ku dhaarane, soo bixinta (Qiyaame iyo in risiqiinnu jiro samada) Xaq weeye, sidaad u hadashaanba.

ayat.arabic: هَلۡ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ضَيۡفِ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ ٱلۡمُكۡرَمِينَ

en.text: Has there reached you the story of the honored guests of Abraham?[1539] -
en.footnotes: [1539] Who were angels given honored positions by Allāh.

so.text: 24. Ma ku soo gaaray warka martidii Ibraahiim ee sharafta lahayd?

ayat.arabic: إِذۡ دَخَلُواْ عَلَيۡهِ فَقَالُواْ سَلَٰمٗاۖ قَالَ سَلَٰمٞ قَوۡمٞ مُّنكَرُونَ

en.text: When they entered upon him and said, "[We greet you with] peace." He answered, "[And upon you] peace; [you are] a people unknown."

so.text: 25. Markay u soo galeen oo yidhaahdeen: nabad ahow, wuxuu yidhi: nabad ahaada. (waxaad tihiin) qolo aan la garaneyn.

ayat.arabic: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِهِۦ فَجَآءَ بِعِجۡلٖ سَمِينٖ

en.text: Then he went to his family and came with a fat [roasted] calf.

so.text: 26. Markaasuu u laabtay dhinac xagga reerkiisii oo keenay dibi buuran oo shiilan.

ayat.arabic: فَقَرَّبَهُۥٓ إِلَيۡهِمۡ قَالَ أَلَا تَأۡكُلُونَ

en.text: And placed it near them; he said, "Will you not eat?"

so.text: 27. Una soo dhoweeyey (isagoo ku leh): Miyeydaan cunayn?

ayat.arabic: فَأَوۡجَسَ مِنۡهُمۡ خِيفَةٗۖ قَالُواْ لَا تَخَفۡۖ وَبَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلَٰمٍ عَلِيمٖ

en.text: And he felt from them apprehension.[1540] They said, "Fear not," and gave him good tidings of a learned boy.
en.footnotes: [1540] See footnote to 11:70.

so.text: 28. (Waxbase ma ay cunin) markaas baa waxaa ka galay dareen cabsi ah. Waxay (malaa’igtii) yidhaahdeen: Ha cabsan,  waxayna ugu bishaareeyeen wiil aqoon leh (isxaaq).

ayat.arabic: فَأَقۡبَلَتِ ٱمۡرَأَتُهُۥ فِي صَرَّةٖ فَصَكَّتۡ وَجۡهَهَا وَقَالَتۡ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمٞ

en.text: And his wife approached with a cry [of alarm] and struck her face and said, "[I am] a barren old woman!"

so.text: 29. Markaasay soo qaabishay marwadiisii iyadoo qaylyi, oo iska dharbaaxday wejiga iyadoo yaabban, oo tidhi: Ma habar ma dhasho ah oo duqowday (yaa wax dhali)!.

ayat.arabic: قَالُواْ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ

en.text: They said, "Thus has said your Lord; indeed, He is the Wise, the Knowing."

so.text: 30. Waxay (malaa’igtii) yidhaahdeen: Sidaasuu yidhi Rabbigaa. Waa Isaga Xakiimka, Wax kasta Ogsoon.

ayat.arabic: ۞ قَالَ فَمَا خَطۡبُكُمۡ أَيُّهَا ٱلۡمُرۡسَلُونَ

en.text: [Abraham] said, "Then what is your business [here], O messengers?"

so.text: 31.(Ibraahiim) wuxuu yidhi: Muxuu xaalkiin- nu yahay kuwayahow la soo diray?

ayat.arabic: قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّآ أُرۡسِلۡنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوۡمٖ مُّجۡرِمِينَ

en.text: They said, "Indeed, we have been sent to a people of criminals[1541]
en.footnotes: [1541] i.e., those who defied Lot (upon him be peace).

so.text: 32.Waxay (malaa’igtii) yidhaahdeen: Waxaa naloo soo diray qolo denbiilayaal ah [3].
so.footnotes: [3]. Waa kuwaasi beeniyey Luud.

ayat.arabic: لِنُرۡسِلَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ حِجَارَةٗ مِّن طِينٖ

en.text: To send down upon them stones of clay,

so.text: 33. Si aan ugu soo dirno korkooda dhagaxyo dhoobo kulul ah.

ayat.arabic: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلۡمُسۡرِفِينَ

en.text: Marked in the presence of your Lord for the transgressors."

so.text: 34. Looga soo calaameeyey xagga Rabbigaa xadgudbayaasha [4].
so.footnotes: [4]. Iyadoo dhagax walba lagu qoray magaca qofka lagu halaagayo oo ku dhiman.

ayat.arabic: فَأَخۡرَجۡنَا مَن كَانَ فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ

en.text: So We brought out whoever was in them [i.e., the cities] of the believers.

so.text: 35. Markaasaan ka soo bixinnay halkaa wixii ku jiray ee mu’miniin ah.

ayat.arabic: فَمَا وَجَدۡنَا فِيهَا غَيۡرَ بَيۡتٖ مِّنَ ٱلۡمُسۡلِمِينَ

en.text: And We found not within them other than a [single] house of Muslims.[1542]
en.footnotes: [1542] i.e., Lot and his family, excepting his wife.

so.text: 36. Kamase aanu helin gudaheeda (magaaladaa) wax aan aheyn hal guri oo muslimiin ah [5].
so.footnotes: [5]. Luud iyo reerkiisa marka laga reebo xaaskiisa.

ayat.arabic: وَتَرَكۡنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَةٗ لِّلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ ٱلۡعَذَابَ ٱلۡأَلِيمَ

en.text: And We left therein a sign for those who fear the painful punishment.

so.text: 37. Waxaan uga tagnay halkaa (magaalooyinkii Sodom iyo Gammurah ee dadkii Luud) Calaamo [6] kuwa 'mu'miniinta' ka cabsada cadaabka xanuunka badan.
so.footnotes: [6]. Raad muujinaya halaaggii ku dhacay qolodii Luud.

ayat.arabic: وَفِي مُوسَىٰٓ إِذۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَٰهُ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ بِسُلۡطَٰنٖ مُّبِينٖ

en.text: And in Moses [was a sign], when We sent him to Pharaoh with clear authority.[1543]
en.footnotes: [1543] i.e., evidences.

so.text: 38. Muuse (calaamad baa ku sugan), markaan u dirnay Fircoon isagoo wata Xujo Cad.

ayat.arabic: فَتَوَلَّىٰ بِرُكۡنِهِۦ وَقَالَ سَٰحِرٌ أَوۡ مَجۡنُونٞ

en.text: But he turned away with his supporters and said, "A magician or a madman."

so.text: 39. Wuuse jeestay (Fircoon) isagoo ay la jiraan ciidammadiisii oo yidhi: 'Kani Muuse' waa saaxir ama jinnoole.

ayat.arabic: فَأَخَذۡنَٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذۡنَٰهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٞ

en.text: So We took him and his soldiers and cast them into the sea, and he was blameworthy.

so.text: 40. Markaasaan qabannay isaga (Fircoon) iyo askartiisiiba oo xoog ugu tuurnay badda isagoo eedeysan.

ayat.arabic: وَفِي عَادٍ إِذۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلرِّيحَ ٱلۡعَقِيمَ

en.text: And in ʿAad [was a sign], when We sent against them the barren wind.[1544]
en.footnotes: [1544] Barren of any benefit, i.e., evil.

so.text: 41. Reer Caadna (waxaa ku sugan calaamo lagu waano qaato) markaan ku dirnay dabeyl ma dhaleys ah [7].
so.footnotes: [7]. Aan dhalin wax faa’ido ah, khayr daran, macnaha waa shar xambaarsan.

ayat.arabic: مَا تَذَرُ مِن شَيۡءٍ أَتَتۡ عَلَيۡهِ إِلَّا جَعَلَتۡهُ كَٱلرَّمِيمِ

en.text: It left nothing of what it came upon but that it made it like disintegrated ruins.

so.text:
42. Wax kama tegin ay ku timid inay ka
dhigtay maahee digada oo kale.

ayat.arabic: وَفِي ثَمُودَ إِذۡ قِيلَ لَهُمۡ تَمَتَّعُواْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٖ

en.text: And in Thamūd, when it was said to them, "Enjoy yourselves for a time."

so.text: 43. Reer Thamuudna (calaamo baa ku sugan lagu waano qaato), markii lagu yidhi: Raaxeysta in muddo yar ah.

ayat.arabic: فَعَتَوۡاْ عَنۡ أَمۡرِ رَبِّهِمۡ فَأَخَذَتۡهُمُ ٱلصَّٰعِقَةُ وَهُمۡ يَنظُرُونَ

en.text: But they were insolent toward the command of their Lord, so the thunderbolt seized them while they were looking on.

so.text: 44. Waxayse ka madax adeygeen Amarka Rabbigood, markaasaa waxaa qabtay danab xoog leh iyagoo arkayey.

ayat.arabic: فَمَا ٱسۡتَطَٰعُواْ مِن قِيَامٖ وَمَا كَانُواْ مُنتَصِرِينَ

en.text: And they were unable to arise, nor could they defend themselves.

so.text: 45. Sidaa darteed waa awoodi waayeen inay soo kacaan, isumana gargaari karin.

ayat.arabic: وَقَوۡمَ نُوحٖ مِّن قَبۡلُۖ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ قَوۡمٗا فَٰسِقِينَ

en.text: And [We destroyed] the people of Noah before; indeed, they were a people defiantly disobedient.

so.text: 46. Qolodii Nuuxna iyaga hortood (waxaa ku sugan calaamo lagu waano qaato), waxay ahaayeen qolo fallaago ah.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ بَنَيۡنَٰهَا بِأَيۡيْدٖ وَإِنَّا لَمُوسِعُونَ

en.text: And the heaven We constructed with strength,[1545] and indeed, We are [its] expander.
en.footnotes: [1545] Literally, "hands."

so.text: 47. Samada waxaan ku dhisnay awood Oo waa Annaga (Alle  ah) kuwa waasiciya.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ فَرَشۡنَٰهَا فَنِعۡمَ ٱلۡمَٰهِدُونَ

en.text: And the earth We have spread out, and excellent is the preparer.

so.text: 48. Oo dhulka Waanu gogolnay, Ee fiicanaa diyaariyuhu.

ayat.arabic: وَمِن كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ خَلَقۡنَا زَوۡجَيۡنِ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَذَكَّرُونَ

en.text: And of all things We created two mates [i.e., counterparts]; perhaps you will remember.

so.text: 49. Wax walbana Waxaan ka abuurnay labo nooc, si aad ugu waano qaadataan.

ayat.arabic: فَفِرُّوٓاْ إِلَى ٱللَّهِۖ إِنِّي لَكُم مِّنۡهُ نَذِيرٞ مُّبِينٞ

en.text: So flee to Allāh.[1546] Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner.
en.footnotes: [1546] i.e., turn to Allāh and take refuge in Him from disbelief and sin, thereby escaping His punishment.

so.text: 50. Ee u carara xagga Alle [8], waxaan idiin ahay dige cad ka yimid Xaggiisa.
so.footnotes: [8]. Waxaa loola jeedaa u laabta oo ka magan gala gaalnimo iyo denbi falid si aad uga badbaaddaan ciqaabkiisa.

ayat.arabic: وَلَا تَجۡعَلُواْ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَۖ إِنِّي لَكُم مِّنۡهُ نَذِيرٞ مُّبِينٞ

en.text: And do not make [as equal] with Allāh another deity. Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner.

so.text: 51. Ha u yeelina la jirka Alle Ilaah kale. Waxaan idiin ahay dige cad ka yimid Xaggiisa.

ayat.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَتَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا قَالُواْ سَاحِرٌ أَوۡ مَجۡنُونٌ

en.text: Similarly, there came not to those before them any messenger except that they said, "A magician or a madman."

so.text: 52. Waa sidaase, ma jiro Rasuul u yimid kuwii iyaga ka horreeyey oo aysan odhan: waa saaxir, ama jinnoole.

ayat.arabic: أَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِهِۦۚ بَلۡ هُمۡ قَوۡمٞ طَاغُونَ

en.text: Did they suggest it to them?[1547] Rather, they [themselves] are a transgressing people.
en.footnotes: [1547] i.e., Did the former disbelievers pass on these words to the Makkans so that they repeat the same expressions?

so.text: 53. Miyey iskula dardaarmeen arrinkani [9]? Mayee’ waa qolo xadgudub badan.
so.footnotes: [9]. Miyey gaaladii beri hore u soo gudbiyeen hadalladan kuwaan hadda jira, sidaa darteed ay u yidhaahdeen isla hadalkoodii oo kale?.

ayat.arabic: فَتَوَلَّ عَنۡهُمۡ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِمَلُومٖ

en.text: So leave them, [O Muḥammad], for you are not to be blamed.

so.text: 54. Ee iskaga jeeso, kaama saarna eede.

ayat.arabic: وَذَكِّرۡ فَإِنَّ ٱلذِّكۡرَىٰ تَنفَعُ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ

en.text: And remind, for indeed, the reminder benefits the believers.

so.text: 55. Waani, waanadu waxay anfici mu’miniinta.

ayat.arabic: وَمَا خَلَقۡتُ ٱلۡجِنَّ وَٱلۡإِنسَ إِلَّا لِيَعۡبُدُونِ

en.text: And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me.

so.text: 56. Uma aan abuurin jinka iyo insiga waxaan ahayn inay i caabudaan [10].
so.footnotes: [10]. Macnaha Alle Keliya caabudaan iyagoon cidna wax la wadaajin.

ayat.arabic: مَآ أُرِيدُ مِنۡهُم مِّن رِّزۡقٖ وَمَآ أُرِيدُ أَن يُطۡعِمُونِ

en.text: I do not want from them any provision, nor do I want them to feed Me.

so.text: 57. Kama doonayo wax risiq ah, kamana doonayo inay quudiyaan (uunkayga).

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلرَّزَّاقُ ذُو ٱلۡقُوَّةِ ٱلۡمَتِينُ

en.text: Indeed, it is Allāh who is the [continual] Provider,[1548] the firm possessor of strength.
en.footnotes: [1548] Providing everything required by His creations during their decreed existence. His provision includes guidance.

so.text: 58. Hubaal waa Allaah Irsaaqaha, Rabbiga iska leh Awoodda sare, Xoogga Badan.

ayat.arabic: فَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ ذَنُوبٗا مِّثۡلَ ذَنُوبِ أَصۡحَٰبِهِمۡ فَلَا يَسۡتَعۡجِلُونِ

en.text: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a portion [of punishment] like the portion of their companions [i.e., predecessors], so let them not impatiently urge Me.

so.text: 59. Xaqiiq kuwa fala dulmiga (shirkiga iyo macaasida) waxaa u sugnaaday saami 'Cadaab ah' la mid ah saamigii asxaabtood, ee waxba yey dalbin in aan u soo dedejiyo (cadaabka).

ayat.arabic: فَوَيۡلٞ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِن يَوۡمِهِمُ ٱلَّذِي يُوعَدُونَ

en.text: And woe to those who have disbelieved from their Day which they are promised.

so.text: 60. Hoog waxaa leh kuwa gaalooba, kaasoo ku iman Maalinkoodaasi loogu gooddiyey (Maalinta Qiyaamaha).

ayat.arabic: وَٱلطُّورِ

en.text: By the mount

so.text: 1. Waxaan ku dhaartay Buurta 'Siinaay' [1].
so.footnotes: [1]. Ad-Duur: Buurta, waxaa loola jeedaa Buurtii uu Alle kula hadlay Nabi Muuse c.s.

ayat.arabic: وَكِتَٰبٖ مَّسۡطُورٖ

en.text: And [by] a Book inscribed[1550]
en.footnotes: [1550] Interpreted as the Preserved Slate or possibly the Qur’ān.

so.text: 2. Iyo Kitaab qoran [2].
so.footnotes: [2]. Waxaa lagu fasiray Looxa Maxfuudka, ama Qur’aanka.

ayat.arabic: فِي رَقّٖ مَّنشُورٖ

en.text: In parchment spread open

so.text: 3. Ku qoran xaashiyo (maqaar ido khafiif ah) fidsan oo furan.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلۡبَيۡتِ ٱلۡمَعۡمُورِ

en.text: And [by] the frequented House[1551]
en.footnotes: [1551] The house of worship for the angels in the seventh heaven, comparable to the Kaʿbah on earth.

so.text: 4. Iyo Guriga (Kacbada) la siyaarto [3].
so.footnotes: [3]. Waa Beytka Alle ay ku caabudaan malaa’igta ee ku yaal samada toddobaad, abbaarta Kacbada ama Kacbada Makkah.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلسَّقۡفِ ٱلۡمَرۡفُوعِ

en.text: And [by] the ceiling [i.e., heaven] raised high

so.text: 5. Iyo saqafka la kor yeelay (samada).

ayat.arabic: وَٱلۡبَحۡرِ ٱلۡمَسۡجُورِ

en.text: And [by] the sea set on fire,[1552]
en.footnotes: [1552] On the Day of Resurrection. Or "the sea which has overflowed."

so.text: 6. Iyo badda lagu huriyey 'dabka ama soo fatahda' [4].
so.footnotes: [4]. Badahoo sidaas noqon Maalinta Qiyaamaha.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ لَوَٰقِعٞ

en.text: Indeed, the punishment of your Lord will occur.

so.text: 7. Hubaal, cadaabka Rabbigaa waa wax dhici oo sugan -

ayat.arabic: مَّا لَهُۥ مِن دَافِعٖ

en.text: Of it there is no preventer.

so.text: 8. Ma jiro wax celin.

ayat.arabic: يَوۡمَ تَمُورُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ مَوۡرٗا

en.text: On the Day the heaven will sway with circular motion

so.text: 9. Maalinta markuu cirku hadba dhinac u wareegi,

ayat.arabic: وَتَسِيرُ ٱلۡجِبَالُ سَيۡرٗا

en.text: And the mountains will pass on, departing[1553] -
en.footnotes: [1553] Becoming dust and moving as clouds.

so.text: 10. Buuruhuna socon socosho (yaab) leh [5].
so.footnotes: [5]. Oo noqon sida boor oo u socon sida daruuraha.

ayat.arabic: فَوَيۡلٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ

en.text: Then woe, that Day, to the deniers,

so.text: 11. Hoog waxaa leh Maalinkaas kuwa (Xaqa) beeniya (ee nabad diidka ah).

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ فِي خَوۡضٖ يَلۡعَبُونَ

en.text: Who are in [empty] discourse amusing themselves.

so.text: 12. Kuwa iska cayaara ee dhex gala xumaanta.

ayat.arabic: يَوۡمَ يُدَعُّونَ إِلَىٰ نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّا

en.text: The Day they are thrust toward the fire of Hell with a [violent] thrust, [its angels will say],

so.text: 13. Maalinka loogu tuuri Naarta Jahannama si daran oo xoog leh (waxaa lagu dhihi):

ayat.arabic: هَٰذِهِ ٱلنَّارُ ٱلَّتِي كُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ

en.text: "This is the Fire which you used to deny.

so.text: 14. Waa tan Naartii aad beenin jirteen.

ayat.arabic: أَفَسِحۡرٌ هَٰذَآ أَمۡ أَنتُمۡ لَا تُبۡصِرُونَ

en.text: Then is this magic, or do you not see?

so.text: 15. Ma sixir baa (cadaabkani), mise wax ma aragtaan?

ayat.arabic: ٱصۡلَوۡهَا فَٱصۡبِرُوٓاْ أَوۡ لَا تَصۡبِرُواْ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيۡكُمۡۖ إِنَّمَا تُجۡزَوۡنَ مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ

en.text: [Enter to] burn therein; then be patient or impatient - it is all the same for you. You are only being recompensed [for] what you used to do."

so.text: 16. Gala, markaa ku samra ama ha ku samrina - waa isugu kiin mid, Waxaa uun laydinka goyn waxaad fali jirteen (oo xumaan ah).

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّٰتٖ وَنَعِيمٖ

en.text: Indeed, the righteous will be in gardens and pleasure,

so.text: 17. Kuwa ka dhowrsada xumaha [6] waxay dhex ahaan beero iyo barwaaqo (Janno).
so.footnotes: [6]. Sida shirkiga, dilka gardarrada ah, zinada, ribada, xasadka, xatooyada, sixirka, beenta, khiyaanada, kibirka, iwm.

ayat.arabic: فَٰكِهِينَ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ وَوَقَىٰهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ عَذَابَ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ

en.text: Enjoying what their Lord has given them, and their Lord protected them from the punishment of Hellfire.

so.text: 18. Iyagoo ku raaxeysan wuxuu siiyey Rabbigood, Wuxuuna ka badbaadshay Rabbigood cadaabka Naarta ololka badan.

ayat.arabic: كُلُواْ وَٱشۡرَبُواْ هَنِيٓـَٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ

en.text: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do."

so.text: 19. (Waxaa lagu odhan): Cuna oo cabba si bogaadin leh. Waa abaalka waxaad fali jirteen (oo wanaag ah).

ayat.arabic: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ سُرُرٖ مَّصۡفُوفَةٖۖ وَزَوَّجۡنَٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٖ

en.text: They will be reclining on thrones lined up, and We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes.

so.text: 20. Waxay ku dangiigsan sariiro heer sare ahoo la safay. Waxaanna u guurin dumar leh indho waasic ahoo (qurux badan).

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَٱتَّبَعَتۡهُمۡ ذُرِّيَّتُهُم بِإِيمَٰنٍ أَلۡحَقۡنَا بِهِمۡ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمۡ وَمَآ أَلَتۡنَٰهُم مِّنۡ عَمَلِهِم مِّن شَيۡءٖۚ كُلُّ ٱمۡرِيِٕۭ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَهِينٞ

en.text: And those who believed and whose descendants followed them in faith - We will join with them their descendants, and We will not deprive them of anything of their deeds.[1554] Every person, for what he earned, is retained.[1555]
en.footnotes:
[1554] i.e., the reward thereof.
[1555] i.e., subject or held responsible. Literally, "a hostage."
