so.text: 21. Kuwa (Xaqa) rumeeyey oo ay durriyadoodu ku raacdo Iimaanka - waxaanu isu wada keeni iyaga iyo durriyadooda, waxnana kama nusqaaminayno camalkooda. Qof walbaa wuxuu  mudan (curaar u yahay) camalkiisa.

ayat.arabic: وَأَمۡدَدۡنَٰهُم بِفَٰكِهَةٖ وَلَحۡمٖ مِّمَّا يَشۡتَهُونَ

en.text: And We will provide them with fruit and meat from whatever they desire.

so.text: 22. Waxaannu siin midho iyo hilib waxay rabaan.

ayat.arabic: يَتَنَٰزَعُونَ فِيهَا كَأۡسٗا لَّا لَغۡوٞ فِيهَا وَلَا تَأۡثِيمٞ

en.text: They will exchange with one another a cup [of wine] wherein [results] no ill speech or commission of sin.

so.text: 23. Waxay isu dhiib-dhiibi galaas (khamro xalaal) ah aan lahayn wax ah laqwi iyo dambaabid.

ayat.arabic: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ غِلۡمَانٞ لَّهُمۡ كَأَنَّهُمۡ لُؤۡلُؤٞ مَّكۡنُونٞ

en.text: There will circulate among them [servant] boys [especially] for them, as if they were pearls well-protected.

so.text: 24. Waxaa u adeegi wiilal yar yar ay leeyihiin, la moodo luul la dhowray.

ayat.arabic: وَأَقۡبَلَ بَعۡضُهُمۡ عَلَىٰ بَعۡضٖ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ

en.text: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other.

so.text: 25. Qaarkood (ehlu Jannaha) waxay qaabili qaar kale iyagoo is-wareysan.

ayat.arabic: قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا كُنَّا قَبۡلُ فِيٓ أَهۡلِنَا مُشۡفِقِينَ

en.text: They will say, "Indeed, we were previously among our people fearful [of displeasing Allāh].

so.text: 26. Waxay odhan: Waxaan ka hor 'intaan adduunka joognay' ahayn kuwo ehelkayaga dhexdooda ka cabsada (cadaabka Alle).

ayat.arabic: فَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡنَا وَوَقَىٰنَا عَذَابَ ٱلسَّمُومِ

en.text: So Allāh conferred favor upon us and protected us from the punishment of the Scorching Fire.

so.text: 27. Markaasuu Alle nagu manneystay (denbi dhaaf) oo naga dhowray cadaabka hanfiga kulul.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّا كُنَّا مِن قَبۡلُ نَدۡعُوهُۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡبَرُّ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

en.text: Indeed, we used to supplicate[1556] Him before. Indeed, it is He who is the Beneficent, the Merciful."
en.footnotes: [1556] i.e., worship.

so.text: 28. Waxaan ahayn horey kuwa barya Alle (Keliya).Waa Isaga xaqiiq Baarriga, Naxariista Badan.

ayat.arabic: فَذَكِّرۡ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِنِعۡمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنٖ وَلَا مَجۡنُونٍ

en.text: So remind, [O Muḥammad], for you are not, by the favor of your Lord, a soothsayer or a madman.

so.text: 29. Ee waani (Nabi Muxammadow), Waayo adigu ma tihid waa igu Nicmadda Rabbigaa, faallalow iyo jinnoole midna.

ayat.arabic: أَمۡ يَقُولُونَ شَاعِرٞ نَّتَرَبَّصُ بِهِۦ رَيۡبَ ٱلۡمَنُونِ

en.text: Or do they say [of you], "A poet for whom we await a misfortune of time"?[1557]
en.footnotes: [1557] i.e., some accident or inevitable death.

so.text: 30. Mise waxay leeyihiin waa gabyaa, aan la sugno musiibo waqtiga la iman [7].
so.footnotes: [7]. Inay dhibaato uun ku dhacdo ama dhimasho dhaqso ah.

ayat.arabic: قُلۡ تَرَبَّصُواْ فَإِنِّي مَعَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡمُتَرَبِّصِينَ

en.text: Say, "Wait, for indeed I am, with you, among the waiters."

so.text: 31. Dheh: Suga (geeridayda)! Aniguna waxaan sugi (waxa idinku dhaca).

ayat.arabic: أَمۡ تَأۡمُرُهُمۡ أَحۡلَٰمُهُم بِهَٰذَآۚ أَمۡ هُمۡ قَوۡمٞ طَاغُونَ

en.text: Or do their minds[1558] command them to [say] this, or are they a transgressing people?
en.footnotes: [1558] In this expression is also a subtle allusion to the leaders of the Quraysh, who considered themselves to be great minds.

so.text: 32. Ma caqliyadooda (xun) baa ku amra sidaa (inay kaa been sheegaan Nabiyow), ma aha ee waa qolo xadgudub badan.

ayat.arabic: أَمۡ يَقُولُونَ تَقَوَّلَهُۥۚ بَل لَّا يُؤۡمِنُونَ

en.text: Or do they say, "He has made it up"? Rather, they do not believe.

so.text: 33. Mise waxay leeyihiin: Waa been abuurtay (Qur’aanka)? Mayee! Ma rumeysna (Xaqa).

ayat.arabic: فَلۡيَأۡتُواْ بِحَدِيثٖ مِّثۡلِهِۦٓ إِن كَانُواْ صَٰدِقِينَ

en.text: Then let them produce a statement like it, if they should be truthful.

so.text: 34. Ee ha keenaan hadal la mid ahi (Qur’aankani) hadday run sheegayaan.

ayat.arabic: أَمۡ خُلِقُواْ مِنۡ غَيۡرِ شَيۡءٍ أَمۡ هُمُ ٱلۡخَٰلِقُونَ

en.text: Or were they created by nothing, or were they the creators [of themselves]?

so.text: 35. Mise waxaa la abuuray abuure la'aan, mise iyagaa abuuray nafahooda?.

ayat.arabic: أَمۡ خَلَقُواْ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَۚ بَل لَّا يُوقِنُونَ

en.text: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Rather, they are not certain.

so.text: 36. Mise waxay abuureen samooyinka iyo arlada? Mayee, ma yaqiinsana.

ayat.arabic: أَمۡ عِندَهُمۡ خَزَآئِنُ رَبِّكَ أَمۡ هُمُ ٱلۡمُصَۜيۡطِرُونَ

en.text: Or have they the depositories [containing the provision] of your Lord? Or are they the controllers [of them]?

so.text: 37. Mise waxay hayaan khasnadaha Rabbigaa? Mise waxaa la siiyey awood dhan (mayee waa kuwo tabar daran, liita)?

ayat.arabic: أَمۡ لَهُمۡ سُلَّمٞ يَسۡتَمِعُونَ فِيهِۖ فَلۡيَأۡتِ مُسۡتَمِعُهُم بِسُلۡطَٰنٖ مُّبِينٍ

en.text: Or have they a stairway [into the heaven] upon which they listen? Then let their listener produce a clear authority [i.e., proof].

so.text: 38. Mise waxay leeyihiin sallaanno ay  ku dhegaystaan (Ghaybka iyo warka samada); ee ha keeno dhegaystahoodu xujo cad.

ayat.arabic: أَمۡ لَهُ ٱلۡبَنَٰتُ وَلَكُمُ ٱلۡبَنُونَ

en.text: Or has He daughters while you have sons?

so.text: 39. Mise wuxuu (Alle) leeyahay gabdho idinkuna leedihiin wiilal?

ayat.arabic: أَمۡ تَسۡـَٔلُهُمۡ أَجۡرٗا فَهُم مِّن مَّغۡرَمٖ مُّثۡقَلُونَ

en.text: Or do you, [O Muḥammad], ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down?

so.text: 40. Mise waxaad weydiisataa ujro, sidaa awgeed deyn la culaabeysan yihiin?

ayat.arabic: أَمۡ عِندَهُمُ ٱلۡغَيۡبُ فَهُمۡ يَكۡتُبُونَ

en.text: Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down?

so.text: 41. Mise waxay og yihiin waxa qarsoon aan muuqan oo ay qoraan?.

ayat.arabic: أَمۡ يُرِيدُونَ كَيۡدٗاۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ هُمُ ٱلۡمَكِيدُونَ

en.text: Or do they intend a plan? But those who disbelieve - they are the object of a plan.

so.text: 42. Mise waxay kula maaggan yihin dabin, kuwase gaalooba waa iyaga kuwa ku jaba dabinkooda.

ayat.arabic: أَمۡ لَهُمۡ إِلَٰهٌ غَيۡرُ ٱللَّهِۚ سُبۡحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُونَ

en.text: Or have they a deity other than Allāh? Exalted is Allāh above whatever they associate with Him.

so.text: 43. Mise waxay leeyihiin ilaah aan ahayn Alle? Alle waa ka hufan yahay waxay la wadaajiyaan (cibaadada).

ayat.arabic: وَإِن يَرَوۡاْ كِسۡفٗا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ سَاقِطٗا يَقُولُواْ سَحَابٞ مَّرۡكُومٞ

en.text: And if they were to see a fragment from the sky falling,[1559] they would say, "[It is merely] clouds heaped up."
en.footnotes: [1559] Marking the onset of Allāh's punishment, as they had requested.

so.text: 44. Hadday arkaan gabal cirka ka mid ah oo soo dhacaya [8] waxay odhan: Waa daruuro is dul saaran (cinaad darti).
so.footnotes: [8]. Kaasoo calaamo u ah soo degitaanka Ciqaabka Alle, sida ay dalbadeen ah.

ayat.arabic: فَذَرۡهُمۡ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُواْ يَوۡمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِي فِيهِ يُصۡعَقُونَ

en.text: So leave them until they meet their Day in which they will be struck insensible -

so.text: 45. Ee iskaga tag intay la kulmaan Maalinkooda ay la suuxi (qarracan).

ayat.arabic: يَوۡمَ لَا يُغۡنِي عَنۡهُمۡ كَيۡدُهُمۡ شَيۡـٔٗا وَلَا هُمۡ يُنصَرُونَ

en.text: The Day their plan will not avail them at all, nor will they be helped.

so.text: 46. Maalinka uusan dabinkoodu waxba u tareyn oo aan loo gargaareyn.

ayat.arabic: وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ عَذَابٗا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ

en.text: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a punishment[1560] before that, but most of them do not know.
en.footnotes: [1560] If not in this world, in the grave.

so.text: 47. Waxay xaqiiq kuwa fala dulmiga (shirkiga iyo xumaha kale) la kulmi cadaab taa ka sokow 'adduunka gudahi' [9] badankooduse ma ay oga.
so.footnotes: [9]. In lagu sallado daadyo, dhul gariirro, abaaro, gaajo, jirrooyin, musiibooyin, iwm. Haddaan lagu ciqaabin adduunka, markaas waa cadaabka qabriga.

ayat.arabic: وَٱصۡبِرۡ لِحُكۡمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعۡيُنِنَاۖ وَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ

en.text: And be patient, [O Muḥammad], for the decision of your Lord, for indeed, you are in Our eyes [i.e., sight]. And exalt [Allāh] with praise of your Lord when you arise

so.text: 48. Ee ku samir (Nabiyow) xukunka Rabbigaa, waxaad tahay indhahayaga hortood, oo ku tasbiixso Ammaanaha Rabbigaa markaad soo kacdo.

ayat.arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيۡلِ فَسَبِّحۡهُ وَإِدۡبَٰرَ ٱلنُّجُومِ

en.text: And in a part of the night exalt Him and after [the setting of] the stars.

so.text: 49. Habeenka qaarkiisna tuko, iyo markay xiddiguhu dhacaan (oogga hore).

ayat.arabic: وَٱلنَّجۡمِ إِذَا هَوَىٰ

en.text: By the star when it descends,

so.text: 1. Waxaan ku dhaartay xiddigaha markay  dhacaan.

ayat.arabic: مَا ضَلَّ صَاحِبُكُمۡ وَمَا غَوَىٰ

en.text: Your companion [i.e., Muḥammad] has not strayed, nor has he erred,

so.text: 2. Saaxibkiin (Nabi  Muxammad s.c.w.) ma ka habaabin (Jidka Toosan iyo hanuunka), (Xaqana) kama uusan lumin.

ayat.arabic: وَمَا يَنطِقُ عَنِ ٱلۡهَوَىٰٓ

en.text: Nor does he speak from [his own] inclination.

so.text: 3. Ma ku hadlo hawadiisa.

ayat.arabic: إِنۡ هُوَ إِلَّا وَحۡيٞ يُوحَىٰ

en.text: It is not but a revelation revealed,

so.text: 4. Wax kale maahee (hadalkiisu) waa waxyi loo waxyooday.

ayat.arabic: عَلَّمَهُۥ شَدِيدُ ٱلۡقُوَىٰ

en.text: Taught to him by one intense in strength [i.e., Gabriel] -

so.text: 5. Waxaa baray (oo xagga Alle ka soo gaarsiiyey) mid xoog weyn.

ayat.arabic: ذُو مِرَّةٖ فَٱسۡتَوَىٰ

en.text: One of soundness.[1562] And he rose to [his] true form[1563]
en.footnotes:
[1562] i.e., strength of body and of mind.
[1563] Gabriel appeared to Muḥammad (ﷺ) at the outset of his prophethood in the angelic form in which Allāh originally created him.

so.text: 6. Ee muuqaal san, abuuraddiisuna dhan tahay 'waa Jabriil c.s.' [1].
so.footnotes: [1]. Jabriil wuxuu ugu muuqday Nabi Muxammad s.c.w. muuqaalkiisa dhabta ah.

ayat.arabic: وَهُوَ بِٱلۡأُفُقِ ٱلۡأَعۡلَىٰ

en.text: While he was in the higher [part of the] horizon.[1564]
en.footnotes: [1564] i.e., in the sky, above the eastern horizon.

so.text: 7. Isagoo ku sugan halka ugu sarreysa jihada sare [2].
so.footnotes: [2]. Cirka, halka ka korreysa jihada bari ee qorrax soo baxa.

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ دَنَا فَتَدَلَّىٰ

en.text: Then he approached and descended

so.text: 8. Markaasuu (Jabriil) soo dhowaaday oo in yar u soo jirsaday.

ayat.arabic: فَكَانَ قَابَ قَوۡسَيۡنِ أَوۡ أَدۡنَىٰ

en.text: And was at a distance of two bow lengths or nearer.

so.text: 9. In le’eg labo qaanso xadhigeed ama ka dhow.

ayat.arabic: فَأَوۡحَىٰٓ إِلَىٰ عَبۡدِهِۦ مَآ أَوۡحَىٰ

en.text: And he revealed to His Servant[1565] what he revealed [i.e., conveyed].
en.footnotes: [1565] i.e., to the Servant of Allāh, Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ).

so.text: 10. Markaasuu (Alle) u Waxyooday addoonkiisa (Nabi Muxammad s.c.w.) wuxuu u waxyooday [3].
so.footnotes: [3]. Waa Qur'aanka.

ayat.arabic: مَا كَذَبَ ٱلۡفُؤَادُ مَا رَأَىٰٓ

en.text: The heart[1566] did not lie [about] what it saw.
en.footnotes: [1566] i.e., mind or perception (of the Prophet [ﷺ]).

so.text: 11. Kama been sheegin Qalbiga wuxuu arkay [4].
so.footnotes: [4]. Nabigu s.c.w habeenkii micraajka ee Calaamooyinka waaweyn ah ee Rabbi.

ayat.arabic: أَفَتُمَٰرُونَهُۥ عَلَىٰ مَا يَرَىٰ

en.text: So will you dispute with him over what he saw?

so.text: 12.  Ma waxaad kala murmi wuxuu arkay (habeenkii Israha iyo Micraajka).

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ رَءَاهُ نَزۡلَةً أُخۡرَىٰ

en.text: And he certainly saw him in another descent[1567]
en.footnotes: [1567] i.e., on another occasion. During his ascent into the heavens (al-Miʿrāj), the Prophet (ﷺ) also saw Gabriel in his true form.

so.text: 13. Wuxuuna dhab ahaan ku arkay (Jabriil) soo degid kale.

ayat.arabic: عِندَ سِدۡرَةِ ٱلۡمُنتَهَىٰ

en.text: At the Lote Tree of the Utmost Boundary -

so.text: 14. Dhammaadka xadka geedka gobka [5].
so.footnotes: [5]. Sidratal muntahaa, waa halka u sarreysa samada toddobaad.

ayat.arabic: عِندَهَا جَنَّةُ ٱلۡمَأۡوَىٰٓ

en.text: Near it is the Garden of Refuge [i.e., Paradise] -

so.text: 15. Waxaa agteeda ah Jannada hoyashada.

ayat.arabic: إِذۡ يَغۡشَى ٱلسِّدۡرَةَ مَا يَغۡشَىٰ

en.text: When there covered the Lote Tree that which covered [it].[1568]
en.footnotes: [1568] Then and there he (ﷺ) saw Gabriel in angelic form.

so.text: 16. Markuu daboolay gobka waxa daboolay (oo qurux ah).

ayat.arabic: مَا زَاغَ ٱلۡبَصَرُ وَمَا طَغَىٰ

en.text: The sight [of the Prophet (ﷺ)] did not swerve, nor did it transgress [its limit].

so.text: 17. Aragga (Nabiga s.c .w) uma iilan dhinacna, mana dhaafin xadkii loo dhigay.

ayat.arabic: لَقَدۡ رَأَىٰ مِنۡ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّهِ ٱلۡكُبۡرَىٰٓ

en.text: He certainly saw of the greatest signs of his Lord.

so.text: 18. Wuxuu xaqiiq wax ka arkay Calaamooyinka Rabbigi ee waaweyn.

ayat.arabic: أَفَرَءَيۡتُمُ ٱللَّٰتَ وَٱلۡعُزَّىٰ

en.text: So have you considered al-Lāt and al-ʿUzzā?

so.text: 19. Ee (gaaloy) ka warrama (sanamyada) Al-Laat iyo Al-Cuzza.

ayat.arabic: وَمَنَوٰةَ ٱلثَّالِثَةَ ٱلۡأُخۡرَىٰٓ

en.text: And Manāt, the third - the other one?[1569]
en.footnotes: [1569] The three names given in this and the previous verse are those of well-known "goddesses" which were worshipped by the pagan Arabs before the spread of Islām.

so.text: 20. Iyo Manaat, tan seddexaad ee kale [6]?
so.footnotes: [6]. Seddexdan magac ee lagu xusay halkan iyo Aayadda ka horreysa waa ilaahyo caan ahaa oo dheddig ah ay caabudi jireen mushrikiintii Carbeed.

ayat.arabic: أَلَكُمُ ٱلذَّكَرُ وَلَهُ ٱلۡأُنثَىٰ

en.text: Is the male for you and for Him the female?

so.text: 21. idinku ma waxaad leedihiin labka Isaguna dheddigga?

ayat.arabic: تِلۡكَ إِذٗا قِسۡمَةٞ ضِيزَىٰٓ

en.text: That, then, is an unjust division.[1570]
en.footnotes: [1570] According to their own standards.

so.text: 22. Tanu waa qayb dulun ah.

ayat.arabic: إِنۡ هِيَ إِلَّآ أَسۡمَآءٞ سَمَّيۡتُمُوهَآ أَنتُمۡ وَءَابَآؤُكُم مَّآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَا مِن سُلۡطَٰنٍۚ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ وَمَا تَهۡوَى ٱلۡأَنفُسُۖ وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَهُم مِّن رَّبِّهِمُ ٱلۡهُدَىٰٓ

en.text: They are not but [mere] names you have named them - you and your forefathers - for which Allāh has sent down no authority. They follow not except assumption and what [their] souls desire, and there has already come to them from their Lord guidance.

so.text: 23. Ma aha wax kale aan aheyn magacyo aad bixiseen - idinka iyo aabbayaashiin - oo uusan Alle u soo dejin wax Xujo ah. Ma raacaan waxba aan ahayn male iyo waxa xun ay naftoodu u iilato, waxaana uga yimid xagga Rabbigood hanuun wacan (Islaamka).

ayat.arabic: أَمۡ لِلۡإِنسَٰنِ مَا تَمَنَّىٰ

en.text: Or is there for man whatever he wishes?

so.text: 24. Mise Aadmigu wuxuu leeyahay wuxuu jecleystoba?

ayat.arabic: فَلِلَّهِ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةُ وَٱلۡأُولَىٰ

en.text: Rather, to Allāh belongs the Hereafter and the first [life].

so.text: 25. Mayee, Alle baa iska leh tan dambe 'Aakhirada' iyo 'nolosha' horeba 'Adduunka'.

ayat.arabic: ۞ وَكَم مِّن مَّلَكٖ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ لَا تُغۡنِي شَفَٰعَتُهُمۡ شَيۡـًٔا إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعۡدِ أَن يَأۡذَنَ ٱللَّهُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَرۡضَىٰٓ

en.text: And how many angels there are in the heavens whose intercession will not avail at all except [only] after Allāh has permitted [it] to whom He wills and approves.

so.text: 26. Badanaa inta malag jooga samooyinka, aysan shafeecadoodu waxba taraynin in Alle u idmo maahee cidduu doono oo ka  Raalli yahay.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ لَيُسَمُّونَ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ تَسۡمِيَةَ ٱلۡأُنثَىٰ

en.text: Indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter name the angels female names,

so.text: 27. Hubaal kuwaa (gaalada mushrikiinta ah) aan rumeysnayn Aakhirada, waxay ku magacaabaan malaa’igta magacyo dheddig ah.

ayat.arabic: وَمَا لَهُم بِهِۦ مِنۡ عِلۡمٍۖ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّۖ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّنَّ لَا يُغۡنِي مِنَ ٱلۡحَقِّ شَيۡـٔٗا

en.text: And they have thereof no knowledge. They follow not except assumption, and indeed, assumption avails not against the truth at all.

so.text: 28. Iyagoo aan wax aqoon ah u laheyn. Waxay raacaan oo keliya malo, maluhuna waxba kama taro Xaqa.

ayat.arabic: فَأَعۡرِضۡ عَن مَّن تَوَلَّىٰ عَن ذِكۡرِنَا وَلَمۡ يُرِدۡ إِلَّا ٱلۡحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا

en.text: So turn away from whoever turns his back on Our message and desires not except the worldly life.

so.text: 29. Ee iskaga jeeso kan ka tegay Xuskayga (Qur’aanka) oo aan doonayn waxaan aheyn nolosha adduunka.

ayat.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ مَبۡلَغُهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡعِلۡمِۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱهۡتَدَىٰ

en.text: That is their sum of knowledge. Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who strays from His way, and He is most knowing of who is guided.

so.text: 30. Kaasi waa intuu gaaray garaadkooda aqooneed. Rabbigaa waa Ogsoon yahay kan ka luma Jidkiisa, waana Ogsoon yahay kan hanuunsan.

ayat.arabic: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ لِيَجۡزِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسَٰٓـُٔواْ بِمَا عَمِلُواْ وَيَجۡزِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَحۡسَنُواْ بِٱلۡحُسۡنَى

en.text: And to Allāh belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth - that He may recompense those who do evil with [the penalty of] what they have done and recompense those who do good with the best [reward] -

so.text: 31. Allaah baa iska leh waxaa ku sugan samooyinka iyo waxa ku sugan arlada, si uu uga abaal marsho kuwa fala xumaanta waxay falaan, iyo (inuu) ugu abaal gudo kuwa fala samaanta samaan (Janno).

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجۡتَنِبُونَ كَبَٰٓئِرَ ٱلۡإِثۡمِ وَٱلۡفَوَٰحِشَ إِلَّا ٱللَّمَمَۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ وَٰسِعُ ٱلۡمَغۡفِرَةِۚ هُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِكُمۡ إِذۡ أَنشَأَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَإِذۡ أَنتُمۡ أَجِنَّةٞ فِي بُطُونِ أُمَّهَٰتِكُمۡۖ فَلَا تُزَكُّوٓاْ أَنفُسَكُمۡۖ هُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱتَّقَىٰٓ

en.text: Those who avoid the major sins and immoralities, only [committing] slight ones. Indeed, your Lord is vast in forgiveness. He was most knowing of you when He produced you from the earth and when you were fetuses in the wombs of your mothers. So do not claim yourselves to be pure; He is most knowing of who fears Him.

so.text: 32. Kuwa ka fogaada denbiyada waaweyn iyo xumaha, waxa yar yar ee ku soo dhaca maanankooda mooyaane - Rabbigaa waa mid leh denbi dhaaf ballaadhan. Wuuna idin og yahay, markuu idinka abuuray dhulka iyo markaadba ku asturan tihiin uurarka hooyooyinkiin, ee ha is ammaanina, Isagaa (Alle) Og kan ka dhowrsada xumaha.

ayat.arabic: أَفَرَءَيۡتَ ٱلَّذِي تَوَلَّىٰ

en.text: Have you seen the one who turned away

so.text: 33. Ee ma aragtay kan ka jeesaday (Islaamka).

ayat.arabic: وَأَعۡطَىٰ قَلِيلٗا وَأَكۡدَىٰٓ

en.text: And gave a little and [then] refrained?

so.text: 34. Oo wax yar bixiyey [7], inta kalena ceshaday.
so.footnotes: [7]. Waxaa ka dhaadhacsan in maalkiisa uu ku yaraan hadduu wax siiyo saboolka, halka Alle subxaanahu wa tacaalaa uu ballan qaaday si ka duwan.

ayat.arabic: أَعِندَهُۥ عِلۡمُ ٱلۡغَيۡبِ فَهُوَ يَرَىٰٓ

en.text: Does he have knowledge of the unseen, so he sees?[1571]
en.footnotes: [1571] Knows that his provision will be exhausted if he spends on the poor, while Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) has promised otherwise.

so.text: 35. Ma wuxuu hayaa cilmiga waxaan muuqan, oo arkaa?

ayat.arabic: أَمۡ لَمۡ يُنَبَّأۡ بِمَا فِي صُحُفِ مُوسَىٰ

en.text: Or has he not been informed of what was in the scriptures of Moses

so.text: 36. Mise waan loo sheegin wixii ku yiil waraaqahii Muuse -

ayat.arabic: وَإِبۡرَٰهِيمَ ٱلَّذِي وَفَّىٰٓ

en.text: And [of] Abraham, who fulfilled [his obligations] -

so.text: 37. Iyo Ibraahiim ee oofiyey 'amarradii Alle'.

ayat.arabic: أَلَّا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٞ وِزۡرَ أُخۡرَىٰ

en.text: That no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another

so.text: 38. Inaan nafna naf kale denbigeeda qaadeyn (inuu gacan ka geysto maahee).

ayat.arabic: وَأَن لَّيۡسَ لِلۡإِنسَٰنِ إِلَّا مَا سَعَىٰ

en.text: And that there is not for man except that [good] for which he strives

so.text: 39. Iyo inuusan aadmigu mudanin waxaan aheyn wuxuu shaqeysto (khayr ama shar).

ayat.arabic: وَأَنَّ سَعۡيَهُۥ سَوۡفَ يُرَىٰ

en.text: And that his effort is going to be seen -

so.text: 40. Camalkiisana la arki doono.

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ يُجۡزَىٰهُ ٱلۡجَزَآءَ ٱلۡأَوۡفَىٰ

en.text: Then he will be recompensed for it with the fullest recompense -

so.text: 41. Kaddibna looga abaal marin si buuxda.

ayat.arabic: وَأَنَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ٱلۡمُنتَهَىٰ

en.text: And that to your Lord is the finality

so.text: 42. Iyo in xagga Rabbigaa uu yahay meel noqodka dambe.

ayat.arabic: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَضۡحَكَ وَأَبۡكَىٰ

en.text: And that it is He who makes [one] laugh and weep

so.text: 43.Waana Kan wax ka qosliya kana oohiya.

ayat.arabic: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَمَاتَ وَأَحۡيَا

en.text: And that it is He who causes death and gives life

so.text: 44. Isagaana wax dhinsiiya waxna nooleeya.

ayat.arabic: وَأَنَّهُۥ خَلَقَ ٱلزَّوۡجَيۡنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلۡأُنثَىٰ

en.text: And that He creates the two mates - the male and female -

so.text: 45. Isagaa (Alle) abuuray labada nooc, labka iyo dheddigga.

ayat.arabic: مِن نُّطۡفَةٍ إِذَا تُمۡنَىٰ

en.text: From a sperm-drop when it is emitted

so.text: 46. Ka abuuray dhibic mino ah marka la shubo.

ayat.arabic: وَأَنَّ عَلَيۡهِ ٱلنَّشۡأَةَ ٱلۡأُخۡرَىٰ

en.text: And that [incumbent] upon Him is the other [i.e., next] creation.

so.text: 47. Isagayna saaran tahay soo celinta kale (abuurista Aakhirada).

ayat.arabic: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَغۡنَىٰ وَأَقۡنَىٰ

en.text: And that it is He who enriches and suffices

so.text: 48. Waa Isaga Kan wax hodmiya waxna faqiiriya;

ayat.arabic: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلشِّعۡرَىٰ

en.text: And that it is He who is the Lord of Sirius[1572]
en.footnotes: [1572] A star worshipped by some of the pagan Arabs.

so.text: 49. Waana Rabbiga xiddiga Shicra [8].
so.footnotes: [8]. Waa xiddig ay caabudi jireen qaar ka mid ah mushrikiintii Carbeed.

ayat.arabic: وَأَنَّهُۥٓ أَهۡلَكَ عَادًا ٱلۡأُولَىٰ

en.text: And that He destroyed the first [people of] ʿAad

so.text: 50. Alle Isagaa halaagay Caadkii hore,

ayat.arabic: وَثَمُودَاْ فَمَآ أَبۡقَىٰ

en.text: And Thamūd - and He did not spare [them] -

so.text: 51. Iyo Thamuudba, waxnana kama reebin.

ayat.arabic: وَقَوۡمَ نُوحٖ مِّن قَبۡلُۖ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ هُمۡ أَظۡلَمَ وَأَطۡغَىٰ

en.text: And the people of Noah before. Indeed, it was they who were [even] more unjust and oppressing.

so.text: 52. Iyo qolodii Nuux awal hore; waxay ahaayeen kuwo dulmi iyo xadgudub badan.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلۡمُؤۡتَفِكَةَ أَهۡوَىٰ

en.text: And the overturned towns[1573] He hurled down
en.footnotes: [1573] Whose inhabitants defied Prophet Lot.

so.text: 53. Iyo magaalooyinkii (Sodom iyo Gammurah) ee la rogay [9].
so.footnotes: [9]. Dadka degaankaasoo ka hor yimid Nabi Luud.

ayat.arabic: فَغَشَّىٰهَا مَا غَشَّىٰ

en.text: And covered them by that which He covered.[1574]
en.footnotes: [1574] i.e., a rain of stones.

so.text: 54. Markaasaa Waxaa daboolay wixii daboolay (oo cadaab ah).

ayat.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكَ تَتَمَارَىٰ

en.text: Then which of the favors of your Lord do you doubt?

so.text: 55. Ee tee baad Nicmooyinka Rabbigaa ka doodeysaa oo ka shaki qabtaa?

ayat.arabic: هَٰذَا نَذِيرٞ مِّنَ ٱلنُّذُرِ ٱلۡأُولَىٰٓ

en.text: This [Prophet (ﷺ)] is a warner from [i.e., like] the former warners.

so.text: 56. Kanu (Nabi Muxammad) waa dige ka mid ah digayaashii hore.

ayat.arabic: أَزِفَتِ ٱلۡأٓزِفَةُ

en.text: The Approaching Day has approached.

so.text: 57. Way soo dhowaatay Saacaddii  (Qiyaame).

ayat.arabic: لَيۡسَ لَهَا مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ كَاشِفَةٌ

en.text: Of it, [from those] besides Allāh, there is no remover.

so.text: 58. Ma jiro Alle ka sokow cid feydi kartaa (dhibaha iyo shiddooyinkeeda ama og waqtigeeda).

ayat.arabic: أَفَمِنۡ هَٰذَا ٱلۡحَدِيثِ تَعۡجَبُونَ

en.text: Then at this statement do you wonder?

so.text: 59. Ma waxaad la yaabban tihiin warkani weyn (Qur’aanka Kariimka)?.

ayat.arabic: وَتَضۡحَكُونَ وَلَا تَبۡكُونَ

en.text: And you laugh and do not weep

so.text: 60. Oo aad qoslaysaan (idinkoo beenin)  oo aydaan ooyeynin (cabsi Alle darteed)?

ayat.arabic: وَأَنتُمۡ سَٰمِدُونَ

en.text: While you are proudly sporting?[1575]
en.footnotes: [1575] Additional meanings are "singing [with expanded chest]," "heedless," or "lost in vain amusements."

so.text: 61. Idinkoo iska haasaawaya.

ayat.arabic: فَٱسۡجُدُواْۤ لِلَّهِۤ وَٱعۡبُدُواْ۩

en.text: So prostrate to Allāh and worship [Him].

so.text: 62. Ee u sujuuda Alle oo caabuda (Isagoo Keliya idinkoon waxba u shariik yeelin).

ayat.arabic: ٱقۡتَرَبَتِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ وَٱنشَقَّ ٱلۡقَمَرُ

en.text: The Hour has come near, and the moon has split [in two].[1577]
en.footnotes: [1577] This was a sign given by Allāh to Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ) when the Quraysh challenged him to show them a miracle.

so.text: 1. Saacadda (Qiyaame) way soo dhowaatay, dayaxiina wuxuu u kala dhanbalmay labo gabal [1].
so.footnotes: [1]. Tani waxay aheyd calaamo mucjisad ah uu Alle siiyey Nabi Muxammad s.c.w. markay Quraysh ka dalbeen inuu tusiyo mucjiso.

ayat.arabic: وَإِن يَرَوۡاْ ءَايَةٗ يُعۡرِضُواْ وَيَقُولُواْ سِحۡرٞ مُّسۡتَمِرّٞ

en.text: And if they see a sign [i.e., miracle], they turn away and say, "Passing magic."[1578]
en.footnotes: [1578] Or "Continuing magic."

so.text: 2. Hadday (gaaladu) arkaan mucjiso (xag Alle ah) waxay u jeestaan dhinac oo yidhaahdaan: Waa sixir is daba taxan.

ayat.arabic: وَكَذَّبُواْ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓاْ أَهۡوَآءَهُمۡۚ وَكُلُّ أَمۡرٖ مُّسۡتَقِرّٞ

en.text: And they denied and followed their inclinations. But for every matter is a [time of] settlement.

so.text: 3. Waxay beeniyeen (Xaqa) oo raaceen hawadooda. Arrin kastana wuxuu leeyahay meel uu ku sugnaado.

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَنۢبَآءِ مَا فِيهِ مُزۡدَجَرٌ

en.text: And there has already come to them of information that in which there is deterrence.

so.text: 4. Waxaana dhab ahaan u yimid warar ku dheehan waano (iyo digniino).

ayat.arabic: حِكۡمَةُۢ بَٰلِغَةٞۖ فَمَا تُغۡنِ ٱلنُّذُرُ

en.text: Extensive wisdom - but warning does not avail [them].

so.text: 5. Xikmad xeel dheer; maxayse u tartaa digidi (xaq diid).

ayat.arabic: فَتَوَلَّ عَنۡهُمۡۘ يَوۡمَ يَدۡعُ ٱلدَّاعِ إِلَىٰ شَيۡءٖ نُّكُرٍ

en.text: So leave them, [O Muḥammad]. The Day the Caller[1579] calls to something forbidding,
en.footnotes: [1579] Said to be an angel announcing the account and judgement.

so.text: 6. Ee iskaga jeeso (Nabi Muxammadow); (oo dhowr) Maalinka uu baaquhu ugu baaqi wax daran [2].
so.footnotes: [2]. Waxaa la yidhi waa malag ugu yeedhi dadka xisaab iyo garsoor.

ayat.arabic: خُشَّعًا أَبۡصَٰرُهُمۡ يَخۡرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡأَجۡدَاثِ كَأَنَّهُمۡ جَرَادٞ مُّنتَشِرٞ

en.text: Their eyes humbled, they will emerge from the graves as if they were locusts spreading,

so.text: 7. Iyagoo arag dulleysan, waxay ka soo baxayaan qubuurahooda iyagoo la moodo ayax faafay.

ayat.arabic: مُّهۡطِعِينَ إِلَى ٱلدَّاعِۖ يَقُولُ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا يَوۡمٌ عَسِرٞ

en.text: Racing ahead toward the Caller. The disbelievers will say, "This is a difficult Day."

so.text: 8. U degdegaya dhinaca baaqaha, gaaladu waxay odhan: Kani waa Maalin daran.

ayat.arabic: ۞ كَذَّبَتۡ قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمُ نُوحٖ فَكَذَّبُواْ عَبۡدَنَا وَقَالُواْ مَجۡنُونٞ وَٱزۡدُجِرَ

en.text: The people of Noah denied before them, and they denied Our servant and said, "A madman," and he was repelled.

so.text: 9. Waxaa (Xaqa) beeniyey iyaga hortood Qolodii Nuux, waxay beeniyeen addoonkayagii (Nuux) oo yidhaahdeen: waa jinnoole, oo la handaday.

ayat.arabic: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّي مَغۡلُوبٞ فَٱنتَصِرۡ

en.text: So he invoked his Lord, "Indeed, I am overpowered, so help."

so.text: 10. Markaasuu baryey Rabbigi (isagoo leh): Waa la iga adkaadaye ii soo hiilli.

ayat.arabic: فَفَتَحۡنَآ أَبۡوَٰبَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَآءٖ مُّنۡهَمِرٖ

en.text: Then We opened the gates of the heaven with rain pouring down

so.text: 11. Markaasaan ka soo furnay albaabadii daruuraha biyo da’aya oo badan.

ayat.arabic: وَفَجَّرۡنَا ٱلۡأَرۡضَ عُيُونٗا فَٱلۡتَقَى ٱلۡمَآءُ عَلَىٰٓ أَمۡرٖ قَدۡ قُدِرَ

en.text: And caused the earth to burst with springs, and the waters met for a matter already predestined.

so.text: 12. Kana soo burqinnay dhulka ilo (biyo ah), markaasay biyihii (cirka iyo dhulka) is qabteen oo ku kulmeen arrin la qaddaray .

ayat.arabic: وَحَمَلۡنَٰهُ عَلَىٰ ذَاتِ أَلۡوَٰحٖ وَدُسُرٖ

en.text: And We carried him on a [construction of] planks and nails,

so.text: 13. Waxaana (Nuux) ku qaadnay (Doonni) laga sameeyey Alwaax iyo masaamiir.

ayat.arabic: تَجۡرِي بِأَعۡيُنِنَا جَزَآءٗ لِّمَن كَانَ كُفِرَ

en.text: Sailing under Our observation as reward for he who had been denied.

so.text: 14. Ku socota indhahayaga hortood (waxaana harqinnay gaaladii) ka jaazeyn gaalnimadooda (iyo u hiillin ahaan Nuux).

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَد تَّرَكۡنَٰهَآ ءَايَةٗ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرٖ

en.text: And We left it as a sign, so is there any who will remember?

so.text: 15. Waxaana uga tagnay si ay u ahaato Calaamad (lagu waantoobo), ee ma jiraa mid ku waantoobi?

ayat.arabic: فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ

en.text: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.[1580]
en.footnotes: [1580] To those after them, who were expected to derive a lesson from previous occurrences.

so.text: 16. Ee Sidee ahaa cadaabkeygii iyo digniinaheygii?

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرٖ

en.text: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?

so.text: 17. Waxaanu dhabtii sahalnay Qur’aanka si loo xusuusto, mase jiraa cid waantoobi?

ayat.arabic: كَذَّبَتۡ عَادٞ فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ

en.text: ʿAad denied; and how [severe] were My punishment and warning.

so.text: 18. Reer Caad waxay beeniyeen (Xaqa), ee sidee ahaa cadaabkeygii iyo digniinaheygii.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ رِيحٗا صَرۡصَرٗا فِي يَوۡمِ نَحۡسٖ مُّسۡتَمِرّٖ

en.text: Indeed, We sent upon them a screaming wind on a day of continuous misfortune,

so.text: 19. Waxaan ku soo dirnay dushood dabeyl qabow badan maalin baaskeedu is daba joogo.

ayat.arabic: تَنزِعُ ٱلنَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمۡ أَعۡجَازُ نَخۡلٖ مُّنقَعِرٖ

en.text: Extracting the people[1581] as if they were trunks of palm trees uprooted.
en.footnotes: [1581] From their hiding places.

so.text: 20. Iyadoo u majaxaabineysa dadka [3] sida inay ahaayeen geedo timir jirriddoodii la rujiyey.
so.footnotes: [3]. Ka soo bixineysa halkay ku gabbanaayeen.

ayat.arabic: فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ

en.text: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.

so.text: 21. Ee sidee ahaa cadaabkeygii iyo digniinaheygii.

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرٖ

en.text: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?

so.text: 22. Waxaanu dhabtii sahalnay Qur’aanka si loo xusuusto, mase jiraa cid waantoobi?

ayat.arabic: كَذَّبَتۡ ثَمُودُ بِٱلنُّذُرِ

en.text: Thamūd denied the warning.

so.text: 23. Reer Thamuud waxay beeniyeen digniinihii.

ayat.arabic: فَقَالُوٓاْ أَبَشَرٗا مِّنَّا وَٰحِدٗا نَّتَّبِعُهُۥٓ إِنَّآ إِذٗا لَّفِي ضَلَٰلٖ وَسُعُرٍ

en.text: And said, "Is it one human being[1582] among us that we should follow? Indeed, we would then be in error and madness.
en.footnotes: [1582] i.e., the prophet Ṣāliḥ.

so.text: 24. Waxay yidhaahdeen: Ma qof keliya oo naga mid ah (Saalix) yaan raaceynaa, markaas waxaanu ku sugannahay habow iyo heehaab (waalli).

ayat.arabic: أَءُلۡقِيَ ٱلذِّكۡرُ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۢ بَيۡنِنَا بَلۡ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرٞ

en.text: Has the message been sent down upon him from among us? Rather, he is an insolent liar."

so.text: 25. Ma waxaa Wacdiga lagu soo dejiyey isaga oo nalaga dhex doortay? Mayee, waa beenlow isla weyn [4].
so.footnotes: [4]. Waxay ula jeedaan Nabi Saalix.

ayat.arabic: سَيَعۡلَمُونَ غَدٗا مَّنِ ٱلۡكَذَّابُ ٱلۡأَشِرُ

en.text: They will know tomorrow who is the insolent liar.

so.text: 26. Berri bay ogaan, waa kee beenalaha, islaweynaha ah?

ayat.arabic: إِنَّا مُرۡسِلُواْ ٱلنَّاقَةِ فِتۡنَةٗ لَّهُمۡ فَٱرۡتَقِبۡهُمۡ وَٱصۡطَبِرۡ

en.text: Indeed, We are sending the she-camel as trial for them, so watch them and be patient.[1583]
en.footnotes: [1583] This and the following verse are an address to Ṣāliḥ (upon him be peace).

so.text: 27. Waxaan soo direynaa Hal lagu imtixaani ee sug oo samir yeelo [5].
so.footnotes: [5]. Aayaddan iyo tan xigta waxay ku socdaan Saalix c.s.

ayat.arabic: وَنَبِّئۡهُمۡ أَنَّ ٱلۡمَآءَ قِسۡمَةُۢ بَيۡنَهُمۡۖ كُلُّ شِرۡبٖ مُّحۡتَضَرٞ

en.text: And inform them that the water is shared between them,[1584] each [day of] drink attended [by turn].
en.footnotes: [1584] i.e., between the tribe of Thamūd and the she-camel - a day for each to drink.

so.text: 28. U sheeg in biyuhu yihiin qayb iyo kaltan dhexdooda ah, mid walbaa leeyahay cabbid maalin gaar ah.

ayat.arabic: فَنَادَوۡاْ صَاحِبَهُمۡ فَتَعَاطَىٰ فَعَقَرَ

en.text: But they called their companion,[1585] and he dared[1586] and hamstrung [her].
en.footnotes:
[1585] i.e., the worst and most despicable among them.
[1586] Or "he took," referring to his sword or to the she-camel.

so.text: 29. Waxayse u dhawaaqeen saaxiibkood [6] oo soo qaatay (seef) oo boqna gooyey hashii (oo dilay).
so.footnotes: [6]. Habaar qabe Qudaar.

ayat.arabic: فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ

en.text: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.

so.text: 30. Ee Sidee ahaa cadaabkeygii iyo digniinaheygii.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ صَيۡحَةٗ وَٰحِدَةٗ فَكَانُواْ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلۡمُحۡتَظِرِ

en.text: Indeed, We sent upon them one shriek [i.e., blast from the sky], and they became like the dry twig fragments of an [animal] pen.

so.text: 31. Waxaan ku soo dirnay dushooda dhawaaq keliya, markaasay waxay noqdeen sida jabad burburay ee dhulka laga xaaqo.

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرٖ

en.text: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?

so.text: 32. Waxaanu dhabtii sahalnay Qur’aanka si loo xusuusto, mase jiraa cid waantoobi?

ayat.arabic: كَذَّبَتۡ قَوۡمُ لُوطِۭ بِٱلنُّذُرِ

en.text: The people of Lot denied the warning.

so.text: 33. Qoonkii Luud baa beeniyey digniinihii.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ حَاصِبًا إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٖۖ نَّجَّيۡنَٰهُم بِسَحَرٖ

en.text: Indeed, We sent upon them a storm of stones, except the family of Lot - We saved them before dawn.

so.text: 34. Waxaan ku dirnay dushooda dabeyl dhagaxyo wadata Reer Luud ma’ahee, waan badbaadinnay waaberiga hortiis.

ayat.arabic: نِّعۡمَةٗ مِّنۡ عِندِنَاۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي مَن شَكَرَ

en.text: As favor from Us. Thus do We reward he who is grateful.

so.text: 35. Nicmo Xaggayaga ah, sidaasoo kale baan u abaal marinnaa qofkii (Alle) mahdiya.

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ أَنذَرَهُم بَطۡشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوۡاْ بِٱلنُّذُرِ

en.text: And he had already warned them of Our assault, but they disputed the warning.

so.text: 36. Wuxuu (Luud) uga digay qolodiisii Qabashadayada daran, wayse ka doodeen oo shakiyeen digniinihii.

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ رَٰوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيۡفِهِۦ فَطَمَسۡنَآ أَعۡيُنَهُمۡ فَذُوقُواْ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ

en.text: And they had demanded from him his guests, but We obliterated their eyes, [saying], "Taste My punishment and warning."

so.text: 37. Oo waxay dhab ahaan dooneen inay martidiisii (faro xumeeyaan) markaasaan indha tirray ee dhadhamiya cadaabkeyga iyo digniinaheyga.

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ صَبَّحَهُم بُكۡرَةً عَذَابٞ مُّسۡتَقِرّٞ

en.text: And there came upon them by morning an abiding punishment.

so.text: 38. Waxaana ku waabariistay aroortiiba cadaab sugan.

ayat.arabic: فَذُوقُواْ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ

en.text: So taste My punishment and warning.

so.text: 39. Ee dhadhamiya Cadaabkeyga iyo Digniinaheyga.

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرٖ

en.text: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?

so.text: 40. Waxaanu dhabtii sahalnay Qur’aanka si loo xusuusto, mase jiraa cid waantoobi?

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَ ءَالَ فِرۡعَوۡنَ ٱلنُّذُرُ

en.text: And there certainly came to the people of Pharaoh warning.

so.text: 41. Waxaa u yimid qoladii Fircoon digniino.

ayat.arabic: كَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذۡنَٰهُمۡ أَخۡذَ عَزِيزٖ مُّقۡتَدِرٍ

en.text: They denied Our signs, all of them, so We seized them with a seizure of one Exalted in Might and Perfect in Ability.

so.text: 42. Waxay beeniyeen Aayadahayagii oo dhan, markaasaan qabannay Qabasho Awood Badane, Karaan Badan.

ayat.arabic: أَكُفَّارُكُمۡ خَيۡرٞ مِّنۡ أُوْلَٰٓئِكُمۡ أَمۡ لَكُم بَرَآءَةٞ فِي ٱلزُّبُرِ

en.text: Are your disbelievers better than those [former ones], or have you immunity in the scriptures?

so.text: 43. Ma gaaladiinnan baa ka khayr badan kuwaas mise ma waxaad heysataan cafis idiinku qoran Kutabahayaga?

ayat.arabic: أَمۡ يَقُولُونَ نَحۡنُ جَمِيعٞ مُّنتَصِرٞ

en.text: Or do they say, "We are an assembly supporting [each other]"?

so.text: 44. Mise ma waxay leeyihiin: Waxaanu nahay ciidan dhan oo guuleysan.

ayat.arabic: سَيُهۡزَمُ ٱلۡجَمۡعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ ٱلدُّبُرَ

en.text: [Their] assembly will be defeated, and they will turn their backs [in retreat].[1587]
en.footnotes: [1587] This foretold event took place on the day of Badr.

so.text: 45. Waa la jabin ciidankooda, dabadayna jeedin.

ayat.arabic: بَلِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ مَوۡعِدُهُمۡ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدۡهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ

en.text: But the Hour is their appointment [for due punishment], and the Hour is more disastrous and more bitter.

so.text: 46. Saacadda (Qiyaame) yaa ballan u ah, Saacadduna iyadaa daran oo kharaar.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ فِي ضَلَٰلٖ وَسُعُرٖ

en.text: Indeed, the criminals are in error and madness.[1588].
en.footnotes: [1588] Or "in blazing fires."

so.text: 47. Hubaal kuwa denbiilayaasha ah waxay ku sugan yihiin habow (adduunka), Aakhirona dhex ahaan dab ololaya.

ayat.arabic: يَوۡمَ يُسۡحَبُونَ فِي ٱلنَّارِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمۡ ذُوقُواْ مَسَّ سَقَرَ

en.text: The Day they are dragged into the Fire on their faces [it will be said], "Taste the touch of Saqar."[1589]
en.footnotes: [1589] One of the proper names of Hell.

so.text: 48. Maalinka marka wejiyadooda lagu dhex jiidi Naarta (waxaa lagu odhan): Dhadhamiya taabashada Naarta.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّا كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ خَلَقۡنَٰهُ بِقَدَرٖ

en.text: Indeed, all things We created with predestination.

so.text: 49.Waxaan ku abuurnay wax kasta Qaddar.

ayat.arabic: وَمَآ أَمۡرُنَآ إِلَّا وَٰحِدَةٞ كَلَمۡحِۭ بِٱلۡبَصَرِ

en.text: And Our command is but one, like a glance of the eye.

so.text: 50. Amarkayaguna ma aha waxaan ahayn sida ilbiriqsi.

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَآ أَشۡيَاعَكُمۡ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرٖ

en.text: And We have already destroyed your kinds,[1590] so is there any who will remember?
en.footnotes: [1590] i.e., those similar to you in attitude and behavior when they rejected Allāh's messengers.

so.text: 51. Waxaan dhab ahaan horay u hallignay kuwii idin la midka ahaa ee ma jiraan mid uun ku waantoobi?

ayat.arabic: وَكُلُّ شَيۡءٖ فَعَلُوهُ فِي ٱلزُّبُرِ

en.text: And everything they did is in written records.

so.text: 52. Wax kastoo ay faleenna waxay ku yaalliin kutubta (camalladooda).

ayat.arabic: وَكُلُّ صَغِيرٖ وَكَبِيرٖ مُّسۡتَطَرٌ

en.text: And every small and great [thing] is inscribed.

so.text: 53. Wax walibana yar iyo weyn waxay ku yaalliin (Looxa Maxfuudka).

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّٰتٖ وَنَهَرٖ

en.text: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and rivers,

so.text: 54. Hubaal kuwa ka dhowrsada (shirkiga iyo xumaha) waxay ku sugnaan  beero iyo webiyo (Janno).

ayat.arabic: فِي مَقۡعَدِ صِدۡقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكٖ مُّقۡتَدِرِۭ

en.text: In a seat of honor near a Sovereign, Perfect in Ability.[1591]
en.footnotes: [1591] Who accomplishes whatever He wills whenever He wills.

so.text: 55. Fadhi sharfeed run ah oo (Allaah) Boqorka Awooda wax walba agtiisa ah.

ayat.arabic: ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ

en.text: The Most Merciful

so.text: 1. (Allaah) Raxmaanka,

ayat.arabic: عَلَّمَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ

en.text: Taught the Qur’ān,

so.text: 2. Wuxuu baray Qur'aanka.

ayat.arabic: خَلَقَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ

en.text: Created man,

so.text: 3. Abuuray aadmiga.

ayat.arabic: عَلَّمَهُ ٱلۡبَيَانَ

en.text: [And] taught him eloquence.

so.text: 4. Oo baray caddeynta (hadalka iyo waxa uu dooni).

ayat.arabic: ٱلشَّمۡسُ وَٱلۡقَمَرُ بِحُسۡبَانٖ

en.text: The sun and the moon [move] by precise calculation,

so.text: 5. Qorraxda iyo dayaxu waxay ku socdaan xisaab.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلنَّجۡمُ وَٱلشَّجَرُ يَسۡجُدَانِ

en.text: And the stars and trees prostrate.[1593]
en.footnotes: [1593] They submit obediently to the laws of Allāh. See 22:18. An additional meaning of "najm" is vegetation of a kind without a trunk, stalk or stem.

so.text: 6. Xiddigaha iyo geedahuna way sujuudaan [1].
so.footnotes: [1]. Xiddigaha waxaa caabudi jirey qaar ka mid ah Carabta waagii Jaahiliyadda. Halka xiddigaha iyo geeduhuba u sujuudaan Alle, oo u hoggaansan yihiin Xeerarkiisa.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ رَفَعَهَا وَوَضَعَ ٱلۡمِيزَانَ

en.text: And the heaven He raised and imposed the balance

so.text: 7. Samada wuu kor yeelay, wuxuuna dhigay caddaalad 'iyo garsoor wanaagsan'.

ayat.arabic: أَلَّا تَطۡغَوۡاْ فِي ٱلۡمِيزَانِ

en.text: That you not transgress within the balance.

so.text: 8. Si aydaan ugu xad gudbin cadaaladda.

ayat.arabic: وَأَقِيمُواْ ٱلۡوَزۡنَ بِٱلۡقِسۡطِ وَلَا تُخۡسِرُواْ ٱلۡمِيزَانَ

en.text: And establish weight in justice and do not make deficient the balance.

so.text: 9. Hagaajiya beegga si caadil ah, hana dhimina miisaanka.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَضَعَهَا لِلۡأَنَامِ

en.text: And the earth He laid [out] for the creatures.

so.text: 10. Dhulka Wuxuu (Alle) degaan uga dhigay uumanka nool oo dhan.

ayat.arabic: فِيهَا فَٰكِهَةٞ وَٱلنَّخۡلُ ذَاتُ ٱلۡأَكۡمَامِ

en.text: Therein is fruit and palm trees having sheaths [of dates]

so.text: 11. Dhexdeeda waxaa ah midho iyo geedaha timirta ee fiidaha leh.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلۡحَبُّ ذُو ٱلۡعَصۡفِ وَٱلرَّيۡحَانُ

en.text: And grain having husks and scented plants.

so.text: 12. Iyo haruurka leh balka iyo dhir udug wanaagsan.

ayat.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

en.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?[1594]
en.footnotes: [1594] Literally, "you two," addressing the species of mankind and jinn.

so.text: 13. Ee taa baad Nicmooyinka Rabbigiin beenineysaan (dadka iyo jinkow)?

ayat.arabic: خَلَقَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ مِن صَلۡصَٰلٖ كَٱلۡفَخَّارِ

en.text: He created man from clay like [that of] pottery.

so.text: 14. Wuxuu (Alle) ka abuuray Aadmiga dhoobo jilay oo kale ah.

ayat.arabic: وَخَلَقَ ٱلۡجَآنَّ مِن مَّارِجٖ مِّن نَّارٖ

en.text: And He created the jinn from a smokeless flame of fire.

so.text: 15. Jinkana wuxuu ka abuuray olol dab [2].
so.footnotes: [2]. Malaa’igta wuxuu ka abuuray nuur ifiya.

ayat.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

en.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

so.text: 16. Ee tee baad Nicmooyinka Rabbigiin beenineysaan?

ayat.arabic: رَبُّ ٱلۡمَشۡرِقَيۡنِ وَرَبُّ ٱلۡمَغۡرِبَيۡنِ

en.text: [He is] Lord of the two sunrises and Lord of the two sunsets.[1595]
en.footnotes: [1595] i.e., the points of sunrise in the east and sunset in the west in both summer and winter.

so.text: 17. (Alle) waa Rabbiga labada bari iyo Rabbiga labada galbeed [3].
so.footnotes: [3]. Waa halka iyo dhibcaha ay ka soo baxaan qorraxda subaxii dhanka bari iyo halkay u dhacaan galabkii xilliyada jiilaalka iyo xagaayada.

ayat.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

en.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

so.text: 18. Ee tee baad Nicmooyinka Rabbigiin beenineysaan?

ayat.arabic: مَرَجَ ٱلۡبَحۡرَيۡنِ يَلۡتَقِيَانِ

en.text: He released the two seas,[1596] meeting [one another];
en.footnotes: [1596] Two bodies of water or two sea waters of distinct characteristics.

so.text: 19. Wuxuu dareersiiyey labada badood [4] iyagoo kulmi.
so.footnotes: [4]. Labada badood:  Midda biyaha macaan iyo midda biyaha dhanaan.

ayat.arabic: بَيۡنَهُمَا بَرۡزَخٞ لَّا يَبۡغِيَانِ

en.text: Between them is a barrier so neither of them transgresses.

so.text: 20. Dhexdooda waxaa ah shareer (soohdin), iskuma xad gudbaan.

ayat.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

en.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

so.text: 21. Ee tee baad Nicmooyinka Rabbigiin beenineysaan?

ayat.arabic: يَخۡرُجُ مِنۡهُمَا ٱللُّؤۡلُؤُ وَٱلۡمَرۡجَانُ

en.text: From both of them emerge pearl and coral.

so.text: 22. Waxaa ka soo baxa labadaba luul mid weyn iyo mid yarba.

ayat.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

en.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

so.text: 23. Ee tee baad Nicmooyinka Rabbigiin beenineysaan?

ayat.arabic: وَلَهُ ٱلۡجَوَارِ ٱلۡمُنشَـَٔاتُ فِي ٱلۡبَحۡرِ كَٱلۡأَعۡلَٰمِ

en.text: And to Him belong the ships [with sails] elevated in the sea like mountains.

so.text: 24. Isagaa (Alle) leh doonyaha dhex maaxa [5] badda ee buuraha la moodo.
so.footnotes: [5]. Haddii loo akhriyo munshi’aatu markaas macnuhu wuxuu noqon ka muuqda.

ayat.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

en.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

so.text: 25. Ee tee baad Nicmooyinka Rabbigiin beenineysaan?

ayat.arabic: كُلُّ مَنۡ عَلَيۡهَا فَانٖ

en.text: Everyone upon it [i.e., the earth] will perish,

so.text: 26. Dhammaan waxa dhulka korkiisa ah way dhiman.

ayat.arabic: وَيَبۡقَىٰ وَجۡهُ رَبِّكَ ذُو ٱلۡجَلَٰلِ وَٱلۡإِكۡرَامِ

en.text: And there will remain the Face[1597] of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor.
en.footnotes: [1597] See footnote to 2:19.

so.text: 27. Waxaase waari abadki Wejiga Rabbigaa Haybadda iyo Sharafta Badan.

ayat.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

en.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

so.text: 28. Ee tee baad Nicmooyinka Rabbigiin beenineysaan?

ayat.arabic: يَسۡـَٔلُهُۥ مَن فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ كُلَّ يَوۡمٍ هُوَ فِي شَأۡنٖ

en.text: Whoever is within the heavens and earth asks Him; every day He is in [i.e., bringing about] a matter.[1598]
en.footnotes: [1598] For each of His creatures.

so.text: 29. Waxaa wax weydiista (Alle) waxa ku sugan  samooyinka iyo arlada. Goor kasta wuxuu agaasimaa arrin.

ayat.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

en.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

so.text: 30. Ee tee baad Nicmooyinka Rabbigiin beenineysaan?

ayat.arabic: سَنَفۡرُغُ لَكُمۡ أَيُّهَ ٱلثَّقَلَانِ

en.text: We will attend to you, O prominent beings.[1599]
en.footnotes: [1599] Specifically two: mankind and jinn.

so.text: 31. Waanu idinla xisaabtami labadiinna ciidammow culculus [6].
so.footnotes: [6]. Waxaa loola jeedaa labadaa culculus dadka iyo jinka.

ayat.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

en.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

so.text: 32. Ee tee baad Nicmooyinka Rabbigiin beenineysaan?

ayat.arabic: يَٰمَعۡشَرَ ٱلۡجِنِّ وَٱلۡإِنسِ إِنِ ٱسۡتَطَعۡتُمۡ أَن تَنفُذُواْ مِنۡ أَقۡطَارِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَٱنفُذُواْۚ لَا تَنفُذُونَ إِلَّا بِسُلۡطَٰنٖ

en.text: O company of jinn and mankind, if you are able to pass beyond the regions of the heavens and the earth, then pass. You will not pass except by authority [from Allāh].

so.text: 33. Kulanka jinka iyo insigoow! Haddaad kartaan inaad ka soo gudubtaan nawaaxiga cirarka iyo dhulka, ka soo gudba. Ma ka soo gudbi kartaan amar la'aan (xag Alle ah).

ayat.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

en.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

so.text: 34. Ee tee baad Nicmooyinka Rabbigiin beenineysaan?

ayat.arabic: يُرۡسَلُ عَلَيۡكُمَا شُوَاظٞ مِّن نَّارٖ وَنُحَاسٞ فَلَا تَنتَصِرَانِ

en.text: There will be sent upon you a flame of fire and smoke,[1600] and you will not defend yourselves.
en.footnotes: [1600] Another possible meaning is liquefied brass or copper.

so.text: 35. Wuxuu idinku soo diri olol naar ah iyo maar 'la dhalaaliyey' [7], ma kareysaan inaad is difaacdaan.
so.footnotes: [7]. Macne kale waa naxaas.

ayat.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

en.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

so.text: 36. Ee tee baad Nicmooyinka Rabbigiin beenineysaan?

ayat.arabic: فَإِذَا ٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتۡ وَرۡدَةٗ كَٱلدِّهَانِ

en.text: And when the heaven is split open and becomes rose-colored like oil[1601] -
en.footnotes: [1601] Or "like a tanned skin."

so.text: 37. Markay samadu dillaacdo oo ay noqoto gaduud sida idiinta [8].
so.footnotes: [8]. Sida harag (maqaar) la magdiyey ee gaduudan, waa Maalinta Qiyaamaha markaas baa la idin abaal marin.

ayat.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

en.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

so.text: 38. Ee tee baad Nicmooyinka Rabbigiin [9] beenineysaan?.
so.footnotes: [9]. Macnaha Rabbi waa Abuuraha, Nooleeyaha, Dhinsiiyaha, maamulaha uunka, Irsaaqaha, iwm. Waana Allaah.

ayat.arabic: فَيَوۡمَئِذٖ لَّا يُسۡـَٔلُ عَن ذَنۢبِهِۦٓ إِنسٞ وَلَا جَآنّٞ

en.text: Then on that Day none will be asked about his sin among men or jinn.[1602]
en.footnotes: [1602] Once they have been condemned to the Fire.

so.text: 39. Maalinkaas waxba lagama weydiiyo denbigooda Insi iyo Jinba (oo waa cad yihiin oo la og yahay, waase lagu qiri).

ayat.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

en.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

so.text: 40. Ee tee baad Nicmooyinka Rabbigiin beenineysaan?

ayat.arabic: يُعۡرَفُ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمُونَ بِسِيمَٰهُمۡ فَيُؤۡخَذُ بِٱلنَّوَٰصِي وَٱلۡأَقۡدَامِ

en.text: The criminals will be known by their marks, and they will be seized by the forelocks and the feet.

so.text: 41. Denbiilayaasha waxaa lagu aqoonsan astaamahooda, markaasaa laga soo qaban foodaha iyo cagaha (oo lagu tuuri Naarta).

ayat.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

en.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

so.text: 42. Ee tee baad Nicmooyinka Rabbigiin beenineysaan?

ayat.arabic: هَٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِي يُكَذِّبُ بِهَا ٱلۡمُجۡرِمُونَ

en.text: This is Hell, which the criminals deny.

so.text: 43. Tanu waa Jahannamadii ay beeniyeen denbiilayaashu.

ayat.arabic: يَطُوفُونَ بَيۡنَهَا وَبَيۡنَ حَمِيمٍ ءَانٖ

en.text: They will circulate between it and scalding water, heated [to the utmost degree].

so.text: 44. Waxay ku meereysan dhexdooda Naarta iyo biyo kulul ee karaya.

ayat.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

en.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

so.text: 45. Ee tee baad Nicmooyinka Rabbigiin beenineysaan?.

ayat.arabic: وَلِمَنۡ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ جَنَّتَانِ

en.text: But for he who has feared the position of his Lord[1603] are two gardens -
en.footnotes: [1603] An alternative meaning is "the standing [for account] before his Lord."

so.text: 46. Kii se ka cabsada hor istaagga Rabbigi, wuxuu mudan labo beerood (Jannada gudaheed).

ayat.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

en.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

so.text: 47. Ee tee baad Nicmooyinka Rabbigiin beenineysaan?

ayat.arabic: ذَوَاتَآ أَفۡنَانٖ

en.text: Having [spreading] branches.

so.text: 48. (Labadaa beerood oo) leh midabyo kala duwan iyo laamo.

ayat.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

en.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

so.text: 49. Ee tee baad Nicmooyinka Rabbigiin beenineysaan?.

ayat.arabic: فِيهِمَا عَيۡنَانِ تَجۡرِيَانِ

en.text: In both of them are two springs, flowing.

so.text: 50. Dhexdooda (labadaa beerood) waxaa ah labo ilood oo dur dur ah.

ayat.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

en.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

so.text: 51. Ee tee baad Nicmooyinka Rabbigiin beenineysaan?.

ayat.arabic: فِيهِمَا مِن كُلِّ فَٰكِهَةٖ زَوۡجَانِ

en.text: In both of them are of every fruit, two kinds.

so.text: 52. Dhexdooda waxaa ah (labadaa beerood) midho nooc kasta oo lammaane ah.

ayat.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

en.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

so.text: 53. Ee tee baad Nicmooyinka Rabbigiin beenineysaan?

ayat.arabic: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ فُرُشِۭ بَطَآئِنُهَا مِنۡ إِسۡتَبۡرَقٖۚ وَجَنَى ٱلۡجَنَّتَيۡنِ دَانٖ

en.text: [They are] reclining on beds whose linings are of silk brocade, and the fruit of the two gardens is hanging low.

so.text: 54. Iyagoo ku dangiigsan firaashyo cudbi-goodu xariir yahay, midhaha labadaa beeroodna waxay ahaan kuwo goosi dhow.

ayat.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

en.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

so.text: 55. Ee tee baad Nicmooyinka Rabbigiin beenineysaan?

ayat.arabic: فِيهِنَّ قَٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرۡفِ لَمۡ يَطۡمِثۡهُنَّ إِنسٞ قَبۡلَهُمۡ وَلَا جَآنّٞ

en.text: In them are women limiting [their] glances,[1604] untouched[1605] before them by man or jinnī -
en.footnotes:
[1604] To their own mates, i.e., being chaste and modest.
[1605] Literally, they have not been caused to bleed by loss of virginity.

so.text: 56. Waxaa ku sugan (Jannada) kuwaa soo laaba araggooda (ku kooba nimankooda keliya) ka hor iyaga aanu taaban insi iyo jin midkoodna.

ayat.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

en.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

so.text: 57. Ee tee baad Nicmooyinka Rabbigiin beenineysaan?

ayat.arabic: كَأَنَّهُنَّ ٱلۡيَاقُوتُ وَٱلۡمَرۡجَانُ

en.text: As if they were rubies and coral.[1606]
en.footnotes: [1606] In purity, color and beauty.

so.text: 58. (Haweenkaa oo) la moodo dheeman iyo luul.

ayat.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

en.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

so.text: 59. Ee tee baad Nicmooyinka Rabbigiin beenineysaan?

ayat.arabic: هَلۡ جَزَآءُ ٱلۡإِحۡسَٰنِ إِلَّا ٱلۡإِحۡسَٰنُ

en.text: Is the reward for good [anything] but good?

so.text: 60. Wanaag abaalkiisu ma waxaan ahayn baa wanaag?

ayat.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

en.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

so.text: 61. Ee tee baad Nicmooyinka Rabbigiin beenineysaan?

ayat.arabic: وَمِن دُونِهِمَا جَنَّتَانِ

en.text: And below them both [in excellence] are two [other] gardens -

so.text: 62. Barbarkoodana labadatani (beerood), waxaa ah labo beerood oo kale (Jannada).

ayat.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

en.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

so.text: 63. Ee tee baad Nicmooyinka Rabbigiin beenineysaan?

ayat.arabic: مُدۡهَآمَّتَانِ

en.text: Dark green [in color].

so.text: 64. Madow cagaaran ah.

ayat.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

en.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

so.text: 65. Ee tee baad Nicmooyinka Rabbigiin beenineysaan?

ayat.arabic: فِيهِمَا عَيۡنَانِ نَضَّاخَتَانِ

en.text: In both of them are two springs, spouting.

so.text: 66. Dhexdooda (labadaa beerood) waxaa ah labo ilood oo burqanaya.

ayat.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

en.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

so.text: 67. Ee tee baad Nicmooyinka Rabbigiin beenineysaan?

ayat.arabic: فِيهِمَا فَٰكِهَةٞ وَنَخۡلٞ وَرُمَّانٞ

en.text: In both of them are fruit and palm trees and pomegranates.

so.text: 68. Waxaa (labadaa beerood) dhexdooda ah midho, geedo timir iyo Rummaan.

ayat.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

en.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

so.text: 69. Ee tee baad Nicmooyinka Rabbigiin beenineysaan?

ayat.arabic: فِيهِنَّ خَيۡرَٰتٌ حِسَانٞ

en.text: In them are good and beautiful women -

so.text: 70. Dhexdooda waxaa ah (afartaa beerood) xaasas khayr iyo qurux badnooyin ah.

ayat.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

en.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

so.text: 71. Ee tee baad Nicmooyinka Rabbigiin beenineysaan?

ayat.arabic: حُورٞ مَّقۡصُورَٰتٞ فِي ٱلۡخِيَامِ

en.text: Fair ones reserved in pavilions -

so.text: 72. Xuurulceyn ku kooban oo aan ka bixin guryahooda.

ayat.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

en.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

so.text: 73. Ee tee baad Nicmooyinka Rabbigiin beenineysaan?

ayat.arabic: لَمۡ يَطۡمِثۡهُنَّ إِنسٞ قَبۡلَهُمۡ وَلَا جَآنّٞ

en.text: Untouched before them by man or jinnī -

so.text: 74. Aanay horey u taabanin insi iyo jin midkoodna.

ayat.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

en.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

so.text: 75. Ee tee baad Nicmooyinka Rabbigiin beenineysaan?

ayat.arabic: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ رَفۡرَفٍ خُضۡرٖ وَعَبۡقَرِيٍّ حِسَانٖ

en.text: Reclining on green cushions and beautiful fine carpets.

so.text: 76. Iyagoo ku dangiigsan barkimooyin cagaaran iyo gogollo qurux badan.

ayat.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

en.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

so.text: 77. Ee tee baad Nicmooyinka Rabbigiin beenineysaan [10]?
so.footnotes:
[10]. Midna beeninmeyno Allow ka mid ah Nicmooyinkaaga oo ammaan iyo mahad idilkeed Adigaa leh oo ku caabudi Adigoo Keliya annagoon waxba kula wadaajin 
cibaadada.

ayat.arabic: تَبَٰرَكَ ٱسۡمُ رَبِّكَ ذِي ٱلۡجَلَٰلِ وَٱلۡإِكۡرَامِ

en.text: Blessed is the name of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor.

so.text: 78. Waxaa barakadiisu badnaatay Magaca Rabbigaa, Weynaha, Sharafta Badan.

ayat.arabic: إِذَا وَقَعَتِ ٱلۡوَاقِعَةُ

en.text: When the Occurrence occurs,

so.text: 1. Markay dhacdada weyni dhacdo [1].
so.footnotes: [1]. Al-Waaqica: Dhacdada dhici doonta, waxaa loola jeedaa Maalinta Qiyaamaha.

ayat.arabic: لَيۡسَ لِوَقۡعَتِهَا كَاذِبَةٌ

en.text: There is, at its occurrence, no denial.

so.text: 2. Ma jiro dhiciddeeda wax beenin.

ayat.arabic: خَافِضَةٞ رَّافِعَةٌ

en.text: It will bring down [some] and raise up [others].[1608]
en.footnotes: [1608] According to their deeds rather than wealth and social position, as is the case in this world.

so.text: 3. Hoos u dhigeysa (ehlu Naarka) kor u qaadeysa 'ehlu Jannaha' [2].
so.footnotes: [2]. Hadba sida camalkoodu yahay oo looma eegayo maal iyo jago uu hayo siduu yahay xaalka adduunkan.

ayat.arabic: إِذَا رُجَّتِ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ رَجّٗا

en.text: When the earth is shaken with convulsion

so.text: 4. Marka la gilgilo dhulka gilgilid daran.

ayat.arabic: وَبُسَّتِ ٱلۡجِبَالُ بَسّٗا

en.text: And the mountains are broken down, crumbling

so.text: 5. Buuraha la ridqo ridqin daran.

ayat.arabic: فَكَانَتۡ هَبَآءٗ مُّنۢبَثّٗا

en.text: And become dust dispersing,

so.text: 6. Oo ay noqoto sida boor firdhisan.

ayat.arabic: وَكُنتُمۡ أَزۡوَٰجٗا ثَلَٰثَةٗ

en.text: And you become [of] three kinds:

so.text: 7. Oo aad ahaataan (dadow) saddex nooc.

ayat.arabic: فَأَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡمَيۡمَنَةِ مَآ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡمَيۡمَنَةِ

en.text: Then the companions of the right - what are the companions of the right?[1609]
en.footnotes: [1609] i.e., those given their records in their right hand and who are destined for Paradise.

so.text: 8. Kuwa ah Gacanta Midig, waayo kuwa ah Gacanta Midig?

ayat.arabic: وَأَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡمَشۡـَٔمَةِ مَآ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡمَشۡـَٔمَةِ

en.text: And the companions of the left - what are companions of the left?[1610]
en.footnotes: [1610] i.e., those given their records in their left hand and who are destined for Hell.

so.text: 9. Kuwase ah Gacanta Bidix, waayo kuwa ah Gacanta Bidix?

ayat.arabic: وَٱلسَّٰبِقُونَ ٱلسَّٰبِقُونَ

en.text: And the forerunners, the forerunners[1611] -
en.footnotes: [1611] The words can also be understood as a complete sentence, i.e., "The forerunners [in good deeds] are the forerunners [in entering Paradise]."

so.text: 10. Kuwa u hor mara (Iimaanka iyo falashada camallada wanaagsan) iyagaa horreyn [3].
so.footnotes: [3]. Sida anbiyada Alle iyo kuwa horey ka rumeeyey iyagaa hor geli doona Jannada.

ayat.arabic: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلۡمُقَرَّبُونَ

en.text: Those are the ones brought near [to Allāh]

so.text: 11. Waa kuwa loo soo dhoweyn (Ilaahay).

ayat.arabic: فِي جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ

en.text: In the Gardens of Pleasure,

so.text: 12. Waxay Ku sugnaan Beero barwaaqo ah gudahood (jannooyin).

ayat.arabic: ثُلَّةٞ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ

en.text: A [large] company of the former peoples

so.text: 13. (Ay geli) jameeco badan oo ah horraankii (ummadan iyo ummadaha kaleba).

ayat.arabic: وَقَلِيلٞ مِّنَ ٱلۡأٓخِرِينَ

en.text: And a few of the later peoples,

so.text: 14.Iyo in yar oo ka mid ah facyadii dambe [4].
so.footnotes: [4]. Waxaa loola jeedaa kuwii ahaa aakhirka ummaddan.

ayat.arabic: عَلَىٰ سُرُرٖ مَّوۡضُونَةٖ

en.text: On thrones woven [with ornament],

so.text: 15. Iyagoo ku sugnaan sariiro dahab lagu qurxiyey.

ayat.arabic: مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَيۡهَا مُتَقَٰبِلِينَ

en.text: Reclining on them, facing each other.

so.text: 16. Ku dangiigsan korkeeda, si fool ka fool ah.

ayat.arabic: يَطُوفُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وِلۡدَٰنٞ مُّخَلَّدُونَ

en.text: There will circulate among them young boys made eternal

so.text: 17. Waxaa u adeegi wiilal waaraya aanay da’ doorin, kuwaa oo kula wareegi doona,

ayat.arabic: بِأَكۡوَابٖ وَأَبَارِيقَ وَكَأۡسٖ مِّن مَّعِينٖ

en.text: With vessels, pitchers and a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring -

so.text: 18. Koobab iyo kirliyo iyo galaasyo (khamri saafi ah) xagga il socota (Jannada).

ayat.arabic: لَّا يُصَدَّعُونَ عَنۡهَا وَلَا يُنزِفُونَ

en.text: No headache will they have therefrom, nor will they be intoxicated -

so.text: 19. Aanu marnaba madaxu ku wareerin kuna maan guurin.

ayat.arabic: وَفَٰكِهَةٖ مِّمَّا يَتَخَيَّرُونَ

en.text: And fruit of what they select

so.text: 20. Iyo midho waxay doortaan ah.

ayat.arabic: وَلَحۡمِ طَيۡرٖ مِّمَّا يَشۡتَهُونَ

en.text: And the meat of fowl, from whatever they desire.

so.text: 21. Iyo hilib shimbiro kay rabaanba.

ayat.arabic: وَحُورٌ عِينٞ

en.text: And [for them are] fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes,

so.text: 22. Oo (ay u wehelin doonaan) xuurul cayn.

ayat.arabic: كَأَمۡثَٰلِ ٱللُّؤۡلُوِٕ ٱلۡمَكۡنُونِ

en.text: The likenesses of pearls well-protected,

so.text: 23. La moodo luul la dhowray.

ayat.arabic: جَزَآءَۢ بِمَا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ

en.text: As reward for what they used to do.

so.text: 24. Waa abaalgud waxay camalsan fali jireen.

ayat.arabic: لَا يَسۡمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغۡوٗا وَلَا تَأۡثِيمًا

en.text: They will not hear therein ill speech or commission of sin -

so.text: 25. Kuma maqlaan (Jannada) hadal macno darro ah iyo denbi midna.

ayat.arabic: إِلَّا قِيلٗا سَلَٰمٗا سَلَٰمٗا

en.text: Only a saying [of] peace, peace.

so.text: 26. Waxaan ahayn odhaahda nabad nabad.

ayat.arabic: وَأَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡيَمِينِ مَآ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡيَمِينِ

en.text: The companions of the right - what are the companions of the right?

so.text: 27. Kuwa ah Gacanta Midig, waayo kuwaa ah Gacanta Midig (ehlu Jannaha)?

ayat.arabic: فِي سِدۡرٖ مَّخۡضُودٖ

en.text: [They will be] among lote trees with thorns removed

so.text: 28. (Waxay dhex ahaan) geedo gob aan qodax lahayn.

ayat.arabic: وَطَلۡحٖ مَّنضُودٖ

en.text: And [banana] trees layered [with fruit]

so.text: 29. Iyo geedo Muus ah midho karooran.

ayat.arabic: وَظِلّٖ مَّمۡدُودٖ

en.text: And shade extended

so.text: 30. Iyo har fidsan,

ayat.arabic: وَمَآءٖ مَّسۡكُوبٖ

en.text: And water poured out

so.text: 31. Iyo biyo u socda joogto,

ayat.arabic: وَفَٰكِهَةٖ كَثِيرَةٖ

en.text: And fruit, abundant [and varied],

so.text: 32. Iyo midho tiro badan.

ayat.arabic: لَّا مَقۡطُوعَةٖ وَلَا مَمۡنُوعَةٖ

en.text: Neither limited [to season] nor forbidden,

so.text: 33. Marnaba aan go’eyn, la isuna diideyn.

ayat.arabic: وَفُرُشٖ مَّرۡفُوعَةٍ

en.text: And [upon] beds raised high.

so.text: 34. iyo joodariyaal sare loo qaaday (oo sariiro saaran).

ayat.arabic: إِنَّآ أَنشَأۡنَٰهُنَّ إِنشَآءٗ

en.text: Indeed, We have produced them [i.e., the women of Paradise] in a [new] creation

so.text: 35. Waxaan Annaga (Alle ah) ka yeeli inay soo baxaan iyaga (haweenka Jannada) soo bixid gaar ah.

ayat.arabic: فَجَعَلۡنَٰهُنَّ أَبۡكَارًا

en.text: And made them virgins,

so.text: 36. Kana dhigi bikrooyin ugub ah.

ayat.arabic: عُرُبًا أَتۡرَابٗا

en.text: Devoted [to their husbands] and of equal age,

so.text: 37. Gacalooyin (jecel nimankooda), isku wada da’ ah.

ayat.arabic: لِّأَصۡحَٰبِ ٱلۡيَمِينِ

en.text: For the companions of the right [who are]

so.text: 38. Oo ay leeyihiin kuwa ah Gacanta Midig.

ayat.arabic: ثُلَّةٞ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ

en.text: A company of the former peoples

so.text: 39. Kuwo badan oo ka mid ah waa facyadii hore.

ayat.arabic: وَثُلَّةٞ مِّنَ ٱلۡأٓخِرِينَ

en.text: And a company of the later peoples.

so.text: 40. Kuwo badan oo ka mid ahna facyada dambe.

ayat.arabic: وَأَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلشِّمَالِ مَآ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلشِّمَالِ

en.text: And the companions of the left - what are the companions of the left?

so.text: 41.Kuwase ah Gacanta Bidix- waayo kuwaa ah Gacanta Bidix (ehlu Naarka)?

ayat.arabic: فِي سَمُومٖ وَحَمِيمٖ

en.text: [They will be] in scorching fire and scalding water

so.text: 42. Waxay dhex ahaan hanfi kulul iyo biyo karkaraya.

ayat.arabic: وَظِلّٖ مِّن يَحۡمُومٖ

en.text: And a shade of black smoke,

so.text: 43. Iyo hoos qiiq badan.

ayat.arabic: لَّا بَارِدٖ وَلَا كَرِيمٍ

en.text: Neither cool nor beneficial.

so.text: 44. Aan laheyn qabow iyo arag fiican midna.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ قَبۡلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُتۡرَفِينَ

en.text: Indeed they were, before that, indulging in affluence,

so.text: 45. Waxay ahaayeen taa horteed (adduunka) kuwo ku raaxeysta (xaaraan).

ayat.arabic: وَكَانُواْ يُصِرُّونَ عَلَى ٱلۡحِنثِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ

en.text: And they used to persist in the great violation,[1612]
en.footnotes: [1612] i.e., shirk (association with Allāh) or disbelief.

so.text: 46. Oo waxay ku adkeysan jireen Denbiga weyn (shirkiga).

ayat.arabic: وَكَانُواْ يَقُولُونَ أَئِذَا مِتۡنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابٗا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبۡعُوثُونَ

en.text: And they used to say, "When we die and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?

so.text: 47. Waxay odhan jireen: Ma markaan dhimanno oo noqonno carro iyo lafo, miyaa nala soo nooleyn (dhimashada kaddib)?.

ayat.arabic: أَوَءَابَآؤُنَا ٱلۡأَوَّلُونَ

en.text: And our forefathers [as well]?"

so.text: 48. Sidoo kale miyaa aabbayaashayadii hore (la soo nooleyn)?

ayat.arabic: قُلۡ إِنَّ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ وَٱلۡأٓخِرِينَ

en.text: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Indeed, the former and later peoples

so.text: 49. Dheh, kuwii hore iyo kuwa dambaba.

ayat.arabic: لَمَجۡمُوعُونَ إِلَىٰ مِيقَٰتِ يَوۡمٖ مَّعۡلُومٖ

en.text: Are to be gathered together for the appointment of a known Day."

so.text: 50. Waxaa hubaal loo soo kulmin wada jir madal Maalin la yaqaan (Qiyaamada).

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمۡ أَيُّهَا ٱلضَّآلُّونَ ٱلۡمُكَذِّبُونَ

en.text: Then indeed you, O those astray [who are] deniers,

so.text: 51. Markaas idinka kuwiinan habowsana- yaasha ahow, ee beeniyow (Qiyaamaha).

ayat.arabic: لَأٓكِلُونَ مِن شَجَرٖ مِّن زَقُّومٖ

en.text: Will be eating from trees of zaqqūm

so.text: 52. Waxaad wax ka cuneysaan geed xun oo Zaqquum ah [5].
so.footnotes: [5]. Waa geed Naarta ku yaal oo u keena xanuun daran qofkii cuna.

ayat.arabic: فَمَالِـُٔونَ مِنۡهَا ٱلۡبُطُونَ

en.text: And filling with it your bellies

so.text: 53. Oo ka buuxineysaan caloolihiinna.

ayat.arabic: فَشَٰرِبُونَ عَلَيۡهِ مِنَ ٱلۡحَمِيمِ

en.text: And drinking on top of it from scalding water

so.text: 54. Waxaad ku dul cabbeyssan biyo kulul oo karkaraya.

ayat.arabic: فَشَٰرِبُونَ شُرۡبَ ٱلۡهِيمِ

en.text: And will drink as the drinking of thirsty camels.

so.text: 55. U cabbeysaan sida cabbidda geel asqoobay.

ayat.arabic: هَٰذَا نُزُلُهُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلدِّينِ

en.text: That is their accommodation on the Day of Recompense.

so.text: 56. Kaasi waa waxa lagu soori (gaalada) Maalinta Abaal marinta (Qiyaamaha).

ayat.arabic: نَحۡنُ خَلَقۡنَٰكُمۡ فَلَوۡلَا تُصَدِّقُونَ

en.text: We have created you, so why do you not believe?

so.text: 57. Annagaa (Alle ah) idin abuurnay, ee maxaad la rumeyn weydeen?

ayat.arabic: أَفَرَءَيۡتُم مَّا تُمۡنُونَ

en.text: Have you seen that which you emit?[1613]
en.footnotes: [1613] i.e., semen, which contains the potential for human life.

so.text: 58. Ma u fiirsateen minada idinka timaadda (biyo bixiinna - shawada)?

ayat.arabic: ءَأَنتُمۡ تَخۡلُقُونَهُۥٓ أَمۡ نَحۡنُ ٱلۡخَٰلِقُونَ

en.text: Is it you who creates it, or are We the Creator?

so.text: 59. Ma idinkaa abuura mise waa Annaga (Alle ah) Abuurayaasha?

ayat.arabic: نَحۡنُ قَدَّرۡنَا بَيۡنَكُمُ ٱلۡمَوۡتَ وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمَسۡبُوقِينَ

en.text: We have decreed death among you, and We are not to be outdone

so.text: 60. Annagaa idiin qaddarnay dhimashada dhexdiinna, mana jiro qof naga baxsan kara.

ayat.arabic: عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ أَمۡثَٰلَكُمۡ وَنُنشِئَكُمۡ فِي مَا لَا تَعۡلَمُونَ

en.text: In that We will change your likenesses and produce you in that [form] which you do not know.[1614]
en.footnotes: [1614] An alternative meaning has also been given: "...in that We will replace the likes of you [with others upon the earth] and create you [in the Hereafter] in that which you do not know."

so.text: 61. Inaan idinku beddelno kuwa idinla mid ah oo aan idiin soo saarno (qaabab iyo suurado) aydaan garaneyn.

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ عَلِمۡتُمُ ٱلنَّشۡأَةَ ٱلۡأُولَىٰ فَلَوۡلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ

en.text: And you have already known the first creation, so will you not remember?

so.text: 62.  Waadna og tihiin abuuriddii hore, ee miyeydaan waantoobeyn?

ayat.arabic: أَفَرَءَيۡتُم مَّا تَحۡرُثُونَ

en.text: And have you seen that [seed] which you sow?

so.text: 63. Ma u fiirsateen waxaad beertaan?;

ayat.arabic: ءَأَنتُمۡ تَزۡرَعُونَهُۥٓ أَمۡ نَحۡنُ ٱلزَّٰرِعُونَ

en.text: Is it you who makes it grow, or are We the grower?

so.text: 64. Ma idinkaa soo bixiya, mise waa Annaga (Alle ah) Kuwa soo Bixiya?

ayat.arabic: لَوۡ نَشَآءُ لَجَعَلۡنَٰهُ حُطَٰمٗا فَظَلۡتُمۡ تَفَكَّهُونَ

en.text: If We willed, We could make it [dry] debris, and you would remain in wonder,[1615]
en.footnotes: [1615] At what had happened or remain in a state of shock. Another meaning is "in regret."

so.text: 65. Haddaan Doonno,waxaan ka dhigeynaa xaabo engagan, markaasaad ka xumaan.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّا لَمُغۡرَمُونَ

en.text: [Saying], "Indeed, we are [now] in debt;

so.text: 66. (idinkoo leh): Waa nala khasaariyey.

ayat.arabic: بَلۡ نَحۡنُ مَحۡرُومُونَ

en.text: Rather, we have been deprived."

so.text: 67. Balse waa nala hoojiyey.

ayat.arabic: أَفَرَءَيۡتُمُ ٱلۡمَآءَ ٱلَّذِي تَشۡرَبُونَ

en.text: And have you seen the water that you drink?

so.text: 68. Ma u fiirsateen biyahaad cabtaan?

ayat.arabic: ءَأَنتُمۡ أَنزَلۡتُمُوهُ مِنَ ٱلۡمُزۡنِ أَمۡ نَحۡنُ ٱلۡمُنزِلُونَ

en.text: Is it you who brought it down from the clouds, or is it We who bring it down?

so.text: 69. Ma idinkaa kuwa ka soo dejiya daruura- ha, mise Annaga weeye kuwa soo dejiya?

ayat.arabic: لَوۡ نَشَآءُ جَعَلۡنَٰهُ أُجَاجٗا فَلَوۡلَا تَشۡكُرُونَ

en.text: If We willed, We could make it bitter, so why are you not grateful?

so.text: 70.Haddaan doonno, Waxaan ka dhigeynaa jaan dhanaan oo milix ah (aan la dhami karin), ee maad ku shukridaan (Alle)?

ayat.arabic: أَفَرَءَيۡتُمُ ٱلنَّارَ ٱلَّتِي تُورُونَ

en.text: And have you seen the fire that you ignite?

so.text: 71. Ma u fiirsateen dabka aad madagta ka shiddaan.

ayat.arabic: ءَأَنتُمۡ أَنشَأۡتُمۡ شَجَرَتَهَآ أَمۡ نَحۡنُ ٱلۡمُنشِـُٔونَ

en.text: Is it you who produced its tree, or are We the producer?

so.text: 72. Ma idinkaa kuwa u soo saara geedaha, mise Annaga (Alle ah) weeye soo saarayaasha?

ayat.arabic: نَحۡنُ جَعَلۡنَٰهَا تَذۡكِرَةٗ وَمَتَٰعٗا لِّلۡمُقۡوِينَ

en.text: We have made it a reminder[1616] and provision for the travelers,[1617]
en.footnotes:
[1616] Of the great fire of Hell.
[1617] In the form of flints or other means by which to ignite fire. Travelers are mentioned because of the special convenience to them, although it is a provision for all people in general.

so.text: 73. Annaga (Alle ah) baa waxaynu ka dhignay xusuus; iyo waxay ku intifaacaan kuwa ku safra saxraha 'iyo qeyrkoodba' [6].
so.footnotes: [6]. Musaafiriinta ama socotada waxaa halkan loogu xusay gaar ahaan inuu arrinkaasi mudnaan gaar ah u leeyahay iyaga, inkastoo uu yahay sahay ay u baahan yihiin dadka guud ahaan. Dabkana waxaa lagu xusuustaa Naarta Aakhiro.

ayat.arabic: فَسَبِّحۡ بِٱسۡمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ

en.text: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.

so.text: 74. Ee xurmee oo ku tasbiixso Magaca Rabbigaa, Weynaha, Sharafta Badan.

ayat.arabic: ۞ فَلَآ أُقۡسِمُ بِمَوَٰقِعِ ٱلنُّجُومِ

en.text: Then I swear by the setting of the stars,[1618]
en.footnotes: [1618] Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) confirms absolutely by oath.

so.text: 75. Mayee, waxaan ku dhaartay halkay xiddiguhu ku dhacaan.

ayat.arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَقَسَمٞ لَّوۡ تَعۡلَمُونَ عَظِيمٌ

en.text: And indeed, it is an oath - if you could know - [most] great.

so.text: 76. Xaqiiqna waa dhaar weyn, haddaad ogaan lahaydeen.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ لَقُرۡءَانٞ كَرِيمٞ

en.text: Indeed, it is a noble Qur’ān.

so.text: 77. Hubaal kani waa Qur'aan Sharaf Badan.

ayat.arabic: فِي كِتَٰبٖ مَّكۡنُونٖ

en.text: In a Register well-protected;[1619].
en.footnotes: [1619] The Preserved Slate (al-Lawḥ al-Maḥfūẓ), which is with Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā).

so.text: 78. Ku yaal Kitaab aad la dhowray (Looxa Maxfuudka).

ayat.arabic: لَّا يَمَسُّهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱلۡمُطَهَّرُونَ

en.text: None touch it except the purified [i.e., the angels].

so.text: 79. Cidna taaban kuwa la daahiriyey mooyee (malaa’igta).

ayat.arabic: تَنزِيلٞ مِّن رَّبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

en.text: [It is] a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.

so.text: 80. Waa soo dejinta Rabbiga uumanka.

ayat.arabic: أَفَبِهَٰذَا ٱلۡحَدِيثِ أَنتُم مُّدۡهِنُونَ

en.text: Then is it to this statement that you are indifferent

so.text: 81. Ma warkan (Qur’aanka) baad (gaaloy) u qaadataan wax fudud aan qiimo lahayn?

ayat.arabic: وَتَجۡعَلُونَ رِزۡقَكُمۡ أَنَّكُمۡ تُكَذِّبُونَ

en.text: And make [the thanks for] your provision that you deny [the Provider]?

so.text: 82. oo aad ka yeeleysaan (mahaddii) risiqiinna beenin (Xaqa).

ayat.arabic: فَلَوۡلَآ إِذَا بَلَغَتِ ٱلۡحُلۡقُومَ

en.text: Then why, when it [i.e., the soul at death] reaches the throat

so.text: 83. Maxaydaan markay (naftu) dhuunta gaadho.

ayat.arabic: وَأَنتُمۡ حِينَئِذٖ تَنظُرُونَ

en.text: And you are at that time looking on -

so.text: 84. Idinkuna markaas aad u jeeddaan (qofka dhiman).

ayat.arabic: وَنَحۡنُ أَقۡرَبُ إِلَيۡهِ مِنكُمۡ وَلَٰكِن لَّا تُبۡصِرُونَ

en.text: And We [i.e., Our angels] are nearer to him than you, but you do not see -

so.text: 85. Annaguna (Alle ah Ogaal iyo Awood ahaan iyo malaa’igtayada) idiinka dhownahay, laakiinse aydaan arkayn.

ayat.arabic: فَلَوۡلَآ إِن كُنتُمۡ غَيۡرَ مَدِينِينَ

en.text: Then why do you not, if you are not to be recompensed,

so.text: 86. Haddaad tihiin kuwo aan la soo bixineyn oo la xisaabineyn (Aakhirada).

ayat.arabic: تَرۡجِعُونَهَآ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ

en.text: Bring it back,[1620] if you should be truthful?
en.footnotes: [1620] i.e., return the soul to the body, meaning that just as you cannot prevent death when it is decreed, you will not escape the recompense when it is decreed.

so.text: 87. Maxaad Ugu soo celin (weydeen) nafta (jirkeedii) haddaad run sheegeysaan?

ayat.arabic: فَأَمَّآ إِن كَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُقَرَّبِينَ

en.text: And if he [i.e., the deceased] was of those brought near [to Allāh],

so.text: 88. Hadduu ka mid yahay kuwa loo soo dhoweeyo (Allaah).

ayat.arabic: فَرَوۡحٞ وَرَيۡحَانٞ وَجَنَّتُ نَعِيمٖ

en.text: Then [for him is] rest and bounty and a garden of pleasure.

so.text: 89. Waxaa u ahaaday raaxo, reynreyn, reexaan udgoon iyo Janno barwaaqo ah.

ayat.arabic: وَأَمَّآ إِن كَانَ مِنۡ أَصۡحَٰبِ ٱلۡيَمِينِ

en.text: And if he was of the companions of the right,

so.text: 90. Hadduu ka mid yahayse kuwa ah gacanta midig (ehlu Jannada).

ayat.arabic: فَسَلَٰمٞ لَّكَ مِنۡ أَصۡحَٰبِ ٱلۡيَمِينِ

en.text: Then [the angels will say], "Peace for you; [you are] from the companions of the right."

so.text: 91. Nabad baa idiin sugnaatay kuwa ahow gacanta midig.

ayat.arabic: وَأَمَّآ إِن كَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ

en.text: But if he was of the deniers [who were] astray,

so.text: 92. Haddiise uu ka mid yahay (Xaq) beeniyayaasha, habowsanaaysaha ah.

ayat.arabic: فَنُزُلٞ مِّنۡ حَمِيمٖ

en.text: Then [for him is] accommodation of scalding water

so.text: 93. Waxaa lagu sooryeen biyo kulul oo karaya.

ayat.arabic: وَتَصۡلِيَةُ جَحِيمٍ

en.text: And burning in Hellfire.

so.text: 94. Iyo ku gubasho Dabka aan dameyn ee ololka badan (Naarta).

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَهُوَ حَقُّ ٱلۡيَقِينِ

en.text: Indeed, this is the true certainty,

so.text: 95. Arrinkani waa run la hubo oo xaqiiq ah.

ayat.arabic: فَسَبِّحۡ بِٱسۡمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ

en.text: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.

so.text: 96. Ee xurmee oo huf Magaca Rabbigaa, Weynaha, Sharafta Badan.

ayat.arabic: سَبَّحَ لِلَّهِ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ

en.text: Whatever is in the heavens and earth exalts Allāh,[1622] and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
en.footnotes: [1622] By praising Him and declaring Him far above and beyond any failure or imperfection.

so.text: 1. Waxaa xurmo weyneeya oo (ceeb iyo nuqsaan ka) hufa Alle Waxa ku sugan samooyinka iyo arlada [1]. Waana Adkaadaha, Xikmadda Badan.
so.footnotes: [1]. Iyagoo ammaana oo caddeeya inuu ka hufan yahay xumaan oo dhan oo uusan laheyn xaas, ilmo, iyo shariig.

ayat.arabic: لَهُۥ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ يُحۡيِۦ وَيُمِيتُۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٌ

en.text: His is the dominion of the heavens and earth. He gives life and causes death, and He is over all things competent.

so.text: 2. Isagaa (Alle) leh Boqortooyada samooyinka iyo arlada, wax nooleeya oo dhinsiiya; Isagaana wax walba Kara.

ayat.arabic: هُوَ ٱلۡأَوَّلُ وَٱلۡأٓخِرُ وَٱلظَّٰهِرُ وَٱلۡبَاطِنُۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيمٌ

en.text: He is the First[1623] and the Last,[1624] the Ascendant[1625] and the Intimate,[1626] and He is, of all things, Knowing.
en.footnotes:
[1623] Before whom nothing existed. Also, He who is supreme, foremost or uppermost.
[1624] Enduring eternally when nothing else remains.
[1625] Nothing being above Him. Another meaning is "the Apparent," i.e., evident through His creation and revelation.
[1626] Nothing being nearer than Him by way of His knowledge. Another meaning is "the Unapparent," i.e., concealed from man's physical senses.

so.text: 3. Waa Isaga (Alle) Kan horreeyey iyo Kan dambeyn, iyo Kan ka sarreeya wax walba ee kor jira (samada, Carshigiisa dushiisa) iyo Kan Dhowaanshaha Badan. Isagaana Wax walba Ogsoon.

ayat.arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٖ ثُمَّ ٱسۡتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلۡعَرۡشِۖ يَعۡلَمُ مَا يَلِجُ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا يَخۡرُجُ مِنۡهَا وَمَا يَنزِلُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا يَعۡرُجُ فِيهَاۖ وَهُوَ مَعَكُمۡ أَيۡنَ مَا كُنتُمۡۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ بَصِيرٞ

en.text: It is He who created the heavens and earth in six days and then established Himself above the Throne.[1627] He knows what penetrates into the earth and what emerges from it and what descends from the heaven and what ascends therein; and He is with you[1628] wherever you are. And Allāh, of what you do, is Seeing.
en.footnotes:
[1627] See footnotes to 2:19 and 7:54.
[1628] In knowledge - observing and witnessing.

so.text: 4. Waa Isaga 'Alle' Kan ku abuuray samooyinka iyo arlada lix maalmood, markaas dul ahaaday Carshigiisa. Wuxuu Og yahay waxa gala arlada iyo waxa ka soo baxa, iyo waxa ka soo dega cirka iyo waxa kor u fuula. Wuuna idinla jiraa meel aad joogtaanba [2]. Alle Wuu Arkaa waxaad fashaan.
so.footnotes: [2]. Wuxuu idinkula jiraa Cilmigiisa – isagoo ka kor ah cirarka, ka baxsan oo soocan uunkiisa, sidaas oy tahay wuu idin arkaa oo maqlaa oo awood dhan idinku dul leeyahay.

ayat.arabic: لَّهُۥ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ تُرۡجَعُ ٱلۡأُمُورُ
