en.text: The example of those who were entrusted with the Torah and then did not take it on[1687] is like that of a donkey who carries volumes [of books].[1688] Wretched is the example of the people who deny the signs of Allāh. And Allāh does not guide the wrongdoing people.
en.footnotes:
[1687] i.e., neglected their responsibility towards it by not putting its teachings into practice.
[1688] But does not benefit from their contents.

so.text: 5. Tusaalaha kuwaa loo xil saaray Towraad- da, markaas aan ku camal falin oo gabay qaadista 'xilkaa' [2], waa sida dameer xambaarsan kutub [3] culus (aanse waxba ka fahmin). Xumaa tusaalaha kuwa beeniya Aayadaha Alle. Alle ma hanuuniyo qoloda daalimiinta ah (gar diidka).
so.footnotes:
[2]. Waa dayacay xilkooda ka saarnaa inay dhaqan geliyaan waxa ku soo arooray oo amarro ah Kitaabkooda oo ka joogaan waxa laga reebay. 
[3]. Ha yeeshee aan ka faa’idin waxa ku yaal oo xikmad iyo khayr ah.

ayat.arabic: قُلۡ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ هَادُوٓاْ إِن زَعَمۡتُمۡ أَنَّكُمۡ أَوۡلِيَآءُ لِلَّهِ مِن دُونِ ٱلنَّاسِ فَتَمَنَّوُاْ ٱلۡمَوۡتَ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ

en.text: Say, "O you who are Jews, if you claim that you are allies of Allāh, excluding the [other] people, then wish for death, if you should be truthful."

so.text: 6.Dheh: Idinka heysta diinta Yuhuudiyadow! Haddaad sheegataan inaad tihiin awliyo Alle [4], dadka kale ka sokow, jeclaada dhimasho haddaad run sheegeysaan.
so.footnotes: [4]. Awliyo Alle waxaa loola jeedaa kuwo rumeysan towxiidka ee hanuunsan ee iska jira shirkiga iyo macaasida, awliyo Ilaahay waa kuwa ku dhaqma sharciga Ilaahay.

ayat.arabic: وَلَا يَتَمَنَّوۡنَهُۥٓ أَبَدَۢا بِمَا قَدَّمَتۡ أَيۡدِيهِمۡۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمُۢ بِٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ

en.text: But they will not wish for it, ever, because of what their hands have put forth. And Allāh is Knowing of the wrongdoers.

so.text: 7. Ma jeclaanayaanna weligood 'dhimasho' waxay gacmahoodu horay u geysteen darteed (oo denbiyo ah). Alle waa Og yahay daalimiinta (gar ma qaatayaasha).

ayat.arabic: قُلۡ إِنَّ ٱلۡمَوۡتَ ٱلَّذِي تَفِرُّونَ مِنۡهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مُلَٰقِيكُمۡۖ ثُمَّ تُرَدُّونَ إِلَىٰ عَٰلِمِ ٱلۡغَيۡبِ وَٱلشَّهَٰدَةِ فَيُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ

en.text: Say, "Indeed, the death from which you flee - indeed, it will meet you. Then you will be returned to the Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, and He will inform you about what you used to do."

so.text: 8. Waxaad ku dhahdaa: Geerida aad ka carartaan, way idinla kulmi, markaasaa dib la idiinku soo celin xagga (Alle) Ogsoonaha waxa aan muuqan iyo waxa muuqda,  Wuxuuna idiin sheegi (idinka jaazeyn) waxaad camal fali jirteen.

ayat.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِذَا نُودِيَ لِلصَّلَوٰةِ مِن يَوۡمِ ٱلۡجُمُعَةِ فَٱسۡعَوۡاْ إِلَىٰ ذِكۡرِ ٱللَّهِ وَذَرُواْ ٱلۡبَيۡعَۚ ذَٰلِكُمۡ خَيۡرٞ لَّكُمۡ إِن كُنتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُونَ

en.text: O you who have believed, when [the adhān] is called for the prayer on the day of Jumuʿah [Friday], then proceed to the remembrance of Allāh and leave trade. That is better for you, if you only knew.

so.text: 9. Kuwa (Xaqa) rumeeyow! Marka la isugu yeedho salaadda maalinta Jimcaha,  u degedga Xusidda Alle, kana taga ganacsiga, sidaas baa idiin khayr badan, haddaad ogtihiin.

ayat.arabic: فَإِذَا قُضِيَتِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةُ فَٱنتَشِرُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَٱبۡتَغُواْ مِن فَضۡلِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱذۡكُرُواْ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرٗا لَّعَلَّكُمۡ تُفۡلِحُونَ

en.text: And when the prayer has been concluded, disperse within the land and seek from the bounty of Allāh, and remember Allāh often that you may succeed.

so.text: 10. Markase salaadda la dhammeeyo, ku kala faafa arlada, dalba Deeqda Alle [5], xusana Alle in badan aad liibaantaane.
so.footnotes: [5]. Macnaha waa aada qaraabo salaan, booqda qof buka, fasha camallo san, akhrista Qur'aanka, xusa Alle, oo badiya ku sallinta Nabiga s.c.w.

ayat.arabic: وَإِذَا رَأَوۡاْ تِجَٰرَةً أَوۡ لَهۡوًا ٱنفَضُّوٓاْ إِلَيۡهَا وَتَرَكُوكَ قَآئِمٗاۚ قُلۡ مَا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ خَيۡرٞ مِّنَ ٱللَّهۡوِ وَمِنَ ٱلتِّجَٰرَةِۚ وَٱللَّهُ خَيۡرُ ٱلرَّٰزِقِينَ

en.text: But [on one occasion] when they saw a transaction or a diversion, [O Muḥammad], they rushed to it and left you standing. Say, "What is with Allāh is better than diversion and than a transaction, and Allāh is the best of providers."

so.text: 11. Mar ay arkeen ganacsi ama madaddaallo way u kala yaaceen xaggeeda, kaana tageen (Nabiyow) adigoo taagan (oo khudbo jeedin). Dheh: Waxa Alle uu heysto baa ka khayr badan madaddaallo oo (ka khayr badan) ganacsi kasta. Alle waa Kan u wanaagsan inta wax irsaaqda.

ayat.arabic: إِذَا جَآءَكَ ٱلۡمُنَٰفِقُونَ قَالُواْ نَشۡهَدُ إِنَّكَ لَرَسُولُ ٱللَّهِۗ وَٱللَّهُ يَعۡلَمُ إِنَّكَ لَرَسُولُهُۥ وَٱللَّهُ يَشۡهَدُ إِنَّ ٱلۡمُنَٰفِقِينَ لَكَٰذِبُونَ

en.text: When the hypocrites come to you, [O Muḥammad], they say, "We testify that you are the Messenger of Allāh." And Allāh knows that you are His Messenger, and Allāh testifies that the hypocrites are liars.

so.text: 1. Markay munaafiqiintu kuu yimaadaan (Nabi Muxammadow) waxay yidhaahdaan: Waxaanu marag ka nahay inaad tahay Rasuul Alle [1]. Alle waa Og yahay inaad tahay Rasuulkiisa, Allena wuxuu marag ka yahay inay munaafiqiintu yihiin beenaalayaal.
so.footnotes: [1]. Waxay ugu dhaarteen si ay u badbaadsadaan maalkooda iyo nafahooda oo loo nabad geliyo maadaama ay daahirka muslimiiin yihiin.

ayat.arabic: ٱتَّخَذُوٓاْ أَيۡمَٰنَهُمۡ جُنَّةٗ فَصَدُّواْ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِۚ إِنَّهُمۡ سَآءَ مَا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ

en.text: They have taken their oaths as a cover, so they averted [people] from the way of Allāh. Indeed, it was evil that they were doing.

so.text: 2.Waxay ka dhigtaan dhaarahooda   gaashaan. Oo sidaas uga weeciyaan (dadka) jidka Alle. Xumaa waxay falaan.

ayat.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمۡ ءَامَنُواْ ثُمَّ كَفَرُواْ فَطُبِعَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمۡ فَهُمۡ لَا يَفۡقَهُونَ

en.text: That is because they believed, and then they disbelieved; so their hearts were sealed over, and they do not understand.

so.text: 3. (Arrin)kaasi waxaa ugu wacan inta rumeeyaan (af ahaan) bay haddana (hoosta) ka gaaloobaan, markaasaa quluubtooda la daboolay, sidaas awgeed wax ma fahmaan.

ayat.arabic: ۞ وَإِذَا رَأَيۡتَهُمۡ تُعۡجِبُكَ أَجۡسَامُهُمۡۖ وَإِن يَقُولُواْ تَسۡمَعۡ لِقَوۡلِهِمۡۖ كَأَنَّهُمۡ خُشُبٞ مُّسَنَّدَةٞۖ يَحۡسَبُونَ كُلَّ صَيۡحَةٍ عَلَيۡهِمۡۚ هُمُ ٱلۡعَدُوُّ فَٱحۡذَرۡهُمۡۚ قَٰتَلَهُمُ ٱللَّهُۖ أَنَّىٰ يُؤۡفَكُونَ

en.text: And when you see them, their forms please you, and if they speak, you listen to their speech. [They are] as if they were pieces of wood propped up[1690] - they think that every shout is against them. They are the enemy, so beware of them. May Allāh destroy them; how are they deluded?
en.footnotes: [1690] i.e., bodies with empty minds and empty hearts.

so.text: 4. Markaad aragto (munaafiqiinta) wuu ku cajab gelin muuqaalka jirarkooda; hadday hadlaanna, waad dhageysan hadalkooda, waxaad mooddaa dogobyo la tiirtiiriyey [2] oo dhar la huwshay. Waxay moodi dhawaaq walba in iyaga loogu dan leeyahay. Waa iyaga cadowga, ee ka digtoonow. Allaha baabbi’iyee! Xaggee looga iilay (Xaqa)?
so.footnotes: [2]. "Sida inay yihiin dogoybo la tiirtiiriyey” waxaa loola jeedaa waxay leeyihiin jirar leh cuquul iyo qalbiyo maran, inkastoo jirkoodu qurxoon yahay oo ay cod kar yihiin hadalka heli og.

ayat.arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمۡ تَعَالَوۡاْ يَسۡتَغۡفِرۡ لَكُمۡ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ لَوَّوۡاْ رُءُوسَهُمۡ وَرَأَيۡتَهُمۡ يَصُدُّونَ وَهُم مُّسۡتَكۡبِرُونَ

en.text: And when it is said to them, "Come, the Messenger of Allāh will ask forgiveness for you," they turn their heads aside and you see them evading while they are arrogant.

so.text: 5. Marka lagu yidhaahdo (munaafiqiinta): Kaalaya, ha idiin denbi dhaaf dalbee  Rasuulka Alle, waxay dib u jeediyaan madaxyadooda, oo arkeysaa iyagoo sii jeesanaya oo isla weyn.

ayat.arabic: سَوَآءٌ عَلَيۡهِمۡ أَسۡتَغۡفَرۡتَ لَهُمۡ أَمۡ لَمۡ تَسۡتَغۡفِرۡ لَهُمۡ لَن يَغۡفِرَ ٱللَّهُ لَهُمۡۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهۡدِي ٱلۡقَوۡمَ ٱلۡفَٰسِقِينَ

en.text: It is all the same for them whether you ask forgiveness for them or do not ask forgiveness for them; never will Allāh forgive them. Indeed, Allāh does not guide the defiantly disobedient people.

so.text: 6. Waa isugu mid haddaad u denbi dhaaf dalabto (Nabiyow) iyo haddaadan u denbi dhaaf dalbin. Marnaba Alle u denbi dhaafi maayo. Alle ma hanuuniyo qolada caasiyaasha ah (fallaagada).

ayat.arabic: هُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ لَا تُنفِقُواْ عَلَىٰ مَنۡ عِندَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ حَتَّىٰ يَنفَضُّواْۗ وَلِلَّهِ خَزَآئِنُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱلۡمُنَٰفِقِينَ لَا يَفۡقَهُونَ

en.text: They are the ones who say, "Do not spend on those who are with the Messenger of Allāh until they disband." And to Allāh belong the depositories of the heavens and the earth, but the hypocrites do not understand.

so.text: 7. Iyaga weeye kuwa yidhaahda: Wax ha ku bixinnana kuwa la jira Rasuulka Alle, jeeray ka kala yaacaan. Alle baa iska leh khasnadaha samooyinka iyo arlada, munaafiqiintuse ma fahansana.

ayat.arabic: يَقُولُونَ لَئِن رَّجَعۡنَآ إِلَى ٱلۡمَدِينَةِ لَيُخۡرِجَنَّ ٱلۡأَعَزُّ مِنۡهَا ٱلۡأَذَلَّۚ وَلِلَّهِ ٱلۡعِزَّةُ وَلِرَسُولِهِۦ وَلِلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱلۡمُنَٰفِقِينَ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ

en.text: They say, "If we return to al-Madīnah, the more honored [for power] will surely expel therefrom the more humble." And to Allāh belongs [all] honor, and to His Messenger, and to the believers, but the hypocrites do not know.

so.text: 8. Waxay (munaafiqiintu) yidhaahdaan: Markaan u laabanno Madiina, kan gobta ahi [3] wuxuu ka saari halkaa kan gunta ahi [4], Allaah baa se iska leh Sharaf iyo Cizoo dhan (sidaa awgeed waxay u ahaan cizo) Rasuulkiisa, iyo mu’miniinta, munaafiqiintuse ma oga.
so.footnotes:
[3]. Waxay ula jeedaan Cabdullaah bin abii  Salool, madaxii munaafiqiinta waagaas.
[4]. Waxay ula jeedaan Nabi Muxammad, Rasuulul Laah s.c.w.

ayat.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَا تُلۡهِكُمۡ أَمۡوَٰلُكُمۡ وَلَآ أَوۡلَٰدُكُمۡ عَن ذِكۡرِ ٱللَّهِۚ وَمَن يَفۡعَلۡ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡخَٰسِرُونَ

en.text: O you who have believed, let not your wealth and your children divert you from the remembrance of Allāh. And whoever does that - then those are the losers.

so.text: 9. Kuwa (Xaqa) rumeeyow! Yeysan maalkiinnu iyo awlaaddiinnu idinka shuqlin Xusidda Alle (salaadda). Qofkii falaa sidaas, kuwaa weeye kuwa khasaaray.

ayat.arabic: وَأَنفِقُواْ مِن مَّا رَزَقۡنَٰكُم مِّن قَبۡلِ أَن يَأۡتِيَ أَحَدَكُمُ ٱلۡمَوۡتُ فَيَقُولَ رَبِّ لَوۡلَآ أَخَّرۡتَنِيٓ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٖ قَرِيبٖ فَأَصَّدَّقَ وَأَكُن مِّنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ

en.text: And spend [in the way of Allāh] from what We have provided you before death approaches one of you and he says, "My Lord, if only You would delay me for a brief term so I would give charity and be of the righteous."

so.text: 10. Oo bixiya wax ka mid ah waxa aanu idin siinnay, inta aysan geeridu u iman midkiin oo markaas odhan: Rabbiyow! Maad  muddo dhow dib ii dhigtid, markaa waxaan la baxayaa sadaqo oo ka mid ahaan kuwa wanaagga fala.

ayat.arabic: وَلَن يُؤَخِّرَ ٱللَّهُ نَفۡسًا إِذَا جَآءَ أَجَلُهَاۚ وَٱللَّهُ خَبِيرُۢ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ

en.text: But never will Allāh delay a soul when its time has come. And Allāh is Aware of what you do.

so.text: 11. Alle se dib uma dhigo nafi marka ajasheed la gaaro. Alle waa u Xog Ogaal waxaad fashaan.

ayat.arabic: يُسَبِّحُ لِلَّهِ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ لَهُ ٱلۡمُلۡكُ وَلَهُ ٱلۡحَمۡدُۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٌ

en.text: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth is exalting Allāh.[1692] To Him belongs dominion, and to Him belongs [all] praise, and He is over all things competent.
en.footnotes: [1692] See footnote to 57:1.

so.text: 1. Waxaa Xurma weyneeya oo (xumaan ka) hufa Alle waxa ku sugan samooyinka iyo waxa ku sugan arlada. Alle baana leh Boqortooyada (runta ah), oo leh Ammaan idilkeed iyo Mahad, oo wax walba Kara.

ayat.arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَكُمۡ فَمِنكُمۡ كَافِرٞ وَمِنكُم مُّؤۡمِنٞۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ

en.text: It is He who created you, and among you is the disbeliever, and among you is the believer. And Allāh, of what you do, is Seeing.

so.text: 2. Alle waa Kan idin abuuray, markaas qaarkiin noqdeen gaalo, qaarkiinna m’uminiin. Alle wuu Arkaa waxaad fashaan.

ayat.arabic: خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَصَوَّرَكُمۡ فَأَحۡسَنَ صُوَرَكُمۡۖ وَإِلَيۡهِ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ

en.text: He created the heavens and earth in truth and formed you and perfected your forms; and to Him is the [final] destination.

so.text: 3. Wuxuu u abuuray samooyinka iyo arlada Xaq, wuuna idin suureeyey oo wanaajiyey suuradahiinna, waana Xaggiisa Noqodka Dambe (Aakhirada).

ayat.arabic: يَعۡلَمُ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَيَعۡلَمُ مَا تُسِرُّونَ وَمَا تُعۡلِنُونَۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمُۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ

en.text: He knows what is within the heavens and earth and knows what you conceal and what you declare. And Allāh is Knowing of that within the breasts.

so.text: 4. Wuxuu Og yahay waxa ku sugan samooyinka iyo arlada, Wuxuuna Og yahay waxaad qarisaan iyo waxaad muujisaanba. Alle waa ogaha waxa ku jira laabaha (dadka).

ayat.arabic: أَلَمۡ يَأۡتِكُمۡ نَبَؤُاْ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِن قَبۡلُ فَذَاقُواْ وَبَالَ أَمۡرِهِمۡ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٞ

en.text: Has there not come to you the news of those who disbelieved before? So they tasted the bad consequence of their affair, and they will have a painful punishment.

so.text: 5. Miyuusan idin soo gaadhin warka kuwii gaaloobay awal hore, waxay dhadhamiyeen cidhib xumadii arrinkooda, waxayna leeyihiin cadaab xanuun badan?

ayat.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُۥ كَانَت تَّأۡتِيهِمۡ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِ فَقَالُوٓاْ أَبَشَرٞ يَهۡدُونَنَا فَكَفَرُواْ وَتَوَلَّواْۖ وَّٱسۡتَغۡنَى ٱللَّهُۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَنِيٌّ حَمِيدٞ

en.text: That is because their messengers used to come to them with clear evidences, but they said, "Shall human beings guide us?" and disbelieved and turned away. And Allāh dispensed [with them]; and Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy.

so.text: 6. (Arrin)kaasi waxaa ugu wacan waxay ula yimaadeen Rusushoodii xujooyin cad, waxayse yidhaahdeen: Ma qof aadmi ah baa na hanuuninaya? markaasay gaaloobeen oo ka jeesadeen (Xaqa). Alle uma baahna (cidna). Alle waa Hodan Deeqtoon, Ammaanan.

ayat.arabic: زَعَمَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ أَن لَّن يُبۡعَثُواْۚ قُلۡ بَلَىٰ وَرَبِّي لَتُبۡعَثُنَّ ثُمَّ لَتُنَبَّؤُنَّ بِمَا عَمِلۡتُمۡۚ وَذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرٞ

en.text: Those who disbelieve have claimed that they will never be resurrected. Say, "Yes, by my Lord, you will surely be resurrected; then you will surely be informed of what you did. And that, for Allāh, is easy."

so.text: 7. Kuwa gaalooba waxay moodaan inaan marnaba laga soo bixinaynin (iilka). Dheh: Haayoo! waa igu Rabbigaye, waa la idin soo bixin, markaas waxaa la idiin sheegi (oo la idinka jaazeyn) waxaad fasheen, (arrin)kaasina Alle wuu u fudud yahay.

ayat.arabic: فَـَٔامِنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَٱلنُّورِ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنزَلۡنَاۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ خَبِيرٞ

en.text: So believe in Allāh and His Messenger and the light [i.e., the Qur’ān] which We have sent down. And Allāh is Aware of what you do.

so.text: 8. Ee rumeeya Alle iyo Rasuulkiisa iyo Nuurka (Qur’aanka) aan soo dejinnay. Alle waa ka war hayaa waxaad fashaan.

ayat.arabic: يَوۡمَ يَجۡمَعُكُمۡ لِيَوۡمِ ٱلۡجَمۡعِۖ ذَٰلِكَ يَوۡمُ ٱلتَّغَابُنِۗ وَمَن يُؤۡمِنۢ بِٱللَّهِ وَيَعۡمَلۡ صَٰلِحٗا يُكَفِّرۡ عَنۡهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِۦ وَيُدۡخِلۡهُ جَنَّٰتٖ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدٗاۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡعَظِيمُ

en.text: The Day He will assemble you for the Day of Assembly - that is the Day of Deprivation.[1693] And whoever believes in Allāh and does righteousness - He will remove from him his misdeeds and admit him to gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever. That is the great attainment.
en.footnotes: [1693] "At-Taghābun" suggests having been outdone by others in the acquisition of something valued. That Day, the disbelievers will suffer the loss of Paradise to the believers.

so.text: 9. Maalinta (Qiyaamada) uu idiin soo kulmin idinkoo dhan Maalinta Kulanka [1], taasu waa maalin kedo uu qof khayr heli (mu’minka) ama uu ku dhici  khasaaro weyn (gaalka). Qofkii rumeeya Alle oo sama fala, Wuxuu (Alle) ka tiri  denbiyadiisa oo gelin Jannooyin ay hoostoodu webiyo qulqulaan ay ku dhex waarayaan weligood, taasi waa Liibaanta Weyn.
so.footnotes: [1]. At-Taqaabun waa magac kale oo loo yaqaan Maalinta Qiyaamaha.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَكَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَاۖ وَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ

en.text: But the ones who disbelieved and denied Our verses - those are the companions of the Fire, abiding eternally therein; and wretched is the destination.

so.text: 10. Kuwase gaalooba oo beeniya Aayadahayaga kuwaasu waa ehlu-Naar, iyagoo ku dhex waaraya weligood. Xumaa aayotiin ahaan iyo meel la ahaado.

ayat.arabic: مَآ أَصَابَ مِن مُّصِيبَةٍ إِلَّا بِإِذۡنِ ٱللَّهِۗ وَمَن يُؤۡمِنۢ بِٱللَّهِ يَهۡدِ قَلۡبَهُۥۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيمٞ

en.text: No disaster strikes except by permission of Allāh. And whoever believes in Allāh - He will guide his heart. And Allāh is Knowing of all things.

so.text: 11. Ma jirto wax masiibo ah oo dhaca ilaa waxay ku dhacdaa Idanka Alle. Qofkii rumeeya Alle, wuxuu hanuuniyaa qalbigiisa (oo xasila). Alle wax walba wuu Og yahay.

ayat.arabic: وَأَطِيعُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُواْ ٱلرَّسُولَۚ فَإِن تَوَلَّيۡتُمۡ فَإِنَّمَا عَلَىٰ رَسُولِنَا ٱلۡبَلَٰغُ ٱلۡمُبِينُ

en.text: And obey Allāh and obey the Messenger; but if you turn away - then upon Our Messenger is only [the duty of] clear notification.

so.text: 12. Adeeca Allaah, adeecana Rasuulka, haddaadse jeesataan (Xaqa diiddaan), waxaa saaran Rasuulkayaga oo keliya Gaarsiin Cad.

ayat.arabic: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۚ وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَلۡيَتَوَكَّلِ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ

en.text: Allāh - there is no deity except Him. And upon Allāh let the believers rely.

so.text: 13. Allaah! Ma jiro Ilaah (Xaq lagu caabudo) aan Isaga ahayn, Allaah (oo keliya) ha talo saarteen mu’miiniintu.

ayat.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِنَّ مِنۡ أَزۡوَٰجِكُمۡ وَأَوۡلَٰدِكُمۡ عَدُوّٗا لَّكُمۡ فَٱحۡذَرُوهُمۡۚ وَإِن تَعۡفُواْ وَتَصۡفَحُواْ وَتَغۡفِرُواْ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٌ

en.text: O you who have believed, indeed, among your spouses and your children are enemies to you, so beware of them. But if you pardon and overlook and forgive - then indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.

so.text: 14. Kuwa (Xaqa) rumeeyow! Waxaa ka mid ah xaasaskiinna iyo ilmahiinna kuwo cadow idiin ah, ee ka digtoonaada! Haddaadse iska cafidaan (gefafka ay idinka galaan) oo saamaxdaan (adduunyo wixii la xidhiidha), oo u ceeb qarisaan, Alle waa Denbi Dhaaf Badane, Naxariis Badan.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّمَآ أَمۡوَٰلُكُمۡ وَأَوۡلَٰدُكُمۡ فِتۡنَةٞۚ وَٱللَّهُ عِندَهُۥٓ أَجۡرٌ عَظِيمٞ

en.text: Your wealth and your children are but a trial, and Allāh has with Him a great reward.

so.text: 15. Maalkiinna iyo awlaadiinna waa uun imtixaan [2], Alle agtiisase waxaa ah abaalgud Weyn (Janno).
so.footnotes: [2]. Waxay ku noqon karaan ilmuhu fidmo iyagoo ku xambaara waalidiinta inay falaan waxyaalaha la reebay ee xaaraanta ah .

ayat.arabic: فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ مَا ٱسۡتَطَعۡتُمۡ وَٱسۡمَعُواْ وَأَطِيعُواْ وَأَنفِقُواْ خَيۡرٗا لِّأَنفُسِكُمۡۗ وَمَن يُوقَ شُحَّ نَفۡسِهِۦ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡمُفۡلِحُونَ

en.text: So fear Allāh as much as you are able and listen and obey and spend [in the way of Allāh]; it is better for your selves. And whoever is protected from the stinginess of his soul - it is those who will be the successful.

so.text: 16. Ee dhowra (amarrada) Alle intii karaankiinna ah [3]; oo maqla, adeecana, lana baxa sadaqo idinkay idiin roon tahaye. Qofkii laga dhowro bakheylnimada naftiisa, kuwaasi weeye kuwa liibaani.
so.footnotes: [3]. Nabigu s.c.w. wuxuu yidhi: “Markaan wax idin amro la imaada waxaad kartaan, markaanse wax idinka reebo ka reebtoonaada oo ka fogaada”.

ayat.arabic: إِن تُقۡرِضُواْ ٱللَّهَ قَرۡضًا حَسَنٗا يُضَٰعِفۡهُ لَكُمۡ وَيَغۡفِرۡ لَكُمۡۚ وَٱللَّهُ شَكُورٌ حَلِيمٌ

en.text: If you loan Allāh a goodly loan, He will multiply it for you and forgive you. And Allāh is [most] Appreciative[1694] and Forbearing,[1695]
en.footnotes:
[1694] Who gives much in return for little.
[1695] Refer to footnote in 2:225.

so.text: 17. Haddaad amaahisaan Alle amaah wanaagsan [4], Wuu idiin labo laabayaa (ajarka) oo idiin denbi dhaafi. Alle waa Tixgeliye wanaagga, ajar siin iyo Dul qaad Badan.
so.footnotes: [4]. Waa bixisaan sadaqo Alle darti ama deymisaan walaal Muslim ah deyn aan kor saar lahayn.

ayat.arabic: عَٰلِمُ ٱلۡغَيۡبِ وَٱلشَّهَٰدَةِ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ

en.text: Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

so.text: 18. Waa Ogsoonaha waxaan muuqan iyo waxa muuqda, Adkaadaha, Xakiimka ah.

ayat.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِيُّ إِذَا طَلَّقۡتُمُ ٱلنِّسَآءَ فَطَلِّقُوهُنَّ لِعِدَّتِهِنَّ وَأَحۡصُواْ ٱلۡعِدَّةَۖ وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ رَبَّكُمۡۖ لَا تُخۡرِجُوهُنَّ مِنۢ بُيُوتِهِنَّ وَلَا يَخۡرُجۡنَ إِلَّآ أَن يَأۡتِينَ بِفَٰحِشَةٖ مُّبَيِّنَةٖۚ وَتِلۡكَ حُدُودُ ٱللَّهِۚ وَمَن يَتَعَدَّ حُدُودَ ٱللَّهِ فَقَدۡ ظَلَمَ نَفۡسَهُۥۚ لَا تَدۡرِي لَعَلَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحۡدِثُ بَعۡدَ ذَٰلِكَ أَمۡرٗا

en.text: O Prophet, when you [Muslims] divorce women, divorce them for [the commencement of] their waiting period and keep count of the waiting period,[1697] and fear Allāh, your Lord. Do not turn them out of their [husbands'] houses, nor should they [themselves] leave [during that period] unless they are committing a clear immorality. And those are the limits [set by] Allāh. And whoever transgresses the limits of Allāh has certainly wronged himself. You know not; perhaps Allāh will bring about after that a [different] matter.[1698]
en.footnotes:
[1697] See rulings in 2:228-233. A wife should not be divorced except after the completion of her menstrual period but before sexual intercourse has occurred, or else during a confirmed pregnancy. The pronouncement of divorce begins her waiting period (ʿiddah).
[1698] Such as regret or renewed desire for the wife.

so.text: 1. Nabiyow! Markaad furaysaan haween, fura iyagoo markaas ku jira waqtiga loo qabtay furitaanka [1], oo u tiriya (si dhan) maalmaha ciddada 'muddada ay sugayaan furitaanka kaddib' [2], Alle ka cabsada, Rabbigiin, ha uga saarina (xaasaskiinna) debedda guryahooda,  yeysan iyaguna bixin (intay ciddada ku jiraan ee la soo ceshan karo) inay la yimaadaan maahee xumaan cad. Kuwaas waa soohdimaha uu dhigay Alle. Qofkii ka tillaaba soohdimaha uu dhigay Alle, wuxuu dulmiyey naftiisa. (Midka furayow xaaskiisa) ma ogid waxaa laga yaabaa inuu Alle dib ka keeno xaal cusub [3].
so.footnotes:
[1]. Haweeni waxaa bannaan in la furo markuu dhammaado dhiigga caadadeeda oo ka daahir noqoto, ka hor inta aan loo galmoon ama iyadoo uur leh. 
[2]. Waa inaan lagu dirqin inay baxaan ama is madax furtaan. 
[3]. Sida inay ka xumaadaan waxa ka dhex dhacay ama uu jaceyl hor leh uu galo ninka iyo xaaskiisa oo isku soo noqdaan.

ayat.arabic: فَإِذَا بَلَغۡنَ أَجَلَهُنَّ فَأَمۡسِكُوهُنَّ بِمَعۡرُوفٍ أَوۡ فَارِقُوهُنَّ بِمَعۡرُوفٖ وَأَشۡهِدُواْ ذَوَيۡ عَدۡلٖ مِّنكُمۡ وَأَقِيمُواْ ٱلشَّهَٰدَةَ لِلَّهِۚ ذَٰلِكُمۡ يُوعَظُ بِهِۦ مَن كَانَ يُؤۡمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلۡيَوۡمِ ٱلۡأٓخِرِۚ وَمَن يَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ يَجۡعَل لَّهُۥ مَخۡرَجٗا

en.text: And when they have [nearly] fulfilled their term, either retain them according to acceptable terms or part with them according to acceptable terms. And bring to witness two just men from among you and establish the testimony for [the acceptance of] Allāh. That is instructed to whoever should believe in Allāh and the Last Day. And whoever fears Allāh - He will make for him a way out[1699]
en.footnotes: [1699] i.e., relief from distress.

so.text: 2. Markay ku dhowaadaan (dhammaadka) ciddadooda la qabtay [4], dib ugu soo ceshada si wanaagsan oo gar ah ama u kala taga si wanaagsan oo gar ah. Oo u gashada markhaati (kolka aad rabtaan inaad soo ceshataan, ama aad furtaan) labo caddaalad leh oo idinka mid ah (muslimiin ah) una toosiya maragga Alle darti. (Arrin)kaasi waa waano lagu waanin qof kastoo rumeysan Alle iyo Maalinta Aakhiro. Qofkii dhowra (amarrada) Alle (oo ka dhowrsada xumaha) Wuxuu u yeeli  jid uu kaga baxo (dhibaato kasta).
so.footnotes: [4]. Intay ciddada ku jiraan, waa xaasaska la furay furriin la soo ceshan karo.

ayat.arabic: وَيَرۡزُقۡهُ مِنۡ حَيۡثُ لَا يَحۡتَسِبُۚ وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلۡ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسۡبُهُۥٓۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بَٰلِغُ أَمۡرِهِۦۚ قَدۡ جَعَلَ ٱللَّهُ لِكُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدۡرٗا

en.text: And will provide for him from where he does not expect. And whoever relies upon Allāh - then He is sufficient for him. Indeed, Allāh will accomplish His purpose. Allāh has already set for everything a [decreed] extent.

so.text: 3. Oo wuxuu ka siin risiq xagga (meel) uusan fileyn. Qofkii talo saarta Alle wuu ku filan yahay. Hubaal, Alle wuu fulaa muraadkiisa. Alle Wuxuu u yeelay wax walba qaddar iyo waqti go'an.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّٰٓـِٔي يَئِسۡنَ مِنَ ٱلۡمَحِيضِ مِن نِّسَآئِكُمۡ إِنِ ٱرۡتَبۡتُمۡ فَعِدَّتُهُنَّ ثَلَٰثَةُ أَشۡهُرٖ وَٱلَّٰٓـِٔي لَمۡ يَحِضۡنَۚ وَأُوْلَٰتُ ٱلۡأَحۡمَالِ أَجَلُهُنَّ أَن يَضَعۡنَ حَمۡلَهُنَّۚ وَمَن يَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ يَجۡعَل لَّهُۥ مِنۡ أَمۡرِهِۦ يُسۡرٗا

en.text: And those who no longer expect menstruation among your women - if you doubt, then their period is three months, and [also for] those who have not menstruated. And for those who are pregnant, their term is until they give birth.[1700] And whoever fears Allāh - He will make for him of his matter ease.
en.footnotes: [1700] The ruling concerning pregnancy applies also in the case of the husband's death.

so.text: 4. Kuwa ka mid ah haweenkiinna ee ka quustay xaydka (dhiigga caadada), haddaad shakideen, ciddadoodu waa seddex bilood, iyo kuwa (sidoo kale) aan weli helin xaydka. Kuwase uurka leh (haddii la furo) ciddadooda waa intay ka dhigaan culeysyadooda oo ka dhalaan [5]. Qofkii dhowra (amarrada) Alle (oo ka dhowrsada xumaha) wuxuu uga dhigi arrinkiisa wax u fudud.
so.footnotes: [5]. Xukunkan waxaa sidoo kale soo galaya marka uu ninka dhinto, haweenta uu ninkeeda dhinto iyadoo uur leh, ciddadeeda waa intay ka dhasho.

ayat.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ أَمۡرُ ٱللَّهِ أَنزَلَهُۥٓ إِلَيۡكُمۡۚ وَمَن يَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ يُكَفِّرۡ عَنۡهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِۦ وَيُعۡظِمۡ لَهُۥٓ أَجۡرًا

en.text: That is the command of Allāh, which He has sent down to you; and whoever fears Allāh - He will remove for him his misdeeds and make great for him his reward.

so.text: 5. Kaasi waa Amarka Alle uu idiin soo dejiyey. Qofkii dhowra (amarka) Alle wuxuu ka tiri xumaatooyinkiisa, oo siin ajar weyn.

ayat.arabic: أَسۡكِنُوهُنَّ مِنۡ حَيۡثُ سَكَنتُم مِّن وُجۡدِكُمۡ وَلَا تُضَآرُّوهُنَّ لِتُضَيِّقُواْ عَلَيۡهِنَّۚ وَإِن كُنَّ أُوْلَٰتِ حَمۡلٖ فَأَنفِقُواْ عَلَيۡهِنَّ حَتَّىٰ يَضَعۡنَ حَمۡلَهُنَّۚ فَإِنۡ أَرۡضَعۡنَ لَكُمۡ فَـَٔاتُوهُنَّ أُجُورَهُنَّ وَأۡتَمِرُواْ بَيۡنَكُم بِمَعۡرُوفٖۖ وَإِن تَعَاسَرۡتُمۡ فَسَتُرۡضِعُ لَهُۥٓ أُخۡرَىٰ

en.text: Lodge them[1701] [in a section] of where you dwell out of your means and do not harm them in order to oppress them.[1702] And if they should be pregnant, then spend on them until they give birth. And if they breastfeed for you, then give them their payment and confer among yourselves in the acceptable way; but if you are in discord, then there may breastfeed for him [i.e., the father] another woman.[1703]
en.footnotes:
[1701] During their waiting period (referring to wives whose divorce has been pronounced).
[1702] So that they would be forced to leave or to ransom themselves.
[1703] See 2:233.

so.text: 6. Dejiya (haweenka ciddada ku jira) meeshaad deggan tihiin, hadba sida karaankiinnu yahay, hana dhibina si aad u gelisaan cidhiidhi [6]. Hadday leeyihiinna uur, masruufa intay ka dhigaan culeyskooda (dhalaan). Markaas hadday idiin nuujiyaan (ilmaha), siiya gunnadooda, oo is amra dhexdiinna sama falka, haddaad is khilaaftaanna mid kale ayaa u nuujin [7].
so.footnotes:
[6]. Dhanka hab dhaqanka, degaanka iyo masruufka si ay isu madax furtaan.
[7]. Eeg sharaxa hoose ee Suuradda 2: Aayadda 233.

ayat.arabic: لِيُنفِقۡ ذُو سَعَةٖ مِّن سَعَتِهِۦۖ وَمَن قُدِرَ عَلَيۡهِ رِزۡقُهُۥ فَلۡيُنفِقۡ مِمَّآ ءَاتَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُۚ لَا يُكَلِّفُ ٱللَّهُ نَفۡسًا إِلَّا مَآ ءَاتَىٰهَاۚ سَيَجۡعَلُ ٱللَّهُ بَعۡدَ عُسۡرٖ يُسۡرٗا

en.text: Let a man of wealth spend from his wealth, and he whose provision is restricted - let him spend from what Allāh has given him. Allāh does not charge a soul except [according to] what He has given it. Allāh will bring about, after hardship, ease [i.e., relief].

so.text: 7. Kan ladani wax ha ka bixiyo maalka loo waasiciyey. Kii ilaha ay wax ka soo galaan cidhiidhi yihiin, ha bixiyo wax ka mid ah wuxuu Alle siiyey. Alle kuma kallifo nafna wuxuusan siin. Alle wuxuu keeni faraj iyo fudayd dhibaatada kaddib.

ayat.arabic: وَكَأَيِّن مِّن قَرۡيَةٍ عَتَتۡ عَنۡ أَمۡرِ رَبِّهَا وَرُسُلِهِۦ فَحَاسَبۡنَٰهَا حِسَابٗا شَدِيدٗا وَعَذَّبۡنَٰهَا عَذَابٗا نُّكۡرٗا

en.text: And how many a city was insolent toward the command of its Lord and His messengers, so We took it to severe account and punished it with a terrible punishment.

so.text: 8. Badanaa inta magaalo ku caasiday Amarka Rabbigeed iyo Rusushiisa, markaas aan ugu yeernay xisaab daran (adduunka), oo aan ku cadaabi cadaab adag (Aakhirada).

ayat.arabic: فَذَاقَتۡ وَبَالَ أَمۡرِهَا وَكَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ أَمۡرِهَا خُسۡرًا

en.text: And it tasted the bad consequence of its affair [i.e., rebellion], and the outcome of its affair was loss.

so.text: 9. Oo dhadhamisay cidhib xumadii arrinkeeda, cidhibteedana ku dambeysey khasaaro.

ayat.arabic: أَعَدَّ ٱللَّهُ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٗا شَدِيدٗاۖ فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ يَٰٓأُوْلِي ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْۚ قَدۡ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ إِلَيۡكُمۡ ذِكۡرٗا

en.text: Allāh has prepared for them a severe punishment; so fear Allāh, O you of understanding who have believed. Allāh has sent down to you a message [i.e., the Qur’ān].[1704]
en.footnotes: [1704] Some scholars have interpreted "dhikr" here as "a reminder," meaning the Messenger (ﷺ), since he is mentioned in the following verse.

so.text: 10. Alle wuxuu u diyaariyey kuwaa cadaab daran. Ee dhowra (amarrada) Alle oo iska jira xumaha wax garadkow (Xaqa) rumeeyey. Wuxuu Alle idiin soo dejiyey Waano (Qur’aankan).

ayat.arabic: رَّسُولٗا يَتۡلُواْ عَلَيۡكُمۡ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ مُبَيِّنَٰتٖ لِّيُخۡرِجَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ مِنَ ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ إِلَى ٱلنُّورِۚ وَمَن يُؤۡمِنۢ بِٱللَّهِ وَيَعۡمَلۡ صَٰلِحٗا يُدۡخِلۡهُ جَنَّٰتٖ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدٗاۖ قَدۡ أَحۡسَنَ ٱللَّهُ لَهُۥ رِزۡقًا

en.text: [He sent] a Messenger [i.e., Muḥammad (ﷺ)] reciting to you the distinct verses of Allāh that He may bring out those who believe and do righteous deeds from darknesses into the light. And whoever believes in Allāh and does righteousness - He will admit him into gardens beneath which rivers flow to abide therein forever. Allāh will have perfected for him a provision.

so.text: 11. Rasuulna (wuu idiin soo diray) idiin akhriya Aayadaha Alle ee cad, si uu ugaga saaro kuwa (Xaqa) rumeeyey oo samaha fala mugdiyada xagga Nuurka;  qofkii rumeeya Alle oo sama fala, Wuxuu galin Jannooyin ay hoostoodu webiyo qul-qulaan iyagoo ku dhex waaraya waligood. Alle Waa uu wanaajiyey kaasi risiqa.

ayat.arabic: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ سَبۡعَ سَمَٰوَٰتٖ وَمِنَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مِثۡلَهُنَّۖ يَتَنَزَّلُ ٱلۡأَمۡرُ بَيۡنَهُنَّ لِتَعۡلَمُوٓاْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٞ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَدۡ أَحَاطَ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عِلۡمَۢا

en.text: It is Allāh who has created seven heavens and of the earth, the like of them.[1705] [His] command descends among them so you may know that Allāh is over all things competent and that Allāh has encompassed all things in knowledge.
en.footnotes: [1705] i.e., a similar number: seven.

so.text: 12. Alle waa Kan abuuray toddoba samood, arladana intaa oo kale 'ka abuuray' [8]. Amarkiisa ka soo dego dhexdooda, si aad u ogaataan inuu Alle wax walba Karo iyo in Alle ku koobo wax walba ogaal.
so.footnotes: [8]. Macnaha waa tiro la mid ah: toddobo arlo. Nabigu s.c.w. wuxuu yidhi: Qofkii dulmiyaa oo ku qaata xaq darro taako dhul ah, waxaa qoorta loo suraa Maalinta Qiyaamaha toddobo dhul”.

ayat.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِيُّ لِمَ تُحَرِّمُ مَآ أَحَلَّ ٱللَّهُ لَكَۖ تَبۡتَغِي مَرۡضَاتَ أَزۡوَٰجِكَۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٞ

en.text: O Prophet, why do you prohibit [yourself from] what Allāh has made lawful for you, seeking the approval of your wives? And Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.

so.text: 1. Nabiyow! Maxaad uga xarrimeysaa (Naftaada) wuxuu Alle kuu xalaaaleeyey si aad u raalli geliso xaasaskaaga? Alle waa Denbi Dhaaf Badane, Naxariis badan.

ayat.arabic: قَدۡ فَرَضَ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمۡ تَحِلَّةَ أَيۡمَٰنِكُمۡۚ وَٱللَّهُ مَوۡلَىٰكُمۡۖ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ

en.text: Allāh has already ordained for you [Muslims] the dissolution of your oaths.[1707] And Allāh is your protector, and He is the Knowing, the Wise.
en.footnotes: [1707] By means of a kaffārah (expiation). This is required when one is unable to fulfill an oath or when one has taken an oath which would not be pleasing to Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā). See 5:89.

so.text: 2. Wuxuu Alle horeyba idiinku jideeyey dhaar furyo [1]. Alle waa gargaarahiin. Waa wax walba Ogsoonaha, Xakiimka ah.
so.footnotes: [1]. Inaad sameysaan kafaara gud:. Xagga kafaara gudka la bixinayo: eeg Suuradda 5: Aayadda 89

ayat.arabic: وَإِذۡ أَسَرَّ ٱلنَّبِيُّ إِلَىٰ بَعۡضِ أَزۡوَٰجِهِۦ حَدِيثٗا فَلَمَّا نَبَّأَتۡ بِهِۦ وَأَظۡهَرَهُ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡهِ عَرَّفَ بَعۡضَهُۥ وَأَعۡرَضَ عَنۢ بَعۡضٖۖ فَلَمَّا نَبَّأَهَا بِهِۦ قَالَتۡ مَنۡ أَنۢبَأَكَ هَٰذَاۖ قَالَ نَبَّأَنِيَ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ ٱلۡخَبِيرُ

en.text: And [remember] when the Prophet confided to one of his wives a statement; and when she informed [another] of it and Allāh showed it to him, he made known part of it and ignored a part. And when he informed her about it, she said, "Who told you this?" He said, "I was informed by the Knowing, the Aware."

so.text: 3. Markuu Nabigu ku qarsaday war sir ah mid ka mid ah xaasaskiisa [2], markayse u sheegaty mid kale [3] warkaa, Allena u soo bandhigay (Nabiga), wuxuu xusay qaar ka mid ah waxay sheegtay oo iska daayey qaar. Markuu u sheegay arrinkaa, waxay tidhi: Yaa kuu sheegay arrinkani? Wuxuu yidhi: Waxaa ii sheegay (Allaah) Wax walba Ogsoonaha, Xog Ogaalka ah.
so.footnotes:
[2]. Waa Xafsah a.k.r.
[3]. Waa Caa'ishah a.k.r.

ayat.arabic: إِن تَتُوبَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ فَقَدۡ صَغَتۡ قُلُوبُكُمَاۖ وَإِن تَظَٰهَرَا عَلَيۡهِ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ مَوۡلَىٰهُ وَجِبۡرِيلُ وَصَٰلِحُ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَۖ وَٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ بَعۡدَ ذَٰلِكَ ظَهِيرٌ

en.text: If you two [wives] repent to Allāh, [it is best], for your hearts have deviated. But if you cooperate against him - then indeed Allāh is his protector, and Gabriel and the righteous of the believers and the angels, moreover, are [his] assistants.

so.text: 4. Haddaad labadiinnu Alle u noqotaan (oo tawbad keentaan) inkastoo quluubtiinnu iilatay (Alle wuu idiin denbi dhaafi); haddaadse isu kaalmeysataan (Nabiga) dhibkiisa, hubaal, Alle baa ah Gargaarahiis iyo Jabriil iyo mu’miniinta wanaagsan - malaa’igta (kale) baana intaas kaddib garab u ah.

ayat.arabic: عَسَىٰ رَبُّهُۥٓ إِن طَلَّقَكُنَّ أَن يُبۡدِلَهُۥٓ أَزۡوَٰجًا خَيۡرٗا مِّنكُنَّ مُسۡلِمَٰتٖ مُّؤۡمِنَٰتٖ قَٰنِتَٰتٖ تَٰٓئِبَٰتٍ عَٰبِدَٰتٖ سَٰٓئِحَٰتٖ ثَيِّبَٰتٖ وَأَبۡكَارٗا

en.text: Perhaps his Lord, if he divorced you [all], would substitute for him wives better than you - submitting [to Allāh], believing, devoutly obedient, repentant, worshipping, and traveling[1708] - [ones] previously married and virgins.
en.footnotes: [1708] Emigrating for the cause of Allāh. Another meaning is "given to fasting."

so.text: 5. Waa intaasoo, Rabbigi, hadduu (Nabigu) idin furo, siiyo beddelkiin xaasas idinka khayr badan, muslimooyin ah, mu’minooyin, daacad, soo noqosho iyo tawbad keen badan, caabidooyin, soomanooyin [4], leh garoobbo iyo gabdhaba bikrooyin ah.
so.footnotes: [4]. Saa’ixaat waxaa lagu fasiray soomanooyin. Waxaa sidoo kale lagu fasiray kuwa u socda  khayrka iyo fidinta diinta Alle (Islaamka) iyo wanaagga iyo samo ka talinta.

ayat.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ قُوٓاْ أَنفُسَكُمۡ وَأَهۡلِيكُمۡ نَارٗا وَقُودُهَا ٱلنَّاسُ وَٱلۡحِجَارَةُ عَلَيۡهَا مَلَٰٓئِكَةٌ غِلَاظٞ شِدَادٞ لَّا يَعۡصُونَ ٱللَّهَ مَآ أَمَرَهُمۡ وَيَفۡعَلُونَ مَا يُؤۡمَرُونَ

en.text: O you who have believed, protect yourselves and your families from a Fire whose fuel is people and stones, over which are [appointed] angels, harsh and severe; they do not disobey Allāh in what He commands them but do what they are commanded.

so.text: 6. Kuwa (Xaqa) rumeeyow! Ka dhowra nafahiinna iyo eheladdiinaba Naar lagu hurinaayo dad iyo dhagax, ay u xilsaaran yihiin malaa’ig adag oo daran, kuma ay caasiyaan Alle wuxuu ku amraba, waxayna falaan wixii la amro.

ayat.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَا تَعۡتَذِرُواْ ٱلۡيَوۡمَۖ إِنَّمَا تُجۡزَوۡنَ مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ

en.text: O you who have disbelieved, make no excuses that Day. You will only be recompensed for what you used to do.

so.text: 7. Gaaloy! Ha cudur daarannina Maanta. Waxaa la idinku abaal marin uun wax waafaqsan waxaad fasheen.

ayat.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ تُوبُوٓاْ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ تَوۡبَةٗ نَّصُوحًا عَسَىٰ رَبُّكُمۡ أَن يُكَفِّرَ عَنكُمۡ سَيِّـَٔاتِكُمۡ وَيُدۡخِلَكُمۡ جَنَّٰتٖ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ يَوۡمَ لَا يُخۡزِي ٱللَّهُ ٱلنَّبِيَّ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ مَعَهُۥۖ نُورُهُمۡ يَسۡعَىٰ بَيۡنَ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ وَبِأَيۡمَٰنِهِمۡ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَآ أَتۡمِمۡ لَنَا نُورَنَا وَٱغۡفِرۡ لَنَآۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٞ

en.text: O you who have believed, repent to Allāh with sincere repentance. Perhaps[1709] your Lord will remove from you your misdeeds and admit you into gardens beneath which rivers flow [on] the Day when Allāh will not disgrace the Prophet and those who believed with him. Their light will proceed before them and on their right; they will say, "Our Lord, perfect for us our light and forgive us. Indeed, You are over all things competent."
en.footnotes: [1709] i.e., it is expected or promised.

so.text: 8. Kuwa (Xaqa) rumeeyow! U tawbad keena Alle tawbad san, si uu Rabbigiin idiinka tirtiro xumaatooyinkiinna, idiin geliyona Jannooyin ay hoostoodu webiyo qul-qulaan, Maalinta uusan Alle hoojineyn Nabiga iyo kuwa (Xaqa) la rumeeyey, Nuurkoodu socon hortooda, iyo xagga gacmahooda midig, waxay odhan: Rabbigayow! Noo dhammeystir Nuurkayaga oo noo denbi dhaaf. Adigu wax walba waad Kartaaye.

ayat.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِيُّ جَٰهِدِ ٱلۡكُفَّارَ وَٱلۡمُنَٰفِقِينَ وَٱغۡلُظۡ عَلَيۡهِمۡۚ وَمَأۡوَىٰهُمۡ جَهَنَّمُۖ وَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ

en.text: O Prophet, strive against the disbelievers and the hypocrites and be harsh upon them. And their refuge is Hell, and wretched is the destination.

so.text: 9. Nabiyow! La jihaad gaalada iyo munaafiqiinta (nabad diidka ah), kuna adkow, hoygoodu waa Jahannama - oo u xun meel la ahaado.

ayat.arabic: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلٗا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ ٱمۡرَأَتَ نُوحٖ وَٱمۡرَأَتَ لُوطٖۖ كَانَتَا تَحۡتَ عَبۡدَيۡنِ مِنۡ عِبَادِنَا صَٰلِحَيۡنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمۡ يُغۡنِيَا عَنۡهُمَا مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيۡـٔٗا وَقِيلَ ٱدۡخُلَا ٱلنَّارَ مَعَ ٱلدَّٰخِلِينَ

en.text: Allāh presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them,[1710] so they [i.e., those prophets] did not avail them from Allāh at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter."
en.footnotes: [1710] In the matter of religion.

so.text: 10. Alle wuxuu tusaale uga dhigay kuwa gaalada ahi, xaaskii Nuux iyo xaaskii Luud; waxay hoos joogeen labo addoon oo ka mid ah addoomahayaga wanaagsan, waxayse u dhaqmeen si khiyaano ah xaggooda [5], marka waxba iyagu ugama ay tarin (xaasaskoodii) xagga Alle. Waxaana la yidhi: La gala Naarta kuwa gali.
so.footnotes: [5]. Xagga arrimaha diinta ee ma aha gogosha, iwm.

ayat.arabic: وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلٗا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ٱمۡرَأَتَ فِرۡعَوۡنَ إِذۡ قَالَتۡ رَبِّ ٱبۡنِ لِي عِندَكَ بَيۡتٗا فِي ٱلۡجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِي مِن فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَعَمَلِهِۦ وَنَجِّنِي مِنَ ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ

en.text: And Allāh presents an example of those who believed: the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, "My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds and save me from the wrongdoing people."

so.text: 11. Wuxuuna Alle tusaale uga dhigay kuwa (Xaqa) rumeeyey, xaaskii Fircoon; markay tidhi: Rabbiyow! Iiga dhis guri agtaada jannada gudaheeda, oo iga samata bixi Fircoon iyo camal xumadiisa, igana samata bixi qoloda daalimiinta ah (gar diidka).

ayat.arabic: وَمَرۡيَمَ ٱبۡنَتَ عِمۡرَٰنَ ٱلَّتِيٓ أَحۡصَنَتۡ فَرۡجَهَا فَنَفَخۡنَا فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِنَا وَصَدَّقَتۡ بِكَلِمَٰتِ رَبِّهَا وَكُتُبِهِۦ وَكَانَتۡ مِنَ ٱلۡقَٰنِتِينَ

en.text: And [the example of] Mary, the daughter of ʿImrān, who guarded her chastity, so We blew into [her garment] through Our angel [i.e., Gabriel], and she believed in the words of her Lord and His scriptures and was of the devoutly obedient.

so.text: 12. Iyo sidoo kale Maryam, gabadhii Cimraan, taasoo xafidday farjigeeda; waxaana ka afuufnay (jeebka cambuurkeeda uu ka afuufay malag Jabriil), waxayna rumeysay Kelmedihii Rabbigeed iyo Kutubtiisa, kana mid aheyd kuwa Alle adeeca.

ayat.arabic: تَبَٰرَكَ ٱلَّذِي بِيَدِهِ ٱلۡمُلۡكُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٌ

en.text: Blessed is He in whose hand is dominion, and He is over all things competent -

so.text: 1. Waxaa khayr iyo barako badan (Alle) ay Gacantiisu ku jirto Mulkiga (iyo Maamulka uunka oo dhan), Isagaana wax walba Kara.

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلۡمَوۡتَ وَٱلۡحَيَوٰةَ لِيَبۡلُوَكُمۡ أَيُّكُمۡ أَحۡسَنُ عَمَلٗاۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡغَفُورُ

en.text: [He] who created death and life to test you [as to] which of you is best in deed - and He is the Exalted in Might, the Forgiving -

so.text: 2. Ee ah Kan abuuray geeri iyo nololba, si uu idiin imtixaano kiinna idiinku camal wanaagsan. Waana Adkaadaha sare, Denbi Dhaafka Badan.

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ سَبۡعَ سَمَٰوَٰتٖ طِبَاقٗاۖ مَّا تَرَىٰ فِي خَلۡقِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ مِن تَفَٰوُتٖۖ فَٱرۡجِعِ ٱلۡبَصَرَ هَلۡ تَرَىٰ مِن فُطُورٖ

en.text: [And] who created seven heavens in layers.[1712] You do not see in the creation of the Most Merciful any inconsistency. So return [your] vision [to the sky]; do you see any breaks?
en.footnotes: [1712] i.e., one covering or fitting over the other.

so.text: 3. Kan abuuray toddobo samooyin dabaqyo ah kala korreeya, ku arki meysid wax isdhaafsanaan ah abuurka Raxmaanka. Ee ku celi araggee: Miyaad ku aragtaa wax dillaac ah iyo duleello.

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ ٱرۡجِعِ ٱلۡبَصَرَ كَرَّتَيۡنِ يَنقَلِبۡ إِلَيۡكَ ٱلۡبَصَرُ خَاسِئٗا وَهُوَ حَسِيرٞ

en.text: Then return [your] vision twice again.[1713] [Your] vision will return to you humbled while it is fatigued.
en.footnotes: [1713] i.e., repeatedly.

so.text: 4. Misna ku celi aragga mar labaad, araggaagu adiga buu kugu soo noqon isagoo dulleysan oo daallan.

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا بِمَصَٰبِيحَ وَجَعَلۡنَٰهَا رُجُومٗا لِّلشَّيَٰطِينِۖ وَأَعۡتَدۡنَا لَهُمۡ عَذَابَ ٱلسَّعِيرِ

en.text: And We have certainly beautified the nearest heaven with lamps [i.e., stars] and have made [from] them what is thrown at the devils[1714] and have prepared for them the punishment of the Blaze.
en.footnotes: [1714] Thereby driving them from the heavens and preventing them from eavesdropping. See 72:8-9.

so.text: 5. Waxaan dhab ahaan ku qurxinnay samada dhow nalal (xiddigo), Waxaana ka yeellay (xiddigahaa) gantaallo lagu gano shayaadiinta [1], waxaanuna u diyaarinnay cadaab Naar hureysa ah.
so.footnotes: [1]. Xiddigahaa waa qurux iyo ilaalo.

ayat.arabic: وَلِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِرَبِّهِمۡ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَۖ وَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ

en.text: And for those who disbelieved in their Lord is the punishment of Hell, and wretched is the destination.

so.text: 6. Kuwa ku gaalooba Rabbigood waxay leeyihiin cadaab jahannamo, oo u xun aayotiin iyo meel la ahaado.

ayat.arabic: إِذَآ أُلۡقُواْ فِيهَا سَمِعُواْ لَهَا شَهِيقٗا وَهِيَ تَفُورُ

en.text: When they are thrown into it, they hear from it a [dreadful] inhaling while it boils up.

so.text: 7. Marka (gaalada) lagu tuuro Naarta, waxay ka maqli cartan daran iyadoo karaysa.

ayat.arabic: تَكَادُ تَمَيَّزُ مِنَ ٱلۡغَيۡظِۖ كُلَّمَآ أُلۡقِيَ فِيهَا فَوۡجٞ سَأَلَهُمۡ خَزَنَتُهَآ أَلَمۡ يَأۡتِكُمۡ نَذِيرٞ

en.text: It almost bursts with rage. Every time a company is thrown into it, its keepers ask them, "Did there not come to you a warner?"

so.text: 8. Waxay ku sigan inay la kala dillaacdo cadho. Mar kastoo guuto lagu tuuro, wuxuu waardiyaheeda weydiin: Miyuusan idiin imaan dige (Rasuul Alle)?

ayat.arabic: قَالُواْ بَلَىٰ قَدۡ جَآءَنَا نَذِيرٞ فَكَذَّبۡنَا وَقُلۡنَا مَا نَزَّلَ ٱللَّهُ مِن شَيۡءٍ إِنۡ أَنتُمۡ إِلَّا فِي ضَلَٰلٖ كَبِيرٖ

en.text: They will say, "Yes, a warner had come to us, but we denied and said, 'Allāh has not sent down anything. You are not but in great error.'"

so.text: 9. Waxay odhan: Haayoo waa noo yimid dige, waanse beeninnay oo nidhi: Alle ma soo dejin wax (Waxyi ah), waxaad uun idinku ku sugan tihiin habow weyn.

ayat.arabic: وَقَالُواْ لَوۡ كُنَّا نَسۡمَعُ أَوۡ نَعۡقِلُ مَا كُنَّا فِيٓ أَصۡحَٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ

en.text: And they will say, "If only we had been listening or reasoning, we would not be among the companions of the Blaze."

so.text: 10. Waxay odhan: Haddaan wax maqli laheyn ama garowsan laheyn, kama aanu mid ahaaneyn ehlu Naarka.

ayat.arabic: فَٱعۡتَرَفُواْ بِذَنۢبِهِمۡ فَسُحۡقٗا لِّأَصۡحَٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ

en.text: And they will admit their sin, so [it is] alienation[1715] for the companions of the Blaze.
en.footnotes: [1715] From all good and from Allāh's mercy.

so.text: 11. Marka waxay qiran denbigooda, ee ha fogaadeen [2] qolada Naarta Hureysa.
so.footnotes: [2]. Iyagoo laga fogeeyey wax khayr ah oo dhan ama wax Naxariis Alle ah.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخۡشَوۡنَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلۡغَيۡبِ لَهُم مَّغۡفِرَةٞ وَأَجۡرٞ كَبِيرٞ

en.text: Indeed, those who fear their Lord unseen will have forgiveness and great reward.

so.text: 12. Hubaal, kuwa ka baqa Rabbigood sir (iyo saaqba) waxay leeyihiin Denbi Dhaaf iyo Ajar Weyn (Janno).

ayat.arabic: وَأَسِرُّواْ قَوۡلَكُمۡ أَوِ ٱجۡهَرُواْ بِهِۦٓۖ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمُۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ

en.text: And conceal your speech or publicize it; indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.

so.text: 13. Hoos u dhiga hadalkiinna ama kor u qaada. Hubaal (Alle) wuu Og yahay waxa ku jira laabaha (dadka).

ayat.arabic: أَلَا يَعۡلَمُ مَنۡ خَلَقَ وَهُوَ ٱللَّطِيفُ ٱلۡخَبِيرُ

en.text: Does He who created not know,[1716] while He is the Subtle, the Aware?
en.footnotes: [1716] Another accepted meaning is "Does He not know those whom He created...?"

so.text: 14. Miyuusan Ogeyn Kan abuuray 'uunkiisa iyo arrimahooda' [3]? Waa Roonaan Badanaha, Xog Ogaalka ah.
so.footnotes: [3]. Tafsiirka kale waxaa weeye: Miyuusan Alle ogeyn xaalka kuwa uu abuuray?

ayat.arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ ذَلُولٗا فَٱمۡشُواْ فِي مَنَاكِبِهَا وَكُلُواْ مِن رِّزۡقِهِۦۖ وَإِلَيۡهِ ٱلنُّشُورُ

en.text: It is He who made the earth tame[1717] for you - so walk among its slopes and eat of His provision - and to Him is the resurrection.
en.footnotes: [1717] i.e., stable and subservient.

so.text: 15. Waa Isaga (Alle) Kan idiinka dhigay dhulka hayin ee ku socda aagaggiisa waasica ah, oo wax ka cuna risiqiisa, Xaggiisa bay ahaan u soo Bixiddu (Qiyaamada).

ayat.arabic: ءَأَمِنتُم مَّن فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يَخۡسِفَ بِكُمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ فَإِذَا هِيَ تَمُورُ

en.text: Do you feel secure that He who is above[1718] would not cause the earth to swallow you and suddenly it would sway?[1719]
en.footnotes:
[1718] Literally, "in ascendancy" or "over the heaven."
[1719] In a circular motion, as in an earthquake.

so.text: 16. Ma waxaad aamin ka tihiin in (Alle) ee ka kor ah cirka idinla gooyo arlada, ayna idin la dhaqdhaqaaqdo [4].
so.footnotes: [4]. Sida dhul gariirka.

ayat.arabic: أَمۡ أَمِنتُم مَّن فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يُرۡسِلَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ حَاصِبٗاۖ فَسَتَعۡلَمُونَ كَيۡفَ نَذِيرِ

en.text: Or do you feel secure that He who is above would not send against you a storm of stones? Then you would know how [severe] was My warning.

so.text: 17. Mise ma waxaad aamin ka tihiin in (Alle) ka kor ah cirka, uu idiin soo diro dabeyl kulul oo habaas wadata? Marka waad ogaan sidee aheyd Digniinteydu?

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡ فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ

en.text: And already had those before them denied, and how [terrible] was My reproach.

so.text: 18. Waxaa dhab ahaan beeniyey (Xaqa) kuwii ka horreeyey, ee sidee buu ahaa Ciqaabkeygii?

ayat.arabic: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ إِلَى ٱلطَّيۡرِ فَوۡقَهُمۡ صَٰٓفَّٰتٖ وَيَقۡبِضۡنَۚ مَا يُمۡسِكُهُنَّ إِلَّا ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُۚ إِنَّهُۥ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءِۭ بَصِيرٌ

en.text: Do they not see the birds above them with wings outspread and [sometimes] folded in? None holds them [aloft] except the Most Merciful. Indeed He is, of all things, Seeing.

so.text: 19. Miyeyna arag shimbiraha korkooda ah ee fidinaya (baalashooda) oo isku soo laabaya? Ma jiraan wax haya iyaga aan aheyn Raxmaanka. Hubaal, wax walba wuu Arkaa.

ayat.arabic: أَمَّنۡ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي هُوَ جُندٞ لَّكُمۡ يَنصُرُكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِۚ إِنِ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ إِلَّا فِي غُرُورٍ

en.text: Or who is it that could be an army for you to aid you other than the Most Merciful? The disbelievers are not but in delusion.

so.text: 20. Waa kee kan idiin noqon kara ciidan idiin soo gargaara Raxmaanka (Alle) sokadi? Gaaladu kuma sugna waxaan aheyn hodnaan.

ayat.arabic: أَمَّنۡ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي يَرۡزُقُكُمۡ إِنۡ أَمۡسَكَ رِزۡقَهُۥۚ بَل لَّجُّواْ فِي عُتُوّٖ وَنُفُورٍ

en.text: Or who is it that could provide for you if He withheld His provision? But they have persisted in insolence and aversion.

so.text: 21. Ama waa kee kaa idin siin risiq haddii uu (Alle) heysto Risiqiisa? Waxayse ku adkeystaan kibir iyo didmo.

ayat.arabic: أَفَمَن يَمۡشِي مُكِبًّا عَلَىٰ وَجۡهِهِۦٓ أَهۡدَىٰٓ أَمَّن يَمۡشِي سَوِيًّا عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٖ مُّسۡتَقِيمٖ

en.text: Then is one who walks fallen on his face better guided or one who walks erect on a straight path?

so.text: 22. Ma mid socda wejigiisoo foorara baa hanuunsan, mise mid ugu socda si quman Jid Toosan?

ayat.arabic: قُلۡ هُوَ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنشَأَكُمۡ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمۡعَ وَٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرَ وَٱلۡأَفۡـِٔدَةَۚ قَلِيلٗا مَّا تَشۡكُرُونَ

en.text: Say, "It is He who has produced you and made for you hearing and vision and hearts [i.e., intellect]; little are you grateful."

so.text: 23. Dheh: (Alle) waa Kan idin uumay idiinna yeelay maqalka, aragga iyo laabaha. Yaraa intaad (ku) mahdisaan.

ayat.arabic: قُلۡ هُوَ ٱلَّذِي ذَرَأَكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَإِلَيۡهِ تُحۡشَرُونَ

en.text: Say, "It is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered."

so.text: 24. Dheh: (Alle) waa Kan idinku fidshay (abuuray) dhulka, Xaggiisaana la idiin soo kulmin (Qiyaamada).

ayat.arabic: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلۡوَعۡدُ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ

en.text: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"

so.text: 25. Waxay odhan: Waa goorma waqtiga gooddigani la fulin haddaad run sheegi?

ayat.arabic: قُلۡ إِنَّمَا ٱلۡعِلۡمُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَإِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٞ مُّبِينٞ

en.text: Say, "The knowledge is only with Allāh, and I am only a clear warner."

so.text: 26. Dheh: Alle baa Og (waqtigay tahay), waxaanse ahay anigu dige cad.

ayat.arabic: فَلَمَّا رَأَوۡهُ زُلۡفَةٗ سِيٓـَٔتۡ وُجُوهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَقِيلَ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَدَّعُونَ

en.text: But when they see it[1720] approaching, the faces of those who disbelieve will be distressed, and it will be said, "This is that for which you used to call."[1721]
en.footnotes:
[1720] The punishment of which they were warned.
[1721] When they challenged their prophets, saying, "Bring on the punishment, if you are truthful."

so.text: 27. Markayse arkaan (cadaabka Alle) oo ku soo dhow, waxaa xumaan wejiyada gaalada, waxaana lagu odhan: Waa kan waxaad u yeedhan jirteen (in la idiin soo dedejiyo oo cadaab ah).

ayat.arabic: قُلۡ أَرَءَيۡتُمۡ إِنۡ أَهۡلَكَنِيَ ٱللَّهُ وَمَن مَّعِيَ أَوۡ رَحِمَنَا فَمَن يُجِيرُ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ مِنۡ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٖ

en.text: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Have you considered:[1722] whether Allāh should cause my death and those with me or have mercy upon us, who can protect the disbelievers from a painful punishment?"
en.footnotes: [1722] i.e., inform me.

so.text: 28. Dheh: Bal ka warrama haddii Alle na oofsado aniga iyo inta ila jirta (mu'miniinta), ama noo naxariisto, yaa ka badbaaadin gaalada cadaab xanuun badan?

ayat.arabic: قُلۡ هُوَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ وَعَلَيۡهِ تَوَكَّلۡنَاۖ فَسَتَعۡلَمُونَ مَنۡ هُوَ فِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٖ

en.text: Say, "He is the Most Merciful; we have believed in Him, and upon Him we have relied. And you will [come to] know who it is that is in clear error."

so.text: 29. Dheh: Alle waa Raxmaanka, waanu rumeynay, Isagaana tala saarannaa. Waad ogaan doontaan waa kee kan ku sugan habow cad.

ayat.arabic: قُلۡ أَرَءَيۡتُمۡ إِنۡ أَصۡبَحَ مَآؤُكُمۡ غَوۡرٗا فَمَن يَأۡتِيكُم بِمَآءٖ مَّعِينِۭ

en.text: Say, "Have you considered: if your water was to become sunken [into the earth], then who could bring you flowing water?"

so.text: 30. Dheh: Bal ka warrama hadday biyihiin- nu dhulka ku guraan, waa kee kan idiin keeni kara biyo socda oo dur dur ah [5]?
so.footnotes: [5]. Ma jiro waxaan Alle ahayn oo keeni kara.

ayat.arabic: نٓۚ وَٱلۡقَلَمِ وَمَا يَسۡطُرُونَ

en.text: Nūn.[1724] By the pen and what they inscribe,
en.footnotes: [1724] See footnote to 2:1.

so.text:
1. Nuun [1].
Waxaan (waa Alle'e) ku dhaartay Qalinka iyo waxay (malaa’igtu) qoraan.
so.footnotes: [1]. Eeg sharaxa hoose ee Suuradda 2 Al-Baqarah: Aayadda 1.

ayat.arabic: مَآ أَنتَ بِنِعۡمَةِ رَبِّكَ بِمَجۡنُونٖ

en.text: You are not, [O Muḥammad], by the favor of your Lord, a madman.

so.text: 2. Waa igu Nicmadda Rabbigaaye, ma ahid (Muxammadow) jinnoole.

ayat.arabic: وَإِنَّ لَكَ لَأَجۡرًا غَيۡرَ مَمۡنُونٖ

en.text: And indeed, for you is a reward uninterrupted.

so.text: 3.Waxaad leedahay (Nabiyow) ajar aan weligii go'eyn.

ayat.arabic: وَإِنَّكَ لَعَلَىٰ خُلُقٍ عَظِيمٖ

en.text: And indeed, you are of a great moral character.

so.text: 4. Waxaa xaqiiq kuu sugnaaday (Nabiyow) dabeecad san oo sare.

ayat.arabic: فَسَتُبۡصِرُ وَيُبۡصِرُونَ

en.text: So you will see and they will see

so.text: 5. Marka waad arki, iyaguna (sidoo kale) way arki,

ayat.arabic: بِأَييِّكُمُ ٱلۡمَفۡتُونُ

en.text: Which of you is the afflicted [by a devil].

so.text: 6. Kiinna fidmeysan (ama la cadaabo).

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِٱلۡمُهۡتَدِينَ

en.text: Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who has gone astray from His way, and He is most knowing of the [rightly] guided.

so.text: 7. Hubaal Rabbigaa baa Ogsoon kan ka dhuma Jidkiisa, Isagaana Og kuwa hanuunsan.

ayat.arabic: فَلَا تُطِعِ ٱلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ

en.text: Then do not obey the deniers.

so.text: 8. Ee ha adeecin xaq beeniyayaasha.

ayat.arabic: وَدُّواْ لَوۡ تُدۡهِنُ فَيُدۡهِنُونَ

en.text: They wish that you would soften [in your position], so they would soften [toward you].

so.text: 9. Waxay jecel yihiin inaad u iilato (oo ku raacdo wax ka mid ah baadilkooda),  iyaguna (markaa) kuu soo iishaan.

ayat.arabic: وَلَا تُطِعۡ كُلَّ حَلَّافٖ مَّهِينٍ

en.text: And do not obey every worthless habitual swearer

so.text: 10. Oo ha adeecin mid kastoo dhaar badan qiimo laheyn.

ayat.arabic: هَمَّازٖ مَّشَّآءِۭ بِنَمِيمٖ

en.text: [And] scorner, going about with malicious gossip -

so.text: 11. Xamasho badan, u socod badan dira diro (nabiibiye ah).

ayat.arabic: مَّنَّاعٖ لِّلۡخَيۡرِ مُعۡتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ

en.text: A preventer of good, transgressing and sinful,

so.text: 12. Khayr diid, xad-gudbe, denbi badan.

ayat.arabic: عُتُلِّۭ بَعۡدَ ذَٰلِكَ زَنِيمٍ

en.text: Cruel, moreover, and an illegitimate pretender.[1725]
en.footnotes: [1725] i.e., claiming a particular lineage falsely. The description given in these verses is of al-Waleed bin al-Mugheerah (see also 74:11-25) or possibly, as asserted by Ibn Katheer, al-Akhnas bin Shurayq.

so.text: 13. macangag ah madax adag - intaasoo dhan ka sokow mid liita ah (aan nasab ahayn).

ayat.arabic: أَن كَانَ ذَا مَالٖ وَبَنِينَ

en.text: Because he is a possessor of wealth and children,

so.text: 14. Haba lahaadee maal iyo wiilal.

ayat.arabic: إِذَا تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ

en.text: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples."

so.text: 15. Kaasoo marka Aayadahayaga loo akhriyo, yidhaahda: Waa sheekooyinkii kuwii hore.

ayat.arabic: سَنَسِمُهُۥ عَلَى ٱلۡخُرۡطُومِ

en.text: We will brand him upon the snout.[1726]
en.footnotes: [1726] Literally, "trunk," meaning the nose of an elephant or pig.

so.text: 16. Waxaanu ka calaameyn sanqaroorka dushiisa.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّا بَلَوۡنَٰهُمۡ كَمَا بَلَوۡنَآ أَصۡحَٰبَ ٱلۡجَنَّةِ إِذۡ أَقۡسَمُواْ لَيَصۡرِمُنَّهَا مُصۡبِحِينَ

en.text: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning

so.text: 17. Waxaanu u imtixaannay sidaanu u imtixaannay qoladii iska lahaa beerta, markay ku dhaarteen inay goosanayaan midhaheeda aroorta hore.

ayat.arabic: وَلَا يَسۡتَثۡنُونَ

en.text: Without making exception.[1727]
en.footnotes: [1727] i.e., without conceding that nothing can be accomplished unless Allāh wills, saying, "...if Allāh wills" ("in-shā’-Allāh"). See 18:23-24.

so.text: 18. Iyagoon dhihin inshaa Allaah (dooneyna inay qayb u dhigaan saboolka).

ayat.arabic: فَطَافَ عَلَيۡهَا طَآئِفٞ مِّن رَّبِّكَ وَهُمۡ نَآئِمُونَ

en.text: So there came upon it [i.e., the garden] an affliction from your Lord while they were asleep.

so.text: 19. Markaasaa waxaa uga yimid amar (dab) xagga Rabbigaa habeennimadii (oo beertii gubatay) intay hurdeen.

ayat.arabic: فَأَصۡبَحَتۡ كَٱلصَّرِيمِ

en.text: And it became as though reaped.

so.text: 20. Markaasay noqotay sida xaabo madoobaatay oo la shafay.

ayat.arabic: فَتَنَادَوۡاْ مُصۡبِحِينَ

en.text: And they called one another at morning,

so.text: 21. Waxay isu dhawaaqeen subaxnimadii,

ayat.arabic: أَنِ ٱغۡدُواْ عَلَىٰ حَرۡثِكُمۡ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰرِمِينَ

en.text: [Saying], "Go early to your crop if you would cut the fruit."

so.text: 22. iyagoo leh: Ku kallaha beertiinna haddaad goosanaysaan midhaha.

ayat.arabic: فَٱنطَلَقُواْ وَهُمۡ يَتَخَٰفَتُونَ

en.text: So they set out, while lowering their voices,

so.text: 23. Markaasay tageen iyagoo ku wada tashaday si qarsoodi ah,

ayat.arabic: أَن لَّا يَدۡخُلَنَّهَا ٱلۡيَوۡمَ عَلَيۡكُم مِّسۡكِينٞ

en.text: [Saying], "There will surely not enter it today upon you [any] poor person."

so.text: 24. Inuusan qof miskiin ah u soo gelin maanta (beerta, waxnana siin).

ayat.arabic: وَغَدَوۡاْ عَلَىٰ حَرۡدٖ قَٰدِرِينَ

en.text: And they went early in determination, [assuming themselves] able.[1728]
en.footnotes: [1728] To carry out their plan, confident of their ability.

so.text: 25. Waxayna kallaheen subaxii hore iyagoo go’aansan inay (beerta) ka celiyaan (masaakiinta).

ayat.arabic: فَلَمَّا رَأَوۡهَا قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا لَضَآلُّونَ

en.text: But when they saw it, they said, "Indeed, we are lost;

so.text: 26. Markayse arkeen beertii, waxay yidhaahdeen: xaqiiq waanu dhunnay.

ayat.arabic: بَلۡ نَحۡنُ مَحۡرُومُونَ

en.text: Rather, we have been deprived."

so.text: 27. Mayee, waa la ina hoojiyey .

ayat.arabic: قَالَ أَوۡسَطُهُمۡ أَلَمۡ أَقُل لَّكُمۡ لَوۡلَا تُسَبِّحُونَ

en.text: The most moderate of them said, "Did I not say to you, 'Why do you not exalt [Allāh]?'"[1729]
en.footnotes: [1729] i.e., remember or mention Him by saying, "...if Allāh wills." An additional meaning is "praise" or "thank" Him for His bounty.

so.text: 28. Koodii u wanaagsanaa baa yidhi: Miyaana idinku odhan: (Alle) u tasbiixsada oo hufa?

ayat.arabic: قَالُواْ سُبۡحَٰنَ رَبِّنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ

en.text: They said, "Exalted is our Lord! Indeed, we were wrongdoers."

so.text: 29. Waxay yidhaahdeen: Xurmoo idil waxaa iska leh oo ceeb iyo nuqsaan ka hufan Rabbigeen. Hubaal Waanu gefnay.

ayat.arabic: فَأَقۡبَلَ بَعۡضُهُمۡ عَلَىٰ بَعۡضٖ يَتَلَٰوَمُونَ

en.text: Then they approached one another, blaming each other.

so.text: 30. Markaasaa qaarba qaar ka hor jeesaday iyagoo is eedeynaya.

ayat.arabic: قَالُواْ يَٰوَيۡلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا طَٰغِينَ

en.text: They said, "O woe to us; indeed we were transgressors.

so.text: 31. Waxay yidhaahdeen: Magaceen ba'ye, waanu xadgudubnay.

ayat.arabic: عَسَىٰ رَبُّنَآ أَن يُبۡدِلَنَا خَيۡرٗا مِّنۡهَآ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا رَٰغِبُونَ

en.text: Perhaps our Lord will substitute for us [one] better than it. Indeed, we are toward our Lord desirous."[1730]
en.footnotes: [1730] Of His mercy, forgiveness and bounty.

so.text: 32. Waa intaasoo Rabbigeen noogu beddelo beer ka wanaagsan, Isagaan innagu xaqiiq khayr ka rajeyne.

ayat.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡعَذَابُۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ أَكۡبَرُۚ لَوۡ كَانُواْ يَعۡلَمُونَ

en.text: Such is the punishment [of this world]. And the punishment of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew.

so.text: 33. Waa sidaas cadaabku. Cadaabka Aakhiraana ka sii weyn. Hadday ogaan lahaayeen.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمۡ جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ

en.text: Indeed, for the righteous with their Lord are the Gardens of Pleasure.

so.text: 34. Hubaal kuwa Alle ka cabsada (oo ka dhowrsada xumaha) waxay leeyihiin Rabbigood agtiisa Jannooyin barwaaqo ah.

ayat.arabic: أَفَنَجۡعَلُ ٱلۡمُسۡلِمِينَ كَٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ

en.text: Then will We treat the Muslims like the criminals?

so.text: 35. Ma Muslimiinta (Alle u hoggaansan) baanu kala mid dhigi denbiilayaasha.

ayat.arabic: مَا لَكُمۡ كَيۡفَ تَحۡكُمُونَ

en.text: What is [the matter] with you? How do you judge?

so.text: 36. Maxaad leedihiin? Sidee baad wax u xukumeysaan?

ayat.arabic: أَمۡ لَكُمۡ كِتَٰبٞ فِيهِ تَدۡرُسُونَ

en.text: Or do you have a scripture in which you learn

so.text: 37. Mise waxaad heysataan kitaab aad ka akhrisataan -

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ لَكُمۡ فِيهِ لَمَا تَخَيَّرُونَ

en.text: That indeed for you is whatever you choose?

so.text: 38. Inaad heleysaan waxaad doorataanba?

ayat.arabic: أَمۡ لَكُمۡ أَيۡمَٰنٌ عَلَيۡنَا بَٰلِغَةٌ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ إِنَّ لَكُمۡ لَمَا تَحۡكُمُونَ

en.text: Or do you have oaths [binding] upon Us, extending until the Day of Resurrection, that indeed for you is whatever you judge?

so.text: 39. Mise waxaad naga heysataan ballan Xaggayaga ah lagu adkeeyey dhaar gaaraysa ilaa Maalinta Qiyaamaha inaad heleysaan waxaad doontaanba?

ayat.arabic: سَلۡهُمۡ أَيُّهُم بِذَٰلِكَ زَعِيمٌ

en.text: Ask them which of them, for that [claim], is responsible.

so.text: 40. Weydii kooda uga ah arrinkaas damiin.

ayat.arabic: أَمۡ لَهُمۡ شُرَكَآءُ فَلۡيَأۡتُواْ بِشُرَكَآئِهِمۡ إِن كَانُواْ صَٰدِقِينَ

en.text: Or do they have partners?[1731] Then let them bring their partners, if they should be truthful.
en.footnotes: [1731] i.e., those to whom they attribute divinity other than Allāh or partners from among themselves.

so.text: 41. Mise waxay leeyihiin shariigyo (ilaahyo u soo gargaaraya), marka ha keenaan shariigyadooda hadday run sheegayaan.

ayat.arabic: يَوۡمَ يُكۡشَفُ عَن سَاقٖ وَيُدۡعَوۡنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ فَلَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ

en.text: The Day the shin will be uncovered[1732] and they are invited to prostration but they [i.e., the disbelievers] will not be able,
en.footnotes: [1732] i.e., when everyone will find before him great difficulty. In accordance with authentic ḥadīths, "the shin" might also refer to that of Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā), before which every believer will prostrate on the Day of Judgement. See footnote to 2:19.

so.text: 42. Maalinta (Qiyaamada) marka dhudhunka la feydo 'dhudhunka Alle' [2] oo loogu yeedho inay sujuudaan, mase karayaan inay sujuudaan (waa gaalada iyo munaafiqiinta).
so.footnotes: [2]. Dhudhunka la feydo waxaa sidoo kale lagu fasiray ay jirto shiddada iyo dhibaatada weyn, waa Maalinta Qiyaamaha.

ayat.arabic: خَٰشِعَةً أَبۡصَٰرُهُمۡ تَرۡهَقُهُمۡ ذِلَّةٞۖ وَقَدۡ كَانُواْ يُدۡعَوۡنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ وَهُمۡ سَٰلِمُونَ

en.text: Their eyes humbled, humiliation will cover them. And they used to be invited to prostration while they were sound.[1733]
en.footnotes: [1733] During worldly life.

so.text: 43. Indhahoodu hoos u rogan yihiin, dulli baa dabooli; waxaana loogu yeedhi jirey inay sujuudaan iyagoo fayow 'mase yeelin'.

ayat.arabic: فَذَرۡنِي وَمَن يُكَذِّبُ بِهَٰذَا ٱلۡحَدِيثِۖ سَنَسۡتَدۡرِجُهُم مِّنۡ حَيۡثُ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ

en.text: So leave Me, [O Muḥammad], with [the matter of] whoever denies this statement [i.e., the Qur’ān]. We will progressively lead them [to punishment] from where they do not know.[1734]
en.footnotes: [1734] Allāh will increase His favors to them in this world by way of trial, whereby they will sink deeper into sin and thus into destruction.

so.text: 44. Ee isu kaana daa Aniga iyo kuwa beeniya warkan (Qur’aanka); waxaan ka qaban si heerar ah meel aysan fileyn.

ayat.arabic: وَأُمۡلِي لَهُمۡۚ إِنَّ كَيۡدِي مَتِينٌ

en.text: And I will give them time. Indeed, My plan is firm.

so.text: 45. Waan u seeto dheereyn, hubaal, tabteydu waa mid sugan oo adag.

ayat.arabic: أَمۡ تَسۡـَٔلُهُمۡ أَجۡرٗا فَهُم مِّن مَّغۡرَمٖ مُّثۡقَلُونَ

en.text: Or do you ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down?

so.text: 46. Mise waxaad weydiisataa ujro, sidaa awgeed bay la culaabeysan yihiin deyn?

ayat.arabic: أَمۡ عِندَهُمُ ٱلۡغَيۡبُ فَهُمۡ يَكۡتُبُونَ

en.text: Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down?

so.text: 47. Mise cilmiga waxaan muuqan bay hayaan, sidaas darteed iyagu qoraan?

ayat.arabic: فَٱصۡبِرۡ لِحُكۡمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تَكُن كَصَاحِبِ ٱلۡحُوتِ إِذۡ نَادَىٰ وَهُوَ مَكۡظُومٞ

en.text: Then be patient for the decision of your Lord, [O Muḥammad], and be not like the companion of the fish [i.e., Jonah] when he called out while he was distressed.

so.text: 48. Ee ku samir Xukunka Rabbigaa, oo ha noqonnin sida (Nabi Yuunus) rafiiqii nibiriga - markuu noo yeedhay isagoo walbahaarsan,

ayat.arabic: لَّوۡلَآ أَن تَدَٰرَكَهُۥ نِعۡمَةٞ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ لَنُبِذَ بِٱلۡعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ مَذۡمُومٞ

en.text: If not that a favor [i.e., mercy] from his Lord overtook him, he would have been thrown onto the naked shore while he was censured.[1735]
en.footnotes: [1735] But instead, Allāh accepted his repentance and provided means for his recovery. See 37:139-148.

so.text: 49. Haddaysan Nicmad xagga Rabbigi ah haleesheen, waxaa lagu tuuri lahaa cidla’ bannaan isagoo eedeysan.

ayat.arabic: فَٱجۡتَبَٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَجَعَلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ

en.text: And his Lord chose him and made him of the righteous.

so.text: 50. Rabbigiis baase doortay, kana mid yeelay kuwa wanaagsan.

ayat.arabic: وَإِن يَكَادُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَيُزۡلِقُونَكَ بِأَبۡصَٰرِهِمۡ لَمَّا سَمِعُواْ ٱلذِّكۡرَ وَيَقُولُونَ إِنَّهُۥ لَمَجۡنُونٞ

en.text: And indeed, those who disbelieve would almost make you slip with their eyes [i.e., looks] when they hear the message, and they say, "Indeed, he is mad."

so.text: 51. Kuwaa gaalada ahise waxay sigaan inay kugu gubaan indhahooda (dhabatoda) naceyb gala awgiis markay maqlaan Waanada (Qur’aankan); waxayna yidhaahdaan: Kani waa jinnoole.

ayat.arabic: وَمَا هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكۡرٞ لِّلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

en.text: But it is not except a reminder to the worlds.

so.text: 52. Ma se ah (Qur’aanka) wax kale aan aheyn Waano ku socota ummadahoo dhan.

ayat.arabic: ٱلۡحَآقَّةُ

en.text: The Inevitable Reality -

so.text: 1. Xaqiiqda dhabta ah ee sugan [1]!
so.footnotes: [1]. Al-Xaaqqah: Xaqiiqda dhabta ah, waa magac kale oo loo yaqaan Qiyaamaha.

ayat.arabic: مَا ٱلۡحَآقَّةُ

en.text: What is the Inevitable Reality?

so.text: 2. Waa maxay xaqiiqda dhabta ahi?!

ayat.arabic: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلۡحَآقَّةُ

en.text: And what can make you know what is the Inevitable Reality?

so.text: 3. Maxaad ka og tahay waxay tahay xaqiiqdaa dhabta ahi ee sugan?!

ayat.arabic: كَذَّبَتۡ ثَمُودُ وَعَادُۢ بِٱلۡقَارِعَةِ

en.text: Thamūd and ʿAad denied the Striking Calamity [i.e., the Resurrection].

so.text: 4. Thamuud iyo Caadba waxay beeniyeen (Qalbi) Garaacdada (Maalinta Qiyaame).

ayat.arabic: فَأَمَّا ثَمُودُ فَأُهۡلِكُواْ بِٱلطَّاغِيَةِ

en.text: So as for Thamūd, they were destroyed by the overpowering [blast].

so.text: 5. Ma Thamuud, waxaa lagu halaagay Qeylo Daran [2].
so.footnotes: [2]. Qarax xoog leh oo ay la dhinteen dadkii.

ayat.arabic: وَأَمَّا عَادٞ فَأُهۡلِكُواْ بِرِيحٖ صَرۡصَرٍ عَاتِيَةٖ

en.text: And as for ʿAad, they were destroyed by a screaming,[1737] violent wind
en.footnotes: [1737] Or "cold."

so.text: 6. Caad se, waxaa lagu halaagay dabeyl daran oo qabow badan.

ayat.arabic: سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ سَبۡعَ لَيَالٖ وَثَمَٰنِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ حُسُومٗاۖ فَتَرَى ٱلۡقَوۡمَ فِيهَا صَرۡعَىٰ كَأَنَّهُمۡ أَعۡجَازُ نَخۡلٍ خَاوِيَةٖ

en.text: Which He [i.e., Allāh] imposed upon them for seven nights and eight days in succession, so you would see the people therein fallen as if they were hollow trunks of palm trees.

so.text: 7. (Alle) uu ku salliday toddoba habeen iyo siddeed maalmood oo xidhiidh ah; sidaas darteed waxaad arki lahayd dadkiiyoo halkaas u daadsan af gambi la moodo jirrido timreed dhacay.

ayat.arabic: فَهَلۡ تَرَىٰ لَهُم مِّنۢ بَاقِيَةٖ

en.text: Then do you see of them any remains?

so.text: 8. Ee ma aragtaa wax ka hadhay?

ayat.arabic: وَجَآءَ فِرۡعَوۡنُ وَمَن قَبۡلَهُۥ وَٱلۡمُؤۡتَفِكَٰتُ بِٱلۡخَاطِئَةِ

en.text: And there came Pharaoh and those before him and the overturned cities[1738] with sin.
en.footnotes: [1738] Those to which Lot was sent (see 11:82-83) or generally, all cities which were destroyed due to their denial of a messenger from Allāh.

so.text: 9. Fircoon iyo kuwii ka horreeyey iyo magalooyinkii la rogay [3] waxay joogto ula yimaadeen gefaf weyn.
so.footnotes: [3]. Ee qowmu Luud- Sodom iyo Gomorrah.

ayat.arabic: فَعَصَوۡاْ رَسُولَ رَبِّهِمۡ فَأَخَذَهُمۡ أَخۡذَةٗ رَّابِيَةً

en.text: And they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with a seizure exceeding [in severity].

so.text: 10. Waxay caasiyeen Rasuulkii Rabbigood, markaasuu (Alle) qabtay 'ciqaabay' qabasho 'ciqaab' daran.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّا لَمَّا طَغَا ٱلۡمَآءُ حَمَلۡنَٰكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡجَارِيَةِ

en.text: Indeed, when the water overflowed, We carried you [i.e., your ancestors] in the sailing ship[1739]
en.footnotes: [1739] Which was constructed by Noah.

so.text: 11. Markay biyihii xad dhaafeen waxaan idinku qaadnay (dadow) Doonidii (uu sameeyey Nuux).

ayat.arabic: لِنَجۡعَلَهَا لَكُمۡ تَذۡكِرَةٗ وَتَعِيَهَآ أُذُنٞ وَٰعِيَةٞ

en.text: That We might make it for you a reminder and [that] a conscious ear would be conscious of it.

so.text: 12. Si aan idiinkaga dhigno waano, oo una xafiddo dheg wax maqasha oo u fahanto.

ayat.arabic: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِي ٱلصُّورِ نَفۡخَةٞ وَٰحِدَةٞ

en.text: Then when the Horn is blown with one blast

so.text: 13. Ee marka Buunka (Qiyaame) la afuufo afuufid keliya (afuufka hore),

ayat.arabic: وَحُمِلَتِ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَٱلۡجِبَالُ فَدُكَّتَا دَكَّةٗ وَٰحِدَةٗ

en.text: And the earth and the mountains are lifted and leveled with one blow [i.e., stroke] -

so.text: 14. Dhulka iyo buurahana laga rujiyo meelahooda, oo la baduugo baduugid mar keliya ah.

ayat.arabic: فَيَوۡمَئِذٖ وَقَعَتِ ٱلۡوَاقِعَةُ

en.text: Then on that Day, the Occurrence [i.e., Resurrection] will occur,

so.text: 15. Maalintaa bay Dhacdada (Weyn) dhici (Qiyaamada).

ayat.arabic: وَٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَهِيَ يَوۡمَئِذٖ وَاهِيَةٞ

en.text: And the heaven will split [open], for that Day it is infirm.[1740]
en.footnotes: [1740] i.e., weak, enfeebled and unstable.

so.text: 16. Samadu Maalintaa u kala dillaaci gaballo, marka waxay ahaan mid jilicsan.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلۡمَلَكُ عَلَىٰٓ أَرۡجَآئِهَاۚ وَيَحۡمِلُ عَرۡشَ رَبِّكَ فَوۡقَهُمۡ يَوۡمَئِذٖ ثَمَٰنِيَةٞ

en.text: And the angels are at its edges. And there will bear the Throne of your Lord above them, that Day, eight [of them].

so.text: 17. Malaa’igtu waxay ahaan agagaar- keeda, waxaana ku xambaari Carshiga Rabbigaa korkooda Maalintaas siddeed (saf oo malaa'g ah).

ayat.arabic: يَوۡمَئِذٖ تُعۡرَضُونَ لَا تَخۡفَىٰ مِنكُمۡ خَافِيَةٞ

en.text: That Day, you will be exhibited [for judgement]; not hidden among you is anything concealed.[1741]
en.footnotes: [1741] i.e., any person or any secret you might attempt to conceal.

so.text: 18. Maalintaas waa la idin soo bandhigi, ma jirto sir aad leedihiin oo qarsoonaan.

ayat.arabic: فَأَمَّا مَنۡ أُوتِيَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ هَآؤُمُ ٱقۡرَءُواْ كِتَٰبِيَهۡ

en.text: So as for he who is given his record in his right hand, he will say, "Here, read my record!

so.text: 19. Kan laga siiyo kitaabkiisa gacantiisa midig, wuxuu odhan: Waa kane, akhriya kitaabkeyga.

ayat.arabic: إِنِّي ظَنَنتُ أَنِّي مُلَٰقٍ حِسَابِيَهۡ

en.text: Indeed, I was certain that I would be meeting my account."

so.text: 20. Anigu waan hubay inaan la kulmi  Xisaabteyda.

ayat.arabic: فَهُوَ فِي عِيشَةٖ رَّاضِيَةٖ

en.text: So he will be in a pleasant life -

so.text: 21. Marka wuxuu kaasi ku noolaan nolol farxad iyo raallinnimo leh.

ayat.arabic: فِي جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٖ

en.text: In an elevated garden,

so.text: 22. Beer sare gudaheed ah (Janno),

ayat.arabic: قُطُوفُهَا دَانِيَةٞ

en.text: Its [fruit] to be picked hanging near.

so.text: 23. Midhaheedu (goosasho iyo) gurasho dhow yihiin.

ayat.arabic: كُلُواْ وَٱشۡرَبُواْ هَنِيٓـَٔۢا بِمَآ أَسۡلَفۡتُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَيَّامِ ٱلۡخَالِيَةِ

en.text: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you put forth[1742] in the days past."
en.footnotes: [1742] Literally, "advanced" in anticipation of reward in the Hereafter.

so.text: 24. Cuna oo cabba idinkoo faraxsan, waa waxaad horay u falateen maalmihii tegaye.

ayat.arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنۡ أُوتِيَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِشِمَالِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ يَٰلَيۡتَنِي لَمۡ أُوتَ كِتَٰبِيَهۡ

en.text: But as for he who is given his record in his left hand, he will say, "Oh, I wish I had not been given my record

so.text: 25. Kanse laga siiyo kitaabkiisa gacantiisa bidix, wuxuu odhan: Alla haddaan marnaba la I siiyeen kitaabkeyga.

ayat.arabic: وَلَمۡ أَدۡرِ مَا حِسَابِيَهۡ

en.text: And had not known what is my account.

so.text: 26.Oo aan ogaadeen, waxay xisaabteydu tahay?

ayat.arabic: يَٰلَيۡتَهَا كَانَتِ ٱلۡقَاضِيَةَ

en.text: I wish it [i.e., my death] had been the decisive one.[1743]
en.footnotes: [1743] i.e., ending life rather than being the gateway to eternal life.

so.text: 27. Alla hadday taa (dhamishadu) ahaan laheyd dhammaadkeyga.

ayat.arabic: مَآ أَغۡنَىٰ عَنِّي مَالِيَهۡۜ

en.text: My wealth has not availed me.

so.text: 28. Maalkeygii waxba iima tarin.

ayat.arabic: هَلَكَ عَنِّي سُلۡطَٰنِيَهۡ

en.text: Gone from me is my authority."[1744]
en.footnotes: [1744] i.e., I have no valid excuse to stand on.

so.text: 29. Awooddeydii waa iga baabba’een.

ayat.arabic: خُذُوهُ فَغُلُّوهُ

en.text: [Allāh will say], "Seize him and shackle him.

so.text: 30. (Waxaa la odhan): Qabta oo xidha.

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ ٱلۡجَحِيمَ صَلُّوهُ

en.text: Then into Hellfire drive him.

so.text: 31. Markaas geliya dabka ololka badan.

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ فِي سِلۡسِلَةٖ ذَرۡعُهَا سَبۡعُونَ ذِرَاعٗا فَٱسۡلُكُوهُ

en.text: Then into a chain whose length is seventy cubits insert him."

so.text: 32. Markaas ku xirxira silsilad ballaceedu yahay toddobaatan dhudhumood.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ

en.text: Indeed, he did not used to believe in Allāh, the Most Great,

so.text: 33. Ma uu rumeysneyn Allaah, Sarreeyaha Weyn.

ayat.arabic: وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلۡمِسۡكِينِ

en.text: Nor did he encourage the feeding of the poor.

so.text: 34. Mana dhiirra gelin jirin quudinta miskiinka.

ayat.arabic: فَلَيۡسَ لَهُ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ هَٰهُنَا حَمِيمٞ

en.text: So there is not for him here this Day any devoted friend

so.text: 35. Sidaa awgeed kuma laha halkan maanta wax saaxiib run ah.

ayat.arabic: وَلَا طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِنۡ غِسۡلِينٖ

en.text: Nor any food except from the discharge of wounds;

so.text: 36. ama wax cunno ah milil iyo malax ma’ahee.

ayat.arabic: لَّا يَأۡكُلُهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱلۡخَٰطِـُٔونَ

en.text: None will eat it except the sinners.

so.text: 37. Aanay cidi cunin geflowyada maahee.

ayat.arabic: فَلَآ أُقۡسِمُ بِمَا تُبۡصِرُونَ

en.text: So I swear by what you see

so.text: 38. Mayee, waxaan ku dhaartay waxaad aragtaan.

ayat.arabic: وَمَا لَا تُبۡصِرُونَ

en.text: And what you do not see

so.text: 39. Iyo wax aydaan aragba,

ayat.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوۡلُ رَسُولٖ كَرِيمٖ

en.text: [That] indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is the word of a noble Messenger.

so.text: 40. Kani hubaal waa hadal (Alle) uu keenay Rasuul sharaf leh (Nabi Muxammad s.c.w.)

ayat.arabic: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوۡلِ شَاعِرٖۚ قَلِيلٗا مَّا تُؤۡمِنُونَ

en.text: And it is not the word of a poet; little do you believe.

so.text: 41. Ma aha hadal gabyaa, yaraa intaad rumeysaan.

ayat.arabic: وَلَا بِقَوۡلِ كَاهِنٖۚ قَلِيلٗا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ

en.text: Nor the word of a soothsayer; little do you remember.

so.text: 42. ama hadal curraafle, yaraa intaad waantowdaan.

ayat.arabic: تَنزِيلٞ مِّن رَّبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

en.text: [It is] a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.

so.text: 43. Waa Waxyi ka soo degay xagga Rabbiga uumanka (Allaah).

ayat.arabic: وَلَوۡ تَقَوَّلَ عَلَيۡنَا بَعۡضَ ٱلۡأَقَاوِيلِ

en.text: And if he [i.e., Muḥammad] had made up about Us some [false] sayings,

so.text: 44. Hadduu (Nabi Muxammad) naga been sheegi lahaa;

ayat.arabic: لَأَخَذۡنَا مِنۡهُ بِٱلۡيَمِينِ

en.text: We would have seized him by the right hand;[1745]
en.footnotes: [1745] Another interpretation is "by [Our] right hand," i.e., Allāh would have exacted revenge with might and power.

so.text: 45. Waxaan ku qaban laheyn gacanta Midig.

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ لَقَطَعۡنَا مِنۡهُ ٱلۡوَتِينَ

en.text: Then We would have cut from him the aorta.[1746]
en.footnotes: [1746] Causing immediate death.

so.text: 46. Oo waxaan goyn laheyn halbowlaha.

ayat.arabic: فَمَا مِنكُم مِّنۡ أَحَدٍ عَنۡهُ حَٰجِزِينَ

en.text: And there is no one of you who could prevent [Us] from him.

so.text: 47. Ma jiro qof idinka mid ahi oo naga celin lahaa.

ayat.arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَتَذۡكِرَةٞ لِّلۡمُتَّقِينَ

en.text: And indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a reminder for the righteous.

so.text: 48. (Qur'aanku) waa u waano kuwa ka dhowrsada xumaha ee Alle u hoggaansan.

ayat.arabic: وَإِنَّا لَنَعۡلَمُ أَنَّ مِنكُم مُّكَذِّبِينَ

en.text: And indeed, We know that among you are deniers.

so.text: 49. Waan ognahay dhabtii inay idinka mid yihiin kuwa beeniya (Xaqa).

ayat.arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَحَسۡرَةٌ عَلَى ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ

en.text: And indeed, it will be [a cause of] regret upon the disbelievers.

so.text: 50. (Qur’aanku) hubaal waa qoomamada gaalada (Maalinta Qiyaame).

ayat.arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَحَقُّ ٱلۡيَقِينِ

en.text: And indeed, it is the truth of certainty.

so.text: 51. Waana xaq dhab ah oo la hubo.

ayat.arabic: فَسَبِّحۡ بِٱسۡمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ

en.text: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.

so.text: 52. Ee ku tasbiixso, oo huf Magaca Rabbigaa, Weynaha, Sharafta Badan [4].
so.footnotes: [4]. Subxaannallaah wa bi xamdihi Subxaanallaahi Cadiim.

ayat.arabic: سَأَلَ سَآئِلُۢ بِعَذَابٖ وَاقِعٖ

en.text: A supplicant asked for a punishment bound to happen[1748]
en.footnotes: [1748] In the Hereafter. Disbelievers had challenged the Prophet (ﷺ) by invoking Allāh to bring on His punishment. See 8:32.

so.text: 1. Mid wax dalbaya baa dalbay in cadaab ku dhacda 'gaalada loo soo dedejiyo' [1].
so.footnotes: [1]. Gaaladu waxay ka hor yimaadeen Nabiga s.c.w. iyagoo ka dalbay inuu ku keeno cadaab dushooda.

ayat.arabic: لِّلۡكَٰفِرِينَ لَيۡسَ لَهُۥ دَافِعٞ

en.text: To the disbelievers; of it there is no preventer.

so.text: 2. (Cadaabkaasna) ma jiro wax gaalada ka celin -

ayat.arabic: مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ ذِي ٱلۡمَعَارِجِ
