en.text: [It is] from Allāh, owner of the ways of ascent.

so.text: 3. Ka iman xagga Alle, ee leh jidadka kor loogu fuulo (samooyinka).

ayat.arabic: تَعۡرُجُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ إِلَيۡهِ فِي يَوۡمٖ كَانَ مِقۡدَارُهُۥ خَمۡسِينَ أَلۡفَ سَنَةٖ

en.text: The angels and the Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] will ascend to Him during a Day the extent of which is fifty thousand years.

so.text: 4. Kor u koraan Malaa’igta iyo Ruuxa (Jabriil) Maalin qaddarkeedu dhan yahay konton kun oo sano.

ayat.arabic: فَٱصۡبِرۡ صَبۡرٗا جَمِيلًا

en.text: So be patient with gracious patience.

so.text: 5. Ee samir (Nabiyow) samir wanaagsan.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّهُمۡ يَرَوۡنَهُۥ بَعِيدٗا

en.text: Indeed, they see it [as] distant,

so.text: 6. Waxay (gaaladu) u arkaan (cadaabka Qiyaame) wax fog.

ayat.arabic: وَنَرَىٰهُ قَرِيبٗا

en.text: But We see it [as] near.

so.text: 7. Annaguse waxaan u aragnaa inuu dhow yahay.

ayat.arabic: يَوۡمَ تَكُونُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ كَٱلۡمُهۡلِ

en.text: On the Day the sky will be like murky oil,[1749]
en.footnotes: [1749] Or "molten metal."

so.text: 8. Maalintay samadu noqon sida maar shuban.

ayat.arabic: وَتَكُونُ ٱلۡجِبَالُ كَٱلۡعِهۡنِ

en.text: And the mountains will be like wool,[1750]
en.footnotes: [1750] i.e., in the process of disintegration.

so.text: 9. Buuruhuna noqon sida cudbi la dhilay.

ayat.arabic: وَلَا يَسۡـَٔلُ حَمِيمٌ حَمِيمٗا

en.text: And no friend will ask [anything of] a friend,

so.text: 10. Saaxiib uusan saaxiib kale wax weydiineyn.

ayat.arabic: يُبَصَّرُونَهُمۡۚ يَوَدُّ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمُ لَوۡ يَفۡتَدِي مِنۡ عَذَابِ يَوۡمِئِذِۭ بِبَنِيهِ

en.text: They will be shown each other. The criminal will wish that he could be ransomed from the punishment of that Day by his children

so.text: 11. Wayse is arkayaan, denbiilahu wuxuu jeclaan inuu isaga furto Maalintaasi (Qiyaamada) cadaabka ilmahiisa.

ayat.arabic: وَصَٰحِبَتِهِۦ وَأَخِيهِ

en.text: And his wife and his brother

so.text: 12. Iyo xaaskiisa iyo walaalki.

ayat.arabic: وَفَصِيلَتِهِ ٱلَّتِي تُـٔۡوِيهِ

en.text: And his nearest kindred who shelter him

so.text: 13. Iyo kuwa u xiga qaraabo ahaan ee siiya meeluu hoydo,

ayat.arabic: وَمَن فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ جَمِيعٗا ثُمَّ يُنجِيهِ

en.text: And whoever is on earth entirely [so] then it could save him.

so.text: 14. Iyo waxa dhulka ku sugan dhammaan markaas uu isagu badbaado.

ayat.arabic: كَلَّآۖ إِنَّهَا لَظَىٰ

en.text: No![1751] Indeed, it is the Flame [of Hell],
en.footnotes: [1751] An emphatic refusal meaning "It is not to be."

so.text: 15. Mayee! Hubaal waa Naar ololeysa.

ayat.arabic: نَزَّاعَةٗ لِّلشَّوَىٰ

en.text: A remover of exteriors.[1752]
en.footnotes: [1752] This refers to the skin of the head or of the body or to the body extremities - which will be burned away.

so.text: 16. Diiraneysa haragga Madaxa.

ayat.arabic: تَدۡعُواْ مَنۡ أَدۡبَرَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ

en.text: It invites he who turned his back [on truth] and went away [from obedience]

so.text: 17. U yeedhi kan jeestay ee Xaqa diiday.

ayat.arabic: وَجَمَعَ فَأَوۡعَىٰٓ

en.text: And collected [wealth] and hoarded.

so.text: 18. Oo maal kulmiyey oo afka u xiray (wax ka bixin sadaqo ahaan).

ayat.arabic: ۞ إِنَّ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ خُلِقَ هَلُوعًا

en.text: Indeed, mankind was created anxious:

so.text: 19. Hubaal Aadmigu waxaa lagu abuuray samir yaraan iyo degdegsiinyo.

ayat.arabic: إِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلشَّرُّ جَزُوعٗا

en.text: When evil touches him, impatient,

so.text: 20. Markuu dhib taabto wuu murugoodaa oo samir yar yahay.

ayat.arabic: وَإِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلۡخَيۡرُ مَنُوعًا

en.text: And when good touches him, withholding [of it],

so.text: 21. Markuu khayr helana waa bakhayl (aan wax bixin).

ayat.arabic: إِلَّا ٱلۡمُصَلِّينَ

en.text: Except the observers of prayer -

so.text: 22. Kuwa salaadda tukada mooyaane.

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمۡ دَآئِمُونَ

en.text: Those who are constant in their prayer

so.text: 23. Ee ah kuwa salaaddooda daa’ima;

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ فِيٓ أَمۡوَٰلِهِمۡ حَقّٞ مَّعۡلُومٞ

en.text: And those within whose wealth is a known right[1753]
en.footnotes: [1753] i.e., a specified share, meaning the obligatory zakāh.

so.text: 24. Ee ah kuwa maalkooda uu ugu jiro qayb la yaqaan.

ayat.arabic: لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلۡمَحۡرُومِ

en.text: For the petitioner and the deprived -

so.text: 25. Kan wax weydiista, iyo kan aan wax heysan.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُصَدِّقُونَ بِيَوۡمِ ٱلدِّينِ

en.text: And those who believe in the Day of Recompense

so.text: 26. Ee ah kuwa rumeysan Maalinta jaazeynta (Qiyaamaha).

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم مِّنۡ عَذَابِ رَبِّهِم مُّشۡفِقُونَ

en.text: And those who are fearful of the punishment of their Lord -

so.text: 27. Ee ah kuwa iyagu ka baqa cadaabka Rabbigood.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّهِمۡ غَيۡرُ مَأۡمُونٖ

en.text: Indeed, the punishment of their Lord is not that from which one is safe -

so.text: 28. Hubaal Cadaabka Rabbigaa waa wax aan aamin laga aheyn.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ لِفُرُوجِهِمۡ حَٰفِظُونَ

en.text: And those who guard their private parts

so.text: 29. Ee ah kuwa ilaaliya xubnahooda gaarka ah.

ayat.arabic: إِلَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَزۡوَٰجِهِمۡ أَوۡ مَا مَلَكَتۡ أَيۡمَٰنُهُمۡ فَإِنَّهُمۡ غَيۡرُ مَلُومِينَ

en.text: Except from their wives or those their right hands possess,[1754] for indeed, they are not to be blamed -
en.footnotes: [1754] i.e., female slaves.

so.text: 30. Xagga xaasaskooda ma’ahee ama kuwa ay gacmahoodu midig hantaan (markaa) ma laha wax eed ah.

ayat.arabic: فَمَنِ ٱبۡتَغَىٰ وَرَآءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡعَادُونَ

en.text: But whoever seeks beyond that, then they are the transgressors -

so.text: 31. Kiise doona inuu intaas dabo maro, kuwaa weeye kuwa xadgudbayaasha ah.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ لِأَمَٰنَٰتِهِمۡ وَعَهۡدِهِمۡ رَٰعُونَ

en.text: And those who are to their trusts and promises attentive

so.text: 32. Ee ah kuwaa ilaaliya ammaanooyinkoo- da iyo ballankooda;

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِشَهَٰدَٰتِهِمۡ قَآئِمُونَ

en.text: And those who are in their testimonies upright

so.text: 33. Ee ah kuwaa iyagu si toosan u guta oo u fura maraggooda;

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمۡ يُحَافِظُونَ

en.text: And those who [carefully] maintain their prayer:

so.text: 34. Ee ah kuwa xafida oo dhowra salaaddooda,

ayat.arabic: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ فِي جَنَّٰتٖ مُّكۡرَمُونَ

en.text: They will be in gardens,[1755] honored.
en.footnotes: [1755] In Paradise.

so.text: 35. Kuwaasi waxay geli Beeraha Jannada iyagoo sharfan.

ayat.arabic: فَمَالِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ قِبَلَكَ مُهۡطِعِينَ

en.text: So what is [the matter] with those who disbelieve, hastening [from] before you, [O Muḥammad],

so.text: 36. Muxuuse arrinkoodu yahay kuwaa Xaqa diida waa iyaga u soo degdega hareerahaada’e.

ayat.arabic: عَنِ ٱلۡيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ عِزِينَ

en.text: [To sit] on [your] right and [your] left in separate groups?[1756]
en.footnotes: [1756] They sat at a distance in order to oppose and mock the Prophet (ﷺ), claiming that they would enter Paradise before the believers.

so.text: 37. Xagga midigta iyo bidixda koox koox u jooga?

ayat.arabic: أَيَطۡمَعُ كُلُّ ٱمۡرِيٕٖ مِّنۡهُمۡ أَن يُدۡخَلَ جَنَّةَ نَعِيمٖ

en.text: Does every person among them aspire to enter a garden of pleasure?

so.text: 38. Ma wuxuu qof walba oo ka mid ahi damci in la geliyo Jannada barwaaqada ah?

ayat.arabic: كَلَّآۖ إِنَّا خَلَقۡنَٰهُم مِّمَّا يَعۡلَمُونَ

en.text: No! Indeed, We have created them from that which they know.[1757]
en.footnotes: [1757] i.e., a liquid disdained. So how can they expect to enter Paradise except by the will of their Creator?

so.text: 39. Mayee, Waxaanu xaqiiq ka abuurnay waxay og yihiin (biyo liita oo haddana is kibriyaan).

ayat.arabic: فَلَآ أُقۡسِمُ بِرَبِّ ٱلۡمَشَٰرِقِ وَٱلۡمَغَٰرِبِ إِنَّا لَقَٰدِرُونَ

en.text: So I swear by the Lord of [all] risings and settings[1758] that indeed We are able
en.footnotes: [1758] i.e., Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā), who determines the point at which the sun, moon and stars rise and set according to season and every position of observation.

so.text: 40. Mayee se! Waxaan ku dhaartay Rabbiga bariyada iyo galbeedyada (waa isla Alle'e oo naf ahaantiisa ku dhaaran) inaan xaqiiq Karno;

ayat.arabic: عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ خَيۡرٗا مِّنۡهُمۡ وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمَسۡبُوقِينَ

en.text: To replace them with better than them; and We are not to be outdone.

so.text: 41. Inaan ku beddelno (kuwo kale) oo ka wanaagsan; nalagamana adkaado.

ayat.arabic: فَذَرۡهُمۡ يَخُوضُواْ وَيَلۡعَبُواْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُواْ يَوۡمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِي يُوعَدُونَ

en.text: So leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised -

so.text: 42. Ee iska dhaaf ha dhumbadeene (xumaanta) hana iska cayaareen, intay kala kulmaan Maalinkooda loogu gooddiyo.

ayat.arabic: يَوۡمَ يَخۡرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡأَجۡدَاثِ سِرَاعٗا كَأَنَّهُمۡ إِلَىٰ نُصُبٖ يُوفِضُونَ

en.text: The Day they will emerge from the graves rapidly as if they were, toward an erected idol, hastening.[1759]
en.footnotes: [1759] i.e., just as they used to race, whenever an idol was newly appointed, to be the first of its worshippers.

so.text: 43. Maalintay ka soo bixi qubuuraha iyagoo degdegaya sida inay u tartarmayaan taallooyin loo taagay.

ayat.arabic: خَٰشِعَةً أَبۡصَٰرُهُمۡ تَرۡهَقُهُمۡ ذِلَّةٞۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡيَوۡمُ ٱلَّذِي كَانُواْ يُوعَدُونَ

en.text: Their eyes humbled, humiliation will cover them. That is the Day which they had been promised.

so.text: 44. Indhahoodu rogan yihiin, dulli baa dabooli (korka oo dhan)! Kaasi waa Maalin- kii loogu gooddiyey (ay beeninayeen).

ayat.arabic: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوۡمِهِۦٓ أَنۡ أَنذِرۡ قَوۡمَكَ مِن قَبۡلِ أَن يَأۡتِيَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٞ

en.text: Indeed, We sent Noah to his people, [saying], "Warn your people before there comes to them a painful punishment."

so.text: 1. Waxaanu xaqiiq u dirnay Nuux qolodiisii (Annagoo leh): U dig qolodaada intaysan u iman cadaab xanuun badan.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ إِنِّي لَكُمۡ نَذِيرٞ مُّبِينٌ

en.text: He said, "O my people, indeed I am to you a clear warner -

so.text: 2. (Nuux) Wuxuu yidhi: Tolkaygiiyow! Waxaan anigu idiin ahay dige cad.

ayat.arabic: أَنِ ٱعۡبُدُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَٱتَّقُوهُ وَأَطِيعُونِ

en.text: To worship Allāh, fear Him and obey me.

so.text: 3. Ee caabuda Alle oo keliya, oo ka cabsada, anigana i adeeca.

ayat.arabic: يَغۡفِرۡ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمۡ وَيُؤَخِّرۡكُمۡ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٖ مُّسَمًّىۚ إِنَّ أَجَلَ ٱللَّهِ إِذَا جَآءَ لَا يُؤَخَّرُۚ لَوۡ كُنتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُونَ

en.text: He [i.e., Allāh] will forgive you of your sins and delay you for a specified term. Indeed, the time [set by] Allāh, when it comes, will not be delayed, if you only knew."

so.text: 4. Wuxuu 'Alle' idiin dhaafi denbiyadiinna, oo idiin dib dhigi ilaa muddo magacaaban. Ajasha Alle (mowdku) markuu yimaado lama dib dhigo, waase haddaad og tihiin.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّي دَعَوۡتُ قَوۡمِي لَيۡلٗا وَنَهَارٗا

en.text: He said, "My Lord, indeed I invited my people [to truth] night and day.

so.text: 5. (Nuux) wuxuu yidhi: Rabbiyow! Waxaan qolodeydii ugu baaqay (Towxiid iyo falasho camallo san) habeen iyo maalinba.

ayat.arabic: فَلَمۡ يَزِدۡهُمۡ دُعَآءِيٓ إِلَّا فِرَارٗا

en.text: But my invitation increased them not except in flight [i.e., aversion].

so.text: 6. Ha yeeshee baaqeygu uma uusan kordhin waxaan aheyn didmo.

ayat.arabic: وَإِنِّي كُلَّمَا دَعَوۡتُهُمۡ لِتَغۡفِرَ لَهُمۡ جَعَلُوٓاْ أَصَٰبِعَهُمۡ فِيٓ ءَاذَانِهِمۡ وَٱسۡتَغۡشَوۡاْ ثِيَابَهُمۡ وَأَصَرُّواْ وَٱسۡتَكۡبَرُواْ ٱسۡتِكۡبَارٗا

en.text: And indeed, every time I invited them that You may forgive them, they put their fingers in their ears, covered themselves with their garments,[1761] persisted, and were arrogant with [great] arrogance.
en.footnotes: [1761] Refusing to look or listen.

so.text: 7. Mar kastoo aan u yeedhana si aad ugu denbi dhaafto, waxay yeelaan farahooda dhegahooda, iskuna dadaan maryahooda [1], oo madax adaygaan, wayna is kibriyaan iskibrin.
so.footnotes: [1]. Iyagoo diidaya inay fiirshaan ama dhageystaan Xaqa.

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنِّي دَعَوۡتُهُمۡ جِهَارٗا

en.text: Then I invited them publicly.

so.text: 8. Haddana waxaan xaqiiq ugu baaqay (Towxiidka oo uga digay shirkiga) si cad.

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنِّيٓ أَعۡلَنتُ لَهُمۡ وَأَسۡرَرۡتُ لَهُمۡ إِسۡرَارٗا

en.text: Then I announced to them and [also] confided to them secretly

so.text: 9. Markaasaan ula hadlay si kore, si hoosana waan ula hadlay oo wax ugu sheegay [2].
so.footnotes: [2]. Wuxuu Nuux c.s. la soo maray ku baaqiisa Islaamka heerar iyo xaalado kala duwan:

ayat.arabic: فَقُلۡتُ ٱسۡتَغۡفِرُواْ رَبَّكُمۡ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفَّارٗا

en.text: And said, 'Ask forgiveness of your Lord. Indeed, He is ever a Perpetual Forgiver.

so.text: 10. Waxaan ku idhi: Ka barya denbi dhaaf Rabbigiin; waa Denbi Dhaaf Badane’e.

ayat.arabic: يُرۡسِلِ ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيۡكُم مِّدۡرَارٗا

en.text: He will send [rain from] the sky upon you in [continuing] showers

so.text: 11. Wuxuu idiinka keeni daruuraha roob darar ah;

ayat.arabic: وَيُمۡدِدۡكُم بِأَمۡوَٰلٖ وَبَنِينَ وَيَجۡعَل لَّكُمۡ جَنَّٰتٖ وَيَجۡعَل لَّكُمۡ أَنۡهَٰرٗا

en.text: And give you increase in wealth and children and provide for you gardens and provide for you rivers.

so.text: 12. Oo idiinku deeqi maal iyo awlaad, oo idiin yeeli beero, idiinna yeeli webiyaal.

ayat.arabic: مَّا لَكُمۡ لَا تَرۡجُونَ لِلَّهِ وَقَارٗا

en.text: What is [the matter] with you that you do not attribute to Allāh [due] grandeur

so.text: 13. Maxaad leedihiin aydaan uga heybeysan Alle?

ayat.arabic: وَقَدۡ خَلَقَكُمۡ أَطۡوَارًا

en.text: While He has created you in stages?[1762]
en.footnotes: [1762] i.e., in various progressive states and conditions. See also 22:5 and 23:12-14 in reference to development of the embryo.

so.text: 14. Isagoo dhabtii idin abuuray idinkoo soo maray xaalado iyo heerar (kala duwan).

ayat.arabic: أَلَمۡ تَرَوۡاْ كَيۡفَ خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ سَبۡعَ سَمَٰوَٰتٖ طِبَاقٗا

en.text: Do you not consider how Allāh has created seven heavens in layers[1763]
en.footnotes: [1763] See footnote to 67:3.

so.text: 15. Miyeydaan arag sida Alle u abuuray toddobada samo ee kala korreeya.

ayat.arabic: وَجَعَلَ ٱلۡقَمَرَ فِيهِنَّ نُورٗا وَجَعَلَ ٱلشَّمۡسَ سِرَاجٗا

en.text: And made the moon therein a [reflected] light and made the sun a burning lamp?

so.text: 16. Oo dayaxa uga yeelay dhexdooda nuur, qorraxdana ka yeelay nal shidan?

ayat.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ أَنۢبَتَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ نَبَاتٗا

en.text: And Allāh has caused you to grow from the earth a [progressive] growth.

so.text: 17. Alle Waa Kan idinka beeray (abuuray) dhulka beeritaan (abuuris).

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ يُعِيدُكُمۡ فِيهَا وَيُخۡرِجُكُمۡ إِخۡرَاجٗا

en.text: Then He will return you into it and extract you [another] extraction.

so.text: 18. Haddana idinku celin gudahiisa oo idinka soo bixin  baxniin (cusub).

ayat.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ بِسَاطٗا

en.text: And Allāh has made for you the earth an expanse

so.text: 19. Alle waa Kan idiinka yeelay dhulka gogol fidsan.

ayat.arabic: لِّتَسۡلُكُواْ مِنۡهَا سُبُلٗا فِجَاجٗا

en.text: That you may follow therein roads of passage.'"

so.text: 20. Si aad ugu socotaan dhexdiisa waddooyin waasic ah.

ayat.arabic: قَالَ نُوحٞ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمۡ عَصَوۡنِي وَٱتَّبَعُواْ مَن لَّمۡ يَزِدۡهُ مَالُهُۥ وَوَلَدُهُۥٓ إِلَّا خَسَارٗا

en.text: Noah said, "My Lord, indeed they have disobeyed me and followed him whose wealth and children will not increase him except in loss.

so.text: 21. Nuux wuxuu yidhi: Rabbiyow! Waa ii caasiyeen, waxayna raaceen mid aan maalkiisa iyo dhashiisa u kordhin waxaan  ahayn khasaaro.

ayat.arabic: وَمَكَرُواْ مَكۡرٗا كُبَّارٗا

en.text: And they conspired an immense conspiracy

so.text: 22. Oo waxay qooleen shirqool aad u weyn.

ayat.arabic: وَقَالُواْ لَا تَذَرُنَّ ءَالِهَتَكُمۡ وَلَا تَذَرُنَّ وَدّٗا وَلَا سُوَاعٗا وَلَا يَغُوثَ وَيَعُوقَ وَنَسۡرٗا

en.text: And said, 'Never leave your gods and never leave Wadd or Suwāʿ or Yaghūth and Yaʿūq and Nasr.'[1764]
en.footnotes: [1764] These were the names of specific idols named after pious men of earlier generations.

so.text: 23. Oo yidhaahdeen: Sinnaba ha uga tegina ilaahyadiinna, hana ka tegina (gaar ahaan) Wadd ama Suwaac ama Yaquus iyo Yacuuq iyo Nasar.

ayat.arabic: وَقَدۡ أَضَلُّواْ كَثِيرٗاۖ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا ضَلَٰلٗا

en.text: And already they have misled many. And, [my Lord], do not increase the wrongdoers except in error."

so.text: 24. Waxay lumiyeen dad badan, ee (Allow) ha u kordhin daalimiinta 'gar diidka' waxaan aheyn habow.

ayat.arabic: مِّمَّا خَطِيٓـَٰٔتِهِمۡ أُغۡرِقُواْ فَأُدۡخِلُواْ نَارٗا فَلَمۡ يَجِدُواْ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَنصَارٗا

en.text: Because of their sins they were drowned and put into the Fire, and they found not for themselves besides Allāh [any] helpers.

so.text: 25. Gefafkoodii dartood baa loo harqiyey, Naarna loo geliyay, marka ma helin cid u soo gargaarta Alle sokadi.

ayat.arabic: وَقَالَ نُوحٞ رَّبِّ لَا تَذَرۡ عَلَى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مِنَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ دَيَّارًا

en.text: And Noah said, "My Lord, do not leave upon the earth from among the disbelievers an inhabitant.

so.text: 26. Nuux wuxuu yidhi: Rabbiyow! Ha kaga tegin dhulka korkiisa gaalada qofna.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّكَ إِن تَذَرۡهُمۡ يُضِلُّواْ عِبَادَكَ وَلَا يَلِدُوٓاْ إِلَّا فَاجِرٗا كَفَّارٗا

en.text: Indeed, if You leave them, they will mislead Your servants and not beget except [every] wicked one and [confirmed] disbeliever.

so.text: 27. Waayo haddaad kaga tagto, waxay xaqiiq dhumin addoomahaaga, mana dhalayaan waxaan aheyn faajir, gaalnimo badan.

ayat.arabic: رَّبِّ ٱغۡفِرۡ لِي وَلِوَٰلِدَيَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيۡتِيَ مُؤۡمِنٗا وَلِلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنَٰتِۖ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا تَبَارَۢا

en.text: My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house a believer and the believing men and believing women. And do not increase the wrongdoers except in destruction."

so.text: 28. Rabbiyow! Ii Denbi dhaaf aniga, iyo waalidkeyba iyo qofkii soo gala gurigeyga isagoo mu’min ah, iyo mu’miniinta iyo mu’minooyinka. Hana u kordhin daalimiinta (gar diidka) waxaan aheyn baabba’.

ayat.arabic: قُلۡ أُوحِيَ إِلَيَّ أَنَّهُ ٱسۡتَمَعَ نَفَرٞ مِّنَ ٱلۡجِنِّ فَقَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا سَمِعۡنَا قُرۡءَانًا عَجَبٗا

en.text: Say, [O Muḥammad], "It has been revealed to me that a group of the jinn listened and said, 'Indeed, we have heard an amazing Qur’ān [i.e., recitation].

so.text: 1. (Nabi Muxammadow) dheh: Waxaa la ii waxyooday inay koox Jin ahi dhegaysteen (Qur’aanka). Markaasay yidhaahdeen: Waxaanu maqallay Qur'aan cajab leh.

ayat.arabic: يَهۡدِيٓ إِلَى ٱلرُّشۡدِ فَـَٔامَنَّا بِهِۦۖ وَلَن نُّشۡرِكَ بِرَبِّنَآ أَحَدٗا

en.text: It guides to the right course, and we have believed in it. And we will never associate with our Lord anyone.

so.text: 2. Oo wax ku hanuunin dhabbaha toosan ee abbaarta ah, markaasaan rumeynay, umana shariig yeeleyno cidna Rabbigayo.

ayat.arabic: وَأَنَّهُۥ تَعَٰلَىٰ جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا ٱتَّخَذَ صَٰحِبَةٗ وَلَا وَلَدٗا

en.text: And [it teaches] that exalted is the nobleness of our Lord; He has not taken a wife or a son

so.text: 3. Waxaa sarreeya Sharafta iyo Haybadda (Alle) Rabbigeen, ma uusan yeelan xaas iyo ilmo midna [1].
so.footnotes: [1]. Waxay qaarkood rumeysnaayeen jinku inuu Allaah leeyahay xaas iyo ilmo, laakiin kaddib markay soo Islameen waa ka hareen odhaahdaasi xun iyo caqiidadaas gurracan oo ka hufeen Alle inuu leeyahay wiil ama gabdho ama shariigyo.

ayat.arabic: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ يَقُولُ سَفِيهُنَا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ شَطَطٗا

en.text: And that our foolish one [i.e., Iblees][1766] has been saying about Allāh an excessive transgression.
en.footnotes: [1766] A plural form may also be understood, i.e., "the foolish ones among us."

so.text: 4. Wuxuu ahaa kan maan gaabka ahi [2] ee dhexdeenna ah mid ka sheega hadallo xadgudub ah aan habbooneyn Alle.
so.footnotes: [2]. Ibliis. Waxaa sidoo kale lagu fasiri karaa wadar ahaan, markaas waa in la yidhaahdo: “iyo in kuweenna maangaabka ahi ee naga mid ah”.

ayat.arabic: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن تَقُولَ ٱلۡإِنسُ وَٱلۡجِنُّ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبٗا

en.text: And we had thought that mankind and the jinn would never speak about Allāh a lie.

so.text: 5. Waxaan u malaynaynay inaysan dadka iyo jinkaba ka been sheegin Alle.

ayat.arabic: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ رِجَالٞ مِّنَ ٱلۡإِنسِ يَعُوذُونَ بِرِجَالٖ مِّنَ ٱلۡجِنِّ فَزَادُوهُمۡ رَهَقٗا

en.text: And there were men from mankind who sought refuge in men from the jinn, so they [only] increased them in burden [i.e., sin].

so.text: 6. Waxay rag ku jira dadka magan galayeen rag ku jira jinka, markaasay u kordhiyeen dhib iyo culeys (denbi).

ayat.arabic: وَأَنَّهُمۡ ظَنُّواْ كَمَا ظَنَنتُمۡ أَن لَّن يَبۡعَثَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٗا

en.text: And they had thought, as you thought, that Allāh would never send anyone [as a messenger].

so.text: 7. Waxay moodeen sidaad idinkuba mooddeen inuusan Alle ka soo bixineyn (iilka) qofna.

ayat.arabic: وَأَنَّا لَمَسۡنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ فَوَجَدۡنَٰهَا مُلِئَتۡ حَرَسٗا شَدِيدٗا وَشُهُبٗا

en.text: And we have sought [to reach] the heaven but found it filled with powerful guards and burning flames.

so.text: 8. Waxaan doonnay inaan gaarno samada, waxaanse la kulannay iyadoo laga buuxiyey ilaalooyin adag iyo danabyo.

ayat.arabic: وَأَنَّا كُنَّا نَقۡعُدُ مِنۡهَا مَقَٰعِدَ لِلسَّمۡعِۖ فَمَن يَسۡتَمِعِ ٱلۡأٓنَ يَجِدۡ لَهُۥ شِهَابٗا رَّصَدٗا

en.text: And we used to sit therein in positions for hearing,[1767] but whoever listens now will find a burning flame lying in wait for him.
en.footnotes: [1767] Before the prophethood of Muḥammad (ﷺ) the jinn used to collect information by eavesdropping on the angels and then pass it on to fortunetellers and soothsayers.

so.text: 9. Waxaan ka fadhiisan jirnay rugag laga fadhiisto si aan u raaricinno maqalka, kiise (isku dayaa) inuu wax soo dhegaysto haatan wuxuu la kulmayaa danab sugaya.

ayat.arabic: وَأَنَّا لَا نَدۡرِيٓ أَشَرٌّ أُرِيدَ بِمَن فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ أَمۡ أَرَادَ بِهِمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ رَشَدٗا

en.text: And we do not know [therefore] whether evil is intended for those on earth or whether their Lord intends for them a right course.

so.text: 10. Ma ogin in shar lala maagay waxa jooga dhulka korkiisa, ama in Rabbigood la doonay hanuun toosan.

ayat.arabic: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلصَّٰلِحُونَ وَمِنَّا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَۖ كُنَّا طَرَآئِقَ قِدَدٗا

en.text: And among us are the righteous, and among us are [others] not so; we were [of] divided ways.[1768]
en.footnotes: [1768] In opinion, belief and religious practice.

so.text: 11. Waxaa naga mid ah kuwo wanaagsan iyo kuwo kaleba aan sidaasi ahayn, waxaanu nahay kooxo raaca dariiqooyin kala duwan.

ayat.arabic: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن نُّعۡجِزَ ٱللَّهَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَن نُّعۡجِزَهُۥ هَرَبٗا

en.text: And we have become certain that we will never cause failure to Allāh upon earth, nor can we escape Him by flight.

so.text: 12. Waxaan hubnaa inaan uga fakan karin (ciqaabka) Alle dhulka, oo ugama fakan karno (ciqaabka) carar.

ayat.arabic: وَأَنَّا لَمَّا سَمِعۡنَا ٱلۡهُدَىٰٓ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦۖ فَمَن يُؤۡمِنۢ بِرَبِّهِۦ فَلَا يَخَافُ بَخۡسٗا وَلَا رَهَقٗا

en.text: And when we heard the guidance [i.e., the Qur’ān], we believed in it. And whoever believes in his Lord will not fear deprivation or burden.[1769]
en.footnotes: [1769] In regard to his account in the Hereafter. Nothing of his good will be diminished, nor will the evil of another be placed upon him.

so.text: 13. Markaan maqallay Hanuunkana waan rumaynay, qofkii rumeeya Rabbigi (Alle) kama baqo nuqsaan ajar ama dulmi midna.

ayat.arabic: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلۡمُسۡلِمُونَ وَمِنَّا ٱلۡقَٰسِطُونَۖ فَمَنۡ أَسۡلَمَ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ تَحَرَّوۡاْ رَشَدٗا

en.text: And among us are Muslims [in submission to Allāh], and among us are the unjust.[1770] And whoever has become Muslim - those have sought out the right course.
en.footnotes: [1770] i.e., those who deviate from the truth and act tyrannically.

so.text: 14. Waxaa naga mid ah kuwo 'Alle u' hoggaansan (Muslimiin ah), iyo kuwo xadgudba; qofkii u hoggaansama (Alle), kuwaasi waxay raacaan hanuun toosan.

ayat.arabic: وَأَمَّا ٱلۡقَٰسِطُونَ فَكَانُواْ لِجَهَنَّمَ حَطَبٗا

en.text: But as for the unjust, they will be, for Hell, firewood.'

so.text: 15. Kuwase ah xadgudbayaasha, kuwaasu waa xaabada Naarta,

ayat.arabic: وَأَلَّوِ ٱسۡتَقَٰمُواْ عَلَى ٱلطَّرِيقَةِ لَأَسۡقَيۡنَٰهُم مَّآءً غَدَقٗا

en.text: And [Allāh revealed] that if they had remained straight on the way, We would have given them abundant rain [i.e., provision]

so.text: 16. Hadday ku toosaan (dadku) Jidka (Islaamka) waxaan ka waraabin laheyn biyo badan (risiq wanaagsan).

ayat.arabic: لِّنَفۡتِنَهُمۡ فِيهِۚ وَمَن يُعۡرِضۡ عَن ذِكۡرِ رَبِّهِۦ يَسۡلُكۡهُ عَذَابٗا صَعَدٗا

en.text: So We might test them therein. And whoever turns away from the remembrance of his Lord[1771] He will put into arduous punishment.
en.footnotes: [1771] i.e., refuses obedience to Him.

so.text: 17. Si aan ugu imtixaanno. Qofkii ka jeesada Xusidda (Alle) Rabbigi, Wuxuu galin cadaab sii kordheysa.

ayat.arabic: وَأَنَّ ٱلۡمَسَٰجِدَ لِلَّهِ فَلَا تَدۡعُواْ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدٗا

en.text: And [He revealed] that the masjids[1772] are for Allāh, so do not invoke[1773] with Allāh anyone.
en.footnotes:
[1772] The term "masjid" here includes every place of worship or the earth in general.
[1773] Or "worship."

so.text: 18. Masaajidda (iyo dhulkoo dhan) waxaa leh Alle keliya, ee ha kula baryina (caabudina) Alle cid kale.

ayat.arabic: وَأَنَّهُۥ لَمَّا قَامَ عَبۡدُ ٱللَّهِ يَدۡعُوهُ كَادُواْ يَكُونُونَ عَلَيۡهِ لِبَدٗا

en.text: And that when the Servant [i.e., Prophet] of Allāh stood up supplicating Him, they almost became about him a compacted mass."[1774]
en.footnotes: [1774] Crowding on top of each other in the manner of locusts in order to hear him (ﷺ). "They" may refer to the jinn or to the disbelievers among the Arabs.

so.text: 19. Markuu addoonkaa Alle (Nabi Muxammad) istaagay isagoo (Alle Keliya) baryaya, waxay jinku u dhowaadeen inay is buurtaan dushiisa (si ay u dhageystaan).

ayat.arabic: قُلۡ إِنَّمَآ أَدۡعُواْ رَبِّي وَلَآ أُشۡرِكُ بِهِۦٓ أَحَدٗا

en.text: Say, [O Muḥammad], "I only invoke my Lord and do not associate with Him anyone."

so.text: 20. Dheh: Waxaan uun baryayaa (caabudi Allaah Keliya) Rabbigay, lana wadaajin maayo cidna cibaadada.

ayat.arabic: قُلۡ إِنِّي لَآ أَمۡلِكُ لَكُمۡ ضَرّٗا وَلَا رَشَدٗا

en.text: Say, "Indeed, I do not possess for you [the power of] harm or right direction."

so.text: 21. Dheh: Anigu xaqiiq idiin ma hayo dhib ama dheef (habow ama hanuun) midna.

ayat.arabic: قُلۡ إِنِّي لَن يُجِيرَنِي مِنَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدٞ وَلَنۡ أَجِدَ مِن دُونِهِۦ مُلۡتَحَدًا

en.text: Say, "Indeed, there will never protect me from Allāh anyone [if I should disobey], nor will I find in other than Him a refuge.

so.text: 22. Dheh: Cidina igama celin karto (Ciqaabka) Alle (Haddaan ku caasiyo), mana helayo sokadi wax ciirsi iyo agab ah.

ayat.arabic: إِلَّا بَلَٰغٗا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِسَٰلَٰتِهِۦۚ وَمَن يَعۡصِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا

en.text: But [I have for you] only notification from Allāh, and His messages." And whoever disobeys Allāh and His Messenger - then indeed, for him is the fire of Hell; they will abide therein forever.

so.text: 23. (Xilkeygu waa) oo keliya Gaarsiinta (Xaqa) ka yimid Alle iyo Farriimahiisa (Towxiidka). Qofkii caasiya Alle iyo Rasuulkiisa, hubaal wuxuu mudan Naarta Jahannama ay ku dhex waari weligood.

ayat.arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوۡاْ مَا يُوعَدُونَ فَسَيَعۡلَمُونَ مَنۡ أَضۡعَفُ نَاصِرٗا وَأَقَلُّ عَدَدٗا

en.text: [The disbelievers continue] until, when they see that which they are promised, then they will know who is weaker in helpers and less in number.

so.text: 24. Jeer markay arkaan waxa loogu gooddiyo, markaasay ogaan cidda gargaarahiisu tabar daran yahay oo tiro yar.

ayat.arabic: قُلۡ إِنۡ أَدۡرِيٓ أَقَرِيبٞ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ أَمۡ يَجۡعَلُ لَهُۥ رَبِّيٓ أَمَدًا

en.text: Say, "I do not know if what you are promised is near or if my Lord will grant for it a [long] period."

so.text: 25. Dheh: Anigu ma ogi in waxa la idiinku gooddiyo uu dhow yahay, ama in Rabbigay u yeeli waqti go’an.

ayat.arabic: عَٰلِمُ ٱلۡغَيۡبِ فَلَا يُظۡهِرُ عَلَىٰ غَيۡبِهِۦٓ أَحَدًا

en.text: [He is] Knower of the unseen, and He does not disclose His [knowledge of the] unseen to anyone

so.text: 26. Waa Ogsoonaha Ghaybka (waxaan muuqan ee qarsoon), umana bandhigo Ghaybkiisa qofna.

ayat.arabic: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱرۡتَضَىٰ مِن رَّسُولٖ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَسۡلُكُ مِنۢ بَيۡنِ يَدَيۡهِ وَمِنۡ خَلۡفِهِۦ رَصَدٗا

en.text: Except whom He has approved of messengers, and indeed, He sends before him [i.e., each messenger] and behind him observers[1775]
en.footnotes: [1775] Guardian angels to protect the messenger and the message.

so.text: 27. Mid maahee uu u doorto Rasuul ahaan, markaa wuxuu u yeelaa ilaalo socota hortiisa iyo gadaashiisaba.

ayat.arabic: لِّيَعۡلَمَ أَن قَدۡ أَبۡلَغُواْ رِسَٰلَٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ وَأَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيۡهِمۡ وَأَحۡصَىٰ كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ عَدَدَۢا

en.text: That he [i.e., Muḥammad (ﷺ)] may know[1776] that they have conveyed the messages of their Lord; and He has encompassed whatever is with them and has enumerated all things in number.
en.footnotes: [1776] This phrase may also be read: "So He [i.e., Allāh] may make evident."

so.text: 28. Si uu u muujiiyo inay run ahaan gaarsiiyeen Farriimihii Rabbigood, (Allena) wuu koobay waxa agtooda ah, wayna u tira kooban yihiin wax walba.

ayat.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡمُزَّمِّلُ

en.text: O you who wraps himself [in clothing],[1778]
en.footnotes: [1778] Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) addresses the Prophet (ﷺ), who was asleep, wrapped in his garments.

so.text: 1. Kani isku duuduubayow maryaha [1].
so.footnotes: [1]. Nabiga s.c.w. waxaa la amray halkii  hurda macaansiga inuu xilkaa weyn qaado oo u kaco cibaado iyo Alle bari iyo inuu dadka amro (towxiidka) iyo camalka san oo kaga digo shirkiga iyo xuma falka.

ayat.arabic: قُمِ ٱلَّيۡلَ إِلَّا قَلِيلٗا

en.text: Arise [to pray] the night, except for a little -

so.text: 2. U kac (salaad) habeenka in yar maahee.

ayat.arabic: نِّصۡفَهُۥٓ أَوِ ٱنقُصۡ مِنۡهُ قَلِيلًا

en.text: Half of it - or subtract from it a little

so.text: 3. Barkiis ama ka nusqaami in yar.

ayat.arabic: أَوۡ زِدۡ عَلَيۡهِ وَرَتِّلِ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ تَرۡتِيلًا

en.text: Or add to it, and recite the Qur’ān with measured recitation.

so.text: 4. Amaba ka badi, oo u akhri Qur’aanka si wanaagsan oo habboon.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّا سَنُلۡقِي عَلَيۡكَ قَوۡلٗا ثَقِيلًا

en.text: Indeed, We will cast upon you a heavy word.[1779]
en.footnotes: [1779] i.e., the revelation, which when descending on the Prophet (ﷺ) bore down upon him with a great weight. Another meaning is "important ordinances."

so.text: 5. Waxaanu kugu soo dejin Hadal culus [2].
so.footnotes: [2].Waxaa loola jeedaa Waxyiga iyo xeerarka sharciga, oo ku soo degayey Nabiga s.c.w. ee ah xil culus.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ نَاشِئَةَ ٱلَّيۡلِ هِيَ أَشَدُّ وَطۡـٔٗا وَأَقۡوَمُ قِيلًا

en.text: Indeed, the hours of the night are more effective for concurrence [of heart and tongue][1780] and more suitable for words.[1781]
en.footnotes:
[1780] Another accepted interpretation of the same words is "Indeed, arising at night is more difficult...," meaning that it will only be done by sincere believers and not others.
[1781] i.e., for recitation of the Qur’ān and for hearing and understanding it.

so.text: 6. Xaqiiq, habeenka saacadahiisa (oo la tukado) baa leh khushuuc badan aadna u toosan odhaah ahaan [3].
so.footnotes: [3]. Tafsiir kale oo aqbal ah ee isla ereyadaa waa: Hubaal kicitaanka habeenka baa sii adag.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ لَكَ فِي ٱلنَّهَارِ سَبۡحٗا طَوِيلٗا

en.text: Indeed, for you by day is prolonged occupation.

so.text: 7. Waxaad xaqiiq leedahay inta maalinta ah howl dheer.

ayat.arabic: وَٱذۡكُرِ ٱسۡمَ رَبِّكَ وَتَبَتَّلۡ إِلَيۡهِ تَبۡتِيلٗا

en.text: And remember the name of your Lord and devote yourself to Him with [complete] devotion.

so.text: 8. Ee xus Magaca Rabbigaa, oo u ahow daacad si dhan Isagoo Keliyana u go'.

ayat.arabic: رَّبُّ ٱلۡمَشۡرِقِ وَٱلۡمَغۡرِبِ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَٱتَّخِذۡهُ وَكِيلٗا

en.text: [He is] the Lord of the East and the West; there is no deity except Him, so take Him as Disposer of [your] affairs.[1782]
en.footnotes: [1782] i.e., trust in Allāh and rely upon Him.

so.text: 9. Rabbiga bariga iyo galbeedka. Ma jiro ilaah (xaq ah) aan aheyn Isaga ee ka dhigo wakiil (maamula arrimahaaga oo dhan).

ayat.arabic: وَٱصۡبِرۡ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱهۡجُرۡهُمۡ هَجۡرٗا جَمِيلٗا

en.text: And be patient over what they say and avoid them with gracious avoidance.

so.text: 10. U samir waxay (gaaladu) yidhaahdaan, oo uga dheerow si qurxoon.

ayat.arabic: وَذَرۡنِي وَٱلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ أُوْلِي ٱلنَّعۡمَةِ وَمَهِّلۡهُمۡ قَلِيلًا

en.text: And leave Me with [the matter of] the deniers, those of ease [in life], and allow them respite a little.

so.text: 11. Isu kaanna daa Aniga iyo kuwa beeniya (Aayadaheyga) ee nicmeysan, una sug in xoogaa ah.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ لَدَيۡنَآ أَنكَالٗا وَجَحِيمٗا

en.text: Indeed, with Us [for them] are shackles and burning fire

so.text: 12. Xaqiiq waxaa agtannada ah jeebbado iyo dab ololaya.

ayat.arabic: وَطَعَامٗا ذَا غُصَّةٖ وَعَذَابًا أَلِيمٗا

en.text: And food that chokes and a painful punishment -

so.text: 13. Iyo cunno lagu margado, iyo cadaab xanuun badan.

ayat.arabic: يَوۡمَ تَرۡجُفُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَٱلۡجِبَالُ وَكَانَتِ ٱلۡجِبَالُ كَثِيبٗا مَّهِيلًا

en.text: On the Day the earth and the mountains will convulse and the mountains will become a heap of sand pouring down.

so.text: 14. (Waxay ku dhici arrintaasi) Maalinta dhulka iyo buuruhu gilgilan gil-gilasho xoog leh, buuruhuna ahaan (sida) bacaad la shubay.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَآ إِلَيۡكُمۡ رَسُولٗا شَٰهِدًا عَلَيۡكُمۡ كَمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ رَسُولٗا

en.text: Indeed, We have sent to you a Messenger as a witness upon you just as We sent to Pharaoh a messenger.

so.text: 15. Waxaanu xaqiiq idiin soo dirnay Rasuul markhaati idinku ah, sidaan ugu soo dirnayba Rasuul xagga Fircoon.

ayat.arabic: فَعَصَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنُ ٱلرَّسُولَ فَأَخَذۡنَٰهُ أَخۡذٗا وَبِيلٗا

en.text: But Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger, so We seized him with a ruinous seizure.

so.text: 16. Fircoon se wuu caasiyey Rasuulka, markaasaan qabannay qabasho daran.

ayat.arabic: فَكَيۡفَ تَتَّقُونَ إِن كَفَرۡتُمۡ يَوۡمٗا يَجۡعَلُ ٱلۡوِلۡدَٰنَ شِيبًا

en.text: Then how can you fear, if you disbelieve, a Day that will make the children white-haired?[1783]
en.footnotes: [1783] Another meaning is "How can you avoid [punishment]" on such a Day?

so.text: 17. Ee sidee baad isaga celin (cadaabka), haddaad gaalowdaan Maalin ka dhigi carruurta cirroole.

ayat.arabic: ٱلسَّمَآءُ مُنفَطِرُۢ بِهِۦۚ كَانَ وَعۡدُهُۥ مَفۡعُولًا

en.text: The heaven will break apart therefrom;[1784] ever is His promise fulfilled.
en.footnotes: [1784] From the terror of that Day.

so.text: 18. Samada arrinkaa darti la dildillaaci. Yabooha (Alle) waa mid abad fula.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦ تَذۡكِرَةٞۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا

en.text: Indeed, this is a reminder, so whoever wills may take to his Lord a way.

so.text: 19. Hubaal tani wa waano, ee qofkii doonaa ha u samaysto xagga Rabbigi jid.

ayat.arabic: ۞ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَعۡلَمُ أَنَّكَ تَقُومُ أَدۡنَىٰ مِن ثُلُثَيِ ٱلَّيۡلِ وَنِصۡفَهُۥ وَثُلُثَهُۥ وَطَآئِفَةٞ مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ مَعَكَۚ وَٱللَّهُ يُقَدِّرُ ٱلَّيۡلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَۚ عَلِمَ أَن لَّن تُحۡصُوهُ فَتَابَ عَلَيۡكُمۡۖ فَٱقۡرَءُواْ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانِۚ عَلِمَ أَن سَيَكُونُ مِنكُم مَّرۡضَىٰ وَءَاخَرُونَ يَضۡرِبُونَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ يَبۡتَغُونَ مِن فَضۡلِ ٱللَّهِ وَءَاخَرُونَ يُقَٰتِلُونَ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِۖ فَٱقۡرَءُواْ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنۡهُۚ وَأَقِيمُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُواْ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَقۡرِضُواْ ٱللَّهَ قَرۡضًا حَسَنٗاۚ وَمَا تُقَدِّمُواْ لِأَنفُسِكُم مِّنۡ خَيۡرٖ تَجِدُوهُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ هُوَ خَيۡرٗا وَأَعۡظَمَ أَجۡرٗاۚ وَٱسۡتَغۡفِرُواْ ٱللَّهَۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمُۢ

en.text: Indeed, your Lord knows, [O Muḥammad], that you stand [in prayer] almost two thirds of the night or half of it or a third of it, and [so do] a group of those with you. And Allāh determines [the extent of] the night and the day. He has known that you [Muslims] will not be able to do it[1785] and has turned to you in forgiveness, so recite what is easy [for you] of the Qur’ān. He has known that there will be among you those who are ill and others traveling throughout the land seeking [something] of the bounty of Allāh and others fighting for the cause of Allāh. So recite what is easy from it and establish prayer and give zakāh and loan Allāh a goodly loan.[1786] And whatever good you put forward for yourselves - you will find it with Allāh. It is better and greater in reward. And seek forgiveness of Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.
en.footnotes:
[1785] Allāh has known that if they were to continue in such long periods of worship each night, the people would be caused much hardship.
[1786] In the form of charities and contributions to His cause.

so.text: 20. Xaqiiq, Rabbigaa waa og yahay inaad u istaagto (salaad) ku dhowaad saddex meeloodoo labo meelood habeenka, (mararka qaarna) kala barkiis, (marmarna) saddex meeloodoo meel, iyo in koox ka mid ah kuwaa kula jira.  Alle waa u qaddaran yahay habeenka iyo maalintuba. Wuxuu og yahay inaydaan fali kareyn sidaas (inaad tukataan habeenka intiisa badan), sidaa awgeed wuu idinka cafiyey oo tawbad aqbalay. Ee akhriya wixii idiin fududaada oo Qur’aan ah. Wuxuu og yahay inay idin ka mid yihiin kuwo buka, iyo kuwo kale oo ku safra dhulka iyagoo dalbaya Deeqda Alle; iyo kuwo kale oo u diriraya Jidka Alle. Ee akhriya wixii idiin fududaada  (oo Qur’aan ah), oo ooga salaadda, bixiyana Zakada, amaahsada Alle Amaah wanaagsan. Waxaad u hormarsataan nafahiinna oo khayr ah waxaad ka heli Alle agtiisa; sidaasaa khayr badan oo ajar weyn. Weydiista Denbi dhaaf Alle. Hubaal, Alle waa Denbi Dhaaf Badane, Naxariis Badan.

ayat.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡمُدَّثِّرُ

en.text: O you who covers himself [with a garment],[1788]
en.footnotes: [1788] Referring to the Prophet (ﷺ).

so.text: 1. Kani ku dedanow dharka!

ayat.arabic: قُمۡ فَأَنذِرۡ

en.text: Arise and warn

so.text: 2. Kac oo dig,

ayat.arabic: وَرَبَّكَ فَكَبِّرۡ

en.text: And your Lord glorify

so.text: 3. Rabbigaa weynee.

ayat.arabic: وَثِيَابَكَ فَطَهِّرۡ

en.text: And your clothing purify

so.text: 4. Maryahaagana daahiri.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلرُّجۡزَ فَٱهۡجُرۡ

en.text: And uncleanliness[1789] avoid
en.footnotes: [1789] Specifically, idols or generally, bad conduct and morals.

so.text: 5. Fadaradana (sanamada iyo najaasooyinka) ka fogow.

ayat.arabic: وَلَا تَمۡنُن تَسۡتَكۡثِرُ

en.text: And do not confer favor to acquire more[1790]
en.footnotes: [1790] An alternative meaning is "Do not consider any favor you have conferred to be great."

so.text: 6. Waxna ha u bixin si aad u hesho wax ka badan.

ayat.arabic: وَلِرَبِّكَ فَٱصۡبِرۡ

en.text: But for your Lord be patient.

so.text: 7. Rabbigaana dartiis u samir.

ayat.arabic: فَإِذَا نُقِرَ فِي ٱلنَّاقُورِ

en.text: And when the trumpet is blown,

so.text: 8. Marka Buunka (Qiyaame) la afuufo;

ayat.arabic: فَذَٰلِكَ يَوۡمَئِذٖ يَوۡمٌ عَسِيرٌ

en.text: That Day will be a difficult day

so.text: 9. Maalintaasi waa maalin aad u Daran.

ayat.arabic: عَلَى ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ غَيۡرُ يَسِيرٖ

en.text: For the disbelievers - not easy.

so.text: 10. Gaalada aan u fududeyn.

ayat.arabic: ذَرۡنِي وَمَنۡ خَلَقۡتُ وَحِيدٗا

en.text: Leave Me with the one I created alone[1791]
en.footnotes: [1791] i.e., without wealth or children. The reference is to al-Waleed bin al-Mugheerah, who after inclining toward the Qur’ān, denied it publicly in order to win the approval of the Quraysh.

so.text: 11. Isu kaanna daa aniga iyo kaan abuuray isagoo keli ah (qaawan).

ayat.arabic: وَجَعَلۡتُ لَهُۥ مَالٗا مَّمۡدُودٗا

en.text: And to whom I granted extensive wealth

so.text: 12. Oo aan siiyey hanti ballaadhan.

ayat.arabic: وَبَنِينَ شُهُودٗا

en.text: And children present [with him]

so.text: 13. Iyo wiilal ag jooga oo garabkiis ah.

ayat.arabic: وَمَهَّدتُّ لَهُۥ تَمۡهِيدٗا

en.text: And spread [everything] before him, easing [his life].

so.text: 14. (Oo aan u waasiciyey risiqa), una goglay wax walba hortiisa goglid.

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ يَطۡمَعُ أَنۡ أَزِيدَ

en.text: Then he desires that I should add more.

so.text: 15. Haddana damci inaan u ziyaadiyo;

ayat.arabic: كَلَّآۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لِأٓيَٰتِنَا عَنِيدٗا

en.text: No! Indeed, he has been toward Our verses obstinate.

so.text: 16. Mayee, kaasi wuxuu diiday Aayadahayaga.

ayat.arabic: سَأُرۡهِقُهُۥ صَعُودًا

en.text: I will cover him with arduous torment.

so.text: 17. Waxaan ku kallifi inuu kor u fuulo cadaab silic iyo saxariir badan.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ فَكَّرَ وَقَدَّرَ

en.text: Indeed, he thought and deliberated.[1792]
en.footnotes: [1792] About what he would say concerning the Qur’ān and how he might discredit the Prophet (ﷺ).

so.text: 18. (Gaalkaasu) wuu fekaray, wax buuna goostay;

ayat.arabic: فَقُتِلَ كَيۡفَ قَدَّرَ

en.text: So may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated.

so.text: 19. Nacaladi ha ku dhacdee! Siduu wax u qorsheeyey.

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ قُتِلَ كَيۡفَ قَدَّرَ

en.text: Then may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated.

so.text: 20. Misna, nacladi ha ku dhacdee, siduu wax u qorsheeyey.

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ نَظَرَ

en.text: Then he considered [again];

so.text: 21. Kaddib wuu eegay;

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ عَبَسَ وَبَسَرَ

en.text: Then he frowned and scowled;

so.text: 22. Markaasuu wejiga kaduuday oo soo uruuriyey.

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ أَدۡبَرَ وَٱسۡتَكۡبَرَ

en.text: Then he turned back and was arrogant

so.text: 23. Haddana dhabarka jeediyey oo is kibriyay;

ayat.arabic: فَقَالَ إِنۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحۡرٞ يُؤۡثَرُ

en.text: And said, "This is not but magic imitated [from others].

so.text: 24. Wuxuu yidhi: Kani (Qur'aanka) wax kale maahee waa sixir laga soo minguuriyey kuwo kale.

ayat.arabic: إِنۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا قَوۡلُ ٱلۡبَشَرِ

en.text: This is not but the word of a human being."

so.text: 25. Kanu (Qur'aanku) ma aha waxaan aheyn hadal Aadmi.

ayat.arabic: سَأُصۡلِيهِ سَقَرَ

en.text: I will drive him into Saqar.[1793]
en.footnotes: [1793] One of the proper names of Hell.

so.text: 26. Waxaan galin kaasi Saqaro (Naar).

ayat.arabic: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا سَقَرُ

en.text: And what can make you know what is Saqar?

so.text: 27. Maxaad ka og tahay waxay Saqaro tahay?

ayat.arabic: لَا تُبۡقِي وَلَا تَذَرُ

en.text: It lets nothing remain and leaves nothing [unburned],

so.text: 28. Ma reebto (hilib iyo laf midna) waxnana kama tagto.

ayat.arabic: لَوَّاحَةٞ لِّلۡبَشَرِ

en.text: Altering [i.e., blackening] the skins.

so.text: 29. Waxay doorisaa jirka oo gubtaa.

ayat.arabic: عَلَيۡهَا تِسۡعَةَ عَشَرَ

en.text: Over it are nineteen [angels].

so.text: 30. Waxaa kor jooga sagaal iyo toban (malag oo adadag).

ayat.arabic: وَمَا جَعَلۡنَآ أَصۡحَٰبَ ٱلنَّارِ إِلَّا مَلَٰٓئِكَةٗۖ وَمَا جَعَلۡنَا عِدَّتَهُمۡ إِلَّا فِتۡنَةٗ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لِيَسۡتَيۡقِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَيَزۡدَادَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِيمَٰنٗا وَلَا يَرۡتَابَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ وَلِيَقُولَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٞ وَٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ مَاذَآ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَٰذَا مَثَلٗاۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهۡدِي مَن يَشَآءُۚ وَمَا يَعۡلَمُ جُنُودَ رَبِّكَ إِلَّا هُوَۚ وَمَا هِيَ إِلَّا ذِكۡرَىٰ لِلۡبَشَرِ

en.text: And We have not made the keepers of the Fire except angels. And We have not made their number except as a trial for those who disbelieve - that those who were given the Scripture will be convinced and those who have believed will increase in faith and those who were given the Scripture and the believers will not doubt and that those in whose hearts is disease [i.e., hypocrisy] and the disbelievers will say, "What does Allāh intend by this as an example?" Thus does Allāh send astray whom He wills and guide whom He wills. And none knows the soldiers of your Lord except Him. And it [i.e., mention of the Fire] is not but a reminder to humanity.

so.text: 31. Kama aanu yeelin waardiyada Naarta waxaan ahayn malaa'ig, umana aanu yeelin tiradooda waxaan ahayn imtixaan ahaan gaalada - si ay ehlu Kitaabku u yaqiinsadaan (Xaq ahaanta Islaamka), mu’miniintuna u kororsadaan Iimaan - oo aanay kuwaa ehlu Kitaabka ah iyo mu’miniinta u shakiyin, iyo in kuwaa uu quluubtoodu ku jiro cudur iyo gaalada (mushrikiinta ah) u yidhaahdaan: Muxuu Alle ugala jeedaa tusaalahan? Sidaasuu Alle u lumiyaa qofkuu doono, oo u hanuuniyaa qofkuu doono. Ma jiro wax og ciidammada Rabbigaa Isaga maahee. Waxan la soo sheegayna ma aha waxaan aheyn waano ku socota dadka.

ayat.arabic: كَلَّا وَٱلۡقَمَرِ

en.text: No! By the moon

so.text: 32. Mayee, waxaan ku dhaartay dayaxa,

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّيۡلِ إِذۡ أَدۡبَرَ

en.text: And [by] the night when it departs

so.text: 33. Iyo habeenka markuu tago.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلصُّبۡحِ إِذَآ أَسۡفَرَ

en.text: And [by] the morning when it brightens,

so.text: 34. Iyo waagu markuu caddaado.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّهَا لَإِحۡدَى ٱلۡكُبَرِ

en.text: Indeed, it [i.e., the Fire] is of the greatest [afflictions]

so.text: 35. Hubaal iyadu (Naartu) waa mid ka mid ah balaayooyinka waaweyn.

ayat.arabic: نَذِيرٗا لِّلۡبَشَرِ

en.text: As a warning to humanity -

so.text: 36. Digniin u ah dadka.

ayat.arabic: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمۡ أَن يَتَقَدَّمَ أَوۡ يَتَأَخَّرَ

en.text: To whoever wills among you to proceed[1794] or stay behind.
en.footnotes: [1794] To righteousness by acceptance of the warning.

so.text: 37.  Qofkii doona inuu ku hormaro (camallo san) ama  dib ugu haro (xume fal),

ayat.arabic: كُلُّ نَفۡسِۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتۡ رَهِينَةٌ

en.text: Every soul, for what it has earned, will be retained[1795]
en.footnotes: [1795] i.e., subject or held responsible.

so.text: 38. Naf walbaa waxaa loogu heystaa curaar waxay kasbato.

ayat.arabic: إِلَّآ أَصۡحَٰبَ ٱلۡيَمِينِ

en.text: Except the companions of the right,[1796].
en.footnotes: [1796] i.e., the righteous who receive their records in their right hands.

so.text: 39. Qolada midigta maahee.

ayat.arabic: فِي جَنَّٰتٖ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ

en.text: [Who will be] in gardens, questioning each other

so.text: 40. Jannooyin gudahood waxay iska wareysan,

ayat.arabic: عَنِ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ

en.text: About the criminals,

so.text: 41. Xaalka denbiilayaasha:

ayat.arabic: مَا سَلَكَكُمۡ فِي سَقَرَ

en.text: [And asking them], "What put you into Saqar?"

so.text: 42. Maxaa idin keenay Naarta Saqaro?

ayat.arabic: قَالُواْ لَمۡ نَكُ مِنَ ٱلۡمُصَلِّينَ

en.text: They will say, "We were not of those who prayed,

so.text: 43. Waxay odhan: Kama aynu mid aheyn kuwa tukada.

ayat.arabic: وَلَمۡ نَكُ نُطۡعِمُ ٱلۡمِسۡكِينَ

en.text: Nor did we used to feed the poor.

so.text: 44. Mana aannaan aheyn kuwo quudiya miskiinka;

ayat.arabic: وَكُنَّا نَخُوضُ مَعَ ٱلۡخَآئِضِينَ

en.text: And we used to enter into vain discourse with those who engaged [in it],

so.text: 45. Waxaanu ahayn kuwo la dhumbada waxyaalo been ahoo aan jirin iyo xumaan kuwa dhumbada.

ayat.arabic: وَكُنَّا نُكَذِّبُ بِيَوۡمِ ٱلدِّينِ

en.text: And we used to deny the Day of Recompense

so.text: 46. Waxaanu ahayn kuwa beeniya Maalinta abaal marinta (jaazeynta).

ayat.arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ أَتَىٰنَا ٱلۡيَقِينُ

en.text: Until there came to us the certainty [i.e., death]."

so.text: 47. Jeer ay noo timid yaqiinta la hubo (geeridu).

ayat.arabic: فَمَا تَنفَعُهُمۡ شَفَٰعَةُ ٱلشَّٰفِعِينَ

en.text: So there will not benefit them the intercession of [any] intercessors.

so.text: 48. Marka waxba u tarimeyso shafeecada kuwa shafeeca.

ayat.arabic: فَمَا لَهُمۡ عَنِ ٱلتَّذۡكِرَةِ مُعۡرِضِينَ

en.text: Then what is [the matter] with them that they are, from the reminder, turning away

so.text: 49. Ee maxaa heysta iyaga oo ay uga jeestaan (qaadashada) waanada?

ayat.arabic: كَأَنَّهُمۡ حُمُرٞ مُّسۡتَنفِرَةٞ

en.text: As if they were alarmed donkeys

so.text: 50. Sida inay yihiin dameero duur joog ah oo didsan.

ayat.arabic: فَرَّتۡ مِن قَسۡوَرَةِۭ

en.text: Fleeing from a lion?

so.text: 51. Ee ka soo cararay libaax?

ayat.arabic: بَلۡ يُرِيدُ كُلُّ ٱمۡرِيٕٖ مِّنۡهُمۡ أَن يُؤۡتَىٰ صُحُفٗا مُّنَشَّرَةٗ

en.text: Rather, every person among them desires that he[1797] would be given scriptures spread about.[1798]
en.footnotes:
[1797] Instead of Muḥammad (ﷺ).
[1798] i.e., made public. Much of their refusal of his message was due to envy and jealousy of the Prophet (ﷺ).

so.text: 52. Mayee, qof walba oo ka mid ahi wuxuu rabaa in la siiyo kitaab faahfaahsan (oo xag Alle ah).

ayat.arabic: كَلَّاۖ بَل لَّا يَخَافُونَ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةَ

en.text: No! But they do not fear the Hereafter.

so.text: 53. Mayee! balse, kama cabsadaan Aakhirada (Ciqaabka Alle).

ayat.arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُۥ تَذۡكِرَةٞ

en.text: No! Indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a reminder

so.text: 54. Mayee, hubaal kani (Qur’aanka) waa waano.

ayat.arabic: فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ

en.text: Then whoever wills will remember it.

so.text: 55. Ee qofkii rabaa ha ku waano qaato.

ayat.arabic: وَمَا يَذۡكُرُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُۚ هُوَ أَهۡلُ ٱلتَّقۡوَىٰ وَأَهۡلُ ٱلۡمَغۡفِرَةِ

en.text: And they will not remember except that Allāh wills. He is worthy of fear and adequate for [granting] forgiveness.

so.text: 56. Ma waantoobayaanse in Alle doono maahee; waa Isaga Kan mudan inay aadmigu ka cabsadaan, oo mudan inuu Denbi Dhaafo.

ayat.arabic: لَآ أُقۡسِمُ بِيَوۡمِ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ

en.text: I swear by the Day of Resurrection

so.text: 1. Waxaan ku dhaartay Maalinta Qiyaamaha.

ayat.arabic: وَلَآ أُقۡسِمُ بِٱلنَّفۡسِ ٱللَّوَّامَةِ

en.text: And I swear by the reproaching soul[1800] [to the certainty of resurrection].
en.footnotes: [1800] i.e., that of the believer, which blames him when he falls into sin or error.

so.text: 2. Waxaan (kaloo) ku dhaartay nafta is eedda [1] 'in la idin soo bixin Aakhirada'.
so.footnotes: [1]. Waa mu’minka, ee is canaanta markuu ku dhaco denbi ama gef oo ka xumaada.

ayat.arabic: أَيَحۡسَبُ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ أَلَّن نَّجۡمَعَ عِظَامَهُۥ

en.text: Does man think that We will not assemble his bones?

so.text: 3. Ma wuxuu aadmigu moodaa inaanaan isu soo kulmineyn lafahiisa?

ayat.arabic: بَلَىٰ قَٰدِرِينَ عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّسَوِّيَ بَنَانَهُۥ

en.text: Yes. [We are] Able [even] to proportion his fingertips.

so.text: 4. Haayoo, Waxaan karnaa inaan sinno oo sidoodii ka yeelno farahiisa oo dhan.

ayat.arabic: بَلۡ يُرِيدُ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ لِيَفۡجُرَ أَمَامَهُۥ

en.text: But man desires to continue in sin.[1801]
en.footnotes: [1801] Literally, "to sin ahead of him." This refers to the disbeliever, who denies the Day of Account.

so.text: 5. Wuxuuse Aadmigu dooni inuu beeniyo waxa ka horreeya 'ee sugaya' [2].
so.footnotes: [2]. Macnaha waa inuu denbi isaga sii socdo. Waxaana loola jeedaa qofka gaalka ah ee beeniya maalinta xisaabta ee iska wata shirkiga iyo macaasidiisa.

ayat.arabic: يَسۡـَٔلُ أَيَّانَ يَوۡمُ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ

en.text: He asks, "When is the Day of Resurrection?"

so.text: 6. Wuxuu weydiin: Waa Goorma Maalinta Qiyaamaha?

ayat.arabic: فَإِذَا بَرِقَ ٱلۡبَصَرُ

en.text: So when vision is dazzled

so.text: 7. Ee marka araggu argagaxo (taagmo).

ayat.arabic: وَخَسَفَ ٱلۡقَمَرُ

en.text: And the moon darkens

so.text: 8. Oo dayaxu madoobaado.

ayat.arabic: وَجُمِعَ ٱلشَّمۡسُ وَٱلۡقَمَرُ

en.text: And the sun and the moon are joined,

so.text: 9. Oo la kulmiyo qorraxda iyo dayaxa.

ayat.arabic: يَقُولُ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ يَوۡمَئِذٍ أَيۡنَ ٱلۡمَفَرُّ

en.text: Man will say on that Day, "Where is the [place of] escape?"

so.text: 10. Aadmigu wuxuu Maalintaas odhan: Xaggee loo cararaa?

ayat.arabic: كَلَّا لَا وَزَرَ

en.text: No! There is no refuge.

so.text: 11. Mayee! Ma jiro agab (meel la magan galo).

ayat.arabic: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوۡمَئِذٍ ٱلۡمُسۡتَقَرُّ

en.text: To your Lord, that Day, is the [place of] permanence.

so.text: 12. Xagga Rabbigaa (Keliya) buu ahaan Maalintaa meesha agabka ah.

ayat.arabic: يُنَبَّؤُاْ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ يَوۡمَئِذِۭ بِمَا قَدَّمَ وَأَخَّرَ

en.text: Man will be informed that Day of what he sent ahead[1802] and kept back.[1803]
en.footnotes:
[1802] i.e., his deeds, which await him in the Hereafter.
[1803] i.e., that which he did not do or which he delayed.

so.text: 13. Waxaa looga warrami Aadmiga Maalintaas wuxuu hormarsaday iyo wuxuu dib marsaday.

ayat.arabic: بَلِ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ عَلَىٰ نَفۡسِهِۦ بَصِيرَةٞ

en.text: Rather, man, against himself, will be a witness,[1804]
en.footnotes: [1804] As described in 36:65 and 41:20-23.

so.text: 14. Balse Aadmigu wuxuu ku marag furi naftiisa Isagaana is og.

ayat.arabic: وَلَوۡ أَلۡقَىٰ مَعَاذِيرَهُۥ

en.text: Even if he presents his excuses.

so.text: 15. Si kasta hadduu u cudurdaarto (wax uma tarto cudur daarasho).

ayat.arabic: لَا تُحَرِّكۡ بِهِۦ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعۡجَلَ بِهِۦٓ

en.text: Move not your tongue with it, [O Muḥammad], to hasten with it [i.e., recitation of the Qur’ān].

so.text: 16. Ha ku dhaqaajin (Nabiyow) carrabkaaga (markuu Waxyigu soo degayo) inaad ku degdegto (Qur’aanka akhrintiisa).

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ عَلَيۡنَا جَمۡعَهُۥ وَقُرۡءَانَهُۥ

en.text: Indeed, upon Us is its collection [in your heart] and [to make possible] its recitation.

so.text: 17. Xaqiiq, waa xil Annaga na saaran inaan ku kulminno (laabtaada, ku xifdisiinno) oo kuu (sahalno) akhrintiisa (iyo fahankiisa).

ayat.arabic: فَإِذَا قَرَأۡنَٰهُ فَٱتَّبِعۡ قُرۡءَانَهُۥ

en.text: So when We have recited it [through Gabriel], then follow its recitation.

so.text: 18. Ee markaan akhrinno (Jabriil kuu akhriyo) u raarici (maqalka) akhriskiisa.

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيۡنَا بَيَانَهُۥ

en.text: Then upon Us is its clarification [to you].

so.text: 19. Kaddib xaqiiq Annaggay na saaran tahay inaan kuu caddeyno (fasirkiisa).

ayat.arabic: كَلَّا بَلۡ تُحِبُّونَ ٱلۡعَاجِلَةَ

en.text: No! But you [i.e., mankind] love the immediate

so.text: 20. Mayee se, waxaad jeceshihiin noloshatan (adduunka) ee durba tageysa.

ayat.arabic: وَتَذَرُونَ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةَ

en.text: And leave [i.e., neglect] the Hereafter.

so.text: 21. Oo dayacdaan Aakhirada.

ayat.arabic: وُجُوهٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ نَّاضِرَةٌ

en.text: [Some] faces, that Day, will be radiant,

so.text: 22. Wejiyo Maalintaas way ifi.

ayat.arabic: إِلَىٰ رَبِّهَا نَاظِرَةٞ

en.text: Looking at their Lord.[1805]
en.footnotes: [1805] The people of Paradise will actually see their Creator in the Hereafter.

so.text: 23. Xagga Rabbigood iyagoo eegaya;

ayat.arabic: وَوُجُوهٞ يَوۡمَئِذِۭ بَاسِرَةٞ

en.text: And [some] faces, that Day, will be contorted,

so.text: 24. Wejiyo (kale) Maalintaas waxay ahaan kuwo kuduudsan.

ayat.arabic: تَظُنُّ أَن يُفۡعَلَ بِهَا فَاقِرَةٞ

en.text: Expecting that there will be done to them [something] backbreaking.

so.text: 25. Waxay hubtaa in lagu fali balaayo weyn;

ayat.arabic: كَلَّآ إِذَا بَلَغَتِ ٱلتَّرَاقِيَ

en.text: No! When it [i.e., the soul] has reached the collar bones[1806]
en.footnotes: [1806] At the time it is about to leave the body when one is on the verge of death.

so.text: 26. Mayee, markay (naftu) soo gaarto mirgiga (waqtiga geerida).

ayat.arabic: وَقِيلَ مَنۡۜ رَاقٖ

en.text: And it is said, "Who will cure [him]?"

so.text: 27. Oo la yidhaahdo: Yaa ku tufi oo dabiibi?

ayat.arabic: وَظَنَّ أَنَّهُ ٱلۡفِرَاقُ

en.text: And he [i.e., the dying one] is certain that it is the [time of] separation

so.text: 28. Oo yaqiinsado inay tahay (waqtigii) tagidda (geerida).

ayat.arabic: وَٱلۡتَفَّتِ ٱلسَّاقُ بِٱلسَّاقِ

en.text: And the leg is wound about the leg,[1807]
en.footnotes: [1807] From the difficulties the person faces at death or his sudden awareness of the realities of both this world and the Hereafter. It may also refer to his shrouding after death.

so.text: 29.Oo lagu isku maro labada jeeni (kafno).

ayat.arabic: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوۡمَئِذٍ ٱلۡمَسَاقُ

en.text: To your Lord, that Day, will be the procession.[1808]
en.footnotes: [1808] Literally, "driving" or "herding" or "the place to which one is driven."

so.text: 30. Waa xagga Rabbigaa Maalintaas halka laysu wadaa.

ayat.arabic: فَلَا صَدَّقَ وَلَا صَلَّىٰ

en.text: And he [i.e., the disbeliever] had not believed, nor had he prayed.

so.text: 31. (Gaalkuse) ma rumeyn (Xaqa) mana tukan.

ayat.arabic: وَلَٰكِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ

en.text: But [instead], he denied and turned away.

so.text: 32. Wuuse beeniyey oo jeesaday.

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِهِۦ يَتَمَطَّىٰٓ

en.text: And then he went to his people, swaggering [in pride].

so.text: 33. Markaasuu aaday xagga ehelkiisa isagoo u socda si kibir iyo faan leh.

ayat.arabic: أَوۡلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوۡلَىٰ

en.text: Woe to you, and woe!

so.text: 34. Dhowaa hooggaagu oo dhowaa.

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ أَوۡلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوۡلَىٰٓ

en.text: Then woe to you, and woe!

so.text: 35. Haddana dhowaa hoggaagu oo dhowaa.

ayat.arabic: أَيَحۡسَبُ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ أَن يُتۡرَكَ سُدًى

en.text: Does man think that he will be left neglected?[1809]
en.footnotes: [1809] i.e., to no end, without responsibility, or without being returned to the Creator for judgement.

so.text: 36. Ma wuxuu Aadmigu moodaa in looga tegi bilaash (ujeeddo la'aan)?

ayat.arabic: أَلَمۡ يَكُ نُطۡفَةٗ مِّن مَّنِيّٖ يُمۡنَىٰ

en.text: Had he not been a sperm from semen emitted?

so.text: 37. Miyuusan aheyn mani-nool oo la dhibciyo?

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ كَانَ عَلَقَةٗ فَخَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ

en.text: Then he was a clinging clot, and [Allāh] created [his form] and proportioned [him]

so.text: 38. Markaas noqota xinjir oo (Alle) abuuro qaab wanaagsanna u yeelo.

ayat.arabic: فَجَعَلَ مِنۡهُ ٱلزَّوۡجَيۡنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلۡأُنثَىٰٓ

en.text: And made of him two mates, the male and the female.

so.text: 39. Oo ka yeelo labo nooc, lab iyo dheddig.

ayat.arabic: أَلَيۡسَ ذَٰلِكَ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُحۡـِۧيَ ٱلۡمَوۡتَىٰ

en.text: Is not that [Creator] Able to give life to the dead?

so.text: 40.Miyuusan Kaasi (Alle) awoodin inuu soo nooleeyo maytida [3]?
so.footnotes: [3]. Haayoo wuu Karaa.

ayat.arabic: هَلۡ أَتَىٰ عَلَى ٱلۡإِنسَٰنِ حِينٞ مِّنَ ٱلدَّهۡرِ لَمۡ يَكُن شَيۡـٔٗا مَّذۡكُورًا

en.text: Has there [not] come upon man a period of time when he was not a thing [even] mentioned?

so.text: 1. Waxaa Aadmiga soo maray waqti wax la sheego uusan aheyn (uusan jirinba).

ayat.arabic: إِنَّا خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ مِن نُّطۡفَةٍ أَمۡشَاجٖ نَّبۡتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلۡنَٰهُ سَمِيعَۢا بَصِيرًا

en.text: Indeed, We created man from a sperm-drop mixture[1811] that We may try him; and We made him hearing and seeing.
en.footnotes: [1811] i.e., a combination of the male and female substance, within the womb.

so.text: 2. Waxaanu xaqiiq ka abuurnay Aadmiga dhibic mani ah isku dhafanta [1], si aynu u imtixaanno, markaas waxaan ka yeellay mid wax maqla, wax arka.
so.footnotes: [1]. Isku dhaf biyaha ninka iyo haweenta ee gala riximka haweenta.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّا هَدَيۡنَٰهُ ٱلسَّبِيلَ إِمَّا شَاكِرٗا وَإِمَّا كَفُورًا

en.text: Indeed, We guided him to the way, be he grateful or be he ungrateful.

so.text: 3. Waxaanu xaqiiq tusnay jidka ama waa mid mahad naqa ama mid abaal dhac badan (gaal ah).

ayat.arabic: إِنَّآ أَعۡتَدۡنَا لِلۡكَٰفِرِينَ سَلَٰسِلَاْ وَأَغۡلَٰلٗا وَسَعِيرًا

en.text: Indeed, We have prepared for the disbelievers chains and shackles and a blaze.

so.text: 4. Waxaanu xaqiiq u diyaarinnay gaalada silsilado, heegayaal, iyo dab huraya.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلۡأَبۡرَارَ يَشۡرَبُونَ مِن كَأۡسٖ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُورًا

en.text: Indeed, the righteous will drink from a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of Kāfūr,[1812]
en.footnotes: [1812] A sweet-smelling spring in Paradise.

so.text: 5. Hubaal, kuwa baarriyiinta ah waxay ka cabbi galaas (khamro saafi ah) oo lagu dheehay Kaafuur.

ayat.arabic: عَيۡنٗا يَشۡرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ ٱللَّهِ يُفَجِّرُونَهَا تَفۡجِيرٗا

en.text: A spring of which the [righteous] servants of Allāh will drink; they will make it gush forth in force [and abundance].

so.text: 6. Il ay ka cabbi addoomaha Alle oo ay u burqin sida iyo halkay doonaan burqin.

ayat.arabic: يُوفُونَ بِٱلنَّذۡرِ وَيَخَافُونَ يَوۡمٗا كَانَ شَرُّهُۥ مُسۡتَطِيرٗا

en.text: They [are those who] fulfill [their] vows and fear a Day whose evil will be widespread.

so.text: 7. Waa kuwa oofiya nidarradooda, ka cabsadana Maalin sharkeedu fidi (Maalinta Qayaamaha).

ayat.arabic: وَيُطۡعِمُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِۦ مِسۡكِينٗا وَيَتِيمٗا وَأَسِيرًا

en.text: And they give food in spite of love for it[1813] to the needy, the orphan, and the captive,
en.footnotes: [1813] The meaning here may also be "out of love for Him," i.e., Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā).

so.text: 8. Waxay siiyaan cunno iyagoo jecel miskiinka, agoonka iyo maxbuuska.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّمَا نُطۡعِمُكُمۡ لِوَجۡهِ ٱللَّهِ لَا نُرِيدُ مِنكُمۡ جَزَآءٗ وَلَا شُكُورًا

en.text: [Saying], "We feed you only for the face [i.e., approval] of Allāh. We wish not from you reward or gratitude.

so.text: 9. (iyagoo laabta ka leh) Waxaan uun idiin siin raashinka Wejiga Alle Darti idinkama rabno abaal gud iyo mahadnaq midna.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّا نَخَافُ مِن رَّبِّنَا يَوۡمًا عَبُوسٗا قَمۡطَرِيرٗا

en.text: Indeed, We fear from our Lord a Day austere and distressful."

so.text: 10. Xaqiiq, waxaanu ka cabsan Rabbigayo Maalin (wajigu) doorsoomi, murugo badan.

ayat.arabic: فَوَقَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ شَرَّ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡيَوۡمِ وَلَقَّىٰهُمۡ نَضۡرَةٗ وَسُرُورٗا

en.text: So Allāh will protect them from the evil of that Day and give them radiance and happiness

so.text: 11. Sidaa awgeed Alle wuxuu ka samata bixin sharka Maalinkaas, oo siin nuur iyo farxad.

ayat.arabic: وَجَزَىٰهُم بِمَا صَبَرُواْ جَنَّةٗ وَحَرِيرٗا

en.text: And will reward them for what they patiently endured [with] a garden [in Paradise] and silk [garments].

so.text: 12. Oo ku abaal marin sabarkooda dartiis Janno iyo xariir.

ayat.arabic: مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا عَلَى ٱلۡأَرَآئِكِۖ لَا يَرَوۡنَ فِيهَا شَمۡسٗا وَلَا زَمۡهَرِيرٗا

en.text: [They will be] reclining therein on adorned couches. They will not see therein any [burning] sun or [freezing] cold.

so.text: 13. Iyagoo ku dangiigsan sariiro korreeya korkooda, kuma arkayaan (Jannada) gudaheeda kuleyl qorrax iyo dhaxan midna.

ayat.arabic: وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيۡهِمۡ ظِلَٰلُهَا وَذُلِّلَتۡ قُطُوفُهَا تَذۡلِيلٗا

en.text: And near above them are its shades, and its [fruit] to be picked will be lowered in compliance.

so.text: 14. Waxaa u dhow (geedaha Jannada) Hoosaskooda, waana loo soo raaricin midhaheeda raaricin.

ayat.arabic: وَيُطَافُ عَلَيۡهِم بِـَٔانِيَةٖ مِّن فِضَّةٖ وَأَكۡوَابٖ كَانَتۡ قَوَارِيرَا۠

en.text: And there will be circulated among them vessels of silver and cups having been [created] clear [as glass],

so.text: 15. Waxaa lagula dhex wareegi weelal qalin ah iyo koobab quraarado ah.

ayat.arabic: قَوَارِيرَاْ مِن فِضَّةٖ قَدَّرُوهَا تَقۡدِيرٗا

en.text: Clear glasses [made] from silver of which they have determined the measure.

so.text: 16. Quraarado fiddo (qalin) ah si fiicanna u qiyaasan.

ayat.arabic: وَيُسۡقَوۡنَ فِيهَا كَأۡسٗا كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنجَبِيلًا

en.text: And they will be given to drink a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of ginger

so.text: 17. Waxaa laga waraabin galaas (khamro saafi ah) lagu dheehay Sanjabiil,

ayat.arabic: عَيۡنٗا فِيهَا تُسَمَّىٰ سَلۡسَبِيلٗا

en.text: [From] a fountain within it [i.e., Paradise] named Salsabeel.

so.text: 18.Il 'Jannada' gudaheeda ah, la yidhaahdo Salsabiil.

ayat.arabic: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وِلۡدَٰنٞ مُّخَلَّدُونَ إِذَا رَأَيۡتَهُمۡ حَسِبۡتَهُمۡ لُؤۡلُؤٗا مَّنثُورٗا

en.text: There will circulate among them young boys made eternal. When you see them, you would think them [as beautiful as] scattered pearls.

so.text: 19. Waxaa u adeegi wiilal da’ yar aan gaboobin oo waari markaad aragto aad moodi sida luul la firdhiyey.

ayat.arabic: وَإِذَا رَأَيۡتَ ثَمَّ رَأَيۡتَ نَعِيمٗا وَمُلۡكٗا كَبِيرًا

en.text: And when you look there [in Paradise], you will see pleasure and great dominion.

so.text: 20. Haddaad aragto halkaas (Jannada), waxaad arki barwaaqo iyo boqortooyo weyn.

ayat.arabic: عَٰلِيَهُمۡ ثِيَابُ سُندُسٍ خُضۡرٞ وَإِسۡتَبۡرَقٞۖ وَحُلُّوٓاْ أَسَاوِرَ مِن فِضَّةٖ وَسَقَىٰهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ شَرَابٗا طَهُورًا

en.text: Upon them [i.e., the inhabitants] will be green garments of fine silk and brocade. And they will be adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord will give them a purifying drink.

so.text: 21. Dharkoodu (ehlu Jannaha) waa xariir jilicsan oo cagaaran iyo xariir adagba.  Waxaana lagu qurxin  jin-jimo qalin ah, wuxuu Rabbigood ka waraabin sharaab daahir ah.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمۡ جَزَآءٗ وَكَانَ سَعۡيُكُم مَّشۡكُورًا

en.text: [And it will be said], "Indeed, this is for you a reward, and your effort has been appreciated."

so.text: 22. Hubaal kani waa abaalgud aad leedihiin, dadaalkiinniina waa la idiin gudi  oo ajar weyn la idinka siin.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّا نَحۡنُ نَزَّلۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ تَنزِيلٗا

en.text: Indeed, it is We who have sent down to you, [O Muḥammad], the Qur’ān progressively.

so.text: 23. Xaqiiq, Annagaa kugu soo dejinnay Qur’aanka (Muxammadow) si qayb qayb ah (Suurado iyo Aayado) soo dejin dhan.

ayat.arabic: فَٱصۡبِرۡ لِحُكۡمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تُطِعۡ مِنۡهُمۡ ءَاثِمًا أَوۡ كَفُورٗا

en.text: So be patient for the decision of your Lord and do not obey from among them a sinner or ungrateful [disbeliever].

so.text: 24. Ee ku samir Xukunka Rabbigaa, hana adeecin denbiile iyo abaal darne midna.

ayat.arabic: وَٱذۡكُرِ ٱسۡمَ رَبِّكَ بُكۡرَةٗ وَأَصِيلٗا

en.text: And mention the name of your Lord [in prayer] morning and evening

so.text: 25. Xus Magaca Rabbigaa subax iyo galabba.

ayat.arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيۡلِ فَٱسۡجُدۡ لَهُۥ وَسَبِّحۡهُ لَيۡلٗا طَوِيلًا

en.text: And during the night prostrate to Him and exalt [i.e., praise] Him a long [part of the] night.

so.text: 26.Habeenka qaarkina u sujuud, oo ammaan (hufna) in dheer oo habeenka ah.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ يُحِبُّونَ ٱلۡعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُونَ وَرَآءَهُمۡ يَوۡمٗا ثَقِيلٗا

en.text: Indeed, these [disbelievers] love the immediate and leave behind them[1814] a grave Day.
en.footnotes: [1814] i.e., neglect. The meaning may also be "leave ahead of them."

so.text: 27. Xaqiiq, kuwaasi (gaalada ah) waxay jecel yihiin noloshatan adduunka, waxayna mariyaan gadaashooda (oo dan u gelin) Maalin culus (Qiyaamada).

ayat.arabic: نَّحۡنُ خَلَقۡنَٰهُمۡ وَشَدَدۡنَآ أَسۡرَهُمۡۖ وَإِذَا شِئۡنَا بَدَّلۡنَآ أَمۡثَٰلَهُمۡ تَبۡدِيلًا

en.text: We have created them and strengthened their forms, and when We will, We can change their likenesses with [complete] alteration.

so.text: 28. Annagaa abuurnay oo adkaynay seedahooda, haddaan doonnona Waxaan ku beddeli karnaa kuwo kale oo la mid ah beddelid dhan.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦ تَذۡكِرَةٞۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلٗا

en.text: Indeed, this is a reminder, so he who wills may take to his Lord a way.

so.text: 29. Suuraddani xaqiiq waa waano, ee qofkii doonaa, ha u samaysto jid xagga Rabbigi.

ayat.arabic: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمٗا

en.text: And you do not will except that Allāh wills. Indeed, Allāh is ever Knowing and Wise.

so.text: 30. Waxna ma dooni kartaan in Alle doono mooyee. Hubaal, Alle waa wax walba Oge, Xikmad Badan.

ayat.arabic: يُدۡخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِي رَحۡمَتِهِۦۚ وَٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ أَعَدَّ لَهُمۡ عَذَابًا أَلِيمَۢا

en.text: He admits whom He wills into His mercy; but the wrongdoers - He has prepared for them a painful punishment.

so.text: 31. Wuxuu geliyaa qofkuu doono Naxariistiisa, daalimiintana (mushrikiinta, gaalada, denbiilayaasha) wuxuu u diyaariyey cadaab xanuun badan.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلۡمُرۡسَلَٰتِ عُرۡفٗا

en.text: By those [winds] sent forth in gusts

so.text: 1. Waxaan ku dhaartay dabeylaha wanaagga lala soo diro.

ayat.arabic: فَٱلۡعَٰصِفَٰتِ عَصۡفٗا

en.text: And the winds that blow violently

so.text: 2. Iyo dabeylaha sida daran u kaca.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلنَّٰشِرَٰتِ نَشۡرٗا

en.text: And [by] the winds that spread [clouds]

so.text: 3. Iyo dabeylaha u kaxeeya daruuraha meelahooda loogu tala galay;

ayat.arabic: فَٱلۡفَٰرِقَٰتِ فَرۡقٗا

en.text: And those [angels] who bring criterion[1816]
en.footnotes: [1816] To Allāh's human messengers.

so.text: 4. Iyo (malaa'igta) kala saara (Xaqa iyo baadilka) kala saarid dhan [1].
so.footnotes: [1]. Xalaasha iyo xaaraanta.

ayat.arabic: فَٱلۡمُلۡقِيَٰتِ ذِكۡرًا

en.text: And those [angels] who deliver a message

so.text: 5. Iyo malaa’igta keena Waxyiga

ayat.arabic: عُذۡرًا أَوۡ نُذۡرًا

en.text: As justification or warning,

so.text: 6. Si loo caddeeyo (Xaqa) ama loo digo;

ayat.arabic: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَوَٰقِعٞ

en.text: Indeed, what you are promised is to occur.

so.text: 7. Ee waxa (dadow) la idiinku yabooho ( Qiyaamada) waa Xaq dhacaya.

ayat.arabic: فَإِذَا ٱلنُّجُومُ طُمِسَتۡ

en.text: So when the stars are obliterated

so.text: 8. Marka xiddiguhu beelaan nuurkooda;

ayat.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ فُرِجَتۡ

en.text: And when the heaven is opened

so.text: 9. Oo samadu dildillaacdo,

ayat.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلۡجِبَالُ نُسِفَتۡ

en.text: And when the mountains are blown away

so.text: 10. Oo buuraha la rujiyo.

ayat.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلرُّسُلُ أُقِّتَتۡ

en.text: And when the messengers' time has come...[1817]
en.footnotes: [1817] i.e., when they are gathered to witness concerning their nations. The sentence's conclusion is understood to be "...the promised judgement will then take place."

so.text: 11. Oo Rusulladii la kulmiyo (iyo dadkoodii) waqtigii loo qabtay.

ayat.arabic: لِأَيِّ يَوۡمٍ أُجِّلَتۡ

en.text: For what Day was it postponed?[1818]
en.footnotes: [1818] "It" may refer to either the aforementioned occurrences collectively or to the testimony of the messengers.

so.text: 12. Maalintee baa loo dib dhigay?

ayat.arabic: لِيَوۡمِ ٱلۡفَصۡلِ

en.text: For the Day of Judgement.

so.text: 13. Maalinta kala baxa (Qiyaamada).

ayat.arabic: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا يَوۡمُ ٱلۡفَصۡلِ

en.text: And what can make you know what is the Day of Judgement?

so.text: 14. Maxaa ku ogeysiiyey waxay Maalinta kala baxu tahay?

ayat.arabic: وَيۡلٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ

en.text: Woe,[1819] that Day, to the deniers.
en.footnotes: [1819] i.e., death and destruction.

so.text: 15. Hoog Maalintaas waxaa leh xaq beeniyayaasha (nabad diidka).

ayat.arabic: أَلَمۡ نُهۡلِكِ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ

en.text: Did We not destroy the former peoples?

so.text: 16. Miyaanaan halaagin facyadii hore (ee gaaloobay)?

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ نُتۡبِعُهُمُ ٱلۡأٓخِرِينَ

en.text: Then We will follow them with the later ones.

so.text: 17. Misna waxaan raacin kuwa (facyada) dambe (ee eynigood ah).

ayat.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ نَفۡعَلُ بِٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ

en.text: Thus do We deal with the criminals.

so.text: 18. Sidaasaan u galnaa denbiilayaasha.

ayat.arabic: وَيۡلٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ

en.text: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

so.text: 19. Hoog Maalintaas waxaa leh xaq beeniyayaasha (nabad diidka).

ayat.arabic: أَلَمۡ نَخۡلُقكُّم مِّن مَّآءٖ مَّهِينٖ

en.text: Did We not create you from a liquid disdained?

so.text: 20. Miyaanaan idinka abuurin biyo daciif ah liita?

ayat.arabic: فَجَعَلۡنَٰهُ فِي قَرَارٖ مَّكِينٍ

en.text: And We placed it in a firm lodging [i.e., the womb]

so.text: 21. Markaas yeelnay meel aamin ah gudaheed (riximka),

ayat.arabic: إِلَىٰ قَدَرٖ مَّعۡلُومٖ

en.text: For a known extent.

so.text: 22. Ilaa muddo la yaqaanno,

ayat.arabic: فَقَدَرۡنَا فَنِعۡمَ ٱلۡقَٰدِرُونَ

en.text: And We determined [it], and excellent [are We] to determine.

so.text: 23. Sidaasaan wax u qaddarnay, Annagaana u fiican kuwo wax qaddara.

ayat.arabic: وَيۡلٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ

en.text: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

so.text: 24. Hoog Maalintaas waxaa leh xaq beeniyayaasha (nabad diidka).

ayat.arabic: أَلَمۡ نَجۡعَلِ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ كِفَاتًا

en.text: Have We not made the earth a container

so.text: 25. Miyaanaan ka dhigin dhulka mid qaada oo ku filan?

ayat.arabic: أَحۡيَآءٗ وَأَمۡوَٰتٗا

en.text: Of the living and the dead?

so.text: 26. Kuwa nool iyo kuwa mowtanba [2].
so.footnotes: [2]. Alle wuxuu ku kulmiyey dadka nool arlada dusheeda, mowtidana arlada hoosteeda.

ayat.arabic: وَجَعَلۡنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِيَ شَٰمِخَٰتٖ وَأَسۡقَيۡنَٰكُم مَّآءٗ فُرَاتٗا

en.text: And We placed therein lofty, firmly set mountains and have given you to drink sweet water.

so.text: 27. Oo ka yeelin dhulka dhexdiisa buuro sugan oo dhaadheer oo aan idinka waraabinin biyo macaan?

ayat.arabic: وَيۡلٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ

en.text: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

so.text: 28. Hoog Maalintaas waxaa leh xaq beeniyayaasha (nabad diidka).

ayat.arabic: ٱنطَلِقُوٓاْ إِلَىٰ مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ

en.text: [They will be told], "Proceed to that which you used to deny.

so.text: 29. Aada waxaad beenin jirteen.

ayat.arabic: ٱنطَلِقُوٓاْ إِلَىٰ ظِلّٖ ذِي ثَلَٰثِ شُعَبٖ

en.text: Proceed to a shadow [of smoke] having three columns

so.text: 30. Aada hoos (qiiqa Naarta ah) oo seddex laamood leh [3].
so.footnotes: [3]. Xagga seddex jiho: Midigta, bidixda, iyo dusha sare, macnaha waa cadaabka wuxuu uga iman oo ka hareereyn gaalada jiho kasta.

ayat.arabic: لَّا ظَلِيلٖ وَلَا يُغۡنِي مِنَ ٱللَّهَبِ

en.text: [But having] no cool shade and availing not against the flame."

so.text: 31. Oo aan harsi laheyn, waxnana ka tareyn ololka dabka.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّهَا تَرۡمِي بِشَرَرٖ كَٱلۡقَصۡرِ

en.text: Indeed, it throws sparks [as huge] as a fortress,

so.text: 32. Waxay (Naartu) tuuri dhimbilo daran oo daaro oo kale ah .

ayat.arabic: كَأَنَّهُۥ جِمَٰلَتٞ صُفۡرٞ

en.text: As if they were yellowish [black] camels.

so.text: 33. Aad mooddo awr aydin ah.

ayat.arabic: وَيۡلٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ

en.text: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

so.text: 34. Hoog Maalintaas waxaa leh xaq beeniyayaasha (nabad diidka).

ayat.arabic: هَٰذَا يَوۡمُ لَا يَنطِقُونَ

en.text: This is a Day they will not speak,

so.text: 35. Kanu waa Maalin aysan (gaaladu) hadleyn.

ayat.arabic: وَلَا يُؤۡذَنُ لَهُمۡ فَيَعۡتَذِرُونَ

en.text: Nor will it be permitted for them to make an excuse.

so.text: 36. Oo aan idan la siineyn si ay u cudurdaartaan.

ayat.arabic: وَيۡلٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ

en.text: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

so.text: 37. Hoog Maalintaas waxaa leh xaq beeniyayaasha (nabad diidka).

ayat.arabic: هَٰذَا يَوۡمُ ٱلۡفَصۡلِۖ جَمَعۡنَٰكُمۡ وَٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ

en.text: This is the Day of Judgement; We will have assembled you and the former peoples.

so.text: 38. Kani waa Maalinka kala Baxa. Waa idin soo kulminnay idinka iyo kuwii horreeyey.

ayat.arabic: فَإِن كَانَ لَكُمۡ كَيۡدٞ فَكِيدُونِ

en.text: So if you have a plan, then plan against Me.

so.text: 39. Ee haddaad wax dhagri kartaan, Aniga I dhagra.

ayat.arabic: وَيۡلٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ

en.text: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

so.text: 40. Hoog Maalintaas waxaa leh xaq beeniyayaasha (nabad diidka).

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ فِي ظِلَٰلٖ وَعُيُونٖ

en.text: Indeed, the righteous will be among shades and springs

so.text: 41. Hubaal kuwa ka dhowrsada xumaha waxay ku sugnaan hoosas iyo ilo.

ayat.arabic: وَفَوَٰكِهَ مِمَّا يَشۡتَهُونَ

en.text: And fruits from whatever they desire,

so.text: 42. Iyo midho waxay doonaan ah.

ayat.arabic: كُلُواْ وَٱشۡرَبُواْ هَنِيٓـَٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ

en.text: [Being told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do."

so.text: 43. Cuna oo cabba si raaxo leh waa waxaad camalsan fali jirteen darteed.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ

en.text: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.

so.text: 44. Sidaasaan xaqiiq u abaal marinnaa sama falayaasha.

ayat.arabic: وَيۡلٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ

en.text: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

so.text: 45. Hoog Maalintaas waxaa leh xaq beeniyayaasha (nabad diidka).

ayat.arabic: كُلُواْ وَتَمَتَّعُواْ قَلِيلًا إِنَّكُم مُّجۡرِمُونَ

en.text: [O disbelievers], eat and enjoy yourselves a little; indeed, you are criminals.

so.text: 46. (Gaaloy) cuna oo raaxeysta in yar. waxaad tihiin denbiilayaal.

ayat.arabic: وَيۡلٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ

en.text: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

so.text: 47. Hoog Maalintaas waxaa leh xaq beeniyayaasha (nabad diidka).

ayat.arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱرۡكَعُواْ لَا يَرۡكَعُونَ

en.text: And when it is said to them, "Bow [in prayer]," they do not bow.

so.text: 48. Marka lagu yidhaahdo: Rukuuca ma ay rukuucaan [4].
so.footnotes: [4]. Marka lagu yidhaahdo u hoggaansama Amarka Alle uma hoggaansamaan, sidoo kale waxaa lagu fasiray marka lagu yidhaahdo tukada ma ay tukadaan.

ayat.arabic: وَيۡلٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ

en.text: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

so.text: 49. Hoog Maalintaas waxaa leh xaq beeniyayaasha (nabad diidka).

ayat.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ حَدِيثِۭ بَعۡدَهُۥ يُؤۡمِنُونَ

en.text: Then in what statement after it [i.e., the Qur’ān] will they believe?

so.text: 50. Ee Hadalkee bay kan (Qur’aanka) kaddib (gaaladu) rumeynayaan?

ayat.arabic: عَمَّ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ

en.text: About what are they asking one another?

so.text: 1. Maxay isweydiinayaan (gaaladu)?

ayat.arabic: عَنِ ٱلنَّبَإِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ

en.text: About the great news[1821] -
en.footnotes: [1821] i.e., the Resurrection.

so.text: 2. Ma Warka Weyn (Qur’aanka ama Qiyaamada).

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِي هُمۡ فِيهِ مُخۡتَلِفُونَ

en.text: That over which they are in disagreement.

so.text: 3. Ay isku khilaafsan yihiin (mid rumeysan iyo mid beeninaya)?

ayat.arabic: كَلَّا سَيَعۡلَمُونَ

en.text: No! They are going to know.

so.text: 4. Mayee, way ogaan doonaan (waxa ku dhaca beenintooda Xaqa darteed).

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَيَعۡلَمُونَ

en.text: Then, no! They are going to know.

so.text: 5. Misna, mayee way ogaan doonaan (waxa ku dhaca).

ayat.arabic: أَلَمۡ نَجۡعَلِ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ مِهَٰدٗا

en.text: Have We not made the earth a resting place?

so.text: 6. Miyaanaan ka yeelin dhulka gogol?

ayat.arabic: وَٱلۡجِبَالَ أَوۡتَادٗا

en.text: And the mountains as stakes?[1822]
en.footnotes: [1822] To stabilize the land and balance the earth.

so.text: 7. Buurahana tiirar (dhulka lagu adkeeyey)?

ayat.arabic: وَخَلَقۡنَٰكُمۡ أَزۡوَٰجٗا

en.text: And We created you in pairs

so.text: 8. Oo  idinka abuurin noocyo  (lab iyo dheddig)?,

ayat.arabic: وَجَعَلۡنَا نَوۡمَكُمۡ سُبَاتٗا

en.text: And made your sleep [a means for] rest

so.text: 9. oo ka yeelin hurdadiinna nasiino?,

ayat.arabic: وَجَعَلۡنَا ٱلَّيۡلَ لِبَاسٗا

en.text: And made the night as clothing[1823]
en.footnotes: [1823] Covering you in darkness and providing rest.

so.text: 10. Oo ka dhigin habeenka hu’ oo kale (idinku daboola mugdigiisa)?,

ayat.arabic: وَجَعَلۡنَا ٱلنَّهَارَ مَعَاشٗا

en.text: And made the day for livelihood

so.text: 11.Oo ka dhigin maalinta maciishad raadin,

ayat.arabic: وَبَنَيۡنَا فَوۡقَكُمۡ سَبۡعٗا شِدَادٗا

en.text: And constructed above you seven strong [heavens]

so.text: 12. Oo ka dhisin korkiinna toddobo (samo) oo adadag?.

ayat.arabic: وَجَعَلۡنَا سِرَاجٗا وَهَّاجٗا

en.text: And made [therein] a burning lamp

so.text: 13. Oo yeelin nal shidan aad u ifi (qorrax)?.

ayat.arabic: وَأَنزَلۡنَا مِنَ ٱلۡمُعۡصِرَٰتِ مَآءٗ ثَجَّاجٗا

en.text: And sent down from the rain clouds pouring water

so.text: 14. Oo ka soo dejinin daruuraha biyo badan oo shubmaya (roob)?.

ayat.arabic: لِّنُخۡرِجَ بِهِۦ حَبّٗا وَنَبَاتٗا

en.text: That We may bring forth thereby grain and vegetation

so.text: 15. Si aan ugu soo saarno haruur iyo naq.

ayat.arabic: وَجَنَّٰتٍ أَلۡفَافًا

en.text: And gardens of entwined growth.

so.text: 16. Iyo beero isku maran.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡفَصۡلِ كَانَ مِيقَٰتٗا

en.text: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is an appointed time -

so.text: 17. Xaqiiq, Maalinka kala baxu (Qiyaamaha) waa waqti go’an.

ayat.arabic: يَوۡمَ يُنفَخُ فِي ٱلصُّورِ فَتَأۡتُونَ أَفۡوَاجٗا

en.text: The Day the Horn is blown and you will come forth in multitudes

so.text: 18.Maalinka marka Buunka la afuufi, oo aad iman idinkoo ummado kala duwan ah;

ayat.arabic: وَفُتِحَتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتۡ أَبۡوَٰبٗا

en.text: And the heaven is opened and will become gateways

so.text: 19. Oo samada la furi oo yeelan albaabbo.

ayat.arabic: وَسُيِّرَتِ ٱلۡجِبَالُ فَكَانَتۡ سَرَابًا
