en.text: And the mountains are removed and will be [but] a mirage.

so.text: 20. Buurahana la rujin oo noqon dhalanteed oo kale.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ كَانَتۡ مِرۡصَادٗا

en.text: Indeed, Hell has been lying in wait

so.text: 21. Xaqiiq, Naartu waa heegan sugeysa,

ayat.arabic: لِّلطَّٰغِينَ مَـَٔابٗا

en.text: For the transgressors, a place of return,

so.text: 22. Xad gudbayaasha, meel noqod u ah.

ayat.arabic: لَّٰبِثِينَ فِيهَآ أَحۡقَابٗا

en.text: In which they will remain for ages [unending].

so.text: 23. Iyagoo ku negaadi waayo badan,

ayat.arabic: لَّا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا بَرۡدٗا وَلَا شَرَابًا

en.text: They will not taste therein [any] coolness or drink.

so.text: 24. Ma ku dhadhaminayaan dhexdeeda wax qabow ah iyo cabbitaan midna.

ayat.arabic: إِلَّا حَمِيمٗا وَغَسَّاقٗا

en.text: Except scalding water and [foul] purulence -

so.text: 25. Biyo kulul oo karaya iyo malax maahee (dhacaanka ehlu Naarka ah)

ayat.arabic: جَزَآءٗ وِفَاقًا

en.text: An appropriate recompense.[1824]
en.footnotes: [1824] In proportion to and comparable with their crimes.

so.text: 26.Waa abaal marin ku habboon (gaalada).

ayat.arabic: إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ لَا يَرۡجُونَ حِسَابٗا

en.text: Indeed, they were not expecting an account

so.text: 27. Waxay ahaayeen kuwo aan fileyn Xisaab (Aakhiro).

ayat.arabic: وَكَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا كِذَّابٗا

en.text: And denied Our verses with [emphatic] denial.

so.text: 28. Oo waxay beeniyeen Aayadahayaga beenin cad.

ayat.arabic: وَكُلَّ شَيۡءٍ أَحۡصَيۡنَٰهُ كِتَٰبٗا

en.text: But all things We have enumerated in writing.

so.text: 29. Wax walba se (oo camalladooda ah) waxaan ku koobnay qoraal.

ayat.arabic: فَذُوقُواْ فَلَن نَّزِيدَكُمۡ إِلَّا عَذَابًا

en.text: "So taste [the penalty], and never will We increase you except in torment."[1825]
en.footnotes: [1825] This announcement will be made to the companions of Hell.

so.text: 30. Ee dhadhamiya (ciqaabka); idiinma kordhineyno waxaan ahayn Cadaab.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ مَفَازًا

en.text: Indeed, for the righteous is attainment[1826] -
en.footnotes: [1826] Of security, success and reward, including escape and safety from Hell.

so.text: 31. Xaqiiq, kuwa Alle ka cabsada ee (ka) dhowrsada (xumaha) waxay leeyihiin meel lagu liibaano (Janno).

ayat.arabic: حَدَآئِقَ وَأَعۡنَٰبٗا

en.text: Gardens and grapevines

so.text: 32. Beero iyo canabyo.

ayat.arabic: وَكَوَاعِبَ أَتۡرَابٗا

en.text: And young women [companions] of equal age.

so.text: 33. Iyo gashaantiyo da' yar oo isla eg.

ayat.arabic: وَكَأۡسٗا دِهَاقٗا

en.text: And a full cup.[1827]
en.footnotes: [1827] Of wine which is delicious and does not intoxicate.

so.text: 34.Iyo galaas buuxa (oo khamri saafi ah).

ayat.arabic: لَّا يَسۡمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغۡوٗا وَلَا كِذَّٰبٗا

en.text: No ill speech will they hear therein or any falsehood -

so.text: 35.Kuma maqlayaan (Jannada) gudaheeda hadal macno darro ah ama wax been ah.

ayat.arabic: جَزَآءٗ مِّن رَّبِّكَ عَطَآءً حِسَابٗا

en.text: [As] reward from your Lord, [a generous] gift [made due by] account,[1828]
en.footnotes: [1828] i.e., as a result of both their own righteous deeds and the limitless generosity of Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) . Another meaning is "a gift calculated [to be adequate]."

so.text: 36. Abaal marin xagga Rabbigaa; deeq (daa'in ah badan) oo ku filan.

ayat.arabic: رَّبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِۖ لَا يَمۡلِكُونَ مِنۡهُ خِطَابٗا

en.text: [From] the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Most Merciful. They possess not from Him [authority for] speech.[1829]
en.footnotes: [1829] None of Allāh's creatures can plead with Him on the Day of Judgement except by His permission.

so.text: 37. Rabbiga samooyinka iyo arlada iyo waxa u dhexeeya, - Raxmaanka, ma jiro wax ku soo celin karaa hadal (Qiyaamada).

ayat.arabic: يَوۡمَ يَقُومُ ٱلرُّوحُ وَٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ صَفّٗاۖ لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنۡ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابٗا

en.text: The Day that the Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] and the angels will stand in rows, they will not speak except for one whom the Most Merciful permits, and he will say what is correct.

so.text: 38. Maalinka uu Ruuxu iyo malaa’igtu ay u istaagi saf saf, ma jiro wax hadli, mid maahee Allaah - Raxmaanku u idmo, oo ku hadla hadal toosan oo abbaar ah.

ayat.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡيَوۡمُ ٱلۡحَقُّۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ مَـَٔابًا

en.text: That is the True [i.e., certain] Day; so he who wills may take to his Lord a [way of] return.[1830]
en.footnotes: [1830] i.e., a direct route through correct beliefs and righteous deeds.

so.text: 39. Kaasi waa Maalinka la hubo ee xaqa ah, ee qofkii doona, ha u maro Rabbigi jid toos ah uu ugula laabto (caqiido sax ah iyo camallo san).

ayat.arabic: إِنَّآ أَنذَرۡنَٰكُمۡ عَذَابٗا قَرِيبٗا يَوۡمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلۡمَرۡءُ مَا قَدَّمَتۡ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلۡكَافِرُ يَٰلَيۡتَنِي كُنتُ تُرَٰبَۢا

en.text: Indeed, We have warned you of an impending punishment on the Day when a man will observe what his hands have put forth[1831] and the disbeliever will say, "Oh, I wish that I were dust!"
en.footnotes: [1831] i.e., the deeds he did in this world, which await him in the Hereafter.

so.text: 40. Waxaanu idiinka dignay cadaab dhow - Maalinka uu qofku arki waxay gacmihiisu hormarsadeen (oo khayr ah ama shar), oo gaalku odhan:Hoogaye! Maan ciid ahaado.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلنَّٰزِعَٰتِ غَرۡقٗا

en.text: By those [angels] who extract with violence[1833]
en.footnotes: [1833] i.e., those who tear out the souls of those destined for Hell.

so.text: 1. Waxaan ku dhaartay (malaa’igta) sida daran u soo siibta nafaha (gaalada).

ayat.arabic: وَٱلنَّٰشِطَٰتِ نَشۡطٗا

en.text: And [by] those who remove with ease[1834]
en.footnotes: [1834] i.e., those angels who ease out the souls of those destined for Paradise.

so.text: 2. Iyo (malaa'igta) sida fudud u qaadda (nafaha mu’miniinta waqtiga dhimashada).

ayat.arabic: وَٱلسَّٰبِحَٰتِ سَبۡحٗا

en.text: And [by] those who glide [as if] swimming[1835]
en.footnotes: [1835] Speeding to execute Allāh's commands.

so.text: 3. Iyo (malaa'igta) hawada dabaalata (iyagoo u socda fulin amarrada Alle).

ayat.arabic: فَٱلسَّٰبِقَٰتِ سَبۡقٗا

en.text: And those who race each other in a race[1836]
en.footnotes: [1836] Racing to deliver the souls of the believers to Paradise.

so.text: 4. Iyo (malaa'igta) u dheereeya 'khayrka iyo wanaagga' dheereyn.

ayat.arabic: فَٱلۡمُدَبِّرَٰتِ أَمۡرٗا

en.text: And those who arrange [each] matter,[1837]
en.footnotes: [1837] According to Allāh's decree.

so.text: 5. Iyo 'malaa'igta' isku duwa arrin 'walba' [1]
so.footnotes: [1]. Si waafaqsan amarka Alle, in dadow la idin soo bixin oo xisaabin Aakhirada.

ayat.arabic: يَوۡمَ تَرۡجُفُ ٱلرَّاجِفَةُ

en.text: On the Day the blast [of the Horn] will convulse [creation],

so.text: 6. Maalinta ay gilgilatadu gilgilan (waa afuufka hore ee Buunka).

ayat.arabic: تَتۡبَعُهَا ٱلرَّادِفَةُ

en.text: There will follow it the subsequent [one].

so.text: 7. Oo ay raaci tan xigta (afuufka labaad).

ayat.arabic: قُلُوبٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ وَاجِفَةٌ

en.text: Hearts,[1838] that Day, will tremble,
en.footnotes: [1838] Those of the disbelievers who denied the Resurrection.

so.text: 8. Quluub (qalbiyada gaalada) Maalintaas way gariiri.

ayat.arabic: أَبۡصَٰرُهَا خَٰشِعَةٞ

en.text: Their eyes[1839] humbled.
en.footnotes: [1839] Those of the disbelievers.

so.text: 9. Indhahoodu dulleysnaan.

ayat.arabic: يَقُولُونَ أَءِنَّا لَمَرۡدُودُونَ فِي ٱلۡحَافِرَةِ

en.text: They are [presently] saying, "Will we indeed be returned to [our] former state [of life]?

so.text: 10. Waxay (haatan) leeyihiin: Ma waxaa naloo soo celin (dhimashadayada kaddib) sidayadii hore (ee nolosha adduunka)?

ayat.arabic: أَءِذَا كُنَّا عِظَٰمٗا نَّخِرَةٗ

en.text: Even if we should be decayed bones?"[1840]
en.footnotes: [1840] The disbelievers say this in ridicule of the warning.

so.text: 11. Ma markaan noqonno lafo bololay?

ayat.arabic: قَالُواْ تِلۡكَ إِذٗا كَرَّةٌ خَاسِرَةٞ

en.text: They say, "That, then, would be a losing return."[1841]
en.footnotes: [1841] i.e., "If that were so, we would not be able to escape punishment."

so.text: 12. Waxay odhan: Taasi waa noqosho khasaaro ah.

ayat.arabic: فَإِنَّمَا هِيَ زَجۡرَةٞ وَٰحِدَةٞ

en.text: Indeed, it will be but one shout,

so.text: 13. Waase hal Qeylo keliya.

ayat.arabic: فَإِذَا هُم بِٱلسَّاهِرَةِ

en.text: And suddenly they will be [alert] upon the earth's surface.

so.text: 14. Mise, waxay ahaan (kuwo nool) dhulka guudki (dhimashadoodii kaddib).

ayat.arabic: هَلۡ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰٓ

en.text: Has there reached you the story of Moses? -

so.text: 15. Ma ku soo gaaray warkii Muuse?

ayat.arabic: إِذۡ نَادَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ بِٱلۡوَادِ ٱلۡمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى

en.text: When his Lord called to him in the sacred valley of Ṭuwā,

so.text: 16. Markuu Rabbigi (Alle) uga dhawaaqay togga barakeysan ee Duwa.

ayat.arabic: ٱذۡهَبۡ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ

en.text: "Go to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed.

so.text: 17. Aad Fircoon, wuu xadgudbaye.

ayat.arabic: فَقُلۡ هَل لَّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَن تَزَكَّىٰ

en.text: And say to him, 'Would you [be willing to] purify yourself

so.text: 18. Oo ku dheh: Ma dooneysaa inaad iska daahiriso (shirkiga iyo macaasida)?

ayat.arabic: وَأَهۡدِيَكَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَتَخۡشَىٰ

en.text: And let me guide you to your Lord so you would fear [Him]?'"

so.text: 19. Oo aan kugu hanuunsho xagga Rabbigaa si aad uga baqdo?.

ayat.arabic: فَأَرَىٰهُ ٱلۡأٓيَةَ ٱلۡكُبۡرَىٰ

en.text: And he showed him the greatest sign,[1842]
en.footnotes: [1842] i.e., the miracle of his staff becoming a great snake.

so.text: 20. Markaasuu tusay Calaamddii Weyneyd [2].
so.footnotes: [2]. Gacantii ifeysay ama ushii maska weyn noqoneysay.

ayat.arabic: فَكَذَّبَ وَعَصَىٰ

en.text: But he [i.e., Pharaoh] denied and disobeyed.

so.text: 21. (Fircoon) se wuu beeniyey oo caasiyey.

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ أَدۡبَرَ يَسۡعَىٰ

en.text: Then he turned his back, striving [i.e., plotting].[1843]
en.footnotes: [1843] An alternative meaning is "running [from the snake]."

so.text: 22. Markaasuu dib u jeestay isagoo (xumaan u) socda.

ayat.arabic: فَحَشَرَ فَنَادَىٰ

en.text: And he gathered [his people] and called out

so.text: 23. Oo soo kulmiyey (dadkiisii) oo kor u dhawaaqay.

ayat.arabic: فَقَالَ أَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمُ ٱلۡأَعۡلَىٰ

en.text: And said, "I am your most exalted lord."

so.text: 24. Oo yidhi: Waa aniga rabbigiin, sarreeya.

ayat.arabic: فَأَخَذَهُ ٱللَّهُ نَكَالَ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ وَٱلۡأُولَىٰٓ

en.text: So Allāh seized him in exemplary punishment for the last and the first [transgression].[1844].
en.footnotes: [1844] i.e., for Pharaoh's setting himself up as a deity and for his previous oppression of the people and denial of Moses.

so.text: 25. Markaasuu Alle ku dhigay ciqaab lagu tusaale qaato (xadgudubkii) dambe (sheegashadiisa ilaahnimo) iyo tii hore darteed (beeninta Muuse).

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبۡرَةٗ لِّمَن يَخۡشَىٰٓ

en.text: Indeed in that is a lesson [i.e., warning] for whoever would fear [Allāh].

so.text: 26. Arrinkani waxaa xaqiiq ugu sugan cibrad (digniin) qof kastoo ka baqa Alle.

ayat.arabic: ءَأَنتُمۡ أَشَدُّ خَلۡقًا أَمِ ٱلسَّمَآءُۚ بَنَىٰهَا

en.text: Are you a more difficult creation or is the heaven? He [i.e., Allāh] constructed it.

so.text: 27. Ma idinkaa adag abuur ahaan, mise samada, wuu dhisay.

ayat.arabic: رَفَعَ سَمۡكَهَا فَسَوَّىٰهَا

en.text: He raised its ceiling and proportioned it.

so.text: 28.Wuxuu (samada) kor yeelay jurmigeeda oo waliba simay.

ayat.arabic: وَأَغۡطَشَ لَيۡلَهَا وَأَخۡرَجَ ضُحَىٰهَا

en.text: And He darkened its night and extracted its brightness.[1845]
en.footnotes: [1845] i.e., created the day from within the surrounding darkness.

so.text: 29. Oo ka yeelay mugdi habeenkeeda oo soo bixiyey maalinteeda (ifiyey).

ayat.arabic: وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ بَعۡدَ ذَٰلِكَ دَحَىٰهَآ

en.text: And after that He spread the earth.

so.text: 30. Dhulka markaa kaddib fidshay.

ayat.arabic: أَخۡرَجَ مِنۡهَا مَآءَهَا وَمَرۡعَىٰهَا

en.text: He extracted from it its water and its pasture,

so.text: 31. Wuxuu ka soo saaray biyaheeda iyo baadkeeda;

ayat.arabic: وَٱلۡجِبَالَ أَرۡسَىٰهَا

en.text: And the mountains He set firmly

so.text: 32. Buurahana wuu dhidbay;

ayat.arabic: مَتَٰعٗا لَّكُمۡ وَلِأَنۡعَٰمِكُمۡ

en.text: As enjoyment [i.e., provision] for you and your grazing livestock.

so.text: 33. Sahay aad leedihiin idinka iyo xoolahiinnuba.

ayat.arabic: فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلطَّآمَّةُ ٱلۡكُبۡرَىٰ

en.text: But when there comes the greatest Overwhelming Calamity[1846] -
en.footnotes: [1846] i.e., the Day of Resurrection.

so.text: 34. Markase ay timaaddo musiibada weyni.

ayat.arabic: يَوۡمَ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ مَا سَعَىٰ

en.text: The Day when man will remember that for which he strove,

so.text: 35. Maalinka uu Aadmigu xusuusan wuxuu falay oo dhan.

ayat.arabic: وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلۡجَحِيمُ لِمَن يَرَىٰ

en.text: And Hellfire will be exposed for [all] those who see -

so.text: 36. Oo Naarta loo muujiyo qof (waliba) oo arkaya,

ayat.arabic: فَأَمَّا مَن طَغَىٰ

en.text: So as for he who transgressed

so.text: 37. Ma qofkii xad gudba.

ayat.arabic: وَءَاثَرَ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا

en.text: And preferred the life of the world,

so.text: 38. Oo door bida nolosha adduunkan.

ayat.arabic: فَإِنَّ ٱلۡجَحِيمَ هِيَ ٱلۡمَأۡوَىٰ

en.text: Then indeed, Hellfire will be [his] refuge.

so.text: 39. Hubaal Naarta waa hoygiisa.

ayat.arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنۡ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ وَنَهَى ٱلنَّفۡسَ عَنِ ٱلۡهَوَىٰ

en.text: But as for he who feared the position of his Lord[1847] and prevented the soul from [unlawful] inclination,
en.footnotes: [1847] See footnote to 55:46.

so.text: 40. Qofkiise ka cabsada hor istaagga Rabbigi, oo ka reeba nafta hawa raaca.

ayat.arabic: فَإِنَّ ٱلۡجَنَّةَ هِيَ ٱلۡمَأۡوَىٰ

en.text: Then indeed, Paradise will be [his] refuge.

so.text: 41. Hubaal Jannada - waa hoygiisa.

ayat.arabic: يَسۡـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلسَّاعَةِ أَيَّانَ مُرۡسَىٰهَا

en.text: They ask you, [O Muḥammad], about the Hour: when is its arrival?[1848]
en.footnotes: [1848] Literally, "resting" or "establishment."

so.text: 42. Waxay wax kaa weydiin (Nabiyow) Saacadda (Qiyaame) goortay tahay.

ayat.arabic: فِيمَ أَنتَ مِن ذِكۡرَىٰهَآ

en.text: In what [position] are you that you should mention it?[1849]
en.footnotes: [1849] Meaning that Muḥammad (ﷺ) had no knowledge of it, so how could he inform them?

so.text: 43. Maxaa ku ogeysiiyey waqtigeeda? Waxaad tahay mid ka mid ah calaamadaha soo dhowaanshaheeda.

ayat.arabic: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ مُنتَهَىٰهَآ

en.text: To your Lord is its finality.[1850]
en.footnotes: [1850] i.e., its destination and termination. And to Him belongs ultimate knowledge of it.

so.text: 44. Waa xagga Rabbigaa halkay ku dhammaan (ogaanshaheeda).

ayat.arabic: إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُنذِرُ مَن يَخۡشَىٰهَا

en.text: You are only a warner for those who fear it.

so.text: 45. Waxaad uun tahay (Nabiyow) u dige kuwa ka baqa.

ayat.arabic: كَأَنَّهُمۡ يَوۡمَ يَرَوۡنَهَا لَمۡ يَلۡبَثُوٓاْ إِلَّا عَشِيَّةً أَوۡ ضُحَىٰهَا

en.text: It will be, on the Day they see it,[1851] as though they had not remained [in the world] except for an afternoon or a morning thereof.
en.footnotes: [1851] i.e., the Hour, the Resurrection.

so.text: 46. Maalinta ay arkayaan waxay ahaan  sida inaysan ku nagaadin (adduunka) waxaan ahayn galab ama barqadeed.

ayat.arabic: عَبَسَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ

en.text: He [i.e., the Prophet (ﷺ) ] frowned and turned away

so.text: 1. (Wejiguu) kuduuday oo jeesaday (Nebiga s.c.w),

ayat.arabic: أَن جَآءَهُ ٱلۡأَعۡمَىٰ

en.text: Because there came to him the blind man,[1853] [interrupting].
en.footnotes: [1853] ʿAbdullāh, the son of Umm Maktūm.

so.text: 2. Inuu u yimid indhoolihii [1] darteed,
so.footnotes: [1]. Waa Cabdullaah ibn Um Maktuum a.k.r.

ayat.arabic: وَمَا يُدۡرِيكَ لَعَلَّهُۥ يَزَّكَّىٰٓ

en.text: But what would make you perceive, [O Muḥammad], that perhaps he might be purified[1854]
en.footnotes: [1854] As a result of what he learns from you.

so.text: 3. Miyaadse ogtahay waa intaasoo uu dooni inuu hanuuno oo is daahiriyo,

ayat.arabic: أَوۡ يَذَّكَّرُ فَتَنفَعَهُ ٱلذِّكۡرَىٰٓ

en.text: Or be reminded and the remembrance would benefit him?

so.text: 4. Ama waansamo, oo waanadu anfacdo.

ayat.arabic: أَمَّا مَنِ ٱسۡتَغۡنَىٰ

en.text: As for he who thinks himself without need,[1855]
en.footnotes: [1855] i.e., without need of faith or need of Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) . Here it is in reference to a certain influential member of the Quraysh whom the Prophet (ﷺ) had hoped to bring to Islām.

so.text: 5. Kan is deeqtoonsiiya (ee isla weyn),

ayat.arabic: فَأَنتَ لَهُۥ تَصَدَّىٰ

en.text: To him you give attention.

so.text: 6. Miyaad adigu u banbixi,

ayat.arabic: وَمَا عَلَيۡكَ أَلَّا يَزَّكَّىٰ

en.text: And not upon you [is any blame] if he will not be purified.[1856]
en.footnotes: [1856] The Prophet (ﷺ) was responsible only for conveying the message, not for ultimate guidance.

so.text: 7. Eedna kaama saarna hadduusan hanuunin oo daahirin naftiisa,

ayat.arabic: وَأَمَّا مَن جَآءَكَ يَسۡعَىٰ

en.text: But as for he who came to you striving [for knowledge]

so.text: 8. Kan se kuu yimid isagoo dadaalaya,

ayat.arabic: وَهُوَ يَخۡشَىٰ

en.text: While he fears [Allāh],

so.text: 9. Oo (Alle ka) baqa,

ayat.arabic: فَأَنتَ عَنۡهُ تَلَهَّىٰ

en.text: From him you are distracted.

so.text: 10. Miyaad adigu ka mashquuli.

ayat.arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّهَا تَذۡكِرَةٞ

en.text: No! Indeed, they [i.e., these verses] are a reminder;

so.text: 11. Mayee, Aayadahani waa waano.

ayat.arabic: فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ

en.text: So whoever wills may remember it.[1857]
en.footnotes: [1857] The revelation. Or "Him," i.e., Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) .

so.text: 12. Ee qofkii doona ha ku waano qaato.

ayat.arabic: فِي صُحُفٖ مُّكَرَّمَةٖ

en.text: [It is recorded] in honored sheets,

so.text: 13. Waxay ku sugan tahay (waanadan) kutub la sharfay (Looxa Maxfuudka).

ayat.arabic: مَّرۡفُوعَةٖ مُّطَهَّرَةِۭ

en.text: Exalted and purified,

so.text: 14. Kor ah, la dahiray.

ayat.arabic: بِأَيۡدِي سَفَرَةٖ

en.text: [Carried] by the hands of messenger-angels,

so.text: 15. Ku jira gacmaha qorayaal (malaa’ig).

ayat.arabic: كِرَامِۭ بَرَرَةٖ

en.text: Noble and dutiful.

so.text: 16. Sharaf leh oo baariyaal ah.

ayat.arabic: قُتِلَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ مَآ أَكۡفَرَهُۥ

en.text: Destroyed [i.e., cursed] is man;[1858] how disbelieving is he.
en.footnotes: [1858] i.e., those who deny Allāh's message.

so.text: 17. Belo ha ku dhacdo aadmigee (waa kan gaalka ahi)! Muxuu jazaar yahay!

ayat.arabic: مِنۡ أَيِّ شَيۡءٍ خَلَقَهُۥ

en.text: From what thing [i.e., substance] did He create him?

so.text: 18. Muxuu Alle ka abuuray?

ayat.arabic: مِن نُّطۡفَةٍ خَلَقَهُۥ فَقَدَّرَهُۥ

en.text: From a sperm-drop He created him and destined for him;[1859]
en.footnotes: [1859] His proportions, provisions, life span, etc.

so.text: 19. Dhibic mani ah buu ka abuuray wuuna ekeeyey.

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ ٱلسَّبِيلَ يَسَّرَهُۥ

en.text: Then He eased the way for him;[1860]
en.footnotes: [1860] Into this world (i.e., his birth) . It may also refer to life itself, which has been made easier by Allāh's guidance.

so.text: 20. Markaas uga dhigay sahal dhabbaha [2];
so.footnotes: [2]. Waa ka soo bixitaanka uurka hooyadi ama dhabbaha nolosha Ama jidka hanuunka.

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ أَمَاتَهُۥ فَأَقۡبَرَهُۥ

en.text: Then He causes his death and provides a grave for him.[1861]
en.footnotes: [1861] To conceal his decaying body.

so.text: 21. Markaasuu sababaa inuu dhinto, oo qabri lagu aaso;

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ إِذَا شَآءَ أَنشَرَهُۥ

en.text: Then when He wills, He will resurrect him.

so.text: 22. Markuu doonana wuu soo bixin.

ayat.arabic: كَلَّا لَمَّا يَقۡضِ مَآ أَمَرَهُۥ

en.text: No! He [i.e., man] has not yet accomplished what He commanded him.

so.text: 23. Mayee, ma uusan yeelin wuxuu amray.

ayat.arabic: فَلۡيَنظُرِ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ إِلَىٰ طَعَامِهِۦٓ

en.text: Then let mankind look at his food -

so.text: 24. Ee qofku bal ha eego cunnadiisa.

ayat.arabic: أَنَّا صَبَبۡنَا ٱلۡمَآءَ صَبّٗا

en.text: How We poured down water in torrents,

so.text: 25. Annagaa soo shubna biyaha (roobka) soo shubid badan,

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ شَقَقۡنَا ٱلۡأَرۡضَ شَقّٗا

en.text: Then We broke open the earth, splitting [it with sprouts],

so.text: 26. Markaas Waxaan jeexnaa arlada jeexdin.

ayat.arabic: فَأَنۢبَتۡنَا فِيهَا حَبّٗا

en.text: And caused to grow within it grain

so.text: 27. Oo ka soo bixinnaa hadhuudh,

ayat.arabic: وَعِنَبٗا وَقَضۡبٗا

en.text: And grapes and herbage

so.text: 28. Iyo cinab iyo naq.

ayat.arabic: وَزَيۡتُونٗا وَنَخۡلٗا

en.text: And olive and palm trees

so.text: 29. Iyo zaytuun iyo geedo timireed.

ayat.arabic: وَحَدَآئِقَ غُلۡبٗا

en.text: And gardens of dense shrubbery

so.text: 30. Iyo beero tanaad ah.

ayat.arabic: وَفَٰكِهَةٗ وَأَبّٗا

en.text: And fruit and grass -

so.text: 31. Iyo midho iyo caws.

ayat.arabic: مَّتَٰعٗا لَّكُمۡ وَلِأَنۡعَٰمِكُمۡ

en.text: [As] enjoyment [i.e., provision] for you and your grazing livestock.

so.text: 32. Sahay aad leedihiin ah idinka iyo xoolihiinnuba.

ayat.arabic: فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلصَّآخَّةُ

en.text: But when there comes the Deafening Blast[1862]
en.footnotes: [1862] The piercing blast of the Horn which signals resurrection. Aṣ-Ṣākhkhah is also a name for the Day of Resurrection.

so.text: 33. Markase ay qeylada dhego beelisada ah timaaddo (afuufka labaad ee Buunka).

ayat.arabic: يَوۡمَ يَفِرُّ ٱلۡمَرۡءُ مِنۡ أَخِيهِ

en.text: On the Day a man will flee from his brother

so.text: 34. Maalinta uu qofku ka carari walaalki,

ayat.arabic: وَأُمِّهِۦ وَأَبِيهِ

en.text: And his mother and his father

so.text: 35. Iyo hooyadi iyo aabbihi.

ayat.arabic: وَصَٰحِبَتِهِۦ وَبَنِيهِ

en.text: And his wife and his children,

so.text: 36. Iyo xaaskiisa iyo ilmahiisa,

ayat.arabic: لِكُلِّ ٱمۡرِيٕٖ مِّنۡهُمۡ يَوۡمَئِذٖ شَأۡنٞ يُغۡنِيهِ

en.text: For every man, that Day, will be a matter adequate for him.[1863]
en.footnotes: [1863] i.e., to occupy him. He will be concerned only with himself, thus forgetting all others.

so.text: 37. Qof walba oo ka mid ah Maalinkaas waxaa heysan arrin ku filan.

ayat.arabic: وُجُوهٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ مُّسۡفِرَةٞ

en.text: [Some] faces, that Day, will be bright -

so.text: 38. Wejiyo (qaar) Maalinkaas way ifi.

ayat.arabic: ضَاحِكَةٞ مُّسۡتَبۡشِرَةٞ

en.text: Laughing, rejoicing at good news.

so.text: 39. Iyagoo qosli ku faraxsan (Jannada) loogu bishaareyey.

ayat.arabic: وَوُجُوهٞ يَوۡمَئِذٍ عَلَيۡهَا غَبَرَةٞ

en.text: And [other] faces, that Day, will have upon them dust.

so.text: 40. Wejiyona Maalinkaas (Qiyaame) waxay ahaan  kuwo booreysan dulli ka muuqdo;

ayat.arabic: تَرۡهَقُهَا قَتَرَةٌ

en.text: Blackness will cover them.

so.text: 41. Mugdi baa dabooli (iyo naxdin).

ayat.arabic: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡكَفَرَةُ ٱلۡفَجَرَةُ

en.text: Those are the disbelievers, the wicked ones.

so.text: 42. Kuwaasi waa kuwa ah gaalada, denbiilayaasha.

ayat.arabic: إِذَا ٱلشَّمۡسُ كُوِّرَتۡ

en.text: When the sun is wrapped up [in darkness]

so.text: 1. Marka qorraxda la duubo (oo la iftiin tiro),

ayat.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلنُّجُومُ ٱنكَدَرَتۡ

en.text: And when the stars fall, dispersing,

so.text: 2. Oo xiddiguhu daataan (oo nuurkoodu tago),

ayat.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلۡجِبَالُ سُيِّرَتۡ

en.text: And when the mountains are removed

so.text: 3. Oo buuraha la rujiyo 'oo budo noqdaan'.

ayat.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلۡعِشَارُ عُطِّلَتۡ

en.text: And when full-term she-camels[1865] are neglected
en.footnotes: [1865] Those ten months pregnant and nearing delivery. This verse alludes to distraction from the most valued of possessions.

so.text: 4. Oo geela rimman [1] la cidleeyo (oo laga hayaamo).
so.footnotes: [1]. Qofka waxa uu maal ugu jecel yahay.

ayat.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلۡوُحُوشُ حُشِرَتۡ

en.text: And when the wild beasts are gathered

so.text: 5. Oo dugaagga la soo wada kulmiyo (qisaas darteed).

ayat.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلۡبِحَارُ سُجِّرَتۡ

en.text: And when the seas are filled with flame[1866]
en.footnotes: [1866] Or "when the seas have overflowed [into each other]."

so.text: 6. Oo badaha la shido (ama isku soo fatahmaan);

ayat.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلنُّفُوسُ زُوِّجَتۡ

en.text: And when the souls are paired[1867]
en.footnotes: [1867] With another like soul. It can also mean "joined" (with their groups or sects) .

so.text: 7. Oo nafaha lagu lammaaniyo jirarkoodii [2];
so.footnotes: [2]. Macno kale lagu lammaansho eynigood iyo waxay is leeyihiin oo la mid ah.

ayat.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلۡمَوۡءُۥدَةُ سُئِلَتۡ

en.text: And when the girl [who was] buried alive is asked

so.text: 8.Oo (tii kastoo yaraan) lagu nolol xabaalay la weydiiyo,

ayat.arabic: بِأَيِّ ذَنۢبٖ قُتِلَتۡ

en.text: For what sin she was killed

so.text: 9. Maxaa denbi ahoo loo dilay?

ayat.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلصُّحُفُ نُشِرَتۡ

en.text: And when the pages[1868] are spread [i.e., made public]
en.footnotes: [1868] On which are recorded the deeds of all people.

so.text: 10. Marka kutubta (acmaasha aadmiga ee malaa'igtu qorayeen) la fidiyo.

ayat.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ كُشِطَتۡ

en.text: And when the sky is stripped away

so.text: 11. Oo samada laga rujiyo meesheeda,

ayat.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلۡجَحِيمُ سُعِّرَتۡ

en.text: And when Hellfire is set ablaze

so.text: 12. Oo Naarta la huriyo.

ayat.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلۡجَنَّةُ أُزۡلِفَتۡ

en.text: And when Paradise is brought near,

so.text: 13. Oo Jannada la soo dhoweeyo.

ayat.arabic: عَلِمَتۡ نَفۡسٞ مَّآ أَحۡضَرَتۡ

en.text: A soul will [then] know what it has brought [with it].[1869]
en.footnotes: [1869] i.e., all of one's deeds from worldly life, which have accompanied the soul to the Hereafter.

so.text: 14. Waxay ogaan nafi waxay la timid (khayr ama shar).

ayat.arabic: فَلَآ أُقۡسِمُ بِٱلۡخُنَّسِ

en.text: So I swear by the retreating stars -

so.text: 15. Waxaan ku dhaartay xiddigaha qarsooma (maalintii).

ayat.arabic: ٱلۡجَوَارِ ٱلۡكُنَّسِ

en.text: Those that run [their courses] and disappear [i.e., set]

so.text: 16. Ee ku socda rugahooda ee qarsoomee (dhaca).

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّيۡلِ إِذَا عَسۡعَسَ

en.text: And by the night as it closes in[1870]
en.footnotes: [1870] An alternative meaning is "as it departs."

so.text: 17. Iyo habeenka markuu yimaado (ama tago).

ayat.arabic: وَٱلصُّبۡحِ إِذَا تَنَفَّسَ

en.text: And by the dawn when it breathes [i.e., stirs]

so.text: 18. Iyo subaxu markuu neefsado (oo soo baxo iftiinkiisa).

ayat.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوۡلُ رَسُولٖ كَرِيمٖ

en.text: [That] indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a word [conveyed by] a noble messenger [i.e., Gabriel]

so.text: 19. Hubaal kani (Qur'aanka) waa hadal 'Alle' uu keenay Rasuul sharaf badan (Jabriil).

ayat.arabic: ذِي قُوَّةٍ عِندَ ذِي ٱلۡعَرۡشِ مَكِينٖ

en.text: [Who is] possessed of power and with the Owner of the Throne, secure [in position],

so.text: 20. Awood iyo meeqaan sare ku leh (Alle) agtiis, Rabbiga Carshiga Weyn,

ayat.arabic: مُّطَاعٖ ثَمَّ أَمِينٖ

en.text: Obeyed there [in the heavens] and trustworthy.

so.text: 21. La adeeco, haddana aamin ah kalsooni lagu qabo.

ayat.arabic: وَمَا صَاحِبُكُم بِمَجۡنُونٖ

en.text: And your companion [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ) ] is not [at all] mad.[1871]
en.footnotes: [1871] Literally, "possessed by jinn."

so.text: 22. Saaxiibkiin (Nabi Muxammad) ma aha jinnoole.

ayat.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ رَءَاهُ بِٱلۡأُفُقِ ٱلۡمُبِينِ

en.text: And he has already seen him [i.e., Gabriel] in the clear horizon.[1872]
en.footnotes: [1872] i.e., the eastern horizon, where the sun rises. See footnote to 53:6.

so.text: 23. Horay buuna ugu arkay (Jabriil) jihada cad (dhinaca qorrax soo baxa).

ayat.arabic: وَمَا هُوَ عَلَى ٱلۡغَيۡبِ بِضَنِينٖ

en.text: And he [i.e., Muḥammad (ﷺ)] is not a withholder of [knowledge of] the unseen.[1873]
en.footnotes: [1873] Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ) did not withhold that knowledge of the unseen which Allāh had revealed to him in the Qur’ān.

so.text: 24. Ma aha  (Nabi Muxammad) mid ceshada 'bakheyla amaba looga shakiyo' cilmiga ku saabsan Ghaybka 'ee Qarsoon'.

ayat.arabic: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوۡلِ شَيۡطَٰنٖ رَّجِيمٖ

en.text: And it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is not the word of a devil, expelled [from the heavens].

so.text: 25. (Qur’aankuna) ma aha hadalka Shaydaan laga fogeeyey (Naxariista Alle).

ayat.arabic: فَأَيۡنَ تَذۡهَبُونَ

en.text: So where are you going?[1874]
en.footnotes: [1874] In your denial of the Qur’ān and in your accusations against the Prophet (ﷺ) . The meaning is essentially "Surely, you have strayed far from Allāh's path."

so.text: 26. Ee xaggee 'gaalooy' aadeysaan?

ayat.arabic: إِنۡ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكۡرٞ لِّلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

en.text: It is not except a reminder to the worlds

so.text: 27. (Qur’aanku) ma aha waxaan aheyn Waano ku socota ummadaha oo dhan.

ayat.arabic: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمۡ أَن يَسۡتَقِيمَ

en.text: For whoever wills among you to take a right course.

so.text: 28. Qofkii idinka mid ah ee dooni inuu (ku) toosnaado (Xaqa).

ayat.arabic: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

en.text: And you do not will except that Allāh wills - Lord of the worlds.

so.text: 29. Oo waxna ma dooni kartaan wuxuu Alle doono maahee, Rabbiga uumanka.

ayat.arabic: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنفَطَرَتۡ

en.text: When the sky breaks apart

so.text: 1. Markay samada dildillaacdo.

ayat.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلۡكَوَاكِبُ ٱنتَثَرَتۡ

en.text: And when the stars fall, scattering,

so.text: 2. Markay xiddiguhu daataan oo kala firdhaan.

ayat.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلۡبِحَارُ فُجِّرَتۡ

en.text: And when the seas are erupted

so.text: 3. Marka badaha laysku furo oo soo fatahaan.

ayat.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلۡقُبُورُ بُعۡثِرَتۡ

en.text: And when the [contents of] graves are scattered [i.e., exposed],

so.text: 4. Marka qabuuraha la soo qufo.

ayat.arabic: عَلِمَتۡ نَفۡسٞ مَّا قَدَّمَتۡ وَأَخَّرَتۡ

en.text: A soul will [then] know what it has put forth and kept back.

so.text: 5. Naf walbaa waxay ogaan waxay hormarsatay iyo (waxay) dib marisay (khayr ama shar oo laga jaazeyn).

ayat.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ ٱلۡكَرِيمِ

en.text: O mankind, what has deceived you concerning your Lord, the Generous,

so.text: 6. Qof yahow! Maxaa kaa jeediyey Rabbigaaga, Roonaanta Badan?

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَكَ فَسَوَّىٰكَ فَعَدَلَكَ

en.text: Who created you, proportioned you, and balanced you?

so.text: 7. Kaasoo ku abuuray, kuna ekeeyey oo ku simay?

ayat.arabic: فِيٓ أَيِّ صُورَةٖ مَّا شَآءَ رَكَّبَكَ

en.text: In whatever form He willed has He assembled you.

so.text: 8. Suuradduu doonana kuu sameeyey?.

ayat.arabic: كَلَّا بَلۡ تُكَذِّبُونَ بِٱلدِّينِ

en.text: No! But you deny the Recompense.

so.text: 9. Mayee bal waxaad beenisaan maalinta is abaal marinta (jaazeynta).

ayat.arabic: وَإِنَّ عَلَيۡكُمۡ لَحَٰفِظِينَ

en.text: And indeed, [appointed] over you are keepers,[1876]
en.footnotes: [1876] Angels who preserve the deeds of men in records.

so.text: 10. Waxaana xaqiiq korkiinna ah (oo idiin xil saaran malaa’ig) gaar idinka haya.

ayat.arabic: كِرَامٗا كَٰتِبِينَ

en.text: Noble and recording;

so.text: 11.Sharaf leh, qoraya (acmaashiinna),

ayat.arabic: يَعۡلَمُونَ مَا تَفۡعَلُونَ

en.text: They know whatever you do.

so.text: 12. Ogsoon wax kastoo aad fashaan.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلۡأَبۡرَارَ لَفِي نَعِيمٖ

en.text: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure,

so.text: 13. Hubaal, baarriyadu waxay dhex ahaan barwaaqo (Janno).

ayat.arabic: وَإِنَّ ٱلۡفُجَّارَ لَفِي جَحِيمٖ

en.text: And indeed, the wicked will be in Hellfire.

so.text: 14. Oo hubaal xume falayaashu waxay ku sugnaan Naar ololaysa.

ayat.arabic: يَصۡلَوۡنَهَا يَوۡمَ ٱلدِّينِ

en.text: They will [enter to] burn therein on the Day of Recompense,

so.text: 15. Ay geli oo ku guban Maalinta Is abaalmarinta (Jaazeynta).

ayat.arabic: وَمَا هُمۡ عَنۡهَا بِغَآئِبِينَ

en.text: And never therefrom will they be absent.

so.text: 16. Kamana maqnaadaan marnaba xaggeeda (Naarta).

ayat.arabic: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا يَوۡمُ ٱلدِّينِ

en.text: And what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?

so.text: 17. Maxaa ku ogeysiiyey waxay Maalinta is abaal marintu tahay?

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ مَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا يَوۡمُ ٱلدِّينِ

en.text: Then, what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?

so.text: 18. Misna, maxaa ku ogeysiiyey waxay Maalinta is abaal marintu tahay?

ayat.arabic: يَوۡمَ لَا تَمۡلِكُ نَفۡسٞ لِّنَفۡسٖ شَيۡـٔٗاۖ وَٱلۡأَمۡرُ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلَّهِ

en.text: It is the Day when a soul will not possess for another soul [power to do] a thing; and the command, that Day, is [entirely] with Allāh.

so.text: 19. (Waa) maalinta aysan nafi wax u tarin naf kale. Amarkana Maalintaas waxaa gebi ahaanba iska leh Allaah.

ayat.arabic: وَيۡلٞ لِّلۡمُطَفِّفِينَ

en.text: Woe to those who give less [than due],[1878]
en.footnotes: [1878] i.e., those who cheat people by giving them less than what they paid for when weighing or measuring - an amount so little as to hardly be noticed.

so.text: 1. Hoog waxaa leh kuwa dadka (xaqooda) duudsiya oo dhima 'nuqsaamiya'.

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكۡتَالُواْ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسۡتَوۡفُونَ

en.text: Who, when they take a measure from people, take in full.

so.text: 2. Waa kuwa markay wax beegan u oofsada si dhan oo kaamil ah.

ayat.arabic: وَإِذَا كَالُوهُمۡ أَو وَّزَنُوهُمۡ يُخۡسِرُونَ

en.text: But if they give by measure or by weight to them, they cause loss.

so.text: 3. Markase ay u beegi dadka kale ama miisaami ka dhima oo nuqsaamiya.

ayat.arabic: أَلَا يَظُنُّ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ أَنَّهُم مَّبۡعُوثُونَ

en.text: Do they not think that they will be resurrected

so.text: 4. Miyeyna u malaynaynin kuwaasi in loo soo bixin doono (si loo xisaabiyo).

ayat.arabic: لِيَوۡمٍ عَظِيمٖ

en.text: For a tremendous Day -

so.text: 5. Maalin weyn (Qiyaamada).

ayat.arabic: يَوۡمَ يَقُومُ ٱلنَّاسُ لِرَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

en.text: The Day when mankind will stand before the Lord of the worlds?

so.text: 6. Maalinta  dadku istaagi Rabbiga uumanka horti?

ayat.arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلۡفُجَّارِ لَفِي سِجِّينٖ

en.text: No! Indeed, the record of the wicked is in sijjeen.

so.text: 7. Mayee, hubaal diiwaanka (camalka) dadka xun wuxuu yaal Sijjiin.

ayat.arabic: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا سِجِّينٞ

en.text: And what can make you know what is sijjeen?

so.text: 8. Maxaa ku ogeysiiyey waxa uu Sijiin yahay [1]?
so.footnotes: [1]. Sijiin waa meel cidhiidhi ah oo ah halka u hooseysa arlada toddobaad.

ayat.arabic: كِتَٰبٞ مَّرۡقُومٞ

en.text: It is [their destination[1879] recorded in] a register inscribed.
en.footnotes: [1879] The lowest depths of Hell.

so.text: 9. Waa (aayahooda) kitaab (ku) calaameysan.

ayat.arabic: وَيۡلٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ

en.text: Woe, that Day, to the deniers,

so.text: 10. Hoog Maalintaas waxaa leh xaq beeniyayaasha (nabad diidka).

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يُكَذِّبُونَ بِيَوۡمِ ٱلدِّينِ

en.text: Who deny the Day of Recompense.

so.text: 11. Kuwa beeniya Maalinta is abaal marinta (Qiyaamada).

ayat.arabic: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعۡتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ

en.text: And none deny it except every sinful transgressor.

so.text: 12.Cidina ma beeniso aan aheyn xadgudbe kastoo denbiile ah.

ayat.arabic: إِذَا تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ

en.text: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples."

so.text: 13. Marka Aayadahayaga loo akhriyo,  yidhaahda: Waa sheekooyinkii dadkii hore.

ayat.arabic: كَلَّاۖ بَلۡۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُواْ يَكۡسِبُونَ

en.text: No! Rather, the stain has covered their hearts of that which they were earning.[1880]
en.footnotes: [1880] i.e., their sins.

so.text: 14. Mayee’ bal waxay fali jireen (oo macaasi ah) baa waxay ku noqdeen sida mirir madow quluubtooda dushood.

ayat.arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُمۡ عَن رَّبِّهِمۡ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لَّمَحۡجُوبُونَ

en.text: No! Indeed, from their Lord, that Day, they will be partitioned.[1881]
en.footnotes: [1881] i.e., they will not be able to see Him.

so.text: 15. Mayee, hubaal waxaa maalintaa laga xijaabi Rabbigood.

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّهُمۡ لَصَالُواْ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ

en.text: Then indeed, they will [enter and] burn in Hellfire.

so.text: 16. Markaasay waxay hubaal gali oo ku guban Naar olol badan.

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ

en.text: Then it will be said [to them], "This is what you used to deny."

so.text: 17. Waxaa markaa lagu odhan: Waxakanu waa waxaad beenin jirteen.

ayat.arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلۡأَبۡرَارِ لَفِي عِلِّيِّينَ

en.text: No! Indeed, the record of the righteous is in ʿilliyyūn.

so.text: 18. Mayee, hubaal, diiwaanka (camalka) dadka wanaagsan wuxuu yaal Cilliyyiin (samada toddobaad).

ayat.arabic: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا عِلِّيُّونَ

en.text: And what can make you know what is ʿilliyyūn?

so.text: 19. Maxaa ku ogeysiiyey waxa uu Cilliyiin yahay?

ayat.arabic: كِتَٰبٞ مَّرۡقُومٞ

en.text: It is [their destination[1882] recorded in] a register inscribed
en.footnotes: [1882] The highest elevations of Paradise.

so.text: 20. Waa (aayaha mu'miniinta) kitaab (ku)  calaameysan.

ayat.arabic: يَشۡهَدُهُ ٱلۡمُقَرَّبُونَ

en.text: Which is witnessed by those brought near [to Allāh].

so.text: 21. Waxaa arka (malaa’igtaa) ku dhow (Alle).

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلۡأَبۡرَارَ لَفِي نَعِيمٍ

en.text: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure

so.text: 22. Hubaal, baarriyiinta waxay ku sugnaan  barwaaqo (Janno).

ayat.arabic: عَلَى ٱلۡأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ

en.text: On adorned couches, observing.

so.text: 23. Sariiro boqoreed korkood iyagoo ka daawan (wax waliba oo nicmooyinka Jannada ah).

ayat.arabic: تَعۡرِفُ فِي وُجُوهِهِمۡ نَضۡرَةَ ٱلنَّعِيمِ

en.text: You will recognize in their faces the radiance of pleasure.

so.text: 24. Waxaad ka garan wejiyadooda dhalaalka barwaaqada.

ayat.arabic: يُسۡقَوۡنَ مِن رَّحِيقٖ مَّخۡتُومٍ

en.text: They will be given to drink [pure] wine[1883] [which was] sealed.
en.footnotes: [1883] Which is delicious and does not intoxicate.

so.text: 25. Waxaa laga waraabin khamri (saafi ah) ee la abburay.

ayat.arabic: خِتَٰمُهُۥ مِسۡكٞۚ وَفِي ذَٰلِكَ فَلۡيَتَنَافَسِ ٱلۡمُتَنَٰفِسُونَ

en.text: The last of it[1884] is musk. So for this let the competitors compete.
en.footnotes: [1884] i.e., its lingering odor.

so.text: 26. Inteeda u dambeysa ay tahay miski, ee (arrin)kani ha u tartameen tartamayaashu.

ayat.arabic: وَمِزَاجُهُۥ مِن تَسۡنِيمٍ

en.text: And its mixture is of Tasneem,[1885]
en.footnotes: [1885] The highest spring in Paradise and the most favored drink of its inhabitants.

so.text: 27. Dheeheeda waa biyo xagga Tasniim ah.

ayat.arabic: عَيۡنٗا يَشۡرَبُ بِهَا ٱلۡمُقَرَّبُونَ

en.text: A spring from which those near [to Allāh] drink.

so.text: 28. Il ay ka cabbi kuwa (Alle) u dhow.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجۡرَمُواْ كَانُواْ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ يَضۡحَكُونَ

en.text: Indeed, those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed.

so.text: 29. Denbiilayaashu waxay ku qosli jireen kuwa (Xaqa) rumeeyey ee mu'miniinta ah.

ayat.arabic: وَإِذَا مَرُّواْ بِهِمۡ يَتَغَامَزُونَ

en.text: And when they passed by them, they would exchange derisive glances.

so.text: 30. Hadday soo ag maraanna waa isu il-jabin jireen.

ayat.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوٓاْ إِلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِهِمُ ٱنقَلَبُواْ فَكِهِينَ

en.text: And when they returned to their people, they would return jesting.

so.text: 31. Markay u laabtaanna ehelkooda waxay laaban jireen iyagoo ku maaweeleysanaya,

ayat.arabic: وَإِذَا رَأَوۡهُمۡ قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّونَ

en.text: And when they saw them, they would say, "Indeed, those are truly lost."

so.text: 32. Markay arkaan (mu'miniinta) waxay odhan jireen: Kuwakanu xaqiiq waa kuwo lunsan.

ayat.arabic: وَمَآ أُرۡسِلُواْ عَلَيۡهِمۡ حَٰفِظِينَ

en.text: But they had not been sent as guardians over them.

so.text: 33. Ma loo dirsan inay gaar ka hayaan iyo ilaalo (mu’miniinta) dushooda.

ayat.arabic: فَٱلۡيَوۡمَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ مِنَ ٱلۡكُفَّارِ يَضۡحَكُونَ

en.text: So Today[1886] those who believed are laughing at the disbelievers,
en.footnotes: [1886] On the Day of Judgement.

so.text: 34. Maalinta (Qiyaame) kuwa (Xaqa) rumeeyey waxay ku qosli gaalada.

ayat.arabic: عَلَى ٱلۡأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ

en.text: On adorned couches, observing.

so.text: 35. Sariiro boqoreed (sare) korkood iyagoo ka daawan.

ayat.arabic: هَلۡ ثُوِّبَ ٱلۡكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُواْ يَفۡعَلُونَ

en.text: Have the disbelievers [not] been rewarded [this Day] for what they used to do?

so.text: 36. Miyaan laga abaal marin gaalada waxay (xume) falayeen?

ayat.arabic: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنشَقَّتۡ

en.text: When the sky has split [open]

so.text: 1. Markay samadu dildillaacdo  (Qiyaamada).

ayat.arabic: وَأَذِنَتۡ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتۡ

en.text: And has listened [i.e., responded][1888] to its Lord and was obligated [to do so]
en.footnotes: [1888] It will have heard Allāh's command and will have inclined immediately to compliance and willing obedience.

so.text: 2. Oo ay adeecdo Rabbigeed, waana xaq inay adeecdo;

ayat.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلۡأَرۡضُ مُدَّتۡ

en.text: And when the earth has been extended[1889]
en.footnotes: [1889] i.e., stretched flat and spread out.

so.text: 3. Marka arlada la fidiyo,

ayat.arabic: وَأَلۡقَتۡ مَا فِيهَا وَتَخَلَّتۡ

en.text: And has cast out that within it[1890] and relinquished [it]
en.footnotes: [1890] Of the dead and all else buried therein.

so.text: 4. Oo u soo tuurto debedda waxa gudaheeda ku jira oo ka marnaato,

ayat.arabic: وَأَذِنَتۡ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتۡ

en.text: And has listened [i.e., responded] to its Lord and was obligated [to do so] –

so.text: 5. Oo ay adeecdo Rabbigeed, waana xaq inay adeecdo [1].
so.footnotes: [1]. Wuxuu la kulmi qof walba camalkiisa.

ayat.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدۡحٗا فَمُلَٰقِيهِ

en.text: O mankind, indeed you are laboring toward your Lord with [great] exertion[1891] and will meet it.[1892]
en.footnotes:
[1891] i.e., striving throughout your life until you meet your Lord, hastening toward death.
[1892] i.e., you will find all that you intended and accomplished awaiting you in the Hereafter. Another meaning is "And will meet Him [i.e., your Lord]" and be recompensed in full by Him.

so.text: 6. Qofyahow! Waad dhibboon oo u camal fali xagga Rabbigaa, waadna la kulmi [2].
so.footnotes: [2]. Natiijada camalkaaga khayr ama shar wuxuu yahayba Maalinta Qiyaamaha.

ayat.arabic: فَأَمَّا مَنۡ أُوتِيَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ

en.text: Then as for he who is given his record in his right hand,

so.text: 7. Ee ma kan lagu siiyo Kitaabkiisa gacantiisa midig,

ayat.arabic: فَسَوۡفَ يُحَاسَبُ حِسَابٗا يَسِيرٗا

en.text: He will be judged with an easy account

so.text: 8. Waxaa la xisaabin xisaab fudud.

ayat.arabic: وَيَنقَلِبُ إِلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِهِۦ مَسۡرُورٗا

en.text: And return to his people in happiness.

so.text: 9. Wuxuu u laaban ehelkiisa (Jannada ku sugan) isagoo faraxsan.

ayat.arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنۡ أُوتِيَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ وَرَآءَ ظَهۡرِهِۦ

en.text: But as for he who is given his record behind his back,

so.text: 10. Kanse laga siiyo Kitaabkiisa dhabarkiisa gadaashiisa,

ayat.arabic: فَسَوۡفَ يَدۡعُواْ ثُبُورٗا

en.text: He will cry out for destruction

so.text: 11. Wuxuu u yeedhan hoog iyo ba'.

ayat.arabic: وَيَصۡلَىٰ سَعِيرًا

en.text: And [enter to] burn in a Blaze.

so.text: 12. Oo geli naar ololeysa oo hur badan.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فِيٓ أَهۡلِهِۦ مَسۡرُورًا

en.text: Indeed, he had [once] been among his people in happiness;

so.text: 13. Wuxuu ahaa xaqiiq mid Ehelkiisa dhexdooda (waagii adduunka) kibirsan.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ ظَنَّ أَن لَّن يَحُورَ

en.text: Indeed, he had thought he would never return [to Allāh].

so.text: 14. Wuxuu xaqiiq moodayey inuusan marnaba (u) soo noqoneyn (Xaggayaga).

ayat.arabic: بَلَىٰٓۚ إِنَّ رَبَّهُۥ كَانَ بِهِۦ بَصِيرٗا

en.text: But yes! Indeed, his Lord was ever, of him, Seeing.

so.text: 15. Haayoo, hubaal, Rabbigiis baa u jeeday.

ayat.arabic: فَلَآ أُقۡسِمُ بِٱلشَّفَقِ

en.text: So I swear by the twilight glow

so.text: 16. Mayee, Waxaan ku dhaartay cir gaduudda gabbal dhac;

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّيۡلِ وَمَا وَسَقَ

en.text: And [by] the night and what it envelops

so.text: 17. Iyo habeenka iyo wuxuu qariyo;

ayat.arabic: وَٱلۡقَمَرِ إِذَا ٱتَّسَقَ

en.text: And [by] the moon when it becomes full

so.text: 18. Iyo dayaxa markuu buuxsamo.

ayat.arabic: لَتَرۡكَبُنَّ طَبَقًا عَن طَبَقٖ

en.text: [That] you will surely embark upon [i.e., experience] state after state.[1893]
en.footnotes: [1893] i.e., various stages, both in this life and in the Hereafter.

so.text: 19. Waxaad (dadow) mari heerar kala duwan (noloshan iyo Aakhiradaba).

ayat.arabic: فَمَا لَهُمۡ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ

en.text: So what is [the matter] with them [that] they do not believe,

so.text: 20. Muxuuse arrinkoodu yahay inaysan rumeyn xaqa?

ayat.arabic: وَإِذَا قُرِئَ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانُ لَا يَسۡجُدُونَۤ۩

en.text: And when the Qur’ān is recited to them, they do not prostrate [to Allāh]?

so.text: 21. Marka Qur’aanka loo akhriyana uma sujuudaan Rabbigood (umana hoggansamaan)?

ayat.arabic: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ يُكَذِّبُونَ

en.text: But those who have disbelieved deny,

so.text: 22. Waxayse kuwa gaalooba beeniyaan (Xaqa).

ayat.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَا يُوعُونَ

en.text: And Allāh is most knowing of what they keep within themselves.

so.text: 23. Oo Alle waa og yahay waxay qarsan.

ayat.arabic: فَبَشِّرۡهُم بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ

en.text: So give them tidings of a painful punishment,

so.text: 24. Ee ugu bishaaree cadaab xanuun badan.

ayat.arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمۡ أَجۡرٌ غَيۡرُ مَمۡنُونِۭ

en.text: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds. For them is a reward uninterrupted.

so.text: 25. Hase yeeshee kuwa (xaqa) rumeeyey oo samaha fala waxay leeyihiin abaalgud aan marnaba go’eynin (waa Jannada'e).

ayat.arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلۡبُرُوجِ

en.text: By the sky containing great stars

so.text: 1.Waxaan ku dhaartay samada xiddigaha waaweyn leh iyo (jidadkooda).

ayat.arabic: وَٱلۡيَوۡمِ ٱلۡمَوۡعُودِ

en.text: And [by] the promised Day

so.text: 2. Iyo Maalinta ballanta ah (Qiyaamada).

ayat.arabic: وَشَاهِدٖ وَمَشۡهُودٖ

en.text: And [by] the witness and what is witnessed,

so.text: 3. Iyo Mid marag furi oo Nabiga ah iyo kuwo lagu marag furi 'oo ummadda ah.'

ayat.arabic: قُتِلَ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡأُخۡدُودِ

en.text: Destroyed [i.e., cursed] were the companions of the trench[1895]
en.footnotes: [1895] Or "May they be destroyed" or "cursed." The "companions of the trench" (or ditch) were agents of a tyrannical king who refused to allow his people to believe in Allāh. Their evil deed in obedience to their ruler earned for them the curse of Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) .

so.text: 4. Lacnadi ha ku dhacdo qoladii godka lahaa (mu'miniinta lagu caddibo).

ayat.arabic: ٱلنَّارِ ذَاتِ ٱلۡوَقُودِ

en.text: [Containing] the fire full of fuel,

so.text: 5. Ee ahaa dab olol iyo huritaan badan.

ayat.arabic: إِذۡ هُمۡ عَلَيۡهَا قُعُودٞ

en.text: When they were sitting near it.

so.text: 6. Iyagoo (gaaladu) kor fadhiyeen (godka).

ayat.arabic: وَهُمۡ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفۡعَلُونَ بِٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ شُهُودٞ

en.text: And they, to what they were doing against the believers, were witnesses. [1896]
en.footnotes: [1896] After casting the believers into a trench filled with fire, they sat at its edge, watching them burn to death. This event occurred before the time of Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ) .

so.text: 7. Waxay ka ahaayeen goob joog waxay ku falayeen (oo gardarro ah) Mu’miniinta.

ayat.arabic: وَمَا نَقَمُواْ مِنۡهُمۡ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤۡمِنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡحَمِيدِ

en.text: And they resented them not except because they believed in Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy,

so.text: 8. Kuma ay qoonsan wax kale aan aheyn inay rumeeyeen Allaah, Adkaadaha Sharafta leh, Ammaanan.

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِي لَهُۥ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ شَهِيدٌ

en.text: To whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And Allāh, over all things, is Witness.[1897]
en.footnotes: [1897] See footnote to 4:79.

so.text: 9. Ee iska leh Mulkiga (iyo Maamulka) samooyinka iyo arlada! Alle wax walba waa u Jeedaa.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ فَتَنُواْ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنَٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمۡ يَتُوبُواْ فَلَهُمۡ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابُ ٱلۡحَرِيقِ

en.text: Indeed, those who have tortured[1898] the believing men and believing women and then have not repented will have the punishment of Hell, and they will have the punishment of the Burning Fire.
en.footnotes: [1898] Or, in this instance, the literal meaning of "burned" is also appropriate.

so.text: 10. Xaqiiq kuwa caddiba mu’miniinta iyo mu’minooyinka, haddana aan tawbad keenin, waxay mudan cadaab Naar ah,  waxayna mudan cadaab gubeysa.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمۡ جَنَّٰتٞ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡكَبِيرُ

en.text: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds will have gardens beneath which rivers flow. That is the great attainment.

so.text: 11. Kuwa (Xaqa) rumeeyey oo samaha fala, waxay leeyihiin beero hoostoodu ay webiyo qulqulaan. Kaasi baa ah Liibaanta Weyn.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ بَطۡشَ رَبِّكَ لَشَدِيدٌ

en.text: Indeed, the assault [i.e., vengeance] of your Lord is severe.

so.text: 12. Xaqiiq, Qabashada Rabbigaa (Ciqaabtiisu) way daran tahay.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ يُبۡدِئُ وَيُعِيدُ

en.text: Indeed, it is He who originates [creation] and repeats.

so.text: 13. Xaqiiq (Alle) Isagaa uumay (uunka) dibna u soo nooleyn (dhimasho kaddib).

ayat.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلۡغَفُورُ ٱلۡوَدُودُ

en.text: And He is the Forgiving, the Affectionate,

so.text: 14. Waana Denbi Dhaaf Badanaha, Jecel (kuwa adeeca).

ayat.arabic: ذُو ٱلۡعَرۡشِ ٱلۡمَجِيدُ

en.text: Honorable Owner of the Throne,

so.text: 15. Ee iska leh Carshiga Sharafta Badan.

ayat.arabic: فَعَّالٞ لِّمَا يُرِيدُ

en.text: Effecter of what He intends.

so.text: 16. Falaha Weyn ee wuxuu Doono.

ayat.arabic: هَلۡ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلۡجُنُودِ

en.text: Has there reached you the story of the soldiers -

so.text: 17. Ma ku soo gaaray warka ciidammadii,

ayat.arabic: فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَثَمُودَ

en.text: [Those of] Pharaoh and Thamūd?

so.text: 18. Fircoon iyo Thamuud?

ayat.arabic: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فِي تَكۡذِيبٖ

en.text: But they who disbelieve are in [persistent] denial,

so.text: 19. Kuwase gaalooba waxay ku sugan yihiin beeninta Xaqa.

ayat.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ مِن وَرَآئِهِم مُّحِيطُۢ

en.text: While Allāh encompasses them from behind.[1899]
en.footnotes: [1899] See footnote to 2:19

so.text: 20. Allena wuu koobay (oo kama baxsan karaan).

ayat.arabic: بَلۡ هُوَ قُرۡءَانٞ مَّجِيدٞ

en.text: But this is an honored Qur’ān

so.text: 21. Kani se waa Qur’aan Sharaf Badan.

ayat.arabic: فِي لَوۡحٖ مَّحۡفُوظِۭ

en.text: [Inscribed] in a Preserved Slate.

so.text: 22. Oo ku qoran Loox la dhowray (Looxul Maxfuudka).

ayat.arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلطَّارِقِ

en.text: By the sky and the knocker

so.text: 1. Waxaan ku dhaartay samada iyo Xiddigga guura.

ayat.arabic: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلطَّارِقُ

en.text: And what can make you know what is the knocker?

so.text: 2. Maxaa ku ogeysiiyey waxa uu xiddiga guura) yahay?

ayat.arabic: ٱلنَّجۡمُ ٱلثَّاقِبُ

en.text: It is the piercing star[1901].
en.footnotes: [1901] Whose light pierces through the darkness.

so.text: 3. Waa xiddiggaa iftiinka badan.

ayat.arabic: إِن كُلُّ نَفۡسٖ لَّمَّا عَلَيۡهَا حَافِظٞ

en.text: There is no soul but that it has over it a protector.

so.text: 4. Ma jirto naf aanu kor joogin ilaaliye (malag).

ayat.arabic: فَلۡيَنظُرِ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ مِمَّ خُلِقَ

en.text: So let man observe from what he was created.

so.text: 5. Ee ha fiiriyo qofka waxa laga abuuray.

ayat.arabic: خُلِقَ مِن مَّآءٖ دَافِقٖ

en.text: He was created from a fluid, ejected,

so.text: 6. Waxaa laga abuuray biyo horay u soo booda.

ayat.arabic: يَخۡرُجُ مِنۢ بَيۡنِ ٱلصُّلۡبِ وَٱلتَّرَآئِبِ

en.text: Emerging from between the backbone and the ribs.

so.text: 7. Oo ka yimaada dhabarka iyo feeraha dhexdood,

ayat.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ رَجۡعِهِۦ لَقَادِرٞ

en.text: Indeed, He [i.e., Allāh], to return him [to life], is Able.

so.text: 8. Hubaal (Alle) wuu Karaa inuu u soo celiyo nolosha (dhimasho kaddib).

ayat.arabic: يَوۡمَ تُبۡلَى ٱلسَّرَآئِرُ

en.text: The Day when secrets will be put on trial,[1902]
en.footnotes: [1902] i.e., exposed, examined and judged.

so.text: 9. Maalinta waxyaalaha qarsoon iyo siraha la soo bandhigi (xaqiiqdooda).

ayat.arabic: فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن قُوَّةٖ وَلَا نَاصِرٖ

en.text: Then he [i.e., man] will have no power or any helper.

so.text: 10. Ma leh (gaalku Maalintaas) xoog ama wax u soo gargaara midna.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلرَّجۡعِ

en.text: By the sky which sends back[1903]
en.footnotes: [1903] Rain, heat, sound waves, etc.

so.text: 11. Waxaan ku dhaartay cirka leh roobka soo noqnoqda.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ ذَاتِ ٱلصَّدۡعِ

en.text: And [by] the earth which splits,[1904]
en.footnotes: [1904] With plant growth or from geological rifts.

so.text: 12. Iyo dhulka dil-dillaaca badan (ee soo saara dhirta iyo daaqa),

ayat.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوۡلٞ فَصۡلٞ

en.text: Indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a decisive statement,

so.text: 13. Xaqiiq, kani (Qur'aanku) waa hadal cad oo kala saara (xaqa iyo baadilka).

ayat.arabic: وَمَا هُوَ بِٱلۡهَزۡلِ

en.text: And it is not amusement.

so.text: 14. Oo ma aha dhayal (dheel).

ayat.arabic: إِنَّهُمۡ يَكِيدُونَ كَيۡدٗا

en.text: Indeed, they are planning a plan,

so.text: 15. Xaqiiq (gaaladu) wax bay dhagri oo qorsheyn.

ayat.arabic: وَأَكِيدُ كَيۡدٗا

en.text: But I am planning a plan.

so.text: 16. Aniguna (sidoo kale) Waxaan qorsheyn  qorshe.

ayat.arabic: فَمَهِّلِ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ أَمۡهِلۡهُمۡ رُوَيۡدَۢا

en.text: So allow time for the disbelievers. Leave them awhile.[1905]
en.footnotes: [1905] i.e., Do not be in haste for revenge, for you will see what will become of them.

so.text: 17. Ee u sug gaalada: Daa wax yar.

ayat.arabic: سَبِّحِ ٱسۡمَ رَبِّكَ ٱلۡأَعۡلَى

en.text: Exalt the name of your Lord, the Most High,

so.text: 1. Xurmo weynee oo ku tasbiixso Magaca Rabbigaa ee Sarreeya.

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ

en.text: Who created and proportioned

so.text: 2. Ee abuuray (uunka) oo ekeeyey.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّذِي قَدَّرَ فَهَدَىٰ

en.text: And who destined and [then] guided

so.text: 3.Ee ah Kan wax walba qaddaray, ee hagay.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّذِيٓ أَخۡرَجَ ٱلۡمَرۡعَىٰ

en.text: And who brings out the pasture

so.text: 4. Ee ah Kan soo saara daaqa.

ayat.arabic: فَجَعَلَهُۥ غُثَآءً أَحۡوَىٰ

en.text: And [then] makes it black stubble.

so.text:
5. Ka dhiga markaas kaddib caws 
engagan oo madow.

ayat.arabic: سَنُقۡرِئُكَ فَلَا تَنسَىٰٓ

en.text: We will make you recite, [O Muḥammad], and you will not forget,

so.text: 6. Waxaan kuu akhriyeynaa (Nabiyow) Qur’aanka mana illaaweysid,

ayat.arabic: إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُۚ إِنَّهُۥ يَعۡلَمُ ٱلۡجَهۡرَ وَمَا يَخۡفَىٰ

en.text: Except what Allāh should will. Indeed, He knows what is declared and what is hidden.

so.text: 7. Wuxuu Alle doono ma’ahee, Wuxuu xaqiiq Og yahay waxa muuqda iyo waxa qarsoonba.

ayat.arabic: وَنُيَسِّرُكَ لِلۡيُسۡرَىٰ

en.text: And We will ease you toward ease.[1907]
en.footnotes: [1907] To the path of Allāh's religion, which is easy and natural, or toward Paradise, by giving opportunities for righteous deeds.

so.text: 8. Waxaanu kuu fududeyn waddada sahlan (Islaamka).

ayat.arabic: فَذَكِّرۡ إِن نَّفَعَتِ ٱلذِّكۡرَىٰ

en.text: So remind, if the reminder should benefit;[1908]
en.footnotes: [1908] i.e., wherever it will be heard and understood.

so.text: 9. Ee waani, markay wax tari waanadu.

ayat.arabic: سَيَذَّكَّرُ مَن يَخۡشَىٰ

en.text: He who fears [Allāh] will be reminded.

so.text: 10. Waxaa waantoobi Kan (ka) baqa (Alle).

ayat.arabic: وَيَتَجَنَّبُهَا ٱلۡأَشۡقَى

en.text: But the wretched one will avoid it –

so.text: 11. Waxaana ka fogaan 'waanada' qofka xun.

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِي يَصۡلَى ٱلنَّارَ ٱلۡكُبۡرَىٰ

en.text: [He] who will [enter and] burn in the greatest Fire,

so.text: 12. Kaasoo geli Naar weyn oo ku guban.

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحۡيَىٰ

en.text: Neither dying therein nor living.

so.text: 13. Uusan ku dhimanayn dhexdeeda, kuna noolaanayn.

ayat.arabic: قَدۡ أَفۡلَحَ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ

en.text: He has certainly succeeded who purifies himself

so.text: 14. Waxaa liibaani qofkii ka daahiriya naftiisa (shirkiga iyo macaasida).

ayat.arabic: وَذَكَرَ ٱسۡمَ رَبِّهِۦ فَصَلَّىٰ

en.text: And mentions the name of his Lord and prays.

so.text: 15. Oo xusa Magaca Rabbigi oo tukada.

ayat.arabic: بَلۡ تُؤۡثِرُونَ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا

en.text: But you prefer the worldly life,

so.text: 16. Waxaadse door biddaan nolosha adduunkan;

ayat.arabic: وَٱلۡأٓخِرَةُ خَيۡرٞ وَأَبۡقَىٰٓ

en.text: While the Hereafter is better and more enduring.

so.text: 17. Aakhiro baase khayr badan oo baaqi ah.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَفِي ٱلصُّحُفِ ٱلۡأُولَىٰ

en.text: Indeed, this is in the former scriptures,

so.text: 18. Hubaal (hadal)kani wuxuu ku yaal Kututbtii hore,

ayat.arabic: صُحُفِ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ

en.text: The scriptures of Abraham and Moses.

so.text: 19. Kutubtii Ibraahiim iyo Muuse.

ayat.arabic: هَلۡ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلۡغَٰشِيَةِ

en.text: Has there reached you the report of the Overwhelming [event]?

so.text: 1. Mawuusan kuu iman warka dabooshada (Qiyaamada).

ayat.arabic: وُجُوهٞ يَوۡمَئِذٍ خَٰشِعَةٌ

en.text: [Some] faces, that Day, will be humbled,

so.text: 2. Wejiyaal maalintaas waxay ahaan kuwo dullaysan (waa gaalada).

ayat.arabic: عَامِلَةٞ نَّاصِبَةٞ

en.text: Working [hard] and exhausted.[1910]
en.footnotes: [1910] Another accepted meaning is "They were working hard and exhausted," i.e., doing deeds during worldly life which did not benefit them since they were not accompanied by faith or done for the acceptance of Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) .

so.text: 3. (Ku) howlan (adduunka caabuddaada cid kale la jirka Alle), daallan (Aakhirada).

ayat.arabic: تَصۡلَىٰ نَارًا حَامِيَةٗ

en.text: They will [enter to] burn in an intensely hot Fire.

so.text: 4. Gali Naar kulul oo ku guban.

ayat.arabic: تُسۡقَىٰ مِنۡ عَيۡنٍ ءَانِيَةٖ

en.text: They will be given drink from a boiling spring.

so.text: 5. Waxaa laga waraabin il kulul oo kareysa.

ayat.arabic: لَّيۡسَ لَهُمۡ طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِن ضَرِيعٖ

en.text: For them there will be no food except from a poisonous, thorny plant

so.text: 6. Ma laha wax cunto ah qodxo maahee.

ayat.arabic: لَّا يُسۡمِنُ وَلَا يُغۡنِي مِن جُوعٖ

en.text: Which neither nourishes nor avails against hunger.

so.text: 7. Kaasoo aan waxna cayilineynin, gaajona wax ka tareyn.

ayat.arabic: وُجُوهٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ نَّاعِمَةٞ

en.text: [Other] faces, that Day, will show pleasure.

so.text: 8. Wejiyo Maalintaas waxay ahaan kuwo nicmeysan (waa wejiyada mu'miniinta).

ayat.arabic: لِّسَعۡيِهَا رَاضِيَةٞ

en.text: With their effort [they are] satisfied

so.text: 9. Raalli ah dadaalkoodii darti.

ayat.arabic: فِي جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٖ

en.text: In an elevated garden,

so.text: 10. Ku sugnaan Janno sare gudaheed.

ayat.arabic: لَّا تَسۡمَعُ فِيهَا لَٰغِيَةٗ

en.text: Wherein they will hear no unsuitable speech.[1911]
en.footnotes: [1911] i.e., any insult, falsehood, immorality, idle or vain talk, etc.

so.text: 11. Aysan ku maqleyn hadal macno darro ah.

ayat.arabic: فِيهَا عَيۡنٞ جَارِيَةٞ

en.text: Within it is a flowing spring.

so.text: 12. Waxaa ah dhexdeeda il socota.

ayat.arabic: فِيهَا سُرُرٞ مَّرۡفُوعَةٞ

en.text: Within it are couches raised high

so.text: 13. Iyo sariirro la kor yeelay.

ayat.arabic: وَأَكۡوَابٞ مَّوۡضُوعَةٞ

en.text: And cups put in place

so.text: 14. Iyo koobab diyaar laga dhigay.

ayat.arabic: وَنَمَارِقُ مَصۡفُوفَةٞ

en.text: And cushions lined up

so.text: 15. Iyo barkimooyin la safay.

ayat.arabic: وَزَرَابِيُّ مَبۡثُوثَةٌ

en.text: And carpets spread around.

so.text: 16. Iyo gogollo la fidshey.

ayat.arabic: أَفَلَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَى ٱلۡإِبِلِ كَيۡفَ خُلِقَتۡ

en.text: Then do they not look at the camels - how they are created?

so.text: 17. Mawaysan fiirin geela, sida loo abuuray?

ayat.arabic: وَإِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ كَيۡفَ رُفِعَتۡ

en.text: And at the sky - how it is raised?

so.text: 18. Iyo cirka, sida loo kor yeelay?

ayat.arabic: وَإِلَى ٱلۡجِبَالِ كَيۡفَ نُصِبَتۡ

en.text: And at the mountains - how they are erected?

so.text: 19. Iyo buuraha, sida loo taagay?

ayat.arabic: وَإِلَى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ كَيۡفَ سُطِحَتۡ

en.text: And at the earth - how it is spread out?

so.text: 20. Iyo dhulka, sida loo fidiyey?

ayat.arabic: فَذَكِّرۡ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُذَكِّرٞ

en.text: So remind, [O Muḥammad]; you are only a reminder.

so.text: 21. Ee waani (dadka), waayo waxaad adigu (Nabiyow) uun tahay waaniye.

ayat.arabic: لَّسۡتَ عَلَيۡهِم بِمُصَيۡطِرٍ

en.text: You are not over them a controller.

so.text: 22. Ma tihid adigu mid qasab ku leh.

ayat.arabic: إِلَّا مَن تَوَلَّىٰ وَكَفَرَ

en.text: However, he who turns away and disbelieves –

so.text: 23. Qofkiise (Xaqa) ka jeesada oo gaalooba;

ayat.arabic: فَيُعَذِّبُهُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡعَذَابَ ٱلۡأَكۡبَرَ

en.text: Then Allāh will punish him with the greatest punishment.

so.text: 24. Wuxuu Alle ku cadaabi cadaab aad u weyn.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ إِلَيۡنَآ إِيَابَهُمۡ

en.text: Indeed, to Us is their return.

so.text: 25. Hubaal waa Xaggayaga meel noqodkoodu;

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيۡنَا حِسَابَهُم

en.text: Then indeed, upon Us is their account.

so.text: 26. Markaas hubaal Annagay na saaran tahay xisaabintooda.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلۡفَجۡرِ

en.text: By the dawn

so.text: 1. Waxaan ku dhaartay waaberiga,

ayat.arabic: وَلَيَالٍ عَشۡرٖ

en.text: And [by] ten nights[1913]
en.footnotes: [1913] Usually interpreted as the first ten nights of the month of Dhul-Ḥijjah.

so.text: 2. Iyo habeennada tobanka ah [1].
so.footnotes: [1]. Tobanka maalmood ee u horreeya bisha Arrafo (Xajka).

ayat.arabic: وَٱلشَّفۡعِ وَٱلۡوَتۡرِ

en.text: And [by] the even [number] and the odd

so.text: 3.Iyo dhabanka iyo witirka (tirada is dheer).

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّيۡلِ إِذَا يَسۡرِ

en.text: And [by] the night when it passes,

so.text: 4. Iyo habeenka markuu (soo galo ama) baxo.

ayat.arabic: هَلۡ فِي ذَٰلِكَ قَسَمٞ لِّذِي حِجۡرٍ

en.text: Is there [not] in [all] that an oath [sufficient] for one of perception?[1914]
en.footnotes: [1914] Based upon the following verses, what has been sworn to by Allāh is that He will certainly punish the disbelievers.

so.text: 5. Miyey dhaarahaasi ahayn wax uu ku qanco in loogu dhaarto qof caqli leh?

ayat.arabic: أَلَمۡ تَرَ كَيۡفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِعَادٍ

en.text: Have you not considered how your Lord dealt with ʿAad -

so.text: 6. Mawaadan ogaan sida (Alle) Rabbigaa u galay (reer) Caad?

ayat.arabic: إِرَمَ ذَاتِ ٱلۡعِمَادِ

en.text: [With] Iram[1915] - who had lofty pillars,[1916]
en.footnotes:
[1915] Another name for the first people of ʿAad, to whom Prophet Hūd was sent.
[1916] Supporting their tents or buildings.

so.text: 7. Qolodii Iram, ee xoogga lahaa, aadna u dhaadheeraa [2].
so.footnotes: [2]. Sidoo kale lahaa dhismooyin dhaadheer iyo waddooyin habeysan.

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّتِي لَمۡ يُخۡلَقۡ مِثۡلُهَا فِي ٱلۡبِلَٰدِ

en.text: The likes of whom had never been created in the land?

so.text: 8. Aan wax la mid ah lagu abuurin dhulka.

ayat.arabic: وَثَمُودَ ٱلَّذِينَ جَابُواْ ٱلصَّخۡرَ بِٱلۡوَادِ

en.text: And [with] Thamūd, who carved out the rocks in the valley?

so.text: 9. Iyo (siduu u galay) Thamuud, ee kala dhambalayey dhadhaabyo waaweyn tog gudahi ah (ay ka dhigtaan guryo iy jidad).

ayat.arabic: وَفِرۡعَوۡنَ ذِي ٱلۡأَوۡتَادِ

en.text: And [with] Pharaoh, owner of the stakes?[1917]
en.footnotes: [1917] By which he tortured people.

so.text: 10. Iyo (siduu u galay) Fircoon, ee tiirarka lahaa (iyo ciidammada tirada badan)?

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ طَغَوۡاْ فِي ٱلۡبِلَٰدِ

en.text: [All of] whom oppressed within the lands

so.text: 11. Kuwaasoo ku xadgudbay dhulka.

ayat.arabic: فَأَكۡثَرُواْ فِيهَا ٱلۡفَسَادَ

en.text: And increased therein the corruption.

so.text: 12. Oo ku badiyey fasahaad dhexdeeda?

ayat.arabic: فَصَبَّ عَلَيۡهِمۡ رَبُّكَ سَوۡطَ عَذَابٍ

en.text: So your Lord poured upon them a scourge of punishment.

so.text: 13. Markaasuu Rabbigaa ku shubay korkooda noocyo kala duwan oo cadaab daran ah.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَبِٱلۡمِرۡصَادِ

en.text: Indeed, your Lord is in observation.

so.text: 14. Xaqiiq, Rabbigaa baa u jeeda (addoomahiisa) oo gaar ka haya.

ayat.arabic: فَأَمَّا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ إِذَا مَا ٱبۡتَلَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَأَكۡرَمَهُۥ وَنَعَّمَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّيٓ أَكۡرَمَنِ

en.text: And as for man, when his Lord tries him and [thus] is generous to him and favors him, he says, "My Lord has honored me."[1918]
en.footnotes: [1918] He is proud rather than grateful, attributing the favor to his own merit.

so.text: 15. Aadmiga (kan gaalka ahi), markuu Rabbigi imtixaano oo sharfo oo u nicmeeyo wuxuu yidhaahdaa: Rabbigay waa i sharfay.

ayat.arabic: وَأَمَّآ إِذَا مَا ٱبۡتَلَىٰهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيۡهِ رِزۡقَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّيٓ أَهَٰنَنِ

en.text: But when He tries him and restricts his provision, he says, "My Lord has humiliated me."

so.text: 16. Markase uu (si kale) u imtixaano oo ku ciriirsho risiqa, wuxuu yidhaahdaa; Rabbigay waa i liiday.

ayat.arabic: كَلَّاۖ بَل لَّا تُكۡرِمُونَ ٱلۡيَتِيمَ

en.text: No![1919] But you do not honor the orphan
en.footnotes: [1919] It is not like you imagine. Rather, Allāh tries people through prosperity and hardship and rewards both gratitude and patience with honor in the Hereafter.

so.text: 17. Mayee’ ma daryeeshaan agoonka.

ayat.arabic: وَلَا تَحَٰٓضُّونَ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلۡمِسۡكِينِ

en.text: And you do not encourage one another to feed the poor.

so.text: 18. Oo iskuma boorrisaan in masaakiinta wax la siiyo.

ayat.arabic: وَتَأۡكُلُونَ ٱلتُّرَاثَ أَكۡلٗا لَّمّٗا

en.text: And you consume inheritance, devouring [it] altogether,[1920]
en.footnotes: [1920] Not caring whether it is lawful or unlawful.

so.text: 19. Waxaadna cuntaan dhaxalka cunid xaqdarro ah.

ayat.arabic: وَتُحِبُّونَ ٱلۡمَالَ حُبّٗا جَمّٗا

en.text: And you love wealth with immense love.

so.text: 20. Oo aad jeceshihiin maalka jaceyl daran.

ayat.arabic: كَلَّآۖ إِذَا دُكَّتِ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ دَكّٗا دَكّٗا

en.text: No! When the earth has been leveled - pounded and crushed

so.text: 21. Mayee! Marka dhulka laga dhigo budo,

ayat.arabic: وَجَآءَ رَبُّكَ وَٱلۡمَلَكُ صَفّٗا صَفّٗا

en.text: And your Lord has come[1921] and the angels, rank upon rank,
en.footnotes: [1921] To pass judgement. See footnote to 2:19.

so.text: 22. Oo Rabbigaa yimaado iyo (sidoo kale) malaa’igta oo saf saf ah.

ayat.arabic: وَجِاْيٓءَ يَوۡمَئِذِۭ بِجَهَنَّمَۚ يَوۡمَئِذٖ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُ ٱلذِّكۡرَىٰ

en.text: And brought [within view], that Day, is Hell - that Day, man will remember, but how [i.e., what good] to him will be the remembrance?

so.text: 23. Oo la keeno Maalintaas Naarta. Maalintaas buu Aadmigu (gaalku) waansami, maxayse waantoobidda (markaa) u tari?

ayat.arabic: يَقُولُ يَٰلَيۡتَنِي قَدَّمۡتُ لِحَيَاتِي

en.text: He will say, "Oh, I wish I had sent ahead [some good] for my life."[1922]
en.footnotes: [1922] The everlasting life of the Hereafter.

so.text: 24. Wuxuu odhan: Alla haddaan u soo hormarsan lahaa wanaag noloshaydatan (Aakhirada).

ayat.arabic: فَيَوۡمَئِذٖ لَّا يُعَذِّبُ عَذَابَهُۥٓ أَحَدٞ

en.text: So on that Day, none will punish [as severely] as His punishment,

so.text: 25. Maalintaas, cidna wax uma cadaabto (si daran sida) Cadaabka (Alle) oo kale.

ayat.arabic: وَلَا يُوثِقُ وَثَاقَهُۥٓ أَحَدٞ

en.text: And none will bind [as severely] as His binding [of the evildoers].

so.text:
26. Cidna wax uma xidho (si adag sida), 
 Xidhidda (Alle) oo kale.

ayat.arabic: يَٰٓأَيَّتُهَا ٱلنَّفۡسُ ٱلۡمُطۡمَئِنَّةُ

en.text: [To the righteous it will be said], "O reassured soul,

so.text: 27. (Waxaa lagu odhan mu'minka): Naf yahay xasillooneey.

ayat.arabic: ٱرۡجِعِيٓ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكِ رَاضِيَةٗ مَّرۡضِيَّةٗ

en.text: Return to your Lord, well-pleased and pleasing [to Him],

so.text: 28. U noqo Rabbigaa, adigoo raalli ah oo raalli lagaa yahay.

ayat.arabic: فَٱدۡخُلِي فِي عِبَٰدِي

en.text: And enter among My [righteous] servants

so.text: 29. Ee gal addoomaheyga (wanaagsan) dhexdood.

ayat.arabic: وَٱدۡخُلِي جَنَّتِي

en.text: And enter My Paradise."

so.text: 30. Gal Jannadeyda.

ayat.arabic: لَآ أُقۡسِمُ بِهَٰذَا ٱلۡبَلَدِ

en.text: I swear by this city [i.e., Makkah] –

so.text: 1. Waxaan ku dhaartay magaaladan (Makkah ee xurmadda leh).

ayat.arabic: وَأَنتَ حِلُّۢ بِهَٰذَا ٱلۡبَلَدِ

en.text: And you, [O Muḥammad], are free of restriction in this city –

so.text: 2. Waa kuu xalaal (Nabiyow inaad saacad ku dagaallanto) magaaladan [1] (aad horey u degganeyd).
so.footnotes:
[1]. Nabigu s.c w. Wuxuu yidhi: Aniga waxaa la I banneeyey inaan kula dagaalo (gaalada mushrikiinta ah) saacad keliya Makkah, haddana xurmadeedda waa sidii hore."
Rasuulkii Alle s.c.w. wuxuu yidhi maalintii furashada Makkah: Beledkan Alle waa caagay, waa inaan la goyn qodaxdiisa, oo la didin ugaadhiisa, oo la qaadan wixii ku luma oo dad ka dhaca qof naadinaya oo carrifaya maahee.

ayat.arabic: وَوَالِدٖ وَمَا وَلَدَ

en.text: And [by] the father[1924] and that which was born [of him],
en.footnotes: [1924] Said to be Adam (upon him be peace) .

so.text: 3. Waa igu waalidka (Ibraahiim) iyo wiilkiisa 'Ismaaciil' [2].
so.footnotes: [2]. Waxaa kaloo lagu fasiray: Waa igu Aadam iyo durriyadiisa.

ayat.arabic: لَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ فِي كَبَدٍ

en.text: We have certainly created man into hardship.

so.text: 4. Waxaan abuurnay aadmiga isagoo dhib iyo howl (kala kulmi nolosha adduunka).

ayat.arabic: أَيَحۡسَبُ أَن لَّن يَقۡدِرَ عَلَيۡهِ أَحَدٞ

en.text: Does he think that never will anyone overcome him?

so.text: 5. Ma wuxuu moodaa inaysan cidna awood ku dul lahayn?

ayat.arabic: يَقُولُ أَهۡلَكۡتُ مَالٗا لُّبَدًا

en.text: He says, "I have spent wealth in abundance."

so.text: 6. Wuxuu leeyahay (isagoo ku faani): Waxaan lumiyey maal tiro badan.

ayat.arabic: أَيَحۡسَبُ أَن لَّمۡ يَرَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌ

en.text: Does he think that no one has seen him?

so.text: 7. Ma wuxuu moodaa inaysan cidna arag?

ayat.arabic: أَلَمۡ نَجۡعَل لَّهُۥ عَيۡنَيۡنِ

en.text: Have We not made for him two eyes?

so.text: 8. Miyaannaan u yeelin labo indhood?.

ayat.arabic: وَلِسَانٗا وَشَفَتَيۡنِ

en.text: And a tongue and two lips?

so.text: 9. Iyo carrab iyo labo bishimood?

ayat.arabic: وَهَدَيۡنَٰهُ ٱلنَّجۡدَيۡنِ

en.text: And have shown him the two ways?[1925]
en.footnotes: [1925] Of good and evil.

so.text: 10. oo aan tusin labada jidood (khayrka iyo sharka)?.

ayat.arabic: فَلَا ٱقۡتَحَمَ ٱلۡعَقَبَةَ

en.text: But he has not broken through the difficult pass.[1926]
en.footnotes: [1926] i.e., the steep incline or obstacle. In other words, he has not spent in the cause of Allāh but only boasts of spending in front of others.

so.text: 11. Ee muu ka gudbo jidka buurta ah?

ayat.arabic: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلۡعَقَبَةُ

en.text: And what can make you know what is [breaking through] the difficult pass?

so.text: 12. Maxaa ku ogeysiiyey (waxa looga gudbo) jidka buurta ah?

ayat.arabic: فَكُّ رَقَبَةٍ

en.text: It is the freeing of a slave

so.text: 13. Waa addoon la xoreeyo.

ayat.arabic: أَوۡ إِطۡعَٰمٞ فِي يَوۡمٖ ذِي مَسۡغَبَةٖ

en.text: Or feeding on a day of severe hunger

so.text: 14. Ama siinta cunno maalin gaajo (abaar) jirto.

ayat.arabic: يَتِيمٗا ذَا مَقۡرَبَةٍ

en.text: An orphan of near relationship

so.text: 15. Agoon kuu dhow.

ayat.arabic: أَوۡ مِسۡكِينٗا ذَا مَتۡرَبَةٖ

en.text: Or a needy person in misery

so.text: 16. Ama miskiin dhulka yaal.

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِٱلصَّبۡرِ وَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِٱلۡمَرۡحَمَةِ

en.text: And then being among those who believed and advised one another to patience and advised one another to compassion.

so.text: 17. Haddana ka mid ah kuwa (Xaqa) rumeeyey, oo iskula dardaarma sugnaanta iyo samirka, oo (sidoo kale) iskula dardaarma naxariista (iyo is jeclaanta).

ayat.arabic: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡمَيۡمَنَةِ

en.text: Those are the companions of the right.[1927]
en.footnotes: [1927] Or "the companions of good fortune," i.e., those who receive their records in their right hands and proceed to Paradise.

so.text: 18. Waa kuwaas qolada Midigta (Jannada).

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا هُمۡ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡمَشۡـَٔمَةِ

en.text: But they who disbelieved in Our signs - those are the companions of the left.[1928]
en.footnotes: [1928] Or "the companions of ill fortune," i.e., those who receive their records in their left hands and proceed to Hell.

so.text: 19. Kuwase ku gaalooba Aayadahayaga waa kuwaas qolada Bidixda (ehlu Naarka).

ayat.arabic: عَلَيۡهِمۡ نَارٞ مُّؤۡصَدَةُۢ

en.text: Over them will be fire closed in.[1929]
en.footnotes: [1929] The cover over Hell will be sealed and locked, containing its fire and its inhabitants.

so.text: 20. Waxaa lagu dabooli dushooda Naar (dab aan dameyn ah).

ayat.arabic: وَٱلشَّمۡسِ وَضُحَىٰهَا

en.text: By the sun and its brightness

so.text: 1. Waxaan ku dhaartay qorraxda iyo caddaanta barqadeeda;

ayat.arabic: وَٱلۡقَمَرِ إِذَا تَلَىٰهَا

en.text: And [by] the moon when it follows it

so.text: 2. Iyo dayaxa markuu raaco (qorraxda).

ayat.arabic: وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا جَلَّىٰهَا

en.text: And [by] the day when it displays it[1931]
en.footnotes: [1931] The earth. Also interpreted as the sun. The same applies to the following verse.

so.text: 3. Iyo maalinta markay muujiso (arlada) oo ifiso.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّيۡلِ إِذَا يَغۡشَىٰهَا

en.text: And [by] the night when it covers [i.e., conceals] it

so.text: 4. Iyo habeenka markuu daboolo arlada (oo madoobaado).

ayat.arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا بَنَىٰهَا

en.text: And [by] the sky and He who constructed it

so.text: 5. Iyo samada iyo siduu (Alle) u dhisay;

ayat.arabic: وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا طَحَىٰهَا

en.text: And [by] the earth and He who spread it

so.text: 6 Iyo arlada iyo siduu (Alle) u fidshay,

ayat.arabic: وَنَفۡسٖ وَمَا سَوَّىٰهَا

en.text: And [by] the soul and He who proportioned it[1932]
en.footnotes: [1932] i.e., balanced and refined it, creating in it sound tendencies and consciousness.

so.text: 7. Iyo nafta iyo siduu (Alle) u ekeeyey.

ayat.arabic: فَأَلۡهَمَهَا فُجُورَهَا وَتَقۡوَىٰهَا

en.text: And inspired it [with discernment of] its wickedness and its righteousness,

so.text: 8. Markaas kala garansiiyey xumaheeda iyo toosnideeda,

ayat.arabic: قَدۡ أَفۡلَحَ مَن زَكَّىٰهَا

en.text: He has succeeded who purifies it,

so.text: 9. Waxaa liibaani qofka (ka) daahiriya naftiisa (shirki iyo macaasi).

ayat.arabic: وَقَدۡ خَابَ مَن دَسَّىٰهَا

en.text: And he has failed who instills it [with corruption].

so.text: 10. Waxaa khasaari qofka xumeeya naftiisa.

ayat.arabic: كَذَّبَتۡ ثَمُودُ بِطَغۡوَىٰهَآ

en.text: Thamūd denied [their prophet] by reason of their transgression,

so.text: 11. Thamuud waxay beeniyeen (Xaqa) kibirkoodii darti.

ayat.arabic: إِذِ ٱنۢبَعَثَ أَشۡقَىٰهَا

en.text: When the most wretched of them was sent forth.[1933]
en.footnotes: [1933] To hamstring the she-camel which had been sent by Allāh as a sign to them.

so.text: 12. Markuu soo baxay koodii uga sharka badnaa (si uu hasha u dilo).

ayat.arabic: فَقَالَ لَهُمۡ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ نَاقَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَسُقۡيَٰهَا

en.text: And the messenger of Allāh [i.e., Ṣāliḥ] said to them, "[Do not harm] the she-camel of Allāh or [prevent her from] her drink."

so.text: 13. Markaasuu Rasuulkii Alle (Nabi Saalix) ku yidhi : Iska daaya Hasha Alle (ha dilana) oo siiya waraabkeeda.

ayat.arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمۡدَمَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ رَبُّهُم بِذَنۢبِهِمۡ فَسَوَّىٰهَا

en.text: But they denied him and hamstrung[1934] her. So their Lord brought down upon them destruction for their sin and made it equal [upon all of them].
en.footnotes: [1934] And then killed.

so.text: 14. Wayse beeniyeen oo boqna gooyeen hashii (dileen). Markaasuu Rabbigood u baabbi’yey denbigoodii dartiis, oo dhulka la simay (ama ka wada simay ciqaabkii).

ayat.arabic: وَلَا يَخَافُ عُقۡبَٰهَا

en.text: And He does not fear the consequence thereof.[1935]
en.footnotes: [1935] Allāh is not asked about what He does, but His servants will be asked. See 21:23.

so.text: 15. Kama uuna cabsado cidhibteeda [1].
so.footnotes: [1]. Cidhibta kuwa uu halaagay oo wax loo soo raacdo ama looga daba yimaado, waayo waa Adkaadaha aan laga adkaan.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّيۡلِ إِذَا يَغۡشَىٰ

en.text: By the night when it covers[1937]
en.footnotes: [1937] With darkness.

so.text: 1. Waxaan ku dhaartay habeenka markuu daboolo (waxa samada iyo arlada dhexdooda ah).

ayat.arabic: وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا تَجَلَّىٰ

en.text: And [by] the day when it appears

so.text: 2. Iyo maalinta markay muuqato (ifto);

ayat.arabic: وَمَا خَلَقَ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلۡأُنثَىٰٓ

en.text: And [by] He who created the male and female,

so.text: 3. Iyo abuurista labka iyo dheddigga.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ سَعۡيَكُمۡ لَشَتَّىٰ

en.text: Indeed, your efforts are diverse.

so.text: 4. Xaqiiq, camalkiinnu (dadow) waa kala duwan yahay.

ayat.arabic: فَأَمَّا مَنۡ أَعۡطَىٰ وَٱتَّقَىٰ

en.text: As for he who gives and fears Allāh

so.text: 5. Ma kan bixiya (xuquuqda lagu leeyahay) oo iska jira (shirki iyo macaasi).

ayat.arabic: وَصَدَّقَ بِٱلۡحُسۡنَىٰ

en.text: And believes in the best [reward].

so.text: 6. Ee rumeeya tan wanaagga badan ee fiican (Jannada):

ayat.arabic: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلۡيُسۡرَىٰ

en.text: We will ease him toward ease.

so.text: 7. Waxaan u fududeyneynaa jidka fudud (Islaamka).

ayat.arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنۢ بَخِلَ وَٱسۡتَغۡنَىٰ

en.text: But as for he who withholds and considers himself free of need

so.text: 8. Qofkiise ku bakheyla (maalka) oo isu arka mid deeqtoon (iskibriya).

ayat.arabic: وَكَذَّبَ بِٱلۡحُسۡنَىٰ

en.text: And denies the best [reward],

so.text: 9. Oo beeniya tan wanaagga badan ee fiican (Jannada).

ayat.arabic: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلۡعُسۡرَىٰ

en.text: We will ease him toward difficulty.

so.text: 10. Waxaan u fududeyneynaa jidka xun (dhabbaha Naarta);

ayat.arabic: وَمَا يُغۡنِي عَنۡهُ مَالُهُۥٓ إِذَا تَرَدَّىٰٓ

en.text: And what will his wealth avail him when he falls?[1938]
en.footnotes: [1938] i.e., when he dies or is destroyed. It can also mean when he falls into the Hellfire.

so.text: 11. Maalkiisu wax uma taro markuu halaagsamo.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ عَلَيۡنَا لَلۡهُدَىٰ

en.text: Indeed, [incumbent] upon Us is guidance.

so.text: 12. Annagaa xaqiiq wax hanuuninna,

ayat.arabic: وَإِنَّ لَنَا لَلۡأٓخِرَةَ وَٱلۡأُولَىٰ

en.text: And indeed, to us belongs the Hereafter and the first [life].

so.text: 13. Oo Annagaa xaqiiq leh Aakhiro iyo adduunba.

ayat.arabic: فَأَنذَرۡتُكُمۡ نَارٗا تَلَظَّىٰ

en.text: So I have warned you of a Fire which is blazing.

so.text: 14. Waxaan idiinka digayaa Naar ololeysa.

ayat.arabic: لَا يَصۡلَىٰهَآ إِلَّا ٱلۡأَشۡقَى

en.text: None will [enter to] burn therein except the most wretched one

so.text: 15. Uusan galaynin qof xun mooyaane.

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِي كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ

en.text: Who had denied and turned away.

so.text: 16. Ee (Xaqa) beeniya oo ka jeesada.

ayat.arabic: وَسَيُجَنَّبُهَا ٱلۡأَتۡقَى

en.text: But the righteous one will avoid it –

so.text: 17. Waxaana laga fogeyn (Naarta) kan (ka) dhowrsada (shirkiga iyo xumaha kale).

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِي يُؤۡتِي مَالَهُۥ يَتَزَكَّىٰ

en.text: [He] who gives [from] his wealth to purify himself

so.text: 18. Ee bixiya maalkiisa si uu isu daahiriyo.

ayat.arabic: وَمَا لِأَحَدٍ عِندَهُۥ مِن نِّعۡمَةٖ تُجۡزَىٰٓ

en.text: And not [giving] for anyone who has [done him] a favor to be rewarded[1939] –
en.footnotes: [1939] i.e., without intending reciprocation for some benefit to himself.

so.text: 19. Isagoo uusan jirin cid ku leh abaal uu u gudayo.

ayat.arabic: إِلَّا ٱبۡتِغَآءَ وَجۡهِ رَبِّهِ ٱلۡأَعۡلَىٰ

en.text: But only seeking the face [i.e., acceptance] of his Lord, Most High.

so.text: 20. Waxse u bixiya doonista Wejiga Rabbigi, ee Sarreeya.

ayat.arabic: وَلَسَوۡفَ يَرۡضَىٰ
