en.text: And he is going to be satisfied.

so.text: 21. Wuu raalli noqon doonaa qofkaasi.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلضُّحَىٰ

en.text: By the morning brightness

so.text: 1. Waxaan ku dhaartay Barqada.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلَّيۡلِ إِذَا سَجَىٰ

en.text: And [by] the night when it covers with darkness,[1941]
en.footnotes: [1941] And becomes still.

so.text: 2. Iyo habeenka markuu xasilo (madoobaado).

ayat.arabic: مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَىٰ

en.text: Your Lord has not taken leave of you, [O Muḥammad], nor has He detested [you].

so.text: 3. Rabbigaa kaama tagin (Nabi Muxammadow), mana uu kuu cadhoon.

ayat.arabic: وَلَلۡأٓخِرَةُ خَيۡرٞ لَّكَ مِنَ ٱلۡأُولَىٰ

en.text: And the Hereafter is better for you than the first [life].

so.text: 4. Aakhiro baa kaaga khayr badan noloshatan (hore ee adduunka).

ayat.arabic: وَلَسَوۡفَ يُعۡطِيكَ رَبُّكَ فَتَرۡضَىٰٓ

en.text: And your Lord is going to give you, and you will be satisfied.

so.text: 5. Rabbigaa baa ku siin (khayr badan), waadna raalli noqon.

ayat.arabic: أَلَمۡ يَجِدۡكَ يَتِيمٗا فَـَٔاوَىٰ

en.text: Did He not find you an orphan and give [you] refuge?

so.text: 6. Miyuusan ku helin adigoo agoon ah oo ku hoyaadin?

ayat.arabic: وَوَجَدَكَ ضَآلّٗا فَهَدَىٰ

en.text: And He found you lost and guided [you],

so.text: 7. Oo ku helin adigoo habowsan oo kuma hanuunin?

ayat.arabic: وَوَجَدَكَ عَآئِلٗا فَأَغۡنَىٰ

en.text: And He found you poor and made [you] self-sufficient.

so.text: 8. Oo ku helin adigoo caydh ah oo kuma hodmin?

ayat.arabic: فَأَمَّا ٱلۡيَتِيمَ فَلَا تَقۡهَرۡ

en.text: So as for the orphan, do not oppress [him].

so.text: 9. Ee agoon, ha dhibin.

ayat.arabic: وَأَمَّا ٱلسَّآئِلَ فَلَا تَنۡهَرۡ

en.text: And as for the petitioner,[1942] do not repel [him].
en.footnotes: [1942] Anyone who seeks aid or knowledge.

so.text: 10.Kan wax ku weydiistana, ha ku qeylin.

ayat.arabic: وَأَمَّا بِنِعۡمَةِ رَبِّكَ فَحَدِّثۡ

en.text: But as for the favor of your Lord, report [it].

so.text: 11. Nicmadda Rabbigaana (Islaamka, Towxiidka, Qur'aanka, Xaqa, sheeg (oo ka mahad celi).

ayat.arabic: أَلَمۡ نَشۡرَحۡ لَكَ صَدۡرَكَ

en.text: Did We not expand for you, [O Muḥammad], your breast?[1944]
en.footnotes: [1944] i.e., enlighten, assure and gladden your heart with guidance.

so.text: 1. Miyaanaan kuu waasicinnin (Nabi Muxammadow) laabtaada?

ayat.arabic: وَوَضَعۡنَا عَنكَ وِزۡرَكَ

en.text: And We removed from you your burden[1945]
en.footnotes: [1945] By forgiving any errors which you may have committed previously or might commit consequently. "Burden" can also refer to the anxiety experienced by the Prophet (ﷺ) at the beginning of his mission.

so.text: 2. Oo sidaa kaaga dejin culeyskii ku saarnaa [1],
so.footnotes: [1]. Macnaha waa aan kuu dhaafin oo cafin gefafkaaga kuwii hore iyo kuwa dambeba, ama kaa qaadin culeyskii aad dareemeysey billowgii gaarsiinta iyo fidint diinta.

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنقَضَ ظَهۡرَكَ

en.text: Which had weighed upon your back

so.text: 3. Kaasoo cusleeyey dhabarkaaga,

ayat.arabic: وَرَفَعۡنَا لَكَ ذِكۡرَكَ

en.text: And raised high for you your repute.

so.text: 4. Oo aanaan kor yeelin meeqaankaaga?

ayat.arabic: فَإِنَّ مَعَ ٱلۡعُسۡرِ يُسۡرًا

en.text: For indeed, with hardship [will be] ease [i.e., relief].

so.text: 5. Xaqiiq, dhibka waxaa la socda faraj.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ مَعَ ٱلۡعُسۡرِ يُسۡرٗا

en.text: Indeed, with hardship [will be] ease.

so.text: 6. Xaqiiq, waxaa dhibka la socda faraj.

ayat.arabic: فَإِذَا فَرَغۡتَ فَٱنصَبۡ

en.text: So when you have finished [your duties], then stand up [for worship].

so.text: 7. Ee markaad bogto (salaadda) ku dadaal duceysiga (iyo Alle ammaanka iyo Xuskiis).

ayat.arabic: وَإِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَٱرۡغَب

en.text: And to your Lord direct [your] longing.

so.text: 8. Xagga Rabbigaa (keliyana) wax ka rajee.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلتِّينِ وَٱلزَّيۡتُونِ

en.text: By the fig and the olive[1947]
en.footnotes: [1947] Referring to the places known for their production, i.e., Damascus and Jerusalem, respectively. It could also refer to the fig and olive trees or to the fruits themselves.

so.text: 1. Waxaan ku dhaartay Tiinka iyo Zaytuunka [1].
so.footnotes: [1]. Waa tilmaan sidoo kale halkay ka baxaan ee Falastiin ee ah halka laga soo saaray Ciise c.s. Nabi ahaan.

ayat.arabic: وَطُورِ سِينِينَ

en.text: And [by] Mount Sinai

so.text: 2. Iyo Buurta Siinaay [2].
so.footnotes: [2]. Ee ah halkuu Alle kula hadlay Muuse c.s.

ayat.arabic: وَهَٰذَا ٱلۡبَلَدِ ٱلۡأَمِينِ

en.text: And [by] this secure city [i.e., Makkah],

so.text: 3. Iyo magaaladan Aaminka ah 'Makkah' [3],
so.footnotes: [3]. Ee Nabi Muxammad laga soo doortay Rasuul Alle ahaan.

ayat.arabic: لَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ فِيٓ أَحۡسَنِ تَقۡوِيمٖ

en.text: We have certainly created man in the best of stature;[1948]
en.footnotes: [1948] i.e., upright, symmetrical, and balanced in form and nature.

so.text: 4. Waxaan dhab ahaan u abuurnay Aadmiga qaab kan u wanaagsan.

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ رَدَدۡنَٰهُ أَسۡفَلَ سَٰفِلِينَ

en.text: Then We return him to the lowest of the low,[1949]
en.footnotes: [1949] This can refer to the depths of Hell, to decrepit old age or to immorality.

so.text: 5. Misna waxaan u celinnay hooseeyayaasha kan u hooseeya [4].
so.footnotes: [4]. Naarta gudaheeda ama da'da asaasqnimada.

ayat.arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَلَهُمۡ أَجۡرٌ غَيۡرُ مَمۡنُونٖ

en.text: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds, for they will have a reward uninterrupted.

so.text: 6. Kuwase (Xaqa) rumeeyey oo samaha fala, waxay leeyihiin jar aan weligi go’ynin (Janno).

ayat.arabic: فَمَا يُكَذِّبُكَ بَعۡدُ بِٱلدِّينِ

en.text: So what yet causes you to deny the Recompense?[1950]
en.footnotes: [1950] More literally, "What makes you lie concerning it?"

so.text: 7. Maxaa kugu xamaabri (aadmigow) inaad beeniso arrinka is abaal marinta (Aakhiro)?

ayat.arabic: أَلَيۡسَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَحۡكَمِ ٱلۡحَٰكِمِينَ

en.text: Is not Allāh the most just of judges?

so.text: 8. Sow ma aha Alle Kan u wanaagsan inta wax xukunta [5]?
so.footnotes: [5]. Haayoo, wuu Yahay.

ayat.arabic: ٱقۡرَأۡ بِٱسۡمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ

en.text: Recite in the name of your Lord who created –

so.text: 1. Ku akhri 'Nabiyow' Magaca Rabbigaa ee abuuray (wax waliba).

ayat.arabic: خَلَقَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ مِنۡ عَلَقٍ

en.text: Created man from a clinging substance.

so.text: 2. Ka abuuray aadmiga xinjir.

ayat.arabic: ٱقۡرَأۡ وَرَبُّكَ ٱلۡأَكۡرَمُ

en.text: Recite, and your Lord is the most Generous -

so.text: 3. Akhri! Rabbigaana waa Sharaf Badnaha,

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِي عَلَّمَ بِٱلۡقَلَمِ

en.text: Who taught by the pen –

so.text: 4. (Dadka) baray sida wax loogu qoro qalinka.

ayat.arabic: عَلَّمَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ مَا لَمۡ يَعۡلَمۡ

en.text: Taught man that which he knew not.

so.text: 5. Baray Aadmiga wax uusan aqoon.

ayat.arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ لَيَطۡغَىٰٓ

en.text: No! [But] indeed, man transgresses

so.text: 6. Mayee! Aadmigu (kan gaalka ahi) wuu xadgudbaa oo kibraa.

ayat.arabic: أَن رَّءَاهُ ٱسۡتَغۡنَىٰٓ

en.text: Because he sees himself self-sufficient.

so.text: 7. Markuu isku ogaado Hodantinnimo iyo deeqtoonaan.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ٱلرُّجۡعَىٰٓ

en.text: Indeed, to your Lord is the return.

so.text: 8. Hubaal! Waa xagga Rabbigaa noqodku.

ayat.arabic: أَرَءَيۡتَ ٱلَّذِي يَنۡهَىٰ

en.text: Have you seen the one who forbids

so.text: 9. Ka warran midka ka reeba.

ayat.arabic: عَبۡدًا إِذَا صَلَّىٰٓ

en.text: A servant when he prays?

so.text: 10. Addoon (Alle) oo tukan salaad?

ayat.arabic: أَرَءَيۡتَ إِن كَانَ عَلَى ٱلۡهُدَىٰٓ

en.text: Have you seen if he is upon guidance

so.text: 11. Bal ka warran hadduu ku sugan yahay (addoonkaa) jid toosan?

ayat.arabic: أَوۡ أَمَرَ بِٱلتَّقۡوَىٰٓ

en.text: Or enjoins righteousness?

so.text: 12. Amaba uu amro Alle ka cabsiga iyo xume ka dhowrsiga?

ayat.arabic: أَرَءَيۡتَ إِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ

en.text: Have you seen if he denies and turns away -

so.text: 13. Bal ka warran hadduu kaasina (gaalka ahi) beeniyo Xaqa, kana jeesado?

ayat.arabic: أَلَمۡ يَعۡلَم بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَرَىٰ

en.text: Does he not know that Allāh sees?

so.text: 14. Mawuusan ogeyn in Alle arko?

ayat.arabic: كَلَّا لَئِن لَّمۡ يَنتَهِ لَنَسۡفَعَۢا بِٱلنَّاصِيَةِ

en.text: No! If he does not desist, We will surely drag him by the forelock[1952] –
en.footnotes: [1952] It may also mean "slap him" or "blacken his face at the forelock."

so.text: 15. Mayee! Haddii uusan meel joogin, waxaanu hubaal qaban foodda,

ayat.arabic: نَاصِيَةٖ كَٰذِبَةٍ خَاطِئَةٖ

en.text: A lying, sinning forelock.

so.text: 16. Food beenley ah oo gefley ah.

ayat.arabic: فَلۡيَدۡعُ نَادِيَهُۥ

en.text: Then let him call his associates;

so.text: 17. Ha u yeedho golihiisa.

ayat.arabic: سَنَدۡعُ ٱلزَّبَانِيَةَ

en.text: We will call the angels of Hell.[1953]
en.footnotes: [1953] Those who push the wicked into the Fire.

so.text: 18. Waxaanu u yeedhi malaa’ig daran.

ayat.arabic: كَلَّا لَا تُطِعۡهُ وَٱسۡجُدۡۤ وَٱقۡتَرِب۩

en.text: No! Do not obey him. But prostrate and draw near [to Allāh].

so.text: 19. Mayee, ha adeecin oo sujuud, una dhowow (Alle).

ayat.arabic: إِنَّآ أَنزَلۡنَٰهُ فِي لَيۡلَةِ ٱلۡقَدۡرِ

en.text: Indeed, We sent it [i.e., the Qur’ān] down during the Night of Decree.

so.text: 1. Waxaanu xaqiiq soo dejinnay (Qur’aanka) habeenka Qadarka.

ayat.arabic: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا لَيۡلَةُ ٱلۡقَدۡرِ

en.text: And what can make you know what is the Night of Decree?

so.text: 2. Maxaa ku ogeysiiyey wuxuu habeenka Qadarku yahay?

ayat.arabic: لَيۡلَةُ ٱلۡقَدۡرِ خَيۡرٞ مِّنۡ أَلۡفِ شَهۡرٖ

en.text: The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months.

so.text: 3. Habeenka Qadarku wuxuu ka khayr badan yahay kun bilood [1].
so.footnotes: [1]. 83 sano iyo afar bilood, waa camalka iyo cibaadeysiga habeenkaa.

ayat.arabic: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذۡنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمۡرٖ

en.text: The angels and the Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] descend therein by permission of their Lord for every matter.[1955]
en.footnotes: [1955] Bringing the exact measures apportioned for everything by Allāh in the course of the coming year.

so.text: 4. Malaa’igta iyo Jabriil baa la soo dega (habeenkaa) Idanka Rabbigood arrin walba oo xukun ah,

ayat.arabic: سَلَٰمٌ هِيَ حَتَّىٰ مَطۡلَعِ ٱلۡفَجۡرِ

en.text: Peace it is[1956] until the emergence of dawn.
en.footnotes: [1956] Upon the believers.

so.text: 5. Nabad weeye (habeenkaa) ilaa waagu ka baryo [2].
so.footnotes: [2]. Rasuulkii Alle s.c.w. wuxuu yidhi: Ka doondoona layaltul Qadarka tirooyinka is dheer ee tobanka habeenood ee u dambeeya Ramadaanka.

ayat.arabic: لَمۡ يَكُنِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِنۡ أَهۡلِ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ وَٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ مُنفَكِّينَ حَتَّىٰ تَأۡتِيَهُمُ ٱلۡبَيِّنَةُ

en.text: Those who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture and the polytheists were not to be parted [from misbelief][1958] until there came to them clear evidence –
en.footnotes: [1958] i.e., from their erroneous beliefs and superstitions.

so.text: 1. Kuwa gaaloobay oo ka mid ah ehlu Kitaabka (Yuhuudda iyo Nasaarada) iyo mushrikiinta ma ahayn kuwa ka tagaya (gaalnimadooda) intay uga timaado xujada cad.

ayat.arabic: رَسُولٞ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ يَتۡلُواْ صُحُفٗا مُّطَهَّرَةٗ

en.text: A Messenger from Allāh, reciting purified[1959] scriptures
en.footnotes: [1959] i.e., containing no falsehood.

so.text: 2. Rasuul (Muxammad) ka socda xagga Alle oo akhriyaya waraaqo daahir ah.

ayat.arabic: فِيهَا كُتُبٞ قَيِّمَةٞ

en.text: Within which are correct writings [i.e., rulings and laws].

so.text: 3. Ay ku yaallaan xukunno wanaagsan.

ayat.arabic: وَمَا تَفَرَّقَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا جَآءَتۡهُمُ ٱلۡبَيِّنَةُ

en.text: Nor did those who were given the Scripture become divided[1960] until after there had come to them clear evidence.
en.footnotes: [1960] Into sects and denominations.

so.text: 4. Kuwaa la siiyey Kitaabka (Yuhuudda iyo Nasaarada) isma ay khilaafin oo kala tegin kaddib markii mooyaane ay Xujada cad u timid [1].
so.footnotes: [1]. Waa Nabi Muxammad s.c.w iyo Qur'aanka.

ayat.arabic: وَمَآ أُمِرُوٓاْ إِلَّا لِيَعۡبُدُواْ ٱللَّهَ مُخۡلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ حُنَفَآءَ وَيُقِيمُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤۡتُواْ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَۚ وَذَٰلِكَ دِينُ ٱلۡقَيِّمَةِ

en.text: And they were not commanded except to worship Allāh, [being] sincere to Him in religion, inclining to truth, and to establish prayer and to give zakāh. And that is the correct religion.

so.text: 5. Lama amrin waxaan aheyn inay caabudaan Alle keliya iyagoo u gooni yeelaya cibaadada oo toosan, iyo inay oogaan salaadda oo bixyaan Zakada, sidaas baana ah diinta toosan.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِنۡ أَهۡلِ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ وَٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ فِي نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمۡ شَرُّ ٱلۡبَرِيَّةِ

en.text: Indeed, they who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture and the polytheists will be in the fire of Hell, abiding eternally therein. Those are the worst of creatures.

so.text: 6. Xaqiiq, kuwa gaalooba oo ka mid ah ehlu-Kitaabka iyo mushrikiinta waxay dhex ahaan Naarta Jahannama iyagoo ku waaraya gudaheeda. Kuwaasi waa kuwa ugu sharka badan uumanka.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمۡ خَيۡرُ ٱلۡبَرِيَّةِ

en.text: Indeed, they who have believed and done righteous deeds - those are the best of creatures.

so.text: 7. Xaqiiq, kuwa (Xaqa) rumeeyey oo samaha fala, kuwaasi waa kuwa ugu khayr badan uumanka.

ayat.arabic: جَزَآؤُهُمۡ عِندَ رَبِّهِمۡ جَنَّٰتُ عَدۡنٖ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدٗاۖ رَّضِيَ ٱللَّهُ عَنۡهُمۡ وَرَضُواْ عَنۡهُۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَنۡ خَشِيَ رَبَّهُۥ

en.text: Their reward with their Lord will be gardens of perpetual residence beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever, Allāh being pleased with them and they with Him. That is for whoever has feared his Lord.

so.text: 8. Abaalkooda Rabbigood agtiis ah waa Beero negaadi ah (Jannooyin) oo ay hoostoodu webiyadu qul-qulaan, ay ku waari weligood, Alle Raalli buu ka yahay, iyaguna Raalli ku yihiin. Sidaas waxaa leh qofkii ka baqa Rabbigi 'oo ka dhowrsada xumaha'.

ayat.arabic: إِذَا زُلۡزِلَتِ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ زِلۡزَالَهَا

en.text: When the earth is shaken with its [final] earthquake

so.text: 1. Marka arlada la gilgilo gilgilashadeeda daran (Qiyaamada).

ayat.arabic: وَأَخۡرَجَتِ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ أَثۡقَالَهَا

en.text: And the earth discharges its burdens[1962]
en.footnotes: [1962] See verse 84:4.

so.text: 2. Oo arladu soo bixiso culeysyadeeda (wixii ku aasnaa),

ayat.arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ مَا لَهَا

en.text: And man says,[1963] "What is [wrong] with it?" -
en.footnotes: [1963] In terror and amazement.

so.text: 3. Aadmigu yidhaahdo: Maxay leedahay?

ayat.arabic: يَوۡمَئِذٖ تُحَدِّثُ أَخۡبَارَهَا

en.text: That Day, it will report its news

so.text: 4. Maalintaas waxay ka warrami akhbaarteeda.

ayat.arabic: بِأَنَّ رَبَّكَ أَوۡحَىٰ لَهَا

en.text: Because your Lord has inspired [i.e., commanded] it.

so.text: 5. Inuu Rabbigaa u waxyooday darteed.

ayat.arabic: يَوۡمَئِذٖ يَصۡدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشۡتَاتٗا لِّيُرَوۡاْ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ

en.text: That Day, the people will depart[1964] separated [into categories] to be shown [the result of] their deeds.
en.footnotes: [1964] From the place of Judgement to their final abode. Another interpretation is "emerge separately" (from the graves) .

so.text: 6. Maalintaas dadku wuxuu u soo dareeri rac rac si loo tusiyo 'jazaha' acmaashooda.

ayat.arabic: فَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيۡرٗا يَرَهُۥ

en.text: So whoever does an atom's weight[1965] of good will see it,
en.footnotes: [1965] Or "the weight of a small ant."

so.text: 7. Ee qofkii fala samaan le’eg saxar wuu arki,

ayat.arabic: وَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٖ شَرّٗا يَرَهُۥ

en.text: And whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it.

so.text: 8. Qofkii falana xumaan le’eg saxar wuu arki.

ayat.arabic: وَٱلۡعَٰدِيَٰتِ ضَبۡحٗا

en.text: By the racers, panting,[1967]
en.footnotes: [1967] i.e., the horses bearing riders as they race to attack the enemy.

so.text: 1. Waxaan ku dhaartay ordayaasha dheereeya iyagoo qaylyi (fardaha dagaalka, iwm).

ayat.arabic: فَٱلۡمُورِيَٰتِ قَدۡحٗا

en.text: And the producers of sparks [when] striking[1968]
en.footnotes: [1968] Their hoofs while galloping over rocky terrain.

so.text: 2. Iyo kuwa kiciya dhimbilaha dabka.

ayat.arabic: فَٱلۡمُغِيرَٰتِ صُبۡحٗا

en.text: And the chargers at dawn,[1969]
en.footnotes: [1969] While the enemy is unaware.

so.text: 3. Iyo kuwa (cadowga) weerara subaxa horeba,

ayat.arabic: فَأَثَرۡنَ بِهِۦ نَقۡعٗا

en.text: Stirring up thereby [clouds of] dust,

so.text: 4. Ee boodhka kiciya,

ayat.arabic: فَوَسَطۡنَ بِهِۦ جَمۡعًا

en.text: Arriving thereby in the center[1970] collectively,
en.footnotes: [1970] i.e., penetrating into the enemy ranks during a surprise attack.

so.text: 5. Ee bartanka u gala kulanka 'cadowga';

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ لِرَبِّهِۦ لَكَنُودٞ

en.text: Indeed mankind, to his Lord, is ungrateful.

so.text: 6. Hubaal! Aadmigu waa ka abaal dhacaa Rabbigi (Allaah).

ayat.arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكَ لَشَهِيدٞ

en.text: And indeed, he is to that a witness.[1971]
en.footnotes: [1971] Through his speech and his actions.

so.text: 7. Isaga baana taasi ka markhaati ah.

ayat.arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ لِحُبِّ ٱلۡخَيۡرِ لَشَدِيدٌ

en.text: And indeed he is, in love of wealth, intense.

so.text: 8. Oo hubaal waa ku daran yahay Jaceylka maalka.

ayat.arabic: ۞ أَفَلَا يَعۡلَمُ إِذَا بُعۡثِرَ مَا فِي ٱلۡقُبُورِ

en.text: But does he not know that when the contents of the graves are scattered

so.text: 9. Ma wuusan ogeyn marka waxa ku jira qabuuraha la soo bixiyo.

ayat.arabic: وَحُصِّلَ مَا فِي ٱلصُّدُورِ

en.text: And that within the breasts is obtained,[1972]
en.footnotes: [1972] i.e., when all secrets are made known.

so.text: 10. Waxa ku jirana laabaha la caddeeyo.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّهُم بِهِمۡ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لَّخَبِيرُۢ

en.text: Indeed, their Lord with them, that Day, is [fully] Aware.[1973]
en.footnotes: [1973] Fully acquainted and familiar with everything about each one of them.

so.text: 11. Hubaal Rabbigood maalintaas waa u Xog-Ogaal (arrimahooda oo dhan).

ayat.arabic: ٱلۡقَارِعَةُ

en.text: The Striking Calamity -

so.text: 1.Garaacdada (qalbiyada waa Qiyaamada).

ayat.arabic: مَا ٱلۡقَارِعَةُ

en.text: What is the Striking Calamity?

so.text: 2. Maxay tahay Garaacdadu?.

ayat.arabic: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلۡقَارِعَةُ

en.text: And what can make you know what is the Striking Calamity?

so.text: 3. Maxaa ku ogeysiiyeyna waxay tahay Garaacdadu?

ayat.arabic: يَوۡمَ يَكُونُ ٱلنَّاسُ كَٱلۡفَرَاشِ ٱلۡمَبۡثُوثِ

en.text: It is the Day when people will be like moths, dispersed,[1975]
en.footnotes: [1975] The people will be as such after having been expelled from their graves.

so.text: 4. Waa Maalintay dadku noqon  sida baalallay kala firdhay.

ayat.arabic: وَتَكُونُ ٱلۡجِبَالُ كَٱلۡعِهۡنِ ٱلۡمَنفُوشِ

en.text: And the mountains will be like wool, fluffed up.[1976]
en.footnotes: [1976] i.e., beginning to disintegrate.

so.text: 5. Oo buurahu noqon sida cudbi la dhilay.

ayat.arabic: فَأَمَّا مَن ثَقُلَتۡ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ

en.text: Then as for one whose scales are heavy [with good deeds],

so.text: 6. Qofka miisaankiisa (camallada wanaagsan) uu culeys yahay.

ayat.arabic: فَهُوَ فِي عِيشَةٖ رَّاضِيَةٖ

en.text: He will be in a pleasant life.

so.text: 7. Wuxuu ku noolaan nolol barwaaqo iyo farxad leh oo raalli lagu yahay (Janno).

ayat.arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنۡ خَفَّتۡ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ

en.text: But as for one whose scales are light,

so.text: 8. Qofkase uu miisaankiisa (camallada wanaagsan) fudeyd yahay.

ayat.arabic: فَأُمُّهُۥ هَاوِيَةٞ

en.text: His refuge[1977] will be an abyss.[1978]
en.footnotes:
[1977] Literally, "mother" (a man's original refuge) , which will envelop him as in an embrace.
[1978] i.e., the pit of Hellfire.

so.text: 9. Hoygiisu waa Haawiya.

ayat.arabic: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا هِيَهۡ

en.text: And what can make you know what that is?

so.text: 10. Maxaa ku ogeysiiyeyna waxay tahay?

ayat.arabic: نَارٌ حَامِيَةُۢ

en.text: It is a Fire, intensely hot.

so.text: 11. (Waa) Naar kuleyl badan.

ayat.arabic: أَلۡهَىٰكُمُ ٱلتَّكَاثُرُ

en.text: Competition in [worldly] increase diverts you

so.text: 1. Waxaa idin shuqliya (dadow) adduun badsi (iyo isu faan).

ayat.arabic: حَتَّىٰ زُرۡتُمُ ٱلۡمَقَابِرَ

en.text: Until you visit the graveyards.[1980]
en.footnotes: [1980] i.e., remain in them temporarily, meaning until the Day of Resurrection.

so.text: 2. Ilaa aad siyaarataan qubuuraha (macnaha dhimataan oo la idinku aaso).

ayat.arabic: كَلَّا سَوۡفَ تَعۡلَمُونَ

en.text: No! You are going to know.

so.text: 3. Mayee! Waad ogaan doontaan.

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَوۡفَ تَعۡلَمُونَ

en.text: Then, no! You are going to know.

so.text: 4. Misna, mayee! Waad ogaan doontaan.

ayat.arabic: كَلَّا لَوۡ تَعۡلَمُونَ عِلۡمَ ٱلۡيَقِينِ

en.text: No! If you only knew with knowledge of certainty...[1981]
en.footnotes: [1981] The conclusion of this verse is estimated to be "...you would not have been distracted from preparing for the Hereafter."

so.text: 5. Mayee! haddaad og tihiin ogaansho dhab ah.

ayat.arabic: لَتَرَوُنَّ ٱلۡجَحِيمَ

en.text: You will surely see the Hellfire.

so.text: 6.Waxaad hubaal arki Naarta ololka badan.

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ لَتَرَوُنَّهَا عَيۡنَ ٱلۡيَقِينِ

en.text: Then you will surely see it with the eye of certainty.[1982]
en.footnotes: [1982] i.e., with actual eyesight.

so.text: 7. Markaas waxaad u ark si yaqiin leh.

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ لَتُسۡـَٔلُنَّ يَوۡمَئِذٍ عَنِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ

en.text: Then you will surely be asked that Day about pleasure.[1983]
en.footnotes: [1983] i.e., the comforts of worldly life and whether you were grateful to Allāh for His blessings.

so.text: 8. Waxaana Maalintaa la idin weydiin Nicmooyinkii (Alle idinku galladeystay).

ayat.arabic: وَٱلۡعَصۡرِ

en.text: By time,[1985]
en.footnotes: [1985] An oath in which Allāh swears by time throughout the ages.

so.text: 1. Waxaan ku dhaartay waqtiga.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ لَفِي خُسۡرٍ

en.text: Indeed, mankind is in loss,

so.text: 2. Hubaal Aadmigu wuxuu ku sugan yahay khasaaro dhan.

ayat.arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِٱلصَّبۡرِ

en.text: Except for those who have believed and done righteous deeds and advised each other to truth and advised each other to patience.

so.text: 3. Kuwa (Xaqa) rumeeyey mooyee oo samaha fala, ee isu dardaraama Xaqa (iyo caddaalad falka), isuna dardaarama sabarka (iyo sugnaanta).

ayat.arabic: وَيۡلٞ لِّكُلِّ هُمَزَةٖ لُّمَزَةٍ

en.text: Woe to every scorner and mocker

so.text: 1. Hoog waxaa leh dure kasta, wax xanta.

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِي جَمَعَ مَالٗا وَعَدَّدَهُۥ

en.text: Who collects wealth and [continuously] counts it.[1987]
en.footnotes: [1987] Rather than spending in the way of Allāh.

so.text: 2. Kaasoo maal ururiya oo u heysta sahay ahaan (aanse ka bixin xaqa lagu leeyahay: sakada, iwm);

ayat.arabic: يَحۡسَبُ أَنَّ مَالَهُۥٓ أَخۡلَدَهُۥ

en.text: He thinks that his wealth will make him immortal.

so.text: 3. Wuxuu moodaa in maalkiisu waarin.

ayat.arabic: كَلَّاۖ لَيُنۢبَذَنَّ فِي ٱلۡحُطَمَةِ

en.text: No! He will surely be thrown into the Crusher.[1988]
en.footnotes: [1988] i.e., Hellfire, which crushes and destroys all that enters it.

so.text: 4. Mayee! Waxaa lagu tuuri  burburisada.

ayat.arabic: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلۡحُطَمَةُ

en.text: And what can make you know what is the Crusher?

so.text: 5. Maxaa ku ogeysiiyeyna waxay burburisadu tahay?

ayat.arabic: نَارُ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡمُوقَدَةُ

en.text: It is the fire of Allāh, [eternally] fueled,

so.text: 6. Waa Naar Alle oo la huriyey.

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّتِي تَطَّلِعُ عَلَى ٱلۡأَفۡـِٔدَةِ

en.text: Which mounts directed at the hearts.[1989]
en.footnotes: [1989] Covering them and penetrating them.

so.text: 7. Ee kor ugu baxda quluubta dushooda (iyadoo gubeysa),

ayat.arabic: إِنَّهَا عَلَيۡهِم مُّؤۡصَدَةٞ

en.text: Indeed, it [i.e., Hellfire] will be closed down upon them

so.text: 8. Waxaa lagaga xidhi dusha (gaalada).

ayat.arabic: فِي عَمَدٖ مُّمَدَّدَةِۭ

en.text: In extended columns.[1990]
en.footnotes: [1990] Interpreted to be either columns of fire or columns of iron to which are chained the inmates of Hell.

so.text: 9. Tiirar la taagay dhexdood.

ayat.arabic: أَلَمۡ تَرَ كَيۡفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصۡحَٰبِ ٱلۡفِيلِ

en.text: Have you not considered, [O Muḥammad], how your Lord dealt with the companions of the elephant?[1992]
en.footnotes: [1992] i.e., the army under the command of Abrahah al-Ashram which was accompanied by a huge elephant and came with the intention of destroying the Kaʿbah at Makkah.

so.text: 1. Mawaadan ogaan sida Rabbigaa u galay qoladii maroodiga?

ayat.arabic: أَلَمۡ يَجۡعَلۡ كَيۡدَهُمۡ فِي تَضۡلِيلٖ

en.text: Did He not make their plan into misguidance?[1993]
en.footnotes: [1993] Causing them to perish.

so.text: 2. Sow kama uu dhigin dhagartoodii wax dhumay (ku dhammaaday jab iyo jah wareer),

ayat.arabic: وَأَرۡسَلَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ طَيۡرًا أَبَابِيلَ

en.text: And He sent against them birds in flocks,

so.text: 3. Oo ku soo dirin shimbiro guutoooyin ah,

ayat.arabic: تَرۡمِيهِم بِحِجَارَةٖ مِّن سِجِّيلٖ

en.text: Striking them with stones of hard clay,

so.text: 4. Ku soo ganeysa dhagaxyo dhoobo la kululeeyey ah,

ayat.arabic: فَجَعَلَهُمۡ كَعَصۡفٖ مَّأۡكُولِۭ

en.text: And He made them like eaten straw.[1994]
en.footnotes: [1994] i.e., husks which have been chewed by cattle. This event took place in the year of the Prophet's birth.

so.text: 5. Markaas ka yeelay sidii bal la daaqay?

ayat.arabic: لِإِيلَٰفِ قُرَيۡشٍ

en.text: For the accustomed security of the Quraysh[1996] -
en.footnotes: [1996] i.e., the honor and reputation Allāh had given them as guardians of the Holy Kaʿbah, which allowed them to travel without fear of being harmed.

so.text: 1. Caadeysigii Quraysh darteed.

ayat.arabic: إِۦلَٰفِهِمۡ رِحۡلَةَ ٱلشِّتَآءِ وَٱلصَّيۡفِ

en.text: Their accustomed security [in] the caravan of winter and summer[1997] -
en.footnotes: [1997] i.e., the trading caravans that traveled south in winter and north in summer.

so.text: 2. Ay ka caada yeesheen safarka xagaaga iyo jilaalka (si nabdoonaan ah ganacsiga).

ayat.arabic: فَلۡيَعۡبُدُواْ رَبَّ هَٰذَا ٱلۡبَيۡتِ

en.text: Let them worship the Lord of this House,[1998]
en.footnotes: [1998] i.e., the Kaʿbah.

so.text: 3. Ee ha caabudeen Rabbiga Baytkan (Kacbada Makkah ku taal).

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِيٓ أَطۡعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٖ وَءَامَنَهُم مِّنۡ خَوۡفِۭ

en.text: Who has fed them, [saving them] from hunger and made them safe, [saving them] from fear.

so.text: 4. Kaasoo ka quudiyey gaajo, kana aamin yeelay cabsi.

ayat.arabic: أَرَءَيۡتَ ٱلَّذِي يُكَذِّبُ بِٱلدِّينِ

en.text: Have you seen the one who denies the Recompense?

so.text: 1. Ka warran kan beeniya is abaal marinta (Aakhiro).

ayat.arabic: فَذَٰلِكَ ٱلَّذِي يَدُعُّ ٱلۡيَتِيمَ

en.text: For that is the one who drives away the orphan

so.text: 2. Kaasu waa kan ula dhaqma agoonta si qallafsan [1].
so.footnotes: [1]. Rasuulkii Alle s.c.w. wuxuu yidhi: Aniga iyo kan daryeela agoonka oo kafaala qaada, waxaan gali Jannada innagoo sidaas oo kale ah. Wuxuuna kor u qaaday fardhexeda iyo murugsatada oo simay oo isu dhoweeyey.

ayat.arabic: وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلۡمِسۡكِينِ

en.text: And does not encourage the feeding of the poor.

so.text: 3. Oo aan ku dhiirra gelin (dadka) quudinta miskiinka [2].
so.footnotes: [2]. Nabigu s.c.w wuxuu yidhi: Qofka u dadaala oo u shaqeeya dumarka da'da ah ee laga dhintay iyo masaakiinta wuxuu heli ajar la mid ah mujaahidka u diriraya Jidka Alle ama kan habeenkii oo dhan u taagan salaad oo aan daaleyn iyo soomanaha aan afurin.

ayat.arabic: فَوَيۡلٞ لِّلۡمُصَلِّينَ

en.text: So woe to those who pray

so.text: 4. Waxaa hoog leh kuwaa tukada (munaafiqiinta ah),

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ عَن صَلَاتِهِمۡ سَاهُونَ

en.text: [But] who are heedless of their prayer[2000] -
en.footnotes: [2000] i.e., the hypocrites who are unconcerned if they miss prayers when no one sees them.

so.text: 5. Ee ka dhoohan salaaddooda (ka dib dhiga waqtiyadooda).

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ يُرَآءُونَ

en.text: Those who make show [of their deeds]

so.text: 6. Kuwaasoo u fala (samaha) si loo arko.

ayat.arabic: وَيَمۡنَعُونَ ٱلۡمَاعُونَ

en.text: And withhold [simple] assistance.

so.text: 7. U diida (dadka) maacuunta (waxyaalaha yar yar ee laysugu kaalmeeyo, zako iyo sadaqo iyaga warkoodba daaye).

ayat.arabic: إِنَّآ أَعۡطَيۡنَٰكَ ٱلۡكَوۡثَرَ

en.text: Indeed, We have granted you, [O Muḥammad], al-Kawthar.

so.text: 1. Waxaanu xaqiiq ku siinnay (Nabi Muxammadow) Al-Kawthar (webi ah Jannada iyo khayr tiro badan).

ayat.arabic: فَصَلِّ لِرَبِّكَ وَٱنۡحَرۡ

en.text: So pray to your Lord and offer sacrifice [to Him alone].

so.text: 2. Ee u tuko Rabbigaa Dartiis, (oo u) gawrac xoolo (adigoo Isaga Keliya Magaciisa ku xusi, uguna dhowaan).

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ شَانِئَكَ هُوَ ٱلۡأَبۡتَرُ

en.text: Indeed, your enemy is the one cut off.[2002]
en.footnotes: [2002] From all good in this world and the Hereafter.

so.text: 3.Hubaal nacabkaaga waa kan cidhib go’i [1].
so.footnotes: [1]. Rasuulkii Alle s.c.w. wuxuu yidhi: Waxaan ku dhaartay Kan ay Gacantiisu ku jirto nafteyda, midkiinna ma ahaan doono mu'min dhan jeer uu i jeclaado in ka badan waalidki iyo ilmahiisa iyo dadka oo dhammi".

ayat.arabic: قُلۡ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ

en.text: Say, "O disbelievers,

so.text: 1. Dheh: Gaalooy.

ayat.arabic: لَآ أَعۡبُدُ مَا تَعۡبُدُونَ

en.text: I do not worship what you worship.

so.text: 2. Anigu ma caabudayo waxaad caabudeysaan,

ayat.arabic: وَلَآ أَنتُمۡ عَٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعۡبُدُ

en.text: Nor are you worshippers of what I worship.

so.text: 3. Idinkuna ma caabuddaan Kaan Anigu caabudo (Alle Keliya).

ayat.arabic: وَلَآ أَنَا۠ عَابِدٞ مَّا عَبَدتُّمۡ

en.text: Nor will I be a worshipper of what you worship.

so.text: 4. Anigu ma caabudayo waxaad idinku caabudeysaan (oo ilaahyo been ah).

ayat.arabic: وَلَآ أَنتُمۡ عَٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعۡبُدُ

en.text: Nor will you be worshippers of what I worship.

so.text: 5. Idinkuna ma caabuddaan Kaan anigu caabudo (Alle Weyne kor ahaaye).

ayat.arabic: لَكُمۡ دِينُكُمۡ وَلِيَ دِينِ

en.text: For you is your religion, and for me is my religion."

so.text: 6.Waxaad leedihiin diintiinna (camalkiinna), aniguna waxaa leeyahay diinteyda (camalkeyga, oo barii baan idinka ahay).

ayat.arabic: إِذَا جَآءَ نَصۡرُ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلۡفَتۡحُ

en.text: When the victory of Allāh has come and the conquest,[2005]
en.footnotes: [2005] The conquest of Makkah.

so.text: 1. Markuu yimaado Gargaarka Alle iyo guusha (Furashada Makkah).

ayat.arabic: وَرَأَيۡتَ ٱلنَّاسَ يَدۡخُلُونَ فِي دِينِ ٱللَّهِ أَفۡوَاجٗا

en.text: And you see the people entering into the religion of Allāh in multitudes,

so.text: 2. Oo aad aragto dadka oo u soo galaya diinta Alle (Islaamka) rac-rac (kooxo),

ayat.arabic: فَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ وَٱسۡتَغۡفِرۡهُۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ تَوَّابَۢا

en.text: Then exalt [Him] with praise of your Lord and ask forgiveness of Him. Indeed, He is ever Accepting of Repentance.[2006]
en.footnotes: [2006] Refer to footnote of 2:37.

so.text: 3. Markaas ku tasbiixso Ammaanaha Rabbigaa, weydiisona Denbi Dhaaf. Hubaal Alle waa Tawbad aqbal Badane.

ayat.arabic: تَبَّتۡ يَدَآ أَبِي لَهَبٖ وَتَبَّ

en.text: May the hands of Abū Lahab be ruined, and ruined is he.[2008]
en.footnotes: [2008] Abū Lahab (the Prophet's uncle) , who was an enemy of Islām.

so.text: 1. Ha hoogeen labada gacmood ee Abuu-Lahab [1], hoogyeyna [2].
so.footnotes:
[1]. Waa Nabiga adeerki oo ahaa cadow Islaam, waxaana la mid ah oo soo galaya cadow Islaam kasta.
[2]. Markay soo degtay Aayadda Qur'aanka ee leh: "U dig xigaaladaada kuu dhow". Nabigu s.c.w. wuxuu billaabay inuu u yeeraa ( qabaa'isha Carbeed): Reer Banii Fihirow, Reer Banii Cadiyow, isagoo mid mid u xusaya jilbaha iyo laamaha ay ka kooban yihiin Quraysh. Xitaa ninkii aan imaan karin wuxuu soo dirsaday cid ka socota isaga si uu u soo eego waxa jira. Markaasaa waxaa yimid Abuu Lahab iyo odayaashii Quraysh. Nabigu s.c.w. wuxuu yidhi: Ka warrama haddaan idiin sheego ciidan fardooley ah oo soo socda toggan gadaashiisa ee dooneysa inay idin weeraraan ma iga rumeysan laheydeen? Waxay yidhaahdeen: Haa , kuguma baran waxaan run aheyn.. markaasuu Nabigu s.c.w. wuxuu yidhi: Haddaba waxaan idiinka digayaa cadaab daran oo idinku soo fool leh haddii aydaan Allaah rumeyn iyo Rusushiisa. Abuu Lahab wuxuu yidhi: Hoog oo ba' maanta oo idil, ma waxaan baad isugu kaaya yeertay? Markaasaa waxaa soo degay Tabbat Yadaa Abii Lahab….

ayat.arabic: مَآ أَغۡنَىٰ عَنۡهُ مَالُهُۥ وَمَا كَسَبَ

en.text: His wealth will not avail him or that which he gained.

so.text: 2. Waxna uma tarin maalkiisa iyo wuxuu kasbaday.

ayat.arabic: سَيَصۡلَىٰ نَارٗا ذَاتَ لَهَبٖ

en.text: He will [enter to] burn in a Fire of [blazing] flame

so.text: 3. Wuxuu geli oo ku guban Naar olol badan.

ayat.arabic: وَٱمۡرَأَتُهُۥ حَمَّالَةَ ٱلۡحَطَبِ

en.text: And his wife [as well] - the carrier of firewood.[2009]
en.footnotes: [2009] She used to put thorns in the Prophet's path and slander him (ﷺ) . The word "firewood" was used by the Arabs to allude to slander and backbiting.

so.text: 4. Iyo marwadiisuba, xaabo siddada ah, (xanta, xinta iyo dirdirada badan),

ayat.arabic: فِي جِيدِهَا حَبۡلٞ مِّن مَّسَدِۭ

en.text: Around her neck is a rope of [twisted] fiber.

so.text: 5. Qoorteeda waxaa la yeeli xadhig adag xaskul la soohay (oo Naar) ah.

ayat.arabic: قُلۡ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ

en.text: Say, "He is Allāh, [who is] One,[2011]
en.footnotes: [2011] Alone, without another, indivisible with absolute and permanent unity and distinct from all else. The one and only true deity, unique in His essence, attributes and deeds.

so.text: 1. Dheh: Allaah waa Mid Keliya [1].
so.footnotes: [1]. Axad ah aan wax shariig ah lahayn.

ayat.arabic: ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ

en.text: Allāh, the Eternal Refuge.[2012]
en.footnotes: [2012] He who is absolute, perfect, complete, essential, self-sufficient and sufficient to meet the needs of all creation; the one eternally and constantly required and sought, depended upon by all existence and to whom all matters will ultimately return.

so.text: 2. Allaah waa Sayidka Deeqtoon [2].
so.footnotes: [2]. Ee ah ma baahdaha loo wada baahan yahay.

ayat.arabic: لَمۡ يَلِدۡ وَلَمۡ يُولَدۡ

en.text: He neither begets nor is born,

so.text: 3. Ma dhalin [3], lamana dhalin [4].
so.footnotes:
[3]. Macnaha waa ma leh ilmo. 
[4]. Macnaha waa ma leh waalid - aabbe iyo hooyo iyo xaas midna.

ayat.arabic: وَلَمۡ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدُۢ

en.text: Nor is there to Him any equivalent."

so.text: 4. Mana jiro axad u dhigma [5].
so.footnotes: [5]. Alle oo la mid ah ama la barbar dhigo iyo cid wax la wadaagta midna.

ayat.arabic: قُلۡ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلۡفَلَقِ

en.text: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak

so.text: 1. Dheh: Waxaan ka magan galayaa Rabbiga oogga (dillaacsha, waa Alle'e),

ayat.arabic: مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ

en.text: From the evil of that which He created

so.text: 2. Sharka wuxuu abuuray;

ayat.arabic: وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ

en.text: And from the evil of darkness when it settles

so.text: 3. Iyo sharka habeenka mugdiga badan markuu mugdigiisa daboolo (samada iyo arlada dhexdooda).

ayat.arabic: وَمِن شَرِّ ٱلنَّفَّٰثَٰتِ فِي ٱلۡعُقَدِ

en.text: And from the evil of the blowers in knots[2014]
en.footnotes: [2014] i.e., those who practice magic.

so.text: 4. Iyo sharka kuwa wax ku tufa guntimaha (saaxirooyinka iyo sixiroolayaasha).

ayat.arabic: وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ

en.text: And from the evil of an envier when he envies."

so.text: 5. Iyo sharka xaasidka markuu wax xasdo.

ayat.arabic: قُلۡ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ

en.text: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind,

so.text: 1. Dheh: Waxaan ka magan galayaa Rabbiga dadka.

ayat.arabic: مَلِكِ ٱلنَّاسِ

en.text: The Sovereign of mankind,

so.text: 2. Boqorka dadka.

ayat.arabic: إِلَٰهِ ٱلنَّاسِ

en.text: The God of mankind,

so.text: 3. Ilaaha dadka.

ayat.arabic: مِن شَرِّ ٱلۡوَسۡوَاسِ ٱلۡخَنَّاسِ

en.text: From the evil of the retreating whisperer[2016] -
en.footnotes: [2016] i.e., a devil who makes evil suggestions to man but disappears when one remembers Allāh.

so.text: 4. Sharka waswaasiyaha (sheydaanka) soo noqnoqodka badan.

ayat.arabic: ٱلَّذِي يُوَسۡوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ

en.text: Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind -

so.text: 5. Kaasoo waswaasiya laabaha dadka.

ayat.arabic: مِنَ ٱلۡجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ

en.text: From among the jinn and mankind."[2017]
en.footnotes: [2017] Evil prompters may be from men as well as from jinn.

so.text: 6. (Shaydaankaa) oo jin iyo dadba leh.

ar.text: عن أنس بن مالك رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: «إِنَّ اللهَ لَيَرْضَى عَنِ الْعَبْدِ أَنْ يَأْكُلَ الْأَكْلَةَ فَيَحْمَدَهُ عَلَيْهَا، أَوْ يَشْرَبَ الشَّرْبَةَ فَيَحْمَدَهُ عَلَيْهَا».

en.title: Allah is pleased with one who eats some food and praises Him for it, or drinks some drink and praises Him for it
en.text: Anas ibn Mālik (may Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah’s peace and blessings be upon him) said: "Allah is pleased with one who eats some food and praises Him for it, or drinks some drink and praises Him for it."
en.explanation: The Prophet (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) points out that praising Allah for His bounty and blessings is one of the ways the servant can win the pleasure of his Lord. He eats food, says "al-hamdulillāh" (praise be to Allah), drinks some drink, and says al-hamdulillāh.
hints: The Hadīth shows Allah's bounty, as He provides sustenance to His servants and is pleased with the praise.
The pleasure of Allah can be attained by the simplest means, like praising Him after eating and drinking.
One etiquette of eating and drinking is to praise Allah Almighty after that.

so.title: Ilaahay wuu kaga raali noqdaa Qofka  markuu wax cuno oo Ilaahay ku mahadiyo iyo markuu wax cabo oo uu Ilaahay ku mahadiyo
so.text: Anas Binu Maalik Allaha ka raali ahaade waxaa laga wariyey inuu yiri: Rasuulka Ilaahay nabadgelyo iyo naxariis Allaha siiyee wuxuu yiri: "Ilaahay wuu kaga raali noqdaa Qofka  markuu wax cuno oo Ilaahay ku mahadiyo iyo markuu wax cabo oo uu Ilaahay ku mahadiyo".
so.explanation: Nabigu nabadgelyo iyo naxariis Allaha siiyee  wuxuu cadeeyey in marka Adoonku Ilaahay fadligiisa iyo nicmadiisa uu ku mahadiyo ay ka mid tahay arimaha lagu gaaro Ilaahay raali ahaantiisa, markuu cuntada cuno wuxuu oran: Alxamdu lilaah, haduu cabana wuxuu oran: Alxamdu lilaah.
hints: Deeqsinimada Ilaahay casa wajala, wuxuu fadligiisa ku siiyey irsaaqad hadii lagu xamdiyona wuu ku raalinoqdaa.
Raali ahaanta Ilaahay waxaa lagu gaaraa asbaabta ugu fudud, sida mahadnaqa marka wax la cuno ama wax la cabo.
Aadaabta cuntada iyo cabitaanka waxaa ka mida: Ilaahay oo loo mahadiyo cunida iyo cabida ka dib.

ar.text: عن عُمر بن أبي سلمة رضي الله عنه قال: كُنْتُ غُلَامًا فِي حَجْرِ رَسُولِ اللهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَكَانَتْ يَدِي تَطِيشُ فِي الصَّحْفَةِ، فَقَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «يَا غُلَامُ، سَمِّ اللهَ، وَكُلْ بِيَمِينِكَ، وَكُلْ مِمَّا يَلِيكَ» فَمَا زَالَتْ تِلْكَ طِعْمَتِي بَعْدُ.

en.title: O boy, mention Allah's name, eat with your right hand, and eat from what is nearer to you
en.text: ‘Umar ibn Abi Salamah (may Allah be pleased with him) reported: I was a young boy under the care of the Messenger of Allah (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him), and my hand used to wander all over the platter (of food). The Messenger of Allah (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) said, "O boy, mention Allah's name, eat with your right hand, and eat from what is nearer to you." Since then, I have been eating that way.
en.explanation:
Umar bin Abi Salamah, may God be pleased with them both, the son of the wife of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, Umm Salamah, wife Umm Salamah (may Allah be pleased with her) - and he was under his upbringing and care - narrates that while eating, he used to move his hand all over the platter to pick up food, so the Prophet, (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him), taught him three etiquettes of Eating etiquette:

First: Saying 'bismillāh' (in the name of Allah) when beginning to eat.

Second: Eating with the right hand.

Third: Eating from the side next to one.
hints: One of the etiquettes of eating and drinking is to begin with mentioning the name of Allah.
Teaching children the proper etiquettes, especially those under one’s care.
It shows the Prophet's leniency and patience in teaching and educating children.
One of the etiquettes of eating is that one eats from the nearest side, except if there are various items of food, in which case a person can eat from that place.
The Companions (may Allah be pleased with them) would comply with the Prophet's teachings, as indicated by 'Umar's statement: Since then, I have been eating that way.

so.title: Bismi Allah dheh oo Midigta ku cun, oo ka cun dhinaca ku soo xiga
so.text: Cumar Binu Abii Salama Allaha ka raali ahaadee waxaa laga wariyey inuu yiri: Anoo ah Wiil yar oo ku nool Guriga Nabiga nabadgelyo iyo naxariis Allaha siiyee ayey Gacantaydu  xeerada ku dhex wareegtay markaasaa Rasuulku nabadgelyo iyo naxariis Allaha siiyee igu yiri: yarow Bismi Allah dheh oo Midigta ku cun, oo ka cun dhinaca ku soo xiga, intii ka danbaysay sidaas ayaan u cuni jiray cuntada.
so.explanation:
Cumar Binu Abii Salama-Allaha ka raali ahaade wuxuu sheegay inuu ahaa Wiilkii yar oo ay dhashay xaaskii Nabiga nabadgelyo iyo naxariis Allaha siiyee ee Umu Salama Allaha ka raali ahaadee- waxaana Gacanta ku hayey oo tarbiyeynaayey Nabiga nabadgelyo iyo naxariis Allaha siiyee isagoo Nabiga wax la cunaya ayuu weelkii cuntada dhinacyada cunto ka qaatay, markaasuu Nabigu nabadgelyo iyo naxarasiis Allaha siiyee wuxuu baray seddexdan aadaabta cuntada ku saabsan.

Tan 1aad: waa erayga "Bismillaah" bilawga cuntada.

Tan 2aad: Midigta oo lagu cuno.

Tan 3aad: waa inuu cuntaa ka cuno dhinaca u dhaw isaga.
hints: Aadaabta cunida iyo cabida waxaa ka mida Bisinka oo lagu bilaabo.
Waa muhiim in caruurta la baro aadaabta, gaar ahaana kuwa Qofku masuulka ka yahay.
Xadiiska waxaa ku sugan in Nabiga nabadgelyo iyo naxariis Allaha siiyee naxariistiisa iyo dulqaadkiisu ay waasac yihiin  markuu caruurta wax barayo oo uu tarbiyeynaayo.
Waxaa ka mid ah aadaabta cuntada in Qofku ka cuno dhinaca isaga soo xiga hadayna ahayn cuntadu noocyo kala duwan, markaa waxaa u banaan tahaty inuu ka qaato shay walba halkuu yaallo.

Asaxaabtu waxay qaadan jireen aadaabta uu baray Nabigu nabadgelyo iyo naxarasiis Allaha siiyee arinkaana waxaa laga fahmayaa hadalka Cumar Binu Abii Salama: intii ka danbaysay sidaas ayaan cuntada u cuni jiray.

ar.text: عن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: «إِذَا أَكَلَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيَأْكُلْ بِيَمِينِهِ، وَإِذَا شَرِبَ فَلْيَشْرَبْ بِيَمِينِهِ، فَإِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ يَأْكُلُ بِشِمَالِهِ، وَيَشْرَبُ بِشِمَالِهِ».

en.title: If anyone of you eats, let him eat with his right hand, and if he drinks, let him drink with his right hand, for indeed the devil eats with his left hand and drinks with his left hand
en.text: Ibn ‘Umar (may Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) said: "If anyone of you eats, let him eat with his right hand, and if he drinks, let him drink with his right hand, for indeed the devil eats with his left hand and drinks with his left hand."
en.explanation: The Prophet (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) enjoins that Muslims should eat and drink with their right hand and forbade eating and drinking with their left hand. This is because the devil eats and drinks with the left hand.
hints: It is prohibited to imitate the devil in eating or drinking with the left hand.

so.title: Hadii Qof idinka mida uu wax cunayo ha ku cuno Midigtiisa, haduu wax cabaayana ha ku cabo Midigtiisa, waayo Shaydaanku wuxuu ku cunaa Bidixdiisa wuxuuna ku cabaa Bidixdiisa
so.text: Ibnu Cumar Allaha ka wada raali ahaado isaga iyo Aabihiye waxaa laga wariyey in Rasuulka Ilaahay nabadgelyo iyo naxarasiis Allaha siiyee uu yiri: "Hadii Qof idinka mida uu wax cunayo ha ku cuno Midigtiisa, haduu wax cabaayana ha ku cabo Midigtiisa, waayo Shaydaanku wuxuu ku cunaa Bidixdiisa wuxuuna ku cabaa Bidixdiisa".
so.explanation: Nabigu nabadgelyo iyo naxarasiis Allaha siiyee  wuxuu faray inuu Qofka Muslimka ahi wax ku cuno kuna cabo Gacantiisa Midig, wuuna reebay in wax lagu cuno laguna cabo Gacanta Bidix, waayo Shaydaankaa kuna cuna kuna caba Bidixda.
hints: Waxaa la reebay in Shaydaanka looga ekaado ku cunida iyo ku cabida Bidixda.

ar.text: عَنْ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ رضي الله عنه قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «لَا يُمْسِكَنَّ أَحَدُكُمْ ذَكَرَهُ بِيَمِينِهِ وَهُوَ يَبُولُ، وَلَا يَتَمَسَّحْ مِنَ الْخَلَاءِ بِيَمِينِهِ، وَلَا يَتَنَفَّسْ فِي الْإِنَاءِ».

en.title: None of you should hold his penis with his right hand while urinating, nor wipe himself after answering the call of nature using his right hand, nor breathe into the vessel
en.text: Abu Qatādah (may Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) said: "None of you should hold his penis with his right hand while urinating, nor wipe himself after answering the call of nature using his right hand, nor breathe into the vessel."
en.explanation: The Prophet (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) clarified here some manners as he forbade men from holding their penis with their right hand while urinating and forbade the act of removing impurity from the private parts, front or back, with the right hand because the right hand is meant to be used for noble matters. He also forbade breathing into the vessel from which one is drinking.
hints: Demonstrating how Islam is in the lead when it comes to manners and cleanliness.
Avoiding filth, but if one has to touch it, then let him do so with his left hand.
Highlighting the nobility of the right hand and its superiority over the left one.
Perfection of the Islamic Shariah and comprehensiveness of its teachings.

so.title: Yaanu midkiin ku qaban midigtiisa guskiisa isagoo kaadinaaya, oo yaanu midigtiisa isaga tirin najaasada, oo yaanu ku neefsan weelka uu ku cabayo
so.text: Abii Qataada-Allaha ka raali ahaadee- wuxuu yiri: Rasuulka Ilaahay -naxariis iyo nabadi korkiisa ha ahaatee wuxuu yiri: "Yaanu midkiin ku qaban midigtiisa guskiisa isagoo kaadinaaya, oo yaanu midigtiisa isaga tirin najaasada, oo yaanu ku neefsan weelka uu ku cabayo.
so.explanation: Nabigu -naxariis iyo nabdi korkiisa ha ahaatee-wuxuu cadeeyey qaar ka mida aadaabta, isagoo reebay in ninku midigtiisa ku qabto guskiisa markuu kaadinaayo wuxuu kaloo reebay inuu gacantiisa midig uu kaga tiro najaasada guska ama dabada, waayo midigtu waxay u diyaarsan tahay waxyaabaha fiican. Sidaasoo kale wuxuu reebay inuu qofku ku neefsado weelka uu wax ku cabaayo.
hints: Waxaa cad in Islaamku ugu horeeyey aadaabta iyo nadaafada.
Waa in laga fogaado waxyaabaha qurunka ah, hadayse daruuri noqoto waa in gacanta bidix loo adeegsado.
Waxaa la cadeeyey sharafta ay leedahay midigtu iyo inay wax dheer tahay bidixda.
Shareecada Islaamku waa mid kaamil ah, cilmiga shareecaduna waa mid wax walba ku dhan yihiin.

ar.text: عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ الْأَكْوَعِ رضي الله عنه: أَنَّ رَجُلًا أَكَلَ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِشِمَالِهِ، فَقَالَ: «كُلْ بِيَمِينِكَ»، قَالَ: لَا أَسْتَطِيعُ، قَالَ: «لَا اسْتَطَعْتَ»، مَا مَنَعَهُ إِلَّا الْكِبْرُ، قَالَ: فَمَا رَفَعَهَا إِلَى فِيهِ.

en.title: A man ate with his left hand in the presence of the Messenger of Allah (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him), whereupon he said: "Eat with your right hand." The man said: I cannot do that. Thereupon, he said: "May you not be able to do that
en.text: Salamah ibn al-Akwa‘ (may Allah be pleased with him) reported: A man ate with his left hand in the presence of the Messenger of Allah (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him), whereupon he said: "Eat with your right hand." The man said: I cannot do that. Thereupon, he said: "May you not be able to do that." It was only arrogance that prevented him. He said: He could not raise it up to his mouth afterward.
en.explanation: The Prophet (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) saw a man eating with his left hand, so, he ordered him to eat with his right hand. The man lied and said, out of arrogance, that he could not do this. So, the Prophet (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) supplicated against him to be deprived of the ability to eat with his right hand. Allah fulfilled His Prophet's supplication and the man's right hand was paralyzed and he could not raise it to his mouth after that with any food or drink.
hints: It is obligatory to eat with the right hand and it is prohibited to eat with the left hand.
Disdaining to apply the Shariah rulings makes one worthy of punishment.
Allah Almighty honored His Prophet Muhammad (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) by answering his supplication.
The legitimacy of enjoining good and forbidding evil in all situations even while eating.

so.title: Nin ayaa Bidixda ku cunay isagoo la jooga Rasuulka nabadgelyo iyo naxariis Allaha siiyee, wuxuu Rasuulku nabadgelyo iyo naxariis Allaha siiyee ku yiri: "midigtaada ku cun", wuxuuse yiri: ma awoodo, Rasuulku nabadgelyo iyo naxariis Allaha siiyee wuxuu yiri: " ha awoodin
so.text: Salama Binu Alakwac Allaha ka raali ahaadee waxaa laga wariyey: Nin ayaa Bidixda ku cunay isagoo la jooga Rasuulka nabadgelyo iyo naxariis Allaha siiyee, wuxuu Rasuulku nabadgelyo iyo naxariis Allaha siiyee ku yiri: "midigtaada ku cun", wuxuuse yiri: ma awoodo, Rasuulku nabadgelyo iyo naxariis Allaha siiyee wuxuu yiri: " ha awoodin ", kibir baa u diiday, wuxuu yiri: mar danbe Gacantiisii Afkiisa uma qaadin, .
so.explanation: Nabiga nabadgelyo iyo naxariis Allaha siiyee ayaa arkay nin Bidixda wax ku cunaaya, wuxuuna amray inuu Midigtiisa ku cuno, Wuxuu ku jawaabay inuusan awoodin isagoo ay kibir iyo been ka tahay! Nabigu nabadgelyo iyo naxariis Allaha siiyee wuxuu ku habaaray inuu kari waayo Midigta inuu wax ku cuno. Ilaahayna wuu aqbalay habaarkii Nabigiisa oo waa qalashay Midigtiisii, mana awoodin inuu Afkiisa gaarsiiyo intaa ka dib cunto iyo cabitaanba.
hints: Waxaa waajib ah in Midigta wax lagu cuno, waana  xaaraan in Bidixda wax lagu cuno.
Qofka iska waynaysiiya ku dhaqanka Axkaanta Shareecada Islaamka wuxuu  mudan yahay in la  ciqaabo.
Ilaahay wuxuu ku karaameeyey Nabigiisa nabadgelyo iyo naxariis Allaha siiyee inuu habaarkiisa aqbalay.
Farida wanaaga iyo  reebida xumaha waa waajib shareecadu fartay, xaalad kastoo lagu jiro, xataa waqtiga cuntada.

ar.text: عن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: ما عاب رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم طعاما قط، إن اشتهاه أكله، وإن كرهه تركه.

en.title: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) never found fault with any food. If he liked it, he would eat; and if he disliked it, he would leave it
en.text: Abu Hurayrah (may Allah be pleased with him) reported that the Messenger of Allah (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) never found fault with any food. If he liked it, he would eat; and if he disliked it, he would leave it.
en.explanation: The Prophet never spoke badly of any food served to him. Rather, if he liked it, he would eat it, if not, he would leave it, not belittling it.

ar.text: عن أبي جُحَيْفَة رضي الله عنه قال: كنتُ عند النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم فقال لرجل عنده: «لا آكُلُ وأنا مُتَّكِئ».

en.title: I do not eat while reclining on my side
en.text: Abu Juhayfah (may Allah be pleased with him) reported: I was with the Prophet (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) when he said to a man there: "I do not eat while reclining on my side."
en.explanation: Abu Juhayfah Wahb ibn ‘Abdullāh As-Sawā’i (may Allah be pleased with him) reports in this Hadīth that it was not of the practice of the Prophet (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) that he ate leaning on a pillow or something, putting his hand on the ground and reclining on it. The Prophet (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) would not sit this way because when doing so, one eats a lot. Eating a lot makes one lazy, and this results in physical problems. Leaning while eating entails that the food runs down the stomach in a way that is not straight, which is abnormal and could be harmful. Also, leaning while eating is position that indicates arrogance, which is not decorous.

ar.text: عن ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما قال: «نهى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم أنْ يُتَنَفَّسَ في الإناء، أو يُنْفَخَ فيه».
ar.attribution: رواه أبو داود والترمذي وابن ماجه وأحمد والدارمي

en.title: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) forbade breathing into the pot or blowing into it
en.text: Ibn ‘Abbās (may Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) forbade breathing into the pot or blowing into it.
en.explanation: This Hadīth relates one of the manners of eating and drinking, which is the prohibition to breathe or blow into the pot when eating or drinking. Breathing is forbidden because of its demerits, such as blemishing the cleanness of the pot and contaminating the drink, besides the fact that doing this entails that the person breathes and drinks at the same time, which may cause suffocating. As the Sunnah indicates, one should drink three times, breathing outside the pot, which makes drinking more enjoyable and pleasing. The Hadīth in hand forbids blowing into the food and drink for any reason, such as hotness or for removing something. This way, one keeps the food clean from saliva or bad smell.
en.attribution: Narrated by Ibn Majah - Narrated by At-Termedhy - Narrated by Abu Daoud - Narrated by Ahmad - Ad-Daarimi

ar.text: عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رضي الله عنهما أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: ««إذَا أَكَلَ أَحَدُكُمْ طَعَامًا فَلا يَمْسَحْ يَدَهُ حَتَّى يَلْعَقَهَا، أَوْ يُلْعِقَهَا».

en.title: When anyone of you eats food, let him not wipe his hand until he licks it or has it licked.
en.text: Ibn ‘Abbās (may Allah be pleased with him) reported that the Prophet (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) said: "When anyone of you eats food, let him not wipe his hand until he licks it or has it licked."
en.explanation: The Prophet (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) ordered whoever eats not to wipe his hand or wash it until he licks it or has it licked. The reason for this, as some narrations state, is that one does not know where the blessing lies in the food. Therefore, the Prophet (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) ordered licking one's fingers, because the blessing may be in the traces of food on fingers.

ar.text: عن عائشة رضي الله عنها: «أَنَّ رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم سُئِل عن الْبِتْعِ؟ فقال: كل شَرَابٍ أَسْكَر فهو حَرَامٌ».

en.title: Every drink that intoxicates is unlawful.
en.text: ‘Ā’ishah (may Allah be pleased with her) reported that the Messenger of Allah (may Allah’s peace and blessings be upon him) was asked about mead, and he said: "Every drink that intoxicates is unlawful."
en.explanation:
The Messenger of Allah (may Allah’s peace and blessings be upon him) was asked about mead, an alcoholic drink made of honey, and his answer was complete and comprehensive, to the effect that the difference of names does not matter as long as the meaning and essence is the same.
Every drink that causes intoxication is forbidden wine, regardless of its kind or name.
This Hadīth constitutes one of the concise and profound statements made by the Prophet (may Allah’s peace and blessings be upon him) as he demonstrated the rulings laid down by his Lord. The period of his prophet-hood contained such knowledge that would render all humanity blissful in the worldly life and in the Hereafter.

ar.text: عن عبد الله بنِ عمر رضي الله عنهما أن عمرَ بْن الخطاب رضي الله عنه قال: ((يا رسول الله، أّيَرقُدُ أَحَدُنا وهو جُنُب؟ قال: نعم، إِذَا تَوَضَّأ أَحَدُكُم فَليَرقُد)).

en.title: O Messenger of Allah, may anyone of us sleep while being ritually impure? He said: Yes, he may sleep if he makes ablution
en.text: ‘Abdullāh ibn ‘Umar (may Allah be pleased with him) reported: ‘Umar ibn al-Khattāb (may Allah be pleased with him) said: "O Messenger of Allah, may anyone of us sleep while being ritually impure?" He said: "Yes, he may sleep if he makes ablution."
en.explanation: ‘Umar ibn al-Khattāb (may Allah be pleased with him) asked the Prophet (may Allah’s peace and blessings be upon him) about whether it is permissible for a man to sleep in a state of ritual impurity at the earlier part of the night, after having sexual intercourse with his wife, even if there is no ejaculation, or having a wet dream. The Prophet (may Allah’s peace and blessings be upon him) declared it permissible, provided that this major ritual impurity is lessened with ablution.

ar.text:
عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رضي الله عنه أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ: «إِذَا تَوَضَّأَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيَجْعَلْ فِي أَنْفِهِ ثُمَّ لِيَنْثُرْ، وَمَنِ اسْتَجْمَرَ فَلْيُوتِرْ، وَإِذَا اسْتَيْقَظَ أَحَدُكُمْ مِنْ نَوْمِهِ فَلْيَغْسِلْ يَدَهُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُدْخِلَهَا فِي وَضُوئِهِ، فَإِنَّ أَحَدَكُمْ لاَ يَدْرِي أَيْنَ بَاتَتْ يَدُهُ».
ولفظ مسلم: «إِذَا اسْتَيْقَظَ أَحَدُكُمْ مِنْ نَوْمِهِ فَلَا يَغْمِسْ يَدَهُ فِي الْإِنَاءِ حَتَّى يَغْسِلَهَا ثَلَاثًا، فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَدْرِي أَيْنَ بَاتَتْ يَدُهُ».

en.title: When any of you performs ablution, let him sniff water in his nose and then blow it out. Whoever cleans his private parts with stones, let him do so with an odd number of stones
en.text: Abu Hurayrah (may Allah be pleased with him) reported that the Messenger of Allah (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) said: "When any of you performs ablution, let him sniff water in his nose and then blow it out. Whoever cleans his private parts with stones, let him do so with an odd number of stones. Whoever wakes up from his sleep, let him wash his hand before putting it in the water container of ablution, for none of you knows where his hand was during his sleep." The wording of Muslim reads: "Whoever wakes up from his sleep, let him not put his hand in the water container until he washes it three times, for he does not  know where his hand was during his sleep."
en.explanation: The Prophet (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) clarified some of the Tahārah (ritual purity) rulings including the following: First: Whoever performs ablution must sniff water into the nose by inhaling and then blow it out by exhaling. Second: Whoever wants to clean his private parts from impurities with something other than water, like stones and the like, should do so with an odd number of stones; the least of which is three, and the most of which is what is necessary to fully cleanse the impurities off his body. Third: Whoever wakes up from night sleep should not put his hand in the water vessel to perform ablution until he washes it three times outside the vessel, for he does not know where his hand was during his sleep. It might have been affected by some impurity or the devil might have been meddling with it carrying to it what could either be harmful to man or what could make the water impure.
hints: In Wudū’ (ablution), one must make Istinshāq, which is sniffing water into the nose by inhaling, and one must also make Istinthār, which is blowing water out from the nose by exhaling.
It is recommended to make Istijmār (clean the private parts from impurities using stones or so) with an odd number of stones.
It is prescribed to wash the hands three times after waking up from night sleep.

so.title: Markuu  wayso qaadanayo midkiin Biyaha Sankiisa ha geliyo  hadana ha soo firdhiyo, Qofka dhagax ku istinjoodana dhagxaanta witir ha ka dhigo
so.text: Abii Hurayra -Allaha ka raali ahaadee- waxaa laga wariyey in Rasuulka Ilaahay nabadgelyo iyo naxariis Allaha siiyee uu yiri: "Markuu  wayso qaadanayo midkiin Biyaha Sankiisa ha geliyo  hadana ha soo firdhiyo, Qofka dhagax ku istinjoodana dhagxaanta witir ha ka dhigo,  markuu midkiin hurdada ka tooso ha dhaqo Gacmihiisa intaanu Biyaha waysada gelin, waayo ma oga midkiin halka ay Gacantiisu bariday", imaam Muslim ayaa isna sidan u wariyey: "markuu midkiin tooso yaanu gelin Gacantiisa weelka ilaa uu seddex jeer uu dhaqo, waayo ma oga halkay Gacantiisu bariday."
so.explanation: Nabigu nabadgelyo iyo naxariis Allaha siiyee  wuxuu cadeeyey qaar ka mida axkaanta dahaarada, waxaana ka mida: Mida 1aad: Qofki wayso qaadanaya waa inuu  Biyaha Sanka geliyo, hadana neefta soo raaciyo oo soo firdhiyo. Mida 2aad: Qofkii doonaya inuu isaga nadiifiyo najaasada ka soo baxaysa isaga waxaan Biyo ahayn sida dhagxaanta iyo wixii la mida, wuxuu isku nadiifinayaa tirsi kinsi ah oo ugu yaraan ah seddex ugu badnaan wixii tirtiraya najaasada meeshana nadiifinaya. Mida 3aad: Qofka ka toosa hurdada habeenka Gacantiisa galinmaayo weelka markuu wayso qaadanayo ilaa uu Gacantiisa ku dhaqdo weelka dibadiisa, waayo ma oga halkay Gacantiisu bariday, kama aamin aha in  Gacantiisu najaaso taabatay, waxaana dhici kara inuu shaydaan ku ciyaaray, oo uu saaray waxyaabo dadka dhibaya ama Biyaha xumaynaya.
hints: Waa waajib San daarsigu marka la wayso qaadanayo, waana Biyaha oo inta neefta Sanka lagu jiido hadana neefta la soo raaciyo oo la soo firdhiyo.
Waa Suno in Dhagaxa lagu istijoodo laga dhigo tira kinsi ah oo is dheer.
Waa Sharci in la dhaqo Gacmaha seddex jeer marka hurdada Habeennimo laga soo tooso.

ar.text: عن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما مرفوعاً: «لا تَتْرُكُوا النار في بيوتكم حين تنامون».

en.title: Do not keep the fire burning in your homes when you go to bed
en.text: Ibn ‘Umar (may Allah be pleased with him) reported that the Prophet (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) said: "Do not keep the fire burning in your homes when you go to bed."
en.explanation: Meaning of the Hadīth: The Prophet (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) prohibits his Ummah from sleeping before putting out the fire that they lit.

ar.text: عَنْ ‌عَائِشَةَ رضي الله عنها: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ إِذَا أَوَى إِلَى فِرَاشِهِ كُلَّ لَيْلَةٍ جَمَعَ كَفَّيْهِ، ثُمَّ نَفَثَ فِيهِمَا فَقَرَأَ فِيهِمَا: {قُلْ هُوَ اللهُ أَحَدٌ}، وَ{قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ}، وَ{قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ}، ثُمَّ يَمْسَحُ بِهِمَا مَا اسْتَطَاعَ مِنْ جَسَدِهِ، يَبْدَأُ بِهِمَا عَلَى رَأْسِهِ وَوَجْهِهِ وَمَا أَقْبَلَ مِنْ جَسَدِهِ، يَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ.

en.title: When the Prophet (may Allah’s peace and blessings be upon him) went to bed every night, he would join his palms together and blow into them and recite the Surahs al-Ikhlās, al-Falaq, and an-Nās,
en.text: ‘Ā’ishah (may Allah be pleased with her) reported: When the Prophet (may Allah’s peace and blessings be upon him) went to bed every night, he would join his palms together and blow into them and recite the Surahs al-Ikhlās, al-Falaq, and an-Nās, and then he would wipe with his hands over as many parts of his body as he could, starting with his head, face, and the front of his body. He used to do that three times.
en.explanation: It was part of the Prophet's custom that when he went to bed, he would join his palms together and raise them as a supplicant does, and he would blow into them in a mild manner, along with little saliva. Meanwhile, he would recite the three surahs of al-Ikhlās, al-Falaq, and an-Nās. Then, he would wipe with his palms over as much of his body as he could, starting with his head, face, and the front part of his body, repeating this three times.
hints: We are recommended to recite Surat al-Ikhlās and the two refuge-seeking surahs of al-Falaq and an-Nās before going to bed and to blow with them into our palms and then wipe over as many parts of our bodies as we can.

so.title: Nabigu nabadgelyo iyo naxariis Allaha siiyee markuu tago Gogoshiisa Habeen walba wuu isku qaban jirey labadiisa Sacab, wuxuu ku akhrin jiray kuna tufi jiray: { قل هو الله أحد}, iyo {قل أعوذ بربّ الفلق}, iyo { قل أعوذ بربّ النّاس}
so.text: Caa'isha Allaha  ka raali noqde waxaa laga wariyey: Nabigu nabadgelyo iyo naxariis Allaha siiyee markuu tago Gogoshiisa Habeen walba wuu isku qaban jirey labadiisa Sacab, wuxuu ku akhrin jiray kuna tufi jiray: { قل هو الله أحد}, iyo {قل أعوذ بربّ الفلق}, iyo { قل أعوذ بربّ النّاس}, ka dibna ku masixi jiray inta uu ka gaaro Jirkiisa, isagoo ka bilaabaya  Madaxa iyo Wajigiisa iyo inta soo qaabisha Jirkiisa, seddex jeer buu samayn jiray.
so.explanation: Nabiga nabadgelyo iyo naxariis Allaha siiyee dhaqankiisa waxaa ka mid ahaa markuu tago Gogoshiisa si uu u seexdo wuxuu isku qaban jiray labadiisa Sacab isago kor u qaadaya sida Qofka ducaysanaya si khafiifa ayuu ugu tufi jiray Afkiisa Candhuufo yar, wuxuuna ku akhriyi jiray seddexda suuradood ee:{ قل هو الله أحد } iyo { قل أعوذ بربّ الفلق } iyo  قل أعوذ برب النّاس }, ka dibna wuxuu ku masixi jiray labadiisa Sacab inta uu gaaro ee Jirkiisa ah, isagoo ku bilaabaya Madaxa iyo Wajigiisa iyo soo jeedkiisa, wuuna ku celcelin jiray ficilkaa seddex jeer.
hints: Waa suno akhrinta suuradaha saddexda ah ee: Alikhlaas iyo labada qul acuudu intaan la seexan iyo in lagu tufo gacmaha, jirkana inta laga gaaro lagu masoxo.

ar.text: عن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه أن أبا بكر الصديق رضي الله عنه قال: يا رسول الله مُرني بكلمات أقُولُهُنَّ إذا أصبَحتُ وإذا أمسَيتُ، قال: «قل: اللهم فاطِرَ السماوات والأرض عالم الغيبِ والشهادة، ربَّ كُلِّ شَيءٍ ومَلِيكَه، أَشْهد أن لا إله إلا أنت، أعوذ بك من شرِّ نفسي وشرِّ الشيطان وشِرْكِهِ وأن أقترف على نفسي سوءًا أو أجرُّه إلى مسلم» قال: «قلها إذا أصبحت، وإذا أمسيت، وإذا أخذْتَ مَضْجَعَك».
ar.attribution: رواه أبو داود والترمذي والنسائي وأحمد

en.title: He said: Say: O Allah, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the hidden and the apparent, Lord of everything and its Possessor, I bear witness that there is no god but You. I seek refuge in You from the evil of my own self and from the evil of the devil and the evil of polytheism to which he calls.
en.text: Abu Hurayrah (may Allah be pleased with him) reported that Abu Bakr (may Allah be pleased with him) said: "O Messenger of Allah, teach me some words to recite in the morning and in the evening." He said: "Say: 'O Allah, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the hidden and the apparent, Lord of everything and its Possessor. I bear witness that there is no god but You. I seek refuge in You from the evil of my own self and from the evil of the devil and the evil of polytheism to which he calls, and from incurring any sin upon myself or upon any other Muslim.'" He added: "Recite them in the morning, in the evening, and when you go to bed."
en.explanation: This Dhikr is one of the supplications that are recited in the morning and in the evening, which the Prophet (may Allah’s peace and blessings be upon him) taught Abu Bakr (may Allah be pleased with him), who said: "Teach me!" So, the Prophet (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) taught him a Dhikr and a supplication that he could recite every morning and every evening. He ordered him to say: O Allah, the Creator of the heavens and the earth in an unprecedented manner, Who originated them and brought them into existence from non-existence. Knower of what is hidden from the creatures and what is apparent to them, because Allah, the Almighty, knows the present, the past, and the future. Lord of everything and its Possessor, as Allah, the Almighty, is the Lord of everything and the Owner of everything. I testify with my tongue and heart that there is no god but You. Everything worshiped other than Allah is a false deity that has no right to be worshiped, and none has the right to be worshiped but Allah alone, may He be Glorified. I seek refuge in You from the evil of my own self, because the self has evils, as a verse reads: {And I do not acquit myself. Indeed, the soul is a persistent enjoiner of evil, except those upon whom my Lord has mercy} [Yusuf: 53]. So, if Allah does not protect you from the evils of your own self, then it will harm you and order you to do evil things. If He protects you from its evil, then He has guided you to all goodness. The Prophet (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) concluded his supplication with: and from the evil of the devil and the evil of polytheism to which he calls, or from the evil of his trap which he sets for people through desires, doubts, or other means of temptation. The completion of the supplication is to say: I seek refuge in Allah from committing evil against myself or causing evil to another Muslim. This supplication is what the Prophet (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) taught Abu Bakr to say in the morning, evening, and before going to bed.
en.attribution: Narrated by At-Termedhy - An-Nasaa’i - Narrated by Abu Daoud - Narrated by Ahmad

ar.text: عن أبي موسى الأشعري رضي الله عنه قال: احْتَرَقَ بَيْتٌ بالمَدِينَةِ عَلَى أهْلِهِ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ، فَلَمَّا حُدِّثَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِشَأنِهِم، قالَ: «إنَّ هذه النارَ عَدُوٌّ لَكُمْ، فَإِذَا نِمْتُم، فَأَطْفِئُوهَا عَنْكُمْ».

en.title: This fire is your enemy, so put it out before going to bed
en.text: Abu Mūsa al-Ash‘ari (may Allah be pleased with him) reported: One night, a house in Madīnah was burnt with its inhabitants inside. When this was reported to the Messenger of Allah (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) he said: “This fire is your enemy, so put it out before going to bed."
en.explanation: A house in Madīnah was burnt one night, and the Prophet (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) heard about it. So, he informed people that this fire is their enemy if they do not take precautions against its flames and burning effect. Then, he ordered them to put it out before sleeping so as to avoid its outbreak.

ar.text: عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ بْنِ اليَمَانِ رَضيَ اللهُ عنه: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ إِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَنَامَ وَضَعَ يَدَهُ تَحْتَ رَأْسِهِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: «اللَّهُمَّ قِنِي عَذَابَكَ يَوْمَ تَجْمَعُ أَوْ تَبْعَثُ عِبَادَكَ».

en.title: Allāhumma qini ‘adhābaka yawma tajma‘u or tab‘athu ‘ibādak (O Allah, protect me from Your punishment on the Day You gather or resurrect Your servants)
en.text: Hudhayfah ibn al-Yamān (may Allah be pleased with him) reported: When the Prophet (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) intended to sleep, he would place his hand under his head, then say: "Allāhumma qini ‘adhābaka yawma tajma‘u or tab‘athu ‘ibādak (O Allah, protect me from Your punishment on the Day You gather or resurrect Your servants)."
en.explanation: When the Prophet (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) lay down to sleep, he would rest his head on his right hand and place his right cheek upon it, and he would say: "O Allah" my Lord, "protect me" and guard me against "Your punishment" and torment "on the Day You gather or resurrect Your servants" for reckoning, i.e., the Day of Judgment.
hints: The merit of this blessed supplication and the recommendation of reciting it frequently, following the example of the Prophet (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him).
Lying down on the right side is recommended.
As-Sindi said: His statement (O Allah, protect me from Your punishment) implies that a wise person should treat sleep as a reminder of death and the resurrection that follows it.
Protection from Allah's punishment on the Day of Judgment is through His grace and mercy, by guiding the servant to righteous deeds and by Allah's forgiveness of his sins.
Humility of the Prophet (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) before his Almighty Lord and Master.

Affirmation of resurrection and the return, and that people will be brought back to their Lord to be held accountable for their deeds. Whoever finds good should praise Allah Almighty, and whoever finds otherwise should blame none but himself, for they are merely the deeds of the servants that Allah keeps count of against them.
Keenness of the Companions (may Allah be pleased with them) to elaborate on the conditions of the Prophet (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) in his sleep.

His statement: "He would place his right hand under his cheek": this was from the Prophet's habit of favoring the right side in all matters, except in cases where there is evidence indicating otherwise.

Sleeping on the right side leads to quicker wakefulness, as the heart is less settled in that position, and it is more restful for the heart because it is located on the left side. If a person sleeps on the left side, it may harm the heart due to the body's weight pressing upon it.

ar.text: عن أبي مسعود رضي الله عنه قال: قال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم: «مَنْ قَرَأَ بِالْآيَتَيْنِ مِنْ آخِرِ سُورَةِ الْبَقَرَةِ فِي لَيْلَةٍ كَفَتَاهُ».

en.title: Whoever recites the last two verses of Sūrat al-Baqarah at a night, they will suffice him
en.text: Abu Mas‘ūd (may Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Prophet (may Allah’s peace and blessings be upon him) said: "Whoever recites the last two verses of Sūrat al-Baqarah at a night, they will suffice him."
en.explanation: The Prophet (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) informed that whoever recites the last two verses of Surat al-Baqarah at night, Allah will protect him from evil and harm. It is also said that they are sufficient for him in place of qiyām al-layl (supererogatory prayer at night). They are also said to suffice him in place of all regular dhikrs. Others say that they are the least sufficient amount of Qur'anic recitation in qiyām al-layl. Other opinions were also expressed. Perhaps all those views are correct and consistent with the Hadīth's wording.
hints: The Hadīth points out the merit of the last verses of Surat al-Baqarah - From {The Messenger believes...} to the end of the Surah.
The last verses of Surat al-Baqarah protect its reciter from evil, harm, and the devil if recited during the night.
The night starts at sunset and ends at dawn.

so.title: Qofka akhriya labada Aayadood ee Suurada AlBaqara u dambeeya Habeenka way ku filan yihiin
so.text: Abii Mascuud Allaha ka raali ahaadee waxaa laga wariyey inuu yiri: Nabigu nabadgelyo iyo naxariis Allaha siiyee wuxuu yiri: "Qofka akhriya labada Aayadood ee Suurada AlBaqara u dambeeya Habeenka way ku filan yihiin".
so.explanation: Nabigu nabadgelyo iyo naxariis Allaha siiyee wuxuu sheegay in qofka akhriya labada Aayadood ee u dambeeya Suurada Albaqara Habeenkii Ilaahay wuuka kaafiyaa Sharka iyo Dhibaatada, waxaa kaloo la yiri: way ka kaafidaa Salaatul-laylka, waxaa kaloo la yiri: waxay ka kaafidaa adkaarta kale, waxaa kaloo la yiri: waa waxa ugu yar ee ay kaga gudmayso akhrinta Qur'aanka ee Salaatul-laylka, siyaabo kalana waa lagu fasiray, waxaa dhici kara inuu sax yahay dhamaan waxaa lagu fasiray oo dhan oo ay erayadu soo wada galaan.
hints: Xadiiska waxaa kucad fadliga weyn ee ku jira dhamaadka  suuratul Baqara, waana hadalkii ilaahay yiri:     (آمن الرسول) ilaa dhammaadka Suurada.
Dhamaadka Suurada Albaqara wuxuu ka difaacaa Qofka dhibka, Sharka, Shaydaanka, haduu akhriyo Habeenkii.
Habeenku wuxuu ka bilawdaa dhicida Qoraxda, wuxuuna ku dhamaadaa soo bixitaanka Fajarka.

ar.text: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رضي الله عنه عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ إِذَا أَصْبَحَ: «اللهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ» وَإِذَا أَمْسَى قَالَ: «بِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ» قَالَ: وَمَرَّةً أُخْرَى: «وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ».
ar.attribution: رواه أبو داود والترمذي والنسائي في الكبرى وابن ماجه

en.title: O Allah, by You we have reached the morning, and by You we have reached the evening; by You we live, and by You we die, and to You is the Resurrection
en.text: Abu Hurayrah (may Allah be pleased with him) reported that the Prophet (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him): Upon reaching the morning, he used to say: "O Allah, by You we have reached the morning, and by You we have reached the evening; by You we live, and by You we die, and to You is the Resurrection." Upon reaching the evening, he would say: "By You we have reached the evening, and by You we have reached the morning, by You we live, and by You we die, and to You is the resurrection." He said: And another time: "And to You is the final destination.".
en.explanation:
Upon reaching the morning, i.e., the early part of the day, with the break of dawn, the Prophet (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) used to say:

(O Allah, by You we have reached the morning) enjoying Your protection, overwhelmed with Your Favor, preoccupied with remembering You, seeking help with Your name, encompassed by Your guidance, and proceeding with Your might and strength. (And by You we have reached the evening, by You we live, and by You we die), i.e., like the previous wording along with reciting it in the evening saying: O Allah, by You we have reached the evening. So, by Your name, the Bestower of Life, we live, and by Your name, the Bringer of Death, we die. (And to You is the Resurrection), the return to life after death, and the separation after assembly. We continue like this at all times and in all situations, and I will never stop or leave it.

Upon reaching the evening, right after ‘Asr, he would say: (O Allah, by You we have reached the evening, and by You we have reached the morning, by You we live, and by You we die, and to You is the final destination), the return in this world, and the return in the Hereafter, as it is You Who give me life and it is You Who cause me to die.
en.attribution: Narrated by Abu Dāwūd, At-Tirmidhi, and An-Nasā’i in Al-Kubra and by Ibn Mājah
hints: It is recommended to recite this supplication in the morning and the evening following the example of the Prophet (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him).
The slave needs his Lord in all situations and at all times.

What is preferable in reciting the Adhkār (regular supplications) in the morning: from the break of dawn until sunrise in the early morning, and from the time after ‘Asr (afternoon) until just before sunset. If one happens to say them after such times, i.e., in the morning after the rise of Duha (forenoon), it will be sufficient for him, and if he says them after Zhuhr, it will be sufficient for him, and if he says them after Maghrib, it will be sufficient for him, as this is a time for making Dhikr.

His saying "And to You is the Resurrection" is suitable for the morning, as it reminds him of the major Resurrection when people die and are resurrected on the Day of Judgment. Similarly, it is a new return to life, a new day on which the souls are returned, people go in different directions, and this new morning that is created by Allah breathes to be a witness upon the son of Adam, and its times and periods act as a safe deposit to keep our deeds.

His saying "and to You is the final destination" is suitable for the evening, as it is the time when people return from their work and from going around seeking their interests and living. They return to their homes and resort to rest after being dispersed. This reminds one of returning to Allah Almighty, to Whom the return and the final destination will be.
